import R1Z.ProverCommitOwnerBytes42

/-! Stateful structural owner bridge. The primitive is the existing byte-blind
schedule/OS model; arbitrary full 64-byte draws remain on the tape. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitOwnerRun42
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1PublicNonce41
open ProverCommitOwnerZero42 ProverCommitOwnerBytes42
open ProverCommitLedger36
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
abbrev IOError := ProverCommitEnvironment35.IOError
abbrev NativeStatus := core.result.Result owner.Secret (owner.Error IOError)

def next (schedule : Schedule) (tape : Nat → owner.Raw) (s : State) :
    core.result.Result owner.Raw IOError × State :=
  let (result,after) := ask schedule .rng s
  match result with
  | .error e => (.Err e,after)
  | .ok _ => (.Ok (tape s.cursor),{after with cursor := s.cursor+1})

def io (schedule : Schedule) (tape : Nat → owner.Raw) : owner.IO Unit State IOError where
  fill s := ok (next schedule tape s)

def run (nonce : ProverCommitOwnerZero42.Bytes) (schedule : Schedule) (tape : Nat → owner.Raw) :
    Nat → State → NativeStatus × State
  | 0,s => (.Err .RepeatedZero,s)
  | n+1,s =>
    let (result,after) := next schedule tape s
    match result with
    | .Err e => (.Err (.Os e),after)
    | .Ok r => if block r.field = 0 ∨ block r.leaf = 0 then run nonce schedule tape n after
      else (.Ok ⟨nonce,r⟩,after)

theorem fuel_sub (fuel : U8) (positive : 0 < fuel.val) :
    (U8.wrapping_sub fuel 1#u8).val = fuel.val-1 := by
  rw [U8.wrapping_sub_val_eq]
  simp only [show (1#u8).val=1 from rfl]
  simp only [UScalar.size_def,UScalarTy.U8_numBits_eq]
  have bound := fuel.bv.isLt
  change fuel.val < 256 at bound
  omega

theorem run_exact (nonce : ProverCommitOwnerZero42.Bytes) (schedule : Schedule)
    (tape : Nat → owner.Raw) (n : Nat) (fuel : U8) (s : State) (count : fuel.val=n) :
    owner.run (io schedule tape) nonce fuel s = ok (run nonce schedule tape n s) := by
  induction n generalizing fuel s with
  | zero =>
    have zero : fuel=0#u8 := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq count
    subst fuel
    rw [owner.run]
    rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    have notzero : fuel ≠ 0#u8 := by intro h; subst fuel; change 0=n+1 at count; omega
    have positive : 0<fuel.val := by omega
    have tail := ih (U8.wrapping_sub fuel 1#u8)
    rw [owner.run]
    simp only [notzero,if_false,io,bind_tc_ok]
    rw [run]
    cases step : next schedule tape s with
    | mk result after =>
      cases result with
      | Err e => rfl
      | Ok r =>
        simp only [step,zero_block,bind_tc_ok]
        by_cases hf : block r.field=0
        · simp [hf,lift,bind_tc_ok]
          exact tail after (by rw [fuel_sub fuel positive]; omega)
        · simp [hf]
          by_cases hl : block r.leaf=0
          · simp [hl,lift,bind_tc_ok]
            exact tail after (by rw [fuel_sub fuel positive]; omega)
          · simp [hl]

def generate (nonce : ProverCommitOwnerZero42.Bytes) (schedule : Schedule)
    (tape : Nat → owner.Raw) (s : State) : NativeStatus × State :=
  if block nonce=0 then (.Err .RepeatedZero,s) else run nonce schedule tape 16 s

theorem generate_exact (nonce : ProverCommitOwnerZero42.Bytes) (schedule : Schedule)
    (tape : Nat → owner.Raw) (s : State) :
    owner.generate (io schedule tape) nonce s = ok (generate nonce schedule tape s) := by
  rw [owner.generate,zero_block]
  by_cases hz : block nonce=0
  · simp only [hz,decide_true,if_true,bind_tc_ok,generate]
  · simp only [hz,decide_false,Bool.false_eq_true,if_false,bind_tc_ok,generate]
    exact run_exact nonce schedule tape 16 16#u8 s rfl

#print axioms fuel_sub
#print axioms run_exact
#print axioms generate_exact
end R1Z.ProverCommitOwnerRun42

def byte (b : U8) : UInt8 := ⟨b.bv⟩

theorem byte_zero (b : U8) : byte b = 0 ↔ b = 0#u8 := by

  · intro h

  · intro h j; apply (byte_zero _).mp; exact congrFun h j
  · intro h; funext j; exact (byte_zero _).mpr (h j)

theorem zero_block (bytes : Bytes) : owner.zero bytes 0#u8 = ok (decide (block bytes = 0)) := by

    (∀ j, raw r j ≠ 0) ↔ block r.field ≠ 0 ∧ block r.leaf ≠ 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h; exact ⟨h 0,h 1⟩
  · rintro ⟨hf,hl⟩ j
    fin_cases j <;> assumption

/-! Symbolic byte-array zero test. No array value or seed carrier is enumerated. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitOwnerZero42
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1PublicNonce41
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
abbrev Bytes := Aeneas.Std.Array U8 32#usize

def getByte (bytes : Bytes) (j : Fin 32) : U8 :=
  bytes.val[j.val]'(by have := bytes.property; change bytes.val.length = 32 at this; omega)

def zeroFrom (bytes : Bytes) (index : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ j : Fin 32, index ≤ j.val → getByte bytes j = 0#u8

theorem next_index (i : U8) (bound : i.val < 32) :
    (U8.wrapping_add i 1#u8).val = i.val+1 := by
  rw [U8.wrapping_add_val_eq]
  simp only [UScalar.size_def,UScalarTy.U8_numBits_eq,show (1#u8).val=1 from rfl]
  change (i.val+1)%256 = i.val+1
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)

theorem zero_from (bytes : Bytes) (n : Nat) (index : U8)
    (count : index.val+n=32) :
    owner.zero bytes index = ok (decide (zeroFrom bytes index.val)) := by
  induction n generalizing index with
  | zero =>
    have stop : index >= 32#u8 := by change 32 ≤ index.val; omega
    have all : zeroFrom bytes index.val := by intro j hj; have := j.isLt; omega
    rw [owner.zero]
    simp only [stop,if_true,all,decide_true]
  | succ n ih =>
    have bound : index.val < 32 := by omega
    have go : ¬ index >= 32#u8 := by change ¬ 32 ≤ index.val; omega
    let pos : Usize := UScalar.cast .Usize index
    have pv : pos.val = index.val := by dsimp [pos]; scalar_tac
    have read := ProverCommitArrayIndex25.array_index_usize_ok bytes pos
      (by change pos.val < 32; omega)
    have elem : bytes.val[pos.val]'(by have := bytes.property; change bytes.val.length=32 at this; omega) =
        getByte bytes ⟨index.val,bound⟩ := by simp only [getByte,pv]
    have step := ih (U8.wrapping_add index 1#u8) (by rw [next_index index bound]; omega)
    have split : zeroFrom bytes index.val ↔
        getByte bytes ⟨index.val,bound⟩ = 0#u8 ∧ zeroFrom bytes (index.val+1) := by
      constructor
      · intro h; exact ⟨h _ (le_refl _),fun j hj => h j (by omega)⟩
      · rintro ⟨h,t⟩ j hj
        by_cases eq : j.val=index.val
        · have je : j = ⟨index.val,bound⟩ := Fin.ext eq
          simpa only [je] using h
        · exact t j (by omega)
    rw [owner.zero]
    simp only [go,if_false,lift,bind_tc_ok]
    change (do let b ← Aeneas.Std.Array.index_usize bytes pos
               if b != 0#u8 then ok false
               else owner.zero bytes (U8.wrapping_add index 1#u8)) = _
    rw [read]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok,elem]
    by_cases hz : getByte bytes ⟨index.val,bound⟩ = 0#u8
    · have allEq : zeroFrom bytes index.val ↔ zeroFrom bytes (index.val+1) := by simp only [split,hz,true_and]
      simp only [hz,bne_self_eq_false,Bool.false_eq_true,if_false,step,next_index index bound,allEq]
    · have notAll : ¬ zeroFrom bytes index.val := fun h => hz (h _ (le_refl _))
      simp [hz,notAll]

theorem zero_spec (bytes : Bytes) :
    owner.zero bytes 0#u8 = ok (decide (∀ j, getByte bytes j = 0#u8)) := by
  simpa only [zeroFrom,show (0#u8).val=0 from rfl,Nat.zero_le,forall_const] using
    zero_from bytes 32 0#u8 (by rfl)

#print axioms next_index
#print axioms zero_from
#print axioms zero_spec
end R1Z.ProverCommitOwnerZero42

import R1Z.ProverCommitPrivateMemo40

/-! Public, adversary-chosen nonce route. The owned model uses two raw seed
blocks, with the native zero guard and sixteen-candidate limit. This is not
an extraction certificate for generate_for_mask_nonce. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitPublicNonce40
open R0Z.FsStatement ProverCommitLedger36
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
abbrev Raw := Fin 2 → OracleAnswer
abbrev Private := {raw : Raw // ∀ i, raw i ≠ 0}
abbrev EntropyError := ProverCommitEntropy18.Error ProverCommitEnvironment35.IOError
abbrev Error := ProverCommitEnvironment35.Error

def decode (raw : Raw) : Option Private :=
  if good : ∀ i, raw i ≠ 0 then some ⟨raw,good⟩ else none

def next (schedule : Schedule) (tape : Nat → Raw) (s : State) :
    Except ProverCommitEnvironment35.IOError Raw × State :=
  let (result,after) := ask schedule .rng s
  match result with
  | .error e => (.error e,after)
  | .ok _ => (.ok (tape s.cursor),{after with cursor := s.cursor+1})

def run (schedule : Schedule) (tape : Nat → Raw) :
    Nat → State → Except EntropyError Private × State
  | 0, s => (.error .repeatedZero,s)
  | fuel+1, s =>
    let (result,after) := next schedule tape s
    match result with
    | .error e => (.error (.os e),after)
    | .ok raw =>
      match decode raw with
      | none => run schedule tape fuel after
      | some secret => (.ok secret,after)

/-- The nonce is checked before any RNG call; it is never sampled. -/
def generate (nonce : Path) (schedule : Schedule) (tape : Nat → Raw) (s : State) :
    Except EntropyError Private × State :=
  if nonce = 0 then (.error .repeatedZero,s) else run schedule tape 16 s

/-- E1 at the actual 64-byte successful OS-return carrier. This is the same
named environmental trust item, specialised to the actual API draw size. -/
def E1 {C : Type} (law : C → Raw → ℚ) : Prop :=
  ∀ context raw, law context raw = 1 / (Fintype.card Raw : ℚ)

def prepare (address : Path → Path) (nonce : Path) (schedule : Schedule)
    (tape : Nat → Raw) (unix : Bool) (s : State) : Except Error Private × State :=
  let (result,after) := generate nonce schedule tape s
  match result with
  | .error e => (.error (.entropy e),after)
  | .ok secret =>
    let (reserved,final) := reserve schedule unix (address nonce) after
    (reserved.map (fun _ => secret) |>.mapError ProverCommitEnvironment35.Error.reservation,final)

def withPrepared {W P : Type} (address : Path → Path) (nonce : Path)
    (schedule : Schedule) (tape : Nat → Raw) (unix : Bool) (s : State) (w : W)
    (continuation : W → Private → State → Except Error P × State) :
    Except Error P × State :=
  match prepare address nonce schedule tape unix s with
  | (.error e,after) => (.error e,after)
  | (.ok secret,after) => continuation w secret after

theorem zero_guard (schedule : Schedule) (tape : Nat → Raw) (s : State) :
    generate 0 schedule tape s = (.error .repeatedZero,s) := by simp [generate]

theorem decode_success (secret : Private) : decode secret.val = some secret := by
  simp only [decode,dif_pos secret.property]

theorem run_os_error (schedule : Schedule) (tape : Nat → Raw)
    (s after : State) (e : ProverCommitEnvironment35.IOError) (fuel : Nat)
    (failed : next schedule tape s = (.error e,after)) :
    run schedule tape (fuel+1) s = (.error (.os e),after) := by
  simp only [run,failed]

theorem run_success (schedule : Schedule) (tape : Nat → Raw)
    (s after : State) (secret : Private) (fuel : Nat)
    (drawn : next schedule tape s = (.ok secret.val,after)) :
    run schedule tape (fuel+1) s = (.ok secret,after) := by
  simp only [run,drawn,decode_success]

/-- The context may include all earlier adversary queries and their answers.
The nonce policy is unrestricted on that context. The same context, public
policy, private tape and ledger give exact prefix equality for all ledgers. -/
theorem adaptive_prefix {C : Type} (choose : C → Path) (c d : C) (same : c = d)
    (address : Path → Path) (schedule : Schedule) (tape : Nat → Raw)
    (unix : Bool) (s t : State) (shared : s = t) :
    prepare address (choose c) schedule tape unix s =
      prepare address (choose d) schedule tape unix t := by rw [same,shared]

theorem reservation_uses_public_nonce (address : Path → Path) (nonce : Path)
    (schedule : Schedule) (tape : Nat → Raw) (unix : Bool)
    (s after : State) (secret : Private)
    (generated : generate nonce schedule tape s = (.ok secret,after)) :
    prepare address nonce schedule tape unix s =
      let (result,final) := reserve schedule unix (address nonce) after
      (result.map (fun _ => secret) |>.mapError ProverCommitEnvironment35.Error.reservation,final) := by
  simp only [prepare,generated]

theorem duplicate_stops (address : Path → Path) (nonce : Path)
    (schedule : Schedule) (tape : Nat → Raw) (unix : Bool)
    (s after : State) (secret : Private)
    (generated : generate nonce schedule tape s = (.ok secret,after))
    (occupied : address nonce ∈ after.ledger) :
    (prepare address nonce schedule tape unix s).1 = .error (.reservation .duplicate) := by
  rw [reservation_uses_public_nonce address nonce schedule tape unix s after secret generated]
  have hit := duplicate_path schedule unix (address nonce) after occupied
  simp only [hit,Except.map,Except.mapError]

theorem fail_closed {W P : Type} (address : Path → Path) (nonce : Path)
    (schedule : Schedule) (tape : Nat → Raw) (unix : Bool)
    (s after : State) (e : Error)
    (failed : prepare address nonce schedule tape unix s = (.error e,after))
    (w : W) (real : W → Private → State → Except Error P × State)
    (ideal : Unit → Private → State → Except Error P × State) :
    withPrepared address nonce schedule tape unix s w real =
      withPrepared address nonce schedule tape unix s () ideal := by
  simp only [withPrepared,failed]

/-- Exactly the existing part-39 reservation coupling, now applied to an
arbitrary public nonce rather than a uniformly sampled nonce. -/
theorem public_reservation (address : Path → Path) (nonce : Path)
    (schedule : Schedule) (unix : Bool) (s t : State) (shared : s = t) :
    reserve schedule unix (address nonce) s = reserve schedule unix (address nonce) t :=
  ProverCommitLedgerCoupling39.same_reservation address schedule unix nonce s t shared

/-- Ordered public oracle observations retain repeats and memo hits. -/
def publicReads (rom : List UInt8 → OracleAnswer) (inputs : List (List UInt8)) :=
  inputs.map (fun a => (a,rom a))

theorem public_reads_preserved (real ideal : List UInt8 → OracleAnswer)
    (inputs : List (List UInt8)) (agree : ∀ a ∈ inputs, real a = ideal a) :
    publicReads real inputs = publicReads ideal inputs := by
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro a ha
  rw [agree a ha]

theorem memo_preserved (rom : List UInt8 → OracleAnswer)
    (a : List UInt8) (value : OracleAnswer) (memo : rom a = value) :
    publicReads rom [a,a] = [(a,value),(a,value)] := by simp [publicReads,memo]

#print axioms zero_guard
#print axioms decode_success
#print axioms run_os_error
#print axioms run_success
#print axioms adaptive_prefix
#print axioms reservation_uses_public_nonce
#print axioms duplicate_stops
#print axioms fail_closed
#print axioms public_reservation
#print axioms public_reads_preserved
#print axioms memo_preserved
end R1Z.ProverCommitPublicNonce40

namespace R1Z.ProverCommitLedgerCoupling39
open ProverCommitLedger36 ProverCommitEntropy18

  rw [shared]

entry is classified as a probabilistic privacy failure. -/

    (unix : Bool) (nonce : Path) (s : State)
    (collision : address nonce ∈
      (inject (schedule s.history.length .create s.history) s).ledger) :
    reserve schedule unix (address nonce) s =

        (createNew (address nonce) (schedule s.history.length .create s.history) s).2) := by

  simp only [reserve,hit]

theorem same_preparation (address : Path → Path) (schedule : Schedule)
    (tape : Nat → Candidate) (unix : Bool) (s t : State) (shared : s = t) :
    prepare address schedule tape unix s = prepare address schedule tape unix t := by
  rw [shared]

    (failed : prepare address schedule tape unix s =

    (w : Witness)
    (real : Witness → ProverCommitEnvironment35.Secret → State → Except ProverCommitEnvironment35.Error Proof × State)

      withPrepared address schedule tape unix s () ideal := by
  rw [fail_closed address schedule tape unix s after _ failed w real,
    fail_closed address schedule tape unix s after _ failed () ideal]

#print axioms same_reservation
#print axioms collision_duplicate
#print axioms same_preparation
#print axioms duplicate_fail_closed
end R1Z.ProverCommitLedgerCoupling39

chosen without private bytes. This component specifies membership/retention;
it does not certify the native SHA-256 address distribution or file contents. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitLedger36
open R0Z.FsStatement ProverCommitEntropy18 ProverCommitEnvironment35
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

abbrev Path := OracleAnswer
abbrev Ledger := List Path

structure Action where
  fault : Option Nat
  additions : List Path

/-- No nonce, address, ledger, payload, witness or successful RNG bytes are
arguments. The initial ledger is chosen separately, before the private tape. -/
abbrev Schedule := Nat → Kind → History → Action

structure State where
  history : History
  cursor : Nat
  ledger : Ledger

def inject (a : Action) (s : State) : State :=
  {s with ledger := s.ledger ++ a.additions}

def record (kind : Kind) (result : Outcome) (s : State) : Outcome × State :=
  (result, {s with history := s.history ++ [(kind,result)]})

def faultResult (a : Action) : Outcome :=
  match a.fault with
  | none => .ok ()
  | some e => .error (.other e)

def ask (schedule : Schedule) (kind : Kind) (s : State) : Outcome × State :=
  let a := schedule s.history.length kind s.history
  record kind (faultResult a) (inject a s)

/-- Membership is private, not a schedule decision. An occupied path always
returns AlreadyExists. A fresh path may fail before atomic creation. Entries
are never deleted, including on partial-write/fsync failures. -/
def createNew (path : Path) (a : Action) (s : State) : Outcome × State :=
  let t := inject a s
  if path ∈ t.ledger then record .create (.error .alreadyExists) t
  else match a.fault with
  | some e => record .create (.error (.other e)) t
  | none => record .create (.ok ()) {t with ledger := path :: t.ledger}

theorem alreadyExists_iff (path : Path) (a : Action) (s : State) :
    (createNew path a s).1 = .error .alreadyExists ↔ path ∈ (inject a s).ledger := by
  by_cases h : path ∈ (inject a s).ledger
  · simp [createNew,h,record]
  · cases hf : a.fault <;> simp [createNew,h,hf,record]

theorem create_preserves (path old : Path) (a : Action) (s : State)
    (present : old ∈ s.ledger) : old ∈ (createNew path a s).2.ledger := by
  have h : old ∈ (inject a s).ledger := List.mem_append_left _ present
  by_cases hp : path ∈ (inject a s).ledger
  · simpa [createNew,hp,record] using h
  · cases hf : a.fault <;> simp [createNew,hp,hf,record,h]

theorem created_present (path : Path) (a : Action) (s : State)
    (ok : (createNew path a s).1 = .ok ()) :
    path ∈ (createNew path a s).2.ledger := by
  by_cases hp : path ∈ (inject a s).ledger
  · simp [createNew,hp,record] at ok
  · cases hf : a.fault <;> simp_all [createNew,record]

def ioChain (schedule : Schedule) : List Kind → State → Outcome × State
  | [], s => (.ok (),s)
  | kind::rest, s =>
    let step := ask schedule kind s
    match step.1 with
    | .error e => (.error e,step.2)
    | .ok _ => ioChain schedule rest step.2

theorem chain_preserves (schedule : Schedule) (kinds : List Kind)
    (s : State) (path : Path) (present : path ∈ s.ledger) :
    path ∈ (ioChain schedule kinds s).2.ledger := by
  induction kinds generalizing s with
  | nil => exact present
  | cons kind rest ih =>
    have h : path ∈ (ask schedule kind s).2.ledger :=
      List.mem_append_left _ present
    cases he : (ask schedule kind s).1 with
    | error e => simp only [ioChain,he]; exact h
    | ok u => simp only [ioChain,he]; exact ih _ h

  let a := schedule s.history.length .create s.history

  | .error .alreadyExists => (.error .duplicate,step.2)
  | .error e => (.error (.io e),step.2)
  | .ok _ =>
    let (result,after) := ioChain schedule (writes unix) step.2

    (path : Path) (s : State)

      .error .alreadyExists := (alreadyExists_iff _ _ _).2

  | .error e => (.error e,after)

    Except ProverCommitEnvironment35.Error Secret × State :=

  | .error e => (.error (.entropy e),after)
  | .ok secret =>
    let (result,final) := reserve schedule unix (address (secret 0).val) after

def withPrepared {Witness Proof : Type} (address : Path → Path)
    (schedule : Schedule) (tape : Nat → Candidate) (unix : Bool) (s : State)
    (w : Witness) (continuation : Witness → Secret → State →
      Except ProverCommitEnvironment35.Error Proof × State) :
    Except ProverCommitEnvironment35.Error Proof × State :=
  match prepare address schedule tape unix s with
  | (.error e,after) => (.error e,after)
  | (.ok secret,after) => continuation w secret after

theorem fail_closed {Witness Proof : Type} (address : Path → Path)
    (schedule : Schedule) (tape : Nat → Candidate) (unix : Bool)
    (s after : State) (e : ProverCommitEnvironment35.Error)
    (failed : prepare address schedule tape unix s = (.error e,after))
    (w : Witness) (continuation : Witness → Secret → State →
      Except ProverCommitEnvironment35.Error Proof × State) :
    withPrepared address schedule tape unix s w continuation = (.error e,after) := by
  simp only [withPrepared,failed]

theorem failure_replay {Witness Proof : Type} (address : Path → Path)
    (schedule : Schedule) (tape : Nat → Candidate) (unix : Bool)
    (s after : State) (e : ProverCommitEnvironment35.Error)
    (failed : prepare address schedule tape unix s = (.error e,after))
    (w : Witness)
    (real : Witness → Secret → State → Except ProverCommitEnvironment35.Error Proof × State)
    (ideal : Unit → Secret → State → Except ProverCommitEnvironment35.Error Proof × State) :

/-- Named environment trust item E2. The native implementation must instantiate
this contract; this definition is not an axiom or a claim of that instance.

    (create : OS → Path → Outcome × OS)
    (stored : OS → Path → Data → Prop)
    (writtenFsynced : OS → Path → Data → OS → Prop)
    (persists : OS → OS → Prop) : Prop where

    (∀ q, present s q → present (create s p).2 q)

    stored t p data ∧ ∀ u, persists t u → stored u p data

#print axioms create_preserves
#print axioms created_present
#print axioms chain_preserves
#print axioms reservation_retained

theorem ask_blind (schedule : Schedule) (kind : Kind) (a b : State)
    (same : a.history = b.history) :
    (ask schedule kind a).1 = (ask schedule kind b).1 := by
  simp only [ask, same]

theorem ask_retains (schedule : Schedule) (kind : Kind) (s : State) :
    (ask schedule kind s).2.burned = s.burned ∧
    (ask schedule kind s).2.cursor = s.cursor := ⟨rfl,rfl⟩

def ioChain (schedule : Schedule) : List Kind → State → Outcome × State
  | [], s => (.ok (),s)
  | kind::rest, s =>
    let step := ask schedule kind s
    match step.1 with
    | .error e => (.error e,step.2)
    | .ok _ => ioChain schedule rest step.2

theorem chain_retains (schedule : Schedule) (kinds : List Kind) (s : State) :
    (ioChain schedule kinds s).2.burned = s.burned := by
  induction kinds generalizing s with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons kind rest ih =>
    cases h : (ask schedule kind s).1 with
    | error e => simp only [ioChain,h]; rfl
    | ok u =>
      simp only [ioChain,h]
      exact ih (ask schedule kind s).2

inductive ReservationError where
  | duplicate | io : IOError → ReservationError
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Unix directory open is a fallible primitive too; non-Unix matches the
source's no-op sync_directory branch. No file is removed on any branch. -/
def writes (unix : Bool) : List Kind :=
  [.writeMagic,.writeDigest,.writeNonce,.fileSync] ++
    if unix then [.directoryOpen,.directorySync] else []

def reserve (schedule : Schedule) (unix : Bool) (nonce : OracleAnswer)
    (s : State) : Except ReservationError Unit × State :=
  let step := ask schedule .create s
  match step.1 with
  | .error .alreadyExists => (.error .duplicate,step.2)
  | .error e => (.error (.io e),step.2)
  | .ok _ =>
    let retained := {step.2 with burned := nonce :: step.2.burned}
    let (result,final) := ioChain schedule (writes unix) retained
    (result.mapError ReservationError.io, final)

theorem create_retained (schedule : Schedule) (unix : Bool)
    (nonce : OracleAnswer) (s : State)
    (created : (ask schedule .create s).1 = .ok ()) :
    (reserve schedule unix nonce s).2.burned = nonce :: s.burned := by
  simp only [reserve,created]
  exact chain_retains schedule (writes unix) _

theorem create_failed (schedule : Schedule) (unix : Bool)
    (nonce : OracleAnswer) (s : State) (error : IOError)
    (failed : (ask schedule .create s).1 = .error error) :
    (reserve schedule unix nonce s).2.burned = s.burned := by
  cases error <;> simp only [reserve,failed] <;> rfl

/-- RNG call status is public to the scheduler; the successful bytes come
from a separate private tape, never from the schedule. -/
def next (schedule : Schedule) (tape : Nat → Candidate) (s : State) :
    Except IOError Candidate × State :=
  let (result,after) := ask schedule .rng s
  match result with
  | .error e => (.error e,after)
  | .ok _ => (.ok (tape s.cursor),{after with cursor := s.cursor+1})

/-- E1 specifies the law of each successful raw 96-byte RNG return,
conditional on arbitrary prior context, hence independent of that context.
Context must include the complete prior private and public execution state.
No availability or filesystem-success hypothesis is included. -/
def E1 {Context : Type} (okLaw : Context → Candidate → ℚ) : Prop :=
  ∀ context bytes, okLaw context bytes = 1 / (Fintype.card Candidate : ℚ)

inductive Error where
  | entropy : ProverCommitEntropy18.Error IOError → Error
  | reservation : ReservationError → Error

def prepare (schedule : Schedule) (tape : Nat → Candidate) (unix : Bool)
    (s : State) : Except Error Secret × State :=
  let (generated,after) := generate (next schedule tape) s
  match generated with
  | .error e => (.error (.entropy e),after)
  | .ok secret =>
    let (result,final) := reserve schedule unix (secret 0).val after
    (result.map (fun _ => secret) |>.mapError Error.reservation,final)

/-- Full internal state is passed into the successful continuation. A failed
environment step cannot call derivation or publication, for any witness. -/
def withPrepared {Witness Proof : Type} (schedule : Schedule)
    (tape : Nat → Candidate) (unix : Bool) (s : State) (w : Witness)
    (continuation : Witness → Secret → State → Except Error Proof × State) :
    Except Error Proof × State :=
  match prepare schedule tape unix s with
  | (.error error,after) => (.error error,after)
  | (.ok secret,after) => continuation w secret after

/-- D143/D147 view: success returns proof bytes; failure returns only its
error tag. Internal ledger, RNG bytes and call history are never projected. -/
def observable {Proof : Type} (result : Except Error Proof × State) := result.1

theorem fail_closed {Witness Proof : Type} (schedule : Schedule)
    (tape : Nat → Candidate) (unix : Bool) (s after : State) (e : Error)
    (failed : prepare schedule tape unix s = (.error e,after))
    (w : Witness)
    (continuation : Witness → Secret → State → Except Error Proof × State) :
    withPrepared schedule tape unix s w continuation = (.error e,after) := by
  simp only [withPrepared,failed]

/-- Same schedule and private coins couple the real environment prefix to a
witness-free simulator prefix. This is pointwise, for every failure schedule;
there is no OS/fs probability charge. E1 is needed only for the coins' law. -/
theorem failure_replay {Witness Proof : Type} (schedule : Schedule)
    (tape : Nat → Candidate) (unix : Bool) (s after : State) (e : Error)
    (failed : prepare schedule tape unix s = (.error e,after))
    (w : Witness)
    (real : Witness → Secret → State → Except Error Proof × State)
    (ideal : Unit → Secret → State → Except Error Proof × State) :
    observable (withPrepared schedule tape unix s w real) =
      observable (withPrepared schedule tape unix s () ideal) := by
  rw [fail_closed schedule tape unix s after e failed w real,
    fail_closed schedule tape unix s after e failed () ideal]

#print axioms ask_blind
#print axioms ask_retains
#print axioms chain_retains
#print axioms create_retained
#print axioms create_failed
#print axioms fail_closed
#print axioms failure_replay
end R1Z.ProverCommitEnvironment35

import R1Z.ProverCommitEntropyJoin18
import R1Z.ProverCommitEntropyStep19
import R1Z.ProverCommitEntropySymmetry18
import R1Z.CommitReadsR1
import R1Z.QueryScanSharedHistoryMass
/-! Explicit entropy bad events. No OS law or durable-store guarantee is
assumed. The numerical zero-draw bound below is for the stated uniform finite
raw carrier, not the OS. It conservatively uses the first rejected 96-byte
candidate, so no independence of later draws is needed for that upper bound. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitEntropy34
open R0Z R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsGood R0Z.HvzkV
open ProverCommitEntropy18 ProverCommitEntropyJoin18
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {State OsError R : Type}

def osBad (next : State → Except OsError Candidate × State) (initial : R → State)
    (r : R) : Prop := ∃ e, (generate next (initial r)).1 = .error (.os e)

def zeroBad (next : State → Except OsError Candidate × State) (initial : R → State)
    (r : R) : Prop := (generate next (initial r)).1 = .error .repeatedZero

def failed (next : State → Except OsError Candidate × State) (initial : R → State)
    (r : R) : Prop := ∃ e, (generate next (initial r)).1 = .error e

/-- These are exact masses of the specified runtime law; no numerical OS
availability assertion is smuggled into the uniform zero-draw result. -/
def osMass [Fintype R] (next : State → Except OsError Candidate × State)
    (initial : R → State) : ℚ := eventMass (osBad next initial)
def zeroMass [Fintype R] (next : State → Except OsError Candidate × State)
    (initial : R → State) : ℚ := eventMass (zeroBad next initial)

theorem bad_disjoint (next : State → Except OsError Candidate × State)
    (initial : R → State) (r : R) : ¬ (osBad next initial r ∧ zeroBad next initial r) := by
  rintro ⟨⟨e,he⟩,hz⟩
  unfold zeroBad at hz
  rw [he] at hz
  cases hz

theorem failure_mass [Fintype R] (next : State → Except OsError Candidate × State)
    (initial : R → State) :
    eventMass (failed next initial) = osMass next initial + zeroMass next initial := by
  unfold osMass zeroMass
  unfold eventMass
  rw [← R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mean_add'']
  congr 1
  funext r
  unfold failed osBad zeroBad
  cases hg : (generate next (initial r)).1 with
  | ok secret => simp
  | error e => cases e <;> simp

/-- An OS error on the first call has mass one under an all-failing OS law.
The source signature/control alone therefore gives no subunit OS bound. -/
theorem always_os_mass [Fintype R] [Nonempty R] (initial : R → State)
    (error : OsError) :
    osMass (fun s => (.error error,s)) initial = 1 := by
  unfold osMass osBad generate
  simp [run,eventMass,mean_const]

theorem no_universal_os_bound (δ : ℚ) (hδ : δ < 1) :
    ¬ ∀ next : Unit → Except Unit Candidate × Unit,
      osMass next (fun _ : Unit => ()) ≤ δ := by
  intro bound
  have h := bound (fun s => (.error (),s))
  rw [always_os_mass] at h
  exact (not_le_of_gt hδ) h

theorem decode_none_iff (raw : Candidate) :
    decode raw = none ↔ ∃ i, raw i = 0 := by
  unfold decode
  split
  next good =>
    simp only [Option.some_ne_none, false_iff, not_exists]
    exact good
  next bad =>
    simp only [true_iff]
    simpa only [not_forall,not_not] using bad

def zeroBudget : ℚ := 3 / (2 : ℚ)^256

/-- Each of the three 32-byte slices has point mass 2^-256 in this uniform
carrier. The union bound needs no independence between the three events. -/
theorem candidate_bad_mass : eventMass (fun raw : Candidate => decode raw = none) ≤ zeroBudget := by
  have h := R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass_exists_le_card
    (fun i : Fin 3 => fun raw : Candidate => raw i = 0) (1 / (2 : ℚ)^256)
    (fun i => by
      rw [CommitReadsR1.mass_coord (N := 3) (X := OracleAnswer) i
        (fun a : OracleAnswer => a = 0)]
      rw [R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass_point,QueryScanSharedHistoryMass.answer_cardinality,
        Nat.cast_pow,Nat.cast_ofNat])
  have equal : (fun raw : Candidate => decode raw = none) = fun raw => ∃ i, raw i = 0 :=
    funext fun raw => propext (decode_none_iff raw)
  rw [equal]
  simpa only [eventMass,R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass,Fintype.card_fin,Nat.cast_ofNat,
    zeroBudget,div_eq_mul_inv,one_mul] using h

theorem zero_failure_first (raw : RawRand)
    (hz : rawGenerate raw = .error .repeatedZero) : decode (raw 0) = none := by
  cases hd : decode (raw 0) with
  | none => rfl
  | some secret =>
    have erase := ProverCommitEntropySymmetry18.erase_of_decode (raw 0) secret hd
    have drawn : rawNext raw 0 = (.ok (fun i => (secret i).val),1) := by
      change ((Except.ok (raw 0) : Except Unit Candidate),(1 : Nat)) = _
      rw [← erase]
      rfl
    have hs := ProverCommitEntropy18.success (rawNext raw) 0 1 secret 15 drawn
    have hr : rawGenerate raw = .ok secret := congrArg Prod.fst hs
    rw [hr] at hz
    cases hz

/-- Sixteen-draw exhaustion is a subset of first-draw rejection. The actual
16-draw probability can be smaller; it is not silently set to zero. -/
theorem uniform_zero_mass :
    eventMass (fun raw : RawRand => rawGenerate raw = .error .repeatedZero) ≤ zeroBudget := by
  have sub := eventMass_mono
    (fun raw : RawRand => rawGenerate raw = .error .repeatedZero)
    (fun raw : RawRand => decode (raw 0) = none) zero_failure_first
  have coord : eventMass (fun raw : RawRand => decode (raw 0) = none) =
      eventMass (fun raw : Candidate => decode raw = none) := CommitReadsR1.mass_coord (N := 16) (X := Candidate) 0
        (fun r : Candidate => decode r = none)
  exact sub.trans (coord.trans_le candidate_bad_mass)

/-- Any specified per-attempt OS/zero masses admit this union bound, with no
independence assertion and no dropping rejected attempt histories. -/
theorem eight_failure_mass {M : Type} [Fintype M]
    (bad : Fin 8 → M → Prop) (δos δzero : ℚ)
    (per_attempt : ∀ i, eventMass (bad i) ≤ δos+δzero) :
    eventMass (fun m => ∃ i, bad i m) ≤ 8*(δos+δzero) := by
  simpa only [eventMass,R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass,Fintype.card_fin,Nat.cast_ofNat] using
    R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass_exists_le_card bad (δos+δzero) per_attempt

#print axioms bad_disjoint
#print axioms failure_mass
#print axioms always_os_mass
#print axioms no_universal_os_bound
#print axioms decode_none_iff
#print axioms candidate_bad_mass
#print axioms zero_failure_first
#print axioms uniform_zero_mass
#print axioms eight_failure_mass
end R1Z.ProverCommitEntropy34

import R1Z.ProverCommitEntropy18
import R0Z.FsAbort
/-! Necessary conditions on an entropy adapter, not a replacement for a
whole-run certificate. All events and laws are explicit. Positive failure
mass alone does NOT refute a join outside the existing fixed bad events. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitEntropyJoin18
open R0Z R0Z.FsGood R0Z.FsAbort R1Z.ProverCommitEntropy18
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-- Any visible failure absent from the model must lie within the nominated
bad event, with its full probability. This applies to every observation type. -/
theorem failure_mass_le_bad {R M Obs : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype M]
    (cp : Coupling R M) (runtime : R → Obs) (model : M → Obs)
    (bad : M → Prop) (failed : Obs → Prop)
    (agreement : ∀ s, ¬ bad (cp.toM s) → runtime (cp.toR s) = model (cp.toM s))
    (no_model_failure : ∀ m, ¬ failed (model m)) :
    eventMass (fun r => failed (runtime r)) ≤ eventMass bad := by
  unfold eventMass
  rw [← cp.meanR, ← cp.meanM]
  apply mean_le_mean
  intro s
  by_cases hb : bad (cp.toM s)
  · simp only [if_pos hb]
    split <;> norm_num
  · have hn : ¬ failed (runtime (cp.toR s)) := by
      rw [agreement s hb]
      exact no_model_failure _
    simp only [if_neg hb, if_neg hn, le_refl]

/-- Uniform finite draws give every possible failure trace positive mass.
The argument is symbolic and never enumerates a seed or trace space. -/
theorem eventMass_pos_of_witness {R : Type} [Fintype R] [Nonempty R]
    (event : R → Prop) (r : R) (hr : event r) : 0 < eventMass event := by
  unfold eventMass mean
  apply div_pos
  · have h : (1 : ℚ) ≤ ∑ x : R, if event x then (1 : ℚ) else 0 := by
      have one := Finset.single_le_sum (s := Finset.univ)
        (f := fun x : R => if event x then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
        (fun x _ => by split <;> norm_num) (Finset.mem_univ r)
      simpa only [if_pos hr] using one
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) h
  · exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos

abbrev RawRand := Fin 16 → Candidate

def rawNext (raw : RawRand) (cursor : Nat) : Except Unit Candidate × Nat :=
  (.ok (raw ⟨cursor % 16, Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)⟩), cursor+1)

def rawGenerate (raw : RawRand) : Except (Error Unit) R1Z.GamesR1PBin.SecP :=
  (generate (rawNext raw) 0).1

theorem zero_trace : rawGenerate (fun _ _ => 0) = .error .repeatedZero := by
  change (run (fun n : Nat =>
    ((.ok (fun _ => 0) : Except Unit Candidate), n+1)) 16 0).1 = _
  rw [zero_draws]

theorem raw_failure_positive :
    0 < eventMass (fun raw => rawGenerate raw = .error .repeatedZero) :=
  eventMass_pos_of_witness _ (fun _ _ => 0) zero_trace

/-- Consequently the unconditioned, bounded raw-draw sampler has no exact
coupling to an always-successful nonzero-secret carrier. A failure allowance,
conditioning, or an explicit transport bound is required at this component.
This says nothing about whether the fixed query-scan budget can absorb it. -/
theorem no_exact_success_coupling {M : Type} [Fintype M]
    (model : M → R1Z.GamesR1PBin.SecP) :
    ¬ ∃ cp : Coupling RawRand M,
      ∀ s, rawGenerate (cp.toR s) = Except.ok (model (cp.toM s)) := by
  rintro ⟨cp, agrees⟩
  have bound := failure_mass_le_bad cp rawGenerate (fun m => Except.ok (model m))
    (fun _ => False) (fun result => result = .error .repeatedZero)
    (fun s _ => agrees s) (fun _ => by intro h; cases h)
  have no_bad : eventMass (fun _ : M => False) = 0 := by
    simp only [eventMass, if_false, mean, Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_div]
  rw [no_bad] at bound
  exact (not_le_of_gt raw_failure_positive) bound

#print axioms failure_mass_le_bad
#print axioms eventMass_pos_of_witness
#print axioms zero_trace
#print axioms raw_failure_positive
#print axioms no_exact_success_coupling
end R1Z.ProverCommitEntropyJoin18

import R1Z.GamesR1PBin
/-! Source entropy adapter, before reservation and the eight-attempt loop.
This preserves the 16-draw rejection limit, OS failure and retained state.
It is not the full shipped FS experiment and assumes no OS probability law.
`Candidate` groups the source's consecutive 32-byte slices of its 96-byte draw.
The source/Lean translation remains a P6 component boundary. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitEntropy18
open R0Z.FsStatement R1Z.GamesR1PBin
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

abbrev Candidate := Fin 3 → OracleAnswer

def decode (raw : Candidate) : Option SecP :=
  if good : ∀ i, raw i ≠ 0 then some (fun i => ⟨raw i, good i⟩) else none

inductive Error (OsError : Type) where
  | os : OsError → Error OsError
  | repeatedZero : Error OsError
  deriving DecidableEq

/-- The draw state can retain the complete OS-call history. Only the next
96-byte draw is consumed; no input is inspected after success or OS error. -/
def run {State OsError : Type}
    (next : State → Except OsError Candidate × State) :
    Nat → State → Except (Error OsError) SecP × State
  | 0, state => (.error .repeatedZero, state)
  | fuel+1, state =>
    let (status, after) := next state
    match status with
    | .error e => (.error (.os e), after)
    | .ok raw =>
      match decode raw with
      | some secrets => (.ok secrets, after)
      | none => run next fuel after

def generate {State OsError : Type} (next : State → Except OsError Candidate × State)
    (state : State) : Except (Error OsError) SecP × State := run next 16 state

theorem decode_success (secrets : SecP) :
    decode (fun i => (secrets i).val) = some secrets := by
  simp only [decode, dif_pos (fun i => (secrets i).property)]

theorem decode_zero : decode (fun _ => 0) = none := by
  simp only [decode]
  split
  · next good => exact False.elim (good 0 rfl)
  · rfl

theorem os_error {State OsError : Type} (next : State → Except OsError Candidate × State)
    (state after : State) (error : OsError) (fuel : Nat)
    (failed : next state = (.error error, after)) :
    run next (fuel+1) state = (.error (.os error), after) := by
  simp only [run, failed]

theorem success {State OsError : Type} (next : State → Except OsError Candidate × State)
    (state after : State) (secrets : SecP) (fuel : Nat)
    (drawn : next state = (.ok (fun i => (secrets i).val), after)) :
    run next (fuel+1) state = (.ok secrets, after) := by
  simp only [run, drawn, decode_success]

/-- All-zero draws are a possible source input and consume the entire limit.
There is no deterministic replacement by nonzero secrets preserving status. -/
theorem zero_draws {State OsError : Type} (advance : State → State)
    (fuel : Nat) (state : State) :
    run (fun s => ((.ok (fun _ => 0) : Except OsError Candidate), advance s)) fuel state =
      (.error .repeatedZero, advance^[fuel] state) := by
  induction fuel generalizing state with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ fuel ih =>
    simp only [run, decode_zero]
    rw [ih, Function.iterate_succ_apply]

/-- A type-level adapter from successful generation is exact, but cannot be
extended to every source trace while preserving the actual error status. -/
theorem no_total_success_adapter {OsError : Type} :
    ¬ ∃ adapt : Except (Error OsError) SecP → SecP,
      ∀ result : Except (Error OsError) SecP, result = Except.ok (adapt result) := by
  rintro ⟨adapt, preserves⟩
  have impossible := preserves (Except.error Error.repeatedZero)
  cases impossible

/-- Changing any unused suffix of the draw stream has no effect on a
successful first draw, including the retained state at that boundary. -/
theorem success_ignores_suffix {State OsError : Type}
    (left right : State → Except OsError Candidate × State)
    (state after : State) (secrets : SecP) (fuel : Nat)
    (hl : left state = (.ok (fun i => (secrets i).val), after))
    (hr : right state = (.ok (fun i => (secrets i).val), after)) :
    run left (fuel+1) state = run right (fuel+1) state := by
  rw [success left state after secrets fuel hl, success right state after secrets fuel hr]

#print axioms decode_success
#print axioms decode_zero
#print axioms os_error
#print axioms success
#print axioms zero_draws
#print axioms no_total_success_adapter
#print axioms success_ignores_suffix

/-! Phase-indexed R1 games over the BINARY commitment trees (LOG D76; the
eight-way original is `R1Z.GamesR1P`, unchanged).  Only `NodeIdx` differs.

Phase-indexed R1 games (LOG D48.3, DESIGN-R1-REAL §1).

The landed `R1Prover.commit` returns all three roots before the transcript;
in Rust the C2 root depends on rows 0–1 (h1 = helper(λ, χ)) and the folded
root on rows ≤ 29 (fold(q, α0)).  Here the honest attempt is one CAUSAL READ
PROGRAM over `Pos1 = TRead ⊕ CPos`: the 115 transcript reads and the
commitment reads (three roots, the two expander streams, and `RIdx`: the two
binding reads, the three seed reads, the salts, leaves and non-root binary
nodes of the three trees), evaluated in the prover's order `ord` against the
oracle with partial answer vectors (`LazyFrozen.runC`).  Every address —
transcript or commitment — is computed from the answers read so far, so the
roots, the challenges `chOf W tr` and the tape are evaluated at the PARTIAL
vector; the C2 and folded roots therefore depend on the challenges before
them exactly as in Rust (R-causal, `RCausal`, makes this a fixpoint).

* `R1ProverP`: the commitment address map `caddr` (REF R-commit; its byte
  grammar is the named premise `RCommitBytes`, LayoutR1P), the leaf values,
  the mask decode `tapeOf` of the two expander streams (none = exhausted),
  the opened fibres, the verifier's opening list and the read order `ord`.
* `realGameP`: N attempts with independent secrets (nonce, field-mask
  entropy, leaf-salt seed, each a nonzero 32-byte value) against one oracle;
  the statement digest `H(public_bytes)` is read first; accept the first
  attempt with `P ∧ V ∧ ¬exhausted`; publish its view with the verifier log
  (115 transcript reads and the opening reads, answers `H(address)`), then
  the adversary's log; nothing of the other attempts.
* `fsR1P`: real = `realGameP`, ideal = the landed simulator game of `fsR1`;
  `abR1P = abR1` (the middle game and the ideal side are unchanged: the roots
  there are coins). -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.GamesR1PBin
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.Shift R0Z.FsGood R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.HvzkV R0Z.HvzkS
  R0Z.FsAbortBounds R1Z.Batched R1Z.ModelsVR1 R1Z.LensR1 R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.GamesR1
  R1Z.LazyFrozen
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-! ### Commitment read index sets -/

/-- Fibres of one tree: `FIBRE_COUNT = 2^18` (aspis-core r0/mod.rs). -/
abbrev Fib := Fin (2 ^ 18)

/-- Non-root binary nodes (format adopted in LOG D76): level `d+1` (`d < 17`)
has `2^(17−d)` nodes; the root (level 18) is a separate position, so with the
three roots each tree has `2^18 − 1` parents (`CommitReadsR1.card_nodes`). -/
abbrev NodeIdx := Σ d : Fin 17, Fin (2 ^ (17 - d.val))

/-- The private commitment reads other than roots and expander blocks:
binding reads (0: precommit binding of prover.rs, 1: pool-v1 attempt binding),
seed reads (0: mask seed, 1: source-mask seed, 2: D seed), and per tree
(0: C1, 1: C2, 2: folded) the salts, leaves and non-root nodes. -/
abbrev RIdx := Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 3 ⊕ (Fin 3 × Fib) ⊕ (Fin 3 × Fib) ⊕ (Fin 3 × NodeIdx)

/-- Commitment positions: the three roots, the two expander streams, `RIdx`. -/
abbrev CPos (E₁ E₂ : ℕ) := Fin 3 ⊕ (Fin E₁ ⊕ Fin E₂) ⊕ RIdx

/-- All reads of one attempt. -/
abbrev Pos1 (E₁ E₂ : ℕ) := TRead ⊕ CPos E₁ E₂

/-- Count levels, not concrete nodes: the sum has only seventeen terms. -/
theorem card_NodeIdx : Fintype.card NodeIdx = 262142 := by
  rw [Fintype.card_sigma]
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => 2 ^ (17 - i)) 17]
  norm_num [Finset.sum_range_succ]

/-- Includes both binding reads, which `CommitReadsR1.McR1` omits. -/
theorem card_Pos1 (E₁ E₂ : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (Pos1 E₁ E₂) = 2359413 + E₁ + E₂ := by
  simp only [Pos1, CPos, RIdx, Fib, Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_prod,
    Fintype.card_fin, card_NodeIdx, card_TRead]
  norm_num <;> omega

/-- A nonzero 32-byte secret. -/
abbrev NZ := {v : OracleAnswer // v ≠ 0}

/-- Attempt secrets (StateOnlyAttemptSecrets): 0 the mask nonce, 1 the
field-mask entropy, 2 the leaf-salt seed.  None is published. -/
abbrev SecP := Fin 3 → NZ

instance : Nonempty NZ := ⟨⟨fun _ => 1, fun h => by
  have := congrFun h 0
  exact absurd this (by decide)⟩⟩

/-! ### The phase-indexed prover -/

structure R1ProverP (K CommitHandle Aux : Type) [Field K] (F : Subfield K)
    (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) where
  E₁ : ℕ
  E₂ : ℕ
  /-- commitment-read addresses (REF R-commit) from the instance, the
  statement, the attempt secrets, the statement digest, the mask tape, the
  `RIdx` answers and the challenges -/
  caddr : (h : HonestProver K) → h.Instance → Statement K CommitHandle → SecP → OracleAnswer →
    Tape K F → (RIdx → OracleAnswer) → Challenges K → CPos E₁ E₂ → List UInt8
  /-- the committed column values at fibre `u` of tree `T` -/
  leafVal : (h : HonestProver K) → h.Instance → Statement K CommitHandle → Tape K F →
    Challenges K → Fin 3 → Fib → List UInt8
  /-- the mask decode of the two expander streams (none: MaskSampleExhausted) -/
  tapeOf : (Fin E₁ → OracleAnswer) → (Fin E₂ → OracleAnswer) → Option (Tape K F)
  /-- the opened fibres of each tree (QueryScan; folded tree `u / 4`) -/
  openFib : Challenges K → Fin 3 → Finset Fib
  /-- the verifier's opening reads, in its order -/
  openList : Challenges K → List (Fin 3 ⊕ RIdx)
  /-- the prover's read order of one attempt -/
  ord : Fin (Fintype.card (Pos1 E₁ E₂)) ≃ Pos1 E₁ E₂

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

def tape0 : Tape K F := (0, 0)

section Attempt
variable {E₁ E₂ : ℕ}

def trOf (v : Pos1 E₁ E₂ → OracleAnswer) : TRead → OracleAnswer := fun j => v (.inl j)
def rootsOf (v : Pos1 E₁ E₂ → OracleAnswer) : Fin 3 → OracleAnswer := fun i => v (.inr (.inl i))
def e₁Of (v : Pos1 E₁ E₂ → OracleAnswer) : Fin E₁ → OracleAnswer :=
  fun c => v (.inr (.inr (.inl (.inl c))))
def e₂Of (v : Pos1 E₁ E₂ → OracleAnswer) : Fin E₂ → OracleAnswer :=
  fun c => v (.inr (.inr (.inl (.inr c))))
def restOf (v : Pos1 E₁ E₂ → OracleAnswer) : RIdx → OracleAnswer := fun q => v (.inr (.inr (.inr q)))

/-- An opening position as a commitment position. -/
def cposOf : Fin 3 ⊕ RIdx → CPos E₁ E₂
  | .inl i => .inl i
  | .inr q => .inr (.inr q)

end Attempt

section Game
variable (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W)
include W Pr

/-- The mask tape decoded from an attempt's answers (default on exhaustion). -/
def tapeR (v : Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) : Tape K F :=
  (Pr.tapeOf (e₁Of v) (e₂Of v)).getD tape0

/-- The address of each read of one attempt, from its (partial) answer
vector `v`: transcript reads use the view at the challenges `chOf W (trOf v)`
and the roots `rootsOf v`; commitment reads use `caddr`. -/
def attAddr (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) (sec : SecP) (d : OracleAnswer)
    (v : Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) : Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ → List UInt8
  | .inl j => addr j (recP W x (view h B outputs x w (chOf W (trOf v)) (tapeR W Pr v)) (trOf v) (rootsOf v))
  | .inr c => Pr.caddr h w x sec d (tapeR W Pr v) (restOf v) (chOf W (trOf v)) c

abbrev n1 : ℕ := Fintype.card (Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂)

/-- Attempt `k`'s answers inside the global answer vector. -/
def attVec {N : ℕ} (V : Fin (N * n1 W Pr) → OracleAnswer) (k : Fin N) :
    Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer :=
  fun p => V (finProdFinEquiv (k, Pr.ord.symm p))

/-- The global read program of `N` attempts (attempt-major, each in `ord`). -/
def gAddr (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) {N : ℕ} (sec : Fin N → SecP)
    (d : OracleAnswer) (g : Fin (N * n1 W Pr)) (V : Fin (N * n1 W Pr) → OracleAnswer) : List UInt8 :=
  attAddr W Pr h B outputs x w (sec (finProdFinEquiv.symm g).1) d
    (attVec W Pr V (finProdFinEquiv.symm g).1) (Pr.ord (finProdFinEquiv.symm g).2)

/-- One attempt's published data from its answers (verifier recomputation). -/
def attOut (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) (H : List UInt8 → OracleAnswer) (sec : SecP)
    (d : OracleAnswer) (v : Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) : AttemptOut K CommitHandle Aux :=
  let ch := chOf W (trOf v)
  let τ := tapeR W Pr v
  let Vw := view h B outputs x w ch τ
  ⟨ch, Vw,
    schedule.map (fun j => (addr j (recP W x Vw (trOf v) (rootsOf v)),
      H (addr j (recP W x Vw (trOf v) (rootsOf v))))) ++
    (Pr.openList ch).map (fun c => (Pr.caddr h w x sec d τ (restOf v) ch (cposOf c),
      H (Pr.caddr h w x sec d τ (restOf v) ch (cposOf c)))),
    (Pr.tapeOf (e₁Of v) (e₂Of v)).isNone⟩

/-- The honest prover's attempts: the digest read, then the global read
program run in order against `H` (`runC`), then each attempt's output. -/
def realOut (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) {N : ℕ} (H : List UInt8 → OracleAnswer)
    (sec : Fin N → SecP) (k : Fin N) : AttemptOut K CommitHandle Aux :=
  attOut W Pr h B outputs x w H (sec k) (H (W.pubBytes x))
    (attVec W Pr (runC (gAddr W Pr h B outputs x w sec (H (W.pubBytes x))) H 0) k)

/-- The real game: accept the first attempt with `P ∧ V ∧ ¬ exhausted`. -/
def realGameP (N : ℕ) (P : Challenges K → Prop)
    (Vp : (h : HonestProver K) → Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop)
    (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux) (adv : R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) (r : W.Tab × (Fin N → SecP)) :
    ROMView K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat :=
  let H := W.look r.1
  let out := realOut W Pr h B outputs x w H r.2
  match firstGood (fun o : AttemptOut K CommitHandle Aux => P o.ch ∧ Vp h o.ch w ∧ o.exh = false) out with
  | none => ⟨W.failView, runLog (adv.prog W.failView []) H W.qmax⟩
  | some k => ⟨(out k).view, (out k).log ++ runLog (adv.prog (out k).view (out k).log) H W.qmax⟩

def fsR1P (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (P : Challenges K → Prop)
    (Vp : (h : HonestProver K) → Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) :
    FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat F where
  Adversary := R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux
  RealRand := W.Tab × (Fin N → SecP)
  IdealRand := (Fin N → R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) × (Fin N → Tape K F)
  real := fun h B outputs adv x w r => realGameP W Pr N P Vp h B outputs adv x w r
  ideal := fun sim adv x r =>
    retryOut N (fun c => P (drawW W c)) (fun c t => sim (drawW W c) t)
      (fun c k v => (abR1 W N hN).extend adv x c k v) (fun c => (abR1 W N hN).fail adv x c) r
  observe := fun adv rv => adv.decide rv

instance instRealFinP (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (P : Challenges K → Prop)
    (Vp : (h : HonestProver K) → Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) :
    Fintype (fsR1P (F := F) W Pr N hN P Vp).RealRand :=
  inferInstanceAs (Fintype (W.Tab × (Fin N → SecP)))

instance instRealNeP (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (P : Challenges K → Prop)
    (Vp : (h : HonestProver K) → Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) :
    Nonempty (fsR1P (F := F) W Pr N hN P Vp).RealRand :=
  inferInstanceAs (Nonempty (W.Tab × (Fin N → SecP)))

instance instIdealFinP (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (P : Challenges K → Prop)
    (Vp : (h : HonestProver K) → Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) :
    Fintype (fsR1P (F := F) W Pr N hN P Vp).IdealRand :=
  inferInstanceAs (Fintype ((Fin N → R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) × (Fin N → Tape K F)))

instance instIdealNeP (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (P : Challenges K → Prop)
    (Vp : (h : HonestProver K) → Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) :
    Nonempty (fsR1P (F := F) W Pr N hN P Vp).IdealRand := by
  haveI : Nonempty (Tape K F) := ⟨(0, 0)⟩
  exact inferInstanceAs (Nonempty ((Fin N → R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) × (Fin N → Tape K F)))

/-- The abort bridge of the phase-indexed games is the landed `abR1`. -/
abbrev abR1P (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) := abR1 W N hN

end Game
