/-! J0 (DESIGN-ii-prime §1.4, §1.5, §4; DESIGN-R1-PRIVACY-MODEL §3.5; LOG D24.1):
the validity restriction for clause (ii′).

* `HonestValid pub B t ch`: at the payload trace `u = actual pub B t ch 0`,
  every production lane vanishes on the Boolean rows and the two H1 helper
  sums (all rows, inactive rows) are zero.  It reads only the semantic layer,
  so it is the same for every batched block `Bat`.
* `HonestProver.restrict h V`: the prover on the instances satisfying `V`.
  `MaskImageOn`, `hvzk_on_of` and the FsAbort theorems are generic in the
  prover, so they apply verbatim to `h.restrict V` (corollaries below).
* `iota` (initial sum minus `.maskSum`) and `.inactiveSum` vanish on the
  whole tape image `A`; on `cTilde` they equal the Boolean sum of the original
  terminal and γ²⁶ times the inactive helper sum, and both are zero for a
  valid instance (`iota_cTilde_zero`, `inactive_cTilde_zero`).
* `not_iiPrime_witness`: two witnesses with different `iota (cTilde ·)` are
  never related by `range A` (the §1.4 obstruction, as an implication).

Builder completeness (honest builds are `HonestValid`) is J0b and is not
asserted here.  No row set is enumerated: the only concrete evaluation is the
membership of row 1023 in the inactive set, one entry of a 64-entry table. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R0Z.ZkStatement.HonestProver

/-- DESIGN-ii-prime §1.5: the prover restricted to the instances satisfying `V`. -/
def restrict {K : Type} (h : HonestProver K) (V : h.Instance → Prop) : HonestProver K :=
  ⟨{w // V w}, h.transport, fun w => h.public w.1, fun w => h.build w.1⟩

end R0Z.ZkStatement.HonestProver

namespace R0Z.HonestValid
open R0P R0P.Sumcheck R0P.SemSource R0P.SemDegree R0Z.MaskLayout R0Z.HonestView
  R0Z.Partition R0Z.D12 R0Z.Shift Polynomial

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
  {Bat : Type} [BatchedLayer K Bat]

/-! ### Row 1023 is copy-inactive (DESIGN-ii-prime P6) -/

/-- One entry of the 64-entry mask table: `copyActiveRowMasks 63 = 1749`,
whose bit 15 is clear. -/
theorem inactive_1023 : (1023 : Fin 1024) ∈ copyInactiveRows := by
  rw [R0Z.TerminalEligible.mem_inactive]
  have h63 : copyActiveRowMasks 63 = 1749 := by unfold copyActiveRowMasks; rfl
  change ¬ (copyActiveRowMasks 63).testBit 15 = true
  rw [h63]
  decide

attribute [local irreducible] copyLinks copyPatterns copyActiveRowMasks copyInactiveRows

/-! ### The validity predicate and the restricted prover -/

/-- DESIGN-ii-prime §1.5: validity of the payload trace `u = actual pub B t ch 0`
at the semantic challenges `λ = ch.sem 0`, `χ = ch.sem 1`. -/
def HonestValid (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K) : Prop :=
  (∀ i b, laneOf (PayloadSplit.actual pub B t ch 0) pub (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) B i b = 0) ∧
  (∑ r, PayloadSplit.actual pub B t ch 0 26 r = 0) ∧
  (∑ r ∈ copyInactiveRows, PayloadSplit.actual pub B t ch 0 26 r = 0)

/-- DESIGN-R1-PRIVACY-MODEL §3.5: valid for every challenge satisfying `P`. -/
def ValidOn (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) : h.Instance → Prop :=
  fun w => ∀ ch, P ch → HonestValid x.1 B (h.build w) ch

/-- DESIGN-ii-prime §1.5: clause (ii′) for valid witnesses. -/
def IIPrimeValid (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) : Prop :=
  ∀ ch, P ch → ∀ w w', h.public w = x.1 → h.public w' = x.1 →
    HonestValid x.1 B (h.build w) ch → HonestValid x.1 B (h.build w') ch →
    cTilde (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch - cTilde h B x w' ch ∈ LinearMap.range (A h.transport B ch)

section Restrict
variable (h : HonestProver K) (V : h.Instance → Prop)

theorem restrict_public (w : (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h V).Instance) :
    (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h V).public w = h.public w.1 := rfl

theorem restrict_build (w : (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h V).Instance) :
    (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h V).build w = h.build w.1 := rfl

theorem restrict_transport :
    (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h V).transport = h.transport := rfl

theorem sRem_restrict (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h V).Instance) (ch : Challenges K) (n : N K F) :
    sRem (Bat := Bat) (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h V) B x w ch n = sRem h B x w.1 ch n := rfl

theorem cTilde_restrict (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h V).Instance) (ch : Challenges K) :
    cTilde (Bat := Bat) (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h V) B x w ch = cTilde h B x w.1 ch := rfl

theorem inLanguage_restrict (x : Statement K CommitHandle) :
    JointView.InLanguage (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h V) x ↔ ∃ w, V w ∧ h.public w = x.1 :=
  ⟨fun ⟨w, hw⟩ => ⟨w.1, w.2, hw⟩, fun ⟨w, hv, hw⟩ => ⟨⟨w, hv⟩, hw⟩⟩

/-- `MaskImageOn` of the restricted prover, unfolded: both clauses on the
instances satisfying `V`. -/
theorem maskImageOn_restrict_iff (P : Challenges K → Prop) (B : PackBasis F)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) :
    MaskImageOn (Bat := Bat) P (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h V) B x ↔
      (∀ ch, P ch → ∀ w n, V w → h.public w = x.1 →
        sRem (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch n ∈ LinearMap.range ((A h.transport B ch).comp inlM)) ∧
      (∀ ch, P ch → ∀ w w', V w → V w' → h.public w = x.1 → h.public w' = x.1 →
        cTilde (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch - cTilde h B x w' ch ∈ LinearMap.range (A h.transport B ch)) :=
  ⟨fun hm => ⟨fun ch hP w n hv hw => hm.1 ch hP ⟨w, hv⟩ n hw,
      fun ch hP w w' hv hv' hw hw' => hm.2 ch hP ⟨w, hv⟩ ⟨w', hv'⟩ hw hw'⟩,
    fun hm => ⟨fun ch hP w n hw => hm.1 ch hP w.1 n w.2 hw,
      fun ch hP w w' hw hw' => hm.2 ch hP w.1 w'.1 w.2 w'.2 hw hw'⟩⟩

end Restrict

/-- DESIGN-ii-prime §2.5 composition: clause (i′) for all witnesses and the
valid form of (ii′) give `MaskImageOn` for the prover restricted to `ValidOn`. -/
theorem maskImageOn_restrict_of (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (hi : ∀ ch, P ch → ∀ w n, h.public w = x.1 →
      sRem (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch n ∈ LinearMap.range ((A h.transport B ch).comp inlM))
    (hii : IIPrimeValid (Bat := Bat) P h B x) :
    MaskImageOn (Bat := Bat) P (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h (ValidOn P h B x)) B x :=
  (maskImageOn_restrict_iff h (ValidOn P h B x) P B x).2
    ⟨fun ch hP w n _ hw => hi ch hP w n hw,
      fun ch hP w w' hv hv' hw hw' => hii ch hP w w' hw hw' (hv ch hP) (hv' ch hP)⟩

/-- `hvzk_on_of` applied verbatim to the restricted prover. -/
theorem hvzk_on_restrict [Fintype Bat] (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K)
    (V : h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux) (x : Statement K CommitHandle) :
    MaskImageOn (Bat := Bat) P (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h V) B x →
      HVZK_on (Bat := Bat) P (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h V) B outputs x :=
  hvzk_on_of P (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h V) B outputs x

/-- ZF1-abort Theorem A applied verbatim to the restricted prover. -/
theorem zkfs_restrict_abort [Fintype Bat] (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K)
    (V : h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FsStatement.FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    [Fintype fs.RealRand] [Nonempty fs.RealRand]
    [Fintype fs.IdealRand] [Nonempty fs.IdealRand]
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (ab : FsAbort.AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary) (ε_real ε_ideal : ℚ)
    (hm : MaskImageOn (Bat := Bat) P (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h V) B x)
    (hr : FsAbort.AbortReductionWith P (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h V) B outputs fs ab x
      ε_real ε_ideal) :
    FsStatement.ZK_FS (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h V) B outputs fs x (ε_real + ε_ideal) :=
  FsAbort.zkfs_of_hvzk_on_abort P _ B outputs fs x
    (hvzk_on_restrict P h V B outputs x hm) ab ε_real ε_ideal hr

/-- ZF1-abort Theorem B applied verbatim to the restricted prover. -/
theorem zkfs_restrict_abort_terms [Fintype Bat] (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K)
    (V : h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FsStatement.FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    [Fintype fs.RealRand] [Nonempty fs.RealRand]
    [Fintype fs.IdealRand] [Nonempty fs.IdealRand]
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (ab : FsAbort.AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary) (ε_hit ε_coll ε_prog : ℚ)
    (h0 : 0 ≤ ε_hit) (h1 : 0 ≤ ε_coll) (h2 : 0 ≤ ε_prog)
    (hm : MaskImageOn (Bat := Bat) P (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h V) B x)
    (hreal : FsAbort.RealAbortCoupling P (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h V) B outputs fs ab x
      ε_hit ε_coll)
    (hideal : FsAbort.IdealAbortCoupling P (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h V) B outputs fs ab x
      ε_prog) :
    FsStatement.ZK_FS (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h V) B outputs fs x
      (ε_hit + ε_coll + ε_prog) :=
  FsAbort.zkfs_of_hvzk_on_abort_terms P _ B outputs fs x
    (hvzk_on_restrict P h V B outputs x hm) ab ε_hit ε_coll ε_prog h0 h1 h2 hreal hideal

/-! ### The initial-sum functional ι -/

/-- DESIGN-ii-prime (O1): `ι v = p₀(0) + p₀(1) − v.maskSum`. -/
def iota : Payload K Bat →ₗ[K] K :=
  Chain.evalRound 0 0 + Chain.evalRound 0 1 - Shift.proj .maskSum

theorem iota_apply (v : Payload K Bat) :
    iota v = (Chain.roundPoly 0 v).eval 0 + (Chain.roundPoly 0 v).eval 1 - v .maskSum := by
  simp only [iota, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, Chain.evalRound_apply, Shift.proj_apply]

/-- ι vanishes on `L τ` for every trace (rounds_initial with maskLinear_vdeg). -/
theorem iota_L (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) (τ : Trace K) :
    iota (PayloadSplit.L (Bat := Bat) π B ch τ) = 0 := by
  rw [iota_apply, PureRounds.roundPoly_L, Chain.rounds_initial ch _ (maskLinear_vdeg π B τ),
    Chain.bsumB_eq_sum, PureRounds.L_maskSum]
  exact sub_self _

/-- ι vanishes on the whole tape image. -/
theorem iota_A (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) (t : T K F) :
    iota (A (Bat := Bat) π B ch t) = 0 := by
  have hA : A (Bat := Bat) π B ch t = PayloadSplit.L π B ch (JointTrace.tapeLinear B t) := rfl
  rw [hA]
  exact iota_L π B ch (JointTrace.tapeLinear B t)

theorem iota_originalRounds (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) (u : Trace K) :
    iota (PayloadSplit.roundInclusion (Bat := Bat) (PayloadSplit.originalRounds pub B ch u)) =
      bsumB 10 (fun b => fOrig pub B ch u (ofBool b)) := by
  have h0 : PayloadSplit.roundInclusion (Bat := Bat)
      (PayloadSplit.originalRounds pub B ch u) .maskSum = 0 := rfl
  rw [iota_apply, Chain.roundPoly_originalRounds, Chain.rounds_initial ch _ (vdeg_fOrig pub B ch u),
    h0, sub_zero]

theorem iota_dir : iota (dir : Payload K Bat) = 0 := by
  have hm : (dir : Payload K Bat) .maskSum = 0 := rfl
  have h09 : (0 : Fin 10) ≠ 9 := by decide
  simp only [iota_apply, Chain.roundPoly_dir, h09, ↓reduceIte, eval_zero, hm, add_zero, sub_zero]

/-! ### The zero-tape payload -/

/-- `c = L u + O u` at `u = actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch 0` (D12's `hc`). -/
theorem c_eq (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) :
    JointView.c (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch =
      PayloadSplit.L h.transport B ch (PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch 0) +
        PayloadSplit.O x.1 B ch (PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch 0) := by
  have hs : D12.payload (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch 0 =
      PayloadSplit.L h.transport B ch (PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch 0) +
        PayloadSplit.O x.1 B ch (PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch 0) :=
    PayloadSplit.run_split h.transport x.1 B (applyEligible (h.build w) (0 : T K F).2.2) ch
      (aff (0 : T K F))
  have hz : D12.payload (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch 0 = JointView.c h B x w ch :=
    congrArg (JointView.payload h B x w ch) (map_zero Partition.equiv)
  exact hz.symm.trans hs

theorem iota_c (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) :
    iota (JointView.c (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch) =
      bsumB 10 (fun b => fOrig x.1 B ch (PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch 0) (ofBool b)) := by
  rw [c_eq, map_add, iota_L, zero_add]
  exact iota_originalRounds x.1 B ch _

/-- DESIGN-ii-prime §1.4 (O1) on `cTilde`. -/
theorem iota_cTilde (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) :
    iota (cTilde (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch) =
      bsumB 10 (fun b => fOrig x.1 B ch (PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch 0) (ofBool b)) := by
  unfold cTilde
  rw [map_sub, map_smul, iota_dir, smul_zero, sub_zero]
  exact iota_c h B x w ch

/-! ### The Boolean sum of the original terminal at a valid trace -/

/-- The 14 pre-sumcheck challenges read from `ch.sem` (λ, χ, θ, zc, μ). -/
def preOf (ch : Challenges K) : Fin 14 → K := fun i => ch.sem ⟨i.val, by omega⟩

/-- `fOrig`'s terminal arguments are exactly `virtualPoly`'s at `preOf ch`. -/
theorem fOrig_eq_virtualPoly (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K)
    (u : Trace K) (a : Fin 10 → K) :
    fOrig pub B ch u a = ch.sem 14 * virtualPoly pub B u (preOf ch) a := rfl

theorem fOrig_ofBool (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) (u : Trace K)
    (h1 : ∀ i b, laneOf u pub (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) B i b = 0) (b : Fin 10 → Bool) :
    fOrig pub B ch u (ofBool b) = ch.sem 14 * (ch.sem 13 * u 26 (rowOf b) +
      ch.sem 13 ^ 2 * ((1 - copyActiveLiteral (copySelectors (rowSel (rowOf b)))) *
        u 26 (rowOf b))) := by
  rw [fOrig_eq_virtualPoly, honestRows pub B u (preOf ch) b]
  have hl : lanesComp (preOf ch 2) (laneOf u pub (preOf ch 0) (preOf ch 1) B) b = 0 := by
    unfold lanesComp
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => by
      rw [show laneOf u pub (preOf ch 0) (preOf ch 1) B i b = 0 from h1 i b, mul_zero])
  rw [hl, mul_zero, zero_add]
  rfl

/-- DESIGN-ii-prime §1.5: with the lanes zero and both helper sums zero, the
Boolean sum of the original terminal vanishes (honestRows, lane_h1_sum,
lane_inactive_sum). -/
theorem bsum_fOrig_zero_of (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) (u : Trace K)
    (h1 : ∀ i b, laneOf u pub (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) B i b = 0)
    (h2 : ∑ r, u 26 r = 0) (h3 : ∑ r ∈ copyInactiveRows, u 26 r = 0) :
    bsumB 10 (fun b => fOrig pub B ch u (ofBool b)) = 0 := by
  have hs : (fun b => fOrig pub B ch u (ofBool b)) = fun b => ch.sem 14 * (ch.sem 13 * u 26 (rowOf b) +
      ch.sem 13 ^ 2 * ((1 - copyActiveLiteral (copySelectors (rowSel (rowOf b)))) *
        u 26 (rowOf b))) := funext (fOrig_ofBool pub B ch u h1)
  rw [hs, bsumB_smul, bsumB_add, bsumB_smul, bsumB_smul, lane_h1_sum, lane_inactive_sum, h2, h3]
  simp only [mul_zero, add_zero]

theorem bsum_fOrig_zero (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K)
    (hv : HonestValid pub B t ch) :
    bsumB 10 (fun b => fOrig pub B ch (PayloadSplit.actual pub B t ch 0) (ofBool b)) = 0 :=
  bsum_fOrig_zero_of pub B ch _ hv.1 hv.2.1 hv.2.2

/-- DESIGN-ii-prime §1.5: ι vanishes on `cTilde` of a valid instance. -/
theorem iota_cTilde_zero (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) (hv : HonestValid x.1 B (h.build w) ch) :
    iota (cTilde (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch) = 0 :=
  (iota_cTilde h B x w ch).trans (bsum_fOrig_zero x.1 B (h.build w) ch hv)

/-! ### The inactive sum -/

theorem dot_indicator (v : Fin 1024 → K) :
    dotLinear (AspisR0.Opening.indicator copyInactiveRows) v = ∑ r ∈ copyInactiveRows, v r := by
  unfold dotLinear
  rw [LinearMap.sum_apply]
  simp only [LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply]
  have hi (i : Fin 1024) :
      (AspisR0.Opening.indicator copyInactiveRows i : K) • v i =
      if i ∈ copyInactiveRows then v i else 0 := by
    unfold AspisR0.Opening.indicator
    by_cases hm : i ∈ copyInactiveRows
    · simp only [hm, ↓reduceIte, one_smul]
    · simp only [hm, ↓reduceIte, zero_smul]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hi i), Finset.sum_ite_mem, Finset.univ_inter]

/-- If every lane of `τ` sums to zero over the inactive rows, so does `L τ`. -/
theorem inactive_L_zero (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K)
    (τ : Trace K) (hτ : ∀ l, ∑ r ∈ copyInactiveRows, τ l r = 0) :
    PayloadSplit.L (Bat := Bat) π B ch τ .inactiveSum = 0 := by
  rw [SilentReduction.L_inactiveSum, SilentReduction.linearPayload_inactiveSum]
  exact Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun l _ => by rw [dot_indicator, hτ l, mul_zero])

/-- Each semantic column of `applyEligible` is balanced over the inactive rows. -/
theorem applyEligible_inactive_sum (t : Trace K) (e : EligibleNoise K F) (l : Fin 29)
    (hl : l.val < 16) : ∑ r ∈ copyInactiveRows, applyEligible t e l r = 0 := by
  simp only [applyEligible, hl, ↓reduceIte]
  unfold balance
  exact SilentReduction.balance_sum_generic copyInactiveRows 1023 _ _ inactive_1023
    (fun s => t l s + semanticNoise (Sum.elim e 0) l s)

/-- Every lane of the eligible-noise trace is balanced over the inactive rows. -/
theorem eligible_inactive_sum (e : EligibleNoise K F) (l : Fin 29) :
    ∑ r ∈ copyInactiveRows, JointTrace.eligibleLinear e l r = 0 := by
  by_cases hl : l.val < 16
  · simp only [JointTrace.eligibleLinear_apply, hl, ↓reduceIte]
    unfold balance
    exact SilentReduction.balance_sum_generic copyInactiveRows 1023 _ _ inactive_1023
      (fun s => semanticNoise (Sum.elim e 0) l s)
  · simp only [JointTrace.eligibleLinear_apply, hl, ↓reduceIte, Finset.sum_const_zero]

/-- Every lane of the tape trace is balanced over the inactive rows. -/
theorem tape_inactive_sum (B : PackBasis F) (t : T K F) (l : Fin 29) :
    ∑ r ∈ copyInactiveRows, JointTrace.tapeLinear B t l r = 0 := by
  have he (r : Fin 1024) : JointTrace.tapeLinear B t l r =
      JointTrace.eligibleLinear t.2.2 l r + traceLinear B (aff t) l r := rfl
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun r _ => he r), Finset.sum_add_distrib, eligible_inactive_sum,
    SilentReduction.traceLinear_inactive_sum, add_zero]

/-- DESIGN-ii-prime §1.4 (O2): `.inactiveSum` vanishes on the whole tape image. -/
theorem inactive_A (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) (t : T K F) :
    A (Bat := Bat) π B ch t .inactiveSum = 0 := by
  have hA : A (Bat := Bat) π B ch t = PayloadSplit.L π B ch (JointTrace.tapeLinear B t) := rfl
  rw [hA]
  exact inactive_L_zero (Bat := Bat) π B ch (JointTrace.tapeLinear B t) (tape_inactive_sum B t)

/-- Every lane other than H1 of the payload trace is balanced over the inactive rows. -/
theorem actual_inactive_sum (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K)
    (l : Fin 29) (hl : l.val ≠ 26) :
    ∑ r ∈ copyInactiveRows, PayloadSplit.actual pub B t ch 0 l r = 0 := by
  have he : PayloadSplit.actual pub B t ch 0 =
      traceBase (prepare pub (applyEligible t (0 : T K F).2.2) ch) + traceLinear B (aff (0 : T K F)) :=
    applyAff_eq_base_add B (prepare pub (applyEligible t (0 : T K F).2.2) ch) (aff (0 : T K F))
  rw [he]
  simp only [Pi.add_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, SilentReduction.traceLinear_inactive_sum, add_zero]
  by_cases h16 : l.val < 16
  · have hb (r : Fin 1024) : traceBase (prepare pub (applyEligible t (0 : T K F).2.2) ch) l r =
        applyEligible t (0 : T K F).2.2 l r := by
      simp only [traceBase, prepare, h16, hl, true_or, ↓reduceIte]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun r _ => hb r)]
    exact applyEligible_inactive_sum t _ l h16
  · have hb (r : Fin 1024) : traceBase (prepare pub (applyEligible t (0 : T K F).2.2) ch) l r = 0 := by
      simp only [traceBase, h16, hl, or_self, ↓reduceIte]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun r _ => hb r), Finset.sum_const_zero]

theorem inactive_c (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) :
    JointView.c (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch .inactiveSum = ch.opening 0 ^ (26 : Fin 29).val *
      ∑ r ∈ copyInactiveRows, PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch 0 26 r := by
  have hO : PayloadSplit.O (Bat := Bat) x.1 B ch
      (PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch 0) .inactiveSum = 0 := rfl
  rw [c_eq, Pi.add_apply, hO, add_zero, SilentReduction.L_inactiveSum,
    SilentReduction.linearPayload_inactiveSum, Finset.sum_eq_single (26 : Fin 29)]
  · rw [dot_indicator]
  · intro l _ hl
    rw [dot_indicator, actual_inactive_sum _ _ _ _ l (fun he => hl (Fin.ext he)), mul_zero]
  · intro hn
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) hn

/-- DESIGN-ii-prime §1.4 (O2) on `cTilde`. -/
theorem inactive_cTilde (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) :
    cTilde (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch .inactiveSum = ch.opening 0 ^ (26 : Fin 29).val *
      ∑ r ∈ copyInactiveRows, PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch 0 26 r := by
  have hd : (dir : Payload K Bat) .inactiveSum = 0 := rfl
  unfold cTilde
  rw [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, hd, smul_zero, sub_zero]
  exact inactive_c h B x w ch

theorem inactive_cTilde_zero (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) (hv : HonestValid x.1 B (h.build w) ch) :
    cTilde (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch .inactiveSum = 0 := by
  rw [inactive_cTilde, hv.2.2, mul_zero]

/-- (R2)/(R3) of DESIGN-ii-prime §2.3 for the (★) difference of two valid witnesses. -/
theorem iota_inactive_diff_zero (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w w' : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K)
    (hv : HonestValid x.1 B (h.build w) ch) (hv' : HonestValid x.1 B (h.build w') ch) :
    iota (cTilde (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch - cTilde h B x w' ch) = 0 ∧
      (cTilde (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch - cTilde h B x w' ch : Payload K Bat) .inactiveSum = 0 := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [map_sub, iota_cTilde_zero h B x w ch hv, iota_cTilde_zero h B x w' ch hv', sub_zero]
  · rw [Pi.sub_apply, inactive_cTilde_zero h B x w ch hv, inactive_cTilde_zero h B x w' ch hv',
      sub_zero]

/-! ### The obstruction (DESIGN-ii-prime §1.4) -/

/-- Unequal ι-values are never related by the tape image: clause (ii′) without
a validity premise fails for any prover with two such instances. -/
theorem not_iiPrime_witness (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w w' : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K)
    (hne : iota (cTilde (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch) ≠ iota (cTilde (Bat := Bat) h B x w' ch)) :
    cTilde (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch - cTilde h B x w' ch ∉ LinearMap.range (A h.transport B ch) := by
  rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
  apply hne
  have h0 := iota_A (Bat := Bat) h.transport B ch t
  rw [ht, map_sub] at h0
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp h0

/-- The same for unequal inactive sums. -/
theorem not_iiPrime_inactive (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w w' : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K)
    (hne : cTilde (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch .inactiveSum ≠ cTilde (Bat := Bat) h B x w' ch .inactiveSum) :
    cTilde (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch - cTilde h B x w' ch ∉ LinearMap.range (A h.transport B ch) := by
  rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
  apply hne
  have h0 := inactive_A (Bat := Bat) h.transport B ch t
  rw [ht, Pi.sub_apply] at h0
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp h0

import R0Z.PureRounds

/-! J3 (T2b-2b design §2.1, §5; DESIGN-T2b-2b-Dprime §2.1, §6): the
structural reduction of `Chain0₄ ⊆ silent image` to the round cover (Q′) and
the batched condition (B).

* `exists_silent_of_cover` is payload-generic linear algebra over any ring.
* `ownMap`, `batMap`, `ia_pure_zero`, `ms_pure_eq_initial`, `QPrime`, `BCond`
  and `chain0K4_le_silent_of` are the R0 instantiation.  `BCond` is exactly
  the premise "B-open" of D23.2: `(ker own ⊓ ker R).map bat = (ker own).map bat`.
* `ownMap` keeps the direct observations `.pointClaim`, `.extraClaim`, `.ood`,
  `.opened` on all 29 columns; `batMap` reads the batched cells `.bat b`
  (for R0, `.openingCoeff` and `.finalCoeff`), valued in `Bat → K` (R1-0).

Nothing here asserts (Q′) or (B); both enter `chain0K4_le_silent_of` as
named hypotheses. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R0Z.SilentReduction
open R0P R0P.Sumcheck R0P.SemSource R0P.SemDegree R0Z.MaskLayout R0Z.HonestView
  R0Z.Partition R0Z.D12 R0Z.Shift R0Z.Chain R0Z.Z4Maps R0Z.PureRounds R0Z.K4 Polynomial
attribute [local irreducible] copyInactiveRows

/-! ### Generic reduction -/

/-- Design §2.1: (Q′) and (B) give every target vector as the round image of
a tape that is silent for `o` and `b`. -/
theorem exists_silent_of_cover {R V W₁ W₂ W₃ : Type*} [Ring R]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module R V] [AddCommGroup W₁] [Module R W₁]
    [AddCommGroup W₂] [Module R W₂] [AddCommGroup W₃] [Module R W₃]
    (Rm : V →ₗ[R] W₁) (o : V →ₗ[R] W₂) (b : V →ₗ[R] W₃) (T : Submodule R W₁)
    (hQ : T ≤ (LinearMap.ker o).map Rm)
    (hB : (LinearMap.ker o ⊓ LinearMap.ker Rm).map b = (LinearMap.ker o).map b) :
    T ≤ (LinearMap.ker o ⊓ LinearMap.ker b).map Rm := by
  intro t ht
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.1 (hQ ht)
  have hbx : b x ∈ (LinearMap.ker o).map b := Submodule.mem_map.2 ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  rw [← hB] at hbx
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyb⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.1 hbx
  obtain ⟨hyo, hyR⟩ := Submodule.mem_inf.1 hy
  refine Submodule.mem_map.2 ⟨x - y, Submodule.mem_inf.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, map_sub, LinearMap.mem_ker.1 hx, LinearMap.mem_ker.1 hyo, sub_zero]
  · rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, map_sub, hyb, sub_self]
  · rw [map_sub, LinearMap.mem_ker.1 hyR, sub_zero]

variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
  {Bat : Type} [BatchedLayer K Bat]

/-! ### Observation maps on the mask tape -/

/-- Keep the per-lane direct observations; zero every other cell. -/
def ownProj : Payload K Bat →ₗ[F] Payload K Bat :=
  LinearMap.pi fun coord => match coord with
  | .pointClaim j c => (LinearMap.proj (.pointClaim j c) : Payload K Bat →ₗ[F] K)
  | .extraClaim c => (LinearMap.proj (.extraClaim c) : Payload K Bat →ₗ[F] K)
  | .ood j c => (LinearMap.proj (.ood j c) : Payload K Bat →ₗ[F] K)
  | .opened q s c => (LinearMap.proj (.opened q s c) : Payload K Bat →ₗ[F] K)
  | _ => 0

/-- Read the batched opening cells (R1-0: replaces R0's `batProj`). -/
def batRead : Payload K Bat →ₗ[F] (Bat → K) :=
  LinearMap.pi fun b => (LinearMap.proj (PayloadCell.bat b) : Payload K Bat →ₗ[F] K)

/-- `own m`: claims, extra claims, OOD values and opened symbols of `A(inlM m)`. -/
def ownMap (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) :
    M K F →ₗ[F] Payload K Bat :=
  (ownProj (F := F)).comp ((A (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp inlM)

/-- `bat m`: the batched cells of `A(inlM m)` (for R0, `.openingCoeff` and
`.finalCoeff`). -/
def batMap (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) :
    M K F →ₗ[F] (Bat → K) :=
  (batRead (F := F)).comp ((A (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp inlM)

/-! ### The inactive sum vanishes on mask tapes (balance) -/

/-- Generic cancellation in `K`: the set and both decidability instances are
arguments, so they are unified from the goal rather than synthesized, and no
concrete row set is ever reduced. -/
theorem balance_sum_generic {ι : Type*} (S : Finset ι) (d : ι)
    (instE : DecidableEq ι) (instI : (r : ι) → Decidable (r = d)) (hd : d ∈ S) (g : ι → K) :
    ∑ r ∈ S, @ite K (r = d) (instI r) (-(∑ s ∈ @Finset.erase ι instE S d, g s)) (g r) = 0 := by
  letI : DecidableEq ι := instE
  rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase S _ hd]
  have he : ∑ r ∈ S.erase d, @ite K (r = d) (instI r) (-(∑ s ∈ S.erase d, g s)) (g r) =
      ∑ r ∈ S.erase d, g r :=
    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun r hr => if_neg (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hr))
  rw [if_pos rfl, he]
  exact neg_add_cancel _

/-- The same cancellation for a balanced family of linear maps, evaluated at a
point; instances again come from the goal. -/
theorem balance_apply_sum_generic {ι V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module F V]
    (S : Finset ι) (d : ι) (instE : DecidableEq ι) (instI : (r : ι) → Decidable (r = d))
    (hd : d ∈ S) (f : ι → V →ₗ[F] K) (p : V) :
    ∑ r ∈ S, (@ite (V →ₗ[F] K) (r = d) (instI r)
      (-(∑ s ∈ @Finset.erase ι instE S d, f s)) (f r)) p = 0 := by
  have e : ∀ r ∈ S, (@ite (V →ₗ[F] K) (r = d) (instI r)
      (-(∑ s ∈ @Finset.erase ι instE S d, f s)) (f r)) p =
      @ite K (r = d) (instI r) (-(∑ s ∈ @Finset.erase ι instE S d, f s p)) (f r p) := by
    intro r _
    by_cases h : r = d
    · rw [if_pos h, if_pos h, LinearMap.neg_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply]
    · rw [if_neg h, if_neg h]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl e]
  exact balance_sum_generic S d instE instI hd (fun r => f r p)

/-- A balanced family sums to zero over the inactive rows, at every tape. -/
theorem balanceAff_sum_apply (f : Fin 1024 → AffTape K F →ₗ[F] K) (p : AffTape K F) :
    ∑ r ∈ copyInactiveRows, balanceAff 0 f r p = 0 := by
  have h0 : (0 : Fin 1024) ∈ copyInactiveRows :=
    (R0Z.TerminalEligible.mem_inactive 0).2 R0Z.TerminalEligible.zero_inactive
  unfold balanceAff
  exact balance_apply_sum_generic copyInactiveRows 0 _ _ h0 f p

/-- Every column of the affine trace part sums to zero over the inactive rows. -/
theorem traceLinear_inactive_sum (B : PackBasis F) (p : AffTape K F) (c : Fin 29) :
    ∑ r ∈ copyInactiveRows, traceLinear B p c r = 0 := by
  simp only [traceLinear, LinearMap.pi_apply]
  by_cases h1 : c.val < 16
  · simp only [h1, ↓reduceIte, LinearMap.zero_apply, Finset.sum_const_zero]
  · by_cases h2 : c.val < 26
    · simp only [h1, h2, ↓reduceIte, ↓reduceDIte]
      exact balanceAff_sum_apply _ p
    · by_cases h3 : c.val = 26
      · simp only [h1, h2, ↓reduceIte, ↓reduceDIte, if_pos h3]
        exact balanceAff_sum_apply _ p
      · by_cases h4 : c.val = 27
        · simp only [h1, h2, ↓reduceIte, ↓reduceDIte, if_neg h3, if_pos h4]
          exact balanceAff_sum_apply _ p
        · simp only [h1, h2, ↓reduceIte, ↓reduceDIte, if_neg h3, if_neg h4]
          exact balanceAff_sum_apply _ p

theorem pureTrace_inactive_dot (B : PackBasis F) (m : M K F) (c : Fin 29) :
    dotLinear (AspisR0.Opening.indicator copyInactiveRows) (pureTrace B m c) = 0 := by
  unfold dotLinear
  rw [LinearMap.sum_apply]
  simp only [LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply]
  have hi (i : Fin 1024) :
      (AspisR0.Opening.indicator copyInactiveRows i : K) • pureTrace B m c i =
      if i ∈ copyInactiveRows then pureTrace B m c i else 0 := by
    unfold AspisR0.Opening.indicator
    by_cases h : i ∈ copyInactiveRows
    · simp only [h, ↓reduceIte, one_smul]
    · simp only [h, ↓reduceIte, zero_smul]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hi i), Finset.sum_ite_mem, Finset.univ_inter]
  exact traceLinear_inactive_sum B (pureAff m) c

/-- `L` at `.inactiveSum` is the linear payload there (one definitional step;
`L` itself is not unfolded by `simp`, whose `.maskSum` branch sums over the
Boolean cube). -/
theorem L_inactiveSum (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K)
    (t : Trace K) :
    PayloadSplit.L (Bat := Bat) π B ch t .inactiveSum = linearPayload (Bat := Bat) π ch t .inactiveSum := rfl

section LRead
/- As in Shift.LRead: keep the large readers opaque while `simp` reduces the
payload match. -/
attribute [local irreducible] copyLinks copyPatterns copyActiveRowMasks
  claimsLinear extraLinear dotLinear honestClaims batchLinear

theorem linearPayload_inactiveSum (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K)
    (t : Trace K) :
    linearPayload (Bat := Bat) π ch t .inactiveSum = ∑ c : Fin 29, ch.opening 0 ^ c.val *
      dotLinear (AspisR0.Opening.indicator copyInactiveRows) (t c) := by
  simp only [linearPayload, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, smul_eq_mul]

end LRead

/-- Design §2.2.1: `.inactiveSum` is identically zero on mask tapes. -/
theorem ia_pure_zero (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K)
    (m : M K F) : (A (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp inlM m .inactiveSum = 0 := by
  rw [A_pure, L_inactiveSum, linearPayload_inactiveSum]
  exact Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun c _ => by rw [pureTrace_inactive_dot, mul_zero])

/-- `.maskSum` on a mask tape is the initial sum `p₀(0) + p₀(1)` of its rounds. -/
theorem ms_pure_eq_initial (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K)
    (m : M K F) :
    (A (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp inlM m .maskSum =
      (roundPoly 0 ((A (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp inlM m)).eval 0 +
        (roundPoly 0 ((A (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp inlM m)).eval 1 := by
  rw [A_pure, roundPoly_L, rounds_initial ch _ (maskLinear_vdeg _ B _), bsumB_eq_sum,
    L_maskSum]
  try rfl

/-! ### Target spaces -/

/-- Round vectors with the nine chain equalities and terminal `p₉(α₉) = 0`;
the initial sum is free (design §2.1, `Chain_T0`). -/
def ChainT0 (ch : Challenges K) : Submodule K (PayloadSplit.RoundPayload K) :=
  ((⨅ j : Fin 9, LinearMap.ker
      (evalRound j.succ 0 + evalRound j.succ 1 - evalRound j.castSucc (alpha ch j.castSucc))) ⊓
    LinearMap.ker (evalRound 9 (alpha ch 9))).comap (PayloadSplit.roundInclusion (Bat := Bat))

theorem mem_chainT0_iff (ch : Challenges K) (t : PayloadSplit.RoundPayload K) :
    t ∈ ChainT0 (Bat := Bat) ch ↔
      (∀ j : Fin 9, (roundPoly j.succ (PayloadSplit.roundInclusion (Bat := Bat) t)).eval 0 +
          (roundPoly j.succ (PayloadSplit.roundInclusion (Bat := Bat) t)).eval 1 =
        (roundPoly j.castSucc (PayloadSplit.roundInclusion (Bat := Bat) t)).eval (alpha ch j.castSucc)) ∧
      (roundPoly 9 (PayloadSplit.roundInclusion (Bat := Bat) t)).eval (alpha ch 9) = 0 := by
  simp only [ChainT0, Submodule.mem_comap, Submodule.mem_inf, Submodule.mem_iInf,
    LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply, evalRound_apply, sub_eq_zero]

/-- Round vectors with every coefficient in `K₄`. -/
def K4Round (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) : Submodule F (PayloadSplit.RoundPayload K) :=
  ⨅ j : Fin 10, ⨅ i : Fin 28, (K4F B hB).comap
    ((LinearMap.proj i : (Fin 28 → K) →ₗ[F] K).comp
      (LinearMap.proj j : PayloadSplit.RoundPayload K →ₗ[F] (Fin 28 → K)))

theorem mem_K4Round_iff (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) (t : PayloadSplit.RoundPayload K) :
    t ∈ K4Round B hB ↔ ∀ j i, t j i ∈ K4 B hB := by
  simp only [K4Round, Submodule.mem_iInf, Submodule.mem_comap, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    LinearMap.proj_apply, mem_K4F]

/-- `Chain_T0₄`: K₄-valued `Chain_T0` (F-dimension 1,080 on Z8c's vectors). -/
def ChainT0K4 (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) (ch : Challenges K) :
    Submodule F (PayloadSplit.RoundPayload K) :=
  (ChainT0 (Bat := Bat) ch).restrictScalars F ⊓ K4Round B hB

/-- Payload vectors with every cell in `K₄`. -/
def K4Payload (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) : Submodule F (Payload K Bat) :=
  ⨅ cell : PayloadCell Bat, (K4F B hB).comap (LinearMap.proj cell : Payload K Bat →ₗ[F] K)

/-- Design §1.3: `Chain0₄ = Chain0 ∩ K₄`-valued cells. -/
def Chain0K4 (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) (ch : Challenges K) :
    Submodule F (Payload K Bat) :=
  (Chain0 ch).restrictScalars F ⊓ K4Payload B hB

theorem mem_chain0K4_iff (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) (ch : Challenges K)
    (v : Payload K Bat) : v ∈ Chain0K4 B hB ch ↔ v ∈ Chain0 ch ∧ ∀ cell, v cell ∈ K4 B hB := by
  simp only [Chain0K4, K4Payload, Submodule.mem_inf, Submodule.restrictScalars_mem,
    Submodule.mem_iInf, Submodule.mem_comap, LinearMap.proj_apply, mem_K4F]

/-! ### The two premises -/

/-- (Q′), design §2.1: every `Chain_T0₄` vector is the round image of an
own-silent mask tape. -/
def QPrime (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B)
    (ch : Challenges K) : Prop :=
  ChainT0K4 (Bat := Bat) B hB ch ≤
    (LinearMap.ker (ownMap (Bat := Bat) π B ch)).map (roundMaskMap (Bat := Bat) π B ch)

/-- (B), DESIGN-T2b-2b-Dprime §2.1 / LOG D23.2 ("B-open"): the batched
coordinates reach on own-silent round-kernel tapes what they reach on all
own-silent tapes. -/
def BCond (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) : Prop :=
  (LinearMap.ker (ownMap (Bat := Bat) π B ch) ⊓ LinearMap.ker (roundMaskMap (Bat := Bat) π B ch)).map
      (batMap (Bat := Bat) π B ch) =
    (LinearMap.ker (ownMap (Bat := Bat) π B ch)).map (batMap (Bat := Bat) π B ch)

/-! ### The reduction -/

/-- Two payloads with the same non-round cells and the same round cells agree. -/
theorem payload_ext {v w : Payload K Bat} (h1 : nonRound (F := F) v = nonRound (F := F) w)
    (h2 : roundProjection (F := F) v = roundProjection (F := F) w) : v = w := by
  funext cell
  cases cell with
  | semanticCoeff j i => exact congrFun (congrFun h2 j) i
  | maskSum => exact congrFun h1 .maskSum
  | pointClaim j c => exact congrFun h1 (.pointClaim j c)
  | extraClaim c => exact congrFun h1 (.extraClaim c)
  | ood j c => exact congrFun h1 (.ood j c)
  | inactiveSum => exact congrFun h1 .inactiveSum
  | opened q s c => exact congrFun h1 (.opened q s c)
  | bat b => exact congrFun h1 (.bat b)

theorem roundPoly_eq_of_roundProjection {v w : Payload K Bat}
    (h : roundProjection (F := F) v = roundProjection (F := F) w) (j : Fin 10) :
    roundPoly j v = roundPoly j w := by
  rw [Chain.roundPoly_apply, Chain.roundPoly_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
  have hji : v (.semanticCoeff j i) = w (.semanticCoeff j i) := congrFun (congrFun h j) i
  rw [hji]

/-- A mask tape with zero own, zero batched cells and zero initial round sum
is silent. -/
theorem mem_silentMasks_of (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K)
    (m : M K F) (hown : ownMap (Bat := Bat) π B ch m = 0) (hbat : batMap (Bat := Bat) π B ch m = 0)
    (hinit : (roundPoly 0 ((A (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp inlM m)).eval 0 +
        (roundPoly 0 ((A (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp inlM m)).eval 1 = 0) :
    m ∈ silentMasks (Bat := Bat) π B ch := by
  show nonRound (F := F) ((A (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp inlM m) = 0
  funext cell
  cases cell with
  | semanticCoeff j i => rfl
  | maskSum =>
    change (A (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp inlM m .maskSum = 0
    rw [ms_pure_eq_initial]
    exact hinit
  | pointClaim j c =>
    simpa only [ownMap, ownProj, batMap, batRead, nonRound, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, Pi.zero_apply] using congrFun hown (.pointClaim j c)
  | extraClaim c =>
    simpa only [ownMap, ownProj, batMap, batRead, nonRound, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, Pi.zero_apply] using congrFun hown (.extraClaim c)
  | ood j c =>
    simpa only [ownMap, ownProj, batMap, batRead, nonRound, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, Pi.zero_apply] using congrFun hown (.ood j c)
  | inactiveSum =>
    simpa only [nonRound, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply,
      Pi.zero_apply] using ia_pure_zero π B ch m
  | opened q s c =>
    simpa only [ownMap, ownProj, batMap, batRead, nonRound, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, Pi.zero_apply] using congrFun hown (.opened q s c)
  | bat b =>
    simpa only [ownMap, ownProj, batMap, batRead, nonRound, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, Pi.zero_apply] using congrFun hbat b

/-- Design §2.1 / D23: (Q′) and (B) give `Chain0₄ ⊆ A(inlM(silentMasks))`. -/
theorem chain0K4_le_silent_of (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F)
    (hB : PackField B) (ch : Challenges K)
    (hQ : QPrime (Bat := Bat) π B hB ch) (hBc : BCond (Bat := Bat) π B ch) :
    Chain0K4 (Bat := Bat) B hB ch ≤ (silentMasks (Bat := Bat) π B ch).map ((A (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp inlM) := by
  intro v hv
  obtain ⟨hvC, hvK⟩ := (mem_chain0K4_iff B hB ch v).1 hv
  obtain ⟨hnr, hinit, hchain, hterm⟩ := (mem_chain0_iff (F := F) ch v).1 hvC
  let t : PayloadSplit.RoundPayload K := roundProjection (F := F) v
  have hvt : PayloadSplit.roundInclusion t = v := by
    apply payload_ext (F := F)
    · rw [hnr]
      exact nonRound_roundInclusion (F := F) t
    · rfl
  have ht : t ∈ ChainT0K4 (Bat := Bat) B hB ch := by
    refine Submodule.mem_inf.2 ⟨?_, (mem_K4Round_iff B hB t).2 (fun j i => hvK _)⟩
    rw [Submodule.restrictScalars_mem, mem_chainT0_iff, hvt]
    exact ⟨hchain, hterm⟩
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hRm⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.1
    (exists_silent_of_cover (roundMaskMap (Bat := Bat) π B ch) (ownMap (Bat := Bat) π B ch)
      (batMap (Bat := Bat) π B ch) _ hQ hBc ht)
  obtain ⟨hown, hbat⟩ := Submodule.mem_inf.1 hm
  have hproj : roundProjection (F := F) ((A (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp inlM m) = roundProjection (F := F) v :=
    hRm
  have hsil : m ∈ silentMasks (Bat := Bat) π B ch := by
    refine mem_silentMasks_of π B ch m (LinearMap.mem_ker.1 hown) (LinearMap.mem_ker.1 hbat) ?_
    rw [roundPoly_eq_of_roundProjection hproj 0]
    exact hinit
  refine Submodule.mem_map.2 ⟨m, hsil, ?_⟩
  apply payload_ext (F := F)
  · rw [hnr]
    exact hsil
  · exact hproj

/-! J1 (T2b-2b design §1.1, §1.2, §5): the packing subfields `K₂ = F(i)` and
`K₄ = F(i, u)`, the prefix spans `Λ_j`, the quadratic-subfield lemma, and
`Good₃ → Λ_j = K₄` for `j ≥ 4`.

Payload-generic part: everything up to `lambda4_eq_K4` uses only a finite field
`K`, a subfield `F`, a packing basis and the closure premise `PackField`.  The
only protocol objects are `eqPrefix` (the multilinear prefix weight of
PureRounds) and, in `Good3`, the R0 challenge record (`alpha`, `sem`, `Good`).
No concrete row set is enumerated; `Λ_j` is a span over the symbolic range of
`eqPrefix`, and every row used below is built as `rowOf` of an updated bit
vector. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R0Z.K4
open R0P R0P.SemDegree R0Z.HonestView

section Field
variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] {F : Subfield K}

/-! ### The closure premise and the two subfields -/

/-- The packing basis spans a field: `i² ∈ F` and `u² ∈ F + F·i`.  For the
QM31 tower `i² = −1`, `u² = 2 + i`; a refinement fact of the concrete basis. -/
def PackField (B : PackBasis F) : Prop :=
  B.i * B.i ∈ F ∧ ∃ a b : K, a ∈ F ∧ b ∈ F ∧ B.u * B.u = a + B.i * b

/-- Scalar action of the base subfield is multiplication. -/
theorem fsmul_eq (c : F) (x : K) : c • x = (c : K) * x := rfl

/-- In a finite field every subring is closed under inversion. -/
theorem inv_mem_of_subring (S : Subring K) {x : K} (hx : x ∈ S) : x⁻¹ ∈ S := by
  by_cases h0 : x = 0
  · rw [h0, inv_zero]
    exact S.zero_mem
  · have hc : 1 < Fintype.card K := Fintype.one_lt_card
    have hm : x * x ^ (Fintype.card K - 2) = 1 := by
      calc x * x ^ (Fintype.card K - 2) = x ^ (Fintype.card K - 2 + 1) := (pow_succ' x _).symm
        _ = x ^ (Fintype.card K - 1) := by congr 1; omega
        _ = 1 := FiniteField.pow_card_sub_one_eq_one x h0
    rw [inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_right hm]
    exact pow_mem hx _

/-- A subring of a finite field, as a subfield. -/
def subfieldOfSubring (S : Subring K) : Subfield K :=
  { S with inv_mem' := fun _ hx => inv_mem_of_subring S hx }

/-- `F + F·i` as a subring. -/
def K2Subring (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) : Subring K where
  carrier := {x | ∃ a ∈ F, ∃ b ∈ F, x = a + B.i * b}
  mul_mem' := by
    rintro _ _ ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ ⟨c, hc, d, hd, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨a * c + (B.i * B.i) * (b * d),
      F.add_mem (F.mul_mem ha hc) (F.mul_mem hB.1 (F.mul_mem hb hd)),
      a * d + b * c, F.add_mem (F.mul_mem ha hd) (F.mul_mem hb hc), by ring⟩
  one_mem' := ⟨1, F.one_mem, 0, F.zero_mem, by ring⟩
  add_mem' := by
    rintro _ _ ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ ⟨c, hc, d, hd, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨a + c, F.add_mem ha hc, b + d, F.add_mem hb hd, by ring⟩
  zero_mem' := ⟨0, F.zero_mem, 0, F.zero_mem, by ring⟩
  neg_mem' := by
    rintro _ ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨-a, F.neg_mem ha, -b, F.neg_mem hb, by ring⟩

/-- `K₂ = F(i)`. -/
def K2 (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) : Subfield K :=
  subfieldOfSubring (K2Subring B hB)

theorem mem_K2 (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) {x : K} :
    x ∈ K2 B hB ↔ ∃ a ∈ F, ∃ b ∈ F, x = a + B.i * b := Iff.rfl

theorem F_le_K2 (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) {x : K} (hx : x ∈ F) :
    x ∈ K2 B hB :=
  (mem_K2 B hB).2 ⟨x, hx, 0, F.zero_mem, by ring⟩

theorem i_mem_K2 (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) : B.i ∈ K2 B hB :=
  (mem_K2 B hB).2 ⟨0, F.zero_mem, 1, F.one_mem, by ring⟩

theorem uu_mem_K2 (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) : B.u * B.u ∈ K2 B hB := by
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, h⟩ := hB.2
  exact (mem_K2 B hB).2 ⟨a, ha, b, hb, h⟩

/-- `K₂ + u·K₂` as a subring. -/
def K4Subring (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) : Subring K where
  carrier := {x | ∃ A ∈ K2 B hB, ∃ C ∈ K2 B hB, x = A + B.u * C}
  mul_mem' := by
    rintro _ _ ⟨A, hA, C, hC, rfl⟩ ⟨A', hA', C', hC', rfl⟩
    exact ⟨A * A' + (B.u * B.u) * (C * C'),
      (K2 B hB).add_mem ((K2 B hB).mul_mem hA hA')
        ((K2 B hB).mul_mem (uu_mem_K2 B hB) ((K2 B hB).mul_mem hC hC')),
      A * C' + C * A',
      (K2 B hB).add_mem ((K2 B hB).mul_mem hA hC') ((K2 B hB).mul_mem hC hA'), by ring⟩
  one_mem' := ⟨1, (K2 B hB).one_mem, 0, (K2 B hB).zero_mem, by ring⟩
  add_mem' := by
    rintro _ _ ⟨A, hA, C, hC, rfl⟩ ⟨A', hA', C', hC', rfl⟩
    exact ⟨A + A', (K2 B hB).add_mem hA hA', C + C', (K2 B hB).add_mem hC hC', by ring⟩
  zero_mem' := ⟨0, (K2 B hB).zero_mem, 0, (K2 B hB).zero_mem, by ring⟩
  neg_mem' := by
    rintro _ ⟨A, hA, C, hC, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨-A, (K2 B hB).neg_mem hA, -C, (K2 B hB).neg_mem hC, by ring⟩

/-- `K₄ = F(i, u)`. -/
def K4 (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) : Subfield K :=
  subfieldOfSubring (K4Subring B hB)

theorem mem_K4_iff_K2 (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) {x : K} :
    x ∈ K4 B hB ↔ ∃ A ∈ K2 B hB, ∃ C ∈ K2 B hB, x = A + B.u * C := Iff.rfl

/-- The carrier characterisation through `pack4` used by every word lemma. -/
theorem mem_K4_iff_pack4 (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) {x : K} :
    x ∈ K4 B hB ↔ ∃ v : Fin 4 → K, (∀ j, v j ∈ F) ∧ x = pack4 B v := by
  rw [mem_K4_iff_K2]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨A, hA, C, hC, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := (mem_K2 B hB).1 hA
    obtain ⟨c, hc, d, hd, rfl⟩ := (mem_K2 B hB).1 hC
    let v : Fin 4 → K := fun j =>
      if j.val = 0 then a else if j.val = 1 then b else if j.val = 2 then c else d
    refine ⟨v, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro j
      simp only [v]
      split_ifs
      · exact ha
      · exact hb
      · exact hc
      · exact hd
    · have h0 : v 0 = a := rfl
      have h1 : v 1 = b := rfl
      have h2 : v 2 = c := rfl
      have h3 : v 3 = d := rfl
      unfold pack4
      rw [h0, h1, h2, h3]
      ring
  · rintro ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨v 0 + B.i * v 1, (mem_K2 B hB).2 ⟨v 0, hv 0, v 1, hv 1, rfl⟩,
      v 2 + B.i * v 3, (mem_K2 B hB).2 ⟨v 2, hv 2, v 3, hv 3, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    unfold pack4
    ring

theorem K2_le_K4 (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) : K2 B hB ≤ K4 B hB :=
  fun x hx => (mem_K4_iff_K2 B hB).2 ⟨x, hx, 0, (K2 B hB).zero_mem, by ring⟩

theorem F_le_K4 (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) {x : K} (hx : x ∈ F) :
    x ∈ K4 B hB :=
  K2_le_K4 B hB (F_le_K2 B hB hx)

theorem u_mem_K4 (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) : B.u ∈ K4 B hB :=
  (mem_K4_iff_K2 B hB).2 ⟨0, (K2 B hB).zero_mem, 1, (K2 B hB).one_mem, by ring⟩

theorem i_mem_K4 (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) : B.i ∈ K4 B hB :=
  K2_le_K4 B hB (i_mem_K2 B hB)

theorem pack4_mem_K4 (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) (v : Fin 4 → K)
    (hv : ∀ j, v j ∈ F) : pack4 B v ∈ K4 B hB :=
  (mem_K4_iff_pack4 B hB).2 ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩

theorem towerBasis_mem_K4 (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) (j : Fin 4) :
    R0P.Mask.towerBasis B j ∈ K4 B hB := by
  unfold R0P.Mask.towerBasis
  split_ifs
  · exact (K4 B hB).one_mem
  · exact i_mem_K4 B hB
  · exact u_mem_K4 B hB
  · exact (K4 B hB).mul_mem (i_mem_K4 B hB) (u_mem_K4 B hB)

theorem natCast_mem_K4 (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) (n : ℕ) :
    (n : K) ∈ K4 B hB :=
  natCast_mem (K4 B hB) n

theorem half_mem_K4 (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) : (1 / 2 : K) ∈ K4 B hB := by
  have h2 : (2 : K) ∈ K4 B hB := by
    have h := natCast_mem_K4 B hB 2
    simpa using h
  exact (K4 B hB).div_mem (K4 B hB).one_mem h2

/-! ### F-dimensions -/

/-- `K₄` as an `F`-subspace of `K` (same carrier). -/
def K4F (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) : Submodule F K where
  carrier := (K4 B hB : Set K)
  add_mem' := fun ha hb => (K4 B hB).add_mem ha hb
  zero_mem' := (K4 B hB).zero_mem
  smul_mem' := fun c x hx => by
    rw [fsmul_eq]
    exact (K4 B hB).mul_mem (F_le_K4 B hB c.2) hx

theorem mem_K4F (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) {x : K} :
    x ∈ K4F B hB ↔ x ∈ K4 B hB := Iff.rfl

/-- `K₂` as an `F`-subspace of `K`. -/
def K2F (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) : Submodule F K where
  carrier := (K2 B hB : Set K)
  add_mem' := fun ha hb => (K2 B hB).add_mem ha hb
  zero_mem' := (K2 B hB).zero_mem
  smul_mem' := fun c x hx => by
    rw [fsmul_eq]
    exact (K2 B hB).mul_mem (F_le_K2 B hB c.2) hx

theorem mem_K2F (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) {x : K} :
    x ∈ K2F B hB ↔ x ∈ K2 B hB := Iff.rfl

theorem towerBasis_zero (B : PackBasis F) : R0P.Mask.towerBasis B 0 = 1 := rfl
theorem towerBasis_one (B : PackBasis F) : R0P.Mask.towerBasis B 1 = B.i := rfl
theorem towerBasis_two (B : PackBasis F) : R0P.Mask.towerBasis B 2 = B.u := rfl
theorem towerBasis_three (B : PackBasis F) : R0P.Mask.towerBasis B 3 = B.i * B.u := rfl

/-- `{1, i, u, iu}` is `F`-independent (from `PackBasis.indep`). -/
theorem towerBasis_linearIndependent (B : PackBasis F) :
    LinearIndependent F (R0P.Mask.towerBasis B) := by
  rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
  intro g hg
  have h : (g 0 : K) + B.i * g 1 + B.u * g 2 + B.i * B.u * g 3 = 0 := by
    rw [← hg, Fin.sum_univ_four]
    simp only [fsmul_eq, towerBasis_zero, towerBasis_one, towerBasis_two, towerBasis_three]
    ring
  obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2, h3⟩ := B.indep _ _ _ _ (g 0).2 (g 1).2 (g 2).2 (g 3).2 h
  intro j
  fin_cases j
  · exact Subtype.ext h0
  · exact Subtype.ext h1
  · exact Subtype.ext h2
  · exact Subtype.ext h3

theorem K4F_eq_span (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) :
    K4F B hB = Submodule.span F (Set.range (R0P.Mask.towerBasis B)) := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := (mem_K4_iff_pack4 B hB).1 hx
    have e : pack4 B v =
        v 0 * R0P.Mask.towerBasis B 0 + v 1 * R0P.Mask.towerBasis B 1 +
        v 2 * R0P.Mask.towerBasis B 2 + v 3 * R0P.Mask.towerBasis B 3 := by
      rw [towerBasis_zero, towerBasis_one, towerBasis_two, towerBasis_three]
      unfold pack4
      ring
    rw [e]
    have hm (j : Fin 4) : v j * R0P.Mask.towerBasis B j ∈
        Submodule.span F (Set.range (R0P.Mask.towerBasis B)) :=
      Submodule.smul_mem _ (⟨v j, hv j⟩ : F) (Submodule.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩)
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.add_mem _ (hm 0) (hm 1)) (hm 2))
      (hm 3)
  · rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    exact towerBasis_mem_K4 B hB j

theorem finrank_K4F (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) :
    Module.finrank F (K4F B hB) = 4 := by
  rw [K4F_eq_span B hB, finrank_span_eq_card (towerBasis_linearIndependent B),
    Fintype.card_fin]

/-- The `K₂` basis `{1, i}`. -/
def k2Basis (B : PackBasis F) : Fin 2 → K := fun j => if j.val = 0 then 1 else B.i

theorem k2Basis_linearIndependent (B : PackBasis F) :
    LinearIndependent F (k2Basis B) := by
  rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
  intro g hg
  have h' : (g 0 : K) + B.i * g 1 = 0 := by
    rw [← hg, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp only [fsmul_eq]
    have e0 : k2Basis B 0 = 1 := rfl
    have e1 : k2Basis B 1 = B.i := rfl
    rw [e0, e1]
    ring
  have h : (g 0 : K) + B.i * g 1 + B.u * 0 + B.i * B.u * 0 = 0 := by
    rw [mul_zero, mul_zero, add_zero, add_zero]
    exact h'
  obtain ⟨h0, h1, -, -⟩ := B.indep _ _ _ _ (g 0).2 (g 1).2 F.zero_mem F.zero_mem h
  intro j
  fin_cases j
  · exact Subtype.ext h0
  · exact Subtype.ext h1

theorem K2F_eq_span (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) :
    K2F B hB = Submodule.span F (Set.range (k2Basis B)) := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := (mem_K2 B hB).1 hx
    have e : a + B.i * b = a * k2Basis B 0 + b * k2Basis B 1 := by
      have e0 : k2Basis B 0 = 1 := rfl
      have e1 : k2Basis B 1 = B.i := rfl
      rw [e0, e1]
      ring
    rw [e]
    have h0 : a * k2Basis B 0 ∈ Submodule.span F (Set.range (k2Basis B)) :=
      Submodule.smul_mem _ (⟨a, ha⟩ : F) (Submodule.subset_span ⟨0, rfl⟩)
    have h1 : b * k2Basis B 1 ∈ Submodule.span F (Set.range (k2Basis B)) :=
      Submodule.smul_mem _ (⟨b, hb⟩ : F) (Submodule.subset_span ⟨1, rfl⟩)
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ h0 h1
  · rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    unfold k2Basis
    split_ifs
    · exact (K2 B hB).one_mem
    · exact i_mem_K2 B hB

theorem finrank_K2F (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) :
    Module.finrank F (K2F B hB) = 2 := by
  rw [K2F_eq_span B hB, finrank_span_eq_card (k2Basis_linearIndependent B),
    Fintype.card_fin]

theorem K2F_le_K4F (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) : K2F B hB ≤ K4F B hB :=
  fun _ hx => K2_le_K4 B hB hx

/-! ### The quadratic-subfield lemma -/

/-- Frobenius over `F` (power `|F|`) squares to the identity on every root of
a quadratic over `F`. -/
theorem frob_sq_of_quadratic [Fintype F] {y a b : K} (ha : a ∈ F) (hb : b ∈ F)
    (hy : y * y = a + b * y) :
    (y ^ Fintype.card F) ^ Fintype.card F = y := by
  let φ := FiniteField.frobeniusAlgHom F K
  have hφ (w : K) : φ w = w ^ Fintype.card F := rfl
  have hfix {c : K} (hc : c ∈ F) : φ c = c := φ.commutes ⟨c, hc⟩
  rw [← hφ, ← hφ]
  set z := φ y with hzdef
  have hz : z * z = a + b * z := by
    have h := congrArg φ hy
    rw [map_mul, map_add, map_mul, hfix ha, hfix hb] at h
    exact h
  have hprod : (z - y) * (z + y - b) = 0 := by linear_combination hz - hy
  rcases mul_eq_zero.1 hprod with h | h
  · have h1 : z = y := sub_eq_zero.1 h
    rw [h1]
    exact h1
  · have h2 : z = b - y := by linear_combination h
    rw [h2, map_sub, hfix hb]
    have h3 : φ y = z := rfl
    rw [h3, h2]
    ring

/-- An element of `K` that is quadratic over `F` lies in `K₂`.  The proof is
by Frobenius and the root count of `X^(q²) − X` against the `q²` elements of
`K₂`, with `q = |F|`; it needs no premise beyond finiteness of `K` (the
cardinality of `F` is read from its `Fintype` structure), and it holds for
every `x : K`, not only `x ∈ K₄`. -/
theorem mem_K2_of_quadratic (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) {x : K}
    (hx : x * x ∈ Submodule.span F ({1, x} : Set K)) : x ∈ K2 B hB := by
  classical
  letI : Fintype F := Fintype.ofFinite F
  set q := Fintype.card F with hq
  have hq1 : 1 < q := Fintype.one_lt_card
  have hqq : 1 < q * q := by nlinarith
  by_contra hxK
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_pair.1 hx
  rw [fsmul_eq, fsmul_eq, mul_one] at hab
  have hroot {w : K} (hw : (w ^ q) ^ q = w) :
      w ∈ (Polynomial.X ^ (q * q) - Polynomial.X : Polynomial K).roots := by
    rw [Polynomial.mem_roots (FiniteField.X_pow_card_sub_X_ne_zero K hqq)]
    simp only [Polynomial.IsRoot.def, Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_pow,
      Polynomial.eval_X]
    rw [pow_mul, hw, sub_self]
  let S : Finset K := Finset.univ.image (fun p : F × F => (p.1 : K) + B.i * p.2)
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun p : F × F => (p.1 : K) + B.i * p.2) := by
    intro p p' h0
    have h : (p.1 : K) + B.i * p.2 = p'.1 + B.i * p'.2 := h0
    have h' : ((p.1 : K) - p'.1) + B.i * ((p.2 : K) - p'.2) + B.u * 0 + B.i * B.u * 0 = 0 := by
      linear_combination h
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, -, -⟩ := B.indep _ _ _ _ (F.sub_mem p.1.2 p'.1.2)
      (F.sub_mem p.2.2 p'.2.2) F.zero_mem F.zero_mem h'
    exact Prod.ext (Subtype.ext (sub_eq_zero.1 h1)) (Subtype.ext (sub_eq_zero.1 h2))
  have hS : S.card = q * q := by
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hinj, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_prod]
  have hxS : x ∉ S := by
    intro h
    obtain ⟨p, -, hp⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 h
    exact hxK ((mem_K2 B hB).2 ⟨p.1, p.1.2, p.2, p.2.2, hp.symm⟩)
  have hsub : (insert x S).val ⊆
      (Polynomial.X ^ (q * q) - Polynomial.X : Polynomial K).roots := by
    intro w hw
    have hw' : w ∈ insert x S := hw
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hw' with h | h
    · rw [h]
      exact hroot (frob_sq_of_quadratic a.2 b.2 hab.symm)
    · obtain ⟨p, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 h
      apply hroot
      have hs := hB.1
      refine frob_sq_of_quadratic (a := -((p.1 : K) * p.1) + (B.i * B.i) * ((p.2 : K) * p.2))
        (b := 2 * (p.1 : K)) ?_ ?_ ?_
      · exact F.add_mem (F.neg_mem (F.mul_mem p.1.2 p.1.2)) (F.mul_mem hs (F.mul_mem p.2.2 p.2.2))
      · have h2 : (2 : K) ∈ F := by
          have h := natCast_mem F 2
          simpa using h
        exact F.mul_mem h2 p.1.2
      · ring
  have hcard := Polynomial.card_le_degree_of_subset_roots hsub
  rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hxS, hS,
    FiniteField.X_pow_card_sub_X_natDegree_eq K hqq] at hcard
  omega

/-! ### Invariant subspaces of `K₄` -/

/-- A subspace of `K₄` containing 1 and stable under multiplication by some
`β ∈ K₄ ∖ K₂` is all of `K₄`. -/
theorem K4F_le_of_invariant (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B)
    {T : Submodule F K} (hT : T ≤ K4F B hB) (h1 : (1 : K) ∈ T)
    {β : K} (hβ : β ∈ K4 B hB) (hβ2 : β ∉ K2 B hB)
    (hinv : ∀ y ∈ T, β * y ∈ T) : K4F B hB ≤ T := by
  have hβT : β ∈ T := by simpa using hinv 1 h1
  have hββ : β * β ∈ T := hinv β hβT
  have hβF : β ∉ F := fun h => hβ2 (F_le_K2 B hB h)
  have hTle : Module.finrank F T ≤ 4 := by
    have := Submodule.finrank_mono hT
    rw [finrank_K4F] at this
    exact this
  have hP1 : Module.finrank F (Submodule.span F ({1} : Set K)) = 1 :=
    finrank_span_singleton one_ne_zero
  have hlt : Submodule.span F ({1} : Set K) < Submodule.span F ({1, β} : Set K) := by
    refine lt_of_le_of_ne (Submodule.span_mono (by simp)) ?_
    intro heq
    have hm : β ∈ Submodule.span F ({1} : Set K) := by
      rw [heq]
      exact Submodule.subset_span (by simp)
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.1 hm
    rw [fsmul_eq, mul_one] at hc
    exact hβF (hc ▸ c.2)
  have hP2 : 2 ≤ Module.finrank F (Submodule.span F ({1, β} : Set K)) := by
    have := Submodule.finrank_lt_finrank_of_lt hlt
    omega
  have hP2T : Submodule.span F ({1, β} : Set K) ≤ T := by
    rw [Submodule.span_le]
    intro w hw
    rcases hw with rfl | hw
    · exact h1
    · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.1 hw]
      exact hβT
  by_cases hT4 : Module.finrank F T = 4
  · exact (Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq hT (hT4.trans (finrank_K4F B hB).symm)).ge
  by_cases hT3 : Module.finrank F T = 3
  · exfalso
    have hne : ¬ K4F B hB ≤ T := fun h => by
      have := Submodule.finrank_mono h
      rw [finrank_K4F] at this
      omega
    obtain ⟨y, hyK, hyT⟩ := SetLike.not_le_iff_exists.1 hne
    have hlt' : T < T ⊔ Submodule.span F ({y} : Set K) := by
      refine lt_of_le_of_ne le_sup_left ?_
      intro h
      apply hyT
      rw [h]
      exact Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self y)
    have hsup_le : T ⊔ Submodule.span F ({y} : Set K) ≤ K4F B hB :=
      sup_le hT (by
        rw [Submodule.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
        exact hyK)
    have hfin : Module.finrank F ↥(T ⊔ Submodule.span F ({y} : Set K)) = 4 := by
      have h3 := Submodule.finrank_lt_finrank_of_lt hlt'
      have h4 := Submodule.finrank_mono hsup_le
      rw [finrank_K4F] at h4
      omega
    have hsup : T ⊔ Submodule.span F ({y} : Set K) = K4F B hB :=
      Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq hsup_le (hfin.trans (finrank_K4F B hB).symm)
    have hβy : β * y ∈ T ⊔ Submodule.span F ({y} : Set K) := by
      rw [hsup]
      exact (K4 B hB).mul_mem hβ hyK
    obtain ⟨p, hp, q', hq', hpq⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hβy
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.1 hq'
    rw [fsmul_eq] at hpq
    have key : ∀ w ∈ K4F B hB, (β - (c : K)) * w ∈ T := by
      intro w hw
      rw [← hsup] at hw
      obtain ⟨t, ht, s, hs, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hw
      obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.1 hs
      rw [fsmul_eq]
      have e : (β - (c : K)) * (t + (d : K) * y) =
          β * t + ((-c : F) : K) * t + (d : K) * p := by
        have hn : ((-c : F) : K) = -(c : K) := rfl
        rw [hn]
        linear_combination (d : K) * hpq.symm
      rw [e]
      have m2 : ((-c : F) : K) * t ∈ T := by
        rw [← fsmul_eq]
        exact T.smul_mem _ ht
      have m3 : (d : K) * p ∈ T := by
        rw [← fsmul_eq]
        exact T.smul_mem _ hp
      exact T.add_mem (T.add_mem (hinv t ht) m2) m3
    apply hne
    intro w hw
    have hβc : β - (c : K) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      apply hβF
      rw [sub_eq_zero.1 h]
      exact c.2
    have hm : (β - (c : K))⁻¹ * w ∈ K4F B hB :=
      (K4 B hB).mul_mem ((K4 B hB).inv_mem ((K4 B hB).sub_mem hβ (F_le_K4 B hB c.2))) hw
    have := key _ hm
    rwa [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hβc, one_mul] at this
  · exfalso
    have h2 : Module.finrank F T ≤ Module.finrank F (Submodule.span F ({1, β} : Set K)) := by
      have := Submodule.finrank_mono hP2T
      omega
    have heq : Submodule.span F ({1, β} : Set K) = T :=
      Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_le hP2T h2
    have hm : β * β ∈ Submodule.span F ({1, β} : Set K) := by
      rw [heq]
      exact hββ
    exact hβ2 (mem_K2_of_quadratic B hB hm)

/-! ### One growth step -/

/-- `T + β·T`. -/
def stepT (T : Submodule F K) (β : K) : Submodule F K :=
  T ⊔ T.map (LinearMap.mulLeft F β)

/-- Indicator of `β ∉ S`, as a natural number. -/
def notIn (S : Subfield K) (β : K) : ℕ := by
  classical
  exact if β ∈ S then 0 else 1

theorem notIn_of_not_mem {S : Subfield K} {β : K} (h : β ∉ S) : notIn S β = 1 := by
  unfold notIn
  rw [if_neg h]

/-- The growth invariant: `K₄ ⊆ T` or `n ≤ dim T`. -/
def Grow (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) (T : Submodule F K) (n : ℕ) : Prop :=
  K4F B hB ≤ T ∨ n ≤ Module.finrank F T

theorem step_grow (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B)
    {T : Submodule F K} (hT : T ≤ K4F B hB) (h1 : (1 : K) ∈ T)
    {β : K} (hβ : β ∈ K4 B hB) {n : ℕ} (hG : Grow B hB T n) :
    stepT T β ≤ K4F B hB ∧ (1 : K) ∈ stepT T β ∧
      Grow B hB (stepT T β) (n + notIn (K2 B hB) β) := by
  have hle : T ≤ stepT T β := le_sup_left
  have hT' : stepT T β ≤ K4F B hB := by
    refine sup_le hT ?_
    rw [Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    intro y hy
    rw [Submodule.mem_comap, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply]
    exact (K4 B hB).mul_mem hβ (hT hy)
  refine ⟨hT', hle h1, ?_⟩
  have hmono : Module.finrank F T ≤ Module.finrank F (stepT T β) := Submodule.finrank_mono hle
  by_cases hb : β ∈ K2 B hB
  · have h0 : notIn (K2 B hB) β = 0 := by
      unfold notIn
      rw [if_pos hb]
    rw [h0, add_zero]
    rcases hG with h | h
    · exact Or.inl (h.trans hle)
    · exact Or.inr (h.trans hmono)
  · rw [notIn_of_not_mem hb]
    rcases hG with h | h
    · exact Or.inl (h.trans hle)
    · by_cases hinv : stepT T β ≤ T
      · left
        refine (K4F_le_of_invariant B hB hT h1 hβ hb ?_).trans hle
        intro y hy
        apply hinv
        exact Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hy)
      · right
        have hlt : T < stepT T β := lt_of_le_of_ne hle (fun h => hinv (by rw [← h]))
        have := Submodule.finrank_lt_finrank_of_lt hlt
        omega

theorem grow_mono (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) {T : Submodule F K}
    {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) (hG : Grow B hB T n) : Grow B hB T m := by
  rcases hG with h | h
  · exact Or.inl h
  · exact Or.inr (hmn.trans h)

end Field

/-! ### The prefix spans `Λ_j` -/

section Lambda
variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K]

/-- `Λ_j = span_F {eqPrefix(a, r, j) : r}`; the range is symbolic. -/
def Lambda (F : Subfield K) (a : Fin 10 → K) (j : Fin 10) : Submodule F K :=
  Submodule.span F (Set.range fun r : Fin 1024 => R0Z.PureRounds.eqPrefix a r j)

/-- Extending a prefix by one bit multiplies by that bit's factor. -/
theorem eqPrefix_update (a : Fin 10 → K) (j : Fin 9) (r : Fin 1024) (b : Bool) :
    R0Z.PureRounds.eqPrefix a (rowOf (Function.update (rowBits r) j.castSucc b)) j.succ =
      R0Z.PureRounds.eqPrefix a r j.castSucc * bitFactor b (a j.castSucc) := by
  unfold R0Z.PureRounds.eqPrefix
  rw [rowBits_rowOf]
  have h : ∀ i : Fin 10,
      (if i.val < j.succ.val then
        bitFactor (Function.update (rowBits r) j.castSucc b i) (a i) else 1) =
      (if i.val < j.castSucc.val then bitFactor (rowBits r i) (a i) else 1) *
        (if i = j.castSucc then bitFactor b (a j.castSucc) else 1) := by
    intro i
    by_cases h1 : i = j.castSucc
    · subst h1
      have hlt : j.castSucc.val < j.succ.val := by
        rw [Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc]
        omega
      rw [if_pos hlt, if_neg (lt_irrefl _), if_pos rfl, Function.update_self, one_mul]
    · rw [if_neg h1, mul_one, Function.update_of_ne h1]
      have hne : i.val ≠ j.val := fun h => h1 (Fin.ext (by rw [Fin.val_castSucc]; exact h))
      by_cases h2 : i.val < j.castSucc.val
      · rw [if_pos h2, if_pos]
        rw [Fin.val_succ]
        rw [Fin.val_castSucc] at h2
        omega
      · rw [if_neg h2, if_neg]
        rw [Fin.val_succ]
        rw [Fin.val_castSucc] at h2
        omega
  rw [Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun i _ => h i), Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_ite_eq']
  simp only [Finset.mem_univ, if_true]

theorem bitFactor_true (x : K) : bitFactor true x = x := rfl
theorem bitFactor_false (x : K) : bitFactor false x = 1 - x := rfl

variable {F : Subfield K}

theorem eqPrefix_mem_succ (a : Fin 10 → K) (j : Fin 9) (r : Fin 1024) :
    R0Z.PureRounds.eqPrefix a r j.castSucc ∈ Lambda F a j.succ ∧
      R0Z.PureRounds.eqPrefix a r j.castSucc * a j.castSucc ∈ Lambda F a j.succ := by
  have g (b : Bool) : R0Z.PureRounds.eqPrefix a
      (rowOf (Function.update (rowBits r) j.castSucc b)) j.succ ∈ Lambda F a j.succ :=
    Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have e1 := eqPrefix_update a j r true
  have e0 := eqPrefix_update a j r false
  rw [bitFactor_true] at e1
  rw [bitFactor_false] at e0
  have h1 := g true
  have h0 := g false
  rw [e1] at h1
  rw [e0] at h0
  refine ⟨?_, h1⟩
  have hs := Submodule.add_mem _ h1 h0
  have e : R0Z.PureRounds.eqPrefix a r j.castSucc * a j.castSucc +
      R0Z.PureRounds.eqPrefix a r j.castSucc * (1 - a j.castSucc) =
      R0Z.PureRounds.eqPrefix a r j.castSucc := by ring
  rw [e] at hs
  exact hs

theorem Lambda_le_succ (a : Fin 10 → K) (j : Fin 9) :
    Lambda F a j.castSucc ≤ Lambda F a j.succ := by
  rw [Lambda, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨r, rfl⟩
  exact (eqPrefix_mem_succ a j r).1

theorem mul_mem_Lambda_succ (a : Fin 10 → K) (j : Fin 9) {x : K}
    (hx : x ∈ Lambda F a j.castSucc) : x * a j.castSucc ∈ Lambda F a j.succ := by
  have hle : Lambda F a j.castSucc ≤
      (Lambda F a j.succ).comap (LinearMap.mulRight F (a j.castSucc)) := by
    rw [Lambda, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨r, rfl⟩
    simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, Submodule.mem_comap, LinearMap.mulRight_apply]
    exact (eqPrefix_mem_succ a j r).2
  have := hle hx
  rw [Submodule.mem_comap, LinearMap.mulRight_apply] at this
  exact this

theorem Lambda_mono (a : Fin 10 → K) {j k : Fin 10} (h : j ≤ k) :
    Lambda F a j ≤ Lambda F a k := by
  have key : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ k : Fin 10, k.val = j.val + n → Lambda F a j ≤ Lambda F a k := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro k hk
      have hkj : k = j := Fin.ext (by omega)
      subst hkj
      exact le_rfl
    | succ n ih =>
      intro k hk
      have hk9 : j.val + n < 9 := by omega
      let k' : Fin 9 := ⟨j.val + n, hk9⟩
      have h1 : k'.castSucc.val = j.val + n := rfl
      have h2 : k'.succ = k := Fin.ext (by rw [Fin.val_succ]; show j.val + n + 1 = k.val; omega)
      refine (ih k'.castSucc h1).trans ?_
      rw [← h2]
      exact Lambda_le_succ a k'
  exact key (k.val - j.val) k (by have := Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mp h; omega)

theorem one_mem_Lambda (a : Fin 10 → K) (j : Fin 10) : (1 : K) ∈ Lambda F a j := by
  have h0 : R0Z.PureRounds.eqPrefix a 0 0 = 1 := by
    unfold R0Z.PureRounds.eqPrefix
    simp
  have hm : (1 : K) ∈ Lambda F a 0 := Submodule.subset_span ⟨0, h0⟩
  exact Lambda_mono a (Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.2 (Nat.zero_le _)) hm

theorem alpha_mem_Lambda (a : Fin 10 → K) {i j : Fin 10} (h : i < j) :
    a i ∈ Lambda F a j := by
  have hi : i.val < 9 := by have := Fin.lt_def.mp h; have := j.isLt; omega
  let i' : Fin 9 := ⟨i.val, hi⟩
  have hc : i'.castSucc = i := Fin.ext rfl
  have h1 := mul_mem_Lambda_succ (F := F) a i' (one_mem_Lambda a i'.castSucc)
  rw [one_mul, hc] at h1
  refine Lambda_mono a ?_ h1
  rw [Fin.le_iff_val_le_val, Fin.val_succ]
  have := Fin.lt_def.mp h
  show i.val + 1 ≤ j.val
  omega

theorem Lambda_le_K4F (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) (a : Fin 10 → K)
    (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ K4 B hB) (j : Fin 10) : Lambda F a j ≤ K4F B hB := by
  rw [Lambda, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨r, rfl⟩
  show R0Z.PureRounds.eqPrefix a r j ∈ K4 B hB
  unfold R0Z.PureRounds.eqPrefix
  refine prod_mem (fun i _ => ?_)
  split_ifs
  · unfold bitFactor
    split_ifs
    · exact ha i
    · exact (K4 B hB).sub_mem (K4 B hB).one_mem (ha i)
  · exact (K4 B hB).one_mem

/-- One `Λ` step: `T ≤ Λ_j ⇒ T + a_j·T ≤ Λ_{j+1}`. -/
theorem stepT_le_Lambda (a : Fin 10 → K) (j : Fin 9) {T : Submodule F K}
    (hT : T ≤ Lambda F a j.castSucc) : stepT T (a j.castSucc) ≤ Lambda F a j.succ := by
  refine sup_le (hT.trans (Lambda_le_succ a j)) ?_
  rw [Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  intro y hy
  rw [Submodule.mem_comap, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, mul_comm]
  exact mul_mem_Lambda_succ a j (hT hy)

/-! ### `Good₃` and `Λ₄ = K₄` -/

/-- `Good₃` as proposed in design §1.2 and kept by LOG D21.3/D23.3:
`Good`, every semantic challenge in `K₄`, and at least three of `α₀..α₃`
outside `K₂`. -/
def Good3 (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) (ch : Challenges K) : Prop :=
  R0Z.Shift.Good ch ∧ (∀ i : Fin 25, ch.sem i ∈ K4 B hB) ∧
    ∃ s : Finset (Fin 4), 3 ≤ s.card ∧
      ∀ i ∈ s, alpha ch ⟨i.val, lt_trans i.isLt (by norm_num)⟩ ∉ K2 B hB

/-- Design lemma lambda4_eq_K4: on `Good₃`, `Λ_j = K₄` for every `j ≥ 4`. -/
theorem lambda4_eq_K4 (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) (ch : Challenges K)
    (hG : Good3 B hB ch) (j : Fin 10) (hj : 4 ≤ j.val) :
    Lambda F (alpha ch) j = K4F B hB := by
  obtain ⟨-, hsem, s, hs3, hs⟩ := hG
  have hα (k : Fin 10) : alpha ch k ∈ K4 B hB := hsem _
  apply le_antisymm (Lambda_le_K4F B hB _ hα j)
  -- count of α₀..α₃ outside K₂
  have hcount : 3 ≤ notIn (K2 B hB) (alpha ch 0) + notIn (K2 B hB) (alpha ch 1) +
      notIn (K2 B hB) (alpha ch 2) + notIn (K2 B hB) (alpha ch 3) := by
    have hsum : s.card ≤ ∑ i : Fin 4,
        notIn (K2 B hB) (alpha ch ⟨i.val, lt_trans i.isLt (by norm_num)⟩) := by
      calc s.card = ∑ _i ∈ s, (1 : ℕ) := by simp
        _ = ∑ i ∈ s,
            notIn (K2 B hB) (alpha ch ⟨i.val, lt_trans i.isLt (by norm_num)⟩) :=
            Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => (notIn_of_not_mem (hs i hi)).symm)
        _ ≤ _ := Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset (Finset.subset_univ s)
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_four] at hsum
    exact hs3.trans hsum
  -- the chain T₀ ≤ … ≤ T₄
  let T0 : Submodule F K := Submodule.span F ({1} : Set K)
  have hT0K : T0 ≤ K4F B hB := by
    rw [Submodule.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    exact (K4 B hB).one_mem
  have hT01 : (1 : K) ∈ T0 := Submodule.subset_span rfl
  have hT0G : Grow B hB T0 1 := Or.inr (finrank_span_singleton one_ne_zero).ge
  have hT0L : T0 ≤ Lambda F (alpha ch) 0 := by
    rw [Submodule.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    exact one_mem_Lambda _ _
  obtain ⟨hT1K, hT11, hT1G⟩ := step_grow B hB hT0K hT01 (hα 0) hT0G
  have hT1L := stepT_le_Lambda (alpha ch) 0 hT0L
  obtain ⟨hT2K, hT21, hT2G⟩ := step_grow B hB hT1K hT11 (hα 1) hT1G
  have hT2L := stepT_le_Lambda (alpha ch) 1 hT1L
  obtain ⟨hT3K, hT31, hT3G⟩ := step_grow B hB hT2K hT21 (hα 2) hT2G
  have hT3L := stepT_le_Lambda (alpha ch) 2 hT2L
  obtain ⟨hT4K, -, hT4G⟩ := step_grow B hB hT3K hT31 (hα 3) hT3G
  have hT4L := stepT_le_Lambda (alpha ch) 3 hT3L
  have hG4 := grow_mono B hB (m := 4) (by omega) hT4G
  have hK4 : K4F B hB ≤ Lambda F (alpha ch) ((3 : Fin 9).succ) := by
    rcases hG4 with h | h
    · exact h.trans hT4L
    · have he := Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_le hT4K (by rw [finrank_K4F]; exact h)
      rw [← he]
      exact hT4L
  exact hK4.trans (Lambda_mono _ (Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.2 (show 4 ≤ j.val from hj)))

end Lambda

R0P.CoreExt:
import R0P.Core

/-! # Skeleton extension (lead decisions after G3/G4)

* **Challenge-dependent families** (G4 finding): the copy residual reads the
  H1 helper at the current row (`A 26 b`) and the challenges λ, χ.
  `CFamily` carries them; `CHolds` fixes λ, χ and quantifies over rows.
* **Base typing and packing** (G3 finding): the Poseidon relation is the
  *unpacked* canonical permutation per base limb.  The source's packed
  terminal `v0 + i·v1 + u·v2 + i·u·v3` agrees with it on base-typed cells when
  `{1, i, u, i·u}` is linearly independent over the base subfield
  (`PackBasis`).  That the optimized raw-limb code computes the canonical
  permutation is a source-refinement obligation, not proved here. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R0P

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

/-- A family whose residuals read the H1 helper and the challenges λ, χ. -/
structure CFamily (K : Type) where
  residuals : Public K → (lam chi : K) → Openings K → (h1 : K) → Sel K → List K

def CHolds (f : CFamily K) (pub : Public K) (lam chi : K) (A : Trace K) : Prop :=
  ∀ b : Fin 1024, ∀ r ∈ f.residuals pub lam chi (rowOpenings A b) (A 26 b) (rowSel b), r = 0

/-- C1 columns 0–25 take values in the base subfield (Q11). -/
def BaseTyped (F : Subfield K) (A : Trace K) : Prop :=
  ∀ c : Fin 29, c.val < 26 → ∀ b, A c b ∈ F

/-- The packing basis `{1, i, u, i·u}` is independent over the base subfield. -/
structure PackBasis (F : Subfield K) where
  i : K
  u : K
  indep : ∀ a b c d : K, a ∈ F → b ∈ F → c ∈ F → d ∈ F →
    a + i * b + u * c + i * u * d = 0 → a = 0 ∧ b = 0 ∧ c = 0 ∧ d = 0

/-- The source's `qm31_pack_base4`. -/
def pack4 {F : Subfield K} (B : PackBasis F) (v : Fin 4 → K) : K :=
  v 0 + B.i * v 1 + B.u * v 2 + B.i * B.u * v 3

theorem pack4_eq_zero_iff {F : Subfield K} (B : PackBasis F) (v : Fin 4 → K)
    (hv : ∀ j, v j ∈ F) : pack4 B v = 0 ↔ ∀ j, v j = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h j
    obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2, h3⟩ := B.indep _ _ _ _ (hv 0) (hv 1) (hv 2) (hv 3) h
    fin_cases j <;> assumption
  · intro h
    simp [pack4, h]

#print axioms pack4_eq_zero_iff
end R0P

namespace R0P

/-- The public statement's field values lie in the base field. In the source
every public field is M31 (`pair_forest_semantic_terminal.rs:88–96`:
`anchor_root`, `nullifier`, `recipient`, `change`, frontier and root digests
are `[M31; 8]`, `asset_id: M31`, `withdrawal_amount: Option<u32>`, all read
through `lift_m31`), so this holds for every statement the verifier accepts
and is a typing fact, not an assumption on the prover. -/
def PublicBase (F : Subfield K) (pub : Public K) : Prop :=
  (∀ i, pub.anchor i ∈ F) ∧ (∀ i, pub.nullifier i ∈ F) ∧ pub.assetId ∈ F ∧
  (∀ r, pub.recipient = some r → ∀ i, r i ∈ F) ∧ (∀ i, pub.change i ∈ F) ∧
  (∀ a, pub.withdrawalAmount = some a → a ∈ F) ∧
  (∀ l i, pub.snapshotFrontier l i ∈ F) ∧ (∀ i, pub.nextRoot i ∈ F) ∧
  (∀ l i, pub.nextFrontier l i ∈ F)

import Mathlib.Tactic

/-! # R0 semantic relation: shared skeleton for the per-family ports

The semantic terminal of the pinned source (`pair_forest_semantic_terminal.rs`)
evaluates residual lanes at an extension point.  On a Boolean row `b` its
row selectors are the indicators `[k = b]` and its openings are the trace
cells at `b`, `succ b` and `xor12 b`.  The **unrandomized relation** of a
family is: every residual it emits vanishes at every Boolean row.

Each family file (`Poseidon`, `Schedule`, `Path`, `Value`, `Occupancy`,
`Digest`, `Asset`, `Positive`, `Copy`) ports its source function literally as
a `Family K`, citing source line ranges, and proves row-local lemmas.  The
extraction implication (Part C) is stated over `Holds`. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R0P

/-- Physical trace: 29 columns (0–15 semantic C1, 16–25 mask-only C1,
26 = H1, 27 = G, 28 = D) over 1024 rows. -/
abbrev Trace (K : Type) := Fin 29 → Fin 1024 → K

/-- Big-endian row bits: coordinate `i` of row `b` is bit `9 - i`.  On
Boolean points the source's `succ` is increment mod 1024 and `xor12` flips
coordinates 6 and 7, i.e. `b xor 12`. -/
def succRow (b : Fin 1024) : Fin 1024 := ⟨(b.val + 1) % 1024, Nat.mod_lt _ (by norm_num)⟩
def xor12Row (b : Fin 1024) : Fin 1024 := ⟨b.val ^^^ 12, by
  have := b.isLt
  exact Nat.xor_lt_two_pow (n := 10) (by simpa using this) (by norm_num)⟩

/-- The three openings the terminal reads (16 semantic columns each). -/
structure Openings (K : Type) where
  z : Fin 16 → K
  succ : Fin 16 → K
  xor12 : Fin 16 → K

/-- Row selectors: `row k` of the source. -/
abbrev Sel (K : Type) := Fin 1024 → K

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

def rowOpenings (A : Trace K) (b : Fin 1024) : Openings K :=
  ⟨fun c => A (Fin.castLE (by norm_num) c) b, fun c => A (Fin.castLE (by norm_num) c) (succRow b),
    fun c => A (Fin.castLE (by norm_num) c) (xor12Row b)⟩

def rowSel (b : Fin 1024) : Sel K := fun k => if k = b then 1 else 0

/-- Digests are eight base-field elements, embedded in `K`. -/
abbrev Digest (K : Type) := Fin 8 → K

inductive Variant
  | privateTransfer
  | withdrawal
  deriving DecidableEq

/-- Port of `SemanticPublic` (terminal source lines 86–98), digests in `K`. -/
structure Public (K : Type) where
  variant : Variant
  anchor : Digest K
  nullifier : Digest K
  assetId : K
  recipient : Option (Digest K)
  change : Digest K
  withdrawalAmount : Option K
  nextPairIndex : Nat
  snapshotFrontier : Fin 20 → Digest K
  nextRoot : Digest K
  nextFrontier : Fin 20 → Digest K

/-- A residual family: a literal port of one source function. -/
structure Family (K : Type) where
  residuals : Public K → Openings K → Sel K → List K

/-- The family's unrandomized relation on a trace. -/
def Holds (f : Family K) (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K) : Prop :=
  ∀ b : Fin 1024, ∀ r ∈ f.residuals pub (rowOpenings A b) (rowSel b), r = 0

theorem rowSel_self (b : Fin 1024) : rowSel (K := K) b b = 1 := by simp [rowSel]

theorem rowSel_ne (b k : Fin 1024) (h : k ≠ b) : rowSel (K := K) b k = 0 := by simp [rowSel, h]

end R0P

/-! G25: selected claim-dependent mask, ported from R0Z.MaskedProtocol.
