import R0Z.FsStatement
import R0Z.Shift

/-! D17.2 item 9: the FS ledger term of statistical HVZK. The middle
experiments agree exactly on the coins whose drawn challenge satisfies `P`,
and differ by at most one on the rest because the observer bit is 0/1-valued.
`badMass P` is that remaining mass; identifying it with `21/|K_α|` is ZF1's
obligation and needs the FS draw's alpha-row law, which is not chosen here. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R0Z.FsGood
open R0P R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.Shift
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
  {Bat : Type} [HonestView.BatchedLayer K Bat]

/-! ### Elementary facts about finite uniform means -/

theorem mean_sub {R : Type} [Fintype R] (f g : R → ℚ) :
    mean f - mean g = mean (fun r => f r - g r) := by
  simp only [mean, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, sub_div]

theorem abs_mean_le {R : Type} [Fintype R] (f : R → ℚ) :
    |mean f| ≤ mean (fun r => |f r|) := by
  unfold mean
  rw [abs_div, abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℚ) (Fintype.card R))]
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

theorem mean_le_mean {R : Type} [Fintype R] (f g : R → ℚ) (h : ∀ r, f r ≤ g r) :
    mean f ≤ mean g :=
  div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun r _ => h r)) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

theorem mean_nonneg {R : Type} [Fintype R] (f : R → ℚ) (h : ∀ r, 0 ≤ f r) : 0 ≤ mean f :=
  div_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun r _ => h r)) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

theorem mean_le_one {R : Type} [Fintype R] (f : R → ℚ) (h : ∀ r, f r ≤ 1) : mean f ≤ 1 := by
  unfold mean
  apply div_le_one_of_le₀ _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  have hs := Finset.sum_le_card_nsmul Finset.univ f 1 (fun r _ => h r)
  simpa only [Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one] using hs

theorem bit_nonneg (b : Bool) : 0 ≤ bit b := by
  unfold bit
  split_ifs <;> norm_num

theorem bit_le_one (b : Bool) : bit b ≤ 1 := by
  unfold bit
  split_ifs <;> norm_num

/-! ### The ledger term -/

/-- The mass of bridge coins whose drawn challenge fails `P`. -/
def badMass {Adv : Type} (P : Challenges K → Prop) (bridge : ROMBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat Adv)
    (adv : Adv) (x : Statement K CommitHandle) : ℚ :=
  mean (fun coin => if P (bridge.draw adv x coin) then 0 else 1)

/-- `middle_means_eq` on the good coins; a difference of at most one elsewhere. -/
theorem middle_means_close (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    (bridge : ROMBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary) (adv : fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hx : InLanguage h x) (w : h.Instance)
    (hw : h.public w = x.1) (P : Challenges K → Prop) (hh : HVZK_on (Bat := Bat) P h B outputs x) :
    |mean (middleReal h B outputs fs bridge adv x w) -
      mean (middleIdeal h B outputs fs bridge adv x hx)| ≤ badMass P bridge adv x := by
  rw [LawTransport.mean_product, LawTransport.mean_product, mean_sub]
  refine (abs_mean_le _).trans (mean_le_mean _ _ ?_)
  intro coin
  by_cases hP : P (bridge.draw adv x coin)
  · rw [if_pos hP]
    have heq : mean (fun r => middleReal h B outputs fs bridge adv x w (coin, r)) =
        mean (fun r => middleIdeal h B outputs fs bridge adv x hx (coin, r)) :=
      LawTransport.mean_eq_of_equalLaws _ _
        (fun v => bit (fs.observe adv (bridge.extend adv x coin v)))
        (hh hx w (bridge.draw adv x coin) hP hw)
    simp only [heq, sub_self, abs_zero, le_refl]
  · rw [if_neg hP]
    have h1 : 0 ≤ mean (fun r => middleReal h B outputs fs bridge adv x w (coin, r)) :=
      mean_nonneg _ (fun r => bit_nonneg _)
    have h2 : mean (fun r => middleReal h B outputs fs bridge adv x w (coin, r)) ≤ 1 :=
      mean_le_one _ (fun r => bit_le_one _)
    have h3 : 0 ≤ mean (fun r => middleIdeal h B outputs fs bridge adv x hx (coin, r)) :=
      mean_nonneg _ (fun r => bit_nonneg _)
    have h4 : mean (fun r => middleIdeal h B outputs fs bridge adv x hx (coin, r)) ≤ 1 :=
      mean_le_one _ (fun r => bit_le_one _)
    rw [abs_sub_le_iff]
    constructor <;> linarith

/-- D20′.3: statistical HVZK on `P` composed using the specified bridge's bad mass. -/
theorem zkfs_of_hvzk_on_bridge (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    [Fintype fs.RealRand] [Nonempty fs.RealRand]
    [Fintype fs.IdealRand] [Nonempty fs.IdealRand]
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (P : Challenges K → Prop) (hh : HVZK_on (Bat := Bat) P h B outputs x)
    (bridge : ROMBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary) (ε_real ε_ideal ε_bad : ℚ)
    (hr : ROMReductionWith h B outputs fs bridge x ε_real ε_ideal)
    (hmass : ∀ adv, badMass P bridge adv x ≤ ε_bad) :
    ZK_FS h B outputs fs x (ε_real + ε_ideal + ε_bad) := by
  intro hx adv w hw
  obtain ⟨_, _, hb⟩ := hr
  obtain ⟨hreal, hideal⟩ := hb hx adv w hw
  have hmid := middle_means_close h B outputs fs bridge adv x hx w hw P hh
  have hbad := hmass adv
  have t1 := abs_sub_le (mean (realTest h B outputs fs adv x w))
    (mean (middleReal h B outputs fs bridge adv x w)) (mean (idealTest h B outputs fs adv x hx))
  have t2 := abs_sub_le (mean (middleReal h B outputs fs bridge adv x w))
    (mean (middleIdeal h B outputs fs bridge adv x hx)) (mean (idealTest h B outputs fs adv x hx))
  linarith

/-- D20′.3: mask image on `Good` composed with the specified bridge's reduction and bad mass. -/
theorem zkfs_of_maskImageOn_good_bridge [Fintype Bat] (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    [Fintype fs.RealRand] [Nonempty fs.RealRand]
    [Fintype fs.IdealRand] [Nonempty fs.IdealRand]
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (bridge : ROMBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary) (ε_real ε_ideal ε_bad : ℚ) :
    MaskImageOn (Bat := Bat) Good h B x → ROMReductionWith h B outputs fs bridge x ε_real ε_ideal →
    (∀ adv, badMass Good bridge adv x ≤ ε_bad) →
    ZK_FS h B outputs fs x (ε_real + ε_ideal + ε_bad) :=
  fun hm hr hmass => zkfs_of_hvzk_on_bridge h B outputs fs x Good
    (hvzk_on_good h B outputs x hm) bridge ε_real ε_ideal ε_bad hr hmass

/-- D17.2 item 9: statistical HVZK on `P` composed with a ROM reduction;
superseded by the `_bridge` forms (D20′.3). -/
theorem zkfs_of_hvzk_on (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    [Fintype fs.RealRand] [Nonempty fs.RealRand]
    [Fintype fs.IdealRand] [Nonempty fs.IdealRand]
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (P : Challenges K → Prop) (epsilon_fs epsilon_bad : ℚ)
    (hh : HVZK_on (Bat := Bat) P h B outputs x) (hr : ROMReduction h B outputs fs x epsilon_fs)
    (hmass : ∀ (bridge : ROMBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary) (adv : fs.Adversary),
      badMass P bridge adv x ≤ epsilon_bad) :
    ZK_FS h B outputs fs x (epsilon_fs + epsilon_bad) := by
  intro hx adv w hw
  obtain ⟨bridge, er, ei, _, _, hsum, hb⟩ := hr
  obtain ⟨hreal, hideal⟩ := hb hx adv w hw
  have hmid := middle_means_close h B outputs fs bridge adv x hx w hw P hh
  have hbad := hmass bridge adv
  have t1 := abs_sub_le (mean (realTest h B outputs fs adv x w))
    (mean (middleReal h B outputs fs bridge adv x w)) (mean (idealTest h B outputs fs adv x hx))
  have t2 := abs_sub_le (mean (middleReal h B outputs fs bridge adv x w))
    (mean (middleIdeal h B outputs fs bridge adv x hx)) (mean (idealTest h B outputs fs adv x hx))
  linarith

/-- The Lean form of "statistical HVZK with the 21/|K_α| term": perfect on `Good`
plus one named ledger term; superseded by the `_bridge` forms (D20′.3). -/
theorem zkfs_of_maskImageOn_good [Fintype Bat] (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    [Fintype fs.RealRand] [Nonempty fs.RealRand]
    [Fintype fs.IdealRand] [Nonempty fs.IdealRand]
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (epsilon_fs epsilon_bad : ℚ) :
    MaskImageOn (Bat := Bat) Good h B x → ROMReduction h B outputs fs x epsilon_fs →
    (∀ (bridge : ROMBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary) (adv : fs.Adversary),
      badMass Good bridge adv x ≤ epsilon_bad) →
    ZK_FS h B outputs fs x (epsilon_fs + epsilon_bad) :=
  fun hm hr hmass => zkfs_of_hvzk_on h B outputs fs x Good epsilon_fs epsilon_bad
    (hvzk_on_good h B outputs x hm) hr hmass

#print badMass
#print axioms middle_means_close
#print axioms zkfs_of_hvzk_on_bridge
#print axioms zkfs_of_maskImageOn_good_bridge
#print axioms zkfs_of_hvzk_on
#print axioms zkfs_of_maskImageOn_good
end R0Z.FsGood
R0Z.FsStatement:
import R0Z.JointView
import R0Z.LawTransport

/-! D11's adopted FS interface. The current 32-round view and a Boolean
observer replace the historical Z1 types. ROMReduction is an explicit open
obligation about the real games, not an instance supplied by this module.
No oracle programming policy, query bound, or numerical error is chosen. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R0Z.FsStatement
open R0P R0Z.JointView
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

abbrev Bytes := List UInt8
abbrev OracleAnswer := Fin 32 → UInt8

/-- Full public model view plus the observer's own query/answer transcript.
The honest prover's private oracle-input log is not a public field. -/
structure ROMView (K CommitHandle Aux Bat : Type) [Field K] where
  disclosed : View K CommitHandle Aux Bat
  observerOracle : List (Bytes × OracleAnswer)

structure FSExperiments (K CommitHandle Aux Bat : Type) [Field K] (F : Subfield K) where
  Adversary : Type
  RealRand : Type
  IdealRand : Type
  real : (h : HonestProver K) → PackBasis F →
    (Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux) → Adversary →
    Statement K CommitHandle → h.Instance → RealRand → ROMView K CommitHandle Aux Bat
  ideal : (Challenges K → Tape K F → View K CommitHandle Aux Bat) → Adversary →
    Statement K CommitHandle → IdealRand → ROMView K CommitHandle Aux Bat
  observe : Adversary → ROMView K CommitHandle Aux Bat → Bool

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
  {Bat : Type} [HonestView.BatchedLayer K Bat]

def bit (b : Bool) : ℚ := if b then 1 else 0

def realTest (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F) (adv : fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) : fs.RealRand → ℚ :=
  fun r => bit (fs.observe adv (fs.real h B outputs adv x w r))

def idealTest (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F) (adv : fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hx : InLanguage h x) : fs.IdealRand → ℚ :=
  fun r => bit (fs.observe adv (fs.ideal (simulator h B outputs x hx) adv x r))

/-- Adopted distinguishing-advantage target. Epsilon remains symbolic;
neither HVZK nor a ROM reduction is a premise of this definition. -/
def ZK_FS (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    [Fintype fs.RealRand] [Nonempty fs.RealRand]
    [Fintype fs.IdealRand] [Nonempty fs.IdealRand]
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (epsilon_fs : ℚ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (hx : InLanguage h x) (adv : fs.Adversary) (w : h.Instance), h.public w = x.1 →
    |mean (realTest h B outputs fs adv x w) - mean (idealTest h B outputs fs adv x hx)| ≤ epsilon_fs

/-- Data for a common randomized extension of the two interactive views.
Its coins include the instance-independent challenge draw and any observer
randomness. Their product with Tape expresses independence from prover coins. -/
structure ROMBridge (K CommitHandle Aux Bat Adv : Type) [Field K] where
  Coins : Type
  finiteCoins : Fintype Coins
  nonemptyCoins : Nonempty Coins
  draw : Adv → Statement K CommitHandle → Coins → Challenges K
  extend : Adv → Statement K CommitHandle → Coins →
    View K CommitHandle Aux Bat → ROMView K CommitHandle Aux Bat

attribute [instance] ROMBridge.finiteCoins ROMBridge.nonemptyCoins

def middleReal (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    (bridge : ROMBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary) (adv : fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) : bridge.Coins × Tape K F → ℚ :=
  fun t => bit (fs.observe adv (bridge.extend adv x t.1
    (view h B outputs x w (bridge.draw adv x t.1) t.2)))

def middleIdeal (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    (bridge : ROMBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary) (adv : fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hx : InLanguage h x) : bridge.Coins × Tape K F → ℚ :=
  fun t => bit (fs.observe adv (bridge.extend adv x t.1
    (simulator h B outputs x hx (bridge.draw adv x t.1) t.2)))

/-- ZF1's substantive obligation: exhibit a common extension and prove both
real-game comparison bounds. All commitment, programming, seed, abort, and
source errors must be justified in these bounds; no such proof is supplied. -/
def ROMReduction (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    [Fintype fs.RealRand] [Nonempty fs.RealRand]
    [Fintype fs.IdealRand] [Nonempty fs.IdealRand]
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (epsilon_fs : ℚ) : Prop :=
  ∃ bridge : ROMBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary,
    ∃ epsilon_real epsilon_ideal : ℚ,
      0 ≤ epsilon_real ∧ 0 ≤ epsilon_ideal ∧ epsilon_real + epsilon_ideal ≤ epsilon_fs ∧
      ∀ (hx : InLanguage h x) (adv : fs.Adversary) (w : h.Instance), h.public w = x.1 →
        |mean (realTest h B outputs fs adv x w) -
          mean (middleReal h B outputs fs bridge adv x w)| ≤ epsilon_real ∧
        |mean (middleIdeal h B outputs fs bridge adv x hx) -
          mean (idealTest h B outputs fs adv x hx)| ≤ epsilon_ideal

/-- D20′.3: the two real-game comparison bounds for a specified bridge. -/
def ROMReductionWith (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    [Fintype fs.RealRand] [Nonempty fs.RealRand]
    [Fintype fs.IdealRand] [Nonempty fs.IdealRand]
    (bridge : ROMBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (ε_real ε_ideal : ℚ) : Prop :=
  0 ≤ ε_real ∧ 0 ≤ ε_ideal ∧
  ∀ (hx : InLanguage h x) (adv : fs.Adversary) (w : h.Instance), h.public w = x.1 →
    |mean (realTest h B outputs fs adv x w) -
      mean (middleReal h B outputs fs bridge adv x w)| ≤ ε_real ∧
    |mean (middleIdeal h B outputs fs bridge adv x hx) -
      mean (idealTest h B outputs fs adv x hx)| ≤ ε_ideal

/-- The original reduction existentially packages a bridge and its two bounds. -/
theorem romReduction_iff (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    [Fintype fs.RealRand] [Nonempty fs.RealRand]
    [Fintype fs.IdealRand] [Nonempty fs.IdealRand]
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (ε : ℚ) :
    ROMReduction h B outputs fs x ε ↔
      ∃ bridge ε_real ε_ideal,
        ROMReductionWith h B outputs fs bridge x ε_real ε_ideal ∧ ε_real + ε_ideal ≤ ε := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨bridge, ε_real, ε_ideal, hr, hi, hsum, hb⟩
    exact ⟨bridge, ε_real, ε_ideal, ⟨hr, hi, hb⟩, hsum⟩
  · rintro ⟨bridge, ε_real, ε_ideal, ⟨hr, hi, hb⟩, hsum⟩
    exact ⟨bridge, ε_real, ε_ideal, hr, hi, hsum, hb⟩

theorem middle_means_eq (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    (bridge : ROMBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary) (adv : fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hx : InLanguage h x) (w : h.Instance)
    (hw : h.public w = x.1) (hh : HVZK_perfect (Bat := Bat) h B outputs x) :
    mean (middleReal h B outputs fs bridge adv x w) =
      mean (middleIdeal h B outputs fs bridge adv x hx) := by
  rw [LawTransport.mean_product, LawTransport.mean_product]
  apply congrArg mean
  funext coin
  exact LawTransport.mean_eq_of_equalLaws _ _
    (fun v => bit (fs.observe adv (bridge.extend adv x coin v)))
    (hh hx w (bridge.draw adv x coin) hw)

/-- Only the composition is discharged. ZF1 still requires an actual
ROMReduction certificate for the chosen games and their symbolic ledger. -/
theorem zkfs_of_hvzk_perfect (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    [Fintype fs.RealRand] [Nonempty fs.RealRand]
    [Fintype fs.IdealRand] [Nonempty fs.IdealRand]
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (epsilon_fs : ℚ) :
    HVZK_perfect (Bat := Bat) h B outputs x → ROMReduction h B outputs fs x epsilon_fs →
      ZK_FS h B outputs fs x epsilon_fs := by
  intro hh hr hx adv w hw
  obtain ⟨bridge, er, ei, _, _, hsum, hb⟩ := hr
  obtain ⟨hr, hi⟩ := hb hx adv w hw
  rw [middle_means_eq h B outputs fs bridge adv x hx w hw hh] at hr
  exact (abs_sub_le _ _ _).trans ((add_le_add hr hi).trans hsum)

#print axioms ZK_FS
#print axioms ROMReduction
#print axioms ROMReductionWith
#print axioms romReduction_iff
#print axioms middle_means_eq
#print axioms zkfs_of_hvzk_perfect
end R0Z.FsStatement
R1Z.ModelsVR1:
import R0Z.HvzkV
import R0Z.FsAbortR1
import R1Z.Batched

/-! J0c (LOG D41): the ZF1 R1 models for the pole-aware retry games.  The
fields are those of `R0Z.FsAbortR1.R1RealModel` / `R1IdealModel`; only the
agreement field names `middleRealAbortV` (attempts accepted on `P ∧ V`) and
the per-challenge simulator games.  The coupling bounds are proved from
`FsAbortBounds` exactly as in `FsAbortR1`. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R1Z.ModelsVR1
open R0P R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.Shift R0Z.FsGood R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.HvzkV
  R1Z.Batched
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-! ### The ZF1 R1 models for the pole-aware games -/

/-- `R1RealModel` (LOG D41) with the agreement field naming `middleRealAbortV`. -/
def R1RealModelV (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K)
    (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat F) [Fintype fs.RealRand]
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (M q Umin : ℕ) (εexh : ℚ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (adv : fs.Adversary) (w : h.Instance), h.public w = x.1 →
    ∃ (cp : Coupling fs.RealRand ((Fin ab.N → ab.Coins) × (Fin ab.N → Tape K F)))
      (charged : Fin M → cp.S → Prop) (priv : Fin M → Prop)
      (addr : Fin M → cp.S → Bytes) (qry : Fin q → cp.S → Bytes) (exh : cp.S → Prop),
      (∀ s, ¬ R0Z.FsAbortBounds.HitEv M q charged qry addr s →
          ¬ (R0Z.FsAbortBounds.CollEv M priv addr s ∨ exh s) →
        realTest h B outputs fs adv x w (cp.toR s) =
          middleRealAbortV P h V B outputs fs ab adv x w (cp.toM s)) ∧
      (∀ j i, R0Z.FsAbortBounds.HitFresh (charged j) (qry i) (addr j) Umin) ∧
      (∀ j j', j < j' → (priv j ∨ priv j') →
        R0Z.FsAbortBounds.PairFresh (addr j) (addr j') Umin ∨
          R0Z.FsAbortBounds.PairFresh (addr j') (addr j) Umin) ∧
      R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass exh ≤ εexh

/-- `R1IdealModel` (LOG D41) with the agreement field naming the per-challenge
simulator games. -/
def R1IdealModelV (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K)
    (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat F) [Fintype fs.IdealRand]
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (M Umin : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (hx : InLanguage h x) (adv : fs.Adversary),
    ∃ (cp : Coupling fs.IdealRand ((Fin ab.N → ab.Coins) × (Fin ab.N → Tape K F)))
      (priv : Fin M → Prop) (addr : Fin M → cp.S → Bytes),
      (∀ s, ¬ R0Z.FsAbortBounds.CollEv M priv addr s →
        middleIdealAbortV P h V B outputs fs ab adv x hx (cp.toM s) =
          idealTestV h V B outputs fs adv x hx (cp.toR s)) ∧
      (∀ j j', j < j' → (priv j ∨ priv j') →
        R0Z.FsAbortBounds.PairFresh (addr j) (addr j') Umin ∨
          R0Z.FsAbortBounds.PairFresh (addr j') (addr j) Umin)

theorem realAbortCouplingV_of_R1 (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K)
    (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat F) [Fintype fs.RealRand]
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (M q Umin : ℕ) (εexh : ℚ) (hU : 0 < Umin)
    (hm : R1RealModelV P h V B outputs fs ab x M q Umin εexh) :
    RealAbortCouplingV P h V B outputs fs ab x ((M : ℚ) * q / Umin)
      ((M : ℚ) * M / Umin + εexh) := by
  intro adv w hw
  obtain ⟨cp, charged, priv, addr, qry, exh, hag, hhit, hpair, hexh⟩ := hm adv w hw
  refine ⟨cp, R0Z.FsAbortBounds.HitEv M q charged qry addr,
    fun s => R0Z.FsAbortBounds.CollEv M priv addr s ∨ exh s, hag, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [R0Z.FsAbortR1.eventMass_eq_mass]
    exact R0Z.FsAbortBounds.hitEv_mass_fresh M q Umin hU charged qry addr hhit
  · rw [R0Z.FsAbortR1.eventMass_eq_mass]
    calc R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass (fun s => R0Z.FsAbortBounds.CollEv M priv addr s ∨ exh s)
        ≤ R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass (R0Z.FsAbortBounds.CollEv M priv addr) +
            R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass exh :=
          R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass_or_le _ _
      _ ≤ (M : ℚ) * M / Umin + εexh :=
          add_le_add (R0Z.FsAbortBounds.collEv_mass_fresh M Umin hU priv addr hpair) hexh

theorem idealAbortCouplingV_of_R1 (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K)
    (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat F) [Fintype fs.IdealRand]
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (M Umin : ℕ) (hU : 0 < Umin)
    (hm : R1IdealModelV P h V B outputs fs ab x M Umin) :
    IdealAbortCouplingV P h V B outputs fs ab x ((M : ℚ) * M / Umin) := by
  intro hx adv
  obtain ⟨cp, priv, addr, hag, hpair⟩ := hm hx adv
  refine ⟨cp, R0Z.FsAbortBounds.CollEv M priv addr, hag, ?_⟩
  rw [R0Z.FsAbortR1.eventMass_eq_mass]
  exact R0Z.FsAbortBounds.collEv_mass_fresh M Umin hU priv addr hpair

#print axioms R1RealModelV
#print axioms R1IdealModelV
#print axioms realAbortCouplingV_of_R1
#print axioms idealAbortCouplingV_of_R1
end R1Z.ModelsVR1
R0Z.FsAbortR1:
import R0Z.FsAbort
import R0Z.FsAbortBounds

/-! ZF1a/b on R1 (DESIGN-ZF1-COUPLINGS-R1 §3–§8). The abort couplings of
`FsAbort` (`RealAbortCoupling`, `IdealAbortCoupling`) for the retrying R1
prover, with the charged events made concrete as address events over the
coupling space:

* `Hit`  := `HitEv`: some charged prover read (any read of a discarded
  attempt, or an unpublished read of the accepted attempt) is read by the
  adversary;
* `Coll` := `CollEv ∨ exh`: two prover reads, at least one private, have the
  same address, or a mask limb exhausted its 16 rejection tries;
* `Prog` := `CollEv` on the ideal coupling space (two programmed reads with
  the same address).

`R1RealModel` / `R1IdealModel` bundle the named hypotheses: the couplings
themselves (the lazy-programming law), agreement of the games outside the
events (protocol refinement of the Rust prover to the Lean view), the
per-read freshness facts `HitFresh` / `PairFresh` (the designated fields of
the R1 byte layout), and the exhaustion mass. From them the event masses are
PROVED (`FsAbortBounds`), giving ZK_FS with error
`M*q/Umin + (M*M/Umin + εexh) + Mi*Mi/Umin`, and `≤ 2^-166` at N = 8
(`M = Mi = 8 * 2^21` positions), `q = 2^64`, `Umin = 2^255`. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R0Z.FsAbortR1
open R0P R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.Shift R0Z.FsGood R0Z.FsAbort
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-- `FsAbort.eventMass` and `FsAbortBounds.mass` are the same constant body. -/
theorem eventMass_eq_mass {S : Type} [Fintype S] (E : S → Prop) :
    eventMass E = FsAbortBounds.mass E := rfl

/-! ### R1 read counts (design §1.1, §1.5; source counts, not instrumented) -/

/-- init + rows 0..26 (absorb, squeeze, advance) + reseed + rows 27..30 +
row 31 (absorb and eight squeeze/advance pairs) + row 32. -/
def r1TranscriptReads : ℕ := 1 + 27 * 3 + 1 + 4 * 3 + (1 + 16) + 3

theorem r1TranscriptReads_eq : r1TranscriptReads = 115 := by
  norm_num [r1TranscriptReads]

/-- Per-attempt reads: salts, leaves, 8-ary nodes (C1, C2, folded), expander
blocks (worst case), transcript, seeds/binding/context. -/
def r1AttemptReadBound : ℕ :=
  (2 * 2 ^ 18 + 2 ^ 16) + (2 * 2 ^ 18 + 2 ^ 16) + (2 * 2 ^ 18 / 7 + 2 ^ 16) + 2 ^ 18 +
    r1TranscriptReads + 64

theorem r1AttemptReadBound_le : r1AttemptReadBound ≤ 2 ^ 21 := by
  norm_num [r1AttemptReadBound, r1TranscriptReads]

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
  {Bat : Type} [HonestView.BatchedLayer K Bat]

/-! ### The real coupling (Hit, Coll) -/

/-- Named hypotheses of the R1 real coupling, for every adversary and witness:
a coupling `cp` of the real randomness with the abort-middle coins (HYP:
lazy-programming law); `M` prover positions with addresses `addr`, a static
`priv` flag and a charging event; `q` adversary reads `qry`; agreement of
`realTest` and `middleRealAbort` outside `HitEv ∨ (CollEv ∨ exh)` (HYP:
refinement); `HitFresh` for every charged position and read, `PairFresh` for
every private-involving pair (HYP: R1 byte layout, design §1.4); and the
exhaustion mass. -/
def R1RealModel (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F) [Fintype fs.RealRand]
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (M q Umin : ℕ) (εexh : ℚ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (adv : fs.Adversary) (w : h.Instance), h.public w = x.1 →
    ∃ (cp : Coupling fs.RealRand ((Fin ab.N → ab.Coins) × (Fin ab.N → Tape K F)))
      (charged : Fin M → cp.S → Prop) (priv : Fin M → Prop)
      (addr : Fin M → cp.S → Bytes) (qry : Fin q → cp.S → Bytes) (exh : cp.S → Prop),
      (∀ s, ¬ FsAbortBounds.HitEv M q charged qry addr s →
          ¬ (FsAbortBounds.CollEv M priv addr s ∨ exh s) →
        realTest h B outputs fs adv x w (cp.toR s) =
          middleRealAbort P h B outputs fs ab adv x w (cp.toM s)) ∧
      (∀ j i, FsAbortBounds.HitFresh (charged j) (qry i) (addr j) Umin) ∧
      (∀ j j', j < j' → (priv j ∨ priv j') →
        FsAbortBounds.PairFresh (addr j) (addr j') Umin ∨
          FsAbortBounds.PairFresh (addr j') (addr j) Umin) ∧
      FsAbortBounds.mass exh ≤ εexh

omit [DecidableEq K] in
theorem realAbortCoupling_of_R1 (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K)
    (B : PackBasis F) (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F) [Fintype fs.RealRand]
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (M q Umin : ℕ) (εexh : ℚ) (hU : 0 < Umin)
    (hm : R1RealModel P h B outputs fs ab x M q Umin εexh) :
    RealAbortCoupling P h B outputs fs ab x ((M : ℚ) * q / Umin)
      ((M : ℚ) * M / Umin + εexh) := by
  intro adv w hw
  obtain ⟨cp, charged, priv, addr, qry, exh, hag, hhit, hpair, hexh⟩ := hm adv w hw
  refine ⟨cp, FsAbortBounds.HitEv M q charged qry addr,
    fun s => FsAbortBounds.CollEv M priv addr s ∨ exh s, hag, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [eventMass_eq_mass]
    exact FsAbortBounds.hitEv_mass_fresh M q Umin hU charged qry addr hhit
  · rw [eventMass_eq_mass]
    calc FsAbortBounds.mass (fun s => FsAbortBounds.CollEv M priv addr s ∨ exh s)
        ≤ FsAbortBounds.mass (FsAbortBounds.CollEv M priv addr) + FsAbortBounds.mass exh :=
          FsAbortBounds.mass_or_le _ _
      _ ≤ (M : ℚ) * M / Umin + εexh :=
          add_le_add (FsAbortBounds.collEv_mass_fresh M Umin hU priv addr hpair) hexh

/-! ### The ideal coupling (Prog) -/

/-- Named hypotheses of the R1 ideal coupling: a coupling of the ideal
randomness with the abort-middle coins (HYP), `M` programmed positions,
agreement outside `CollEv` (HYP), and `PairFresh` for private-involving pairs. -/
def R1IdealModel (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F) [Fintype fs.IdealRand]
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (M Umin : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (hx : InLanguage h x) (adv : fs.Adversary),
    ∃ (cp : Coupling fs.IdealRand ((Fin ab.N → ab.Coins) × (Fin ab.N → Tape K F)))
      (priv : Fin M → Prop) (addr : Fin M → cp.S → Bytes),
      (∀ s, ¬ FsAbortBounds.CollEv M priv addr s →
        middleIdealAbort P h B outputs fs ab adv x hx (cp.toM s) =
          idealTest h B outputs fs adv x hx (cp.toR s)) ∧
      (∀ j j', j < j' → (priv j ∨ priv j') →
        FsAbortBounds.PairFresh (addr j) (addr j') Umin ∨
          FsAbortBounds.PairFresh (addr j') (addr j) Umin)

omit [DecidableEq K] in
theorem idealAbortCoupling_of_R1 (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K)
    (B : PackBasis F) (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F) [Fintype fs.IdealRand]
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (M Umin : ℕ) (hU : 0 < Umin)
    (hm : R1IdealModel P h B outputs fs ab x M Umin) :
    IdealAbortCoupling P h B outputs fs ab x ((M : ℚ) * M / Umin) := by
  intro hx adv
  obtain ⟨cp, priv, addr, hag, hpair⟩ := hm hx adv
  refine ⟨cp, FsAbortBounds.CollEv M priv addr, hag, ?_⟩
  rw [eventMass_eq_mass]
  exact FsAbortBounds.collEv_mass_fresh M Umin hU priv addr hpair

/-! ### Composition and the numbers -/

omit [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] in
theorem zkfs_mono (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    [Fintype fs.RealRand] [Nonempty fs.RealRand]
    [Fintype fs.IdealRand] [Nonempty fs.IdealRand]
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (ε ε' : ℚ)
    (hz : ZK_FS h B outputs fs x ε) (hle : ε ≤ ε') : ZK_FS h B outputs fs x ε' :=
  fun hx adv w hw => (hz hx adv w hw).trans hle

/-- ZK_FS for the retrying R1 prover from HVZK on `P` and the two R1 models. -/
theorem zkfs_R1_abort (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    [Fintype fs.RealRand] [Nonempty fs.RealRand]
    [Fintype fs.IdealRand] [Nonempty fs.IdealRand]
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hh : HVZK_on (Bat := Bat) P h B outputs x)
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary)
    (M Mi q Umin : ℕ) (εexh : ℚ) (hU : 0 < Umin) (he : 0 ≤ εexh)
    (hr : R1RealModel P h B outputs fs ab x M q Umin εexh)
    (hi : R1IdealModel P h B outputs fs ab x Mi Umin) :
    ZK_FS h B outputs fs x
      ((M : ℚ) * q / Umin + ((M : ℚ) * M / Umin + εexh) + (Mi : ℚ) * Mi / Umin) :=
  zkfs_of_hvzk_on_abort_terms P h B outputs fs x hh ab
    ((M : ℚ) * q / Umin) ((M : ℚ) * M / Umin + εexh) ((Mi : ℚ) * Mi / Umin)
    (by positivity) (add_nonneg (by positivity) he) (by positivity)
    (realAbortCoupling_of_R1 P h B outputs fs ab x M q Umin εexh hU hr)
    (idealAbortCoupling_of_R1 P h B outputs fs ab x Mi Umin hU hi)

/-- N = 8 attempts of at most 2^21 reads, q = 2^64 adversary reads, designated
fields of at least 2^255 values; the exhaustion slot is 2^-250, a loose upper
bound of 8 · 2^17 limbs · 2^-496 (design §5.4). -/
theorem r1_error_N8 :
    ((8 * 2 ^ 21 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((2 ^ 64 : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
      (((8 * 2 ^ 21 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((8 * 2 ^ 21 : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
        (1 / 2 ^ 250 : ℚ)) +
      ((8 * 2 ^ 21 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((8 * 2 ^ 21 : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) ≤
    1 / 2 ^ 166 := by
  norm_num

theorem zkfs_R1_abort_N8 (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    [Fintype fs.RealRand] [Nonempty fs.RealRand]
    [Fintype fs.IdealRand] [Nonempty fs.IdealRand]
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hh : HVZK_on (Bat := Bat) P h B outputs x)
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary)
    (hr : R1RealModel P h B outputs fs ab x (8 * 2 ^ 21) (2 ^ 64) (2 ^ 255)
      (1 / 2 ^ 250))
    (hi : R1IdealModel P h B outputs fs ab x (8 * 2 ^ 21) (2 ^ 255)) :
    ZK_FS h B outputs fs x (1 / 2 ^ 166) :=
  zkfs_mono h B outputs fs x _ _
    (zkfs_R1_abort P h B outputs fs x hh ab (8 * 2 ^ 21) (8 * 2 ^ 21) (2 ^ 64) (2 ^ 255)
      (1 / 2 ^ 250) (by positivity) (by positivity) hr hi)
    r1_error_N8

R0Z.FsAbortBounds:
import R0Z.LawTransport

/-! ZF1a/b (DESIGN-ZF1-COUPLINGS-R1 §5, §7): generic event-mass bounds for the
abort couplings. Everything here is over an arbitrary finite uniform space
`S`; nothing refers to the payload, the transcript or a concrete oracle.

* `mass` is the uniform mass of an event (the body of `FsAbort.eventMass`).
* union bounds over finite index sets (`mass_exists_le_card`);
* the conditioning step (`mass_cond_le`): if `S ≃ R × X`, an event `D` depends
  on `R` only and, for every `r` with `D`, the `X`-mass of `E` is at most `δ`,
  then `mass (D ∧ E) ≤ mass D * δ`;
* the first-read step (`hit_le`, `hitFresh_mass`): a read whose address does
  not move when a coordinate `u` moves, compared with an address that
  determines `u` (a designated field), agrees with probability `≤ 1/|U|`;
* the pair step (`pair_le`, `pairFresh_mass`) for prover-address collisions;
* the assembled events `HitEv` (charged reads hit by the adversary) and
  `CollEv` (address repetition among positions, at least one private), with
  `hitEv_mass_le : ≤ M*q/Umin` and `collEv_mass_le : ≤ M*M/Umin`.

The concrete facts (which coordinate is the designated field of which read,
and that the adversary's reads do not depend on it) are the hypotheses
`HitFresh` / `PairFresh`; they are source-correspondence facts about the R1
byte layout, not proved here. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R0Z.FsAbortBounds
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-! ### Uniform means -/

theorem mean_equiv' {R S : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype S] (e : R ≃ S) (f : R → ℚ) :
    mean f = mean (fun s => f (e.symm s)) := by
  unfold mean
  rw [Fintype.card_congr e]
  congr 1
  exact Fintype.sum_equiv e f (fun s => f (e.symm s)) (fun r => by simp)

theorem mean_mono' {R : Type} [Fintype R] (f g : R → ℚ) (h : ∀ r, f r ≤ g r) :
    mean f ≤ mean g :=
  div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun r _ => h r)) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

theorem mean_sum' {R ι : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype ι] (f : ι → R → ℚ) :
    mean (fun r => ∑ i, f i r) = ∑ i, mean (f i) := by
  unfold mean
  rw [Finset.sum_comm, Finset.sum_div]

theorem mean_add'' {R : Type} [Fintype R] (f g : R → ℚ) :
    mean (fun r => f r + g r) = mean f + mean g := by
  simp only [mean, Finset.sum_add_distrib, add_div]

theorem mean_mul_const {R : Type} [Fintype R] (f : R → ℚ) (c : ℚ) :
    mean (fun r => f r * c) = mean f * c := by
  unfold mean
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
  ring

theorem mean_const' {R : Type} [Fintype R] [Nonempty R] (c : ℚ) :
    mean (fun _ : R => c) = c := by
  unfold mean
  rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have h : (Fintype.card R : ℚ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero
  field_simp

/-! ### Event mass -/

/-- Uniform mass of an event; the same body as `FsAbort.eventMass`. -/
def mass {S : Type} [Fintype S] (E : S → Prop) : ℚ :=
  mean (fun s => if E s then (1 : ℚ) else 0)

theorem ind_nonneg (p : Prop) : 0 ≤ (if p then (1 : ℚ) else 0) := by
  split_ifs <;> norm_num

theorem ind_le_one (p : Prop) : (if p then (1 : ℚ) else 0) ≤ 1 := by
  split_ifs <;> norm_num

theorem mass_nonneg {S : Type} [Fintype S] (E : S → Prop) : 0 ≤ mass E :=
  div_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun s _ => ind_nonneg (E s))) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

theorem mass_le_one {S : Type} [Fintype S] (E : S → Prop) : mass E ≤ 1 := by
  unfold mass mean
  apply div_le_one_of_le₀ _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  have hs := Finset.sum_le_card_nsmul Finset.univ (fun s => if E s then (1 : ℚ) else 0) 1
    (fun s _ => ind_le_one (E s))
  simpa only [Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one] using hs

theorem mass_mono {S : Type} [Fintype S] (E E' : S → Prop) (h : ∀ s, E s → E' s) :
    mass E ≤ mass E' := by
  apply mean_mono'
  intro s
  by_cases h1 : E s
  · rw [if_pos h1, if_pos (h s h1)]
  · rw [if_neg h1]
    exact ind_nonneg (E' s)

theorem mass_congr {S : Type} [Fintype S] (E E' : S → Prop) (h : ∀ s, E s ↔ E' s) :
    mass E = mass E' :=
  le_antisymm (mass_mono E E' (fun s => (h s).mp)) (mass_mono E' E (fun s => (h s).mpr))

theorem mass_false {S : Type} [Fintype S] : mass (fun _ : S => False) = 0 := by
  simp [mass, mean]

theorem mass_true {S : Type} [Fintype S] [Nonempty S] : mass (fun _ : S => True) = 1 := by
  unfold mass
  simp only [if_true]
  exact mean_const' 1

theorem mass_or_le {S : Type} [Fintype S] (E E' : S → Prop) :
    mass (fun s => E s ∨ E' s) ≤ mass E + mass E' := by
  unfold mass
  rw [← mean_add'']
  apply mean_mono'
  intro s
  by_cases h1 : E s <;> by_cases h2 : E' s <;> simp [h1, h2]

theorem mass_exists_le {S ι : Type} [Fintype S] [Fintype ι] (E : ι → S → Prop) :
    mass (fun s => ∃ i, E i s) ≤ ∑ i, mass (E i) := by
  unfold mass
  rw [← mean_sum']
  apply mean_mono'
  intro s
  by_cases h : ∃ i, E i s
  · rw [if_pos h]
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := h
    have hle : (if E i s then (1 : ℚ) else 0) ≤ ∑ j, (if E j s then (1 : ℚ) else 0) :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => if E j s then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
        (fun j _ => ind_nonneg (E j s)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    rw [if_pos hi] at hle
    exact hle
  · rw [if_neg h]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => ind_nonneg (E j s))

/-- Union bound with a uniform per-index bound. -/
theorem mass_exists_le_card {S ι : Type} [Fintype S] [Fintype ι] (E : ι → S → Prop) (δ : ℚ)
    (h : ∀ i, mass (E i) ≤ δ) :
    mass (fun s => ∃ i, E i s) ≤ Fintype.card ι * δ := by
  refine (mass_exists_le E).trans ?_
  have hs := Finset.sum_le_card_nsmul Finset.univ (fun i => mass (E i)) δ (fun i _ => h i)
  simpa only [Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul] using hs

theorem mass_equiv {S T : Type} [Fintype S] [Fintype T] (e : S ≃ T) (E : S → Prop) :
    mass E = mass (fun t => E (e.symm t)) :=
  mean_equiv' e _

theorem mass_prod {R X : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype X] (E : R × X → Prop) :
    mass E = mean (fun r => mass (fun x => E (r, x))) :=
  LawTransport.mean_product _

/-- A single point of a finite uniform coordinate. -/
theorem mass_point {U : Type} [Fintype U] (u₀ : U) :
    mass (fun u => u = u₀) = 1 / Fintype.card U := by
  simp [mass, mean]

/-! ### Conditioning on the other coordinates -/

/-- If `S ≃ R × X`, `D` depends only on `R`, and on every `r` with `D` the
`X`-mass of `E` is at most `δ`, then `mass (D ∧ E) ≤ mass D * δ`. -/
theorem mass_cond_le {S R X : Type} [Fintype S] [Fintype R] [Fintype X] [Nonempty X]
    (e : S ≃ R × X) (D E : S → Prop) (δ : ℚ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hD : ∀ r x x', D (e.symm (r, x)) → D (e.symm (r, x')))
    (hE : ∀ r x₀, D (e.symm (r, x₀)) → mass (fun x => E (e.symm (r, x))) ≤ δ) :
    mass (fun s => D s ∧ E s) ≤ mass D * δ := by
  have hl : mass (fun s => D s ∧ E s) =
      mean (fun r => mass (fun x => D (e.symm (r, x)) ∧ E (e.symm (r, x)))) := by
    rw [mass_equiv e, mass_prod]
  have hr : mass D = mean (fun r => mass (fun x => D (e.symm (r, x)))) := by
    rw [mass_equiv e, mass_prod]
  rw [hl, hr, ← mean_mul_const]
  apply mean_mono'
  intro r
  by_cases h : ∃ x₀, D (e.symm (r, x₀))
  · obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := h
    have hall : ∀ x, D (e.symm (r, x)) := fun x => hD r x₀ x hx₀
    have h1 : mass (fun x => D (e.symm (r, x))) = 1 := by
      rw [mass_congr (fun x => D (e.symm (r, x))) (fun _ => True)
        (fun x => ⟨fun _ => trivial, fun _ => hall x⟩)]
      exact mass_true
    have h2 : mass (fun x => D (e.symm (r, x)) ∧ E (e.symm (r, x))) =
        mass (fun x => E (e.symm (r, x))) :=
      mass_congr _ _ (fun x => ⟨fun hx => hx.2, fun hx => ⟨hall x, hx⟩⟩)
    rw [h1, h2, one_mul]
    exact hE r x₀ hx₀
  · have h0 : mass (fun x => D (e.symm (r, x)) ∧ E (e.symm (r, x))) = 0 := by
      rw [mass_congr (fun x => D (e.symm (r, x)) ∧ E (e.symm (r, x))) (fun _ => False)
        (fun x => ⟨fun hx => h ⟨x, hx.1⟩, fun hx => hx.elim⟩)]
      exact mass_false
    rw [h0]
    exact mul_nonneg (mass_nonneg _) hδ

/-! ### First read against a designated field -/

/-- On `D`, the read `qa` does not move with the coordinate `u`; the address
`ga` determines `u` (its designated field). Then they agree on `D` with mass
at most `mass D / |U|`. -/
theorem hit_le {S R U A : Type} [Fintype S] [Fintype R] [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]
    (e : S ≃ R × U) (D : S → Prop) (qa ga : S → A) (π : R → A → U)
    (hD : ∀ r u u', D (e.symm (r, u)) → D (e.symm (r, u')))
    (hq : ∀ r u u', D (e.symm (r, u)) → qa (e.symm (r, u)) = qa (e.symm (r, u')))
    (hf : ∀ r u a, ga (e.symm (r, u)) = a → u = π r a) :
    mass (fun s => D s ∧ qa s = ga s) ≤ mass D * (1 / Fintype.card U) := by
  apply mass_cond_le e D (fun s => qa s = ga s) (1 / (Fintype.card U : ℚ)) (by positivity) hD
  intro r u₀ hu₀
  calc mass (fun u => qa (e.symm (r, u)) = ga (e.symm (r, u)))
      ≤ mass (fun u => u = π r (qa (e.symm (r, u₀)))) := by
        apply mass_mono
        intro u hu
        exact hf r u _ (hu.symm.trans (hq r u₀ u hu₀).symm)
    _ = 1 / Fintype.card U := mass_point _

/-- Collision of an address that does not move with `u` and one whose designated
field is `u`. -/
theorem pair_le {S R U A : Type} [Fintype S] [Fintype R] [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]
    (e : S ≃ R × U) (fa ga : S → A) (π : R → A → U)
    (hfa : ∀ r u u', fa (e.symm (r, u)) = fa (e.symm (r, u')))
    (hf : ∀ r u a, ga (e.symm (r, u)) = a → u = π r a) :
    mass (fun s => fa s = ga s) ≤ 1 / Fintype.card U := by
  have h := hit_le e (fun _ => True) fa ga π (fun _ _ _ _ => trivial)
    (fun r u u' _ => hfa r u u') hf
  calc mass (fun s => fa s = ga s) = mass (fun s => True ∧ fa s = ga s) :=
        mass_congr _ _ (fun s => ⟨fun hs => ⟨trivial, hs⟩, fun hs => hs.2⟩)
    _ ≤ mass (fun _ : S => True) * (1 / Fintype.card U) := h
    _ ≤ 1 * (1 / Fintype.card U) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mass_le_one _) (by positivity)
    _ = 1 / Fintype.card U := one_mul _

/-! ### The named freshness hypotheses -/

/-- Hit freshness of a charged read: there is a coordinate `u` of the coupling
space, of at least `Umin` values, that is the designated field of `ga`, while
the charging event `D` and the adversary read `qa` (on `D`) do not depend on it. -/
def HitFresh {S A : Type} [Fintype S] (D : S → Prop) (qa ga : S → A) (Umin : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ (R U : Type) (_ : Fintype R) (_ : Fintype U) (_ : Nonempty U) (e : S ≃ R × U)
    (π : R → A → U),
    Umin ≤ Fintype.card U ∧
    (∀ r u u', D (e.symm (r, u)) → D (e.symm (r, u'))) ∧
    (∀ r u u', D (e.symm (r, u)) → qa (e.symm (r, u)) = qa (e.symm (r, u'))) ∧
    (∀ r u a, ga (e.symm (r, u)) = a → u = π r a)

/-- Pair freshness: the two addresses never coincide (structurally distinct), or
the second has a designated field on which the first does not depend. -/
def PairFresh {S A : Type} [Fintype S] (fa ga : S → A) (Umin : ℕ) : Prop :=
  (∀ s, fa s ≠ ga s) ∨
  ∃ (R U : Type) (_ : Fintype R) (_ : Fintype U) (_ : Nonempty U) (e : S ≃ R × U)
    (π : R → A → U),
    Umin ≤ Fintype.card U ∧
    (∀ r u u', fa (e.symm (r, u)) = fa (e.symm (r, u'))) ∧
    (∀ r u a, ga (e.symm (r, u)) = a → u = π r a)

theorem one_div_card_le {U : Type} [Fintype U] (Umin : ℕ) (hU : 0 < Umin)
    (hc : Umin ≤ Fintype.card U) : (1 : ℚ) / Fintype.card U ≤ 1 / Umin :=
  one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by exact_mod_cast hU) (by exact_mod_cast hc)

theorem hitFresh_mass {S A : Type} [Fintype S] (D : S → Prop) (qa ga : S → A) (Umin : ℕ)
    (hU : 0 < Umin) (hF : HitFresh D qa ga Umin) :
    mass (fun s => D s ∧ qa s = ga s) ≤ 1 / Umin := by
  obtain ⟨R, U, iR, iU, hne, e, π, hcard, hD, hq, hf⟩ := hF
  calc mass (fun s => D s ∧ qa s = ga s) ≤ mass D * (1 / Fintype.card U) :=
        hit_le e D qa ga π hD hq hf
    _ ≤ 1 * (1 / Fintype.card U) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mass_le_one D) (by positivity)
    _ = 1 / Fintype.card U := one_mul _
    _ ≤ 1 / Umin := one_div_card_le Umin hU hcard

theorem pairFresh_mass_one {S A : Type} [Fintype S] (fa ga : S → A) (Umin : ℕ)
    (hU : 0 < Umin) (hF : PairFresh fa ga Umin) :
    mass (fun s => fa s = ga s) ≤ 1 / Umin := by
  rcases hF with hne | ⟨R, U, iR, iU, hn, e, π, hcard, hfa, hf⟩
  · calc mass (fun s => fa s = ga s) ≤ mass (fun _ : S => False) :=
          mass_mono _ _ (fun s hs => hne s hs)
      _ = 0 := mass_false
      _ ≤ 1 / Umin := by positivity
  · exact (pair_le e fa ga π hfa hf).trans (one_div_card_le Umin hU hcard)

theorem pairFresh_mass {S A : Type} [Fintype S] (fa ga : S → A) (Umin : ℕ)
    (hU : 0 < Umin) (hF : PairFresh fa ga Umin ∨ PairFresh ga fa Umin) :
    mass (fun s => fa s = ga s) ≤ 1 / Umin := by
  rcases hF with h | h
  · exact pairFresh_mass_one fa ga Umin hU h
  · rw [mass_congr (fun s => fa s = ga s) (fun s => ga s = fa s) (fun s => eq_comm)]
    exact pairFresh_mass_one ga fa Umin hU h

/-! ### The assembled events -/

/-- Some charged prover position (a discarded attempt's read, or an unpublished
read of the accepted attempt) is read by the adversary. -/
def HitEv {S A : Type} (M q : ℕ) (charged : Fin M → S → Prop) (qry : Fin q → S → A)
    (addr : Fin M → S → A) (s : S) : Prop :=
  ∃ j i, charged j s ∧ qry i s = addr j s

/-- Two prover positions, at least one private, have the same address. -/
def CollEv {S A : Type} (M : ℕ) (priv : Fin M → Prop) (addr : Fin M → S → A) (s : S) : Prop :=
  ∃ j j', j < j' ∧ (priv j ∨ priv j') ∧ addr j s = addr j' s

/-- First-read union bound: `M` positions, `q` adversary reads. -/
theorem hitEv_mass_le {S A : Type} [Fintype S] (M q : ℕ) (charged : Fin M → S → Prop)
    (qry : Fin q → S → A) (addr : Fin M → S → A) (δ : ℚ)
    (h : ∀ j i, mass (fun s => charged j s ∧ qry i s = addr j s) ≤ δ) :
    mass (HitEv M q charged qry addr) ≤ M * q * δ := by
  have hu := mass_exists_le_card (ι := Fin M × Fin q)
    (fun p s => charged p.1 s ∧ qry p.2 s = addr p.1 s) δ (fun p => h p.1 p.2)
  calc mass (HitEv M q charged qry addr)
      ≤ mass (fun s => ∃ p : Fin M × Fin q, charged p.1 s ∧ qry p.2 s = addr p.1 s) :=
        mass_mono _ _ (fun s hs => by
          obtain ⟨j, i, hji⟩ := hs
          exact ⟨(j, i), hji⟩)
    _ ≤ Fintype.card (Fin M × Fin q) * δ := hu
    _ = M * q * δ := by
        rw [Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_fin]
        push_cast
        ring

/-- Pair union bound over the ordered pairs of `M` positions. -/
theorem collEv_mass_le {S A : Type} [Fintype S] (M : ℕ) (priv : Fin M → Prop)
    (addr : Fin M → S → A) (δ : ℚ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (h : ∀ j j', j < j' → (priv j ∨ priv j') → mass (fun s => addr j s = addr j' s) ≤ δ) :
    mass (CollEv M priv addr) ≤ M * M * δ := by
  have hp : ∀ p : Fin M × Fin M,
      mass (fun s => p.1 < p.2 ∧ (priv p.1 ∨ priv p.2) ∧ addr p.1 s = addr p.2 s) ≤ δ := by
    intro p
    by_cases hc : p.1 < p.2 ∧ (priv p.1 ∨ priv p.2)
    · calc mass (fun s => p.1 < p.2 ∧ (priv p.1 ∨ priv p.2) ∧ addr p.1 s = addr p.2 s)
          ≤ mass (fun s => addr p.1 s = addr p.2 s) := mass_mono _ _ (fun s hs => hs.2.2)
        _ ≤ δ := h p.1 p.2 hc.1 hc.2
    · calc mass (fun s => p.1 < p.2 ∧ (priv p.1 ∨ priv p.2) ∧ addr p.1 s = addr p.2 s)
          ≤ mass (fun _ : S => False) := mass_mono _ _ (fun s hs => hc ⟨hs.1, hs.2.1⟩)
        _ = 0 := mass_false
        _ ≤ δ := hδ
  have hu := mass_exists_le_card (ι := Fin M × Fin M)
    (fun p s => p.1 < p.2 ∧ (priv p.1 ∨ priv p.2) ∧ addr p.1 s = addr p.2 s) δ hp
  calc mass (CollEv M priv addr)
      ≤ mass (fun s => ∃ p : Fin M × Fin M,
          p.1 < p.2 ∧ (priv p.1 ∨ priv p.2) ∧ addr p.1 s = addr p.2 s) :=
        mass_mono _ _ (fun s hs => by
          obtain ⟨j, j', hjj⟩ := hs
          exact ⟨(j, j'), hjj⟩)
    _ ≤ Fintype.card (Fin M × Fin M) * δ := hu
    _ = M * M * δ := by
        rw [Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin]
        push_cast
        ring

/-- `HitEv` under per-read hit freshness. -/
theorem hitEv_mass_fresh {S A : Type} [Fintype S] (M q Umin : ℕ) (hU : 0 < Umin)
    (charged : Fin M → S → Prop) (qry : Fin q → S → A) (addr : Fin M → S → A)
    (hF : ∀ j i, HitFresh (charged j) (qry i) (addr j) Umin) :
    mass (HitEv M q charged qry addr) ≤ M * q / Umin := by
  have h := hitEv_mass_le M q charged qry addr (1 / Umin)
    (fun j i => hitFresh_mass (charged j) (qry i) (addr j) Umin hU (hF j i))
  calc mass (HitEv M q charged qry addr) ≤ M * q * (1 / Umin) := h
    _ = M * q / Umin := by ring

/-- `CollEv` under pair freshness of every private-involving pair. -/
theorem collEv_mass_fresh {S A : Type} [Fintype S] (M Umin : ℕ) (hU : 0 < Umin)
    (priv : Fin M → Prop) (addr : Fin M → S → A)
    (hF : ∀ j j', j < j' → (priv j ∨ priv j') →
      PairFresh (addr j) (addr j') Umin ∨ PairFresh (addr j') (addr j) Umin) :
    mass (CollEv M priv addr) ≤ M * M / Umin := by
  have h := collEv_mass_le M priv addr (1 / Umin) (by positivity)
    (fun j j' hj hp => pairFresh_mass (addr j) (addr j') Umin hU (hF j j' hj hp))
  calc mass (CollEv M priv addr) ≤ M * M * (1 / Umin) := h
    _ = M * M / Umin := by ring

import R0Z.PayloadSplit
import R1Z.BatchedAlgebra

/-! R1-2 (DESIGN-R1-PRIVACY-MODEL §2.3, §4; LOG D30, D32, D33): the R1 batched
opening block as an instance of `HonestView.BatchedLayer`.

R1 batches the 29 transported coefficient words with powers of γ (no chord
quotient), pairs the batch with the κ-batched weights of seven functionals
(inactive rows, three claim points, Libra, two OOD points), and folds twice
(α₀ on the 1024-coefficient vector, α₁ on the 256-coefficient one).  The
disclosed cells are the two round polynomials (7 coefficients each), the
query-gated folded word (`FoldedOpen`) and the 64 final coefficients.

All sums over rows are symbolic; the π reindexing is `Equiv.sum_comp`. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

namespace R1Z.Batched

open scoped BigOperators
open R0P R0P.SemSource R0Z.MaskLayout R0Z.HonestView
open AspisPool.AlgorithmicCircleDecoderV7

attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
attribute [local irreducible] copyLinks copyPatterns copyActiveRowMasks copyInactiveRows

/-! ## The cell type -/

/-- R1's batched cells: two round polynomials, the folded word, the final
coefficients. -/
inductive R1Bat
  | round0 (i : Fin 7)
  | round1 (i : Fin 7)
  | folded (p : Fin 262144)
  | final (e : Fin 64)
  deriving DecidableEq

/-- `R1Bat` as a sum of finite types (used only for `Fintype`). -/
def R1Bat.equivSum : R1Bat ≃ (Fin 7 ⊕ Fin 7) ⊕ (Fin 262144 ⊕ Fin 64) where
  toFun
    | .round0 i => .inl (.inl i)
    | .round1 i => .inl (.inr i)
    | .folded p => .inr (.inl p)
    | .final e => .inr (.inr e)
  invFun
    | .inl (.inl i) => .round0 i
    | .inl (.inr i) => .round1 i
    | .inr (.inl p) => .folded p
    | .inr (.inr e) => .final e
  left_inv b := by cases b <;> rfl
  right_inv x := by rcases x with (i | i) | (p | e) <;> rfl

instance : Fintype R1Bat := Fintype.ofEquiv _ R1Bat.equivSum.symm

variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K]

/-! ## Challenge names (transcript rows 27–30) -/

abbrev gamma (ch : Challenges K) : K := ch.opening 0
abbrev kappa (ch : Challenges K) : K := ch.opening 1
abbrev alpha0 (ch : Challenges K) : K := ch.opening 2
abbrev alpha1 (ch : Challenges K) : K := ch.opening 3

/-! ## Batch and weights -/

/-- γ-batch of the 29 transported coefficient words (no quotient). -/
def batchR1 (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) :
    Trace K →ₗ[K] InitialMessage K :=
  ∑ c : Fin 29, ch.opening 0 ^ c.val • (coeffsLinear π).comp (LinearMap.proj c)

/-- Any functional of the batch is the γ-batch of the functional of each word. -/
theorem map_batchR1 (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K)
    (f : InitialMessage K →ₗ[K] K) (t : Trace K) :
    f (batchR1 π ch t) = ∑ c : Fin 29, ch.opening 0 ^ c.val * f (coeffsLinear π (t c)) := by
  simp only [batchR1, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    LinearMap.proj_apply, map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]

theorem dotLinear_apply {n : Nat} (w x : Fin n → K) :
    dotLinear w x = ∑ i : Fin n, w i * x i := by
  simp only [dotLinear, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply,
    smul_eq_mul]

/-- Row weights read through π: `Equiv.sum_comp`, no enumeration of rows. -/
theorem dot_reindex (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (w x : InitialMessage K) :
    dotLinear (fun j => w (π.symm j)) (coeffsLinear π x) = dotLinear w x := by
  simp only [dotLinear_apply, coeffsLinear_apply]
  exact Equiv.sum_comp π.symm (fun r => w r * x r)

/- From here on `dotLinear` (a sum over 1024 rows) is never unfolded by
definitional checks. -/
attribute [local irreducible] dotLinear

/-- The seven coefficient functionals (weights.rs kinds: inactive rows, the
three claim points, Libra, the two OOD points). -/
def ell (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) : Fin 7 → (InitialMessage K →ₗ[K] K) :=
  ![dotLinear (fun j => AspisR0.Opening.indicator copyInactiveRows (π.symm j)),
    dotLinear (fun j => AspisR0.Opening.eqWeight (openingPoints (alpha ch) 0) (π.symm j)),
    dotLinear (fun j => AspisR0.Opening.eqWeight (openingPoints (alpha ch) 1) (π.symm j)),
    dotLinear (fun j => AspisR0.Opening.eqWeight (openingPoints (alpha ch) 2) (π.symm j)),
    dotLinear (libraWeight (alpha ch)),
    oodLinear (ch.circle 0),
    oodLinear (ch.circle 1)]

theorem ell_zero (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) : ell π ch 0 =
    dotLinear (fun j => AspisR0.Opening.indicator copyInactiveRows (π.symm j)) := rfl
theorem ell_one (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) : ell π ch 1 =
    dotLinear (fun j => AspisR0.Opening.eqWeight (openingPoints (alpha ch) 0) (π.symm j)) := rfl
theorem ell_two (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) : ell π ch 2 =
    dotLinear (fun j => AspisR0.Opening.eqWeight (openingPoints (alpha ch) 1) (π.symm j)) := rfl
theorem ell_three (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) : ell π ch 3 =
    dotLinear (fun j => AspisR0.Opening.eqWeight (openingPoints (alpha ch) 2) (π.symm j)) := rfl
theorem ell_four (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) : ell π ch 4 =
    dotLinear (libraWeight (alpha ch)) := rfl
theorem ell_five (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) : ell π ch 5 =
    oodLinear (ch.circle 0) := rfl
theorem ell_six (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) : ell π ch 6 =
    oodLinear (ch.circle 1) := rfl

/-! ### `ell_batchR1`: each functional of the batch is the γ-batched own value -/

theorem ell_batch_inactive (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K) :
    ell π ch 0 (batchR1 π ch t) = ∑ c : Fin 29, ch.opening 0 ^ c.val *
      dotLinear (AspisR0.Opening.indicator copyInactiveRows) (t c) := by
  rw [ell_zero, map_batchR1]
  simp only [dot_reindex]

private theorem eq_batch (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) (p : Fin 10 → K)
    (t : Trace K) :
    dotLinear (fun j => AspisR0.Opening.eqWeight p (π.symm j)) (batchR1 π ch t) =
      ∑ c : Fin 29, ch.opening 0 ^ c.val * dotLinear (AspisR0.Opening.eqWeight p) (t c) := by
  rw [map_batchR1]
  simp only [dot_reindex]

theorem ell_batch_claim0 (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K) :
    ell π ch 1 (batchR1 π ch t) =
      ∑ c : Fin 29, ch.opening 0 ^ c.val * claimsLinear (alpha ch) 0 c t := by
  rw [ell_one, eq_batch]
  rfl

theorem ell_batch_claim1 (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K) :
    ell π ch 2 (batchR1 π ch t) =
      ∑ c : Fin 29, ch.opening 0 ^ c.val * claimsLinear (alpha ch) 1 c t := by
  rw [ell_two, eq_batch]
  rfl

theorem ell_batch_claim2 (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K) :
    ell π ch 3 (batchR1 π ch t) =
      ∑ c : Fin 29, ch.opening 0 ^ c.val * claimsLinear (alpha ch) 2 c t := by
  rw [ell_three, eq_batch]
  rfl

theorem ell_batch_extra (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K) :
    ell π ch 4 (batchR1 π ch t) =
      ∑ c : Fin 29, ch.opening 0 ^ c.val * extraLinear π (alpha ch) c t := by
  rw [ell_four, map_batchR1]
  rfl

theorem ell_batch_ood0 (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K) :
    ell π ch 5 (batchR1 π ch t) =
      ∑ c : Fin 29, ch.opening 0 ^ c.val * oodLinear (ch.circle 0) (coeffsLinear π (t c)) := by
  rw [ell_five, map_batchR1]

theorem ell_batch_ood1 (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K) :
    ell π ch 6 (batchR1 π ch t) =
      ∑ c : Fin 29, ch.opening 0 ^ c.val * oodLinear (ch.circle 1) (coeffsLinear π (t c)) := by
  rw [ell_six, map_batchR1]

/-- κ-batched weights `w j = Σ_k κ^k ℓ_k(e_j)`. -/
def weightsR1 (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) : InitialMessage K :=
  R1Z.BatchedAlgebra.weightsOf (ch.opening 1) (ell π ch)

theorem dot_weightsR1 (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) (q : InitialMessage K) :
    AspisR1.RoundPairing.dot q (weightsR1 π ch) =
      ∑ k : Fin 7, ch.opening 1 ^ k.val * ell π ch k q :=
  R1Z.BatchedAlgebra.dot_weightsOf (ch.opening 1) (ell π ch) q

/-! ## The two fold layers -/

/-- The α₀-folded 256 coefficients. -/
def q1 (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) : Trace K →ₗ[K] (Fin 256 → K) :=
  (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.coefficientFoldLayer 256 (ch.opening 2)).comp
    (batchR1 π ch)

def w1 (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) : Fin 256 → K :=
  AspisR1.RoundPairing.dualFold (n := 256) (ch.opening 2) (weightsR1 π ch)

def w2 (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) : Fin 64 → K :=
  AspisR1.RoundPairing.dualFold (n := 64) (ch.opening 3) (w1 π ch)

/-- A folded symbol is disclosed iff its parent fibre holds a query. -/
def FoldedOpen (ch : Challenges K) (p : Fin 262144) : Prop :=
  ∃ u ∈ ch.queries, u.val / 4 = p.val / 4

/-- The round polynomial as a K-linear map of the message, for fixed weights. -/
def roundPolynomialLinear {n : Nat} (w : Fin (4 * n) → K) :
    (Fin (4 * n) → K) →ₗ[K] Polynomial K :=
  ∑ d : Fin n, ∑ s : Fin 4, ∑ u : Fin 4,
    (LinearMap.proj (AspisR1.childIndex d s)).smulRight
      (Polynomial.monomial (s.val + (4 - u.val) % 4)
        (AspisR1.RoundPairing.quarter * w (AspisR1.childIndex d u)))

theorem roundPolynomialLinear_apply {n : Nat} (w q : Fin (4 * n) → K) :
    roundPolynomialLinear w q = AspisR1.RoundPairing.roundPolynomial q w := by
  simp only [roundPolynomialLinear, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smulRight_apply,
    LinearMap.proj_apply, Polynomial.smul_monomial, smul_eq_mul,
    AspisR1.RoundPairing.roundPolynomial]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro d _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro s _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro u _
  congr 1
  ring

/-! ## The read and the instance -/

/-- The R1 read of the batched block (prover.rs prove_from_semantics). -/
def r1Read (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) : Trace K →ₗ[K] (R1Bat → K) :=
  LinearMap.pi fun b => match b with
  | .round0 i => (Polynomial.lcoeff K i.val).comp
      ((roundPolynomialLinear (n := 256) (weightsR1 π ch)).comp (batchR1 π ch))
  | .round1 i => (Polynomial.lcoeff K i.val).comp
      ((roundPolynomialLinear (n := 64) (w1 π ch)).comp (q1 π ch))
  | .folded p => if FoldedOpen ch p then
      (LinearMap.proj p).comp (AspisWide.FinalEncoder.exactFinalLinear.comp (q1 π ch)) else 0
  | .final e => (LinearMap.proj e).comp
      ((AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.coefficientFoldLayer 64 (ch.opening 3)).comp
        (q1 π ch))

instance instBatchedLayer : BatchedLayer K R1Bat where
  read := r1Read

/-- R1 payload cells. -/
abbrev R1Payload (K : Type) := Payload K R1Bat

attribute [local irreducible] batchR1 weightsR1 w1 q1 roundPolynomialLinear

/-! ## `batRead_L`: the four cell formulas -/

theorem read_round0 (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K) (i : Fin 7) :
    BatchedLayer.read (Bat := R1Bat) π ch t (.round0 i) =
      (AspisR1.RoundPairing.roundPolynomial (n := 256) (batchR1 π ch t) (weightsR1 π ch)).coeff
        i.val := by
  show r1Read π ch t (.round0 i) = _
  simp only [r1Read, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, Polynomial.lcoeff_apply,
    roundPolynomialLinear_apply]

theorem read_round1 (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K) (i : Fin 7) :
    BatchedLayer.read (Bat := R1Bat) π ch t (.round1 i) =
      (AspisR1.RoundPairing.roundPolynomial (n := 64) (q1 π ch t) (w1 π ch)).coeff i.val := by
  show r1Read π ch t (.round1 i) = _
  simp only [r1Read, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, Polynomial.lcoeff_apply,
    roundPolynomialLinear_apply]

theorem read_folded (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K)
    (p : Fin 262144) (h : FoldedOpen ch p) :
    BatchedLayer.read (Bat := R1Bat) π ch t (.folded p) =
      AspisWide.FinalEncoder.exactFinalLinear (q1 π ch t) p := by
  show r1Read π ch t (.folded p) = _
  simp only [r1Read, LinearMap.pi_apply, if_pos h, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply]

theorem folded_unqueried_zero (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K)
    (p : Fin 262144) (h : ¬ FoldedOpen ch p) :
    BatchedLayer.read (Bat := R1Bat) π ch t (.folded p) = 0 := by
  show r1Read π ch t (.folded p) = _
  simp only [r1Read, LinearMap.pi_apply, if_neg h, LinearMap.zero_apply]

theorem read_final (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K) (e : Fin 64) :
    BatchedLayer.read (Bat := R1Bat) π ch t (.final e) =
      AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.coefficientFoldLayer 64 (ch.opening 3)
        (q1 π ch t) e := rfl

/-- The payload's batched cells are the R1 read (no other cell is touched). -/
theorem L_bat {F : Subfield K} (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F)
    (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K) (b : R1Bat) :
    R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch t (.bat b) =
      BatchedLayer.read (Bat := R1Bat) π ch t b := rfl

#print axioms R1Bat.equivSum
#print axioms map_batchR1
#print axioms dot_reindex
#print axioms ell_batch_inactive
#print axioms ell_batch_claim0
#print axioms ell_batch_claim1
#print axioms ell_batch_claim2
#print axioms ell_batch_extra
#print axioms ell_batch_ood0
#print axioms ell_batch_ood1
#print axioms dot_weightsR1
#print axioms roundPolynomialLinear_apply

#print axioms read_round1

#print axioms folded_unqueried_zero

end R1Z.Batched
