R0Z.FsAbortTape:
import R0Z.FsAbortBounds

/-! ZF1a/b on R1 (DESIGN-ZF1-COUPLINGS-R1 §3.1, §5.2): two generic facts used
by the tape factor of the real coupling.

* `mean_decodeOrSpare`: a rejection decoder `dec : B → Option T` whose fibres
  over `some t` all have the same size, completed by an independent uniform
  spare on `none`, is measure-preserving onto uniform `T`. This is the
  `meanM` half of the tape coupling once the R1 mask sampler's equal-fibre
  property is given (HYP; by symmetry of the accepted word values).
* `mass_fst`: an event of the first factor of a product has its own mass
  (used to read the tape factor off the coupling space).
The per-limb exhaustion mass `(2/2^32)^16` of §5.2 is not formalised here
(HYP H-exh). -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R0Z.FsAbortTape
open R0Z.FsAbortBounds
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-! ### Rejection with a uniform spare -/

theorem sum_fibres {B T : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype T] (dec : B → Option T) (g : Option T → ℚ) :
    ∑ b, g (dec b) =
      ((Finset.univ.filter (fun b => dec b = none)).card : ℚ) * g none +
        ∑ t, ((Finset.univ.filter (fun b => dec b = some t)).card : ℚ) * g (some t) := by
  have hc : ∀ o : Option T, ∑ b ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun b => dec b = o), g (dec b) =
      ((Finset.univ.filter (fun b => dec b = o)).card : ℚ) * g o := by
    intro o
    calc ∑ b ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun b => dec b = o), g (dec b)
        = ∑ b ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun b => dec b = o), g o :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b hb => by rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hb).2])
      _ = ((Finset.univ.filter (fun b => dec b = o)).card : ℚ) * g o := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
  rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ dec (fun b => g (dec b)), Fintype.sum_option, hc none]
  congr 1
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun t _ => hc (some t))

theorem mean_decodeOrSpare {B T : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype T] [Nonempty B] [Nonempty T]
    (dec : B → Option T) (c : ℕ)
    (hfib : ∀ t, (Finset.univ.filter (fun b => dec b = some t)).card = c) (f : T → ℚ) :
    mean (fun p : B × T => f ((dec p.1).getD p.2)) = mean f := by
  set n0 : ℚ := ((Finset.univ.filter (fun b => dec b = none)).card : ℚ) with hn0
  set F : ℚ := ∑ t, f t with hF
  have hT : (Fintype.card T : ℚ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have hB : (Fintype.card B : ℚ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero
  let w : Option T → ℚ := fun o => match o with
    | none => F
    | some t => (Fintype.card T : ℚ) * f t
  have hinner : ∀ b, ∑ t', f ((dec b).getD t') = w (dec b) := by
    intro b
    cases hb : dec b with
    | none => simp [w, hF]
    | some t => simp [w, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hnum : ∑ p : B × T, f ((dec p.1).getD p.2) =
      (n0 + c * Fintype.card T) * F := by
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    simp only [hinner]
    rw [sum_fibres dec w]
    simp only [hfib, w]
    rw [← hn0, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← hF]
    ring
  have hcard : (Fintype.card B : ℚ) = n0 + c * Fintype.card T := by
    have h1 := sum_fibres dec (fun _ => (1 : ℚ))
    simp only [mul_one, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, hfib] at h1
    rw [← hn0] at h1
    rw [h1]
    ring
  unfold mean
  rw [hnum, Fintype.card_prod, Nat.cast_mul, ← hcard, hF]
  exact mul_div_mul_left _ _ hB

/-! ### Product marginal -/

/-- An event of the first factor of a product has its own mass. -/
theorem mass_fst {R X : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype X] [Nonempty X] (Q : R → Prop) :
    mass (fun t : R × X => Q t.1) = mass Q := by
  rw [mass_prod]
  show mean _ = mean _
  congr 1
  funext r
  by_cases hq : Q r
  · rw [if_pos hq, mass_congr (fun x : X => Q (r, x).1) (fun _ => True)
      (fun _ => ⟨fun _ => trivial, fun _ => hq⟩)]
    exact mass_true
  · rw [if_neg hq, mass_congr (fun x : X => Q (r, x).1) (fun _ => False)
      (fun _ => ⟨fun h => hq h, fun h => h.elim⟩)]
    exact mass_false

#print axioms sum_fibres
#print axioms mean_decodeOrSpare
#print axioms mass_fst
end R0Z.FsAbortTape
R1Z.QueryScanSharedHistoryMass:
import R1Z.QueryScanSharedHistoryObstruction
import R1Z.QueryScanIdealHistory

/-! Even unconditioned, a uniform shared-ROM scan from a fixed input state
has a self-loop contribution. This is a scan-subrun result, not a lower bound
on the complete release game's differently distributed starting state. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.QueryScanSharedHistoryMass
open R0Z R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.HvzkV R1Z.CouplingR1PBin
  R1Z.QueryScanSharedHistoryObstruction R1Z.PhaseSamplerParserBin
  R1Z.PhaseQueryScanBin R1Z.QueryScanPrivacyFinal
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

theorem eval_uniform {A U : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]
    (a : A) : MP (fun t : A → U => t a) := by
  intro f
  have he := mp_equiv (R1Z.LazyTable.splitAt (U := U) a) (fun p => f p.1)
  exact he.trans (mp_fst f)

theorem point_mass {U : Type} [Fintype U] (u : U) :
    eventMass (fun v : U => v = u) = 1 / (Fintype.card U : ℚ) := by
  unfold eventMass mean
  simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]

theorem eval_point_mass {A U : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]
    (a : A) (u : U) : eventMass (fun t : A → U => t a = u) = 1 / (Fintype.card U : ℚ) := by
  have hu := eval_uniform (U := U) a (fun v => if v = u then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
  exact hu.trans (point_mass u)

theorem self_loop_mass (bound : ℕ) (hbound : 33 ≤ bound) :
    eventMass (fun tab : R1Z.RomFiniteBin.Address bound → OracleAnswer =>
      R1Z.RomFiniteBin.lookup bound tab (advanceAddress 0) = 0) =
      1 / (Fintype.card OracleAnswer : ℚ) := by
  let a : R1Z.RomFiniteBin.Address bound :=
    ⟨advanceAddress 0, (loop_addresses_in_domain bound hbound 0).2⟩
  have he (tab : R1Z.RomFiniteBin.Address bound → OracleAnswer) :
      R1Z.RomFiniteBin.lookup bound tab (advanceAddress 0) = tab a := by
    unfold R1Z.RomFiniteBin.lookup
    rw [show R1Z.RomFiniteBin.decode bound (advanceAddress 0) = some a from
      R1Z.RomFiniteBin.decode_encode bound a]
  simp only [he]
  exact eval_point_mass a (0 : OracleAnswer)

theorem uniform_shared_scan_failure_lower_bound (bound : ℕ) (hbound : 33 ≤ bound) :
    1 / (Fintype.card OracleAnswer : ℚ) ≤
    eventMass (fun tab : R1Z.RomFiniteBin.Address bound → OracleAnswer =>
      ∃ count, AspisV8R19.Q22WordScan.finish (scanned
        (stop done (queryBlocks (R1Z.RomFiniteBin.lookup bound tab) 0))
        (queryBlocks (R1Z.RomFiniteBin.lookup bound tab) 0)).1 = .error count) := by
  rw [← self_loop_mass bound hbound]
  exact eventMass_mono _ _ (fun tab ht => shared_loop_finish_fails _ _ ht)

/-- Count the bytes symbolically; no universe of answers is reduced. -/
theorem answer_cardinality : Fintype.card OracleAnswer = 2^256 := by
  have hA : ∀ j : Fintype OracleAnswer, @Fintype.card OracleAnswer j = 2^256 := fun j =>
    (congrArg (@Fintype.card OracleAnswer) (Subsingleton.elim j _)).trans R1Z.LensR1.card_ans
  exact hA _

theorem scanProbability_lt_self_loop_mass :
    scanProbability < 1 / (Fintype.card OracleAnswer : ℚ) := by
  rw [answer_cardinality, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat]
  apply scan_probability_le.trans_lt
  apply one_div_lt_one_div_of_lt (by positivity)
  exact pow_lt_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega : 256 < 486)

theorem uniform_shared_scan_not_independent_bound (bound : ℕ) (hbound : 33 ≤ bound) :
    ¬ eventMass (fun tab : R1Z.RomFiniteBin.Address bound → OracleAnswer =>
      ∃ count, AspisV8R19.Q22WordScan.finish (scanned
        (stop done (queryBlocks (R1Z.RomFiniteBin.lookup bound tab) 0))
        (queryBlocks (R1Z.RomFiniteBin.lookup bound tab) 0)).1 = .error count) ≤ scanProbability := by
  intro hh
  exact not_le_of_gt scanProbability_lt_self_loop_mass
    ((uniform_shared_scan_failure_lower_bound bound hbound).trans hh)

#print axioms eval_uniform
#print axioms point_mass

R1Z.QueryScanSharedHistoryObstruction:
import R1Z.QueryScanHistorySplit
import R1Z.PhaseSamplerParserBin
import R1Z.RomObserverBin

/-! A legal shared-ROM query-state self-loop. Re-reading a known address
is deterministic even though the unconditioned table is uniform. The scan
argument is symbolic in its words, prefix length and scan state. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.QueryScanSharedHistoryObstruction
open R0Z R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.LensR1
  R1Z.PhaseSamplerParserBin R1Z.PhaseQueryScanBin R1Z.QueryScanPrivacyFinal
  R1Z.QueryScanHistorySplit AspisV8R19.Q22WordScan
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-- Query read addresses are exactly the existing transcript grammar. -/
def squeezeAddress (s : OracleAnswer) : List UInt8 := ans s ++ [1]
def advanceAddress (s : OracleAnswer) : List UInt8 := ans s ++ [2]

def queryState (H : List UInt8 → OracleAnswer) (s : OracleAnswer) : ℕ → OracleAnswer
  | 0 => s
  | n+1 => H (advanceAddress (queryState H s n))

def queryBlocks (H : List UInt8 → OracleAnswer) (s : OracleAnswer) : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer :=
  fun k => H (squeezeAddress (queryState H s k.val))

theorem queryState_self_loop (H : List UInt8 → OracleAnswer) (s : OracleAnswer)
    (loop : H (advanceAddress s) = s) (n : ℕ) : queryState H s n = s := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simpa only [queryState, ih] using loop

theorem queryBlocks_self_loop (H : List UInt8 → OracleAnswer) (s : OracleAnswer)
    (loop : H (advanceAddress s) = s) : queryBlocks H s = fun _ => H (squeezeAddress s) := by
  funext k
  unfold queryBlocks
  rw [queryState_self_loop H s loop]

/-- Both addresses use the retained model grammar, including its LE bytes;
there is no invented query-counter domain separation in this example. -/
theorem transcript_query_addresses (rest : R1Z.TranscriptR1.Rest)
    (s : OracleAnswer) (k : Fin 8) :
    R1Z.TranscriptR1.addrWith (.qb k) s rest = squeezeAddress s ∧
    R1Z.TranscriptR1.addrWith (.qa k) s rest = advanceAddress s := ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

/-- The zero-answer history is actually reachable in the in-order evaluator
for every address program. This induction never unfolds the read count. -/
theorem zero_oracle_runN {A : Type} {m : ℕ}
    (a : Fin m → (Fin m → OracleAnswer) → A) (n : ℕ) :
    R1Z.LazyFrozen.runN a (fun _ => 0) 0 n = fun _ => 0 := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [R1Z.LazyFrozen.runN_succ, ih]
      split
      · funext i
        simp only [Function.update_apply]
        split <;> rfl
      · rfl

theorem zero_oracle_runC {A : Type} {m : ℕ}
    (a : Fin m → (Fin m → OracleAnswer) → A) :
    R1Z.LazyFrozen.runC a (fun _ => 0) 0 = fun _ => 0 := zero_oracle_runN a m

theorem zero_table_lookup (bound : ℕ) :
    R1Z.RomFiniteBin.lookup bound (fun _ => 0) = fun _ => 0 := by
  funext bs
  unfold R1Z.RomFiniteBin.lookup
  cases R1Z.RomFiniteBin.decode bound bs <;> rfl

/-- The exhibited zero-answer history is reachable in the finite ROM used
by the endpoint, for its actual bound and any prover address program. -/
theorem finite_rom_zero_history (bound : ℕ) {m : ℕ}
    (a : Fin m → (Fin m → OracleAnswer) → List UInt8) :
    R1Z.LazyFrozen.runC a (R1Z.RomFiniteBin.lookup bound (fun _ => 0)) 0 = fun _ => 0 := by
  rw [zero_table_lookup]
  exact zero_oracle_runC a

/-- Scanning never invents a candidate. This induction also covers the stop
branches and the empty-list branch without reducing a 64-word recurrence. -/
theorem scan_alphabet (alphabet : Finset ℕ) (xs : List ℕ) (s : ScanState)
    (hs : ∀ x ∈ s.accepted, x ∈ alphabet) (hx : ∀ x ∈ xs, x ∈ alphabet) :
    ∀ x ∈ (scan s xs).1.accepted, x ∈ alphabet := by
  induction xs generalizing s with
  | nil => exact hs
  | cons x xs ih =>
      by_cases stop : s.accepted.length = 22 ∨ s.draws = 64
      · simpa only [scan, if_pos stop] using hs
      · simp only [scan, if_neg stop]
        apply ih
        · intro y hy
          rcases (AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.keep_mem _ _ _).mp hy with hy | rfl
          · exact hs y hy
          · exact hx y (List.mem_cons_self)
        · intro y hy
          exact hx y (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hy)

theorem repeated_block_scan_bound (b : OracleAnswer) (k : Fin 8) :
    (scanned k (fun _ => b)).1.accepted.length ≤ 8 := by
  let alphabet := (blockWords b).toFinset
  have hm : ∀ x ∈ parsedWords (fun _ => b) k, x ∈ alphabet := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨bb, hbb, hxb⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp hx
    have hbb' : bb ∈ List.ofFn (fun _ : Fin 8 => b) := List.mem_of_mem_take hbb
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.mp hbb'
    have he : bb = b := hj.symm
    rw [he] at hxb
    exact List.mem_toFinset.mpr hxb
  have hs := scan_alphabet alphabet (parsedWords (fun _ => b) k)
    AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.initial (by simp [AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.initial]) hm
  have hsub : (scanned k (fun _ => b)).1.accepted.toFinset ⊆ alphabet := by
    intro x hx
    exact hs x (List.mem_toFinset.mp hx)
  have hn := AspisR1.QueryScanOrderedModel.scan_nodup
    AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.initial (parsedWords (fun _ => b) k)
    (by simp [AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.initial])
  calc _ = (scanned k (fun _ => b)).1.accepted.toFinset.card :=
          (List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hn).symm
       _ ≤ alphabet.card := Finset.card_le_card hsub
       _ ≤ (blockWords b).length := List.toFinset_card_le _
       _ = 8 := blockWords_length b

theorem repeated_block_finish_fails (b : OracleAnswer) (k : Fin 8) :
    ∃ count, finish (scanned k (fun _ => b)).1 = .error count := by
  have h := repeated_block_scan_bound b k
  exact ⟨_, finish_error_count _ (by omega)⟩

/-- Failure at the constructed parser's own selected first-stop endpoint,
not at a separately chosen or enumerated block index. -/
theorem shared_loop_finish_fails (H : List UInt8 → OracleAnswer) (s : OracleAnswer)
    (loop : H (advanceAddress s) = s) :
    ∃ count, finish (scanned (stop done (queryBlocks H s)) (queryBlocks H s)).1 = .error count := by
  rw [queryBlocks_self_loop H s loop]
  exact repeated_block_finish_fails _ _

/-- With the release-sized domain, both self-loop read addresses are valid;
the example does not rely on the lookup fallback outside the finite ROM. -/
theorem loop_addresses_in_domain (bound : ℕ) (hbound : 33 ≤ bound) (s : OracleAnswer) :
    squeezeAddress s ∈ R1Z.RomFiniteBin.domain bound ∧
    advanceAddress s ∈ R1Z.RomFiniteBin.domain bound := by
  constructor <;> apply (R1Z.RomFiniteBin.mem_domain _ _).mpr <;>
    simpa only [squeezeAddress, advanceAddress, List.length_append, length_ans,
      List.length_singleton] using hbound

/-- This history is inhabited in the existing finite byte-string ROM. The
only condition is a previously seen advance answer, not a source assumption. -/
abbrev LoopHistory (bound : ℕ) :=
  {tab : R1Z.RomFiniteBin.Address bound → OracleAnswer //
    R1Z.RomFiniteBin.lookup bound tab (advanceAddress 0) = 0}

instance loopHistory_nonempty (bound : ℕ) : Nonempty (LoopHistory bound) := by
  refine ⟨⟨fun _ => 0, ?_⟩⟩
  unfold R1Z.RomFiniteBin.lookup
  cases R1Z.RomFiniteBin.decode bound (advanceAddress 0) <;> rfl

/-- Conditioning on this retained advance answer leaves mass-one failure.
The claim holds for every bound, including the release ROM bound. -/
theorem reached_shared_history_failure_mass (bound : ℕ) :
    eventMass (fun tab : LoopHistory bound =>
      ∃ count, finish (scanned
        (stop done (queryBlocks (R1Z.RomFiniteBin.lookup bound tab.val) 0))
        (queryBlocks (R1Z.RomFiniteBin.lookup bound tab.val) 0)).1 = .error count) = 1 := by
  have hh : ∀ tab : LoopHistory bound,
      ∃ count, finish (scanned
        (stop done (queryBlocks (R1Z.RomFiniteBin.lookup bound tab.val) 0))
        (queryBlocks (R1Z.RomFiniteBin.lookup bound tab.val) 0)).1 = .error count :=
    fun tab => shared_loop_finish_fails _ _ tab.property
  unfold eventMass
  simp only [hh, if_true]
  exact mean_const 1

theorem reached_shared_history_not_bounded (bound : ℕ) :
    ¬ eventMass (fun tab : LoopHistory bound =>
      ∃ count, finish (scanned
        (stop done (queryBlocks (R1Z.RomFiniteBin.lookup bound tab.val) 0))
        (queryBlocks (R1Z.RomFiniteBin.lookup bound tab.val) 0)).1 = .error count) ≤ scanProbability := by
  rw [reached_shared_history_failure_mass]
  exact not_le_of_gt scanProbability_lt_one

#print axioms queryState_self_loop
#print axioms queryBlocks_self_loop
#print axioms transcript_query_addresses

R1Z.QueryScanHistorySplit:
import R1Z.QueryScanPrivacyFinal

/-! Exact separation of the existing handoff. Removing the mass field alone
is unsound: arbitrary all-True exceptions erase the execution agreement.
A usable execution-only join must instead name fixed model events. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.QueryScanHistorySplit
open R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsGood R0Z.HvzkV
  R1Z.QueryScanPrivacyFinal
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-- Literally ScanCoupling with only its probability field removed. -/
structure ScanExecution {R M : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype M]
    (source : R → ℚ) (model : M → ℚ) where
  cp : Coupling R M
  queryScan : Fin 8 → cp.S → Prop
  R_wire_agreement_off_queryScan : ∀ s, ¬ (∃ i, queryScan i s) →
    source (cp.toR s) = model (cp.toM s)

def ScanExecution.ProbabilityContent {R M : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype M]
    {f : R → ℚ} {g : M → ℚ} (e : ScanExecution f g) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, eventMass (e.queryScan i) ≤ scanProbability

def forget {R M : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype M]
    {f : R → ℚ} {g : M → ℚ} (c : ScanCoupling f g) : ScanExecution f g :=
  ⟨c.cp, c.queryScan, c.R_wire_agreement_off_queryScan⟩

def complete {R M : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype M]
    {f : R → ℚ} {g : M → ℚ} (e : ScanExecution f g)
    (p : e.ProbabilityContent) : ScanCoupling f g :=
  ⟨e.cp, e.queryScan, p, e.R_wire_agreement_off_queryScan⟩

theorem exact_split {R M : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype M]
    (f : R → ℚ) (g : M → ℚ) :
    Nonempty (ScanCoupling f g) ↔ ∃ e : ScanExecution f g, e.ProbabilityContent := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c⟩
    exact ⟨forget c, c.R_rom_query_word_history⟩
  · rintro ⟨e, p⟩
    exact ⟨complete e p⟩

/-- Every pair of observations admits an unbounded execution join whenever
its randomness carriers already admit a coupling. -/
def vacuousExecution {R M : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype M]
    (f : R → ℚ) (g : M → ℚ) (cp : Coupling R M) : ScanExecution f g where
  cp := cp
  queryScan := fun _ _ => True
  R_wire_agreement_off_queryScan := by
    intro s hn
    exact False.elim (hn ⟨0, trivial⟩)

def unitCoupling : Coupling Unit Unit where
  S := Unit
  finS := inferInstance
  nonemptyS := inferInstance
  toR := id
  toM := id
  meanR := fun _ => rfl
  meanM := fun _ => rfl

theorem scanProbability_lt_one : scanProbability < 1 := by
  have h : (1 : ℚ) / 2^486 < 1 := by
    apply (div_lt_one (by positivity)).mpr
    exact one_lt_pow₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
  exact scan_probability_le.trans_lt h

/-- A compiled Boolean-observation counterexample, not just a bad event
chosen for an otherwise correct coupling. No bounded coupling can exist. -/
theorem zero_one_no_scanCoupling :
    ¬ Nonempty (ScanCoupling (fun _ : Unit => (0 : ℚ)) (fun _ : Unit => (1 : ℚ))) := by
  rintro ⟨c⟩
  have h := scan_coupling_le _ _ c (fun _ => by norm_num) (fun _ => by norm_num)
  rw [mean_const, mean_const] at h
  have hsmall : (8 : ℚ) / 2^486 < 1 := by
    apply (div_lt_one (by positivity)).mpr
    have hh : (8 : ℚ) < 2^4 := by norm_num
    exact hh.trans_le (pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega : 4 ≤ 486))
  norm_num only [zero_sub, abs_neg, abs_one] at h
  linarith

theorem probability_not_execution_content :
    (∃ e : ScanExecution (fun _ : Unit => (0 : ℚ)) (fun _ : Unit => (1 : ℚ)),
      ¬ e.ProbabilityContent) ∧
    ¬ (∀ e : ScanExecution (fun _ : Unit => (0 : ℚ)) (fun _ : Unit => (1 : ℚ)),
      e.ProbabilityContent) := by
  have hn : ∀ e : ScanExecution (fun _ : Unit => (0 : ℚ)) (fun _ : Unit => (1 : ℚ)),
      ¬ e.ProbabilityContent := by
    intro e hp
    exact zero_one_no_scanCoupling ⟨complete e hp⟩
  let e := vacuousExecution (fun _ : Unit => (0 : ℚ)) (fun _ : Unit => (1 : ℚ)) unitCoupling
  exact ⟨⟨e, hn e⟩, fun hp => hn e (hp e)⟩

/-- The repair: exceptions are fixed model events, not arbitrary predicates
chosen by the source execution join. This structure has no mass fields. -/
structure ModelExecutionJoin {R M : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype M]
    (source : R → ℚ) (model : M → ℚ) (bad : Fin 8 → M → Prop) where
  cp : Coupling R M
  agreement : ∀ s, ¬ (∃ i, bad i (cp.toM s)) → source (cp.toR s) = model (cp.toM s)

def ModelExecutionJoin.toScanCoupling {R M : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype M]
    {f : R → ℚ} {g : M → ℚ} {bad : Fin 8 → M → Prop}
    (e : ModelExecutionJoin f g bad)
    (modelLaw : ∀ i, eventMass (bad i) ≤ scanProbability) : ScanCoupling f g where
  cp := e.cp
  queryScan := fun i s => bad i (e.cp.toM s)
  R_rom_query_word_history := by
    intro i
    have ht := e.cp.meanM (fun m => if bad i m then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
    exact ht.le.trans (modelLaw i)
  R_wire_agreement_off_queryScan := e.agreement

#print axioms exact_split
#print axioms scanProbability_lt_one
#print axioms zero_one_no_scanCoupling
#print axioms probability_not_execution_content
#print axioms ModelExecutionJoin.toScanCoupling
end R1Z.QueryScanHistorySplit

import QueryScanExhaustion
import R0Z.HvzkS

/-! QueryScan's independent-word counting bound, sharpened before taking the
union over eight real and eight simulator attempts. Source/history transport
is deliberately a field of ScanCoupling, not inferred from classical ROM. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.QueryScanPrivacyFinal
open R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsGood R0Z.HvzkV
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

abbrev scanProbability : ℚ := AspisR1.QueryScanExhaustion.probability (2^18) 64 21

theorem scan_probability_le : scanProbability ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ)^486 := by
  have h := AspisR1.QueryScanExhaustion.probability_le
    (N := 2^18) (n := 64) (k := 21) (by positivity)
  have h21 : (21 : ℚ)^4 ≤ (2 : ℚ)^18 := by norm_num
  have hn : ((2 : ℚ)^18)^21 * (21 : ℚ)^64 ≤ (2 : ℚ)^666 := by
    calc _ = ((2 : ℚ)^18)^21 * ((21 : ℚ)^4)^16 := by rw [← pow_mul (21 : ℚ) 4 16]
         _ ≤ ((2 : ℚ)^18)^21 * ((2 : ℚ)^18)^16 := by gcongr
         _ = (2 : ℚ)^666 := by rw [← pow_mul, ← pow_mul, ← pow_add]
  have hc : ((2^18 : ℕ) : ℚ) = (2 : ℚ)^18 := by norm_cast
  rw [hc] at h
  calc _ ≤ (2 : ℚ)^666 / ((2 : ℚ)^18)^64 :=
          h.trans (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hn (by positivity))
       _ = 1 / (2 : ℚ)^486 := by
          rw [← pow_mul, show 18*64 = 666+486 from rfl, pow_add]
          field_simp

/-- Each scan event is charged on a common finite coupling space. The mass
premise must hold for the actual reached histories, including repeated reads.
Agreement names the whole observation, so includes retry/failure publication.
No independence among the eight events is required. -/
structure ScanCoupling {R M : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype M]
    (source : R → ℚ) (model : M → ℚ) where
  cp : Coupling R M
  queryScan : Fin 8 → cp.S → Prop
  R_rom_query_word_history : ∀ i, eventMass (queryScan i) ≤ scanProbability
  R_wire_agreement_off_queryScan : ∀ s, ¬ (∃ i, queryScan i s) →
    source (cp.toR s) = model (cp.toM s)

theorem scan_coupling_le {R M : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype M]
    (f : R → ℚ) (g : M → ℚ) (c : ScanCoupling f g)
    (hf : ∀ r, 0 ≤ f r ∧ f r ≤ 1) (hg : ∀ r, 0 ≤ g r ∧ g r ≤ 1) :
    |mean f - mean g| ≤ 8 / (2 : ℚ)^486 := by
  have hu : eventMass (fun s => ∃ i, c.queryScan i s) ≤
      ∑ i : Fin 8, eventMass (c.queryScan i) := by
    unfold eventMass
    rw [← mean_sum Finset.univ]
    apply mean_le_mean
    intro s
    by_cases he : ∃ i, c.queryScan i s
    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := he
      rw [if_pos ⟨i, hi⟩]
      have h := Finset.single_le_sum (s := Finset.univ)
        (f := fun j : Fin 8 => if c.queryScan j s then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
        (fun j _ => by split_ifs <;> norm_num) (Finset.mem_univ i)
      simpa only [if_pos hi] using h
    · rw [if_neg he]
      exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => by split_ifs <;> norm_num)
  have hs : (∑ i : Fin 8, eventMass (c.queryScan i)) ≤ 8 / (2 : ℚ)^486 := by
    calc _ ≤ ∑ _i : Fin 8, 1 / (2 : ℚ)^486 :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => (c.R_rom_query_word_history i).trans scan_probability_le)
         _ = _ := by simp [div_eq_mul_inv]
  rw [← c.cp.meanR f, ← c.cp.meanM g]
  exact (until_bad _ _ (fun s => hf _) (fun s => hg _) _
    c.R_wire_agreement_off_queryScan).trans (hu.trans hs)

/-- Both source handoffs together: 8 real + 8 ideal scans. -/
theorem query_error_le : (16 / (2 : ℚ)^486) ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ)^454 := by
  rw [show (486 : ℕ) = 32 + 454 from rfl, pow_add]
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)).mpr
  have h : (16 : ℚ) ≤ 2^32 := by norm_num
  simpa only [one_mul] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h (by positivity : (0 : ℚ) ≤ 2^454)

#print axioms scan_probability_le
#print axioms scan_coupling_le
#print axioms query_error_le
end R1Z.QueryScanPrivacyFinal
QueryScanExhaustion:
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.EquivFin
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Pi
import Mathlib.Tactic

/-! Uniform-word exhaustion bound. No enumeration of the 2^18-position space.
A word string with at most k distinct values factors through Fin k. Counting
all such factorizations overcounts, and gives N^k * k^n / N^n. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.QueryScanExhaustion
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

 def smallRange {N n : Nat} (w : Fin n → Fin N) (k : Nat) : Prop :=
  Fintype.card (Set.range w) ≤ k

 theorem factorization {N n k : Nat} (hN : 0 < N)
    (w : Fin n → Fin N) (h : smallRange w k) :
    ∃ (table : Fin k → Fin N) (labels : Fin n → Fin k),
      ∀ i, table (labels i) = w i := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := Function.Embedding.nonempty_of_card_le (α := Set.range w) (β := Fin k)
    (by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin, smallRange] using h)
  let table : Fin k → Fin N := fun j =>
    if hj : ∃ r, e r = j then (Classical.choose hj).val else ⟨0, hN⟩
  refine ⟨table, fun i => e ⟨w i, ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩, ?_⟩
  intro i
  have hj : ∃ r, e r = e ⟨w i, ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  dsimp only [table]
  rw [dif_pos hj]
  exact congrArg Subtype.val (e.injective (Classical.choose_spec hj))

 theorem smallRange_count {N n k : Nat} (hN : 0 < N) :
    Fintype.card {w : Fin n → Fin N // smallRange w k} ≤ N ^ k * k ^ n := by
  classical
  let witness (w : {w : Fin n → Fin N // smallRange w k}) :=
    Classical.choose (factorization hN w.val w.property)
  let labels (w : {w : Fin n → Fin N // smallRange w k}) :=
    Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (factorization hN w.val w.property))
  have hw (w : {w : Fin n → Fin N // smallRange w k}) :
      ∀ i, witness w (labels w i) = w.val i :=
    Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (factorization hN w.val w.property))
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun w => (witness w, labels w)) := by
    intro a b hab
    apply Subtype.ext
    funext i
    rw [← hw a i, ← hw b i, (Prod.mk.inj hab).1, (Prod.mk.inj hab).2]
  have hc := Fintype.card_le_of_injective _ hinj
  simpa only [Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin] using hc

 /-- Exact probability of at most k distinct positions under independent uniform
 words. This is a cardinality ratio, not an assumption of uniformity on success. -/
 def probability (N n k : Nat) : ℚ :=
  Fintype.card {w : Fin n → Fin N // smallRange w k} / (N : ℚ) ^ n

 theorem probability_le {N n k : Nat} (hN : 0 < N) :
    probability N n k ≤ (N : ℚ)^k * (k : ℚ)^n / (N : ℚ)^n := by
  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (by positivity)
  exact_mod_cast smallRange_count (n := n) (k := k) hN

 /-- Deliberately loose symbolic bound: 21 ≤ 2^5; 18*21 + 5*64 = 698;
 18*64 = 1152 = 698+454. All powers stay symbolic. -/
 theorem exhaustion_le_two_neg_454 :
    probability (2^18) 64 21 ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ)^454 := by
  have h := probability_le (N := 2^18) (n := 64) (k := 21) (by positivity)
  have h21 : (21 : ℚ)^64 ≤ ((2 : ℚ)^5)^64 :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num) 64
  have hnum : ((2 : ℚ)^18)^21 * (21 : ℚ)^64 ≤ (2 : ℚ)^698 := by
    calc _ ≤ ((2 : ℚ)^18)^21 * ((2 : ℚ)^5)^64 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h21 (by positivity)
         _ = (2 : ℚ)^698 := by rw [← pow_mul, ← pow_mul, ← pow_add]
  have hc : ((2^18 : Nat) : ℚ) = (2 : ℚ)^18 := by push_cast; rfl
  rw [hc] at h
  calc _ ≤ (2 : ℚ)^698 / ((2 : ℚ)^18)^64 :=
          h.trans (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnum (by positivity))
       _ = 1 / (2 : ℚ)^454 := by
          rw [← pow_mul]
          have he : 18*64 = 698+454 := by omega
          rw [he, pow_add]
          field_simp

 theorem exhaustion_le_two_neg_100 :
    probability (2^18) 64 21 ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ)^100 := by
  apply exhaustion_le_two_neg_454.trans
  apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity)
  exact pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega : 100 ≤ 454)

#print axioms factorization
#print axioms smallRange_count
#print axioms probability_le
#print axioms exhaustion_le_two_neg_454
#print axioms exhaustion_le_two_neg_100
end AspisR1.QueryScanExhaustion
R1Z.PhaseSamplerParserBin:
import R1Z.PhaseQueryScanBin
import R1J.PrivacySamplerSpend
import R1Z.PhaseCircleBlocksBin
import QueryScanOrderedModel

/-! Concrete block samplers and retained word-parser/first-22 policy.
The scan tests completion before the next word, as Q22WordScan actually does;
completion on a block's eighth word can therefore consume the next block.
These are Lean-model identities. Rust execution/history correspondence remains
a separate source join, including the rejected/exhausted outcome. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PhaseSamplerParserBin
open R0Z.FsStatement R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin
  R1Z.PhaseQueryScanBin AspisV8R19.Q22WordScan
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

local notation "K" => AspisWideTower.WideExact

def state (b : OracleAnswer) : AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep.State :=
  R1J.SamplerLawSpend.stateEquiv b

def scalar (b : OracleAnswer) : K :=
  R1J.SamplerLawSpend.s1Spend
    (algebraMap R1J.SamplerLawSpend.QF K) b

/-- The small block-circle adapter keeps concrete tower typeclass reduction
out of the combined sampler/ROM import closure. -/
abbrev circle := PhaseCircleBlocksBin.select

def openingScalar (i : Fin 4) (b : OracleAnswer) : K :=
  if i = 0 then (R0C.ModuloField.gammaNZ (state b)).val
  else R0C.ModuloField.ordinary (state b)

/-- Eight little-endian words, masked to 18 bits, in their source order. -/
def blockWords (b : OracleAnswer) : List ℕ := AspisV8R19.SamplerWords.words 18 (state b)

def parsedWords (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) (k : Fin 8) : List ℕ :=
  ((List.ofFn q).take (k.val + 1)).flatMap blockWords

theorem parsed_observed (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) (k : Fin 8) :
    parsedWords (observed q k) k = parsedWords q k := by
  unfold parsedWords
  apply congrArg (fun blocks : List OracleAnswer => blocks.flatMap blockWords)
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp only [List.length_take, List.length_ofFn]
  · intro n hn hn'
    have hn0 := hn
    simp only [List.length_take, List.length_ofFn] at hn0
    simp only [List.getElem_take, List.getElem_ofFn]
    unfold observed
    exact if_pos (by change n ≤ k.val; omega)

theorem parsedWords_bounded (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) (k : Fin 8)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : n ∈ parsedWords q k) : n < 262144 := by
  obtain ⟨b, _, hb⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp hn
  exact AspisV8R19.SamplerWords.words_bounded 18 (state b) n hb

def scanned (k : Fin 8) (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) : ScanState × Bool :=
  scan AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.initial (parsedWords q k)

def done (k : Fin 8) (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) : Prop := (scanned k q).2 = true

def fibre (n : ℕ) : Fib := ⟨n % 262144, Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)⟩

def decoded (k : Fin 8) (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) : Finset Fib :=
  ((scanned k q).1.accepted.map fibre).toFinset

def querySet (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) : Finset Fib := queries done decoded q

def decode (s : Fin 27 → OracleAnswer) (o : Fin 4 → OracleAnswer)
    (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) (_rho : OracleAnswer) : R0Z.HonestView.Challenges K where
  sem := fun i => scalar (s ⟨i.val, by omega⟩)
  circle := fun i => circle i (s ⟨25+i.val, by omega⟩)
  opening := fun i => openingScalar i (o i)
  queries := querySet q

theorem decode_local : DecodeLocal decode where
  sem := fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ he => congrArg scalar he
  circle := fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ i he => congrArg (circle i) he
  opening := fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ i he => congrArg (openingScalar i) he
  queries := fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ => rfl

theorem gamma_nonzero (b : OracleAnswer) : openingScalar 0 b ≠ 0 :=
  (R0C.ModuloField.gammaNZ (state b)).property

theorem blockWords_length (b : OracleAnswer) : (blockWords b).length = 8 :=
  AspisV8R19.SamplerWords.words_length 18 (state b)

theorem blockWords_bounded (b : OracleAnswer) (n : ℕ) (hn : n ∈ blockWords b) :
    n < 262144 := AspisV8R19.SamplerWords.words_bounded 18 (state b) n hn

/-- A successful prefix gives exactly the source model's first 22 distinct
words, in stable order; no sorting of the accepted list is introduced. -/
theorem parsed_first22 (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) (k : Fin 8) (out : List ℕ)
    (he : finish (scanned k q).1 = .ok out) :
    out = ((parsedWords q k).foldl keep []).take 22 :=
  AspisR1.QueryScanOrderedModel.successful_first22
    AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.initial (parsedWords q k) out (by simp [AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.initial]) he

theorem decoded_success (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) (k : Fin 8) (out : List ℕ)
    (he : finish (scanned k q).1 = .ok out) :
    decoded k q = (out.map fibre).toFinset := by
  unfold finish at he
  split at he
  · have hs := Except.ok.inj he
    unfold decoded
    rw [hs]
  · cases he

theorem query_success (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) (out : List ℕ)
    (he : finish (scanned (stop done q) q).1 = .ok out) :
    querySet q = (out.map fibre).toFinset ∧
      out = ((parsedWords q (stop done q)).foldl keep []).take 22 := by
  have hp : scanned (stop done q) (observed q (stop done q)) = scanned (stop done q) q := by
    unfold scanned
    rw [parsed_observed]
  constructor
  · exact decoded_success (observed q (stop done q)) (stop done q) out (by rw [hp]; exact he)
  · exact parsed_first22 q (stop done q) out he

theorem no_earlier_completion (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) (k : Fin 8)
    (hk : k < stop done q) : ¬ done k (observed q k) := by
  intro hd
  have hl := stop_le done q k (by
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, Or.inl hd⟩)
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hl) hk

theorem query_prefix (q q' : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer)
    (he : PrefixAgree q q' (stop done q)) :
    stop done q = stop done q' ∧ querySet q = querySet q' :=
  ⟨stop_local done q q' he, queries_local done decoded q q' he⟩

/-- The eighth block is the explicit fallback endpoint even if readiness
never occurs. Failure remains visible in finish; it is not a successful Q22. -/
theorem exhausted_endpoint (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer)
    (he : ∀ k, ¬ done k (observed q k)) : stop done q = 7 := by
  have hm := stop_mem done q
  have hd : done (stop done q) (observed q (stop done q)) ∨ stop done q = 7 :=
    (Finset.mem_filter.mp hm).2
  exact hd.resolve_left (he _)

def wireData {CommitHandle Aux : Type} (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) :
    R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux := { base with dec := decode, kstarOf := stop done }

def rows01 {CommitHandle Aux : Type} (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) :
    R1Z.Sem1UniformR1.SemRows01 (wireData base) where
  s1 := scalar
  sem1 := fun _ _ _ _ => rfl
  sem0 := fun _ _ _ _ _ he => congrArg scalar (he 0 (by decide))

theorem rows01_source {CommitHandle Aux : Type} (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) :
    (rows01 base).s1 = R1J.SamplerLawSpend.s1Spend (algebraMap R1J.SamplerLawSpend.QF K) := rfl

#print axioms parsedWords_bounded
#print axioms no_earlier_completion
#print axioms parsed_observed
#print axioms query_success
#print axioms decode_local
#print axioms gamma_nonzero
#print axioms blockWords_length
#print axioms blockWords_bounded
#print axioms parsed_first22
#print axioms decoded_success
#print axioms query_prefix
#print axioms exhausted_endpoint
#print axioms rows01
#print axioms rows01_source
end R1Z.PhaseSamplerParserBin

import R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin

/-! An eight-block first-completion scan. Readiness and query decoding get
only the observed observed and its endpoint. The concrete word parser and
22-distinct readiness predicate are source parameters, not silently assumed
to have been identified with Rust. Only the eight block indices are finite. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PhaseQueryScanBin
open R0Z.FsStatement R1Z.GamesR1PBin
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

def PrefixAgree (q q' : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) (k : Fin 8) : Prop :=
  ∀ j, j ≤ k → q j = q' j

def observed (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) (k : Fin 8) : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer :=
  fun j => if j ≤ k then q j else 0

theorem prefix_eq (q q' : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) (k : Fin 8)
    (he : PrefixAgree q q' k) : observed q k = observed q' k := by
  funext j
  unfold observed
  split
  · exact he j (by assumption)
  · rfl

def candidates (done : Fin 8 → (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Prop)
    (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) : Finset (Fin 8) :=
  Finset.univ.filter (fun k => done k (observed q k) ∨ k = 7)

theorem candidates_nonempty (done : Fin 8 → (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Prop)
    (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) : (candidates done q).Nonempty := by
  exact ⟨7, by simp [candidates]⟩

def stop (done : Fin 8 → (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Prop)
    (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) : Fin 8 :=
  (candidates done q).min' (candidates_nonempty done q)

theorem stop_mem (done : Fin 8 → (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Prop)
    (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) : stop done q ∈ candidates done q :=
  Finset.min'_mem _ _

theorem stop_le (done : Fin 8 → (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Prop)
    (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) (k : Fin 8) (hk : k ∈ candidates done q) :
    stop done q ≤ k := Finset.min'_le _ k hk

theorem candidates_agree (done : Fin 8 → (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Prop)
    (q q' : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) (k b : Fin 8)
    (he : PrefixAgree q q' b) (hk : k ≤ b) :
    k ∈ candidates done q ↔ k ∈ candidates done q' := by
  have hp : observed q k = observed q' k := prefix_eq q q' k (fun j hj => he j (hj.trans hk))
  simp only [candidates, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, hp]

/-- Selection cannot inspect a block after its own stopping point, including
the exhaustion/default case k=7. -/
theorem stop_local (done : Fin 8 → (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Prop)
    (q q' : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) (he : PrefixAgree q q' (stop done q)) :
    stop done q = stop done q' := by
  have hb : stop done q' ≤ stop done q := stop_le done q' _
    ((candidates_agree done q q' _ _ he le_rfl).mp (stop_mem done q))
  have ha : stop done q ≤ stop done q' := stop_le done q _
    ((candidates_agree done q q' _ _ he hb).mpr (stop_mem done q'))
  exact le_antisymm ha hb

def queries (done : Fin 8 → (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Prop)
    (decode : Fin 8 → (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Finset Fib)
    (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) : Finset Fib :=
  decode (stop done q) (observed q (stop done q))

theorem queries_local (done : Fin 8 → (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Prop)
    (decode : Fin 8 → (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Finset Fib)
    (q q' : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) (he : PrefixAgree q q' (stop done q)) :
    queries done decode q = queries done decode q' := by
  have hs := stop_local done q q' he
  have hp := prefix_eq q q' (stop done q) he
  unfold queries
  rw [← hs, hp]

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K]

/-- Install the constructed block decoder and first-completion scan in a
wire's remaining data. Message locality must still be proved for this wire. -/
def wireData (W : R1Z.GamesR1.R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (scalar : OracleAnswer → K)
    (circle : Fin 2 → OracleAnswer → AspisR0.ChordGeometry.Point K)
    (done : Fin 8 → (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Prop)
    (decode : Fin 8 → (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Finset Fib) :
    R1Z.GamesR1.R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux :=
  { W with
    dec := R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin.phaseDecode scalar circle (queries done decode)
    kstarOf := stop done }

theorem wireData_decoder_local (W : R1Z.GamesR1.R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (scalar : OracleAnswer → K)
    (circle : Fin 2 → OracleAnswer → AspisR0.ChordGeometry.Point K)
    (done : Fin 8 → (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Prop)
    (decode : Fin 8 → (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Finset Fib) :
    R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin.DecodeLocal (wireData W scalar circle done decode).dec :=
  R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin.phaseDecode_local scalar circle (queries done decode)

theorem wireData_scan_local (W : R1Z.GamesR1.R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (scalar : OracleAnswer → K)
    (circle : Fin 2 → OracleAnswer → AspisR0.ChordGeometry.Point K)
    (done : Fin 8 → (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Prop)
    (decode : Fin 8 → (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Finset Fib)
    (q q' : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer)
    (he : PrefixAgree q q' ((wireData W scalar circle done decode).kstarOf q)) :
    (wireData W scalar circle done decode).kstarOf q =
      (wireData W scalar circle done decode).kstarOf q' ∧
    queries done decode q = queries done decode q' :=
  ⟨stop_local done q q' he, queries_local done decode q q' he⟩

#print axioms wireData_decoder_local
#print axioms wireData_scan_local
#print axioms prefix_eq
#print axioms candidates_nonempty
#print axioms stop_mem
#print axioms stop_le
#print axioms candidates_agree
#print axioms stop_local
#print axioms queries_local
end R1Z.PhaseQueryScanBin
R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin:
import R1Z.PhaseScheduleBin
import R1Z.CausalPremisesR1PBin

/-! Dependency contracts on the *evaluated* protocol messages. These quantify
over all answer vectors, including unsuccessful/exhausted attempts. They are
not certificates that the shipped encoding satisfies the contracts. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R1Z.Batched R1Z.GamesR1
  R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.LayoutR1PBin R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.PhaseScheduleBin

def SqAgree (cut : ℕ) (tr tr' : TRead → OracleAnswer) : Prop :=
  ∀ j, IsSq j → transcriptStage j < cut → tr j = tr' j

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-- Componentwise squeeze-row dependencies, without a sampling-law assumption. -/
structure DecodeLocal (dec : (Fin 27 → OracleAnswer) → (Fin 4 → OracleAnswer) →
    (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → OracleAnswer → Challenges K) : Prop where
  sem : ∀ s s' o o' q q' r r' (i : Fin 25),
    s ⟨i.val, by omega⟩ = s' ⟨i.val, by omega⟩ →
    (dec s o q r).sem i = (dec s' o' q' r').sem i
  circle : ∀ s s' o o' q q' r r' (i : Fin 2),
    s ⟨25 + i.val, by omega⟩ = s' ⟨25 + i.val, by omega⟩ →
    (dec s o q r).circle i = (dec s' o' q' r').circle i
  opening : ∀ s s' o o' q q' r r' i, o i = o' i →
    (dec s o q r).opening i = (dec s' o' q' r').opening i
  queries : ∀ s s' o o' q r r', (dec s o q r).queries = (dec s' o' q r').queries

/-- The original wire together with phase-local message contracts at the
specified experiment. In particular arbitrary auxiliary outputs cannot leak
future challenges through the encoding. -/
structure R1PhaseWire (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) where
  toWire : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux
  decode_local : DecodeLocal toWire.dec
  frame_local : ∀ (w : h.Instance) τ tr tr' r r' i,
    SqAgree (transcriptStage (.absS i)) tr tr' → (i.val = 2 → r = r') →
    toWire.frame (view h B outputs x w (chOf toWire tr) τ) r i =
      toWire.frame (view h B outputs x w (chOf toWire tr') τ) r' i
  payload_local : ∀ (w : h.Instance) τ tr tr' r r' i,
    SqAgree (transcriptStage (.absO i)) tr tr' → (i.val = 3 → r = r') →
    toWire.payload (view h B outputs x w (chOf toWire tr) τ) r i =
      toWire.payload (view h B outputs x w (chOf toWire tr') τ) r' i
  final_local : ∀ (w : h.Instance) τ tr tr', SqAgree (transcriptStage .absQ) tr tr' →
    toWire.final (view h B outputs x w (chOf toWire tr) τ) =
      toWire.final (view h B outputs x w (chOf toWire tr') τ)

/-- A refinement of a prover's data: caddr and ord are constructed, rather
than accepted as arbitrary functions. The C1 cutoff admits no squeeze, C2
admits only semantic rows 0 and 1, folded admits rows through 29. -/
structure R1PhaseProver (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (W : R1PhaseWire h B outputs x) where
  data : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W.toWire
  leaf_local : ∀ (w : h.Instance) τ tr tr' T u,
    SqAgree (treeBase T + 6) tr tr' →
    data.leafVal h w x τ (chOf W.toWire tr) T u =
      data.leafVal h w x τ (chOf W.toWire tr') T u

abbrev R1PhaseProver.toProver {h : HonestProver K} {B : PackBasis F}
    {outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux}
    {x : Statement K CommitHandle} {W : R1PhaseWire h B outputs x}
    (P : R1PhaseProver h B outputs x W) : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W.toWire :=
  { P.data with
    caddr := fun h w x sec d τ rest ch =>
      gram (W.toWire.pubBytes x) W.toWire.vtag (P.data.leafVal h w x τ ch) sec d rest
    ord := PhaseScheduleBin.ord P.data.E₁ P.data.E₂ }

/-- Pointwise block decoding: the semantic/circle/opening components cannot
read any other squeeze, and query decoding cannot read semantic or opening
answers. The rho argument is absent from Challenges and is ignored. -/
def phaseDecode
    (scalar : OracleAnswer → K) (circle : Fin 2 → OracleAnswer → AspisR0.ChordGeometry.Point K)
    (queries : (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Finset Fib)
    (s : Fin 27 → OracleAnswer) (o : Fin 4 → OracleAnswer)
    (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) (_rho : OracleAnswer) : Challenges K where
  sem := fun i => scalar (s ⟨i.val, by omega⟩)
  circle := fun i => circle i (s ⟨25 + i.val, by omega⟩)
  opening := fun i => scalar (o i)
  queries := queries q

theorem phaseDecode_sem (scalar : OracleAnswer → K)
    (circle : Fin 2 → OracleAnswer → AspisR0.ChordGeometry.Point K)
    (queries : (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Finset Fib)
    (s s' : Fin 27 → OracleAnswer) (o o' : Fin 4 → OracleAnswer)
    (q q' : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) (rho rho' : OracleAnswer) (i : Fin 25)
    (he : s ⟨i.val, by omega⟩ = s' ⟨i.val, by omega⟩) :
    (phaseDecode scalar circle queries s o q rho).sem i =
      (phaseDecode scalar circle queries s' o' q' rho').sem i := congrArg scalar he

theorem phaseDecode_local (scalar : OracleAnswer → K)
    (circle : Fin 2 → OracleAnswer → AspisR0.ChordGeometry.Point K)
    (queries : (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Finset Fib) :
    DecodeLocal (phaseDecode scalar circle queries) where
  sem := fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ he => congrArg scalar he
  circle := fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ i he => congrArg (circle i) he
  opening := fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ he => congrArg scalar he
  queries := fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ => rfl

#print axioms phaseDecode_local
#print axioms R1PhaseProver.toProver
#print axioms phaseDecode
#print axioms phaseDecode_sem
end R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin
R1Z.PhaseScheduleBin:
import R1Z.CausalTreeOrderBin
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Sort

/-! Symbolic phase schedule. The finite-order isomorphism is used only through
its order laws: no concrete list of positions or tree recurrence is reduced. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PhaseScheduleBin
open R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.LayoutR1PBin R1Z.TranscriptR1

def treeBase (T : Fin 3) : ℕ := if T.val = 0 then 1 else if T.val = 1 then 27 else 131

def transcriptStage : TRead → ℕ
  | .init => 26
  | .absS i => if i.val < 2 then 27 + 3 * i.val else 52 + 3 * (i.val - 2)
  | .sqS i => if i.val < 2 then 28 + 3 * i.val else 53 + 3 * (i.val - 2)
  | .advS i => if i.val < 2 then 29 + 3 * i.val else 54 + 3 * (i.val - 2)
  | .reseed => 127
  | .absO i => if i.val < 3 then 128 + 3 * i.val else 156
  | .sqO i => if i.val < 3 then 129 + 3 * i.val else 157
  | .advO i => if i.val < 3 then 130 + 3 * i.val else 158
  | .absQ => 159
  | .qb k => 160 + 2 * k.val
  | .qa k => 161 + 2 * k.val
  | .absR => 176
  | .sqR => 177
  | .advR => 178

def restStage : RIdx → ℕ
  | .inl b => b.val
  | .inr (.inl i) => 2 + i.val
  | .inr (.inr (.inl _)) => 6
  | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inl (T, _)))) => treeBase T + 6
  | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (T, n)))) => treeBase T + 7 + n.1.val

def stage {E₁ E₂ : ℕ} : Pos1 E₁ E₂ → ℕ
  | .inl j => transcriptStage j
  | .inr (.inl T) => treeBase T + 24
  | .inr (.inr (.inl _)) => 5
  | .inr (.inr (.inr q)) => restStage q

/-- Separate type prevents the schedule order leaking into other interfaces. -/
def Scheduled (E₁ E₂ : ℕ) := Pos1 E₁ E₂
instance (E₁ E₂ : ℕ) : Fintype (Scheduled E₁ E₂) := inferInstanceAs (Fintype (Pos1 E₁ E₂))

def key {E₁ E₂ : ℕ} (p : Scheduled E₁ E₂) : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ :=
  toLex (stage p, (Fintype.equivFin (Pos1 E₁ E₂) p).val)

theorem key_injective {E₁ E₂ : ℕ} : Function.Injective (@key E₁ E₂) := by
  intro p q h
  apply (Fintype.equivFin (Pos1 E₁ E₂)).injective
  apply Fin.ext
  exact congrArg (fun x : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ => (ofLex x).2) h

instance (E₁ E₂ : ℕ) : LinearOrder (Scheduled E₁ E₂) :=
  LinearOrder.lift' key key_injective

def orderIso (E₁ E₂ : ℕ) : Fin (Fintype.card (Pos1 E₁ E₂)) ≃o Scheduled E₁ E₂ :=
  Fintype.orderIsoFinOfCardEq (Scheduled E₁ E₂) rfl

def ord (E₁ E₂ : ℕ) : Fin (Fintype.card (Pos1 E₁ E₂)) ≃ Pos1 E₁ E₂ :=
  (orderIso E₁ E₂).toEquiv

theorem stage_before {E₁ E₂ : ℕ} (p q : Pos1 E₁ E₂) (h : stage p < stage q) :
    (ord E₁ E₂).symm p < (ord E₁ E₂).symm q := by
  apply (orderIso E₁ E₂).symm.strictMono
  show key p < key q
  exact Prod.Lex.left _ _ h

theorem child_before_parent (T : Fin 3) (n : NodeIdx) (j : Fin 2) :
    restStage (childQ T n j) < restStage (qNode T n) := by
  have h := CausalTreeOrderBin.child_before_parent T n j
  rcases n with ⟨⟨d, hd⟩, i⟩
  cases d with
  | zero => simp [childQ, restStage, qLeaf, qNode]
  | succ d => simp [childQ, restStage, qNode]

theorem root_children (T : Fin 3) (j : Fin 2) :
    restStage (rootChild T j) < treeBase T + 24 := by
  simp [rootChild, restStage, qNode]

#print axioms key_injective
#print axioms stage_before
#print axioms child_before_parent
#print axioms root_children
end R1Z.PhaseScheduleBin
R1Z.CausalTreeOrderBin:
import R1Z.SharedGrammarBridgeBin

/-! Symbolic bottom-up ranks for the binary grammar. No leaf/node universe
is enumerated. These facts are independent of the missing phase interfaces. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.CausalTreeOrderBin
open R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.LayoutR1PBin

/-- A dependency-layer rank, not a total enumeration of hash calls. -/
def layer : RIdx → ℕ
  | .inl b => b.val
  | .inr (.inl i) => 2 + i.val
  | .inr (.inr (.inl _)) => 5
  | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inl _))) => 6
  | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (_, n)))) => 7 + n.1.val

theorem child_before_parent (T : Fin 3) (n : NodeIdx) (j : Fin 2) :
    layer (childQ T n j) < layer (qNode T n) := by
  rcases n with ⟨⟨d, hd⟩, i⟩
  cases d with
  | zero => simp [childQ, layer, qLeaf, qNode]
  | succ d => simp [childQ, layer, qNode]

theorem child_before_root (T : Fin 3) (j : Fin 2) :
    layer (rootChild T j) < 24 := by
  simp [rootChild, layer, qNode]

theorem salt_before_leaf (T : Fin 3) (u : Fib) :
    layer (qSalt T u) < layer (qLeaf T u) := by
  simp [layer, qSalt, qLeaf]

/-- The ranked parent uses precisely the shared binary node bytes. -/
theorem shared_parent (rest : RIdx → R0Z.FsStatement.OracleAnswer)
    (T : Fin 3) (n : NodeIdx) :
    nodeBytes rest (childQ T n) =
      AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.nodeInput (fun j => rest (childQ T n j)) :=
  R1Z.SharedGrammarBridgeBin.node_eq rest (childQ T n)

#print axioms child_before_parent
#print axioms child_before_root
#print axioms salt_before_leaf
#print axioms shared_parent
end R1Z.CausalTreeOrderBin

/-! Equality bridge for the frozen privacy definitions; length/separation
proofs below are transported from the existing privacy theorems. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.SharedGrammarBridgeBin
open R0Z.FsStatement R1Z.LensR1 R1Z.TranscriptR1

theorem node_eq (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) (ch : Fin 2 → RIdx) :
    nodeBytes rest ch = AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.nodeInput (fun j => rest (ch j)) := rfl

theorem treeTag_eq : treeTag = AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.treeTag := rfl

theorem leaf_eq (tag : UInt8) (packed : List UInt8) (salt : OracleAnswer) :
    [0x10, tag] ++ packed ++ ans salt = AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.leafInput tag packed (ans salt) := by
  simp only [AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.leafInput, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, List.append_assoc]

theorem semanticTag_eq : WireLengthsR1PBin.semanticTag = AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.semanticTag := rfl
theorem openingSize_eq : WireLengthsR1PBin.openingSize = AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.openingSize := rfl

def toShared (w : WireLengthsR1PBin.Wire) : AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.Wire :=
  ⟨w.semantic, w.opening, w.final, w.publicBytes, w.tag⟩
def fromShared (w : AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.Wire) : WireLengthsR1PBin.Wire :=

theorem wire_roundtrip (w : WireLengthsR1PBin.Wire) : fromShared (toShared w) = w := rfl
theorem shared_roundtrip (w : AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.Wire) : toShared (fromShared w) = w := rfl

theorem framed_eq (w : WireLengthsR1PBin.Wire) (i : Fin 27) :
    WireLengthsR1PBin.framed w i = AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.framed (toShared w) i := rfl

theorem class_eq (c : AspisR1.WireBindingRecordCodec.Tx1Class) :
    c.size = AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.classSize c := rfl

theorem shared_framed_safe (w : AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.Wire) (i : Fin 27) :
    (AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.framed w i).length ≠ 31 ∧ (AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.framed w i).length ≠ 65 :=
  WireLengthsR1PBin.framed_safe (fromShared w) i

theorem shared_node_ne_binding (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) (ch : Fin 2 → RIdx)
    (r : AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.BindingRecord) : AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.nodeInput (fun j => rest (ch j)) ≠ AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.bindingBytes r := by
  rw [← node_eq]
  exact WireBindingLengthsR1PBin.node_ne_binding rest ch r

#print axioms node_eq
#print axioms treeTag_eq
#print axioms leaf_eq

#print axioms semanticTag_eq

SharedBinaryRecordGrammar:
import WireBindingRecordCodec
import Mathlib.Data.List.OfFn

/-! Module of record for the binary commitment / typed R1 wire grammar.
The generic byte carrier admits both soundness's `Fin 256` and privacy's
`UInt8`. Binding classes reuse the D79 codec, including its checksum body;
there is no second copy of that codec or its separation proofs here.
Existing frozen definitions are identified in the two importing bridges. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar

def nodeInput {Byte : Type} [OfNat Byte 18] (cs : Fin 2 → Fin 32 → Byte) : List Byte :=
  0x12 :: (List.ofFn (cs 0) ++ List.ofFn (cs 1))

def leafInput {Byte : Type} [OfNat Byte 16] (tag : Byte)
    (packed salt : List Byte) : List Byte := 0x10 :: tag :: (packed ++ salt)

def treeTag (t : Fin 3) : UInt8 :=
  if t.val = 0 then 0x71 else if t.val = 1 then 0xf1 else 0x72

def semanticSize (i : Fin 27) : Nat :=
  if i.val = 2 ∨ i.val = 14 then 32
  else if 15 ≤ i.val ∧ i.val ≤ 24 then 896
  else if i.val = 25 then 3712
  else if i.val = 26 then 928 else 0

def semanticTag (i : Fin 27) : UInt8 :=
  if i.val = 2 then 1 else if i.val = 14 then 3
  else if 15 ≤ i.val ∧ i.val ≤ 24 then 2
  else if i.val = 25 then 4 else if i.val = 26 then 5 else 0

def openingSize (i : Fin 4) : Nat :=
  if i.val = 0 then 928 else if i.val = 1 then 32 else if i.val = 2 then 224 else 256

def le32 (n : Nat) : List UInt8 :=
  [(n % 256).toUInt8, (n / 256 % 256).toUInt8, (n / 65536 % 256).toUInt8,
    (n / 16777216 % 256).toUInt8]

structure Wire where
  semantic : (i : Fin 27) → Vector UInt8 (semanticSize i)
  opening : (i : Fin 4) → Vector UInt8 (openingSize i)
  final : Vector UInt8 2048
  publicBytes : List UInt8
  tag : UInt8

def framed (w : Wire) (i : Fin 27) : List UInt8 :=
  [semanticTag i] ++ le32 (semanticSize i) ++ (w.semantic i).toList

abbrev BindingClass := WireBindingRecordCodec.BindingClass
abbrev BindingRecord := WireBindingRecordCodec.BindingRecord
abbrev CheckpointBody := WireBindingRecordCodec.CheckpointBody
abbrev Tx1Class := WireBindingRecordCodec.Tx1Class
abbrev classSize := WireBindingRecordCodec.Tx1Class.size
abbrev bindingSize := WireBindingRecordCodec.BindingClass.size
abbrev bindingBytes := WireBindingRecordCodec.BindingRecord.bytes

/-- Reuse the established typed-class separation result. -/
theorem class_safe (c : Tx1Class) (hn : c ≠ .binaryNode) :
    classSize c ≠ 65 ∧ classSize c ≠ 31 :=
  WireBindingRecordCodec.tx1_class_safe c hn

#print axioms class_safe
end AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar
WireBindingRecordCodec:
import Mathlib.Data.List.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Init
import Lean.Elab.Tactic.Omega

/-! Source-shaped byte widths for the three checkpoint digest inputs.
This is a codec model, not an extraction of checkpoint or whole tx1.
Source pins are in design/WIRE-LENGTHS-ADDENDUM-20261020.md. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.WireBindingRecordCodec

/-- compact.rs:26–50,69: offsets, compact values, and six padded node slots. -/
def proof_bytes : Nat :=
  16 + ((12903 + 29 * 32) - 16 * (1 + 10 * 28 + (87 + 29) + 29)) +
  29 * 16 + 32 + 224 + 32 + 224 + 64 * 32 +
  22 * (480 + 128 + 32 + 32 + 128 + 32) + 32 * (2 * (146 + 172) + (128 + 150))

/-- ASF8 header, late statement and payment; pair_forest_terminal.rs:33. -/
def asf8_size : Nat := 144 + 1520 + 216

theorem proof_bytes_eq : proof_bytes = 57607 := by rfl
theorem asf8_size_eq : asf8_size = 1880 := by rfl

/-- The fields appended before the checksum, verifier.rs:273–283.
Wide values occupy 32 bytes; K values 16; S2 has 64 weights. -/
structure CheckpointBody (Byte : Type) where
  header : Vector Byte 16
  proofHash : Vector Byte 32
  publicHash : Vector Byte 32
  state : Vector Byte 32
  roots : Vector Byte (2 * 32)
  challenges : Vector Byte (4 * 32)
  rho : Vector Byte 16
  queries : Vector Byte (22 * 4)
  semanticAlpha : Vector Byte (10 * 16)
  z : Vector Byte (2 * 2 * 16)
  claimRhs : Vector Byte (2 * 32)
  power : Vector Byte 16
  weights : Vector Byte (64 * 16)

def CheckpointBody.bytes {Byte : Type} (b : CheckpointBody Byte) : List Byte :=
  b.header.toList ++ b.proofHash.toList ++ b.publicHash.toList ++ b.state.toList ++
  b.roots.toList ++ b.challenges.toList ++ b.rho.toList ++ b.queries.toList ++
  b.semanticAlpha.toList ++ b.z.toList ++ b.claimRhs.toList ++ b.power.toList ++ b.weights.toList

theorem checkpoint_body_length {Byte : Type} (b : CheckpointBody Byte) :
    b.bytes.length = 1736 := by simp [CheckpointBody.bytes]

/-- Literal 22-byte ASCII domain, followed by the body (no trailing checksum). -/
theorem byteArray_length (bs : ByteArray) : bs.toList.length = bs.size := by
  have aux : ∀ n i acc, bs.size - i = n →
      (ByteArray.toList.loop bs i acc).length = acc.length + n := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h n ih =>
      intro i acc hn
      rw [ByteArray.toList.loop]
      split
      · rename_i hi
        rw [ih (bs.size - (i + 1)) (by omega) (i + 1) (bs.get! i :: acc) rfl]
        simp only [List.length_cons]
        omega
      · simp only [List.length_reverse]
        omega
  simpa only [ByteArray.toList, List.length_nil, Nat.zero_add] using
    aux bs.size 0 [] (by omega)

def checksumDomain : List UInt8 := "UNPROVED:R1:checkpoint".toUTF8.toList

theorem checksum_domain_length : checksumDomain.length = 22 := by
  rw [checksumDomain, byteArray_length]
  rfl

def checksumInput (b : CheckpointBody UInt8) : List UInt8 := checksumDomain ++ b.bytes

theorem checksum_input_length (b : CheckpointBody UInt8) :
    (checksumInput b).length = 1758 := by
  simp only [checksumInput, List.length_append, checksum_domain_length, checkpoint_body_length]

inductive BindingClass where
  | compactProof | asf8Account | checkpointChecksum
  deriving DecidableEq

def BindingClass.size : BindingClass → Nat
  | .compactProof => proof_bytes
  | .asf8Account => asf8_size
  | .checkpointChecksum => 1758

/-- Each constructor is the actual binding input, rather than its hash output. -/
inductive BindingRecord where
  | compactProof (bytes : Vector UInt8 proof_bytes)
  | asf8Account (bytes : Vector UInt8 asf8_size)
  | checkpointChecksum (body : CheckpointBody UInt8)

def BindingRecord.kind : BindingRecord → BindingClass
  | .compactProof _ => .compactProof
  | .asf8Account _ => .asf8Account
  | .checkpointChecksum _ => .checkpointChecksum

def BindingRecord.bytes : BindingRecord → List UInt8
  | .compactProof bytes => bytes.toList
  | .asf8Account bytes => bytes.toList
  | .checkpointChecksum body => checksumInput body

theorem binding_length (r : BindingRecord) : r.bytes.length = r.kind.size := by
  cases r <;> simp [BindingRecord.bytes, BindingRecord.kind, BindingClass.size,
    checksum_input_length]

theorem binding_safe (r : BindingRecord) : r.bytes.length ≠ 65 ∧ r.bytes.length ≠ 31 := by
  rw [binding_length]
  cases r <;> simp [BindingRecord.kind, BindingClass.size, proof_bytes_eq, asf8_size_eq]

/-- All digest-site classes in the WIRE-TX1 inventory. Several sites share a
class. Binary node is deliberately included and is exempt from self-separation. -/
inductive Tx1Class where
  | initTransfer | initWithdrawal | semanticEmpty | semanticRoot | semanticCoefficients
  | circleClaims | circleBefore | openingY1 | openingInactive | openingFirst
  | openingFolded | openingFinal | openingEmpty | reseed | read
  | leafC1 | leafSmall | binaryNode | binding (kind : BindingClass)
  deriving DecidableEq

def Tx1Class.size : Tx1Class → Nat
  | .initTransfer => 1530 | .initWithdrawal => 1502
  | .semanticEmpty => 39 | .semanticRoot => 71 | .semanticCoefficients => 935
  | .circleClaims => 3751 | .circleBefore => 967
  | .openingY1 => 966 | .openingInactive => 70 | .openingFirst => 262
  | .openingFolded => 294 | .openingFinal => 2086 | .openingEmpty => 38
  | .reseed => 62 | .read => 33 | .leafC1 => 514 | .leafSmall => 162
  | .binaryNode => 65 | .binding k => k.size

theorem tx1_class_safe (c : Tx1Class) (hn : c ≠ .binaryNode) :
    c.size ≠ 65 ∧ c.size ≠ 31 := by
  cases c <;> simp_all [Tx1Class.size]
  rename_i k
  cases k <;> simp [BindingClass.size, proof_bytes_eq, asf8_size_eq]

#print axioms proof_bytes_eq
#print axioms asf8_size_eq
#print axioms checkpoint_body_length
#print axioms byteArray_length
#print axioms checksum_domain_length
#print axioms checksum_input_length
#print axioms binding_length
#print axioms binding_safe
#print axioms tx1_class_safe
end AspisR1.WireBindingRecordCodec

/-! D79 extension to all three checkpoint-binding digest classes. The codec
is shared verbatim with soundness; the existing transcript and privacy roots
are unchanged. Executed tx1 membership remains the R-wire refinement. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.WireBindingLengthsR1PBin
open AspisR1.WireBindingRecordCodec
open R0Z.FsStatement R1Z.LensR1 R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.LayoutR1PBin

/-- The checksum constructor fixes the actual input width, not a supplied
length inequality. All possible payload byte contents are covered. -/
theorem binding_fixed_length (r : BindingRecord) :
    r.bytes.length = 57607 ∨ r.bytes.length = 1880 ∨ r.bytes.length = 1758 := by
  rw [binding_length]
  cases r <;> simp [BindingRecord.kind, BindingClass.size, proof_bytes_eq, asf8_size_eq]

theorem node_ne_binding (answers : GamesR1PBin.RIdx → OracleAnswer)
    (ch : Fin 2 → GamesR1PBin.RIdx) (r : BindingRecord) :
    nodeBytes answers ch ≠ r.bytes := by
  intro he
  have hl := congrArg List.length he
  rw [nodeBytes_length] at hl
  exact (binding_safe r).1 hl.symm

theorem binding_ne_framed31 (r : BindingRecord) (frame : List UInt8)
    (hf : frame.length = 31) : r.bytes ≠ frame := by
  intro he
  exact (binding_safe r).2 ((congrArg List.length he).trans hf)

/-- Extension of the D79 concrete transcript carrier with checkpoint reads.
These inputs are additional verifier reads, not duplex transcript rows. -/
inductive ExtendedRead where
  | transcript (j : TRead) (answer : OracleAnswer)
  | binding (r : BindingRecord)

def ExtendedRead.bytes (w : WireLengthsR1PBin.Wire) : ExtendedRead → List UInt8
  | .transcript j f => addrWith j f (WireLengthsR1PBin.rest w)
  | .binding r => r.bytes

theorem node_ne_extended_read (w : WireLengthsR1PBin.Wire)
    (answers : GamesR1PBin.RIdx → OracleAnswer) (ch : Fin 2 → GamesR1PBin.RIdx)
    (read : ExtendedRead) : nodeBytes answers ch ≠ read.bytes w := by
  cases read with
  | transcript j f => exact WireLengthsR1PBin.node_ne_concrete_transcript w answers ch j f
  | binding r => exact node_ne_binding answers ch r

/-- Covers the entire tx1 site class table, including salted leaves. Node
reads are included in the table but cannot be separated from themselves. -/
theorem node_ne_classified_read (answers : GamesR1PBin.RIdx → OracleAnswer)
    (ch : Fin 2 → GamesR1PBin.RIdx) (c : Tx1Class) (hn : c ≠ .binaryNode)
    (bs : List UInt8) (hclass : bs.length = c.size) : nodeBytes answers ch ≠ bs := by
  intro he
  have hl := congrArg List.length he
  rw [nodeBytes_length, hclass] at hl
  exact (tx1_class_safe c hn).1 hl.symm

#print axioms binding_fixed_length
#print axioms node_ne_binding
#print axioms binding_ne_framed31
#print axioms node_ne_extended_read
#print axioms node_ne_classified_read
end R1Z.WireBindingLengthsR1PBin

import R1Z.LayoutTagR1PBin

/-! Concrete logical R1/S2 byte-shape carrier. Fixed-size vectors describe
payload slices, without assuming field canonicality. Compact stored fields
are expanded to these logical widths before transcript hashing.
This is the wire grammar; identification with a Rust execution remains R-wire. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.WireLengthsR1PBin
open R0Z.FsStatement R1Z.LensR1 R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.LayoutR1PBin

def semanticSize (i : Fin 27) : Nat :=
  if i.val = 2 ∨ i.val = 14 then 32
  else if 15 ≤ i.val ∧ i.val ≤ 24 then 896
  else if i.val = 25 then 3712
  else if i.val = 26 then 928 else 0

def semanticTag (i : Fin 27) : UInt8 :=
  if i.val = 2 then 1 else if i.val = 14 then 3
  else if 15 ≤ i.val ∧ i.val ≤ 24 then 2
  else if i.val = 25 then 4 else if i.val = 26 then 5 else 0

def openingSize (i : Fin 4) : Nat :=
  if i.val = 0 then 928 else if i.val = 1 then 32 else if i.val = 2 then 224 else 256

structure Wire where
  semantic : (i : Fin 27) → Vector UInt8 (semanticSize i)
  opening : (i : Fin 4) → Vector UInt8 (openingSize i)
  final : Vector UInt8 2048
  publicBytes : List UInt8
  tag : UInt8

def framed (w : Wire) (i : Fin 27) : List UInt8 :=
  [semanticTag i] ++ le32 (semanticSize i) ++ (w.semantic i).toList

def rest (w : Wire) : Rest where
  framed := framed w
  payload := fun i => (w.opening i).toList
  final := w.final.toList
  pubB := w.publicBytes
  vtag := w.tag

theorem framed_length (w : Wire) (i : Fin 27) :
    (framed w i).length = 5 + semanticSize i := by
  simp [framed, le32]
  omega

theorem framed_safe (w : Wire) (i : Fin 27) :
    (framed w i).length ≠ 31 ∧ (framed w i).length ≠ 65 := by
  rw [framed_length]
  unfold semanticSize
  split <;> (try split) <;> (try split) <;> (try split) <;> omega

theorem opening_safe (w : Wire) (i : Fin 4) :
    ((rest w).payload i).length ≠ 27 := by
  change (w.opening i).toList.length ≠ 27
  simp only [Vector.length_toList]
  unfold openingSize
  split <;> (try split) <;> (try split) <;> omega

theorem transcriptNodeLengths (w : Wire) : TranscriptNodeLengths (rest w) := by
  refine ⟨fun i => (framed_safe w i).1, opening_safe w, ?_⟩
  change w.final.toList.length ≠ 27
  simp

theorem node_ne_concrete_transcript (w : Wire) (answers : GamesR1PBin.RIdx → OracleAnswer)
    (ch : Fin 2 → GamesR1PBin.RIdx) (j : TRead) (f : OracleAnswer) :
    nodeBytes answers ch ≠ addrWith j f (rest w) :=
  nodeBytes_ne_transcript answers ch j f (rest w) (transcriptNodeLengths w)

#print axioms framed_length
#print axioms framed_safe
#print axioms opening_safe
#print axioms transcriptNodeLengths
#print axioms node_ne_concrete_transcript
end R1Z.WireLengthsR1PBin
R1Z.LayoutTagR1PBin:
import R1Z.LayoutR1PBin

/-! Binary-node separation. Commitment records have disjoint leading tags.
Duplex addresses begin with an arbitrary digest: their separation requires
record lengths, not a claim that every transcript address has a fixed tag. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.LayoutR1PBin
open R0Z.FsStatement R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.LensR1

variable {E₁ E₂ : ℕ}

def nodePosition : CPos E₁ E₂ → Prop
  | .inl _ => True
  | .inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr (.inr _))))) => True
  | _ => False

theorem nodeBytes_length (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) (ch : Fin 2 → RIdx) :
    (nodeBytes rest ch).length = 65 := by simp [nodeBytes, length_ans]

theorem nodeBytes_ne_tag (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) (ch : Fin 2 → RIdx)
    (tag : UInt8) (tail : List UInt8) (ht : tag ≠ binTag) :
    nodeBytes rest ch ≠ tag :: tail := by
  intro h
  have hh := congrArg (fun l : List UInt8 => l[0]?) h
  simp [nodeBytes] at hh
  exact ht hh.symm

/-- All other commitment classes: bindings, seeds, salts, leaves, expanders. -/
theorem nodeBytes_ne_other_commit (rest₀ : RIdx → OracleAnswer) (ch : Fin 2 → RIdx)
    (pub : List UInt8) (vtag : UInt8) (lv : Fin 3 → Fib → List UInt8) (sec : SecP)
    (d : OracleAnswer) (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) (c : CPos E₁ E₂)
    (hn : ¬ nodePosition c) : nodeBytes rest₀ ch ≠ gram pub vtag lv sec d rest c := by
  rcases c with T | (c | c) | (b | i | ⟨T, u⟩ | ⟨T, u⟩ | ⟨T, n⟩)
  · exact False.elim (hn trivial)
  · exact nodeBytes_ne_tag _ _ _ _ (by decide)
  · exact nodeBytes_ne_tag _ _ _ _ (by decide)
  · by_cases hb : b.val = 0
    · simp only [gram, hb, if_true]
      exact nodeBytes_ne_tag _ _ _ _ (by decide)
    · simp only [gram, hb, if_false]
      exact nodeBytes_ne_tag _ _ _ _ (by decide)
  · by_cases h0 : i.val = 0
    · simp only [gram, h0, if_true]
      exact nodeBytes_ne_tag _ _ _ _ (by decide)
    · by_cases h1 : i.val = 1
      · simp only [gram, h1, if_true]
        exact nodeBytes_ne_tag _ _ _ _ (by decide)
      · simp only [gram, h0, h1, if_false]
        exact nodeBytes_ne_tag _ _ _ _ (by decide)
  · exact nodeBytes_ne_tag _ _ _ _ (by decide)
  · exact nodeBytes_ne_tag _ _ _ _ (by decide)
  · exact False.elim (hn trivial)

/-- Includes separation from the retained eight-way node format. -/
theorem nodeBytes_ne_eightway (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) (ch : Fin 2 → RIdx)
    (tail : List UInt8) : nodeBytes rest ch ≠ (0x18 : UInt8) :: tail :=
  nodeBytes_ne_tag _ _ _ _ (by decide)

/-- Avoid unfolding a byte-array traversal for each literal domain. -/
theorem byteArray_toList_length (bs : ByteArray) : bs.toList.length = bs.size := by
  have aux : ∀ n i acc, bs.size - i = n →
      (ByteArray.toList.loop bs i acc).length = acc.length + n := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h n ih =>
      intro i acc hn
      rw [ByteArray.toList.loop]
      split
      · rename_i hi
        rw [ih (bs.size - (i + 1)) (by omega) (i + 1) (bs.get! i :: acc) rfl]
        simp only [List.length_cons]
        omega
      · simp only [List.length_reverse]
        omega
  simpa only [ByteArray.toList, List.length_nil, Nat.zero_add] using
    (aux bs.size 0 [] (by omega))

/-- Named wire-length condition: `Rest` otherwise permits arbitrary bytes.
The wire/source refinement must establish this for actual message encodings. -/
def TranscriptNodeLengths (r : Rest) : Prop :=
  (∀ i, (r.framed i).length ≠ 31) ∧
  (∀ i, (r.payload i).length ≠ 27) ∧ r.final.length ≠ 27

theorem nodeBytes_ne_transcript (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) (ch : Fin 2 → RIdx)
    (j : TRead) (f : OracleAnswer) (r : Rest) (hr : TranscriptNodeLengths r) :
    nodeBytes rest ch ≠ addrWith j f r := by
  intro h
  have hl := congrArg List.length h
  rw [nodeBytes_length] at hl
  cases j with
  | init =>
      have hs : semDomain.length = 38 := by
        rw [semDomain, byteArray_toList_length]; rfl
      simp only [addrWith, List.length_append, List.length_singleton, length_ans] at hl
      simp only [le32, List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at hl
      rw [hs] at hl
      omega
  | reseed =>
      have hs : openDomain.length = 29 := by
        rw [openDomain, byteArray_toList_length]; rfl
      simp only [addrWith, List.length_append, List.length_singleton, length_ans] at hl
      rw [hs] at hl
      omega
  | absS i =>
      have hi := hr.1 i
      simp only [addrWith, List.length_append, length_ans, List.length_cons,
        List.length_nil] at hl
      omega
  | absO i =>
      have hi := hr.2.1 i
      simp [addrWith, length_ans, le32] at hl
      omega
  | absQ =>
      have hi := hr.2.2
      simp [addrWith, length_ans, le32] at hl
      omega
  | absR => simp [addrWith, length_ans, le32] at hl
  | sqS _ | advS _ | sqO _ | advO _ | qb _ | qa _ | sqR | advR =>
      simp [addrWith, length_ans] at hl

#print axioms byteArray_toList_length
#print axioms nodeBytes_length
#print axioms nodeBytes_ne_tag
#print axioms nodeBytes_ne_other_commit
#print axioms nodeBytes_ne_eightway
#print axioms nodeBytes_ne_transcript
end R1Z.LayoutR1PBin

/-! BINARY format (LOG D76; crates/aspis-r1-cost-probe/src/multiproof.rs
`binary_parent`: node `0x12 ‖ left ‖ right`, eighteen levels, leaves unchanged).
The eight-way original is `R1Z.LayoutR1P`, unchanged; here only the node
index algebra (`child_bound*`, `childQ`, `rootChild`), `nodeBytes` and the
designated child of a node (the right child, `1`) differ.

The commitment-phase byte layout of R1 (DESIGN-R1-REAL §3), from the Rust
source (read with `git show origin/codex/100bit-spend-path-20261013:…`):
prover.rs (precommit binding, three salted trees), state_only_entropy.rs
(attempt binding, source / D seeds, leaf salts, Profile21 expander),
state_only_hiding.rs (mask seed, SeedExpander), aspis-core state_only_hiding.rs
(`StateOnlyHidingContext::encode`), multiproof.rs (binary node `0x12 ‖ 2
children`), state_only_private_merkle.rs (leaf `0x10 ‖ tag ‖ value ‖ salt`).
Every Rust hash is `SHA256` of the concatenation of its slices.

* `gram`: the address of every commitment read (named premise
  `RCommitBytes Pr`: `Pr.caddr` is `gram`).
* `src`: the DESIGNATED FIELD of each read — an attempt secret (nonce,
  entropy, leaf-salt seed) or the answer of an earlier `RIdx` read — and
  `fld`: its reader (trailing 32 bytes, or a fixed offset).  `fld_gram`.
* `depS`: which secrets / `RIdx` answers each address reads; `gram` is
  unchanged by every other coordinate (`gram_rest_update`, `gram_sec_update`).
* `fresh_or_sep`: for two distinct reads, one does not read the other's
  designated field, or (seeds 0/1, two salts, two blocks of one expander
  stream) their addresses differ for every input.
* `openedQ`: the opened reads (roots, leaves at the opened fibres and their
  ancestors); `hidden`: the designated field of an unopened read is neither
  read by nor the answer of any opened read. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.LayoutR1PBin
open R0Z.FsStatement R1Z.LensR1 R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin
