/-! (c) end to end on the unified base (LOG D65 follow-up): the `QM31SamplerLaw` premise of
`privacy_R1_games_sampler` discharged in one closure by the spend path's extracted sampler,
`R1J.SamplerLawSpend.qm31SamplerLaw_spend` → `R1Z.SamplerLawBridge.toSem1`.

What remains a premise: `SemRows01 W` (the wire decoder reads χ = sem 1 from row 1 through
`s1`, and λ = sem 0 not from row 1), here with its `s1` fixed to `s1Spend ι` for an injective
`ι : QM31Exact → K` (the QM31 ↔ K carrier map), and the hypotheses of `privacy_R1_games`. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1J.PrivacySamplerSpend
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.HvzkV R0Z.HvzkS R0Z.RefPayload
  R1Z.Batched R1Z.PredicateR1 R1Z.MaskImageVR1 R1Z.PoleMassR1 R1Z.ModelsVR1 R1Z.SimulatorR1
  R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.Sem1UniformR1 R1Z.PrivacyGamesR1 R1Z.PrivacyGamesSamplerR1
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-- The sampler law for the wire's row-1 map, when that map is the spend path's extracted
`qm31_sample` read through an injective carrier map. -/
def samplerLaw_of_spend (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (D : SemRows01 W)
    (ι : R1J.SamplerLawSpend.QF → K) (hι : Function.Injective ι)
    (hD : D.s1 = R1J.SamplerLawSpend.s1Spend ι) : QM31SamplerLaw D.s1 := by
  rw [hD]
  exact R1Z.SamplerLawBridge.toSem1 (R1J.SamplerLawSpend.qm31SamplerLaw_spend ι hι)

/-- `privacy_R1_games_sampler` with `QM31SamplerLaw` discharged by the extracted sampler. -/
theorem privacy_R1_games_spendSampler (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (Pr : R1Prover K CommitHandle Aux F W)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : R0Z.K4.PackField B)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hpub : PublicBase F x.1)
    (hs : R0Z.HonestValidity.BuilderSoundOn h B x) (Mc : ℕ) (εexh : ℚ)
    (hd : ∀ (adv : R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux) (w : h.Instance), h.public w = x.1 →
      ∃ d : R1RealData W Pr N hN (P_R1 h.transport B hB) (fun h' => VR1 h') h (VR1 h) B outputs x
          adv w Mc,
        d.Agree ∧ R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass d.exh ≤ εexh)
    (D : SemRows01 W) (ι : R1J.SamplerLawSpend.QF → K) (hι : Function.Injective ι)
    (hD : D.s1 = R1J.SamplerLawSpend.s1Spend ι) :
    ZK_FSS h B outputs (fsR1 W Pr N hN (P_R1 h.transport B hB) (fun h' => VR1 h')) x
      (simE h.transport B outputs x)
      (((N * (115 + Mc) : ℕ) : ℚ) * (W.qmax : ℕ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
        (((N * (115 + Mc) : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((N * (115 + Mc) : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) + εexh) +
        ((0 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((0 : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
        (abR1 W N hN).N * ((4096 : ℚ) / (((2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 - 1 : ℕ) : ℚ))) :=
  privacy_R1_games_sampler W Pr N hN h B hB outputs x hpub hs Mc εexh hd D
    (samplerLaw_of_spend W D ι hι hD)

end R1J.PrivacySamplerSpend

#print axioms R1J.PrivacySamplerSpend.samplerLaw_of_spend

/-! `privacy_R1_games` with its `Sem1Uniform` hypothesis discharged by
`sem1Uniform_drawW`: the `hdraw` premise is replaced by the wire facts
`SemRows01 W` and `QM31SamplerLaw`, and `Q = p⁴ − 1`.  The landed theorem is
unchanged; this is a new corollary. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PrivacyGamesSamplerR1
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.HvzkV R0Z.HvzkS R0Z.RefPayload
  R1Z.Batched R1Z.PredicateR1 R1Z.MaskImageVR1 R1Z.PoleMassR1 R1Z.ModelsVR1 R1Z.SimulatorR1
  R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.Sem1UniformR1 R1Z.PrivacyGamesR1
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-- The R1 privacy theorem for the concrete games against `simE`, with the
sampler premise discharged: error `N(115+Mc)·q/2^255 + (N(115+Mc))²/2^255 +
εexh + N·4096/(p⁴ − 1)`. -/
theorem privacy_R1_games_sampler (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (Pr : R1Prover K CommitHandle Aux F W)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : R0Z.K4.PackField B)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hpub : PublicBase F x.1)
    (hs : R0Z.HonestValidity.BuilderSoundOn h B x) (Mc : ℕ) (εexh : ℚ)
    (hd : ∀ (adv : R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux) (w : h.Instance), h.public w = x.1 →
      ∃ d : R1RealData W Pr N hN (P_R1 h.transport B hB) (fun h' => VR1 h') h (VR1 h) B outputs x
          adv w Mc,
        d.Agree ∧ R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass d.exh ≤ εexh)
    (D : SemRows01 W) (L : QM31SamplerLaw D.s1) :
    ZK_FSS h B outputs (fsR1 W Pr N hN (P_R1 h.transport B hB) (fun h' => VR1 h')) x
      (simE h.transport B outputs x)
      (((N * (115 + Mc) : ℕ) : ℚ) * (W.qmax : ℕ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
        (((N * (115 + Mc) : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((N * (115 + Mc) : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) + εexh) +
        ((0 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((0 : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
        (abR1 W N hN).N * ((4096 : ℚ) / (((2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 - 1 : ℕ) : ℚ))) :=
  privacy_R1_games W Pr N hN h B hB outputs x hpub hs Mc ((2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 - 1) εexh hd
    (sem1Uniform_drawW W D L)

end R1Z.PrivacyGamesSamplerR1
R1Z.Sem1UniformR1:
import R1Z.SamplerLawR1
import R1Z.PoleMassR1
import R1Z.GamesR1

/-! Sem1Uniform (LOG D42.3) for the concrete R1 games.  In `abR1` the attempt
coins carry every transcript read's answer as an independent uniform
coordinate; the draw is `W.dec` of the squeeze answers.  Two named premises
on the wire data, both R-wire refinement facts (LOG D45.5):

* `SemRows01 W`: `sem 1` (χ) is `s1` of the row-1 squeeze answer `sqS 1`, and
  `sem 0` (λ) does not read `sqS 1` (r1_wire.rs `begin`: λ from row 0, whose
  absorb carries C1, χ from row 1; the C1 absorb enters the address, not the
  answer, so it does not touch the coin coordinate);
* `QM31SamplerLaw s1`: `s1 b = emb (rank b mod p⁴)` with `rank` a bijection
  onto `Fin 2^256` and `emb` injective below `p⁴` (sampler.rs `qm31_sample`;
  restated from the spend path's `ExtractedQM31SamplerCorrect.sample_total`
  + `SamplerNatModel.qm31Digits_value` + `SourceSamplerByteRank.rank` =
  `ModuloField.blockRank ∘ decodeState`, an `Equiv`; the K-side carrier map
  `emb` and its injectivity are the `sampled_decode_eq_iff` content).

Result: `Sem1Uniform (drawW W) (p⁴ − 1)` for every wire satisfying them, so
`Sem1Uniform ((abR1 W N hN).draw adv x) (p⁴ − 1)` for every adversary and
statement; exact form `m·(⌊2^256/p⁴⌋+1)/2^256`.  No additive term.  ROM
address repeats do not arise here: `abR1`'s answers are independent coin
coordinates; repeats belong to the real↔middle coupling (ε_coll). -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.Sem1UniformR1
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsAbortBounds R1Z.LensR1
  R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.PoleMassR1 R1Z.SamplerLawR1
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K]

/-- R-wire (HYP): the decoder's rows 0 and 1.  `sem 1 = s1 (row-1 answer)`;
`sem 0` does not read the row-1 answer. -/
structure SemRows01 (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) where
  s1 : OracleAnswer → K
  sem1 : ∀ (a : Fin 27 → OracleAnswer) (o : Fin 4 → OracleAnswer) (qb : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer)
    (r : OracleAnswer), (W.dec a o qb r).sem 1 = s1 (a 1)
  sem0 : ∀ (a a' : Fin 27 → OracleAnswer) (o : Fin 4 → OracleAnswer) (qb : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer)
    (r : OracleAnswer), (∀ i : Fin 27, i ≠ 1 → a i = a' i) →
      (W.dec a o qb r).sem 0 = (W.dec a' o qb r).sem 0

/-- The QM31 sampler law (restated from the spend path, HYP for the K carrier):
rank the 32 bytes bijectively into `Fin 2^256`, reduce mod `p⁴`, embed
injectively. -/
structure QM31SamplerLaw (s1 : OracleAnswer → K) where
  rank : OracleAnswer ≃ Fin (2 ^ 256)
  emb : ℕ → K
  emb_inj : ∀ x y : ℕ, x < (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 → y < (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 → emb x = emb y → x = y
  sample : ∀ b, s1 b = emb ((rank b).val % (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4)

section
variable (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)

/-- The row-1 coin lens of one attempt. -/
abbrev row1Lens : Lens (R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) OracleAnswer := coinLens W (.ans (.sqS 1))

theorem row1Lens_set (c : R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) (u : OracleAnswer) :
    (row1Lens W).set c u = (Function.update c.1 (.sqS 1) u, c.2) := rfl

theorem row1Lens_get (c : R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) : (row1Lens W).get c = c.1 (.sqS 1) := rfl

theorem draw_sem1 (D : SemRows01 W) (c : R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) :
    (drawW (K := K) W c).sem 1 = D.s1 ((row1Lens W).get c) :=
  D.sem1 _ _ _ _

theorem draw_sem0_set (D : SemRows01 W) (c : R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) (u : OracleAnswer) :
    (drawW (K := K) W ((row1Lens W).set c u)).sem 0 = (drawW (K := K) W c).sem 0 := by
  rw [row1Lens_set]
  show (W.dec (fun i => Function.update c.1 (.sqS 1) u (.sqS i))
      (fun i => Function.update c.1 (.sqS 1) u (.sqO i))
      (fun k => Function.update c.1 (.sqS 1) u (.qb k))
      (Function.update c.1 (.sqS 1) u .sqR)).sem 0 =
    (W.dec (fun i => c.1 (.sqS i)) (fun i => c.1 (.sqO i)) (fun k => c.1 (.qb k))
      (c.1 .sqR)).sem 0
  have ho : (fun i => Function.update c.1 (.sqS 1) u (.sqO i)) = (fun i => c.1 (.sqO i)) :=
    funext fun i => Function.update_of_ne (by intro h; cases h) _ _
  have hq : (fun k => Function.update c.1 (.sqS 1) u (.qb k)) = (fun k => c.1 (.qb k)) :=
    funext fun k => Function.update_of_ne (by intro h; cases h) _ _
  have hr : Function.update c.1 (.sqS 1) u .sqR = c.1 .sqR :=
    Function.update_of_ne (by intro h; cases h) _ _
  rw [ho, hq, hr]
  exact D.sem0 _ _ _ _ _ (fun i hi => Function.update_of_ne (fun h => hi (TRead.sqS.inj h)) _ _)

/-- Exact form: a `λ`-indexed family of at most `m` values is hit by `χ` with
mass at most `m · (⌊2^256/p⁴⌋ + 1) / 2^256`. -/
theorem sem1_mass_le_exact (D : SemRows01 W) (L : QM31SamplerLaw D.s1)
    (T : K → Finset K) (m : ℕ) (hT : ∀ l, (T l).card ≤ m) :
    eventMass (fun c => (drawW (K := K) W c).sem 1 ∈ T ((drawW (K := K) W c).sem 0)) ≤
      ((m * (2 ^ 256 / (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 + 1) : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 256 : ℕ) : ℚ) := by
  rw [R0Z.FsAbortR1.eventMass_eq_mass,
    mass_congr _ (fun c => D.s1 ((row1Lens W).get c) ∈ T ((drawW (K := K) W c).sem 0))
      (fun c => by rw [draw_sem1 W D c])]
  exact lens_sampler_mass_le (row1Lens W) (fun c => (drawW (K := K) W c).sem 0) D.s1 T m
    (2 ^ 256) ((2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4) L.rank m31_q_pos L.emb L.emb_inj L.sample
    (draw_sem0_set W D) hT

/-- `Sem1Uniform` for the R1 draw with `Q = p⁴ − 1`. -/
theorem sem1Uniform_drawW (D : SemRows01 W) (L : QM31SamplerLaw D.s1) :
    Sem1Uniform (drawW (K := K) W) ((2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 - 1) := by
  intro T m hT
  rw [R0Z.FsAbortR1.eventMass_eq_mass,
    mass_congr _ (fun c => D.s1 ((row1Lens W).get c) ∈ T ((drawW (K := K) W c).sem 0))
      (fun c => by rw [draw_sem1 W D c])]
  exact lens_qm31_mass_le (row1Lens W) (fun c => (drawW (K := K) W c).sem 0) D.s1 T m
    L.rank L.emb L.emb_inj L.sample (draw_sem0_set W D) hT

    Sem1Uniform ((abR1 W N hN).draw adv x) ((2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 - 1) :=
  sem1Uniform_drawW W D L

import R1Z.LensR1
import R1Z.PoleN8

/-! Sem1Uniform (LOG D42.3) discharge, generic part.  The R1 χ sampler is
`qm31_sample` on the row-1 squeeze answer: the 32-byte block is ranked as a
256-bit integer (a bijection), reduced mod p⁴ (four base-p digits) and the
digits are packed injectively into QM31.  Restated from the spend path
(`ExtractedQM31SamplerCorrect.sample_total`, `SamplerNatModel.qm31Digits_value`,
`SourceSamplerByteRank.rank`, `ModuloField.blockRank`; SHAs in
zf1/sem1-uniform-evidence.json) as the hypothesis shape
`s1 b = emb ((rank b) % q)` with `rank` a bijection and `emb` injective
below `q`.

* `residue_card_le`: at most `n / q + 1` points of `Fin n` per residue mod q;
* `fibre_card_le`: hence every fibre of `s1` has at most `n / q + 1` points;
* `lens_mem_mass_le`: if a lens coordinate `u` feeds `s1` and the family
  index `lam` does not move with `u`, a family of `m` values is hit with mass
  at most `m · f / |U|` (f = fibre bound);
* `lens_qm31_mass_le`: for q = p⁴, n = 2^256 this is at most `m / (p⁴ − 1)`
  (exact: `m · (⌊2^256/p⁴⌋ + 1) / 2^256`), from the symbolic
  `(q − 1)(⌊n/q⌋ + 1) ≤ n` when `q² ≤ n`.
No concrete Finset over the 2^256 answers is evaluated. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.SamplerLawR1
open R0Z R0Z.FsAbortBounds R1Z.LensR1
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-! ### Counting -/

/-- At most `n / q + 1` ranks below `n` have a given residue mod `q`. -/
theorem residue_card_le {U : Type} [Fintype U] {n : ℕ} (rank : U ≃ Fin n) (q t : ℕ)
    (hq : 0 < q) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun u => (rank u).val % q = t)).card ≤ n / q + 1 := by
  have hmaps : Set.MapsTo (fun u => (rank u).val / q)
      (↑(Finset.univ.filter (fun u => (rank u).val % q = t)) : Set U)
      (↑(Finset.range (n / q + 1)) : Set ℕ) := by
    intro u _
    show (rank u).val / q ∈ Finset.range (n / q + 1)
    rw [Finset.mem_range]
    exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.div_le_div_right (rank u).isLt.le)
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun u => (rank u).val / q)
      (↑(Finset.univ.filter (fun u => (rank u).val % q = t)) : Set U) := by
    intro u hu v hv huv
    have hmu : (rank u).val % q = t := (Finset.mem_filter.1 (Finset.mem_coe.1 hu)).2
    have hmv : (rank v).val % q = t := (Finset.mem_filter.1 (Finset.mem_coe.1 hv)).2
    have huv' : (rank u).val / q = (rank v).val / q := huv
    have hval : (rank u).val = (rank v).val :=
      calc (rank u).val = q * ((rank u).val / q) + (rank u).val % q := (Nat.div_add_mod _ _).symm
        _ = q * ((rank v).val / q) + (rank v).val % q := by rw [huv', hmu, hmv]
        _ = (rank v).val := Nat.div_add_mod _ _
    exact rank.injective (Fin.ext hval)
  calc (Finset.univ.filter (fun u => (rank u).val % q = t)).card
      ≤ (Finset.range (n / q + 1)).card := Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn _ hmaps hinj
    _ = n / q + 1 := Finset.card_range _

/-- The fibres of `b ↦ emb (rank b mod q)` have at most `n / q + 1` points. -/
theorem fibre_card_le {U K : Type} [Fintype U] {n : ℕ} (rank : U ≃ Fin n) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (emb : ℕ → K) (hemb : ∀ x y : ℕ, x < q → y < q → emb x = emb y → x = y)
    (s1 : U → K) (hs : ∀ b, s1 b = emb ((rank b).val % q)) (y : K) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun u => s1 u = y)).card ≤ n / q + 1 := by
  by_cases h : ∃ u₀, s1 u₀ = y
  · obtain ⟨u₀, hu₀⟩ := h
    refine (Finset.card_le_card ?_).trans (residue_card_le rank q ((rank u₀).val % q) hq)
    intro u hu
    have hu2 : s1 u = y := (Finset.mem_filter.1 hu).2
    refine Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    apply hemb _ _ (Nat.mod_lt _ hq) (Nat.mod_lt _ hq)
    rw [← hs, ← hs, hu2, hu₀]
  · have he : Finset.univ.filter (fun u => s1 u = y) = ∅ := by
      apply Finset.filter_eq_empty_iff.2
      intro u _ hu
      exact h ⟨u, hu⟩
    rw [he, Finset.card_empty]
    exact Nat.zero_le _

/-- A family of `m` values is hit by `s1` on at most `m · f` points. -/
theorem mem_card_le {U K : Type} [Fintype U] (s1 : U → K) (T0 : Finset K) (m f : ℕ)
    (hT : T0.card ≤ m) (hfib : ∀ y, (Finset.univ.filter (fun u => s1 u = y)).card ≤ f) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun u => s1 u ∈ T0)).card ≤ m * f := by
  have h := Finset.card_le_mul_card_image_of_maps_to (f := s1)
    (s := Finset.univ.filter (fun u => s1 u ∈ T0)) (t := T0)
    (fun u hu => (Finset.mem_filter.1 hu).2) f
    (fun y _ => (Finset.card_le_card (fun u hu => Finset.mem_filter.2
      ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, (Finset.mem_filter.1 hu).2⟩)).trans (hfib y))
  calc _ ≤ f * T0.card := h
    _ ≤ f * m := Nat.mul_le_mul_left f hT
    _ = m * f := Nat.mul_comm _ _

/-- Uniform mass form of `mem_card_le`. -/
theorem mass_mem_le {U K : Type} [Fintype U] (s1 : U → K) (T0 : Finset K) (m f : ℕ)
    (hT : T0.card ≤ m) (hfib : ∀ y, (Finset.univ.filter (fun u => s1 u = y)).card ≤ f) :
    mass (fun u => s1 u ∈ T0) ≤ ((m * f : ℕ) : ℚ) / Fintype.card U := by
  have h' : ((Finset.univ.filter (fun u => s1 u ∈ T0)).card : ℚ) ≤ ((m * f : ℕ) : ℚ) := by
    exact_mod_cast mem_card_le s1 T0 m f hT hfib
  have hsum : (∑ u, if s1 u ∈ T0 then (1 : ℚ) else 0) =
      ((Finset.univ.filter (fun u => s1 u ∈ T0)).card : ℚ) := by
    first
      | exact Finset.sum_boole _ _
      | simp only [Finset.sum_boole]
      | rw [← Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
      | simp
  have key : (∑ u, if s1 u ∈ T0 then (1 : ℚ) else 0) / (Fintype.card U : ℚ) ≤
      ((m * f : ℕ) : ℚ) / Fintype.card U := by
    rw [hsum]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h' (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  unfold mass mean
  convert key using 3 with x _
  by_cases hx : s1 x ∈ T0 <;> simp [hx]

/-! ### The lens step -/

/-- If the lens coordinate `u` feeds `s1` and the family index `lam` does not
move with `u`, the event `s1 u ∈ T (lam s)` has mass at most `m · f / |U|`. -/
theorem lens_mem_mass_le {S U K : Type} [Fintype S] [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]
    (L : Lens S U) (lam : S → K) (s1 : U → K) (T : K → Finset K) (m f : ℕ)
    (hlam : ∀ s u, lam (L.set s u) = lam s) (hT : ∀ l, (T l).card ≤ m)
    (hfib : ∀ y, (Finset.univ.filter (fun u => s1 u = y)).card ≤ f) :
    mass (fun s => s1 (L.get s) ∈ T (lam s)) ≤ ((m * f : ℕ) : ℚ) / Fintype.card U := by
  have hδ : (0 : ℚ) ≤ ((m * f : ℕ) : ℚ) / Fintype.card U := by positivity
  have h := mass_cond_le (L.equiv (Classical.arbitrary U)) (fun _ => True)
    (fun s => s1 (L.get s) ∈ T (lam s)) _ hδ (fun _ _ _ _ => trivial) (by
      intro r x₀ _
      have hc : ∀ x, s1 (L.get ((L.equiv (Classical.arbitrary U)).symm (r, x))) ∈
          T (lam ((L.equiv (Classical.arbitrary U)).symm (r, x))) ↔ s1 x ∈ T (lam r.1) := by
        intro x
        rw [Lens.equiv_symm, L.get_set, hlam]
      rw [mass_congr _ _ hc]
      exact mass_mem_le s1 (T (lam r.1)) m f (hT _) hfib)
  calc mass (fun s => s1 (L.get s) ∈ T (lam s))
      = mass (fun s => True ∧ s1 (L.get s) ∈ T (lam s)) :=
        mass_congr _ _ (fun s => ⟨fun hs => ⟨trivial, hs⟩, fun hs => hs.2⟩)
    _ ≤ mass (fun _ : S => True) * (((m * f : ℕ) : ℚ) / Fintype.card U) := h
    _ ≤ 1 * (((m * f : ℕ) : ℚ) / Fintype.card U) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mass_le_one _) hδ
    _ = ((m * f : ℕ) : ℚ) / Fintype.card U := one_mul _

/-- The lens step with the rank-mod-q sampler: mass at most `m (n/q + 1) / n`. -/
theorem lens_sampler_mass_le {S U K : Type} [Fintype S] [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]
    (L : Lens S U) (lam : S → K) (s1 : U → K) (T : K → Finset K) (m n q : ℕ)
    (rank : U ≃ Fin n) (hq : 0 < q) (emb : ℕ → K)
    (hemb : ∀ x y : ℕ, x < q → y < q → emb x = emb y → x = y)
    (hs : ∀ b, s1 b = emb ((rank b).val % q))
    (hlam : ∀ s u, lam (L.set s u) = lam s) (hT : ∀ l, (T l).card ≤ m) :
    mass (fun s => s1 (L.get s) ∈ T (lam s)) ≤ ((m * (n / q + 1) : ℕ) : ℚ) / n := by
  have hc : Fintype.card U = n := by rw [Fintype.card_congr rank, Fintype.card_fin]
  have h := lens_mem_mass_le L lam s1 T m (n / q + 1) hlam hT
    (fibre_card_le rank q hq emb hemb s1 hs)
  rwa [hc] at h

/-! ### Arithmetic: from the exact bound to `m / (q − 1)` -/

/-- `(q − 1)(⌊n/q⌋ + 1) ≤ n` whenever `q² ≤ n`. -/
theorem pred_mul_div_succ_le (q n : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hqq : q * q ≤ n) :
    (q - 1) * (n / q + 1) ≤ n := by
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ : ∃ r, q = r + 1 := ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩
  have hf : r + 1 ≤ n / (r + 1) := (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hq).2 hqq
  have hr : r ≤ n / (r + 1) := Nat.le_of_succ_le hf
  rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  calc r * (n / (r + 1) + 1) = r * (n / (r + 1)) + r := by rw [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one]
    _ ≤ r * (n / (r + 1)) + n / (r + 1) := Nat.add_le_add_left hr _
    _ = (r + 1) * (n / (r + 1)) := (add_one_mul r (n / (r + 1))).symm
    _ ≤ n := Nat.mul_div_le n (r + 1)

theorem mul_div_le_div (m g n Q : ℕ) (hQ : 0 < Q) (hn : 0 < n) (h : Q * g ≤ n) :
    ((m * g : ℕ) : ℚ) / n ≤ (m : ℚ) / Q := by
  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by exact_mod_cast hn) (by exact_mod_cast hQ)]
  have hm : m * g * Q ≤ m * n :=
    calc m * g * Q = m * (Q * g) := by rw [Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_comm g Q]
      _ ≤ m * n := Nat.mul_le_mul_left m h
  exact_mod_cast hm

/-! ### The M31 numerals (symbolic) -/

/-- `p⁴ · p⁴ ≤ 2^256` for `p = 2^31 − 1`. -/
theorem m31_q_sq_le : (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 * (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 ≤ 2 ^ 256 := by
  have h : (2 ^ 31 - 1 : ℕ) ≤ 2 ^ 31 := Nat.sub_le _ _
  have h4 : ((2 : ℕ) ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 ≤ (2 ^ 31) ^ 4 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left h 4
  calc ((2 : ℕ) ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 * (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 ≤ (2 ^ 31) ^ 4 * (2 ^ 31) ^ 4 :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul h4 h4
    _ ≤ 2 ^ 256 := by
        rw [← pow_mul, ← pow_add]
        exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by norm_num)

/-- `p⁴ − 1 ≥ 2^123` for `p = 2^31 − 1` (as `PoleN8.m31_pow4`, with the slack). -/
theorem m31_pow4_pred : 2 ^ 123 ≤ (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 - 1 := by
  have h31 : (2 : ℕ) ^ 31 = 2 * 2 ^ 30 := by norm_num
  have h123 : (2 : ℕ) ^ 123 = 2 ^ 3 * (2 ^ 30) ^ 4 := by
    rw [← pow_mul, ← pow_add]
  have h4 : (4 : ℕ) ≤ 2 ^ 30 := by norm_num
  rw [h31, h123]
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h4
  rw [hy, show 2 * (4 + y) - 1 = 2 * y + 7 by omega,
    show (2 * y + 7) ^ 4 = 2 ^ 3 * (4 + y) ^ 4 +
      (8 * y ^ 4 + 96 * y ^ 3 + 408 * y ^ 2 + 696 * y + 353) by ring]
  exact Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt (Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right (by positivity))

theorem m31_q_pos : 0 < (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 :=
  lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) (m31_pow4_pred.trans (Nat.sub_le _ _))

theorem m31_qpred_pos : 0 < (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 - 1 :=
  lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) m31_pow4_pred

/-- `(p⁴ − 1)(⌊2^256/p⁴⌋ + 1) ≤ 2^256`. -/
theorem m31_pred_mul_le :
    ((2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 - 1) * (2 ^ 256 / (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 + 1) ≤ 2 ^ 256 :=
  pred_mul_div_succ_le _ _ m31_q_pos m31_q_sq_le

/-- The QM31 sampler on a lens coordinate of 2^256 points: a family of `m`
values is hit with mass at most `m / (p⁴ − 1)`. -/
theorem lens_qm31_mass_le {S U K : Type} [Fintype S] [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]
    (L : Lens S U) (lam : S → K) (s1 : U → K) (T : K → Finset K) (m : ℕ)
    (rank : U ≃ Fin (2 ^ 256)) (emb : ℕ → K)
    (hemb : ∀ x y : ℕ, x < (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 → y < (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 → emb x = emb y → x = y)
    (hs : ∀ b, s1 b = emb ((rank b).val % (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4))
    (hlam : ∀ s u, lam (L.set s u) = lam s) (hT : ∀ l, (T l).card ≤ m) :
    mass (fun s => s1 (L.get s) ∈ T (lam s)) ≤ (m : ℚ) / (((2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 - 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) :=
  (lens_sampler_mass_le L lam s1 T m (2 ^ 256) ((2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4) rank m31_q_pos emb hemb hs
    hlam hT).trans
    (mul_div_le_div m _ _ _ m31_qpred_pos (by positivity) m31_pred_mul_le)

/-- The pole term at N = 8 with `Q = p⁴ − 1`: still `≤ 2^-108`. -/
theorem pole_N8_M31_pred :
    ((8 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((4096 : ℚ) / (((2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 - 1 : ℕ) : ℚ)) ≤ 1 / 2 ^ 108 :=
  R1Z.PoleN8.pole_N8 _ m31_pow4_pred

import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Field.Rat
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
import Mathlib.Tactic.Positivity

/-! J0c numeral (LOG D40.3, D42.1): the pole term of `privacy_R1` at the cap
N = 8, `N · (4096 / Q) ≤ 2^-108` whenever `Q ≥ 2^123`, and `p⁴ ≥ 2^123` for
the M31 prime `p = 2^31 − 1` (`AspisCircleGroupOrder.P` is the abbreviation
`2 ^ 31 - 1`), so for `Q = p⁴ = |QM31|` the pole term is at most 2^-108.
No large numeral is evaluated: `p⁴ ≥ 2^123` is the polynomial inequality
`8·(4+y)⁴ ≤ (2y+7)⁴` at `2^30 = 4 + y`, and the ℚ bound is a monotonicity step
plus `2^123 = 2^15 · 2^108`.  This module imports only the tactics it uses. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace R1Z.PoleN8

/-- `p⁴ ≥ 2^123` for `p = 2^31 − 1`. -/
theorem m31_pow4 : 2 ^ 123 ≤ (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 := by
  have h31 : (2 : ℕ) ^ 31 = 2 * 2 ^ 30 := by norm_num
  have h123 : (2 : ℕ) ^ 123 = 2 ^ 3 * (2 ^ 30) ^ 4 := by
    rw [← pow_mul, ← pow_add]
  have h4 : (4 : ℕ) ≤ 2 ^ 30 := by norm_num
  rw [h31, h123]
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h4
  rw [hy, show 2 * (4 + y) - 1 = 2 * y + 7 by omega,
    show (2 * y + 7) ^ 4 = 2 ^ 3 * (4 + y) ^ 4 +
      (8 * y ^ 4 + 96 * y ^ 3 + 408 * y ^ 2 + 696 * y + 353) by ring]
  exact Nat.le_add_right _ _

/-- The pole term of `privacy_R1` at N = 8 for any `Q ≥ 2^123`. -/
theorem pole_N8 (Q : ℕ) (hQ : 2 ^ 123 ≤ Q) :
    ((8 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((4096 : ℚ) / Q) ≤ 1 / 2 ^ 108 := by
  have hQ' : (2 : ℚ) ^ 123 ≤ Q := by exact_mod_cast hQ
  have hpos : (0 : ℚ) < 2 ^ 123 := by positivity
  have h1 : ((8 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((4096 : ℚ) / Q) = 2 ^ 15 / Q := by
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [h1]
  calc (2 : ℚ) ^ 15 / Q ≤ 2 ^ 15 / 2 ^ 123 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) hpos hQ'
    _ = 1 / 2 ^ 108 := by
      rw [show (123 : ℕ) = 15 + 108 from rfl, pow_add, div_mul_eq_div_div,
        div_self (by positivity)]

/-- The instantiation `Q = p⁴`, `p = 2^31 − 1`: `8 · 4096 / p⁴ ≤ 2^-108`. -/
theorem pole_N8_M31 :
    ((8 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((4096 : ℚ) / (((2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 : ℕ) : ℚ)) ≤ 1 / 2 ^ 108 :=
  pole_N8 _ m31_pow4

#print axioms m31_pow4
#print axioms pole_N8
#print axioms pole_N8_M31
end R1Z.PoleN8

import R0Z.HonestValidity
import R0Z.HvzkV

/-! J0c (LOG D40.3): the LogUp pole mass of one attempt.  `¬ NoPole t λ χ`
puts `χ` in `poleSet t λ`, at most 4·|active rows| ≤ 4096 values; under the
named sampler premise `Sem1Uniform draw Q` (χ = sem 1 uniform on Q values
given λ = sem 0; for R1, K₄ = QM31 and Q = p⁴) one attempt's pole mass is at
most 4096 / Q.  No Lean lemma fixes the law of the FS challenge draw
(FsGood.lean header: the alpha-row law "is not chosen here"; R0P MaskD2.lean
`uniform_point_mass` is for an abstract uniform type), so the premise is a
named hypothesis. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R1Z.PoleMassR1
open R0P R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.Shift R0Z.FsGood R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.HvzkV
attribute [local irreducible] copyLinks copyPatterns copyActiveRowMasks copyInactiveRows

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-! ### The pole mass -/

/-- The copy-active rows (kept opaque: never evaluated). -/
@[irreducible] def activeRows : Finset (Fin 1024) :=
  Finset.univ.filter (fun b : Fin 1024 => CopyActiveRow b)

theorem mem_activeRows (b : Fin 1024) (hb : CopyActiveRow b) : b ∈ activeRows := by
  unfold activeRows
  exact Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hb⟩

theorem activeRows_card_le : activeRows.card ≤ 1024 := by
  unfold activeRows
  exact (Finset.card_filter_le _ _).trans (by rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin])

/-- The four LogUp values of one active row and slot (producer or consumer). -/
def poleValue (t : Trace K) (lam : K) (p : Fin 1024 × Fin 2 × Bool) : K :=
  cond p.2.2 (copyRowValues t lam p.1 CopyLink.producer p.2.1)
    (copyRowValues t lam p.1 CopyLink.consumer p.2.1)

/-- All producer and consumer LogUp values of the active rows. -/
@[irreducible] def poleSet (t : Trace K) (lam : K) : Finset K :=
  (activeRows ×ˢ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2 × Bool))).image (poleValue t lam)

theorem poleValue_mem (t : Trace K) (lam : K) (p : Fin 1024 × Fin 2 × Bool)
    (hp : CopyActiveRow p.1) : poleValue t lam p ∈ poleSet t lam := by
  unfold poleSet
  exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem (poleValue t lam)
    (Finset.mem_product.2 ⟨mem_activeRows p.1 hp, Finset.mem_univ _⟩)

theorem mem_poleSet_of_not_noPole (t : Trace K) (lam chi : K)
    (hn : ¬ R0Z.HonestValidity.NoPole t lam chi) : chi ∈ poleSet t lam := by
  by_contra hc
  apply hn
  intro b hb s
  constructor
  · intro he
    apply hc
    have hm := poleValue_mem t lam (b, s, true) hb
    have hv : poleValue t lam (b, s, true) = chi := he.symm
    rw [hv] at hm
    exact hm
  · intro he
    apply hc
    have hm := poleValue_mem t lam (b, s, false) hb
    have hv : poleValue t lam (b, s, false) = chi := he.symm
    rw [hv] at hm
    exact hm

theorem poleSet_card_le (t : Trace K) (lam : K) :
    (poleSet t lam).card ≤ 4 * activeRows.card := by
  unfold poleSet
  -- Memory (J0d probes 3879/3880): the former `rw [...]; omega` closing of this
  -- lemma alone cost ≈440 MB over the import baseline; every step here closes
  -- syntactically, so nothing is asked to reduce `activeRows.card`.
  have hu : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2 × Bool)).card = 4 := by
    rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_bool]
  calc _ ≤ (activeRows ×ˢ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2 × Bool))).card := Finset.card_image_le
    _ = activeRows.card * 4 := by rw [Finset.card_product, hu]
    _ = 4 * activeRows.card := Nat.mul_comm _ _

theorem poleSet_card_le_4096 (t : Trace K) (lam : K) : (poleSet t lam).card ≤ 4096 :=
  (poleSet_card_le t lam).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 4 activeRows_card_le)

/-- Sampler premise (HYP): `χ = sem 1` is uniform on a set of `Q` values given
`λ = sem 0` (for R1: K₄ = QM31, `Q = p⁴`), in the upper-bound form used here:
for any `λ`-indexed family of at most `m` values, the draw hits it with mass at
most `m / Q`. -/
def Sem1Uniform {Coins : Type} [Fintype Coins] (draw : Coins → Challenges K) (Q : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : K → Finset K) (m : ℕ), (∀ l, (S l).card ≤ m) →
    eventMass (fun c => (draw c).sem 1 ∈ S ((draw c).sem 0)) ≤ (m : ℚ) / Q

/-- One attempt's pole mass for a fixed trace. -/
theorem pole_mass_le {Coins : Type} [Fintype Coins] (draw : Coins → Challenges K) (Q : ℕ)
    (hU : Sem1Uniform draw Q) (t : Trace K) :
    eventMass (fun c => ¬ R0Z.HonestValidity.NoPole t ((draw c).sem 0) ((draw c).sem 1)) ≤
      (4096 : ℚ) / Q := by
  have h := hU (poleSet t) 4096 (fun l => poleSet_card_le_4096 t l)
  refine (eventMass_mono (fun c => ¬ R0Z.HonestValidity.NoPole t ((draw c).sem 0) ((draw c).sem 1))
    (fun c => (draw c).sem 1 ∈ poleSet t ((draw c).sem 0))
    (fun c hc => mem_poleSet_of_not_noPole t _ _ hc)).trans ?_
  exact_mod_cast h

/-! J0b (DESIGN-ii-prime §1.5, §4 J0b; LOG D36.4, D39.2): honest builds and
`HonestValid`.

Through the row-1023 lemma `laneOf_actual_zero`, `HonestValid pub B t ch` is a
statement about the prepared instance `prepare pub t ch` (lane 26 = the
literal helper of `t`):

* lanes 0..27 of `prepare pub t ch` are those of `t` (`laneOf_prepare_lt`);
* lane 28 (Copy) of `prepare pub t ch` vanishes at every active row whose four
  LogUp denominators `χ − value` are nonzero, for EVERY trace
  (`copyHolds_prepare`): the helper is then exactly the fraction sum;
* the two helper sums of `actual pub B t ch 0` are those of `helper pub t`
  (`actual_26`).

So `honestValid_of` derives `HonestValid` from the named builder properties
`HonestBuilderSound` (base typing, the 28 non-copy production lanes, the two
helper sums) and the challenge condition `NoPole`.

The pole is a genuine obstruction (`not_honestValid_of_pole`): at an active
row where `χ` equals a producer value, the Copy lane is
`−(χ−c₀)(χ−c₁)·pw₀·(χ−p₁)` whatever the helper, so `HonestValid` fails.  The
condition depends on the witness's tuple values, so `ValidOn P` (validity for
every `P`-challenge) cannot be derived for honest builds from builder
properties alone (`validOn_of_noPole` needs `NoPole` at every `P`-challenge).
Nothing here is assumed beyond the stated hypotheses. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R0Z.HonestValidity
open R0P R0P.Sumcheck R0P.SemSource R0Z.MaskLayout R0Z.HonestView R0Z.Partition R0Z.D12

attribute [local irreducible] copyLinks copyPatterns copyActiveRowMasks copyInactiveRows

variable {K CommitHandle : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-! ### The prepared instance -/

theorem prepare_sem (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K) (c : Fin 16) (r : Fin 1024) :
    prepare pub t ch (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) r = t (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) r := by
  have hc : c.val ≠ 26 := by have := c.isLt; omega
  simp only [prepare, Fin.val_castLE, hc, ↓reduceIte]

theorem rowOpenings_prepare (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K) (b : Fin 1024) :
    rowOpenings (prepare pub t ch) b = rowOpenings t b := by
  simp only [rowOpenings, prepare_sem]

theorem copyEndpointTuple_prepare (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K) (tag : Nat)
    (ep : CopyEndpoint) :
    copyEndpointTuple (prepare pub t ch) tag ep = copyEndpointTuple t tag ep := by
  simp only [copyEndpointTuple, prepare_sem]

theorem copyRowValues_prepare (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K) (lam : K)
    (b : Fin 1024) (endpoint : CopyLink → CopyEndpoint) (slot : Fin 2) :
    copyRowValues (prepare pub t ch) lam b endpoint slot = copyRowValues t lam b endpoint slot := by
  simp only [copyRowValues, copyEndpointTuple_prepare]

theorem prepare_26 (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K) (b : Fin 1024) :
    prepare pub t ch 26 b = helper pub t (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) b := by
  unfold prepare
  exact if_pos rfl

/-- Lanes 0..27 (Poseidon and the packed semantic families) read only the
semantic openings, so preparing H1 changes none of them. -/
theorem laneOf_prepare_lt (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K) (lam chi : K)
    (B : PackBasis F) (i : Fin 29) (bits : Fin 10 → Bool) (hi : i.val < 28) :
    laneOf (prepare pub t ch) pub lam chi B i bits = laneOf t pub lam chi B i bits := by
  unfold laneOf
  by_cases h4 : i.val < 4
  · simp only [dif_pos h4, rowOpenings_prepare]
  · simp only [dif_neg h4, dif_pos hi, semanticPackedLane, scalarLaneRow, rowOpenings_prepare]

/-- Lane 28 is the single Copy residual. -/
theorem laneOf_copy (t : Trace K) (pub : Public K) (lam chi : K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (bits : Fin 10 → Bool) :
    laneOf t pub lam chi B 28 bits =
      (copyFamily.residuals pub lam chi (rowOpenings t (rowOf bits)) (t 26 (rowOf bits))
        (rowSel (rowOf bits))).getD 0 0 := rfl

/-- H1 of the payload trace is the literal helper of the instance. -/
theorem actual_26 (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K) (r : Fin 1024) :
    PayloadSplit.actual pub B t ch 0 26 r = helper pub t (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) r := by
  have h0 : (Sum.elim 0 (aff (0 : T K F)) : MaskTape K F) = 0 := by
    rw [map_zero (aff (K := K) (F := F))]
    funext z
    cases z <;> rfl
  unfold PayloadSplit.actual
  rw [R0Z.TerminalEligible.h1_applyAff, h0, R0Z.TerminalEligible.h1Padding_zero, Pi.zero_apply,
    add_zero, prepare_26]
  exact R0Z.HelperInvariant.helper_eligible pub t _ _ _ r

/-! ### The Copy lane away from poles -/

/-- No LogUp denominator of an active row vanishes at `χ`. -/
def NoPole (t : Trace K) (lam chi : K) : Prop :=
  ∀ b : Fin 1024, CopyActiveRow b → ∀ s : Fin 2,
    chi ≠ copyRowValues t lam b CopyLink.producer s ∧ chi ≠ copyRowValues t lam b CopyLink.consumer s

/-- Away from poles the Copy family holds on the prepared instance of EVERY trace. -/
theorem copyHolds_prepare (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K)
    (hnp : NoPole t (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1)) :
    CHolds copyFamily pub (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) (prepare pub t ch) := by
  rw [copy_holds_iff]
  intro b hb
  dsimp only
  simp only [copyRowValues_prepare, prepare_26]
  obtain ⟨hp0, hc0⟩ := hnp b hb 0
  obtain ⟨hp1, hc1⟩ := hnp b hb 1
  have dp0 := sub_ne_zero.2 hp0
  have dp1 := sub_ne_zero.2 hp1
  have dc0 := sub_ne_zero.2 hc0
  have dc1 := sub_ne_zero.2 hc1
  simp only [helper, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  field_simp
  ring

/-! ### The builder properties and HonestValid -/

/-- J0b: the properties of an honest build that `HonestValid` needs, stated on
the raw instance trace.  `lanes` is ProductionHolds without the Copy family
(lanes 0..27 do not read λ, χ or H1); `helperSum` and `helperInactive` are the
two helper sums of the source terminal (Pair-forest terminal:1307–1308). -/
structure HonestBuilderSound (F : Subfield K) (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) :
    Prop where
  baseTyped : BaseTyped F t
  lanes : ∀ (lam chi : K) (i : Fin 29) (b : Fin 10 → Bool), i.val < 28 → laneOf t pub lam chi B i b = 0
  helperSum : ∀ lam chi : K, ∑ r, helper pub t lam chi r = 0
  helperInactive : ∀ lam chi : K, ∑ r ∈ copyInactiveRows, helper pub t lam chi r = 0

/-- J0b: an honest build is valid at every pole-free challenge. -/
theorem honestValid_of (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K)
    (hs : HonestBuilderSound F pub B t) (hnp : NoPole t (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1)) :
    R0Z.HonestValid.HonestValid pub B t ch := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i b
    rw [R0Z.IIPrimeResidual.laneOf_actual_zero]
    by_cases hi : i.val < 28
    · rw [laneOf_prepare_lt pub t ch _ _ B i b hi]
      exact hs.lanes _ _ i b hi
    · obtain rfl : i = 28 := Fin.ext (by have := i.isLt; omega)
      rw [laneOf_copy]
      exact copyHolds_prepare pub t ch hnp (rowOf b) _ (List.mem_singleton_self _)
  · simp only [actual_26]
    exact hs.helperSum _ _
  · simp only [actual_26]
    exact hs.helperInactive _ _

/-- The prover-level form: honest instances of the statement. -/
def BuilderSoundOn (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle) : Prop :=
  ∀ w, h.public w = x.1 → HonestBuilderSound F x.1 B (h.build w)

theorem baseTyped_of (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (hs : BuilderSoundOn h B x) : ∀ w, h.public w = x.1 → BaseTyped F (h.build w) :=
  fun w hw => (hs w hw).baseTyped

/-- `ValidOn P` for an honest instance needs `NoPole` at every `P`-challenge. -/
theorem validOn_of_noPole (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hs : BuilderSoundOn h B x) (w : h.Instance)
    (hw : h.public w = x.1)
    (hnp : ∀ ch, P ch → NoPole (h.build w) (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1)) :
    R0Z.HonestValid.ValidOn P h B x w :=
  fun ch hP => honestValid_of x.1 B (h.build w) ch (hs w hw) (hnp ch hP)

/-! ### The pole obstruction -/

/-- At an active row with `χ` equal to producer value 0, `HonestValid` fails
unless `(χ−c₀)(χ−c₁)·pw₀·(χ−p₁) = 0`; the helper value plays no role. -/
theorem not_honestValid_of_pole (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K)
    (b : Fin 1024) (hb : CopyActiveRow b)
    (hχ : ch.sem 1 = copyRowValues t (ch.sem 0) b CopyLink.producer 0)
    (hne : ((ch.sem 1 - copyRowValues t (ch.sem 0) b CopyLink.consumer 0) *
        (ch.sem 1 - copyRowValues t (ch.sem 0) b CopyLink.consumer 1)) *
      (copyRowWeights pub b CopyLink.producer 0 *
        (ch.sem 1 - copyRowValues t (ch.sem 0) b CopyLink.producer 1)) ≠ 0) :
    ¬ R0Z.HonestValid.HonestValid pub B t ch := by
  intro hv
  have hC : CHolds copyFamily pub (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) (prepare pub t ch) := by
    intro b' r hr
    rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hr]
    have h1 := hv.1 28 (rowBits b')
    rw [R0Z.IIPrimeResidual.laneOf_actual_zero, laneOf_copy, rowOf_rowBits] at h1
    exact h1
  have he := (copy_holds_iff pub (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) (prepare pub t ch)).1 hC b hb
  dsimp only at he
  simp only [copyRowValues_prepare] at he
  rw [← hχ] at he
  simp only [sub_self, zero_mul, mul_zero, add_zero] at he
  exact hne he.symm

#print axioms prepare_sem
#print axioms rowOpenings_prepare
#print axioms copyEndpointTuple_prepare
#print axioms copyRowValues_prepare
#print axioms prepare_26
#print axioms laneOf_prepare_lt
#print axioms laneOf_copy
#print axioms actual_26
#print axioms NoPole
#print axioms copyHolds_prepare
#print axioms HonestBuilderSound
#print axioms honestValid_of
#print axioms BuilderSoundOn
#print axioms baseTyped_of
#print axioms validOn_of_noPole
#print axioms not_honestValid_of_pole
end R0Z.HonestValidity

/-! J15 (DESIGN-ii-prime §2.3–2.4; DESIGN-R1-PRIVACY-MODEL §4 J15-R1), the
Bat-generic part: the residual steps and the mask lift of clause (ii′).

namespace R0Z.IIPrimeResidual
open R0P R0P.Sumcheck R0P.SemSource R0P.SemDegree R0Z.MaskLayout R0Z.HonestView
  R0Z.Partition R0Z.D12 R0Z.Shift R0Z.K4 Polynomial

attribute [local irreducible] copyLinks copyPatterns copyActiveRowMasks copyInactiveRows

variable {K CommitHandle : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
  {Bat : Type} [BatchedLayer K Bat]

/-! ### Lanes of the payload trace -/

/-- Row-1023 lemma (LOG D36.4): the lanes of the payload trace equal those of
the prepared instance, for every `λ, χ`.  Row 1023 is read by `rowOpenings`
(at rows 1023, 1022 and 1011), but no lane value changes under the
rebalancing (`lanes_eligible`; copy endpoints are `Protected`, row ≠ 1023). -/
theorem laneOf_actual_zero (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K)
    (lam chi : K) :
    laneOf (PayloadSplit.actual pub B t ch 0) pub lam chi B = laneOf (prepare pub t ch) pub lam chi B := by
  have h0 : (Sum.elim 0 (aff (0 : T K F)) : MaskTape K F) = 0 := by
    rw [map_zero (aff (K := K) (F := F))]
    funext z
    cases z <;> rfl
  funext i bits
  rw [laneOf_eq_laneAt, laneOf_eq_laneAt]
  unfold PayloadSplit.actual
  rw [R0Z.TerminalEligible.openings_applyAff, R0Z.TerminalEligible.h1_applyAff, h0,
    R0Z.TerminalEligible.h1Padding_zero, Pi.zero_apply, add_zero,
    R0Z.TerminalEligible.prepare_eligible, R0Z.TerminalEligible.lanes_eligible]

/-- The semantic lanes of the payload trace of a base-typed instance are F-valued. -/
theorem actual_sem_mem (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K)
    (hF : BaseTyped F t) (l : Fin 29) (hl : l.val < 16) (s : Fin 1024) :
    PayloadSplit.actual pub B t ch 0 l s ∈ F := by
  unfold PayloadSplit.actual applyAff
  try dsimp only
  rw [if_pos hl]
  unfold prepare
  try dsimp only
  rw [if_neg (by omega)]
  unfold applyEligible
  try dsimp only
  rw [if_pos hl]
  refine R0Z.K4Values.balance_mem F 1023 _ (fun s' => ?_) s
  refine F.add_mem (hF l (by omega) s') ?_
  unfold semanticNoise
  split_ifs
  · exact Subtype.mem _
  · exact F.zero_mem

/-- Lanes 16..25, 27, 28 of the payload trace are zero. -/
theorem actual_other_zero (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K)
    (l : Fin 29) (hl : ¬ (l.val < 16 ∨ l.val = 26)) :
    PayloadSplit.actual pub B t ch 0 l = 0 := by
  have he : PayloadSplit.actual pub B t ch 0 =
      traceBase (prepare pub (applyEligible t (0 : T K F).2.2) ch) + traceLinear B (aff (0 : T K F)) :=
    applyAff_eq_base_add B (prepare pub (applyEligible t (0 : T K F).2.2) ch) (aff (0 : T K F))
  rw [he, map_zero (aff (K := K) (F := F)), map_zero (traceLinear B), add_zero]
  funext s
  simp only [traceBase, hl, ↓reduceIte, Pi.zero_apply]

/-! ### `cTilde` and Φ₀ (R4) -/

/-- The direction coefficient `k = fOrig u(α)·(α₉ − ½)⁻¹`. -/
def kOf (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) : K :=
  fOrig x.1 B ch (PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch 0) (alpha ch) * (alpha ch 9 - 1/2)⁻¹

theorem cTilde_eq (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) :
    cTilde (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch =
      PayloadSplit.L h.transport B ch (PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch 0) +
        PayloadSplit.roundInclusion
          (PayloadSplit.originalRounds x.1 B ch (PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch 0)) -
        kOf h B x w ch • dir := by
  unfold cTilde kOf
  rw [originalOf_c]
  rw [show (c (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch) = _ from R0Z.HonestValid.c_eq h B x w ch]
  all_goals rfl

/-- (R4): `Φ₀(cTilde) = 0` off `α₉ = ½`. -/
theorem Phi0_cTilde (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) (hhalf : alpha ch 9 ≠ 1/2) :
    Phi0 B ch (cTilde (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch) = 0 := by
  rw [cTilde_eq, map_sub, map_add, Phi0_L, Phi0_roundInclusion, evalRound9_originalRounds,
    map_smul, Phi0_dir, smul_eq_mul, zero_add]
  unfold kOf
  have hne : alpha ch 9 - 1/2 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hhalf
  rw [mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hne, mul_one, sub_self]

/-! ### The chain equalities (R6) -/

/-- The nine boundary-chain equalities of the ten rounds. -/
def ChainEqs (ch : Challenges K) : Submodule K (Payload K Bat) :=
  ⨅ j : Fin 9, LinearMap.ker
    (Chain.evalRound j.succ 0 + Chain.evalRound j.succ 1 - Chain.evalRound j.castSucc (alpha ch j.castSucc))

theorem mem_chainEqs_iff (ch : Challenges K) (v : Payload K Bat) :
    v ∈ ChainEqs ch ↔ ∀ j : Fin 9, (Chain.roundPoly j.succ v).eval 0 + (Chain.roundPoly j.succ v).eval 1 =
      (Chain.roundPoly j.castSucc v).eval (alpha ch j.castSucc) := by
  simp only [ChainEqs, Submodule.mem_iInf, LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.add_apply,
    LinearMap.sub_apply, Chain.evalRound_apply, sub_eq_zero]

theorem initialChain0_le (ch : Challenges K) :
    Chain.InitialChain0 (Bat := Bat) ch ≤ ChainEqs ch := inf_le_right

theorem L_mem_chainEqs (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) (τ : Trace K) :
    PayloadSplit.L (Bat := Bat) π B ch τ ∈ ChainEqs ch := by
  rw [mem_chainEqs_iff]
  intro j
  rw [PureRounds.roundPoly_L, PureRounds.roundPoly_L]
  exact Chain.rounds_chain ch _ (maskLinear_vdeg π B τ) j

theorem originalRounds_mem_chainEqs (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K) :
    PayloadSplit.roundInclusion (Bat := Bat) (PayloadSplit.originalRounds pub B ch t) ∈ ChainEqs ch := by
  rw [mem_chainEqs_iff]
  intro j
  rw [Chain.roundPoly_originalRounds, Chain.roundPoly_originalRounds]
  exact Chain.rounds_chain ch _ (vdeg_fOrig pub B ch t) j

theorem dir_mem_chainEqs (ch : Challenges K) : (dir : Payload K Bat) ∈ ChainEqs ch :=
  initialChain0_le ch (Chain.dir_mem_initialChain0 ch)

theorem A_mem_chainEqs (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) (t : T K F) :
    A (Bat := Bat) π B ch t ∈ ChainEqs ch := by
  have hA : A (Bat := Bat) π B ch t = PayloadSplit.L π B ch (JointTrace.tapeLinear B t) := rfl
  rw [hA]
  exact L_mem_chainEqs π B ch _

theorem cTilde_mem_chainEqs (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) :
    cTilde (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch ∈ ChainEqs ch := by
  rw [cTilde_eq]
  exact (ChainEqs ch).sub_mem
    ((ChainEqs ch).add_mem (L_mem_chainEqs _ B ch _) (originalRounds_mem_chainEqs x.1 B ch _))
    ((ChainEqs ch).smul_mem _ (dir_mem_chainEqs ch))

theorem roundPoly_roundProjection (v : Payload K Bat) (j : Fin 10) :
    Chain.roundPoly j (PayloadSplit.roundInclusion (Bat := Bat)
      (R0Z.Z4Maps.roundProjection (F := F) v)) = Chain.roundPoly j v :=
  (Chain.roundPoly_roundInclusion j _).trans (Chain.roundPoly_apply j v).symm

/-- The chain equalities and the terminal equation give `ChainT0`. -/
theorem roundProjection_mem_chainT0 (ch : Challenges K) (v : Payload K Bat) (hv : v ∈ ChainEqs ch)
    (h9 : (Chain.roundPoly 9 v).eval (alpha ch 9) = 0) :
    R0Z.Z4Maps.roundProjection (F := F) v ∈ R0Z.SilentReduction.ChainT0 (Bat := Bat) ch := by
  rw [R0Z.SilentReduction.mem_chainT0_iff]
  simp only [roundPoly_roundProjection]
  exact ⟨(mem_chainEqs_iff ch v).1 hv, h9⟩

/-! ### Round cells in a subfield (R7) -/

theorem maskLinear_mem (S : Subfield K) (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F)
    (hi : B.i ∈ S) (hu : B.u ∈ S) (a : Fin 10 → K) (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ S) (τ : Trace K)
    (hτ : ∀ c r, τ c r ∈ S) : PayloadSplit.maskLinear π B a τ ∈ S := by
  rw [PayloadSplit.maskLinear_apply]
  have hcl := fun j c => R0Z.K4Values.honestClaims_mem S τ hτ a ha j c
  have hml : ∀ fam : ℕ, R0P.Mask.maskLinear fam a ∈ S :=
    fun fam => sum_mem fun j _ => S.mul_mem (natCast_mem S _) (ha j)
  have htb : ∀ j, R0P.Mask.towerBasis B j ∈ S := by
    intro j
    unfold R0P.Mask.towerBasis
    split_ifs
    · exact S.one_mem
    · exact hi
    · exact hu
    · exact S.mul_mem hi hu
  refine S.add_mem ?_ ?_
  · unfold R0P.Mask.maskValue
    refine S.add_mem (S.add_mem (sum_mem fun c _ => S.mul_mem ?_ (hcl _ _))
      (S.mul_mem ?_ (hcl _ _))) (sum_mem fun c _ => S.mul_mem ?_ (hcl _ _))
    · show R0P.Mask.mulTowerBasis B _ _ ∈ S
      exact S.mul_mem (htb _) (S.pow_mem (hml 0) _)
    · show 1 + R0P.Mask.maskLinear 16 a ^ 26 ∈ S
      exact S.add_mem S.one_mem (S.pow_mem (hml 16) _)
    · show R0P.Mask.mulTowerBasis B _ _ ∈ S
      exact S.mul_mem (htb _) (S.pow_mem (hml 0) _)
  · unfold R0P.Mask.honestExtra AspisR0.RoundNormalization.dot
    refine sum_mem fun j _ => S.mul_mem ?_ ?_
    · unfold R0P.Mask.libraWeight R0P.SemSource.libraWeight
      split_ifs
      · exact S.pow_mem (ha 8) _
      · exact S.pow_mem (ha 9) _
      · exact S.zero_mem
    · unfold coeffsOf
      exact hτ _ _

theorem L_round_mem (S : Subfield K) (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F)
    (hi : B.i ∈ S) (hu : B.u ∈ S) (ch : Challenges K) (hsem : ∀ i, ch.sem i ∈ S)
    (τ : Trace K) (hτ : ∀ c r, τ c r ∈ S) (j : Fin 10) (i : Fin 28) :
    PayloadSplit.L (Bat := Bat) π B ch τ (.semanticCoeff j i) ∈ S := by
  rw [PayloadSplit.L_round, PayloadSplit.rounds_apply]
  exact R0Z.K4Values.interpolate_coeff_mem S _ (fun k => sum_mem fun tail _ =>
    maskLinear_mem S π B hi hu _ (R0Z.K4Values.roundPoint_mem S ch hsem j k.val tail) τ hτ) i.val

/-! ### Round-only payloads -/

/-- A difference of round inclusions and a multiple of `dir` vanishes off the
round cells. -/
theorem roundOnly_cell (p p' : PayloadSplit.RoundPayload K) (k : K) (cell : PayloadCell Bat)
    (hc : ∀ j i, cell ≠ .semanticCoeff j i) :
    (PayloadSplit.roundInclusion (Bat := Bat) p - PayloadSplit.roundInclusion p' - k • dir :
      Payload K Bat) cell = 0 := by
  cases cell with
  | semanticCoeff j i => exact absurd rfl (hc j i)
  | maskSum => show (0 : K) - 0 - k * 0 = 0; ring
  | pointClaim j c => show (0 : K) - 0 - k * 0 = 0; ring
  | extraClaim c => show (0 : K) - 0 - k * 0 = 0; ring
  | ood j c => show (0 : K) - 0 - k * 0 = 0; ring
  | inactiveSum => show (0 : K) - 0 - k * 0 = 0; ring
  | opened q s c => show (0 : K) - 0 - k * 0 = 0; ring
  | bat b => show (0 : K) - 0 - k * 0 = 0; ring

/-! ### The mask lift (DESIGN-ii-prime §2.4) -/

theorem nonRound_pointClaim (v : Payload K Bat) (j : Fin 3) (c : Fin 29) :
    nonRound (F := F) v (.pointClaim j c) = v (.pointClaim j c) := rfl

theorem nonRound_inactiveSum (v : Payload K Bat) :
    nonRound (F := F) v .inactiveSum = v .inactiveSum := rfl

theorem nonRound_extraClaim (v : Payload K Bat) (c : Fin 29) :
    nonRound (F := F) v (.extraClaim c) = v (.extraClaim c) := rfl

/-- `mask_lift`, generic in the batched block and in the relation space `B0`. -/
theorem mask_lift_of (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B)
    (ch : Challenges K) (B0 : Submodule F (Bat → K))
    (hQ : R0Z.SilentReduction.QPrime (Bat := Bat) π B hB ch)
    (hown : (LinearMap.ker (R0Z.SilentReduction.ownMap (Bat := Bat) π B ch)).map
      (R0Z.SilentReduction.batMap (Bat := Bat) π B ch) ≤ B0)
    (hR : B0 ≤ (LinearMap.ker (R0Z.SilentReduction.ownMap (Bat := Bat) π B ch) ⊓
      LinearMap.ker (R0Z.Z4Maps.roundMaskMap (Bat := Bat) π B ch)).map
        (R0Z.SilentReduction.batMap (Bat := Bat) π B ch))
    (Y : Payload K Bat)
    (hclaim : ∀ j c, Y (.pointClaim j c) = 0) (hextra : ∀ c, Y (.extraClaim c) = 0)
    (hood : ∀ j c, Y (.ood j c) = 0) (hopen : ∀ q s c, Y (.opened q s c) = 0)
    (hia : Y .inactiveSum = 0) (hinit : R0Z.HonestValid.iota Y = 0)
    (hT : R0Z.Z4Maps.roundProjection (F := F) Y ∈ R0Z.SilentReduction.ChainT0K4 (Bat := Bat) B hB ch)
    (hb : R0Z.SilentReduction.batRead (F := F) Y ∈ B0) :
    Y ∈ LinearMap.range ((A (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp inlM) := by
  obtain ⟨x0, hx0, hRx0⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.1 (hQ hT)
  have hbx0 : R0Z.SilentReduction.batMap (Bat := Bat) π B ch x0 ∈ B0 :=
    hown (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hx0)
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hby⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.1 (hR (B0.sub_mem hb hbx0))
  obtain ⟨hyo, hyR⟩ := Submodule.mem_inf.1 hy
  have hown_m : R0Z.SilentReduction.ownMap (Bat := Bat) π B ch (x0 + y) = 0 := by
    rw [map_add, LinearMap.mem_ker.1 hx0, LinearMap.mem_ker.1 hyo, add_zero]
  have hR_m : R0Z.Z4Maps.roundMaskMap (Bat := Bat) π B ch (x0 + y) =
      R0Z.Z4Maps.roundProjection (F := F) Y := by
    rw [map_add, hRx0, LinearMap.mem_ker.1 hyR, add_zero]
  have hbat_m : R0Z.SilentReduction.batMap (Bat := Bat) π B ch (x0 + y) =
      R0Z.SilentReduction.batRead (F := F) Y := by
    rw [map_add, hby]
    abel
  have hproj : R0Z.Z4Maps.roundProjection (F := F) ((A (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp inlM (x0 + y)) =
      R0Z.Z4Maps.roundProjection (F := F) Y := hR_m
  refine ⟨x0 + y, ?_⟩
  apply R0Z.SilentReduction.payload_ext (F := F)
  · funext cell
    cases cell with
    | semanticCoeff j i => rfl
    | maskSum =>
      show (A (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp inlM (x0 + y) .maskSum = Y .maskSum
      rw [R0Z.SilentReduction.ms_pure_eq_initial,
        R0Z.SilentReduction.roundPoly_eq_of_roundProjection hproj 0]
      have hi := hinit
      rw [R0Z.HonestValid.iota_apply] at hi
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp hi
    | pointClaim j c =>
      have h1 : (A (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp inlM (x0 + y) (.pointClaim j c) = 0 := by
        simpa only [R0Z.SilentReduction.ownMap, R0Z.SilentReduction.ownProj, LinearMap.comp_apply,
          LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, Pi.zero_apply] using congrFun hown_m (.pointClaim j c)
      rw [nonRound_pointClaim, nonRound_pointClaim, h1, hclaim j c]
    | extraClaim c =>
      have h1 : (A (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp inlM (x0 + y) (.extraClaim c) = 0 := by
        simpa only [R0Z.SilentReduction.ownMap, R0Z.SilentReduction.ownProj, LinearMap.comp_apply,
          LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, Pi.zero_apply] using congrFun hown_m (.extraClaim c)
      rw [nonRound_extraClaim, nonRound_extraClaim, h1, hextra c]
    | ood j c =>
      have h1 : (A (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp inlM (x0 + y) (.ood j c) = 0 := by
        simpa only [R0Z.SilentReduction.ownMap, R0Z.SilentReduction.ownProj, LinearMap.comp_apply,
          LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, Pi.zero_apply] using congrFun hown_m (.ood j c)
      show (A (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp inlM (x0 + y) (.ood j c) = Y (.ood j c)
      rw [h1, hood j c]
    | inactiveSum =>
      rw [nonRound_inactiveSum, nonRound_inactiveSum,
        R0Z.SilentReduction.ia_pure_zero (Bat := Bat) π B ch (x0 + y), hia]
    | opened q s c =>
      have h1 : (A (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp inlM (x0 + y) (.opened q s c) = 0 := by
        simpa only [R0Z.SilentReduction.ownMap, R0Z.SilentReduction.ownProj, LinearMap.comp_apply,
          LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, Pi.zero_apply] using congrFun hown_m (.opened q s c)
      show (A (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp inlM (x0 + y) (.opened q s c) = Y (.opened q s c)
      rw [h1, hopen q s c]
    | bat b =>
      exact congrFun hbat_m b
  · exact hproj

/-! J2 / J2-R1 (DESIGN-T2b-2b §5 J2; DESIGN-R1-PRIVACY-MODEL §4 J2-R1):
`sRem ∈ Chain0K4`, stated once for every batched layer `Bat` (R0 and R1).

The remainder `sRem` is supported on the ten round arrays; its cells are the
coefficient differences `g` of the original-terminal round polynomials of two
actual traces, minus a multiple of the direction `X − ½`.  This module proves:

* `interpolate_mem`: Lagrange interpolation on the nodes `0, …, 27` with values
  in a subfield `S` has every coefficient in `S`;
* `actual_mem`: every cell of an actual (masked, prepared) trace lies in `K₄`
  when the instance is base-typed and `λ, χ ∈ K₄` (the H1 helper column
  included, `helper_mem`);
* `honestClaims_mem`, `roundPoint_mem`, `originalRounds_mem`, `g_mem`;
* `sRem_mem_K4` and `sRem_mem_chain0K4`.

One closure fact about the R0P terminal is NOT proved here and enters as the
named premise `TerminalClosed S pub B ch`: the terminal value
`terminalValue pub λ χ θ μ zc B y a` lies in `S` whenever the claims `y` and
the point `a` do.  It is a pure field-closure property of the ported
constraint families (`laneAt`: Poseidon, schedule, occupancy, path, value,
digest, asset, copy), given the challenges in `S` and the public statement in
the base field. -/

/-! ## Polynomials with coefficients in a subfield -/

/-- Polynomials all of whose coefficients lie in `S`. -/
def coeffRing (S : Subfield K) : Subring K[X] where
  carrier := {p | ∀ n, p.coeff n ∈ S}
  mul_mem' := by
    intro p q hp hq n
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_mul]
    exact sum_mem fun x _ => S.mul_mem (hp _) (hq _)
  one_mem' := by
    intro n
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_one]
    split_ifs
    · exact S.one_mem
    · exact S.zero_mem
  add_mem' := by
    intro p q hp hq n
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_add]
    exact S.add_mem (hp n) (hq n)
  zero_mem' := by
    intro n
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_zero]
    exact S.zero_mem
  neg_mem' := by
    intro p hp n
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_neg]
    exact S.neg_mem (hp n)

theorem C_mem_coeffRing (S : Subfield K) {c : K} (hc : c ∈ S) : C c ∈ coeffRing S := by
  intro n
  rw [Polynomial.coeff_C]
  split_ifs
  · exact hc
  · exact S.zero_mem

theorem X_mem_coeffRing (S : Subfield K) : (X : K[X]) ∈ coeffRing S := by
  intro n
  rw [Polynomial.coeff_X]
  split_ifs
  · exact S.one_mem
  · exact S.zero_mem

/-- Interpolation on the 28 natural nodes keeps coefficients in `S`. -/
theorem interpolate_mem (S : Subfield K) (v : Fin 28 → K) (hv : ∀ i, v i ∈ S) :
    Lagrange.interpolate Finset.univ (fun i : Fin 28 => (i.val : K)) v ∈ coeffRing S := by
  rw [Lagrange.interpolate_apply]
  refine sum_mem fun i _ => (coeffRing S).mul_mem (C_mem_coeffRing S (hv i)) ?_
  unfold Lagrange.basis
  refine prod_mem fun j _ => ?_
  unfold Lagrange.basisDivisor
  exact (coeffRing S).mul_mem
    (C_mem_coeffRing S (S.inv_mem (S.sub_mem (natCast_mem S _) (natCast_mem S _))))
    ((coeffRing S).sub_mem (X_mem_coeffRing S) (C_mem_coeffRing S (natCast_mem S _)))

theorem interpolate_coeff_mem (S : Subfield K) (v : Fin 28 → K) (hv : ∀ i, v i ∈ S) (d : ℕ) :
    (Lagrange.interpolate Finset.univ (fun i : Fin 28 => (i.val : K)) v).coeff d ∈ S :=
  interpolate_mem S v hv d

theorem eqWeight_mem (S : Subfield K) (p : Fin 10 → K) (hp : ∀ i, p i ∈ S) (r : Fin 1024) :

theorem succCarry_mem (S : Subfield K) (p : Fin 10 → K) (hp : ∀ i, p i ∈ S) :

  | k + 1 => by

    · exact hp _

theorem openingPoints_mem (S : Subfield K) (a : Fin 10 → K) (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ S)

  | 1 =>

    unfold successorPoint

    exact S.sub_mem (S.add_mem (ha _) hc)
      (S.add_mem (S.mul_mem (ha _) hc) (S.mul_mem (ha _) hc))
  | 2 =>
    show xor12Point a ⟨9 - i.val, by omega⟩ ∈ S
    unfold xor12Point
    split_ifs
    · exact S.sub_mem S.one_mem (ha _)
    · exact ha _

theorem balance_mem (S : Subfield K) (dep : Fin 1024) (word : Fin 1024 → K)

/-- Every cell of an actual trace lies in `K₄`: base-typed semantic lanes and
F-valued noise, K₄-packed G/H1/D limbs, and the helper column. -/
theorem actual_mem (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K)
    (ch : Challenges K) (hF : BaseTyped F t) (hlam : ch.sem 0 ∈ K4 B hB)
    (hchi : ch.sem 1 ∈ K4 B hB) (r : T K F) (c : Fin 29) (s : Fin 1024) :
    PayloadSplit.actual pub B t ch r c s ∈ K4 B hB := by
  have hFK : ∀ x : F, (x : K) ∈ K4 B hB := fun x => F_le_K4 B hB x.2
  have hE : ∀ (c' : Fin 29) (s' : Fin 1024), c'.val < 16 →
      applyEligible t r.2.2 c' s' ∈ K4 B hB := by
    intro c' s' hc'
    unfold applyEligible
    rw [if_pos hc']
    refine balance_mem _ 1023 _ (fun s'' => ?_) s'
    try dsimp only
    refine (K4 B hB).add_mem (F_le_K4 B hB (hF c' (by omega) s'')) ?_
    unfold semanticNoise
    split_ifs
    · exact hFK _
    · exact (K4 B hB).zero_mem
  have hext : ∀ (lane : Fin 3) (q : Fin 1024),
      extensionRaw B (Sum.elim (0 : EligibleNoise K F) (aff r)) lane q ∈ K4 B hB := by
    intro lane q
    exact pack4_mem_K4 B hB _ (fun j => Subtype.mem _)
  unfold PayloadSplit.actual applyAff
  try dsimp only
  split_ifs with h1 h2 h3 h4
  · unfold prepare
    rw [if_neg (by omega)]
    exact hE c s h1
  · unfold maskOnlyColumns
    exact balance_mem _ 0 _ (fun q => hFK _) s
  · refine (K4 B hB).add_mem ?_ ?_
    · unfold prepare
      rw [if_pos h3]
      exact helper_mem _ pub _ hE _ _ hlam hchi s
    · unfold h1Padding
      refine balance_mem _ 0 _ (fun q => ?_) s
      try dsimp only
      split_ifs
      · exact (K4 B hB).zero_mem
      · exact hext 1 q
  · exact balance_mem _ 0 _ (fun q => hext 0 q) s
  · unfold dWord
    exact balance_mem _ 0 _ (fun q => hext 2 q) s

/-! ## Original round polynomials and the remainder -/

/-- The missing field-closure fact about the R0P terminal (see the header). -/
def TerminalClosed (S : Subfield K) (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) :
    Prop :=
  ∀ (y : Fin 3 → Fin 29 → K) (a : Fin 10 → K), (∀ j c, y j c ∈ S) → (∀ i, a i ∈ S) →
    terminalValue pub (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) (ch.sem 2) (ch.sem 13) (zc ch) B y a ∈ S

theorem originalRounds_mem (S : Subfield K) (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (ch : Challenges K) (hsem : ∀ i, ch.sem i ∈ S) (hT : TerminalClosed S pub B ch)
    (t : Trace K) (ht : ∀ c r, t c r ∈ S) (j : Fin 10) (i : Fin 28) :
    PayloadSplit.originalRounds pub B ch t j i ∈ S := by
  unfold PayloadSplit.originalRounds
  rw [PayloadSplit.rounds_apply]
  refine interpolate_coeff_mem S _ (fun k => sum_mem fun tail _ => ?_) i.val
  refine S.mul_mem (hsem 14) (hT _ _ (fun j' c => ?_) (roundPoint_mem S ch hsem j k.val tail))
  exact honestClaims_mem S t ht _ (roundPoint_mem S ch hsem j k.val tail) j' c

theorem g_mem (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) (n : N K F)
    (hsem : ∀ i, ch.sem i ∈ K4 B hB) (hF : BaseTyped F (h.build w))
    (hT : TerminalClosed (K4 B hB) x.1 B ch) (j : Fin 10) (i : Fin 28) :
    g h B x w ch n j i ∈ K4 B hB := by
  have hact := fun r => actual_mem B hB x.1 (h.build w) ch hF (hsem 0) (hsem 1) r
  exact (K4 B hB).sub_mem
    (originalRounds_mem _ x.1 B ch hsem hT _ (hact _) j i)
    (originalRounds_mem _ x.1 B ch hsem hT _ (hact _) j i)

theorem dirCoeff_mem (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) (j : Fin 10) (i : Fin 28) :
    (if j = 9 then (X - C (1 / 2 : K)).coeff i.val else 0) ∈ K4 B hB := by
  split_ifs
  · rw [Polynomial.coeff_sub, Polynomial.coeff_X, Polynomial.coeff_C]
    refine (K4 B hB).sub_mem ?_ ?_
    · split_ifs
      · exact (K4 B hB).one_mem
      · exact (K4 B hB).zero_mem
    · split_ifs
      · exact half_mem_K4 B hB
      · exact (K4 B hB).zero_mem
  · exact (K4 B hB).zero_mem

/-- J2: every cell of `sRem` lies in `K₄`. -/
theorem sRem_mem_K4 (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) (n : N K F)
    (hsem : ∀ i, ch.sem i ∈ K4 B hB) (hF : BaseTyped F (h.build w))
    (hT : TerminalClosed (K4 B hB) x.1 B ch) :
    ∀ cell, sRem (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch n cell ∈ K4 B hB := by
  set S := K4 B hB with hS
  let p := g h B x w ch n
  let coef : K := Phi0 B ch (roundInclusion (F := F) (Bat := Bat) p) * (alpha ch 9 - 1 / 2)⁻¹
  have hcell : ∀ cell, sRem (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch n cell =
      PayloadSplit.roundInclusion (Bat := Bat) p cell - coef * dir (K := K) (Bat := Bat) cell :=
    fun cell => rfl
  have hphi : Phi0 B ch (roundInclusion (F := F) (Bat := Bat) p) ∈ S := by
    have e : Phi0 B ch (roundInclusion (F := F) (Bat := Bat) p) =
        evalRound9 ch (PayloadSplit.roundInclusion (Bat := Bat) p) :=
      Phi0_roundInclusion B ch p
    rw [e, evalRound9_roundInclusion, Polynomial.eval_finsetSum]
    refine sum_mem fun i _ => ?_
    rw [Polynomial.eval_monomial]
    exact S.mul_mem (g_mem h B hB x w ch n hsem hF hT 9 i)
      (S.pow_mem (alpha_mem S ch hsem 9) _)
  have hcoef : coef ∈ S :=
    S.mul_mem hphi (S.inv_mem (S.sub_mem (alpha_mem S ch hsem 9) (half_mem_K4 B hB)))
  intro cell
  rw [hcell]
  cases cell with
  | semanticCoeff j i =>
    show p j i - coef * (if j = 9 then (X - C (1 / 2 : K)).coeff i.val else 0) ∈ S
    exact S.sub_mem (g_mem h B hB x w ch n hsem hF hT j i)
      (S.mul_mem hcoef (dirCoeff_mem B hB j i))
  | maskSum =>
    show (0 : K) - coef * 0 ∈ S
    rw [mul_zero, sub_zero]
    exact S.zero_mem
  | pointClaim j c =>
    show (0 : K) - coef * 0 ∈ S
    rw [mul_zero, sub_zero]
    exact S.zero_mem
  | extraClaim c =>
    show (0 : K) - coef * 0 ∈ S
    rw [mul_zero, sub_zero]
    exact S.zero_mem
  | ood j c =>
    show (0 : K) - coef * 0 ∈ S
    rw [mul_zero, sub_zero]
    exact S.zero_mem
  | inactiveSum =>
    show (0 : K) - coef * 0 ∈ S
    rw [mul_zero, sub_zero]
    exact S.zero_mem
  | opened q s c =>
    show (0 : K) - coef * 0 ∈ S
    rw [mul_zero, sub_zero]
    exact S.zero_mem
  | bat b =>
    show (0 : K) - coef * 0 ∈ S
    rw [mul_zero, sub_zero]
    exact S.zero_mem

/-- J2 / J2-R1: `sRem ∈ Chain0₄` for every batched layer (R0 and R1), given
`SemK4`, a base-typed instance, `α₉ ≠ ½`, and `TerminalClosed`. -/
theorem sRem_mem_chain0K4 (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) (n : N K F)
    (hsem : ∀ i, ch.sem i ∈ K4 B hB) (hF : BaseTyped F (h.build w))
    (hT : TerminalClosed (K4 B hB) x.1 B ch) (hhalf : alpha ch 9 ≠ 1 / 2) :
    sRem (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch n ∈ R0Z.SilentReduction.Chain0K4 (Bat := Bat) B hB ch :=
  (R0Z.SilentReduction.mem_chain0K4_iff B hB ch _).2
    ⟨R0Z.Chain.sRem_mem_chain0 h B x w ch n hhalf, sRem_mem_K4 h B hB x w ch n hsem hF hT⟩

/-! R1 games (zf1/DESIGN-R1-GAMES §6): `privacy_R1_eff` (LOG D44) instantiated
with the concrete R1 experiments `fsR1` and bridge `abR1`.  The ideal model
`R1IdealModelS … simE` is a theorem (`idealModelS_R1`, with no private
position, so the programming term is 0); the real model comes from
`realModel_R1`, whose remaining inputs are the `R1RealData` hypotheses. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PrivacyGamesR1
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.HvzkV R0Z.HvzkS R0Z.RefPayload
  R1Z.Batched R1Z.PredicateR1 R1Z.MaskImageVR1 R1Z.PoleMassR1 R1Z.ModelsVR1 R1Z.SimulatorR1
  R1Z.GamesR1
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-- `R1IdealModelS` for the R1 games and any simulator (in particular `simE`). -/
theorem idealModelS_R1 (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1Prover K CommitHandle Aux F W)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (P : Challenges K → Prop)
    (Vp : (h : HonestProver K) → Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (M Umin : ℕ) (sim : Challenges K → Tape K F → View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat) :
    R1IdealModelS P (fsR1 W Pr N hN P Vp) (abR1 W N hN) x M Umin sim :=
  fun adv => idealModelS_body W Pr N hN P Vp x M Umin sim adv

/-- The R1 privacy theorem for the concrete games against the explicit
simulator `simE`: error `N(115+Mc)·q/2^255 + (N(115+Mc))²/2^255 + εexh +
N·4096/Q`; the ideal (programming) term is 0. -/
theorem privacy_R1_games (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1Prover K CommitHandle Aux F W)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : R0Z.K4.PackField B)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hpub : PublicBase F x.1)
    (hs : R0Z.HonestValidity.BuilderSoundOn h B x) (Mc Q : ℕ) (εexh : ℚ)
    (hd : ∀ (adv : R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux) (w : h.Instance), h.public w = x.1 →
      ∃ d : R1RealData W Pr N hN (P_R1 h.transport B hB) (fun h' => VR1 h') h (VR1 h) B outputs x
          adv w Mc,
        d.Agree ∧ R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass d.exh ≤ εexh)
    (hdraw : Sem1Uniform (drawW (K := K) W) Q) :
    ZK_FSS h B outputs (fsR1 W Pr N hN (P_R1 h.transport B hB) (fun h' => VR1 h')) x
      (simE h.transport B outputs x)
      (((N * (115 + Mc) : ℕ) : ℚ) * (W.qmax : ℕ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
        (((N * (115 + Mc) : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((N * (115 + Mc) : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) + εexh) +
        ((0 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((0 : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
        (abR1 W N hN).N * ((4096 : ℚ) / Q)) :=
  privacy_R1_eff h B hB outputs (fsR1 W Pr N hN (P_R1 h.transport B hB) (fun h' => VR1 h')) x
    hpub hs (abR1 W N hN) (N * (115 + Mc)) 0 W.qmax (2 ^ 255) Q εexh (by positivity)
    (realModel_R1 Mc εexh hd)
    (idealModelS_R1 W Pr N hN _ _ x 0 (2 ^ 255) (simE h.transport B outputs x))
    (fun _ => hdraw)

#print axioms idealModelS_R1
#print axioms privacy_R1_games
end R1Z.PrivacyGamesR1

/-! ZF2 (zf1/DESIGN-ZF2-SIMULATOR.txt §5.3): the R1 privacy theorem with the
explicit simulator `simE` in place of the choice simulator `simV`.

* `hvzk_R1S`: on `P_R1` and the pole-free valid set `VR1`, every honest view
  has the law of `simE h.transport B outputs x ch` (clause (i′), Claim Z,
  `equalLaws_simE_of`).
* `R1IdealModelS`: `R1IdealModelV` with the agreement field naming the games
  of the given simulator; `idealAbortCouplingS_of_R1` as in ModelsVR1.
* `privacy_R1_eff`: ZK_FS against `simE`, with the error terms of
  `privacy_R1`. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R1Z.SimulatorR1
open R0P R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.Shift R0Z.FsGood R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.HvzkV R0Z.HvzkS
  R0Z.RefPayload R1Z.Batched R1Z.PredicateR1 R1Z.MaskImageVR1 R1Z.PoleMassR1 R1Z.ModelsVR1
  R1Z.RefCosetR1
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-- HVZK on `P_R1` and the pole-free valid set against the explicit simulator. -/
theorem hvzk_R1S (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : R0Z.K4.PackField B)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hpub : PublicBase F x.1)
    (hs : R0Z.HonestValidity.BuilderSoundOn h B x) :
    HVZK_onS (Bat := R1Bat) (P_R1 h.transport B hB) h (VR1 h) B outputs x
      (simE h.transport B outputs x) := by
  intro w ch hP hV hw
  have hF := R0Z.HonestValidity.baseTyped_of h B x hs
  have hval : R0Z.HonestValid.HonestValid x.1 B (h.build w) ch :=
    R0Z.HonestValidity.honestValid_of x.1 B (h.build w) ch (hs w hw) hV
  exact equalLaws_simE_of h B outputs x w ch
    (fun n => R1Z.ClauseIR1.clause_i_R1_all h B hB x hpub hF ch hP w n hw)
    (cTilde_sub_ref_mem_range_R1 h B hB x hpub ch hP w (hF w hw) hval)

/-- `R1IdealModelV` (LOG D41, D42.2) for a given simulator. -/
def R1IdealModelS (P : Challenges K → Prop)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat F) [Fintype fs.IdealRand]
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (M Umin : ℕ)
    (sim : Challenges K → Tape K F → View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat) : Prop :=
  ∀ (adv : fs.Adversary),
    ∃ (cp : Coupling fs.IdealRand ((Fin ab.N → ab.Coins) × (Fin ab.N → Tape K F)))
      (priv : Fin M → Prop) (addr : Fin M → cp.S → Bytes),
      (∀ s, ¬ R0Z.FsAbortBounds.CollEv M priv addr s →
        middleIdealAbortS P fs ab adv x sim (cp.toM s) = idealTestS fs adv x sim (cp.toR s)) ∧
      (∀ j j', j < j' → (priv j ∨ priv j') →
        R0Z.FsAbortBounds.PairFresh (addr j) (addr j') Umin ∨
          R0Z.FsAbortBounds.PairFresh (addr j') (addr j) Umin)

theorem idealAbortCouplingS_of_R1 (P : Challenges K → Prop)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat F) [Fintype fs.IdealRand]
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (M Umin : ℕ) (hU : 0 < Umin)
    (sim : Challenges K → Tape K F → View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat)
    (hm : R1IdealModelS P fs ab x M Umin sim) :
    IdealAbortCouplingS P fs ab x sim ((M : ℚ) * M / Umin) := by
  intro adv
  obtain ⟨cp, priv, addr, hag, hpair⟩ := hm adv
  refine ⟨cp, R0Z.FsAbortBounds.CollEv M priv addr, hag, ?_⟩
  rw [R0Z.FsAbortR1.eventMass_eq_mass]
  exact R0Z.FsAbortBounds.collEv_mass_fresh M Umin hU priv addr hpair

/-- ZF2: ZK_FS for the retrying R1 prover against the explicit simulator
`simE`, error `ε_hit + ε_coll + ε_prog + N · 4096 / Q` (as `privacy_R1`). -/
theorem privacy_R1_eff (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : R0Z.K4.PackField B)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat F)
    [Fintype fs.RealRand] [Nonempty fs.RealRand]
    [Fintype fs.IdealRand] [Nonempty fs.IdealRand]
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hpub : PublicBase F x.1)
    (hs : R0Z.HonestValidity.BuilderSoundOn h B x)
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat fs.Adversary)
    (M Mi q Umin Q : ℕ) (εexh : ℚ) (hU : 0 < Umin)
    (hr : R1RealModelV (P_R1 h.transport B hB) h (VR1 h) B outputs fs ab x M q Umin εexh)
    (hi : R1IdealModelS (P_R1 h.transport B hB) fs ab x Mi Umin (simE h.transport B outputs x))
    (hdraw : ∀ adv : fs.Adversary, Sem1Uniform (ab.draw adv x) Q) :
    ZK_FSS h B outputs fs x (simE h.transport B outputs x)
      ((M : ℚ) * q / Umin + ((M : ℚ) * M / Umin + εexh) + (Mi : ℚ) * Mi / Umin +
        ab.N * ((4096 : ℚ) / Q)) :=
  zkfs_of_hvzk_onS_terms (P_R1 h.transport B hB) h (VR1 h) B outputs fs x
    (simE h.transport B outputs x) (hvzk_R1S h B hB outputs x hpub hs) ab
    ((M : ℚ) * q / Umin) ((M : ℚ) * M / Umin + εexh) ((Mi : ℚ) * Mi / Umin) ((4096 : ℚ) / Q)
    (realAbortCouplingV_of_R1 _ h _ B outputs fs ab x M q Umin εexh hU hr)
    (idealAbortCouplingS_of_R1 _ fs ab x Mi Umin hU _ hi)
    (fun adv w _ => (eventMass_mono _ _ (fun c hc => hc.2)).trans
      (pole_mass_le (ab.draw adv x) Q (hdraw adv) (h.build w)))

#print axioms hvzk_R1S
#print axioms R1IdealModelS
#print axioms idealAbortCouplingS_of_R1
#print axioms privacy_R1_eff
end R1Z.SimulatorR1

/-! ZF2 Claim Z (zf1/DESIGN-ZF2-SIMULATOR.txt §3.2, §5.3): on `P_R1`, the
normalised honest offset `cTilde w` of every valid, base-typed instance lies
in the public coset `refPayload x.1 B ch + range A_ch`.

The proof is `cTilde_sub_mem_range_R1` (R1Z/IIPrimeR1) with the second
instance replaced by the zero payload trace: `δ = u_w − 0` satisfies the
noise-lift hypotheses by validity of `w` alone, and the `.maskSum` patch of
`refPayload` restores `ι = 0`.  Every challenge condition is a conjunct of
`P_R1`; nothing else is assumed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R1Z.RefCosetR1
open R0P R0P.SemSource R0Z.MaskLayout R0Z.HonestView R0Z.Partition R0Z.D12 R0Z.Shift
  R0Z.K4 R1Z.Batched R1Z.VerifierRelationsR1 R1Z.PredicateR1 R1Z.NoiseLiftR1
  R0Z.IIPrimeResidual R1Z.IIPrimeR1 R0Z.RefPayload Polynomial

attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
attribute [local irreducible] copyLinks copyPatterns copyActiveRowMasks copyInactiveRows

variable {K CommitHandle : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

theorem msCell_ne (s : K) (cell : PayloadCell R1Bat) (hc : cell ≠ .maskSum) :
    msCell (Bat := R1Bat) s cell = 0 := by
  cases cell <;> first | rfl | exact absurd rfl hc

/-- Claim Z. -/
theorem cTilde_sub_ref_mem_range_R1 (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hpub : PublicBase F x.1) (ch : Challenges K)
    (hP : P_R1 h.transport B hB ch) (w : h.Instance)
    (hF : BaseTyped F (h.build w))
    (hv : R0Z.HonestValid.HonestValid x.1 B (h.build w) ch) :
    cTilde (Bat := R1Bat) h B x w ch - refPayload x.1 B ch ∈ LinearMap.range (A h.transport B ch) := by
  have hsem : ∀ i, ch.sem i ∈ K4 B hB := hP.semK4
  have hT : R0Z.K4Values.TerminalClosed (K4 B hB) x.1 B ch :=
    R0Z.TerminalClosed.terminalClosed B hB x.1 ch hsem hpub
  have hi : B.i ∈ K4 B hB := i_mem_K4 B hB
  have hu : B.u ∈ K4 B hB := u_mem_K4 B hB
  obtain ⟨u, hu_def⟩ : ∃ u, u = R0Z.PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hu4 : ∀ c r, u c r ∈ K4 B hB := fun c r => by
    rw [hu_def]; exact R0Z.K4Values.actual_mem B hB x.1 _ ch hF (hsem 0) (hsem 1) 0 c r
  -- Step N, with δ = u − 0
  have hδ : ∀ c : Fin 16, u (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) ∈ Wsem (K := K) (F := F) := by
    intro c
    rw [hu_def, mem_Wsem_iff]
    refine ⟨fun r => mem_baseF (R0Z.IIPrimeResidual.actual_sem_mem x.1 B _ ch hF
      (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) c.isLt r), ?_⟩
    have hne : (Fin.castLE (by omega) c : Fin 29).val ≠ 26 := by
      have := c.isLt
      simp only [Fin.val_castLE]
      omega
    exact R0Z.HonestValid.actual_inactive_sum _ _ _ _ _ hne
  have hδ26 : u 26 ∈ Wh1 B hB := by
    rw [hu_def, mem_Wh1_iff]
    exact ⟨fun r => R0Z.K4Values.actual_mem B hB x.1 _ ch hF (hsem 0) (hsem 1) 0 26 r, hv.2.2⟩
  obtain ⟨n, hn1, hn2⟩ := noise_lift_R1 h.transport B hB ch hP u hδ hδ26
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ_def⟩ : ∃ τ, τ = u - R0Z.JointTrace.tapeLinear B (inrN n) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hAn : A (Bat := R1Bat) h.transport B ch (inrN n) =
      R0Z.PayloadSplit.L h.transport B ch (R0Z.JointTrace.tapeLinear B (inrN n)) := rfl
  have hLτ : R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := R1Bat) h.transport B ch τ =
      R0Z.PayloadSplit.L h.transport B ch u - A h.transport B ch (inrN n) := by
    rw [hτ_def, map_sub, hAn]
  have hown : ∀ l : Fin 29,
      ownRead (Bat := R1Bat) (F := F) l (R0Z.PayloadSplit.L h.transport B ch τ) = 0 := by
    intro l
    rw [hLτ, map_sub (ownRead (Bat := R1Bat) (F := F) l)]
    by_cases hl : l.val < 16 ∨ l.val = 26
    · rw [hn1 l hl, sub_self]
    · have hz : u l = 0 := by
        rw [hu_def]
        exact actual_other_zero _ _ _ _ l hl
      rw [hn2 l hl, own_L_eq_obs, hz, map_zero, sub_zero]
  have hcl : ∀ j c, R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := R1Bat) h.transport B ch τ (.pointClaim j c) = 0 := by
    intro j c
    simpa only [ownRead, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, Pi.zero_apply]
      using congrFun (hown c) (.claim j)
  have hex : ∀ c, R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := R1Bat) h.transport B ch τ (.extraClaim c) = 0 := by
    intro c
    simpa only [ownRead, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, Pi.zero_apply]
      using congrFun (hown c) .extra
  have hoo : ∀ j c, R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := R1Bat) h.transport B ch τ (.ood j c) = 0 := by
    intro j c
    simpa only [ownRead, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, Pi.zero_apply]
      using congrFun (hown c) (.ood j)
  have hop : ∀ q s c, R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := R1Bat) h.transport B ch τ (.opened q s c) = 0 := by
    intro q s c
    simpa only [ownRead, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, Pi.zero_apply]
      using congrFun (hown c) (.opened q s)
