/-! ### The lane word spaces -/

theorem batRead_apply (v : Payload K R1Bat) (b : R1Bat) :
    R0Z.SilentReduction.batRead (F := F) v b = v (.bat b) := rfl

theorem mem_baseF {x : K} (hx : x ∈ F) : x ∈ baseF (F := F) := ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩

theorem mem_Wsem_iff (v : Fin 1024 → K) :
    v ∈ Wsem (K := K) (F := F) ↔ (∀ r, v r ∈ baseF (F := F)) ∧ ∑ r ∈ copyInactiveRows, v r = 0 := by
  simp only [Wsem, Submodule.mem_inf, Submodule.mem_iInf, Submodule.mem_comap,
    LinearMap.proj_apply, LinearMap.mem_ker, inactiveSumF, LinearMap.sum_apply]

theorem mem_Wh1_iff (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) (v : Fin 1024 → K) :
    v ∈ Wh1 B hB ↔ (∀ r, v r ∈ K4 B hB) ∧ ∑ r ∈ copyInactiveRows, v r = 0 := by
  simp only [Wh1, Submodule.mem_inf, Submodule.mem_iInf, Submodule.mem_comap,
    LinearMap.proj_apply, LinearMap.mem_ker, inactiveSumF, LinearMap.sum_apply, mem_K4F]

/-- The semantic lanes of `δ` lie in `Wsem`. -/
theorem delta_sem_mem (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t t' : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K)
    (hF : BaseTyped F t) (hF' : BaseTyped F t') (c : Fin 16) :
    (R0Z.PayloadSplit.actual pub B t ch 0 - R0Z.PayloadSplit.actual pub B t' ch 0) (Fin.castLE (by omega) c)
      ∈ Wsem (K := K) (F := F) := by
  rw [mem_Wsem_iff]
  refine ⟨fun r => mem_baseF (F.sub_mem (actual_sem_mem pub B t ch hF (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) c.isLt r)
    (actual_sem_mem pub B t' ch hF' (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) c.isLt r)), ?_⟩
  have hne : (Fin.castLE (by omega) c : Fin 29).val ≠ 26 := by
    have := c.isLt
    simp only [Fin.val_castLE]
    omega
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, R0Z.HonestValid.actual_inactive_sum _ _ _ _ _ hne,
    R0Z.HonestValid.actual_inactive_sum _ _ _ _ _ hne, sub_zero]

/-- The H1 lane of `δ` lies in `Wh1` (clause 3 of `HonestValid` for both). -/
theorem delta_h1_mem (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) (t t' : Trace K)
    (ch : Challenges K) (hF : BaseTyped F t) (hF' : BaseTyped F t')
    (hlam : ch.sem 0 ∈ K4 B hB) (hchi : ch.sem 1 ∈ K4 B hB)
    (hv : R0Z.HonestValid.HonestValid pub B t ch) (hv' : R0Z.HonestValid.HonestValid pub B t' ch) :
    (R0Z.PayloadSplit.actual pub B t ch 0 - R0Z.PayloadSplit.actual pub B t' ch 0) 26 ∈ Wh1 B hB := by
  rw [mem_Wh1_iff]
  refine ⟨fun r => (K4 B hB).sub_mem
    (R0Z.K4Values.actual_mem B hB pub t ch hF hlam hchi 0 26 r)
    (R0Z.K4Values.actual_mem B hB pub t' ch hF' hlam hchi 0 26 r), ?_⟩
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hv.2.2, hv'.2.2, sub_zero]

    simp only [Pi.sub_apply]

    exact (K4 B hB).sub_mem ((K4 B hB).sub_mem (hu4 c r) (hu4' c r))
      ((K4 B hB).sub_mem
        (R0Z.K4Values.actual_mem B hB x.1 _ ch hF (hsem 0) (hsem 1) _ c r)
        (R0Z.K4Values.actual_mem B hB x.1 _ ch hF (hsem 0) (hsem 1) 0 c r))
  have hk4 : ∀ (v : h.Instance), BaseTyped F (h.build v) → kOf h B x v ch ∈ K4 B hB := by
    intro v hFv
    have hv4 : ∀ c r, R0Z.PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build v) ch 0 c r ∈ K4 B hB :=
      fun c r => R0Z.K4Values.actual_mem B hB x.1 _ ch hFv (hsem 0) (hsem 1) 0 c r
    have ha : ∀ i, alpha ch i ∈ K4 B hB := R0Z.K4Values.alpha_mem _ ch hsem
    unfold kOf fOrig
    refine (K4 B hB).mul_mem ((K4 B hB).mul_mem (hsem 14) (hT _ _ (fun j c =>
      R0Z.K4Values.honestClaims_mem _ _ hv4 _ ha j c) ha)) ?_
    exact (K4 B hB).inv_mem ((K4 B hB).sub_mem (ha 9) (half_mem_K4 B hB))
  have hYK4 : ∀ j i, Y (.semanticCoeff j i) ∈ K4 B hB := by
    intro j i
    rw [hY, Pi.add_apply]
    refine (K4 B hB).add_mem (L_round_mem _ h.transport B hi hu ch hsem τ hτ4 j i) ?_
    show R0Z.PayloadSplit.originalRounds x.1 B ch u j i - R0Z.PayloadSplit.originalRounds x.1 B ch u' j i -
        (kOf h B x w ch - kOf h B x w' ch) * (if j = 9 then (X - C (1 / 2 : K)).coeff i.val else 0)
      ∈ K4 B hB
    exact (K4 B hB).sub_mem ((K4 B hB).sub_mem
      (R0Z.K4Values.originalRounds_mem _ x.1 B ch hsem hT u hu4 j i)
      (R0Z.K4Values.originalRounds_mem _ x.1 B ch hsem hT u' hu4' j i))
      ((K4 B hB).mul_mem ((K4 B hB).sub_mem (hk4 w hF) (hk4 w' hF'))
        (R0Z.K4Values.dirCoeff_mem B hB j i))
  have hYT : R0Z.Z4Maps.roundProjection (F := F) Y ∈
      R0Z.SilentReduction.ChainT0K4 (Bat := R1Bat) B hB ch := by
    refine Submodule.mem_inf.2 ⟨?_, (R0Z.SilentReduction.mem_K4Round_iff B hB _).2 hYK4⟩
    rw [Submodule.restrictScalars_mem]
    exact roundProjection_mem_chainT0 ch Y hYchain hY9
  -- Step M
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := mask_lift_of h.transport B hB ch (B0R1' h.transport ch) hP.qprime
    (bat_ker_own_le_B0R1' h.transport B ch) hP.breach Y hYcl hYex hYoo hYop hYia hYiota hYT hYb
  refine ⟨inlM m + inrN n, ?_⟩
  rw [map_add, ← LinearMap.comp_apply (A (Bat := R1Bat) h.transport B ch) inlM m, hm, hY_def,
    sub_add_cancel]

R0Z.TerminalClosed:
import R0Z.K4Values

/-! J2b (LOG D35): `TerminalClosed` from `SemK4 ∧ PublicBase`.

The R0P terminal `terminalValue pub λ χ θ μ zc B y α` reads only its
arguments: the public statement `pub`, the four challenges, `zc`, the packing
basis `B`, the claims `y` and the point `α` (its type takes no trace and no
other state).  Every constraint family it evaluates (Poseidon packed,
schedule, occupancy, path, value, digest, asset, copy) is built from these
by ring operations, inverses-free products, numerals, finite folds and
branches on public/static data.  Hence, for any subfield `S` containing `F`,
`B.i`, `B.u` and all those inputs, the terminal lies in `S`
(`terminalValue_mem`).  Specialised to `S = K₄` this is `terminalClosed`.

Proof style follows R0P/LaneMap's Boolean-row closure lemmas, generalised to
arbitrary openings and selector vectors with entries in `S`.  No table is
evaluated: numerals are discharged by `natCast_mem`, vectors by `Fin.cases`. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

namespace R0Z.TerminalClosed

open scoped BigOperators
open R0P R0P.SemSource

variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] (S : Subfield K)

/-! ## Generic tools -/

theorem foldl_mem {α : Type} (f : K → α → K) (l : List α) (init : K) (hinit : init ∈ S)
    (hf : ∀ acc, acc ∈ S → ∀ x ∈ l, f acc x ∈ S) : l.foldl f init ∈ S := by
  induction l generalizing init with
  | nil => exact hinit
  | cons x xs ih =>
    rw [List.foldl_cons]
    exact ih _ (hf init hinit x (List.mem_cons_self ..))
      (fun acc hacc y hy => hf acc hacc y (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hy))

theorem getD_mem (l : List K) (h : ∀ x ∈ l, x ∈ S) (i : ℕ) : l.getD i 0 ∈ S := by
  induction l generalizing i with
  | nil => simpa using S.zero_mem
  | cons x xs ih =>
    cases i with
    | zero => simpa using h x (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    | succ i =>
      simpa using ih (fun y hy => h y (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hy)) i

theorem vec_cons_mem {n : Nat} (head : K) (tail : Fin n → K) (hh : head ∈ S)
    (ht : ∀ i, tail i ∈ S) : ∀ i, Matrix.vecCons head tail i ∈ S := by
  intro i; exact Fin.cases hh ht i

theorem vec_cons_fun {α : Type} {n : Nat} (P : α → Prop)
    (head : α) (tail : Fin n → α) (hh : P head) (ht : ∀ i, P (tail i)) :
    ∀ i, P (Matrix.vecCons head tail i) := by
  intro i; exact Fin.cases hh ht i

theorem vec_nil_fun {α : Type} (P : α → Prop) : ∀ i, P (Matrix.vecEmpty (α := α) i) := by
  intro i; exact Fin.elim0 i

/-! ## Selector adapters -/

section Sel

variable {S} (sel : Sel K) (hsel : ∀ k, sel k ∈ S)
include hsel

theorem g2High_mem (h : Fin 64) : g2High sel h ∈ S :=
  sum_mem fun l _ => hsel _

theorem g2Low_mem (l : Fin 16) : g2Low sel l ∈ S :=
  sum_mem fun h _ => hsel _

theorem g2SumHigh_mem (start count : Nat) (bound : start + count ≤ 64) :
    g2SumHigh sel start count bound ∈ S := by
  unfold g2SumHigh
  refine foldl_mem S _ _ _ S.zero_mem (fun acc hacc x hx => ?_)
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.1 hx
  exact S.add_mem hacc (g2High_mem sel hsel _)

theorem scheduleNodes_mem : scheduleNodes sel ∈ S := by
  unfold scheduleNodes
  refine foldl_mem S _ _ _ S.zero_mem (fun acc hacc x hx => S.add_mem hacc ?_)
  rcases List.mem_append.1 hx with hx | hx
  · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.1 hx
    exact g2High_mem sel hsel _
  · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.1 hx
    exact g2High_mem sel hsel _

end Sel

/- The selector adapters and the copy registries are never unfolded by
definitional checks below. -/
attribute [local irreducible] g2High g2Low g2SumHigh scheduleNodes copyLinks copyPatterns
  copyActiveRowMasks copyLinksBeforePositivity copyLinksAfterPositivity

/- The closure tactic on goals `x ∈ S` (after unfolding): hypotheses of the
fixed names `hz hs hx hsel hhigh hlow`, ring operations, finite sums and
products, branches, and finally numerals.  No hypothesis is applied with an
unconstrained conclusion. -/
set_option hygiene false in
macro "sclose" : tactic => `(tactic| repeat' first
  | assumption
  | exact hhigh _
  | exact hlow _
  | exact hz _
  | exact hs _
  | exact hx _
  | exact hsel _
  | exact zero_mem _
  | exact one_mem _
  | constructor
  | (intro _)
  | apply add_mem
  | apply sub_mem
  | apply mul_mem
  | apply neg_mem
  | apply pow_mem
  | (apply sum_mem; intro _ _)
  | (apply prod_mem; intro _ _)
  | split_ifs
  | split
  | exact natCast_mem _ _)

/- A narrower closure for the schedule arithmetic (no list, branch or
big-operator alternatives). -/
set_option hygiene false in
macro "rclose" : tactic => `(tactic| repeat' first
  | assumption
  | exact hhigh _
  | exact hlow _
  | exact hz _
  | exact hsel _
  | exact zero_mem _
  | exact one_mem _
  | exact natCast_mem _ _
  | apply add_mem
  | apply sub_mem
  | apply mul_mem)

/-! ## Families at arbitrary openings and selectors -/

section Families

variable {S} (pub : Public K) (o : Openings K) (sel : Sel K)

theorem scheduleInitial_mem_pt (hz : ∀ i, o.z i ∈ S) (hsel : ∀ k, sel k ∈ S)
    (lane : Fin 16) : scheduleInitial .privateTransfer o sel lane ∈ S := by
  have hhigh := g2High_mem sel hsel
  have hlow := g2Low_mem sel hsel
  have hnodes := scheduleNodes_mem sel hsel
  unfold scheduleInitial scheduleVariantSelectors
  try dsimp only
  split_ifs <;> rclose

theorem scheduleInitial_mem_wd (hz : ∀ i, o.z i ∈ S) (hsel : ∀ k, sel k ∈ S)
    (lane : Fin 16) : scheduleInitial .withdrawal o sel lane ∈ S := by
  have hhigh := g2High_mem sel hsel
  have hlow := g2Low_mem sel hsel
  have hnodes := scheduleNodes_mem sel hsel
  unfold scheduleInitial scheduleVariantSelectors
  try dsimp only
  split_ifs <;> rclose

theorem scheduleInitial_mem (v : Variant) (hz : ∀ i, o.z i ∈ S) (hsel : ∀ k, sel k ∈ S)
    (lane : Fin 16) : scheduleInitial v o sel lane ∈ S := by
  cases v
  · exact scheduleInitial_mem_pt o sel hz hsel lane
  · exact scheduleInitial_mem_wd o sel hz hsel lane

theorem scheduleAbsorption_mem (v : Variant) (hz : ∀ i, o.z i ∈ S) (hsel : ∀ k, sel k ∈ S)
    (lane : Fin 16) : scheduleAbsorption v o sel lane ∈ S := by
  have hhigh := g2High_mem sel hsel
  have hlow := g2Low_mem sel hsel
  have hnodes := scheduleNodes_mem sel hsel
  cases v <;>
    (unfold scheduleAbsorption scheduleAbsorptionLiteral scheduleVariantSelectors; try dsimp only) <;>
    sclose

theorem schedule_mem (hz : ∀ i, o.z i ∈ S) (hsel : ∀ k, sel k ∈ S) :
    ∀ r ∈ scheduleFamily.residuals pub o sel, r ∈ S := by
  simp only [scheduleFamily, List.forall_mem_append, List.forall_mem_ofFn_iff]
  exact ⟨scheduleInitial_mem o sel _ hz hsel, scheduleAbsorption_mem o sel _ hz hsel⟩

theorem occupancy_mem (hz : ∀ i, o.z i ∈ S) (hsel : ∀ k, sel k ∈ S) :
    ∀ r ∈ occupancyFamily.residuals pub o sel, r ∈ S := by
  have he : occupancyExpected (K := K) pub.variant ∈ S := by
    cases pub.variant
    · exact S.one_mem
    · exact S.zero_mem
  simp only [occupancyFamily, occupancyLanesLiteral, List.forall_mem_append,
    List.forall_mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, false_implies, implies_true,
    and_true, List.forall_mem_ofFn_iff]
  sclose

theorem path_mem (hz : ∀ i, o.z i ∈ S) (hs : ∀ i, o.succ i ∈ S) (hsel : ∀ k, sel k ∈ S) :
    ∀ r ∈ pathFamily.residuals pub o sel, r ∈ S := by
  have hq : pathSelector sel ∈ S := by
    unfold pathSelector
    exact S.mul_mem (g2SumHigh_mem sel hsel _ _ _)
      (S.add_mem (S.add_mem (S.add_mem (g2Low_mem sel hsel _) (g2Low_mem sel hsel _))
        (g2Low_mem sel hsel _)) (g2Low_mem sel hsel _))
  simp only [pathFamily, pathLanes, List.forall_mem_append, List.forall_mem_cons,
    List.not_mem_nil, false_implies, implies_true, and_true, List.forall_mem_ofFn_iff]
  sclose

theorem value_mem (hz : ∀ i, o.z i ∈ S) (hs : ∀ i, o.succ i ∈ S) (hx : ∀ i, o.xor12 i ∈ S)
    (hsel : ∀ k, sel k ∈ S) : ∀ r ∈ valueFamily.residuals pub o sel, r ∈ S := by
  have hrz : valueReconstruct10 o.z ∈ S := by
    rw [value_reconstruct10_eq]; sclose
  have hrs : valueReconstruct10 o.succ ∈ S := by
    rw [value_reconstruct10_eq]; sclose
  have hrx : valueReconstruct10 o.xor12 ∈ S := by
    rw [value_reconstruct10_eq]; sclose
  have hrange : ∀ r ∈ valueRange o, r ∈ S := by
    simp only [valueRange, List.forall_mem_append, List.forall_mem_ofFn_iff,
      List.forall_mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, false_implies, implies_true, and_true]
    sclose
  simp only [valueFamily, List.forall_mem_append, List.forall_mem_map, List.forall_mem_cons,
    List.not_mem_nil, false_implies, implies_true, and_true]
  constructor
  · intro r hr
    refine S.mul_mem ?_ (hrange r hr)
    clear hrange
    sclose
  · clear hrange
    sclose

theorem emptyRoot_mem (level : Fin 20) (i : Fin 8) : emptyRootRightTarget (K := K) level i ∈ S := by
  unfold emptyRootRightTarget
  split_ifs <;> exact natCast_mem S _

theorem digestTarget_mem {F : Subfield K} (hFS : ∀ x ∈ F, x ∈ S) (hpub : PublicBase F pub)
    (key : DigestKey) (i : Fin 8) : digestTarget pub key i ∈ S := by
  obtain ⟨ha, hn, _, hr, hc, _, hsf, hroot, hnext⟩ := hpub
  cases key with
  | anchor => exact hFS _ (ha i)
  | nullifier => exact hFS _ (hn i)
  | recipient =>
      cases he : pub.recipient with
      | none => simp only [digestTarget, he, Option.getD_none]; exact S.zero_mem
      | some r =>
          simp only [digestTarget, he, Option.getD_some]
          exact hFS _ (hr r he i)
  | change => exact hFS _ (hc i)
  | frontier level =>
      simp only [digestTarget]
      split_ifs
      · exact emptyRoot_mem level i
      · exact hFS _ (hsf level i)
  | nextRoot => exact hFS _ (hroot i)
  | carry =>
      simp only [digestTarget]
      split_ifs
      · exact hFS _ (hnext _ i)
      · exact S.zero_mem

theorem digest_mem (hz : ∀ i, o.z i ∈ S) (hsel : ∀ k, sel k ∈ S) {F : Subfield K} (hFS : ∀ x ∈ F, x ∈ S) (hpub : PublicBase F pub) :
    ∀ r ∈ digestFamily.residuals pub o sel, r ∈ S := by
  simp only [digestFamily, List.forall_mem_ofFn_iff]
  intro i
  unfold publicDigestLanes
  rw [digest_fold_eq]
  apply S.add_mem S.zero_mem
  apply list_sum_mem
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨key, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
  exact S.mul_mem (hsel _) (S.sub_mem (hz _) (digestTarget_mem pub hFS hpub key i))

theorem asset_mem (hz : ∀ i, o.z i ∈ S) (hsel : ∀ k, sel k ∈ S) {F : Subfield K} (hFS : ∀ x ∈ F, x ∈ S) (hpub : PublicBase F pub) :
    ∀ r ∈ assetFamily.residuals pub o sel, r ∈ S := by
  have hasset : pub.assetId ∈ S := hFS _ hpub.2.2.1
  have hamount : pub.withdrawalAmount.getD 0 ∈ S := by
    cases he : pub.withdrawalAmount with
    | none => simp only [Option.getD_none]; exact S.zero_mem
    | some a =>
        simp only [Option.getD_some]
        exact hFS _ (hpub.2.2.2.2.2.1 a he)
  cases hv : pub.variant <;> cases hw : pub.withdrawalAmount.isSome
  all_goals
    simp only [assetFamily, assetScalarLanes, hv, hw, Bool.false_eq_true,
      ite_false, ite_true, List.forall_mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil,
      false_implies, implies_true, and_true]
    sclose

end Families

/-! ## Poseidon -/

section Poseidon

variable {S}

theorem poseidon_initial_mem : ∀ r lane, poseidonExternalInitial (K := K) r lane ∈ S := by
  unfold poseidonExternalInitial
  repeat' first
    | apply vec_cons_fun (fun row : Fin 16 → K => ∀ lane, row lane ∈ S)
    | apply vec_nil_fun (fun row : Fin 16 → K => ∀ lane, row lane ∈ S)
    | apply vec_cons_mem
    | apply vec_nil_fun
    | exact natCast_mem S _

theorem poseidon_final_mem : ∀ r lane, poseidonExternalFinal (K := K) r lane ∈ S := by
  unfold poseidonExternalFinal
  repeat' first
    | apply vec_cons_fun (fun row : Fin 16 → K => ∀ lane, row lane ∈ S)
    | apply vec_nil_fun (fun row : Fin 16 → K => ∀ lane, row lane ∈ S)
    | apply vec_cons_mem
    | apply vec_nil_fun
    | exact natCast_mem S _

theorem poseidon_internal_constants_mem : ∀ r, poseidonInternalConstants (K := K) r ∈ S := by
  unfold poseidonInternalConstants
  repeat' first
    | apply vec_cons_mem
    | apply vec_nil_fun
    | exact natCast_mem S _

theorem poseidon_pow5_mem (x : K) (hx : x ∈ S) : poseidonPow5 x ∈ S := by
  unfold poseidonPow5
  exact S.mul_mem (S.mul_mem (S.mul_mem hx hx) (S.mul_mem hx hx)) hx

theorem poseidon_mat4_mem (v : Fin 4 → K) (hv : ∀ i, v i ∈ S) : ∀ i, poseidonMat4 v i ∈ S := by
  unfold poseidonMat4
  repeat' first
    | apply vec_cons_mem
    | apply vec_nil_fun
    | apply S.add_mem
    | exact hv _

theorem poseidon_external_mem (v : Fin 16 → K) (hv : ∀ i, v i ∈ S) :
    ∀ i, poseidonExternalLinear v i ∈ S := by
  intro i
  unfold poseidonExternalLinear
  repeat' first
    | apply S.add_mem
    | exact S.zero_mem
    | apply poseidon_mat4_mem
    | intro j
    | exact hv _

theorem poseidon_internal_mem (v : Fin 16 → K) (hv : ∀ i, v i ∈ S) :
    ∀ i, poseidonInternalLinear v i ∈ S := by
  have hsum : (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin 15 => v i.succ)).foldl (· + ·) 0 ∈ S := by
    refine foldl_mem S _ _ _ S.zero_mem (fun acc hacc x hx => S.add_mem hacc ?_)
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.mp hx
    exact hv i.succ
  intro i
  unfold poseidonInternalLinear
  split_ifs
  · exact S.sub_mem hsum (hv 0)
  · exact S.add_mem (S.add_mem hsum (hv 0)) (S.mul_mem (hv i) (natCast_mem S _))

theorem poseidon_full_round_mem (v c : Fin 16 → K) (hv : ∀ i, v i ∈ S) (hc : ∀ i, c i ∈ S) :
    ∀ i, poseidonFullRound v c i ∈ S := by
  unfold poseidonFullRound
  apply poseidon_external_mem
  intro i
  exact poseidon_pow5_mem _ (S.add_mem (hv i) (hc i))

theorem poseidon_internal_round_mem (v : Fin 16 → K) (c : K) (hv : ∀ i, v i ∈ S) (hc : c ∈ S) :
    ∀ i, poseidonInternalRound v c i ∈ S := by
  unfold poseidonInternalRound
  apply poseidon_internal_mem
  intro i
  split_ifs
  · exact poseidon_pow5_mem _ (S.add_mem (hv 0) hc)
  · exact hv i

theorem poseidon_leading_mem (v a : Fin 16 → K) (hv : ∀ i, v i ∈ S) (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ S) :
    ∀ i, poseidonLeadingPair v a i ∈ S := by
  unfold poseidonLeadingPair
  try dsimp only
  apply poseidon_full_round_mem
  · apply poseidon_full_round_mem
    · apply poseidon_external_mem
      intro i; split_ifs
      · exact S.add_mem (hv i) (ha i)
      · exact hv i
    · exact poseidon_initial_mem 0
  · exact poseidon_initial_mem 1

theorem poseidon_scalarResidual_mem (o : Openings K) (block : K) (low : Fin 16 → K)
    (hz : ∀ i, o.z i ∈ S) (hs : ∀ i, o.succ i ∈ S) (hx : ∀ i, o.xor12 i ∈ S)
    (hblock : block ∈ S) (hlow : ∀ i, low i ∈ S) (lane : Fin 16) :
    poseidonScalarResidual o block low lane ∈ S := by
  have hfull : ∀ i, poseidonInterpolatedFullPair o.z low i ∈ S := by
    unfold poseidonInterpolatedFullPair
    try dsimp only
    apply poseidon_full_round_mem
    · apply poseidon_full_round_mem _ _ hz
      intro i
      exact S.add_mem (S.add_mem (S.mul_mem (hlow _) (poseidon_initial_mem _ _))
        (S.mul_mem (hlow _) (poseidon_final_mem _ _))) (S.mul_mem (hlow _) (poseidon_final_mem _ _))
    · intro i
      exact S.add_mem (S.add_mem (S.mul_mem (hlow _) (poseidon_initial_mem _ _))
        (S.mul_mem (hlow _) (poseidon_final_mem _ _))) (S.mul_mem (hlow _) (poseidon_final_mem _ _))
  have hfoldc : ∀ (f : Fin 7 → K), (∀ i, f i ∈ S) → (List.ofFn f).foldl (· + ·) 0 ∈ S := by
    intro f hf
    refine foldl_mem S _ _ _ S.zero_mem (fun acc hacc x hx => S.add_mem hacc ?_)
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.mp hx
    exact hf i
  have hinternal : ∀ i, poseidonInterpolatedInternalPair o.z low i ∈ S := by
    unfold poseidonInterpolatedInternalPair
    try dsimp only
    apply poseidon_internal_round_mem
    · apply poseidon_internal_round_mem _ _ hz
      exact hfoldc _ (fun i => S.mul_mem (hlow _) (poseidon_internal_constants_mem _))
    · exact hfoldc _ (fun i => S.mul_mem (hlow _) (poseidon_internal_constants_mem _))
  have hleading := poseidon_leading_mem o.z o.xor12 hz hx
  have hfullLow : ([1, 9, 10] : List (Fin 16)).foldl (fun sum row => sum + low row) 0 ∈ S :=
    foldl_mem S _ _ _ S.zero_mem (fun acc hacc x _ => S.add_mem hacc (hlow x))
  have hinternalLow : (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin 7 => low ⟨i.val + 2, by omega⟩)).foldl (· + ·) 0 ∈ S :=
    hfoldc _ (fun i => hlow _)
  unfold poseidonScalarResidual
  try dsimp only
  exact S.mul_mem hblock (S.add_mem (S.add_mem (S.add_mem S.zero_mem
    (S.mul_mem (hlow 0) (S.sub_mem (hs lane) (hleading lane))))
    (S.mul_mem hfullLow (S.sub_mem (hs lane) (hfull lane))))
    (S.mul_mem hinternalLow (S.sub_mem (hs lane) (hinternal lane))))

theorem pack4_mem {F : Subfield K} (B : PackBasis F) (hi : B.i ∈ S) (hu : B.u ∈ S)

theorem copySelectorRow_mem (s : CopySelectors K) (hh : ∀ i, s.high i ∈ S)

theorem copyMaskSum_mem (values : Fin 16 → K) (hv : ∀ i, values i ∈ S) (mask : Nat) :
    copySelectorMaskSum16 values mask ∈ S := by
  unfold copySelectorMaskSum16

  refine foldl_mem S _ _ _ ?_ (fun acc hacc x _ => ?_)

    · exact S.one_mem
    · exact S.zero_mem

    · exact S.sub_mem hacc (hv x)
    · exact S.add_mem hacc (hv x)

  try dsimp only

  try dsimp only

  · exact S.add_mem hacc (S.mul_mem (copyPowers_mem lam hlam x)
      (S.add_mem (ho _) (natCast_mem S _)))
  · exact hacc

/-- Every field of a copy row extension in `S`. -/
def RowIn (row : CopyRowExtension K) : Prop :=
  (∀ s, row.producerValues s ∈ S) ∧ (∀ s, row.producerWeights s ∈ S) ∧
    (∀ s, row.consumerValues s ∈ S) ∧ (∀ s, row.consumerWeights s ∈ S)

theorem update_mem (f : Fin 2 → K) (hf : ∀ s, f s ∈ S) (slot : Fin 2) (x : K) (hx : x ∈ S) :
    ∀ s, Function.update f slot x s ∈ S := by
  intro s

  split_ifs
  · exact hx
  · exact hf s

theorem copyAccumulate_mem (values weights : Fin 2 → K) (hv : ∀ s, values s ∈ S)
    (hw : ∀ s, weights s ∈ S) (ep : CopyEndpoint) (tag : Nat) (weight : K) (hwt : weight ∈ S)
    (patterns : Fin 14 → K) (hp : ∀ i, patterns i ∈ S) (sels : CopySelectors K)
    (hh : ∀ i, sels.high i ∈ S) (hl : ∀ i, sels.low i ∈ S) :
    (∀ s, (copyAccumulateEndpoint values weights ep tag weight patterns sels).1 s ∈ S) ∧
      (∀ s, (copyAccumulateEndpoint values weights ep tag weight patterns sels).2 s ∈ S) := by
  unfold copyAccumulateEndpoint
  try dsimp only
  have hsr := copySelectorRow_mem sels hh hl ep.row
  exact ⟨update_mem _ hv _ _ (S.add_mem (hv _) (S.mul_mem hsr
      (S.add_mem (natCast_mem S _) (hp _)))),
    update_mem _ hw _ _ (S.add_mem (hw _) (S.mul_mem hsr hwt))⟩

theorem copyResidual_mem (row : CopyRowExtension K) (hrow : RowIn (S := S) row)
    (helper chi : K) (hh : helper ∈ S) (hc : chi ∈ S) : copyResidual row helper chi ∈ S := by
  obtain ⟨r1, r2, r3, r4⟩ := hrow
  have d : ∀ i, (![chi - row.producerValues 0, chi - row.producerValues 1,
      chi - row.consumerValues 0, chi - row.consumerValues 1] : Fin 4 → K) i ∈ S := by
    repeat' first
      | apply vec_cons_mem
      | apply vec_nil_fun
      | exact S.sub_mem hc (r1 _)
      | exact S.sub_mem hc (r3 _)
  unfold copyResidual
  exact S.sub_mem (S.mul_mem (S.mul_mem (d 0) (d 1))
      (S.add_mem (S.mul_mem hh (S.mul_mem (d 2) (d 3)))
        (S.add_mem (S.mul_mem (r4 0) (d 3)) (S.mul_mem (r4 1) (d 2)))))
    (S.mul_mem (S.mul_mem (d 2) (d 3))
      (S.add_mem (S.mul_mem (r2 0) (d 1)) (S.mul_mem (r2 1) (d 0))))

theorem copyEvaluate_mem (openings : Fin 16 → K) (ho : ∀ i, openings i ∈ S) (h1 : K)
    (hh1 : h1 ∈ S) (sels : CopySelectors K) (hh : ∀ i, sels.high i ∈ S)
    (hl : ∀ i, sels.low i ∈ S) (lam chi : K) (hlam : lam ∈ S) (hchi : chi ∈ S)
    (n : Nat) (v : Variant) :
    (copyEvaluateWithSelectors openings h1 sels lam chi n v).1 ∈ S := by
  unfold copyEvaluateWithSelectors
  try dsimp only
  have hp := copyPatternValues_mem openings ho lam hlam
  have hrow : ∀ (l : List CopyLink) (init : CopyRowExtension K), RowIn (S := S) init →
      RowIn (S := S) (l.foldl (fun row link =>
        let weight := copyLinkWeight link n v
        let producer := copyAccumulateEndpoint row.producerValues row.producerWeights
          link.producer link.tag weight (copyPatternValuesLiteral openings lam) sels
        let consumer := copyAccumulateEndpoint row.consumerValues row.consumerWeights
          link.consumer link.tag weight (copyPatternValuesLiteral openings lam) sels
        (⟨producer.1, producer.2, consumer.1, consumer.2⟩ : CopyRowExtension K)) init) := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil => intro init h; exact h
    | cons link xs ih =>
      intro init h
      rw [List.foldl_cons]
      apply ih
      obtain ⟨h1', h2', h3', h4'⟩ := h
      have hwt := R0Z.K4Values.copyLinkWeight_mem S link n v
      have hP := copyAccumulate_mem _ _ h1' h2' link.producer link.tag _ hwt _ hp sels hh hl
      have hC := copyAccumulate_mem _ _ h3' h4' link.consumer link.tag _ hwt _ hp sels hh hl
      exact ⟨hP.1, hP.2, hC.1, hC.2⟩
  have hinit : RowIn (S := S) (⟨fun _ => 0, fun _ => 0, fun _ => 0, fun _ => 0⟩ : CopyRowExtension K) :=
    ⟨fun _ => S.zero_mem, fun _ => S.zero_mem, fun _ => S.zero_mem, fun _ => S.zero_mem⟩
  obtain ⟨r1, r2, r3, r4⟩ := hrow copyLinks _ hinit
  exact S.mul_mem (copyActive_mem sels hh hl) (copyResidual_mem _ ⟨r1, r2, r3, r4⟩ h1 chi hh1 hchi)

    (o : Openings K) (hz : ∀ i, o.z i ∈ S) (h1 : K) (hh1 : h1 ∈ S) (sel : Sel K)
    (hsel : ∀ k, sel k ∈ S) : ∀ r ∈ copyFamily.residuals pub lam chi o h1 sel, r ∈ S := by
  simp only [copyFamily, List.forall_mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, false_implies,

theorem laneAt_mem {F : Subfield K} (hFS : ∀ x ∈ F, x ∈ S) (B : PackBasis F)

    (h1 : K) (hh1 : h1 ∈ S) (sel : Sel K) (hsel : ∀ k, sel k ∈ S) (i : Fin 29) :

/-- The terminal lies in any subfield containing `F`, `B.i`, `B.u`, the
challenges, `zc`, the claims and the point. -/
theorem terminalValue_mem {F : Subfield K} (hFS : ∀ x ∈ F, x ∈ S) (B : PackBasis F)
    (hi : B.i ∈ S) (hu : B.u ∈ S) (pub : Public K) (hpub : PublicBase F pub)
    (lam chi θ μ : K) (hlam : lam ∈ S) (hchi : chi ∈ S) (hθ : θ ∈ S) (hμ : μ ∈ S)
    (zc : Fin 10 → K) (hzc : ∀ i, zc i ∈ S) (y : Fin 3 → Fin 29 → K) (hy : ∀ j c, y j c ∈ S)
    (α : Fin 10 → K) (hα : ∀ i, α i ∈ S) :
    terminalValue pub lam chi θ μ zc B y α ∈ S := by
  have hsel : ∀ k, selAt α k ∈ S := fun k =>
    R0Z.K4Values.eqWeight_mem S _ (fun b => hα _) k
  have hlane := laneAt_mem S hFS B hi hu pub hpub lam chi hlam hchi
    ⟨fun c => y 0 (Fin.castLE (by omega) c), fun c => y 1 (Fin.castLE (by omega) c),
      fun c => y 2 (Fin.castLE (by omega) c)⟩
    (fun _ => hy _ _) (fun _ => hy _ _) (fun _ => hy _ _) (y 0 26) (hy _ _) (selAt α) hsel
  have heq : eqValue zc α ∈ S := by
    unfold eqValue
    exact prod_mem fun c _ => S.add_mem (S.add_mem (S.sub_mem (S.sub_mem S.one_mem (hzc c)) (hα c))
      (S.mul_mem (hzc c) (hα c))) (S.mul_mem (hzc c) (hα c))
  have hact : activeAt α ∈ S :=
    copyActive_mem (copySelectors (selAt α)) (g2High_mem _ hsel) (g2Low_mem _ hsel)
  unfold terminalValue
  try dsimp only
  exact S.add_mem (S.add_mem (S.mul_mem heq (sum_mem fun i _ => S.mul_mem (S.pow_mem hθ _) (hlane i)))
    (S.mul_mem hμ (hy _ _))) (S.mul_mem (S.mul_mem hμ hμ) (S.mul_mem (S.sub_mem S.one_mem hact) (hy _ _)))

C1Lift and H1Lift are hypotheses (conjuncts of P_R1, D29); nothing here

/-! ### Lane separability (DESIGN-ii-prime §2.0) -/

theorem L_pointClaim_congr (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K)
    (l : Fin 29) (τ τ' : Trace K) (hτ : τ l = τ' l) (j : Fin 3) :
    R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := Bat) π B ch τ (.pointClaim j l) =
      R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := Bat) π B ch τ' (.pointClaim j l) := by
  rw [R0Z.Shift.L_pointClaim, R0Z.Shift.L_pointClaim]
  simp only [honestClaims, hτ]

theorem L_extraClaim_congr (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K)
    (l : Fin 29) (τ τ' : Trace K) (hτ : τ l = τ' l) :
    R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := Bat) π B ch τ (.extraClaim l) =
      R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := Bat) π B ch τ' (.extraClaim l) := by
  rw [R0Z.Shift.L_extraClaim, R0Z.Shift.L_extraClaim]
  unfold R0P.Mask.honestExtra
  congr 1
  funext j
  show τ l (π.symm j) = τ' l (π.symm j)
  rw [hτ]

theorem L_ood_congr (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K)
    (l : Fin 29) (τ τ' : Trace K) (hτ : τ l = τ' l) (j : Fin 2) :
    R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := Bat) π B ch τ (.ood j l) =
      R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := Bat) π B ch τ' (.ood j l) := by
  simp only [R0Z.PayloadSplit.L, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply,
    linearPayload, hτ]

theorem L_opened_congr (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K)
    (l : Fin 29) (τ τ' : Trace K) (hτ : τ l = τ' l) (q : Fin 262144) (s : Fin 4) :
    R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := Bat) π B ch τ (.opened q s l) =
      R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := Bat) π B ch τ' (.opened q s l) := by
  simp only [R0Z.PayloadSplit.L, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply,
    linearPayload]
  split_ifs <;> simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply, hτ]

/-- The own cells of lane `l` of `L τ` depend only on `τ l`. -/
theorem L_own_congr (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K)
    (l : Fin 29) (τ τ' : Trace K) (hτ : τ l = τ' l) :
    ownRead (Bat := Bat) (F := F) l (R0Z.PayloadSplit.L π B ch τ) =
      ownRead (Bat := Bat) (F := F) l (R0Z.PayloadSplit.L π B ch τ') := by
  funext o
  cases o with
  | claim j => exact L_pointClaim_congr (Bat := Bat) π B ch l τ τ' hτ j
  | extra => exact L_extraClaim_congr (Bat := Bat) π B ch l τ τ' hτ
  | ood j => exact L_ood_congr (Bat := Bat) π B ch l τ τ' hτ j
  | opened q s => exact L_opened_congr (Bat := Bat) π B ch l τ τ' hτ q s

/-- DESIGN-ii-prime §2.0: `own_l (L τ) = obs_l (τ l)` for every trace. -/
theorem own_L_eq_obs (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K)
    (l : Fin 29) (τ : Trace K) :
    ownRead (Bat := Bat) (F := F) l (R0Z.PayloadSplit.L π B ch τ) = obs (Bat := Bat) π B ch l (τ l) := by
  simp only [obs, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.restrictScalars_apply]
  apply L_own_congr
  first
    | exact (Pi.single_eq_same _ _).symm
    | simp

theorem ownRead_A (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K)
    (l : Fin 29) (t : T K F) :
    ownRead (Bat := Bat) (F := F) l (A π B ch t) =
      ownRead (Bat := Bat) (F := F) l (R0Z.PayloadSplit.L π B ch (R0Z.JointTrace.tapeLinear B t)) := by
  have hA : A (Bat := Bat) π B ch t =
      R0Z.PayloadSplit.L π B ch (R0Z.JointTrace.tapeLinear B t) := rfl
  rw [hA]

/-! ### The lanes written by the noise tape -/

theorem noise_lane_sem (B : PackBasis F) (p : ExtTape F) (e : EligibleNoise K F) (l : Fin 29)
    (hl : l.val < 16) :
    R0Z.JointTrace.tapeLinear B (inrN (p, e)) l = R0Z.JointTrace.eligibleLinear e l := by
  funext r
  have h0 : traceLinear B (aff (inrN (p, e) : T K F)) l r = 0 := by
    simp only [traceLinear, LinearMap.pi_apply, if_pos hl, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  show R0Z.JointTrace.eligibleLinear e l r + traceLinear B (aff (inrN (p, e))) l r = _
  rw [h0, add_zero]

theorem noise_lane_h1 (B : PackBasis F) (p : ExtTape F) (e : EligibleNoise K F) :
    R0Z.JointTrace.tapeLinear B (inrN (p, e)) 26 =
      R0Z.JointTrace.tapeLinear B (inrN (LinearMap.inl F (ExtTape F) (EligibleNoise K F) p)) 26 := by
  funext r
  have h : ¬ ((26 : Fin 29).val < 16) := by decide
  have hz : ∀ e' : EligibleNoise K F, R0Z.JointTrace.eligibleLinear e' 26 r = 0 := by
    intro e'
    rw [R0Z.JointTrace.eligibleLinear_apply, if_neg h]
  show R0Z.JointTrace.eligibleLinear e 26 r + traceLinear B (aff (inrN (p, e))) 26 r =
    R0Z.JointTrace.eligibleLinear (0 : EligibleNoise K F) 26 r +
      traceLinear B (aff (inrN (p, (0 : EligibleNoise K F)))) 26 r
  rw [hz, hz]
  all_goals rfl

theorem noise_lane_other (B : PackBasis F) (n : N K F) (l : Fin 29)
    (hl : ¬ (l.val < 16 ∨ l.val = 26)) :
    R0Z.JointTrace.tapeLinear B (inrN n) l = 0 := by
  funext r
  have h16 : ¬ l.val < 16 := fun h => hl (Or.inl h)
  have h26 : ¬ l.val = 26 := fun h => hl (Or.inr h)
  have he : R0Z.JointTrace.eligibleLinear n.2 l r = 0 := by
    rw [R0Z.JointTrace.eligibleLinear_apply, if_neg h16]
  show R0Z.JointTrace.eligibleLinear n.2 l r + traceLinear B (aff (inrN n)) l r = 0
  rw [he, zero_add]
  by_cases h2 : l.val < 26
  · simp only [traceLinear, LinearMap.pi_apply, h16, h2, ↓reduceIte, ↓reduceDIte]
    apply balance_zero_generic
    intro s
    rfl
  · by_cases h4 : l.val = 27
    · simp only [traceLinear, LinearMap.pi_apply, h16, h2, h26, h4, ↓reduceIte, ↓reduceDIte]
      apply balance_zero_generic
      intro s
      change (0 : K) + B.i * 0 + B.u * 0 + (B.i * B.u) * 0 = 0
      ring
    · simp only [traceLinear, LinearMap.pi_apply, h16, h2, h26, h4, ↓reduceIte, ↓reduceDIte]
      apply balance_zero_generic
      intro s
      change (0 : K) + B.i * 0 + B.u * 0 + (B.i * B.u) * 0 = 0
      ring

/-! ### Column-wise assembly of eligible noise -/

theorem eligible_col_lt {c : Fin 29} {r : Fin 1024} (h : eligible c r) : c.val < 16 := And.left h

/-- Take column `c` of the noise from `E c`. -/
def assemble (E : Fin 16 → EligibleNoise K F) : EligibleNoise K F :=
  fun cell => E ⟨cell.1.1.val, eligible_col_lt cell.2⟩ cell

theorem eligibleLinear_assemble (E : Fin 16 → EligibleNoise K F) (c : Fin 16) :
    R0Z.JointTrace.eligibleLinear (assemble E) (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) =
      R0Z.JointTrace.eligibleLinear (E c) (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) := by
  funext r
  have hs : ∀ s, semanticNoise (Sum.elim (assemble E) 0) (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) s =
      semanticNoise (Sum.elim (E c) 0) (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) s := by
    intro s
    unfold semanticNoise
    split_ifs <;> rfl
  rw [R0Z.JointTrace.eligibleLinear_apply, R0Z.JointTrace.eligibleLinear_apply]
  simp only [hs]

/-! ### Step N -/

/-- DESIGN-ii-prime §2.1 `noise_lift`, Bat-generic, with the lifts as premises. -/
theorem noise_lift (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B)
    (ch : Challenges K)
    (hC : ∀ c : Fin 16, C1Lift (Bat := Bat) π B ch c) (hH : H1Lift (Bat := Bat) π B hB ch)
    (δ : Trace K) (hδ : ∀ c : Fin 16, δ (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) ∈ Wsem (K := K) (F := F))
    (hδ26 : δ 26 ∈ Wh1 B hB) :
    ∃ n : N K F,
      (∀ l : Fin 29, (l.val < 16 ∨ l.val = 26) →
        ownRead (Bat := Bat) (F := F) l (A π B ch (inrN n)) =
          ownRead (Bat := Bat) (F := F) l (R0Z.PayloadSplit.L π B ch δ)) ∧
      (∀ l : Fin 29, ¬ (l.val < 16 ∨ l.val = 26) →
        ownRead (Bat := Bat) (F := F) l (A π B ch (inrN n)) = 0) := by
  have hc : ∀ c : Fin 16, ∃ e : EligibleNoise K F,
      obs (Bat := Bat) π B ch (Fin.castLE (by omega) c)
          (R0Z.JointTrace.eligibleLinear e (Fin.castLE (by omega) c)) =
        obs (Bat := Bat) π B ch (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) (δ (Fin.castLE (by omega) c)) := by
    intro c
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hvo⟩ := hC c (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (hδ c))
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := LinearMap.mem_range.1 hv
    have he' : R0Z.JointTrace.eligibleLinear e (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) = v := he
    exact ⟨e, by rw [he', hvo]⟩
  choose E hE using hc
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hvo⟩ := hH (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hδ26)
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := LinearMap.mem_range.1 hv
  have hp' : R0Z.JointTrace.tapeLinear B
      (inrN (LinearMap.inl F (ExtTape F) (EligibleNoise K F) p)) 26 = v := hp
  have key : ∀ c : Fin 16,
      ownRead (Bat := Bat) (F := F) (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) (A π B ch (inrN (p, assemble E))) =
        ownRead (Bat := Bat) (F := F) (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) (R0Z.PayloadSplit.L π B ch δ) := by
    intro c
    rw [ownRead_A, own_L_eq_obs, own_L_eq_obs, noise_lane_sem B p _ _ c.isLt,
      eligibleLinear_assemble]
    exact hE c
  refine ⟨(p, assemble E), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro l hl
    rcases hl with h16 | h26
    · have hl' : l = Fin.castLE (by omega) (⟨l.val, h16⟩ : Fin 16) := Fin.ext rfl
      rw [hl']
      exact key _
    · obtain rfl : l = 26 := Fin.ext h26
      rw [ownRead_A, own_L_eq_obs, own_L_eq_obs, noise_lane_h1, hp', hvo]
  · intro l hl
    rw [ownRead_A, own_L_eq_obs, noise_lane_other B _ l hl, map_zero]

/-! ### Named accessors for the conjuncts of `P_R1` (LOG D36.3) -/

section Accessors
variable {π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024} {B : PackBasis F} {hB : PackField B} {ch : Challenges K}

theorem _root_.R1Z.PredicateR1.P_R1.halfOK (hP : P_R1 π B hB ch) : HalfOK ch := hP.1

theorem _root_.R1Z.PredicateR1.P_R1.semK4 (hP : P_R1 π B hB ch) : SemK4 B hB ch := hP.2.1

theorem _root_.R1Z.PredicateR1.P_R1.c1lift (hP : P_R1 π B hB ch) :
    ∀ c : Fin 16, C1Lift (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch c := hP.2.2.2.2.1

theorem _root_.R1Z.PredicateR1.P_R1.h1lift (hP : P_R1 π B hB ch) :

/-- Step N for the R1 instance: both lifts are conjuncts of `P_R1`. -/
theorem noise_lift_R1 (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B)

import R1Z.VerifierRelationsR1

/-! R1-3 (DESIGN-R1-PRIVACY-MODEL §3, §4; LOG D30.3, D34): the public
rejection predicate `P_R1` of the R1 prover, as a conjunction of named Props.

* `QPrime_R1`: (Q′) on the R1 instance.
* `V_G`, `BCondG_R1 := B0R1' ≤ V_G`, and the two consequences `bcond_of_G`
  (BCond, for clause (i′)) and `breach_of_G` (BReach, for clause (ii′)), from
  `bat_ker_own_le_B0R1'`.  `B0R1' := B0R1 ⊓ (unopened folded cells zero)`:
  the unprimed `B0R1 ≤ V_G` is false for every challenge, because `relR1`
  never constrains the folded cells outside `FoldedOpen` while `V_G` is zero
  there (Z9b, LOG design correction).  The number of independent relations
  varies with the query set (queries sharing a parent u/4 give coinciding
  line relations); nothing here counts relations.
* `C1Lift`, `H1Lift` (the (ii′) noise lifts, design §3.3), stated
  Bat-generically and specialised to `R1Bat` in `P_R1`.
* `HalfOK`, `SemK4`, `QueryCard`.

Every conjunct is a function of (π, B, hB, ch) only.  Nothing here asserts
any conjunct. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

namespace R1Z.PredicateR1

open scoped BigOperators
open R0P R0Z.MaskLayout R0Z.HonestView R0Z.Partition R0Z.D12 R0Z.K4
open R1Z.Batched R1Z.VerifierRelationsR1

attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-! ## (Q′) -/

/-- (Q′) for R1 (design §3.1): `ChainT0K4 ≤ (ker own).map roundMaskMap`. -/
def QPrime_R1 (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B)
    (ch : Challenges K) : Prop :=
  R0Z.SilentReduction.QPrime (Bat := R1Bat) π B hB ch

/-! ## (B) in the V_G = B0 form -/

/-- Mask tapes with only G limbs: zero mask-only raw part, zero D limbs. -/
def Gonly : Submodule F (M K F) :=
  LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.fst F (Fin 10 × Fin 1024 → F) (ExtTape F × ExtTape F)) ⊓
    LinearMap.ker ((LinearMap.snd F (ExtTape F) (ExtTape F)).comp
      (LinearMap.snd F (Fin 10 × Fin 1024 → F) (ExtTape F × ExtTape F)))

/-- Batched image of G-only, round-silent, own-silent mask tapes. -/
def V_G (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) :
    Submodule F (R1Bat → K) :=
  ((Gonly (K := K) (F := F)) ⊓
      LinearMap.ker (R0Z.Z4Maps.roundMaskMap (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch) ⊓
      LinearMap.ker (R0Z.SilentReduction.ownMap (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch)).map
    (R0Z.SilentReduction.batMap (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch)

/-- Batched vectors whose folded cells vanish outside `FoldedOpen`. -/
def unopenedZero (ch : Challenges K) : Submodule F (R1Bat → K) where
  carrier := {b | ∀ p, ¬ FoldedOpen ch p → b (.folded p) = 0}
  add_mem' := by
    intro a b ha hb p hp
    rw [Pi.add_apply, ha p hp, hb p hp, add_zero]
  zero_mem' := fun _ _ => rfl
  smul_mem' := by
    intro c b hb p hp
    rw [Pi.smul_apply, hb p hp, smul_zero]

/-- `B0`, corrected: relation-consistent batched vectors with zero unopened
folded cells. -/
def B0R1' (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) : Submodule F (R1Bat → K) :=
  B0R1 (F := F) π ch ⊓ unopenedZero ch

/-- Every mask tape has zero batched cells at the unopened folded positions. -/
theorem batMap_unopened (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K)
    (m : M K F) (p : Fin 262144) (hp : ¬ FoldedOpen ch p) :
    R0Z.SilentReduction.batMap (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch m (.folded p) = 0 := by
  have e : R0Z.SilentReduction.batMap (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch m (.folded p) =
      BatchedLayer.read (Bat := R1Bat) π ch (pureTrace B m) (.folded p) := by
    rw [R0Z.SilentReduction.batMap, LinearMap.comp_apply, R0Z.PureRounds.A_pure]
    rfl
  rw [e]
  exact folded_unqueried_zero π ch (pureTrace B m) p hp

/-- The batched image of own-silent mask tapes lies in `B0R1'`. -/
theorem bat_ker_own_le_B0R1' (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) :
    (LinearMap.ker (R0Z.SilentReduction.ownMap (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch)).map
        (R0Z.SilentReduction.batMap (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch) ≤ B0R1' π ch := by
  intro v hv
  refine Submodule.mem_inf.2 ⟨bat_ker_own_le_B0R1 (F := F) π B ch hv, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨m, _, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.1 hv
  exact fun p hp => batMap_unopened π B ch m p hp

/-- Shape sanity: `B0R1'` lives on the opened coordinates. -/
theorem B0R1'_le_unopenedZero (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) :
    B0R1' (F := F) π ch ≤ unopenedZero ch := inf_le_right

/-- The (B) conjunct of `P_R1`: every relation-consistent batched vector with
zero unopened folded cells is reached by a G-only silent tape. -/
def BCondG_R1 (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) : Prop :=
  B0R1' π ch ≤ V_G π B ch

/-- (B) as used by clause (i′) (SilentReduction.BCond on R1). -/
def BCond_R1 (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) : Prop :=
  R0Z.SilentReduction.BCond (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch

/-- (B) as used by clause (ii′). -/
def BReach_R1 (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) : Prop :=
  B0R1' π ch ≤
    (LinearMap.ker (R0Z.SilentReduction.ownMap (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch) ⊓
      LinearMap.ker (R0Z.Z4Maps.roundMaskMap (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch)).map
      (R0Z.SilentReduction.batMap (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch)

theorem V_G_le (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) :
    V_G π B ch ≤
      (LinearMap.ker (R0Z.SilentReduction.ownMap (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch) ⊓
        LinearMap.ker (R0Z.Z4Maps.roundMaskMap (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch)).map
        (R0Z.SilentReduction.batMap (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch) := by
  apply Submodule.map_mono
  intro m hm
  rcases Submodule.mem_inf.1 hm with ⟨hGR, ho⟩
  exact Submodule.mem_inf.2 ⟨ho, (Submodule.mem_inf.1 hGR).2⟩

/-- Shape sanity: `V_G` also lives on the opened coordinates, so
`BCondG_R1` compares two subspaces of the same coordinate space (the
unprimed `B0R1 ≤ V_G` could never hold). -/
theorem V_G_le_unopenedZero (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) :
    V_G π B ch ≤ unopenedZero ch := by
  intro v hv
  obtain ⟨m, _, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.1 hv
  exact fun p hp => batMap_unopened π B ch m p hp

theorem breach_of_G (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K)
    (hG : BCondG_R1 π B ch) : BReach_R1 π B ch :=
  hG.trans (V_G_le π B ch)

theorem bcond_of_G (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K)
    (hG : BCondG_R1 π B ch) : BCond_R1 π B ch :=
  le_antisymm (Submodule.map_mono inf_le_left)
    ((bat_ker_own_le_B0R1' π B ch).trans (hG.trans (V_G_le π B ch)))

/-! ## The (ii′) noise lifts (design §3.3) -/

section Lifts

variable {Bat : Type} [BatchedLayer K Bat]

/-- The own cells of one lane. -/
inductive OwnCell
  | claim (j : Fin 3)
  | extra
  | ood (j : Fin 2)
  | opened (q : Fin 262144) (s : Fin 4)

/-- Read the own cells of lane `c` from a payload. -/
def ownRead (c : Fin 29) : Payload K Bat →ₗ[F] (OwnCell → K) :=
  LinearMap.pi fun o => match o with
  | .claim j => (LinearMap.proj (PayloadCell.pointClaim j c) : Payload K Bat →ₗ[F] K)
  | .extra => (LinearMap.proj (PayloadCell.extraClaim c) : Payload K Bat →ₗ[F] K)
  | .ood j => (LinearMap.proj (PayloadCell.ood j c) : Payload K Bat →ₗ[F] K)
  | .opened q s => (LinearMap.proj (PayloadCell.opened q s c) : Payload K Bat →ₗ[F] K)

/-- The own cells of lane `c` produced by a word placed in lane `c` alone. -/
def obs (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) (c : Fin 29) :
    (Fin 1024 → K) →ₗ[F] (OwnCell → K) :=
  (ownRead (Bat := Bat) c).comp
    (((R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := Bat) π B ch).restrictScalars F).comp
      (LinearMap.single F (fun _ : Fin 29 => Fin 1024 → K) c))

end Lifts

/-- The base field inside `K`. -/
def baseF : Submodule F K := LinearMap.range (Algebra.linearMap F K)

/-- Sum of a lane word over the inactive rows. -/
def inactiveSumF : (Fin 1024 → K) →ₗ[F] K :=
  ∑ r ∈ copyInactiveRows, (LinearMap.proj r : (Fin 1024 → K) →ₗ[F] K)

/-- Base-field lane words with zero inactive sum. -/
def Wsem : Submodule F (Fin 1024 → K) :=
  (⨅ r : Fin 1024, (baseF (F := F)).comap (LinearMap.proj r : (Fin 1024 → K) →ₗ[F] K)) ⊓
    LinearMap.ker (inactiveSumF (K := K) (F := F))

/-- K₄-valued lane words with zero inactive sum. -/
def Wh1 (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) : Submodule F (Fin 1024 → K) :=
  (⨅ r : Fin 1024, (K4F B hB).comap (LinearMap.proj r : (Fin 1024 → K) →ₗ[F] K)) ⊓
    LinearMap.ker (inactiveSumF (K := K) (F := F))

/-- Lane `c` of the eligible semantic noise. -/
def Vsem (c : Fin 29) : Submodule F (Fin 1024 → K) :=
  LinearMap.range ((LinearMap.proj c : Trace K →ₗ[F] (Fin 1024 → K)).comp
    (R0Z.JointTrace.eligibleLinear (K := K) (F := F)))

/-- Lane 26 (H1) of the H1-padding tape. -/
def Ph1 (B : PackBasis F) : Submodule F (Fin 1024 → K) :=
  LinearMap.range ((LinearMap.proj 26 : Trace K →ₗ[F] (Fin 1024 → K)).comp
    ((R0Z.JointTrace.tapeLinear B).comp
      (inrN.comp (LinearMap.inl F (ExtTape F) (EligibleNoise K F)))))

/-- C1 lane lift (design §3.3): every own observation of a base, inactive-
balanced word in C1 lane `c` is produced by eligible noise. -/
def C1Lift {Bat : Type} [BatchedLayer K Bat] (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F)
    (ch : Challenges K) (c : Fin 16) : Prop :=
  (Wsem (K := K) (F := F)).map (obs (Bat := Bat) π B ch (Fin.castLE (by omega) c)) ≤
    (Vsem (Fin.castLE (by omega) c)).map (obs (Bat := Bat) π B ch (Fin.castLE (by omega) c))

/-- H1 lane lift (design §3.3). -/
def H1Lift {Bat : Type} [BatchedLayer K Bat] (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F)
    (hB : PackField B) (ch : Challenges K) : Prop :=
  (Wh1 B hB).map (obs (Bat := Bat) π B ch 26) ≤ (Ph1 B).map (obs (Bat := Bat) π B ch 26)

/-! ## Field and sampler conjuncts -/

/-- α₉ ≠ ½ (J2 / `Phi0_sRem`). -/
def HalfOK (ch : Challenges K) : Prop := alpha ch 9 ≠ 1 / 2

/-- Every semantic challenge lies in K₄. -/
def SemK4 (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) (ch : Challenges K) : Prop :=
  ∀ i : Fin 25, ch.sem i ∈ K4 B hB

/-- At most 22 queries. -/
def QueryCard (ch : Challenges K) : Prop := ch.queries.card ≤ 22

/-! ## The predicate -/

/-- The R1 honest-prover rejection predicate (design §3.4, LOG D30.3). -/
def P_R1 (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B)
    (ch : Challenges K) : Prop :=
  HalfOK ch ∧ SemK4 B hB ch ∧ QPrime_R1 π B hB ch ∧ BCondG_R1 π B ch ∧
    (∀ c : Fin 16, C1Lift (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch c) ∧ H1Lift (Bat := R1Bat) π B hB ch ∧
    QueryCard ch

theorem P_R1.qprime {π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024} {B : PackBasis F} {hB : PackField B}
    {ch : Challenges K} (h : P_R1 π B hB ch) : QPrime_R1 π B hB ch := h.2.2.1

theorem P_R1.bcond {π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024} {B : PackBasis F} {hB : PackField B}
    {ch : Challenges K} (h : P_R1 π B hB ch) : BCond_R1 π B ch :=
  bcond_of_G π B ch h.2.2.2.1

theorem P_R1.breach {π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024} {B : PackBasis F} {hB : PackField B}
    {ch : Challenges K} (h : P_R1 π B hB ch) : BReach_R1 π B ch :=
  breach_of_G π B ch h.2.2.2.1

/-- Clause (i′) on Chain0₄ (design §3.6 b, first half): under `P_R1`, every
`Chain0K4` vector is the payload of a silent mask tape.  J2-R1 supplies
`sRem ∈ Chain0K4`. -/
theorem chain0K4_le_silent_R1 {π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024} {B : PackBasis F}
    {hB : PackField B} {ch : Challenges K} (h : P_R1 π B hB ch) :
    R0Z.SilentReduction.Chain0K4 (Bat := R1Bat) B hB ch ≤
      (R0Z.Z4Maps.silentMasks (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch).map
        ((A (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch).comp inlM) :=
  R0Z.SilentReduction.chain0K4_le_silent_of π B hB ch h.qprime h.bcond

#print axioms batMap_unopened
#print axioms bat_ker_own_le_B0R1'
#print axioms B0R1'_le_unopenedZero
#print axioms V_G_le_unopenedZero
#print axioms V_G_le
#print axioms breach_of_G
#print axioms bcond_of_G
#print axioms P_R1.qprime
#print axioms P_R1.bcond
#print axioms P_R1.breach
#print axioms chain0K4_le_silent_R1

end R1Z.PredicateR1

end
R1Z.VerifierRelationsR1:
import R0Z.SilentReduction
import R1Z.Batched

/-! J4-R1(b) (DESIGN-R1-PRIVACY-MODEL §2.4, §4; LOG D30, D33): the 47 batched
verifier relations of R1 (S2a, S2b, S1, and C_u, L_u per query) as one linear
map `relR1` on the batched cells, its kernel `B0R1`, and

* `bat_L_mem_B0R1`: for EVERY trace τ (J4′ form) whose own cells and inactive
  sum vanish, the batched cells of `L τ` satisfy every relation;
* `bat_ker_own_le_B0R1`: the batched image of own-silent mask tapes lies in
  `B0R1`.

S2b, S1 and L_u hold for every trace; S2a and C_u are the own-silent forms.
The line relation uses the inverse table `lineInverse` of BatchedAlgebra
(the normalisation Z9b found independently).  No challenge restriction. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

namespace R1Z.VerifierRelationsR1

open scoped BigOperators
open R0P R0P.SemSource R0Z.MaskLayout R0Z.HonestView R0Z.Partition R0Z.D12
open R1Z.Batched
open AspisPool.AlgorithmicCircleDecoderV7

attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
attribute [local irreducible] copyLinks copyPatterns copyActiveRowMasks copyInactiveRows
  dotLinear claimsLinear extraLinear honestClaims batchLinear

variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K]

/-! ## Relations -/

inductive R1Rel
  | s2a
  | s2b
  | s1
  | circ (u : Fin 262144)
  | line (u : Fin 262144)

/-- One batched coordinate. -/
def pr (b : R1Bat) : (R1Bat → K) →ₗ[K] K := LinearMap.proj b

/-- The folded-word cells as a word on the line-18 domain. -/
def foldedWordOf : (R1Bat → K) →ₗ[K] (Fin 262144 → K) := LinearMap.funLeft K K R1Bat.folded

/-- The final cells as 64 coefficients. -/
def finalOf : (R1Bat → K) →ₗ[K] (Fin 64 → K) := LinearMap.funLeft K K R1Bat.final

/-- Parent of a query on the log-16 line. -/
def parent16 (u : Fin 262144) : Fin 65536 := ⟨u.val / 4, by omega⟩

/-- The R1 verifier relations (verifier.rs finish_relation :284-297, query
C_u :273-276, L_u :277-279; ρ batches the L_u in Rust and never enters). -/
def relR1 (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) : (R1Bat → K) →ₗ[K] (R1Rel → K) :=
  LinearMap.pi fun r => match r with
  | .s2a => pr (.round0 0) + pr (.round0 4)
  | .s2b => pr (.round1 0) + pr (.round1 4) -
      AspisR1.RoundPairing.quarter (K := K) • ∑ i : Fin 7, ch.opening 2 ^ i.val • pr (.round0 i)
  | .s1 => ∑ i : Fin 7, ch.opening 3 ^ i.val • pr (.round1 i) -
      ∑ e : Fin 64, w2 π ch e • pr (.final e)
  | .circ u => if u ∈ ch.queries then pr (.folded u) else 0
  | .line u => if u ∈ ch.queries then
      (LinearMap.proj (parent16 u)).comp
        ((AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.lineFoldLayer 65536 (ch.opening 3)
            R1Z.BatchedAlgebra.lineInverse).comp foldedWordOf -
          (AspisR1.RepeatedLift.secondLinear (K := K)).comp finalOf)
    else 0

/-- `B0`: batched vectors satisfying all relations, as an `F`-subspace. -/
def B0R1 {F : Subfield K} (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) :
    Submodule F (R1Bat → K) :=
  (LinearMap.ker (relR1 π ch)).restrictScalars F

/-! ### Evaluation of each relation -/

theorem relR1_s2a (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) (v : R1Bat → K) :
    relR1 π ch v .s2a = v (.round0 0) + v (.round0 4) := by
  simp only [relR1, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, pr, LinearMap.proj_apply]

theorem relR1_s2b (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) (v : R1Bat → K) :
    relR1 π ch v .s2b = v (.round1 0) + v (.round1 4) -
      AspisR1.RoundPairing.quarter * ∑ i : Fin 7, ch.opening 2 ^ i.val * v (.round0 i) := by
  simp only [relR1, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.add_apply,
    LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply, smul_eq_mul, pr, LinearMap.proj_apply]

theorem relR1_s1 (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) (v : R1Bat → K) :
    relR1 π ch v .s1 = ∑ i : Fin 7, ch.opening 3 ^ i.val * v (.round1 i) -
      ∑ e : Fin 64, w2 π ch e * v (.final e) := by
  simp only [relR1, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    LinearMap.sum_apply, smul_eq_mul, pr, LinearMap.proj_apply]

theorem relR1_circ (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) (v : R1Bat → K)
    (u : Fin 262144) (hu : u ∈ ch.queries) : relR1 π ch v (.circ u) = v (.folded u) := by
  simp only [relR1, LinearMap.pi_apply, if_pos hu, pr, LinearMap.proj_apply]

theorem relR1_circ_off (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) (v : R1Bat → K)
    (u : Fin 262144) (hu : u ∉ ch.queries) : relR1 π ch v (.circ u) = 0 := by
  simp only [relR1, LinearMap.pi_apply, if_neg hu, LinearMap.zero_apply]

theorem relR1_line (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) (v : R1Bat → K)
    (u : Fin 262144) (hu : u ∈ ch.queries) :
    relR1 π ch v (.line u) =
      AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.lineFoldLayer 65536 (ch.opening 3)
          R1Z.BatchedAlgebra.lineInverse (foldedWordOf v) (parent16 u) -
        AspisR1.RepeatedLift.secondLinear (finalOf v) (parent16 u) := by
  simp only [relR1, LinearMap.pi_apply, if_pos hu, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply,
    LinearMap.proj_apply, Pi.sub_apply]

theorem relR1_line_off (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) (v : R1Bat → K)
    (u : Fin 262144) (hu : u ∉ ch.queries) : relR1 π ch v (.line u) = 0 := by
  simp only [relR1, LinearMap.pi_apply, if_neg hu, LinearMap.zero_apply]

/-- A polynomial of degree at most six evaluated through its seven coefficients. -/
theorem eval_fin7 (p : Polynomial K) (hp : p.natDegree ≤ 6) (x : K) :
    p.eval x = ∑ i : Fin 7, x ^ i.val * p.coeff i.val := by
  rw [Polynomial.eval_eq_sum_range' (p := p) (n := 7) (by omega) x, Finset.sum_range]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => mul_comm _ _

/-! ## The relations on the honest batched read -/

/-- S2b holds for every trace. -/
theorem read_s2b (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) (τ : Trace K) :
    relR1 π ch (BatchedLayer.read (Bat := R1Bat) π ch τ) .s2b = 0 := by
  rw [relR1_s2b, read_round1, read_round1]
  simp only [read_round0]
  rw [← eval_fin7 _ (AspisR1.RoundPairing.round_degree (n := 256) (batchR1 π ch τ)
    (weightsR1 π ch))]
  have h : (AspisR1.RoundPairing.roundPolynomial (n := 64) (q1 π ch τ) (w1 π ch)).coeff
        (0 : Fin 7).val +
      (AspisR1.RoundPairing.roundPolynomial (n := 64) (q1 π ch τ) (w1 π ch)).coeff
        (4 : Fin 7).val =
      AspisR1.RoundPairing.quarter *
        (AspisR1.RoundPairing.roundPolynomial (n := 256) (batchR1 π ch τ)
          (weightsR1 π ch)).eval (ch.opening 2) :=
    R1Z.BatchedAlgebra.s2b_identity (ch.opening 2) (batchR1 π ch τ) (weightsR1 π ch)
  rw [h, sub_self]

/-- S1 holds for every trace. -/
theorem read_s1 (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) (τ : Trace K) :
    relR1 π ch (BatchedLayer.read (Bat := R1Bat) π ch τ) .s1 = 0 := by
  rw [relR1_s1]
  simp only [read_round1, read_final]
  rw [← eval_fin7 _ (AspisR1.RoundPairing.round_degree (n := 64) (q1 π ch τ) (w1 π ch))]
  have h : (AspisR1.RoundPairing.roundPolynomial (n := 64) (q1 π ch τ) (w1 π ch)).eval
        (ch.opening 3) =
      ∑ e : Fin 64,
        AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.coefficientFoldLayer 64 (ch.opening 3)
            (q1 π ch τ) e *
          AspisR1.RoundPairing.dualFold (n := 64) (ch.opening 3) (w1 π ch) e :=
    R1Z.BatchedAlgebra.s1_identity (ch.opening 3) (q1 π ch τ) (w1 π ch)
  rw [h, sub_eq_zero]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => mul_comm _ _

/-- L_u holds for every trace (line_identity on the α₀-folded coefficients). -/
theorem read_line (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) (τ : Trace K)
    (u : Fin 262144) : relR1 π ch (BatchedLayer.read (Bat := R1Bat) π ch τ) (.line u) = 0 := by
  by_cases hu : u ∈ ch.queries
  · rw [relR1_line _ _ _ _ hu, sub_eq_zero,
      AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.lineFoldLayer_apply]
    have hc (s : Fin 4) :
        foldedWordOf (BatchedLayer.read (Bat := R1Bat) π ch τ)
            (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex (parent16 u) s) =
          AspisWide.FinalEncoder.exactFinalLinear (q1 π ch τ)
            (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex (parent16 u) s) := by
      have hopen : FoldedOpen ch
          (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex (parent16 u) s) := by
        refine ⟨u, hu, ?_⟩
        have hs := s.isLt
        simp only [AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex_val, parent16]
        omega
      exact read_folded π ch τ _ hopen
    have hf : finalOf (BatchedLayer.read (Bat := R1Bat) π ch τ) =
        AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.coefficientFoldLayer 64 (ch.opening 3)
          (q1 π ch τ) := by
      funext e
      exact read_final π ch τ e
    simp only [hc]
    rw [hf]
    exact R1Z.BatchedAlgebra.line_identity (ch.opening 3) (q1 π ch τ) (parent16 u)
  · exact relR1_line_off _ _ _ _ hu

/-! ## Own-silent traces: S2a and C_u -/

section OwnSilent

variable {F : Subfield K} (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K)
  (τ : Trace K)

/-- S2a on a trace whose own claim/extra/OOD cells and inactive sum vanish. -/
theorem read_s2a
    (hclaim : ∀ j c, R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch τ (.pointClaim j c) = 0)
    (hextra : ∀ c, R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch τ (.extraClaim c) = 0)
    (hood : ∀ j c, R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch τ (.ood j c) = 0)
    (hia : R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch τ .inactiveSum = 0) :
    relR1 π ch (BatchedLayer.read (Bat := R1Bat) π ch τ) .s2a = 0 := by
  have z0 : ell π ch 0 (batchR1 π ch τ) = 0 := by
    rw [ell_batch_inactive]
    exact (R0Z.SilentReduction.linearPayload_inactiveSum (Bat := R1Bat) π ch τ).symm.trans hia
  have z1 : ell π ch 1 (batchR1 π ch τ) = 0 := by
    rw [ell_batch_claim0]
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun c _ => by
      rw [show claimsLinear (alpha ch) 0 c τ = 0 from hclaim 0 c, mul_zero]
  have z2 : ell π ch 2 (batchR1 π ch τ) = 0 := by
    rw [ell_batch_claim1]
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun c _ => by
      rw [show claimsLinear (alpha ch) 1 c τ = 0 from hclaim 1 c, mul_zero]
  have z3 : ell π ch 3 (batchR1 π ch τ) = 0 := by
    rw [ell_batch_claim2]
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun c _ => by
      rw [show claimsLinear (alpha ch) 2 c τ = 0 from hclaim 2 c, mul_zero]
  have z4 : ell π ch 4 (batchR1 π ch τ) = 0 := by
    rw [ell_batch_extra]
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun c _ => by
      rw [show extraLinear π (alpha ch) c τ = 0 from hextra c, mul_zero]
  have z5 : ell π ch 5 (batchR1 π ch τ) = 0 := by
    rw [ell_batch_ood0]
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun c _ => by
      rw [show oodLinear (ch.circle 0) (coeffsLinear π (τ c)) = 0 from hood 0 c, mul_zero]
  have z6 : ell π ch 6 (batchR1 π ch τ) = 0 := by
    rw [ell_batch_ood1]
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun c _ => by
      rw [show oodLinear (ch.circle 1) (coeffsLinear π (τ c)) = 0 from hood 1 c, mul_zero]
  rw [relR1_s2a, read_round0, read_round0]
  have h : (AspisR1.RoundPairing.roundPolynomial (n := 256) (batchR1 π ch τ)
          (weightsR1 π ch)).coeff (0 : Fin 7).val +
        (AspisR1.RoundPairing.roundPolynomial (n := 256) (batchR1 π ch τ)
          (weightsR1 π ch)).coeff (4 : Fin 7).val =
      AspisR1.RoundPairing.quarter *
        ∑ k : Fin 7, ch.opening 1 ^ k.val * ell π ch k (batchR1 π ch τ) :=
    R1Z.BatchedAlgebra.s2a_identity (ch.opening 1) (ell π ch) (batchR1 π ch τ)
  rw [h, Fin.sum_univ_seven, z0, z1, z2, z3, z4, z5, z6]
  simp only [mul_zero, add_zero]

/-- C_u on a trace whose opened symbols vanish. -/
theorem read_circ
    (hopen : ∀ q s c, R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch τ (.opened q s c) = 0)
    (u : Fin 262144) :
    relR1 π ch (BatchedLayer.read (Bat := R1Bat) π ch τ) (.circ u) = 0 := by
  by_cases hu : u ∈ ch.queries
  · rw [relR1_circ _ _ _ _ hu, read_folded π ch τ u ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩]
    have hop (s : Fin 4) (c : Fin 29) :
        AspisWide.Agreement.exactInitialLinear (coeffsLinear π (τ c))
          (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex u s) = 0 := by
      have h := hopen u s c
      rw [show R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch τ (.opened u s c) =
        linearPayload (Bat := R1Bat) π ch τ (.opened u s c) from rfl] at h
      simp only [linearPayload, LinearMap.pi_apply, if_pos hu, LinearMap.comp_apply,
        LinearMap.proj_apply] at h
      exact h
    have hfib : AspisR1.FirstFold.fibre
        (AspisWide.InitialEncoder.exactInitialEncoder (batchR1 π ch τ)) u = 0 := by
      funext s
      have e : AspisWide.InitialEncoder.exactInitialEncoder (batchR1 π ch τ)
            (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex u s) =
          ∑ c : Fin 29, ch.opening 0 ^ c.val *
            AspisWide.Agreement.exactInitialLinear (coeffsLinear π (τ c))
              (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex u s) :=
        map_batchR1 π ch ((LinearMap.proj
          (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex u s)).comp
            AspisWide.Agreement.exactInitialLinear) τ
      show AspisWide.InitialEncoder.exactInitialEncoder (batchR1 π ch τ)
          (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex u s) = 0
      rw [e]
      exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun c _ => by rw [hop s c, mul_zero]
    exact R1Z.BatchedAlgebra.circ_zero_of_fibre_zero (ch.opening 2) (batchR1 π ch τ) u hfib
  · exact relR1_circ_off _ _ _ _ hu

/-- J4′ form: for every trace whose own cells (claims, extra claims, OOD,
opened symbols) and inactive sum vanish, the batched cells of `L τ` satisfy
every R1 relation. -/
theorem bat_L_mem_B0R1
    (hclaim : ∀ j c, R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch τ (.pointClaim j c) = 0)
    (hextra : ∀ c, R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch τ (.extraClaim c) = 0)
    (hood : ∀ j c, R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch τ (.ood j c) = 0)
    (hopen : ∀ q s c, R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch τ (.opened q s c) = 0)
    (hia : R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch τ .inactiveSum = 0) :
    R0Z.SilentReduction.batRead (F := F) (Bat := R1Bat)
        (R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch τ) ∈ B0R1 (F := F) π ch := by
  have hb : R0Z.SilentReduction.batRead (F := F) (Bat := R1Bat)
      (R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch τ) =
        BatchedLayer.read (Bat := R1Bat) π ch τ := by
    funext b
    rfl
  rw [hb, B0R1, Submodule.restrictScalars_mem, LinearMap.mem_ker]
  funext r
  cases r with
  | s2a => exact read_s2a π B ch τ hclaim hextra hood hia
  | s2b => exact read_s2b π ch τ
  | s1 => exact read_s1 π ch τ
  | circ u => exact read_circ π B ch τ hopen u
  | line u => exact read_line π ch τ u

end OwnSilent

/-- Corollary for mask tapes: the batched image of own-silent tapes lies in
`B0R1` (`ia_pure_zero` supplies the inactive sum). -/
theorem bat_ker_own_le_B0R1 {F : Subfield K} (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F)
    (ch : Challenges K) :
    (LinearMap.ker (R0Z.SilentReduction.ownMap (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch)).map
        (R0Z.SilentReduction.batMap (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch) ≤ B0R1 (F := F) π ch := by
  rintro _ ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
  have hA : (A (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch).comp inlM m =
      R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch (pureTrace B m) :=
    R0Z.PureRounds.A_pure π B ch m
  have hown : ∀ cell, R0Z.SilentReduction.ownProj (F := F) (Bat := R1Bat)
      (R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch (pureTrace B m)) cell = 0 := by
    intro cell
    have h := congrFun (LinearMap.mem_ker.1 hm) cell
    rw [R0Z.SilentReduction.ownMap, LinearMap.comp_apply, hA] at h
    exact h
  have hia : R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch (pureTrace B m) .inactiveSum = 0 := by
    have h := R0Z.SilentReduction.ia_pure_zero (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch m
    rw [hA] at h
    exact h
  have hmb : R0Z.SilentReduction.batMap (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch m =
      R0Z.SilentReduction.batRead (F := F) (Bat := R1Bat)
        (R0Z.PayloadSplit.L (Bat := R1Bat) π B ch (pureTrace B m)) := by
    rw [R0Z.SilentReduction.batMap, LinearMap.comp_apply, hA]
  rw [hmb]
  exact bat_L_mem_B0R1 π B ch (pureTrace B m)
    (fun j c => hown (.pointClaim j c)) (fun c => hown (.extraClaim c))
    (fun j c => hown (.ood j c)) (fun q s c => hown (.opened q s c)) hia

#print axioms relR1_s2a
#print axioms relR1_s2b
#print axioms relR1_s1
#print axioms relR1_circ
#print axioms relR1_line
#print axioms eval_fin7
#print axioms read_s2b
#print axioms read_s1
#print axioms read_line
#print axioms read_s2a
#print axioms read_circ
#print axioms bat_L_mem_B0R1
#print axioms bat_ker_own_le_B0R1

end R1Z.VerifierRelationsR1

end
R0Z.RefPayload:
import R0Z.IIPrimeResidual

/-! ZF2 (zf1/DESIGN-ZF2-SIMULATOR.txt §3.2, §5.1): the public reference
payload and the explicit simulator, generic in the batched layer.

* `refPayload pub B ch`: `cTilde`'s formula (`cTilde_eq`) at the zero payload
  trace (`L 0 = 0`), plus `S₀ = Σ_b fOrig(0)(b)` in the `.maskSum` cell.  It is
  a function of `(pub, B, ch)` only.
* Its silent values: `ι = 0`, `.inactiveSum = 0`, `Φ₀ = 0` (α₉ ≠ ½), the chain
  equalities, round cells in `K₄` (under `TerminalClosed`), zero on every cell
  other than the round cells and `.maskSum`.
* `simE π B outputs x ch t = (metadata, Ψ_ch (refPayload + A_ch (equiv⁻¹ t)))`:
  no instance, no choice.
* `equalLaws_simE_of`: given clause (i′) for `w` and
  `cTilde w − refPayload ∈ range A_ch`, the honest view of `w` at `ch` and
  `simE … ch` have equal laws (the proof of `hvzk_on_of` with the chosen
  witness replaced by `refPayload`).

No challenge predicate is asserted here. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R0Z.RefPayload
open R0P R0P.Sumcheck R0P.SemSource R0Z.MaskLayout R0Z.HonestView R0Z.Partition R0Z.D12
  R0Z.Shift R0Z.K4 Polynomial

attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
  {Bat : Type} [BatchedLayer K Bat]

/-! ### The reference payload -/

/-- The payload with `s` at `.maskSum` and `0` elsewhere. -/
def msCell (s : K) : Payload K Bat := fun cell => match cell with
  | .maskSum => s
  | _ => 0

theorem msCell_maskSum (s : K) : msCell (Bat := Bat) s .maskSum = s := rfl
theorem msCell_semanticCoeff (s : K) (j : Fin 10) (i : Fin 28) :
    msCell (Bat := Bat) s (.semanticCoeff j i) = 0 := rfl
theorem msCell_pointClaim (s : K) (j : Fin 3) (c : Fin 29) :
    msCell (Bat := Bat) s (.pointClaim j c) = 0 := rfl
theorem msCell_extraClaim (s : K) (c : Fin 29) : msCell (Bat := Bat) s (.extraClaim c) = 0 := rfl

/-- The direction coefficient of the zero payload trace. -/
def k0 (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) : K :=
  fOrig pub B ch 0 (alpha ch) * (alpha ch 9 - 1/2)⁻¹

/-- The Boolean sum of the original terminal at the zero payload trace. -/
def S0 (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) : K :=
  bsumB 10 (fun b => fOrig pub B ch 0 (ofBool b))

/-- The public reference payload (design §3.2). -/
def refPayload (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) : Payload K Bat :=
  PayloadSplit.roundInclusion (PayloadSplit.originalRounds pub B ch 0) - k0 pub B ch • dir +
    msCell (S0 pub B ch)

/-! ### Silent values -/

theorem roundPoly_msCell (j : Fin 10) (s : K) : Chain.roundPoly j (msCell (Bat := Bat) s) = 0 := by
  rw [Chain.roundPoly_apply]
  simp only [msCell_semanticCoeff, monomial_zero_right, Finset.sum_const_zero]

theorem iota_msCell (s : K) : HonestValid.iota (msCell (Bat := Bat) s) = -s := by
  simp only [HonestValid.iota_apply, roundPoly_msCell, msCell_maskSum, eval_zero, zero_add,
    zero_sub]

theorem iota_refPayload (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) :
    HonestValid.iota (refPayload (Bat := Bat) pub B ch) = 0 := by
  rw [refPayload, map_add, map_sub, map_smul, HonestValid.iota_originalRounds, HonestValid.iota_dir,
    iota_msCell, smul_zero, sub_zero]
  unfold S0
  ring

/-- Every cell other than the round cells and `.maskSum` is zero. -/
theorem refPayload_cell (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K)
    (cell : PayloadCell Bat) (hc : ∀ j i, cell ≠ .semanticCoeff j i) (hm : cell ≠ .maskSum) :
    refPayload (Bat := Bat) pub B ch cell = 0 := by
  cases cell with
  | semanticCoeff j i => exact absurd rfl (hc j i)
  | maskSum => exact absurd rfl hm
  | pointClaim j c => show (0 : K) - k0 pub B ch * 0 + 0 = 0; ring
  | extraClaim c => show (0 : K) - k0 pub B ch * 0 + 0 = 0; ring
  | ood j c => show (0 : K) - k0 pub B ch * 0 + 0 = 0; ring
  | inactiveSum => show (0 : K) - k0 pub B ch * 0 + 0 = 0; ring
  | opened q s c => show (0 : K) - k0 pub B ch * 0 + 0 = 0; ring
  | bat b => show (0 : K) - k0 pub B ch * 0 + 0 = 0; ring

theorem inactive_refPayload (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) :
    refPayload (Bat := Bat) pub B ch .inactiveSum = 0 :=
  refPayload_cell pub B ch .inactiveSum (by intro _ _ h; cases h) (by intro h; cases h)

theorem Phi0_msCell (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) (s : K) :
    Phi0 B ch (msCell (Bat := Bat) s) = 0 := by
  have hr : round9Poly (msCell (Bat := Bat) s) = 0 := by
    rw [round9Poly_apply]
    simp only [msCell_semanticCoeff, monomial_zero_right, Finset.sum_const_zero]
  have hc : claimMask B (alpha ch) (msCell (Bat := Bat) s) = 0 := by
    simp only [claimMask, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,

theorem Phi0_refPayload (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K)

theorem msCell_mem_chainEqs (ch : Challenges K) (s : K) :

    ((IIPrimeResidual.ChainEqs ch).sub_mem
      (IIPrimeResidual.originalRounds_mem_chainEqs pub B ch 0)
      ((IIPrimeResidual.ChainEqs ch).smul_mem _ (IIPrimeResidual.dir_mem_chainEqs ch)))
    (msCell_mem_chainEqs ch _)

/-- `k₀ ∈ K₄` from `TerminalClosed` (the zero trace has zero claims). -/
theorem k0_mem (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) (pub : Public K) (ch : Challenges K)
    (hsem : ∀ i, ch.sem i ∈ K4 B hB) (hT : K4Values.TerminalClosed (K4 B hB) pub B ch) :

  have ha : ∀ i, alpha ch i ∈ K4 B hB := K4Values.alpha_mem _ ch hsem
  have h0 : ∀ c r, (0 : Trace K) c r ∈ K4 B hB := fun _ _ => (K4 B hB).zero_mem
  unfold k0 fOrig
  refine (K4 B hB).mul_mem ((K4 B hB).mul_mem (hsem 14) (hT _ _ (fun j c =>
    K4Values.honestClaims_mem _ _ h0 _ ha j c) ha)) ?_
  exact (K4 B hB).inv_mem ((K4 B hB).sub_mem (ha 9) (half_mem_K4 B hB))

theorem refPayload_round_mem (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) (pub : Public K)
    (ch : Challenges K) (hsem : ∀ i, ch.sem i ∈ K4 B hB)
    (hT : K4Values.TerminalClosed (K4 B hB) pub B ch) (j : Fin 10) (i : Fin 28) :
    refPayload (Bat := Bat) pub B ch (.semanticCoeff j i) ∈ K4 B hB := by
  show PayloadSplit.originalRounds pub B ch 0 j i -
      k0 pub B ch * (if j = 9 then (X - C (1 / 2 : K)).coeff i.val else 0) + 0 ∈ K4 B hB
  exact (K4 B hB).add_mem ((K4 B hB).sub_mem
    (K4Values.originalRounds_mem _ pub B ch hsem hT 0 (fun _ _ => (K4 B hB).zero_mem) j i)
    ((K4 B hB).mul_mem (k0_mem B hB pub ch hsem hT) (K4Values.dirCoeff_mem B hB j i)))
    (K4 B hB).zero_mem

/-! ### The explicit simulator -/

/-- ZF2's simulator: the shifted reference coset at a uniform tape.  Its
arguments are public; there is no instance and no choice. -/
def simE (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : JointView.Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : JointView.Statement K CommitHandle) (ch : Challenges K) (t : JointView.Tape K F) :
    JointView.View K CommitHandle Aux Bat :=
  (ZkStatement.metadata outputs x ch,
    shift x.1 B ch (refPayload x.1 B ch + A π B ch (Partition.equiv.symm t)))

attribute [local irreducible] JointView.payload A g

/-- Clause (i′) for `w` and the reference coset give equal laws of the honest
view and `simE`. -/
theorem equalLaws_simE_of [Fintype Bat] (h : JointView.HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : JointView.Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : JointView.Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K)
    (hi : ∀ n, sRem (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch n ∈ LinearMap.range ((A h.transport B ch).comp inlM))
    (hz : cTilde (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch - refPayload x.1 B ch ∈ LinearMap.range (A h.transport B ch)) :
    EqualLaws (JointView.view (Bat := Bat) h B outputs x w ch) (simE h.transport B outputs x ch) := by
  have hlaw := payload_law_on h B x w ch hi
  have hlinear := AffineLaw.equal_laws_of_mask_image (A h.transport B ch) (A h.transport B ch)
    (cTilde h B x w ch) (refPayload x.1 B ch) rfl hz
  have hshift := equalLaws_comp (shift x.1 B ch) hlinear
  have hpart : EqualLaws (D12.payload (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch)
      (fun t => shift x.1 B ch (refPayload x.1 B ch + A h.transport B ch t)) := by
    intro v
    exact (hlaw v).trans (hshift v)
  have hold : EqualLaws (JointView.payload (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch)
      (fun t => shift x.1 B ch (refPayload x.1 B ch + A h.transport B ch (Partition.equiv.symm t))) := by
    refine AbsorptionLaw.equal_laws_of_equiv Partition.equiv.toEquiv _ _ ?_
    have hg : ∀ r : T K F, Partition.equiv.symm (Partition.equiv.toEquiv r) = r :=
      fun r => Partition.equiv.symm_apply_apply r
    simp only [hg]
    unfold R0Z.D12.payload at hpart
    exact hpart
  have hp := AffineLaw.equal_laws_const_pair (JointView.payload (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch)
    (fun t => shift x.1 B ch (refPayload x.1 B ch + A h.transport B ch (Partition.equiv.symm t)))
    (ZkStatement.metadata outputs x ch) hold
  unfold JointView.view simE
  exact hp

/-! ### The per-challenge valid sets -/

/-- Validity at the challenge, for instances of the statement. -/
def VValid (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle) :
    Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop :=
  fun ch w => h.public w = x.1 → R0Z.HonestValid.HonestValid x.1 B (h.build w) ch

/-- The prover's attempt acceptance beyond `P_R1`: no LogUp pole. -/
def VR1 (h : HonestProver K) : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop :=
  fun ch w => R0Z.HonestValidity.NoPole (h.build w) (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1)

theorem maskImageOnV_R1_valid (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : R0Z.K4.PackField B)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hpub : PublicBase F x.1)
    (hF : ∀ w, h.public w = x.1 → BaseTyped F (h.build w)) :
    MaskImageOnV (Bat := R1Bat) (P_R1 h.transport B hB) h (VValid h B x) B x :=
  ⟨fun ch hP w n _ hw => R1Z.ClauseIR1.clause_i_R1_all h B hB x hpub hF ch hP w n hw,
    fun ch hP w w' hv hv' hw hw' => R1Z.IIPrimeR1.cTilde_sub_mem_range_R1 h B hB x hpub ch hP w w'
      (hF w hw) (hF w' hw') (hv hw) (hv' hw')⟩

theorem maskImageOnV_R1 (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : R0Z.K4.PackField B)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hpub : PublicBase F x.1)
    (hs : R0Z.HonestValidity.BuilderSoundOn h B x) :
    MaskImageOnV (Bat := R1Bat) (P_R1 h.transport B hB) h (VR1 h) B x :=
  maskImageOnV_mono _ h (VR1 h) (VValid h B x) B x
    (fun ch w _ hv hw => R0Z.HonestValidity.honestValid_of x.1 B (h.build w) ch (hs w hw) hv)
    (maskImageOnV_R1_valid h B hB x hpub (R0Z.HonestValidity.baseTyped_of h B x hs))

theorem hvzk_R1V (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : R0Z.K4.PackField B)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hpub : PublicBase F x.1)
    (hs : R0Z.HonestValidity.BuilderSoundOn h B x) :
    HVZK_onV (Bat := R1Bat) (P_R1 h.transport B hB) h (VR1 h) B outputs x :=

/-! Clause (i′) on R1 (DESIGN-R1-PRIVACY-MODEL §3.6 b; LOG D30.3, D35):
under `P_R1`, the remainder `sRem` of every instance with the given public
statement is the payload of a mask tape.  Inputs: J2/J2-R1
(`sRem_mem_chain0K4`), J2b (`terminalClosed`), R1-3 (`chain0K4_le_silent_R1`,
which uses `BCondG_R1` through `bcond_of_G`).  This is the first half of
`MaskImageOn P_R1`; clause (ii′) is separate. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

namespace R1Z.ClauseIR1

open R0P R0Z.MaskLayout R0Z.HonestView R0Z.Partition R0Z.D12 R0Z.Shift
open R1Z.Batched R1Z.PredicateR1

variable {K CommitHandle : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-- Clause (i′) at one challenge. -/
theorem clause_i_R1 (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : R0Z.K4.PackField B)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hpub : PublicBase F x.1)
    (hF : ∀ w, h.public w = x.1 → BaseTyped F (h.build w))
    (ch : Challenges K) (hP : P_R1 h.transport B hB ch) (w : h.Instance) (n : N K F)
    (hw : h.public w = x.1) :
    sRem (Bat := R1Bat) h B x w ch n ∈
      LinearMap.range ((A (Bat := R1Bat) h.transport B ch).comp inlM) := by
  have hK := R0Z.K4Values.sRem_mem_chain0K4 (Bat := R1Bat) h B hB x w ch n hP.2.1 (hF w hw)
    (R0Z.TerminalClosed.terminalClosed B hB x.1 ch hP.2.1 hpub) hP.1
  obtain ⟨m, _, hm⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.1 (chain0K4_le_silent_R1 hP hK)
  exact ⟨m, hm⟩

/-- Clause (i′) in the form of the first conjunct of `MaskImageOn P_R1`. -/
theorem clause_i_R1_all (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : R0Z.K4.PackField B)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hpub : PublicBase F x.1)
    (hF : ∀ w, h.public w = x.1 → BaseTyped F (h.build w)) :
    ∀ ch, P_R1 h.transport B hB ch → ∀ w n, h.public w = x.1 →
      sRem (Bat := R1Bat) h B x w ch n ∈
        LinearMap.range ((A (Bat := R1Bat) h.transport B ch).comp inlM) :=
  fun ch hP w n hw => clause_i_R1 h B hB x hpub hF ch hP w n hw

#print axioms clause_i_R1

end R1Z.ClauseIR1
