import Mathlib.Logic.Equiv.Defs

/-! Statement-only interface for the D47.2 sampler premise (DESIGN-BUILD-INTEGRATION §4 (c)).

The four fields of `R1Z.Sem1UniformR1.QM31SamplerLaw`, over the same carrier
`Fin 32 → UInt8` (= `R0Z.FsStatement.OracleAnswer`), with no typeclass on `K`.  The import
closure is Mathlib's `Equiv` only, so this module's object is the same on the privacy base and
on the spend-path base; a joint module on either base can produce a value of it, and
`Sem1UniformR1.QM31SamplerLaw` is obtained from it field by field. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace R1Z.SamplerLawIface

/-- Rank the 32 bytes bijectively into `Fin 2^256`, reduce mod `p⁴`, embed injectively. -/
structure QM31SamplerLaw {K : Type} (s1 : (Fin 32 → UInt8) → K) where
  rank : (Fin 32 → UInt8) ≃ Fin (2 ^ 256)
  emb : Nat → K
  emb_inj : ∀ x y : Nat, x < (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 → y < (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 → emb x = emb y → x = y
  sample : ∀ b, s1 b = emb ((rank b).val % (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4)

end R1Z.SamplerLawIface

#print axioms R1Z.SamplerLawIface.QM31SamplerLaw
R1J.SamplerLawSpend:
import R1Z.SamplerLawIface
import ExtractedQM31SamplerCorrect

/-! The D47.2 premise `QM31SamplerLaw` from the spend path's proved sampler facts
(DESIGN-BUILD-INTEGRATION §4 (c)).  Joint module: compiled on the spend-path sampler base
(pinned overlay qm31-index-sampler-correct-432-20261016, correct-c).

* carrier transport `arrEquiv : (Fin 32 → UInt8) ≃ Array U8 32#usize`, through the byte state
  `Fin 32 → Fin 256` and the spend path's `encodeState`/`decodeState` round trips;
* `s1Spend ι`: the extracted `qm31_sample` on the transported block, read through the current
  carrier `decode ∘ toCurrent` into `QM31Exact`, then through any injective `ι : QM31Exact → K`
  (the QM31 ↔ K transport);
* `rankE`: `SourceSamplerByteRank.rank ∘ arrEquiv` as an equivalence onto `Fin 2^256`;
* `qm31SamplerLaw_spend`: the interface law, from `ExtractedQM31SamplerCorrect.sample_total`,
  `SamplerNatModel.qm31Digits_value` and the digit canonicality, with no premise besides `ι`
  injective.  `SemRows01` (which decoder rows feed χ and λ) is a property of the wire, not of
  the sampler, and is not addressed here. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

namespace R1J.SamplerLawSpend

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std

abbrev Ans := Fin 32 → UInt8
abbrev QF := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact.QM31Exact
abbrev MF := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact.M31Exact
abbrev Pm : ℕ := AspisR1.SamplerMachineBounds.P

/-! ## Carrier transport -/

def stateEquiv : Ans ≃ (Fin 32 → Fin 256) where
  toFun a := fun i => (a i).toFin
  invFun s := fun i => UInt8.ofFin (s i)
  left_inv a := by funext i; exact UInt8.ofFin_toFin (a i)
  right_inv s := by funext i; exact UInt8.toFin_ofFin (s i)

def stateArrEquiv : (Fin 32 → Fin 256) ≃ Array U8 32#usize where
  toFun := AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.encodeState
  invFun := AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.decodeState
  left_inv := AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.state_roundtrip
  right_inv := AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.array_roundtrip

def arrEquiv : Ans ≃ Array U8 32#usize := stateEquiv.trans stateArrEquiv

theorem pow_eq : (256 : ℕ) ^ 32 = 2 ^ 256 := by norm_num

def rankE : Ans ≃ Fin (2 ^ 256) :=
  (stateEquiv.trans R0C.ModuloField.blockRank).trans (finCongr pow_eq)

theorem rankE_val (a : Ans) :
    (rankE a).val = AspisR1.SourceSamplerByteRank.rank (arrEquiv a) := by
  show (R0C.ModuloField.blockRank (stateEquiv a)).val =
    (R0C.ModuloField.blockRank (AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.decodeState
      (AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.encodeState (stateEquiv a)))).val
  rw [AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.state_roundtrip]

/-! ## The sampled value -/

/-- The actual extracted sampler on the transported block, through the current carrier. -/
def s1Spend {K : Type} (ι : QF → K) (a : Ans) : K :=
  match AspisR1Qm31SamplerIndex.sampler.qm31_sample (arrEquiv a) with
  | .ok q => ι (AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact.decode
      (AspisR1.ExtractedQM31SamplerCarrier.toCurrent q))
  | _ => ι 0

theorem s1Spend_ok {K : Type} (ι : QF → K) (a : Ans) :
    ∃ q, AspisR1Qm31SamplerIndex.sampler.qm31_sample (arrEquiv a) = .ok q ∧
      s1Spend ι a = ι (AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact.decode
        (AspisR1.ExtractedQM31SamplerCarrier.toCurrent q)) := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, -, -⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedQM31SamplerCorrect.sample_total (arrEquiv a)
  exact ⟨q, hq, by simp only [s1Spend, hq]⟩

/-! ## Digits -/

/-- The four low base-`p` digits read into the exact tower, c0.a/c0.b/c1.a/c1.b order. -/
def digitsQ (x : ℕ) : QF :=
  ⟨⟨((x % Pm : ℕ) : MF), ((x / Pm % Pm : ℕ) : MF)⟩,
    ⟨((x / Pm / Pm % Pm : ℕ) : MF), ((x / Pm / Pm / Pm % Pm : ℕ) : MF)⟩⟩

def emb {K : Type} (ι : QF → K) (x : ℕ) : K := ι (digitsQ x)

theorem lowDigits_mod (p : ℕ) :
    ∀ n x, AspisR1.SamplerNatModel.lowDigits p n (x % p ^ n) =
      AspisR1.SamplerNatModel.lowDigits p n x
  | 0, _ => rfl
  | n + 1, x => by
    show x % p ^ (n + 1) % p :: AspisR1.SamplerNatModel.lowDigits p n (x % p ^ (n + 1) / p) =
      x % p :: AspisR1.SamplerNatModel.lowDigits p n (x / p)
    rw [Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd x (dvd_pow_self p (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)), pow_succ',
      Nat.mod_mul_right_div_self, lowDigits_mod p n (x / p)]

theorem qm31Digits_mod (x : ℕ) :
    AspisR1.SamplerNatModel.qm31Digits (x % Pm ^ 4) = AspisR1.SamplerNatModel.qm31Digits x :=
  lowDigits_mod Pm 4 x

theorem qm31Digits_eq (x : ℕ) :
    AspisR1.SamplerNatModel.qm31Digits x =
      [x % Pm, x / Pm % Pm, x / Pm / Pm % Pm, x / Pm / Pm / Pm % Pm] := rfl

theorem Pm_eq : Pm = 2147483647 := by norm_num [Pm, AspisR1.SamplerMachineBounds.P]

theorem Pm_pos : 0 < Pm := by rw [Pm_eq]; norm_num

theorem cast_digit_inj {u v : ℕ} (hu : u < Pm) (hv : v < Pm)
    (h : ((u : ℕ) : MF) = ((v : ℕ) : MF)) : u = v := by
  have h' : u % 2147483647 = v % 2147483647 := (ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff' u v 2147483647).mp h
  rw [Pm_eq] at hu hv
  rwa [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hu, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hv] at h'

theorem digitsQ_inj (x y : ℕ) (h : digitsQ x = digitsQ y) :
    AspisR1.SamplerNatModel.qm31Digits x = AspisR1.SamplerNatModel.qm31Digits y := by
  have h0 : ((x % Pm : ℕ) : MF) = ((y % Pm : ℕ) : MF) := congrArg (fun q : QF => q.re.re) h
  have h1 : ((x / Pm % Pm : ℕ) : MF) = ((y / Pm % Pm : ℕ) : MF) :=
    congrArg (fun q : QF => q.re.im) h
  have h2 : ((x / Pm / Pm % Pm : ℕ) : MF) = ((y / Pm / Pm % Pm : ℕ) : MF) :=
    congrArg (fun q : QF => q.im.re) h
  have h3 : ((x / Pm / Pm / Pm % Pm : ℕ) : MF) = ((y / Pm / Pm / Pm % Pm : ℕ) : MF) :=
    congrArg (fun q : QF => q.im.im) h
  rw [qm31Digits_eq, qm31Digits_eq,
    cast_digit_inj (Nat.mod_lt _ Pm_pos) (Nat.mod_lt _ Pm_pos) h0,
    cast_digit_inj (Nat.mod_lt _ Pm_pos) (Nat.mod_lt _ Pm_pos) h1,
    cast_digit_inj (Nat.mod_lt _ Pm_pos) (Nat.mod_lt _ Pm_pos) h2,
    cast_digit_inj (Nat.mod_lt _ Pm_pos) (Nat.mod_lt _ Pm_pos) h3]

theorem digitsQ_mod (x : ℕ) : digitsQ (x % Pm ^ 4) = digitsQ x := by
  have hm := qm31Digits_mod x
  rw [qm31Digits_eq, qm31Digits_eq] at hm
  simp only [List.cons.injEq] at hm
  obtain ⟨e0, e1, e2, e3, -⟩ := hm
  simp only [digitsQ, e0, e1, e2, e3]

theorem emb_inj {K : Type} (ι : QF → K) (hι : Function.Injective ι) (x y : ℕ)
    (hx : x < (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4) (hy : y < (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4) (h : emb ι x = emb ι y) :
    x = y := by
  have hd := digitsQ_inj x y (hι h)
  have hv := congrArg (AspisR1.SamplerAddDigits.digitsValue AspisR1.SamplerMachineBounds.P) hd
  rw [AspisR1.SamplerNatModel.qm31Digits_value, AspisR1.SamplerNatModel.qm31Digits_value] at hv
  have hP : AspisR1.SamplerMachineBounds.P = 2 ^ 31 - 1 := rfl
  rw [hP] at hv
  rwa [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hx, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hy] at hv

theorem decode_sample (q : AspisR1.ExtractedQM31SamplerCarrier.SamplerQM) (r : ℕ)
    (hv : AspisR1.ExtractedQM31SamplerCorrect.coordinates q =
      AspisR1.SamplerNatModel.qm31Digits r) :
    AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact.decode
      (AspisR1.ExtractedQM31SamplerCarrier.toCurrent q) = digitsQ r := by
  rw [qm31Digits_eq] at hv
  simp only [AspisR1.ExtractedQM31SamplerCorrect.coordinates, List.cons.injEq] at hv
  obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2, h3, -⟩ := hv
  show (⟨⟨((q.c0.a.val : ℕ) : MF), ((q.c0.b.val : ℕ) : MF)⟩,
    ⟨((q.c1.a.val : ℕ) : MF), ((q.c1.b.val : ℕ) : MF)⟩⟩ : QF) = digitsQ r
  rw [h0, h1, h2, h3]
  rfl

theorem sample {K : Type} (ι : QF → K) (a : Ans) :
    s1Spend ι a = emb ι ((rankE a).val % (2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4) := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, -, hv⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedQM31SamplerCorrect.sample_total (arrEquiv a)
  have hs : s1Spend ι a = ι (AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact.decode
      (AspisR1.ExtractedQM31SamplerCarrier.toCurrent q)) := by simp only [s1Spend, hq]
  have hP : (2 ^ 31 - 1 : ℕ) = Pm := rfl
  rw [hs, decode_sample q _ hv, emb, hP, digitsQ_mod, rankE_val]

/-- The D47.2 sampler law, from the spend path's sampler theorems. -/
def qm31SamplerLaw_spend {K : Type} (ι : QF → K) (hι : Function.Injective ι) :
    R1Z.SamplerLawIface.QM31SamplerLaw (s1Spend ι) where
  rank := rankE
  emb := emb ι
  emb_inj := emb_inj ι hι
  sample := sample ι

end R1J.SamplerLawSpend

QueryScanOrderedModel:
import QueryScanModelFailure

/-! Ordered, stable dedup and block/word recurrence correspondence for the
retained Q22 model. Source-library and extraction correspondence are separate. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.QueryScanOrderedModel
open AspisV8R19.Q22WordScan

 theorem keep_prefix (xs : List Nat) (x : Nat) : xs <+: keep xs x := by
  by_cases h : x ∈ xs
  · simp [keep, h]
  · exact ⟨[x], by simp [keep, h]⟩

 theorem fold_keep_prefix (xs ys : List Nat) : xs <+: ys.foldl keep xs := by
  induction ys generalizing xs with
  | nil => exact ⟨[], by simp [scan]⟩
  | cons y ys ih => exact (keep_prefix xs y).trans (ih (keep xs y))

 /-- The accepted output is a prefix of stable first-occurrence deduplication.
 It is never sorted or reordered by the Q22 recurrence. -/
 theorem scan_order_prefix (s : ScanState) (xs : List Nat) :
    (scan s xs).1.accepted <+: xs.foldl keep s.accepted := by
  induction xs generalizing s with
  | nil => exact ⟨[], by simp [scan]⟩
  | cons x xs ih =>
    by_cases hs : s.accepted.length = 22 ∨ s.draws = 64
    · simp only [scan, if_pos hs, List.foldl_cons]
      exact (keep_prefix _ _).trans (fold_keep_prefix _ _)
    · simpa only [scan, if_neg hs, List.foldl_cons] using
        ih ⟨keep s.accepted x, s.draws+1⟩

 theorem keep_nodup (xs : List Nat) (x : Nat) (h : xs.Nodup) :
    (keep xs x).Nodup := by
  by_cases hx : x ∈ xs
  · simpa [keep, hx] using h
  · simpa [keep, hx] using h.concat hx

 theorem scan_nodup (s : ScanState) (xs : List Nat) (h : s.accepted.Nodup) :
    (scan s xs).1.accepted.Nodup := by
  induction xs generalizing s with
  | nil => exact h
  | cons x xs ih =>
    by_cases hs : s.accepted.length = 22 ∨ s.draws = 64
    · simpa only [scan, if_pos hs] using h
    · simpa only [scan, if_neg hs] using
        ih ⟨keep s.accepted x, s.draws+1⟩ (keep_nodup _ _ h)

 theorem scan_stop_state (s : ScanState) (xs : List Nat)
    (hs : s.accepted.length = 22 ∨ s.draws = 64) : (scan s xs).1 = s := by
  cases xs <;> simp [scan, hs]

 theorem scan_append_state (s : ScanState) (xs ys : List Nat) :
    (scan s (xs ++ ys)).1 = (scan (scan s xs).1 ys).1 := by
  induction xs generalizing s with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    by_cases hs : s.accepted.length = 22 ∨ s.draws = 64
    · simp only [List.cons_append, scan, if_pos hs]
      exact (scan_stop_state s ys hs).symm
    · simpa only [List.cons_append, scan, if_neg hs] using
        ih ⟨keep s.accepted x, s.draws+1⟩

 theorem scan_true_stopped (s : ScanState) (xs : List Nat)
    (h : (scan s xs).2 = true) :
    (scan s xs).1.accepted.length = 22 ∨ (scan s xs).1.draws = 64 := by
  induction xs generalizing s with
  | nil => simp [scan] at h
  | cons x xs ih =>
    by_cases hs : s.accepted.length = 22 ∨ s.draws = 64
    · simpa only [scan, if_pos hs] using hs
    · simp only [scan, if_neg hs] at h ⊢
      exact ih _ h

 /-- Number of consumed blocks. The stop test is inside scan, before a word,
 so a completed eighth word is detected in the following nonempty block. -/
 def blockRun (s : ScanState) : List (List Nat) → ScanState × Nat
  | [] => (s, 0)
  | b :: bs =>
    let r := scan s b
    if r.2 then (r.1, 1)
    else let tail := blockRun r.1 bs; (tail.1, tail.2+1)

 theorem blocks_flatten (s : ScanState) (bs : List (List Nat)) :
    (blockRun s bs).1 = (scan s bs.flatten).1 := by
  induction bs generalizing s with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons b bs ih =>
    simp only [blockRun, List.flatten_cons]
    by_cases hs : (scan s b).2 = true
    · simp only [hs, if_true]
      rw [scan_append_state]
      exact (scan_stop_state _ _ (scan_true_stopped s b hs)).symm
    · simp only [hs, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
      rw [ih, scan_append_state]

 theorem block_count_le (s : ScanState) (bs : List (List Nat)) :
    (blockRun s bs).2 ≤ bs.length := by
  induction bs generalizing s with
  | nil => simp [blockRun]
  | cons b bs ih =>
    simp only [blockRun]
    split
    · simp
    · have h := ih (scan s b).1
      simp only [List.length_cons]
      omega

 /-- Successful finish exposes exactly 22 distinct indices in stable scan order. -/
 theorem successful_output (s : ScanState) (xs out : List Nat)
    (hn : s.accepted.Nodup) (h : finish (scan s xs).1 = .ok out) :
    out.length = 22 ∧ out.Nodup ∧ out <+: xs.foldl keep s.accepted := by
  unfold finish at h
  split at h
  · have he : (scan s xs).1.accepted = out := Except.ok.inj h
    exact ⟨he ▸ ‹_›, he ▸ scan_nodup s xs hn, he ▸ scan_order_prefix s xs⟩
  · cases h

/-- The successful array order corresponds to the first 22 stable distinct
values of the candidate-word stream, including partial final blocks. -/
 theorem successful_first22 (s : ScanState) (xs out : List Nat)
    (hn : s.accepted.Nodup) (h : finish (scan s xs).1 = .ok out) :
    out = (xs.foldl keep s.accepted).take 22 := by
  obtain ⟨hlen, _, tail, htail⟩ := successful_output s xs out hn h
  rw [← htail]
  exact (List.take_left' hlen).symm

 theorem block_failure_smallRange {N : Nat} (w : Fin 64 → Fin N)
    (bs : List (List Nat)) (hwords : bs.flatten = QueryScanModelFailure.words w)
    (count : Nat)
    (hfail : finish (blockRun QueryScanModelFailure.initial bs).1 = .error count) :
    QueryScanExhaustion.smallRange w 21 := by
  apply QueryScanModelFailure.failure_smallRange w
  unfold QueryScanModelFailure.fails
  rw [blocks_flatten, hwords] at hfail
  intro he
  simp only [finish, he, if_true] at hfail
  cases hfail

#print axioms keep_prefix
#print axioms fold_keep_prefix
#print axioms scan_order_prefix
#print axioms keep_nodup
#print axioms scan_nodup
#print axioms scan_stop_state
#print axioms scan_append_state
#print axioms scan_true_stopped
#print axioms blocks_flatten
#print axioms block_count_le
#print axioms successful_output
#print axioms successful_first22
#print axioms block_failure_smallRange
end AspisR1.QueryScanOrderedModel
QueryScanModelFailure:
import QueryScanExhaustion
import AspisV8R19.Q22WordScan

/-! The actual retained Q22 recurrence: failure at the 64-word horizon implies
at most 21 distinct positions. It is not enough to bound any one collision. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure
open AspisV8R19.Q22WordScan
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

 theorem keep_mem (a : List Nat) (x y : Nat) :
    y ∈ keep a x ↔ y ∈ a ∨ y = x := by
  by_cases h : x ∈ a
  · simp only [keep, if_pos h]
    constructor
    · exact Or.inl
    · rintro (hy | rfl) <;> assumption
  · simp [keep, h]

 theorem scan_covers (xs : List Nat) (s : ScanState)
    (hbudget : s.draws + xs.length ≤ 64)
    (hfail : (scan s xs).1.accepted.length < 22) :
    ∀ x, x ∈ s.accepted ∨ x ∈ xs → x ∈ (scan s xs).1.accepted := by
  induction xs generalizing s with
  | nil => simpa only [scan, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] using (fun x h => h)
  | cons x xs ih =>
    by_cases hs : s.accepted.length = 22 ∨ s.draws = 64
    · have he : scan s (x :: xs) = (s, true) := by simp only [scan, if_pos hs]
      rw [he] at hfail
      rcases hs with hc | hd
      · simp only at hfail; omega
      · simp only [List.length_cons] at hbudget; omega
    · simp only [scan, if_neg hs] at hfail ⊢
      intro y hy
      apply ih ⟨keep s.accepted x, s.draws+1⟩ (by simp only [List.length_cons] at hbudget; dsimp; omega) hfail
      rcases hy with hy | hy
      · exact Or.inl ((keep_mem _ _ _).2 (Or.inl hy))
      · rcases List.mem_cons.mp hy with rfl | hy
        · exact Or.inl ((keep_mem _ _ _).2 (Or.inr rfl))
        · exact Or.inr hy

 def words {N n : Nat} (w : Fin n → Fin N) : List Nat := List.ofFn (fun i => (w i).val)
 def initial : ScanState := ⟨[], 0⟩
 def fails {N : Nat} (w : Fin 64 → Fin N) : Prop :=
    (scan initial (words w)).1.accepted.length ≠ 22

 theorem failure_smallRange {N : Nat} (w : Fin 64 → Fin N) (hf : fails w) :
    QueryScanExhaustion.smallRange w 21 := by
  classical
  let accepted := (scan initial (words w)).1.accepted
  have hcap : accepted.length ≤ 22 := scan_count_cap initial (words w) (by simp [initial])
  have hlt : accepted.length < 22 := by change accepted.length ≠ 22 at hf; omega
  have hcover := scan_covers (words w) initial (by simp [initial, words]) hlt
  let f : Set.range w → ↥accepted.toFinset := fun x =>
    ⟨x.val.val, by
      apply List.mem_toFinset.mpr
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := x.property
      apply hcover
      right
      simp only [words, List.mem_ofFn]
      exact ⟨i, congrArg Fin.val hi⟩⟩
  have hinj : Function.Injective f := by
    intro x y he
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Fin.ext
    exact congrArg Subtype.val he
  have hc := Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hinj
  have ht : accepted.toFinset.card ≤ accepted.length := List.toFinset_card_le accepted
  unfold QueryScanExhaustion.smallRange
  rw [Fintype.card_coe] at hc
  omega

 def failureProbability (N : Nat) : ℚ :=
  Fintype.card {w : Fin 64 → Fin N // fails w} / (N : ℚ)^64

 theorem failureProbability_le (N : Nat) :
    failureProbability N ≤ QueryScanExhaustion.probability N 64 21 := by
  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (by positivity)
  exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_le_of_injective
    (fun w : {w : Fin 64 → Fin N // fails w} =>
      (⟨w.val, failure_smallRange w.val w.property⟩ :
        {w : Fin 64 → Fin N // QueryScanExhaustion.smallRange w 21}))
    (by
      intro a b h
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact congrArg (fun z : {w : Fin 64 → Fin N // QueryScanExhaustion.smallRange w 21} => z.val) h)

 theorem exhaustion_bound : failureProbability (2^18) ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ)^454 :=
    (failureProbability_le _).trans QueryScanExhaustion.exhaustion_le_two_neg_454

#print axioms keep_mem
#print axioms scan_covers
#print axioms failure_smallRange
#print axioms failureProbability_le
#print axioms exhaustion_bound
end AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure

import R1Z.RomFiniteBin

/-! The classical observer map keeps the entire decision function. Only
its adaptive query program is supplied by the source operational handoff. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.RomObserverBin
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbortBounds
  R1Z.Batched R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.RomFiniteBin R1Z.LazyFrozen
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-- No bound on the size of the table is computed by reduction. The existing
frozen lazy programming law applies to the concrete finite byte carrier. -/
theorem lazy_table_uniform (bound : ℕ) (frozen : Finset (Address bound)) {m : ℕ}
    (a : Fin m → (Fin m → OracleAnswer) → (Address bound → OracleAnswer) → Address bound)
    (causal : CausalF frozen a) (f : (Address bound → OracleAnswer) → ℚ) :
    mean (fun p : (Address bound → OracleAnswer) × (Fin m → OracleAnswer) =>
      f (progF frozen a p.1 p.2)) = mean f := mean_progF frozen a causal f

/-- The cap counts query calls, including repeats, on every branch. -/
theorem runLog_length (program : OProg) (oracle : List UInt8 → OracleAnswer) (fuel : ℕ) :
    (runLog program oracle fuel).length ≤ fuel := by
  induction fuel generalizing program with
  | zero => cases program <;> simp only [runLog, List.length_nil, Nat.le_refl]
  | succ n ih =>
      cases program with
      | done => simp only [runLog, List.length_nil, Nat.zero_le]
      | query a k =>
          simpa only [runLog, List.length_cons] using Nat.succ_le_succ (ih (k (oracle a)))

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] {F : Subfield K}

def observerMap (source : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat F)
    (program : source.Adversary → View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat →
      List (List UInt8 × OracleAnswer) → OProg) (adv : source.Adversary) :
    R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux :=
  ⟨program adv, source.observe adv⟩

theorem observer_preserved (source : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat F)
    (program : source.Adversary → View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat →
      List (List UInt8 × OracleAnswer) → OProg) (adv : source.Adversary)
    (rv : ROMView K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat) :
    (observerMap source program adv).decide rv = source.observe adv rv := rfl

theorem capped_queries (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (bound : ℕ)
    (program : OProg) (tab : (wire base bound).Tab) :
    (runLog program ((wire base bound).look tab) (wire base bound).qmax).length ≤ 2^64 :=
  runLog_length program _ _

variable [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K]

theorem model_observer_preserved (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (bound : ℕ)
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F (wire base bound)) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (P : Challenges K → Prop) (Vp : (h : HonestProver K) → Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop)
    (source : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat F)
    (program : source.Adversary → View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat →
      List (List UInt8 × OracleAnswer) → OProg) (adv : source.Adversary)
    (rv : ROMView K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat) :
    (fsR1P (wire base bound) Pr N hN P Vp).observe (observerMap source program adv) rv =
      source.observe adv rv := rfl

#print axioms lazy_table_uniform
#print axioms runLog_length
#print axioms observer_preserved
#print axioms capped_queries
#print axioms model_observer_preserved
end R1Z.RomObserverBin
R1Z.RomFiniteBin:
import R1Z.CouplingR1PBin
import Mathlib.Data.List.OfFn

/-! A classical finite byte-string ROM. No concrete address space or table
is enumerated by the kernel. The address bound is a model parameter. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.RomFiniteBin
open R0Z.FsStatement R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.CouplingR1PBin
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-- All strings of at most `bound` bytes, via finite vectors. -/
def domain (bound : ℕ) : Finset (List UInt8) :=
  Finset.univ.image (fun p : (Σ n : Fin (bound + 1), Fin n.val → UInt8) => List.ofFn p.2)

theorem mem_domain (bound : ℕ) (bs : List UInt8) :
    bs ∈ domain bound ↔ bs.length ≤ bound := by
  constructor
  · intro hb
    obtain ⟨⟨n, v⟩, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hb
    simpa only [List.length_ofFn] using Nat.le_of_lt_succ n.isLt
  · intro hb
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨⟨⟨bs.length, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hb⟩, bs.get⟩,
      Finset.mem_univ _, List.ofFn_get bs⟩

abbrev Address (bound : ℕ) := {bs : List UInt8 // bs ∈ domain bound}

instance address_nonempty (bound : ℕ) : Nonempty (Address bound) :=
  ⟨⟨[], (mem_domain bound []).mpr (Nat.zero_le _)⟩⟩

def decode (bound : ℕ) (bs : List UInt8) : Option (Address bound) :=
  if hb : bs ∈ domain bound then some ⟨bs, hb⟩ else none

theorem decode_encode (bound : ℕ) (a : Address bound) : decode bound a.val = some a := by
  simp only [decode, dif_pos a.property]

theorem encode_decode (bound : ℕ) (bs : List UInt8) (a : Address bound)
    (ha : decode bound bs = some a) : a.val = bs := by
  unfold decode at ha
  split at ha
  · cases Option.some.inj ha
    rfl
  · contradiction

theorem decode_isSome (bound : ℕ) (bs : List UInt8) :
    (decode bound bs).isSome ↔ bs.length ≤ bound := by
  by_cases hb : bs ∈ domain bound
  · simp only [decode, dif_pos hb, Option.isSome_some, Bool.true_eq, true_iff]
    exact (mem_domain bound bs).mp hb
  · simp only [decode, dif_neg hb, Option.isSome_none, Bool.false_eq_true, false_iff]
    exact fun hl => hb ((mem_domain bound bs).mpr hl)

def lookup (bound : ℕ) (tab : Address bound → OracleAnswer) (bs : List UInt8) : OracleAnswer :=
  match decode bound bs with
  | some a => tab a
  | none => 0

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K]

/-- Choose the table model and the claimed adversary class. All protocol
encodings/decoders are retained from `base`; its old table and cap are unused. -/
def wire (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (bound : ℕ) : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux :=
  { base with
    Tab := Address bound → OracleAnswer
    finTab := inferInstance
    neTab := inferInstance
    look := lookup bound
    qmax := 2^64 }

variable [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K]

def rom (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (bound : ℕ) : RomModel (wire base bound) where
  A := Address bound
  finA := inferInstance
  deqA := inferInstance
  neA := inferInstance
  dec := decode bound
  enc := Subtype.val
  dec_enc := decode_encode bound
  enc_of_dec := encode_decode bound
  eTab := Equiv.refl _
  look_eq := by
    intro tab bs
    change lookup bound tab bs = _
    unfold lookup
    cases decode bound bs <;> rfl

theorem lookup_law (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (bound : ℕ)
    (tab : (wire base bound).Tab) (a : Address bound) :
    (wire base bound).look tab a.val = tab a := by
  change lookup bound tab a.val = tab a
  unfold lookup
  rw [decode_encode]

theorem adversary_budget (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (bound : ℕ) :
    (wire base bound).qmax ≤ 2^64 := Nat.le_refl _

/-- Uniform tables are transported by the full table equivalence. -/
theorem table_uniform (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (bound : ℕ) :
    MP (rom base bound).eTab := mp_equiv _

#print axioms mem_domain
#print axioms decode_encode
#print axioms encode_decode
#print axioms decode_isSome
#print axioms rom
#print axioms lookup_law
#print axioms adversary_budget
#print axioms table_uniform
end R1Z.RomFiniteBin

import R1Z.QueryScanFirstStopHistory
import R1Z.PhaseProtocolInstanceBin

/-! The constructed ideal experiment has independent transcript-answer coins.
This proves the scan mass on that exact randomness carrier, including any
attempt reachability restriction. It does not assert a source coupling. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.QueryScanIdealHistory
open R0Z R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.HvzkV R1Z.CouplingR1PBin
  R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.TranscriptR1
  R1Z.QueryScanPrivacyFinal R1Z.QueryScanIndependentHistory
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-- Split out any injectively indexed set of independent coordinates. -/
def splitCoordinates {I J U : Type} (j : I → J) (hj : Function.Injective j) :
    (J → U) ≃ (I → U) × ({x : J // ¬ ∃ i, j i = x} → U) where
  toFun v := (fun i => v (j i), fun x => v x.val)
  invFun p x := if hx : ∃ i, j i = x then p.1 (Classical.choose hx) else p.2 ⟨x, hx⟩
  left_inv v := by
    funext x
    dsimp only
    split
    · next hx => exact congrArg v (Classical.choose_spec hx)
    · rfl
  right_inv p := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · funext i
      dsimp only
      rw [dif_pos (show ∃ k, j k = j i from ⟨i, rfl⟩)]
      exact congrArg p.1 (hj (Classical.choose_spec (show ∃ k, j k = j i from ⟨i, rfl⟩)))
    · funext x
      dsimp only
      rw [dif_neg x.property]

/-- This mean law is generic in all carrier sizes. -/
theorem coordinates_uniform {I J U : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    [Fintype U] [Nonempty U] (j : I → J) (hj : Function.Injective j) :
    MP (fun v : J → U => fun i => v (j i)) := by
  intro f
  have he := mp_equiv (splitCoordinates (U := U) j hj) (fun p => f p.1)
  exact he.trans (mp_fst f)

/-- Transport across extensionally equal finite universes without reducing
the byte-carrier enumeration hidden in an inferred Fintype instance. -/
theorem mean_fintype_transport {A : Type} (fin1 fin2 : Fintype A) (f : A → ℚ) :
    @mean A fin1 f = @mean A fin2 f := by
  have he : @Finset.univ A fin1 = @Finset.univ A fin2 := by
    ext a
    simp only [Finset.mem_univ]
  unfold mean Fintype.card
  rw [he]

def queryCoins {Cm Tab : Type} (c : R1Coins Cm Tab) : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer :=
  fun k => c.1 (.qb k)

theorem queryCoins_uniform {Cm Tab : Type} [Fintype Cm] [Nonempty Cm]
    [Fintype Tab] [Nonempty Tab] : MP (queryCoins (Cm := Cm) (Tab := Tab)) := by
  change MP (fun c : (TRead → OracleAnswer) × ((Fin 3 → OracleAnswer) × Cm × Tab) =>
    fun k => c.1 (.qb k))
  intro f
  have hc := coordinates_uniform (U := OracleAnswer) TRead.qb
    (by intro a b hab; cases hab; rfl) f
  have hp := mp_fst (X := TRead → OracleAnswer)
    (Y := (Fin 3 → OracleAnswer) × Cm × Tab) (fun tr => f (fun k => tr (.qb k)))
  trans mean (fun tr : TRead → OracleAnswer => f (fun k => tr (.qb k)))
  · exact hp
  · convert hc using 1 <;> apply mean_fintype_transport

variable {Cm Tab Tape : Type} [Fintype Cm] [Nonempty Cm] [Fintype Tab] [Nonempty Tab]
  [Fintype Tape] [Nonempty Tape]

/-- These are exactly fsR1P.IdealRand's outer product and retry coordinates. -/
abbrev IdealCoins := (Fin 8 → R1Coins Cm Tab) × (Fin 8 → Tape)

def bad (i : Fin 8) (r : IdealCoins (Cm := Cm) (Tab := Tab) (Tape := Tape)) : Prop :=
  AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.fails (words64 (queryCoins (r.1 i)))

theorem ideal_bad_mass (i : Fin 8) :
    eventMass (bad (Cm := Cm) (Tab := Tab) (Tape := Tape) i) ≤ scanProbability := by
  have hm := mp_comp
    (mp_fst (X := Fin 8 → R1Coins Cm Tab) (Y := Fin 8 → Tape))
    (mp_pi (queryCoins_uniform (Cm := Cm) (Tab := Tab)) 8)
  have he := hm (fun q => if AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.fails (words64 (q i)) then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
  have hb := eight_reached_failures_le (fun _ _ => True) i
  simp only [true_and] at hb
  exact he.le.trans hb

theorem reached_ideal_bad_mass
    (reached : Fin 8 → IdealCoins (Cm := Cm) (Tab := Tab) (Tape := Tape) → Prop) (i : Fin 8) :
    eventMass (fun r => reached i r ∧ bad i r) ≤ scanProbability :=
  (eventMass_mono _ _ (fun _ h => h.2)).trans (ideal_bad_mass i)

/-- The bad event at the parser's selected endpoint, including fallback and
failure. This is fixed by the model, not selected by a source coupling. -/
def selectedBad (i : Fin 8) (r : IdealCoins (Cm := Cm) (Tab := Tab) (Tape := Tape)) : Prop :=
  let q := queryCoins (r.1 i)
  ∃ count, AspisV8R19.Q22WordScan.finish
    (PhaseSamplerParserBin.scanned (PhaseQueryScanBin.stop PhaseSamplerParserBin.done q) q).1 =
      .error count

theorem selected_bad_mass (i : Fin 8) :
    eventMass (selectedBad (Cm := Cm) (Tab := Tab) (Tape := Tape) i) ≤ scanProbability := by
  apply (eventMass_mono _ (bad i) ?_).trans (ideal_bad_mass i)
  intro r hr
  obtain ⟨count, hf⟩ := hr
  exact QueryScanFirstStopHistory.selected_failure_implies_words_failure _ count hf

theorem reached_selected_bad_mass
    (reached : Fin 8 → IdealCoins (Cm := Cm) (Tab := Tab) (Tape := Tape) → Prop) (i : Fin 8) :
    eventMass (fun r => reached i r ∧ selectedBad i r) ≤ scanProbability :=
  (eventMass_mono _ _ (fun _ h => h.2)).trans (selected_bad_mass i)

#print axioms mean_fintype_transport
#print axioms coordinates_uniform
#print axioms queryCoins_uniform
#print axioms ideal_bad_mass
#print axioms reached_ideal_bad_mass
#print axioms selected_bad_mass
#print axioms reached_selected_bad_mass
end R1Z.QueryScanIdealHistory
R1Z.QueryScanFirstStopHistory:
import R1Z.QueryScanIndependentHistory

/-! Connect the independent-word event to the constructed parser's actual
first-stop failure. No scan recurrence or word universe is enumerated. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.QueryScanFirstStopHistory
open R0Z.FsStatement R1Z.PhaseSamplerParserBin R1Z.PhaseQueryScanBin
  R1Z.QueryScanIndependentHistory AspisV8R19.Q22WordScan
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

theorem parsed_length (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) (k : Fin 8) :
    (parsedWords q k).length = 8 * (k.val + 1) := by
  have hlen (bs : List OracleAnswer) : (bs.flatMap blockWords).length = 8 * bs.length := by
    induction bs with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons b bs ih => simp only [List.flatMap_cons, List.length_append, blockWords_length,
        ih, List.length_cons]; omega
  unfold parsedWords
  rw [hlen, List.length_take, List.length_ofFn, Nat.min_eq_left (by omega)]

theorem parsed_full_words64 (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) :
    parsedWords q 7 = AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.words (words64 q) := by
  unfold parsedWords AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.words
  rw [show (7 : Fin 8).val + 1 = 8 from rfl,
    List.take_of_length_le (by rw [List.length_ofFn])]
  rw [List.ofFn_mul' (m := 8) (n := 8)]
  have he (bs : List OracleAnswer) : bs.flatMap blockWords = (bs.map blockWords).flatten := by
    induction bs with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons b bs ih =>
        simp only [List.flatMap_cons, List.map_cons, List.flatten_cons]
        exact congrArg (fun t => blockWords b ++ t) ih
  rw [he, List.map_ofFn]
  apply congrArg List.flatten
  apply congrArg List.ofFn
  funext k
  change blockWords (q k) = List.ofFn (fun j : Fin 8 =>
    (words64 q ⟨8*k.val+j.val, by omega⟩).val)
  rw [block_le_words]
  apply congrArg List.ofFn
  funext j
  have hi : (⟨8*k.val+j.val, by omega⟩ : Fin 64) = finProdFinEquiv (k,j) := by
    apply Fin.ext
    change 8*k.val+j.val = j.val+8*k.val
    omega
  simp only [hi, words64, flatten, Equiv.coe_fn_mk, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

/-- Read-count bound valid on stopped and non-stopped branches alike. -/
theorem scan_draws_le (s : ScanState) (xs : List ℕ) :
    (scan s xs).1.draws ≤ s.draws + xs.length := by
  induction xs generalizing s with
  | nil => simp only [scan, List.length_nil, Nat.add_zero, le_refl]
  | cons x xs ih =>
      by_cases hs : s.accepted.length = 22 ∨ s.draws = 64
      · simp only [scan, if_pos hs, List.length_cons]; omega
      · simp only [scan, if_neg hs, List.length_cons]
        have hh := ih ⟨keep s.accepted x, s.draws+1⟩
        dsimp only at hh
        omega

theorem selected_failure_at_last (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) (count : ℕ)
    (hf : finish (scanned (stop done q) q).1 = .error count) : stop done q = 7 := by
  have hn : (scanned (stop done q) q).1.accepted.length ≠ 22 := by
    intro hh
    simp only [finish, hh, if_true] at hf
    cases hf
  have hm := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (stop_mem done q)).2
  rcases hm with hd | he
  · have heq : scanned (stop done q) (observed q (stop done q)) = scanned (stop done q) q := by
      unfold scanned
      rw [parsed_observed]
    change (scanned (stop done q) (observed q (stop done q))).2 = true at hd
    rw [heq] at hd
    have hst := AspisR1.QueryScanOrderedModel.scan_true_stopped
      AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.initial (parsedWords q (stop done q)) hd
    rcases hst with hlen | hdraw
    · exact False.elim (hn hlen)
    · change (scanned (stop done q) q).1.draws = 64 at hdraw
      have hh := scan_draws_le AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.initial (parsedWords q (stop done q))
      rw [parsed_length] at hh
      change (scanned (stop done q) q).1.draws ≤ 0 + 8 * ((stop done q).val+1) at hh
      have hk := (stop done q).isLt
      apply Fin.ext
      change (stop done q).val = 7
      omega
  · exact he

theorem selected_failure_implies_words_failure (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) (count : ℕ)
    (hf : finish (scanned (stop done q) q).1 = .error count) :
    AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.fails (words64 q) := by
  rw [selected_failure_at_last q count hf] at hf
  unfold AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.fails
  rw [← parsed_full_words64]
  intro hlen
  simp only [scanned, finish, hlen, if_true] at hf
  cases hf

#print axioms parsed_length
#print axioms parsed_full_words64
#print axioms scan_draws_le
#print axioms selected_failure_at_last
#print axioms selected_failure_implies_words_failure
end R1Z.QueryScanFirstStopHistory

import R1Z.QueryScanHistorySplit
import R1Z.PhaseSamplerParserBin
import AspisV8R19.R406SamplerWordDistribution

/-! Symbolic law for independent block coins. Reached-history restrictions
are subevents, not conditioning on already revealed future query answers.
This is not a claim that repeated shared-ROM answers are fresh coins. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.QueryScanIndependentHistory
open R0Z R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.HvzkV R1Z.CouplingR1PBin
  R1Z.QueryScanPrivacyFinal R1Z.PhaseSamplerParserBin
  AspisV8R19.R406SamplerWordDistribution
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

abbrev Word := Fin (2^18)

def block (b : OracleAnswer) : Fin 8 → Word := (splitBlockEquiv (state b)).2

theorem block_le_words (b : OracleAnswer) :
    blockWords b = List.ofFn (fun j => (block b j).val) := words_value (state b)

theorem block_uniform : MP block := by
  intro f
  have h := mp_equiv (R1J.SamplerLawSpend.stateEquiv.trans splitBlockEquiv)
    (fun p => f p.2)
  have h2 := mp_snd (X := Fin 8 → Fin (2^14)) (Y := Fin 8 → Word) f
  exact h.trans h2

def flatten : (Fin 8 → Fin 8 → Word) ≃ (Fin 64 → Word) where
  toFun q i := q ((finProdFinEquiv (m := 8) (n := 8)).symm i).1 ((finProdFinEquiv (m := 8) (n := 8)).symm i).2
  invFun w k j := w (finProdFinEquiv (k, j))
  left_inv q := by funext k j; simp
  right_inv w := by funext i; simp

def words64 (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) : Fin 64 → Word := flatten (fun k => block (q k))

theorem words64_uniform : MP words64 := by
  intro f
  exact (mp_pi block_uniform 8 (fun q => f (flatten q))).trans (mp_equiv flatten f)

theorem smallRange_mass :
    eventMass (fun w : Fin 64 → Word => AspisR1.QueryScanExhaustion.smallRange w 21) =
      scanProbability := by
  have hc {A : Type} [Fintype A] (E : A → Prop) :
      (Fintype.card {a // E a} : ℚ) = ∑ a : A, if E a then (1 : ℚ) else 0 := by
    simp only [Fintype.card_subtype, Finset.sum_boole]
  have hd : (Fintype.card (Fin 64 → Word) : ℚ) = ((2^18 : ℕ) : ℚ)^64 := by
    simp only [Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin, Nat.cast_pow]
  exact congrArg₂ (fun a b : ℚ => a / b)
    (hc (A := Fin 64 → Word) (fun w => AspisR1.QueryScanExhaustion.smallRange w 21)).symm hd

/-- A history-dependent reachability condition may only reduce the mass of
failure on independent coins. No independence of the reachability event is
needed, and the statement is intentionally not a conditional probability. -/
theorem reached_failure_le (reached : (Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Prop) :
    eventMass (fun q => reached q ∧ AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.fails (words64 q)) ≤
      scanProbability := by
  apply (eventMass_mono _ (fun q => AspisR1.QueryScanExhaustion.smallRange (words64 q) 21)
    (fun q h => AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.failure_smallRange _ h.2)).trans
  have hu := words64_uniform
    (fun w => if AspisR1.QueryScanExhaustion.smallRange w 21 then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
  exact hu.le.trans smallRange_mass.le

/-- Eight attempt coordinates are enough, with no concrete enumeration of
blocks, word arrays or histories. -/
theorem eight_reached_failures_le
    (reached : Fin 8 → (Fin 8 → Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) → Prop) (i : Fin 8) :
    eventMass (fun q : Fin 8 → Fin 8 → OracleAnswer =>
      reached i q ∧ AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.fails (words64 (q i))) ≤ scanProbability := by
  apply (eventMass_mono _ (fun q => AspisR1.QueryScanExhaustion.smallRange (words64 (q i)) 21)
    (fun q h => AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.failure_smallRange _ h.2)).trans
  have he := mean_eval i
    (fun q => if AspisR1.QueryScanExhaustion.smallRange (words64 q) 21 then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
  have hu := words64_uniform
    (fun w => if AspisR1.QueryScanExhaustion.smallRange w 21 then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
  exact he.le.trans (hu.le.trans smallRange_mass.le)

#print axioms block_le_words
#print axioms block_uniform
#print axioms words64_uniform
#print axioms smallRange_mass
#print axioms reached_failure_le
#print axioms eight_reached_failures_le
end R1Z.QueryScanIndependentHistory

import R1Z.PhaseSamplerParserBin
