/-! Composed logical protocol instance. The ROM backend and residual prover
coins/opening data remain parameters; messages, block decoding, query scan,
leaves, grammar and order are constructed. This is not a restatement of
PrivacyR1Final over its arbitrary base, and no source execution identity is
silently inferred. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PhaseProtocolInstanceBin
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R1Z.Batched R1Z.GamesR1
  R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.CouplingR1PBin R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin R1Z.PremisesR1PBin
local notation "K" => AspisWideTower.WideExact

variable {CommitHandle Aux : Type} {F : Subfield K}

def wire (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (publicWidth : ℕ)
    (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) : R1PhaseWire h B outputs x :=
  PhaseMessageEncodingBin.phaseWire PhaseMessageEncodingBin.wideBytes
    (PhaseSamplerParserBin.wireData (RomFiniteBin.wire base (RomGrammarBin.bound publicWidth)))
    PhaseSamplerParserBin.decode_local h B outputs x

/-- The concrete message/sampler model passed as base to the final endpoint. -/
def baseWire (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux :=
  PhaseMessageEncodingBin.wireData PhaseMessageEncodingBin.wideBytes
    (PhaseSamplerParserBin.wireData base)

section Instance
variable (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (publicWidth : ℕ)
    (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
local notation "W" => wire base publicWidth h B outputs x
abbrev prover (seed : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F (W).toWire) :
    R1PhaseProver h B outputs x W :=
  PhaseLeafConstructionBin.prover PhaseLeafEncodingBin.encoding W seed

/-- Causality is unconditional for the composed model, including inconsistent
answer vectors. No execution-order premise is needed for this model fact. -/
theorem causal_premise (seed : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F (W).toWire) : ∀ (w : h.Instance) sec d p v v',
    Earlier (W).toWire (prover base publicWidth h B outputs x seed).toProver p v v' →
      attAddr (W).toWire (prover base publicWidth h B outputs x seed).toProver h B outputs x w sec d v p =
        attAddr (W).toWire (prover base publicWidth h B outputs x seed).toProver h B outputs x w sec d v' p := by
  intro w sec d p v v' he
  exact PhaseCausalityBin.R_causal_D80 (wire base publicWidth h B outputs x)
    (prover base publicWidth h B outputs x seed) w sec d p v v' he

def rows01 : Sem1UniformR1.SemRows01 (W).toWire where
  s1 := PhaseSamplerParserBin.scalar
  sem1 := fun _ _ _ _ => rfl
  sem0 := fun _ _ _ _ _ he => congrArg PhaseSamplerParserBin.scalar (he 0 (by decide))

theorem sampler_source : (rows01 base publicWidth h B outputs x).s1 =
    R1J.SamplerLawSpend.s1Spend (algebraMap R1J.SamplerLawSpend.QF K) := rfl

/-- This model can be used at exactly the endpoint's ROM wrapper by choosing
its base explicitly; the generic final theorem does not make this choice. -/
theorem endpoint_wire : (W).toWire =
    RomFiniteBin.wire (baseWire base) (RomGrammarBin.bound publicWidth) := rfl

#print axioms endpoint_wire
/-- The selected model does not inherit the base wire's message functions. -/
theorem frame_selected : (W).toWire.frame =
    PhaseMessageEncodingBin.frame PhaseMessageEncodingBin.wideBytes := rfl

theorem decoder_selected : (W).toWire.dec = PhaseSamplerParserBin.decode := rfl

#print axioms causal_premise
#print axioms rows01
#print axioms sampler_source
#print axioms frame_selected
#print axioms decoder_selected
end Instance
#print axioms wire
end R1Z.PhaseProtocolInstanceBin
R1Z.PhaseLeafEncodingBin:
import R1Z.PhaseLeafConstructionBin
import R1Z.PhaseMessageEncodingBin
import R1Z.BuilderTransport

/-! Exact-wide Lean-model leaf encoding: D18/S2 row transport, the existing
circle/line domain evaluators, fibre-major lane selection, retained byte
serialization, and folded-tree zero padding. No FFT/Rust execution identity
or low-subfield guard is inferred from these mathematical definitions. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PhaseLeafEncodingBin
open R0P R0P.SemSource R0Z R0Z.HonestView R0Z.MaskLayout R0Z.JointView
  R1Z.Batched R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.PhaseBuilderDependenciesBin
  R1Z.PhaseMessageEncodingBin AspisPool.AlgorithmicCircleDecoderV7

abbrev K := AspisWideTower.WideExact

/-- The original model reads coefficients through pi.symm. D18 is involutive. -/
def coefficients (m : Fin 1024 → K) : Fin 1024 → K := coeffsLinear AspisR1.rowEquiv m

theorem s2_coefficient (m : Fin 1024 → K) (j : Fin 1024) :
    coefficients m j = m (AspisR1.row j) := rfl

/-- Connect the selected coefficient index to the extracted S2 reference. -/
theorem extracted_s2_index (j : Aeneas.Std.Usize) (hj : j.val < 1024) :
    ∃ out : Aeneas.Std.Usize, ∃ hout : out.val < 1024,
      AspisBuilderReference.row_arithmetic j = .ok out ∧
      ∀ m : Fin 1024 → K, coefficients m ⟨j.val, hj⟩ = m ⟨out.val, hout⟩ := by
  obtain ⟨out, ho, hv⟩ := R1Z.BuilderTransport.reference_row_fin j hj
  have hout : out.val < 1024 := by
    rw [hv]
    exact (AspisR1.row ⟨j.val, hj⟩).isLt
  refine ⟨out, hout, ho, ?_⟩
  intro m
  rw [s2_coefficient]
  congr 1
  exact Fin.ext hv.symm

/-- Both commitments store four successive domain symbols, slot then lane. -/
def initialSymbol (m : Fin 1024 → K) (u : Fib) (s : Fin 4) : K :=
  AspisWide.InitialEncoder.exactInitialEncoder (coefficients m) (AspisV5ComponentCConcreteFoldLinearity.childIndex u s)

def c1Leaf (t : Trace K) (u : Fib) : List UInt8 :=
  (List.ofFn (fun s : Fin 4 =>
    (List.ofFn (fun c : Fin 27 =>
      (wideBytes (initialSymbol (t (c1Column c)) u s)).take
        (if c.val < 26 then 4 else 16))).flatten)).flatten

def c2Leaf (t : Trace K) (u : Fib) : List UInt8 :=
  (List.ofFn (fun s : Fin 4 =>
    (List.ofFn (fun c : Fin 2 =>
      (wideBytes (initialSymbol (t ⟨26+c.val, by omega⟩) u s)).take 16)).flatten)).flatten

/-- The final evaluator has 2^18 symbols, hence 2^16 four-symbol data leaves.
The commitment still has 2^18 leaves; the remaining ones are 128 zero bytes. -/
def foldedLeaf (m : Fin 256 → K) (u : Fib) : List UInt8 :=
  if hu : u.val < 65536 then
    (AspisR1.FoldedLeafCodec.encodeFolded (fun s : Fin 4 =>
      AspisWide.FinalEncoder.exactFinalLinear m ⟨4*u.val+s.val, by omega⟩)).map UInt8.ofFin
  else List.replicate 128 0

/-- All three encoder parameters are now instantiated. -/
def encoding : PhaseLeafConstructionBin.LeafEncoding K where
  c1 := fun m u =>
    (List.ofFn (fun s : Fin 4 =>
      (List.ofFn (fun c : Fin 27 =>
        (wideBytes (initialSymbol (m c) u s)).take
          (if c.val < 26 then 4 else 16))).flatten)).flatten
  c2 := fun m u =>
    (List.ofFn (fun s : Fin 4 =>
      (List.ofFn (fun c : Fin 2 =>
        (wideBytes (initialSymbol (m c) u s)).take 16)).flatten)).flatten
  folded := foldedLeaf

attribute [local irreducible] initialSymbol wideBytes
  c1Leaf c2Leaf foldedLeaf

theorem encoding_c1 (t : Trace K) (u : Fib) :
    encoding.c1 (fun c => t (c1Column c)) u = c1Leaf t u := by
  unfold encoding c1Leaf
  rfl

theorem encoding_c2 (t : Trace K) (u : Fib) :
    encoding.c2 (fun c => t ⟨26+c.val, by omega⟩) u = c2Leaf t u := by
  unfold encoding c2Leaf
  rfl

theorem folded_padding (m : Fin 256 → K) (u : Fib) (hu : 65536 ≤ u.val) :
    encoding.folded m u = List.replicate 128 0 := by
  unfold encoding foldedLeaf
  exact dif_neg (by omega)

theorem folded_data (m : Fin 256 → K) (u : Fib) (hu : u.val < 65536) :
    encoding.folded m u =
      (AspisR1.FoldedLeafCodec.encodeFolded (fun s : Fin 4 =>
        AspisWide.FinalEncoder.exactFinalLinear m ⟨4*u.val+s.val, by omega⟩)).map UInt8.ofFin := by
  unfold encoding foldedLeaf
  exact dif_pos hu

/-- Equality with the three independently named model leaves on the same
prepared, masked honest trace. C1's preparation is removed by its dependency
lemma; C2 selects 26/27; folded consumes the existing Batched.q1 word. -/
theorem honest_leaves {CommitHandle : Type} {F : Subfield K}
    (B : PackBasis F) (h : HonestProver K) (w : h.Instance)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (τ : Tape K F) (ch : R0Z.HonestView.Challenges K) (T : Fin 3) (u : Fib) :
    PhaseLeafConstructionBin.leafVal encoding B h w x τ ch T u =
      let t := applyAff B (prepare x.1 (applyEligible (h.build w) τ.2) ch) τ.1
      if T.val = 0 then c1Leaf t u
      else if T.val = 1 then c2Leaf t u
      else foldedLeaf (q1 h.transport ch t) u := by
  dsimp only
  unfold PhaseLeafConstructionBin.leafVal
  split
  · change encoding.c1 _ u = c1Leaf _ u
    rw [← encoding_c1]
    apply congrArg (fun cols => encoding.c1 cols u)
    funext c
    exact (c1_challenge_free x.1 (h.build w) B τ ch c).symm
  · split
    · exact encoding_c2 _ u
    · rfl

/-- Serialized source lanes read from the existing query-gated view. -/
def openedC1 (p : R0Z.HonestView.Payload K R1Bat) (u : Fib) : List UInt8 :=
  (List.ofFn (fun s : Fin 4 =>
    (List.ofFn (fun c : Fin 27 =>
      (wideBytes (p (.opened u s (c1Column c)))).take
        (if c.val < 26 then 4 else 16))).flatten)).flatten

def openedC2 (p : R0Z.HonestView.Payload K R1Bat) (u : Fib) : List UInt8 :=
  (List.ofFn (fun s : Fin 4 =>
    (List.ofFn (fun c : Fin 2 =>
      (wideBytes (p (.opened u s ⟨26+c.val, by omega⟩))).take 16)).flatten)).flatten

theorem initialSymbol_run (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (hπ : π = AspisR1.rowEquiv)
    {F : Subfield K} (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K)
    (r : AffTape K F) (ch : R0Z.HonestView.Challenges K) (u : Fib) (hu : u ∈ ch.queries)
    (slot : Fin 4) (c : Fin 29) :
    initialSymbol (applyAff B (prepare pub t ch) r c) u slot =
      run (Bat := R1Bat) π pub B t ch r (.opened u slot c) := by
  subst hπ
  simp only [initialSymbol, run, if_pos hu]
  rfl

/-- On queried fibres the instantiated C1/C2 leaves equal the actual disclosed
HonestView cells, with the source's slot/lane order and byte widths. -/
theorem c1_view {F : Subfield K} (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (hπ : π = AspisR1.rowEquiv)
    (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (r : AffTape K F)
    (ch : R0Z.HonestView.Challenges K) (u : Fib) (hu : u ∈ ch.queries) :
    c1Leaf (applyAff B (prepare pub t ch) r) u =
      openedC1 (run (Bat := R1Bat) π pub B t ch r) u := by
  unfold c1Leaf openedC1
  simp only [initialSymbol_run π hπ pub B t r ch u hu]

theorem c2_view {F : Subfield K} (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (hπ : π = AspisR1.rowEquiv)
    (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (r : AffTape K F)
    (ch : R0Z.HonestView.Challenges K) (u : Fib) (hu : u ∈ ch.queries) :
    c2Leaf (applyAff B (prepare pub t ch) r) u =
      openedC2 (run (Bat := R1Bat) π pub B t ch r) u := by
  unfold c2Leaf openedC2
  simp only [initialSymbol_run π hπ pub B t r ch u hu]

theorem folded_view {F : Subfield K} (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024)
    (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (r : AffTape K F)
    (ch : R0Z.HonestView.Challenges K) (u : Fib) (hu : u.val < 65536)
    (hq : ∀ slot : Fin 4, FoldedOpen ch ⟨4*u.val+slot.val, by omega⟩) :
    foldedLeaf (q1 π ch (applyAff B (prepare pub t ch) r)) u =
      (AspisR1.FoldedLeafCodec.encodeFolded (fun slot : Fin 4 =>
        run (Bat := R1Bat) π pub B t ch r
          (.bat (.folded ⟨4*u.val+slot.val, by omega⟩)))).map UInt8.ofFin := by
  unfold foldedLeaf
  rw [dif_pos hu]
  apply congrArg (fun values => (AspisR1.FoldedLeafCodec.encodeFolded values).map UInt8.ofFin)
  funext slot
  simp only [run]
  exact (read_folded π ch _ _ (hq slot)).symm

#print axioms folded_view
#print axioms initialSymbol_run
#print axioms c1_view
#print axioms c2_view
#print axioms s2_coefficient
#print axioms extracted_s2_index
#print axioms encoding_c1
#print axioms encoding_c2
#print axioms folded_padding
#print axioms folded_data
#print axioms honest_leaves
end R1Z.PhaseLeafEncodingBin
R1Z.PhaseLeafConstructionBin:
import R1Z.PhaseBuilderDependenciesBin
import R1Z.PhaseCausalityBin

/-! Constructed leaf functions from the existing masked trace and q1 map.
Encoders are parameters because the privacy tree has no sourced field-to-byte
encoder. Source equality for these parameters is not asserted here. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PhaseLeafConstructionBin
open R0P R0P.SemSource R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.HonestView
  R0Z.MaskLayout R1Z.Batched R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin
  R1Z.PhaseScheduleBin R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin R1Z.TranscriptR1
  R1Z.PhaseBuilderDependenciesBin R1Z.PhaseCausalityBin

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

structure LeafEncoding (K : Type) where
  c1 : (Fin 27 → Fin 1024 → K) → Fib → List UInt8
  c2 : (Fin 2 → Fin 1024 → K) → Fib → List UInt8
  folded : (Fin 256 → K) → Fib → List UInt8

def leafVal (enc : LeafEncoding K) (B : PackBasis F) (h : HonestProver K)
    (w : h.Instance) (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (τ : Tape K F)
    (ch : R0Z.HonestView.Challenges K) (T : Fin 3) (u : Fib) : List UInt8 :=
  if T.val = 0 then
    enc.c1 (fun c => applyAff B (applyEligible (h.build w) τ.2) τ.1 (c1Column c)) u
  else if T.val = 1 then
    enc.c2 (fun c => applyAff B (prepare x.1 (applyEligible (h.build w) τ.2) ch) τ.1
      ⟨26 + c.val, by omega⟩) u
  else
    enc.folded (q1 h.transport ch
      (applyAff B (prepare x.1 (applyEligible (h.build w) τ.2) ch) τ.1)) u

theorem leaf_local (enc : LeafEncoding K) (B : PackBasis F) (h : HonestProver K)
    (w : h.Instance) (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (τ : Tape K F)
    (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (hd : DecodeLocal W.dec)
    (tr tr' : TRead → OracleAnswer) (T : Fin 3) (u : Fib)
    (he : SqAgree (treeBase T + 6) tr tr') :
    leafVal enc B h w x τ (chOf W tr) T u = leafVal enc B h w x τ (chOf W tr') T u := by
  unfold leafVal
  by_cases h0 : T.val = 0
  · simp only [h0, if_true]
  · by_cases h1 : T.val = 1
    · have hp := prepared_at_c2 W hd x.1 (h.build w) B τ tr tr'
        (by simpa [treeBase, h0, h1] using he)
      simp only [h0, h1, if_false, if_true, hp]
    · have hf := folded_at_29 W hd h.transport x.1 (h.build w) B τ tr tr'
        (by simpa [treeBase, h0, h1] using he)
      simp only [h0, h1, if_false, hf]

/-- Retain tape decoding and opening data; construct the leaves, commitment
grammar and order. Message-locality evidence is still required in W. -/
def prover (enc : LeafEncoding K) {h : HonestProver K} {B : PackBasis F}
    {outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → R0Z.HonestView.Challenges K → Aux}
    {x : Statement K CommitHandle} (W : R1PhaseWire h B outputs x)
    (data : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W.toWire) : R1PhaseProver h B outputs x W where
  data := { data with leafVal := leafVal enc B }
  leaf_local := fun w τ tr tr' T u he =>
    leaf_local enc B h w x τ W.toWire W.decode_local tr tr' T u he

theorem constructed_causal (enc : LeafEncoding K) {h : HonestProver K} {B : PackBasis F}
    {outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → R0Z.HonestView.Challenges K → Aux}
    {x : Statement K CommitHandle} (W : R1PhaseWire h B outputs x)
    (data : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W.toWire) (w : h.Instance) :
    R1Z.CouplingR1PBin.RCausal W.toWire (prover enc W data).toProver h B outputs x w :=
  phase_causal W (prover enc W data) w

#print axioms leafVal
#print axioms leaf_local
#print axioms prover
#print axioms constructed_causal
end R1Z.PhaseLeafConstructionBin
R1Z.PhaseBuilderDependenciesBin:
import R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin

/-! Dependency facts for the existing honest-view preparation and R1 folded
coefficient map. These are actual model functions, not replacement messages.
The byte encoder/leaf selection correspondence remains a source obligation. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PhaseBuilderDependenciesBin
open R0P R0P.SemSource R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.HonestView
  R0Z.MaskLayout R1Z.Batched R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin
  R1Z.PhaseScheduleBin R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin R1Z.TranscriptR1

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

theorem prepare_local (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (ch ch' : R0Z.HonestView.Challenges K)
    (hl : ch.sem 0 = ch'.sem 0) (hc : ch.sem 1 = ch'.sem 1) :
    prepare pub t ch = prepare pub t ch' := by
  funext c r
  change (if c.val = 26 then helper pub t (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) r else t c r) =
    (if c.val = 26 then helper pub t (ch'.sem 0) (ch'.sem 1) r else t c r)
  rw [hl, hc]

/-- Source C1 column selection: 0..25 and 28 (host_commitment.rs). -/
def c1Column (c : Fin 27) : Fin 29 :=
  if h : c.val < 26 then ⟨c.val, by omega⟩ else 28

theorem c1Column_not_helper (c : Fin 27) : (c1Column c).val ≠ 26 := by
  unfold c1Column
  split <;> simp_all <;> omega

/-- All 27 source C1 columns, including the mask columns, do not use even
lambda/chi. The helper column 26 belongs to C2. -/
theorem c1_challenge_free (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (τ : Tape K F) (ch : R0Z.HonestView.Challenges K) (c : Fin 27) :
    applyAff B (prepare pub (applyEligible t τ.2) ch) τ.1
        (c1Column c) =
      applyAff B (applyEligible t τ.2) τ.1 (c1Column c) := by
  funext r
  simp only [applyAff, prepare, if_neg (c1Column_not_helper c)]

/-- The entire prepared/masked trace depends on rows 0 and 1 only. -/
theorem prepared_at_c2 (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (hd : DecodeLocal W.dec)
    (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (B : PackBasis F) (τ : Tape K F)
    (tr tr' : TRead → OracleAnswer) (he : SqAgree 33 tr tr') :
    applyAff B (prepare pub (applyEligible t τ.2) (chOf W tr)) τ.1 =
      applyAff B (prepare pub (applyEligible t τ.2) (chOf W tr')) τ.1 := by
  congr 1
  apply prepare_local
  · exact hd.sem _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ 0 (he (.sqS 0) trivial (by decide))
  · exact hd.sem _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ 1 (he (.sqS 1) trivial (by decide))

/-- The coefficient fold q1 uses gamma and alpha0, never alpha1 or queries. -/
theorem q1_local (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch ch' : R0Z.HonestView.Challenges K)
    (hg : ch.opening 0 = ch'.opening 0) (ha : ch.opening 2 = ch'.opening 2) :
    q1 π ch = q1 π ch' := by
  simp only [q1, batchR1, hg, ha]

/-- The existing folded map on the existing prepared trace is available
after row 29, even if all subsequent answers differ. -/
theorem folded_at_29 (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (hd : DecodeLocal W.dec)
    (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K)
    (B : PackBasis F) (τ : Tape K F) (tr tr' : TRead → OracleAnswer)
    (he : SqAgree 137 tr tr') :
    q1 π (chOf W tr) (applyAff B (prepare pub (applyEligible t τ.2) (chOf W tr)) τ.1) =
      q1 π (chOf W tr') (applyAff B (prepare pub (applyEligible t τ.2) (chOf W tr')) τ.1) := by
  have hp := prepared_at_c2 W hd pub t B τ tr tr'
    (fun j hj hlt => he j hj (lt_trans hlt (by decide)))
  have hq : q1 π (chOf W tr) = q1 π (chOf W tr') := by
    apply q1_local
    · exact hd.opening _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ 0 (he (.sqO 0) trivial (by decide))
    · exact hd.opening _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ 2 (he (.sqO 2) trivial (by decide))
  rw [hp, hq]

#print axioms prepare_local
#print axioms c1Column_not_helper
#print axioms c1_challenge_free
#print axioms prepared_at_c2
#print axioms q1_local
#print axioms folded_at_29
end R1Z.PhaseBuilderDependenciesBin
R1Z.PhaseCausalityBin:
import R1Z.PhaseTranscriptBin

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PhaseCausalityBin
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R1Z.Batched R1Z.GamesR1
  R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.LayoutR1PBin R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.PhaseScheduleBin
  R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin R1Z.PhaseTranscriptBin R1Z.CouplingR1PBin
  R1Z.PremisesR1PBin

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
  {h : HonestProver K} {B : PackBasis F}
  {outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux}
  {x : Statement K CommitHandle} (W : R1PhaseWire h B outputs x)
  (P : R1PhaseProver h B outputs x W)

theorem commitment_causal (w : h.Instance) (sec : SecP) (d : OracleAnswer)
    (c : CPos P.data.E₁ P.data.E₂) (v v' : Vectors W P)
    (he : StageAgree W P (.inr c) v v') :
    attAddr W.toWire P.toProver h B outputs x w sec d v (.inr c) =
      attAddr W.toWire P.toProver h B outputs x w sec d v' (.inr c) := by
  have hr (q : RIdx) (hq : restStage q < stage (.inr c)) : restOf v q = restOf v' q :=
    he (.inr (.inr (.inr q))) hq
  change gram _ _ _ sec d (restOf v) c = gram _ _ _ sec d (restOf v') c
  rcases c with T | (b | b) | (b | i | ⟨T, u⟩ | ⟨T, u⟩ | ⟨T, n⟩)
  · have hj (j : Fin 2) := hr (rootChild T j) (root_children T j)
    simp only [gram, nodeBytes, hj]
  · have hs := hr (qSeed 0) (by simp [restStage, qSeed, stage])
    simp only [gram, hs]
  · have hs := hr (qSeed 2) (by simp [restStage, qSeed, stage])
    simp only [gram, hs]
  · by_cases hb : b.val = 0
    · simp only [gram, hb, if_pos]
    · have h0 : b.val = 1 := by have := b.isLt; omega
      have hs := hr (qBind 0) (by simp [qBind, restStage, stage, h0])
      simp only [gram, hb, if_false, hs]
  · by_cases hi : i.val = 0
    · have hs := hr (qBind 0) (by simp [qBind, restStage, stage, hi])
      simp only [gram, hi, if_true, hs]
    · by_cases hi1 : i.val = 1
      · have hs := hr (qBind 0) (by simp [qBind, restStage, stage, hi1])
        simp only [gram, hi, hi1, if_false, if_true, hs]
      · have hi2 : i.val = 2 := by have := i.isLt; omega
        have h0 := hr (qBind 1) (by simp [qBind, restStage, stage, hi2])
        have h1 := hr (qSeed 1) (by simp [qSeed, restStage, stage, hi2])
        simp only [gram, hi, hi1, if_false, h0, h1]
  · have hs := hr (qBind 1) (by simp [qBind, restStage, stage])
    simp only [gram, hs]
  · have ht : 5 < stage (.inr (.inr (.inr (qLeaf T u))) : Pos1 P.data.E₁ P.data.E₂) := by
      simp [stage, qLeaf, restStage, treeBase]
    have htape := tape_eq W P _ v v' he ht
    have hs := hr (qSalt T u) (by
      change 6 < treeBase T + 6
      simp [treeBase]; split <;> (try split) <;> omega)
    have hl := P.leaf_local w (tapeR W.toWire P.toProver v') (trOf v) (trOf v') T u
      (fun j _ hj => he (.inl j) hj)
    simp only [gram, htape, hl, hs, R1PhaseProver.toProver]
  · have hj (j : Fin 2) := hr (childQ T n j) (PhaseScheduleBin.child_before_parent T n j)
    simp only [gram, nodeBytes, hj]

/-- Every phase-refined instance is causal at every answer vector. The only
assumptions are the explicit message/leaf dependency contracts; chronology
and commitment bytes are constructed by toProver. -/
theorem phase_causal (w : h.Instance) : RCausal W.toWire P.toProver h B outputs x w := by
  apply (causal_iff W.toWire P.toProver h B outputs x w).mpr
  intro sec d p v v' he
  have hs : StageAgree W P p v v' := fun q hq => he q (stage_before q p hq)
  cases p with
  | inl j => exact transcript_causal W P w sec d j v v' hs
  | inr c => exact commitment_causal W P w sec d c v v' hs

/-- The exact D80 endpoint premise for the constructed prover, without an
execution-order hypothesis. Identifying the shipped encoding with W/P is
a separate, currently unconstructed source certificate. -/
theorem R_causal_D80 (w : h.Instance) (sec : SecP) (d : OracleAnswer)
    (p : Pos1 P.data.E₁ P.data.E₂) (v v' : Vectors W P)
    (he : Earlier W.toWire P.toProver p v v') :
    attAddr W.toWire P.toProver h B outputs x w sec d v p =
      attAddr W.toWire P.toProver h B outputs x w sec d v' p :=
  (causal_iff W.toWire P.toProver h B outputs x w).mp (phase_causal W P w) sec d p v v' he

#print axioms commitment_causal
#print axioms phase_causal
#print axioms R_causal_D80
end R1Z.PhaseCausalityBin
R1Z.PhaseTranscriptBin:
import R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PhaseTranscriptBin
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R1Z.Batched R1Z.GamesR1
  R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.LayoutR1PBin R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.PhaseScheduleBin
  R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin

def CoordBefore (c : Coord) (cut : ℕ) : Prop :=
  match c with
  | .root => 25 < cut
  | .sel => ∀ k : Fin 8, transcriptStage (.qa k) < cut
  | .ans j => transcriptStage j < cut

theorem chain_before (j : TRead) : CoordBefore (fc j) (transcriptStage j) := by
  cases j with
  | init => simp [fc, CoordBefore, transcriptStage]
  | absS i =>
    rcases i with ⟨i, hi⟩
    cases i with
    | zero => simp [fc, CoordBefore, transcriptStage]
    | succ i => simp [fc, CoordBefore, transcriptStage]; split <;> split <;> omega
  | sqS i => simp [fc, CoordBefore, transcriptStage]; split <;> omega
  | advS i => simp [fc, CoordBefore, transcriptStage]; split <;> omega
  | reseed => simp [fc, CoordBefore, transcriptStage]
  | absO i =>
    rcases i with ⟨i, hi⟩
    cases i with
    | zero => simp [fc, CoordBefore, transcriptStage]
    | succ i => simp [fc, CoordBefore, transcriptStage]; split <;> split <;> omega
  | sqO i => simp [fc, CoordBefore, transcriptStage]; split <;> omega
  | advO i => simp [fc, CoordBefore, transcriptStage]; split <;> omega
  | absQ => simp [fc, CoordBefore, transcriptStage]
  | qb k =>
    rcases k with ⟨k, hk⟩
    cases k <;> simp [fc, CoordBefore, transcriptStage] <;> omega
  | qa k =>
    rcases k with ⟨k, hk⟩
    cases k <;> simp [fc, CoordBefore, transcriptStage] <;> omega
  | absR => simp [fc, CoordBefore, transcriptStage]; intro k; have := k.isLt; omega
  | sqR => simp [fc, CoordBefore, transcriptStage]
  | advR => simp [fc, CoordBefore, transcriptStage]

theorem transcript_after_tape (j : TRead) : 5 < transcriptStage j := by
  cases j <;> simp only [transcriptStage] <;> (try split) <;> omega

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
  {h : HonestProver K} {B : PackBasis F}
  {outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux}
  {x : Statement K CommitHandle} (W : R1PhaseWire h B outputs x)
  (P : R1PhaseProver h B outputs x W)

abbrev Vectors := Pos1 P.data.E₁ P.data.E₂ → OracleAnswer

def StageAgree (p : Pos1 P.data.E₁ P.data.E₂) (v v' : Vectors W P) : Prop :=
  ∀ q, stage q < stage p → v q = v' q

theorem tape_eq (p : Pos1 P.data.E₁ P.data.E₂) (v v' : Vectors W P)
    (he : StageAgree W P p v v') (hp : 5 < stage p) :
    tapeR W.toWire P.toProver v = tapeR W.toWire P.toProver v' := by
  have h₁ : e₁Of v = e₁Of v' := funext (fun c => he _ hp)
  have h₂ : e₂Of v = e₂Of v' := funext (fun c => he _ hp)
  simp only [tapeR, R1PhaseProver.toProver, h₁, h₂]

theorem transcript_causal (w : h.Instance) (sec : SecP) (d : OracleAnswer)
    (j : TRead) (v v' : Vectors W P) (he : StageAgree W P (.inl j) v v') :
    attAddr W.toWire P.toProver h B outputs x w sec d v (.inl j) =
      attAddr W.toWire P.toProver h B outputs x w sec d v' (.inl j) := by
  have ht := tape_eq W P (.inl j) v v' he (transcript_after_tape j)
  have hs : SqAgree (transcriptStage j) (trOf v) (trOf v') :=
    fun q _ hq => he (.inl q) hq
  have hc : fieldVal (fc j) (recP W.toWire x
      (view h B outputs x w (chOf W.toWire (trOf v)) (tapeR W.toWire P.toProver v))
      (trOf v) (rootsOf v)) =
      fieldVal (fc j) (recP W.toWire x
      (view h B outputs x w (chOf W.toWire (trOf v')) (tapeR W.toWire P.toProver v'))
      (trOf v') (rootsOf v')) := by
    have hb := chain_before j
    cases hf : fc j with
    | root => exact he (.inr (.inl 0)) (by simpa [hf, CoordBefore, stage, treeBase] using hb)
    | ans q => exact he (.inl q) (by simpa only [hf, CoordBefore, stage] using hb)
    | sel =>
      have hb : ∀ k : Fin 8, transcriptStage (.qa k) < transcriptStage j := by
        simpa [hf, CoordBefore] using hb
      have hq : (fun k => trOf v (.qb k)) = (fun k => trOf v' (.qb k)) := by
        funext k
        apply he (.inl (.qb k))
        have hk := k.isLt
        change 160 + 2 * k.val < transcriptStage j
        have hb' : 161 + 2 * k.val < transcriptStage j := by
          simpa [hf, CoordBefore, transcriptStage] using hb k
        omega
      change trOf v (.qa (W.toWire.kstarOf (fun k => trOf v (.qb k)))) =
        trOf v' (.qa (W.toWire.kstarOf (fun k => trOf v' (.qb k))))
      rw [hq]
      apply he (.inl _)
      simpa only [hf, CoordBefore, stage] using hb (W.toWire.kstarOf (fun k => trOf v' (.qb k)))
  change addrWith j _ _ = addrWith j _ _
  rw [hc]
  cases j with
  | absS i =>
    have hm := W.frame_local w (tapeR W.toWire P.toProver v') (trOf v) (trOf v')
      (rootsOf v 1) (rootsOf v' 1) i hs (by
        intro hi; apply he (.inr (.inl 1)); simp [stage, treeBase, transcriptStage, hi])
    simpa only [addrWith, recP, ht] using congrArg
      (fun m => R1Z.LensR1.ans (fieldVal (fc (.absS i)) (recP W.toWire x
        (view h B outputs x w (chOf W.toWire (trOf v')) (tapeR W.toWire P.toProver v'))
        (trOf v') (rootsOf v'))) ++ ([0, 0xa0 + i.val.toUInt8] ++ m)) hm
  | absO i =>
    have hm := W.payload_local w (tapeR W.toWire P.toProver v') (trOf v) (trOf v')
      (rootsOf v 2) (rootsOf v' 2) i hs (by
        intro hi; apply he (.inr (.inl 2)); simp [stage, treeBase, transcriptStage, hi])
    simp only [addrWith, recP, ht, hm]
  | absQ =>
    have hm := W.final_local w (tapeR W.toWire P.toProver v') (trOf v) (trOf v') hs
    simp only [addrWith, recP, ht, hm]
  | _ => rfl

#print axioms chain_before
#print axioms transcript_after_tape
#print axioms tape_eq
#print axioms transcript_causal
end R1Z.PhaseTranscriptBin
R1Z.PhaseMessageEncodingBin:
import R1Z.PhaseMessageDependenciesBin
import R1Z.WireLengthsR1PBin
import R1RecordFrameCodec
import R1FoldedLeafCodec

/-! Logical protocol messages selected from the existing honest view. The
field codec is explicit; `wideBytes` specializes it to the existing exact-wide
codec. Auxiliary metadata is never passed to a field encoder. This constructs
a protocol model; identity with an arbitrary R1Wire base is not asserted. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PhaseMessageEncodingBin
open R0P R0P.SemSource R0Z R0Z.HonestView R0Z.MaskLayout R0Z.FsStatement
  R1Z.Batched R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.PhaseLocalityBin R1Z.PhaseScheduleBin
  R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.PhaseBuilderDependenciesBin R1Z.PhaseMessageDependenciesBin

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

def wideBytes (x : AspisWideTower.WideExact) : List UInt8 :=
  (AspisR1.FoldedLeafCodec.encodeWide x).map UInt8.ofFin

def encoded (enc : K → List UInt8) {n : ℕ} (values : Fin n → K) : List UInt8 :=
  AspisR1.FixedWidthDecoder.encode enc values

/-- Existing tagged length framing, transported between the two byte carriers. -/
def framed (tag : UInt8) (payload : List UInt8) : List UInt8 :=
  (AspisR1.RecordFrameCodec.frame tag.toFin (payload.map UInt8.toFin)).map UInt8.ofFin

def semantic (enc : K → List UInt8) (p : Payload K R1Bat)
    (root : OracleAnswer) (i : Fin 27) : List UInt8 :=
  if i.val = 2 then R1Z.LensR1.ans root
  else if i.val = 14 then enc (p .maskSum)
  else if hi : 15 ≤ i.val ∧ i.val ≤ 24 then
    encoded enc (fun c : Fin 28 => p (.semanticCoeff ⟨i.val-15, by omega⟩ c))
  else if i.val = 25 then
    (List.ofFn (fun j : Fin 3 => encoded enc (fun c : Fin 29 => p (.pointClaim j c)))).flatten ++
      encoded enc (fun c : Fin 29 => p (.extraClaim c))
  else if i.val = 26 then encoded enc (fun c : Fin 29 => p (.ood 0 c))
  else []

def frame (enc : K → List UInt8) (v : ZkStatement.View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat)
    (root : OracleAnswer) (i : Fin 27) : List UInt8 :=
  framed (WireLengthsR1PBin.semanticTag i) (semantic enc v.2 root i)

def opening (enc : K → List UInt8) (p : Payload K R1Bat)
    (root : OracleAnswer) (i : Fin 4) : List UInt8 :=
  if i.val = 0 then encoded enc (fun c : Fin 29 => p (.ood 1 c))
  else if i.val = 1 then enc (p .inactiveSum)
  else if i.val = 2 then encoded enc (fun c : Fin 7 => p (.bat (.round0 c)))
  else R1Z.LensR1.ans root ++ encoded enc (fun c : Fin 7 => p (.bat (.round1 c)))

def payload (enc : K → List UInt8) (v : ZkStatement.View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat)
    (root : OracleAnswer) (i : Fin 4) : List UInt8 := opening enc v.2 root i

def final (enc : K → List UInt8) (v : ZkStatement.View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat) : List UInt8 :=
  encoded enc (fun c : Fin 64 => v.2 (.bat (.final c)))

/-- The entire encoded transcript is independent of arbitrary auxiliary output. -/
theorem auxiliary_irrelevant (enc : K → List UInt8)
    (m m' : ZkStatement.Meta K CommitHandle Aux) (p : Payload K R1Bat)
    (root : OracleAnswer) :
    frame enc (m,p) root = frame enc (m',p) root ∧
    payload enc (m,p) root = payload enc (m',p) root ∧
    final enc (m,p) = final enc (m',p) := ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

theorem prepared_prefix (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K)
    (r : AffTape K F) (ch ch' : Challenges K) (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (he : SemPrefix n ch ch') :
    applyAff B (prepare pub t ch) r = applyAff B (prepare pub t ch') r := by
  rw [prepare_local pub t ch ch' (he 0 (by omega)) (he 1 (by omega))]

theorem alpha_prefix (ch ch' : Challenges K) (he : SemPrefix 25 ch ch') :
    R0Z.HonestView.alpha ch = R0Z.HonestView.alpha ch' := by
  funext i
  exact he ⟨15+i.val, by omega⟩ (by dsimp; omega)

attribute [local irreducible] encoded framed

theorem semantic_prefix (enc : K → List UInt8) (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024)
    (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (r : AffTape K F)
    (ch ch' : Challenges K) (root root' : OracleAnswer) (i : Fin 27)
    (he : SemPrefix i.val ch ch') (hr : i.val = 2 → root = root')
    (hc : i.val = 26 → ch.circle 0 = ch'.circle 0) :
    semantic enc (run π pub B t ch r) root i =
      semantic enc (run π pub B t ch' r) root' i := by
  unfold semantic
  split
  · rw [hr (by assumption)]
  · split
    · have hp := prepared_prefix pub B t r ch ch' i.val (by omega) he
      simp only [run, hp]
    · split
      · apply congrArg (encoded enc)
        funext c
        apply semanticCoeff_prefix
        intro j hj
        apply he
        dsimp at hj ⊢
        omega
      · split
        · have hp := prepared_prefix pub B t r ch ch' i.val (by omega) he
          have ha := alpha_prefix ch ch' (by simpa only [‹i.val = 25›] using he)
          simp only [run, hp, ha]
        · split
          · have hp := prepared_prefix pub B t r ch ch' i.val (by omega) he
            simp only [run, hp, hc (by assumption)]
          · rfl

theorem opening_prefix (enc : K → List UInt8) (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024)
    (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (r : AffTape K F)
    (ch ch' : Challenges K) (root root' : OracleAnswer) (i : Fin 4)
    (hs : ch.sem = ch'.sem) (hc : ch.circle = ch'.circle)
    (ho : ∀ j : Fin 4, j.val < i.val → ch.opening j = ch'.opening j)
    (hr : i.val = 3 → root = root') :
    opening enc (run π pub B t ch r) root i =
      opening enc (run π pub B t ch' r) root' i := by
  have hp := prepared_prefix pub B t r ch ch' 25 (by omega) (fun _ _ => congrFun hs _)
  unfold opening
  split
  · simp only [run, hp, hc]
  · split
    · simp only [run, hp, ho 0 (by omega)]
    · split
      · apply congrArg (encoded enc)
        funext c
        simp only [run, hp]
        apply round0_prefix π ch ch' _ c hs hc (ho 0 (by omega)) (ho 1 (by omega))
      · rw [hr (by omega)]
        apply congrArg (fun bs => R1Z.LensR1.ans root' ++ bs)
        apply congrArg (encoded enc)
        funext c
        simp only [run, hp]
        apply round1_prefix π ch ch' _ c hs hc
          (ho 0 (by omega)) (ho 1 (by omega)) (ho 2 (by omega))

theorem final_prefix (enc : K → List UInt8) (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024)
    (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (r : AffTape K F)
    (ch ch' : Challenges K) (hs : SemPrefix 2 ch ch')
    (ho : ∀ j : Fin 4, ch.opening j = ch'.opening j) :
    encoded enc (fun c : Fin 64 => run (Bat := R1Bat) π pub B t ch r (.bat (.final c))) =
      encoded enc (fun c : Fin 64 => run (Bat := R1Bat) π pub B t ch' r (.bat (.final c))) := by
  have hp := prepared_prefix pub B t r ch ch' 2 (by omega) hs
  apply congrArg (encoded enc)
  funext c
  simp only [run, hp]
  exact PhaseMessageDependenciesBin.final_prefix π ch ch' _ c (ho 0) (ho 2) (ho 3)

/-- Locality of semantic challenge values, directly from preceding squeezes. -/
theorem semantic_before (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (hd : DecodeLocal W.dec)
    (tr tr' : TRead → OracleAnswer) (i : Fin 27)
    (he : SqAgree (transcriptStage (.absS i)) tr tr') :
    SemPrefix i.val (chOf W tr) (chOf W tr') := by
  intro j hj
  apply hd.sem
  apply he (.sqS ⟨j.val, by omega⟩) trivial
  simp only [transcriptStage]
  split <;> split <;> omega

theorem frame_local (enc : K → List UInt8) (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (hd : DecodeLocal W.dec) (h : JointView.HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : JointView.Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : JointView.Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) (τ : JointView.Tape K F)
    (tr tr' : TRead → OracleAnswer) (root root' : OracleAnswer) (i : Fin 27)
    (he : SqAgree (transcriptStage (.absS i)) tr tr') (hr : i.val = 2 → root = root') :
    frame enc (JointView.view h B outputs x w (chOf W tr) τ) root i =
      frame enc (JointView.view h B outputs x w (chOf W tr') τ) root' i := by
  unfold frame
  apply congrArg (framed (WireLengthsR1PBin.semanticTag i))
  apply semantic_prefix enc h.transport x.1 B (applyEligible (h.build w) τ.2) τ.1
    (chOf W tr) (chOf W tr') root root' i (semantic_before W hd tr tr' i he) hr
  intro hi
  apply hd.circle
  apply he (.sqS 25) trivial
  simp only [transcriptStage, hi]
  decide

/-- Install the actual message selectors in a wire's other data. -/
def wireData (enc : K → List UInt8) (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) :
    R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux :=
  { base with frame := frame enc, payload := payload enc, final := final enc }

theorem payload_local (enc : K → List UInt8) (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (hd : DecodeLocal W.dec) (h : JointView.HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : JointView.Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : JointView.Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) (τ : JointView.Tape K F)
    (tr tr' : TRead → OracleAnswer) (root root' : OracleAnswer) (i : Fin 4)
    (he : SqAgree (transcriptStage (.absO i)) tr tr') (hr : i.val = 3 → root = root') :
    payload enc (JointView.view h B outputs x w (chOf W tr) τ) root i =
      payload enc (JointView.view h B outputs x w (chOf W tr') τ) root' i := by
  apply opening_prefix enc h.transport x.1 B (applyEligible (h.build w) τ.2) τ.1
    (chOf W tr) (chOf W tr') root root' i
  · funext j
    apply hd.sem
    apply he (.sqS ⟨j.val, by omega⟩) trivial
    simp only [transcriptStage]
    split <;> split <;> omega
  · funext j
    apply hd.circle
    apply he (.sqS ⟨25+j.val, by omega⟩) trivial
    simp only [transcriptStage]
    split <;> split <;> omega
  · intro j hj
    apply hd.opening
    apply he (.sqO j) trivial
    simp only [transcriptStage]
    split <;> split <;> omega
  · exact hr

theorem final_local (enc : K → List UInt8) (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (hd : DecodeLocal W.dec) (h : JointView.HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : JointView.Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : JointView.Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) (τ : JointView.Tape K F)
    (tr tr' : TRead → OracleAnswer) (he : SqAgree (transcriptStage .absQ) tr tr') :
    final enc (JointView.view h B outputs x w (chOf W tr) τ) =
      final enc (JointView.view h B outputs x w (chOf W tr') τ) := by
  apply final_prefix enc h.transport x.1 B (applyEligible (h.build w) τ.2) τ.1
    (chOf W tr) (chOf W tr')
  · intro j hj
    apply hd.sem
    apply he (.sqS ⟨j.val, by omega⟩) trivial
    simp only [transcriptStage]
    split <;> omega
  · intro j
    apply hd.opening
    apply he (.sqO j) trivial
    simp only [transcriptStage]
    split <;> omega

/-- A phase inhabitant for this explicit logical encoder, retaining the supplied
block-local decoder. This is not a coercion from an arbitrary endpoint wire. -/
def phaseWire (enc : K → List UInt8) (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (hd : DecodeLocal base.dec) (h : JointView.HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : JointView.Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : JointView.Statement K CommitHandle) : R1PhaseWire h B outputs x where
  toWire := wireData enc base
  decode_local := hd
  frame_local := frame_local enc base hd h B outputs x
  payload_local := payload_local enc base hd h B outputs x
  final_local := final_local enc base hd h B outputs x

#print axioms payload_local
#print axioms final_local
#print axioms phaseWire
#print axioms auxiliary_irrelevant
#print axioms prepared_prefix
#print axioms alpha_prefix
#print axioms semantic_prefix
#print axioms opening_prefix
#print axioms final_prefix
#print axioms semantic_before
#print axioms frame_local
end R1Z.PhaseMessageEncodingBin
R1Z.PhaseMessageDependenciesBin:
import R1Z.PhaseBuilderDependenciesBin

/-! Symbolic message-prefix facts about the existing honest-view model.
No Boolean-tail sum, interpolation table or coefficient universe is evaluated. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PhaseMessageDependenciesBin
open R0P R0P.SemSource R0Z R0Z.HonestView R0Z.MaskLayout R1Z.Batched
  R1Z.PhaseBuilderDependenciesBin

variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

def SemPrefix (n : ℕ) (ch ch' : Challenges K) : Prop :=
  ∀ i : Fin 25, i.val < n → ch.sem i = ch'.sem i

theorem roundPoint_prefix (ch ch' : Challenges K) (j : Fin 10)
    (he : SemPrefix (15 + j.val) ch ch') (z : K) (tail : Fin (9-j.val) → Bool) :
    roundPoint ch j z tail = roundPoint ch' j z tail := by
  funext i
  unfold roundPoint
  split
  · exact he _ (by dsimp [alpha]; omega)
  · rfl

theorem zc_prefix (ch ch' : Challenges K) (n : ℕ) (hn : 13 ≤ n)
    (he : SemPrefix n ch ch') : zc ch = zc ch' := by
  funext i
  exact he ⟨3 + i.val, by omega⟩ (by dsimp; omega)

/-- Actual semantic coefficient cells use only the preceding semantic rows. -/
theorem semanticCoeff_prefix (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (pub : Public K)
    (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (r : AffTape K F)
    (ch ch' : Challenges K) (j : Fin 10) (i : Fin 28)
    (he : SemPrefix (15 + j.val) ch ch') :
    run (Bat := R1Bat) π pub B t ch r (.semanticCoeff j i) =
      run (Bat := R1Bat) π pub B t ch' r (.semanticCoeff j i) := by
  have h0 := he 0 (by omega)
  have h1 := he 1 (by omega)
  have h2 := he 2 (by omega)
  have h13 := he 13 (by omega)
  have h14 := he 14 (by omega)
  have hz := zc_prefix ch ch' (15 + j.val) (by omega) he
  have hp : ∀ z tail, roundPoint ch j z tail = roundPoint ch' j z tail :=
    roundPoint_prefix ch ch' j he
  simp only [run, prepare_local pub t ch ch' h0 h1, hp, h0, h1, h2, h13, h14, hz]

/-- The same prefix fact for the semantic polynomial, before coefficient reads. -/
theorem roundPoly_prefix (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (pub : Public K)
    (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (r : AffTape K F)
    (ch ch' : Challenges K) (j : Fin 10)
    (he : SemPrefix (15 + j.val) ch ch') :
    roundPoly π pub B t ch j r = roundPoly π pub B t ch' j r := by
  rw [roundPoly_apply, roundPoly_apply]
  have hz := zc_prefix ch ch' (15 + j.val) (by omega) he
  simp only [roundPoint_prefix ch ch' j he, he 0 (by omega), he 1 (by omega),
    he 2 (by omega), he 13 (by omega), he 14 (by omega), hz]

theorem batch_prefix (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch ch' : Challenges K)
    (hg : ch.opening 0 = ch'.opening 0) : batchR1 π ch = batchR1 π ch' := by
  simp only [batchR1, hg]

theorem weights_prefix (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch ch' : Challenges K)
    (hs : ch.sem = ch'.sem) (hc : ch.circle = ch'.circle)
    (hk : ch.opening 1 = ch'.opening 1) : weightsR1 π ch = weightsR1 π ch' := by
  have ha : R0Z.HonestView.alpha ch = R0Z.HonestView.alpha ch' := by
    unfold R0Z.HonestView.alpha
    rw [hs]
  unfold weightsR1 ell
  rw [hk, ha, hc]

theorem round0_prefix (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch ch' : Challenges K)
    (t : Trace K) (i : Fin 7) (hs : ch.sem = ch'.sem) (hc : ch.circle = ch'.circle)
    (hg : ch.opening 0 = ch'.opening 0) (hk : ch.opening 1 = ch'.opening 1) :
    BatchedLayer.read π ch t (.round0 i : R1Bat) =
      BatchedLayer.read π ch' t (.round0 i : R1Bat) := by
  rw [read_round0, read_round0, batch_prefix π ch ch' hg, weights_prefix π ch ch' hs hc hk]

theorem round1_prefix (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch ch' : Challenges K)
    (t : Trace K) (i : Fin 7) (hs : ch.sem = ch'.sem) (hc : ch.circle = ch'.circle)
    (hg : ch.opening 0 = ch'.opening 0) (hk : ch.opening 1 = ch'.opening 1)
    (ha : ch.opening 2 = ch'.opening 2) :
    BatchedLayer.read π ch t (.round1 i : R1Bat) =
      BatchedLayer.read π ch' t (.round1 i : R1Bat) := by
  rw [read_round1, read_round1, q1_local π ch ch' hg ha]
  have hw : w1 π ch = w1 π ch' := by
    unfold w1
    rw [ha, weights_prefix π ch ch' hs hc hk]
  rw [hw]

/-- The final word needs neither kappa, the circle answers, nor queries. -/
theorem final_prefix (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch ch' : Challenges K)
    (t : Trace K) (i : Fin 64)
    (hg : ch.opening 0 = ch'.opening 0) (ha : ch.opening 2 = ch'.opening 2)
    (hb : ch.opening 3 = ch'.opening 3) :
    BatchedLayer.read π ch t (.final i : R1Bat) =
      BatchedLayer.read π ch' t (.final i : R1Bat) := by
  rw [read_final, read_final, q1_local π ch ch' hg ha, hb]

#print axioms roundPoint_prefix
#print axioms zc_prefix
#print axioms semanticCoeff_prefix
#print axioms roundPoly_prefix
#print axioms batch_prefix
#print axioms weights_prefix
#print axioms round0_prefix
#print axioms round1_prefix
#print axioms final_prefix
end R1Z.PhaseMessageDependenciesBin
R1RecordFrameCodec:
import R1PublicInitFrame

/-! Exact byte-model codec for a tagged, little-endian length-prefixed record.
This models byte equality and framing only; it does not establish equivalence
to a Rust parser's integer conversion or its error behavior. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.RecordFrameCodec

open FS2.Duplex
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep

def header (tag : Byte) (size : Nat) : Bytes :=
  [tag] ++ AspisR1.PublicInitFrame.lengthBytes size

def frame (tag : Byte) (payload : Bytes) : Bytes :=
  header tag payload.length ++ payload

def parse (tag : Byte) (size : Nat) (bytes : Bytes) : Option Bytes :=
  if bytes.length = 5 + size ∧ bytes.take 5 = header tag size then
    some (bytes.drop 5)
  else none

theorem header_length (tag : Byte) (size : Nat) : (header tag size).length = 5 := by
  simp [header, AspisR1.PublicInitFrame.lengthBytes_length]

theorem frame_length (tag : Byte) (payload : Bytes) :
    (frame tag payload).length = 5 + payload.length := by
  simp [frame, header_length]

theorem parse_frame (tag : Byte) (payload : Bytes) (size : Nat)
    (hsize : payload.length = size) :
    parse tag size (frame tag payload) = some payload := by
  have hlen : (frame tag payload).length = 5 + size := by
    rw [frame_length, hsize]
  have htake : (frame tag payload).take 5 = header tag size := by
    rw [frame, hsize]
    exact List.take_append_of_le_length (by rw [header_length])
  have hdrop : (frame tag payload).drop 5 = payload := by
    rw [frame, hsize]
    rw [List.drop_append_of_le_length (by rw [header_length])]
    rw [List.drop_eq_nil_of_le (by rw [header_length])]
    simp
  unfold parse
  rw [if_pos ⟨hlen, htake⟩]
  exact congrArg some hdrop

theorem parse_sound (tag : Byte) (size : Nat) (bytes payload : Bytes)
    (h : parse tag size bytes = some payload) :
    payload.length = size ∧ bytes = frame tag payload := by
  unfold parse at h
  split at h
  · rename_i hp
    have hdrop : bytes.drop 5 = payload := Option.some.inj h
    have hlen : payload.length = size := by
      have hdropLen : (bytes.drop 5).length = size := by
        rw [List.length_drop, hp.1]
        omega
      rw [hdrop] at hdropLen
      exact hdropLen
    have hbytes : bytes = bytes.take 5 ++ bytes.drop 5 :=
      (List.take_append_drop 5 bytes).symm
    constructor
    · exact hlen
    · rw [hbytes, hp.2, hdrop, ← hlen]
      rfl
  · simp at h

theorem parse_eq_some_iff (tag : Byte) (size : Nat) (bytes payload : Bytes) :
    parse tag size bytes = some payload ↔
      payload.length = size ∧ bytes = frame tag payload := by
  constructor
  · exact parse_sound tag size bytes payload
  · rintro ⟨hsize, rfl⟩
    exact parse_frame tag payload size hsize

theorem zero_tag_empty :
    frame (0 : Byte) [] = AspisR1.PublicInitFrame.emptyRecord := by
  simp [frame, header, AspisR1.PublicInitFrame.emptyRecord,
    AspisR1.PublicInitFrame.lengthBytes]

#print axioms header_length
#print axioms frame_length
#print axioms parse_frame
#print axioms parse_sound
#print axioms parse_eq_some_iff
#print axioms zero_tag_empty

end AspisR1.RecordFrameCodec
R1PublicInitFrame:
import R1TrailingStateFrame

/-! Byte-level P3 semantic initialization and canonical row-zero frames.
The Nat length encoder models four little-endian bytes. Its Rust and typed
public-input correspondence are separate obligations. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.PublicInitFrame
open FS2.Duplex
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep

/-- ASCII `UNPROVED:R1:PRIVATE-SALTED:SEMANTIC:P3`. -/
def domain : Bytes :=
  [85, 78, 80, 82, 79, 86, 69, 68, 58, 82, 49, 58, 80, 82, 73,
   86, 65, 84, 69, 45, 83, 65, 76, 84, 69, 68, 58, 83, 69, 77,
   65, 78, 84, 73, 67, 58, 80, 51]

def lengthBytes (n : Nat) : Bytes :=
  List.ofFn fun j : Fin 4 =>
    (⟨(n / 256^j.val) % 256, Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)⟩ : Byte)

theorem lengthBytes_length (n : Nat) : (lengthBytes n).length = 4 := by
  simp [lengthBytes]

def pre (pubBytes : Bytes) : Bytes :=
  domain ++ [0] ++ lengthBytes pubBytes.length ++ pubBytes

theorem pre_length (pubBytes : Bytes) : (pre pubBytes).length = 43 + pubBytes.length := by
  simp only [pre, List.length_append, List.length_singleton, lengthBytes_length]
  rfl

def frame (pubBytes : Bytes) (c1 : State) : Bytes :=
  TrailingStateFrame.frame (pre pubBytes) c1

  have hlen' : (pre ++ bytes s).length = pre.length + 32 := by

  simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel_right]

  rw [List.drop_eq_nil_of_le (by simp)]

/-! Exact list codec for the four WideExact values in a folded Merkle leaf.
This is a byte-model statement and does not identify the folded leaf with C2. -/

namespace AspisR1.FoldedLeafCodec

open AspisR1.RetainedFieldByteCodec
open AspisR1.StrictWideByteCodec
open AspisR1.WideExactLimbCodec
open AspisWideTower

abbrev Wide := WideExact
abbrev Folded := Fin 4 → Wide

def encodeWide (x : Wide) : List Byte :=
  List.ofFn (encodeWideLE (pairExactEquiv.symm x))

def decodeWide (bytes : List Byte) : Option Wide :=
  ((fixedBytes? 32 bytes).bind decodeWideLE).map pairExactEquiv

theorem encodeWide_length (x : Wide) : (encodeWide x).length = 32 := by
  simp [encodeWide, List.length_ofFn]

theorem decodeWide_encode (x : Wide) : decodeWide (encodeWide x) = some x := by
  unfold decodeWide encodeWide
  rw [AspisR1.ListFieldCodec.fixedBytes?_ofFn]
  simp [decodeWideLE_encodeWideLE]

theorem encodeWide_of_decode (bytes : List Byte) (x : Wide)
    (h : decodeWide bytes = some x) : encodeWide x = bytes := by
  unfold decodeWide at h
  cases hf : fixedBytes? 32 bytes with
  | none => simp [hf] at h
  | some bs =>
      cases hd : decodeWideLE bs with
      | none => simp [decodeWide, hf, hd] at h
      | some limbs =>
          have hx : pairExactEquiv limbs = x := by
            simpa [decodeWide, hf, hd] using h
          have hlimbs : limbs = pairExactEquiv.symm x := by
            apply pairExactEquiv.injective
            simpa using hx
          subst limbs
          have hbytes := AspisR1.ListFieldCodec.fixedBytes?_sound 32 bytes bs hf
          have henc := encodeWideLE_of_decodeWideLE bs
            (pairExactEquiv.symm x) (by simpa [hd])
          change List.ofFn (encodeWideLE (pairExactEquiv.symm x)) = bytes
          rw [henc, ← hbytes]

theorem decodeWide_eq_some_iff (bytes : List Byte) (x : Wide) :
    decodeWide bytes = some x ↔ encodeWide x = bytes := by
  constructor
  · exact encodeWide_of_decode bytes x
  · intro h
    rw [← h]
    exact decodeWide_encode x

def encodeFolded (xs : Folded) : List Byte :=
  AspisR1.FixedWidthDecoder.encode encodeWide xs

def decodeFolded (bytes : List Byte) : Option Folded :=
  AspisR1.FixedWidthDecoder.decode decodeWide 32 4 bytes

theorem encodeFolded_length (xs : Folded) : (encodeFolded xs).length = 128 := by
  unfold encodeFolded AspisR1.FixedWidthDecoder.encode
  simp [List.length_flatMap, List.length_ofFn, encodeWide_length]

theorem decodeFolded_encode (xs : Folded) : decodeFolded (encodeFolded xs) = some xs := by
  exact AspisR1.FixedWidthDecoder.decode_encode decodeWide encodeWide 32 4 xs
    encodeWide_length decodeWide_encode

theorem encodeFolded_of_decode (bytes : List Byte) (xs : Folded)
    (h : decodeFolded bytes = some xs) : encodeFolded xs = bytes := by
  exact AspisR1.FixedWidthDecoder.encode_of_decode decodeWide encodeWide 32 4
    bytes xs h encodeWide_of_decode

theorem decodeFolded_eq_some_iff (bytes : List Byte) (xs : Folded) :
    decodeFolded bytes = some xs ↔
      bytes.length = 128 ∧
        ∀ i : Fin 4, decodeWide ((bytes.drop (32 * i.val)).take 32) = some (xs i) := by
  exact AspisR1.FixedWidthDecodedSlices.decode_eq_some_iff decodeWide encodeWide

theorem decodeFolded_slot (bytes : List Byte) (xs : Folded)
    (h : decodeFolded bytes = some xs) (i : Fin 4) :
    decodeWide ((bytes.drop (32 * i.val)).take 32) = some (xs i) :=
  (decodeFolded_eq_some_iff bytes xs).mp h |>.2 i

#print axioms decodeWide_encode
#print axioms encodeWide_of_decode
#print axioms decodeWide_eq_some_iff
#print axioms encodeFolded_length
#print axioms decodeFolded_encode
#print axioms encodeFolded_of_decode
#print axioms decodeFolded_eq_some_iff
#print axioms decodeFolded_slot

end AspisR1.FoldedLeafCodec

import Mathlib.Data.List.OfFn

/-! Structural encoder/decoder facts for fixed-width list encodings. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.FixedWidthDecoder

def decode {B A : Type} (d : List B → Option A) (k : Nat) :
    (n : Nat) → List B → Option (Fin n → A)
  | 0, bytes => if bytes.length = 0 then some Fin.elim0 else none
  | n + 1, bytes => do
      let head ← d (bytes.take k)
      let tail ← decode d k n (bytes.drop k)
      pure (Fin.cons head tail)

def encode {B A : Type} (f : A → List B) {n : Nat} (xs : Fin n → A) : List B :=
  (List.ofFn xs).flatMap f

theorem decode_encode {B A : Type} (d : List B → Option A) (f : A → List B)
    (k n : Nat) (xs : Fin n → A)
    (hlen : ∀ a, (f a).length = k)
    (hround : ∀ a, d (f a) = some a) :
    decode d k n (encode f xs) = some xs := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      have hxs : xs = Fin.elim0 := by
        funext i
        exact Fin.elim0 i
      simp [decode, encode, hxs]
  | succ n ih =>
      let tail : Fin n → A := fun i => xs i.succ
      have hcons : Fin.cons (xs 0) tail = xs := by
        funext i
        exact Fin.cases rfl (fun _ => rfl) i
      have henc : encode f xs = f (xs 0) ++ encode f tail := by
        simp [encode, tail, List.ofFn_succ, List.flatMap_cons]
      have htail := ih tail
      rw [henc]
      simp only [decode]
      rw [List.take_append_of_le_length (by rw [hlen (xs 0)]),
        List.take_of_length_le (by rw [hlen (xs 0)])]
      simp only [hround]
      rw [List.drop_append_of_le_length (by rw [hlen (xs 0)]),
        List.drop_of_length_le (by rw [hlen (xs 0)]), List.nil_append, htail]
      exact congrArg some hcons

theorem encode_of_decode {B A : Type} (d : List B → Option A) (f : A → List B)
    (k n : Nat) (bytes : List B) (xs : Fin n → A)
    (hsuccess : decode d k n bytes = some xs)
    (hback : ∀ bs a, d bs = some a → f a = bs) :
    encode f xs = bytes := by
  induction n generalizing bytes with
  | zero =>
      cases bytes with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons b bs => simp [decode] at hsuccess
  | succ n ih =>
      cases hhead : d (bytes.take k) with
      | none => simp [decode, hhead] at hsuccess
      | some head =>
          cases htail : decode d k n (bytes.drop k) with
          | none => simp [decode, hhead, htail] at hsuccess
          | some tail =>
              have hxs : Fin.cons head tail = xs := by
                simpa [decode, hhead, htail] using hsuccess
              have htailenc : encode f tail = bytes.drop k :=
                ih (bytes.drop k) tail htail
              have henc : encode f xs = f head ++ encode f tail := by
                rw [← hxs]
                simp [encode, List.ofFn_succ, List.flatMap_cons]
              rw [henc, hback (bytes.take k) head hhead, htailenc]
              exact List.take_append_drop k bytes

#print axioms decode_encode
#print axioms encode_of_decode

end AspisR1.FixedWidthDecoder

import R1FixedWidthDecoder
import R1FixedWidthSlice
import R1FixedWidthReconstruction

/-! Relate recursive fixed-width parsing to its exact per-offset reads. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.FixedWidthDecodedSlices

open AspisR1.FixedWidthDecoder

private theorem encode_length {B A : Type} (f : A → List B) (k n : Nat)
    (xs : Fin n → A) (hlen : ∀ a, (f a).length = k) :
    (encode f xs).length = n * k := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [encode]
  | succ n ih =>
      let tail : Fin n → A := fun i => xs i.succ
      have henc : encode f xs = f (xs 0) ++ encode f tail := by
        simp [encode, tail, List.ofFn_succ, List.flatMap_cons]
      rw [henc, List.length_append, hlen (xs 0), ih tail]
      simp [Nat.succ_mul, Nat.add_comm]

theorem decode_eq_some_iff {B A : Type} (d : List B → Option A) (f : A → List B)
    (k n : Nat) (bytes : List B) (xs : Fin n → A)
    (hlen : ∀ a, (f a).length = k)
    (hround : ∀ a, d (f a) = some a)
    (hback : ∀ bs a, d bs = some a → f a = bs) :
    decode d k n bytes = some xs ↔
      bytes.length = n * k ∧
        ∀ i : Fin n, d ((bytes.drop (k * i.val)).take k) = some (xs i) := by
  constructor
  · intro hsuccess
    have hencode : encode f xs = bytes := encode_of_decode d f k n bytes xs hsuccess hback
    constructor
    · rw [← hencode]
      exact encode_length f k n xs hlen
    · intro i
      have hs := AspisR1.FixedWidthSlice.ofFn_flatMap_slice n f k hlen xs i
      change ((encode f xs).drop (k * i.val)).take k = f (xs i) at hs
      rw [hencode] at hs
      rw [hs, hround]
  · rintro ⟨hbytes, hreads⟩
    have hblocks : ∀ i : Fin n,
        f (xs i) = (bytes.drop (k * i.val)).take k := by
      intro i
      exact hback _ _ (hreads i)
    have hencode : encode f xs = bytes := by
      unfold encode
      rw [List.flatMap_def, List.map_ofFn]
      change (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n => f (xs i))).flatten = bytes
      rw [show List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n => f (xs i)) =
          List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n => (bytes.drop (k * i.val)).take k) by
            apply congrArg List.ofFn
            funext i
            exact hblocks i]
      exact AspisR1.FixedWidthReconstruction.slices_flatten bytes k n hbytes
    rw [← hencode]
    exact decode_encode d f k n xs hlen hround

#print axioms decode_eq_some_iff

end AspisR1.FixedWidthDecodedSlices

import Mathlib.Data.List.OfFn

/-! Recover one equal-width block from a flattened list encoding. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.FixedWidthSlice

theorem flatMap_slice {A B : Type} (f : A → List B) (k : Nat)
    (hlen : ∀ a, (f a).length = k) (xs : List A) (i : Nat)
    (hi : i < xs.length) :
    ((xs.flatMap f).drop (k * i)).take k = f xs[i] := by
  induction xs generalizing i with
  | nil => simp at hi
  | cons a as ih =>
      cases i with
      | zero =>
          simp only [Nat.mul_zero, List.flatMap_cons, List.drop_zero]
          rw [List.take_append_of_le_length (by rw [hlen a])]
          exact List.take_of_length_le (by rw [hlen a])
      | succ i =>
          have hi' : i < as.length := by simpa using hi
          rw [Nat.mul_succ]
          simp only [List.flatMap_cons]
          have hstart : k * i + k = (f a).length + k * i := by
            rw [hlen a]
            omega
          rw [hstart, List.drop_length_add_append]
          simpa [List.getElem_cons_succ] using ih i hi'

theorem ofFn_flatMap_slice {A B : Type} (m : Nat) (f : A → List B)
    (k : Nat) (hlen : ∀ a, (f a).length = k) (xs : Fin m → A) (i : Fin m) :
    (((List.ofFn xs).flatMap f).drop (k * i.val)).take k = f (xs i) := by
  have h := flatMap_slice f k hlen (List.ofFn xs) i.val (by simpa using i.isLt)
  simpa [List.getElem_ofFn] using h

#print axioms flatMap_slice
#print axioms ofFn_flatMap_slice

end AspisR1.FixedWidthSlice

import Mathlib.Data.List.OfFn
import Mathlib.Data.List.TakeDrop

/-! Reconstruction of a list from all of its consecutive fixed-width slices. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.FixedWidthReconstruction

theorem slices_flatten {B : Type} (bytes : List B) (k n : Nat)
    (hlen : bytes.length = n * k) :
    ((List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n => (bytes.drop (k * i.val)).take k)).flatten) = bytes := by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
      simp only [Nat.zero_mul] at hlen
      cases bytes with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons b bs => simp at hlen
  | succ n =>
      cases k with
      | zero =>
          simp only [Nat.mul_zero] at hlen
          cases bytes with
          | nil => simp
          | cons b bs => simp at hlen
      | succ k =>
          classical
          let N := (n + 1) * (k + 1)
          let f : Fin N → B := fun j => bytes.get ⟨j.val, by
            dsimp [N]
            omega⟩
          have hN : bytes.length = N := by
            dsimp [N]
            simpa [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using hlen
          have hblock (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
              (bytes.drop ((k + 1) * i.val)).take (k + 1) =
                List.ofFn (fun j : Fin (k + 1) =>
                  f ⟨(k + 1) * i.val + j.val, by
                    dsimp [N]
                    have hi : i.val + 1 ≤ n + 1 := Nat.succ_le_of_lt i.isLt
                    have hj : j.val < k + 1 := j.isLt
                    have hwindow : (k + 1) * i.val + (k + 1) ≤ (n + 1) * (k + 1) := by
                      calc
                        (k + 1) * i.val + (k + 1) = i.val * (k + 1) + (k + 1) := by rw [Nat.mul_comm]
                        _ = (i.val + 1) * (k + 1) := by rw [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul]
                        _ ≤ (n + 1) * (k + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hi
                    omega⟩) := by
            apply List.ext_getElem
            · have hi : i.val + 1 ≤ n + 1 := Nat.succ_le_of_lt i.isLt
              have hwindow : (k + 1) * i.val + (k + 1) ≤ (n + 1) * (k + 1) := by
                calc
                  (k + 1) * i.val + (k + 1) = i.val * (k + 1) + (k + 1) := by rw [Nat.mul_comm]
                  _ = (i.val + 1) * (k + 1) := by rw [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul]
                  _ ≤ (n + 1) * (k + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hi
              simp only [List.length_take, List.length_drop, List.length_ofFn]
              omega
            · intro j hj₁ hj₂
              simp only [List.getElem_take, List.getElem_drop, List.getElem_ofFn]
              simp [f]
          have hblocks :
              List.ofFn (fun i : Fin (n + 1) => (bytes.drop ((k + 1) * i.val)).take (k + 1)) =
                List.ofFn (fun i : Fin (n + 1) =>
                  List.ofFn (fun j : Fin (k + 1) =>
                    f ⟨(k + 1) * i.val + j.val, by
                      dsimp [N]
                      have hi : i.val + 1 ≤ n + 1 := Nat.succ_le_of_lt i.isLt
                      have hj : j.val < k + 1 := j.isLt
                      have hwindow : (k + 1) * i.val + (k + 1) ≤ (n + 1) * (k + 1) := by
                        calc
                          (k + 1) * i.val + (k + 1) = i.val * (k + 1) + (k + 1) := by rw [Nat.mul_comm]
                          _ = (i.val + 1) * (k + 1) := by rw [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul]
                          _ ≤ (n + 1) * (k + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hi
                      omega⟩)) := by
            apply congrArg List.ofFn
            funext i
            exact hblock i
          calc
            (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin (n + 1) => (bytes.drop ((k + 1) * i.val)).take (k + 1))).flatten =
                (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin (n + 1) =>
                  List.ofFn (fun j : Fin (k + 1) =>
                    f ⟨(k + 1) * i.val + j.val, by
                      dsimp [N]
                      have hi : i.val + 1 ≤ n + 1 := Nat.succ_le_of_lt i.isLt
                      have hj : j.val < k + 1 := j.isLt
                      have hwindow : (k + 1) * i.val + (k + 1) ≤ (n + 1) * (k + 1) := by
                        calc
                          (k + 1) * i.val + (k + 1) = i.val * (k + 1) + (k + 1) := by rw [Nat.mul_comm]
                          _ = (i.val + 1) * (k + 1) := by rw [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul]
                          _ ≤ (n + 1) * (k + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hi
                      omega⟩))).flatten := by rw [hblocks]
            _ = List.ofFn f := by simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using (List.ofFn_mul f).symm
            _ = bytes := by
              apply List.ext_getElem
              · simp [hN, N, Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one]
                omega
              · intro i hi₁ hi₂
                simp only [List.getElem_ofFn]
                simp [f, hN]

#print axioms slices_flatten

end AspisR1.FixedWidthReconstruction

import R1RetainedFieldByteCodec

/-! A strict byte-model codec for two consecutive 16-byte QM31 encodings.
This file reuses the existing strict QM31 decoder and does not claim source
parser correspondence or any arithmetic property of a wide field. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.StrictWideByteCodec

open AspisR1.RetainedFieldByteCodec

abbrev WideBytes := Fin 32 → Byte
abbrev WideLimbs := QM31Limbs × QM31Limbs

def lowBytes (bytes : WideBytes) : QM31Bytes :=
  fun i => bytes (Fin.castAdd 16 i)

def highBytes (bytes : WideBytes) : QM31Bytes :=
  fun i => bytes (Fin.natAdd 16 i)

def encodeWideLE (limbs : WideLimbs) : WideBytes :=
  Fin.append (encodeQM31LE limbs.1) (encodeQM31LE limbs.2)

def decodeWideLE (bytes : WideBytes) : Option WideLimbs := do
  let lo ← decodeQM31LE (lowBytes bytes)
  let hi ← decodeQM31LE (highBytes bytes)
  some (lo, hi)

theorem decodeWideLE_encodeWideLE (limbs : WideLimbs) :
    decodeWideLE (encodeWideLE limbs) = some limbs := by
  rcases limbs with ⟨lo, hi⟩
  have hlo : lowBytes (encodeWideLE (lo, hi)) = encodeQM31LE lo := by
    funext i
    exact Fin.append_left _ _ _
  have hhi : highBytes (encodeWideLE (lo, hi)) = encodeQM31LE hi := by
    funext i
    exact Fin.append_right _ _ _
  simp [decodeWideLE, hlo, hhi, decodeQM31LE_encodeQM31LE]

theorem successful_halves (bytes : WideBytes) (limbs : WideLimbs)
    (h : decodeWideLE bytes = some limbs) :
    decodeQM31LE (lowBytes bytes) = some limbs.1 ∧
      decodeQM31LE (highBytes bytes) = some limbs.2 := by
  rcases limbs with ⟨lo, hi⟩
  unfold decodeWideLE at h
  cases hlo : decodeQM31LE (lowBytes bytes) <;>
    cases hhi : decodeQM31LE (highBytes bytes) <;>
    simp_all

theorem encodeWideLE_of_decodeWideLE (bytes : WideBytes) (limbs : WideLimbs)
    (h : decodeWideLE bytes = some limbs) :
    encodeWideLE limbs = bytes := by
  rcases limbs with ⟨lo, hi⟩
  obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := successful_halves bytes (lo, hi) h
  have hlo' := encodeQM31LE_of_decodeQM31LE (lowBytes bytes) lo hlo
  have hhi' := encodeQM31LE_of_decodeQM31LE (highBytes bytes) hi hhi
  funext i
  by_cases hlow : i.val < 16
  · let j : Fin 16 := ⟨i.val, hlow⟩
    have hi' : i = Fin.castAdd 16 j := Fin.ext rfl
    rw [hi']
    change Fin.append (encodeQM31LE lo) (encodeQM31LE hi)
        (Fin.castAdd 16 j) = bytes (Fin.castAdd 16 j)
    calc
      Fin.append (encodeQM31LE lo) (encodeQM31LE hi) (Fin.castAdd 16 j) =
          encodeQM31LE lo j := Fin.append_left _ _ _
      _ = bytes (Fin.castAdd 16 j) := congrFun hlo' j
  · let j : Fin 16 := ⟨i.val - 16, by omega⟩
    have hi' : i = Fin.natAdd 16 j := by
      apply Fin.ext
      change (i : Nat) = 16 + (j : Nat)
      dsimp [j]
      omega
    rw [hi']
    change Fin.append (encodeQM31LE lo) (encodeQM31LE hi)
        (Fin.natAdd 16 j) = bytes (Fin.natAdd 16 j)
    calc
      Fin.append (encodeQM31LE lo) (encodeQM31LE hi) (Fin.natAdd 16 j) =
          encodeQM31LE hi j := Fin.append_right _ _ _
      _ = bytes (Fin.natAdd 16 j) := congrFun hhi' j

#print axioms decodeWideLE_encodeWideLE
#print axioms encodeWideLE_of_decodeWideLE
#print axioms successful_halves

end AspisR1.StrictWideByteCodec
R1RetainedFieldByteCodec:
import Mathlib.Tactic

/-! Verbatim retained byte and field codec declarations. Their source pins and the only permitted namespace qualification replacement are checked by tools/retain-field-byte-codec.py. This is a retained model interface, not a new source correspondence proof. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.RetainedFieldByteCodec

abbrev rawCandidateCount : Nat := 2 ^ 31
abbrev rawWordCount : Nat := 2 ^ 32
abbrev m31Modulus : Nat := rawCandidateCount - 1
abbrev RawWord := Fin rawWordCount
abbrev M31Value := Fin m31Modulus
abbrev qm31LimbCount : Nat := 4
abbrev QM31Limbs := Fin qm31LimbCount → M31Value

abbrev Byte := Fin 256
abbrev WordBytes := Fin 4 → Byte
abbrev QM31Bytes := Fin 16 → Byte

private def byteMod (n : Nat) : Byte :=
  ⟨n % 256, Nat.mod_lt _ (by norm_num)⟩

/-- Four little-endian bytes of one mathematical `u32`. -/
def encodeWordLE (word : RawWord) : WordBytes :=
  ![byteMod word,
    byteMod ((word : Nat) / 256),
    byteMod ((word : Nat) / 65536),
    byteMod ((word : Nat) / 16777216)]

/-- Reassemble four little-endian bytes into one mathematical `u32`. -/
def decodeWordLE (bytes : WordBytes) : RawWord :=
  ⟨(bytes 0 : Nat) + 256 * (bytes 1 : Nat) +
      65536 * (bytes 2 : Nat) + 16777216 * (bytes 3 : Nat), by
    have h0 := (bytes 0).isLt
    have h1 := (bytes 1).isLt
    have h2 := (bytes 2).isLt
    have h3 := (bytes 3).isLt
    norm_num [rawWordCount] at *
    omega⟩

/-- The mathematical `u32` little-endian codec round trips exactly. -/
theorem decodeWordLE_encodeWordLE (word : RawWord) :
    decodeWordLE (encodeWordLE word) = word := by
  apply Fin.ext
  simp only [decodeWordLE, encodeWordLE, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
    Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.cons_val_three,
    Fin.val_mk, byteMod]
  have hword := word.isLt
  norm_num [rawWordCount] at hword ⊢
  omega

/-- Canonically embed one accepted M31 residue in a mathematical `u32`. -/
def m31AsRawWord (value : M31Value) : RawWord :=
  ⟨value, lt_trans value.isLt (by
    norm_num [m31Modulus, rawCandidateCount, rawWordCount])⟩

def encodeM31LE (value : M31Value) : WordBytes :=
  encodeWordLE (m31AsRawWord value)

/-- Canonical Rust-style M31 decoder: reject a `u32` at or above `P`. -/
def decodeM31LE (bytes : WordBytes) : Option M31Value :=
  let word := decodeWordLE bytes
  if h : (word : Nat) < m31Modulus then some ⟨word, h⟩ else none

theorem decodeM31LE_encodeM31LE (value : M31Value) :
    decodeM31LE (encodeM31LE value) = some value := by
  have hround : decodeWordLE (encodeM31LE value) = m31AsRawWord value :=
    decodeWordLE_encodeWordLE _
  have hlt : ((decodeWordLE (encodeM31LE value) : RawWord) : Nat) < m31Modulus := by
    rw [hround]
    exact value.isLt
  unfold decodeM31LE
  rw [dif_pos hlt]
  apply congrArg some
  apply Fin.ext
  calc
    ((decodeWordLE (encodeM31LE value) : RawWord) : Nat) =
        (m31AsRawWord value : Nat) := congrArg Fin.val hround
    _ = (value : Nat) := rfl

/-- Byte offset `byte + 4*limb`.  Thus limbs `0,1,2,3` occupy byte ranges
`0..4`, `4..8`, `8..12`, `12..16`, exactly Rust's
`(c0.a,c0.b,c1.a,c1.b)` order. -/
def limbByteIndex (limb byte : Fin 4) : Fin 16 :=
  finProdFinEquiv (limb, byte)

@[simp] theorem limbByteIndex_val (limb byte : Fin 4) :
    (limbByteIndex limb byte : Nat) = (byte : Nat) + 4 * (limb : Nat) := rfl

/-- Encode four limbs consecutively in the pinned tower order. -/
def encodeQM31LE (limbs : QM31Limbs) : QM31Bytes :=
  fun offset =>
    let position : Fin 4 × Fin 4 := finProdFinEquiv.symm offset
    encodeM31LE (limbs position.1) position.2

/-- Extract the four bytes belonging to one pinned limb. -/
def qm31LimbBytes (bytes : QM31Bytes) (limb : Fin 4) : WordBytes :=
  fun byte => bytes (limbByteIndex limb byte)

@[simp] theorem qm31LimbBytes_encodeQM31LE (limbs : QM31Limbs) (limb : Fin 4) :
    qm31LimbBytes (encodeQM31LE limbs) limb = encodeM31LE (limbs limb) := by
  funext byte
  simp [qm31LimbBytes, encodeQM31LE, limbByteIndex]

/-- Decode four consecutive canonical M31 words.  Any noncanonical limb is
rejected, just as `QM31::from_le_bytes` rejects through its nested M31
decoders. -/
def decodeQM31LE (bytes : QM31Bytes) : Option QM31Limbs :=
  if h : ∀ limb, ((decodeWordLE (qm31LimbBytes bytes limb) : RawWord) : Nat) <
      m31Modulus then
    some (fun limb => ⟨decodeWordLE (qm31LimbBytes bytes limb), h limb⟩)
  else none

/-- The exact `(c0.a,c0.b,c1.a,c1.b)` 16-byte codec round trip. -/
theorem decodeQM31LE_encodeQM31LE (limbs : QM31Limbs) :
    decodeQM31LE (encodeQM31LE limbs) = some limbs := by
  have hword (limb : Fin 4) :
      decodeWordLE (qm31LimbBytes (encodeQM31LE limbs) limb) =
        m31AsRawWord (limbs limb) := by
    rw [qm31LimbBytes_encodeQM31LE]
    exact decodeWordLE_encodeWordLE _
  have hlt : ∀ limb,
      ((decodeWordLE (qm31LimbBytes (encodeQM31LE limbs) limb) : RawWord) : Nat) <
        m31Modulus := by
    intro limb
    rw [hword]
    exact (limbs limb).isLt
  unfold decodeQM31LE
  rw [dif_pos hlt]
  apply congrArg some
  funext limb
  apply Fin.ext
  calc
    ((decodeWordLE (qm31LimbBytes (encodeQM31LE limbs) limb) : RawWord) : Nat) =
        (m31AsRawWord (limbs limb) : Nat) := congrArg Fin.val (hword limb)
    _ = (limbs limb : Nat) := rfl

theorem encodeWordLE_decodeWordLE (wordBytes : WordBytes) :
    encodeWordLE (decodeWordLE wordBytes) = wordBytes := by
  have injective : Function.Injective encodeWordLE :=
    Function.LeftInverse.injective decodeWordLE_encodeWordLE
  have sameCard : Fintype.card RawWord = Fintype.card WordBytes := by
    simp [RawWord, WordBytes, rawWordCount]
  have surjective : Function.Surjective encodeWordLE :=
    ((Fintype.bijective_iff_injective_and_card encodeWordLE).2
      ⟨injective, sameCard⟩).2
  obtain ⟨word, encoded⟩ := surjective wordBytes
  rw [← encoded, decodeWordLE_encodeWordLE]

/-- Successful canonical four-limb decoding determines every input byte. -/

theorem encodeQM31LE_of_decodeQM31LE
    (encoded : AspisR1.RetainedFieldByteCodec.QM31Bytes)
    (limbs : QM31Limbs) (decoded : decodeQM31LE encoded = some limbs) :
    encodeQM31LE limbs = encoded := by
  unfold decodeQM31LE at decoded
  split at decoded
  next canonical =>
    have limbsEq := Option.some.inj decoded
    rw [← limbsEq]
    funext offset
    let position : Fin 4 × Fin 4 := finProdFinEquiv.symm offset
    have rawEq :
        m31AsRawWord
            ⟨decodeWordLE (qm31LimbBytes encoded position.1),
              canonical position.1⟩ =
          decodeWordLE (qm31LimbBytes encoded position.1) := by
      apply Fin.ext
      rfl
    change encodeM31LE
        ⟨decodeWordLE (qm31LimbBytes encoded position.1),
          canonical position.1⟩ position.2 = encoded offset
    rw [encodeM31LE, rawEq, encodeWordLE_decodeWordLE]
    change encoded (limbByteIndex position.1 position.2) = encoded offset
    congr 1
    exact (finProdFinEquiv (m := 4) (n := 4)).apply_symm_apply offset
  next noncanonical => simp at decoded

/-- A successful Tag-73 canonical decode round-trips to the literal runtime
bytes, not merely to an extension-field value with the same cardinality. -/

def fixedBytes? (width : Nat) (bytes : List Byte) :
    Option (Fin width -> Byte) :=
  if h : bytes.length = width then
    some fun index => bytes.get ⟨index, by omega⟩
  else none

def byteSlice (bytes : List Byte) (offset width : Nat) : List Byte :=
  (bytes.drop offset).take width

def decodeM31Bytes (bytes : List Byte) :=
  (fixedBytes? 4 bytes).bind
    AspisR1.RetainedFieldByteCodec.decodeM31LE

def decodeQM31Bytes (bytes : List Byte) :=
  (fixedBytes? 16 bytes).bind
    AspisR1.RetainedFieldByteCodec.decodeQM31LE

#print axioms decodeWordLE_encodeWordLE

#print axioms decodeM31LE_encodeM31LE

#print axioms decodeQM31LE_encodeQM31LE

#print axioms encodeWordLE_decodeWordLE

#print axioms encodeQM31LE_of_decodeQM31LE

#print axioms decodeQM31Bytes

end AspisR1.RetainedFieldByteCodec
