/-! Bridge pairs of retained canonical QM31 limbs to the existing exact wide
field representation and its eight-digit model. This is representation
plumbing only; it makes no claim about a Rust wide-field parser. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.WideExactLimbCodec

open AspisR1.RetainedFieldByteCodec
open AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase
open AspisWideTower

abbrev WideLimbs := AspisR1.StrictWideByteCodec.WideLimbs

def pairToExact (limbs : WideLimbs) : WideExact :=
  ⟨AspisR1.RetainedExactLimbCodec.qm31ExactLimbEquiv limbs.1,
   AspisR1.RetainedExactLimbCodec.qm31ExactLimbEquiv limbs.2⟩

def pairExactEquiv : WideLimbs ≃ WideExact :=
  (Equiv.prodCongr
    AspisR1.RetainedExactLimbCodec.qm31ExactLimbEquiv
    AspisR1.RetainedExactLimbCodec.qm31ExactLimbEquiv).trans
      (QuadraticAlgebra.equivProd wideU 0).symm

theorem pairExactEquiv_apply (limbs : WideLimbs) :
    pairExactEquiv limbs = pairToExact limbs := rfl

theorem pairExactEquiv_injective : Function.Injective pairExactEquiv :=
  pairExactEquiv.injective

@[simp] private theorem residueEquiv_natCast (x : M31Value) :
    AspisR1.RetainedExactLimbCodec.m31ResidueEquiv x =
      (x.val : M31Exact) := by
  apply ZMod.val_injective P
  change x.val = (x.val : ZMod P).val
  rw [ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt x.isLt]

private theorem retained_qm31_eq_tupleFieldEquiv (limbs : QM31Limbs) :
    AspisR1.RetainedExactLimbCodec.qm31ExactLimbEquiv limbs =
      AspisV8R19.R599CanonicalFieldTuple.tupleFieldEquiv
        (fun i : Fin 4 => ⟨(limbs i).val, by
          have h := (limbs i).isLt
          norm_num [m31Modulus, rawCandidateCount, rawWordCount,
            AspisV8R19.R445InitialBlockRejectionLaw.modulus] at h ⊢
          exact h⟩) := by
  apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext
  · apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext
    · simp [AspisR1.RetainedExactLimbCodec.qm31ExactLimbEquiv,
        AspisR1.RetainedExactLimbCodec.limbsToQM31Exact,
        residueEquiv_natCast,
        AspisV8R19.R599CanonicalFieldTuple.tupleFieldEquiv,
        AspisV8R19.R599CanonicalFieldTuple.tupleField,
        AspisV8R19.SamplerFieldDecode.decode4]
    · simp [AspisR1.RetainedExactLimbCodec.qm31ExactLimbEquiv,
        AspisR1.RetainedExactLimbCodec.limbsToQM31Exact,
        residueEquiv_natCast,
        AspisV8R19.R599CanonicalFieldTuple.tupleFieldEquiv,
        AspisV8R19.R599CanonicalFieldTuple.tupleField,
        AspisV8R19.SamplerFieldDecode.decode4]
  · apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext
    · simp [AspisR1.RetainedExactLimbCodec.qm31ExactLimbEquiv,
        AspisR1.RetainedExactLimbCodec.limbsToQM31Exact,
        residueEquiv_natCast,
        AspisV8R19.R599CanonicalFieldTuple.tupleFieldEquiv,
        AspisV8R19.R599CanonicalFieldTuple.tupleField,
        AspisV8R19.SamplerFieldDecode.decode4]
    · simp [AspisR1.RetainedExactLimbCodec.qm31ExactLimbEquiv,
        AspisR1.RetainedExactLimbCodec.limbsToQM31Exact,
        residueEquiv_natCast,
        AspisV8R19.R599CanonicalFieldTuple.tupleFieldEquiv,
        AspisV8R19.R599CanonicalFieldTuple.tupleField,
        AspisV8R19.SamplerFieldDecode.decode4]

theorem pairToExact_eq_digitsField (limbs : WideLimbs) :
    pairToExact limbs =
      R0C.ModuloField.digitsField (Fin.append limbs.1 limbs.2) := by
  rcases limbs with ⟨lo, hi⟩
  have hsplit : R0C.ModuloField.splitDigits (Fin.append lo hi) = (lo, hi) := by
    apply Prod.ext <;> funext i
    · exact Fin.append_left _ _ _
    · exact Fin.append_right _ _ _
  have hlo := retained_qm31_eq_tupleFieldEquiv lo
  have hhi := retained_qm31_eq_tupleFieldEquiv hi
  -- The eight-digit formula is the product of the two existing four-limb
  -- coordinate maps; `splitDigits` is its literal append inverse.
  unfold R0C.ModuloField.digitsField
  simp only [Equiv.trans_apply]
  rw [hsplit]
  change pairToExact (lo, hi) = _
  unfold pairToExact
  rw [hlo, hhi]
  rfl

#print axioms pairExactEquiv_apply
#print axioms pairExactEquiv_injective
#print axioms pairToExact_eq_digitsField

end AspisR1.WideExactLimbCodec

/-! Exact copied declaration block. The sole body replacement is its namespace/open resolution; source bytes are pinned in the adjacent manifest. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.RetainedExactLimbCodec

open AspisR1.RetainedFieldByteCodec
open AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase

/-! ## Literal tower coordinates -/

/-- Exact canonical-residue equivalence.  Unlike `Fintype.equivOfCardEq`,
this is the standard ring equivalence `Fin P ≃ ZMod P`. -/
def m31ResidueEquiv : M31Value ≃+* M31Exact := ZMod.finEquiv P

/-- Four canonical M31 residues in Rust field order. -/
def limbsToQM31Exact (x : QM31Limbs) : QM31Exact :=
  ⟨⟨m31ResidueEquiv (x 0), m31ResidueEquiv (x 1)⟩,
   ⟨m31ResidueEquiv (x 2), m31ResidueEquiv (x 3)⟩⟩

/-- Recover the four canonical residues in `(c0.a,c0.b,c1.a,c1.b)` order. -/
def qm31ExactToLimbs (x : QM31Exact) : QM31Limbs :=
  ![m31ResidueEquiv.symm x.re.re,
    m31ResidueEquiv.symm x.re.im,
    m31ResidueEquiv.symm x.im.re,
    m31ResidueEquiv.symm x.im.im]

@[simp] theorem qm31ExactToLimbs_limbsToQM31Exact (x : QM31Limbs) :
    qm31ExactToLimbs (limbsToQM31Exact x) = x := by
  funext j
  fin_cases j
  · simp [qm31ExactToLimbs, limbsToQM31Exact]
  · simp [qm31ExactToLimbs, limbsToQM31Exact]
  · exact congrArg x (Fin.ext rfl)
  · exact congrArg x (Fin.ext rfl)

@[simp] theorem limbsToQM31Exact_qm31ExactToLimbs (x : QM31Exact) :
    limbsToQM31Exact (qm31ExactToLimbs x) = x := by
  ext <;> simp [qm31ExactToLimbs, limbsToQM31Exact]

/-- The exact, computable four-limb equivalence. -/
def qm31ExactLimbEquiv : QM31Limbs ≃ QM31Exact where
  toFun := limbsToQM31Exact
  invFun := qm31ExactToLimbs
  left_inv := qm31ExactToLimbs_limbsToQM31Exact
  right_inv := limbsToQM31Exact_qm31ExactToLimbs

@[simp] theorem qm31ExactLimbEquiv_apply (x : QM31Limbs) :
    qm31ExactLimbEquiv x = limbsToQM31Exact x := rfl

@[simp] theorem qm31ExactLimbEquiv_symm_apply (x : QM31Exact) :
    qm31ExactLimbEquiv.symm x = qm31ExactToLimbs x := rfl

end AspisR1.RetainedExactLimbCodec

/-! List wrappers for the existing fixed-width field byte codecs. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.ListFieldCodec

open AspisR1.RetainedFieldByteCodec

theorem fixedBytes?_ofFn (n : Nat) (f : Fin n → Byte) :
    fixedBytes? n (List.ofFn f) = some f := by
  simp [fixedBytes?, List.length_ofFn]

theorem fixedBytes?_sound (n : Nat) (xs : List Byte) (f : Fin n → Byte)
    (h : fixedBytes? n xs = some f) : List.ofFn f = xs := by
  unfold fixedBytes? at h
  split at h
  · rename_i hlen
    have hfun : (fun i : Fin n => xs.get ⟨i.val, by omega⟩) = f :=
      Option.some.inj h
    subst n
    have hf : f = xs.get := by
      funext i
      exact (congrFun hfun i).symm
    rw [hf]
    exact List.ofFn_get xs
  · simp_all

def encodeM31Bytes (value : M31Value) : List Byte :=
  List.ofFn (encodeM31LE value)

def encodeQM31Bytes (limbs : QM31Limbs) : List Byte :=
  List.ofFn (encodeQM31LE limbs)

private theorem encodeM31LE_of_decodeM31LE
    (bytes : WordBytes) (value : M31Value)
    (h : decodeM31LE bytes = some value) : encodeM31LE value = bytes := by
  simp only [decodeM31LE] at h
  split at h
  · rename_i hcanonical
    have hv : (⟨decodeWordLE bytes, hcanonical⟩ : M31Value) = value :=
      Option.some.inj h
    subst value
    have hraw : m31AsRawWord ⟨decodeWordLE bytes, hcanonical⟩ = decodeWordLE bytes := by
      apply Fin.ext
      rfl
    rw [encodeM31LE, hraw, encodeWordLE_decodeWordLE]
  · simp_all

theorem decodeM31Bytes_encode (value : M31Value) :
    decodeM31Bytes (encodeM31Bytes value) = some value := by
  change (fixedBytes? 4 (List.ofFn (encodeM31LE value))).bind decodeM31LE = _
  rw [fixedBytes?_ofFn]
  exact decodeM31LE_encodeM31LE value

theorem encodeM31Bytes_of_decode (bytes : List Byte) (value : M31Value)
    (h : decodeM31Bytes bytes = some value) :
    encodeM31Bytes value = bytes := by
  unfold decodeM31Bytes at h
  cases hf : fixedBytes? 4 bytes with
  | none => simp [hf] at h
  | some wordBytes =>
      have hdecode : decodeM31LE wordBytes = some value := by
        simpa [hf] using h
      change List.ofFn (encodeM31LE value) = bytes
      rw [encodeM31LE_of_decodeM31LE wordBytes value hdecode]
      exact fixedBytes?_sound 4 bytes wordBytes hf

theorem decodeQM31Bytes_encode (limbs : QM31Limbs) :
    decodeQM31Bytes (encodeQM31Bytes limbs) = some limbs := by
  change (fixedBytes? 16 (List.ofFn (encodeQM31LE limbs))).bind decodeQM31LE = _
  rw [fixedBytes?_ofFn]
  exact decodeQM31LE_encodeQM31LE limbs

theorem encodeQM31Bytes_of_decode (bytes : List Byte) (limbs : QM31Limbs)
    (h : decodeQM31Bytes bytes = some limbs) :
    encodeQM31Bytes limbs = bytes := by
  unfold decodeQM31Bytes at h
  cases hf : fixedBytes? 16 bytes with
  | none => simp [hf] at h
  | some qmBytes =>
      have hdecode : decodeQM31LE qmBytes = some limbs := by
        simpa [hf] using h
      change List.ofFn (encodeQM31LE limbs) = bytes
      rw [encodeQM31LE_of_decodeQM31LE qmBytes limbs hdecode]
      exact fixedBytes?_sound 16 bytes qmBytes hf

#print axioms fixedBytes?_ofFn
#print axioms fixedBytes?_sound
#print axioms decodeM31Bytes_encode
#print axioms encodeM31Bytes_of_decode
#print axioms decodeQM31Bytes_encode
#print axioms encodeQM31Bytes_of_decode

/-! P6's Kani certificate connects shipped S2 to this extracted arithmetic
reference. The theorems below are kernel proofs about the extracted reference;
Kani soundness is not introduced as a Lean axiom. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.BuilderTransport
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0Z.WriterRefine

/-- The extracted machine-word reference returns D18 without wrapping. -/
theorem reference_row (j : Usize) :
    ∃ out, AspisBuilderReference.row_arithmetic j = ok out ∧
      out.val = AspisR1.rowNat j.val := by
  obtain ⟨d0, hd0, vd0⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (UScalar.rem_spec j (y := 4#usize) (by simp))
  obtain ⟨q1, hq1, vq1⟩ := UScalar.div_spec j (y := 4#usize) (by simp)
  obtain ⟨d1, hd1, vd1⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (UScalar.rem_spec q1 (y := 4#usize) (by simp))
  obtain ⟨q2, hq2, vq2⟩ := UScalar.div_spec j (y := 16#usize) (by simp)
  obtain ⟨d2, hd2, vd2⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (UScalar.rem_spec q2 (y := 4#usize) (by simp))
  obtain ⟨q3, hq3, vq3⟩ := UScalar.div_spec j (y := 64#usize) (by simp)
  obtain ⟨d3, hd3, vd3⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (UScalar.rem_spec q3 (y := 4#usize) (by simp))
  obtain ⟨q4, hq4, vq4⟩ := UScalar.div_spec j (y := 256#usize) (by simp)
  obtain ⟨d4, hd4, vd4⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (UScalar.rem_spec q4 (y := 4#usize) (by simp))
  have v0 : d0.val = j.val % 4 := by simpa using vd0
  have v1 : d1.val = (j.val / 4) % 4 := by simpa using vd1.trans (by simp [vq1])
  have v2 : d2.val = (j.val / 16) % 4 := by simpa using vd2.trans (by simp [vq2])
  have v3 : d3.val = (j.val / 64) % 4 := by simpa using vd3.trans (by simp [vq3])
  have v4 : d4.val = (j.val / 256) % 4 := by simpa using vd4.trans (by simp [vq4])
  rw [AspisBuilderReference.row_arithmetic, hd0]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
  rw [hq1]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
  rw [hd1]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
  rw [hq2]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
  rw [hd2]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
  rw [hq3]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
  rw [hd3]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
  rw [hq4]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
  rw [hd4]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
  refine ⟨_, rfl, ?_⟩
  let m0 := Usize.wrapping_mul 64#usize d0
  have vm0 : m0.val = 64 * d0.val := by
    dsimp [m0]
    rw [umul _ _ (by simp; omega)]
    simp
  let m1 := Usize.wrapping_mul 256#usize d1

import R0Z.BuilderModel
import R0P.Value
import R0P.Occupancy
import R0P.Asset

/-! Builder model, auxiliary families (t2b2b/DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL.txt §4):
value, occupancy, asset and path hold on `layout C` from local invariants of
the aux records, and on `buildModel pub w` from named witness premises.

Premises are witness facts that the Rust builder checks before it writes the
trace (design §2): conservation (pair_trace.rs:621-628/724-729), pair-leaf
validity and spendability (pair_tree_profile.rs:124-191), the withdrawal
amount, and a non-zero change sentinel for a transfer (two_outputs,
pair_tree_profile.rs:206-226; design §5). -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R0Z.BuilderModel
open R0P

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

/-! ### Value -/

theorem base_poly (v : Nat) :
    valueBaseCell (K := K) v 0 + 2 * valueBaseCell v 1 + 4 * valueBaseCell v 2 +
      8 * valueBaseCell v 3 + 16 * valueBaseCell v 4 + 32 * valueBaseCell v 5 +
      64 * valueBaseCell v 6 + 128 * valueBaseCell v 7 + 256 * valueBaseCell v 8 +
      512 * valueBaseCell v 9 = ((v % 1024 : Nat) : K) :=
  (chunk10 v).symm

theorem mid_poly (v : Nat) :
    valueMidCell (K := K) v 0 + 2 * valueMidCell v 1 + 4 * valueMidCell v 2 +
      8 * valueMidCell v 3 + 16 * valueMidCell v 4 + 32 * valueMidCell v 5 +
      64 * valueMidCell v 6 + 128 * valueMidCell v 7 + 256 * valueMidCell v 8 +
      512 * valueMidCell v 9 = ((v / 1024 % 1024 : Nat) : K) :=
  (chunk10 (v / 1024)).symm

theorem hi_poly (v : Nat) :
    valueHiCell (K := K) v 0 + 2 * valueHiCell v 1 + 4 * valueHiCell v 2 +
      8 * valueHiCell v 3 + 16 * valueHiCell v 4 + 32 * valueHiCell v 5 +
      64 * valueHiCell v 6 + 128 * valueHiCell v 7 + 256 * valueHiCell v 8 +
      512 * valueHiCell v 9 = ((v / 1048576 % 1024 : Nat) : K) :=
  (chunk10 (v / 1048576)).symm

theorem value_recon (v : Nat) (hv : v < 2 ^ 30) :
    valueBaseCell (K := K) v 10 =
      ((valueBaseCell v 0 + 2 * valueBaseCell v 1 + 4 * valueBaseCell v 2 +
        8 * valueBaseCell v 3 + 16 * valueBaseCell v 4 + 32 * valueBaseCell v 5 +
        64 * valueBaseCell v 6 + 128 * valueBaseCell v 7 + 256 * valueBaseCell v 8 +
        512 * valueBaseCell v 9) +
       (valueMidCell v 0 + 2 * valueMidCell v 1 + 4 * valueMidCell v 2 +
        8 * valueMidCell v 3 + 16 * valueMidCell v 4 + 32 * valueMidCell v 5 +
        64 * valueMidCell v 6 + 128 * valueMidCell v 7 + 256 * valueMidCell v 8 +
        512 * valueMidCell v 9) * 1024) +
       (valueHiCell v 0 + 2 * valueHiCell v 1 + 4 * valueHiCell v 2 +
        8 * valueHiCell v 3 + 16 * valueHiCell v 4 + 32 * valueHiCell v 5 +
        64 * valueHiCell v 6 + 128 * valueHiCell v 7 + 256 * valueHiCell v 8 +
        512 * valueHiCell v 9) * 1048576 := by
  rw [base_poly, mid_poly, hi_poly]
  have hv' : v < 1073741824 := hv
  have hn : v = v % 1024 + v / 1024 % 1024 * 1024 + v / 1048576 % 1024 * 1048576 := by omega
  show ((v : Nat) : K) = _
  conv_lhs => rw [hn]
  push_cast
  ring

theorem value_model_range (v : Nat) (hv : v < 2 ^ 30) :
    ∀ r ∈ valueRange (⟨valueBaseCell v, valueMidCell v, valueHiCell v⟩ : Openings K), r = 0 := by
  rw [value_range_zero_iff]
  refine ⟨fun i => ?_, fun i => ?_, fun i => ?_, value_recon v hv, rfl, rfl⟩
  · show valueBaseCell v (i.castAdd 6) = 0 ∨ valueBaseCell v (i.castAdd 6) = 1
    unfold valueBaseCell
    rw [if_pos (show (i.castAdd 6).val < 10 from i.isLt)]
    exact bitK_01 _ _
  · show valueMidCell v (i.castAdd 6) = 0 ∨ valueMidCell v (i.castAdd 6) = 1
    unfold valueMidCell
    rw [if_pos (show (i.castAdd 6).val < 10 from i.isLt)]
    exact bitK_01 _ _
  · show valueHiCell v (i.castAdd 6) = 0 ∨ valueHiCell v (i.castAdd 6) = 1
    unfold valueHiCell
    rw [if_pos (show (i.castAdd 6).val < 10 from i.isLt)]
    exact bitK_01 _ _

theorem aux_1008 (C : Cells K) : auxCell C 1008 = valueBaseCell (C.values 0) := by
  funext c; simp [auxCell]
theorem aux_1009 (C : Cells K) : auxCell C 1009 = valueMidCell (C.values 0) := by
  funext c; simp [auxCell]
theorem aux_1010 (C : Cells K) : auxCell C 1010 = valueBaseCell (C.values 1) := by
  funext c; simp [auxCell]
theorem aux_1011 (C : Cells K) : auxCell C 1011 = valueMidCell (C.values 1) := by
  funext c; simp [auxCell]
theorem aux_1012 (C : Cells K) : auxCell C 1012 = valueBaseCell (C.values 2) := by
  funext c; simp [auxCell]
theorem aux_1013 (C : Cells K) : auxCell C 1013 = valueMidCell (C.values 2) := by
  funext c; simp [auxCell]
theorem aux_1016 (C : Cells K) : auxCell C 1016 = valueHiCell (C.values 2) := by
  funext c; simp [auxCell]
theorem aux_1020 (C : Cells K) : auxCell C 1020 = valueHiCell (C.values 0) := by
  funext c; simp [auxCell]
theorem aux_1022 (C : Cells K) : auxCell C 1022 = valueHiCell (C.values 1) := by
  funext c; simp [auxCell]
theorem aux_1017 (C : Cells K) : auxCell C 1017 = occCell C.inOcc := by
  funext c; simp [auxCell]
theorem aux_1018 (C : Cells K) : auxCell C 1018 = occCell C.outOcc := by
  funext c; simp [auxCell]

/-- Value family on the layout: every value below 2^30 and v0 = v1 + v2. -/
theorem value_layout (pub : Public K) (C : Cells K) (hv : ∀ j, C.values j < 2 ^ 30)
    (hcons : C.values 0 = C.values 1 + C.values 2) : Holds valueFamily pub (layout C) := by
  rw [value_holds_rows_iff]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro b hb
    rcases hb with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · rw [rowOpenings_aux C _ (by decide) (by decide) (by decide),
        show (succRow (1008 : Fin 1024)).val = 1009 from rfl,
        show (xor12Row (1008 : Fin 1024)).val = 1020 by decide,
        show (1008 : Fin 1024).val = 1008 from rfl, aux_1008, aux_1009, aux_1020]
      exact value_model_range _ (hv 0)
    · rw [rowOpenings_aux C _ (by decide) (by decide) (by decide),
        show (succRow (1010 : Fin 1024)).val = 1011 from rfl,
        show (xor12Row (1010 : Fin 1024)).val = 1022 by decide,
        show (1010 : Fin 1024).val = 1010 from rfl, aux_1010, aux_1011, aux_1022]
      exact value_model_range _ (hv 1)
    · rw [rowOpenings_aux C _ (by decide) (by decide) (by decide),
        show (succRow (1012 : Fin 1024)).val = 1013 from rfl,
        show (xor12Row (1012 : Fin 1024)).val = 1016 by decide,
        show (1012 : Fin 1024).val = 1012 from rfl, aux_1012, aux_1013, aux_1016]
      exact value_model_range _ (hv 2)
  · rw [layout_aux C 0 1014 (by decide) (by decide), layout_aux C 1 1014 (by decide) (by decide),
      layout_aux C 2 1014 (by decide) (by decide)]
    simp [auxCell]
  · rw [layout_aux C 0 1015 (by decide) (by decide), layout_aux C 1 1015 (by decide) (by decide)]
    simp only [auxCell, Fin.isValue]
    simp only [show ¬ (912 ≤ (1015 : Fin 1024).val ∧ (1015 : Fin 1024).val < 1008) by decide,
      show (1015 : Fin 1024).val = 1015 from rfl, dite_false]
    norm_num
    rw [hcons]
    push_cast
    ring

/-! ### Occupancy -/

/-- The row-local occupancy equations (PairLeaf.Valid, V7PairLeafOccupancy.lean:44). -/
def OccValid (o : OccAux K) : Prop :=
  o.occupied * (o.occupied - 1) = 0 ∧ o.commitment 7 * o.inverse - o.occupied = 0 ∧
    (1 - o.occupied) * o.inverse = 0 ∧ ∀ lane : Fin 8, (1 - o.occupied) * o.commitment lane = 0

theorem occCell_lane (o : OccAux K) (lane : Fin 8) (h : 2 + lane.val < 16) :
    occCell o ⟨2 + lane.val, h⟩ = o.commitment lane := by
  unfold occCell
  rw [if_neg (by simp), if_neg (by simp; omega), dif_pos (by simp; omega)]
  congr 1
  exact Fin.ext (by simp)

theorem occ_rows (C : Cells K) (b : Fin 1024) (o : OccAux K) (hb : auxCell C b.val = occCell o)
    (hb57 : 57 ≤ b.val / 16) (ho : OccValid o) :
    layout C 0 b * (layout C 0 b - 1) = 0 ∧
      layout C 9 b * layout C 1 b - layout C 0 b = 0 ∧
      (1 - layout C 0 b) * layout C 1 b = 0 ∧
      ∀ lane : Fin 8, (1 - layout C 0 b) * layout C ⟨2 + lane.val, by omega⟩ b = 0 := by
  have e : ∀ (c : Fin 29) (hc : c.val < 16), layout C c b = occCell o ⟨c.val, hc⟩ := by
    intro c hc
    rw [layout_aux C c b hc hb57, hb]
  rw [e 0 (by decide), e 9 (by decide), e 1 (by decide)]
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := ho
  refine ⟨h1, h2, h3, fun lane => ?_⟩
  rw [e _ (by simp; omega)]
  have hl := occCell_lane o lane (by omega)
  simp only at hl ⊢
  rw [hl]
  exact h4 lane

theorem occupancy_layout (pub : Public K) (C : Cells K) (hin : OccValid C.inOcc)
    (hout : OccValid C.outOcc) (hsel : C.inOcc.selected * (1 - C.inOcc.occupied) = 0)
    (hvar : C.outOcc.occupied = occupancyExpected pub.variant) :
    Holds occupancyFamily pub (layout C) := by
  rw [occupancy_holds_iff]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro b hb
    rcases hb with rfl | rfl
    · exact occ_rows C 1017 C.inOcc (aux_1017 C) (by decide) hin
    · exact occ_rows C 1018 C.outOcc (aux_1018 C) (by decide) hout
  · rw [layout_aux C 10 1017 (by decide) (by decide), layout_aux C 0 1017 (by decide) (by decide),
      show (1017 : Fin 1024).val = 1017 from rfl, aux_1017]
    exact hsel
  · rw [layout_aux C 0 1018 (by decide) (by decide), show (1018 : Fin 1024).val = 1018 from rfl,
      aux_1018]
    show C.outOcc.occupied = _
    rw [hvar]
    cases pub.variant <;> rfl

/-! ### Path -/

/-- The row-local path equations (path_holds_iff, Path.lean). -/
def PathValid (p : PathAux K) : Prop :=
  p.bit * (p.bit - 1) = 0 ∧ (∀ i : Fin 8, (1 - p.bit) * (p.left i - p.current i) = 0) ∧
    (∀ i : Fin 8, p.bit * (p.right i - p.current i) = 0)

theorem pathBaseCell_cur (p : PathAux K) (c : Fin 16) (i : Fin 8) (hc : c.val = i.val + 1) :
    pathBaseCell p c = p.current i := by
  unfold pathBaseCell
  rw [if_neg (by omega), dif_pos (by omega)]
  congr 1
  exact Fin.ext (by simp; omega)

theorem pathSuccCell_left (p : PathAux K) (c : Fin 16) (i : Fin 8) (hc : c.val = i.val) :
    pathSuccCell p c = p.left i := by
  unfold pathSuccCell
  rw [dif_pos (by omega)]
  congr 1
  exact Fin.ext (by simp; omega)

theorem pathSuccCell_right (p : PathAux K) (c : Fin 16) (i : Fin 8) (hc : c.val = 8 + i.val) :
    pathSuccCell p c = p.right i := by
  unfold pathSuccCell
  rw [dif_neg (by omega)]
  congr 1
  exact Fin.ext (by simp; omega)

theorem path_layout (pub : Public K) (C : Cells K) (hp : ∀ l, PathValid (C.path l)) :
    Holds pathFamily pub (layout C) := by
  rw [path_holds_iff]
  intro b hb
  obtain ⟨hlo, hhi, hloc⟩ := hb
  have hb1 : 912 ≤ b.val ∧ b.val < 1008 := by omega
  have hsv : (succRow b).val = b.val + 1 := by
    show (b.val + 1) % 1024 = b.val + 1
    omega
  let l : Fin 24 := ⟨4 * ((b.val - 912) / 16) + b.val % 16 / 4, by omega⟩
  have eb : ∀ (c : Fin 29) (hc : c.val < 16),
      layout C c b = pathBaseCell (C.path l) ⟨c.val, hc⟩ := by
    intro c hc
    rw [layout_aux C c b hc (by omega)]
    unfold auxCell
    rw [dif_pos hb1, if_pos (by omega)]
  have es : ∀ (c : Fin 29) (hc : c.val < 16),
      layout C c (succRow b) = pathSuccCell (C.path l) ⟨c.val, hc⟩ := by
    intro c hc
    rw [layout_aux C c (succRow b) hc (by omega), hsv]
    unfold auxCell
    rw [dif_pos (show 912 ≤ b.val + 1 ∧ b.val + 1 < 1008 by omega),
      if_neg (show ¬ ((b.val + 1) % 16 % 4 = 1) by omega),
      if_pos (show (b.val + 1) % 16 % 4 = 2 by omega)]
    exact congrArg (fun p : Fin 24 => pathSuccCell (C.path p) ⟨c.val, hc⟩)
      (Fin.ext (show 4 * ((b.val + 1 - 912) / 16) + (b.val + 1) % 16 / 4 =
        4 * ((b.val - 912) / 16) + b.val % 16 / 4 by omega))
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hp l
  have e0 : layout C 0 b = (C.path l).bit := by rw [eb 0 (by decide)]; rfl
  refine ⟨?_, fun i => ?_, fun i => ?_⟩
  · rw [e0]; exact h1
  · rw [e0, es _ (by simp; omega), eb _ (by simp; omega),
      pathSuccCell_left _ _ i (by simp), pathBaseCell_cur _ _ i (by simp)]
    exact h2 i
  · rw [e0, es _ (by simp; omega), eb _ (by simp; omega),
      pathSuccCell_right _ _ i (by simp <;> omega), pathBaseCell_cur _ _ i (by simp)]
    exact h3 i

/-! ### The model's aux records satisfy the local invariants -/

theorem pathAuxOf_valid (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (l : Fin 24) :
    PathValid (pathAuxOf pub w l) := by
  unfold PathValid pathAuxOf
  cases (w.path l).1 <;> simp [dirK, ordered]

/-- The witness-side premises of the aux families. -/
structure AuxPremises (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) : Prop where
  conservation : w.inputValue.val = w.outputValue.val + w.changeValue.val
  pairValid : OccValid (inOccOf w)
  spendable : dirK (w.path 0).1 * (1 - w.pairOccupied) = 0
  changeSentinel : pub.variant = .privateTransfer → changeDigest pub w 7 ≠ 0
  amount : pub.variant = .withdrawal → ∀ a, pub.withdrawalAmount = some a →
    a = (w.outputValue.val : K)

theorem outOccOf_valid (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K)
    (hs : pub.variant = .privateTransfer → changeDigest pub w 7 ≠ 0) :
    OccValid (outOccOf pub w) := by
  unfold OccValid outOccOf
  cases hv : pub.variant
  · have h7 := hs hv
    simp only
    refine ⟨by ring, by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ h7]; ring, by ring, fun lane => by ring⟩
  · simp

theorem value_model (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K)
    (hc : w.inputValue.val = w.outputValue.val + w.changeValue.val) :
    Holds valueFamily pub (buildModel pub w) :=
  value_layout pub _ (fun j => by
    show valuesOf w j < 2 ^ 30
    fin_cases j
    · exact w.inputValue.isLt
    · exact w.outputValue.isLt
    · exact w.changeValue.isLt) hc

theorem occupancy_model (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (hP : AuxPremises pub w) :
    Holds occupancyFamily pub (buildModel pub w) :=
  occupancy_layout pub _ hP.pairValid (outOccOf_valid pub w hP.changeSentinel) hP.spendable
    (by show (outOccOf pub w).occupied = _
        unfold outOccOf occupancyExpected
        cases pub.variant <;> rfl)

theorem path_model (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) :
    Holds pathFamily pub (buildModel pub w) :=
  path_layout pub _ (pathAuxOf_valid pub w)

theorem asset_model (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K)
    (ha : pub.variant = .withdrawal → ∀ a, pub.withdrawalAmount = some a →
      a = (w.outputValue.val : K)) :
    Holds assetFamily pub (buildModel pub w) := by
  rw [asset_holds_iff]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, fun hv => ?_, fun hv a hwa => ?_⟩
  · rw [buildModel, layout_block _ 1 44 (by decide) 2 (by decide)]
    rfl
  · rw [buildModel, layout_block _ 1 508 (by decide) 31 (by decide)]
    rfl
  · rw [buildModel, layout_block _ 1 460 (by decide) 28 (by decide)]
    show (recipB pub w 1).absorb ⟨1, by decide⟩ = pub.assetId
    unfold recipB
    rw [hv]
    rfl
  · rw [buildModel, layout_aux _ 10 1010 (by decide) (by decide),
      show (1010 : Fin 1024).val = 1010 from rfl, aux_1010]
    rw [ha hv a hwa]
    rfl

R0Z.BuilderModel:
import R0P.Poseidon
import R0P.EmptyRoots

/-! A Lean model of the honest pair-forest builder (t2b2b/DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL.txt §3).

The model follows the Rust stages (design §1):
* Stage B: 57 Poseidon blocks.  A block is its pre-absorption state and its
  absorption (`BlockIn`); local rows 1..11 are the canonical two-round
  transitions `poseidonTransition` (R0P), row 12 is the absorption, rows
  13..15 are zero (write_permutation / write_sponge, pair_trace.rs:268-354).
* Stage A: the forest path aux rows (pair_forest_trace.rs:142-159, rows
  912..1007), the value aux rows 1008..1016/1020/1022 and the occupancy rows
  1017/1018 (pair_trace.rs:401-468, relocated +48 by pair_forest_trace.rs:225).
* Stage M: the bank merge is the placement of blocks 34..53 (rows 544..863).
* Stage W: `cellsOf pub w` computes every block and aux record from a
  Wspend-shaped witness `ModelWitness` and the public input.
Columns 16..28 are zero (mask-only C1 and the extension columns are not read
by NonCopyHolds or CopyLinkBalance).

The witness relation is NOT fixed here; per-family theorems take named
premises (BuilderModelAux, BuilderModelHash). -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R0Z.BuilderModel
open R0P

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

/-! ### Stage B: Poseidon blocks -/

/-- One permutation block: local row 0 and local row 12. -/
structure BlockIn (K : Type) where
  pre : Fin 16 → K
  absorb : Fin 16 → K

/-- Local rows 0..11 of a block: row 0 is the pre-state, row n+1 is the
canonical transition of row n with the absorption (R0P Poseidon.lean:315). -/
def blockIter (b : BlockIn K) : Nat → Fin 16 → K
  | 0 => b.pre
  | n + 1 => if h : n < 11 then poseidonTransition ⟨n, h⟩ (blockIter b n) b.absorb
      else blockIter b n

/-- The final state (local row 11). -/
def blockOut (b : BlockIn K) : Fin 16 → K := blockIter b 11

/-- The returned digest: the first eight lanes of the final state. -/
def blockDigest (b : BlockIn K) : Digest K := fun i => blockOut b (i.castAdd 8)

/-- The cell of a block at local row `l`, lane `c`. -/
def blockCell (b : BlockIn K) (l : Nat) (c : Fin 16) : K :=
  if l < 12 then blockIter b l c else if l = 12 then b.absorb c else 0

/-- A digest in lanes 0..7, zero in lanes 8..15. -/
def lo8 (d : Digest K) : Fin 16 → K := fun l => if h : l.val < 8 then d ⟨l.val, h⟩ else 0

/-- hash_fields_with_trace (poseidon2.rs:511-529): state[8] = domain,
state[9] = input length, everything else zero. -/
def spongeInit (dom len : K) : Fin 16 → K := fun l =>
  if l.val = 8 then dom else if l.val = 9 then len else 0

/-- write_node (pair_trace.rs:356-366): pre = [0^8, right, right[7] + tweak],
absorption = left. -/
def nodeIn (left right : Digest K) : BlockIn K :=
  ⟨fun l => if l.val < 8 then 0 else if l.val = 15 then right 7 + (0x4153_1005 : K)
      else right ⟨l.val - 8, by have := l.isLt; omega⟩, lo8 left⟩

/-- pair_trace.rs:368-375. -/
def ordered (cur sib : Digest K) (bit : Bool) : Digest K × Digest K :=
  if bit then (sib, cur) else (cur, sib)

/-- The 0/1 direction cell. -/
def dirK (b : Bool) : K := if b then 1 else 0

/-! ### Stage A: auxiliary records and their cells -/

structure PathAux (K : Type) where
  bit : K
  current : Digest K
  left : Digest K
  right : Digest K

structure OccAux (K : Type) where
  occupied : K
  inverse : K
  commitment : Digest K
  selected : K

/-- The builder's cell content before placement. -/
structure Cells (K : Type) where
  blocks : Fin 57 → BlockIn K
  path : Fin 24 → PathAux K
  values : Fin 3 → Nat
  inOcc : OccAux K
  outOcc : OccAux K

/-- Bit `i` of `n` as a field cell.  `bitK_eq_shift` is the Rust form
`M31((raw >> bit) & 1)` (pair_trace.rs:404-412). -/
def bitK (n i : Nat) : K := ((n / 2 ^ i % 2 : Nat) : K)

/-- Value base row (1008 + 2j): bits 0..9 of v, raw v in column 10. -/
def valueBaseCell (v : Nat) (c : Fin 16) : K :=
  if c.val < 10 then bitK v c.val else if c.val = 10 then (v : K) else 0

/-- Value successor row (1009 + 2j): bits 10..19. -/
def valueMidCell (v : Nat) (c : Fin 16) : K :=
  if c.val < 10 then bitK (v / 1024) c.val else 0

/-- Value xor-12 row (1020, 1022, 1016): bits 20..29. -/
def valueHiCell (v : Nat) (c : Fin 16) : K :=
  if c.val < 10 then bitK (v / 1048576) c.val else 0

/-- write_occupancy (pair_trace.rs:439-468). -/
def occCell (o : OccAux K) (c : Fin 16) : K :=
  if c.val = 0 then o.occupied else if c.val = 1 then o.inverse
  else if h : c.val < 10 then o.commitment ⟨c.val - 2, by omega⟩
  else if c.val = 10 then o.selected else 0

/-- write_forest_path_aux base row (pair_forest_trace.rs:152-154). -/
def pathBaseCell (p : PathAux K) (c : Fin 16) : K :=
  if c.val = 0 then p.bit else if h : c.val < 9 then p.current ⟨c.val - 1, by omega⟩ else 0

/-- write_forest_path_aux successor row (pair_forest_trace.rs:155-156). -/
def pathSuccCell (p : PathAux K) (c : Fin 16) : K :=
  if h : c.val < 8 then p.left ⟨c.val, h⟩ else p.right ⟨c.val - 8, by have := c.isLt; omega⟩

/-- Rows 912..1023 (blocks 57..63). -/
def auxCell (C : Cells K) (r : Nat) (c : Fin 16) : K :=
  if h : 912 ≤ r ∧ r < 1008 then
    if r % 16 % 4 = 1 then
      pathBaseCell (C.path ⟨4 * ((r - 912) / 16) + r % 16 / 4, by omega⟩) c
    else if r % 16 % 4 = 2 then
      pathSuccCell (C.path ⟨4 * ((r - 912) / 16) + r % 16 / 4, by omega⟩) c
    else 0
  else if r = 1008 then valueBaseCell (C.values 0) c
  else if r = 1009 then valueMidCell (C.values 0) c
  else if r = 1010 then valueBaseCell (C.values 1) c
  else if r = 1011 then valueMidCell (C.values 1) c
  else if r = 1012 then valueBaseCell (C.values 2) c
  else if r = 1013 then valueMidCell (C.values 2) c
  else if r = 1014 then
    (if c.val = 0 then (C.values 0 : K) else if c.val = 1 then (C.values 1 : K)
      else if c.val = 2 then (C.values 0 : K) - (C.values 1 : K) else 0)
  else if r = 1015 then
    (if c.val = 0 then (C.values 0 : K) - (C.values 1 : K)
      else if c.val = 1 then (C.values 2 : K) else 0)
  else if r = 1016 then valueHiCell (C.values 2) c
  else if r = 1017 then occCell C.inOcc c
  else if r = 1018 then occCell C.outOcc c
  else if r = 1020 then valueHiCell (C.values 0) c
  else if r = 1022 then valueHiCell (C.values 1) c
  else 0

/-! ### Placement (stages B, A, M) -/

/-- The 29-column trace: blocks 0..56 in rows 0..911, aux rows above,
columns 16..28 zero. -/
def layout (C : Cells K) : Trace K := fun c r =>
  if hc : c.val < 16 then
    if hb : r.val / 16 < 57 then blockCell (C.blocks ⟨r.val / 16, hb⟩) (r.val % 16) ⟨c.val, hc⟩
    else auxCell C r.val ⟨c.val, hc⟩
  else 0

theorem layout_aux (C : Cells K) (c : Fin 29) (r : Fin 1024) (hc : c.val < 16)
    (hr : 57 ≤ r.val / 16) : layout C c r = auxCell C r.val ⟨c.val, hc⟩ := by
  unfold layout
  rw [dif_pos hc, dif_neg (by omega)]

theorem layout_block (C : Cells K) (c : Fin 29) (r : Fin 1024) (hc : c.val < 16)
    (h : Fin 57) (hr : r.val / 16 = h.val) :
    layout C c r = blockCell (C.blocks h) (r.val % 16) ⟨c.val, hc⟩ := by
  have h57 := h.isLt
  unfold layout
  rw [dif_pos hc, dif_pos (by omega)]
  have he : (⟨r.val / 16, by omega⟩ : Fin 57) = h := Fin.ext hr
  rw [he]

theorem layout_high (C : Cells K) (c : Fin 29) (r : Fin 1024) (hc : 16 ≤ c.val) :
    layout C c r = 0 := by
  unfold layout
  rw [dif_neg (by omega)]

/-- Openings of a row whose row, successor and xor-12 rows are all aux rows. -/
theorem rowOpenings_aux (C : Cells K) (b : Fin 1024) (hb : 57 ≤ b.val / 16)
    (hs : 57 ≤ (succRow b).val / 16) (hx : 57 ≤ (xor12Row b).val / 16) :
    rowOpenings (layout C) b =
      ⟨auxCell C b.val, auxCell C (succRow b).val, auxCell C (xor12Row b).val⟩ := by
  unfold rowOpenings
  congr 1 <;> funext c <;> exact layout_aux C _ _ c.isLt (by assumption)

/-! ### Bits -/

theorem nat_bits (k n : Nat) : n % 2 ^ k = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, n / 2 ^ i % 2 * 2 ^ i := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [Nat.mod_one]
  | succ k ih => rw [Nat.mod_pow_succ, ih, Finset.sum_range_succ]; ring

theorem bitK_01 (n i : Nat) : bitK (K := K) n i = 0 ∨ bitK (K := K) n i = 1 := by
  unfold bitK
  rcases Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one (n / 2 ^ i) with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> simp

/-- Rust form of the bit cells (pair_trace.rs:404-412, `(raw >> bit) & 1`). -/
theorem bitK_eq_shift (n i : Nat) : bitK (K := K) n i = ((n >>> i &&& 1 : Nat) : K) := by
  unfold bitK
  rw [Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow, Nat.and_one_is_mod]

theorem bitK_mid (n i : Nat) : bitK (K := K) (n / 1024) i = bitK (K := K) n (10 + i) := by
  unfold bitK
  rw [Nat.pow_add, ← Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul]

theorem bitK_hi (n i : Nat) : bitK (K := K) (n / 1048576) i = bitK (K := K) n (20 + i) := by
  unfold bitK
  rw [Nat.pow_add, ← Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul]

/-- Ten-bit reconstruction in the literal order of R0P `valueReconstruct10`. -/
theorem chunk10 (n : Nat) : ((n % 1024 : Nat) : K) =
    bitK n 0 + 2 * bitK n 1 + 4 * bitK n 2 + 8 * bitK n 3 + 16 * bitK n 4 +
      32 * bitK n 5 + 64 * bitK n 6 + 128 * bitK n 7 + 256 * bitK n 8 + 512 * bitK n 9 := by
  have h : n % 1024 = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range 10, n / 2 ^ i % 2 * 2 ^ i := nat_bits 10 n
  rw [h]
  push_cast
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, bitK]
  ring

/-! ### Stage W: the witness and the computed cells -/

/-- Wspend-shaped witness (SpendRelation.lean:15 on the spend path), with the
pair leaf unfolded into its four fields. -/
structure ModelWitness (K : Type) where
  inputValue : Fin (2 ^ 30)
  outputValue : Fin (2 ^ 30)
  changeValue : Fin (2 ^ 30)
  sk : Digest K
  salt : Digest K
  path : Fin 24 → Bool × Digest K
  pairFirst : Digest K
  pairOccupied : K
  pairSecond : Digest K
  pairInverse : K
  recipientOwner : Digest K
  recipientSalt : Digest K
  changeOwner : Digest K
  changeSalt : Digest K

/-- Note chunk 1 (note_input[8..16)): value, asset, salt[0..6). -/
def noteC2 (value asset : K) (salt : Digest K) : Fin 16 → K := fun l =>
  if l.val = 0 then value else if l.val = 1 then asset
  else if h : l.val < 8 then salt ⟨l.val - 2, by omega⟩ else 0

/-- Note chunk 2 (note_input[16..18)): salt[6], salt[7]. -/
def noteC3 (salt : Digest K) : Fin 16 → K := fun l =>
  if l.val = 0 then salt 6 else if l.val = 1 then salt 7 else 0

def noteB0 (owner : Digest K) : BlockIn K := ⟨spongeInit 0x4153_0003 18, lo8 owner⟩
def noteB1 (owner : Digest K) (value asset : K) (salt : Digest K) : BlockIn K :=
  ⟨blockOut (noteB0 owner), noteC2 value asset salt⟩
def noteB2 (owner : Digest K) (value asset : K) (salt : Digest K) : BlockIn K :=
  ⟨blockOut (noteB1 owner value asset salt), noteC3 salt⟩
def noteDigest (owner : Digest K) (value asset : K) (salt : Digest K) : Digest K :=
  blockDigest (noteB2 owner value asset salt)

variable (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K)

def ownerB : BlockIn K := ⟨spongeInit 0x4153_0001 8, lo8 w.sk⟩
def ownerDigest : Digest K := blockDigest (ownerB w)
def nulB0 : BlockIn K := ⟨spongeInit 0x4153_0002 16, lo8 w.sk⟩
def nulB1 : BlockIn K := ⟨blockOut (nulB0 w), lo8 w.salt⟩
def nullifierDigest : Digest K := blockDigest (nulB1 w)

def inputLeaf : Digest K :=
  noteDigest (ownerDigest w) (w.inputValue.val : K) pub.assetId w.salt

/-- Membership node at level l (blocks 4..24 and 54..56). -/
def treeNode (cur : Digest K) (l : Fin 24) : BlockIn K :=
  nodeIn (ordered cur (w.path l).2 (w.path l).1).1 (ordered cur (w.path l).2 (w.path l).1).2

/-- The running membership digest: level 0 is the input leaf. -/
def treeCur (leaf : Digest K) : Nat → Digest K
  | 0 => leaf
  | n + 1 => if h : n < 24 then blockDigest (treeNode w (treeCur leaf n) ⟨n, h⟩)
      else treeCur leaf n

/-- build_late_append (pair_trace.rs:579-586): the append bit. -/
def appBit (l : Nat) : Bool := decide (((pub.nextPairIndex >>> l) &&& 1) ≠ 0)

def emptyRootK (l : Fin 20) : Digest K := fun i => ((emptyRootsNat l.castSucc i : Nat) : K)

def appSib (l : Fin 20) : Digest K :=
  if appBit pub l.val then pub.snapshotFrontier l else emptyRootK l

def appNode (cur : Digest K) (l : Fin 20) : BlockIn K :=
  nodeIn (ordered cur (appSib pub l) (appBit pub l.val)).1
    (ordered cur (appSib pub l) (appBit pub l.val)).2

def appCur (start : Digest K) : Nat → Digest K
  | 0 => start
  | n + 1 => if h : n < 20 then blockDigest (appNode pub (appCur start n) ⟨n, h⟩)
      else appCur start n

/-- Blocks 27..29: the recipient note, or three zero permutations
(pair_trace.rs:741-743) for a withdrawal. -/
def recipB (j : Nat) : BlockIn K :=
  match pub.variant with
  | .privateTransfer =>
      if j = 0 then noteB0 w.recipientOwner
      else if j = 1 then noteB1 w.recipientOwner (w.outputValue.val : K) pub.assetId w.recipientSalt
      else noteB2 w.recipientOwner (w.outputValue.val : K) pub.assetId w.recipientSalt
  | .withdrawal => ⟨0, 0⟩

def recipientDigest : Digest K := blockDigest (recipB pub w 2)

def changeDigest : Digest K :=
  noteDigest w.changeOwner (w.changeValue.val : K) pub.assetId w.changeSalt

def outPairB : BlockIn K :=
  match pub.variant with
  | .privateTransfer => nodeIn (recipientDigest pub w) (changeDigest pub w)
  | .withdrawal => nodeIn (changeDigest pub w) 0

def outPair : Digest K := blockDigest (outPairB pub w)

/-- The 57 blocks in the forest layout (pair_tree_profile.rs:326-349 roles,
blocks 54..56 from pair_forest_trace.rs:229-240). -/
def blocksOf (h : Fin 57) : BlockIn K :=
  if h.val = 0 then ownerB w
  else if h.val = 1 then noteB0 (ownerDigest w)
  else if h.val = 2 then noteB1 (ownerDigest w) (w.inputValue.val : K) pub.assetId w.salt
  else if h.val = 3 then noteB2 (ownerDigest w) (w.inputValue.val : K) pub.assetId w.salt
  else if h4 : h.val ≤ 24 then
    treeNode w (treeCur w (inputLeaf pub w) (h.val - 4)) ⟨h.val - 4, by omega⟩
  else if h.val = 25 then nulB0 w
  else if h.val = 26 then nulB1 w
  else if h.val ≤ 29 then recipB pub w (h.val - 27)
  else if h.val = 30 then noteB0 w.changeOwner
  else if h.val = 31 then noteB1 w.changeOwner (w.changeValue.val : K) pub.assetId w.changeSalt
  else if h.val = 32 then noteB2 w.changeOwner (w.changeValue.val : K) pub.assetId w.changeSalt
  else if h.val = 33 then outPairB pub w
  else if h53 : h.val ≤ 53 then
    appNode pub (appCur pub (outPair pub w) (h.val - 34)) ⟨h.val - 34, by omega⟩
  else treeNode w (treeCur w (inputLeaf pub w) (h.val - 33))
    ⟨h.val - 33, by have := h.isLt; omega⟩

/-- Path aux record at level l: the same current/sibling/bit as the node. -/
def pathAuxOf (l : Fin 24) : PathAux K :=
  ⟨dirK (w.path l).1, treeCur w (inputLeaf pub w) l.val,
    (ordered (treeCur w (inputLeaf pub w) l.val) (w.path l).2 (w.path l).1).1,
    (ordered (treeCur w (inputLeaf pub w) l.val) (w.path l).2 (w.path l).1).2⟩

def valuesOf : Fin 3 → Nat := ![w.inputValue.val, w.outputValue.val, w.changeValue.val]

def inOccOf : OccAux K := ⟨w.pairOccupied, w.pairInverse, w.pairSecond, dirK (w.path 0).1⟩

/-- two_outputs / single_output (pair_tree_profile.rs:193-226). -/
def outOccOf : OccAux K :=
  match pub.variant with
  | .privateTransfer => ⟨1, (changeDigest pub w 7)⁻¹, changeDigest pub w, 0⟩
  | .withdrawal => ⟨0, 0, 0, 0⟩

def cellsOf : Cells K :=
  ⟨blocksOf pub w, pathAuxOf pub w, valuesOf w, inOccOf w, outOccOf pub w⟩

/-- The model builder. -/
def buildModel : Trace K := layout (cellsOf pub w)

#print axioms blockIter
#print axioms layout
#print axioms layout_aux
#print axioms layout_block
#print axioms layout_high
#print axioms rowOpenings_aux
#print axioms nat_bits
#print axioms bitK_01
#print axioms bitK_eq_shift
#print axioms bitK_mid
#print axioms bitK_hi
#print axioms chunk10
#print axioms cellsOf
#print axioms buildModel
end R0Z.BuilderModel
D18Transport:
import Mathlib.Data.Fin.Basic
import Lean.Elab.Tactic.Omega

/-! The natural-number arithmetic model of the R1 D18 digit permutation.
This file says nothing about the Rust bitwise implementation or semantic
correspondence. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1

/-- Five base-four digits reordered by τ = [3,4,2,0,1]. -/
def rowNat (j : Nat) : Nat :=
  64 * (j % 4) + 256 * ((j / 4) % 4) + 16 * ((j / 16) % 4) +
    ((j / 64) % 4) + 4 * ((j / 256) % 4)

theorem rowNat_lt (j : Nat) : rowNat j < 1024 := by
  have h0 : j % 4 < 4 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  have h1 : (j / 4) % 4 < 4 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  have h2 : (j / 16) % 4 < 4 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  have h3 : (j / 64) % 4 < 4 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  have h4 : (j / 256) % 4 < 4 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  unfold rowNat
  omega

/-- Reconstruct a number below 4^5 from its five radix-four digits. -/
theorem radix4_reconstruct (j : Nat) (hj : j < 1024) :
    j = j % 4 + 4 * ((j / 4) % 4) + 16 * ((j / 16) % 4) +
      64 * ((j / 64) % 4) + 256 * ((j / 256) % 4) := by
  have h0 : j % 4 < 4 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  have h1 : (j / 4) % 4 < 4 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  have h2 : (j / 16) % 4 < 4 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  have h3 : (j / 64) % 4 < 4 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  have h4 : (j / 256) % 4 < 4 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  omega

/-- Extract the five digits from a bounded radix-four expansion. The quotient
equations are supplied explicitly so arithmetic automation never has to infer
identities between nested divisions. -/
theorem radix4_digit_extract (n a b c d e : Nat)
    (hexpand : n = a + 4 * b + 16 * c + 64 * d + 256 * e)
    (ha : a < 4) (hb : b < 4) (hc : c < 4) (hd : d < 4) (he : e < 4) :
    n % 4 = a ∧ (n / 4) % 4 = b ∧ (n / 16) % 4 = c ∧
      (n / 64) % 4 = d ∧ (n / 256) % 4 = e := by
  have h0 : n % 4 + 4 * (n / 4) = n := Nat.mod_add_div n 4
  have h1 : (n / 4) % 4 + 4 * ((n / 4) / 4) = n / 4 :=
    Nat.mod_add_div (n / 4) 4
  have h2 : ((n / 4) / 4) % 4 + 4 * (((n / 4) / 4) / 4) = (n / 4) / 4 :=
    Nat.mod_add_div ((n / 4) / 4) 4
  have h3 : (((n / 4) / 4) / 4) % 4 +
      4 * ((((n / 4) / 4) / 4) / 4) = ((n / 4) / 4) / 4 :=
    Nat.mod_add_div (((n / 4) / 4) / 4) 4
  have h4 : ((((n / 4) / 4) / 4) / 4) % 4 +
      4 * (((((n / 4) / 4) / 4) / 4) / 4) = (((n / 4) / 4) / 4) / 4 :=
    Nat.mod_add_div ((((n / 4) / 4) / 4) / 4) 4
  have hmod4 : (n / 16) % 4 = ((n / 4) / 4) % 4 := by
    rw [← Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul n 4 4]
  have hmod64 : (n / 64) % 4 = (((n / 4) / 4) / 4) % 4 := by
    rw [← Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul n 4 16]
    rw [← Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul (n / 4) 4 4]
  have hmod256 : (n / 256) % 4 = ((((n / 4) / 4) / 4) / 4) % 4 := by
    rw [← Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul n 4 64]
    rw [← Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul (n / 4) 4 16]
    rw [← Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul ((n / 4) / 4) 4 4]
  have hfirst : n % 4 = a := by omega
  have hsecond : (n / 4) % 4 = b := by omega
  have hthird : ((n / 4) / 4) % 4 = c := by omega
  have hfourth : (((n / 4) / 4) / 4) % 4 = d := by omega
  have hfifth : ((((n / 4) / 4) / 4) / 4) % 4 = e := by omega
  exact ⟨hfirst, hsecond, hmod4 ▸ hthird, hmod64 ▸ hfourth, hmod256 ▸ hfifth⟩

/-- Output digit 0 is input digit 3. -/
theorem rowNat_digit0 (j : Nat) :
    rowNat j % 4 = (j / 64) % 4 := by
  have hrep : rowNat j = (j / 64) % 4 + 4 * ((j / 256) % 4) +
      16 * ((j / 16) % 4) + 64 * (j % 4) + 256 * ((j / 4) % 4) := by
    unfold rowNat
    omega
  have hx := radix4_digit_extract (rowNat j) ((j / 64) % 4)
    ((j / 256) % 4) ((j / 16) % 4) (j % 4) ((j / 4) % 4) hrep
    (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)) (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))
    (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)) (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))
    (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))
  exact hx.1

/-- Output digit 1 is input digit 4. -/
theorem rowNat_digit1 (j : Nat) :
    (rowNat j / 4) % 4 = (j / 256) % 4 := by
  have hrep : rowNat j = (j / 64) % 4 + 4 * ((j / 256) % 4) +
      16 * ((j / 16) % 4) + 64 * (j % 4) + 256 * ((j / 4) % 4) := by
    unfold rowNat
    omega
  have hx := radix4_digit_extract (rowNat j) ((j / 64) % 4)
    ((j / 256) % 4) ((j / 16) % 4) (j % 4) ((j / 4) % 4) hrep
    (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)) (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))
    (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)) (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))
    (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))
  exact hx.2.1

/-- Output digit 2 is input digit 2. -/
theorem rowNat_digit2 (j : Nat) :
    (rowNat j / 16) % 4 = (j / 16) % 4 := by
  have hrep : rowNat j = (j / 64) % 4 + 4 * ((j / 256) % 4) +
      16 * ((j / 16) % 4) + 64 * (j % 4) + 256 * ((j / 4) % 4) := by
    unfold rowNat
    omega
  have hx := radix4_digit_extract (rowNat j) ((j / 64) % 4)
    ((j / 256) % 4) ((j / 16) % 4) (j % 4) ((j / 4) % 4) hrep
    (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)) (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))
    (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)) (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))
    (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))
  exact hx.2.2.1

/-- Output digit 3 is input digit 0. -/
theorem rowNat_digit3 (j : Nat) :
    (rowNat j / 64) % 4 = j % 4 := by
  have hrep : rowNat j = (j / 64) % 4 + 4 * ((j / 256) % 4) +
      16 * ((j / 16) % 4) + 64 * (j % 4) + 256 * ((j / 4) % 4) := by
    unfold rowNat
    omega
  have hx := radix4_digit_extract (rowNat j) ((j / 64) % 4)
    ((j / 256) % 4) ((j / 16) % 4) (j % 4) ((j / 4) % 4) hrep
    (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)) (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))
    (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)) (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))
    (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))
  exact hx.2.2.2.1

/-- Output digit 4 is input digit 1. -/
theorem rowNat_digit4 (j : Nat) :
    (rowNat j / 256) % 4 = (j / 4) % 4 := by
  have hrep : rowNat j = (j / 64) % 4 + 4 * ((j / 256) % 4) +
      16 * ((j / 16) % 4) + 64 * (j % 4) + 256 * ((j / 4) % 4) := by
    unfold rowNat
    omega
  have hx := radix4_digit_extract (rowNat j) ((j / 64) % 4)
    ((j / 256) % 4) ((j / 16) % 4) (j % 4) ((j / 4) % 4) hrep
    (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)) (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))
    (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)) (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))
    (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))
  exact hx.2.2.2.2

/-- τ is an involution: the digit permutation swaps 0↔3 and 1↔4. -/
theorem rowNat_involutive (j : Nat) (hj : j < 1024) :
    rowNat (rowNat j) = j := by
  have h0 := rowNat_digit0 j
  have h1 := rowNat_digit1 j
  have h2 := rowNat_digit2 j
  have h3 := rowNat_digit3 j
  have h4 := rowNat_digit4 j
  have hrec := radix4_reconstruct j hj
  change 64 * (rowNat j % 4) + 256 * ((rowNat j / 4) % 4) +
      16 * ((rowNat j / 16) % 4) + ((rowNat j / 64) % 4) +
      4 * ((rowNat j / 256) % 4) = j
  rw [h0, h1, h2, h3, h4]
  omega

def row (j : Fin 1024) : Fin 1024 :=
  ⟨rowNat j.val, rowNat_lt j.val⟩

theorem row_involutive (j : Fin 1024) : row (row j) = j := by
  apply Fin.ext
  exact rowNat_involutive j.val j.isLt

/-- The arithmetic row permutation is represented by an equivalence whose
inverse is itself. This is only the natural-number model. -/
def rowEquiv : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024 where
  toFun := row
  invFun := row
  left_inv := row_involutive
  right_inv := row_involutive

#print axioms rowNat_lt
#print axioms radix4_reconstruct
#print axioms rowNat_digit0
#print axioms rowNat_digit1
#print axioms rowNat_digit2
#print axioms rowNat_digit3
#print axioms rowNat_digit4
#print axioms rowNat_involutive
#print axioms row_involutive
#print axioms rowEquiv

end AspisR1
R1Z.RomGrammarBin:
import R1Z.RomFiniteBin
import R1Z.SharedGrammarBridgeBin

/-! Membership of the actual binary encodings, including private-only reads
and D79 checkpoint classes. Coverage is the source handoff, at every answer
vector; it is not inferred from a successful trace or opening-only comLog. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.RomGrammarBin
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement
  R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.LensR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin
  R1Z.LayoutR1PBin R1Z.CouplingR1PBin R1Z.RomFiniteBin
open AspisR1.WireBindingRecordCodec
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-- Room for all fixed records plus the public statement and init domains. -/
def bound (publicWidth : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  57607 + publicWidth + semDomain.length + openDomain.length

theorem class_size_le (c : Tx1Class) : c.size ≤ 57607 := by
  cases c <;> simp only [Tx1Class.size]
  all_goals first
    | omega
    | (rename_i k; cases k <;>
        simp only [BindingClass.size, proof_bytes_eq, asf8_size_eq] <;> omega)

theorem semantic_size_le (i : Fin 27) :
    AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.semanticSize i ≤ 3712 := by
  unfold AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.semanticSize
  split <;> (try split) <;> (try split) <;> (try split) <;> omega

theorem opening_size_le (i : Fin 4) :
    AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.openingSize i ≤ 928 := by
  unfold AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.openingSize
  split <;> (try split) <;> (try split) <;> omega

theorem transcript_length (publicWidth : ℕ)
    (w : AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.Wire) (hp : w.publicBytes.length ≤ publicWidth)
    (j : TRead) (a : OracleAnswer) :
    (addrWith j a (WireLengthsR1PBin.rest (SharedGrammarBridgeBin.fromShared w))).length ≤
      bound publicWidth := by
  have hs : ∀ i, WireLengthsR1PBin.semanticSize i ≤ 3712 := semantic_size_le
  have ho : ∀ i, WireLengthsR1PBin.openingSize i ≤ 928 := opening_size_le
  cases j <;>
    simp only [addrWith, List.length_append, List.length_cons, List.length_nil,
      length_ans, le32, WireLengthsR1PBin.rest,
      SharedGrammarBridgeBin.fromShared, WireLengthsR1PBin.framed,
      Vector.length_toList]
  all_goals unfold bound
  all_goals first
    | omega
    | (rename_i i; have hi := hs i; change _ ≤ _ at hi; omega)
    | (rename_i i; have hi := ho i; change _ ≤ _ at hi; omega)

theorem commitment_length {E₁ E₂ : ℕ} (publicWidth : ℕ)
    (pub : List UInt8) (hp : pub.length ≤ publicWidth) (tag : UInt8)
    (lv : Fin 3 → Fib → List UInt8) (hl : ∀ T u, (lv T u).length ≤ 480)
    (sec : SecP) (d : OracleAnswer) (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) (p : CPos E₁ E₂) :
    (gram pub tag lv sec d rest p).length ≤ bound publicWidth := by
  rcases p with T | ((c | c) | (b | (i | (⟨T,u⟩ | (⟨T,u⟩ | ⟨T,n⟩)))))
  all_goals simp only [gram]
  all_goals try split_ifs
  all_goals simp only [nodeBytes, ctxEnc, le32, le64, dExp1, dExp2, dBind0,
    dBind1, dMaskSeed, dSourceSeed, dDSeed, dLeafSalt, descr,
    List.length_append, List.length_cons, List.length_nil, length_ans]
  all_goals unfold bound
  all_goals first | omega | (have hv := hl T u; omega)

/-- Typed read carrier. Commitment records include roots, all internal
parents, all salted leaves, both bindings, every seed/salt/expander block.
The classified constructor additionally covers D79 checkpoint/resume sites. -/
inductive Record (publicWidth : ℕ) where
  | transcript (w : AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.Wire)
      (hp : w.publicBytes.length ≤ publicWidth) (j : TRead) (a : OracleAnswer)
  | commitment {E₁ E₂ : ℕ} (pub : List UInt8) (hp : pub.length ≤ publicWidth)
      (tag : UInt8) (lv : Fin 3 → Fib → List UInt8)
      (hl : ∀ T u, (lv T u).length ≤ 480) (sec : SecP) (d : OracleAnswer)
      (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) (p : CPos E₁ E₂)
  | classified (c : Tx1Class) (bs : Vector UInt8 c.size)
  | publicDigest (bs : List UInt8) (hp : bs.length ≤ publicWidth)

def Record.bytes {publicWidth : ℕ} : Record publicWidth → List UInt8
  | .transcript w _ j a =>
      addrWith j a (WireLengthsR1PBin.rest (SharedGrammarBridgeBin.fromShared w))
  | .commitment pub _ tag lv _ sec d rest p => gram pub tag lv sec d rest p
  | .classified _ bs => bs.toList
  | .publicDigest bs _ => bs

theorem record_length {publicWidth : ℕ} (r : Record publicWidth) :
    r.bytes.length ≤ bound publicWidth := by
  cases r with
  | transcript w hp j a => exact transcript_length publicWidth w hp j a
  | commitment pub hp tag lv hl sec d rest p =>
      exact commitment_length publicWidth pub hp tag lv hl sec d rest p
  | classified c bs =>
      simp only [Record.bytes, Vector.length_toList]
      have hc := class_size_le c
      unfold bound
      omega
  | publicDigest bs hp =>
      change bs.length ≤ bound publicWidth
      unfold bound
      omega

theorem record_in_domain {publicWidth : ℕ} (r : Record publicWidth) :
    (decode (bound publicWidth) r.bytes).isSome :=
  (decode_isSome _ _).mpr (record_length r)

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-- R10/R-wire handoff. All counterfactual answers, not just successful runs.
The source inventory must separately identify any extra operational hashes;
no claim that Pos1 enumerates such additional source calls is made here. -/
structure ReadCoverage (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) (publicWidth : ℕ)
    (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) : Prop where
  public_bytes : (W.pubBytes x).length ≤ publicWidth
  reads : ∀ (w : h.Instance) (sec : SecP) (d : OracleAnswer)
    (v : Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) (p : Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂),
    ∃ r : Record publicWidth, r.bytes = attAddr W Pr h B outputs x w sec d v p

theorem address_domain (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (publicWidth : ℕ)
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F (wire base (bound publicWidth)))
    (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (coverage : ReadCoverage (wire base (bound publicWidth)) Pr publicWidth h B outputs x)
    (w : h.Instance) :
    RAddrIn (wire base (bound publicWidth)) Pr (rom base (bound publicWidth)) h B outputs x w := by
  intro sec d v p
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := coverage.reads w sec d v p
  change (decode (bound publicWidth) _).isSome
  rw [← hr]
  exact record_in_domain r

/-- The frozen statement-digest address is included as well. -/
theorem public_digest_domain (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (publicWidth : ℕ)
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F (wire base (bound publicWidth)))
    (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (coverage : ReadCoverage (wire base (bound publicWidth)) Pr publicWidth h B outputs x) :
    ((rom base (bound publicWidth)).dec ((wire base (bound publicWidth)).pubBytes x)).isSome :=
  record_in_domain (.publicDigest _ coverage.public_bytes)

#print axioms class_size_le
#print axioms semantic_size_le
#print axioms opening_size_le
#print axioms transcript_length
#print axioms commitment_length
#print axioms record_length
#print axioms record_in_domain
#print axioms address_domain
#print axioms public_digest_domain
end R1Z.RomGrammarBin

import R1Z.ProverCommitDomain34
import R1Z.ProverCommitNative30
/-! Stateful retry/publication control. Callbacks retain the full oracle,
entropy and durable-store state. This file does not assert their source laws;
the actual serializer is installed, and the native walk is transported below.
Only Rejected retries; all other errors, backend failure and divergence stop.
No rejected attempt returns a proof. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitRetry34
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SimControl21
abbrev Error := verifier.Error
abbrev Status (P : Type) := core.result.Result P Error
inductive Step (P : Type) where
  | done : P → Step P
  | retry : Step P
  | stop : Error → Step P

abbrev Attempt (S P : Type) := Nat → S → Result (Step P × S)
abbrev Entropy (S Secret : Type) := Nat → S → Result (Status Secret × S)

def classify {P : Type} : Status P → Step P
  | .Ok p => .done p
  | .Err .Rejected => .retry
  | .Err e => .stop e

structure Published (P : Type) where
  proof : P
  attempts : Nat

def run {S P : Type} (attempt : Attempt S P) :
    Nat → Nat → S → Result (Step (Published P) × S)
  | 0, _, state => ok (.stop .AttemptsExhausted,state)
  | fuel+1, index, state => do
    let (result,after) ← attempt index state
    match result with
    | .done proof => ok (.done ⟨proof,index+1⟩,after)
    | .retry => run attempt fuel (index+1) after
    | .stop e => ok (.stop e,after)

def eight {S P : Type} (attempt : Attempt S P) (state : S) :=
  run attempt 8 0 state

/-- Publication projection used by D143: internal attempt count is erased. -/
def published {S P : Type} : Result (Step (Published P) × S) → Option P
  | .ok (.done p,_) => some p.proof
  | _ => none

def NoProof {S P : Type} (r : Result (Step P × S)) : Prop :=
  ∀ proof after, r ≠ ok (.done proof,after)

/-- Exact extracted serializer guard precedes every continuation that can
reserve, derive masks or construct proof bytes in prove_masked_attempt. -/
def checked {S P : Type} (pub : ProverCommitDomain34.Source)
    (continuation : ProverCommitDomain34.SourceBytes → S → Result (Status P × S))
    (state : S) : Result (Step P × S) := do
  let bytes ← AspisR1PublicSerializer.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public.public_bytes pub
  match bytes with
  | .Err _ => ok (.stop .Semantic,state)
  | .Ok bytes => do
    let (status,after) ← continuation bytes state
    ok (classify status,after)

/-- The entropy callback is invoked before the pub guard, as in the
shipped prove_masked_retrying_with, and its returned state is retained. -/
def realAttempt {S Secret P : Type}
    (pub : ProverCommitDomain34.Source)
    (entropy : Entropy S Secret)
    (continuation : Secret → ProverCommitDomain34.SourceBytes → S → Result (Status P × S)) :
    Attempt S P := fun index state => do
  let (result,after) ← entropy index state
  match result with
  | .Err e => ok (.stop e,after)
  | .Ok secret => checked pub (continuation secret) after

theorem checked_outside {S P : Type} (pub : ProverCommitDomain34.Source)
    (hx : ¬ ProverCommitDomain34.DeployedStatement (ProverCommitDomain34.sourceImage pub))
    (continuation : ProverCommitDomain34.SourceBytes → S → Result (Status P × S))
    (state : S) : NoProof (checked pub continuation state) := by
  unfold checked
  cases hs : AspisR1PublicSerializer.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public.public_bytes pub with
  | fail e => intro proof after impossible; cases impossible
  | div => intro proof after impossible; cases impossible
  | ok result =>
    cases result with
    | Err e => intro proof after impossible; cases impossible
    | Ok bytes => exact False.elim (hx ⟨pub,bytes,rfl,hs⟩)

theorem real_outside {S Secret P : Type}
    (pub : ProverCommitDomain34.Source)
    (hx : ¬ ProverCommitDomain34.DeployedStatement (ProverCommitDomain34.sourceImage pub))
    (entropy : Entropy S Secret)
    (continuation : Secret → ProverCommitDomain34.SourceBytes → S → Result (Status P × S))
    (index : Nat) (state : S) : NoProof (realAttempt pub entropy continuation index state) := by
  unfold realAttempt
  cases he : entropy index state with
  | fail e => intro proof after impossible; cases impossible
  | div => intro proof after impossible; cases impossible
  | ok pair =>
    rcases pair with ⟨result,after⟩
    cases result with
    | Err e => intro proof after impossible; cases impossible
    | Ok secret => exact checked_outside pub hx (continuation secret) after

theorem run_no_proof {S P : Type} (attempt : Attempt S P)
    (none : ∀ index state, NoProof (attempt index state))
    (fuel index : Nat) (state : S) : NoProof (run attempt fuel index state) := by
  induction fuel generalizing index state with
  | zero => intro proof after impossible; cases impossible
  | succ fuel ih =>
    unfold run
    cases ha : attempt index state with
    | fail e => intro proof after impossible; cases impossible
    | div => intro proof after impossible; cases impossible
    | ok pair =>
      rcases pair with ⟨result,after⟩
      cases result with
      | done proof => exact False.elim (none index state proof after ha)
      | retry => exact ih (index+1) after
      | stop e => intro proof after impossible; cases impossible

theorem outside_nothing_published {S Secret P : Type}
    (pub : ProverCommitDomain34.Source)
    (hx : ¬ ProverCommitDomain34.DeployedStatement (ProverCommitDomain34.sourceImage pub))
    (entropy : Entropy S Secret)
    (continuation : Secret → ProverCommitDomain34.SourceBytes → S → Result (Status P × S))
    (state : S) : published (eight (realAttempt pub entropy continuation) state) = none := by
  have hn := run_no_proof (realAttempt pub entropy continuation)
    (real_outside pub hx entropy continuation) 8 0 state
  unfold eight
  cases hr : run (realAttempt pub entropy continuation) 8 0 state with
  | fail _ => rfl
  | div => rfl
  | ok pair =>
    rcases pair with ⟨result,after⟩
    cases result with
    | stop _ => rfl
    | retry => rfl
    | done proof => exact False.elim (hn proof after hr)

/-- A rejection retains every state update and advances the attempt index. -/
theorem rejected_next {S P : Type} (attempt : Attempt S P)
    (fuel index : Nat) (state after : S)
    (hr : attempt index state = ok (.retry,after)) :
    run attempt (fuel+1) index state = run attempt fuel (index+1) after := by
  simp only [run,hr,bind_tc_ok]
  rfl

theorem entropy_error {S Secret P : Type}
    (pub : ProverCommitDomain34.Source) (entropy : Entropy S Secret)
    (continuation : Secret → ProverCommitDomain34.SourceBytes → S → Result (Status P × S))
    (index : Nat) (state after : S) (error : Error)
    (he : entropy index state = ok (.Err error,after)) :
    realAttempt pub entropy continuation index state = ok (.stop error,after) := by
  simp only [realAttempt,he,bind_tc_ok]
  rfl

/-- Eight-attempt transport installs pointwise source component equalities
without deleting state, rejected effects or any suffix read before error. -/
theorem run_congr {S P : Type} (left right : Attempt S P)
    (equal : ∀ index state, left index state = right index state)
    (fuel index : Nat) (state : S) :
    run left fuel index state = run right fuel index state := by
  have eq : left = right := funext fun i => funext (equal i)
  rw [eq]

/-- The certified native walk may be installed before any publication
continuation; the entire returned oracle state is retained on both branches. -/
theorem walk_publication {S P : Type}
    (effect : Unit → ProverCommitStateLift28.Parts →
      ProverCommitStateLift28.Port S ProverCommitWalk28.Bytes32)
    (publicBytes : Slice U8) (records : ProverCommitWalk28.Records)
    (variant : transport.Variant)
    (publish : core.result.Result ProverCommitWalk28.Output Error → ProverCommitStateLift28.Port S P) :
    (ProverCommitNative30.walk effect publicBytes records variant >>= publish) =
    ((do let out ← ProverCommitInit28.walk effect publicBytes records variant
         pure out.1) >>= publish) := by
  rw [ProverCommitNative30.walk_model]

#print axioms checked_outside
#print axioms real_outside
#print axioms run_no_proof
#print axioms outside_nothing_published
#print axioms rejected_next
#print axioms entropy_error
#print axioms run_congr
#print axioms walk_publication
end R1Z.ProverCommitRetry34
R1Z.ProverCommitDomain34:
import R1Z.ProverCommitPublicRawBridge34
import R1Z.ProverCommitPublicImage33
/-! D146's announced domain, using the actual extracted serializer carrier.
`sourceImage` preserves every R0P.Public field; metadata omitted by the shipped
serializer is not silently hashed. No nonzero withdrawal condition is added.
This is an extracted-source/P6 statement, not an allocator or OS law. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitDomain34
open R1Z.PrivacyR1AcctBasis
open AspisR1 AspisR1PublicSerializer

abbrev Source := Whole431.Public
abbrev SourceBytes := FieldsRefinement431.ByteVec

def liftWord (w : PublicRawCore.Word) : K :=
  algebraMap (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K (w.val : ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P)

def lowerWord (w : K) : PublicRawCore.Word :=
  ⟨w.re.re.re.val, by
    have bound := w.re.re.re.val_lt
    norm_num [AspisCircleGroupOrder.P] at bound ⊢
    omega⟩

theorem lower_lift (w : PublicRawCore.Word) (hw : w.val < 2147483647) :
    lowerWord (liftWord w) = w := by
  apply Fin.ext
  simp only [lowerWord,liftWord,base_coordinates]
  change (w.val : ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P).val = w.val
  rw [ZMod.val_natCast]
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hw

def commonImage (c : PublicRawCore.Common) : R0P.Public K :=
  { variant := .privateTransfer
    anchor := fun i => liftWord (c.anchor i)
    nullifier := fun i => liftWord (c.nullifier i)
    assetId := liftWord c.assetId
    recipient := none
    change := fun i => liftWord (c.change i)
    withdrawalAmount := none
    nextPairIndex := c.nextPairIndex.val
    snapshotFrontier := fun l i => liftWord (c.snapshotFrontier l i)
    nextRoot := fun i => liftWord (c.nextRoot i)
    nextFrontier := fun l i => liftWord (c.nextFrontier l i) }

def image : PublicRawCore.Public → R0P.Public K
  | .transfer c recipient => {commonImage c with
      recipient := some (fun i => liftWord (recipient i))}
  | .withdrawal c amount => {commonImage c with
      variant := .withdrawal
      withdrawalAmount := some (liftWord amount)}

def lowerCommon (p : R0P.Public K) : PublicRawCore.Common :=
  { anchor := fun i => lowerWord (p.anchor i)
    nullifier := fun i => lowerWord (p.nullifier i)
    assetId := lowerWord p.assetId
    change := fun i => lowerWord (p.change i)
    nextPairIndex := ⟨p.nextPairIndex % 2^64, Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.two_pow_pos 64)⟩
    snapshotFrontier := fun l i => lowerWord (p.snapshotFrontier l i)
    nextRoot := fun i => lowerWord (p.nextRoot i)
    nextFrontier := fun l i => lowerWord (p.nextFrontier l i) }

def lower (p : R0P.Public K) : PublicRawCore.Public :=
  match p.variant with
  | .privateTransfer => .transfer (lowerCommon p)
      (fun i => lowerWord ((p.recipient.getD (fun _ => 0)) i))
  | .withdrawal => .withdrawal (lowerCommon p) (lowerWord (p.withdrawalAmount.getD 0))

def commonCanonical (c : PublicRawCore.Common) : Prop :=
  (∀ i, (c.anchor i).val < 2147483647) ∧
  (∀ i, (c.nullifier i).val < 2147483647) ∧ c.assetId.val < 2147483647 ∧
  (∀ i, (c.change i).val < 2147483647) ∧
  (∀ l i, (c.snapshotFrontier l i).val < 2147483647) ∧
  (∀ i, (c.nextRoot i).val < 2147483647) ∧
  (∀ l i, (c.nextFrontier l i).val < 2147483647)

theorem canonical_transfer (c : PublicRawCore.Common) (r : PublicRawCore.Digest)
    (hc : PublicRawCore.Canonical (.transfer c r)) :
    commonCanonical c ∧ ∀ i, (r i).val < 2147483647 := by
  refine ⟨⟨?_,?_,?_,?_,?_,?_,?_⟩,?_⟩ <;> intros <;> apply hc <;>
    simp only [PublicRawCore.words,PublicRawCore.headerWords,PublicRawCore.afterWords,
      PublicRawCore.digestWords,PublicRawCore.frontierWords,List.mem_append,
      List.mem_cons,List.mem_nil_iff,List.mem_ofFn,List.mem_flatMap] <;> aesop

theorem canonical_withdrawal (c : PublicRawCore.Common) (a : PublicRawCore.Word)
    (hc : PublicRawCore.Canonical (.withdrawal c a)) :
    commonCanonical c ∧ a.val < 2147483647 := by
  refine ⟨⟨?_,?_,?_,?_,?_,?_,?_⟩,?_⟩ <;> intros <;> apply hc <;>
    simp only [PublicRawCore.words,PublicRawCore.headerWords,PublicRawCore.afterWords,
      PublicRawCore.digestWords,PublicRawCore.frontierWords,List.mem_append,
      List.mem_cons,List.mem_nil_iff,List.mem_ofFn,List.mem_flatMap] <;> aesop

theorem lower_common (c : PublicRawCore.Common) (hc : commonCanonical c) :
    lowerCommon (commonImage c) = c := by
  rcases hc with ⟨ha,hn,hi,hc,hs,hr,hf⟩
  have index : (⟨c.nextPairIndex.val % 2^64, Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.two_pow_pos 64)⟩ : PublicRawCore.Index) =
      c.nextPairIndex := Fin.ext (Nat.mod_eq_of_lt c.nextPairIndex.isLt)
  simp only [lowerCommon,commonImage, lower_lift _ (ha _),lower_lift _ (hn _),
    lower_lift _ hi,lower_lift _ (hc _),lower_lift _ (hs _ _),lower_lift _ (hr _),
    lower_lift _ (hf _ _),index]

theorem lower_image (p : PublicRawCore.Public) (hc : PublicRawCore.Canonical p) : lower (image p) = p := by
  cases p with
  | transfer c r =>
    obtain ⟨hcommon,hr⟩ := canonical_transfer c r hc
    have h := lower_common c hcommon
    simpa only [lower,image,commonImage,lowerCommon,Option.getD_some,
      lower_lift _ (hr _)] using congrArg (fun c => PublicRawCore.Public.transfer c r) h
  | withdrawal c a =>
    obtain ⟨hcommon,ha⟩ := canonical_withdrawal c a hc
    have h := lower_common c hcommon
    simpa only [lower,image,commonImage,lowerCommon,Option.getD_some,
      lower_lift _ ha] using congrArg (fun c => PublicRawCore.Public.withdrawal c a) h

/-- Fixed semantic field projection of the extracted shipped source record. -/
def sourceImage (p : Source) : R0P.Public K := image (RawBridge431.project p)

/-- Announced statement-domain restriction. The commitment component is not
restricted here, and the adversary and its queries remain arbitrary. -/
def DeployedStatement (x : R0P.Public K) : Prop :=
  ∃ (p : Source) (out : SourceBytes), sourceImage p = x ∧
    pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public.public_bytes p = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (.Ok out)

/-- Fixed byte function of the model statement; no chosen source witness. -/
def pubBytes (x : R0P.Public K) : PublicRawCore.Bytes := PublicRawCore.encode (lower x)

theorem source_bytes (p : Source) (out : SourceBytes)
    (hs : pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public.public_bytes p =
      Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (.Ok out)) :
    out.val.map RawBridge431.rawByte = pubBytes (sourceImage p) := by
  have h := RawBridge431.source_success_raw p out hs
  unfold PublicRawCore.serialize at h
  split at h
  next hc =>
    have hb := Option.some.inj h
    rw [pubBytes,sourceImage,lower_image _ hc]
    exact hb.symm
  next hc => contradiction

/-- Any successful representative has exactly the public bytes of its model
statement, so witness choice cannot change the public transcript. -/
theorem on_domain (x : R0P.Public K) (hx : DeployedStatement x) :
    ∃ (p : Source) (out : SourceBytes), sourceImage p = x ∧
      pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public.public_bytes p =
        Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (.Ok out) ∧ out.val.map RawBridge431.rawByte = pubBytes x := by
  obtain ⟨p,out,rfl,hs⟩ := hx
  exact ⟨p,out,rfl,hs,source_bytes p out hs⟩

def sourceByte (b : PublicRawCore.Byte) : Aeneas.Std.U8 :=
  Aeneas.Std.UScalar.mk (BitVec.ofFin b)

theorem sourceByte_rawByte (b : Aeneas.Std.U8) : sourceByte (RawBridge431.rawByte b) = b := by
  apply Aeneas.Std.UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
  rfl

theorem encodeWords_length (ws : List PublicRawCore.Word) :
    (PublicRawCore.encodeWords ws).length = 4 * ws.length := by
  induction ws with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons w ws ih =>
    simp only [PublicRawCore.encodeWords,List.flatMap_cons,
      List.length_append,PublicRawCore.wordBytes,List.length_ofFn] at *
    rw [ih]
    simp only [List.length_cons]
    omega

/-! Successful-return refinement of the actual extracted public_bytes entry.
The finite instruction list is only a factoring device: source_eq_program
connects it by equality to the generated definition for both source variants.
No Rust runtime, allocator-success or cross-toolchain integration claim. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

namespace AspisR1PublicSerializer.Whole431
open FieldsRefinement431 Success431 Frontier431
open pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal
open pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public.public_bytes

abbrev Public := r0.Public
abbrev Transfer := pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1PrivateTransferPublicV1
abbrev Withdrawal := pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1WithdrawalPublicV1
abbrev Transition := pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.PoolV1PairLatePublicStatementV1
abbrev Output := core.result.Result ByteVec PublicError

inductive Step where
  | byte : Std.U8 → Step
  | words : Slice Field → Step
  | frontier : Frontier → Step
  | index : Std.U64 → Step

def stepWords : Step → List Field
  | .byte _ => []
  | .words s => s.val
  | .frontier f => (rows f).flatMap (fun s => s.val)
  | .index _ => []

def stepBytes : Step → List Std.U8
  | .byte b => [b]
  | .words s => encodeWords s.val
  | .frontier f => encodeWords ((rows f).flatMap (fun s => s.val))
  | .index n => (core.num.U64.to_le_bytes n).val

def nextPublic (m : Result (Status × ByteVec))
    (k : ByteVec → Result Output) : Result Output := do
  let (r, out) ← m
  let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r
  match cf with
  | .Continue _ => k out
  | .Break residual =>
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
      ByteVec (core.convert.FromSame PublicError) residual

def program : List Step → ByteVec → Result Output
  | [], out => ok (.Ok out)
  | .byte b :: ss, out => do
    let out1 ← alloc.vec.Vec.push out b
    program ss out1
  | .words s :: ss, out => nextPublic (fields out s) (program ss)
  | .frontier f :: ss, out => nextPublic (frontier out f) (program ss)
  | .index n :: ss, out => do
    let out1 ← alloc.vec.Vec.extend_from_slice core.clone.CloneU8 out
      (Array.to_slice (core.num.U64.to_le_bytes n))
    program ss out1

theorem bind_success {α β : Type} (m : Result α) (k : α → Result β) (v : β)
    (h : (do let x ← m; k x) = ok v) :
    ∃ x, m = ok x ∧ k x = ok v := by
  cases m with
  | ok x => exact ⟨x, rfl, h⟩
  | fail e => simp only [bind_tc_fail] at h; cases h
  | div => simp only [bind_tc_div] at h; cases h

theorem push_success (out out' : ByteVec) (b : Std.U8)
    (h : alloc.vec.Vec.push out b = ok out') :
    out'.val = out.val ++ [b] := by
  unfold alloc.vec.Vec.push at h
  dsimp only at h
  split at h
  · have heq := Result.ok.inj h
    rw [← heq]
    change out.val.concat b = out.val ++ [b]
    exact List.concat_eq_append
  · cases h

theorem nextPublic_success (m : Result (Status × ByteVec))
    (k : ByteVec → Result Output) (out' : ByteVec)
    (h : nextPublic m k = ok (.Ok out')) :
    ∃ out, m = ok (.Ok (), out) ∧ k out = ok (.Ok out') := by
  cases m with
  | fail e => simp [nextPublic] at h
  | div => simp [nextPublic] at h
  | ok r =>
    rcases r with ⟨status, out⟩
    cases status with
    | Err e =>
      simp [nextPublic, core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual] at h
    | Ok u =>
      cases u
      exact ⟨out, rfl, by simpa [nextPublic,
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch] using h⟩

theorem program_success (ss : List Step) (out out' : ByteVec)
    (h : program ss out = ok (.Ok out')) :
    canonical (ss.flatMap stepWords) ∧
      out'.val = out.val ++ ss.flatMap stepBytes := by
  induction ss generalizing out with
  | nil =>
    have heq : out = out' := core.result.Result.Ok.inj (Result.ok.inj h)
    subst out'
    simp [canonical]
  | cons s ss ih =>
    cases s with
    | byte b =>
      obtain ⟨out1, hp, hr⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
      have hb := push_success out out1 b hp
      have hi := ih out1 hr
      simpa only [List.flatMap_cons, stepWords, stepBytes, List.nil_append,
        hb, List.append_assoc] using hi
    | index n =>
      obtain ⟨out1, he, hr⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
      have hb := extend_success out out1
        (Array.to_slice (core.num.U64.to_le_bytes n)) he
      have hi := ih out1 hr
      change out1.val = out.val ++ (core.num.U64.to_le_bytes n).val at hb
      simpa only [List.flatMap_cons, stepWords, stepBytes, List.nil_append,
        hb, List.append_assoc] using hi
    | words s =>
      obtain ⟨out1, hf, hr⟩ := nextPublic_success _ _ _ h
      have hf := fields_success out out1 s hf
      have hi := ih out1 hr
      constructor
      · intro x hx
        simp only [List.flatMap_cons, stepWords, List.mem_append] at hx
        exact hx.elim (hf.1 x) (hi.1 x)
      · simpa only [List.flatMap_cons, stepBytes, hf.2, List.append_assoc] using hi.2
    | frontier f =>
      obtain ⟨out1, hf, hr⟩ := nextPublic_success _ _ _ h
      have hf := frontier_success out out1 f hf
      have hi := ih out1 hr
      constructor
      · intro x hx
        simp only [List.flatMap_cons, stepWords, List.mem_append] at hx
        exact hx.elim (hf.1 x) (hi.1 x)
      · simpa only [List.flatMap_cons, stepBytes, hf.2, List.append_assoc] using hi.2

def single (x : Field) : Slice Field := Array.to_slice (Array.make 1#usize [x])

def tailSteps (t : Transition) : List Step :=
  [.index t.live_snapshot.next_pair_index,
   .frontier t.live_snapshot.frontier,
   .words (Array.to_slice t.candidate_afterstate.next_root),
   .frontier t.candidate_afterstate.next_frontier]

def sourceSteps : Public → List Step
  | .Transfer p t =>
    [.byte 0#u8, .words (Array.to_slice p.anchor_root),
     .words (Array.to_slice p.nullifier), .words (single p.asset_id),
     .byte 1#u8, .words (Array.to_slice p.recipient_commitment),
     .words (Array.to_slice p.change_commitment), .byte 0#u8] ++ tailSteps t
  | .Withdrawal p t =>
    [.byte 1#u8, .words (Array.to_slice p.anchor_root),
     .words (Array.to_slice p.nullifier), .words (single p.asset_id),
     .byte 0#u8, .words (Array.to_slice p.change_commitment),
     .byte 1#u8, .words (single p.amount)] ++ tailSteps t

theorem source_eq_program (p : Public) :
    r0.Public.public_bytes p = program (sourceSteps p) (alloc.vec.Vec.new Std.U8) := by
  cases p <;> rfl

/-- Actual generated entry-point success determines all bytes and proves every
serialized field word canonical. There is no capacity/allocator premise. -/
theorem source_success (p : Public) (out : ByteVec)
    (h : r0.Public.public_bytes p = ok (.Ok out)) :
    canonical ((sourceSteps p).flatMap stepWords) ∧
      out.val = (sourceSteps p).flatMap stepBytes := by
  rw [source_eq_program] at h
  have hs := program_success _ _ out h
  simpa only [alloc.vec.Vec.new, List.nil_append] using hs

#print axioms push_success
#print axioms nextPublic_success

def thenCheck (m : Result (Status × ByteVec))

  let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r

  induction ss generalizing out with

    simp [canonical, encodeWords]

    have hs := fields_success out out1 s hf
    have hss := ih out1 ht
    constructor
    · intro x hx
      simp only [List.flatMap_cons, List.mem_append] at hx
      exact hx.elim (hs.1 x) (hss.1 x)
    · rw [hss.2, hs.2]

theorem index20 (values : Frontier) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < 20) :
