/-! Events and freshness, part 4 (DESIGN-R1-REAL §5): `HitFresh` for every
position.  A charged read's designated field is invisible to the middle
adversary: for an unaccepted attempt nothing of it is published; for an
unopened read of the accepted attempt, `hidden` + `RComLog` show the
verifier log does not move (`verLog_rest`). -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.EventsR1PBin
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsAbortBounds R0Z.HvzkV
  R1Z.Batched R1Z.LensR1 R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.LazyFrozen R1Z.GamesR1PBin
  R1Z.CouplingR1PBin R1Z.LayoutR1PBin
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

section Hit
variable (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) (R : RomModel W)
  (eCm : W.Cm ≃ (RIdx → OracleAnswer)) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (P : Challenges K → Prop)
  (h : HonestProver K) (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F)
  (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
  (w : h.Instance) (adv : R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux)

theorem qry_tame {U : Type} (L : Lens (AttS (F := F) W Pr) U) (hL : Tame W Pr L) (k : Fin N)
    (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) (u : U)
    (hv : accM W Pr eCm N P h V w s = some k →
      verLog W x (view h B outputs x w (drawW W ((toMP W Pr eCm s).1 k)) ((toMP W Pr eCm s).2 k))
          ((toMP W Pr eCm ((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u)).1 k) =
        verLog W x (view h B outputs x w (drawW W ((toMP W Pr eCm s).1 k)) ((toMP W Pr eCm s).2 k))
          ((toMP W Pr eCm s).1 k))
    (i : Fin W.qmax) :
    qryQ W Pr eCm N hN P h V B outputs x w adv i ((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u) =
      qryQ W Pr eCm N hN P h V B outputs x w adv i s := by
  unfold qryQ qryR
  rw [advLogR_congr W N hN P h V B outputs x w adv (toMP W Pr eCm s)
    (toMP W Pr eCm ((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u)) (accM_tame W Pr eCm N P h V w L hL k s u)
    (toMP_tame_tab W Pr eCm N L hL k s u ⟨0, hN⟩) ?_]
  intro k₀ hk₀
  refine ⟨toMP_tame_draw W Pr eCm N L hL k s u k₀, congrFun (toMP_tame_tape W Pr eCm N L hL k s u) k₀, ?_⟩
  by_cases hkk : k₀ = k
  · subst hkk
    exact hv hk₀
  · rw [toMP_tame_other W Pr eCm N L k s u k₀ hkk]

theorem hit_tr (k : Fin N) (j : TRead) (i : Fin W.qmax) :
    HitFresh (fun s => chargedQ W Pr eCm N P h V w s (k, .inl j))
      (qryQ W Pr eCm N hN P h V B outputs x w adv i)
      (fun s => addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (k, .inl j)) (2 ^ 255) := by
  refine hitFresh_transcript (frameP W Pr h B outputs x w N) k j _ _ ?_ ?_
  · intro s u hs
    exact (charged_tame W Pr eCm N P h V w (chainL W Pr (fc j)) (tame_chain W Pr (fc j) (chain_fc j))
      k s u (k, .inl j)).mpr hs
  · intro s u hs
    exact qry_tame W Pr eCm N hN P h V B outputs x w adv _ (tame_chain W Pr (fc j) (chain_fc j)) k s u
      (fun ha => absurd ha hs) i

theorem verLog_rest (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr) (hop : ROpen Pr)
    (hcom : RComLog W Pr eCm h B outputs x) (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) (k : Fin N)
    (c : CPos Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) (q : RIdx) (hs : src c = .inr q) (hnp : ¬ pubC W Pr N s k c)
    (u : OracleAnswer) :
    verLog W x (view h B outputs x w (drawW W ((toMP W Pr eCm s).1 k)) ((toMP W Pr eCm s).2 k))
        ((toMP W Pr eCm ((Lens.fnAt k (vL W Pr (.inr (.inr (.inr q))))).set s u)).1 k) =
      verLog W x (view h B outputs x w (drawW W ((toMP W Pr eCm s).1 k)) ((toMP W Pr eCm s).2 k))
        ((toMP W Pr eCm s).1 k) := by
  have e1 : (toMP W Pr eCm ((Lens.fnAt k (vL W Pr (.inr (.inr (.inr q))))).set s u)).1 k =
      (trOf (s k).2.1, rootsOf (s k).2.1, eCm.symm (Function.update (restOf (s k).2.1) q u),
        (s k).2.2.2) := by
    show (gM W Pr eCm (((Lens.fnAt k (vL W Pr (.inr (.inr (.inr q))))).set s u) k)).1 = _
    rw [Lens.fnAt_set_eq]
    show (trOf _, rootsOf _, eCm.symm (restOf _), _) = _
    rw [trOf_vL_rest, rootsOf_vL_rest, restOf_vL_rest]
    rfl
  rw [e1]
  show tLog W x (view h B outputs x w (chOf W (trOf (s k).2.1)) ((toMP W Pr eCm s).2 k))
        (trOf (s k).2.1, rootsOf (s k).2.1, eCm.symm (Function.update (restOf (s k).2.1) q u), (s k).2.2.2) ++
      W.comLog (eCm.symm (Function.update (restOf (s k).2.1) q u)) (rootsOf (s k).2.1)
        (view h B outputs x w (chOf W (trOf (s k).2.1)) ((toMP W Pr eCm s).2 k)) (chOf W (trOf (s k).2.1)) =
    tLog W x (view h B outputs x w (chOf W (trOf (s k).2.1)) ((toMP W Pr eCm s).2 k))
        (trOf (s k).2.1, rootsOf (s k).2.1, eCm.symm (restOf (s k).2.1), (s k).2.2.2) ++
      W.comLog (eCm.symm (restOf (s k).2.1)) (rootsOf (s k).2.1)
        (view h B outputs x w (chOf W (trOf (s k).2.1)) ((toMP W Pr eCm s).2 k)) (chOf W (trOf (s k).2.1))
  rw [hcom w (s k).1 0 ((toMP W Pr eCm s).2 k) (rootsOf (s k).2.1) _ _,
    hcom w (s k).1 0 ((toMP W Pr eCm s).2 k) (rootsOf (s k).2.1) _ _]
  congr 1
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro c0 hc0
  obtain ⟨hdep, hne⟩ := hidden (Pr.openFib (chOf W (trOf (s k).2.1))) c0
    ((hop.covers _ c0).mp hc0) c (fun ho => hnp (pub_of_opened W Pr hop _ c ho)) q hs
  refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
  · show Pr.caddr _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ = Pr.caddr _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
    rw [hb, hb]
    convert gram_rest_update (W.pubBytes x) W.vtag
      (Pr.leafVal h w x ((toMP W Pr eCm s).2 k) (chOf W (trOf (s k).2.1))) (s k).1
      0 (restOf (s k).2.1) q u (cposOf c0) hdep
  · rcases c0 with i | q'
    · rfl
    · show Function.update (restOf (s k).2.1) q u q' = restOf (s k).2.1 q'
      exact Function.update_of_ne (fun e => hne (by rw [e])) _ _

theorem hit_cm (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr) (hop : ROpen Pr) (hcom : RComLog W Pr eCm h B outputs x)
    (k : Fin N) (c : CPos Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) (i : Fin W.qmax) :
    HitFresh (fun s => chargedQ W Pr eCm N P h V w s (k, .inr c))
      (qryQ W Pr eCm N hN P h V B outputs x w adv i)
      (fun s => addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (k, .inr c)) (2 ^ 255) := by
  rcases hsrc : src c with i' | q
  · refine hitFresh_of_lens (Lens.fnAt k (secL W Pr i')) _ _ _
      (fun a => nzOf (fld (W.pubBytes x).length c a)) _ card_NZ ?_ ?_
      (fld_sec W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb k c i' hsrc)
    · intro s z hs
      exact (charged_tame W Pr eCm N P h V w _ (tame_sec W Pr i') k s z (k, .inr c)).mpr hs
    · intro s z _
      refine qry_tame W Pr eCm N hN P h V B outputs x w adv _ (tame_sec W Pr i') k s z (fun _ => ?_) i
      have e : (toMP W Pr eCm ((Lens.fnAt k (secL W Pr i')).set s z)).1 k = (toMP W Pr eCm s).1 k := by
        show (gM W Pr eCm (((Lens.fnAt k (secL W Pr i')).set s z) k)).1 = (gM W Pr eCm (s k)).1
        rw [Lens.fnAt_set_eq]
        rfl
      rw [e]
  · refine hitFresh_of_lens (Lens.fnAt k (vL W Pr (.inr (.inr (.inr q))))) _ _ _
      (fld (W.pubBytes x).length c) _ umin_le_card_ans ?_ ?_
      (fld_rest W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb k c q hsrc)
    · intro s u hs
      exact (charged_tame W Pr eCm N P h V w _ (tame_rest W Pr q) k s u (k, .inr c)).mpr hs
    · intro s u hs
      refine qry_tame W Pr eCm N hN P h V B outputs x w adv _ (tame_rest W Pr q) k s u (fun ha => ?_) i
      exact verLog_rest W Pr eCm N h B outputs x w hb hop hcom s k c q hsrc
        (fun hp => hs ⟨ha, hp⟩) u

end Hit

#print axioms hit_tr
#print axioms verLog_rest
#print axioms hit_cm
end R1Z.EventsR1PBin

import R1Z.EventsR1P2Bin

-- Binary-format copy of `R1Z.EventsR1P3` (LOG D76): the text is unchanged except that it is
-- built over `GamesR1PBin` / `LayoutR1P*Bin` (binary node index and `0x12 ‖ 2 children`).

/-! Events and freshness, part 3 (DESIGN-R1-REAL §5): `HitFresh` for every
position (`hit_tr`, `hit_cm`) and `PairFresh` for every pair of distinct
positions (`pair_all`). -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.EventsR1PBin
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsAbortBounds R0Z.HvzkV
  R1Z.Batched R1Z.LensR1 R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.LazyFrozen R1Z.GamesR1PBin
  R1Z.CouplingR1PBin R1Z.LayoutR1PBin
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

section Blocks
variable (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W)

theorem tapeR_tame {U : Type} (L : Lens (AttS (F := F) W Pr) U) (hL : Tame W Pr L)
    (a : AttS (F := F) W Pr) (u : U) : tapeR W Pr (L.set a u).2.1 = tapeR W Pr a.2.1 := by
  unfold tapeR
  rw [hL.e₁, hL.e₂]

theorem restOf_vL_rest (q : RIdx) (a : AttS (F := F) W Pr) (u : OracleAnswer) :
    restOf ((vL W Pr (.inr (.inr (.inr q)))).set a u).2.1 = Function.update (restOf a.2.1) q u := by
  funext q'
  by_cases hq : q' = q
  · subst hq
    simp [vL, restOf]
  · simp [vL, restOf, Function.update_of_ne hq]

theorem trOf_vL_rest (q : RIdx) (a : AttS (F := F) W Pr) (u : OracleAnswer) :
    trOf ((vL W Pr (.inr (.inr (.inr q)))).set a u).2.1 = trOf a.2.1 := by
  funext j
  simp [vL, trOf]

theorem rootsOf_vL_rest (q : RIdx) (a : AttS (F := F) W Pr) (u : OracleAnswer) :
    rootsOf ((vL W Pr (.inr (.inr (.inr q)))).set a u).2.1 = rootsOf a.2.1 := by
  funext i
  simp [vL, rootsOf]

theorem restOf_chain (c : Coord) (a : AttS (F := F) W Pr) (u : OracleAnswer) :
    restOf ((chainL W Pr c).set a u).2.1 = restOf a.2.1 := by
  funext q
  cases c <;> simp [chainL, vL, selL, restOf]

theorem sec_chain (c : Coord) (a : AttS (F := F) W Pr) (u : OracleAnswer) :
    ((chainL W Pr c).set a u).1 = a.1 := by
  cases c <;> rfl

end Blocks

section Fresh
variable (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) (R : RomModel W)
  (eCm : W.Cm ≃ (RIdx → OracleAnswer)) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (P : Challenges K → Prop)
  (h : HonestProver K) (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F)
  (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
  (w : h.Instance) (adv : R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux)

theorem addrQ_cm (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr) (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) (k : Fin N)
    (c : CPos Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) :
    addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (k, .inr c) =
      gram (W.pubBytes x) W.vtag (Pr.leafVal h w x (tapeR W Pr (s k).2.1) (chOf W (trOf (s k).2.1)))
        (s k).1 (dS W Pr R N hN x s) (restOf (s k).2.1) c :=
  hb _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _

theorem addrQ_other {U : Type} (L : Lens (AttS (F := F) W Pr) U) (hL : Tame W Pr L) (k : Fin N)
    (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) (u : U) (p : Fin N × Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) (hk : p.1 ≠ k) :
    addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w ((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u) p =
      addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s p := by
  unfold addrQ
  rw [Lens.fnAt_set_ne _ _ _ _ _ hk, dS_tame W Pr R N hN x L hL]

theorem addrQ_tr_inv {U : Type} (L : Lens (AttS (F := F) W Pr) U) (hL : Tame W Pr L)
    (htr : ∀ a u, trOf (L.set a u).2.1 = trOf a.2.1) (hrt : ∀ a u, rootsOf (L.set a u).2.1 = rootsOf a.2.1)
    (k : Fin N) (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) (u : U) (k' : Fin N) (j : TRead) :
    addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w ((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u) (k', .inl j) =
      addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (k', .inl j) := by
  by_cases hk : k' = k
  · subst hk
    show addr j (recP W x (view h B outputs x w (chOf W (trOf (((Lens.fnAt k' L).set s u) k').2.1))
        (tapeR W Pr (((Lens.fnAt k' L).set s u) k').2.1)) (trOf (((Lens.fnAt k' L).set s u) k').2.1)
        (rootsOf (((Lens.fnAt k' L).set s u) k').2.1)) = _
    rw [Lens.fnAt_set_eq, htr, hrt, tapeR_tame W Pr L hL]
    rfl
  · exact addrQ_other W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w L hL k s u _ hk

theorem addrQ_cm_chain (c : Coord) (hc : ChainC c) (k : Fin N) (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr)
    (u : OracleAnswer) (k' : Fin N) (c' : CPos Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) :
    addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w ((Lens.fnAt k (chainL W Pr c)).set s u) (k', .inr c') =
      addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (k', .inr c') := by
  by_cases hk : k' = k
  · subst hk
    show Pr.caddr h w x (((Lens.fnAt k' (chainL W Pr c)).set s u) k').1
        (dS W Pr R N hN x ((Lens.fnAt k' (chainL W Pr c)).set s u))
        (tapeR W Pr (((Lens.fnAt k' (chainL W Pr c)).set s u) k').2.1)
        (restOf (((Lens.fnAt k' (chainL W Pr c)).set s u) k').2.1)
        (chOf W (trOf (((Lens.fnAt k' (chainL W Pr c)).set s u) k').2.1)) c' = _
    rw [dS_tame W Pr R N hN x _ (tame_chain W Pr c hc), Lens.fnAt_set_eq, sec_chain,
      tapeR_tame W Pr _ (tame_chain W Pr c hc), restOf_chain, (tame_chain W Pr c hc).ch]
    rfl
  · exact addrQ_other W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w _ (tame_chain W Pr c hc) k s u _ hk

theorem addrQ_sec_inv (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr) (i : Fin 3) (k : Fin N) (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr)
    (z : NZ) (c' : CPos Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) (hd : ¬ depS c' (.inl i)) :
    addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w ((Lens.fnAt k (secL W Pr i)).set s z) (k, .inr c') =
      addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (k, .inr c') := by
  rw [addrQ_cm W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb, addrQ_cm W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb,
    dS_tame W Pr R N hN x _ (tame_sec W Pr i), Lens.fnAt_set_eq]
  exact gram_sec_update _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hd

theorem addrQ_rest_inv (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr) (q : RIdx) (k : Fin N) (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr)
    (u : OracleAnswer) (c' : CPos Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) (hd : ¬ depS c' (.inr q)) :
    addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w ((Lens.fnAt k (vL W Pr (.inr (.inr (.inr q))))).set s u) (k, .inr c') =
      addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (k, .inr c') := by
  rw [addrQ_cm W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb, addrQ_cm W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb,
    dS_tame W Pr R N hN x _ (tame_rest W Pr q), Lens.fnAt_set_eq,
    tapeR_tame W Pr _ (tame_rest W Pr q), (tame_rest W Pr q).ch, restOf_vL_rest,
    show ((vL W Pr (.inr (.inr (.inr q)))).set (s k) u).1 = (s k).1 from rfl]
  convert gram_rest_update (W.pubBytes x) W.vtag
    (Pr.leafVal h w x (tapeR W Pr (s k).2.1) (chOf W (trOf (s k).2.1))) (s k).1
    (dS W Pr R N hN x s) (restOf (s k).2.1) q u c' hd

theorem fld_sec (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr) (k : Fin N) (c : CPos Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) (i : Fin 3)
    (hs : src c = .inl i) (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) (z : NZ) :
    nzOf (fld (W.pubBytes x).length c
      (addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w ((Lens.fnAt k (secL W Pr i)).set s z) (k, .inr c))) = z := by
  rw [addrQ_cm W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb, fld_gram, hs]
  rw [Lens.fnAt_set_eq]
  show nzOf ((Function.update (s k).1 i z) i).1 = z
  rw [Function.update_self, nzOf_val]

theorem fld_rest (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr) (k : Fin N) (c : CPos Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) (q : RIdx)
    (hs : src c = .inr q) (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) (u : OracleAnswer) :
    fld (W.pubBytes x).length c
      (addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w ((Lens.fnAt k (vL W Pr (.inr (.inr (.inr q))))).set s u)
        (k, .inr c)) = u := by
  rw [addrQ_cm W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb, fld_gram, hs, Lens.fnAt_set_eq, restOf_vL_rest]
  show Function.update (restOf (s k).2.1) q u q = u
  rw [Function.update_self]

/-- A commitment read's designated field is fresh against every address that
its lens does not move. -/
theorem cm_pf (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr) (k : Fin N) (c : CPos Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂)
    (fa : (Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) → List UInt8)
    (hsec : ∀ i, src c = .inl i → ∀ s z, fa ((Lens.fnAt k (secL W Pr i)).set s z) = fa s)
    (hrest : ∀ q, src c = .inr q → ∀ s u,
      fa ((Lens.fnAt k (vL W Pr (.inr (.inr (.inr q))))).set s u) = fa s) :
    PairFresh fa (fun s => addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (k, .inr c)) (2 ^ 255) := by
  rcases hsrc : src c with i | q
  · exact pairFresh_of_lens (Lens.fnAt k (secL W Pr i)) fa _
      (fun a => nzOf (fld (W.pubBytes x).length c a)) _ card_NZ (hsec i hsrc)
      (fld_sec W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb k c i hsrc)
  · exact pairFresh_of_lens (Lens.fnAt k (vL W Pr (.inr (.inr (.inr q))))) fa _
      (fld (W.pubBytes x).length c) _ umin_le_card_ans (hrest q hsrc)
      (fld_rest W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb k c q hsrc)

theorem pub_of_opened (hop : ROpen Pr) (ch : Challenges K) (c : CPos Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂)
    (hc : openedC (Pr.openFib ch) c) : c ∈ (Pr.openList ch).map cposOf := by
  rcases c with T | (e | e) | q
  · exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨.inl T, (hop.covers ch _).mpr trivial, rfl⟩
  · exact absurd hc id
  · exact absurd hc id
  · exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨.inr q, (hop.covers ch _).mpr hc, rfl⟩

/-! ### Pair freshness -/

theorem pair_all (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr) (hE₁ : Pr.E₁ ≤ 2 ^ 64) (hE₂ : Pr.E₂ ≤ 2 ^ 64)
    (p p' : Fin N × Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) (hne : p ≠ p') :
    PairFresh (fun s => addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s p)
        (fun s => addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s p') (2 ^ 255) ∨
      PairFresh (fun s => addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s p')
        (fun s => addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s p) (2 ^ 255) := by
  have Fr := frameP W Pr h B outputs x w N
  obtain ⟨k, j | c⟩ := p <;> obtain ⟨k', j' | c'⟩ := p'
  · have hne' : (k, j) ≠ (k', j') := fun e => hne (by
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := Prod.mk.inj e
      rfl)
    exact pairFresh_transcript (frameP W Pr h B outputs x w N) (k, j) (k', j') hne'
  · refine Or.inr (pairFresh_of_lens ((frameP W Pr h B outputs x w N).lens k (fc j)) _
      (taddr (frameP W Pr h B outputs x w N) k j) (extract j) _ umin_le_card_ans ?_
      (taddr_extract (frameP W Pr h B outputs x w N) k j))
    intro s u
    exact addrQ_cm_chain W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w (fc j) (chain_fc j) k s u k' c'
  · refine Or.inl (pairFresh_of_lens ((frameP W Pr h B outputs x w N).lens k' (fc j')) _
      (taddr (frameP W Pr h B outputs x w N) k' j') (extract j') _ umin_le_card_ans ?_
      (taddr_extract (frameP W Pr h B outputs x w N) k' j'))
    intro s u
    exact addrQ_cm_chain W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w (fc j') (chain_fc j') k' s u k c
  · by_cases hk : k = k'
    · subst hk
      have hc : c ≠ c' := fun e => hne (by rw [e])
      rcases fresh_or_sep hE₁ hE₂ c c' hc with h1 | h2 | h3
      · refine Or.inr (cm_pf W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb k c _ ?_ ?_)
        · intro i hi s z
          exact addrQ_sec_inv W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb i k s z c' (by rw [← hi]; exact h1)
        · intro q hq s u
          exact addrQ_rest_inv W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb q k s u c' (by rw [← hq]; exact h1)
      · refine Or.inl (cm_pf W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb k c' _ ?_ ?_)
        · intro i hi s z
          exact addrQ_sec_inv W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb i k s z c (by rw [← hi]; exact h2)
        · intro q hq s u
          exact addrQ_rest_inv W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb q k s u c (by rw [← hq]; exact h2)
      · refine Or.inl (pairFresh_of_ne _ _ _ (fun s => ?_))
        show addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (k, .inr c) ≠ addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (k, .inr c')
        rw [addrQ_cm W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb, addrQ_cm W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb]
        exact h3 _ _ _ _ _ _
    · refine Or.inr (cm_pf W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb k c _ ?_ ?_)
      · intro i _ s z
        exact addrQ_other W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w _ (tame_sec W Pr i) k s z (k', .inr c')
          (fun e => hk e.symm)
      · intro q _ s u
        exact addrQ_other W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w _ (tame_rest W Pr q) k s u (k', .inr c')
          (fun e => hk e.symm)

end Fresh

R1Z.EventsR1P2Bin:
import R1Z.EventsR1PBin
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Card
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Option
import Mathlib.Logic.Equiv.Option

-- Binary-format copy of `R1Z.EventsR1P2` (LOG D76): the text is unchanged except that it is
-- built over `GamesR1PBin` / `LayoutR1P*Bin` (binary node index and `0x12 ‖ 2 children`).

/-! Events and freshness, part 2 (DESIGN-R1-REAL §5): positions, addresses,
charging, adversary reads; the update lemmas for every designated-field lens. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.EventsR1PBin
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsAbortBounds R0Z.HvzkV
  R1Z.Batched R1Z.LensR1 R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.LazyFrozen R1Z.GamesR1PBin
  R1Z.CouplingR1PBin R1Z.LayoutR1PBin
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-- `card_NZ` for any `Fintype NZ` instance (LOG D68.3): counted through
`Option NZ ≃ OracleAnswer` (`Equiv.optionSubtypeNe 0`) and `card_ans`.  The only
cross-module instance (the one `card_ans` was elaborated with) enters through
`Subsingleton (Fintype _)`, so no two instances are compared by reduction. -/
theorem card_NZ_of (i : Fintype NZ) : 2 ^ 255 ≤ @Fintype.card NZ i := by
  have hA : ∀ j : Fintype OracleAnswer, @Fintype.card OracleAnswer j = 2 ^ 256 := fun j =>
    (congrArg (@Fintype.card OracleAnswer) (Subsingleton.elim j _)).trans card_ans
  have e : Option NZ ≃ OracleAnswer := Equiv.optionSubtypeNe (0 : OracleAnswer)
  have h2 : Fintype.card NZ + 1 = 2 ^ 256 := by
    rw [← Fintype.card_option, Fintype.card_congr e]
    exact hA _
  have : (2 : ℕ) ^ 255 < 2 ^ 256 := Nat.pow_lt_pow_right (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  omega

theorem card_NZ : 2 ^ 255 ≤ Fintype.card NZ := card_NZ_of _

def nzOf (a : OracleAnswer) : NZ := if hz : a ≠ 0 then ⟨a, hz⟩ else Classical.arbitrary NZ

theorem nzOf_val (z : NZ) : nzOf z.1 = z := by
  unfold nzOf
  rw [dif_pos z.2]

section Ev
variable (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) (R : RomModel W)
  (eCm : W.Cm ≃ (RIdx → OracleAnswer)) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (P : Challenges K → Prop)
  (h : HonestProver K) (V : Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F)
  (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
  (w : h.Instance) (adv : R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux)

/-- The statement digest on the coupling space (attempt 0's table is the base table). -/
def dS (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) : OracleAnswer :=
  lookA R (R.eTab (s ⟨0, hN⟩).2.2.2) (W.pubBytes x)

/-- The address of position `p` on the lazy answers. -/
def addrQ (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) (p : Fin N × Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) : List UInt8 :=
  attAddr W Pr h B outputs x w (s p.1).1 (dS W Pr R N hN x s) (s p.1).2.1 p.2

def accM (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) : Option (Fin N) := accR W N P h V w (toMP W Pr eCm s)

/-- Commitment position `c` of attempt `k` is opened by the verifier. -/
def pubC (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) (k : Fin N) (c : CPos Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) : Prop :=
  c ∈ (Pr.openList (chOf W (trOf (s k).2.1))).map cposOf

/-- Charged: not published by the accepted attempt. -/
def chargedQ (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) : Fin N × Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ → Prop
  | (k, .inl _) => accM W Pr eCm N P h V w s ≠ some k
  | (k, .inr c) => ¬ (accM W Pr eCm N P h V w s = some k ∧ pubC W Pr N s k c)

def qryQ (i : Fin W.qmax) (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) : List UInt8 :=
  qryR W N hN P h V B outputs x w adv i (toMP W Pr eCm s)

/-! ### Block lenses that leave the table and the tape alone -/

/-- A block lens of attempt `k` that moves neither the spare tape, the table,
nor the expander answers. -/
structure Tame {U : Type} (L : Lens (AttS (F := F) W Pr) U) : Prop where
  tail : ∀ a u, (L.set a u).2.2 = a.2.2
  e₁ : ∀ a u, e₁Of (L.set a u).2.1 = e₁Of a.2.1
  e₂ : ∀ a u, e₂Of (L.set a u).2.1 = e₂Of a.2.1
  ch : ∀ a u, chOf (K := K) W (trOf (L.set a u).2.1) = chOf W (trOf a.2.1)

theorem dS_tame {U : Type} (L : Lens (AttS (F := F) W Pr) U) (hL : Tame W Pr L) (k : Fin N)
    (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) (u : U) :
    dS W Pr R N hN x ((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u) = dS W Pr R N hN x s := by
  unfold dS
  by_cases hk : (⟨0, hN⟩ : Fin N) = k
  · rw [hk, Lens.fnAt_set_eq, hL.tail]
  · rw [Lens.fnAt_set_ne _ _ _ _ _ hk]

theorem accM_tame {U : Type} (L : Lens (AttS (F := F) W Pr) U) (hL : Tame W Pr L) (k : Fin N)
    (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) (u : U) :
    accM W Pr eCm N P h V w ((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u) = accM W Pr eCm N P h V w s := by
  unfold accM accR
  have e1 : ∀ ct : (Fin N → R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) × (Fin N → Tape K F),
      firstGood (fun c => P (drawW W c) ∧ V (drawW W c) w) ct.1 =
        firstGood (fun j => P (drawW W (ct.1 j)) ∧ V (drawW W (ct.1 j)) w) id := fun _ => rfl
  rw [e1, e1]
  apply firstGood_congr
  intro j
  show P (chOf W (trOf (((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u) j).2.1)) ∧ V (chOf W (trOf (((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u) j).2.1)) w ↔
    P (chOf W (trOf (s j).2.1)) ∧ V (chOf W (trOf (s j).2.1)) w
  by_cases hj : j = k
  · rw [hj, Lens.fnAt_set_eq, hL.ch]
  · rw [Lens.fnAt_set_ne _ _ _ _ _ hj]

theorem pubC_tame {U : Type} (L : Lens (AttS (F := F) W Pr) U) (hL : Tame W Pr L) (k : Fin N)
    (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) (u : U) (k' : Fin N) (c : CPos Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) :
    pubC W Pr N ((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u) k' c ↔ pubC W Pr N s k' c := by
  unfold pubC
  by_cases hk : k' = k
  · rw [hk, Lens.fnAt_set_eq, hL.ch]
  · rw [Lens.fnAt_set_ne _ _ _ _ _ hk]

theorem charged_tame {U : Type} (L : Lens (AttS (F := F) W Pr) U) (hL : Tame W Pr L) (k : Fin N)
    (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) (u : U) (p : Fin N × Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) :
    chargedQ W Pr eCm N P h V w ((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u) p ↔ chargedQ W Pr eCm N P h V w s p := by
  obtain ⟨k', q | c⟩ := p
  · show accM W Pr eCm N P h V w ((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u) ≠ some k' ↔ _
    rw [accM_tame W Pr eCm N P h V w L hL]
    rfl
  · show ¬ (accM W Pr eCm N P h V w ((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u) = some k' ∧
      pubC W Pr N ((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u) k' c) ↔ _
    rw [accM_tame W Pr eCm N P h V w L hL, pubC_tame W Pr N L hL]
    rfl

theorem toMP_tame_tape {U : Type} (L : Lens (AttS (F := F) W Pr) U) (hL : Tame W Pr L) (k : Fin N)
    (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) (u : U) :
    (toMP W Pr eCm ((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u)).2 = (toMP W Pr eCm s).2 := by
  funext j
  show (Pr.tapeOf (e₁Of (((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u) j).2.1) (e₂Of (((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u) j).2.1)).getD
      (((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u) j).2.2.1 = _
  by_cases hj : j = k
  · rw [hj, Lens.fnAt_set_eq, hL.e₁, hL.e₂, hL.tail]
    rfl
  · rw [Lens.fnAt_set_ne _ _ _ _ _ hj]
    rfl

theorem toMP_tame_other {U : Type} (L : Lens (AttS (F := F) W Pr) U) (k : Fin N)
    (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) (u : U) (j : Fin N) (hj : j ≠ k) :
    (toMP W Pr eCm ((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u)).1 j = (toMP W Pr eCm s).1 j := by
  show (gM W Pr eCm (((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u) j)).1 = (gM W Pr eCm (s j)).1
  rw [Lens.fnAt_set_ne _ _ _ _ _ hj]

theorem toMP_tame_tab {U : Type} (L : Lens (AttS (F := F) W Pr) U) (hL : Tame W Pr L) (k : Fin N)
    (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) (u : U) (j : Fin N) :
    ((toMP W Pr eCm ((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u)).1 j).2.2.2 = ((toMP W Pr eCm s).1 j).2.2.2 := by
  show (((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u) j).2.2.2 = (s j).2.2.2
  by_cases hj : j = k
  · rw [hj, Lens.fnAt_set_eq, hL.tail]
  · rw [Lens.fnAt_set_ne _ _ _ _ _ hj]

theorem toMP_tame_draw {U : Type} (L : Lens (AttS (F := F) W Pr) U) (hL : Tame W Pr L) (k : Fin N)
    (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) (u : U) (j : Fin N) :
    drawW (K := K) W ((toMP W Pr eCm ((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u)).1 j) = drawW W ((toMP W Pr eCm s).1 j) := by
  show chOf W (trOf (((Lens.fnAt k L).set s u) j).2.1) = chOf W (trOf (s j).2.1)
  by_cases hj : j = k
  · rw [hj, Lens.fnAt_set_eq, hL.ch]
  · rw [Lens.fnAt_set_ne _ _ _ _ _ hj]

/-- The adversary's middle log depends only on the acceptance, the accepted
attempt's draw, tape and verifier log, and the base table. -/
theorem advLogR_congr (ct ct' : (Fin N → R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) × (Fin N → Tape K F))
    (hacc : accR W N P h V w ct' = accR W N P h V w ct)
    (htab : (ct'.1 ⟨0, hN⟩).2.2.2 = (ct.1 ⟨0, hN⟩).2.2.2)
    (hk : ∀ k₀, accR W N P h V w ct = some k₀ →
      drawW (K := K) W (ct'.1 k₀) = drawW W (ct.1 k₀) ∧ ct'.2 k₀ = ct.2 k₀ ∧
      verLog W x (view h B outputs x w (drawW W (ct.1 k₀)) (ct.2 k₀)) (ct'.1 k₀) =
        verLog W x (view h B outputs x w (drawW W (ct.1 k₀)) (ct.2 k₀)) (ct.1 k₀)) :
    advLogR W N hN P h V B outputs x w adv ct' = advLogR W N hN P h V B outputs x w adv ct := by
  unfold advLogR
  rw [hacc]
  rcases hA : accR W N P h V w ct with _ | k₀
  · simp only [htab]
  · obtain ⟨hd, ht, hv⟩ := hk k₀ hA
    simp only
    rw [hd, ht]
    unfold progOracle
    rw [hv, htab]

/-! ### The chain lenses are tame -/

theorem tame_chain (c : Coord) (hc : ChainC c) : Tame W Pr (chainL W Pr c) := by
  cases c with
  | root =>
      refine ⟨fun a u => rfl, fun a u => ?_, fun a u => ?_, fun a u => ?_⟩
      · funext c; simp [e₁Of, e₂Of, chainL, vL, selL, Function.update_apply]
      · funext c; simp [e₁Of, e₂Of, chainL, vL, selL, Function.update_apply]
      · show chOf W (trOf (Function.update a.2.1 (.inr (.inl 0)) u)) = _
        rw [trOf_update_root]
  | sel =>
      refine ⟨fun a u => rfl, fun a u => ?_, fun a u => ?_, fun a u => ?_⟩
      · funext c; simp [e₁Of, e₂Of, chainL, vL, selL, Function.update_apply]
      · funext c; simp [e₁Of, e₂Of, chainL, vL, selL, Function.update_apply]
      · show chOf W (trOf (Function.update a.2.1 (.inl (.qa (ksV W Pr a.2.1))) u)) = _
        rw [trOf_update_tr]
        exact chOf_update_tr W _ (TRead.qa (ksV W Pr a.2.1)) (fun h => h) u
  | ans j =>
      refine ⟨fun a u => rfl, fun a u => ?_, fun a u => ?_, fun a u => ?_⟩
      · funext c; simp [e₁Of, e₂Of, chainL, vL, selL, Function.update_apply]
      · funext c; simp [e₁Of, e₂Of, chainL, vL, selL, Function.update_apply]
      · show chOf W (trOf (Function.update a.2.1 (.inl j) u)) = _
        rw [trOf_update_tr]
        exact chOf_update_tr W _ _ (hc j rfl) u

theorem tame_sec (i : Fin 3) : Tame W Pr (secL W Pr i) :=
  ⟨fun _ _ => rfl, fun _ _ => rfl, fun _ _ => rfl, fun _ _ => rfl⟩

theorem tame_rest (q : RIdx) : Tame W Pr (vL W Pr (.inr (.inr (.inr q)))) := by
  refine ⟨fun a u => rfl, fun a u => ?_, fun a u => ?_, fun a u => ?_⟩
  · funext c; simp [e₁Of, e₂Of, vL, Function.update_apply]
  · funext c; simp [e₁Of, e₂Of, vL, Function.update_apply]
  · show chOf W (trOf (Function.update a.2.1 (.inr (.inr (.inr q))) u)) = _
    congr 1

end Ev

import R1Z.GamesR1PBin

/-! Exact binary attempt size and the existing D76 error bound. The two
binding reads are included, in addition to CommitReadsR1's Mc. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.GamesR1PBin
open R0P R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.HvzkV R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.CommitReadsR1

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
  (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W)

theorem n1_eq : n1 W Pr = 115 + (McR1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ + 2) := by
  rw [n1, card_Pos1]
  unfold McR1
  omega

theorem n1_worst_case (h₁ : Pr.E₁ = 90112) (h₂ : Pr.E₂ = 8192) :
    n1 W Pr = 2457717 := by rw [n1_eq, h₁, h₂]; rfl

/-- Source counts plus expander budgets, including both binding reads. -/
theorem n1_le (L₁ L₂ : ℕ) (hc : RCommitCount L₁ L₂)
    (h₁ : Pr.E₁ ≤ 2 * L₁) (h₂ : Pr.E₂ ≤ 2 * L₂) : n1 W Pr ≤ 2 ^ 22 := by
  rw [n1_eq]
  obtain ⟨hc₁, hc₂⟩ := hc
  unfold McR1
  norm_num at *
  omega

/-- Exactly the error expression in the binary phase-indexed privacy root.
The existing ReadBudgetR1 theorem is instantiated, not modified. -/
theorem binary_games_error_le (L₁ L₂ qmax : ℕ) (εexh : ℚ)
    (hc : RCommitCount L₁ L₂) (h₁ : Pr.E₁ ≤ 2 * L₁) (h₂ : Pr.E₂ ≤ 2 * L₂)
    (hq : qmax ≤ 2 ^ 64) (he : εexh ≤ 1 / 2 ^ 229) :
    ((8 * n1 W Pr : ℕ) : ℚ) * (qmax : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
      (((8 * n1 W Pr : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((8 * n1 W Pr : ℕ) : ℚ) /
        ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) + εexh) +
      ((0 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((0 : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
      (8 : ℚ) * ((4096 : ℚ) / (((2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 - 1 : ℕ) : ℚ)) ≤
        1 / 2 ^ 109 + 1 / 2 ^ 137 := by
  rw [n1_eq]
  exact R1Z.ReadBudgetR1.r1_games_error_le _ qmax εexh
    (by rw [← n1_eq W Pr]; exact n1_le W Pr L₁ L₂ hc h₁ h₂) hq he

R1Z.ReadBudgetR1:
import R1Z.CommitReadsR1

/-! The R1 privacy error at N = 8 under the binary-multiproof read budget
`115 + Mc ≤ 2^22` (`CommitReadsR1.mc_le`; r1p-readbudget/READ-BUDGET-BINARY.md).

The privacy theorems (`privacy_R1`, `privacy_R1_games′` /
`privacy_R1_games_spendSampler`, `privacy_R1P`) are parametric in the read
count (`M`, `Mc`, `N * n1 W Pr`); their statements are unchanged.  This module
evaluates their error expressions at the new constant:

* `r1_error_N8_bin`: the D41 form (`zkfs_R1_abort_N8`, three terms, `M = Mi =
  8 · 2^22`, `q = 2^64`, `Umin = 2^255`, exhaustion slot `2^-250`) is
  `≤ 2^-165` (it was `≤ 2^-166` at `8 · 2^21`).
* `exh_bin_le`: the body of `FinalR1P.εexhP 8 L₁ L₂ M` under `RCommitCount`
  and `M ≤ 8 · 2^22` is `≤ 2^-229`.
* `r1_games_error_le`: the error expression of `privacy_R1_games_spendSampler`
  (D42.1 form with the pole term, `Mi = 0`) at `N = 8`, for every `Mc` with
  `115 + Mc ≤ 2^22`, `qmax ≤ 2^64` and `εexh ≤ 2^-229`, is
  `≤ 2^-109 + 2^-137`: the pole term `8 · 4096 / (p⁴ − 1)` dominates.
* `r1_games_error_RCommitCount`: the same at `Mc = McR1 (2 L₁) (2 L₂)`. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ReadBudgetR1
open R1Z.CommitReadsR1

/-- D41 form at the binary budget: `M = Mi = 8 · 2^22`. -/
theorem r1_error_N8_bin :
    ((8 * 2 ^ 22 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((2 ^ 64 : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
      (((8 * 2 ^ 22 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((8 * 2 ^ 22 : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
        (1 / 2 ^ 250 : ℚ)) +
      ((8 * 2 ^ 22 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((8 * 2 ^ 22 : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) ≤
    1 / 2 ^ 165 := by
  norm_num

/-- The exhaustion slot of `FinalR1P.εexhP` at `N = 8`. -/
theorem exh_bin_le (L₁ L₂ M : ℕ) (hc : RCommitCount L₁ L₂) (hM : M ≤ 8 * 2 ^ 22) :
    ((8 : ℕ) : ℚ) * (16 * (L₁ + L₂)) / 2 ^ 496 + (M : ℚ) * (1 / 2 ^ 255) ≤ 1 / 2 ^ 229 := by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hc
  have hL : ((L₁ + L₂ : ℕ) : ℚ) ≤ 49152 := by
    have : L₁ + L₂ ≤ 49152 := by omega
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hM' : (M : ℚ) ≤ 8 * 2 ^ 22 := by exact_mod_cast hM
  push_cast at hL
  calc ((8 : ℕ) : ℚ) * (16 * (L₁ + L₂)) / 2 ^ 496 + (M : ℚ) * (1 / 2 ^ 255)
      ≤ (8 : ℚ) * (16 * 49152) / 2 ^ 496 + (8 * 2 ^ 22 : ℚ) * (1 / 2 ^ 255) := by
        push_cast
        gcongr
    _ ≤ 1 / 2 ^ 229 := by
        -- `2^496` is past the numeral evaluator's exponent limit (256): split it.
        rw [show (2 : ℚ) ^ 496 = 2 ^ 248 * 2 ^ 248 by rw [← pow_add]]
        norm_num

/-- The pole term at `N = 8`. -/
theorem pole_N8 : (8 : ℚ) * ((4096 : ℚ) / (((2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 - 1 : ℕ) : ℚ)) ≤
    1 / 2 ^ 109 + 1 / 2 ^ 138 + 1 / 2 ^ 160 := by
  norm_num

/-- The error of `privacy_R1_games_spendSampler` at `N = 8` under the binary
read budget. -/
theorem r1_games_error_le (Mc qmax : ℕ) (εexh : ℚ) (hM : 115 + Mc ≤ 2 ^ 22)
    (hq : qmax ≤ 2 ^ 64) (he : εexh ≤ 1 / 2 ^ 229) :
    ((8 * (115 + Mc) : ℕ) : ℚ) * (qmax : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
        (((8 * (115 + Mc) : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((8 * (115 + Mc) : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) + εexh) +
        ((0 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((0 : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
        (8 : ℚ) * ((4096 : ℚ) / (((2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 - 1 : ℕ) : ℚ)) ≤
      1 / 2 ^ 109 + 1 / 2 ^ 137 := by
  have hA : ((8 * (115 + Mc) : ℕ) : ℚ) ≤ 8 * 2 ^ 22 := by
    have : 8 * (115 + Mc) ≤ 8 * 2 ^ 22 := by omega
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hA0 : (0 : ℚ) ≤ ((8 * (115 + Mc) : ℕ) : ℚ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hq' : (qmax : ℚ) ≤ 2 ^ 64 := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hq0 : (0 : ℚ) ≤ qmax := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hU : (0 : ℚ) < ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) := by positivity
  have h1 : ((8 * (115 + Mc) : ℕ) : ℚ) * (qmax : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) ≤
      (8 * 2 ^ 22 : ℚ) * 2 ^ 64 / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) := by
    gcongr
  have h2 : ((8 * (115 + Mc) : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((8 * (115 + Mc) : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) ≤
      (8 * 2 ^ 22 : ℚ) * (8 * 2 ^ 22) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) := by
    gcongr
  have hp := pole_N8
  have hz : ((0 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((0 : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) = 0 := by simp
  rw [hz]
  have hnum : (8 * 2 ^ 22 : ℚ) * 2 ^ 64 / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
      ((8 * 2 ^ 22 : ℚ) * (8 * 2 ^ 22) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) + 1 / 2 ^ 229) + 0 +
      (1 / 2 ^ 109 + 1 / 2 ^ 138 + 1 / 2 ^ 160) ≤ 1 / 2 ^ 109 + 1 / 2 ^ 137 := by
    norm_num
  linarith

/-- The same at the source count `Mc = McR1 (2 L₁) (2 L₂)` (`mc_le`). -/
theorem r1_games_error_RCommitCount (L₁ L₂ qmax : ℕ) (εexh : ℚ) (hc : RCommitCount L₁ L₂)
    (hq : qmax ≤ 2 ^ 64) (he : εexh ≤ 1 / 2 ^ 229) :
    ((8 * (115 + McR1 (2 * L₁) (2 * L₂)) : ℕ) : ℚ) * (qmax : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
        (((8 * (115 + McR1 (2 * L₁) (2 * L₂)) : ℕ) : ℚ) *
            ((8 * (115 + McR1 (2 * L₁) (2 * L₂)) : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) + εexh) +
        ((0 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((0 : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
        (8 : ℚ) * ((4096 : ℚ) / (((2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 - 1 : ℕ) : ℚ)) ≤
      1 / 2 ^ 109 + 1 / 2 ^ 137 :=
  r1_games_error_le _ qmax εexh (mc_le L₁ L₂ hc) hq he

end R1Z.ReadBudgetR1

#print axioms R1Z.ReadBudgetR1.r1_error_N8_bin
#print axioms R1Z.ReadBudgetR1.exh_bin_le
#print axioms R1Z.ReadBudgetR1.pole_N8
#print axioms R1Z.ReadBudgetR1.r1_games_error_le

D80 is consumed at its exact universal quantifiers, including inconsistent
answer vectors. D81 identifies the binary grammar; D79/addendum separation
is exported below on the concrete carrier. See PRIVACY-FINAL-20261020.md. -/

namespace R1Z.PrivacyR1Final
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsGood R0Z.HvzkV R0Z.HvzkS R0Z.RefPayload

/-- D80's eight constructor equations, each at the full AddressAt quantifiers. -/
structure RCommitSource (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) : Prop where
  roots : ∀ T, AddressAt W Pr (.inl T)
  mask_expander : ∀ c, AddressAt W Pr (.inr (.inl (.inl c)))
  source_expander : ∀ c, AddressAt W Pr (.inr (.inl (.inr c)))
  bindings : ∀ b, AddressAt W Pr (.inr (.inr (qBind b)))
  seeds : ∀ i, AddressAt W Pr (.inr (.inr (qSeed i)))
  salts : ∀ T u, AddressAt W Pr (.inr (.inr (qSalt T u)))
  leaves : ∀ T u, AddressAt W Pr (.inr (.inr (qLeaf T u)))
  nodes : ∀ T n, AddressAt W Pr (.inr (.inr (qNode T n)))

theorem commit_source (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) (s : RCommitSource W Pr) :
    RCommitBytes W Pr :=
  (commit_bytes_iff W Pr).mpr ⟨s.roots, s.mask_expander, s.source_expander,
    s.bindings, s.seeds, s.salts, s.leaves, s.nodes⟩

/-- Normalized per-transaction batches, never the repeated raw leaf-call list. -/
structure RWireBatches (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) where
  fib : Challenges K → Fin 2 → Fin 3 → Finset Fib
  reads : Challenges K → Fin 2 → List (Fin 3 ⊕ RIdx)
  concatenation : ∀ ch, Pr.openList ch = reads ch 0 ++ reads ch 1
  nodup : ∀ ch b, (reads ch b).Nodup
  coverage : ∀ ch b c, c ∈ reads ch b ↔ openedQ (fib ch b) c
  fibre_union : ∀ ch T, Pr.openFib ch T = fib ch 0 T ∪ fib ch 1 T

theorem wire_batches (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) (s : RWireBatches W Pr) : ROpen Pr :=
  open_of_batches W Pr s.fib s.reads s.concatenation s.nodup s.coverage s.fibre_union

/-- The shared grammar inherits D79 separation, including all three binding
classes. Execution membership in this concrete carrier is still R-wire. -/
theorem shared_wire_separation (wire : WireLengthsR1PBin.Wire)
    (answers : RIdx → OracleAnswer) (children : Fin 2 → RIdx)
    (read : WireBindingLengthsR1PBin.ExtendedRead) :
    AspisR1.SharedBinaryRecordGrammar.nodeInput (fun j => answers (children j)) ≠
      read.bytes wire := by
  rw [← SharedGrammarBridgeBin.node_eq]
  exact WireBindingLengthsR1PBin.node_ne_extended_read wire answers children read

/-- The exact D52/D77 model error; the ideal programming term is zero. -/
def modelError (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) (L₁ L₂ : ℕ) : ℚ :=
  ((8 * n1 W Pr : ℕ) : ℚ) * W.qmax / (2 : ℚ)^255 +
  (((8 * n1 W Pr : ℕ) : ℚ)^2 / (2 : ℚ)^255 +
    εexhP 8 L₁ L₂ (8 * n1 W Pr)) + 0 +
  (8 : ℚ) * (4096 / (((2^31-1)^4-1 : ℕ) : ℚ))

/-- Every numerical slot at the conservative D76 envelope M=2^25,
q=2^64, L1+L2≤49152. Split powers before normalizing. -/
theorem deployed_term_values :
    ((2 : ℚ)^25 * 2^64 / 2^255 = 1 / 2^166) ∧
    (((2 : ℚ)^25)^2 / 2^255 = 1 / 2^205) ∧
    ((8 : ℚ) * (16 * 49152) / 2^496 ≤ 1 / 2^473) ∧
    ((2 : ℚ)^25 / 2^255 = 1 / 2^230) ∧
    ((8 : ℚ) * (4096 / (((2^31-1)^4-1 : ℕ) : ℚ)) ≤
      1 / 2^109 + 1 / 2^138 + 1 / 2^160) ∧
    ((16 : ℚ) / 2^486 ≤ 1 / 2^454) := by
  refine ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num, ?_, by norm_num,
    R1Z.ReadBudgetR1.pole_N8, query_error_le⟩
  rw [show (496 : ℕ) = 248 + 248 from rfl, pow_add,
    show (473 : ℕ) = 230 + 243 from rfl, pow_add]
  norm_num

/-- Exact D77 worst-case count, rather than the conservative power-of-two
read envelope. This equality displays both components of epsilon_exh. -/
theorem deployed_exact_error (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W)
    (hE₁ : Pr.E₁ = 90112) (hE₂ : Pr.E₂ = 8192) (hq : W.qmax = 2^64) :
    modelError W Pr 45056 4096 =
      (19661736 : ℚ) * 2^64 / 2^255 +
      ((19661736 : ℚ)^2 / 2^255 +
        (6291456 / (2 : ℚ)^496 + 19661736 / (2 : ℚ)^255)) + 0 +
      (8 : ℚ) * (4096 / (((2^31-1)^4-1 : ℕ) : ℚ)) := by
  rw [modelError, n1_worst_case W Pr hE₁ hE₂, hq]
  norm_num only [εexhP, Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_pow]

variable (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (publicWidth : ℕ)

/-- ONE composed endpoint. The two ScanCoupling hypotheses are the source
handoffs: real includes builder/checker/retry/publication correctness; ideal
includes the Rust sim_e/programmed-oracle correspondence. They permit only
QueryScan disagreement and require its actual reached-history law.
All other Semantic errors must be impossible or agree in those handoffs.
The table backend, query cap and Boolean observer map are constructed here;
the source supplies typed read coverage and its operational query program. -/
theorem privacy_R1_final
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W)
    (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : R0Z.K4.PackField B)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hpub : PublicBase F x.1)
    (builder_refinement_D46_D51 : R0Z.HonestValidity.BuilderSoundOn h B x)
    (D : SemRows01 W)
    (ι : R1J.SamplerLawSpend.QF → K) (hι : Function.Injective ι)
    (R_wire_Sem1Uniform : D.s1 = R1J.SamplerLawSpend.s1Spend ι)
    (R_wire_read_coverage : RomGrammarBin.ReadCoverage W Pr publicWidth h B outputs x)
    (R_causal_D80 : ∀ (w : h.Instance) sec d p v v', Earlier W Pr p v v' →
      attAddr W Pr h B outputs x w sec d v p = attAddr W Pr h B outputs x w sec d v' p)
    (R_commit_D80 : RCommitSource W Pr) (cF : ℕ)
    (R_commit_equal_fibres : ∀ τ : Tape K F, (Finset.univ.filter
      (fun e : (Fin Pr.E₁ → OracleAnswer) × (Fin Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) =>
        Pr.tapeOf e.1 e.2 = some τ)).card = cF)
    (L₁ L₂ : ℕ) (R_commit_exhaustion : RExh Pr L₁ L₂)
    (R_commit_counter₁ : Pr.E₁ ≤ 2^64) (R_commit_counter₂ : Pr.E₂ ≤ 2^64)
    (R_commit_stream₁ : 16 * L₁ ≤ Pr.E₁ * 8) (R_commit_stream₂ : 16 * L₂ ≤ Pr.E₂ * 8)
    (R_wire_coin_carrier : (W).Cm ≃ (RIdx → OracleAnswer))
    (R_wire_D80_batches : RWireBatches W Pr)
    (R_wire_D80_ordered_log : ∀ (w : h.Instance) (sec : SecP) (d : OracleAnswer)
      (τ : Tape K F) (roots : Fin 3 → OracleAnswer) (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) (ch : Challenges K),
      (W).comLog (R_wire_coin_carrier.symm rest) roots (view h B outputs x w ch τ) ch =
        (Pr.openList ch).map (fun c =>
          (gram ((W).pubBytes x) (W).vtag (Pr.leafVal h w x τ ch) sec d rest
            (cposOf (E₁ := Pr.E₁) (E₂ := Pr.E₂) c), ansC roots rest c)))
    (R_commit_cell_count : RCommitCount L₁ L₂)
    (R_commit_blocks₁ : Pr.E₁ ≤ 2 * L₁) (R_commit_blocks₂ : Pr.E₂ ≤ 2 * L₂)
    (source : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat F)
    [Fintype source.RealRand] [Nonempty source.RealRand]
    [Fintype source.IdealRand] [Nonempty source.IdealRand]
    (observer_program : source.Adversary → View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat →
      List (List UInt8 × OracleAnswer) → OProg)
    (R_wire_builder_checker_D75_retry : ∀ (adv : source.Adversary) (w : h.Instance),
      h.public w = x.1 → ScanCoupling
        (realTest h B outputs source adv x w)
        (realTest h B outputs (fsR1P W Pr 8 (by decide)
          (P_R1 h.transport B hB) (fun h' => VR1 h')) (RomObserverBin.observerMap source observer_program adv) x w))
    (G_sim_R_wire : ∀ adv : source.Adversary, ScanCoupling
      (idealTestS source adv x (simE h.transport B outputs x))
      (idealTestS (fsR1P W Pr 8 (by decide) (P_R1 h.transport B hB) (fun h' => VR1 h'))
        (RomObserverBin.observerMap source observer_program adv) x (simE h.transport B outputs x))) :
    ZK_FSS h B outputs source x (simE h.transport B outputs x)
      (modelError W Pr L₁ L₂ + 16 / (2 : ℚ)^486) ∧
    modelError W Pr L₁ L₂ + 16 / (2 : ℚ)^486 ≤
      1 / 2^109 + 1 / 2^137 + 1 / 2^454 := by
  let R_rom_classical : RomModel W := RomFiniteBin.rom base (RomGrammarBin.bound publicWidth)
  have R_rom_address_domain : ∀ w : h.Instance,
      RAddrIn W Pr R_rom_classical h B outputs x w :=
    RomGrammarBin.address_domain base publicWidth Pr h B outputs x R_wire_read_coverage
  have R_rom_adversary_budget : (W).qmax ≤ 2^64 :=
    RomFiniteBin.adversary_budget base (RomGrammarBin.bound publicWidth)
  have hb := commit_source W Pr R_commit_D80
  have hc : ∀ w : h.Instance, RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w :=
    fun w => (causal_iff W Pr h B outputs x w).mpr (R_causal_D80 w)
  have hop := wire_batches W Pr R_wire_D80_batches
  have hcom := (com_log_iff W Pr hb R_wire_coin_carrier h B outputs x).mpr R_wire_D80_ordered_log
  have hz := R1Z.PrivacyR1PBin.privacy_R1_games' W Pr 8 (by decide) h B hB outputs x
    hpub builder_refinement_D46_D51 D
    (R1J.PrivacySamplerSpend.samplerLaw_of_spend W D ι hι R_wire_Sem1Uniform)
    R_rom_classical R_rom_address_domain hc hb cF R_commit_equal_fibres L₁ L₂
    R_commit_exhaustion R_commit_counter₁ R_commit_counter₂ R_commit_stream₁ R_commit_stream₂
    R_wire_coin_carrier hop hcom
  have hm : ZK_FSS h B outputs (fsR1P W Pr 8 (by decide)
      (P_R1 h.transport B hB) (fun h' => VR1 h')) x
      (simE h.transport B outputs x) (modelError W Pr L₁ L₂) := by
    simpa only [modelError, abR1P, abR1, Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, zero_div, pow_two] using hz
  constructor
  · intro adv w hw
    have hr := scan_coupling_le _ _ (R_wire_builder_checker_D75_retry adv w hw)
      (fun _ => ⟨bit_nonneg _, bit_le_one _⟩) (fun _ => ⟨bit_nonneg _, bit_le_one _⟩)
    have hi := scan_coupling_le _ _ (G_sim_R_wire adv)
      (fun _ => ⟨bit_nonneg _, bit_le_one _⟩) (fun _ => ⟨bit_nonneg _, bit_le_one _⟩)
    have hmid := hm (RomObserverBin.observerMap source observer_program adv) w hw
    have t₁ := abs_sub_le
      (mean (realTest h B outputs source adv x w))
      (mean (realTest h B outputs (fsR1P W Pr 8 (by decide)
        (P_R1 h.transport B hB) (fun h' => VR1 h')) (RomObserverBin.observerMap source observer_program adv) x w))
      (mean (idealTestS (fsR1P W Pr 8 (by decide)
        (P_R1 h.transport B hB) (fun h' => VR1 h')) (RomObserverBin.observerMap source observer_program adv) x
          (simE h.transport B outputs x)))
    have t₂ := abs_sub_le
      (mean (realTest h B outputs source adv x w))
      (mean (idealTestS (fsR1P W Pr 8 (by decide)
        (P_R1 h.transport B hB) (fun h' => VR1 h')) (RomObserverBin.observerMap source observer_program adv) x
          (simE h.transport B outputs x)))
      (mean (idealTestS source adv x (simE h.transport B outputs x)))
    rw [abs_sub_comm] at hi
    calc _ ≤ (8 / (2 : ℚ)^486 + modelError W Pr L₁ L₂) + 8 / (2 : ℚ)^486 :=
          t₂.trans (add_le_add (t₁.trans (add_le_add hr hmid)) hi)
         _ = _ := by ring
  · have he := R1Z.PrivacyBoundR1PBin.binary_exhaustion_le W Pr L₁ L₂
      R_commit_cell_count R_commit_blocks₁ R_commit_blocks₂
    have hn := R1Z.GamesR1PBin.binary_games_error_le W Pr L₁ L₂ (W).qmax
      (εexhP 8 L₁ L₂ (8 * n1 W Pr)) R_commit_cell_count R_commit_blocks₁ R_commit_blocks₂
      R_rom_adversary_budget he
    have hn' : modelError W Pr L₁ L₂ ≤ 1 / 2^109 + 1 / 2^137 := by

    linarith [query_error_le]

      (R1J.PrivacySamplerSpend.samplerLaw_of_spend W D ι hι hD) adv x)
  intro adv w hw
  refine (hz adv w hw).trans ?_
  simpa only [abR1P, abR1, Nat.cast_ofNat] using
    (binary_games_error_le W Pr L₁ L₂ W.qmax (εexhP 8 L₁ L₂ (8 * n1 W Pr))
      hcount hb₁ hb₂ hq
      (R1Z.PrivacyBoundR1PBin.binary_exhaustion_le W Pr L₁ L₂ hcount hb₁ hb₂))

#print axioms privacy_R1_eff_binary
end R1Z.PrivacySimulatorBin
R1Z.SimulatorLogR1PBin:
import R1Z.SimulatorSupportBin
import R1Z.EventsR1PBin

/-! ZF2's verifier programming uses the binary multiproof read sets. The
payload simulator has no tree geometry: it is `simE` of RefPayload. Geometry
enters through W.comLog and progOracle. RComLog is stated on honest views;
finite-law support transports it to simE on precisely P_R1 ∧ VR1, the domain
of hvzk_R1S. No additional simulator-wire premise is introduced. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.SimulatorLogR1PBin
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.RefPayload
  R1Z.Batched R1Z.MaskImageVR1 R1Z.PredicateR1 R1Z.PoleMassR1 R1Z.SimulatorR1
  R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.EventsR1PBin R1Z.LayoutR1PBin
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-- On the HVZK domain, every simulated payload has an honest-view preimage.
The witness/tape are used only in this proof, never by simE. -/
theorem simE_honest_preimage (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (hB : R0Z.K4.PackField B)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hpub : PublicBase F x.1)
    (hs : R0Z.HonestValidity.BuilderSoundOn h B x)
    (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) (hP : P_R1 h.transport B hB ch)
    (hV : VR1 h ch w) (hw : h.public w = x.1) (t : Tape K F) :
    ∃ τ, view (Bat := R1Bat) h B outputs x w ch τ = simE h.transport B outputs x ch t :=
  SimulatorSupportBin.equalLaws_output _ _
    (hvzk_R1S h B hB outputs x hpub hs w ch hP hV hw) t

/-- The actual comLog at a simulated view is the concatenation of two
binary batches. Each batch reads exactly batchReadSet, without duplicates;
supplied siblings and slot padding add no read positions. -/
theorem simE_comLog_batches (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W)
    (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : R0Z.K4.PackField B)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hpub : PublicBase F x.1)
    (hs : R0Z.HonestValidity.BuilderSoundOn h B x)
    (eCm : W.Cm ≃ (RIdx → OracleAnswer)) (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr) (hop : ROpen Pr)
    (hcom : RComLog W Pr eCm h B outputs x)
    (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) (hP : P_R1 h.transport B hB ch)
    (hV : VR1 h ch w) (hw : h.public w = x.1) (t : Tape K F)
    (sec : SecP) (d : OracleAnswer) (roots : Fin 3 → OracleAnswer)
    (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) :
    ∃ (τ : Tape K F) (fib : Fin 2 → Fin 3 → Finset Fib)
      (reads : Fin 2 → List (Fin 3 ⊕ RIdx)),
      W.comLog (eCm.symm rest) roots (simE h.transport B outputs x ch t) ch =
        (reads 0).map (fun c =>
          (gram (E₁ := Pr.E₁) (E₂ := Pr.E₂) (W.pubBytes x) W.vtag (Pr.leafVal h w x τ ch) sec d rest (cposOf c),
            ansC roots rest c)) ++
        (reads 1).map (fun c =>
          (gram (E₁ := Pr.E₁) (E₂ := Pr.E₂) (W.pubBytes x) W.vtag (Pr.leafVal h w x τ ch) sec d rest (cposOf c),
            ansC roots rest c)) ∧
      (∀ b, (reads b).Nodup) ∧
      (∀ b, (reads b).toFinset = batchReadSet (fib b)) ∧
      (∀ b, (reads b).length = (batchReadSet (fib b)).card) ∧
      (∀ T, Pr.openFib ch T = fib 0 T ∪ fib 1 T) := by
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := simE_honest_preimage h B hB outputs x hpub hs w ch hP hV hw t
  obtain ⟨fib, reads, hcat, hn, hc, hu⟩ := hop.batches
  refine ⟨τ, fib ch, reads ch, ?_, hn ch, ?_, ?_, hu ch⟩
  · rw [← hτ, hcom w sec d τ roots rest ch]
    simp_rw [hb h w x sec d τ rest ch]
    rw [hcat ch, List.map_append]
  · intro b
    exact batch_toFinset _ _ (hc ch b)
  · intro b
    exact batch_length _ _ (hn ch b) (hc ch b)

/-- The ideal game's programmed table is exactly its verifier log: transcript
reads followed by comLog at the explicit simulated view, with fallback only
when the address is absent. Duplicate reads across batches use List.lookup. -/
theorem simE_progOracle (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (ch : Challenges K) (t : Tape K F)
    (c : R1Coins W.Cm W.Tab) (tab : W.Tab) (a : List UInt8) :
    progOracle W x (simE h.transport B outputs x ch t) c tab a =
      match List.lookup a
        (tLog W x (simE h.transport B outputs x ch t) c ++
          W.comLog c.2.2.1 c.2.1 (simE h.transport B outputs x ch t) (drawW W c)) with
      | some v => v
      | none => W.look tab a := rfl

#print axioms simE_honest_preimage
#print axioms simE_comLog_batches
#print axioms simE_progOracle
end R1Z.SimulatorLogR1PBin
R1Z.SimulatorSupportBin:
import R1Z.SimulatorR1

/-! Finite-law support transport, used to carry the binary R-wire log from
honest views to ZF2's explicit simulator without an additional wire axiom. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.SimulatorSupportBin
open R0Z

/-- Every output of an equal-law finite sampler is an output of the other.
This transports existence only; it does not change the simulator algorithm. -/
theorem equalLaws_output {R T V : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype T]
    (f : R → V) (g : T → V) (h : EqualLaws f g) (t : T) :
    ∃ r, f r = g t := by
  classical
  by_contra hn
  have hf : ∀ r, f r ≠ g t := by simpa using hn
  have hz : law f (g t) = 0 := by
    simp [law, mean, hf]
  haveI : Nonempty T := ⟨t⟩
  have hp : 0 < law g (g t) := by
    unfold law mean
    apply div_pos _ (by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos)
    have hb : (1 : ℚ) ≤ ∑ s : T, if g s = g t then (1 : ℚ) else 0 := by
      simpa using (Finset.single_le_sum
        (f := fun s : T => if g s = g t then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
        (fun s _ => by split_ifs <;> norm_num) (Finset.mem_univ t))
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hb
  rw [← h (g t), hz] at hp
  exact (lt_irrefl 0) hp

#print axioms equalLaws_output
end R1Z.SimulatorSupportBin

/-! D76 bound for the binary phase-indexed root, including both binding reads. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PrivacyBoundR1PBin
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.HvzkV R0Z.HvzkS R0Z.RefPayload
  R1Z.Batched R1Z.PredicateR1 R1Z.MaskImageVR1 R1Z.PoleMassR1 R1Z.ModelsVR1 R1Z.SimulatorR1
  R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.Sem1UniformR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.CouplingR1PBin R1Z.EventsR1PBin R1Z.FinalR1PBin
  R1Z.CommitReadsR1
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

theorem binary_exhaustion_le (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) (L₁ L₂ : ℕ)
    (hc : RCommitCount L₁ L₂) (h₁ : Pr.E₁ ≤ 2 * L₁) (h₂ : Pr.E₂ ≤ 2 * L₂) :
    εexhP 8 L₁ L₂ (8 * n1 W Pr) ≤ 1 / 2 ^ 229 := by
  have hm : ((8 * n1 W Pr : ℕ) : ℚ) ≤ 2 ^ 25 := by
    have h := n1_le W Pr L₁ L₂ hc h₁ h₂
    have hh : 8 * n1 W Pr ≤ 2 ^ 25 := by norm_num at h ⊢; omega
    exact_mod_cast hh
  have hl : (16 * (L₁ + L₂) : ℚ) ≤ 2 ^ 20 := by
    obtain ⟨hL₁, hL₂⟩ := hc
    have hh : 16 * (L₁ + L₂) ≤ 2 ^ 20 := by norm_num at hL₁ hL₂ ⊢; omega
    exact_mod_cast hh
  have he : (8 : ℚ) * 2 ^ 20 / 2 ^ 496 ≤ 1 / 2 ^ 230 := by
    apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℚ) < 2 ^ 496)
      (by positivity : (0 : ℚ) < 2 ^ 230)).mpr
    rw [one_mul, show (8 : ℚ) = 2 ^ 3 by norm_num, ← pow_add, ← pow_add]
    exact pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
  have hb : (2 : ℚ) ^ 25 * (1 / 2 ^ 255) = 1 / 2 ^ 230 := by
    rw [show (255 : ℕ) = 25 + 230 from rfl, pow_add]
    field_simp
  unfold εexhP
  norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat]
  calc
    _ ≤ (8 : ℚ) * 2 ^ 20 / 2 ^ 496 + 2 ^ 25 * (1 / 2 ^ 255) :=
      add_le_add
        (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl (by norm_num))
          (by positivity))
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm (by positivity))
    _ ≤ 1 / 2 ^ 230 + 1 / 2 ^ 230 := add_le_add he (le_of_eq hb)
    _ ≤ 1 / 2 ^ 229 := by norm_num

#print axioms binary_exhaustion_le

theorem privacy_R1_games_binary_bound (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W)
    (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : R0Z.K4.PackField B)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hpub : PublicBase F x.1)
    (hs : R0Z.HonestValidity.BuilderSoundOn h B x)
    (D : SemRows01 W)
    (ι : R1J.SamplerLawSpend.QF → K) (hι : Function.Injective ι)
    (hD : D.s1 = R1J.SamplerLawSpend.s1Spend ι)
    (R : RomModel W) (hin : ∀ w : h.Instance, RAddrIn W Pr R h B outputs x w)
    (hc : ∀ w : h.Instance, RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w)
    (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr) (cF : ℕ)
    (hfib : ∀ τ : Tape K F, (Finset.univ.filter
      (fun e : (Fin Pr.E₁ → OracleAnswer) × (Fin Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) =>
        Pr.tapeOf e.1 e.2 = some τ)).card = cF)
    (L₁ L₂ : ℕ) (hex : RExh Pr L₁ L₂) (hE₁ : Pr.E₁ ≤ 2 ^ 64) (hE₂ : Pr.E₂ ≤ 2 ^ 64)
    (h₁ : 16 * L₁ ≤ Pr.E₁ * 8) (h₂ : 16 * L₂ ≤ Pr.E₂ * 8)
    (eCm : W.Cm ≃ (RIdx → OracleAnswer)) (hop : ROpen Pr) (hcom : RComLog W Pr eCm h B outputs x)
    (hcount : RCommitCount L₁ L₂) (hb₁ : Pr.E₁ ≤ 2 * L₁) (hb₂ : Pr.E₂ ≤ 2 * L₂)
    (hq : W.qmax ≤ 2 ^ 64) :
    ZK_FSS h B outputs (fsR1P W Pr 8 (by decide) (P_R1 h.transport B hB) (fun h' => VR1 h')) x
      (simE h.transport B outputs x)
      (1 / 2 ^ 109 + 1 / 2 ^ 137) := by
  have hz := R1J.PrivacySamplerSpendBin.privacy_R1_games_spendSampler_bin
    W Pr 8 (by decide) h B hB outputs x hpub hs D ι hι hD R hin hc hb cF hfib
    L₁ L₂ hex hE₁ hE₂ h₁ h₂ eCm hop hcom
  intro adv w hw
  refine (hz adv w hw).trans ?_
  simpa only [abR1P, abR1, Nat.cast_ofNat] using
    (binary_games_error_le W Pr L₁ L₂ W.qmax (εexhP 8 L₁ L₂ (8 * n1 W Pr))
      hcount hb₁ hb₂ hq (binary_exhaustion_le W Pr L₁ L₂ hcount hb₁ hb₂))

#print axioms privacy_R1_games_binary_bound
end R1Z.PrivacyBoundR1PBin

import R1Z.PrivacyR1PBin

/-! Binary phase-indexed root with the extracted spend sampler law. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1J.PrivacySamplerSpendBin
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.HvzkV R0Z.HvzkS R0Z.RefPayload
  R1Z.Batched R1Z.PredicateR1 R1Z.MaskImageVR1 R1Z.PoleMassR1 R1Z.ModelsVR1 R1Z.SimulatorR1

attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}


theorem privacy_R1_games_spendSampler_bin (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : R0Z.K4.PackField B)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hpub : PublicBase F x.1)
    (hs : R0Z.HonestValidity.BuilderSoundOn h B x)
    (D : SemRows01 W)
    (ι : R1J.SamplerLawSpend.QF → K) (hι : Function.Injective ι)
    (hD : D.s1 = R1J.SamplerLawSpend.s1Spend ι)
    (R : RomModel W) (hin : ∀ w : h.Instance, RAddrIn W Pr R h B outputs x w)
    (hc : ∀ w : h.Instance, RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w)
    (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr) (cF : ℕ)
    (hfib : ∀ τ : Tape K F, (Finset.univ.filter
      (fun e : (Fin Pr.E₁ → OracleAnswer) × (Fin Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) =>
        Pr.tapeOf e.1 e.2 = some τ)).card = cF)
    (L₁ L₂ : ℕ) (hex : RExh Pr L₁ L₂) (hE₁ : Pr.E₁ ≤ 2 ^ 64) (hE₂ : Pr.E₂ ≤ 2 ^ 64)
    (h₁ : 16 * L₁ ≤ Pr.E₁ * 8) (h₂ : 16 * L₂ ≤ Pr.E₂ * 8)
    (eCm : W.Cm ≃ (RIdx → OracleAnswer)) (hop : ROpen Pr) (hcom : RComLog W Pr eCm h B outputs x) :
    ZK_FSS h B outputs (fsR1P W Pr N hN (P_R1 h.transport B hB) (fun h' => VR1 h')) x
      (simE h.transport B outputs x)
      (((N * n1 W Pr : ℕ) : ℚ) * (W.qmax : ℕ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
        (((N * n1 W Pr : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((N * n1 W Pr : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
          εexhP N L₁ L₂ (N * n1 W Pr)) +
        ((0 : ℕ) : ℚ) * ((0 : ℕ) : ℚ) / ((2 ^ 255 : ℕ) : ℚ) +
        (abR1P W N hN).N * ((4096 : ℚ) / (((2 ^ 31 - 1) ^ 4 - 1 : ℕ) : ℚ))) :=
  R1Z.PrivacyR1PBin.privacy_R1_games' W Pr N hN h B hB outputs x hpub hs D
    (R1J.PrivacySamplerSpend.samplerLaw_of_spend W D ι hι hD) R hin hc hb cF hfib
    L₁ L₂ hex hE₁ hE₂ h₁ h₂ eCm hop hcom

#print axioms privacy_R1_games_spendSampler_bin

import R1Z.LayoutTagR1PBin

/-! Counterexample to unconditionally separating binary nodes from abstract
duplex records. Only a 65-byte literal equality is reduced here. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.LayoutR1PBin
open R0Z.FsStatement R1Z.LensR1

/-- An abstract semantic absorb can equal a binary-node record. Wire lengths
are essential; first-byte separation cannot hold for arbitrary digests. -/
theorem binary_duplex_overlap :
    ∃ left right f : OracleAnswer, ∃ framed : List UInt8,
      [binTag] ++ ans left ++ ans right = ans f ++ [0, 0xa0] ++ framed := by
  refine ⟨(fun _ => 0), (fun i => if i.val = 0 then 0xa0 else 0),
    (fun i => if i.val = 0 then binTag else 0), List.replicate 31 0, ?_⟩
  decide

#print axioms binary_duplex_overlap
end R1Z.LayoutR1PBin
R1Z.PhaseProtocolCoverageBin:
import R1Z.PhaseProtocolInstanceBin

/-! Byte lengths and typed coverage of the constructed protocol, independent
of Rust execution joins. All facts hold on arbitrary counterfactual views. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PhaseProtocolCoverageBin
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R1Z.Batched R1Z.GamesR1
  R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.LensR1 R1Z.PhaseMessageEncodingBin
  R1Z.PhaseProtocolInstanceBin
local notation "K" => AspisWideTower.WideExact

/-- Count a fixed-width vector symbolically, without evaluating its cells. -/
theorem flatten_length {n m : ℕ} (xs : Fin n → List UInt8)
    (hf : ∀ i, (xs i).length = m) :
    (List.ofFn xs).flatten.length = n * m := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [List.ofFn_succ, List.flatten_cons, List.length_append, hf 0,
      ih (fun i => xs i.succ) (fun i => hf i.succ)]
    rw [Nat.succ_mul]
    omega

theorem wide_length (a : K) : (wideBytes a).length = 32 := by
  simpa only [wideBytes, List.length_map] using
    AspisR1.FoldedLeafCodec.encodeWide_length a

theorem encoded_length {n : ℕ} (xs : Fin n → K) :
    (encoded wideBytes xs).length = n * 32 := by
  unfold encoded AspisR1.FixedWidthDecoder.encode
  simpa only [List.flatMap_def, List.map_ofFn, Function.comp_def] using
    (flatten_length (fun i => wideBytes (xs i)) (fun i => wide_length (xs i)))

theorem semantic_length (p : R0Z.HonestView.Payload K R1Bat)
    (root : OracleAnswer) (i : Fin 27) :
    (semantic wideBytes p root i).length = WireLengthsR1PBin.semanticSize i := by
  unfold semantic WireLengthsR1PBin.semanticSize
  split_ifs
  all_goals try simp only [length_ans, wide_length, encoded_length, List.length_append,
    flatten_length _ (fun _ => encoded_length _), List.length_nil]
  all_goals omega

theorem opening_length (p : R0Z.HonestView.Payload K R1Bat)
    (root : OracleAnswer) (i : Fin 4) :
    (opening wideBytes p root i).length = WireLengthsR1PBin.openingSize i := by
  unfold opening WireLengthsR1PBin.openingSize
  split <;> (try split) <;> (try split)
  all_goals try simp only [length_ans, wide_length, encoded_length, List.length_append]

theorem final_length {CommitHandle Aux : Type}
    (v : ZkStatement.View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat) :
    (PhaseMessageEncodingBin.final wideBytes v).length = 2048 := encoded_length _

/-- The first 26 lanes are four bytes and the last is sixteen bytes. -/
theorem c1_slot_length (xs : Fin 27 → K) :
    (List.ofFn (fun c : Fin 27 => (wideBytes (xs c)).take
      (if c.val < 26 then 4 else 16))).flatten.length = 120 := by
  rw [List.ofFn_succ', List.concat_eq_append, List.flatten_append,
    List.flatten_cons, List.flatten_nil, List.append_nil, List.length_append]
  have hl : ∀ c : Fin 26, ((wideBytes (xs c.castSucc)).take
      (if c.castSucc.val < 26 then 4 else 16)).length = 4 := by
    intro c
    simp only [Fin.val_castSucc]
    rw [if_pos c.isLt, List.length_take, wide_length]
    rfl
  rw [flatten_length _ hl]
  simp only [Fin.val_last, Nat.lt_irrefl, if_false, List.length_take, wide_length]
  rfl


theorem c1_length (m : Fin 27 → Fin 1024 → K) (u : Fib) :
    (PhaseLeafEncodingBin.encoding.c1 m u).length = 480 := by
  unfold PhaseLeafEncodingBin.encoding
  exact flatten_length _ (fun _ => c1_slot_length _)

theorem c2_length (m : Fin 2 → Fin 1024 → K) (u : Fib) :
    (PhaseLeafEncodingBin.encoding.c2 m u).length = 128 := by
  unfold PhaseLeafEncodingBin.encoding
  dsimp only
  apply flatten_length (m := 32)
  intro s
  apply flatten_length (m := 16)
  intro c
  rw [List.length_take, wide_length]
  rfl

theorem folded_length (m : Fin 256 → K) (u : Fib) :
    (PhaseLeafEncodingBin.encoding.folded m u).length = 128 := by
  unfold PhaseLeafEncodingBin.encoding PhaseLeafEncodingBin.foldedLeaf
  dsimp only
  split <;> simp only [List.length_map, AspisR1.FoldedLeafCodec.encodeFolded_length,
    List.length_replicate]

theorem leaf_length {CommitHandle : Type} {F : Subfield K}
    (B : PackBasis F) (h : HonestProver K) (w : h.Instance)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (τ : Tape K F) (ch : Challenges K) (T : Fin 3) (u : Fib) :
    (PhaseLeafConstructionBin.leafVal PhaseLeafEncodingBin.encoding B h w x τ ch T u).length =
      if T.val = 0 then 480 else 128 := by
  unfold PhaseLeafConstructionBin.leafVal
  split <;> (try split) <;> simp only [c1_length, c2_length, folded_length]

theorem byte_mod_eq (n : ℕ) :
    UInt8.ofFin ⟨n % 256, Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)⟩ = (n % 256).toUInt8 := by
  apply UInt8.toNat_inj.mp
  change n % 256 = (n % 256) % 256
  exact (Nat.mod_mod n 256).symm

/-- Byte-carrier transport preserves the existing four little-endian bytes. -/
theorem length_bytes_eq (n : ℕ) :
    (AspisR1.PublicInitFrame.lengthBytes n).map UInt8.ofFin = le32 n := by
  simp only [AspisR1.PublicInitFrame.lengthBytes, List.ofFn_succ, List.ofFn_zero,
    List.map_cons, List.map_nil, le32, Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_succ]
  norm_num only [pow_zero, pow_one, Nat.div_one, Nat.reducePow]
  simp only [byte_mod_eq]

theorem framed_eq (tag : UInt8) (bs : List UInt8) :
    PhaseMessageEncodingBin.framed tag bs = [tag] ++ le32 bs.length ++ bs := by
  unfold PhaseMessageEncodingBin.framed AspisR1.RecordFrameCodec.frame
    AspisR1.RecordFrameCodec.header
  simp only [List.length_map, List.map_append, List.map_cons, List.map_nil,
    UInt8.ofFin_toFin, length_bytes_eq, List.map_map, Function.comp_def]
  congr 1
  exact List.map_id bs

/-- A list already proved to have the required width inhabits the typed carrier. -/
def bytesVector {n : ℕ} (bs : List UInt8) (hl : bs.length = n) : Vector UInt8 n :=
  ⟨bs.toArray, by simpa only [List.size_toArray] using hl⟩

theorem bytesVector_list {n : ℕ} (bs : List UInt8) (hl : bs.length = n) :
    (bytesVector bs hl).toList = bs := by
  simp only [bytesVector, Vector.toList, List.toList_toArray]

variable {CommitHandle Aux : Type} {F : Subfield K}

/-- The entire selected transcript is a D79/D81 wire, even off successful runs. -/
def transcriptWire (pub : List UInt8) (tag : UInt8)
    (v : ZkStatement.View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat) (c2 cf : OracleAnswer) :
    WireLengthsR1PBin.Wire where
  semantic := fun i => bytesVector (semantic wideBytes v.2 c2 i) (semantic_length _ _ i)
  opening := fun i => bytesVector (opening wideBytes v.2 cf i) (opening_length _ _ i)
  final := bytesVector (PhaseMessageEncodingBin.final wideBytes v) (final_length v)
  publicBytes := pub
  tag := tag

theorem transcript_rest (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (publicWidth : ℕ)
    (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (v : ZkStatement.View K CommitHandle Aux R1Bat)
    (tr : TRead → OracleAnswer) (roots : Fin 3 → OracleAnswer) :
    (recP (wire base publicWidth h B outputs x).toWire x v tr roots).rest =
      WireLengthsR1PBin.rest (transcriptWire (base.pubBytes x) base.vtag v (roots 1) (roots 2)) := by
  change Rest.mk _ _ _ _ _ = Rest.mk _ _ _ _ _
  congr 1
  · funext i
    change PhaseMessageEncodingBin.framed _ _ = WireLengthsR1PBin.framed _ i
    rw [framed_eq]
    simp only [WireLengthsR1PBin.framed, transcriptWire, bytesVector_list, semantic_length]

/-- D84 coverage is a model theorem after the public byte width is chosen. -/
theorem read_coverage (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (publicWidth : ℕ)
    (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (seed : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F (wire base publicWidth h B outputs x).toWire)
    (hp : (base.pubBytes x).length ≤ publicWidth) :
    RomGrammarBin.ReadCoverage (wire base publicWidth h B outputs x).toWire
      (prover base publicWidth h B outputs x seed).toProver publicWidth h B outputs x := by
  refine ⟨hp, ?_⟩
  intro w sec d v p
  cases p with
  | inl j =>
    let record := recP (wire base publicWidth h B outputs x).toWire x
      (view h B outputs x w
        (chOf (wire base publicWidth h B outputs x).toWire (trOf v))
        (tapeR (wire base publicWidth h B outputs x).toWire
          (prover base publicWidth h B outputs x seed).toProver v)) (trOf v) (rootsOf v)
    let tw := transcriptWire (base.pubBytes x) base.vtag
      (view h B outputs x w
        (chOf (wire base publicWidth h B outputs x).toWire (trOf v))
        (tapeR (wire base publicWidth h B outputs x).toWire
          (prover base publicWidth h B outputs x seed).toProver v))
      (rootsOf v 1) (rootsOf v 2)
    refine ⟨.transcript (SharedGrammarBridgeBin.toShared tw) hp j (fieldVal (fc j) record), ?_⟩
    change addrWith j (fieldVal (fc j) record)
      (WireLengthsR1PBin.rest (SharedGrammarBridgeBin.fromShared (SharedGrammarBridgeBin.toShared tw))) =
      addr j record
    rw [SharedGrammarBridgeBin.wire_roundtrip]
    unfold addr
    rw [show record.rest = WireLengthsR1PBin.rest tw from transcript_rest _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _]
  | inr c =>
    have hl : ∀ T u,
        ((prover base publicWidth h B outputs x seed).toProver.leafVal h w x
          (tapeR (wire base publicWidth h B outputs x).toWire
            (prover base publicWidth h B outputs x seed).toProver v)
          (chOf (wire base publicWidth h B outputs x).toWire (trOf v)) T u).length ≤ 480 := by
      intro T u
      change (PhaseLeafConstructionBin.leafVal PhaseLeafEncodingBin.encoding B h w x _ _ T u).length ≤ 480
      rw [leaf_length]
      split <;> omega
    exact ⟨.commitment (base.pubBytes x) hp base.vtag _ hl sec d (restOf v) c, rfl⟩
