import R1Z.QueryScanFreshUnion

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.QueryScanFreshNumerics
open R1Z.QueryScanFreshUnion R1Z.QueryScanRealLazyBound R1Z.QueryScanRealEntropy

/-- Monotonicity in the total prior-query envelope. -/
theorem fresh_budget_mono {q r : ℕ} (hq : q ≤ r) : freshBudget q ≤ freshBudget r := by
  unfold freshBudget
  gcongr

theorem fresh_budget_pow65 : freshBudget (2^65) = 1 / (2 : ℚ)^118 := by
  unfold freshBudget
  rw [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat, show (190 : ℕ) = 65 + 125 from rfl, pow_add]
  have h128 : (128 : ℚ) = 2^7 := by norm_num
  rw [h128, show (125 : ℕ) = 7 + 118 from rfl, pow_add]
  field_simp

theorem fresh_budget_small {q : ℕ} (hq : q ≤ 2^65) :
    freshBudget q ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ)^109 := by
  exact (fresh_budget_mono hq).trans (fresh_budget_pow65.le.trans
    (QueryScanHistoryRealNumerics.dyadic_mono (by omega : 109 ≤ 118)))

/-- The single conservative coupling budget fits inside the same numerical
freshness allowance. This is an inequality of budgets, not equality of events. -/
theorem lazy_budget_le_fresh {M q : ℕ} (hM : M ≤ 2^25) (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    lazyBudget M ≤ freshBudget q := by
  apply (lazy_budget_sharp hM).trans
  apply (QueryScanHistoryRealNumerics.dyadic_mono (by omega : 190 ≤ 204)).trans
  have h1 : 1 / (2 : ℚ)^190 ≤ freshBudget 1 := by
    unfold freshBudget
    rw [Nat.cast_one, mul_one]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by norm_num : (1 : ℚ) ≤ 128) (by positivity)
  exact h1.trans (fresh_budget_mono hq)

theorem fresh_total_lt_target {q : ℕ} (hq : q ≤ 2^65) :
    1 / (2 : ℚ)^109 + 1 / (2 : ℚ)^137 + 1 / (2 : ℚ)^454 + freshBudget q <
      1 / (2 : ℚ)^100 :=
  QueryScanHistoryRealNumerics.total_lt_target _ (fresh_budget_small hq)

/-- Keep the large dyadic denominator opaque to ring preprocessing. -/
theorem amount_identity (a κ d : ℚ) :
    ((κ + 8 / d) + a) + 8 / d = a + 16 / d + κ := by ring

#print axioms fresh_budget_mono
#print axioms fresh_budget_pow65
#print axioms fresh_budget_small
#print axioms lazy_budget_le_fresh
#print axioms fresh_total_lt_target
#print axioms amount_identity
end R1Z.QueryScanFreshNumerics
R1Z.QueryScanFreshUnion:
import R1Z.QueryScanRealEntropy

/-! Scan-step/earlier-entry union bound with a conservative 190-bit exponent.
Each pair law is proved using the retained real/lazy coupling, not inferred
from marginal entropy alone. The marginal state entropy is proved separately. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.QueryScanFreshUnion
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.HvzkV
  R0Z.FsAbortBounds R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.CouplingR1PBin
  R1Z.EventsR1PBin R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.AgreeR1PBin R1Z.LazyFrozen
  R1Z.QueryScanFreshInputs R1Z.QueryScanRealLazyBound R1Z.QueryScanRealFreshMass
  R1Z.QueryScanRealEntropy
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

def scanRead (j : Fin 8) : Bool → TRead
  | false => .qb j
  | true => .qa j

def freshBudget (q : ℕ) : ℚ := 128 * (q : ℚ) / (2 : ℚ)^190

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
variable (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W)
  (R : RomModel W) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
  (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
  (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance)

abbrev ScanStep := Fin N × Fin 8 × Bool

def scanIndex (p : ScanStep N) : Fin (N * n1 W Pr) :=
  (posE W Pr N).symm (p.1, .inl (scanRead p.2.1 p.2.2))

theorem scan_index_coverage (i : Fin (N * n1 W Pr)) (hi : scanPosition W Pr N i) :
    ∃ p, scanIndex W Pr N p = i := by
  rcases hp : posE W Pr N i with ⟨k, j | c⟩
  · cases j with
    | qb j =>
        refine ⟨(k,j,false), ?_⟩
        apply (posE W Pr N).injective
        simpa only [scanIndex, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, scanRead] using hp.symm
    | qa j =>
        refine ⟨(k,j,true), ?_⟩
        apply (posE W Pr N).injective
        simpa only [scanIndex, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, scanRead] using hp.symm
    | _ => simp [scanPosition, hp, IsScan] at hi
  · simp [scanPosition, hp] at hi

def issued (r : W.Tab × (Fin N → SecP)) (i : Fin (N * n1 W Pr)) : List UInt8 :=
  let a := gAddr W Pr h B outputs x w r.2 (W.look r.1 (W.pubBytes x))
  a i (runN a (W.look r.1) 0 i.val)

def priorHit (p : ScanStep N) (earlier : Option (Fin (N * n1 W Pr)))
    (r : W.Tab × (Fin N → SecP)) : Prop :=
  match earlier with
  | none => issued W Pr N h B outputs x w r (scanIndex W Pr N p) = W.pubBytes x
  | some j => j < scanIndex W Pr N p ∧
      issued W Pr N h B outputs x w r j = issued W Pr N h B outputs x w r (scanIndex W Pr N p)

theorem fresh_iff_prior_hit (r : W.Tab × (Fin N → SecP)) :
    realFresh W Pr N h B outputs x w r ↔
      ∃ p earlier, priorHit W Pr N h B outputs x w p earlier r := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, he | ⟨j, hj, he⟩⟩
    · obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := scan_index_coverage W Pr N i hi
      exact ⟨p, none, he⟩
    · obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := scan_index_coverage W Pr N i hi
      exact ⟨p, some j, hj, he⟩
  · rintro ⟨p, earlier, he⟩
    have hi : scanPosition W Pr N (scanIndex W Pr N p) := by
      simp only [scanPosition, scanIndex, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
      cases p.2.2 <;> trivial
    refine ⟨scanIndex W Pr N p, hi, ?_⟩
    cases earlier with
    | none => exact Or.inl he
    | some j => exact Or.inr ⟨j, he⟩

include hN in
/-- Individual earlier-entry guessing law, valid on actual real randomness.
A stronger 204-bit envelope pays upstream collisions before this pair. -/
theorem prior_hit_mass (hin : RAddrIn W Pr R h B outputs x w)
    (hc : RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w) (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr)
    (hE₁ : Pr.E₁ ≤ 2^64) (hE₂ : Pr.E₂ ≤ 2^64)
    (hM : N * n1 W Pr ≤ 2^25) (p : ScanStep N)
    (earlier : Option (Fin (N * n1 W Pr))) :
    eventMass (priorHit W Pr N h B outputs x w p earlier) ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ)^190 := by
  have hs := eventMass_mono (priorHit W Pr N h B outputs x w p earlier)
    (realFresh W Pr N h B outputs x w)
    (fun r hr => (fresh_iff_prior_hit W Pr N h B outputs x w r).mpr ⟨p, earlier, hr⟩)
  exact (hs.trans (real_fresh_mass W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hin hc hb hE₁ hE₂)).trans
    ((lazy_budget_sharp hM).trans
      (QueryScanHistoryRealNumerics.dyadic_mono (by omega : 190 ≤ 204)))

include hN in
/-- Union over the 128 scan calls and at most q earlier entries, including
the digest. Total q includes honest calls; the observer runs afterwards. -/
theorem real_fresh_linear (hin : RAddrIn W Pr R h B outputs x w)
    (hc : RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w) (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr)
    (hE₁ : Pr.E₁ ≤ 2^64) (hE₂ : Pr.E₂ ≤ 2^64)
    (hM : N * n1 W Pr ≤ 2^25) (hN8 : N = 8) (q : ℕ)
    (hq : N * n1 W Pr + 1 ≤ q) :
    eventMass (realFresh W Pr N h B outputs x w) ≤ freshBudget q := by
  have hu := mass_exists_le_card
    (fun p : ScanStep N × Option (Fin (N * n1 W Pr)) =>
      priorHit W Pr N h B outputs x w p.1 p.2)
    (1 / (2 : ℚ)^190)
    (fun p => prior_hit_mass W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hin hc hb hE₁ hE₂ hM p.1 p.2)
  have he : eventMass (realFresh W Pr N h B outputs x w) =
      mass (fun r => ∃ p : ScanStep N × Option (Fin (N * n1 W Pr)),
        priorHit W Pr N h B outputs x w p.1 p.2 r) := by
    unfold eventMass mass
    congr 1
    funext r
    have hh := fresh_iff_prior_hit W Pr N h B outputs x w r
    have hh' : realFresh W Pr N h B outputs x w r ↔
        ∃ p : ScanStep N × Option (Fin (N * n1 W Pr)), priorHit W Pr N h B outputs x w p.1 p.2 r := by
      simpa only [Prod.exists] using hh
    simp only [hh']
    split_ifs <;> rfl
  rw [he]
  apply hu.trans
  have hcard : Fintype.card (ScanStep N × Option (Fin (N * n1 W Pr))) =
      128 * (N * n1 W Pr + 1) := by
    simp [ScanStep, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin, hN8]
    <;> omega
  rw [hcard]
  unfold freshBudget
  push_cast
  simp only [mul_one_div]
  gcongr
  exact_mod_cast hq

#print axioms scan_index_coverage
#print axioms fresh_iff_prior_hit
#print axioms prior_hit_mass
#print axioms real_fresh_linear
end R1Z.QueryScanFreshUnion
R1Z.QueryScanRealEntropy:
import R1Z.QueryScanSharedHistoryMass
import R1Z.QueryScanRealFreshMass
import R1Z.QueryScanRealLazyJoin

/-! Conservative marginal min-entropy of the actual scan state. This is not
conditional entropy after revealing that state, nor is marginal min-entropy
alone used as a pair-collision hypothesis. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.QueryScanRealEntropy
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsGood R0Z.HvzkV
  R0Z.FsAbortBounds R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.CouplingR1PBin
  R1Z.LensR1 R1Z.EventsR1PBin R1Z.PremisesR1PBin R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.QueryScanFreshInputs R1Z.LayoutR1PBin
  R1Z.QueryScanRealLazyBound R1Z.QueryScanRealFreshMass
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

theorem lazy_budget_sharp {M : ℕ} (hM : M ≤ 2^25) :
    lazyBudget M ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ)^204 := by
  apply (QueryScanRealLazyJoin.lazy_budget_mono hM).trans
  have hp : ((2^25 : ℕ) : ℚ) = (2 : ℚ)^25 := by norm_cast
  unfold lazyBudget
  rw [hp]
  have h25 : (2 : ℚ)^25 ≤ (2 : ℚ)^50 := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
  have hh : (2 : ℚ)^25 * 2^25 = (2 : ℚ)^50 := by rw [← pow_add]
  rw [hh]
  calc _ ≤ (2 : ℚ)^50 / 2^255 + (2 : ℚ)^50 / 2^255 := by gcongr
       _ = 1 / (2 : ℚ)^204 := by
         rw [show (255 : ℕ) = 50 + 204 + 1 from rfl, pow_add, pow_add, pow_one]
         field_simp
         <;> ring

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
variable (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W)
  (R : RomModel W) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
  (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
  (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance)

def realState (k : Fin N) (j : Fin 8) (r : W.Tab × (Fin N → SecP)) : OracleAnswer :=
  attVec W Pr (realVector W Pr N h B outputs x w r) k (.inl (predecessor j))

/-- Coordinate projection factored over generic carriers to avoid concrete
byte Fintype instance normalization. -/
theorem coordinate_point {J U V S : Type} [Fintype J] [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]
    [Fintype V] [Nonempty V] [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
    (k : J) (z : U) :
    eventMass (fun p : S × (J → U) × V => p.2.1 k = z) = 1 / Fintype.card U := by
  have h1 : MP (fun p : S × (J → U) × V => p.2) := mp_snd
  have h2 : MP (fun p : (J → U) × V => p.1) := mp_fst
  have hm := (mp_comp h1 h2) (fun q => if q k = z then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
  classical
  have he := QueryScanSharedHistoryMass.eval_point_mass k z
  exact hm.trans he

include hN in
theorem real_state_point (hin : RAddrIn W Pr R h B outputs x w)
    (hc : RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w) (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr)
    (hE₁ : Pr.E₁ ≤ 2^64) (hE₂ : Pr.E₂ ≤ 2^64)
    (k : Fin N) (j : Fin 8) (z : OracleAnswer) :
    eventMass (fun r => realState W Pr N h B outputs x w k j r = z) ≤
      lazyBudget (N * n1 W Pr) + 1 / (2 : ℚ)^256 := by
  have hm := meanR_P W Pr R h B outputs x w N hN hc
    (fun r => if realState W Pr N h B outputs x w k j r = z then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
  have hm' : eventMass (fun s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr =>
      realState W Pr N h B outputs x w k j (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s) = z) =
      eventMass (fun r => realState W Pr N h B outputs x w k j r = z) := by
    unfold eventMass
    convert hm using 1 <;> congr 1 <;> funext a <;> split_ifs <;> rfl
  rw [← hm']
  have hsub : ∀ s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr,
      realState W Pr N h B outputs x w k j (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s) = z →
      lazyBad W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s ∨ (s k).2.1 (.inl (predecessor j)) = z := by
    intro s hs
    by_cases hn : lazyBad W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s
    · exact Or.inl hn
    · right
      unfold realState at hs
      rw [real_vector_toRP W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hin hc s hn, attVec_uVec] at hs
      exact hs
  apply (eventMass_mono _ _ hsub).trans
  have hp : eventMass (fun s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr =>
      (s k).2.1 (.inl (predecessor j)) = z) = 1 / (2 : ℚ)^256 := by
    have he := mean_eval k
      (fun a : AttS (F := F) W Pr => if a.2.1 (.inl (predecessor j)) = z then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
    have hc' := coordinate_point (S := SecP) (V := Tape K F × W.Tab)
      (.inl (predecessor j) : Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂) z
    have hz : eventMass (fun a : AttS (F := F) W Pr =>
        a.2.1 (.inl (predecessor j)) = z) = 1 / (2 : ℚ)^256 := by
      trans 1 / (Fintype.card OracleAnswer : ℚ)
      · convert hc' using 1 <;> unfold eventMass <;> apply QueryScanIdealHistory.mean_fintype_transport
      · rw [QueryScanSharedHistoryMass.answer_cardinality, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat]
    have he' : eventMass (fun s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr =>
        (s k).2.1 (.inl (predecessor j)) = z) =
        eventMass (fun a : AttS (F := F) W Pr => a.2.1 (.inl (predecessor j)) = z) := by
      unfold eventMass
      convert he using 1 <;> congr 1 <;> funext a <;> split_ifs <;> rfl
    exact he'.trans hz
  exact (eventMass_or_le _ _).trans (add_le_add
    (lazy_bad_mass W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb hE₁ hE₂) hp.le)

include hN in
/-- A deliberately conservative, proved 190-bit marginal min-entropy. The
fresh ideal predecessor coordinate has 256 bits; the loss pays all honest
collision histories in this coarse argument. -/
theorem real_state_min_entropy (hin : RAddrIn W Pr R h B outputs x w)
    (hc : RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w) (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr)
    (hE₁ : Pr.E₁ ≤ 2^64) (hE₂ : Pr.E₂ ≤ 2^64)
    (hM : N * n1 W Pr ≤ 2^25) (k : Fin N) (j : Fin 8) (z : OracleAnswer) :
    eventMass (fun r => realState W Pr N h B outputs x w k j r = z) ≤
      1 / (2 : ℚ)^190 := by
  apply (real_state_point W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hin hc hb hE₁ hE₂ k j z).trans
  have hsmall := lazy_budget_sharp hM
  have h256 := QueryScanHistoryRealNumerics.dyadic_mono (by omega : 204 ≤ 256)
  calc _ ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ)^204 + 1 / (2 : ℚ)^204 := add_le_add hsmall h256
       _ = 1 / (2 : ℚ)^203 := by
         rw [show (204 : ℕ) = 203 + 1 from rfl, pow_add, pow_one]
         field_simp
         <;> ring
       _ ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ)^190 := QueryScanHistoryRealNumerics.dyadic_mono (by omega)

#print axioms lazy_budget_sharp
#print axioms coordinate_point
#print axioms real_state_point
#print axioms real_state_min_entropy
end R1Z.QueryScanRealEntropy
R1Z.QueryScanRealFreshMass:
import R1Z.QueryScanRealLazyBound

/-! The actual scan-specific event is transported from real randomness.
A conservative honest-program collision envelope is sufficient to bound it;
this file does not identify that envelope with E_fresh. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.QueryScanRealFreshMass
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsGood R0Z.HvzkV R0Z.FsAbortBounds
  R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.CouplingR1PBin R1Z.LazyFrozen
  R1Z.AgreeR1PBin R1Z.EventsR1PBin R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.LayoutR1PBin
  R1Z.QueryScanFreshInputs R1Z.QueryScanRealLazyBound
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

theorem issued_eq_final {m : ℕ}
    (a : Fin m → (Fin m → OracleAnswer) → List UInt8)
    (hc : ∀ i v v', (∀ j, j < i → v j = v' j) → a i v = a i v')
    (H : List UInt8 → OracleAnswer) (i : Fin m) :
    a i (runN a H 0 i.val) = a i (runC a H 0) := by
  apply hc
  intro j hj
  exact (runN_le a H 0 i.val m (le_of_lt i.isLt) j (Fin.lt_def.mp hj)).symm

def IsScan : TRead → Prop
  | .qb _ | .qa _ => True
  | _ => False

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
variable (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W)
  (R : RomModel W) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
  (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
  (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance)

def scanPosition (i : Fin (N * n1 W Pr)) : Prop :=
  match (posE W Pr N i).2 with
  | .inl j => IsScan j
  | .inr _ => False

/-- E_fresh on the actual real randomness. The digest is included once. -/
def realFresh (r : W.Tab × (Fin N → SecP)) : Prop :=
  FreshFailure (scanPosition W Pr N) (W.pubBytes x)
    (gAddr W Pr h B outputs x w r.2 (W.look r.1 (W.pubBytes x))) (W.look r.1)

include hN in
/-- Reusing scan inputs implies a lazy coupling exception. It does not follow
that every honest exception invalidates scan freshness. -/
theorem real_fresh_implies_lazy (hin : RAddrIn W Pr R h B outputs x w)
    (hc : RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w)
    (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) :
    realFresh W Pr N h B outputs x w (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s) →
      lazyBad W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s := by
  intro he
  by_contra hn
  have hvec := real_vector_toRP W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hin hc s hn
  have hs (i : Fin (N * n1 W Pr)) :
      gAddr W Pr h B outputs x w (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s).2
        (W.look (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s).1 (W.pubBytes x)) i
        (runN (gAddr W Pr h B outputs x w (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s).2
          (W.look (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s).1 (W.pubBytes x)))
          (W.look (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s).1) 0 i.val) =
        addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (posE W Pr N i) := by
    rw [issued_eq_final _ (gAddr_causal W Pr N h B outputs x w hc _ _) _ i]
    change gAddr W Pr h B outputs x w _ _ i
      (realVector W Pr N h B outputs x w (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s)) = _
    rw [hvec, look_toRP, TP_pub]
    exact (addrQ_posE W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s i).symm
  obtain ⟨i, _, hp | ⟨j, hj, heq⟩⟩ := he
  · exact hn (Or.inr ⟨i, (hs i).symm.trans hp⟩)
  · exact hn (Or.inl ⟨j, i, hj, Or.inl trivial, (hs j).symm.trans (heq.trans (hs i))⟩)

include hN in
theorem real_fresh_mass (hin : RAddrIn W Pr R h B outputs x w)
    (hc : RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w) (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr)
    (hE₁ : Pr.E₁ ≤ 2^64) (hE₂ : Pr.E₂ ≤ 2^64) :
    eventMass (realFresh W Pr N h B outputs x w) ≤ lazyBudget (N * n1 W Pr) := by
  have hm := meanR_P W Pr R h B outputs x w N hN hc
    (fun r => if realFresh W Pr N h B outputs x w r then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
  have hm' : eventMass (fun s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr =>
      realFresh W Pr N h B outputs x w (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s)) =
      eventMass (realFresh W Pr N h B outputs x w) := by
    unfold eventMass
    convert hm using 1 <;> congr 1 <;> funext z <;> split_ifs <;> rfl
  rw [← hm']
  exact (eventMass_mono _ _ (real_fresh_implies_lazy W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hin hc)).trans
    (lazy_bad_mass W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb hE₁ hE₂)

#print axioms issued_eq_final
#print axioms real_fresh_implies_lazy
#print axioms real_fresh_mass
end R1Z.QueryScanRealFreshMass
R1Z.QueryScanRealLazyBound:
import R1Z.QueryScanFreshInputs

/-! A conservative real-model law from the retained lazy coupling. This
charges a single *honest program* collision event; it does not include any
adversary rereads. No claim of the sharper scan-only entropy law is made. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.QueryScanRealLazyBound
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsAbortBounds
  R0Z.HvzkV R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.LensR1 R1Z.TranscriptR1
  R1Z.LazyFrozen R1Z.CouplingR1PBin R1Z.AgreeR1PBin R1Z.EventsR1PBin R1Z.FinalR1PBin
  R1Z.LayoutR1PBin R1Z.QueryScanPrivacyFinal
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
variable (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W)
  (R : RomModel W) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
  (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
  (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance)

/-- Fixed all-honest-read event on the independent lazy coupling space. -/
def lazyBad (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) : Prop :=
  CollEv (N * n1 W Pr) (fun _ => True)
    (fun g s => addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (posE W Pr N g)) s ∨
  ∃ g, addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (posE W Pr N g) = W.pubBytes x

def lazyBudget (M : ℕ) : ℚ := (M : ℚ) * M / 2^255 + (M : ℚ) / 2^255

theorem lazy_bad_mass (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr)
    (hE₁ : Pr.E₁ ≤ 2^64) (hE₂ : Pr.E₂ ≤ 2^64) :
    mass (lazyBad W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w) ≤ lazyBudget (N * n1 W Pr) := by
  apply (mass_or_le _ _).trans
  apply add_le_add
  · exact collEv_mass_fresh _ _ (by positivity) _ _
      (fun i j hij _ => pair_all W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb hE₁ hE₂
        _ _ (fun he => ne_of_lt hij ((posE W Pr N).injective he)))
  · have hp := mass_exists_le_card
      (fun g s => addrQ W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s (posE W Pr N g) = W.pubBytes x)
      (1 / ((2^255 : ℕ) : ℚ)) (fun g =>
        pairFresh_mass _ _ _ (by positivity)
          (Or.inr (pf_pub W Pr R N hN h B outputs x hb w (posE W Pr N g))))
    simpa only [Fintype.card_fin, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat, mul_one_div] using hp

theorem off_lazy_bad_run (hin : RAddrIn W Pr R h B outputs x w)
    (hc : RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w)
    (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr)
    (hn : ¬ lazyBad W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s) :
    runC (gAddr W Pr h B outputs x w (fun k => (s k).1) (dS W Pr R N hN x s))
      (lookA R (TP W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s)) 0 = uVec W Pr s := by
  apply run_eq_lazy W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hin hc s
  · intro g j hj he
    exact hn (Or.inl ⟨j, g, hj, Or.inl trivial, he⟩)
  · intro g he
    exact hn (Or.inr ⟨g, he⟩)

/-- Actual vector evaluated by the honest real experiment, before publication. -/
def realVector (r : W.Tab × (Fin N → SecP)) : Fin (N * n1 W Pr) → OracleAnswer :=
  runC (gAddr W Pr h B outputs x w r.2 (W.look r.1 (W.pubBytes x))) (W.look r.1) 0

theorem real_vector_toRP (hin : RAddrIn W Pr R h B outputs x w)
    (hc : RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w)
    (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr)
    (hn : ¬ lazyBad W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s) :
    realVector W Pr N h B outputs x w (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s) =
      uVec W Pr s := by
  unfold realVector
  simp only [look_toRP, TP_pub]
  change runC (gAddr W Pr h B outputs x w (fun k => (s k).1) (dS W Pr R N hN x s))
    (W.look (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s).1) 0 = _
  rw [show W.look (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s).1 =
    lookA R (TP W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s) from funext (look_toRP W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s)]
  exact off_lazy_bad_run W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hin hc s hn

/-- Fixed parser failure at its own selected first-stop block. -/
def parserBad (q : Fin 8 → OracleAnswer) : Prop :=
  ∃ count, AspisV8R19.Q22WordScan.finish
    (PhaseSamplerParserBin.scanned (PhaseQueryScanBin.stop PhaseSamplerParserBin.done q) q).1 =
      .error count

def realBad (k : Fin N) (r : W.Tab × (Fin N → SecP)) : Prop :=
  parserBad (fun j => attVec W Pr (realVector W Pr N h B outputs x w r) k (.inl (.qb j)))

def lazyScanBad (k : Fin N) (s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr) : Prop :=
  parserBad (fun j => (s k).2.1 (.inl (.qb j)))

theorem parser_bad_mass : eventMass parserBad ≤ scanProbability := by
  have hi : ∀ q, parserBad q → AspisR1.QueryScanModelFailure.fails
      (QueryScanIndependentHistory.words64 q) := by
    intro q hq
    obtain ⟨count, hcount⟩ := hq
    exact QueryScanFirstStopHistory.selected_failure_implies_words_failure _ count hcount
  exact (eventMass_mono _ _ hi).trans (by
    simpa only [true_and] using
      QueryScanIndependentHistory.reached_failure_le (fun _ => True))

theorem lazy_scan_bad_mass (k : Fin N) :
    eventMass (lazyScanBad W Pr N k) ≤ scanProbability := by
  have h1 : MP (fun a : AttS (F := F) W Pr => a.2) := mp_snd
  have h2 : MP (fun a : (Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) × (Tape K F × W.Tab) => a.1) := mp_fst
  have h3 := QueryScanIdealHistory.coordinates_uniform (U := OracleAnswer)
    (fun j : Fin 8 => (Sum.inl (.qb j) : Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂))
    (by intro a b he; cases he; rfl)
  have hh1 := (mp_comp h1 h2)
    (fun v => if parserBad (fun j => v (.inl (.qb j))) then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
  have hh3 := h3 (fun q => if parserBad q then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
  have hh : mean (fun a : AttS (F := F) W Pr =>
      if parserBad (fun j => a.2.1 (.inl (.qb j))) then (1 : ℚ) else 0) =
      eventMass parserBad := by
    trans mean (fun v : Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer =>
      if parserBad (fun j => v (.inl (.qb j))) then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
    · exact hh1
    · convert hh3 using 1 <;> apply QueryScanIdealHistory.mean_fintype_transport
  have hm := mean_eval k
    (fun a : AttS (F := F) W Pr => if parserBad (fun j => a.2.1 (.inl (.qb j))) then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
  exact hm.le.trans (hh.le.trans parser_bad_mass)

include hN in
/-- A single global lazy collision budget, rather than one copy per attempt. -/
theorem real_bad_union_mass (hin : RAddrIn W Pr R h B outputs x w)
    (hc : RCausal W Pr h B outputs x w) (hb : RCommitBytes W Pr)
    (hE₁ : Pr.E₁ ≤ 2^64) (hE₂ : Pr.E₂ ≤ 2^64) :
    eventMass (fun r => ∃ k, realBad W Pr N h B outputs x w k r) ≤
      lazyBudget (N * n1 W Pr) + (N : ℚ) * scanProbability := by
  have hm := meanR_P W Pr R h B outputs x w N hN hc
    (fun r => if ∃ k, realBad W Pr N h B outputs x w k r then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
  have hm' : eventMass (fun s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr =>
      ∃ k, realBad W Pr N h B outputs x w k (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s)) =
      eventMass (fun r => ∃ k, realBad W Pr N h B outputs x w k r) := by
    unfold eventMass
    convert hm using 1 <;> congr 1 <;> funext z <;> split_ifs <;> rfl
  rw [← hm']
  change mass (fun s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr =>
    ∃ k, realBad W Pr N h B outputs x w k (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s)) ≤ _
  have hsub : ∀ s : Fin N → AttS (F := F) W Pr,
      (∃ k, realBad W Pr N h B outputs x w k (toRP W Pr R h B outputs x w hN s)) →
      lazyBad W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s ∨ ∃ k, lazyScanBad W Pr N k s := by
    intro s hs
    by_cases hn : lazyBad W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w s
    · exact Or.inl hn
    · right
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hs
      refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
      unfold realBad at hk
      rw [real_vector_toRP W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hin hc s hn, attVec_uVec] at hk
      exact hk
  exact (mass_mono _ _ hsub).trans ((mass_or_le _ _).trans (add_le_add
      (lazy_bad_mass W Pr R N hN h B outputs x w hb hE₁ hE₂)
      (by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using (mass_exists_le_card
        (lazyScanBad W Pr N) scanProbability (fun k => lazy_scan_bad_mass W Pr N k)))))

#print axioms real_vector_toRP
#print axioms parser_bad_mass
#print axioms lazy_scan_bad_mass
#print axioms real_bad_union_mass
#print axioms lazy_bad_mass
#print axioms off_lazy_bad_run
end R1Z.QueryScanRealLazyBound

import R1Z.PrivacyR1FinalProtocolHistory

/-! Exact scan input dependencies and the operational prior-read event.
The finite ROM table is total; freshness refers to the read history, not
membership in its underlying finite address domain. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.QueryScanFreshInputs
open R0P R0Z R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.JointView R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin
  R1Z.TranscriptR1 R1Z.LensR1 R1Z.LazyFrozen R1Z.CouplingR1PBin
  R1Z.AgreeR1PBin
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-- The state feeding each pair, in the actual answer-vector grammar. -/
def predecessor : Fin 8 → TRead
  | ⟨0, _⟩ => .absQ
  | ⟨n+1, hn⟩ => .qa ⟨n, by omega⟩

theorem scan_field (k : Fin 8) :
    fc (.qb k) = .ans (predecessor k) ∧
    fc (.qa k) = .ans (predecessor k) := by
  rcases k with ⟨_ | n, hk⟩ <;> exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

theorem scan_addresses (ρ : Rec) (k : Fin 8) :
    addr (.qb k) ρ = ans (ρ.tr (predecessor k)) ++ [1] ∧
    addr (.qa k) ρ = ans (ρ.tr (predecessor k)) ++ [2] := by
  obtain ⟨hb, ha⟩ := scan_field k
  simp only [addr, hb, ha, fieldVal, addrWith]
  exact ⟨trivial, trivial⟩

/-- Scan-specific prior reads of a causal program. The digest is the first
read; only earlier scheduled reads count. Post-proof adversary rereads do not. -/
def FreshFailure {m : ℕ} (scan : Fin m → Prop)
    (digest : List UInt8) (a : Fin m → (Fin m → OracleAnswer) → List UInt8)
    (H : List UInt8 → OracleAnswer) : Prop :=
  ∃ i, scan i ∧ (a i (runN a H 0 i.val) = digest ∨
    ∃ j : Fin m, j < i ∧
      a j (runN a H 0 j.val) = a i (runN a H 0 i.val))

theorem off_fresh_failure {m : ℕ} (scan : Fin m → Prop)
    (digest : List UInt8) (a : Fin m → (Fin m → OracleAnswer) → List UInt8)
    (H : List UInt8 → OracleAnswer) (hn : ¬ FreshFailure scan digest a H)
    (i : Fin m) (hi : scan i) :
    a i (runN a H 0 i.val) ≠ digest ∧
    ∀ j : Fin m, j < i →
      a j (runN a H 0 j.val) ≠ a i (runN a H 0 i.val) := by
  exact ⟨fun he => hn ⟨i, hi, Or.inl he⟩,
    fun j hj he => hn ⟨i, hi, Or.inr ⟨j, hj, he⟩⟩⟩

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-- No salt, counter, prover secret or message appears directly in a scan
input. Entropy must be established for this preceding oracle answer. -/
theorem real_scan_addresses (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W)
    (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) (sec : SecP)
    (d : OracleAnswer) (v : Pos1 Pr.E₁ Pr.E₂ → OracleAnswer) (k : Fin 8) :
    attAddr W Pr h B outputs x w sec d v (.inl (.qb k)) =
      ans (trOf v (predecessor k)) ++ [1] ∧
    attAddr W Pr h B outputs x w sec d v (.inl (.qa k)) =
      ans (trOf v (predecessor k)) ++ [2] := by
  exact scan_addresses _ k

#print axioms scan_field
#print axioms scan_addresses
#print axioms off_fresh_failure
#print axioms real_scan_addresses
end R1Z.QueryScanFreshInputs
R1Z.QueryScanRealLazyJoin:
import R1Z.QueryScanRealLazyBound
import R1Z.QueryScanHistoryRealNumerics

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.QueryScanRealLazyJoin
open R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.HvzkV R1Z.QueryScanHistorySplit
  R1Z.QueryScanPrivacyFinal R1Z.QueryScanRealLazyBound
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-- Aggregate model mass is transported once, with no per-attempt copy of κ. -/
theorem join_le {A M : Type} [Fintype A] [Fintype M]
    (f : A → ℚ) (g : M → ℚ) (bad : Fin 8 → M → Prop)
    (e : ModelExecutionJoin f g bad) (κ : ℚ)
    (hb : eventMass (fun m => ∃ i, bad i m) ≤ κ + 8 * scanProbability)
    (hf : ∀ a, 0 ≤ f a ∧ f a ≤ 1) (hg : ∀ m, 0 ≤ g m ∧ g m ≤ 1) :
    |mean f - mean g| ≤ κ + 8 / (2 : ℚ)^486 := by
  have hm := e.cp.meanM (fun m => if ∃ i, bad i m then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
  have hmass : eventMass (fun s => ∃ i, bad i (e.cp.toM s)) =
      eventMass (fun m => ∃ i, bad i m) := by
    unfold eventMass
    convert hm using 1 <;> congr 1 <;> funext z <;> split_ifs <;> rfl
  rw [← e.cp.meanR f, ← e.cp.meanM g]
  have ht := until_bad _ _ (fun s => hf _) (fun s => hg _) _ e.agreement
  have h8 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left scan_probability_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℚ) ≤ 8)
  calc _ ≤ eventMass (fun s => ∃ i, bad i (e.cp.toM s)) := ht
       _ = eventMass (fun m => ∃ i, bad i m) := hmass
       _ ≤ κ + 8 * scanProbability := hb
       _ ≤ κ + 8 / (2 : ℚ)^486 := by simpa only [mul_one_div] using add_le_add (le_refl κ) h8

theorem lazy_budget_mono {M Q : ℕ} (h : M ≤ Q) : lazyBudget M ≤ lazyBudget Q := by
  unfold lazyBudget
  gcongr

/-- Symbolic power splitting at the existing binary read-count envelope. -/
theorem lazy_budget_small {M : ℕ} (hM : M ≤ 2^25) :
    lazyBudget M ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ)^109 := by
  apply (lazy_budget_mono hM).trans
  have hp : ((2^25 : ℕ) : ℚ) = (2 : ℚ)^25 := by norm_cast
  unfold lazyBudget
  rw [hp]
  have h25 : (2 : ℚ)^25 ≤ (2 : ℚ)^50 := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
  have hh : (2 : ℚ)^25 * 2^25 = (2 : ℚ)^50 := by rw [← pow_add]
  rw [hh]
  calc _ ≤ (2 : ℚ)^50 / 2^255 + (2 : ℚ)^50 / 2^255 := by gcongr
       _ = 1 / (2 : ℚ)^204 := by
         rw [show (255 : ℕ) = 50 + 204 + 1 from rfl, pow_add, pow_add, pow_one]
         field_simp
         <;> ring
       _ ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ)^109 := QueryScanHistoryRealNumerics.dyadic_mono (by omega)

#print axioms join_le
#print axioms lazy_budget_mono
#print axioms lazy_budget_small
end R1Z.QueryScanRealLazyJoin
R1Z.QueryScanHistoryRealNumerics:
import R1Z.QueryScanWholeRunRepeatReal

/-! Independent numerical facts, not an assertion of a real-run collision law
or of a run-budget theorem. Six is the existing five-reader-plus-output
collision coefficient. The run would still have to prove the stated q cap. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.QueryScanHistoryRealNumerics

def kappa (q : ℕ) : ℚ := 6 * (q : ℚ)^2 / (2 : ℚ)^256

theorem kappa_mono {q r : ℕ} (hq : q ≤ r) : kappa q ≤ kappa r := by
  unfold kappa
  gcongr

/-- Closed form only: no evaluation of 2^256 or a recurrence. -/
theorem kappa_pow (b d : ℕ) (h : b * 2 + d = 256) :
    kappa (2^b) = 6 / (2 : ℚ)^d := by
  unfold kappa
  rw [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat, ← pow_mul, ← h, pow_add]
  field_simp

/-- Inverse powers decrease with the exponent. -/
theorem dyadic_mono {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) :
    1 / (2 : ℚ)^n ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ)^m := by
  exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity)
    (pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) h)

/-- A candidate envelope q ≤ 2^65 gives exactly c=6 and ample numerical slack.
This is conditional on a budget, not proof that the whole-run event is rare. -/
theorem kappa_budget {q : ℕ} (hq : q ≤ 2^65) :
    kappa q ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ)^109 := by
  apply (kappa_mono hq).trans
  rw [kappa_pow 65 126 (by omega)]
  have h6 : (6 : ℚ) ≤ 2^17 := calc
    6 ≤ (2 : ℚ)^3 := by norm_num
    _ ≤ 2^17 := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega)
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)).2
  rw [show (126 : ℕ) = 109 + 17 by omega, pow_add, one_mul]
  simpa only [mul_comm] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h6
    (le_of_lt (pow_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℚ) < 2) 109))

/-- The requested numerical conclusion follows by monotonicity and exponent
splitting whenever a genuine collision law supplies this small a term. -/
theorem total_lt_target (κ : ℚ) (hκ : κ ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ)^109) :
    1 / (2 : ℚ)^109 + 1 / (2 : ℚ)^137 + 1 / (2 : ℚ)^454 + κ <
      1 / (2 : ℚ)^100 := by
  have h137 := dyadic_mono (by omega : 109 ≤ 137)
  have h454 := dyadic_mono (by omega : 109 ≤ 454)
  have hsum : 1 / (2 : ℚ)^109 + 1 / (2 : ℚ)^137 + 1 / (2 : ℚ)^454 + κ ≤
      4 / (2 : ℚ)^109 := by
    have h4 (a : ℚ) : a + a + a + a = 4 * a := by ring

/-! Specialization to the actual finite-ROM randomness and fixed observer cap.
The counterexample is unconditioned and uses the in-domain address []. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.QueryScanWholeRunRepeatReal
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort
  R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin R1Z.QueryScanWholeRunRepeatObstruction
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-- The actual observer cap suffices without evaluating its numeral. -/
theorem observer_cap (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (bound : ℕ) :
    2 ≤ (RomFiniteBin.wire base bound).qmax := by
  change 2 ≤ (2 : ℕ)^64
  exact le_self_pow₀ (by decide) (by decide)

/-- The counterexample reads are within the finite-ROM domain. -/
theorem repeat_address_in_domain (bound : ℕ) :
    ([] : List UInt8) ∈ RomFiniteBin.domain bound :=
  (RomFiniteBin.mem_domain bound []).mpr (Nat.zero_le _)

/-- No hypotheses about honest success or scan outcomes: mass is exactly one
on the finite table × eight-secret real carrier used by fsR1P. -/
theorem finite_real_repeat_mass
    (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (bound : ℕ)
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F (RomFiniteBin.wire base bound))
    (P : Challenges K → Prop)
    (Vp : (h : HonestProver K) → Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop)
    (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) :
    eventMass (fun r : (fsR1P (RomFiniteBin.wire base bound) Pr 8 (by decide) P Vp).RealRand =>
      repeatedRead (realGameP (RomFiniteBin.wire base bound) Pr 8 P Vp h B outputs
        (repeatAdversary []) x w r).observerOracle) = 1 := by
  apply covering_event_mass_one
    (fun r => (realGameP (RomFiniteBin.wire base bound) Pr 8 P Vp h B outputs
      (repeatAdversary []) x w r).observerOracle)
  · intro r
    exact real_game_repeats _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ r [] (observer_cap base bound)
  · intro _ hr
    exact hr

/-- The requested E_coll cannot simultaneously cover whole-run repeats and
have any bound κ < 1, on the retained finite-ROM experiment itself. -/
theorem finite_real_no_small_exclusion
    (base : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux) (bound : ℕ)
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F (RomFiniteBin.wire base bound))
    (P : Challenges K → Prop)
    (Vp : (h : HonestProver K) → Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop)
    (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance)
    (E_coll : (fsR1P (RomFiniteBin.wire base bound) Pr 8 (by decide) P Vp).RealRand → Prop)
    (covers_repeats : ∀ r, repeatedRead (realGameP (RomFiniteBin.wire base bound) Pr 8 P Vp
      h B outputs (repeatAdversary []) x w r).observerOracle → E_coll r)
    (κ : ℚ) (hκ : κ < 1) : ¬ eventMass E_coll ≤ κ := by
  exact no_small_covering_event _ E_coll
    (fun r => real_game_repeats _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ r [] (observer_cap base bound))
    covers_repeats κ hκ

/-! A whole-run event covering every repeated read is not a birthday event.
The retained post-proof adversary may deliberately query one address twice.
The counterexample uses in-domain reads and works for every oracle and every
honest outcome, including failure. No property of the scan is assumed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.QueryScanWholeRunRepeatObstruction
open R0P R0Z R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort
  R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.GamesR1PBin
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-- Two reads, using the answer-insensitive continuations allowed by OProg. -/
def repeatProgram (a : List UInt8) : OProg :=
  .query a (fun _ => .query a (fun _ => .done))

/-- The concrete fixed log event: some address occurs more than once. -/
def repeatedRead (log : List (List UInt8 × OracleAnswer)) : Prop :=
  ¬ (log.map Prod.fst).Nodup

theorem repeatProgram_log (a : List UInt8) (H : List UInt8 → OracleAnswer)
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 2 ≤ q) :
    runLog (repeatProgram a) H q = [(a, H a), (a, H a)] := by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hq
  rw [show 2 + n = n + 1 + 1 by omega]
  rfl

theorem prefix_repeat (pre : List (List UInt8 × OracleAnswer))
    (a : List UInt8) (b : OracleAnswer) :
    repeatedRead (pre ++ [(a, b), (a, b)]) := by
  simp [repeatedRead, List.nodup_append]

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K]

def repeatAdversary (a : List UInt8) : R1Adv K CommitHandle Aux where
  prog := fun _ _ => repeatProgram a
  decide := fun _ => false

variable [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-- Exact retained real game: the repeated reads survive both firstGood branches.
Thus they are also reads of the complete run, not just of an invented subrun. -/
theorem real_game_repeats (W : R1Wire K CommitHandle Aux)
    (Pr : R1ProverP K CommitHandle Aux F W) (N : ℕ)
    (P : Challenges K → Prop)
    (Vp : (h : HonestProver K) → Challenges K → h.Instance → Prop)
    (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance)
    (r : W.Tab × (Fin N → SecP)) (a : List UInt8) (hq : 2 ≤ W.qmax) :
    repeatedRead (realGameP W Pr N P Vp h B outputs (repeatAdversary a) x w r).observerOracle := by
  unfold realGameP
  dsimp only
  split
  · change repeatedRead (runLog (repeatProgram a) (W.look r.1) W.qmax)
    rw [repeatProgram_log a _ _ hq]
    exact prefix_repeat [] a _
  · change repeatedRead (_ ++ runLog (repeatProgram a) (W.look r.1) W.qmax)
    rw [repeatProgram_log a _ _ hq]
    exact prefix_repeat _ a _

/-- Any excluded event containing this fixed repeated-read event has mass one.
The containment premise has only execution content, with no probability law. -/
theorem covering_event_mass_one {R : Type} [Fintype R] [Nonempty R]
    (log : R → List (List UInt8 × OracleAnswer)) (E : R → Prop)
    (hrep : ∀ r, repeatedRead (log r))
    (hcover : ∀ r, repeatedRead (log r) → E r) : eventMass E = 1 := by
  have he : ∀ r, E r := fun r => hcover r (hrep r)
  unfold eventMass
  simp only [he, if_true]
  exact mean_const 1

/-- No collision term below one bounds an event covering all repeated reads. -/
theorem no_small_covering_event {R : Type} [Fintype R] [Nonempty R]
    (log : R → List (List UInt8 × OracleAnswer)) (E : R → Prop)
    (hrep : ∀ r, repeatedRead (log r))
    (hcover : ∀ r, repeatedRead (log r) → E r)
    (κ : ℚ) (hκ : κ < 1) : ¬ eventMass E ≤ κ := by
  rw [covering_event_mass_one log E hrep hcover]
  exact not_le_of_gt hκ

#print axioms prefix_repeat
#print axioms real_game_repeats
#print axioms covering_event_mass_one
#print axioms no_small_covering_event

/-! Assemble SourceIdentification from raw runtime records and admission.
No lane, helper, trace-validity or BuilderSoundOn field is assumed. The
runtime witness of this structure for the shipped compiler is still open. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.BuilderRuntimeJoin
open R0P R0Z.WriterRefine R0Z.HonestValidity R0Z.ZkStatement
open R1J.SpendWitnessMap BuilderRecordCanonical
variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] [CharP K 2147483647]

/-- One named remaining Rust join. Data is the compiler's raw word records
and full semantic public projection. Proofs must concern those same records.
The empty-root obligation is explicitly in publicCorr.empty; arbitrary-root
mapper equivalence cannot supply it. `admission` includes D50's sentinel.
Only WitnessOk's value/bit/sibling bounds are required, not canonical
key/owner/salt/pair words. The build handoff uses field-trace normalization,
so the two optional byte-roundtrip lemmas below are not assembly premises.
This record contains neither a source-identification certificate nor any of
the four soundness conclusions it is used to derive. -/
structure RustRuntimeJoin (source : HonestProver K) where
  publicInput : source.Instance → Public F
  witnessRecord : source.Instance → RustWitness
  publicRecord : source.Instance → RustPublic
  words : ∀ w, WitnessOk (witnessRecord w)
  publicCorr : ∀ w, PubCorr (publicRecord w) (mapPub (K := K) (publicInput w))
  admission : ∀ w, BuilderSpendRelation.RspendPlus
    (mapPub (K := K) (publicInput w))
    (BuilderCanonical.liftWitness (witness (witnessRecord w)))
  public_eq : ∀ w, source.public w = mapPub (publicInput w)
  raw_trace_eq : ∀ w, source.build w =
    BuilderRefinement.mergedTrace (witnessRecord w) (publicRecord w)
  transport_eq : source.transport = BuilderSource.π

variable {source : HonestProver K}

def toInstance (join : RustRuntimeJoin source) (w : source.Instance) :
    BuilderCanonical.Instance (K := K) :=
  ⟨(join.publicInput w, witness (join.witnessRecord w)), join.admission w⟩

theorem witness_record (join : RustRuntimeJoin source) (w : source.Instance)
    (hw : CanonicalWords (join.witnessRecord w)) :
    BuilderCanonical.rustWitness (toInstance join w).val.2 = join.witnessRecord w :=
  canonical_witness _ hw

theorem public_record (join : RustRuntimeJoin source) (w : source.Instance)
    (hp : PubCorr (join.publicRecord w) (join.publicInput w))
    (ha : (join.publicRecord w).asset.val < 2147483647) :
    BuilderCanonical.rustPublic (toInstance join w).val.1 = join.publicRecord w :=
  BuilderPublicCanonical.public_roundtrip _ _ hp ha

/-- Complete final assembly of the three original SourceIdentification
fields. The primitive runtime join is explicit, not constructed for Rust. -/
def sourceIdentification (join : RustRuntimeJoin source) :
    BuilderSource.SourceIdentification source (toInstance join) where
  public_eq := join.public_eq
  build_eq := by
    intro w
    rw [join.raw_trace_eq w, BuilderSource.build_map]
    exact BuilderFieldNormalization.trace_normalization _ _ _ (join.words w) (join.publicCorr w)
  transport_eq := join.transport_eq

theorem builder_refinement_D46_D51 {CommitHandle : Type}
    (hcard : 4096 < Fintype.card K) (Fbase : Subfield K)
    (B : PackBasis Fbase) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (join : RustRuntimeJoin source) : BuilderSoundOn source B x :=
  BuilderSource.builder_refinement_D46_D51 hcard Fbase B x source
    (toInstance join) (sourceIdentification join)

/-! Public record reconstruction, including the exact frozen empty roots.
PubCorr is over M31 here, so its equality retains canonical-word identity.
The runtime still owes PubCorr for the computed pair_empty_roots result. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.BuilderPublicCanonical
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std R0Z.WriterRefine R0Z.BuilderModel
open R1J.SpendWitnessMap R1Z.BuilderRecordCanonical

theorem frozen_word (l : Fin 20) (i : Fin 8) :
    w32 (emptyRootK (K := F) l i) = emptyWord l i := by
  apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
  rw [w32_val, emptyWord, UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
  change ((R0P.emptyRootsNat l.castSucc i : Nat) : ZMod 2147483647).val = _
  rw [ZMod.val_natCast, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (emptyRoot_lt _ _)]

/-- Reconstruct every public-record field. Empty roots are fixed by PubCorr,
not inferred from arbitrary-root record projection equivalence. -/
theorem public_roundtrip (p : RustPublic) (pub : R0P.Public F)
    (hp : PubCorr p pub) (ha : p.asset.val < 2147483647) :
    toRustPub pub = p := by
  unfold toRustPub
  congr 1
  · exact hp.variant.symm
  · rw [← hp.asset]
    exact word_roundtrip _ ha
  · exact hp.next.symm
  · apply array_ext
    intro l hl
    rw [arr20_get _ l (by simpa using hl)]
    apply array_ext
    intro i hi
    rw [d32, arr8_get _ i (by simpa using hi)]
    rw [← hp.frontier ⟨l, by simpa using hl⟩ ⟨i, by simpa using hi⟩]
    exact word_roundtrip _ (hp.frontierCanon ⟨l, by simpa using hl⟩ i (by simpa using hi))
  · apply array_ext
    intro l hl
    rw [arr20_get _ l (by simpa using hl)]
    apply array_ext
    intro i hi
    rw [arr8_get _ i (by simpa using hi), ← frozen_word]
    rw [← hp.empty ⟨l, by simpa using hl⟩ ⟨i, by simpa using hi⟩]
    exact word_roundtrip _ (hp.emptyCanon ⟨l, by simpa using hl⟩ i (by simpa using hi))

explicit caller obligations; this does not infer them from Rust admission. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.BuilderRecordCanonical
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std R0Z.WriterRefine R0Z.BuilderModel
open R1J.SpendWitnessMap

structure CanonicalWords (w : RustWitness) : Prop where
  shape : WitnessOk w
  sk : Canon8 w.sk
  salt : Canon8 w.salt
  pairFirst : Canon8 w.pairFirst
  pairOccupied : w.pairOccupied.val < 2147483647
  pairSecond : Canon8 w.pairSecond
  pairInverse : w.pairInverse.val < 2147483647
  recipientOwner : Canon8 w.recipientOwner
  recipientSalt : Canon8 w.recipientSalt
  changeOwner : Canon8 w.changeOwner
  changeSalt : Canon8 w.changeSalt

theorem array_ext {α : Type} [Inhabited α] {n : Usize} (a b : Array α n)
    (h : ∀ i, i < n.val → a.val[i]! = b.val[i]!) : a = b := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply List.ext_getElem (a.property.trans b.property.symm)
  intro i hi hj
  simpa only [getElem!_pos a.val i hi, getElem!_pos b.val i hj] using
    h i (by simpa only [a.property] using hi)

theorem word_roundtrip (x : U32) (hx : x.val < 2147483647) :
    w32 (liftU (K := F) x) = x := by
  apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
  rw [w32_val]
  change (x.val : ZMod 2147483647).val = x.val
  rw [ZMod.val_natCast, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hx]

theorem value_roundtrip (x : U32) (hx : x.val < 2^30) :
    v32 (val30 x) = x := by
  apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
  rw [v32_val]
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hx

theorem digest_roundtrip (d : Array U32 8#usize) (hd : Canon8 d) :
    d32 (digK (K := F) d) = d := by
  apply array_ext
  intro i hi
  rw [d32, arr8_get _ i (by simpa using hi)]
  exact word_roundtrip _ (hd i (by simpa using hi))

/-- Every one of the fifteen raw witness fields is retained, with no modular
aliasing of values, direction bits, pair coordinates or digest limbs. -/
theorem records_roundtrip (w : RustWitness) (hw : CanonicalWords w) :
    toRust (toModel (K := F) w) = w := by
  unfold toRust toModel
  congr 1
  · exact value_roundtrip _ hw.shape.values.1
  · exact value_roundtrip _ hw.shape.values.2.1
  · exact value_roundtrip _ hw.shape.values.2.2
  · exact digest_roundtrip _ hw.sk
  · exact digest_roundtrip _ hw.salt
  · apply array_ext
    intro i hi
    rw [R1J.SpendWitnessMap.arr24_get _ i (by simpa using hi)]
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    change (if decide ((w.bits.val[i]!).val ≠ 0) then 1#u32 else 0#u32).val =
      (w.bits.val[i]!).val
    obtain hz | ho := hw.shape.bits i (by simpa using hi)
    · rw [hz]; rfl
    · rw [ho]; rfl
  · apply array_ext
    intro i hi
    rw [R1J.SpendWitnessMap.arr24_get _ i (by simpa using hi)]
    exact digest_roundtrip _ (hw.shape.sibs i (by simpa using hi))
  · exact digest_roundtrip _ hw.pairFirst
  · exact word_roundtrip _ hw.pairOccupied
  · exact digest_roundtrip _ hw.pairSecond
  · exact word_roundtrip _ hw.pairInverse
  · exact digest_roundtrip _ hw.recipientOwner
  · exact digest_roundtrip _ hw.recipientSalt
  · exact digest_roundtrip _ hw.changeOwner
  · exact digest_roundtrip _ hw.changeSalt

/-- The semantic witness read from the raw records, including the first
commitment (which is not discarded by modelWitness). -/
def witness (w : RustWitness) : AspisR1.SpendRelation.Wspend :=
  let m := toModel (K := F) w
  { inputValue := m.inputValue, outputValue := m.outputValue, changeValue := m.changeValue,
    sk := m.sk, salt := m.salt, path := m.path,
    pair := ⟨m.pairFirst, m.pairOccupied, m.pairSecond, m.pairInverse⟩,
    recipientOwner := m.recipientOwner, recipientSalt := m.recipientSalt,
    changeOwner := m.changeOwner, changeSalt := m.changeSalt }

theorem witness_model (w : RustWitness) :
    BuilderSpendRelation.modelWitness (witness w) = toModel (K := F) w := rfl

theorem canonical_witness (w : RustWitness) (hw : CanonicalWords w) :
    BuilderCanonical.rustWitness (witness w) = w := records_roundtrip w hw

  rw [ι_apply]
  exact natCast_mem F _

theorem witnessBase_lift (F : Subfield K) (w : Wspend) :
    WitnessBase F (modelWitness (liftWitness w)) where
  sk := fun _ => image_mem F _
  salt := fun _ => image_mem F _
  path := fun _ _ => image_mem F _
  pairOccupied := image_mem F _
  pairSecond := fun _ => image_mem F _
  pairInverse := image_mem F _
  recipientOwner := fun _ => image_mem F _
  recipientSalt := fun _ => image_mem F _
  changeOwner := fun _ => image_mem F _
  changeSalt := fun _ => image_mem F _

theorem publicBase_map (F : Subfield K) (pub : Public R1J.SpendWitnessMap.F) :
    PublicBase F (mapPub pub) := by
  refine ⟨fun _ => image_mem F _, fun _ => image_mem F _, image_mem F _, ?_,
    fun _ => image_mem F _, ?_, fun _ _ => image_mem F _, fun _ => image_mem F _,
    fun _ _ => image_mem F _⟩
  · intro r hr i
    change pub.recipient.map (fun d i => (ι : R1J.SpendWitnessMap.F →+* K) (d i)) = some r at hr
    cases ho : pub.recipient with
    | none => simp only [ho, Option.map_none] at hr; contradiction
    | some d =>
      rw [ho, Option.map_some] at hr
      cases hr
      exact image_mem F _
  · intro a ha
    change pub.withdrawalAmount.map (ι : R1J.SpendWitnessMap.F →+* K) = some a at ha
    cases ho : pub.withdrawalAmount with
    | none => simp only [ho, Option.map_none] at ha; contradiction
    | some d =>
      rw [ho, Option.map_some] at ha
      cases ha
      exact image_mem F _

/-- Named canonical record maps; the words are exactly those of T1–T3. -/
def rustWitness (w : Wspend) : RustWitness := toRust (modelWitness w)
def rustPublic (pub : Public R1J.SpendWitnessMap.F) : RustPublic := toRustPub pub

/-- The lifted extracted trace is the semantic model on the embedded witness. -/
theorem canonical_trace (pub : Public R1J.SpendWitnessMap.F) (w : Wspend) :
    BuilderRefinement.mergedTrace (rustWitness w) (rustPublic pub) =
      buildModel (mapPub (K := K) pub) (modelWitness (liftWitness w)) := by
  rw [BuilderRefinement.mergedTrace_eq_model (rustWitness w) (rustPublic pub) (mapPub pub)
    (pubCorr_toRustPub pub) (witnessOk_toRust (modelWitness w))]
  rw [rustWitness, toModel_toRust, ← modelWitness_lift]

/-- No semantic model premise is assumed: it is derived from Rspend⁺. -/
theorem admitted_of_spend (F : Subfield K) (pub : Public R1J.SpendWitnessMap.F)
    (w : Wspend) (h : RspendPlus (mapPub pub) (liftWitness (K := K) w)) :
    BuilderRefinement.Admitted F (mapPub pub) (rustWitness w) (rustPublic pub) where
  publicCorr := pubCorr_toRustPub pub
  words := witnessOk_toRust (modelWitness w)
  semantic := by
    rw [rustWitness, toModel_toRust, ← modelWitness_lift]
    exact modelRel_of_spend F _ _ (publicBase_map F pub) (witnessBase_lift F w) h

/-- Mathematical honest instances of the embedded Rspend⁺ relation. -/
def Instance : Type :=
  {p : Public R1J.SpendWitnessMap.F × Wspend //
    RspendPlus (mapPub (K := K) p.1) (liftWitness p.2)}

/-- The builder is the extracted merged writer composition on canonical records. -/
def prover (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) : HonestProver K where
  Instance := Instance (K := K)
  transport := π
  «public» := fun p => mapPub p.val.1
  build := fun p => BuilderRefinement.mergedTrace (rustWitness p.val.2) (rustPublic p.val.1)

/-- All four BuilderSoundOn fields for canonical Rspend⁺ instances, with no
ModelRel, base-typing, lane, or helper hypothesis. -/
theorem builderSoundOn (hcard : 4096 < Fintype.card K) (F : Subfield K)
    (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle) :
    BuilderSoundOn (prover π) B x := by
  intro p hp
  change mapPub p.val.1 = x.1 at hp
  change HonestBuilderSound F x.1 B
    (BuilderRefinement.mergedTrace (rustWitness p.val.2) (rustPublic p.val.1))
  rw [← hp]
  exact BuilderRefinement.sound_merged hcard F B _ _ _
    (admitted_of_spend F p.val.1 p.val.2 p.property)

#print axioms modelWitness_lift
#print axioms image_mem
#print axioms witnessBase_lift
#print axioms publicBase_map
#print axioms canonical_trace
#print axioms admitted_of_spend
#print axioms builderSoundOn
end R1Z.BuilderCanonical

import R0Z.BuilderWitnessMerged

/-! The four privacy builder fields for the extracted merged writer composition.

The trace here is the lifted output of `copyCellMerged`, not `buildModelSpec`.
`Admitted` makes the remaining caller obligations explicit: public/record
correspondence, word ranges, and the semantic model relation. It is NOT a
claim that the shipped compile functions imply those obligations. In particular
neither the generated Rust glue nor the compile entry points are extracted by
this module. See BUILDER-REFINEMENT-20261021.md for that boundary. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.BuilderRefinement
open R0P R0Z.ZkStatement R0Z.HonestValidity R0Z.BuilderComplete
open R0Z.BuilderModel R0Z.WriterRefine R0Z.BuilderSound

variable {K CommitHandle : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] [CharP K 0x7fffffff]

/-- The actual extracted merged writer output, with stage-H columns zero. -/
def mergedTrace (W : RustWitness) (P : RustPublic) : Trace K :=
  fun c r => liftU (copyCellMerged W P c r)

/-- Caller obligations, not a replacement definition of the deployed relation. -/
structure Admitted (F : Subfield K) (pub : Public K) (W : RustWitness) (P : RustPublic) : Prop where
  publicCorr : PubCorr P pub
  words : WitnessOk W
  semantic : ModelRel F pub (toModel W)

/-- A relation instance retaining the public input and the exact Rust records. -/
structure Instance (F : Subfield K) where
  pub : Public K
  witness : RustWitness
  rustPublic : RustPublic
  admitted : Admitted F pub witness rustPublic

/-- The prover model builds the extracted output directly. Transport is explicit. -/
def prover (F : Subfield K) (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) : HonestProver K where
  Instance := Instance F
  transport := π
  «public» := fun w => w.pub
  build := fun w => mergedTrace w.witness w.rustPublic

theorem mergedTrace_eq_model (W : RustWitness) (P : RustPublic) (pub : Public K)
    (hP : PubCorr P pub) (hW : WitnessOk W) :
    mergedTrace W P = buildModel pub (toModel W) := by
  funext c r
  exact (builder_witness_merged W P pub hP hW).2.2.2.2.2 c r

/-- All four fields for the extracted output. No field is assumed in `Admitted`. -/
theorem sound_merged (hcard : 4096 < Fintype.card K) (F : Subfield K)
    (B : PackBasis F) (pub : Public K) (W : RustWitness) (P : RustPublic)
    (h : Admitted F pub W P) : HonestBuilderSound F pub B (mergedTrace W P) := by
  rw [mergedTrace_eq_model W P pub h.publicCorr h.words]
  have hc := builderCore_of_refines hcard (buildModelSpec F) (ModelRel F)
    (builderRefines_model F) B pub h.semantic.pubBase (toModel W) h.semantic
  rw [buildModelSpec_build F pub (toModel W) h.semantic.pubBase h.semantic.witBase] at hc
  exact honestBuilderSound_of_core pub B _ hc

/-- The D46/D51 premise is now discharged for the extracted composition on
`Admitted` inputs, for every public fibre (including an empty fibre). -/
theorem builderSoundOn (hcard : 4096 < Fintype.card K) (F : Subfield K)
    (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle) :
    BuilderSoundOn (prover F π) B x := by
  intro w hw
  change w.pub = x.1 at hw
  change HonestBuilderSound F x.1 B (mergedTrace w.witness w.rustPublic)
  rw [← hw]
  exact sound_merged hcard F B w.pub w.witness w.rustPublic w.admitted

theorem prover_public (F : Subfield K) (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (w : Instance F) :
    (prover F π).public w = w.pub := rfl

theorem prover_build (F : Subfield K) (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (w : Instance F) :
    (prover F π).build w = mergedTrace w.witness w.rustPublic := rfl

theorem prover_transport (F : Subfield K) (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) :
    (prover F π).transport = π := rfl

#print axioms mergedTrace_eq_model
#print axioms sound_merged
#print axioms builderSoundOn
#print axioms prover_public
#print axioms prover_build
#print axioms prover_transport
end R1Z.BuilderRefinement

/-! The builder model discharges `BuilderRefines` (LOG D46.3, D50; design §4).

* `buildModelSpec F`: the `BuilderSpec` whose 26 base columns are the model's
  columns 0..25 (in `F` by `buildModel_mem`; a classical fallback 0 is used
  only off the base premises) and whose extension columns are 0.
* `ModelRel F`: the witness premises — the Rel⁺ of D50, stated on the
  model's own digests so that a later job derives each field from
  Rspend⁺ = Rspend ∧ (transfer → change[7] ≠ 0) after build integration.
* `builderRefines_model`: `BuilderRefines (buildModelSpec F) (ModelRel F)`,
  over a field of characteristic 2^31−1.
* `builderSoundOn_model`: the resulting `BuilderSoundOn` for the honest
  prover `honestProverOf (buildModelSpec F) (ModelRel F)`. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R0Z.BuilderModel
open R0P R0Z.BuilderComplete R0Z.HonestValidity R0Z.ZkStatement

variable {K CommitHandle : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K]

/-- Rel⁺ for the model: every premise the family and link proofs use. -/
structure ModelRel (F : Subfield K) (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) : Prop where
  pubBase : PublicBase F pub
  witBase : WitnessBase F w
  aux : AuxPremises pub w
  digest : DigestPremises pub w
  pairRight : PairRight pub w

open Classical in
/-- The model as a `BuilderSpec`. -/
def buildModelSpec (F : Subfield K) : BuilderSpec F (ModelWitness K) where
  c1 := fun pub w c r =>
    if h : buildModel pub w (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) r ∈ F then ⟨_, h⟩ else 0
  rest := fun _ _ _ _ => 0

theorem buildModelSpec_build (F : Subfield K) (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K)
    (hp : PublicBase F pub) (hw : WitnessBase F w) :
    (buildModelSpec F).build pub w = buildModel pub w := by
  funext c r
  unfold BuilderSpec.build ofColumns
  split
  · rename_i hc
    show (((buildModelSpec F).c1 pub w ⟨c.val, hc⟩ r : F) : K) = _
    unfold buildModelSpec
    dsimp only
    rw [dif_pos (buildModel_mem pub w hp hw _ r)]
    rfl
  · rename_i hc
    show (0 : K) = _
    rw [buildModel, layout_high _ _ _ (by omega)]

theorem builderRefines_model [CharP K 0x7fffffff] (F : Subfield K) :
    BuilderRefines (buildModelSpec F) (ModelRel F) where
  nonCopy := fun pub w h => by
    rw [buildModelSpec_build F pub w h.pubBase h.witBase]
    exact nonCopy_model pub w h.aux h.digest
  balance := fun pub w h => by
    rw [buildModelSpec_build F pub w h.pubBase h.witBase]
    exact balance_model pub w h.pairRight

theorem builderSoundOn_model [CharP K 0x7fffffff] (hcard : 4096 < Fintype.card K)
    (F : Subfield K) (transport : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hpub : PublicBase F x.1) :
    BuilderSoundOn (honestProverOf (buildModelSpec F) (ModelRel F) transport) B x :=
  builderSoundOn_of_refines hcard _ _ (builderRefines_model F) transport B x hpub

#print axioms buildModelSpec
#print axioms buildModelSpec_build
#print axioms builderRefines_model
#print axioms builderSoundOn_model
end R0Z.BuilderModel

/-! The builder model against `BuilderComplete` (t2b2b/DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL.txt §4, §5).

* `nonCopy_model`: `NonCopyHolds pub (buildModel pub w)` from the aux and
  digest premises — the first field of `BuilderRefines` for the model.
* `refines_forces_sentinel`: whatever the builder, `BuilderRefines S Rel`
  forces `pub.change 7 ≠ 0` on every transfer instance of `Rel`; hence the
  relation to instantiate is Rspend strengthened by the non-zero change
  sentinel (the Rust retry condition), not Rspend itself. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R0Z.BuilderModel
open R0P R0Z.BuilderComplete

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

theorem nonCopy_model [CharP K 0x7fffffff] (pub : Public K) (w : ModelWitness K)
    (hA : AuxPremises pub w) (hD : DigestPremises pub w) : NonCopyHolds pub (buildModel pub w) :=
  ⟨value_model pub w hA.conservation, occupancy_model pub w hA, asset_model pub w hA.amount,
    schedule_model pub w, path_model pub w, digest_model pub w hD, poseidon_model pub w⟩

theorem refines_forces_sentinel [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K} {W : Type}
    (S : BuilderSpec F W) (Rel : Public K → W → Prop) (hR : BuilderRefines S Rel)
    (pub : Public K) (w : W) (hw : Rel pub w) (hv : pub.variant = .privateTransfer) :
    pub.change 7 ≠ 0 := by
  obtain ⟨_, ho, _, _, _, hd, _⟩ := hR.nonCopy pub w hw
  exact change_sentinel_of_balance pub _ ho hd (hR.balance pub w hw) hv

#print axioms nonCopy_model

import R0Z.BuilderSound

/-! Builder completeness (t2b2b/DESIGN-BUILDER-COMPLETE.txt).

There is no concrete witness → trace builder in the Lean model (design §0):
`HonestProver.build` is an uninstantiated field and R0P is entirely in the
trace → witness direction.  This module therefore

* reduces the `lanes` field of `HonestBuilderCore` (laneOf = 0 for lanes
  0..27 at every λ, χ) to `NonCopyHolds`, the seven λ/χ-free production
  families, for every base-typed trace over a field with more than 4,096
  elements (`lanes_iff_nonCopy`, through the proved `lanes_zero_iff_holds`
  and a pole-free χ on the prepared instance);
* gives the constructive shape of the builder: 26 base-field semantic
  columns plus three extension columns (`ofColumns`), for which `baseTyped`
  is a theorem (`baseTyped_ofColumns`);
* states the two remaining builder facts, `NonCopyHolds` and
  `CopyLinkBalance` of the built trace for every witness in the relation,
  as the named refinement premise `BuilderRefines` against the Rust builder;
* gives the honest prover `honestProverOf` whose `build` is that builder,
  and proves `BuilderCoreOn` / `BuilderSoundOn` for it from the premise
  (`builderSoundOn_of_refines`), together with the soundness-side sanity
  check that its builds carry an extracted input note
  (`inputNoteExtracted_of_refines`).

The witness type `W` and relation `Rel` are parameters; the spend-path
instantiation is `W := Wspend`, `Rel := Rspend` (SpendRelation.lean). -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R0Z.BuilderComplete
open R0P R0P.Sumcheck R0P.SemSource R0Z.MaskLayout R0Z.HonestView R0Z.Partition R0Z.D12
open R0Z.HonestValidity R0Z.BuilderSound

attribute [local irreducible] copyLinks copyPatterns copyActiveRowMasks copyInactiveRows

variable {K CommitHandle : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-! ### `lanes` is the non-copy production relation -/

/-- The seven production families that read neither λ, χ nor column 26. -/
def NonCopyHolds (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) : Prop :=
  Holds valueFamily pub t ∧ Holds occupancyFamily pub t ∧ Holds assetFamily pub t ∧
  Holds scheduleFamily pub t ∧ Holds pathFamily pub t ∧ Holds digestFamily pub t ∧
  Holds poseidonScalarFamily pub t

theorem holds_prepare (f : Family K) (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K) :
    Holds f pub (prepare pub t ch) ↔ Holds f pub t := by
  simp only [Holds, rowOpenings_prepare]

theorem prepare_lt26 (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K) (c : Fin 29)
    (hc : c.val < 26) (b : Fin 1024) : prepare pub t ch c b = t c b := by
  unfold prepare
  exact if_neg (by omega)

theorem baseTyped_prepare (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K)
    (hA : BaseTyped F t) : BaseTyped F (prepare pub t ch) := fun c hc b => by
  rw [prepare_lt26 pub t ch c hc b]
  exact hA c hc b

/-- Lanes 0..27 do not read λ or χ. -/
theorem laneOf_lt_indep (t : Trace K) (pub : Public K) (lam chi lam' chi' : K)
    (B : PackBasis F) (i : Fin 29) (bits : Fin 10 → Bool) (hi : i.val < 28) :
    laneOf t pub lam chi B i bits = laneOf t pub lam' chi' B i bits := by
  unfold laneOf
  by_cases h4 : i.val < 4
  · simp only [dif_pos h4]
  · simp only [dif_neg h4, dif_pos hi]

/-- The LogUp pole values of a trace at λ: producer row-slot values on the
left, consumer row-slot values on the right. -/
def poleVal (t : Trace K) (lam : K) : (Fin 1024 × Fin 2) ⊕ (Fin 1024 × Fin 2) → K :=
  Sum.elim (fun p => copyRowValues t lam p.1 CopyLink.producer p.2)
    (fun p => copyRowValues t lam p.1 CopyLink.consumer p.2)

/-- Over a field with more than 4,096 elements, every λ has a pole-free χ:
the poles are at most 1024 rows × 2 slots × 2 endpoints values, so
`poleVal` is not surjective. -/
theorem exists_noPole (hcard : 4096 < Fintype.card K) (t : Trace K) (lam : K) :
    ∃ chi : K, NoPole t lam chi := by
  have hns : ¬ Function.Surjective (poleVal t lam) := by
    intro hs
    have h1 := Fintype.card_le_of_surjective (poleVal t lam) hs
    simp only [Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin] at h1
    omega
  simp only [Function.Surjective, not_forall, not_exists] at hns
  obtain ⟨chi, hchi⟩ := hns
  refine ⟨chi, fun b _ s => ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩⟩
  · have e := hchi (Sum.inl (b, s))
    simp only [poleVal, Sum.elim_inl] at e
    exact e h.symm
  · have e := hchi (Sum.inr (b, s))
    simp only [poleVal, Sum.elim_inr] at e
    exact e h.symm

/-- A challenge record with prescribed `sem 0 = λ`, `sem 1 = χ`. -/
def chOf (lam chi : K) : Challenges K :=
  ⟨fun j => if j.val = 0 then lam else chi, fun _ => ⟨(1, 0), by simp⟩, fun _ => 0, ∅⟩

theorem chOf_sem0 (lam chi : K) : (chOf lam chi).sem 0 = lam :=
  show (if (0 : Fin 25).val = 0 then lam else chi) = lam from if_pos rfl

theorem chOf_sem1 (lam chi : K) : (chOf lam chi).sem 1 = chi :=
  show (if (1 : Fin 25).val = 0 then lam else chi) = chi from if_neg (by decide)

/-- All 29 lanes vanish on the prepared instance at a pole-free challenge,
given the non-copy lanes of the raw trace. -/
theorem lanes_prepare_zero (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K)
    (hnp : NoPole t (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1))
    (hl : ∀ (i : Fin 29) (b : Fin 10 → Bool), i.val < 28 →
      laneOf t pub (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) B i b = 0) :
    ∀ i b, laneOf (prepare pub t ch) pub (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) B i b = 0 := by
  intro i b
  by_cases hi : i.val < 28
  · rw [laneOf_prepare_lt pub t ch _ _ B i b hi]
    exact hl i b hi
  · obtain rfl : i = 28 := Fin.ext (by have := i.isLt; omega)
    rw [laneOf_copy]
    exact copyHolds_prepare pub t ch hnp (rowOf b) _ (List.mem_singleton_self _)

/-- `lanes` of `HonestBuilderCore` is exactly `NonCopyHolds`, for base-typed
traces and base public inputs over a field with more than 4,096 elements. -/
theorem lanes_iff_nonCopy (hcard : 4096 < Fintype.card K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (hA : BaseTyped F t) (hpub : PublicBase F pub) :
    (∀ (lam chi : K) (i : Fin 29) (b : Fin 10 → Bool), i.val < 28 →
      laneOf t pub lam chi B i b = 0) ↔ NonCopyHolds pub t := by
  obtain ⟨chi0, hnp⟩ := exists_noPole hcard t 0
  let ch := chOf (0 : K) chi0
  have hnp' : NoPole t (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) := by
    rw [chOf_sem0, chOf_sem1]; exact hnp
  have hAp := baseTyped_prepare pub t ch hA
  constructor
  · intro hl
    have hall := lanes_prepare_zero pub B t ch hnp' (fun i b hi => hl _ _ i b hi)
    obtain ⟨hv, ho, ha, hs, hp, hd, hpo, _⟩ :=
      (lanes_zero_iff_holds F B pub (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) (prepare pub t ch) hAp hpub).mp hall
    exact ⟨(holds_prepare _ pub t ch).1 hv, (holds_prepare _ pub t ch).1 ho,
      (holds_prepare _ pub t ch).1 ha, (holds_prepare _ pub t ch).1 hs,
      (holds_prepare _ pub t ch).1 hp, (holds_prepare _ pub t ch).1 hd,
      (holds_prepare _ pub t ch).1 hpo⟩
  · rintro ⟨hv, ho, ha, hs, hp, hd, hpo⟩ lam chi i b hi
    have hc : CHolds copyFamily pub (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) (prepare pub t ch) :=
      copyHolds_prepare pub t ch hnp'
    have hall := (lanes_zero_iff_holds F B pub (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) (prepare pub t ch) hAp
      hpub).mpr ⟨(holds_prepare _ pub t ch).2 hv, (holds_prepare _ pub t ch).2 ho,
        (holds_prepare _ pub t ch).2 ha, (holds_prepare _ pub t ch).2 hs,
        (holds_prepare _ pub t ch).2 hp, (holds_prepare _ pub t ch).2 hd,
        (holds_prepare _ pub t ch).2 hpo, hc⟩
    rw [laneOf_lt_indep t pub lam chi (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) B i b hi,
      ← laneOf_prepare_lt pub t ch _ _ B i b hi]
    exact hall i b

/-! ### The builder: constructive shape and refinement premise -/

/-- The builder's output shape: 26 base-field semantic columns (the Rust
`semantic_c1` M31 arrays) and three extension columns 26–28. -/
def ofColumns (c1 : Fin 26 → Fin 1024 → F) (rest : Fin 3 → Fin 1024 → K) : Trace K :=
  fun c r => if h : c.val < 26 then ((c1 ⟨c.val, h⟩ r : F) : K)
    else rest ⟨c.val - 26, by have := c.isLt; omega⟩ r

theorem baseTyped_ofColumns (c1 : Fin 26 → Fin 1024 → F) (rest : Fin 3 → Fin 1024 → K) :
    BaseTyped F (ofColumns c1 rest) := fun c hc b => by
  simp only [ofColumns, dif_pos hc]
  exact (c1 ⟨c.val, hc⟩ b).2

/-- The builder data: a public input and a witness determine the columns.
This is the Rust compile + host_semantic build, uninterpreted. -/
structure BuilderSpec (F : Subfield K) (W : Type) where
  c1 : Public K → W → Fin 26 → Fin 1024 → F
  rest : Public K → W → Fin 3 → Fin 1024 → K

def BuilderSpec.build {W : Type} (S : BuilderSpec F W) (pub : Public K) (w : W) : Trace K :=
  ofColumns (S.c1 pub w) (S.rest pub w)

/-- The refinement premise against the Rust builder: for every witness in
the relation, the built trace satisfies the seven non-copy production
families and every enabled copy link balances. -/
structure BuilderRefines {W : Type} (S : BuilderSpec F W) (Rel : Public K → W → Prop) : Prop where
  nonCopy : ∀ pub w, Rel pub w → NonCopyHolds pub (S.build pub w)
  balance : ∀ pub w, Rel pub w → CopyLinkBalance pub (S.build pub w)

/-- The honest prover whose `build` is the builder, on relation instances. -/
def honestProverOf {W : Type} (S : BuilderSpec F W) (Rel : Public K → W → Prop)
    (transport : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) : HonestProver K where
  Instance := {p : Public K × W // Rel p.1 p.2}
  transport := transport
  «public» := fun p => p.1.1
  build := fun p => S.build p.1.1 p.1.2

theorem builderCore_of_refines (hcard : 4096 < Fintype.card K) {W : Type}
    (S : BuilderSpec F W) (Rel : Public K → W → Prop) (hR : BuilderRefines S Rel)
    (B : PackBasis F) (pub : Public K) (hpub : PublicBase F pub) (w : W) (hw : Rel pub w) :
    HonestBuilderCore F pub B (S.build pub w) :=
  ⟨baseTyped_ofColumns _ _,
    (lanes_iff_nonCopy hcard B pub _ (baseTyped_ofColumns _ _) hpub).2 (hR.nonCopy pub w hw),
    hR.balance pub w hw⟩

theorem builderCoreOn_of_refines (hcard : 4096 < Fintype.card K) {W : Type}
    (S : BuilderSpec F W) (Rel : Public K → W → Prop) (hR : BuilderRefines S Rel)
    (transport : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (hpub : PublicBase F x.1) : BuilderCoreOn (honestProverOf S Rel transport) B x := by
  rintro ⟨⟨pub, w⟩, hw⟩ hx
  change pub = x.1 at hx
  subst hx
  exact builderCore_of_refines hcard S Rel hR B _ hpub w hw

theorem builderSoundOn_of_refines (hcard : 4096 < Fintype.card K) {W : Type}
    (S : BuilderSpec F W) (Rel : Public K → W → Prop) (hR : BuilderRefines S Rel)
    (transport : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (hpub : PublicBase F x.1) : BuilderSoundOn (honestProverOf S Rel transport) B x :=
  builderSoundOn_of_core _ B x (builderCoreOn_of_refines hcard S Rel hR transport B x hpub)

/-- Sanity check against soundness: a refined build carries an extracted
input note (R0P `input_note_extracted`), so the premise is the trace-side
image of the payment relation, not an unrelated condition. -/
theorem inputNoteExtracted_of_refines {W : Type} (S : BuilderSpec F W)
    (Rel : Public K → W → Prop) (hR : BuilderRefines S Rel) (pub : Public K) (w : W)
    (hw : Rel pub w) : InputNoteExtracted pub (S.build pub w) := by
  obtain ⟨_, _, ha, hs, hp, hd, hpo⟩ := hR.nonCopy pub w hw
  exact input_note_extracted pub _ hs hp hd ha hpo (hR.balance pub w hw)

every trace with `CopyLinkBalance` (`HelperSum.helperSum_of_balance`, from the

`CopyLinkBalance pub t` on the raw instance trace `t = h.build w` — every

namespace R0Z.BuilderSound
open R0P R0P.Sumcheck R0P.SemSource R0Z.MaskLayout R0Z.HonestView R0Z.Partition R0Z.D12
open R0Z.HonestValidity

attribute [local irreducible] copyLinks copyPatterns copyActiveRowMasks copyInactiveRows

variable {K CommitHandle : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-- The builder obligations left after J0b's two helper sums are discharged. -/
structure HonestBuilderCore (F : Subfield K) (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) :
    Prop where
  baseTyped : BaseTyped F t
  lanes : ∀ (lam chi : K) (i : Fin 29) (b : Fin 10 → Bool), i.val < 28 → laneOf t pub lam chi B i b = 0
  balance : CopyLinkBalance pub t

theorem honestBuilderSound_of_core (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K)
    (hc : HonestBuilderCore F pub B t) : HonestBuilderSound F pub B t :=
  ⟨hc.baseTyped, hc.lanes, R0Z.HelperSum.helperSum_of_balance pub t hc.balance,
    fun lam chi => R0Z.HelperInactive.helperInactive pub t lam chi⟩

/-- The prover-level form. -/
def BuilderCoreOn (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle) : Prop :=
  ∀ w, h.public w = x.1 → HonestBuilderCore F x.1 B (h.build w)

theorem builderSoundOn_of_core (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hc : BuilderCoreOn h B x) : BuilderSoundOn h B x :=
  fun w hw => honestBuilderSound_of_core x.1 B (h.build w) (hc w hw)

  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero

import R0Z.HonestView
