R0Z.BuilderWitnessTree:
import R0Z.BuilderWitness

/-! The witness-level Rust-copy builder, part 2: node children (DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL §12 (2)).

The running membership digest (levels 0..23, from the input leaf through the
sibling path), the output pair and the running append digest (levels 0..19,
frontier or empty-root sibling by the bits of nextPairIndex) are computed by
the copy's node permutations; `rustChunks W P` is the complete per-block input
(chunks, lengths and node children).  `rust_chunk_lifts`: it satisfies
`BuilderChunkLifts` for `toModel W`, so `builder_witness_blocks`: every block
the chained copy writer produces from (W, P) equals buildModel. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R0Z.WriterRefine
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open R0Z.BuilderModel

def orderedR (cur sib : Array U32 8#usize) (b : Bool) : Array U32 8#usize × Array U32 8#usize :=
  if b then (sib, cur) else (cur, sib)

def bitB (W : RustWitness) (l : Nat) : Bool := decide ((W.bits.val[l]!).val ≠ 0)

def inputLeafR (W : RustWitness) (P : RustPublic) : Result (Array U32 8#usize) := noteDigestR (chunksOf W P) 3
def recipDR (W : RustWitness) (P : RustPublic) : Result (Array U32 8#usize) := noteDigestR (chunksOf W P) 29
def changeDR (W : RustWitness) (P : RustPublic) : Result (Array U32 8#usize) := noteDigestR (chunksOf W P) 32

def treeCurR (W : RustWitness) (P : RustPublic) : Nat → Result (Array U32 8#usize)
  | 0 => inputLeafR W P
  | n + 1 => do
      let c ← treeCurR W P n
      let o := orderedR c (W.sibs.val[n]!) (bitB W n)
      nodeDigestR o.1 o.2

def outPairR (W : RustWitness) (P : RustPublic) : Result (Array U32 8#usize) :=
  match P.variant with
  | .privateTransfer => do
      let r ← recipDR W P
      let c ← changeDR W P
      nodeDigestR r c
  | .withdrawal => do
      let c ← changeDR W P
      nodeDigestR c zero8

def appBitR (P : RustPublic) (n : Nat) : Bool := decide (((P.nextPairIndex >>> n) &&& 1) ≠ 0)

def appSibR (P : RustPublic) (n : Nat) : Array U32 8#usize :=
  if appBitR P n then P.frontier.val[n]! else P.empty.val[n]!

def appCurR (W : RustWitness) (P : RustPublic) : Nat → Result (Array U32 8#usize)
  | 0 => outPairR W P
  | n + 1 => do
      let c ← appCurR W P n
      let o := orderedR c (appSibR P n) (appBitR P n)
      nodeDigestR o.1 o.2

/-- The (left, right) children the builder feeds to node block h. -/
def childrenOf (W : RustWitness) (P : RustPublic) (h : Nat) : Array U32 8#usize × Array U32 8#usize :=
  if 4 ≤ h ∧ h ≤ 24 then orderedR (okOr (treeCurR W P (h - 4)) zero8) (W.sibs.val[h - 4]!) (bitB W (h - 4))
  else if 54 ≤ h then orderedR (okOr (treeCurR W P (h - 33)) zero8) (W.sibs.val[h - 33]!) (bitB W (h - 33))
  else if h = 33 then
    (match P.variant with
      | .privateTransfer => (okOr (recipDR W P) zero8, okOr (changeDR W P) zero8)
      | .withdrawal => (okOr (changeDR W P) zero8, zero8))
  else if 34 ≤ h ∧ h ≤ 53 then
    orderedR (okOr (appCurR W P (h - 34)) zero8) (appSibR P (h - 34)) (appBitR P (h - 34))
  else (zero8, zero8)

/-- **The complete per-block Rust input computed from the records.** -/
def rustChunks (W : RustWitness) (P : RustPublic) : RustChunks :=
  { chunksOf W P with left := fun h => (childrenOf W P h).1, right := fun h => (childrenOf W P h).2 }

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

theorem ordered_lift (c s : Array U32 8#usize) (C S : R0P.Digest K) (b : Bool)
    (hc : DigestLift c C) (hs : DigestLift s S) (hcc : Canon8 c) (hsc : Canon8 s) :
    DigestLift (orderedR c s b).1 (ordered C S b).1 ∧ DigestLift (orderedR c s b).2 (ordered C S b).2 ∧
      Canon8 (orderedR c s b).2 := by
  cases b
  · exact ⟨hc, hs, hsc⟩
  · exact ⟨hs, hc, hcc⟩

theorem zero8_lift : DigestLift (K := K) zero8 0 := by
  intro i
  show liftU ((arr8 (fun _ => 0#u32)).val[i.val]!) = 0
  rw [arr8_get _ _ i.isLt]
  unfold liftU; simp

theorem zero8_canon : Canon8 zero8 := by
  intro i hi
  show ((arr8 (fun _ => 0#u32)).val[i]!).val < _
  rw [arr8_get _ _ hi]; simp

theorem treeCur_succ (w : ModelWitness K) (leaf : R0P.Digest K) (n : Nat) (hn : n < 24) :
    treeCur w leaf (n + 1) = blockDigest (treeNode w (treeCur w leaf n) ⟨n, hn⟩) := by
  first
  | exact dif_pos hn
  | simp only [treeCur, dif_pos hn]

theorem appCur_succ (pub : R0P.Public K) (start : R0P.Digest K) (n : Nat) (hn : n < 20) :
    appCur pub start (n + 1) = blockDigest (appNode pub (appCur pub start n) ⟨n, hn⟩) := by
  first
  | exact dif_pos hn
  | simp only [appCur, dif_pos hn]

variable [CharP K 0x7fffffff]

section build
variable (W : RustWitness) (P : RustPublic) (pub : R0P.Public K) (hP : PubCorr P pub) (hW : WitnessOk W)

include hP hW in
theorem treeCur_lift : ∀ l, l ≤ 24 → ∃ c, treeCurR W P l = ok c ∧
    DigestLift c (treeCur (toModel W) (inputLeaf pub (toModel W)) l) ∧ Canon8 c
  | 0, _ => by
      obtain ⟨d, hd, hdl, hdc⟩ := noteDigest_lift pub (toModel (K := K) W) (chunksOf W P)
        (chunks_sabs W P pub hP hW) 3 (nk 3 (by omega)) (zk _ 3 (by omega))
      exact ⟨d, hd, hdl, hdc⟩
  | n + 1, hn => by
      obtain ⟨c, hc, hcl, hcc⟩ := treeCur_lift n (by omega)
      have ol := ordered_lift c (W.sibs.val[n]!) _ (digK (K := K) (W.sibs.val[n]!)) (bitB W n) hcl
        (fun i => rfl) hcc (hW.sibs n (by omega))
      obtain ⟨d, hd, hdl, hdc⟩ := nodeDigest_lift _ _ _ _ ol.1 ol.2.1 ol.2.2
      refine ⟨d, ?_, ?_, hdc⟩
      · show (do let c ← treeCurR W P n; let o := orderedR c (W.sibs.val[n]!) (bitB W n); nodeDigestR o.1 o.2) = _
        rw [hc]
        simp only [bind_tc_ok]
        exact hd
      · rw [treeCur_succ _ _ n (by omega)]
        exact hdl

include hP hW in
theorem outPair_lift : ∃ c, outPairR W P = ok c ∧ DigestLift c (outPair pub (toModel W)) ∧ Canon8 c := by
  obtain ⟨dc, hdc, hdcl, hdcc⟩ := noteDigest_lift pub (toModel (K := K) W) (chunksOf W P)
    (chunks_sabs W P pub hP hW) 32 (nk 32 (by omega)) (zk _ 32 (by omega))
  replace hdc : noteDigestR (chunksOf W P) 32 = ok dc := hdc
  unfold outPairR outPair outPairB
  rw [hP.variant]
  cases hv : pub.variant
  · have hz : ¬ ZeroKind pub.variant 29 := zk_tr pub 29 hv
    obtain ⟨dr, hdr, hdrl, hdrc⟩ := noteDigest_lift pub (toModel (K := K) W) (chunksOf W P)
      (chunks_sabs W P pub hP hW) 29 (nk 29 (by omega)) hz
    replace hdr : noteDigestR (chunksOf W P) 29 = ok dr := hdr
    obtain ⟨d, hd, hdl, hdd⟩ := nodeDigest_lift dr dc _ _ hdrl hdcl hdcc
    refine ⟨d, ?_, hdl, hdd⟩
    show (do let r ← noteDigestR (chunksOf W P) 29; let c ← noteDigestR (chunksOf W P) 32; nodeDigestR r c) = _
    rw [hdr, hdc]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    exact hd
  · obtain ⟨d, hd, hdl, hdd⟩ := nodeDigest_lift dc zero8 _ _ hdcl zero8_lift zero8_canon
    refine ⟨d, ?_, hdl, hdd⟩
    show (do let c ← noteDigestR (chunksOf W P) 32; nodeDigestR c zero8) = _
    rw [hdc]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    exact hd

include hP in
theorem appBit_eq (n : Nat) : appBitR P n = appBit pub n := by
  unfold appBitR appBit
  rw [hP.next]

include hP in
theorem appSib_lift (n : Nat) (hn : n < 20) :
    DigestLift (appSibR P n) (appSib pub ⟨n, hn⟩) ∧ Canon8 (appSibR P n) := by
  unfold appSibR appSib
  rw [appBit_eq P pub hP n]
  by_cases hb : appBit pub n = true
  · rw [if_pos hb, if_pos hb]
    exact ⟨hP.frontier ⟨n, hn⟩, hP.frontierCanon ⟨n, hn⟩⟩
  · rw [if_neg hb, if_neg hb]
    exact ⟨hP.empty ⟨n, hn⟩, hP.emptyCanon ⟨n, hn⟩⟩

include hP hW in
theorem appCur_lift : ∀ j, j ≤ 20 → ∃ c, appCurR W P j = ok c ∧
    DigestLift c (appCur pub (outPair pub (toModel W)) j) ∧ Canon8 c
  | 0, _ => outPair_lift W P pub hP hW
  | n + 1, hn => by
      obtain ⟨c, hc, hcl, hcc⟩ := appCur_lift n (by omega)
      have hs := appSib_lift P pub hP n (by omega)
      have ol := ordered_lift c (appSibR P n) _ _ (appBitR P n) hcl hs.1 hcc hs.2
      obtain ⟨d, hd, hdl, hdc⟩ := nodeDigest_lift _ _ _ _ ol.1 ol.2.1 ol.2.2
      refine ⟨d, ?_, ?_, hdc⟩
      · show (do let c ← appCurR W P n; let o := orderedR c (appSibR P n) (appBitR P n); nodeDigestR o.1 o.2) = _
        rw [hc]
        simp only [bind_tc_ok]
        exact hd
      · rw [appCur_succ _ _ n (by omega)]
        unfold appNode
        rw [← appBit_eq P pub hP n]
        exact hdl

include hP hW in
/-- The computed node children satisfy the node premise. -/
theorem rust_node_lifts (h : Fin 57) (hn : NodeKind h.val) :
    ∃ L Rr : R0P.Digest K, blocksOf pub (toModel W) h = nodeIn L Rr ∧
      DigestLift ((rustChunks W P).left h.val) L ∧ DigestLift ((rustChunks W P).right h.val) Rr ∧
      ∀ i, i < 8 → (((rustChunks W P).right h.val).val[i]!).val < 2147483647 := by
  have h57 := h.isLt
  unfold NodeKind at hn
  by_cases h24 : h.val ≤ 24
  · have e : childrenOf W P h.val = orderedR (okOr (treeCurR W P (h.val - 4)) zero8)
        (W.sibs.val[h.val - 4]!) (bitB W (h.val - 4)) := by
      unfold childrenOf; rw [if_pos ⟨by omega, h24⟩]
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hcl, hcc⟩ := treeCur_lift W P pub hP hW (h.val - 4) (by omega)
    rw [hc, okOr_ok] at e
    have ol := ordered_lift c (W.sibs.val[h.val - 4]!) _ (digK (K := K) (W.sibs.val[h.val - 4]!))
      (bitB W (h.val - 4)) hcl (fun i => rfl) hcc (hW.sibs _ (by omega))
    refine ⟨_, _, blocksOf_tree_lo pub (toModel W) h (by omega) h24, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · show DigestLift (childrenOf W P h.val).1 _; rw [e]; exact ol.1
    · show DigestLift (childrenOf W P h.val).2 _; rw [e]; exact ol.2.1
    · show ∀ i, i < 8 → (((childrenOf W P h.val).2).val[i]!).val < _; rw [e]; exact ol.2.2
  by_cases h54 : 54 ≤ h.val
  · have e : childrenOf W P h.val = orderedR (okOr (treeCurR W P (h.val - 33)) zero8)
        (W.sibs.val[h.val - 33]!) (bitB W (h.val - 33)) := by
      unfold childrenOf; rw [if_neg (by omega), if_pos h54]
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hcl, hcc⟩ := treeCur_lift W P pub hP hW (h.val - 33) (by omega)
    rw [hc, okOr_ok] at e
    have ol := ordered_lift c (W.sibs.val[h.val - 33]!) _ (digK (K := K) (W.sibs.val[h.val - 33]!))
      (bitB W (h.val - 33)) hcl (fun i => rfl) hcc (hW.sibs _ (by omega))
    refine ⟨_, _, blocksOf_tree_hi pub (toModel W) h h54, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · show DigestLift (childrenOf W P h.val).1 _; rw [e]; exact ol.1
    · show DigestLift (childrenOf W P h.val).2 _; rw [e]; exact ol.2.1
    · show ∀ i, i < 8 → (((childrenOf W P h.val).2).val[i]!).val < _; rw [e]; exact ol.2.2
  by_cases h33 : h.val = 33
  · have hb : blocksOf pub (toModel (K := K) W) h = outPairB pub (toModel W) := by
      have : h = 33 := Fin.ext h33
      rw [this]; rfl
    have e : childrenOf W P h.val = (match P.variant with
        | .privateTransfer => (okOr (recipDR W P) zero8, okOr (changeDR W P) zero8)
        | .withdrawal => (okOr (changeDR W P) zero8, zero8)) := by
      unfold childrenOf; rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_pos h33]
    obtain ⟨dc, hdc, hdcl, hdcc⟩ := noteDigest_lift pub (toModel (K := K) W) (chunksOf W P)
      (chunks_sabs W P pub hP hW) 32 (nk 32 (by omega)) (zk _ 32 (by omega))
    replace hdc : noteDigestR (chunksOf W P) 32 = ok dc := hdc
    rw [hb]
    unfold outPairB
    rw [hP.variant] at e
    cases hv : pub.variant
    · rw [hv] at e
      obtain ⟨dr, hdr, hdrl, hdrc⟩ := noteDigest_lift pub (toModel (K := K) W) (chunksOf W P)
        (chunks_sabs W P pub hP hW) 29 (nk 29 (by omega)) (zk_tr pub 29 hv)
      replace hdr : noteDigestR (chunksOf W P) 29 = ok dr := hdr
      have e2 : childrenOf W P h.val = (dr, dc) := by
        rw [e]; show (okOr (noteDigestR (chunksOf W P) 29) zero8, okOr (noteDigestR (chunksOf W P) 32) zero8) = _
        rw [hdr, hdc]; rfl
      refine ⟨_, _, rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · show DigestLift (childrenOf W P h.val).1 _; rw [e2]; exact hdrl
      · show DigestLift (childrenOf W P h.val).2 _; rw [e2]; exact hdcl
      · show ∀ i, i < 8 → (((childrenOf W P h.val).2).val[i]!).val < _; rw [e2]; exact hdcc
    · rw [hv] at e
      have e2 : childrenOf W P h.val = (dc, zero8) := by
        rw [e]; show (okOr (noteDigestR (chunksOf W P) 32) zero8, zero8) = _
        rw [hdc]; rfl
      refine ⟨_, _, rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · show DigestLift (childrenOf W P h.val).1 _; rw [e2]; exact hdcl
      · show DigestLift (childrenOf W P h.val).2 _; rw [e2]; exact zero8_lift
      · show ∀ i, i < 8 → (((childrenOf W P h.val).2).val[i]!).val < _; rw [e2]; exact zero8_canon
  · have h34 : 34 ≤ h.val := by omega
    have h53 : h.val ≤ 53 := by omega
    have e : childrenOf W P h.val = orderedR (okOr (appCurR W P (h.val - 34)) zero8)
        (appSibR P (h.val - 34)) (appBitR P (h.val - 34)) := by
      unfold childrenOf; rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg h33, if_pos ⟨h34, h53⟩]
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hcl, hcc⟩ := appCur_lift W P pub hP hW (h.val - 34) (by omega)
    rw [hc, okOr_ok] at e
    have hs := appSib_lift P pub hP (h.val - 34) (by omega)
    have ol := ordered_lift c (appSibR P (h.val - 34)) _ _ (appBitR P (h.val - 34)) hcl hs.1 hcc hs.2
    rw [appBit_eq P pub hP] at ol
    refine ⟨_, _, blocksOf_app pub (toModel W) h h34 h53, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · show DigestLift (childrenOf W P h.val).1 _; rw [e, appBit_eq P pub hP]; exact ol.1
    · show DigestLift (childrenOf W P h.val).2 _; rw [e, appBit_eq P pub hP]; exact ol.2.1
    · show ∀ i, i < 8 → (((childrenOf W P h.val).2).val[i]!).val < _
      rw [e, appBit_eq P pub hP]; exact ol.2.2

include hP hW in
theorem rust_chunk_lifts : BuilderChunkLifts pub (toModel W) (rustChunks W P) :=
  ⟨rust_node_lifts W P pub hP hW, chunks_sabs W P pub hP hW⟩

include hP hW in
/-- **All 57 blocks from the records.** -/
theorem builder_witness_blocks (h : Fin 57) :
    ∃ b, RustWriterChain P.variant (rustChunks W P) h.val = ok b ∧ ∀ l c : Fin 16,
      liftU (K := K) (b.val[l.val * 16 + c.val]!) =
        buildModel pub (toModel W) ⟨c.val, by omega⟩ ⟨16 * h.val + l.val, by have := h.isLt; omega⟩ := by
  rw [hP.variant]
  exact builder_blocks_model_chain pub (toModel W) (rustChunks W P) (rust_chunk_lifts W P pub hP hW) h

end build

R0Z.BuilderWitness:
import R0Z.BuilderBlocksChain
import R0Z.PoseidonCanon

/-! The witness-level Rust-copy builder, part 1: records, the named witness map,
sponge chunks and sponge digests (DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL §12 (2)).

`RustWitness` / `RustPublic` are u32-level records with the fields the Rust
builder reads (pair_trace.rs build_transfer_inner / build_withdrawal_inner,
pair_forest_trace.rs for levels 21..23).  `toModel` is the named map to
`ModelWitness`, field by field (`liftU` on every word, values as naturals,
directions as `bit ≠ 0`); `PubCorr` states the public-input correspondences.
The sponge chunks of every sponge block are computed from the records
(`chunksOf`), the owner digest from the copy's block-0 permutation, and the
input-leaf / recipient / change note digests from the chained sponge blocks. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R0Z.WriterRefine
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open R0Z.BuilderModel

/-! ### Records and the named map -/

structure RustWitness where
  inputValue : U32
  outputValue : U32
  changeValue : U32
  sk : Array U32 8#usize
  salt : Array U32 8#usize
  bits : Array U32 24#usize
  sibs : Array (Array U32 8#usize) 24#usize
  pairFirst : Array U32 8#usize
  pairOccupied : U32
  pairSecond : Array U32 8#usize
  pairInverse : U32
  recipientOwner : Array U32 8#usize
  recipientSalt : Array U32 8#usize
  changeOwner : Array U32 8#usize
  changeSalt : Array U32 8#usize

structure RustPublic where
  variant : R0P.Variant
  asset : U32
  nextPairIndex : Nat
  frontier : Array (Array U32 8#usize) 20#usize
  empty : Array (Array U32 8#usize) 20#usize

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

/-- A Rust digest as a model digest. -/
def digK (d : Array U32 8#usize) : R0P.Digest K := fun i => liftU (d.val[i.val]!)

def val30 (x : U32) : Fin (2 ^ 30) := ⟨x.val % 2 ^ 30, Nat.mod_lt _ (by norm_num)⟩

/-- **The named witness map** (Rust witness record → ModelWitness). -/
def toModel (W : RustWitness) : ModelWitness K where
  inputValue := val30 W.inputValue
  outputValue := val30 W.outputValue
  changeValue := val30 W.changeValue
  sk := digK W.sk
  salt := digK W.salt
  path := fun l => (decide ((W.bits.val[l.val]!).val ≠ 0), digK (W.sibs.val[l.val]!))
  pairFirst := digK W.pairFirst
  pairOccupied := liftU W.pairOccupied
  pairSecond := digK W.pairSecond
  pairInverse := liftU W.pairInverse
  recipientOwner := digK W.recipientOwner
  recipientSalt := digK W.recipientSalt
  changeOwner := digK W.changeOwner
  changeSalt := digK W.changeSalt

def Canon8 (d : Array U32 8#usize) : Prop := ∀ i, i < 8 → (d.val[i]!).val < 2147483647

/-- Public-input correspondences (named). -/
structure PubCorr (P : RustPublic) (pub : R0P.Public K) : Prop where
  variant : P.variant = pub.variant
  asset : liftU (K := K) P.asset = pub.assetId
  next : P.nextPairIndex = pub.nextPairIndex
  frontier : ∀ l : Fin 20, DigestLift (P.frontier.val[l.val]!) (pub.snapshotFrontier l)
  empty : ∀ l : Fin 20, DigestLift (P.empty.val[l.val]!) (emptyRootK (K := K) l)
  frontierCanon : ∀ l : Fin 20, Canon8 (P.frontier.val[l.val]!)
  emptyCanon : ∀ l : Fin 20, Canon8 (P.empty.val[l.val]!)

/-- Rust-side range facts of the witness record. -/
structure WitnessOk (W : RustWitness) : Prop where
  values : W.inputValue.val < 2 ^ 30 ∧ W.outputValue.val < 2 ^ 30 ∧ W.changeValue.val < 2 ^ 30
  bits : ∀ l, l < 24 → (W.bits.val[l]!).val = 0 ∨ (W.bits.val[l]!).val = 1
  sibs : ∀ l, l < 24 → Canon8 (W.sibs.val[l]!)

/-! ### Small arrays -/

def arr8 (f : Fin 8 → U32) : Array U32 8#usize := ⟨List.ofFn f, by simp⟩

theorem arr8_get (f : Fin 8 → U32) (i : Nat) (h : i < 8) : (arr8 f).val[i]! = f ⟨i, h⟩ := by
  show (List.ofFn f)[i]! = _
  rw [List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_ofFn, dif_pos h]
  rfl

def zero8 : Array U32 8#usize := arr8 (fun _ => 0#u32)

/-- The first eight lanes of a state. -/
def digest8 (s : Array U32 16#usize) : Array U32 8#usize := arr8 (fun i => s.val[i.val]!)

theorem digest8_get (s : Array U32 16#usize) (i : Nat) (h : i < 8) : (digest8 s).val[i]! = s.val[i]! :=
  arr8_get _ i h

def okOr {α : Type} (r : Result α) (d : α) : α := match r with
  | ok a => a
  | _ => d

theorem okOr_ok {α : Type} (a d : α) : okOr (ok a) d = a := rfl

/-! ### Digests of copy blocks -/

def blockDigestR (pre ab : Array U32 16#usize) : Result (Array U32 8#usize) := do
  let rounds ← R0PoseidonCopy.perm_rounds pre ab
  ok (digest8 rounds.val[10]!)

def spongeDigestR (pre : Array U32 16#usize) (chunk : Array U32 8#usize) (clen : Usize) :
    Result (Array U32 8#usize) := do
  let ab ← R0BlockCopies.sponge_absorb chunk clen
  blockDigestR pre ab

def nodeDigestR (left right : Array U32 8#usize) : Result (Array U32 8#usize) := do
  let pre ← R0BlockCopies.node_pre right
  let ab ← R0BlockCopies.node_absorb left
  blockDigestR pre ab

variable [CharP K 0x7fffffff]

theorem blockDigest_lift (pre ab : Array U32 16#usize) (B : BlockIn K) (he : EndsLift pre ab B) :
    ∃ d, blockDigestR pre ab = ok d ∧ DigestLift d (blockDigest B) ∧ Canon8 d := by
  obtain ⟨rounds, hro, hR⟩ := R0Z.PoseidonRefine.perm_rounds_lift pre ab B he
  have hc := R0Z.PoseidonRefine.perm_canon pre ab rounds hro 10 (by norm_num)
  refine ⟨digest8 rounds.val[10]!, by rw [blockDigestR]; simp only [hro, bind_tc_ok], ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact digest_from_rounds rounds B hR _ (fun i hi => digest8_get _ i hi)
  · intro i hi; rw [digest8_get _ i hi]; exact hc i (by omega)

theorem spongeDigest_lift (pre : Array U32 16#usize) (chunk : Array U32 8#usize) (clen : Usize) (B : BlockIn K)
    (hpre : ∀ i : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) (pre.val[i.val]!) = B.pre i)
    (habs : ∀ i : Fin 16, B.absorb i =
      (if i.val < 8 ∧ i.val < clen.val then liftU (K := K) (chunk.val[i.val]!) else 0)) :
    ∃ d, spongeDigestR pre chunk clen = ok d ∧ DigestLift d (blockDigest B) ∧ Canon8 d := by
  obtain ⟨ab, hab, he⟩ := sponge_ends pre chunk clen B hpre habs
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hdl, hdc⟩ := blockDigest_lift pre ab B he
  exact ⟨d, by rw [spongeDigestR]; simp only [hab, bind_tc_ok, hd], hdl, hdc⟩

theorem nodeDigest_lift (left right : Array U32 8#usize) (L Rr : R0P.Digest K)
    (hl : DigestLift left L) (hr : DigestLift right Rr) (hc : Canon8 right) :
    ∃ d, nodeDigestR left right = ok d ∧ DigestLift d (blockDigest (nodeIn L Rr)) ∧ Canon8 d := by
  obtain ⟨pre, ab, hp, ha, he⟩ := node_ends_lift left right L Rr hl hr hc
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hdl, hdc⟩ := blockDigest_lift pre ab _ he
  exact ⟨d, by rw [nodeDigestR]; simp only [hp, ha, bind_tc_ok, hd], hdl, hdc⟩

/-! ### Chunks -/

def noteC2R (value asset : U32) (salt : Array U32 8#usize) : Array U32 8#usize :=
  arr8 (fun j => if j.val = 0 then value else if j.val = 1 then asset else salt.val[j.val - 2]!)

def noteC3R (salt : Array U32 8#usize) : Array U32 8#usize :=
  arr8 (fun j => if j.val = 0 then salt.val[6]! else if j.val = 1 then salt.val[7]! else 0#u32)

def ownerD (W : RustWitness) : Result (Array U32 8#usize) := do
  let p ← initOwner
  spongeDigestR p W.sk 8#usize

/-- The sponge chunks and lengths of every sponge block (node children filled later). -/
def chunksOf (W : RustWitness) (P : RustPublic) : RustChunks where
  left := fun _ => zero8
  right := fun _ => zero8
  schunk := fun h =>
    if h = 0 ∨ h = 25 then W.sk
    else if h = 1 then okOr (ownerD W) zero8
    else if h = 2 then noteC2R W.inputValue P.asset W.salt
    else if h = 3 then noteC3R W.salt
    else if h = 26 then W.salt
    else if h = 27 then W.recipientOwner
    else if h = 28 then noteC2R W.outputValue P.asset W.recipientSalt
    else if h = 29 then noteC3R W.recipientSalt
    else if h = 30 then W.changeOwner
    else if h = 31 then noteC2R W.changeValue P.asset W.changeSalt
    else if h = 32 then noteC3R W.changeSalt
    else zero8
  sclen := fun h => if h = 3 ∨ h = 29 ∨ h = 32 then 2#usize else 8#usize

theorem n8 : (8#usize : Usize).val = 8 := by simp
theorem n2 : (2#usize : Usize).val = 2 := by simp

theorem sabs_c2 (value asset : U32) (salt : Array U32 8#usize) (v a : K) (s : R0P.Digest K)
    (hv : liftU value = v) (ha : liftU asset = a) (hs : DigestLift salt s) (clen : Usize) (hc : clen.val = 8) :
    ∀ i : Fin 16, noteC2 v a s i =
      (if i.val < 8 ∧ i.val < clen.val then liftU (K := K) ((noteC2R value asset salt).val[i.val]!) else 0) := by
  intro i
  rw [hc]
  unfold noteC2
  by_cases h8 : i.val < 8
  · rw [if_pos (show i.val < 8 ∧ i.val < 8 from ⟨h8, h8⟩), noteC2R, arr8_get _ _ h8]
    dsimp only
    by_cases e0 : i.val = 0
    · rw [if_pos e0, if_pos e0, hv]
    rw [if_neg e0, if_neg e0]
    by_cases e1 : i.val = 1
    · rw [if_pos e1, if_pos e1, ha]
    rw [if_neg e1, if_neg e1, dif_pos h8]
    exact (hs ⟨i.val - 2, by omega⟩).symm
  · rw [if_neg (show ¬ (i.val < 8 ∧ i.val < 8) from fun h => h8 h.1),
      if_neg (show ¬ i.val = 0 by omega), if_neg (show ¬ i.val = 1 by omega), dif_neg h8]

theorem sabs_c3 (salt : Array U32 8#usize) (s : R0P.Digest K) (hs : DigestLift salt s) (clen : Usize)
    (hc : clen.val = 2) :
    ∀ i : Fin 16, noteC3 s i =
      (if i.val < 8 ∧ i.val < clen.val then liftU (K := K) ((noteC3R salt).val[i.val]!) else 0) := by
  intro i
  rw [hc]
  unfold noteC3
  by_cases h2 : i.val < 2
  · rw [if_pos (show i.val < 8 ∧ i.val < 2 from ⟨by omega, h2⟩), noteC3R, arr8_get _ _ (by omega)]
    dsimp only
    by_cases e0 : i.val = 0
    · rw [if_pos e0, if_pos e0]; exact (hs 6).symm
    rw [if_neg e0, if_neg e0, if_pos (show i.val = 1 by omega), if_pos (show i.val = 1 by omega)]
    exact (hs 7).symm
  · rw [if_neg (show ¬ (i.val < 8 ∧ i.val < 2) from fun h => h2 h.2),
      if_neg (show ¬ i.val = 0 by omega), if_neg (show ¬ i.val = 1 by omega)]

/-- The sponge chunk premise, as a named Prop. -/
def SabsOk (pub : R0P.Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (R : RustChunks) : Prop :=
  ∀ h : Fin 57, ¬ NodeKind h.val → ¬ ZeroKind pub.variant h.val →
    ∀ i : Fin 16, (blocksOf pub w h).absorb i =
      (if i.val < 8 ∧ i.val < (R.sclen h.val).val then liftU (K := K) ((R.schunk h.val).val[i.val]!) else 0)

theorem owner_lift (W : RustWitness) :
    ∃ d, ownerD W = ok d ∧ DigestLift d (ownerDigest (toModel (K := K) W)) ∧ Canon8 d := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpv⟩ := owner_init (K := K) (ownerB (toModel W)) rfl
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hdl, hdc⟩ := spongeDigest_lift p W.sk 8#usize (ownerB (toModel W)) hpv
    (sabs_lo8 W.sk 8#usize n8 _ (fun i => rfl))
  exact ⟨d, by rw [ownerD]; simp only [hp, bind_tc_ok, hd], hdl, hdc⟩

theorem trv (v : R0P.Variant) (h : Nat) (h1 : 27 ≤ h) (h2 : h ≤ 29) (hz : ¬ ZeroKind v h) :
    v = .privateTransfer := by
  cases v
  · rfl
  · exact absurd ⟨rfl, h1, h2⟩ hz

/-- The computed chunks satisfy the chunk premise. -/
theorem chunks_sabs (W : RustWitness) (P : RustPublic) (pub : R0P.Public K) (hP : PubCorr P pub)
    (hW : WitnessOk W) : SabsOk pub (toModel W) (chunksOf W P) := by
  intro h hn hz
  obtain ⟨hv, hh⟩ := h
  dsimp only at hn hz ⊢
  have cases : hv = 0 ∨ hv = 1 ∨ hv = 2 ∨ hv = 3 ∨ hv = 25 ∨ hv = 26 ∨ hv = 27 ∨ hv = 28 ∨ hv = 29 ∨
      hv = 30 ∨ hv = 31 ∨ hv = 32 := by
    unfold NodeKind at hn; omega
  have v0 : liftU (K := K) W.inputValue = ((toModel (K := K) W).inputValue.val : K) := by
    show _ = ((W.inputValue.val % 2 ^ 30 : Nat) : K); rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hW.values.1]; rfl
  have v1 : liftU (K := K) W.outputValue = ((toModel (K := K) W).outputValue.val : K) := by
    show _ = ((W.outputValue.val % 2 ^ 30 : Nat) : K); rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hW.values.2.1]; rfl
  have v2 : liftU (K := K) W.changeValue = ((toModel (K := K) W).changeValue.val : K) := by
    show _ = ((W.changeValue.val % 2 ^ 30 : Nat) : K); rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hW.values.2.2]; rfl
  rcases cases with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  · exact sabs_lo8 W.sk 8#usize n8 _ (fun i => rfl)
  · obtain ⟨d, hd, hdl, -⟩ := owner_lift (K := K) W
    have e : (chunksOf W P).schunk 1 = d := by show okOr (ownerD W) zero8 = d; rw [hd]; rfl
    rw [e]
    exact sabs_lo8 d 8#usize n8 _ hdl
  · exact sabs_c2 _ _ _ _ _ _ v0 hP.asset (fun i => rfl) 8#usize n8
  · exact sabs_c3 _ _ (fun i => rfl) 2#usize n2
  · exact sabs_lo8 W.sk 8#usize n8 _ (fun i => rfl)
  · exact sabs_lo8 W.salt 8#usize n8 _ (fun i => rfl)
  · have htr := trv pub.variant 27 (by omega) (by omega) hz
    intro i
    show (recipB pub (toModel W) 0).absorb i = _
    unfold recipB; rw [htr]
    exact sabs_lo8 W.recipientOwner 8#usize n8 _ (fun i => rfl) i
  · have htr := trv pub.variant 28 (by omega) (by omega) hz
    intro i
    show (recipB pub (toModel W) 1).absorb i = _
    unfold recipB; rw [htr]
    exact sabs_c2 _ _ _ _ _ _ v1 hP.asset (fun i => rfl) 8#usize n8 i
  · have htr := trv pub.variant 29 (by omega) (by omega) hz
    intro i
    show (recipB pub (toModel W) 2).absorb i = _
    unfold recipB; rw [htr]
    exact sabs_c3 _ _ (fun i => rfl) 2#usize n2 i
  · exact sabs_lo8 W.changeOwner 8#usize n8 _ (fun i => rfl)
  · exact sabs_c2 _ _ _ _ _ _ v2 hP.asset (fun i => rfl) 8#usize n8
  · exact sabs_c3 _ _ (fun i => rfl) 2#usize n2

section chain
variable (pub : R0P.Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (R : RustChunks) (hS : SabsOk pub w R)

include hS in
theorem spongePre_lift_s (h : Fin 57) (hn : ¬ NodeKind h.val) (hz : ¬ ZeroKind pub.variant h.val) :
    ∃ s, spongePre R h.val = ok s ∧ ∀ i : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) (s.val[i.val]!) = (blocksOf pub w h).pre i := by
  obtain ⟨hv, hh⟩ := h
  dsimp only at hn hz ⊢
  have cases : hv = 0 ∨ hv = 1 ∨ hv = 2 ∨ hv = 3 ∨ hv = 25 ∨ hv = 26 ∨ hv = 27 ∨ hv = 28 ∨ hv = 29 ∨
      hv = 30 ∨ hv = 31 ∨ hv = 32 := by
    unfold NodeKind at hn; omega
  -- the chained blocks of each sponge, with their model chaining equalities
  have s1 := note_init (K := K) (blocksOf pub w 1) rfl
  have s0 := owner_init (K := K) (blocksOf pub w 0) rfl
  have s25 := nul_init (K := K) (blocksOf pub w 25) rfl
  have s30 := note_init (K := K) (blocksOf pub w 30) rfl
  rcases cases with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  · exact s0
  · exact s1
  · obtain ⟨p1, hp1, hv1⟩ := s1
    obtain ⟨p2, hp2, hv2⟩ := chain_step _ _ (pre_2 pub w) p1 hv1 (R.schunk 1) (R.sclen 1)
      (hS ⟨1, by omega⟩ (nk 1 (by omega)) (zk _ 1 (by omega)))
    exact ⟨p2, by simp only [spongePre, hp1, bind_tc_ok, hp2], hv2⟩
  · obtain ⟨p1, hp1, hv1⟩ := s1
    obtain ⟨p2, hp2, hv2⟩ := chain_step _ _ (pre_2 pub w) p1 hv1 (R.schunk 1) (R.sclen 1)
      (hS ⟨1, by omega⟩ (nk 1 (by omega)) (zk _ 1 (by omega)))
    obtain ⟨p3, hp3, hv3⟩ := chain_step _ _ (pre_3 pub w) p2 hv2 (R.schunk 2) (R.sclen 2)
      (hS ⟨2, by omega⟩ (nk 2 (by omega)) (zk _ 2 (by omega)))
    exact ⟨p3, by simp only [spongePre, hp1, bind_tc_ok, hp2, hp3], hv3⟩
  · exact s25
  · obtain ⟨p1, hp1, hv1⟩ := s25
    obtain ⟨p2, hp2, hv2⟩ := chain_step _ _ (pre_26 pub w) p1 hv1 (R.schunk 25) (R.sclen 25)
      (hS ⟨25, by omega⟩ (nk 25 (by omega)) (zk _ 25 (by omega)))
    exact ⟨p2, by simp only [spongePre, hp1, bind_tc_ok, hp2], hv2⟩
  · have htr : pub.variant = .privateTransfer := by
      cases e : pub.variant
      · rfl
      · exact absurd ⟨e, by omega, by omega⟩ hz
    exact note_init (K := K) (blocksOf pub w 27) (by
      show (recipB pub w 0).pre = _; unfold recipB; rw [htr]; rfl)
  · have htr : pub.variant = .privateTransfer := by
      cases e : pub.variant
      · rfl
      · exact absurd ⟨e, by omega, by omega⟩ hz
    obtain ⟨p1, hp1, hv1⟩ := note_init (K := K) (blocksOf pub w 27) (by
      show (recipB pub w 0).pre = _; unfold recipB; rw [htr]; rfl)
    obtain ⟨p2, hp2, hv2⟩ := chain_step _ _ (pre_28 pub w htr) p1 hv1 (R.schunk 27) (R.sclen 27)
      (hS ⟨27, by omega⟩ (nk 27 (by omega)) (zk_tr pub 27 htr))
    exact ⟨p2, by simp only [spongePre, hp1, bind_tc_ok, hp2], hv2⟩
  · have htr : pub.variant = .privateTransfer := by
      cases e : pub.variant
      · rfl
      · exact absurd ⟨e, by omega, by omega⟩ hz
    obtain ⟨p1, hp1, hv1⟩ := note_init (K := K) (blocksOf pub w 27) (by
      show (recipB pub w 0).pre = _; unfold recipB; rw [htr]; rfl)
    obtain ⟨p2, hp2, hv2⟩ := chain_step _ _ (pre_28 pub w htr) p1 hv1 (R.schunk 27) (R.sclen 27)
      (hS ⟨27, by omega⟩ (nk 27 (by omega)) (zk_tr pub 27 htr))
    obtain ⟨p3, hp3, hv3⟩ := chain_step _ _ (pre_29 pub w htr) p2 hv2 (R.schunk 28) (R.sclen 28)
      (hS ⟨28, by omega⟩ (nk 28 (by omega)) (zk_tr pub 28 htr))
    exact ⟨p3, by simp only [spongePre, hp1, bind_tc_ok, hp2, hp3], hv3⟩
  · exact s30
  · obtain ⟨p1, hp1, hv1⟩ := s30
    obtain ⟨p2, hp2, hv2⟩ := chain_step _ _ (pre_31 pub w) p1 hv1 (R.schunk 30) (R.sclen 30)
      (hS ⟨30, by omega⟩ (nk 30 (by omega)) (zk _ 30 (by omega)))
    exact ⟨p2, by simp only [spongePre, hp1, bind_tc_ok, hp2], hv2⟩
  · obtain ⟨p1, hp1, hv1⟩ := s30
    obtain ⟨p2, hp2, hv2⟩ := chain_step _ _ (pre_31 pub w) p1 hv1 (R.schunk 30) (R.sclen 30)
      (hS ⟨30, by omega⟩ (nk 30 (by omega)) (zk _ 30 (by omega)))
    obtain ⟨p3, hp3, hv3⟩ := chain_step _ _ (pre_32 pub w) p2 hv2 (R.schunk 31) (R.sclen 31)
      (hS ⟨31, by omega⟩ (nk 31 (by omega)) (zk _ 31 (by omega)))
    exact ⟨p3, by simp only [spongePre, hp1, bind_tc_ok, hp2, hp3], hv3⟩

end chain

/-! ### Note digests -/

/-- The digest of the last block of a note sponge ending at block h3. -/
def noteDigestR (R : RustChunks) (h3 : Nat) : Result (Array U32 8#usize) := do
  let p ← spongePre R h3
  spongeDigestR p (R.schunk h3) (R.sclen h3)

theorem noteDigest_lift (pub : R0P.Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (R : RustChunks) (hS : SabsOk pub w R)
    (h : Fin 57) (hn : ¬ NodeKind h.val) (hz : ¬ ZeroKind pub.variant h.val) :
    ∃ d, noteDigestR R h.val = ok d ∧ DigestLift d (blockDigest (blocksOf pub w h)) ∧ Canon8 d := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpv⟩ := spongePre_lift_s pub w R hS h hn hz
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hdl, hdc⟩ := spongeDigest_lift p _ _ _ hpv (hS h hn hz)
  exact ⟨d, by rw [noteDigestR]; simp only [hp, bind_tc_ok, hd], hdl, hdc⟩

R0Z.BuilderBlocksChain:
import R0Z.BuilderBlocksCopy

/-! Sponge chaining for the copy (DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL §12 (1)).

The sponge pre-states are no longer inputs.  `spongePre R h` is what the Rust
builder computes: sponge_init(domain, len) for the first block of each sponge
(owner 0x41530001/8 at block 0, note 0x41530003/18 at 1, 27, 30, nullifier
0x41530002/16 at 25), and for a chained block the previous block's final
permutation row (rounds[10] of the copy's perm_rounds on the previous
pre-state and absorption).  `builder_blocks_model_chain`: under
`BuilderChunkLifts` (node children and sponge chunk absorptions only), all 57
blocks of `RustWriterChain` equal buildModel. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R0Z.WriterRefine
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open R0Z.BuilderModel

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

/-- The Rust inputs of every block other than permutation rows and sponge pre-states. -/
structure RustChunks where
  left : Nat → Array U32 8#usize
  right : Nat → Array U32 8#usize
  schunk : Nat → Array U32 8#usize
  sclen : Nat → Usize

/-- One chained sponge step: absorb, permute, return the final row. -/
def spongeStep (pre : Array U32 16#usize) (chunk : Array U32 8#usize) (clen : Usize) :
    Result (Array U32 16#usize) := do
  let ab ← R0BlockCopies.sponge_absorb chunk clen
  let rounds ← R0PoseidonCopy.perm_rounds pre ab
  ok rounds.val[10]!

def initOwner : Result (Array U32 16#usize) := R0BlockCopies.sponge_init 0x41530001#u32 8#u32
def initNote : Result (Array U32 16#usize) := R0BlockCopies.sponge_init 0x41530003#u32 18#u32
def initNul : Result (Array U32 16#usize) := R0BlockCopies.sponge_init 0x41530002#u32 16#u32

/-- The Rust sponge pre-state of block h. -/
def spongePre (R : RustChunks) (h : Nat) : Result (Array U32 16#usize) :=
  match h with
  | 0 => initOwner
  | 1 => initNote
  | 2 => do let p ← initNote; spongeStep p (R.schunk 1) (R.sclen 1)
  | 3 => do
      let p ← initNote
      let p ← spongeStep p (R.schunk 1) (R.sclen 1)
      spongeStep p (R.schunk 2) (R.sclen 2)
  | 25 => initNul
  | 26 => do let p ← initNul; spongeStep p (R.schunk 25) (R.sclen 25)
  | 27 => initNote
  | 28 => do let p ← initNote; spongeStep p (R.schunk 27) (R.sclen 27)
  | 29 => do
      let p ← initNote
      let p ← spongeStep p (R.schunk 27) (R.sclen 27)
      spongeStep p (R.schunk 28) (R.sclen 28)
  | 30 => initNote
  | 31 => do let p ← initNote; spongeStep p (R.schunk 30) (R.sclen 30)
  | 32 => do
      let p ← initNote
      let p ← spongeStep p (R.schunk 30) (R.sclen 30)
      spongeStep p (R.schunk 31) (R.sclen 31)
  | _ => ok zero16

/-- The copy writer of block h, permutation and sponge chaining included. -/
def RustWriterChain (v : R0P.Variant) (R : RustChunks) (h : Nat) : Result (Array U32 256#usize) :=
  if NodeKind h then do
    let pre ← R0BlockCopies.node_pre (R.right h)
    let ab ← R0BlockCopies.node_absorb (R.left h)
    let rounds ← R0PoseidonCopy.perm_rounds pre ab
    R0BlockCopies.write_block pre ab rounds
  else if ZeroKind v h then do
    let rounds ← R0PoseidonCopy.perm_rounds zero16 zero16
    R0BlockCopies.write_block zero16 zero16 rounds
  else do
    let pre ← spongePre R h
    let ab ← R0BlockCopies.sponge_absorb (R.schunk h) (R.sclen h)
    let rounds ← R0PoseidonCopy.perm_rounds pre ab
    R0BlockCopies.write_block pre ab rounds

/-- BuilderInputLifts without the sponge pre-states. -/
structure BuilderChunkLifts (pub : R0P.Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (R : RustChunks) : Prop where
  node : ∀ h : Fin 57, NodeKind h.val → ∃ L Rr : R0P.Digest K, blocksOf pub w h = nodeIn L Rr ∧
    DigestLift (R.left h.val) L ∧ DigestLift (R.right h.val) Rr ∧
    ∀ i, i < 8 → ((R.right h.val).val[i]!).val < 2147483647
  sabs : ∀ h : Fin 57, ¬ NodeKind h.val → ¬ ZeroKind pub.variant h.val →
    ∀ i : Fin 16, (blocksOf pub w h).absorb i =
      (if i.val < 8 ∧ i.val < (R.sclen h.val).val then liftU (K := K) ((R.schunk h.val).val[i.val]!) else 0)

theorem sponge_ends (pre : Array U32 16#usize) (chunk : Array U32 8#usize) (clen : Usize) (B : BlockIn K)
    (hpre : ∀ i : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) (pre.val[i.val]!) = B.pre i)
    (habs : ∀ i : Fin 16, B.absorb i =
      (if i.val < 8 ∧ i.val < clen.val then liftU (K := K) (chunk.val[i.val]!) else 0)) :
    ∃ ab, R0BlockCopies.sponge_absorb chunk clen = ok ab ∧ EndsLift pre ab B := by
  obtain ⟨ab, hab, habs'⟩ := sponge_absorb_spec chunk clen
  refine ⟨ab, hab, hpre, fun i => ?_⟩
  rw [habs i, habs']
  by_cases c : i.val < 8 ∧ i.val < clen.val
  · rw [if_pos c, if_pos c]
  · rw [if_neg c, if_neg c]; unfold liftU; simp

theorem chain_step [CharP K 0x7fffffff] (B B' : BlockIn K) (hB' : B'.pre = blockOut B)
    (pre : Array U32 16#usize) (hpre : ∀ i : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) (pre.val[i.val]!) = B.pre i)
    (chunk : Array U32 8#usize) (clen : Usize)
    (habs : ∀ i : Fin 16, B.absorb i =
      (if i.val < 8 ∧ i.val < clen.val then liftU (K := K) (chunk.val[i.val]!) else 0)) :
    ∃ s, spongeStep pre chunk clen = ok s ∧ ∀ i : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) (s.val[i.val]!) = B'.pre i := by
  obtain ⟨ab, hab, he⟩ := sponge_ends pre chunk clen B hpre habs
  obtain ⟨rounds, hro, hR⟩ := R0Z.PoseidonRefine.perm_rounds_lift pre ab B he
  refine ⟨rounds.val[10]!, ?_, fun i => ?_⟩
  · rw [spongeStep]
    simp only [hab, hro, bind_tc_ok]
  · rw [hB']
    exact hR 10 i (by norm_num)

theorem init_step (dom len : U32) (d l : Nat) [Nat.AtLeastTwo d] [Nat.AtLeastTwo l]
    (hd : dom.val = (OfNat.ofNat d : Nat)) (hl : len.val = (OfNat.ofNat l : Nat)) (B : BlockIn K)
    (hB : B.pre = spongeInit (OfNat.ofNat d) (OfNat.ofNat l)) :
    ∃ s, R0BlockCopies.sponge_init dom len = ok s ∧ ∀ i : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) (s.val[i.val]!) = B.pre i := by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, -⟩ := sponge_init_spec dom len
  refine ⟨s, hs, ?_⟩
  rw [hB]
  exact spre_init dom len _ _ (R0Z.PoseidonRefine.lane_lift d hd rfl)
    (R0Z.PoseidonRefine.lane_lift l hl rfl) s hs

theorem owner_init (B : BlockIn K) (hB : B.pre = spongeInit 0x41530001 8) :
    ∃ s, initOwner = ok s ∧ ∀ i : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) (s.val[i.val]!) = B.pre i :=
  init_step _ _ 0x41530001 8 (UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq _) (UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq _) B hB

theorem note_init (B : BlockIn K) (hB : B.pre = spongeInit 0x41530003 18) :
    ∃ s, initNote = ok s ∧ ∀ i : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) (s.val[i.val]!) = B.pre i :=
  init_step _ _ 0x41530003 18 (UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq _) (UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq _) B hB

theorem nul_init (B : BlockIn K) (hB : B.pre = spongeInit 0x41530002 16) :
    ∃ s, initNul = ok s ∧ ∀ i : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) (s.val[i.val]!) = B.pre i :=
  init_step _ _ 0x41530002 16 (UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq _) (UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq _) B hB

section chain
variable [CharP K 0x7fffffff] (pub : R0P.Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (R : RustChunks)
  (hL : BuilderChunkLifts pub w R)

include hL in
/-- The sabs premise at a literal sponge block. -/
theorem sabs_at (h : Nat) (hh : h < 57) (hn : ¬ NodeKind h) (hz : ¬ ZeroKind pub.variant h) :
    ∀ i : Fin 16, (blocksOf pub w ⟨h, hh⟩).absorb i =
      (if i.val < 8 ∧ i.val < (R.sclen h).val then liftU (K := K) ((R.schunk h).val[i.val]!) else 0) :=
  hL.sabs ⟨h, hh⟩ hn hz

theorem nk (h : Nat) (h1 : h < 4 ∨ (25 ≤ h ∧ h ≤ 32)) : ¬ NodeKind h := by
  unfold NodeKind; omega

theorem zk (v : R0P.Variant) (h : Nat) (h1 : h < 27 ∨ 29 < h) : ¬ ZeroKind v h := by
  unfold ZeroKind; omega

theorem zk_tr (h : Nat) (hv : pub.variant = .privateTransfer) : ¬ ZeroKind pub.variant h := by
  unfold ZeroKind; rw [hv]; simp

include hL in
/-- Every sponge block's Rust pre-state lifts to the model pre-state. -/
theorem spongePre_lift (h : Fin 57) (hn : ¬ NodeKind h.val) (hz : ¬ ZeroKind pub.variant h.val) :
    ∃ s, spongePre R h.val = ok s ∧ ∀ i : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) (s.val[i.val]!) = (blocksOf pub w h).pre i := by
  obtain ⟨hv, hh⟩ := h
  dsimp only at hn hz ⊢
  have cases : hv = 0 ∨ hv = 1 ∨ hv = 2 ∨ hv = 3 ∨ hv = 25 ∨ hv = 26 ∨ hv = 27 ∨ hv = 28 ∨ hv = 29 ∨
      hv = 30 ∨ hv = 31 ∨ hv = 32 := by
    unfold NodeKind at hn; omega
  -- the chained blocks of each sponge, with their model chaining equalities
  have s1 := note_init (K := K) (blocksOf pub w 1) rfl
  have s0 := owner_init (K := K) (blocksOf pub w 0) rfl
  have s25 := nul_init (K := K) (blocksOf pub w 25) rfl
  have s30 := note_init (K := K) (blocksOf pub w 30) rfl
  rcases cases with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  · exact s0
  · exact s1
  · obtain ⟨p1, hp1, hv1⟩ := s1
    obtain ⟨p2, hp2, hv2⟩ := chain_step _ _ (pre_2 pub w) p1 hv1 (R.schunk 1) (R.sclen 1)
      (sabs_at pub w R hL 1 (by omega) (nk 1 (by omega)) (zk _ 1 (by omega)))
    exact ⟨p2, by simp only [spongePre, hp1, bind_tc_ok, hp2], hv2⟩
  · obtain ⟨p1, hp1, hv1⟩ := s1
    obtain ⟨p2, hp2, hv2⟩ := chain_step _ _ (pre_2 pub w) p1 hv1 (R.schunk 1) (R.sclen 1)
      (sabs_at pub w R hL 1 (by omega) (nk 1 (by omega)) (zk _ 1 (by omega)))
    obtain ⟨p3, hp3, hv3⟩ := chain_step _ _ (pre_3 pub w) p2 hv2 (R.schunk 2) (R.sclen 2)
      (sabs_at pub w R hL 2 (by omega) (nk 2 (by omega)) (zk _ 2 (by omega)))
    exact ⟨p3, by simp only [spongePre, hp1, bind_tc_ok, hp2, hp3], hv3⟩
  · exact s25
  · obtain ⟨p1, hp1, hv1⟩ := s25
    obtain ⟨p2, hp2, hv2⟩ := chain_step _ _ (pre_26 pub w) p1 hv1 (R.schunk 25) (R.sclen 25)
      (sabs_at pub w R hL 25 (by omega) (nk 25 (by omega)) (zk _ 25 (by omega)))
    exact ⟨p2, by simp only [spongePre, hp1, bind_tc_ok, hp2], hv2⟩
  · have htr : pub.variant = .privateTransfer := by
      cases e : pub.variant
      · rfl
      · exact absurd ⟨e, by omega, by omega⟩ hz
    exact note_init (K := K) (blocksOf pub w 27) (by
      show (recipB pub w 0).pre = _; unfold recipB; rw [htr]; rfl)
  · have htr : pub.variant = .privateTransfer := by
      cases e : pub.variant
      · rfl
      · exact absurd ⟨e, by omega, by omega⟩ hz
    obtain ⟨p1, hp1, hv1⟩ := note_init (K := K) (blocksOf pub w 27) (by
      show (recipB pub w 0).pre = _; unfold recipB; rw [htr]; rfl)
    obtain ⟨p2, hp2, hv2⟩ := chain_step _ _ (pre_28 pub w htr) p1 hv1 (R.schunk 27) (R.sclen 27)
      (sabs_at pub w R hL 27 (by omega) (nk 27 (by omega)) (zk_tr pub 27 htr))
    exact ⟨p2, by simp only [spongePre, hp1, bind_tc_ok, hp2], hv2⟩
  · have htr : pub.variant = .privateTransfer := by
      cases e : pub.variant
      · rfl
      · exact absurd ⟨e, by omega, by omega⟩ hz
    obtain ⟨p1, hp1, hv1⟩ := note_init (K := K) (blocksOf pub w 27) (by
      show (recipB pub w 0).pre = _; unfold recipB; rw [htr]; rfl)
    obtain ⟨p2, hp2, hv2⟩ := chain_step _ _ (pre_28 pub w htr) p1 hv1 (R.schunk 27) (R.sclen 27)
      (sabs_at pub w R hL 27 (by omega) (nk 27 (by omega)) (zk_tr pub 27 htr))
    obtain ⟨p3, hp3, hv3⟩ := chain_step _ _ (pre_29 pub w htr) p2 hv2 (R.schunk 28) (R.sclen 28)
      (sabs_at pub w R hL 28 (by omega) (nk 28 (by omega)) (zk_tr pub 28 htr))
    exact ⟨p3, by simp only [spongePre, hp1, bind_tc_ok, hp2, hp3], hv3⟩
  · exact s30
  · obtain ⟨p1, hp1, hv1⟩ := s30
    obtain ⟨p2, hp2, hv2⟩ := chain_step _ _ (pre_31 pub w) p1 hv1 (R.schunk 30) (R.sclen 30)
      (sabs_at pub w R hL 30 (by omega) (nk 30 (by omega)) (zk _ 30 (by omega)))
    exact ⟨p2, by simp only [spongePre, hp1, bind_tc_ok, hp2], hv2⟩
  · obtain ⟨p1, hp1, hv1⟩ := s30
    obtain ⟨p2, hp2, hv2⟩ := chain_step _ _ (pre_31 pub w) p1 hv1 (R.schunk 30) (R.sclen 30)
      (sabs_at pub w R hL 30 (by omega) (nk 30 (by omega)) (zk _ 30 (by omega)))
    obtain ⟨p3, hp3, hv3⟩ := chain_step _ _ (pre_32 pub w) p2 hv2 (R.schunk 31) (R.sclen 31)
      (sabs_at pub w R hL 31 (by omega) (nk 31 (by omega)) (zk _ 31 (by omega)))
    exact ⟨p3, by simp only [spongePre, hp1, bind_tc_ok, hp2, hp3], hv3⟩

include hL in
theorem builder_blocks_model_chain (h : Fin 57) :
    ∃ b, RustWriterChain pub.variant R h.val = ok b ∧ ∀ l c : Fin 16,
      liftU (K := K) (b.val[l.val * 16 + c.val]!) =
        buildModel pub w ⟨c.val, by omega⟩ ⟨16 * h.val + l.val, by have := h.isLt; omega⟩ := by
  let RI : RustInputs := ⟨R.left, R.right, fun h => match spongePre R h with
    | ok s => s | _ => zero16, R.schunk, R.sclen⟩
  have hI : BuilderInputLifts pub w RI := by
    refine ⟨hL.node, fun h hn hz => ?_, hL.sabs⟩
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hsv⟩ := spongePre_lift pub w R hL h hn hz
    intro i
    show liftU ((match spongePre R h.val with | ok s => s | _ => zero16).val[i.val]!) = _
    rw [hs]
    exact hsv i
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hcells⟩ := builder_blocks_model_copy pub w RI hI h
  refine ⟨b, ?_, hcells⟩
  unfold RustWriterChain
  unfold RustWriterCopy at hb
  by_cases hn : NodeKind h.val
  · rw [if_pos hn] at hb ⊢; exact hb
  rw [if_neg hn] at hb ⊢
  by_cases hz : ZeroKind pub.variant h.val
  · rw [if_pos hz] at hb ⊢; exact hb
  rw [if_neg hz] at hb ⊢
  obtain ⟨s, hs, -⟩ := spongePre_lift pub w R hL h hn hz
  have e : RI.spre h.val = s := by show (match spongePre R h.val with | ok s => s | _ => zero16) = s; rw [hs]
  rw [e] at hb
  rw [hs]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  exact hb

end chain

#print axioms R0Z.WriterRefine.chain_step
#print axioms R0Z.WriterRefine.spongePre_lift
#print axioms R0Z.WriterRefine.builder_blocks_model_chain
end R0Z.WriterRefine
R0Z.BuilderBlocksCopy:
import R0Z.BuilderBlocksModel
import R0Z.PoseidonRounds

/-! All 57 blocks without the RoundsOk premise, for the copy (DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL §11.5 (3)).

`RustWriterCopy v R h` is the copy writer of block h with its permutation
computed by the extracted Poseidon copy: the block's own pre-state and
absorption (node_pre/node_absorb for the 45 node blocks, zeros for a
withdrawal's 27..29, the sponge pre-state and sponge_absorb otherwise) are
fed to `R0PoseidonCopy.perm_rounds`, and its eleven rows are written by
`write_block`.  `builder_blocks_model_copy`: under `BuilderInputLifts` (the
node children's lifts and the sponge pre-state / absorption lifts — the
premises of `builder_blocks_model` other than RoundsOk), every cell of every
block equals `buildModel pub w` at row 16h+l.  RoundsOk is discharged by
`perm_rounds_lift`.  The copy↔production link for the permutation stays the
differential test diff-g (D54.3). -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R0Z.WriterRefine
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open R0Z.BuilderModel

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

/-- The Rust inputs of every block, without the permutation rows. -/
structure RustInputs where
  left : Nat → Array U32 8#usize
  right : Nat → Array U32 8#usize
  spre : Nat → Array U32 16#usize
  schunk : Nat → Array U32 8#usize
  sclen : Nat → Usize

/-- The copy writer of block h, permutation included. -/
def RustWriterCopy (v : R0P.Variant) (R : RustInputs) (h : Nat) : Result (Array U32 256#usize) :=
  if NodeKind h then do
    let pre ← R0BlockCopies.node_pre (R.right h)
    let ab ← R0BlockCopies.node_absorb (R.left h)
    let rounds ← R0PoseidonCopy.perm_rounds pre ab
    R0BlockCopies.write_block pre ab rounds
  else if ZeroKind v h then do
    let rounds ← R0PoseidonCopy.perm_rounds zero16 zero16
    R0BlockCopies.write_block zero16 zero16 rounds
  else do
    let ab ← R0BlockCopies.sponge_absorb (R.schunk h) (R.sclen h)
    let rounds ← R0PoseidonCopy.perm_rounds (R.spre h) ab
    R0BlockCopies.write_block (R.spre h) ab rounds

/-- BuilderLifts without the RoundsOk field. -/
structure BuilderInputLifts (pub : R0P.Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (R : RustInputs) : Prop where
  node : ∀ h : Fin 57, NodeKind h.val → ∃ L Rr : R0P.Digest K, blocksOf pub w h = nodeIn L Rr ∧
    DigestLift (R.left h.val) L ∧ DigestLift (R.right h.val) Rr ∧
    ∀ i, i < 8 → ((R.right h.val).val[i]!).val < 2147483647
  spre : ∀ h : Fin 57, ¬ NodeKind h.val → ¬ ZeroKind pub.variant h.val →
    ∀ i : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) ((R.spre h.val).val[i.val]!) = (blocksOf pub w h).pre i
  sabs : ∀ h : Fin 57, ¬ NodeKind h.val → ¬ ZeroKind pub.variant h.val →
    ∀ i : Fin 16, (blocksOf pub w h).absorb i =
      (if i.val < 8 ∧ i.val < (R.sclen h.val).val then liftU (K := K) ((R.schunk h.val).val[i.val]!) else 0)

theorem builder_blocks_model_copy [CharP K 0x7fffffff] (pub : R0P.Public K) (w : ModelWitness K)
    (R : RustInputs) (hL : BuilderInputLifts pub w R) (h : Fin 57) :
    ∃ b, RustWriterCopy pub.variant R h.val = ok b ∧ ∀ l c : Fin 16,
      liftU (K := K) (b.val[l.val * 16 + c.val]!) =
        buildModel pub w ⟨c.val, by omega⟩ ⟨16 * h.val + l.val, by have := h.isLt; omega⟩ := by
  have cellEq : ∀ (b : Array U32 256#usize),
      (∀ l c : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) (b.val[l.val * 16 + c.val]!) = blockCell (blocksOf pub w h) l.val c) →
      ∀ l c : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) (b.val[l.val * 16 + c.val]!) =
        buildModel pub w ⟨c.val, by omega⟩ ⟨16 * h.val + l.val, by have := h.isLt; omega⟩ := by
    intro b hb l c
    rw [hb l c, buildModel, cell_block _ _ c.isLt h l.val l.isLt _ rfl]
    rfl
  unfold RustWriterCopy
  by_cases hn : NodeKind h.val
  · rw [if_pos hn]
    obtain ⟨L, Rr, he, hl, hr, hc⟩ := hL.node h hn
    obtain ⟨pre, ab, hp, ha, hE⟩ := node_ends_lift (R.left h.val) (R.right h.val) L Rr hl hr hc
    obtain ⟨rounds, hro, hR⟩ := R0Z.PoseidonRefine.perm_rounds_lift pre ab _ hE
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hs⟩ := block_model pre ab rounds _ hE hR
    refine ⟨b, ?_, cellEq b (by rw [he]; exact hs)⟩
    simp only [hp, ha, hro, bind_tc_ok]
    exact hb
  rw [if_neg hn]
  by_cases hz : ZeroKind pub.variant h.val
  · rw [if_pos hz]
    obtain ⟨hv, h1, h2⟩ := hz
    have hzero : blocksOf pub w h = ⟨0, 0⟩ := by
      rw [blocksOf_recip pub w h h1 h2, recipB_wd pub w _ hv]
    have he : EndsLift zero16 zero16 (blocksOf pub w h) := by
      rw [hzero]
      exact ⟨fun i => by show liftU _ = 0; unfold zero16; rw [rep16]; unfold liftU; simp,
        fun i => by show liftU _ = 0; unfold zero16; rw [rep16]; unfold liftU; simp⟩
    obtain ⟨rounds, hro, hR⟩ := R0Z.PoseidonRefine.perm_rounds_lift zero16 zero16 _ he
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hs⟩ := block_model zero16 zero16 rounds _ he hR
    refine ⟨b, ?_, cellEq b hs⟩
    simp only [hro, bind_tc_ok]
    exact hb
  · rw [if_neg hz]
    obtain ⟨ab, hab, habs⟩ := sponge_absorb_spec (R.schunk h.val) (R.sclen h.val)
    have he : EndsLift (R.spre h.val) ab (blocksOf pub w h) := by
      refine ⟨hL.spre h hn hz, fun i => ?_⟩
      rw [hL.sabs h hn hz i, habs]
      by_cases c : i.val < 8 ∧ i.val < (R.sclen h.val).val
      · rw [if_pos c, if_pos c]
      · rw [if_neg c, if_neg c]; unfold liftU; simp
    obtain ⟨rounds, hro, hR⟩ := R0Z.PoseidonRefine.perm_rounds_lift (R.spre h.val) ab _ he
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hs⟩ := block_model (R.spre h.val) ab rounds _ he hR
    refine ⟨b, ?_, cellEq b hs⟩
    simp only [hab, hro, bind_tc_ok]
    exact hb

end R0Z.WriterRefine

#print axioms R0Z.WriterRefine.builder_blocks_model_copy
R0Z.BuilderBlocksModel:
import R0Z.NoteSpongeModel
import R0Z.BuilderModelCopyMisc

/-! Every writer-produced Poseidon block of the Rust builder equals the
corresponding buildModel block (DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL §11.0).

`RustWriter v R h` is the copy writer that produces block h (write_node for
the 45 node blocks 4..24, 33..56; write_block of zeros for a withdrawal's
blocks 27..29; write_sponge_block for the sponge blocks).  `builder_blocks_model`:
under `BuilderLifts` — RoundsOk for every block (the Poseidon plug-in), the
node children's lifts, and the sponge pre-states / absorptions' lifts — every
cell of every block equals `buildModel pub w` at row 16h+l.  The discharge
lemmas below reduce the sponge pre-state premise to the Rust sponge chaining
(`spre (h+1) = rounds h [10]`, what production does, covered by the
differential test) and to sponge_init, and instantiate the node/absorption
premises for the tree, append and output-pair nodes and the owner and
nullifier sponges. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R0Z.WriterRefine
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open R0Z.BuilderModel

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

def NodeKind (h : Nat) : Prop := (4 ≤ h ∧ h ≤ 24) ∨ (33 ≤ h ∧ h ≤ 56)
def ZeroKind (v : R0P.Variant) (h : Nat) : Prop := v = .withdrawal ∧ 27 ≤ h ∧ h ≤ 29

instance (h : Nat) : Decidable (NodeKind h) := by unfold NodeKind; infer_instance
instance (v : R0P.Variant) (h : Nat) : Decidable (ZeroKind v h) := by unfold ZeroKind; infer_instance

/-- The Rust inputs of every block (all lifts are premises, see BuilderLifts). -/
structure RustBlocks where
  left : Nat → Array U32 8#usize
  right : Nat → Array U32 8#usize
  spre : Nat → Array U32 16#usize
  schunk : Nat → Array U32 8#usize
  sclen : Nat → Usize
  rounds : Nat → Array (Array U32 16#usize) 11#usize

def zero16 : Array U32 16#usize := Array.repeat 16#usize 0#u32

/-- The copy writer that produces block h. -/
def RustWriter (v : R0P.Variant) (R : RustBlocks) (h : Nat) : Result (Array U32 256#usize) :=
  if NodeKind h then R0BlockCopies.write_node (R.left h) (R.right h) (R.rounds h)
  else if ZeroKind v h then R0BlockCopies.write_block zero16 zero16 (R.rounds h)
  else R0BlockCopies.write_sponge_block (R.spre h) (R.schunk h) (R.sclen h) (R.rounds h)

structure BuilderLifts (pub : R0P.Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (R : RustBlocks) : Prop where
  rounds : ∀ h : Fin 57, RoundsOk (R.rounds h.val) (blocksOf pub w h)
  node : ∀ h : Fin 57, NodeKind h.val → ∃ L Rr : R0P.Digest K, blocksOf pub w h = nodeIn L Rr ∧
    DigestLift (R.left h.val) L ∧ DigestLift (R.right h.val) Rr ∧
    ∀ i, i < 8 → ((R.right h.val).val[i]!).val < 2147483647
  spre : ∀ h : Fin 57, ¬ NodeKind h.val → ¬ ZeroKind pub.variant h.val →
    ∀ i : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) ((R.spre h.val).val[i.val]!) = (blocksOf pub w h).pre i
  sabs : ∀ h : Fin 57, ¬ NodeKind h.val → ¬ ZeroKind pub.variant h.val →
    ∀ i : Fin 16, (blocksOf pub w h).absorb i =
      (if i.val < 8 ∧ i.val < (R.sclen h.val).val then liftU (K := K) ((R.schunk h.val).val[i.val]!) else 0)

theorem builder_blocks_model [CharP K 0x7fffffff] (pub : R0P.Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (R : RustBlocks)
    (hL : BuilderLifts pub w R) (h : Fin 57) :
    ∃ b, RustWriter pub.variant R h.val = ok b ∧ ∀ l c : Fin 16,
      liftU (K := K) (b.val[l.val * 16 + c.val]!) =
        buildModel pub w ⟨c.val, by omega⟩ ⟨16 * h.val + l.val, by have := h.isLt; omega⟩ := by
  have cellEq : ∀ (b : Array U32 256#usize),
      (∀ l c : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) (b.val[l.val * 16 + c.val]!) = blockCell (blocksOf pub w h) l.val c) →
      ∀ l c : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) (b.val[l.val * 16 + c.val]!) =
        buildModel pub w ⟨c.val, by omega⟩ ⟨16 * h.val + l.val, by have := h.isLt; omega⟩ := by
    intro b hb l c
    rw [hb l c, buildModel, cell_block _ _ c.isLt h l.val l.isLt _ rfl]
    rfl
  unfold RustWriter
  by_cases hn : NodeKind h.val
  · rw [if_pos hn]
    obtain ⟨L, Rr, he, hl, hr, hc⟩ := hL.node h hn
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hs⟩ := node_model (R.left h.val) (R.right h.val) (R.rounds h.val) L Rr hl hr hc
      (he ▸ hL.rounds h)
    exact ⟨b, hb, cellEq b (by rw [he]; exact hs)⟩
  rw [if_neg hn]
  by_cases hz : ZeroKind pub.variant h.val
  · rw [if_pos hz]
    obtain ⟨hv, h1, h2⟩ := hz
    have hzero : blocksOf pub w h = ⟨0, 0⟩ := by
      rw [blocksOf_recip pub w h h1 h2, recipB_wd pub w _ hv]
    have he : EndsLift zero16 zero16 (blocksOf pub w h) := by
      rw [hzero]
      exact ⟨fun i => by show liftU _ = 0; unfold zero16; rw [rep16]; unfold liftU; simp,
        fun i => by show liftU _ = 0; unfold zero16; rw [rep16]; unfold liftU; simp⟩
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hs⟩ := block_model zero16 zero16 (R.rounds h.val) _ he (hL.rounds h)
    exact ⟨b, hb, cellEq b hs⟩
  · rw [if_neg hz]
    obtain ⟨ab, hab, habs⟩ := sponge_absorb_spec (R.schunk h.val) (R.sclen h.val)
    have he : EndsLift (R.spre h.val) ab (blocksOf pub w h) := by
      refine ⟨hL.spre h hn hz, fun i => ?_⟩
      rw [hL.sabs h hn hz i, habs]
      by_cases c : i.val < 8 ∧ i.val < (R.sclen h.val).val
      · rw [if_pos c, if_pos c]
      · rw [if_neg c, if_neg c]; unfold liftU; simp
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hs⟩ := block_model (R.spre h.val) ab (R.rounds h.val) _ he (hL.rounds h)
    refine ⟨b, ?_, cellEq b hs⟩
    rw [R0BlockCopies.write_sponge_block, hab]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    exact hb

/-! ### Discharging the premises (mechanical instantiations) -/

/-- Sponge chaining: a Rust pre-state equal to the previous block's final
round lifts to the model's pre-state whenever the model chains (pre_2, pre_3,
pre_26, pre_28/29, pre_31, pre_32). -/
theorem spre_chain (pub : R0P.Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (R : RustBlocks) (h : Fin 57) (h' : Fin 57)
    (hr : RoundsOk (R.rounds h.val) (blocksOf pub w h))
    (hchainR : R.spre h'.val = (R.rounds h.val).val[10]!)
    (hchainM : (blocksOf pub w h').pre = blockOut (blocksOf pub w h)) :
    ∀ i : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) ((R.spre h'.val).val[i.val]!) = (blocksOf pub w h').pre i := by
  intro i
  rw [hchainR, hchainM]
  exact hr 10 i (by norm_num)

/-- First sponge blocks: sponge_init lifts to the model's spongeInit. -/
theorem spre_init (domain len : U32) (dom l : K) (hd : liftU (K := K) domain = dom)
    (hl : liftU (K := K) len = l) (s : Array U32 16#usize)
    (hs : R0BlockCopies.sponge_init domain len = ok s) :
    ∀ i : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) (s.val[i.val]!) = spongeInit dom l i := by
  obtain ⟨s', hs', hv⟩ := sponge_init_spec domain len
  rw [hs] at hs'
  cases hs'
  intro i
  rw [hv]
  unfold spongeInit
  by_cases e8 : i.val = 8
  · rw [if_pos e8, if_pos e8, hd]
  · rw [if_neg e8, if_neg e8]
    by_cases e9 : i.val = 9
    · rw [if_pos e9, if_pos e9, hl]
    · rw [if_neg e9, if_neg e9]; unfold liftU; simp

/-- A full eight-word chunk lifting to a digest gives lo8 absorption. -/
theorem sabs_lo8 (chunk : Array U32 8#usize) (clen : Usize) (hc : clen.val = 8) (D : R0P.Digest K)
    (hD : DigestLift chunk D) :
    ∀ i : Fin 16, lo8 D i = (if i.val < 8 ∧ i.val < clen.val then liftU (K := K) (chunk.val[i.val]!) else 0) := by
  intro i
  unfold lo8
  rw [hc]
  by_cases h8 : i.val < 8
  · rw [dif_pos h8, if_pos ⟨h8, h8⟩]; exact (hD ⟨i.val, h8⟩).symm
  · rw [dif_neg h8, if_neg (fun h => h8 h.1)]

/-- Owner-key sponge (block 0, sk, 8 words). -/
theorem owner_sabs (pub : R0P.Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (chunk : Array U32 8#usize) (clen : Usize)
    (hc : clen.val = 8) (hD : DigestLift chunk w.sk) :
    ∀ i : Fin 16, (blocksOf pub w 0).absorb i =
      (if i.val < 8 ∧ i.val < clen.val then liftU (K := K) (chunk.val[i.val]!) else 0) :=
  sabs_lo8 chunk clen hc w.sk hD

theorem owner_spre (pub : R0P.Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (domain len : U32)
    (hd : domain.val = 0x41530001) (hl : len.val = 8) (s : Array U32 16#usize)
    (hs : R0BlockCopies.sponge_init domain len = ok s) :
    ∀ i : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) (s.val[i.val]!) = (blocksOf pub w 0).pre i :=
  spre_init domain len _ _ (by unfold liftU; rw [hd]; norm_num) (by unfold liftU; rw [hl]; norm_num) s hs

/-- Nullifier sponge (blocks 25, 26: sk then salt, 16 words). -/
theorem nul_sabs0 (pub : R0P.Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (chunk : Array U32 8#usize) (clen : Usize)
    (hc : clen.val = 8) (hD : DigestLift chunk w.sk) :
    ∀ i : Fin 16, (blocksOf pub w 25).absorb i =
      (if i.val < 8 ∧ i.val < clen.val then liftU (K := K) (chunk.val[i.val]!) else 0) :=
  sabs_lo8 chunk clen hc w.sk hD

theorem nul_sabs1 (pub : R0P.Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (chunk : Array U32 8#usize) (clen : Usize)
    (hc : clen.val = 8) (hD : DigestLift chunk w.salt) :
    ∀ i : Fin 16, (blocksOf pub w 26).absorb i =
      (if i.val < 8 ∧ i.val < clen.val then liftU (K := K) (chunk.val[i.val]!) else 0) :=
  sabs_lo8 chunk clen hc w.salt hD

theorem nul_spre0 (pub : R0P.Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (domain len : U32)
    (hd : domain.val = 0x41530002) (hl : len.val = 16) (s : Array U32 16#usize)
    (hs : R0BlockCopies.sponge_init domain len = ok s) :
    ∀ i : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) (s.val[i.val]!) = (blocksOf pub w 25).pre i :=
  spre_init domain len _ _ (by unfold liftU; rw [hd]; norm_num) (by unfold liftU; rw [hl]; norm_num) s hs

theorem nul_spre1 (pub : R0P.Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (R : RustBlocks)
    (hr : RoundsOk (R.rounds 25) (blocksOf pub w 25)) (hchain : R.spre 26 = (R.rounds 25).val[10]!) :
    ∀ i : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) ((R.spre 26).val[i.val]!) = (blocksOf pub w 26).pre i :=
  spre_chain pub w R 25 26 hr hchain (pre_26 pub w)

/-- Tree node blocks: the model's children are the ordered (current, sibling). -/
theorem tree_node_children (pub : R0P.Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (l : Fin 24) :
    blocksOf pub w ⟨nodeBlock l, nodeBlock_lt l⟩ =
      nodeIn (ordered (treeCur w (inputLeaf pub w) l.val) (w.path l).2 (w.path l).1).1
        (ordered (treeCur w (inputLeaf pub w) l.val) (w.path l).2 (w.path l).1).2 := by
  rw [blocksOf_node']; rfl

/-- Append node blocks 34..53: the model's children are ordered (current, frontier/empty root). -/
theorem app_node_children (pub : R0P.Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (j : Nat) (hj : j < 20) :
    blocksOf pub w ⟨34 + j, by omega⟩ =
      nodeIn (ordered (appCur pub (outPair pub w) j) (appSib pub ⟨j, hj⟩) (appBit pub j)).1
        (ordered (appCur pub (outPair pub w) j) (appSib pub ⟨j, hj⟩) (appBit pub j)).2 := by
  rw [blocksOf_app' pub w _ j rfl hj]; rfl

/-- The output-pair node (block 33). -/
theorem outpair_children (pub : R0P.Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) :
    blocksOf pub w 33 = (match pub.variant with
      | .privateTransfer => nodeIn (recipientDigest pub w) (changeDigest pub w)
      | .withdrawal => nodeIn (changeDigest pub w) 0) := rfl

/-- The node premise of BuilderLifts for a tree level, from the children's lifts. -/
theorem tree_node_premise (pub : R0P.Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (R : RustBlocks) (l : Fin 24)
    (hl : DigestLift (R.left (nodeBlock l)) (ordered (treeCur w (inputLeaf pub w) l.val) (w.path l).2 (w.path l).1).1)
    (hr : DigestLift (R.right (nodeBlock l)) (ordered (treeCur w (inputLeaf pub w) l.val) (w.path l).2 (w.path l).1).2)
    (hc : ∀ i, i < 8 → ((R.right (nodeBlock l)).val[i]!).val < 2147483647) :
    ∃ L Rr : R0P.Digest K, blocksOf pub w ⟨nodeBlock l, nodeBlock_lt l⟩ = nodeIn L Rr ∧
      DigestLift (R.left (nodeBlock l)) L ∧ DigestLift (R.right (nodeBlock l)) Rr ∧
      ∀ i, i < 8 → ((R.right (nodeBlock l)).val[i]!).val < 2147483647 :=
  ⟨_, _, tree_node_children pub w l, hl, hr, hc⟩

/-- The node premise for an append level. -/
theorem app_node_premise (pub : R0P.Public K) (w : ModelWitness K) (R : RustBlocks) (j : Nat) (hj : j < 20)
    (hl : DigestLift (R.left (34 + j)) (ordered (appCur pub (outPair pub w) j) (appSib pub ⟨j, hj⟩) (appBit pub j)).1)
    (hr : DigestLift (R.right (34 + j)) (ordered (appCur pub (outPair pub w) j) (appSib pub ⟨j, hj⟩) (appBit pub j)).2)
    (hc : ∀ i, i < 8 → ((R.right (34 + j)).val[i]!).val < 2147483647) :
    ∃ L Rr : R0P.Digest K, blocksOf pub w ⟨34 + j, by omega⟩ = nodeIn L Rr ∧
      DigestLift (R.left (34 + j)) L ∧ DigestLift (R.right (34 + j)) Rr ∧
      ∀ i, i < 8 → ((R.right (34 + j)).val[i]!).val < 2147483647 :=
  ⟨_, _, app_node_children pub w j hj, hl, hr, hc⟩

/-- Rust digests computed as a block's final round lift to the model's digest. -/
theorem digest_from_rounds (rounds : Array (Array U32 16#usize) 11#usize) (B : BlockIn K)
    (hr : RoundsOk rounds B) (d : Array U32 8#usize)
    (hd : ∀ i, i < 8 → d.val[i]! = (rounds.val[10]!).val[i]!) : DigestLift d (blockDigest B) := by
  intro i
  rw [hd i.val i.isLt]
  exact hr 10 (i.castAdd 8) (by norm_num)

#print axioms builder_blocks_model
#print axioms spre_chain
#print axioms spre_init
#print axioms owner_sabs
#print axioms owner_spre
#print axioms nul_sabs0
#print axioms nul_sabs1
#print axioms nul_spre0
#print axioms nul_spre1
#print axioms tree_node_premise
#print axioms app_node_premise
#print axioms outpair_children
#print axioms digest_from_rounds
end R0Z.WriterRefine
R0Z.NoteSpongeModel:
import R0Z.SpongeModel

/-! The extracted sponge writer on the note input (owner ‖ value ‖ asset ‖ salt,
note_input pair_trace.rs:227-234, domain 0x41530003, 18 words) produces
exactly the model's note blocks noteB0/noteB1/noteB2 (blocks 1..3, 27..29,
30..32 of buildModel), relative to RoundsOk for each permutation. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace R0Z.WriterRefine
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open R0Z.BuilderModel

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

/-- The note sponge's model blocks. -/
def noteBlocks (o : R0P.Digest K) (v a : K) (s : R0P.Digest K) : Nat → BlockIn K :=
  fun q => if q = 0 then noteB0 o else if q = 1 then noteB1 o v a s else noteB2 o v a s

/-- The 18 note words lift to (owner, value, asset, salt). -/
structure NoteInputLift (input : Array U32 24#usize) (o : R0P.Digest K) (v a : K) (s : R0P.Digest K) : Prop where
  owner : ∀ i : Fin 8, liftU (K := K) (input.val[i.val]!) = o i
  value : liftU (K := K) (input.val[8]!) = v
  asset : liftU (K := K) (input.val[9]!) = a
  salt : ∀ i : Fin 8, liftU (K := K) (input.val[10 + i.val]!) = s i

theorem note_sponge_model (domain : U32) (hd : domain.val = 0x41530003) (input : Array U32 24#usize)
    (len : Usize) (hl : len.val = 18) (rounds : Array (Array (Array U32 16#usize) 11#usize) 3#usize)
    (o : R0P.Digest K) (v a : K) (s : R0P.Digest K) (hin : NoteInputLift input o v a s)
    (hr : ∀ q, q < 3 → RoundsOk (rounds.val[q]!) (noteBlocks o v a s q)) :
    ∃ out, R0BlockCopies.write_sponge domain input len rounds = ok out ∧
      ∀ q, q < 3 → ∀ (l c : Fin 16),
        liftU (K := K) (out.val[q * 256 + (l.val * 16 + c.val)]!) = blockCell (noteBlocks o v a s q) l.val c := by
  have hperm : (len.val + 7) / 8 = 3 := by rw [hl]
  have hS : SpongeLifts input len.val rounds (noteBlocks o v a s) := by
    refine ⟨fun q hq i => ?_, fun q hq => ?_, fun q hq => hr q (by omega)⟩
    · rw [hperm] at hq
      have hi := i.isLt
      rw [hl]
      have c0 : clenOf 18 0 = 8 := by decide
      have c1 : clenOf 18 1 = 8 := by decide
      have c2 : clenOf 18 2 = 2 := by decide
      interval_cases q
      · show lo8 o i = _
        unfold lo8
        rw [c0, show 8 * 0 + i.val = i.val by omega]
        by_cases h8 : i.val < 8
        · rw [dif_pos h8, if_pos ⟨h8, h8⟩]; exact (hin.owner ⟨i.val, h8⟩).symm
        · rw [dif_neg h8, if_neg (fun h => h8 h.1)]
      · show noteC2 v a s i = _
        unfold noteC2
        rw [c1]
        by_cases e0 : i.val = 0
        · rw [if_pos e0, if_pos ⟨by omega, by omega⟩, e0]; exact hin.value.symm
        rw [if_neg e0]
        by_cases e1 : i.val = 1
        · rw [if_pos e1, if_pos ⟨by omega, by omega⟩, e1]; exact hin.asset.symm
        rw [if_neg e1]
        by_cases h8 : i.val < 8
        · rw [dif_pos h8, if_pos ⟨h8, by omega⟩, show 8 * 1 + i.val = 10 + (i.val - 2) by omega]
          exact (hin.salt ⟨i.val - 2, by omega⟩).symm
        · rw [dif_neg h8, if_neg (fun h => h8 h.1)]
      · show noteC3 s i = _
        unfold noteC3
        rw [c2]
        by_cases e0 : i.val = 0
        · rw [if_pos e0, if_pos ⟨by omega, by omega⟩, e0]; exact (hin.salt 6).symm
        rw [if_neg e0]
        by_cases e1 : i.val = 1
        · rw [if_pos e1, if_pos ⟨by omega, by omega⟩, e1]; exact (hin.salt 7).symm
        rw [if_neg e1, if_neg (by omega)]
    · rw [hperm] at hq
      have hq2 : q < 2 := by omega
      interval_cases q <;> rfl
  obtain ⟨out, ho, hcells, _⟩ := sponge_model domain input len (by omega) rounds (noteBlocks o v a s) hS
    (fun i => by
      show spongeInit 0x4153_0003 18 i = _
      unfold spongeInit liftU
      rw [hd, hl]
      by_cases e8 : i.val = 8
      · rw [if_pos e8, if_pos e8]; norm_num
      · rw [if_neg e8, if_neg e8]
        by_cases e9 : i.val = 9
        · rw [if_pos e9, if_pos e9]; norm_num
        · rw [if_neg e9, if_neg e9])
  exact ⟨out, ho, fun q hq => hcells q (by omega)⟩

#print axioms note_sponge_model
end R0Z.WriterRefine
R0Z.SpongeModel:
import R0Z.SpongeRefine

/-! The extracted sponge writer equals the model's sponge blocks
(DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL §10), relative to the Poseidon plug-in RoundsOk. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace R0Z.WriterRefine
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

theorem usub (x y : Usize) (h : y.val ≤ x.val) : (Usize.wrapping_sub x y).val = x.val - y.val := by
  rw [Usize.wrapping_sub_val_eq]
  have hx := x.hSize
  have hs := usize_size_ge
  rw [show x.val + (UScalar.size .Usize - y.val) = (x.val - y.val) + UScalar.size .Usize by omega,
    Nat.add_mod_right]
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

/-- The number of words the sponge absorbs in permutation q. -/
def clenOf (len q : Nat) : Nat := if len - 8 * q < 8 then len - 8 * q else 8

/-- The sponge's model premises: chunk absorptions, chaining, and rounds. -/
structure SpongeLifts (input : Array U32 24#usize) (len : Nat)
    (rounds : Array (Array (Array U32 16#usize) 11#usize) 3#usize)
    (B : Nat → R0Z.BuilderModel.BlockIn K) : Prop where
  absorb : ∀ q, q < (len + 7) / 8 → ∀ i : Fin 16, (B q).absorb i =
    (if i.val < 8 ∧ i.val < clenOf len q then liftU (K := K) (input.val[8 * q + i.val]!) else 0)
  chain : ∀ q, q + 1 < (len + 7) / 8 → (B (q + 1)).pre = R0Z.BuilderModel.blockOut (B q)
  rounds : ∀ q, q < (len + 7) / 8 → RoundsOk (rounds.val[q]!) (B q)

theorem sponge_loop_model (input : Array U32 24#usize) (len : Usize) (hlen : 1 ≤ len.val ∧ len.val ≤ 24)
    (rounds : Array (Array (Array U32 16#usize) 11#usize) 3#usize) (perms : Usize)
    (hperms : perms.val = (len.val + 7) / 8) (B : Nat → R0Z.BuilderModel.BlockIn K)
    (hS : SpongeLifts input len.val rounds B) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (p : Usize) (out : Array U32 768#usize) (state : Array U32 16#usize),
      p.val + n = perms.val →
      (p.val < perms.val → ∀ i : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) (state.val[i.val]!) = (B p.val).pre i) →
      ∃ out', R0BlockCopies.write_sponge_loop input len rounds out state perms p = ok out' ∧
        (∀ q, p.val ≤ q → q < perms.val → ∀ (l c : Fin 16),
          liftU (K := K) (out'.val[q * 256 + (l.val * 16 + c.val)]!) = R0Z.BuilderModel.blockCell (B q) l.val c) ∧
        (∀ k, ¬ (p.val * 256 ≤ k ∧ k < perms.val * 256) → out'.val[k]! = out.val[k]!)
  | 0, p, out, state, h, _ => by
      refine ⟨out, ?_, fun q h1 h2 => by omega, fun k _ => rfl⟩
      rw [R0BlockCopies.write_sponge_loop, if_neg (by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; omega)]
  | n + 1, p, out, state, h, hst => by
      have hpp : p.val < perms.val := by omega
      have hp3 : p.val < 3 := by omega
      have hlt : p < perms := by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; exact hpp
      have h8p : (Usize.wrapping_mul 8#usize p).val = 8 * p.val := by rw [umul _ _ (by simp; omega)]; simp
      have h8lt : 8 * p.val < len.val := by omega
      have hsub : (Usize.wrapping_sub len (Usize.wrapping_mul 8#usize p)).val = len.val - 8 * p.val := by
        rw [usub _ _ (by rw [h8p]; omega), h8p]
      have hp1 : (Usize.wrapping_add p 1#usize).val = p.val + 1 := uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac)
      obtain ⟨chunk, hch, hchs⟩ := sponge_chunk_spec input p hp3
      -- the clen value and the rest of the step, for either branch
      have step : ∀ clen : Usize, clen.val = clenOf len.val p.val →
          ∃ out', (do
            let a ← Array.index_usize rounds p
            let block ← R0BlockCopies.write_sponge_block state chunk clen a
            let out1 ← R0BlockCopies.place_block out p block
            let state1 ← Array.index_usize a 10#usize
            let p1 ← lift (Usize.wrapping_add p 1#usize)
            R0BlockCopies.write_sponge_loop input len rounds out1 state1 perms p1) = ok out' ∧
          (∀ q, p.val ≤ q → q < perms.val → ∀ (l c : Fin 16),
            liftU (K := K) (out'.val[q * 256 + (l.val * 16 + c.val)]!) = R0Z.BuilderModel.blockCell (B q) l.val c) ∧
          (∀ k, ¬ (p.val * 256 ≤ k ∧ k < perms.val * 256) → out'.val[k]! = out.val[k]!) := by
        intro clen hclen
        obtain ⟨ab, hab, habs⟩ := sponge_absorb_spec chunk clen
        have he : EndsLift state ab (B p.val) := by
          refine ⟨hst hpp, fun i => ?_⟩
          rw [hS.absorb p.val (by omega) i, habs, hclen]
          by_cases c : i.val < 8 ∧ i.val < clenOf len.val p.val
          · rw [if_pos c, if_pos c, hchs i.val c.1]
          · rw [if_neg c, if_neg c]; unfold liftU; simp
        have hrp : p.val < (3#usize).val := by simp; omega
        obtain ⟨blk, hblk, hbs⟩ := block_model state ab (rounds.val[p.val]!) (B p.val) he
          (hS.rounds p.val (by omega))
        obtain ⟨o1, ho1, ho1s⟩ := place_loop_spec p hp3 blk 256 0#usize out (by simp)
        have h10 : (10#usize : Usize).val < (11#usize).val := by simp
        have hst' : p.val + 1 < perms.val → ∀ i : Fin 16,
            liftU (K := K) (((rounds.val[p.val]!).val[(10#usize : Usize).val]!).val[i.val]!) =
              (B (p.val + 1)).pre i := by
          intro hq i
          rw [hS.chain p.val (by omega), show (10#usize : Usize).val = 10 by simp]
          exact hS.rounds p.val (by omega) 10 i (by norm_num)

theorem sponge_model (domain : U32) (input : Array U32 24#usize) (len : Usize)

      rw [show (0#usize : Usize).val = 0 by simp, h0 i, hsts]
      unfold liftU
      by_cases e8 : i.val = 8
      · rw [if_pos e8, if_pos e8]
      · rw [if_neg e8, if_neg e8]

        · rw [if_neg e9, if_neg e9]; simp)
