          (r'.val[k]!).val = (right.val[k]!).val := by
  obtain ⟨pre, hp, hps⟩ := node_pre_spec right hc
  obtain ⟨ab, ha, has⟩ := node_absorb_spec left
  have h15 : (pre.val[15]!).val < 2147483647 := by
    rw [hps]; have := hc 7 (by norm_num); split_ifs <;> omega
  obtain ⟨c', l', r', hok, hs⟩ := read_back_loop_spec prev pre ab h15 8 0#usize
    (Array.repeat 8#usize 0#u32) (Array.repeat 8#usize 0#u32) (Array.repeat 8#usize 0#u32) (by simp)
  refine ⟨pre, ab, hp, ha, c', l', r', by rw [R0BlockCopies.read_back]; exact hok, fun k hk => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hs k
  rw [show (0#usize : Usize).val = 0 by simp] at h1 h2 h3
  have hk' : 0 ≤ k ∧ k < 8 := ⟨Nat.zero_le _, hk⟩
  refine ⟨by rw [h1, if_pos hk'], by rw [h2, if_pos hk', has, if_pos hk], ?_⟩
  rw [h3, if_pos hk']
  by_cases e : k = 7
  · rw [if_pos e, e, hps 15, if_neg (show ¬ (15 < 8) by norm_num), if_pos rfl]
    have hr7 := hc 7 (by norm_num)
    generalize (right.val[7]!).val = x at hr7 ⊢
    split_ifs <;> omega
  · rw [if_neg e, hps, if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_pos (by omega),
      show 8 + k - 8 = k by omega]

#print axioms read_back_loop_spec
#print axioms read_back_node
end R0Z.WriterRefine
R0Z.NodeRefine:
import R0Z.BlockRefine

/-! Node writer, sponge pieces and the relocation read-back (DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL §10),
with wide M31 add/sub lemmas (canonical inputs below p, closing B3). -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace R0Z.WriterRefine
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

/-! ### Wide M31 lemmas (inputs < p = 2^31 - 1) -/

theorem u32_add_small (a b : U32) (h : a.val + b.val < 2 ^ 32) : (U32.wrapping_add a b).val = a.val + b.val := by
  rw [U32.wrapping_add_val_eq]; exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by rw [UScalar.size_def]; simpa using h)

theorem u32_sub_small (a b : U32) (h : b.val ≤ a.val) : (U32.wrapping_sub a b).val = a.val - b.val := by
  rw [U32.wrapping_sub_val_eq, UScalar.size_def]
  simp only [show UScalarTy.U32.numBits = 32 from rfl]
  have ha := a.hBounds
  rw [show a.val + (2 ^ 32 - b.val) = (a.val - b.val) + 2 ^ 32 by
    simp only [show UScalarTy.U32.numBits = 32 from rfl] at ha; omega, Nat.add_mod_right]
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by simp only [show UScalarTy.U32.numBits = 32 from rfl] at ha; omega)

theorem pval : (R0BlockCopies.P : U32).val = 2147483647 := by rw [R0BlockCopies.P]; simp
theorem tval : (R0BlockCopies.TWEAK : U32).val = 1095962629 := by rw [R0BlockCopies.TWEAK]; simp

theorem m31_add_spec (a b : U32) (ha : a.val < 2147483647) (hb : b.val < 2147483647) :
    ∃ z, R0BlockCopies.m31_add a b = ok z ∧
      z.val = (if 2147483647 ≤ a.val + b.val then a.val + b.val - 2147483647 else a.val + b.val) := by
  have h1 := u32_add_small a b (by omega)
  rw [R0BlockCopies.m31_add]
  simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok]
  by_cases hs : U32.wrapping_add a b >= R0BlockCopies.P
  · rw [if_pos hs]
    have hs' : 2147483647 ≤ a.val + b.val := by rw [ge_iff_le, UScalar.le_equiv, pval, h1] at hs; exact hs
    exact ⟨_, rfl, by rw [u32_sub_small _ _ (by rw [pval, h1]; exact hs'), h1, pval, if_pos hs']⟩
  · rw [if_neg hs]
    have hs' : ¬ 2147483647 ≤ a.val + b.val := by rw [ge_iff_le, UScalar.le_equiv, pval, h1] at hs; exact hs
    exact ⟨_, rfl, by rw [h1, if_neg hs']⟩

theorem m31_sub_spec_wide (a b : U32) (ha : a.val < 2147483647) (hb : b.val < 2147483647) :
    ∃ z, R0BlockCopies.m31_sub a b = ok z ∧
      z.val = (if b.val ≤ a.val then a.val - b.val else a.val + 2147483647 - b.val) := by
  have h1 := u32_add_small a R0BlockCopies.P (by rw [pval]; omega)
  rw [pval] at h1
  have h2 : (U32.wrapping_sub (U32.wrapping_add a R0BlockCopies.P) b).val = a.val + 2147483647 - b.val :=
    by rw [u32_sub_small _ _ (by rw [h1]; omega), h1]
  rw [R0BlockCopies.m31_sub]
  simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok]
  by_cases hs : U32.wrapping_sub (U32.wrapping_add a R0BlockCopies.P) b >= R0BlockCopies.P
  · rw [if_pos hs]
    have hs' : 2147483647 ≤ a.val + 2147483647 - b.val := by
      rw [ge_iff_le, UScalar.le_equiv, pval, h2] at hs; exact hs
    exact ⟨_, rfl, by rw [u32_sub_small _ _ (by rw [pval, h2]; exact hs'), h2, pval, if_pos (by omega)]; omega⟩
  · rw [if_neg hs]
    have hs' : ¬ 2147483647 ≤ a.val + 2147483647 - b.val := by
      rw [ge_iff_le, UScalar.le_equiv, pval, h2] at hs; exact hs
    exact ⟨_, rfl, by rw [h2, if_neg (by omega)]⟩

/-- B3 (a): the large-tweak read-back of the earlier copy, R0WriterCopies.node_right_lane7. -/
theorem node_right_lane7_spec (x : U32) (hx : x.val < 2147483647) :
    ∃ z, R0WriterCopies.node_right_lane7 x = ok z ∧
      z.val = (if 1095962629 ≤ x.val then x.val - 1095962629 else x.val + 2147483647 - 1095962629) := by
  have pv : (R0WriterCopies.P : U32).val = 2147483647 := by rw [R0WriterCopies.P]; simp
  have tv : (R0WriterCopies.TWEAK : U32).val = 1095962629 := by rw [R0WriterCopies.TWEAK]; simp
  have h1 := u32_add_small x R0WriterCopies.P (by rw [pv]; omega)
  rw [pv] at h1
  have h2 : (U32.wrapping_sub (U32.wrapping_add x R0WriterCopies.P) R0WriterCopies.TWEAK).val =
      x.val + 2147483647 - 1095962629 := by rw [u32_sub_small _ _ (by rw [h1, tv]; omega), h1, tv]
  rw [R0WriterCopies.node_right_lane7, R0WriterCopies.m31_sub]
  simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok]
  by_cases hs : U32.wrapping_sub (U32.wrapping_add x R0WriterCopies.P) R0WriterCopies.TWEAK >= R0WriterCopies.P
  · rw [if_pos hs]
    have hs' : 2147483647 ≤ x.val + 2147483647 - 1095962629 := by
      rw [ge_iff_le, UScalar.le_equiv, pv, h2] at hs; exact hs
    exact ⟨_, rfl, by rw [u32_sub_small _ _ (by rw [pv, h2]; exact hs'), h2, pv, if_pos (by omega)]; omega⟩
  · rw [if_neg hs]
    have hs' : ¬ 2147483647 ≤ x.val + 2147483647 - 1095962629 := by
      rw [ge_iff_le, UScalar.le_equiv, pv, h2] at hs; exact hs
    exact ⟨_, rfl, by rw [h2, if_neg (by omega)]⟩

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

theorem lift_m31_add [CharP K 0x7fffffff] (a b : Nat) :
    (((if 2147483647 ≤ a + b then a + b - 2147483647 else a + b : Nat)) : K) = (a : K) + (b : K) := by
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [Nat.cast_sub h, CharP.cast_eq_zero K 0x7fffffff, sub_zero, Nat.cast_add]
  · rw [Nat.cast_add]

theorem lift_m31_sub [CharP K 0x7fffffff] (a b : Nat) (hb : b < 2147483647) :
    (((if b ≤ a then a - b else a + 2147483647 - b : Nat)) : K) = (a : K) - (b : K) := by
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [Nat.cast_sub h]
  · rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega), Nat.cast_add, CharP.cast_eq_zero K 0x7fffffff]; ring

/-- B3 (a), lifted: the read-back lane is the pre-state lane minus the tweak. -/
theorem node_right_lane7_lift [CharP K 0x7fffffff] (x : U32) (hx : x.val < 2147483647) :
    ∃ z, R0WriterCopies.node_right_lane7 x = ok z ∧
      liftU (K := K) z = liftU x - (0x4153_1005 : K) := by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hv⟩ := node_right_lane7_spec x hx
  refine ⟨z, hz, ?_⟩
  unfold liftU
  rw [hv, lift_m31_sub _ _ (by norm_num)]
  norm_num

/-- add then subtract the tweak is the identity on canonical values. -/
theorem add_sub_tweak (r : Nat) (hr : r < 2147483647) :
    (let s := (if 2147483647 ≤ r + 1095962629 then r + 1095962629 - 2147483647 else r + 1095962629)
     if 1095962629 ≤ s then s - 1095962629 else s + 2147483647 - 1095962629) = r := by
  simp only []
  split_ifs <;> omega

/-! ### node_pre / node_absorb -/

theorem node_pre_loop_spec (right : Array U32 8#usize) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (lane : Usize) (pre : Array U32 16#usize), lane.val + n = 8 →
      ∃ p', R0BlockCopies.node_pre_loop right pre lane = ok p' ∧
        ∀ k, p'.val[k]! = if 8 + lane.val ≤ k ∧ k < 16 then right.val[k - 8]! else pre.val[k]!
  | 0, lane, pre, h => by
      refine ⟨pre, ?_, fun k => by rw [if_neg (by omega)]⟩
      rw [R0BlockCopies.node_pre_loop, if_neg (by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac)]
  | n + 1, lane, pre, h => by
      have hlt : lane < 8#usize := by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac
      have hb : lane.val < (8#usize).val := by simp; omega
      have h8 : (Usize.wrapping_add 8#usize lane).val = 8 + lane.val := by rw [uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac)]; simp
      have hb8 : (Usize.wrapping_add 8#usize lane).val < (16#usize).val := by rw [h8]; simp; omega
      have hl1 : (Usize.wrapping_add lane 1#usize).val = lane.val + 1 := uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac)
      obtain ⟨p', hp', hs⟩ := node_pre_loop_spec right n (Usize.wrapping_add lane 1#usize)
        (pre.set (Usize.wrapping_add 8#usize lane) (right.val[lane.val]!)) (by rw [hl1]; omega)
      refine ⟨p', ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
      · rw [R0BlockCopies.node_pre_loop, if_pos hlt, index_ok right lane hb]
        simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
        rw [update_ok pre _ _ hb8]
        simp only [bind_tc_ok]
        exact hp'
      · have g := set_get' pre (Usize.wrapping_add 8#usize lane) (right.val[lane.val]!) hb8 k
        rw [h8] at g
        rw [hs k, hl1, g]
        split_ifs <;> first | rfl | omega | (rw [show k - 8 = lane.val by omega])

theorem rep16 (k : Nat) : (((Array.repeat 16#usize 0#u32 : Array U32 16#usize).val[k]! : U32)) = 0#u32 := by
  rw [Array.repeat_val]
  by_cases hk : k < (16#usize : Usize).val
  · rw [List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_replicate, if_pos hk]; rfl
  · rw [List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_replicate, if_neg hk]; rfl

theorem node_pre_spec (right : Array U32 8#usize) (hr : ∀ i, i < 8 → (right.val[i]!).val < 2147483647) :
    ∃ pre, R0BlockCopies.node_pre right = ok pre ∧
      ∀ k, (pre.val[k]!).val = if k < 8 then 0 else if k = 15 then
        (if 2147483647 ≤ (right.val[7]!).val + 1095962629 then (right.val[7]!).val + 1095962629 - 2147483647
         else (right.val[7]!).val + 1095962629)
        else if k < 16 then (right.val[k - 8]!).val else 0 := by
  obtain ⟨p1, hp1, hs1⟩ := node_pre_loop_spec right 8 0#usize (Array.repeat 16#usize 0#u32) (by simp)
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzv⟩ := m31_add_spec (right.val[7]!) R0BlockCopies.TWEAK (hr 7 (by norm_num))
    (by rw [tval]; norm_num)
  rw [tval] at hzv
  have h15 : (15#usize : Usize).val < (16#usize).val := by simp
  refine ⟨p1.set 15#usize z, ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
  · rw [R0BlockCopies.node_pre, hp1]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [index_ok right 7#usize (by simp)]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [show (7#usize : Usize).val = 7 by simp, hz]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [update_ok p1 _ _ h15]
  · rw [set_get' p1 15#usize z h15 k, hs1 k, rep16, show (15#usize : Usize).val = 15 by simp]
    simp only [show (0#usize : Usize).val = 0 by simp, Nat.add_zero]
    have z0 : (0#u32 : U32).val = 0 := by simp
    by_cases e15 : k = 15
    · rw [if_pos e15, if_neg (by omega), if_pos e15, hzv]
    rw [if_neg e15]
    by_cases a : k < 8
    · rw [if_neg (show ¬ (8 ≤ k ∧ k < 16) by omega), if_pos a, z0]
    rw [if_neg a, if_neg e15]
    by_cases b : k < 16
    · rw [if_pos (show 8 ≤ k ∧ k < 16 by omega), if_pos b]
    · rw [if_neg (show ¬ (8 ≤ k ∧ k < 16) by omega), if_neg b, z0]

theorem node_absorb_loop_spec (left : Array U32 8#usize) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (lane : Usize) (ab : Array U32 16#usize), lane.val + n = 8 →
      ∃ a', R0BlockCopies.node_absorb_loop left ab lane = ok a' ∧
        ∀ k, a'.val[k]! = if lane.val ≤ k ∧ k < 8 then left.val[k]! else ab.val[k]!
  | 0, lane, ab, h => by
      refine ⟨ab, ?_, fun k => by rw [if_neg (by omega)]⟩
      rw [R0BlockCopies.node_absorb_loop, if_neg (by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac)]
  | n + 1, lane, ab, h => by
      have hlt : lane < 8#usize := by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac
      have hb : lane.val < (8#usize).val := by simp; omega
      have hb16 : lane.val < (16#usize).val := by simp; omega
      have hl1 : (Usize.wrapping_add lane 1#usize).val = lane.val + 1 := uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac)
      obtain ⟨a', ha', hs⟩ := node_absorb_loop_spec left n (Usize.wrapping_add lane 1#usize)
        (ab.set lane (left.val[lane.val]!)) (by rw [hl1]; omega)
      refine ⟨a', ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
      · rw [R0BlockCopies.node_absorb_loop, if_pos hlt, index_ok left lane hb]
        simp only [bind_tc_ok]
        rw [update_ok ab _ _ hb16]
        simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
        exact ha'
      · rw [hs k, hl1, set_get' ab lane _ hb16 k]
        split_ifs <;> first | rfl | omega | (subst_vars; rfl)

theorem node_absorb_spec (left : Array U32 8#usize) :
    ∃ ab, R0BlockCopies.node_absorb left = ok ab ∧
      ∀ k, ab.val[k]! = if k < 8 then left.val[k]! else 0#u32 := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hs⟩ := node_absorb_loop_spec left 8 0#usize (Array.repeat 16#usize 0#u32) (by simp)
  refine ⟨a, by rw [R0BlockCopies.node_absorb]; exact ha, fun k => ?_⟩
  rw [hs k, rep16]
  simp only [show (0#usize : Usize).val = 0 by simp, Nat.zero_le, true_and]

/-! ### The node block against the model -/

/-- The Rust digests lift to the model's children. -/
def DigestLift (d : Array U32 8#usize) (D : R0P.Digest K) : Prop :=
  ∀ i : Fin 8, liftU (K := K) (d.val[i.val]!) = D i

theorem node_ends_lift [CharP K 0x7fffffff] (left right : Array U32 8#usize) (L R : R0P.Digest K)
    (hl : DigestLift left L) (hr : DigestLift right R)
    (hc : ∀ i, i < 8 → (right.val[i]!).val < 2147483647) :
    ∃ pre ab, R0BlockCopies.node_pre right = ok pre ∧ R0BlockCopies.node_absorb left = ok ab ∧
      EndsLift pre ab (R0Z.BuilderModel.nodeIn L R) := by
  obtain ⟨pre, hp, hps⟩ := node_pre_spec right hc
  obtain ⟨ab, ha, has⟩ := node_absorb_spec left
  refine ⟨pre, ab, hp, ha, ⟨fun i => ?_, fun i => ?_⟩⟩
  · have hi := i.isLt
    show liftU (pre.val[i.val]!) = (if i.val < 8 then 0 else if i.val = 15 then R 7 + (0x4153_1005 : K)
      else R ⟨i.val - 8, by omega⟩)
    unfold liftU
    rw [hps]
    by_cases a : i.val < 8
    · rw [if_pos a, if_pos a]; simp
    rw [if_neg a, if_neg a]
    by_cases b : i.val = 15
    · rw [if_pos b, if_pos b, lift_m31_add, ← hr 7]
      unfold liftU; norm_num
    rw [if_neg b, if_neg b, if_pos hi]
    exact hr ⟨i.val - 8, by omega⟩
  · show liftU (ab.val[i.val]!) = R0Z.BuilderModel.lo8 L i
    unfold R0Z.BuilderModel.lo8
    rw [has]
    by_cases a : i.val < 8
    · rw [if_pos a, dif_pos a]; exact hl ⟨i.val, a⟩
    · rw [if_neg a, dif_neg a]; unfold liftU; simp

/-- The extracted node writer equals the model's node block, every cell,
relative to the Poseidon plug-in `RoundsOk`. -/
theorem node_model [CharP K 0x7fffffff] (left right : Array U32 8#usize)
    (rounds : Array (Array U32 16#usize) 11#usize) (L R : R0P.Digest K)
    (hl : DigestLift left L) (hr : DigestLift right R)
    (hc : ∀ i, i < 8 → (right.val[i]!).val < 2147483647)
    (hround : RoundsOk rounds (R0Z.BuilderModel.nodeIn L R)) :
    ∃ b, R0BlockCopies.write_node left right rounds = ok b ∧
      ∀ (l c : Fin 16), liftU (K := K) (b.val[l.val * 16 + c.val]!) =
        R0Z.BuilderModel.blockCell (R0Z.BuilderModel.nodeIn L R) l.val c := by
  obtain ⟨pre, ab, hp, ha, he⟩ := node_ends_lift left right L R hl hr hc
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hs⟩ := block_model pre ab rounds _ he hround
  refine ⟨b, ?_, hs⟩
  rw [R0BlockCopies.write_node, hp]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [ha]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  exact hb

#print axioms m31_add_spec
#print axioms m31_sub_spec_wide
#print axioms node_right_lane7_spec
#print axioms node_right_lane7_lift
#print axioms add_sub_tweak
#print axioms node_pre_spec
#print axioms node_absorb_spec
#print axioms node_ends_lift
#print axioms node_model
end R0Z.WriterRefine
R0Z.BlockRefine:
import R0Z.BlockWritersExtracted
import R0Z.WriterRefinePathBlock

/-! The extracted generic block writer (copy of write_permutation's cell
layout, pair_trace.rs:268-302; DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL §10), with the
permutation abstract: `rounds` are its eleven odd-round outputs.
`block_model`: if `rounds` lift to the model block's rows 1..11
(`RoundsOk`, the plug-in point for the Poseidon refinement), the written
block lifts to `blockCell` of the model block, every cell. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace R0Z.WriterRefine
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0BlockCopies

theorem ends_loop (pre absorb : Array U32 16#usize) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (lane : Usize) (block : Array U32 256#usize), lane.val + n = 16 →
      ∃ b', write_block_ends_loop pre absorb block lane = ok b' ∧
        ∀ k, b'.val[k]! = if lane.val ≤ k ∧ k < 16 then pre.val[k]!
          else if 192 + lane.val ≤ k ∧ k < 208 then absorb.val[k - 192]! else block.val[k]!
  | 0, lane, block, h => by
      refine ⟨block, ?_, fun k => by rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega)]⟩
      rw [write_block_ends_loop, if_neg (by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac)]
  | n + 1, lane, block, h => by
      have hlt : lane < 16#usize := by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac
      have hb : lane.val < (16#usize).val := by simp; omega
      have h192 : (Usize.wrapping_add 192#usize lane).val = 192 + lane.val := by
        rw [uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac)]; simp
      have hl1 : (Usize.wrapping_add lane 1#usize).val = lane.val + 1 := uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac)
      have hb1 : lane.val < (256#usize).val := by simp; omega
      have hb2 : (Usize.wrapping_add 192#usize lane).val < (256#usize).val := by rw [h192]; simp; omega
      let b1 := block.set lane (pre.val[lane.val]!)
      obtain ⟨b', hb', hs⟩ := ends_loop pre absorb n (Usize.wrapping_add lane 1#usize)
        (b1.set (Usize.wrapping_add 192#usize lane) (absorb.val[lane.val]!)) (by rw [hl1]; omega)
      refine ⟨b', ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
      · rw [write_block_ends_loop, if_pos hlt, index_ok pre lane hb]
        simp only [bind_tc_ok]
        rw [update_ok block lane _ hb1]
        simp only [bind_tc_ok]
        rw [index_ok absorb lane hb]
        simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
        rw [update_ok b1 _ _ hb2]
        simp only [bind_tc_ok]
        exact hb'
      · have g2 := set_get' b1 (Usize.wrapping_add 192#usize lane) (absorb.val[lane.val]!) hb2 k
        have g1 := set_get' block lane (pre.val[lane.val]!) hb1 k
        rw [h192] at g2
        rw [hs k, hl1, g2]
        show _ = _
        rw [show b1.val[k]! = (block.set lane (pre.val[lane.val]!)).val[k]! from rfl, g1]

/-! The extracted 24-level path-aux writer computes the model's path rows
912..1007 cell by cell (DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL §9). -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace R0Z.WriterRefine
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0WriterCopies

theorem index_ok_gen {α : Type} [Inhabited α] {n : Usize} (v : Array α n) (i : Usize) (h : i.val < n.val) :
    Array.index_usize v i = ok (v.val[i.val]!) := by
  unfold Array.index_usize
  have hl : i.val < v.val.length := by rw [v.property]; exact h
  rw [Array.getElem?_Usize_eq, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hl, List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD,
    List.getElem?_eq_getElem hl]
  rfl

/-- First flat cell of level l's window (its base row). -/
def pbase (l : Nat) : Nat := (16 * (l / 4) + 1 + 4 * (l % 4)) * 16

/-- The level whose window contains flat cell k. -/
def lvl (k : Nat) : Nat := 4 * (k / 256) + (k / 16 % 16) / 4

/-- k lies in some level's two-row window. -/
def InWin (k : Nat) : Prop := (k / 16 % 16 % 4 = 1 ∨ k / 16 % 16 % 4 = 2) ∧ k < 1536

instance (k : Nat) : Decidable (InWin k) := by unfold InWin; infer_instance

theorem win_iff (l k : Nat) (hl : l < 24) :
    (pbase l ≤ k ∧ k < pbase l + 32) ↔ (InWin k ∧ lvl k = l) := by
  unfold pbase InWin lvl
  constructor
  · intro h; omega
  · intro h; omega

/-- The cell a level writes (path_level's formula). -/
def PV (bit : U32) (cur l r : Array U32 8#usize) (lev : Nat) (dflt : U32) (k : Nat) : U32 :=
  if k = pbase lev then bit
  else if pbase lev + 1 ≤ k ∧ k < pbase lev + 9 then cur.val[k - pbase lev - 1]!
  else if pbase lev + 16 ≤ k ∧ k < pbase lev + 24 then l.val[k - pbase lev - 16]!
  else if pbase lev + 24 ≤ k ∧ k < pbase lev + 32 then r.val[k - pbase lev - 24]!
  else dflt

theorem PV_out (bit : U32) (cur l r : Array U32 8#usize) (lev : Nat) (dflt : U32) (k : Nat)
    (hk : ¬ (pbase lev ≤ k ∧ k < pbase lev + 32)) : PV bit cur l r lev dflt k = dflt := by
  unfold PV
  rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega)]

theorem path_block_loop (bits : Array U32 24#usize) (cur l r : Array (Array U32 8#usize) 24#usize) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (lev : Usize) (buf : Array U32 1536#usize), lev.val + n = 24 →
      ∃ b', write_path_block_loop bits cur l r buf lev = ok b' ∧
        ∀ k, b'.val[k]! = if InWin k ∧ lev.val ≤ lvl k ∧ lvl k < 24 then
          PV (bits.val[lvl k]!) (cur.val[lvl k]!) (l.val[lvl k]!) (r.val[lvl k]!) (lvl k) (buf.val[k]!) k
          else buf.val[k]!
  | 0, lev, buf, h => by
      refine ⟨buf, ?_, fun k => by rw [if_neg (by omega)]⟩
      rw [write_path_block_loop, if_neg (by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac)]
  | n + 1, lev, buf, h => by
      have hlt : lev < 24#usize := by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac
      have hl24 : lev.val < 24 := by omega
      have hb : lev.val < (24#usize).val := by simpa using hl24
      have hl1 : (Usize.wrapping_add lev 1#usize).val = lev.val + 1 := uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac)
      obtain ⟨b1, hb1, hs1⟩ := path_level buf lev hl24 (bits.val[lev.val]!) (cur.val[lev.val]!)
        (l.val[lev.val]!) (r.val[lev.val]!)
      obtain ⟨b', hb', hs⟩ := path_block_loop bits cur l r n (Usize.wrapping_add lev 1#usize) b1
        (by rw [hl1]; omega)
      have hs1' : ∀ k, b1.val[k]! = PV (bits.val[lev.val]!) (cur.val[lev.val]!) (l.val[lev.val]!)
          (r.val[lev.val]!) lev.val (buf.val[k]!) k := fun k => by rw [hs1 k]; rfl
      refine ⟨b', ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
      · rw [write_path_block_loop, if_pos hlt, index_ok bits lev hb, index_ok_gen cur lev hb,
          index_ok_gen l lev hb, index_ok_gen r lev hb]
        simp only [bind_tc_ok]
        rw [hb1]
        simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
        exact hb'
      · rw [hs k, hl1]
        have w := win_iff lev.val k hl24
        by_cases e : InWin k ∧ lvl k = lev.val
        · rw [if_neg (by omega), if_pos ⟨e.1, by omega, by omega⟩, hs1' k, e.2]
        · have hout : ¬ (pbase lev.val ≤ k ∧ k < pbase lev.val + 32) := fun h => e (w.1 h)
          rw [hs1' k, PV_out _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hout]
          by_cases g : InWin k ∧ lev.val + 1 ≤ lvl k ∧ lvl k < 24
          · rw [if_pos g, if_pos ⟨g.1, by omega, g.2.2⟩]
          · have : ¬ (InWin k ∧ lev.val ≤ lvl k ∧ lvl k < 24) := by
              rintro ⟨a, b, c⟩
              exact g ⟨a, by
                by_contra hc
                exact e ⟨a, by omega⟩, c⟩
            rw [if_neg g, if_neg this]

#print axioms win_iff
#print axioms path_block_loop
end R0Z.WriterRefine

/-! The extracted forest path-aux writer (DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL §9):
`write_path_level` (copy of pair_forest_trace.rs:142-159) writes exactly the
base row (bit, current) and the successor row (left, right) of its level. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace R0Z.WriterRefine
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0WriterCopies

theorem set_get' {n : Usize} (v : Array U32 n) (i : Usize) (x : U32) (hi : i.val < n.val) (k : Nat) :
    (v.set i x).val[k]! = if k = i.val then x else v.val[k]! := by
  rw [Array.set_val_eq]
  exact getElem!_set_list _ _ _ _ (by rw [v.property]; exact hi)

theorem path_loop (cur l r : Array U32 8#usize) (base : Usize) (hb : base.val + 32 ≤ 1536) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (lane : Usize) (buf : Array U32 1536#usize), lane.val + n = 8 →
      ∃ b', write_path_level_loop cur l r buf base lane = ok b' ∧
        ∀ k, b'.val[k]! =
          if base.val + 1 + lane.val ≤ k ∧ k < base.val + 9 then cur.val[k - base.val - 1]!
          else if base.val + 16 + lane.val ≤ k ∧ k < base.val + 24 then l.val[k - base.val - 16]!
          else if base.val + 24 + lane.val ≤ k ∧ k < base.val + 32 then r.val[k - base.val - 24]!
          else buf.val[k]!
  | 0, lane, buf, h => by
      refine ⟨buf, ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
      · rw [write_path_level_loop]
        rw [if_neg (by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac)]
      · rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega)]
  | n + 1, lane, buf, h => by
      have hlt : lane < 8#usize := by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac
      have hl8 : lane.val < 8 := by omega
      have e1 : (Usize.wrapping_add base 1#usize).val = base.val + 1 := uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac)
      have i2 : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_add base 1#usize) lane).val =
          base.val + 1 + lane.val := by rw [uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac), e1]
      have e16 : (Usize.wrapping_add base 16#usize).val = base.val + 16 := uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac)
      have i5 : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_add base 16#usize) lane).val =
          base.val + 16 + lane.val := by rw [uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac), e16]
      have e24 : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_add base 16#usize) 8#usize).val =
          base.val + 24 := by rw [uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac), e16]; simp
      have i9 : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_add base 16#usize) 8#usize)
          lane).val = base.val + 24 + lane.val := by rw [uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac), e24]
      have hl1 : (Usize.wrapping_add lane 1#usize).val = lane.val + 1 := uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac)
      let b1 := buf.set (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_add base 1#usize) lane) (cur.val[lane.val]!)
      let b2 := b1.set (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_add base 16#usize) lane) (l.val[lane.val]!)
      let b3 := b2.set (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_add base 16#usize)
        8#usize) lane) (r.val[lane.val]!)
      obtain ⟨b', hb', hspec⟩ := path_loop cur l r base hb n (Usize.wrapping_add lane 1#usize) b3
        (by rw [hl1]; omega)
      refine ⟨b', ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
      · rw [write_path_level_loop, if_pos hlt]
        have hl8' : lane.val < (8#usize).val := by simpa using hl8
        rw [index_ok cur lane hl8']
        simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok]
        rw [update_ok buf _ _ (show _ < (1536#usize).val by rw [i2]; simpa using (by omega : base.val + 1 + lane.val < 1536))]
        simp only [bind_tc_ok]
        rw [index_ok l lane hl8']
        simp only [bind_tc_ok]
        rw [update_ok b1 _ _ (show _ < (1536#usize).val by rw [i5]; simpa using (by omega : base.val + 16 + lane.val < 1536))]
        simp only [bind_tc_ok]
        rw [index_ok r lane hl8']
        simp only [bind_tc_ok]
        rw [update_ok b2 _ _ (show _ < (1536#usize).val by rw [i9]; simpa using (by omega : base.val + 24 + lane.val < 1536))]
        simp only [bind_tc_ok]
        exact hb'
      · rw [hspec k, hl1]
        show _ = _
        have g3 := set_get' b2 _ (r.val[lane.val]!) (show _ < (1536#usize).val by
          rw [i9]; simpa using (by omega : base.val + 24 + lane.val < 1536)) k
        have g2 := set_get' b1 _ (l.val[lane.val]!) (show _ < (1536#usize).val by
          rw [i5]; simpa using (by omega : base.val + 16 + lane.val < 1536)) k
        have g1 := set_get' buf _ (cur.val[lane.val]!) (show _ < (1536#usize).val by
          rw [i2]; simpa using (by omega : base.val + 1 + lane.val < 1536)) k
        rw [i9] at g3; rw [i5] at g2; rw [i2] at g1
        show _ = (if base.val + 1 + lane.val ≤ k ∧ k < base.val + 9 then cur.val[k - base.val - 1]!
          else if base.val + 16 + lane.val ≤ k ∧ k < base.val + 24 then l.val[k - base.val - 16]!
          else if base.val + 24 + lane.val ≤ k ∧ k < base.val + 32 then r.val[k - base.val - 24]!
          else buf.val[k]!)
        by_cases c1 : k = base.val + 1 + lane.val
        · rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), g3, if_neg (by omega), g2,
            if_neg (by omega), g1, if_pos c1, if_pos (by omega)]
          congr 2; omega
        by_cases c2 : k = base.val + 16 + lane.val
        · rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), g3, if_neg (by omega), g2,
            if_pos c2, if_neg (by omega), if_pos (by omega)]
          congr 2; omega
        by_cases c3 : k = base.val + 24 + lane.val
        · rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), g3, if_pos c3,
            if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_pos (by omega)]
          congr 2; omega
        rw [g3, if_neg c3, g2, if_neg c2, g1, if_neg c1]
        by_cases d1 : base.val + 1 + (lane.val + 1) ≤ k ∧ k < base.val + 9
        · rw [if_pos d1, if_pos (by omega)]
        rw [if_neg d1]
        by_cases d2 : base.val + 16 + (lane.val + 1) ≤ k ∧ k < base.val + 24
        · rw [if_pos d2, if_neg (by omega), if_pos (by omega)]
        rw [if_neg d2]
        by_cases d3 : base.val + 24 + (lane.val + 1) ≤ k ∧ k < base.val + 32
        · rw [if_pos d3, if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_pos (by omega)]
        rw [if_neg d3, if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega)]

theorem path_base_row_val (level : Usize) (hl : level.val < 24) :
    ∃ z, path_base_local_row level = ok z ∧ z.val = 16 * (level.val / 4) + 1 + 4 * (level.val % 4) := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqv⟩ := UScalar.div_spec level (y := 4#usize) (by simp)
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hmv⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (UScalar.rem_spec level (y := 4#usize) (by simp))
  have hqv' : q.val = level.val / 4 := by rw [hqv]; simp
  have hmv' : m.val = level.val % 4 := by rw [hmv]; simp
  rw [path_base_local_row]
  rw [show level / 4#usize = ok q from hq]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
  rw [show level % 4#usize = ok m from hm]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  refine ⟨_, rfl, ?_⟩
  have a1 : (Usize.wrapping_mul 16#usize q).val = 16 * (level.val / 4) := by
    rw [umul _ _ (by simp; omega)]; simp [hqv']
  have a2 : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 16#usize q) 1#usize).val = 16 * (level.val / 4) + 1 := by
    rw [uadd _ _ (by rw [a1]; simp; omega), a1]; simp
  have a3 : (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize m).val = 4 * (level.val % 4) := by
    rw [umul _ _ (by simp; omega)]; simp [hmv']
  rw [uadd _ _ (by rw [a2, a3]; omega), a2, a3]

/-- Exact effect of write_path_level on the 1536-cell path block. -/
theorem path_level (buf : Array U32 1536#usize) (level : Usize) (hl : level.val < 24) (bit : U32)
    (cur l r : Array U32 8#usize) :
    ∃ b', write_path_level buf level bit cur l r = ok b' ∧
      ∀ k, b'.val[k]! =
        let base := (16 * (level.val / 4) + 1 + 4 * (level.val % 4)) * 16
        if k = base then bit
        else if base + 1 ≤ k ∧ k < base + 9 then cur.val[k - base - 1]!
        else if base + 16 ≤ k ∧ k < base + 24 then l.val[k - base - 16]!
        else if base + 24 ≤ k ∧ k < base + 32 then r.val[k - base - 24]!
        else buf.val[k]! := by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzv⟩ := path_base_row_val level hl
  have hb : (Usize.wrapping_mul z 16#usize).val = (16 * (level.val / 4) + 1 + 4 * (level.val % 4)) * 16 := by
    rw [umul _ _ (by rw [hzv]; simp; omega), hzv]; simp
  have hbound : (Usize.wrapping_mul z 16#usize).val + 32 ≤ 1536 := by rw [hb]; omega
  obtain ⟨b', hb', hs⟩ := path_loop cur l r (Usize.wrapping_mul z 16#usize) hbound 8 0#usize
    (buf.set (Usize.wrapping_mul z 16#usize) bit) (by simp)
  refine ⟨b', ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
  · rw [write_path_level, hz]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
    rw [update_ok buf _ _ (show _ < (1536#usize).val by rw [hb]; simp; omega)]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    exact hb'
  · rw [hs k, set_get' _ _ _ (show _ < (1536#usize).val by rw [hb]; simp; omega) k, hb]
    simp only [show (0#usize : Usize).val = 0 by simp, Nat.add_zero]
    by_cases e : k = (16 * (level.val / 4) + 1 + 4 * (level.val % 4)) * 16
    · rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_pos e, if_pos e]
    · simp only [show (k = (16 * (level.val / 4) + 1 + 4 * (level.val % 4)) * 16) = False from
        propext ⟨e, False.elim⟩, if_false]

#print axioms set_get'
#print axioms path_loop
#print axioms path_base_row_val
#print axioms path_level

/-! The extracted occupancy-row writer computes the model's occupancy row
(DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL §9): `write_occupancy_row block r occ` returns `ok`,
leaves every cell outside row r unchanged, and the lifted row-r cells are the
model's `occCell o` whenever the record lifts to `o` and the untouched cells
of row r were zero. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace R0Z.WriterRefine
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0WriterCopies

/-- The cell written at row offset c by write_occupancy_row (none = untouched). -/
def occRowCell (occ : OccRecord) (c : Nat) : Option U32 :=
  if c = 0 then some occ.occupied else if c = 1 then some occ.inverse
  else if c < 10 then some (occ.commitment.val[c - 2]!)
  else if c = 10 ∧ occ.has_selected then some occ.selected else none

theorem occ_row (block : Array U32 256#usize) (r : Usize) (hr : r.val ≤ 15) (occ : OccRecord) :
    ∃ b', write_occupancy_row block r occ = ok b' ∧
      ∀ k, b'.val[k]! =
        if r.val * 16 ≤ k ∧ k < r.val * 16 + 16 then
          (occRowCell occ (k - r.val * 16)).getD (block.val[k]!)
        else block.val[k]! := by
  have hbase : (Usize.wrapping_mul r 16#usize).val = r.val * 16 := umul _ _ (by scalar_tac)
  have h1 : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul r 16#usize) 1#usize).val = r.val * 16 + 1 := by
    rw [uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac), hbase]; simp
  have h10 : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul r 16#usize) 10#usize).val = r.val * 16 + 10 := by
    rw [uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac), hbase]; simp
  set base := Usize.wrapping_mul r 16#usize with hb
  let b1 := block.set base occ.occupied
  let b2 := b1.set (Usize.wrapping_add base 1#usize) occ.inverse
  obtain ⟨b3, hb3, hs3⟩ := occ_loop occ.commitment base (by rw [hbase]; omega) 8 0#usize b2 (by simp)
  have hk3 : ∀ k, b3.val[k]! = if r.val * 16 + 2 ≤ k ∧ k < r.val * 16 + 10
      then occ.commitment.val[k - r.val * 16 - 2]!
      else (if k = r.val * 16 + 1 then occ.inverse else if k = r.val * 16 then occ.occupied
        else block.val[k]!) := by
    intro k
    rw [hs3 k]
    simp only [hbase, show (0#usize : Usize).val = 0 by simp, Nat.add_zero]
    split
    · rfl
    · show (b1.set (Usize.wrapping_add base 1#usize) occ.inverse).val[k]! = _
      rw [set_get _ _ _ (by rw [h1]; omega), h1]
      split
      · rfl
      · show (block.set base occ.occupied).val[k]! = _
        rw [set_get _ _ _ (by rw [hbase]; omega), hbase]
  have run : write_occupancy_row block r occ =
      (if occ.has_selected then Array.update b3 (Usize.wrapping_add base 10#usize) occ.selected
        else ok b3) := by
    rw [write_occupancy_row]
    simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok]
    rw [update_ok block _ _ (show base.val < (256#usize).val by rw [hbase]; simp; omega)]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [update_ok _ _ _ (show (Usize.wrapping_add base 1#usize).val < (256#usize).val by
      rw [h1]; simp; omega)]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [hb3]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rfl
  cases hsel : occ.has_selected
  · refine ⟨b3, by rw [run, hsel]; rfl, fun k => ?_⟩
    rw [hk3 k]
    unfold occRowCell
    simp only [hsel]
    by_cases hin : r.val * 16 ≤ k ∧ k < r.val * 16 + 16
    · rw [if_pos hin]
      by_cases e0 : k - r.val * 16 = 0
      · rw [if_pos e0, if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_pos (by omega)]; rfl
      · by_cases e1 : k - r.val * 16 = 1
        · rw [if_neg e0, if_pos e1, if_neg (by omega), if_pos (by omega)]; rfl
        · by_cases e2 : k - r.val * 16 < 10
          · rw [if_neg e0, if_neg e1, if_pos e2, if_pos (by omega)]
            simp only [Option.getD_some]
          · rw [if_neg e0, if_neg e1, if_neg e2, if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega),
              if_neg (by omega)]
            simp
    · rw [if_neg hin, if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega)]
  · refine ⟨b3.set (Usize.wrapping_add base 10#usize) occ.selected, ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
    · rw [run, if_pos hsel, update_ok _ _ _ (show _ < (256#usize).val by rw [h10]; simp; omega)]
    · rw [set_get _ _ _ (by rw [h10]; omega), h10, hk3 k]
      unfold occRowCell
      simp only [hsel, and_true]
      by_cases hin : r.val * 16 ≤ k ∧ k < r.val * 16 + 16
      · rw [if_pos hin]
        by_cases e10 : k = r.val * 16 + 10
        · rw [if_pos e10, if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega),
            if_pos (by omega)]; rfl
        · rw [if_neg e10]
          by_cases e0 : k - r.val * 16 = 0
          · rw [if_pos e0, if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_pos (by omega)]; rfl
          · by_cases e1 : k - r.val * 16 = 1
            · rw [if_neg e0, if_pos e1, if_neg (by omega), if_pos (by omega)]; rfl
            · by_cases e2 : k - r.val * 16 < 10
              · rw [if_neg e0, if_neg e1, if_pos e2, if_pos (by omega)]
                simp only [Option.getD_some]
              · rw [if_neg e0, if_neg e1, if_neg e2, if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega),
                  if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega)]
                rfl
      · rw [if_neg hin, if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega)]

/-! ### Against the model -/

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

/-- Lift of a canonical M31 cell. -/
def liftU (x : U32) : K := ((x.val : Nat) : K)

/-- The record lifts to the model's occupancy record. -/
structure OccLifts (occ : OccRecord) (o : R0Z.BuilderModel.OccAux K) : Prop where
  occupied : liftU occ.occupied = o.occupied
  inverse : liftU occ.inverse = o.inverse
  commitment : ∀ i : Fin 8, liftU (occ.commitment.val[i.val]!) = o.commitment i
  selected : (if occ.has_selected then liftU occ.selected else 0) = o.selected

/-- The extracted writer's row r equals the model's `occCell` cell by cell,
given the record lifts and the untouched cells of row r are zero. -/
theorem occ_row_model (block : Array U32 256#usize) (r : Usize) (hr : r.val ≤ 15)
    (occ : OccRecord) (o : R0Z.BuilderModel.OccAux K) (hl : OccLifts occ o)
    (hz : ∀ c, c < 16 → block.val[r.val * 16 + c]!.val = 0) :
    ∃ b', write_occupancy_row block r occ = ok b' ∧
      (∀ c : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) (b'.val[r.val * 16 + c.val]!) = R0Z.BuilderModel.occCell o c) ∧
      (∀ k, ¬ (r.val * 16 ≤ k ∧ k < r.val * 16 + 16) → b'.val[k]! = block.val[k]!) := by
  obtain ⟨b', hrun, hk⟩ := occ_row block r hr occ
  refine ⟨b', hrun, fun c => ?_, fun k hk' => by rw [hk k, if_neg hk']⟩
  rw [hk, if_pos (by omega), show r.val * 16 + c.val - r.val * 16 = c.val by omega]
  have hzc : liftU (K := K) (block.val[r.val * 16 + c.val]!) = 0 := by
    unfold liftU; rw [hz c.val c.isLt]; simp
  unfold occRowCell R0Z.BuilderModel.occCell
  by_cases e0 : c.val = 0
  · rw [if_pos e0, if_pos e0]; exact hl.occupied
  · rw [if_neg e0, if_neg e0]
    by_cases e1 : c.val = 1
    · rw [if_pos e1, if_pos e1]; exact hl.inverse
    · rw [if_neg e1, if_neg e1]
      by_cases e2 : c.val < 10
      · rw [if_pos e2, dif_pos e2]
        exact hl.commitment ⟨c.val - 2, by omega⟩
      · rw [if_neg e2, dif_neg e2]
        by_cases e10 : c.val = 10
        · rw [if_pos e10]
          have hs := hl.selected
          cases hsel : occ.has_selected
          · rw [if_neg (by simp [hsel])]
            simp only [Option.getD_none]
            rw [hzc, ← hs, hsel]; rfl
          · rw [if_pos (by simp [e10, hsel])]
            simp only [Option.getD_some]
            rw [← hs, hsel]; rfl
        · rw [if_neg e10, if_neg (by omega)]
          simp only [Option.getD_none]
          exact hzc

#print axioms occ_row
#print axioms occ_row_model
end R0Z.WriterRefine

/-! Poseidon refinement, composition (DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL §11.5 (2), (3)).

`apply_round_lift`: the copy's `apply_round s r` lifts to R0P's
`poseidonApplyRound r` for every r < 22 (the three branches use
full_round_lift / internal_round_lift and the generated constant lifts).
`leading_pair_lift`: absorb loop, leading external layer and rounds 0, 1.
`perm_rounds_lift`: under `EndsLift pre absorb B`, `perm_rounds pre absorb`
returns rounds with `RoundsOk rounds B` — the loop invariant is that rows
0..k-1 lift to `blockIter B (r+1)` and the running state to `blockIter B k`. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace R0Z.PoseidonRefine
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0PoseidonCopy R0Z.WriterRefine

/-! ### Generic array plumbing -/

theorem update_ok_a {α : Type} {n : Usize} (v : Array α n) (i : Usize) (x : α) (h : i.val < n.val) :
    Array.update v i x = ok (v.set i x) := by
  unfold Array.update
  have hl : i.val < v.val.length := by rw [v.property]; exact h
  rw [Array.getElem?_Usize_eq, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hl]
  rfl

theorem set_get_a {α : Type} [Inhabited α] {n : Usize} (v : Array α n) (i : Usize) (x : α)
    (hi : i.val < n.val) (k : Nat) :
    (v.set i x).val[k]! = if k = i.val then x else v.val[k]! := by
  rw [Array.set_val_eq]
  have hl : i.val < v.val.length := by rw [v.property]; exact hi
  by_cases hk : k = i.val
  · subst hk
    rw [if_pos rfl, List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_set_self hl]
    rfl
  · rw [if_neg hk, List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD,
      List.getElem?_set_ne (Ne.symm hk)]

theorem v11 : (11#usize : Usize).val = 11 := by simp
theorem v14 : (14#usize : Usize).val = 14 := by simp
theorem v18 : (18#usize : Usize).val = 18 := by simp

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

/-! ### R0P-side unfoldings (no constant is read) -/

theorem ar_init (rr : Fin 22) (h : rr.val < 4) (v : Fin 16 → K) :
    R0P.poseidonApplyRound rr v = R0P.poseidonFullRound v (R0P.poseidonExternalInitial ⟨rr.val, h⟩) := by
  unfold R0P.poseidonApplyRound
  exact dif_pos h

theorem ar_int (rr : Fin 22) (h4 : ¬ rr.val < 4) (h18 : rr.val < 4 + 14) (v : Fin 16 → K) :
    R0P.poseidonApplyRound rr v =
      R0P.poseidonInternalRound v (R0P.poseidonInternalConstants ⟨rr.val - 4, by omega⟩) := by
  unfold R0P.poseidonApplyRound
  rw [dif_neg h4, dif_pos h18]

theorem ar_fin (rr : Fin 22) (h4 : ¬ rr.val < 4) (h18 : ¬ rr.val < 4 + 14) (v : Fin 16 → K) :
    R0P.poseidonApplyRound rr v =
      R0P.poseidonFullRound v (R0P.poseidonExternalFinal ⟨rr.val - 4 - 14, by omega⟩) := by
  unfold R0P.poseidonApplyRound
  rw [dif_neg h4, dif_neg h18]

theorem trans_zero (h : 0 < 11) (s a : Fin 16 → K) :
    R0P.poseidonTransition ⟨0, h⟩ s a = R0P.poseidonLeadingPair s a := by
  unfold R0P.poseidonTransition
  exact if_pos rfl

theorem trans_succ (k : Nat) (hk : k < 11) (hk0 : k ≠ 0) (s a : Fin 16 → K) :
    R0P.poseidonTransition ⟨k, hk⟩ s a =
      R0P.poseidonApplyRound ⟨2 * k + 1, by omega⟩ (R0P.poseidonApplyRound ⟨2 * k, by omega⟩ s) := by
  unfold R0P.poseidonTransition
  exact if_neg hk0

theorem iter_zero (B : R0Z.BuilderModel.BlockIn K) : R0Z.BuilderModel.blockIter B 0 = B.pre := rfl

theorem iter_succ (B : R0Z.BuilderModel.BlockIn K) (k : Nat) (hk : k < 11) :
    R0Z.BuilderModel.blockIter B (k + 1) =
      R0P.poseidonTransition ⟨k, hk⟩ (R0Z.BuilderModel.blockIter B k) B.absorb := by
  first
  | exact dif_pos hk
  | simp only [R0Z.BuilderModel.blockIter, dif_pos hk]

variable [CharP K 0x7fffffff]

/-! ### apply_round -/

theorem apply_round_lift (s : Array U32 16#usize) (round : Usize) (hr : round.val < 22) :
    ∃ t, apply_round s round = ok t ∧
      liftA (K := K) t = R0P.poseidonApplyRound ⟨round.val, hr⟩ (liftA s) := by
  by_cases h4 : round.val < 4
  · have hlt : round < 4#usize := by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac
    have hb : round.val < (4#usize).val := by rw [v4]; exact h4
    obtain ⟨t, ht, htv⟩ := full_round_lift (K := K) s (EXTERNAL_INITIAL.val[round.val]!)
    refine ⟨t, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [apply_round, if_pos hlt, index_ok_gen EXTERNAL_INITIAL round hb]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      exact ht
    · have e : liftA (K := K) t = _ := funext htv
      have ec : liftA (K := K) (EXTERNAL_INITIAL.val[round.val]!) =
          R0P.poseidonExternalInitial ⟨round.val, h4⟩ := funext (ei_rows ⟨round.val, h4⟩)
      rw [e, ec]
      exact (ar_init ⟨round.val, hr⟩ h4 (liftA s)).symm
  · have hlt4 : ¬ round < 4#usize := by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac
    by_cases h18 : round.val < 18
    · have hlt18 : round < 18#usize := by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac
      have hsub : (Usize.wrapping_sub round 4#usize).val = round.val - 4 := by
        rw [usub _ _ (by rw [v4]; omega), v4]
      have hb : (Usize.wrapping_sub round 4#usize).val < (14#usize).val := by rw [hsub, v14]; omega
      obtain ⟨t, ht, htv⟩ := internal_round_lift (K := K) s
        (INTERNAL.val[(Usize.wrapping_sub round 4#usize).val]!) INTERNAL_SHIFTS
        internal_shifts_bound internal_shifts_ok
      refine ⟨t, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [apply_round, if_neg hlt4, if_pos hlt18]
        simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok, index_ok INTERNAL _ hb]
        exact ht
      · have e : liftA (K := K) t = _ := funext htv
        have ec : liftU (K := K) (INTERNAL.val[(Usize.wrapping_sub round 4#usize).val]!) =
            R0P.poseidonInternalConstants ⟨round.val - 4, by omega⟩ := by
          rw [hsub]; exact ic_all ⟨round.val - 4, by omega⟩
        rw [e, ec]
        exact (ar_int ⟨round.val, hr⟩ h4 (by show round.val < 4 + 14; omega) (liftA s)).symm
    · have hlt18 : ¬ round < 18#usize := by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac
      have hsub : (Usize.wrapping_sub round 18#usize).val = round.val - 4 - 14 := by
        rw [usub _ _ (by rw [v18]; omega), v18]; omega
      have hb : (Usize.wrapping_sub round 18#usize).val < (4#usize).val := by rw [hsub, v4]; omega
      obtain ⟨t, ht, htv⟩ := full_round_lift (K := K) s
        (EXTERNAL_FINAL.val[(Usize.wrapping_sub round 18#usize).val]!)
      refine ⟨t, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [apply_round, if_neg hlt4, if_neg hlt18]
        simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok, index_ok_gen EXTERNAL_FINAL _ hb]
        exact ht
      · have e : liftA (K := K) t = _ := funext htv
        have ec : liftA (K := K) (EXTERNAL_FINAL.val[(Usize.wrapping_sub round 18#usize).val]!) =
            R0P.poseidonExternalFinal ⟨round.val - 4 - 14, by omega⟩ := by
          rw [hsub]; exact funext (ef_rows ⟨round.val - 4 - 14, by omega⟩)
        rw [e, ec]
        exact (ar_fin ⟨round.val, hr⟩ h4 (by show ¬ round.val < 4 + 14; omega) (liftA s)).symm

/-! ### Leading pair -/

theorem absorb_loop (pre absorb : Array U32 16#usize) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (i : Usize) (out : Array U32 16#usize), i.val + n = 8 →
      ∃ o, absorb_into_loop pre absorb out i = ok o ∧ ∀ k, k < 16 →
        (i.val ≤ k → k < 8 → liftU (K := K) (o.val[k]!) = liftU (pre.val[k]!) + liftU (absorb.val[k]!)) ∧
        (¬ (i.val ≤ k ∧ k < 8) → o.val[k]! = out.val[k]!)
  | 0, i, out, h => by
      refine ⟨out, ?_, fun k hk => ⟨fun h1 h2 => absurd h1 (by omega), fun _ => rfl⟩⟩
      rw [absorb_into_loop, if_neg (by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac)]
  | n + 1, i, out, h => by
      have hlt : i < 8#usize := by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac
      have hb : i.val < (16#usize).val := by rw [v16]; omega
      have hi1 : (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize).val = i.val + 1 := uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac)
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hzv⟩ := add_lift (K := K) (pre.val[i.val]!) (absorb.val[i.val]!)
      obtain ⟨o, ho, hov⟩ := absorb_loop pre absorb n (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize) (out.set i z)
        (by rw [hi1]; omega)
      refine ⟨o, ?_, fun k hk => ⟨fun hik hk8 => ?_, fun hn => ?_⟩⟩
      · rw [absorb_into_loop, if_pos hlt]
        simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok, index_ok pre i hb, index_ok absorb i hb, hz, update_ok out i z hb]
        exact ho
      · by_cases e : k = i.val
        · subst e
          rw [(hov i.val hk).2 (by rw [hi1]; omega), set_get' out i z hb i.val, if_pos rfl]
          exact hzv
        · exact (hov k hk).1 (by rw [hi1]; omega) hk8
      · rw [(hov k hk).2 (by rw [hi1]; omega), set_get' out i z hb k, if_neg (by omega)]

theorem leading_pair_lift (pre absorb c0 c1 : Array U32 16#usize)
    (h0 : ∀ i : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) (c0.val[i.val]!) = R0P.poseidonExternalInitial 0 i)
    (h1 : ∀ i : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) (c1.val[i.val]!) = R0P.poseidonExternalInitial 1 i) :
    ∃ t, leading_pair pre absorb c0 c1 = ok t ∧
      liftA (K := K) t = R0P.poseidonLeadingPair (liftA pre) (liftA absorb) := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hav⟩ := absorb_loop (K := K) pre absorb 8 0#usize pre (by rw [z0])
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hsv⟩ := external_lift (K := K) a
  obtain ⟨t1, ht1, ht1v⟩ := full_round_lift (K := K) s c0
  obtain ⟨t2, ht2, ht2v⟩ := full_round_lift (K := K) t1 c1
  refine ⟨t2, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [leading_pair]
    simp only [absorb_into, ha, bind_tc_ok, hs, ht1, ht2]
  · have ea : liftA (K := K) a =
        fun lane => if lane.val < 8 then liftA pre lane + liftA absorb lane else liftA pre lane := by
      funext lane
      by_cases hl : lane.val < 8
      · rw [if_pos hl]
        exact (hav lane.val lane.isLt).1 (z0.trans_le (Nat.zero_le _)) hl
      · rw [if_neg hl]
        show liftU (a.val[lane.val]!) = liftU (pre.val[lane.val]!)
        rw [(hav lane.val lane.isLt).2 (by rw [z0]; omega)]
    have es : liftA (K := K) s = _ := funext hsv
    have e1 : liftA (K := K) t1 = _ := funext ht1v
    have e2 : liftA (K := K) t2 = _ := funext ht2v
    have ec0 : liftA (K := K) c0 = R0P.poseidonExternalInitial 0 := funext h0
    have ec1 : liftA (K := K) c1 = R0P.poseidonExternalInitial 1 := funext h1
    rw [e2, e1, es, ea, ec0, ec1]
    rfl

/-! ### perm_rounds -/

theorem perm_loop (B : R0Z.BuilderModel.BlockIn K) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (k : Usize) (rounds : Array (Array U32 16#usize) 11#usize) (state : Array U32 16#usize),
      k.val + n = 11 → 1 ≤ k.val →
      (∀ (r : Nat) (i : Fin 16), r < k.val →
        liftU (K := K) ((rounds.val[r]!).val[i.val]!) = R0Z.BuilderModel.blockIter B (r + 1) i) →
      liftA (K := K) state = R0Z.BuilderModel.blockIter B k.val →
      ∃ out, perm_rounds_loop rounds state k = ok out ∧ RoundsOk out B
  | 0, k, rounds, state, h, _, hinv, _ => by
      refine ⟨rounds, ?_, fun r i hr => hinv r i (by omega)⟩
      rw [perm_rounds_loop, if_neg (by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac)]
  | n + 1, k, rounds, state, h, hk1, hinv, hst => by
      have hlt : k < 11#usize := by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac
      have hkb : k.val < (11#usize).val := by rw [v11]; omega
      have h2k : (Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize k).val = 2 * k.val := by
        rw [umul _ _ (by rw [z2]; omega), z2]
      have h2k1 : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize k) 1#usize).val = 2 * k.val + 1 := by
        rw [uadd _ _ (by rw [h2k, z1]; omega), h2k, z1]
      have hkk : (Usize.wrapping_add k 1#usize).val = k.val + 1 := uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac)
      obtain ⟨a, ha, hav⟩ := apply_round_lift (K := K) state (Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize k)
        (by rw [h2k]; omega)
      obtain ⟨s1, hs1, hs1v⟩ := apply_round_lift (K := K) a
        (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize k) 1#usize) (by rw [h2k1]; omega)
      have f1 : (⟨(Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize k).val, by rw [h2k]; omega⟩ : Fin 22) =
          ⟨2 * k.val, by omega⟩ := Fin.ext h2k
      have f2 : (⟨(Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize k) 1#usize).val, by rw [h2k1]; omega⟩ :
          Fin 22) = ⟨2 * k.val + 1, by omega⟩ := Fin.ext h2k1
      have hnew : liftA (K := K) s1 = R0Z.BuilderModel.blockIter B (k.val + 1) := by
        rw [hs1v, hav, hst, iter_succ B k.val (by omega), trans_succ k.val _ (by omega), f1, f2]
      obtain ⟨o, ho, hR⟩ := perm_loop B n (Usize.wrapping_add k 1#usize) (rounds.set k s1) s1
        (by rw [hkk]; omega) (by rw [hkk]; omega)
        (fun r i hr => by
          rw [hkk] at hr
          rw [set_get_a rounds k s1 hkb r]
          by_cases e : r = k.val
          · rw [if_pos e, e]
            exact congrFun hnew i
          · rw [if_neg e]
            exact hinv r i (by omega))
        (by rw [hkk]; exact hnew)
      refine ⟨o, ?_, hR⟩
      rw [perm_rounds_loop, if_pos hlt]
      simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok, ha, hs1, update_ok_a rounds k s1 hkb]
      exact ho

/-- **RoundsOk for the copy.**  If the Rust pre-state and absorption lift to the
model block, the extracted copy's `perm_rounds` returns rounds satisfying
`RoundsOk` for that block. -/
theorem perm_rounds_lift (pre absorb : Array U32 16#usize) (B : R0Z.BuilderModel.BlockIn K)
    (he : EndsLift pre absorb B) :

  have hb1 : (1#usize : Usize).val < (4#usize).val := by rw [z1, v4]; omega

    show liftA st = R0Z.BuilderModel.blockIter B (0 + 1)

    ((Array.repeat 11#usize (Array.repeat 16#usize 0#u32)).set 0#usize st) st

    bind_tc_ok, hst, update_ok_a _ 0#usize st hb11]
  exact ho

  | ⟨7, _⟩ => ic_7
  | ⟨8, _⟩ => ic_8
  | ⟨9, _⟩ => ic_9
  | ⟨10, _⟩ => ic_10
  | ⟨11, _⟩ => ic_11
  | ⟨12, _⟩ => ic_12
  | ⟨13, _⟩ => ic_13
  | ⟨_ + 14, h⟩ => absurd h (by omega)

used by `internal_round_lift`.  Fifteen lanes of small numerals (at most
16), each checked by `rfl`/`decide` after unfolding the one table; no
field element is involved. -/

namespace R0Z.PoseidonRefine
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0PoseidonCopy

theorem internal_shifts_ok : ShiftsOk INTERNAL_SHIFTS := by
  intro ⟨j, hj⟩
  rw [INTERNAL_SHIFTS]
  interval_cases j <;> rfl

  rw [INTERNAL_SHIFTS]

import R0Z.PoseidonRefine

/-! Poseidon refinement, internal round (DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL §11.4 c).

`internal_round_lift`: the extracted copy's `internal_round s c0 shifts`
returns `ok t` and every lane of `t` lifts to R0P's `poseidonInternalRound`
of the lifted state and constant, for every u32 state and constant, given
two named facts about the shift row (`ShiftsBound`, `ShiftsOk`; they are
the table-correspondence obligation for INTERNAL_SHIFTS and are not
evaluated here).  The part sum is related to R0P's ordered `foldl` over
`List.ofFn` by a generic `ofFn`/`range'` lemma, not by unfolding 15 cells. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace R0Z.PoseidonRefine
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0PoseidonCopy R0Z.WriterRefine

theorem v15 : (15#usize : Usize).val = 15 := by simp

theorem usub (a b : Usize) (h : b.val ≤ a.val) : (Usize.wrapping_sub a b).val = a.val - b.val := by
  rw [Usize.wrapping_sub_val_eq]
  have ha : a.val < UScalar.size .Usize := by rw [UScalar.size_def]; exact a.hBounds
  rw [show a.val + (UScalar.size .Usize - b.val) = (a.val - b.val) + UScalar.size .Usize by omega,
    Nat.add_mod_right]
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)

theorem sub64 (x y : U64) (h : y.val ≤ x.val) : (U64.wrapping_sub x y).val = x.val - y.val := by
  rw [U64.wrapping_sub_val_eq, size64]
  have hx : x.val < 18446744073709551616 := by
    have := x.hBounds; rw [show UScalarTy.U64.numBits = 64 from rfl] at this; exact this
  rw [show x.val + (18446744073709551616 - y.val) = (x.val - y.val) + 18446744073709551616 by omega,
    Nat.add_mod_right]
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)

theorem shl64 (x : U64) (sh : U32) (hx : x.val < 4294967296) (hs : sh.val ≤ 16) :
    (U64.wrapping_shl x sh).val = x.val * 2 ^ sh.val := by
  show (U64.wrapping_shl x sh).bv.toNat = x.bv.toNat * 2 ^ sh.val
  rw [U64.wrapping_shl_bv_eq, show sh.val % 64 = sh.val by omega]
  show (x.bv <<< sh.val).toNat = _
  rw [BitVec.toNat_shiftLeft, Nat.shiftLeft_eq]
  apply Nat.mod_eq_of_lt
  have h1 : x.bv.toNat * 2 ^ sh.val ≤ x.bv.toNat * 2 ^ 16 :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) hs)
  have h2 : x.bv.toNat * 2 ^ 16 < 4294967296 * 2 ^ 16 :=
    Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hx (by norm_num)
  have h3 : (4294967296 * 2 ^ 16 : Nat) < 2 ^ 64 := by norm_num
  omega

theorem lane_val (full x sh : U32) (hs : sh.val ≤ 16) :
    (U64.wrapping_add (UScalar.cast .U64 full) (U64.wrapping_shl (UScalar.cast .U64 x) sh)).val =
      full.val + x.val * 2 ^ sh.val := by
  have hsh := shl64 (UScalar.cast .U64 x) sh (by rw [c64]; exact u32lt x) hs
  rw [c64] at hsh
  have h1 : x.val * 2 ^ sh.val ≤ x.val * 2 ^ 16 :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) hs)
  have h2 : x.val * 2 ^ 16 < 4294967296 * 2 ^ 16 := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (u32lt x) (by norm_num)
  have h3 : (4294967296 * 2 ^ 16 : Nat) + 4294967296 < 18446744073709551616 := by norm_num
  have := u32lt full
  exact add64v _ _ _ _ (c64 full) hsh (by omega)

theorem lane0_val (part s0 : U32) (h : s0.val ≤ part.val + 2147483647) :
    (U64.wrapping_sub (U64.wrapping_add (UScalar.cast .U64 part) (UScalar.cast .U64 P))
      (UScalar.cast .U64 s0)).val = part.val + 2147483647 - s0.val := by
  have hadd := add64v _ _ _ _ (c64 part) p64 (by have := u32lt part; omega)
  rw [sub64 _ _ (by rw [hadd, c64]; exact h), hadd, c64]

theorem canon_mod (x : U64) :
    (UScalar.cast .U32 (⟨BitVec.umod x.bv (UScalar.cast .U64 P).bv⟩ : U64)).val < 2147483647 := by
  have hm : (⟨BitVec.umod x.bv (UScalar.cast .U64 P).bv⟩ : U64).val = x.val % 2147483647 := by
    rw [umod_val, p64]
  have hlt : x.val % 2147483647 < 2147483647 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  rw [c32 _ (by rw [hm]; omega), hm]
  exact hlt

theorem mul_canon (a b : U32) : ∃ z, m31_mul a b = ok z ∧ z.val < 2147483647 := by
  rw [m31_mul]
  simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok, remP]
  exact ⟨_, rfl, canon_mod _⟩

theorem pow5_canon (x z : U32) (h : pow5 x = ok z) : z.val < 2147483647 := by
  obtain ⟨s1, hs1, -⟩ := mul_canon x x
  obtain ⟨s2, hs2, -⟩ := mul_canon s1 s1
  obtain ⟨s3, hs3, hc⟩ := mul_canon s2 x
  have e : pow5 x = ok s3 := by
    rw [pow5, hs1]; simp only [bind_tc_ok]; rw [hs2]; simp only [bind_tc_ok]; exact hs3
  rw [e] at h
  injection h with h'
  rw [← h']
  exact hc

theorem ofFn_range' {α : Type} : ∀ (n s : Nat) (f : Fin n → α) (g : Nat → α),
    (∀ i : Fin n, f i = g (s + i.val)) → List.ofFn f = (List.range' s n).map g
  | 0, s, f, g, _ => by rw [List.ofFn_zero]; rfl
  | n + 1, s, f, g, h => by
      rw [List.ofFn_succ, ofFn_range' n (s + 1) (fun i => f i.succ) g
        (fun i => by rw [h i.succ, Fin.val_succ, show s + (i.val + 1) = s + 1 + i.val by omega]),
        h 0, Fin.val_zero, Nat.add_zero]
      rfl

/-- The shift row's entries are at most 16 (so `x << shift` stays below 2^48). -/
def ShiftsBound (shifts : Array U32 15#usize) : Prop := ∀ j, j < 15 → (shifts.val[j]!).val ≤ 16

/-- The shift row equals R0P's `poseidonInternalShifts` (the INTERNAL_SHIFTS table obligation). -/
def ShiftsOk (shifts : Array U32 15#usize) : Prop :=
  ∀ j : Fin 15, (shifts.val[j.val]!).val = R0P.poseidonInternalShifts j

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

theorem lin_unfold (v : Fin 16 → K) (i : Fin 16) :
    R0P.poseidonInternalLinear v i =
      if h : i.val = 0 then (List.ofFn (fun j : Fin 15 => v j.succ)).foldl (· + ·) 0 - v 0
      else ((List.ofFn (fun j : Fin 15 => v j.succ)).foldl (· + ·) 0 + v 0) +
        v i * ((1 <<< R0P.poseidonInternalShifts ⟨i.val - 1, by have := i.isLt; omega⟩ : Nat) : K) :=
  rfl

variable [CharP K 0x7fffffff]

theorem part_loop (s : Array U32 16#usize) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (i : Usize) (acc : U64), i.val + n = 16 →
      acc.val + n * 4294967296 < 18446744073709551616 →
      ∃ r, int_part_sum_loop s acc i = ok r ∧ r.val ≤ acc.val + n * 4294967296 ∧
        ((r.val : Nat) : K) = ((List.range' i.val n).map (liftN s)).foldl (· + ·) ((acc.val : Nat) : K)
  | 0, i, acc, h, _ => by
      refine ⟨acc, ?_, by omega, rfl⟩
      rw [int_part_sum_loop, if_neg (by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac)]
  | n + 1, i, acc, h, hacc => by
      have hlt : i < 16#usize := by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac
      have hb : i.val < (16#usize).val := by rw [v16]; omega
      have hi1 : (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize).val = i.val + 1 := uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac)
      have hx := u32lt (s.val[i.val]!)
      have ha1 := add64v acc (UScalar.cast .U64 (s.val[i.val]!)) _ _ rfl (c64 _) (by omega)
      obtain ⟨r, hr, hrb, hrv⟩ := part_loop s n (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize)
        (U64.wrapping_add acc (UScalar.cast .U64 (s.val[i.val]!))) (by rw [hi1]; omega)
        (by rw [ha1]; omega)
      refine ⟨r, ?_, by rw [ha1] at hrb; omega, ?_⟩
      · rw [int_part_sum_loop, if_pos hlt]
        simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok, index_ok s i hb]
        exact hr
      · rw [hrv, hi1, ha1, Nat.cast_add]
        rfl

theorem part_lift (s : Array U32 16#usize) :
    ∃ part, int_part_sum s = ok part ∧ part.val < 2147483647 ∧
      liftU (K := K) part = (List.ofFn (fun j : Fin 15 => liftA (K := K) s j.succ)).foldl (· + ·) 0 := by
  have h0 : (0#u64 : U64).val = 0 := by simp
  obtain ⟨r, hr, -, hrv⟩ := part_loop (K := K) s 15 1#usize 0#u64 (by rw [z1]) (by rw [h0]; omega)
  have hof : List.ofFn (fun j : Fin 15 => liftA (K := K) s j.succ) = (List.range' 1 15).map (liftN s) :=
    ofFn_range' 15 1 _ _ (fun j => by
      show liftU (s.val[j.succ.val]!) = liftU (s.val[1 + j.val]!)
      rw [Fin.val_succ, Nat.add_comm])
  rw [int_part_sum]
  simp only [hr, lift, bind_tc_ok, remP]
  refine ⟨_, rfl, canon_mod _, ?_⟩
  rw [liftmod, hrv, z1, h0, Nat.cast_zero, hof]

theorem lin_loop (s : Array U32 16#usize) (shifts : Array U32 15#usize) (full : U32)
    (hsb : ShiftsBound shifts) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (i : Usize) (out : Array U32 16#usize), i.val + n = 16 → 1 ≤ i.val →
      ∃ o, internal_linear_loop s shifts full out i = ok o ∧ ∀ k, k < 16 →
        (i.val ≤ k → liftU (K := K) (o.val[k]!) =
          liftU full + liftN s k * (2 : K) ^ (shifts.val[k - 1]!).val) ∧
        (k < i.val → o.val[k]! = out.val[k]!)
  | 0, i, out, h, _ => by
      refine ⟨out, ?_, fun k hk => ⟨fun h' => absurd h' (by omega), fun _ => rfl⟩⟩
      rw [internal_linear_loop, if_neg (by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac)]
  | n + 1, i, out, h, h1 => by
      have hlt : i < 16#usize := by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac
      have hb : i.val < (16#usize).val := by rw [v16]; omega
      have hi1 : (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize).val = i.val + 1 := uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac)
      have hsub : (Usize.wrapping_sub i 1#usize).val = i.val - 1 := by
        rw [usub _ _ (by rw [z1]; omega), z1]
      have hsb' : (Usize.wrapping_sub i 1#usize).val < (15#usize).val := by rw [hsub, v15]; omega
      have step : ∃ X : U32, internal_linear_loop s shifts full out i =
          internal_linear_loop s shifts full (out.set i X) (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize) ∧
          liftU (K := K) X = liftU full + liftN s i.val * (2 : K) ^ (shifts.val[i.val - 1]!).val := by
        rw [internal_linear_loop, if_pos hlt]
        simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok, index_ok s i hb, index_ok shifts _ hsb', remP, update_ok out i _ hb]
        refine ⟨_, rfl, ?_⟩
        rw [liftmod, lane_val _ _ _ (hsb _ (by rw [hsub]; omega)), hsub]
        unfold liftN liftU
        push_cast
        rfl
      obtain ⟨X, hX, hXv⟩ := step
      obtain ⟨o, ho, hov⟩ := lin_loop s shifts full hsb n (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize) (out.set i X)
        (by rw [hi1]; omega) (by rw [hi1]; omega)
      refine ⟨o, by rw [hX]; exact ho, fun k hk => ⟨fun hik => ?_, fun hki => ?_⟩⟩
      · by_cases e : k = i.val
        · subst e
          rw [(hov i.val hk).2 (by rw [hi1]; omega), set_get' out i X hb i.val, if_pos rfl]
          exact hXv
        · exact (hov k hk).1 (by rw [hi1]; omega)
      · rw [(hov k hk).2 (by rw [hi1]; omega), set_get' out i X hb k, if_neg (by omega)]

/-- The internal linear layer of the copy lifts to R0P's `poseidonInternalLinear`
(lane 0 needs the canonical-lane-0 fact `h0`). -/
theorem internal_linear_lift (s : Array U32 16#usize) (shifts : Array U32 15#usize)
    (h0 : (s.val[0]!).val < 2147483647) (hsb : ShiftsBound shifts) (hsh : ShiftsOk shifts) :
    ∃ t, internal_linear s shifts = ok t ∧
      ∀ i : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) (t.val[i.val]!) = R0P.poseidonInternalLinear (liftA s) i := by
  obtain ⟨part, hp, hpc, hpv⟩ := part_lift (K := K) s
  obtain ⟨full, hf, hfv⟩ := add_lift (K := K) part (s.val[0]!)
  have hle : (s.val[0]!).val ≤ part.val + 2147483647 := by omega
  have hb0 : (0#usize : Usize).val < (16#usize).val := by rw [z0, v16]; omega
  have step : ∃ X0 : U32, internal_linear s shifts =
      internal_linear_loop s shifts full ((Array.repeat 16#usize 0#u32).set 0#usize X0) 1#usize ∧
      liftU (K := K) X0 = liftU part - liftU (s.val[0]!) := by
    rw [internal_linear]
    simp only [hp, lift, bind_tc_ok, index_ok s 0#usize hb0, z0, hf, remP, update_ok _ 0#usize _ hb0]
    refine ⟨_, rfl, ?_⟩
    rw [liftmod, lane0_val _ _ hle]
    unfold liftU
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hle, Nat.cast_add, CharP.cast_eq_zero K 0x7fffffff, add_zero]
  obtain ⟨X0, hX0, hX0v⟩ := step
  obtain ⟨o, ho, hov⟩ := lin_loop (K := K) s shifts full hsb 15 1#usize
    ((Array.repeat 16#usize 0#u32).set 0#usize X0) (by rw [z1]) (le_of_eq z1.symm)
  refine ⟨o, by rw [hX0]; exact ho, fun i => ?_⟩
  have hi := i.isLt
  by_cases hi0 : i.val = 0
  · rw [lin_unfold, dif_pos hi0, hi0, (hov 0 (by omega)).2 (lt_of_lt_of_eq Nat.zero_lt_one z1.symm),
      set_get' _ 0#usize X0 hb0 0, z0, if_pos rfl, hX0v, hpv]
    rfl
  · have hs := hsh ⟨i.val - 1, by omega⟩
    dsimp only at hs
    rw [lin_unfold, dif_neg hi0, (hov i.val hi).1 (by rw [z1]; omega), hfv, hpv, hs, Nat.shiftLeft_eq,
      Nat.one_mul, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat]
    rfl

/-- **Single internal round.**  For every u32 state `s` and constant `c0`, and a
shift row satisfying the named table facts, the extracted copy's
`internal_round` returns `ok t` and every lane of `t` lifts to R0P's
`poseidonInternalRound` of the lifted state and constant. -/
theorem internal_round_lift (s : Array U32 16#usize) (c0 : U32) (shifts : Array U32 15#usize)
    (hsb : ShiftsBound shifts) (hsh : ShiftsOk shifts) :
    ∃ t, internal_round s c0 shifts = ok t ∧
      ∀ i : Fin 16, liftU (K := K) (t.val[i.val]!) =
        R0P.poseidonInternalRound (liftA s) (liftU c0) i := by
  have hb0 : (0#usize : Usize).val < (16#usize).val := by rw [z0, v16]; omega
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzv⟩ := add_lift (K := K) (s.val[0]!) c0
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyv⟩ := pow5_lift (K := K) z
  have hyc := pow5_canon z y hy
  have hset := set_get' s 0#usize y hb0
  have h0 : ((s.set 0#usize y).val[0]!).val < 2147483647 := by
    rw [hset 0, z0, if_pos rfl]; exact hyc
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htv⟩ := internal_linear_lift (K := K) (s.set 0#usize y) shifts h0 hsb hsh
  refine ⟨t, ?_, fun i => ?_⟩
  · rw [internal_round]
    simp only [index_ok s 0#usize hb0, z0, bind_tc_ok, hz, hy, update_ok s 0#usize y hb0]
    exact ht
  · rw [htv i]
    have hfun : liftA (K := K) (s.set 0#usize y) =
        fun lane => if lane = 0 then R0P.poseidonPow5 (liftA s 0 + liftU c0) else liftA s lane := by
      funext lane
      show liftU ((s.set 0#usize y).val[lane.val]!) = _
      rw [hset lane.val, z0]
      by_cases hl : lane = 0
      · have hv : lane.val = 0 := by rw [hl]; rfl
        rw [if_pos hv, if_pos hl, hyv, hzv]
        rfl
      · rw [if_neg (show ¬ (lane.val = 0) from fun h => hl (Fin.ext h)), if_neg hl]
        rfl
    rw [hfun]
    rfl

end R0Z.PoseidonRefine

import R0Z.PoseidonExtracted
