/-! Poseidon refinement, first step (DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL §11.4 c).

`R0PoseidonCopy` is the Aeneas extraction of refine/poseidon (the
extraction-friendly copy of permute_optimized_with_trace, differentially
tested against production).  Here: the field operations, pow5, mat4, the
external linear layer and the single full round lift to R0P's
`poseidonPow5`, `poseidonMat4`, `poseidonExternalLinear`,
`poseidonFullRound`, for every u32 input state and constant row (all
reductions are `(u64 expression) % p`, so no canonicity is needed).  Loops
are proved by induction on the remaining iterations; no table or cell is
evaluated. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace R0Z.PoseidonRefine
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0PoseidonCopy R0Z.WriterRefine

/-! ### Scalar plumbing -/

theorem u32lt (a : U32) : a.val < 4294967296 := by
  have h := a.hBounds
  rw [show UScalarTy.U32.numBits = 32 from rfl] at h
  exact h

theorem size64 : UScalar.size .U64 = 18446744073709551616 := by
  rw [UScalar.size_def]; rfl

theorem c64 (a : U32) : (UScalar.cast .U64 a).val = a.val := by
  rw [UScalar.cast_val_eq, show UScalarTy.U64.numBits = 64 from rfl]
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by have := u32lt a; omega)

theorem c32 (x : U64) (h : x.val < 4294967296) : (UScalar.cast .U32 x).val = x.val := by
  rw [UScalar.cast_val_eq, show UScalarTy.U32.numBits = 32 from rfl]
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h

theorem add64v (x y : U64) (m n : Nat) (hx : x.val = m) (hy : y.val = n)
    (h : m + n < 18446744073709551616) : (U64.wrapping_add x y).val = m + n := by
  rw [U64.wrapping_add_val_eq, size64, hx, hy]; exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h

theorem mul64v (x y : U64) (m n : Nat) (hx : x.val = m) (hy : y.val = n)
    (h : m * n < 18446744073709551616) : (U64.wrapping_mul x y).val = m * n := by
  rw [U64.wrapping_mul_val_eq, size64, hx, hy]; exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h

theorem v2 : (2#u64 : U64).val = 2 := by simp
theorem v3 : (3#u64 : U64).val = 3 := by simp
theorem v4 : (4#usize : Usize).val = 4 := by simp
theorem v16 : (16#usize : Usize).val = 16 := by simp
theorem z0 : (0#usize : Usize).val = 0 := by simp
theorem z1 : (1#usize : Usize).val = 1 := by simp
theorem z2 : (2#usize : Usize).val = 2 := by simp
theorem z3 : (3#usize : Usize).val = 3 := by simp

theorem pval : (P : U32).val = 2147483647 := by rw [P]; simp
theorem p64 : (UScalar.cast .U64 P).val = 2147483647 := by rw [c64, pval]

theorem rem_ok {ty : UScalarTy} (x y : UScalar ty) (h : y.val ≠ 0) :
    (x % y : Result (UScalar ty)) = ok ⟨BitVec.umod x.bv y.bv⟩ := by
  show UScalar.rem x y = _
  unfold UScalar.rem
  rw [if_pos (by simpa using h)]

theorem umod_val {ty : UScalarTy} (x y : UScalar ty) :
    (⟨BitVec.umod x.bv y.bv⟩ : UScalar ty).val = x.val % y.val :=
  BitVec.toNat_umod

theorem remP (x : U64) :
    (x % UScalar.cast .U64 P : Result U64) = ok ⟨BitVec.umod x.bv (UScalar.cast .U64 P).bv⟩ :=
  rem_ok _ _ (by rw [p64]; omega)

/-! ### u64 shapes of the copy (no wrap) -/

theorem add2_val (a b : U32) :
    (U64.wrapping_add (UScalar.cast .U64 a) (UScalar.cast .U64 b)).val = a.val + b.val := by
  have := u32lt a; have := u32lt b
  exact add64v _ _ _ _ (c64 a) (c64 b) (by omega)

theorem mul2_val (a b : U32) :
    (U64.wrapping_mul (UScalar.cast .U64 a) (UScalar.cast .U64 b)).val = a.val * b.val := by
  have ha := u32lt a; have hb := u32lt b
  refine mul64v _ _ _ _ (c64 a) (c64 b) ?_
  calc a.val * b.val < 4294967296 * 4294967296 := Nat.mul_lt_mul'' ha hb
    _ = 18446744073709551616 := by norm_num

theorem sum4_val (a b c d : U32) :
    (U64.wrapping_add (U64.wrapping_add (U64.wrapping_add (UScalar.cast .U64 a) (UScalar.cast .U64 b))
      (UScalar.cast .U64 c)) (UScalar.cast .U64 d)).val = a.val + b.val + c.val + d.val := by
  have := u32lt a; have := u32lt b; have := u32lt c; have := u32lt d
  exact add64v _ _ _ _ (add64v _ _ _ _ (add64v _ _ _ _ (c64 a) (c64 b) (by omega)) (c64 c) (by omega))
    (c64 d) (by omega)

theorem mat_r0 (a b c d : U32) :
    (U64.wrapping_add (U64.wrapping_add (U64.wrapping_add (U64.wrapping_mul 2#u64 (UScalar.cast .U64 a))
      (U64.wrapping_mul 3#u64 (UScalar.cast .U64 b))) (UScalar.cast .U64 c)) (UScalar.cast .U64 d)).val
      = 2 * a.val + 3 * b.val + c.val + d.val := by
  have := u32lt a; have := u32lt b; have := u32lt c; have := u32lt d
  exact add64v _ _ _ _ (add64v _ _ _ _ (add64v _ _ _ _ (mul64v _ _ _ _ v2 (c64 a) (by omega))
    (mul64v _ _ _ _ v3 (c64 b) (by omega)) (by omega)) (c64 c) (by omega)) (c64 d) (by omega)

theorem mat_r1 (a b c d : U32) :
    (U64.wrapping_add (U64.wrapping_add (U64.wrapping_add (UScalar.cast .U64 a)
      (U64.wrapping_mul 2#u64 (UScalar.cast .U64 b))) (U64.wrapping_mul 3#u64 (UScalar.cast .U64 c)))
      (UScalar.cast .U64 d)).val = a.val + 2 * b.val + 3 * c.val + d.val := by
  have := u32lt a; have := u32lt b; have := u32lt c; have := u32lt d
  exact add64v _ _ _ _ (add64v _ _ _ _ (add64v _ _ _ _ (c64 a) (mul64v _ _ _ _ v2 (c64 b) (by omega))
    (by omega)) (mul64v _ _ _ _ v3 (c64 c) (by omega)) (by omega)) (c64 d) (by omega)

theorem mat_r2 (a b c d : U32) :
    (U64.wrapping_add (U64.wrapping_add (U64.wrapping_add (UScalar.cast .U64 a) (UScalar.cast .U64 b))
      (U64.wrapping_mul 2#u64 (UScalar.cast .U64 c))) (U64.wrapping_mul 3#u64 (UScalar.cast .U64 d))).val
      = a.val + b.val + 2 * c.val + 3 * d.val := by
  have := u32lt a; have := u32lt b; have := u32lt c; have := u32lt d
  exact add64v _ _ _ _ (add64v _ _ _ _ (add64v _ _ _ _ (c64 a) (c64 b) (by omega))
    (mul64v _ _ _ _ v2 (c64 c) (by omega)) (by omega)) (mul64v _ _ _ _ v3 (c64 d) (by omega)) (by omega)

theorem mat_r3 (a b c d : U32) :
    (U64.wrapping_add (U64.wrapping_add (U64.wrapping_add (U64.wrapping_mul 3#u64 (UScalar.cast .U64 a))
      (UScalar.cast .U64 b)) (UScalar.cast .U64 c)) (U64.wrapping_mul 2#u64 (UScalar.cast .U64 d))).val
      = 3 * a.val + b.val + c.val + 2 * d.val := by
  have := u32lt a; have := u32lt b; have := u32lt c; have := u32lt d
  exact add64v _ _ _ _ (add64v _ _ _ _ (add64v _ _ _ _ (mul64v _ _ _ _ v3 (c64 a) (by omega))
    (c64 b) (by omega)) (c64 c) (by omega)) (mul64v _ _ _ _ v2 (c64 d) (by omega)) (by omega)

/-! ### Lifting to K -/

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

/-- Lane `k` of a 16-lane state, lifted. -/
def liftN (s : Array U32 16#usize) (k : Nat) : K := liftU (s.val[k]!)

/-- The lifted state as R0P's `Fin 16 → K`. -/
def liftA (s : Array U32 16#usize) : Fin 16 → K := fun i => liftU (s.val[i.val]!)

/-- R0P's group-`g` matrix output `c`, read through `liftN`. -/
def PM (s : Array U32 16#usize) (g c : Fin 4) : K :=
  R0P.poseidonMat4 (fun lane : Fin 4 => liftN s (4 * g.val + lane.val)) c

variable [CharP K 0x7fffffff]

theorem cast_mod (n : Nat) : ((n % 2147483647 : Nat) : K) = (n : K) := by
  conv_rhs => rw [← Nat.mod_add_div n 2147483647]
  rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_mul, CharP.cast_eq_zero K 0x7fffffff, zero_mul, add_zero]

theorem liftmod (x : U64) :
    liftU (K := K) (UScalar.cast .U32 (⟨BitVec.umod x.bv (UScalar.cast .U64 P).bv⟩ : U64)) =
      ((x.val : Nat) : K) := by
  unfold liftU
  have hm : (⟨BitVec.umod x.bv (UScalar.cast .U64 P).bv⟩ : U64).val = x.val % 2147483647 := by
    rw [umod_val, p64]
  have hlt : x.val % 2147483647 < 2147483647 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  rw [c32 _ (by rw [hm]; omega), hm, cast_mod]

theorem add_lift (a b : U32) :
    ∃ z, m31_add a b = ok z ∧ liftU (K := K) z = liftU a + liftU b := by
  rw [m31_add]
  simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok, remP]
  refine ⟨_, rfl, ?_⟩
  rw [liftmod, add2_val]
  unfold liftU
  push_cast
  rfl

theorem mul_lift (a b : U32) :
    ∃ z, m31_mul a b = ok z ∧ liftU (K := K) z = liftU a * liftU b := by
  rw [m31_mul]
  simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok, remP]
  refine ⟨_, rfl, ?_⟩
  rw [liftmod, mul2_val]
  unfold liftU
  push_cast
  rfl

theorem pow5_lift (x : U32) :
    ∃ z, pow5 x = ok z ∧ liftU (K := K) z = R0P.poseidonPow5 (liftU x) := by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hsv⟩ := mul_lift (K := K) x x
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htv⟩ := mul_lift (K := K) s s
  obtain ⟨u, hu, huv⟩ := mul_lift (K := K) t x
  refine ⟨u, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [pow5, hs]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [ht]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    exact hu
  · rw [huv, htv, hsv]
    rfl

/-! ### mat4 -/

theorem mk4 (x0 x1 x2 x3 : U32) (h : [x0, x1, x2, x3].length = (4#usize : Usize).val) :
    (Array.make 4#usize [x0, x1, x2, x3] h).val = [x0, x1, x2, x3] := rfl
theorem gl0 (x0 x1 x2 x3 : U32) : ([x0, x1, x2, x3] : List U32)[0]! = x0 := rfl
theorem gl1 (x0 x1 x2 x3 : U32) : ([x0, x1, x2, x3] : List U32)[1]! = x1 := rfl
theorem gl2 (x0 x1 x2 x3 : U32) : ([x0, x1, x2, x3] : List U32)[2]! = x2 := rfl
theorem gl3 (x0 x1 x2 x3 : U32) : ([x0, x1, x2, x3] : List U32)[3]! = x3 := rfl

theorem pm0 (v : Fin 4 → K) :
    R0P.poseidonMat4 v 0 = ((v 0 + v 1) + (v 2 + v 3) + v 1) + (v 0 + v 1) := rfl
theorem pm1 (v : Fin 4 → K) :
    R0P.poseidonMat4 v 1 = ((v 0 + v 1) + (v 2 + v 3) + v 1) + (v 2 + v 2) := rfl
theorem pm2 (v : Fin 4 → K) :
    R0P.poseidonMat4 v 2 = ((v 0 + v 1) + (v 2 + v 3) + v 3) + (v 2 + v 3) := rfl
theorem pm3 (v : Fin 4 → K) :
    R0P.poseidonMat4 v 3 = ((v 0 + v 1) + (v 2 + v 3) + v 3) + (v 0 + v 0) := rfl

theorem mat4_lift (a b c d : U32) (v : Fin 4 → K) (ha : liftU a = v 0) (hb : liftU b = v 1)
    (hc : liftU c = v 2) (hd : liftU d = v 3) :
    ∃ m, mat4 a b c d = ok m ∧
      liftU (m.val[0]!) = R0P.poseidonMat4 v 0 ∧ liftU (m.val[1]!) = R0P.poseidonMat4 v 1 ∧
      liftU (m.val[2]!) = R0P.poseidonMat4 v 2 ∧ liftU (m.val[3]!) = R0P.poseidonMat4 v 3 := by
  rw [mat4]
  simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok, remP]
  refine ⟨_, rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [mk4, gl0, liftmod, mat_r0, pm0, ← ha, ← hb, ← hc, ← hd]
    unfold liftU; push_cast; ring
  · rw [mk4, gl1, liftmod, mat_r1, pm1, ← ha, ← hb, ← hc, ← hd]
    unfold liftU; push_cast; ring
  · rw [mk4, gl2, liftmod, mat_r2, pm2, ← ha, ← hb, ← hc, ← hd]
    unfold liftU; push_cast; ring
  · rw [mk4, gl3, liftmod, mat_r3, pm3, ← ha, ← hb, ← hc, ← hd]
    unfold liftU; push_cast; ring

/-! ### Four consecutive writes -/

theorem set4 {n : Usize} (v : Array U32 n) (i0 i1 i2 i3 : Usize) (x0 x1 x2 x3 : U32) (b : Nat)
    (h0 : i0.val = b) (h1 : i1.val = b + 1) (h2 : i2.val = b + 2) (h3 : i3.val = b + 3)
    (hb : b + 3 < n.val) :
    ((((v.set i0 x0).set i1 x1).set i2 x2).set i3 x3).val[b]! = x0 ∧
    ((((v.set i0 x0).set i1 x1).set i2 x2).set i3 x3).val[b + 1]! = x1 ∧
    ((((v.set i0 x0).set i1 x1).set i2 x2).set i3 x3).val[b + 2]! = x2 ∧
    ((((v.set i0 x0).set i1 x1).set i2 x2).set i3 x3).val[b + 3]! = x3 ∧
    ∀ k, k < b → ((((v.set i0 x0).set i1 x1).set i2 x2).set i3 x3).val[k]! = v.val[k]! := by
  have e3 := set_get' (((v.set i0 x0).set i1 x1).set i2 x2) i3 x3 (by omega)
  have e2 := set_get' ((v.set i0 x0).set i1 x1) i2 x2 (by omega)
  have e1 := set_get' (v.set i0 x0) i1 x1 (by omega)
  have e0 := set_get' v i0 x0 (by omega)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, fun k hk => ?_⟩ <;>
    (rw [e3, e2, e1, e0, h0, h1, h2, h3]; split_ifs <;> first | rfl | omega)

/-! ### The S-box loop -/

theorem sbox_loop (s c : Array U32 16#usize) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (i : Usize) (out : Array U32 16#usize), i.val + n = 16 →
      ∃ o, sbox_full_loop s c out i = ok o ∧ ∀ k, k < 16 →
        (i.val ≤ k → liftU (K := K) (o.val[k]!) = R0P.poseidonPow5 (liftN s k + liftN c k)) ∧
        (k < i.val → o.val[k]! = out.val[k]!)
  | 0, i, out, h => by
      refine ⟨out, ?_, fun k hk => ⟨fun h' => absurd h' (by omega), fun _ => rfl⟩⟩
      rw [sbox_full_loop, if_neg (by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac)]
  | n + 1, i, out, h => by
      have hlt : i < 16#usize := by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac
      have hb : i.val < (16#usize).val := by rw [v16]; omega
      have hi1 : (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize).val = i.val + 1 := uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac)
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hzv⟩ := add_lift (K := K) (s.val[i.val]!) (c.val[i.val]!)
      obtain ⟨y, hy, hyv⟩ := pow5_lift (K := K) z
      obtain ⟨o, ho, hov⟩ := sbox_loop s c n (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize) (out.set i y)
        (by rw [hi1]; omega)
      refine ⟨o, ?_, fun k hk => ⟨fun hik => ?_, fun hki => ?_⟩⟩
      · rw [sbox_full_loop, if_pos hlt]
        simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok, index_ok s i hb, index_ok c i hb, hz, hy, update_ok out i y hb]
        exact ho
      · by_cases e : k = i.val
        · subst e
          rw [(hov i.val hk).2 (by rw [hi1]; omega), set_get' out i y hb i.val, if_pos rfl, hyv, hzv]
          rfl
        · exact (hov k hk).1 (by rw [hi1]; omega)
      · rw [(hov k hk).2 (by rw [hi1]; omega), set_get' out i y hb k, if_neg (by omega)]

/-! ### The external layer -/

theorem groups_loop (s : Array U32 16#usize) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (g : Usize) (out : Array U32 16#usize), g.val + n = 4 →
      ∃ o, ext_groups_loop s out g = ok o ∧
        (∀ (g' c : Nat) (hg : g' < 4) (hc : c < 4), g.val ≤ g' →
          liftU (K := K) (o.val[4 * g' + c]!) = PM s ⟨g', hg⟩ ⟨c, hc⟩) ∧
        (∀ k, k < 4 * g.val → o.val[k]! = out.val[k]!)
  | 0, g, out, h => by
      refine ⟨out, ?_, fun g' c hg hc h' => absurd h' (by omega), fun _ _ => rfl⟩
      rw [ext_groups_loop, if_neg (by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac)]
  | n + 1, g, out, h => by
      have hlt : g < 4#usize := by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac
      have h4 : (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize g).val = 4 * g.val := by
        rw [umul _ _ (by rw [v4]; omega), v4]
      have h1 : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize g) 1#usize).val = 4 * g.val + 1 := by
        rw [uadd _ _ (by rw [h4, z1]; omega), h4, z1]
      have h2 : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize g) 2#usize).val = 4 * g.val + 2 := by
        rw [uadd _ _ (by rw [h4, z2]; omega), h4, z2]
      have h3 : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize g) 3#usize).val = 4 * g.val + 3 := by
        rw [uadd _ _ (by rw [h4, z3]; omega), h4, z3]
      have hg1 : (Usize.wrapping_add g 1#usize).val = g.val + 1 := uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac)
      have hb0 : (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize g).val < (16#usize).val := by rw [h4, v16]; omega
      have hb1 : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize g) 1#usize).val < (16#usize).val := by
        rw [h1, v16]; omega
      have hb2 : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize g) 2#usize).val < (16#usize).val := by
        rw [h2, v16]; omega
      have hb3 : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize g) 3#usize).val < (16#usize).val := by
        rw [h3, v16]; omega
      obtain ⟨m, hm, hm0, hm1, hm2, hm3⟩ := mat4_lift (K := K)
        (s.val[(Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize g).val]!)
        (s.val[(Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize g) 1#usize).val]!)
        (s.val[(Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize g) 2#usize).val]!)
        (s.val[(Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize g) 3#usize).val]!)
        (fun lane : Fin 4 => liftN s (4 * g.val + lane.val))
        (by rw [h4]; rfl) (by rw [h1]; rfl) (by rw [h2]; rfl) (by rw [h3]; rfl)
      have S := set4 out (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize g)
        (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize g) 1#usize)
        (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize g) 2#usize)
        (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize g) 3#usize)
        (m.val[0]!) (m.val[1]!) (m.val[2]!) (m.val[3]!) (4 * g.val) h4 h1 h2 h3 (by rw [v16]; omega)
      obtain ⟨o, ho, hoG, hoF⟩ := groups_loop s n (Usize.wrapping_add g 1#usize)
        ((((out.set (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize g) (m.val[0]!)).set
          (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize g) 1#usize) (m.val[1]!)).set
          (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize g) 2#usize) (m.val[2]!)).set
          (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize g) 3#usize) (m.val[3]!))
        (by rw [hg1]; omega)
      refine ⟨o, ?_, fun g' c hg hc hle => ?_, fun k hk => ?_⟩
      · rw [ext_groups_loop, if_pos hlt]
        simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok, index_ok s _ hb0, index_ok s _ hb1, index_ok s _ hb2,
          index_ok s _ hb3, hm, index_ok m 0#usize (by rw [z0, v4]; omega),
          index_ok m 1#usize (by rw [z1, v4]; omega), index_ok m 2#usize (by rw [z2, v4]; omega),
          index_ok m 3#usize (by rw [z3, v4]; omega), update_ok _ _ _ hb0, update_ok _ _ _ hb1,
          update_ok _ _ _ hb2, update_ok _ _ _ hb3, z0, z1, z2, z3]
        exact ho
      · by_cases e : g' = g.val
        · subst e
          rw [hoF _ (by rw [hg1]; omega)]
          have hc' : c = 0 ∨ c = 1 ∨ c = 2 ∨ c = 3 := by omega
          rcases hc' with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
          · rw [show 4 * g.val + 0 = 4 * g.val from rfl, S.1]; exact hm0
          · rw [S.2.1]; exact hm1
          · rw [S.2.2.1]; exact hm2
          · rw [S.2.2.2.1]; exact hm3
        · exact hoG g' c hg hc (by rw [hg1]; omega)
      · rw [hoF k (by rw [hg1]; omega)]
        exact S.2.2.2.2 k hk

theorem sums_loop (gr : Array U32 16#usize) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (col : Usize) (sums : Array U32 4#usize), col.val + n = 4 →
      ∃ o, ext_sums_loop gr sums col = ok o ∧ ∀ c, c < 4 →
        (col.val ≤ c → liftU (K := K) (o.val[c]!) =
          liftN gr c + liftN gr (4 + c) + liftN gr (8 + c) + liftN gr (12 + c)) ∧
        (c < col.val → o.val[c]! = sums.val[c]!)
  | 0, col, sums, h => by
      refine ⟨sums, ?_, fun c hc => ⟨fun h' => absurd h' (by omega), fun _ => rfl⟩⟩
      rw [ext_sums_loop, if_neg (by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac)]
  | n + 1, col, sums, h => by
      have hlt : col < 4#usize := by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac
      have hb : col.val < (16#usize).val := by rw [v16]; omega
      have hbs : col.val < (4#usize).val := by rw [v4]; omega
      have hc4 : (Usize.wrapping_add 4#usize col).val = 4 + col.val := by
        rw [uadd _ _ (by rw [v4]; omega), v4]
      have hc8 : (Usize.wrapping_add 8#usize col).val = 8 + col.val := by
        rw [uadd _ _ (by rw [show (8#usize : Usize).val = 8 by simp]; omega),
          show (8#usize : Usize).val = 8 by simp]
      have hc12 : (Usize.wrapping_add 12#usize col).val = 12 + col.val := by
        rw [uadd _ _ (by rw [show (12#usize : Usize).val = 12 by simp]; omega),
          show (12#usize : Usize).val = 12 by simp]
      have hb4 : (Usize.wrapping_add 4#usize col).val < (16#usize).val := by rw [hc4, v16]; omega
      have hb8 : (Usize.wrapping_add 8#usize col).val < (16#usize).val := by rw [hc8, v16]; omega
      have hb12 : (Usize.wrapping_add 12#usize col).val < (16#usize).val := by rw [hc12, v16]; omega
      have hcol1 : (Usize.wrapping_add col 1#usize).val = col.val + 1 := uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac)
      have step : ∃ X : U32, ext_sums_loop gr sums col =
          ext_sums_loop gr (sums.set col X) (Usize.wrapping_add col 1#usize) ∧
          liftU (K := K) X = liftN gr col.val + liftN gr (4 + col.val) + liftN gr (8 + col.val) +
            liftN gr (12 + col.val) := by
        rw [ext_sums_loop, if_pos hlt]
        simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok, index_ok gr col hb, index_ok gr _ hb4, index_ok gr _ hb8,
          index_ok gr _ hb12, remP, update_ok sums col _ hbs]
        refine ⟨_, rfl, ?_⟩
        rw [liftmod, sum4_val, hc4, hc8, hc12]
        unfold liftN liftU
        push_cast
        rfl
      obtain ⟨X, hX, hXv⟩ := step
      have hs := set_get' sums col X hbs
      obtain ⟨o, ho, hov⟩ := sums_loop gr n (Usize.wrapping_add col 1#usize) (sums.set col X)
        (by rw [hcol1]; omega)
      refine ⟨o, by rw [hX]; exact ho, fun c hc => ⟨fun hle => ?_, fun hlt' => ?_⟩⟩
      · by_cases e : c = col.val
        · subst e
          rw [(hov col.val hc).2 (by rw [hcol1]; omega), hs, if_pos rfl]
          exact hXv
        · exact (hov c hc).1 (by rw [hcol1]; omega)
      · rw [(hov c hc).2 (by rw [hcol1]; omega), hs, if_neg (by omega)]

theorem add_loop (gr : Array U32 16#usize) (sums : Array U32 4#usize) :

R0Z.PoseidonCanon:
import R0Z.PoseidonRounds

/-! Canonical outputs of the Poseidon copy (DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL §12 (2)).

Every lane the copy's `perm_rounds` writes is below p: each is a
`cast (x % p)` (m31_add, internal lanes) of a u64 expression.  This is what
lets a computed digest be the right child of a node (node_pre adds the tweak to
lane 7 with a conditional subtraction).  Field-free: no K. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace R0Z.PoseidonRefine
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0PoseidonCopy R0Z.WriterRefine

theorem bind_ok_inv {α β : Type} {x : Result α} {f : α → Result β} {t : β}
    (h : (do let a ← x; f a) = ok t) : ∃ a, x = ok a ∧ f a = ok t := by
  cases x with
  | ok a => exact ⟨a, rfl, by simpa using h⟩
  | fail e => simp at h
  | div => simp at h

/-- All sixteen lanes below p. -/
def Canon (t : Array U32 16#usize) : Prop := ∀ k, k < 16 → (t.val[k]!).val < 2147483647

theorem add_canon (a b : U32) : ∃ z, m31_add a b = ok z ∧ z.val < 2147483647 := by
  rw [m31_add]
  simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok, remP]
  exact ⟨_, rfl, canon_mod _⟩

theorem add_loop_canon (gr : Array U32 16#usize) (sums : Array U32 4#usize) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (i : Usize) (out : Array U32 16#usize), i.val + n = 16 →
      (∀ k, k < i.val → (out.val[k]!).val < 2147483647) →
      ∀ o, ext_add_loop gr sums out i = ok o → Canon o
  | 0, i, out, h, hout, o, ho => by
      rw [ext_add_loop, if_neg (by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac)] at ho
      injection ho with e
      subst e
      exact fun k hk => hout k (by omega)
  | n + 1, i, out, h, hout, o, ho => by
      have hlt : i < 16#usize := by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac
      have hb : i.val < (16#usize).val := by rw [v16]; omega
      have hi1 : (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize).val = i.val + 1 := uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac)
      have hrb : (⟨BitVec.umod i.bv (4#usize : Usize).bv⟩ : Usize).val < (4#usize).val := by
        rw [umod_val, v4]; omega
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hzc⟩ := add_canon (gr.val[i.val]!)
        (sums.val[(⟨BitVec.umod i.bv (4#usize : Usize).bv⟩ : Usize).val]!)
      rw [ext_add_loop, if_pos hlt] at ho
      simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok, index_ok gr i hb, rem_ok i 4#usize (by rw [v4]; omega),
        index_ok sums _ hrb, hz, update_ok out i z hb] at ho
      refine add_loop_canon gr sums n _ _ (by rw [hi1]; omega) (fun k hk => ?_) o ho
      rw [hi1] at hk
      rw [set_get' out i z hb k]
      by_cases e : k = i.val
      · rw [if_pos e]; exact hzc
      · rw [if_neg e]; exact hout k (by omega)

theorem external_canon (s t : Array U32 16#usize) (h : external_linear s = ok t) : Canon t := by
  rw [external_linear] at h
  obtain ⟨gr, -, h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  obtain ⟨sm, -, h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  rw [ext_add] at h
  exact add_loop_canon gr sm 16 0#usize _ (by rw [z0]) (fun k hk => by rw [z0] at hk; omega) t h

theorem full_canon (s c t : Array U32 16#usize) (h : full_round s c = ok t) : Canon t := by
  rw [full_round] at h
  obtain ⟨a, -, h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  exact external_canon a t h

theorem lin_loop_canon (s : Array U32 16#usize) (shifts : Array U32 15#usize) (full : U32) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (i : Usize) (out : Array U32 16#usize), i.val + n = 16 → 1 ≤ i.val →
      (∀ k, k < i.val → (out.val[k]!).val < 2147483647) →
      ∀ o, internal_linear_loop s shifts full out i = ok o → Canon o
  | 0, i, out, h, _, hout, o, ho => by
      rw [internal_linear_loop, if_neg (by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac)] at ho
      injection ho with e
      subst e
      exact fun k hk => hout k (by omega)
  | n + 1, i, out, h, h1, hout, o, ho => by
      have hlt : i < 16#usize := by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac
      have hb : i.val < (16#usize).val := by rw [v16]; omega
      have hi1 : (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize).val = i.val + 1 := uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac)
      have hsub : (Usize.wrapping_sub i 1#usize).val = i.val - 1 := by
        rw [usub _ _ (by rw [z1]; omega), z1]
      have hsb' : (Usize.wrapping_sub i 1#usize).val < (15#usize).val := by rw [hsub, v15]; omega
      rw [internal_linear_loop, if_pos hlt] at ho
      simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok, index_ok s i hb, index_ok shifts _ hsb', remP,
        update_ok out i _ hb] at ho
      refine lin_loop_canon s shifts full n _ _ (by rw [hi1]; omega) (by rw [hi1]; omega) ?_ o ho
      intro k hk
      rw [hi1] at hk
      rw [set_get' out i _ hb k]
      by_cases e : k = i.val
      · rw [if_pos e]; exact canon_mod _
      · rw [if_neg e]; exact hout k (by omega)

theorem internal_linear_canon (s : Array U32 16#usize) (shifts : Array U32 15#usize) (t : Array U32 16#usize)
    (h : internal_linear s shifts = ok t) : Canon t := by
  have hb0 : (0#usize : Usize).val < (16#usize).val := by rw [z0, v16]; omega
  rw [internal_linear] at h
  obtain ⟨part, -, h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  rw [index_ok s 0#usize hb0] at h
  simp only [bind_tc_ok] at h
  obtain ⟨full, -, h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok, remP, update_ok _ 0#usize _ hb0] at h
  refine lin_loop_canon s shifts full 15 1#usize _ (by rw [z1]) (le_of_eq z1.symm) ?_ t h
  intro k hk
  rw [z1] at hk
  obtain rfl : k = 0 := by omega
  rw [set_get' _ 0#usize _ hb0 0, z0, if_pos rfl]
  exact canon_mod _

theorem internal_round_canon (s : Array U32 16#usize) (c0 : U32) (shifts : Array U32 15#usize)
    (t : Array U32 16#usize) (h : internal_round s c0 shifts = ok t) : Canon t := by
  have hb0 : (0#usize : Usize).val < (16#usize).val := by rw [z0, v16]; omega
  rw [internal_round, index_ok s 0#usize hb0] at h
  simp only [bind_tc_ok] at h
  obtain ⟨z, -, h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  obtain ⟨y, -, h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  rw [update_ok s 0#usize y hb0] at h
  simp only [bind_tc_ok] at h
  exact internal_linear_canon _ _ _ h

theorem apply_round_canon (s : Array U32 16#usize) (round : Usize) (t : Array U32 16#usize)
    (h : apply_round s round = ok t) : Canon t := by
  rw [apply_round] at h
  split_ifs at h
  · obtain ⟨a, -, h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
    exact full_canon _ _ _ h
  · simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok] at h
    obtain ⟨c, -, h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
    exact internal_round_canon _ _ _ _ h
  · simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok] at h
    obtain ⟨c, -, h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
    exact full_canon _ _ _ h

theorem leading_canon (pre absorb c0 c1 t : Array U32 16#usize) (h : leading_pair pre absorb c0 c1 = ok t) :
    Canon t := by
  rw [leading_pair] at h
  obtain ⟨a, -, h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  obtain ⟨s, -, h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  obtain ⟨a1, -, h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  exact full_canon _ _ _ h

theorem perm_loop_canon :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (k : Usize) (rounds : Array (Array U32 16#usize) 11#usize) (state : Array U32 16#usize),
      k.val + n = 11 → (∀ r, r < k.val → Canon (rounds.val[r]!)) →
      ∀ out, perm_rounds_loop rounds state k = ok out → ∀ r, r < 11 → Canon (out.val[r]!)
  | 0, k, rounds, state, h, hinv, out, ho => by
      rw [perm_rounds_loop, if_neg (by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac)] at ho
      injection ho with e
      subst e
      exact fun r hr => hinv r (by omega)
  | n + 1, k, rounds, state, h, hinv, out, ho => by
      have hlt : k < 11#usize := by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac
      have hkb : k.val < (11#usize).val := by rw [v11]; omega
      have hkk : (Usize.wrapping_add k 1#usize).val = k.val + 1 := uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac)
      rw [perm_rounds_loop, if_pos hlt] at ho
      simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok] at ho
      obtain ⟨a, -, ho⟩ := bind_ok_inv ho
      obtain ⟨s1, hs1, ho⟩ := bind_ok_inv ho
      rw [update_ok_a rounds k s1 hkb] at ho
      simp only [bind_tc_ok] at ho
      refine perm_loop_canon n _ _ _ (by rw [hkk]; omega) (fun r hr => ?_) out ho
      rw [hkk] at hr
      rw [set_get_a rounds k s1 hkb r]
      by_cases e : r = k.val
      · rw [if_pos e]; exact apply_round_canon _ _ _ hs1
      · rw [if_neg e]; exact hinv r (by omega)

/-- Every row of the copy's perm_rounds output is canonical. -/
theorem perm_canon (pre absorb : Array U32 16#usize) (rounds : Array (Array U32 16#usize) 11#usize)
    (h : perm_rounds pre absorb = ok rounds) : ∀ r, r < 11 → Canon (rounds.val[r]!) := by
  have hb0 : (0#usize : Usize).val < (4#usize).val := by rw [z0, v4]; omega
  have hb1 : (1#usize : Usize).val < (4#usize).val := by rw [z1, v4]; omega
  have hb11 : (0#usize : Usize).val < (11#usize).val := by rw [z0, v11]; omega
  rw [perm_rounds] at h
  simp only [index_ok_gen EXTERNAL_INITIAL 0#usize hb0, index_ok_gen EXTERNAL_INITIAL 1#usize hb1,
    bind_tc_ok] at h
  obtain ⟨st, hst, h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  rw [update_ok_a _ 0#usize st hb11] at h
  simp only [bind_tc_ok] at h
  refine perm_loop_canon 10 1#usize _ st (by rw [z1]) (fun r hr => ?_) rounds h
  rw [z1] at hr
  obtain rfl : r = 0 := by omega
  rw [set_get_a _ 0#usize st hb11 0, z0, if_pos rfl]
  exact leading_canon _ _ _ _ _ hst

end R0Z.PoseidonRefine

R0Z.WriterRefineAuxBlock:
import R0Z.WriterRefineValueModel

/-! The extracted aux-block writer (value aux + both occupancy rows) computes
block 63 of the model (rows 1008..1023), cell by cell (DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL §9). -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace R0Z.WriterRefine
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0WriterCopies

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

theorem aux_block_model [CharP K 0x7fffffff] (values : Array U32 3#usize) (input output : OccRecord)
    (C : R0Z.BuilderModel.Cells K) (hv : ValueLifts values C) (hi : OccLifts input C.inOcc)
    (ho : OccLifts output C.outOcc) :
    ∃ b, write_aux_block values input output = ok b ∧
      ∀ (r c : Fin 16), liftU (K := K) (b.val[r.val * 16 + c.val]!) =
        R0Z.BuilderModel.auxCell C (1008 + r.val) c := by
  obtain ⟨b0, hb0, hs0⟩ := value_block values hv.small
  have n9 : (9#usize : Usize).val = 9 := by simp
  have n10 : (10#usize : Usize).val = 10 := by simp
  obtain ⟨b1, hb1, hr1, hu1⟩ := occ_row_model b0 9#usize (by rw [n9]; omega) input C.inOcc hi
    (fun c hc => by rw [n9]; exact value_rows_zero values b0 hs0 9 (Or.inl rfl) c hc)
  obtain ⟨b2, hb2, hr2, hu2⟩ := occ_row_model b1 10#usize (by rw [n10]; omega) output C.outOcc ho
    (fun c hc => by
      rw [n10, hu1 _ (by rw [n9]; omega)]
      exact value_rows_zero values b0 hs0 10 (Or.inr rfl) c hc)
  refine ⟨b2, ?_, fun r c => ?_⟩
  · rw [write_aux_block, hb0]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [hb1]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    exact hb2
  · have hc := c.isLt
    by_cases e10 : r.val = 10
    · have := hr2 c
      rw [n10] at this
      rw [e10, this, show (1008 + 10 : Nat) = 1018 by norm_num, R0Z.BuilderModel.aux_1018]
    rw [hu2 _ (by rw [n10]; omega)]
    by_cases e9 : r.val = 9
    · have := hr1 c
      rw [n9] at this
      rw [e9, this, show (1008 + 9 : Nat) = 1017 by norm_num, R0Z.BuilderModel.aux_1017]
    rw [hu1 _ (by rw [n9]; omega)]
    have hr := r.isLt
    obtain ⟨rv, hrv⟩ : ∃ rv, r.val = rv := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [hrv]

/-! The extracted value-aux writer computes the model's value rows
(DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL §9): `write_value_block values` returns `ok b` and every
lifted cell of block 63 outside the occupancy rows 9 and 10 equals the model's
`auxCell C (1008 + r) c`, for a characteristic-(2^31−1) field and values below
2^30 equal to the model's `C.values`; rows 9 and 10 are zero. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace R0Z.WriterRefine
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0WriterCopies

theorem m31_sub_spec (a b : U32) (ha : a.val < 2 ^ 30) (hb : b.val < 2 ^ 30) :
    ∃ z, m31_sub a b = ok z ∧ z.val = (if b.val ≤ a.val then a.val - b.val else a.val + 2147483647 - b.val) := by
  have hP : (P : U32).val = 2147483647 := by rw [P]; simp
  have h1 : (U32.wrapping_add a P).val = a.val + 2147483647 := by
    rw [U32.wrapping_add_val_eq, hP]; exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by rw [UScalar.size_def]; simp; omega)
  have h2 : (U32.wrapping_sub (U32.wrapping_add a P) b).val = a.val + 2147483647 - b.val := by
    rw [U32.wrapping_sub_val_eq, h1, UScalar.size_def]
    simp only [show UScalarTy.U32.numBits = 32 from rfl]
    rw [show a.val + 2147483647 + (2 ^ 32 - b.val) = (a.val + 2147483647 - b.val) + 2 ^ 32 by omega,
      Nat.add_mod_right]
    exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)
  rw [m31_sub]
  simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok]
  by_cases hs : U32.wrapping_sub (U32.wrapping_add a P) b >= P
  · rw [if_pos hs]
    have hs' : 2147483647 ≤ a.val + 2147483647 - b.val := by
      rw [ge_iff_le, UScalar.le_equiv, hP, h2] at hs; exact hs
    refine ⟨_, rfl, ?_⟩
    rw [U32.wrapping_sub_val_eq, h2, hP, UScalar.size_def]
    simp only [show UScalarTy.U32.numBits = 32 from rfl]
    rw [if_pos (by omega)]
    rw [show a.val + 2147483647 - b.val + (2 ^ 32 - 2147483647) = (a.val - b.val) + 2 ^ 32 by omega,
      Nat.add_mod_right]
    exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)
  · rw [if_neg hs]
    have hs' : ¬ 2147483647 ≤ a.val + 2147483647 - b.val := by
      rw [ge_iff_le, UScalar.le_equiv, hP, h2] at hs; exact hs
    exact ⟨_, rfl, by rw [h2, if_neg (by omega)]⟩

/-- The cells of the value block (rows 6 and 7 hold the conservation cells). -/
def FinalVal (vals : Nat → Nat) (k : Nat) : Nat :=
  if k = 96 then vals 0 else if k = 97 then vals 1
  else if k = 98 ∨ k = 112 then (if vals 1 ≤ vals 0 then vals 0 - vals 1 else vals 0 + 2147483647 - vals 1)
  else if k = 113 then vals 2 else OuterVal vals 0 (fun _ => 0) k

theorem value_block (values : Array U32 3#usize) (hv : ∀ i, i < 3 → (values.val[i]!).val < 2 ^ 30) :
    ∃ b, write_value_block values = ok b ∧
      ∀ k, (b.val[k]!).val = FinalVal (fun i => (values.val[i]!).val) k := by
  obtain ⟨b1, hb1, hs1⟩ := value_outer values 3 0#usize (Array.repeat 256#usize 0#u32) (by simp)
  have h0 : (0#usize : Usize).val < (3#usize).val := by simp
  have h1 : (1#usize : Usize).val < (3#usize).val := by simp
  have h2 : (2#usize : Usize).val < (3#usize).val := by simp
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzv⟩ := m31_sub_spec (values.val[(0#usize : Usize).val]!) (values.val[(1#usize : Usize).val]!)
    (hv 0 (by simp)) (hv 1 (by simp))
  have e96 : (Usize.wrapping_mul 6#usize 16#usize).val = 96 := by rw [umul _ _ (by simp)]; simp
  have e97 : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 6#usize 16#usize) 1#usize).val = 97 := by
    rw [uadd _ _ (by rw [e96]; simp), e96]; simp
  have e98 : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 6#usize 16#usize) 2#usize).val = 98 := by
    rw [uadd _ _ (by rw [e96]; simp), e96]; simp
  have e112 : (Usize.wrapping_mul 7#usize 16#usize).val = 112 := by rw [umul _ _ (by simp)]; simp
  have e113 : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 7#usize 16#usize) 1#usize).val = 113 := by
    rw [uadd _ _ (by rw [e112]; simp), e112]; simp
  have lt : ∀ (i : Usize) (n : Nat), i.val = n → n < 256 → i.val < (256#usize).val := by
    intro i n h hn; rw [h]; simpa using hn
  let v0 := values.val[(0#usize : Usize).val]!
  let v1 := values.val[(1#usize : Usize).val]!
  let v2 := values.val[(2#usize : Usize).val]!
  let c1 := b1.set (Usize.wrapping_mul 6#usize 16#usize) v0
  let c2 := c1.set (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 6#usize 16#usize) 1#usize) v1
  let c3 := c2.set (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 6#usize 16#usize) 2#usize) z
  let c4 := c3.set (Usize.wrapping_mul 7#usize 16#usize) z
  let c5 := c4.set (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 7#usize 16#usize) 1#usize) v2
  refine ⟨c5, ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
  · rw [write_value_block]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
    rw [hb1]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [index_ok values _ h0, index_ok values _ h1]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [hz]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [update_ok _ _ _ (lt _ _ e96 (by omega))]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [update_ok _ _ _ (lt _ _ e97 (by omega))]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [update_ok _ _ _ (lt _ _ e98 (by omega))]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [update_ok _ _ _ (lt _ _ e112 (by omega))]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [index_ok values _ h2]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [update_ok _ _ _ (lt _ _ e113 (by omega))]
  · show (c5.val[k]!).val = _
    rw [set_get' c4 _ _ (lt _ _ e113 (by omega)), e113, set_get' c3 _ _ (lt _ _ e112 (by omega)), e112,
      set_get' c2 _ _ (lt _ _ e98 (by omega)), e98, set_get' c1 _ _ (lt _ _ e97 (by omega)), e97,
      set_get' b1 _ _ (lt _ _ e96 (by omega)), e96]
    unfold FinalVal
    have hrep : ∀ k : Nat, (((Array.repeat 256#usize 0#u32 : Array U32 256#usize).val[k]! : U32)).val = 0 := by
      intro k
      rw [Array.repeat_val]
      by_cases hk : k < (256#usize : Usize).val
      · rw [List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_replicate, if_pos hk]; rfl
      · rw [List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_replicate, if_neg hk]; rfl
    by_cases a113 : k = 113
    · rw [if_pos a113, if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_pos a113]
      try simp [v0, v1, v2]
    rw [if_neg a113]
    by_cases a112 : k = 112
    · rw [if_pos a112, if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_pos (Or.inr a112), hzv]
      try simp [v0, v1, v2]
    rw [if_neg a112]
    by_cases a98 : k = 98
    · rw [if_pos a98, if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_pos (Or.inl a98), hzv]
      try simp [v0, v1, v2]
    rw [if_neg a98]
    by_cases a97 : k = 97
    · rw [if_pos a97, if_neg (by omega), if_pos a97]
      try simp [v0, v1, v2]
    rw [if_neg a97]
    by_cases a96 : k = 96
    · rw [if_pos a96, if_pos a96]
      try simp [v0, v1, v2]
    rw [if_neg a96, if_neg a96, if_neg a97, if_neg (by omega), if_neg a113, hs1 k]
    simp only [show (0#usize : Usize).val = 0 by simp, hrep]

/-! ### Against the model's aux rows -/

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

theorem tOf_rc (b r c : Nat) (hc : c < 16) :
    tOf b (r * 16 + c) = if r = b then c else if r = b + 1 then 10 + c else 20 + c := by
  unfold tOf
  rw [show (r * 16 + c) / 16 = r by omega, show (r * 16 + c) % 16 = c by omega]

theorem ov_rc (vals : Nat → Nat) (r c : Nat) (hc : c < 16) :
    OuterVal vals 0 (fun _ => 0) (r * 16 + c) =
      if jOf r < 3 then (if c < 10 then vals (jOf r) / 2 ^ tOf (2 * jOf r) (r * 16 + c) % 2
        else if c = 10 ∧ r = 2 * jOf r then vals (jOf r) else 0) else 0 := by
  unfold OuterVal
  rw [show (r * 16 + c) / 16 = r by omega, show (r * 16 + c) % 16 = c by omega]
  by_cases h : jOf r < 3
  · rw [if_pos ⟨h, Nat.zero_le _⟩, if_pos h]
  · rw [if_neg (fun h' => h h'.1), if_neg h]

/-- The model rows the value writer fills, and their premises. -/
structure ValueLifts (values : Array U32 3#usize) (C : R0Z.BuilderModel.Cells K) : Prop where
  small : ∀ i, i < 3 → (values.val[i]!).val < 2 ^ 30
  eq : ∀ i : Fin 3, C.values i = (values.val[i.val]!).val

theorem liftU_nat (x : U32) (n : Nat) (h : x.val = n) : liftU (K := K) x = (n : K) := by
  unfold liftU; rw [h]

theorem m31_lift_sub [CharP K 0x7fffffff] (a b : Nat) (ha : a < 2 ^ 30) (hb : b < 2 ^ 30) :
    (((if b ≤ a then a - b else a + 2147483647 - b : Nat)) : K) = (a : K) - (b : K) := by
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [Nat.cast_sub h]
  · rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega), Nat.cast_add, CharP.cast_eq_zero K 0x7fffffff]
    ring

theorem value_rows_zero (values : Array U32 3#usize) (b : Array U32 256#usize)
    (hb : ∀ k, (b.val[k]!).val = FinalVal (fun i => (values.val[i]!).val) k) (r : Nat) (hr : r = 9 ∨ r = 10)
    (c : Nat) (hc : c < 16) : (b.val[r * 16 + c]!).val = 0 := by
  rw [hb]
  unfold FinalVal
  rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), ov_rc _ _ _ hc]
  rcases hr with rfl | rfl
  · rw [show jOf 9 = 3 by decide, if_neg (by norm_num)]
  · rw [show jOf 10 = 3 by decide, if_neg (by norm_num)]

theorem value_row_0 [CharP K 0x7fffffff] (values : Array U32 3#usize) (C : R0Z.BuilderModel.Cells K)
    (hl : ValueLifts values C) (b : Array U32 256#usize)
    (hb : ∀ k, (b.val[k]!).val = FinalVal (fun i => (values.val[i]!).val) k) (c : Fin 16) :
    liftU (K := K) (b.val[0 * 16 + c.val]!) = R0Z.BuilderModel.auxCell C (1008 + 0) c := by
  have hc := c.isLt
  rw [liftU_nat _ _ (hb _)]
  unfold FinalVal
  rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), ov_rc _ _ _ hc,
    show jOf 0 = 0 by decide, if_pos (by norm_num), tOf_rc _ _ _ hc]
  rw [show (1008 + 0 : Nat) = 1008 by norm_num, R0Z.BuilderModel.aux_1008]
  unfold R0Z.BuilderModel.valueBaseCell
  rw [hl.eq 0]
  by_cases c10 : c.val < 10
  · rw [if_pos c10, if_pos c10, if_pos (by norm_num)]; rfl
  · rw [if_neg c10, if_neg c10]
    by_cases e : c.val = 10
    · rw [if_pos ⟨e, by norm_num⟩, if_pos e]; rfl
    · rw [if_neg (fun h => e h.1), if_neg e]; simp

/-! The extracted value-aux writer, outer loop over the three values
(DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL §9). -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace R0Z.WriterRefine
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0WriterCopies

/-- Which value (0, 1, 2) owns local row r; 3 = none. -/
def jOf (r : Nat) : Nat :=
  if r = 0 then 0 else if r = 1 then 0 else if r = 12 then 0
  else if r = 2 then 1 else if r = 3 then 1 else if r = 14 then 1
  else if r = 4 then 2 else if r = 5 then 2 else if r = 8 then 2 else 3

/-- The value cells written by values j0..2 over a block `blk`. -/
def OuterVal (vals : Nat → Nat) (j0 : Nat) (blk : Nat → Nat) (k : Nat) : Nat :=
  if jOf (k / 16) < 3 ∧ j0 ≤ jOf (k / 16) then
    (if k % 16 < 10 then vals (jOf (k / 16)) / 2 ^ tOf (2 * jOf (k / 16)) k % 2
     else if k % 16 = 10 ∧ k / 16 = 2 * jOf (k / 16) then vals (jOf (k / 16)) else blk k)
  else blk k

theorem rowJ (j r : Nat) (hj : j < 3) :
    (r = 2 * j ∨ r = 2 * j + 1 ∨ r = xr (2 * j)) ↔ jOf r = j := by
  by_cases hr : r < 15
  · interval_cases r <;> interval_cases j <;> decide
  · have h3 : jOf r = 3 := by
      unfold jOf
      rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega),
        if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega)]
    have hx : xr (2 * j) ≤ 14 := by unfold xr; split_ifs <;> omega
    rw [h3]
    constructor
    · intro h; omega
    · intro h; omega

theorem inRows_iff (j k : Nat) (hj : j < 3) :
    InRows (2 * j) k ↔ jOf (k / 16) = j ∧ k % 16 < 10 := by
  unfold InRows
  rw [rowJ j (k / 16) hj]

theorem jOf_base (j : Nat) (hj : j < 3) : jOf (2 * j) = j := by
  unfold jOf; interval_cases j <;> rfl

theorem value_outer (values : Array U32 3#usize) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (j : Usize) (block : Array U32 256#usize), j.val + n = 3 →
      ∃ b', write_value_block_loop0 values block j = ok b' ∧
        ∀ k, (b'.val[k]!).val =
          OuterVal (fun i => (values.val[i]!).val) j.val (fun k => (block.val[k]!).val) k
  | 0, j, block, h => by
      refine ⟨block, ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
      · rw [write_value_block_loop0, if_neg (by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac)]
      · unfold OuterVal; rw [if_neg (by omega)]
  | n + 1, j, block, h => by
      have hj3 : j.val < 3 := by omega
      have hlt : j < 3#usize := by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac
      have h2j : (Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize j).val = 2 * j.val := umul _ _ (by simp; omega)
      have hbase : (Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize j).val = 0 ∨ (Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize j).val = 2 ∨
          (Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize j).val = 4 := by rw [h2j]; omega
      have h16 : (Usize.wrapping_mul (Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize j) 16#usize).val = 2 * j.val * 16 :=
        by rw [umul _ _ (by rw [h2j]; simp; omega), h2j]; simp
      have h10 : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul (Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize j) 16#usize)
          10#usize).val = 2 * j.val * 16 + 10 := by rw [uadd _ _ (by rw [h16]; simp; omega), h16]; simp
      have hj1 : (Usize.wrapping_add j 1#usize).val = j.val + 1 := uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac)
      have hi10 : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul (Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize j) 16#usize)
          10#usize).val < (256#usize).val := by rw [h10]; simp; omega
      let raw := values.val[j.val]!
      obtain ⟨b1, hb1, hs1⟩ := value_inner raw (Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize j) hbase 30 0#u32 block
        (by simp)
      obtain ⟨b', hb', hs⟩ := value_outer values n (Usize.wrapping_add j 1#usize)
        (b1.set (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul (Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize j) 16#usize)
          10#usize) raw) (by rw [hj1]; omega)
      refine ⟨b', ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
      · rw [write_value_block_loop0, if_pos hlt, index_ok values j (by simpa using hj3)]
        simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
        rw [hb1]
        simp only [bind_tc_ok]
        rw [update_ok b1 _ _ hi10]
        simp only [bind_tc_ok]
        exact hb'
      · have ha : ∀ k, ((b1.set (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul (Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize j)
            16#usize) 10#usize) raw).val[k]!).val = (if k = 2 * j.val * 16 + 10 then raw.val else
            (if InRows (2 * j.val) k then raw.val / 2 ^ tOf (2 * j.val) k % 2 else (block.val[k]!).val)) := by
          intro k
          rw [set_get' b1 _ _ hi10 k, h10]
          split
          · rfl
          · rw [hs1 k, h2j]
            simp only [show (0#u32 : U32).val = 0 by simp, Nat.zero_le, and_true]
        rw [hs k, hj1]
        unfold OuterVal
        simp only [ha]
        have f1 := inRows_iff j.val k hj3
        have hraw : raw.val = (values.val[j.val]!).val := rfl
        simp only [f1, hraw]
        by_cases hk : jOf (k / 16) = j.val
        · simp only [hk, true_and, le_refl, and_true]
          split_ifs <;> first | rfl | omega
        · have nk : ¬ k = 2 * j.val * 16 + 10 := by
            intro e; apply hk; rw [e, show (2 * j.val * 16 + 10) / 16 = 2 * j.val by omega]
            exact jOf_base _ hj3
          simp only [hk, nk, false_and, if_false]
          split_ifs <;> first | rfl | omega

#print axioms inRows_iff
#print axioms value_outer

/-! The extracted value-aux writer, inner bit loop (copy of pair_trace.rs:401-437;
DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL §9).  For a base local row b ∈ {0, 2, 4}, bits 0..9 go to
row b, bits 10..19 to row b+1 and bits 20..29 to row b xor 12, column t mod 10. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace R0Z.WriterRefine
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0WriterCopies

/-- base xor 12 for the three value bases. -/
def xr (b : Nat) : Nat := if b = 0 then 12 else if b = 2 then 14 else 8

/-- The bit index stored at flat cell k of the value rows of base b. -/
def tOf (b k : Nat) : Nat := if k / 16 = b then k % 16 else if k / 16 = b + 1 then 10 + k % 16 else 20 + k % 16

/-- Flat cell k belongs to the bit cells of base b. -/
def InRows (b k : Nat) : Prop := (k / 16 = b ∨ k / 16 = b + 1 ∨ k / 16 = xr b) ∧ k % 16 < 10

instance (b k : Nat) : Decidable (InRows b k) := by unfold InRows; infer_instance

/-- The flat cell where the writer stores bit t of base b. -/
def vidx (b t : Nat) : Nat := (if t < 10 then b else if t < 20 then b + 1 else xr b) * 16 + t % 10

theorem shr_val (x s : U32) (hs : s.val < 32) : (U32.wrapping_shr x s).val = x.val / 2 ^ s.val := by
  show (x.bv >>> (s.val % 32)).toNat = _
  rw [BitVec.toNat_ushiftRight, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hs, Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]
  rfl

theorem bit_val (x s : U32) (hs : s.val < 32) :
    (U32.wrapping_shr x s &&& 1#u32).val = x.val / 2 ^ s.val % 2 := by
  rw [UScalar.val_and, shr_val x s hs, show (1#u32 : U32).val = 1 by simp, Nat.and_one_is_mod]

theorem xor12 (b : Usize) (hb : b.val = 0 ∨ b.val = 2 ∨ b.val = 4) :
    (b ^^^ 12#usize).val = xr b.val := by
  rw [UScalar.val_xor, show (12#usize : Usize).val = 12 by simp]
  rcases hb with h | h | h <;> rw [h] <;> decide

theorem rows_facts (b t k : Nat) (hb : b = 0 ∨ b = 2 ∨ b = 4) (ht : t < 30) :
    InRows b (vidx b t) ∧ tOf b (vidx b t) = t ∧
      (InRows b k → tOf b k = t → k = vidx b t) := by
  unfold InRows tOf vidx xr
  rcases hb with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> split_ifs <;> omega

theorem value_inner (raw : U32) (base : Usize) (hb : base.val = 0 ∨ base.val = 2 ∨ base.val = 4) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (bit : U32) (block : Array U32 256#usize), bit.val + n = 30 →
      ∃ b', write_value_block_loop0_loop0 block raw base bit = ok b' ∧
        ∀ k, (b'.val[k]!).val = if InRows base.val k ∧ bit.val ≤ tOf base.val k
          then raw.val / 2 ^ tOf base.val k % 2 else (block.val[k]!).val
  | 0, bit, block, h => by
      refine ⟨block, ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
      · rw [write_value_block_loop0_loop0, if_neg (by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac)]
      · have : ¬ (InRows base.val k ∧ bit.val ≤ tOf base.val k) := by
          unfold InRows tOf xr; rcases hb with e | e | e <;> rw [e] <;> split_ifs <;> omega
        rw [if_neg this]
  | n + 1, bit, block, h => by
      have hlt : bit < 30#u32 := by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; scalar_tac
      have hbit : bit.val < 30 := by omega
      obtain ⟨m, hm, hmv⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (UScalar.rem_spec bit (y := 10#u32) (by simp))
      have hmv' : m.val = bit.val % 10 := by rw [hmv]; simp
      have hb1 : (Usize.wrapping_add base 1#usize).val = base.val + 1 := uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac)
      have hx := xor12 base hb
      have hcast : (UScalar.cast .Usize m).val = bit.val % 10 := by
        rw [UScalar.cast_val_eq, hmv']
        exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le (by omega : bit.val % 10 < 2 ^ 32)
          (by rw [← UScalar.size_def]; exact usize_size_ge))
      have hbit1 : (U32.wrapping_add bit 1#u32).val = bit.val + 1 := by
        rw [U32.wrapping_add_val_eq]; exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by rw [UScalar.size_def]; simp; omega)
      -- the step, for any row value with the right value
      have step : ∀ row : Usize, row.val = (if bit.val < 10 then base.val else if bit.val < 20 then
            base.val + 1 else xr base.val) →
          ∃ b', (do
            let i ← lift (U32.wrapping_shr raw bit)
            let i1 ← lift (Usize.wrapping_mul row 16#usize)
            let i2 ← bit % 10#u32
            let i3 ← lift (UScalar.cast .Usize i2)
            let i4 ← lift (Usize.wrapping_add i1 i3)
            let i5 ← lift (i &&& 1#u32)
            let a ← Array.update block i4 i5
            let bit1 ← lift (U32.wrapping_add bit 1#u32)
            write_value_block_loop0_loop0 a raw base bit1) = ok b' ∧
            ∀ k, (b'.val[k]!).val = if InRows base.val k ∧ bit.val ≤ tOf base.val k
              then raw.val / 2 ^ tOf base.val k % 2 else (block.val[k]!).val := by
        intro row hrow
        have hrow' : row.val ≤ 14 := by
          rw [hrow]; unfold xr; rcases hb with e | e | e <;> rw [e] <;> split_ifs <;> omega
        have h16 : (Usize.wrapping_mul row 16#usize).val = row.val * 16 := umul _ _ (by simp; omega)
        have hidx : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul row 16#usize) (UScalar.cast .Usize m)).val =
            vidx base.val bit.val := by
          rw [uadd _ _ (by rw [h16, hcast]; omega), h16, hcast, hrow]; rfl
        have hi : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul row 16#usize) (UScalar.cast .Usize m)).val <
            (256#usize).val := by
          rw [hidx]; simp; unfold vidx xr; rcases hb with e | e | e <;> rw [e] <;> split_ifs <;> omega
        let v := U32.wrapping_shr raw bit &&& 1#u32
        obtain ⟨b', hb', hs⟩ := value_inner raw base hb n (U32.wrapping_add bit 1#u32)
          (block.set (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul row 16#usize) (UScalar.cast .Usize m)) v)
          (by rw [hbit1]; omega)
        refine ⟨b', ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
        · simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok]
          rw [hm]
          simp only [bind_tc_ok]
          rw [update_ok block _ _ hi]
          simp only [bind_tc_ok]
          exact hb'
        · rw [hs k, hbit1, set_get' block _ _ hi k, hidx]
          obtain ⟨r1, r2, r3⟩ := rows_facts base.val bit.val k
            (by rcases hb with e | e | e <;> simp [e]) hbit
          by_cases e : k = vidx base.val bit.val
          · subst e
            rw [if_neg (by omega), if_pos rfl, if_pos ⟨r1, by omega⟩, r2]
            exact bit_val raw bit (by omega)
          · rw [if_neg e]
            by_cases c : InRows base.val k ∧ bit.val + 1 ≤ tOf base.val k
            · rw [if_pos c, if_pos ⟨c.1, by omega⟩]
            · have : ¬ (InRows base.val k ∧ bit.val ≤ tOf base.val k) := by
                rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
                exact c ⟨h1, by
                  by_contra hc
                  exact e (r3 h1 (by omega))⟩
              rw [if_neg c, if_neg this]
      rw [write_value_block_loop0_loop0, if_pos hlt]
      by_cases t1 : bit < 10#u32
      · rw [if_pos t1]
        simp only [bind_tc_ok]
        exact step base (by rw [if_pos (by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv] at t1; simpa using t1)])
      · rw [if_neg t1]
        have t1' : ¬ bit.val < 10 := by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv] at t1; simpa using t1
        by_cases t2 : bit < 20#u32
        · rw [if_pos t2]
          simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
          exact step _ (by rw [hb1, if_neg t1', if_pos (by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv] at t2; simpa using t2)])
        · rw [if_neg t2]
          have t2' : ¬ bit.val < 20 := by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv] at t2; simpa using t2
          simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
          exact step _ (by rw [hx, if_neg t1', if_neg t2'])

/-! The extracted bank merge (copy of pair_forest_trace.rs:281-314;
DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL §9).  `merge_copy` takes rows 544..863 from the late bank
and every other row from the stable bank; `merge_check` is true exactly when
the stable bank is zero on rows 544..863 and the late bank is zero elsewhere.
`merge_model`: if the banks are the model's cells split by row range, the
check passes and the merge is the model's column-major cell table. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

namespace R0Z.WriterRefine
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0WriterCopies
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

theorem trace_cells : ∃ t : Usize, TRACE_CELLS = ok t ∧ t.val = 16384 := by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hv⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Usize.mul_spec (x := 16#usize) (y := 1024#usize) (by scalar_tac))
  refine ⟨t, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [TRACE_CELLS]; exact ht
  · rw [hv]; simp

/-- Rows 544..863 (the late bank) of the column-major flat index k. -/
def LateRow (k : Nat) : Prop := 544 ≤ k % 1024 ∧ k % 1024 < 864

instance (k : Nat) : Decidable (LateRow k) := by unfold LateRow; infer_instance

theorem rem1024 (i : Usize) : ∃ row : Usize, i % 1024#usize = ok row ∧ row.val = i.val % 1024 := by
  obtain ⟨row, hr, hv⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (UScalar.rem_spec i (y := 1024#usize) (by simp))
  exact ⟨row, hr, by rw [hv]; simp⟩

theorem merge_copy_loop_spec (stable late : Array U32 16384#usize) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (i : Usize) (out : Array U32 16384#usize), i.val + n = 16384 →
      ∃ out', merge_copy_loop stable late out i = ok out' ∧
        ∀ k, out'.val[k]! = if i.val ≤ k ∧ k < 16384 then
          (if LateRow k then late.val[k]! else stable.val[k]!) else out.val[k]!
  | 0, i, out, h => by
      obtain ⟨t, ht, htv⟩ := trace_cells
      refine ⟨out, ?_, fun k => by rw [if_neg (by omega)]⟩
      rw [merge_copy_loop, ht]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      rw [if_neg (by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; omega)]
  | n + 1, i, out, h => by
      obtain ⟨t, ht, htv⟩ := trace_cells
      obtain ⟨row, hrow, hrv⟩ := rem1024 i
      have hi1 : (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize).val = i.val + 1 := uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac)
      have hib : i.val < (16384#usize).val := by simp; omega
      have key : ∀ x : U32, (do
          let a ← out.update i x
          let i3 ← lift (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize)
          merge_copy_loop stable late a i3) =
          merge_copy_loop stable late (out.set i x) (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize) := by
        intro x
        rw [update_ok out i x hib]
        simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
      have IH : ∀ x : U32, ∃ o', merge_copy_loop stable late (out.set i x)
          (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize) = ok o' ∧ ∀ k, o'.val[k]! =
            if i.val + 1 ≤ k ∧ k < 16384 then (if LateRow k then late.val[k]! else stable.val[k]!)
            else (out.set i x).val[k]! := by
        intro x
        obtain ⟨o', ho', hs⟩ := merge_copy_loop_spec stable late n (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize)
          (out.set i x) (by rw [hi1]; omega)
        exact ⟨o', ho', fun k => by rw [hs k, hi1]⟩
      have fin : ∀ x : U32, x = (if LateRow i.val then late.val[i.val]! else stable.val[i.val]!) →
          ∀ o' : Array U32 16384#usize, (∀ k, o'.val[k]! = if i.val + 1 ≤ k ∧ k < 16384 then
            (if LateRow k then late.val[k]! else stable.val[k]!) else (out.set i x).val[k]!) →
          ∀ k, o'.val[k]! = if i.val ≤ k ∧ k < 16384 then
            (if LateRow k then late.val[k]! else stable.val[k]!) else out.val[k]! := by
        intro x hx o' hs k
        rw [hs k, set_get' out i x hib k]
        by_cases e : k = i.val
        · rw [if_neg (show ¬ (i.val + 1 ≤ k ∧ k < 16384) by omega), if_pos e,
            if_pos (show i.val ≤ k ∧ k < 16384 by omega), hx, e]
        · rw [if_neg e]
          by_cases r1 : i.val + 1 ≤ k ∧ k < 16384
          · rw [if_pos r1, if_pos (show i.val ≤ k ∧ k < 16384 by omega)]
          · rw [if_neg r1, if_neg (show ¬ (i.val ≤ k ∧ k < 16384) by omega)]
      rw [merge_copy_loop, ht]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      rw [if_pos (by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; omega), hrow]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      unfold LateRow at fin
      by_cases a : 544 ≤ i.val % 1024
      · rw [if_pos (show row >= 544#usize by rw [ge_iff_le, UScalar.le_equiv]; simp; omega)]
        by_cases b : i.val % 1024 < 864
        · rw [if_pos (show row < 864#usize by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; simp; omega),
            index_ok late i hib]
          simp only [bind_tc_ok]
          rw [key]
          obtain ⟨o', ho', hs⟩ := IH (late.val[i.val]!)
          exact ⟨o', ho', fin _ (by rw [if_pos ⟨a, b⟩]) o' hs⟩
        · rw [if_neg (show ¬ row < 864#usize by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; simp; omega),
            index_ok stable i hib]
          simp only [bind_tc_ok]
          rw [key]
          obtain ⟨o', ho', hs⟩ := IH (stable.val[i.val]!)
          exact ⟨o', ho', fin _ (by rw [if_neg (fun h => b h.2)]) o' hs⟩
      · rw [if_neg (show ¬ row >= 544#usize by rw [ge_iff_le, UScalar.le_equiv]; simp; omega),
          index_ok stable i hib]
        simp only [bind_tc_ok]
        rw [key]
        obtain ⟨o', ho', hs⟩ := IH (stable.val[i.val]!)
        exact ⟨o', ho', fin _ (by rw [if_neg (fun h => a h.1)]) o' hs⟩

/-- The shape condition from index i on. -/
def ShapeFrom (stable late : Array U32 16384#usize) (i : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ k, i ≤ k → k < 16384 → (if LateRow k then stable.val[k]! else late.val[k]!) = 0#u32

theorem shapeFrom_step (stable late : Array U32 16384#usize) (i : Nat) (hi : i < 16384) :
    ShapeFrom stable late i ↔
      (if LateRow i then stable.val[i]! else late.val[i]!) = 0#u32 ∧ ShapeFrom stable late (i + 1) := by
  constructor
  · intro h; exact ⟨h i (le_refl _) hi, fun k h1 h2 => h k (by omega) h2⟩
  · rintro ⟨h0, h⟩ k h1 h2
    by_cases e : k = i
    · subst e; exact h0
    · exact h k (by omega) h2

theorem merge_check_loop_spec (stable late : Array U32 16384#usize) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (i : Usize) (ok1 : Bool), i.val + n = 16384 →
      merge_check_loop stable late ok1 i =
        ok (ok1 && decide (ShapeFrom stable late i.val))
  | 0, i, ok1, h => by
      obtain ⟨t, ht, htv⟩ := trace_cells
      rw [merge_check_loop, ht]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      rw [if_neg (by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; omega)]
      have : ShapeFrom stable late i.val := fun k h1 h2 => by omega
      rw [decide_eq_true this, Bool.and_true]
  | n + 1, i, ok1, h => by
      obtain ⟨t, ht, htv⟩ := trace_cells
      obtain ⟨row, hrow, hrv⟩ := rem1024 i
      have hi1 : (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize).val = i.val + 1 := uadd _ _ (by scalar_tac)
      have hib : i.val < (16384#usize).val := by simp; omega
      have IH : ∀ b : Bool, merge_check_loop stable late b (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize) =
          ok (b && decide (ShapeFrom stable late (i.val + 1))) := by
        intro b; rw [merge_check_loop_spec stable late n _ _ (by rw [hi1]; omega), hi1]
      have hc : ∀ x : U32, x = (if LateRow i.val then stable.val[i.val]! else late.val[i.val]!) →
          (if (x != 0#u32) = true then (do
              let i2 ← lift (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize)
              merge_check_loop stable late false i2) else (do
              let i2 ← lift (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize)
              merge_check_loop stable late ok1 i2)) = ok (ok1 && decide (ShapeFrom stable late i.val)) := by
        intro x hx
        have st := shapeFrom_step stable late i.val (by omega)
        by_cases h0 : x = 0#u32
        · rw [if_neg (by simp [h0])]
          simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
          rw [IH]
          congr 2
          exact decide_eq_decide.mpr ⟨fun hs => st.2 ⟨hx ▸ h0, hs⟩, fun hs => (st.1 hs).2⟩
        · rw [if_pos (by simpa using h0)]
          simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
          rw [IH]
          have : ¬ ShapeFrom stable late i.val := fun hs => h0 (hx ▸ (st.1 hs).1)
          rw [decide_eq_false this]
          simp
      rw [merge_check_loop, ht]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      rw [if_pos (by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; omega), hrow]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      unfold LateRow at hc
      by_cases a : 544 ≤ i.val % 1024
      · rw [if_pos (show row >= 544#usize by rw [ge_iff_le, UScalar.le_equiv]; simp; omega)]
        by_cases b : i.val % 1024 < 864
        · rw [if_pos (show row < 864#usize by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; simp; omega),
            index_ok stable i hib]
          simp only [bind_tc_ok]
          exact hc _ (by rw [if_pos ⟨a, b⟩])
        · rw [if_neg (show ¬ row < 864#usize by rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]; simp; omega),
            index_ok late i hib]
          simp only [bind_tc_ok]
          exact hc _ (by rw [if_neg (fun h => b h.2)])
      · rw [if_neg (show ¬ row >= 544#usize by rw [ge_iff_le, UScalar.le_equiv]; simp; omega),
          index_ok late i hib]
        simp only [bind_tc_ok]
        exact hc _ (by rw [if_neg (fun h => a h.1)])

/-- The merge refines the model's placement: banks split by row range give a
passing check and the full table. -/
theorem merge_model (M : Nat → U32) (stable late : Array U32 16384#usize)
    (hs : ∀ k, k < 16384 → stable.val[k]! = if LateRow k then 0#u32 else M k)
    (hl : ∀ k, k < 16384 → late.val[k]! = if LateRow k then M k else 0#u32) :
    merge_check stable late = ok true ∧
      ∃ out, merge_copy stable late = ok out ∧ ∀ k, k < 16384 → out.val[k]! = M k := by
  constructor
  · rw [merge_check, merge_check_loop_spec stable late 16384 0#usize true (by simp)]
    have : ShapeFrom stable late (0#usize : Usize).val := by
      intro k _ hk
      by_cases hr : LateRow k
      · rw [if_pos hr, hs k hk, if_pos hr]
      · rw [if_neg hr, hl k hk, if_neg hr]
    rw [decide_eq_true this, Bool.true_and]
  · obtain ⟨out, ho, hsp⟩ := merge_copy_loop_spec stable late 16384 0#usize
      (Array.repeat 16384#usize 0#u32) (by simp)
    refine ⟨out, by rw [merge_copy]; exact ho, fun k hk => ?_⟩
    rw [hsp k, if_pos ⟨by simp, hk⟩]
    by_cases hr : LateRow k
    · rw [if_pos hr, hl k hk, if_pos hr]
    · rw [if_neg hr, hs k hk, if_neg hr]

#print axioms trace_cells
#print axioms merge_copy_loop_spec
#print axioms merge_check_loop_spec
#print axioms merge_model
end R0Z.WriterRefine

import R0Z.WriterRefinePathBlock

/-! The extracted path-aux writer equals the model's path rows 912..1007
(DESIGN-BUILDER-MODEL §9). -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace R0Z.WriterRefine
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0WriterCopies

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

/-- The Rust inputs lift to the model's path records. -/
structure PathLifts (bits : Array U32 24#usize) (cur l r : Array (Array U32 8#usize) 24#usize)
    (C : R0Z.BuilderModel.Cells K) : Prop where
  bit : ∀ v : Fin 24, liftU (K := K) (bits.val[v.val]!) = (C.path v).bit
  current : ∀ (v : Fin 24) (i : Fin 8), liftU (K := K) ((cur.val[v.val]!).val[i.val]!) = (C.path v).current i
  left : ∀ (v : Fin 24) (i : Fin 8), liftU (K := K) ((l.val[v.val]!).val[i.val]!) = (C.path v).left i
  right : ∀ (v : Fin 24) (i : Fin 8), liftU (K := K) ((r.val[v.val]!).val[i.val]!) = (C.path v).right i

theorem rep0 (k : Nat) : (((Array.repeat 1536#usize 0#u32 : Array U32 1536#usize).val[k]! : U32)) = 0#u32 := by
  rw [Array.repeat_val]
  by_cases hk : k < (1536#usize : Usize).val
  · rw [List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_replicate, if_pos hk]; rfl
  · rw [List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_replicate, if_neg hk]; rfl

theorem liftU_zero : liftU (K := K) 0#u32 = 0 := by unfold liftU; simp

theorem path_block_model (bits : Array U32 24#usize) (cur l r : Array (Array U32 8#usize) 24#usize)
    (C : R0Z.BuilderModel.Cells K) (hp : PathLifts bits cur l r C) :
    ∃ b, write_path_block bits cur l r = ok b ∧
      ∀ (rr : Nat) (hr : rr < 96) (c : Fin 16), liftU (K := K) (b.val[rr * 16 + c.val]!) =
        R0Z.BuilderModel.auxCell C (912 + rr) c := by
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hs⟩ := path_block_loop bits cur l r 24 0#usize (Array.repeat 1536#usize 0#u32) (by simp)
  refine ⟨b, by rw [write_path_block]; exact hb, fun rr hr c => ?_⟩
  have hc := c.isLt
  rw [hs, rep0]
  simp only [show (0#usize : Usize).val = 0 by simp, Nat.zero_le, true_and]
  unfold R0Z.BuilderModel.auxCell
  rw [dif_pos (show 912 ≤ 912 + rr ∧ 912 + rr < 1008 by omega)]
  have hk16 : (rr * 16 + c.val) / 16 = rr := by omega
  have hlv : lvl (rr * 16 + c.val) = 4 * ((912 + rr - 912) / 16) + (912 + rr) % 16 / 4 := by
    unfold lvl; omega
  have hlv24 : lvl (rr * 16 + c.val) < 24 := by unfold lvl; omega
  by_cases a1 : (912 + rr) % 16 % 4 = 1
  · rw [if_pos a1]
    have hw : InWin (rr * 16 + c.val) := by unfold InWin; omega
    rw [if_pos ⟨hw, hlv24⟩]
    have hpb : pbase (lvl (rr * 16 + c.val)) = rr * 16 := by unfold pbase lvl; omega
    have e : (⟨4 * ((912 + rr - 912) / 16) + (912 + rr) % 16 / 4, by omega⟩ : Fin 24) =
        ⟨lvl (rr * 16 + c.val), hlv24⟩ := Fin.ext hlv.symm
    rw [e]
    unfold PV R0Z.BuilderModel.pathBaseCell
    rw [hpb]
    by_cases c0 : c.val = 0
    · rw [if_pos (by omega), if_pos c0]
      exact hp.bit ⟨_, hlv24⟩
    · rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg c0]
      by_cases c9 : c.val < 9
      · rw [if_pos (by omega), dif_pos c9]
        rw [show rr * 16 + c.val - rr * 16 - 1 = (⟨c.val - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin 8).val by simp <;> omega]
        exact hp.current ⟨_, hlv24⟩ _
      · rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), dif_neg c9]
        exact liftU_zero
  · rw [if_neg a1]
    by_cases a2 : (912 + rr) % 16 % 4 = 2
    · rw [if_pos a2]
      have hw : InWin (rr * 16 + c.val) := by unfold InWin; omega
      rw [if_pos ⟨hw, hlv24⟩]
      have hpb : pbase (lvl (rr * 16 + c.val)) = rr * 16 - 16 := by unfold pbase lvl; omega
      have e : (⟨4 * ((912 + rr - 912) / 16) + (912 + rr) % 16 / 4, by omega⟩ : Fin 24) =
          ⟨lvl (rr * 16 + c.val), hlv24⟩ := Fin.ext hlv.symm
      rw [e]
      unfold PV R0Z.BuilderModel.pathSuccCell
      rw [hpb, if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega)]
      by_cases c8 : c.val < 8
      · rw [if_pos (by omega), dif_pos c8]
        rw [show rr * 16 + c.val - (rr * 16 - 16) - 16 = (⟨c.val, c8⟩ : Fin 8).val by simp <;> omega]
        exact hp.left ⟨_, hlv24⟩ _
      · rw [if_neg (by omega), if_pos (by omega), dif_neg c8]
        rw [show rr * 16 + c.val - (rr * 16 - 16) - 24 = (⟨c.val - 8, by omega⟩ : Fin 8).val by simp <;> omega]
        exact hp.right ⟨_, hlv24⟩ _
    · rw [if_neg a2]
      have hw : ¬ InWin (rr * 16 + c.val) := by unfold InWin; omega
      rw [if_neg (fun h => hw h.1)]
      exact liftU_zero

#print axioms path_block_model
end R0Z.WriterRefine
