/-! Universal coordinate counts for the sequential source model. The source
caller identity/read-log completeness are not inferred from cardinal bounds. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitSourceDecoder
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
open R0Z.MaskLayout R1Z.ProverCommitSourceCarrier

def noiseIndex (c : EligibleCell) : Fin 16 × Fin 1024 :=
  (⟨c.1.1.val, c.2.1⟩, c.1.2)

theorem noiseIndex_injective : Function.Injective noiseIndex := by
  intro a b eq
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Prod.ext
  · apply Fin.ext
    exact congrArg (fun v : Fin 16 × Fin 1024 => v.1.val) eq
  · exact congrArg (fun z : Fin 16 × Fin 1024 => z.2) eq

theorem source_counts : R1Z.CommitReadsR1.RCommitCount L₁ L₂ := by
  have hn := Fintype.card_le_of_injective noiseIndex noiseIndex_injective
  have hr : Fintype.card FreeRow ≤ 1024 := by
    convert Fintype.card_le_of_injective (Subtype.val : FreeRow → Fin 1024) Subtype.val_injective using 1
    simp only [Fintype.card_fin]
  
  simp only [Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin] at hn
  constructor
  · dsimp only [L₁]
    rw [Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_sum]
    simp only [Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin]
    omega
  · simp only [L₂, Stream2Coord, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin]

attribute [local irreducible] L₁ L₂

theorem source_budgets :
    16 * L₁ ≤ E₁ * 8 ∧ 16 * L₂ ≤ E₂ * 8 ∧
    E₁ ≤ 2 * L₁ ∧ E₂ ≤ 2 * L₂ ∧ E₁ ≤ 2^64 ∧ E₂ ≤ 2^64 := by
  have h := R1Z.ProverCommitBudgetJoin.canonical_budgets L₁ L₂ source_counts
  simpa only [E₁, E₂] using And.intro h.1 (And.intro h.2.1 (And.intro (Nat.le_refl (2*L₁)) (And.intro (Nat.le_refl (2*L₂)) h.2.2)))

#print axioms noiseIndex_injective
#print axioms source_counts
#print axioms source_budgets
end R1Z.ProverCommitSourceDecoder
R1Z.ProverCommitSourceDecoder:
import R1Z.ProverCommitSequentialArrays
import R1Z.ProverCommitSourceCarrier
import R1Z.FinalR1PBin

/-! A finite sequential word decoder for the raw source sample families.
Its field law is unconditional; matching its coordinate order to the shipped
caller is deliberately not asserted by these definitions. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitSourceDecoder
open R0P R0Z.JointView R0Z.MaskLayout R0Z.FsStatement R1Z.GamesR1PBin
  R1Z.ProverCommitWordCarrier R1Z.ProverCommitSourceCarrier R1Z.ProverCommitTapeCompletion
  R1Z.ProverCommitSequentialFibres R1Z.FinalR1PBin
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

abbrev Stream1Coord := EligibleCell ⊕ ((Fin 10 × Fin 1024) ⊕
  ((Fin 1024 × Fin 4) ⊕ (FreeRow × Fin 4)))
abbrev Stream2Coord := Fin 1024 × Fin 4
def L₁ : Nat := Fintype.card Stream1Coord
def L₂ : Nat := Fintype.card Stream2Coord
def E₁ : Nat := 2 * L₁
def E₂ : Nat := 2 * L₂

variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K]
local notation "F" => sourceBase (K := K)

def streamCarrierEquiv : ((Stream1Coord → F) × (Stream2Coord → F)) ≃ Samples K F where
  toFun s := ((fun c => s.1 (.inl c)), (fun c => s.1 (.inr (.inl c))),
    (fun c => s.1 (.inr (.inr (.inl c)))), (fun c => s.1 (.inr (.inr (.inr c)))), s.2)
  invFun s := ((fun c => match c with
    | .inl c => s.1 c
    | .inr (.inl c) => s.2.1 c
    | .inr (.inr (.inl c)) => s.2.2.1 c
    | .inr (.inr (.inr c)) => s.2.2.2.1 c), s.2.2.2.2)
  left_inv s := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · funext c; rcases c with c | c | c | c <;> rfl
    · rfl
  right_inv s := rfl

def arrayCarrierEquiv : ((Fin L₁ → F) × (Fin L₂ → F)) ≃ SourceTape K F :=
  ((Equiv.prodCongr
    (Equiv.arrowCongr (Fintype.equivFin Stream1Coord).symm (Equiv.refl F))
    (Equiv.arrowCongr (Fintype.equivFin Stream2Coord).symm (Equiv.refl F))).trans
      streamCarrierEquiv).trans sourceCarrierEquiv

abbrev Inputs := (Fin E₁ → OracleAnswer) × (Fin E₂ → OracleAnswer)
def inputEquiv : Inputs ≃ ((Fin (E₁*8) → R1Z.CommitReadsR1.Word) ×
    (Fin (E₂*8) → R1Z.CommitReadsR1.Word)) :=
  Equiv.prodCongr (wordsE E₁) (wordsE E₂)

def quotientDecoder (e : Inputs) : Option (SourceTape K F) :=
  (pairDecode (accepted (K := K)) (E₁*8) (E₂*8) L₁ L₂ (inputEquiv e)).map arrayCarrierEquiv

theorem map_equiv_some {T U : Type} (eqv : T ≃ U) (o : Option T) (u : U) :
    o.map eqv = some u ↔ o = some (eqv.symm u) := by
  cases o with
  | none => simp
  | some t => simpa only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] using eqv.apply_eq_iff_eq_symm_apply

theorem fibre_transport {I J T U : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (e : I ≃ J) (q : T ≃ U) (decode : J → Option T) (u : U) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => (decode (e i)).map q = some u)).card =
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun j => decode j = some (q.symm u))).card := by
  apply Finset.card_bij (fun i _ => e i)
  · intro i hi
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,
      (map_equiv_some q _ u).mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2⟩
  · intro i _ j _ eq
    exact e.injective eq
  · intro j hj
    refine ⟨e.symm j, ?_, e.apply_symm_apply j⟩
    apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
    refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, (map_equiv_some q _ u).mpr ?_⟩
    simpa only [e.apply_symm_apply] using (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2

def quotientFibreSize : Nat :=
  fibreSize (2^32) 2 2 (E₁*8) L₁ 16 * fibreSize (2^32) 2 2 (E₂*8) L₂ 16

theorem rejected_fibre :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun w : R1Z.CommitReadsR1.Word => accepted (K := K) w = none)).card = 2 := by
  have eq : (Finset.univ.filter (fun w : R1Z.CommitReadsR1.Word => accepted (K := K) w = none)) =
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun w => R1Z.CommitReadsR1.rejB w = true)) := by
    ext w
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, accepted_failure]
  rw [eq, R1Z.CommitReadsR1.card_rej]

attribute [local irreducible] L₁ L₂ E₁ E₂ arrayCarrierEquiv sourceBase

/-- Exact quotient fibres, without an assumed cF or padded-limb decoding. -/
theorem quotient_equal_fibres (s : SourceTape K F) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun e : Inputs => quotientDecoder e = some s)).card = quotientFibreSize := by
  have ht := fibre_transport inputEquiv (arrayCarrierEquiv (K := K))
    (pairDecode (accepted (K := K)) (E₁*8) (E₂*8) L₁ L₂) s
  have hp := pair_equal_fibres (accepted (K := K)) 2 2 (rejected_fibre (K := K))
    (fun a => by convert accepted_equal_fibres (K := K) a) (E₁*8) (E₂*8) L₁ L₂ ((arrayCarrierEquiv (K := K)).symm s)
  calc
    _ = (Finset.univ.filter (fun ws => pairDecode (accepted (K := K))
        (E₁*8) (E₂*8) L₁ L₂ ws = some ((arrayCarrierEquiv (K := K)).symm s))).card := by
      convert ht using 1 <;> congr 1 <;> ext z <;>
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, quotientDecoder]
    _ = _ := by
      simpa only [quotientFibreSize, R1Z.CommitReadsR1.Word, Fintype.card_fin] using hp

#print axioms streamCarrierEquiv
#print axioms arrayCarrierEquiv
#print axioms inputEquiv
#print axioms map_equiv_some
#print axioms fibre_transport
#print axioms rejected_fibre
#print axioms quotient_equal_fibres
end R1Z.ProverCommitSourceDecoder

import R1Z.ProverCommitSequentialFibres

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitSequentialFibres
open R1Z.CommitReadsR1 R1Z.ProverCommitWordCarrier
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

def valuesEquiv (A : Type) : (n : Nat) → Values A n ≃ (Fin n → A)
  | 0 => {
      toFun := fun _ => Fin.elim0
      invFun := fun _ => PUnit.unit
      left_inv := fun v => by cases v; rfl
      right_inv := fun f => by funext i; exact Fin.elim0 i }
  | n+1 => {
      toFun := fun v => Fin.cons v.1 (valuesEquiv A n v.2)
      invFun := fun f => (f 0, (valuesEquiv A n).symm (fun j => f j.succ))
      left_inv := fun v => by
        apply Prod.ext
        · rfl
        · exact (valuesEquiv A n).symm_apply_apply v.2
      right_inv := fun f => by
        funext i
        refine Fin.cases rfl (fun j => ?_) i
        exact congrFun ((valuesEquiv A n).apply_symm_apply (fun j => f j.succ)) j }

variable {W A : Type} [Fintype W]

def arrayDecode (d : W → Option A) (n L r : Nat) (ws : Fin n → W) : Option (Fin L → A) :=
  (decodeWords d n L r ws).map (valuesEquiv A L)

theorem array_equal_fibres (d : W → Option A) (c₀ c₁ : Nat)
    (hz : (Finset.univ.filter (fun w => d w = none)).card = c₀)
    (ha : ∀ a, (Finset.univ.filter (fun w => d w = some a)).card = c₁) (n L r : Nat) (out : Fin L → A) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun ws : Fin n → W => arrayDecode d n L r ws = some out)).card =
      fibreSize (Fintype.card W) c₀ c₁ n L r := by
  have eq : (Finset.univ.filter (fun ws : Fin n → W => arrayDecode d n L r ws = some out)) =
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun ws => decodeWords d n L r ws = some ((valuesEquiv A L).symm out))) := by
    ext ws
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, arrayDecode]
    cases h : decodeWords d n L r ws with
    | none => simp
    | some v =>
      simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq]
      exact (valuesEquiv A L).apply_eq_iff_eq_symm_apply
  rw [eq]
  exact sequential_equal_fibres d c₀ c₁ hz ha n L r _

def pairDecode (d : W → Option A) (n₁ n₂ L₁ L₂ : Nat)
    (ws : (Fin n₁ → W) × (Fin n₂ → W)) : Option ((Fin L₁ → A) × (Fin L₂ → A)) := do
  let a ← arrayDecode d n₁ L₁ 16 ws.1
  let b ← arrayDecode d n₂ L₂ 16 ws.2
  pure (a,b)

theorem pair_equal_fibres (d : W → Option A) (c₀ c₁ : Nat)
    (hz : (Finset.univ.filter (fun w => d w = none)).card = c₀)
    (ha : ∀ a, (Finset.univ.filter (fun w => d w = some a)).card = c₁) (n₁ n₂ L₁ L₂ : Nat) (out : (Fin L₁ → A) × (Fin L₂ → A)) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun ws => pairDecode d n₁ n₂ L₁ L₂ ws = some out)).card =
      fibreSize (Fintype.card W) c₀ c₁ n₁ L₁ 16 * fibreSize (Fintype.card W) c₀ c₁ n₂ L₂ 16 := by
  have eq : (Finset.univ.filter (fun ws => pairDecode d n₁ n₂ L₁ L₂ ws = some out)) =
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun ws => arrayDecode d n₁ L₁ 16 ws = some out.1)) ×ˢ
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun ws => arrayDecode d n₂ L₂ 16 ws = some out.2)) := by
    ext ws
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_product]
    cases h₁ : arrayDecode d n₁ L₁ 16 ws.1 <;>
      cases h₂ : arrayDecode d n₂ L₂ 16 ws.2 <;> simp [pairDecode, h₁, h₂, Prod.ext_iff]
  rw [eq, Finset.card_product, array_equal_fibres d c₀ c₁ hz ha, array_equal_fibres d c₀ c₁ hz ha]

#print axioms valuesEquiv
#print axioms array_equal_fibres
#print axioms pair_equal_fibres
end R1Z.ProverCommitSequentialFibres
R1Z.ProverCommitSequentialFibres:
import R1Z.ProverCommitWordCarrier

/-! Exact successful fibres for a consuming rejection stream. Successful
limbs consume only through their accepted word; no 16-word padding per limb. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitSequentialFibres
open R1Z.CommitReadsR1 R1Z.ProverCommitWordCarrier
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

def step {B T A V : Type} (d : B → Option A) (more : T → Option (A × V))
    (less : T → Option V) (bt : B × T) : Option (A × V) :=
  match d bt.1 with
  | none => more bt.2
  | some a => (less bt.2).map (fun v => (a,v))

theorem step_fibre_card {B T A V : Type} [Fintype B] [Fintype T]
    (d : B → Option A) (more : T → Option (A × V)) (less : T → Option V) (out : A × V) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun bt => step d more less bt = some out)).card =
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun b => d b = none)).card *
        (Finset.univ.filter (fun t => more t = some out)).card +
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun b => d b = some out.1)).card *
        (Finset.univ.filter (fun t => less t = some out.2)).card := by
  have eq : (Finset.univ.filter (fun bt => step d more less bt = some out)) =
      ((Finset.univ.filter (fun b => d b = none)) ×ˢ
        (Finset.univ.filter (fun t => more t = some out))) ∪
      ((Finset.univ.filter (fun b => d b = some out.1)) ×ˢ
        (Finset.univ.filter (fun t => less t = some out.2))) := by
    ext bt
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_product]
    rcases bt with ⟨b,t⟩
    cases hd : d b with
    | none => simp [step, hd]
    | some a =>
      cases hl : less t with
      | none => simp [step, hd, hl]
      | some v => simp [step, hd, hl, Prod.ext_iff]
  rw [eq, Finset.card_union_of_disjoint, Finset.card_product, Finset.card_product]
  apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro bt h₁ h₂
  have hnone := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_product.mp h₁).1).2
  have hsome := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_product.mp h₂).1).2
  rw [hnone] at hsome
  contradiction

def Values (A : Type) : Nat → Type
  | 0 => PUnit
  | n+1 => A × Values A n

variable {W A : Type} [Fintype W]

def decodeWords (d : W → Option A) : (n L r : Nat) → (Fin n → W) → Option (Values A L)
  | 0, 0, _, _ => some PUnit.unit
  | 0, _+1, _, _ => none
  | _+1, 0, _, _ => some PUnit.unit
  | _+1, _+1, 0, _ => none
  | n+1, L+1, r+1, ws =>
    step d (decodeWords d n (L+1) r) (decodeWords d n L 16)
      (ws 0, fun j => ws j.succ)

def wordTailEquiv (W : Type) (n : Nat) : (Fin (n+1) → W) ≃ W × (Fin n → W) where
  toFun ws := (ws 0, fun j => ws j.succ)
  invFun bt := Fin.cons bt.1 bt.2
  left_inv ws := by funext i; exact Fin.cases rfl (fun _ => rfl) i
  right_inv bt := rfl

def consumingFibreEquiv (d : W → Option A) (n L r : Nat) (out : Values A (L+1)) :
    {ws : Fin (n+1) → W // decodeWords d (n+1) (L+1) (r+1) ws = some out} ≃
    {bt : W × (Fin n → W) //
      step d (decodeWords d n (L+1) r) (decodeWords d n L 16) bt = some out} where
  toFun ws := ⟨wordTailEquiv W n ws.1, ws.2⟩
  invFun bt := ⟨(wordTailEquiv W n).symm bt.1, bt.2⟩
  left_inv ws := Subtype.ext ((wordTailEquiv W n).left_inv ws.1)
  right_inv bt := Subtype.ext ((wordTailEquiv W n).right_inv bt.1)

def fibreSize (q c₀ c₁ : Nat) : Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, 0, _ => 1
  | 0, _+1, _ => 0
  | n+1, 0, _ => q^(n+1)
  | _+1, _+1, 0 => 0
  | n+1, L+1, r+1 => c₀ * fibreSize q c₀ c₁ n (L+1) r + c₁ * fibreSize q c₀ c₁ n L 16

/-- Variable-consumption rejection has equal successful fibres. -/
theorem sequential_equal_fibres (d : W → Option A) (c₀ c₁ : Nat)
    (hz : (Finset.univ.filter (fun w => d w = none)).card = c₀)
    (ha : ∀ a, (Finset.univ.filter (fun w => d w = some a)).card = c₁)
    (n L r : Nat) (out : Values A L) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun ws : Fin n → W => decodeWords d n L r ws = some out)).card =
      fibreSize (Fintype.card W) c₀ c₁ n L r := by
  induction n generalizing L r with
  | zero =>
    cases L with
    | zero => cases out; simp [decodeWords, fibreSize]
    | succ L => simp [decodeWords, fibreSize]
  | succ n ih =>
    cases L with
    | zero => cases out; simp [decodeWords, fibreSize, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin]
    | succ L =>
      cases r with
      | zero => simp [decodeWords, fibreSize]
      | succ r =>
        have hc := Fintype.card_congr (consumingFibreEquiv d n L r out)
        simp only [Fintype.card_subtype] at hc
        have hs := @step_fibre_card W (Fin n → W) A (Values A L) inferInstance inferInstance d
          (decodeWords d n (L+1) r) (decodeWords d n L 16) out
        have he := congrArg₂ Nat.add (congrArg₂ Nat.mul hz (ih (L+1) r out))
          (congrArg₂ Nat.mul (ha out.1) (ih L 16 out.2))
        have he' :
            (Finset.univ.filter (fun b : W => d b = none)).card *
              (Finset.univ.filter (fun t : Fin n → W => decodeWords d n (L+1) r t = some out)).card +
            (Finset.univ.filter (fun b : W => d b = some out.1)).card *
              (Finset.univ.filter (fun t : Fin n → W => decodeWords d n L 16 t = some out.2)).card =
            fibreSize (Fintype.card W) c₀ c₁ (n+1) (L+1) (r+1) := by
          convert he using 4 <;> first
          | rfl
          | (congr 1; ext x; simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and])
          | simp only [fibreSize]
        calc
          _ = (Finset.univ.filter (fun bt : W × (Fin n → W) =>
              step d (decodeWords d n (L+1) r) (decodeWords d n L 16) bt = some out)).card := by
                convert hc using 1 <;> congr 1 <;> ext z <;>
                  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
          _ = (Finset.univ.filter (fun b : W => d b = none)).card *
              (Finset.univ.filter (fun t : Fin n → W => decodeWords d n (L+1) r t = some out)).card +
            (Finset.univ.filter (fun b : W => d b = some out.1)).card *
              (Finset.univ.filter (fun t : Fin n → W => decodeWords d n L 16 t = some out.2)).card := by
                convert hs using 4 <;> congr 1 <;> ext z <;>
                  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
          _ = _ := he'

#print axioms step_fibre_card
#print axioms wordTailEquiv
#print axioms consumingFibreEquiv
#print axioms sequential_equal_fibres
end R1Z.ProverCommitSequentialFibres

import R1Z.ProverCommitQuotientLaw

import R1J.SamplerLawSpend

/-! The exact accepted M31 word carrier, with its two raw-word preimages.
No finite stream or tape is enumerated. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitWordCarrier
open R1Z.CommitReadsR1
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
local notation "p" => AspisCircleGroupOrder.P
variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Algebra (ZMod p) K]

def sourceBase : Subfield K := (algebraMap (ZMod p) K).fieldRange

def baseEquiv : Fin p ≃ sourceBase (K := K) :=
  (ZMod.finEquiv p).toEquiv.trans
    (Equiv.ofInjective (algebraMap (ZMod p) K) (RingHom.injective _))

def accepted (w : Word) : Option (sourceBase (K := K)) :=
  if h : w.val % 2^31 < p then some (baseEquiv ⟨w.val % 2^31, h⟩) else none

theorem accepted_failure (w : Word) : accepted (K := K) w = none ↔ rejB w = true := by
  unfold accepted
  rw [rejB_iff]
  have hm := Nat.mod_lt w.val (show 0 < 2^31 by positivity)
  split_ifs with h
  · simp only [reduceCtorEq, false_iff]
    change w.val % 2^31 < 2^31-1 at h
    omega
  · simp only [true_iff]
    change ¬ w.val % 2^31 < 2^31-1 at h
    omega

theorem accepted_fibre (a : sourceBase (K := K)) (w : Word) :
    accepted w = some a ↔ w.val % 2^31 = (baseEquiv.symm a).val := by
  unfold accepted
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [Option.some.injEq, Equiv.apply_eq_iff_eq_symm_apply, Fin.ext_iff]
  · simp only [reduceCtorEq, false_iff]
    intro eq
    have ha := (baseEquiv.symm a).isLt
    rw [eq] at h
    exact h ha

theorem accepted_equal_fibres (a : sourceBase (K := K)) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun w : Word => accepted w = some a)).card = 2 := by
  let v := (baseEquiv.symm a).val
  have hv : v < 2^31-1 := (baseEquiv.symm a).isLt
  have eq : (Finset.univ.filter (fun w : Word => accepted w = some a)) =
      {⟨v, by omega⟩, ⟨v + 2^31, by omega⟩} := by
    ext w
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, accepted_fibre,
      Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, Fin.ext_iff]
    have hw := w.isLt
    change w.val % 2^31 = v ↔ w.val = v ∨ w.val = v + 2^31
    omega
  rw [eq]
  apply Finset.card_pair
  intro same
  have bad := congrArg Fin.val same
  dsimp at bad
  omega

#print axioms baseEquiv
#print axioms accepted_failure
#print axioms accepted_fibre
#print axioms accepted_equal_fibres
end R1Z.ProverCommitWordCarrier
R1Z.ProverCommitSourceCarrier:
import R1Z.ProverCommitQuotientLaw

/-! A lossless field-coordinate carrier for the source's five sampled arrays.
The ordering of the Rust caller's cells is a separate execution identity. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitSourceCarrier
open R0P R0Z.JointView R0Z.MaskLayout R1Z.ProverCommitTapeCompletion
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
abbrev FreeRow := {r : Fin 1024 // r ≠ 0 ∧ ¬ CopyActiveRow r}
instance : Fintype FreeRow := Fintype.ofFinite _
variable {K : Type} [Field K] {F : Subfield K}

abbrev Samples (K : Type) [Field K] (F : Subfield K) :=
  (EligibleCell → F) × ((Fin 10 × Fin 1024 → F) ×
    ((Fin 1024 × Fin 4 → F) × ((FreeRow × Fin 4 → F) × (Fin 1024 × Fin 4 → F))))

def toTape (s : Samples K F) : Tape K F :=
  ((fun c => match c with
    | .inl cr => s.2.1 cr
    | .inr (lane,row,limb) =>
      if lane = 0 then s.2.2.1 (row,limb)
      else if lane = 1 then
        if hr : row ≠ 0 ∧ ¬ CopyActiveRow row then s.2.2.2.1 (⟨row,hr⟩,limb) else 0
      else s.2.2.2.2 (row,limb)), s.1)

def fromQuotient (s : SourceTape K F) : Samples K F :=
  (s.2, (fun cr => s.1 ⟨.inl cr, by simp only [Ignored, not_false_eq_true]⟩),
    (fun rl => s.1 ⟨.inr (0,rl.1,rl.2), by simp [Ignored]⟩),
    (fun rl => s.1 ⟨.inr (1,rl.1.1,rl.2), by
      intro bad
      exact bad.2.elim rl.1.2.1 rl.1.2.2⟩),
    (fun rl => s.1 ⟨.inr (2,rl.1,rl.2), by simp [Ignored]⟩))

theorem from_to (s : Samples K F) : fromQuotient (project (toTape s)) = s := by
  rcases s with ⟨noise,masks,g,h1,d⟩
  apply Prod.ext
  · rfl
  apply Prod.ext
  · rfl
  apply Prod.ext
  · funext rl; simp only [fromQuotient, project, toTape, ite_true]
  apply Prod.ext
  · funext rl
    simp only [fromQuotient, project, toTape, show (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 0 by decide,
      if_false, ite_true]
    rw [dif_pos rl.1.2]
  · funext rl
    simp only [fromQuotient, project, toTape, show (2 : Fin 3) ≠ 0 by decide,
      show (2 : Fin 3) ≠ 1 by decide, if_false]

theorem to_from (s : SourceTape K F) : project (toTape (fromQuotient s)) = s := by
  apply Prod.ext
  · funext c
    rcases c with ⟨c,hc⟩
    cases c with
    | inl cr => rfl
    | inr coord =>
      rcases coord with ⟨lane,row,limb⟩
      have hr : lane = 1 → row ≠ 0 ∧ ¬ CopyActiveRow row := by
        intro hl
        exact ⟨fun h0 => hc ⟨hl, Or.inl h0⟩, fun ha => hc ⟨hl, Or.inr ha⟩⟩
      have cases : lane = 0 ∨ lane = 1 ∨ lane = 2 := by
        have := lane.isLt
        omega
      rcases cases with hl | hl | hl
      · subst lane; rfl
      · subst lane
        simp only [project, toTape, fromQuotient, show (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 0 by decide,
          if_false, ite_true, dif_pos (hr rfl)]
      · subst lane; rfl
  · rfl

def sourceCarrierEquiv : Samples K F ≃ SourceTape K F where
  toFun s := project (toTape s)
  invFun := fromQuotient
  left_inv := from_to
  right_inv := to_from

/-- Mapping all five actual arrays into the quotient loses no field sample. -/
theorem source_fibre_card {Input : Type} [Fintype Input] [Fintype K]
    (decode : Input → Option (Samples K F)) (s : SourceTape K F) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => (decode i).map sourceCarrierEquiv = some s)).card =
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => decode i = some (fromQuotient s))).card := by
  congr 1
  ext i
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  cases hi : decode i with
  | none => simp
  | some a => simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq]
              exact sourceCarrierEquiv.apply_eq_iff_eq_symm_apply

#print axioms from_to
#print axioms to_from
#print axioms sourceCarrierEquiv
#print axioms source_fibre_card
end R1Z.ProverCommitSourceCarrier
R1Z.ProverCommitBudgetJoin:
import R1Z.CommitReadsR1

/-! Arithmetic joins of the actual commitment-budget predicates. These facts
reduce redundant premises; they do not identify a universal source read log. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitBudgetJoin
open R1Z.CommitReadsR1

theorem exact_block_budget (E L : Nat) (capacity : 16 * L ≤ E * 8)
    (blocks : E ≤ 2 * L) : E = 2 * L := by omega

theorem counter_bounds (E₁ E₂ L₁ L₂ : Nat) (cells : RCommitCount L₁ L₂)
    (blocks₁ : E₁ ≤ 2 * L₁) (blocks₂ : E₂ ≤ 2 * L₂) :
    E₁ ≤ 2^64 ∧ E₂ ≤ 2^64 := by
  rcases cells with ⟨first, second⟩
  constructor <;> omega

/-- With the counts fixed, choosing the actual worst-case budgets discharges
both capacity and upper block inequalities, and their counter obligations. -/
theorem canonical_budgets (L₁ L₂ : Nat) (cells : RCommitCount L₁ L₂) :
    16 * L₁ ≤ (2 * L₁) * 8 ∧ 16 * L₂ ≤ (2 * L₂) * 8 ∧
    2 * L₁ ≤ 2^64 ∧ 2 * L₂ ≤ 2^64 := by
  have counters := counter_bounds (2*L₁) (2*L₂) L₁ L₂ cells le_rfl le_rfl
  exact ⟨by omega, by omega, counters⟩

/-- Universal counter distinctness below the budget, before any LE64 encoding.
This does not identify which blocks a particular source execution reads. -/
theorem no_counter_wrap (E L₁ L₂ : Nat) (cells : RCommitCount L₁ L₂)
    (blocks : E ≤ 2 * L₁) (i j : Fin E) :
    i.val % 2^64 = j.val % 2^64 ↔ i = j := by
  have bound := (counter_bounds E 0 L₁ L₂ cells blocks (by omega)).1
  rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le i.isLt bound),
    Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le j.isLt bound), Fin.ext_iff]

#print axioms exact_block_budget
#print axioms counter_bounds
#print axioms canonical_budgets
#print axioms no_counter_wrap
end R1Z.ProverCommitBudgetJoin

/-! Range-based source owner after the independently checked native iteration
substitution. The Rust/Kani evidence is an external source boundary, not an
axiom in Lean. This module composes the finite native counter with the retained
owned walk and stateful model, including ordered oracle effects on rejection. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitNative30
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ProverCommitStateLift28 ProverCommitWalk28

def continuation {M : Type → Type} [Monad M] [MonadLiftT Result M]
    (effect : Unit → Parts → M ProverCommitWalk28.Bytes32) (initial : SemanticState)
    (records : Records) (variant : AspisR1SimControl21.transport.Variant) :
    M (core.result.Result Output AspisR1SimControl21.verifier.Error) := do
  let result ← ProverCommitRows29.rangeRows effect records.semantic 0#u8 25 initial
    (Array.repeat 25#usize AspisR1SimSemantic20.aspis_core.field.QM31.ZERO)
  match result with
  | .Err e => pure (.Err e)
  | .Ok (state,sem) => do
    let out ← ProverCommitWalk29.suffix effect (.Ok sem) state records variant
    pure out.1

theorem continuation_owned {M : Type → Type} [Monad M] [LawfulMonad M]
    [MonadLiftT Result M] [LawfulMonadLiftT Result M]
    (effect : Unit → Parts → M ProverCommitWalk28.Bytes32) (initial : SemanticState)
    (records : Records) (variant : AspisR1SimControl21.transport.Variant) :
    continuation effect initial records variant =
    ProverCommitWalk29.continuation effect initial records variant := by
  unfold continuation ProverCommitWalk29.continuation
  rw [ProverCommitRows29.range_model effect records.semantic 0#u8 25 initial _ (by decide)]
  have zero : UScalar.cast .Usize (0#u8) = 0#usize := by scalar_tac
  rw [zero]
  rfl

def walk {M : Type → Type} [Monad M] [MonadLiftT Result M]
    (effect : Unit → Parts → M ProverCommitWalk28.Bytes32) (publicBytes : Slice U8)
    (records : Records) (variant : AspisR1SimControl21.transport.Variant) :
    M (core.result.Result Output AspisR1SimControl21.verifier.Error) := do
  let initial ← ProverCommitInit28.start effect () publicBytes records.c1_root
  match initial with
  | .Err _ => pure (.Err .Semantic)
  | .Ok initial => continuation effect ⟨initial.state,(),initial.next_row⟩ records variant

theorem walk_owned {M : Type → Type} [Monad M] [LawfulMonad M]
    [MonadLiftT Result M] [LawfulMonadLiftT Result M]
    (effect : Unit → Parts → M ProverCommitWalk28.Bytes32) (publicBytes : Slice U8)
    (records : Records) (variant : AspisR1SimControl21.transport.Variant) :
    walk effect publicBytes records variant =
    ProverCommitWalk29.walk effect publicBytes records variant := by
  simp only [walk,ProverCommitWalk29.walk,continuation_owned]
  rfl

theorem walk_model {M : Type → Type} [Monad M] [LawfulMonad M]
    [MonadLiftT Result M] [LawfulMonadLiftT Result M]
    (effect : Unit → Parts → M ProverCommitWalk28.Bytes32) (publicBytes : Slice U8)
    (records : Records) (variant : AspisR1SimControl21.transport.Variant) :
    walk effect publicBytes records variant =
    (do let out ← ProverCommitInit28.walk effect publicBytes records variant
        pure out.1) := by
  rw [walk_owned]
  exact ProverCommitWalk29.walk_model effect publicBytes records variant

theorem logged_model (publicBytes : Slice U8) (records : Records)
    (variant : AspisR1SimControl21.transport.Variant)
    (machine : ProverCommitLogged28.LoggedMachine) :
    walk (ProverCommitLogged28.dictionary ProverCommitControl28.extracted)
      publicBytes records variant machine =
    (do let out ← ProverCommitInit28.walk
          (ProverCommitLogged28.dictionary ProverCommitControl28.extracted)
          publicBytes records variant
        pure out.1) machine := by
  exact congrFun (walk_model (M := Port ProverCommitLogged28.LoggedMachine)
    (ProverCommitLogged28.dictionary ProverCommitControl28.extracted)
    publicBytes records variant) machine

#print axioms continuation_owned
#print axioms walk_owned
#print axioms walk_model
#print axioms logged_model
end R1Z.ProverCommitNative30

/-! P6 iteration assembly, then both circle points and the complete Transcript
suffix. This file does not assert a retry/serialization or whole-game join. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitWalk29
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ProverCommitStateLift28 ProverCommitWalk28

def suffix {M : Type → Type} [Monad M] [MonadLiftT Result M]
    (effect : Unit → Parts → M ProverCommitWalk28.Bytes32)
    (sample : core.result.Result ProverCommitStep29.Values AspisR1SimSemantic20.r1_wire.Error)
    (state : SemanticState) (records : Records)
    (variant : AspisR1SimControl21.transport.Variant) : M Outcome := do
  match sample with
  | .Err _ => pure (rejected state.state)
  | .Ok sem =>
    let record0 ← alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice (alloc.vec.Vec U8))
      records.semantic 25#usize
    let record0 ← alloc.vec.CloneVec.clone core.clone.CloneU8 record0
    let (sample0,state0) ← ProverCommitCircleProgram28.point effect ProverCommitCircle25.policy
      (ProverCommitCircle25.fromSemantic state) 25#u8 record0
    match sample0 with
    | .Err _ => pure (rejected state0.state)
    | .Ok z0 =>
      let record1 ← alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice (alloc.vec.Vec U8))
        records.semantic 26#usize
      let record1 ← alloc.vec.CloneVec.clone core.clone.CloneU8 record1
      let (sample1,state1) ← ProverCommitCircleProgram28.point effect ProverCommitCircle25.policy
        state0 26#u8 record1
      match sample1 with
      | .Err _ => pure (rejected state1.state)
      | .Ok z1 =>
        ProverCommitControlProgram28.tail effect ProverCommitQuery26.policy () state1.state
          (mapArray fromSemantic sem)
          (Array.make 2#usize [mapArray fromCircle z0,mapArray fromCircle z1]) records variant


def continuation {M : Type → Type} [Monad M] [MonadLiftT Result M]
    (effect : Unit → Parts → M ProverCommitWalk28.Bytes32) (initial : SemanticState)

theorem bind_same {M : Type → Type} [Monad M] {A B : Type}

    (liftM (ok v) : M A) = pure v := by
  change (monadLift (pure v : Result A) : M A) = pure v
  exact monadLift_pure v

    [MonadLiftT Result M] [LawfulMonadLiftT Result M] {H : Type}

  | succ n ih =>
    have rt := cast_roundtrip row (by omega)

      lift_ok,pure_bind,bind_assoc,rt]
    apply bind_same
    intro record

    intro record

not the source execution or the sampler. -/

      let record ← alloc.vec.CloneVec.clone core.clone.CloneU8 record
      let sample ← iteration effect state row record sem
      match sample with
      | .Err e => pure (.Err e)
      | .Ok (next,sem) => rangeRows effect records (U8.wrapping_add row 1#u8) n next sem

    UScalar.cast .U8 (UScalar.cast .Usize row) = row := by scalar_tac

    (U8.wrapping_add row 1#u8).val = row.val+1 := by

  have one : (1#u8).val=1 := by scalar_tac
  rw [one]
  apply Nat.mod_eq_of_lt

    rangeRows effect records row n state sem =

    have bound : row.val<25 := by omega
    have more : row<25#u8 := by scalar_tac
    simp only [rangeRows,rows,more,if_true,lift,lift_ok,pure_bind,range_cast]
    apply bind_same
    intro record
    apply bind_same
    intro record
    apply bind_same
    intro sample

      change rangeRows effect records (U8.wrapping_add row 1#u8) n next after = _
      rw [ih (U8.wrapping_add row 1#u8) next after (by rw [range_value row bound];omega)]

def rows {M : Type → Type} [Monad M] [MonadLiftT Result M] {H : Type}
    (effect : H → Parts → M Bytes32) (records : Records) (row : Usize) :
    Nat → State H → Values → M ((core.result.Result Values r1_wire.Error) × State H)
  | 0, state, sem => pure (core.result.Result.Ok sem,state)
  | n+1, state, sem => do
    let index ← lift (UScalar.cast .U8 row)
    let value ← alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) records row
    let record ← alloc.vec.CloneVec.clone core.clone.CloneU8 value
    let (value,next) ← ProverCommitSemanticProgram28.semantic effect state index record
    match value with
    | core.result.Result.Err e => pure (core.result.Result.Err e,next)
    | core.result.Result.Ok value => do

      rows effect records (Usize.wrapping_add row 1#usize) n next sem

    (records : Records) (row : Usize) (n : Nat) (state : State H) (sem : Values) :
    ProverCommitSemantic20.finite hash records row n state sem =
    rows hash.digest records row n state sem := by
  induction n generalizing row state sem with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [ProverCommitSemantic20.finite,rows,← ProverCommitSemanticSource28.semantic]
    repeat
      apply (Aeneas.Std.bind_eq_iff _ _ _).mpr
      intro v hv
      try (change (_ × _) at v; rcases v with ⟨v1,v2⟩)
      try dsimp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry]
    cases v1 with
    | Err e => rfl
    | Ok value =>
      apply (Aeneas.Std.bind_eq_iff _ _ _).mpr
      intro next hn
      exact ih _ _ _

/-- Exact actual extracted loop, under its existing row-count invariant. -/
theorem extracted_source {H : Type} (hash : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
    (records : Records) (row : Usize) (n : Nat) (state : State H) (sem : Values)
    (count : row.val+n=25) :
    r1_wire.semantic20.rows hash state records row sem =
    rows hash.digest records row n state sem := by
  rw [ProverCommitSemantic20.extracted_finite hash records row n state sem count]
  exact finite_source hash records row n state sem

theorem rows_effects (records : Records) (row : Usize) (n : Nat) (state : State Unit)

/-! Generic monadic lift of the retained semantic caller. Pure validation
and decoding use the original retained functions. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitSemanticProgram28
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1SimSemantic20 ProverCommitStateLift28
variable {M : Type → Type} [Monad M] [MonadLiftT Result M]
def sample
  {H : Type} (effect : H → Parts → M Bytes32)
  (self : r1_wire.SemanticTranscript H) (row : Std.U8) (framed : Slice Std.U8)
  :
  M ((core.result.Result (Array Std.U8 32#usize) r1_wire.Error) ×
    (r1_wire.SemanticTranscript H))
  := do
  if row != self.next_row
  then
    pure (core.result.Result.Err (r1_wire.Error.RowOrder self.next_row row),
      self)
  else
    let s ← lift (Array.to_slice self.state)
    let i ← lift (Std.U8.wrapping_add 160#u8 row)
    let s1 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 2#usize [ 0#u8, i ]))
    let s2 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 3#usize [ s, s1, framed ]))
    let absorbed ← effect self.hash s2
    let s3 ← lift (Array.to_slice absorbed)
    let s4 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 1#usize [ 1#u8 ]))
    let s5 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 2#usize [ s3, s4 ]))
    let block ← effect self.hash s5
    let s6 ← lift (Array.to_slice absorbed)
    let s7 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 1#usize [ 2#u8 ]))
    let s8 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 2#usize [ s6, s7 ]))
    let a ← effect self.hash s8
    let i1 ← lift (Std.U8.wrapping_add self.next_row 1#u8)
    pure (core.result.Result.Ok block, { self with state := a, next_row := i1 })


def semantic
  {H : Type} (effect : H → Parts → M Bytes32)
  (state : r1_wire.SemanticTranscript H) (row : Std.U8)
  (record1 : alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) :
  M ((core.result.Result aspis_core.field.QM31 r1_wire.Error) ×
    (r1_wire.SemanticTranscript H))
  := do
  if row > 24#u8
  then pure (core.result.Result.Err r1_wire.Error.InvalidRow, state)
  else
    if row != state.next_row
    then
      pure (core.result.Result.Err (r1_wire.Error.RowOrder state.next_row row),
        state)
    else
      let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref record1
      let r ← r1_wire.semantic20.checked row s
      match r with
      | core.result.Result.Ok _ =>
        let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref record1
        let (r1, state1) ←
          sample
            effect state row s1
        match r1 with
        | core.result.Result.Ok block =>
          let q ← AspisR1SimSemantic20.sampler.qm31_sample block
          pure (core.result.Result.Ok q, state1)
        | core.result.Result.Err e => pure (core.result.Result.Err e, state1)
      | core.result.Result.Err e => pure (core.result.Result.Err e, state)

end R1Z.ProverCommitSemanticProgram28

import R1Z.ProverCommitEffectCallers27
/-! State transformer used by the complete continuation port. Result failures
and divergence propagate; verifier errors remain ordinary values and retain
state. Pure instructions do not reset the threaded oracle state. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitStateLift28
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
abbrev Port (S A : Type) := StateT S Result A
abbrev Parts := ProverCommitOracleEffect26.Parts
abbrev Bytes32 := ProverCommitCoinCall27.Bytes32
abbrev Effect (S : Type) := S → Parts → Result (Bytes32 × S)

def read {S : Type} (effect : Effect S) (parts : Parts) : Port S Bytes32 :=
  fun state => effect state parts

def liftResult {S A : Type} (r : Result A) : Port S A :=
  fun state => do let value ← r; ok (value,state)

/-- The single state-threading equation: every continuation receives exactly
its predecessor's returned state, including when the value is a verifier error. -/
theorem bind_run {S A B : Type} (p : Port S A) (k : A → Port S B) (state : S) :
    (p >>= k) state = (do let (value,next) ← p state; k value next) := by rfl

theorem lift_run {S A : Type} (r : Result A) (state : S) :
    liftResult r state = (do let value ← r; ok (value,state)) := by rfl

theorem read_run {S : Type} (effect : Effect S) (parts : Parts) (state : S) :
    read effect parts state = effect state parts := by rfl

/-- A pointwise implementation equation may be installed in every stateful
continuation, rather than separately unfolding every caller's hash operations. -/
theorem install {S A : Type} (actual expected : Effect S)
    (calls : ∀ state parts, actual state parts = expected state parts)
    (continuation : Effect S → Port S A) (state : S) :
    continuation actual state = continuation expected state := by
  have eq : actual = expected := funext fun s => funext fun p => calls s p
  rw [eq]

#print axioms bind_run
#print axioms lift_run
#print axioms read_run
#print axioms install

import R1Z.ProverCommitCoinSequence27
/-! Concrete effect dictionary and source-shaped call trees for the shared
semantic/circle helper and the suffix block. These expose returned hash state. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitEffectCallers27
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1EffectCallers27
open ProverCommitCoinTape27 ProverCommitCoinCall27 ProverCommitCoinSequence27
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
abbrev Bytes32 := ProverCommitCoinCall27.Bytes32
abbrev Parts := ProverCommitOracleEffect26.Parts

def hash : AspisR1EffectCallers27.Digest32 Machine :=
  ⟨AspisR1CoinEffect27.CoinOracle.Insts.Effect27EffectDigest32CoinState.digest mapRecording⟩

def absorbParts (state : Bytes32) (row : U8) (framed : Slice U8) : Parts :=
  Array.to_slice (Array.make 3#usize [Array.to_slice state,
    Array.to_slice (Array.make 2#usize [0#u8,U8.wrapping_add 160#u8 row]),framed])

def readParts (state : Bytes32) (side : U8) : Parts :=
  Array.to_slice (Array.make 2#usize [Array.to_slice state,
    Array.to_slice (Array.make 1#usize [side])])

abbrev SemanticValue := (core.result.Result Bytes32 AspisR1EffectCallers27.Error) × Bytes32 × U8

def semanticProgram (state : Bytes32) (nextRow row : U8) (framed : Slice U8) :
    Program Parts Bytes32 SemanticValue :=
  if row != nextRow then .done (.Err (.RowOrder nextRow row),state,nextRow)
  else .call (absorbParts state row framed) fun absorbed =>
    .call (readParts absorbed 1#u8) fun block =>
    .call (readParts absorbed 2#u8) fun advanced =>
    .done (.Ok block,advanced,U8.wrapping_add nextRow 1#u8)

def semanticOutput (r : Run SemanticValue) :
    (core.result.Result Bytes32 AspisR1EffectCallers27.Error) × SemanticTranscript Machine :=
  (r.value.1,⟨r.value.2.1,r.state,r.value.2.2⟩)

/-- The exact extracted semantic/circle three-read helper, including mismatch
rejection with no reads, returns precisely the threaded oracle effects. -/
theorem semantic_call (s : SemanticTranscript Machine) (row : U8) (framed : Slice U8) :
    SemanticTranscript.sample_block_validated hash s row framed =
      ok (semanticOutput (referenceRun (semanticProgram s.state s.next_row row framed) s.hash)) := by
  by_cases same : row = s.next_row
  · subst row
    simp only [SemanticTranscript.sample_block_validated,semanticProgram,bne_self_eq_false,
      Bool.false_eq_true,if_false,hash,call_exact,bind_tc_ok,lift,
      referenceRun,absorbParts,readParts,semanticOutput,Aeneas.Std.uncurry]
  · have different : (row != s.next_row) = true := by simp [same]
    simp only [SemanticTranscript.sample_block_validated,semanticProgram,different,
      if_true,semanticOutput,referenceRun]

def suffixAbsorbParts (state : Bytes32) (row : U8) (payload : Slice U8) : Parts :=
  Array.to_slice (Array.make 4#usize [Array.to_slice state,
    Array.to_slice (Array.make 2#usize [0#u8,U8.wrapping_add 160#u8 row]),
    Array.to_slice (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes (UScalar.cast .U32 (Slice.len payload))),payload])

def blockProgram (state : Bytes32) (row : U8) (payload : Slice U8) :
    Program Parts Bytes32 (Bytes32 × Bytes32) :=
  .call (suffixAbsorbParts state row payload) fun absorbed =>
  .call (readParts absorbed 1#u8) fun block =>
  .call (readParts absorbed 2#u8) fun advanced =>
  .done (block,advanced)

def blockOutput (r : Run (Bytes32 × Bytes32)) : Bytes32 × Transcript Machine :=
  (r.value.1,⟨r.value.2,r.state⟩)

theorem block_call (s : Transcript Machine) (row : U8) (payload : Slice U8) :
    Transcript.block hash s row payload =
      ok (blockOutput (referenceRun (blockProgram s.state row payload) s.hash)) := by
  simp only [Transcript.block,Transcript.absorb,hash,call_exact,bind_tc_ok,lift,
    referenceRun,blockProgram,suffixAbsorbParts,readParts,blockOutput,Aeneas.Std.uncurry]

/-- This is the concrete reference step, not a supplied execution-equality field. -/
def referenceHash : AspisR1EffectCallers27.Digest32 Machine :=
  ⟨fun s parts => ok (expected s parts)⟩

theorem dictionary_exact : hash = referenceHash := by
  unfold hash referenceHash
  congr 1
  funext s parts
  exact call_exact s parts

/-- All sixteen eager query reads and the absorb use exactly the returned
reference effects. No query reads, failures or returned hash state are dropped. -/
theorem query_effects (s : Transcript Machine) (row : U8) (payload : Slice U8) :
    Transcript.materialize hash s row payload =
      Transcript.materialize referenceHash s row payload := by
  rw [dictionary_exact]

theorem semantic_history_length (state : Bytes32) (nextRow row : U8) (framed : Slice U8)
    (s : Machine) :
    (referenceRun (semanticProgram state nextRow row framed) s).history.length =
      if row=nextRow then 3 else 0 := by
  by_cases same : row=nextRow
  · subst row
    simp [semanticProgram,referenceRun]
  · simp [semanticProgram,referenceRun,same]

theorem block_history_length (state : Bytes32) (row : U8) (payload : Slice U8) (s : Machine) :
    (referenceRun (blockProgram state row payload) s).history.length = 3 := by
  simp [blockProgram,referenceRun]

#print axioms semantic_call
#print axioms block_call
#print axioms dictionary_exact
#print axioms query_effects
#print axioms semantic_history_length
#print axioms block_history_length
end R1Z.ProverCommitEffectCallers27

import R1Z.ProverCommitCoinCall27
/-! Induction over the actual extracted digest operation. This retains
wrapping behavior on every path; natural-cursor agreement has an explicit
arithmetic room condition, distinct from execution equality. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitCoinSequence27
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1CoinEffect27
open ProverCommitCoinTape27 ProverCommitCoinCall27
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
abbrev Parts := ProverCommitOracleEffect26.Parts
abbrev Bytes32 := ProverCommitCoinCall27.Bytes32

structure Run (Value : Type) where
  value : Value
  state : Machine
  history : List (Parts × Bytes32)

def evaluate {Value : Type} : Program Parts Bytes32 Value → Machine → Result (Run Value)
  | .done value,s => ok ⟨value,s,[]⟩
  | .call parts next,s => do
    let (answer,s') ← CoinOracle.Insts.Effect27EffectDigest32CoinState.digest mapRecording s parts
    let tail ← evaluate (next answer) s'
    ok {tail with history := (parts,answer)::tail.history}

def referenceRun {Value : Type} : Program Parts Bytes32 Value → Machine → Run Value
  | .done value,s => ⟨value,s,[]⟩
  | .call parts next,s =>
    let (answer,s') := expected s parts
    let tail := referenceRun (next answer) s'
    {tail with history := (parts,answer)::tail.history}

/-- Every extracted call, final recording/collision state and ordered query
history agree, for arbitrary finite adaptive programs, without a success premise. -/
theorem generated_sequence {Value : Type} (p : Program Parts Bytes32 Value) (s : Machine) :
    evaluate p s = ok (referenceRun p s) := by
  induction p generalizing s with
  | done value => rfl
  | call parts next ih =>
    simp only [evaluate,call_exact,bind_tc_ok]
    cases step : expected s parts with
    | mk answer state =>
      simp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry]
      rw [ih]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok,referenceRun,step,Aeneas.Std.uncurry]

/-- No probabilistic exception is introduced by a cursor representation.
Below wrap, the extracted machine's entire state is the Nat reference state. -/
theorem step_view (s : Machine) (parts : Parts)
    (room : s.next.val+1 < UScalar.size .Usize) :
    ( (expected s parts).1, view (expected s parts).2 ) =
      reference (view s) (ProverCommitStreamBytes.wireBytes parts) := by
  have next : (Usize.wrapping_add s.next 1#usize).val = s.next.val+1 := by
    rw [Usize.wrapping_add_val_eq]
    have one : (1#usize).val = 1 := by scalar_tac
    rw [one,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt room]
  unfold expected view reference answer
  simp only [next]

#print axioms generated_sequence
#print axioms step_view
end R1Z.ProverCommitCoinSequence27

/-! Exact generated call equation, including wrapping machine cursor and the
map contract's prior value. The Nat-view theorem separately requires room. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitCoinCall27
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1CoinEffect27
open ProverCommitCoinTape27 ProverCommitExtractedCoin27
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
abbrev Bytes32 := Array U8 32#usize
abbrev Table := List UInt8 → Option Bytes32
local instance : DecidableEq Bytes32 := Classical.decEq _
abbrev Machine := CoinState Table

def mapRecording : Recording Table where
  insert table parts answer := ok (insert table (ProverCommitStreamBytes.wireBytes parts) answer)

def answer (s : Machine) : Bytes32 :=
  (s.coins.val[s.next.val]?).getD (Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8)

def view (s : Machine) : State (List UInt8) Bytes32 :=
  ⟨fun n => (s.coins.val[n]?).getD (Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8),
    s.next.val,s.record,s.collision⟩

def expected (s : Machine) (parts : ProverCommitOracleEffect26.Parts) : Bytes32 × Machine :=
  let effects := (reference (view s) (ProverCommitStreamBytes.wireBytes parts)).2
  (answer s,{s with next := Usize.wrapping_add s.next 1#usize, record := effects.record,collision := effects.collision})

theorem read_total (s : Machine) :
    (if s.next < alloc.vec.Vec.len s.coins then
      alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice Bytes32) s.coins s.next
    else ok (Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8)) = ok (answer s) := by
  by_cases h : s.next.val < s.coins.val.length
  · have cond : s.next < alloc.vec.Vec.len s.coins := h
    rw [if_pos cond,alloc.vec.Vec.index_slice_index]
    simp only [alloc.vec.Vec.index_usize,alloc.vec.Vec.getElem?_Nat_eq,
      List.getElem?_eq_getElem h,answer,Option.getD_some]
  · have cond : ¬ s.next < alloc.vec.Vec.len s.coins := h
    rw [if_neg cond]
    simp only [answer,List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega : s.coins.val.length ≤ s.next.val),Option.getD_none]

/-- Exact generated body, for every finite vector length and every cursor.
Machine overflow is retained here instead of silently assuming it away. -/
theorem call_exact (s : Machine) (parts : ProverCommitOracleEffect26.Parts) :
    CoinOracle.Insts.Effect27EffectDigest32CoinState.digest mapRecording s parts =
      ok (expected s parts) := by
  simp only [CoinOracle.Insts.Effect27EffectDigest32CoinState.digest,read_total,bind_tc_ok,lift]
  cases rec : s.record with
  | none => simp [core.option.Option.take,rec,expected,view,reference,answer]
  | some table =>
    cases previous : table (ProverCommitStreamBytes.wireBytes parts) with
    | none => simp [core.option.Option.take,rec,mapRecording,ProverCommitCoinTape27.insert,previous,expected,view,reference,answer]
    | some old =>
      by_cases same : old = answer s
      · simp only [answer] at same
        simp [core.option.Option.take,rec,mapRecording,ProverCommitCoinTape27.insert,previous,different_eq,same,expected,view,reference,answer]
      · simp only [answer] at same
        simp [core.option.Option.take,rec,mapRecording,ProverCommitCoinTape27.insert,previous,different_eq,same,expected,view,reference,answer]

#print axioms read_total
#print axioms call_exact
end R1Z.ProverCommitCoinCall27

silently reinterpret, the old pure generated Digest32 dictionaries.

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitCoinTape27
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

structure State (Key Answer : Type) where
  coins : Nat → Answer
  cursor : Nat
  record : Option (Key → Option Answer)
  collision : Bool

variable {Key Answer : Type} [DecidableEq Key] [DecidableEq Answer]

def insert (table : Key → Option Answer) (key : Key) (answer : Answer) :
    Option Answer × (Key → Option Answer) :=
  (table key,fun q => if q = key then some answer else table q)

/-- Control order of the shipped body, after the named map contract. -/
def native (s : State Key Answer) (key : Key) : Answer × State Key Answer :=
  let answer := s.coins s.cursor
  let advanced := {s with cursor := s.cursor+1}
  match advanced.record with
  | none => (answer,advanced)
  | some table =>
    let (previous,table') := insert table key answer
    let flagged := match previous with
      | none => advanced.collision
      | some old => if old ≠ answer then true else advanced.collision
    (answer,{advanced with record := some table',collision := flagged})

/-- Explicit returned effects; no mutable handle is hidden in the digest. -/
def reference (s : State Key Answer) (key : Key) : Answer × State Key Answer :=
  let answer := s.coins s.cursor
  (answer,⟨s.coins,s.cursor+1,
    s.record.map (fun t q => if q = key then some answer else t q),
    s.collision || (match s.record.bind (fun t => t key) with
      | none => false
      | some old => decide (old ≠ answer))⟩)

theorem call_preserves (s : State Key Answer) (key : Key) :
    native s key = reference s key := by
  rcases s with ⟨coins,cursor,record,collision⟩
  cases record with
  | none => simp [native,reference]
  | some table =>
    cases old : table key with
    | none => simp [native,reference,insert,old]
    | some previous =>
      by_cases h : previous = coins cursor
      · simp [native,reference,insert,old,h]
      · simp [native,reference,insert,old,h]

/-- Arbitrary finite adaptive call trees, including early exits. -/
inductive Program (Key Answer Value : Type) where
  | done : Value → Program Key Answer Value
  | call : Key → (Answer → Program Key Answer Value) → Program Key Answer Value

structure Execution (Key Answer Value : Type) where
  value : Value
  state : State Key Answer
  history : List (Key × Answer)

def run {Value : Type} (step : State Key Answer → Key → Answer × State Key Answer) :
    Program Key Answer Value → State Key Answer → Execution Key Answer Value
  | .done value,s => ⟨value,s,[]⟩
  | .call key next,s =>
    let (answer,s') := step s key
    let tail := run step (next answer) s'
    {tail with history := (key,answer)::tail.history}

/-- Full final state and ordered history, not just the returned digests. -/
theorem sequence_preserves {Value : Type} (p : Program Key Answer Value)
    (s : State Key Answer) : run native p s = run reference p s := by
  induction p generalizing s with
  | done value => rfl
  | call key next ih =>
    simp only [run,call_preserves]
    exact congrArg (fun tail : Execution Key Answer Value =>
      {tail with history := (key,(reference s key).1)::tail.history})
      (ih (reference s key).1 (reference s key).2)

/-- The cursor counts every query, including duplicates and exhausted reads. -/
theorem cursor_history {Value : Type} (p : Program Key Answer Value)
    (s : State Key Answer) :
    (run reference p s).state.cursor = s.cursor + (run reference p s).history.length := by
  induction p generalizing s with
  | done value => simp [run]
  | call key next ih =>
    have h := ih (reference s key).1 (reference s key).2
    simp only [run,List.length_cons]
    change (run reference (next (reference s key).1) (reference s key).2).state.cursor = _
    rw [h]
    simp only [reference]
    omega

structure Digest32 (S : Type) where
  digest : S → ProverCommitOracleEffect26.Parts → Result (ProverCommitOracleEffect26.Bytes32 × S)

/-- Finite native tapes retain the exact zero fallback. -/
def finite (zero : Answer) (coins : List Answer) : Nat → Answer :=
  fun cursor => (coins[cursor]?).getD zero

theorem success (blocks advances : Blocks) (q : Queries) (next : Bytes32)
    (h : policy.queries blocks advances = ok (.Ok (q,next))) :
    AspisR1Query31Transcript.DriverTrace (modelScanFn actualQueryWords)
      blocks advances initial q next ∧
    ∃ evidence sf, Q22ScanChain actualQueryWords blocks initial evidence sf ∧
      evidence.length ≤ 8 ∧ validState sf ∧

        (fun j => AspisR1QueryScanUnrolled.r0_transcript.queryMaskWord
          (AspisR1QueryScanUnrolled.r0_transcript.blockRankWord e.bytes j)) := by
  have hr : raw blocks advances = ok (.Ok (q,next)) := by
    change (do let r ← raw blocks advances
               match r with
               | .Ok value => ok (core.result.Result.Ok value)
               | .Err _ => ok (core.result.Result.Err verifier.Error.Transcript)) = _ at h
    cases he : raw blocks advances with
    | fail e => simp only [he,bind_tc_fail] at h; cases h
    | div => simp only [he,bind_tc_div] at h; cases h
    | ok r =>

      | Ok value =>

import AspisR1SimSemantic20.Funs
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitSemantic20
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1SimSemantic20
abbrev Bytes := alloc.vec.Vec U8
abbrev Records := alloc.vec.Vec Bytes
abbrev Values := Array aspis_core.field.QM31 25#usize
abbrev State (H : Type) := r1_wire.SemanticTranscript H
abbrev Outcome (H : Type) := Result ((core.result.Result Values r1_wire.Error) × State H)

def finite {H : Type} (hash : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H) (records : Records)
    (row : Usize) : Nat → State H → Values → Result ((core.result.Result Values r1_wire.Error) × State H)
  | 0, state, sem => ok (core.result.Result.Ok sem,state)
  | n+1, state, sem => do
    let index ← lift (UScalar.cast .U8 row)
    let value ← alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice Bytes) records row
    let record ← alloc.vec.CloneVec.clone core.clone.CloneU8 value
    let (value,next) ← r1_wire.semantic20.semantic hash state index record
    match value with
    | core.result.Result.Err e => ok (core.result.Result.Err e,next)
    | core.result.Result.Ok value => do
      let sem ← Array.update sem row value
      finite hash records (Usize.wrapping_add row 1#usize) n next sem

theorem increment (row : Usize) (bound : row.val<25) :
    (Usize.wrapping_add row 1#usize).val=row.val+1 := by
  rw [Usize.wrapping_add_val_eq]
  have one : (1#usize).val=1 := by scalar_tac
  rw [one]
  apply Nat.mod_eq_of_lt
  have cap := (25#usize).hSize
  change 25<UScalar.size .Usize at cap
  omega

/-- Full finite semantic-row execution including errors, advanced state,
array updates, cloned bytes and the actual three-read hash interface. -/
theorem extracted_finite {H : Type} (hash : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
    (records : Records) (row : Usize) (remaining : Nat) (state : State H) (sem : Values)
    (count : row.val+remaining=25) :
    r1_wire.semantic20.rows hash state records row sem =
      finite hash records row remaining state sem := by
  induction remaining generalizing row state sem with
  | zero =>
    have stop : row=25#usize := by scalar_tac
    rw [r1_wire.semantic20.rows]
    simp only [stop,if_true,finite]
  | succ n ih =>
    have more : row≠25#usize := by scalar_tac
    rw [r1_wire.semantic20.rows]
    simp only [more,if_false,finite,lift,bind_tc_ok]
    cases hi : alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice Bytes) records row with
    | fail e => simp only [bind_tc_fail]
    | div => simp only [bind_tc_div]
    | ok value =>
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      cases hc : alloc.vec.CloneVec.clone core.clone.CloneU8 value with
      | fail e => simp only [bind_tc_fail]
      | div => simp only [bind_tc_div]
      | ok record =>
        simp only [bind_tc_ok]
        cases hs : r1_wire.semantic20.semantic hash state (UScalar.cast .U8 row) record with
        | fail e => simp only [bind_tc_fail]
        | div => simp only [bind_tc_div]
        | ok result =>
          rcases result with ⟨value,next⟩
          simp only [bind_tc_ok,Aeneas.Std.uncurry_apply_pair]
          cases value with
          | Err e => rfl
          | Ok value =>
            cases hu : Array.update sem row value with
            | fail e => simp only [hu,bind_tc_fail]
            | div => simp only [hu,bind_tc_div]
            | ok after =>
              simp only [hu,bind_tc_ok,lift]
              exact ih (Usize.wrapping_add row 1#usize) next after
                (by rw [increment row (by omega)];omega)

#print axioms AspisR1SimSemantic20.r1_wire.fields20.validate
end R1Z.ProverCommitSemantic20

private theorem digitsValue_fin_sum (p : Nat) (xs : List Nat) :
    digitsValue p xs =
      ∑ i : Fin xs.length, xs[i.val]'i.isLt * p ^ i.val := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp [digitsValue]
  | cons d ds ih =>
      calc
        digitsValue p (d :: ds) = d + p * digitsValue p ds := rfl
        _ = d + p * (∑ i : Fin ds.length, ds[i.val]'i.isLt * p ^ i.val) := by rw [ih]
        _ = d + ∑ i : Fin ds.length, ds[i.val]'i.isLt * p ^ (i.val + 1) := by
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          congr 1
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i hi
          rw [pow_succ]
          ring
        _ = ∑ i : Fin (ds.length + 1), (d :: ds)[i.val]'i.isLt * p ^ i.val := by
          rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
          simp only [List.getElem_cons_zero, List.getElem_cons_succ,

private theorem candidate_digits_fieldRank (digits : GammaDigits)
    (scalar : Nat)
    (hcanonical : ∀ i : Fin 8,
      (digitAt digits i).val < AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.P)
    (hvalue : digitsValue EP (values digits) = scalar)
    (hscalar : scalar < EP ^ 8) :
    R0C.ModuloField.digitsField
        (AspisR1.ExtractedQM31SamplerIndexedDecode8RetainedBridgeV3.retainedDigits
          digits hcanonical) =
      R0C.ModuloField.fieldRank ⟨scalar, by
        change scalar < AspisCircleGroupOrder.P ^ 8
        have heq : EP = AspisCircleGroupOrder.P :=
          samplerP_eq_exactP.symm.trans samplerP_eq_circleP
        rw [← heq]
        exact hscalar⟩ := by
  let f := AspisR1.ExtractedQM31SamplerIndexedDecode8RetainedBridgeV3.retainedDigits
    digits hcanonical
  have hlen : (values digits).length = 8 := by
    simp only [values, List.length_map]
    have hdigits := digits.property
    change digits.val.length = (8#usize).val at hdigits
    have h8 : (8#usize).val = 8 := by decide
    omega
  have hfval : ∀ i : Fin 8, (f i).val =
      (values digits)[i.val]'(by
        simp only [values, List.length_map]
        have hlen := digits.property
        change digits.val.length = (8#usize).val at hlen
        have h8 : (8#usize).val = 8 := by decide
        omega) := by
    intro i
    unfold f
    change (digits.val[i.val]'(by simpa [digits.property] using i.isLt)).val =
      (values digits)[i.val]'(by simpa [hlen] using i.isLt)
    simp only [values, List.getElem_map]
  have hpos :
      (SamplerRanking.digitsRank EP 8 f).val = digitsValue EP (values digits) := by
    rw [SamplerRanking.digitsRank_value]
    have hsum0 := digitsValue_fin_sum EP (values digits)
    have hsum : digitsValue EP (values digits) =
        ∑ i : Fin 8, (values digits)[i.val]'(by
          simp only [values, List.length_map]
          have hlen' := digits.property
          change digits.val.length = (8#usize).val at hlen'
          have h8 : (8#usize).val = 8 := by decide
          omega) * EP ^ i.val := by
      let e : Fin 8 ≃ Fin (values digits).length := finCongr hlen.symm
      let term : Fin (values digits).length → Nat := fun i =>
        (values digits)[i.val]'i.isLt * EP ^ i.val
      calc
        digitsValue EP (values digits) = ∑ i : Fin (values digits).length,
            (values digits)[i.val]'i.isLt * EP ^ i.val := by
          exact hsum0
        _ = ∑ i : Fin 8, term (e i) := (Equiv.sum_comp e term).symm
        _ = ∑ i : Fin 8, (values digits)[i.val]'(by
              simp only [values, List.length_map]
              have hlen' := digits.property
              change digits.val.length = (8#usize).val at hlen'
              have h8 : (8#usize).val = 8 := by decide
              omega) * EP ^ i.val := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i hi
          simp [term, e, hlen]
    rw [hsum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    rw [hfval i]
  have hscalarCircle : scalar < AspisCircleGroupOrder.P ^ 8 := by
    have heq : EP = AspisCircleGroupOrder.P :=

    rw [← heq]

  have hfin : SamplerRanking.digitsRank EP 8 f = ⟨scalar, hscalarCircle⟩ := by

    simpa [hvalue] using hpos

        rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
      _ = (SamplerRanking.digitsRank EP 8).symm ⟨scalar, hscalarCircle⟩ := by
        rw [hfin]
  change R0C.ModuloField.digitsField f =
    R0C.ModuloField.digitsField ((SamplerRanking.digitsRank EP 8).symm ⟨scalar, hscalarCircle⟩)

private theorem wordValue_reverse_cons (x : U32) (xs : List U32) :

    (arr.val[0]'(by rw [arr.property]; decide)).val = wordValue (words arr).reverse := by
  rcases arr with ⟨xs,hlen⟩
  cases xs with
  | nil => simp at hlen
  | cons x xs =>

      change wordValue ((x :: xs).map decode32).reverse < B at hsmall

theorem low_candidate_refines (block : Bytes32) (ds : Digits) (q : U32)

  have hed : ds1 = ds := congrArg Prod.fst heq
  have heq1 : q1 = q := congrArg Prod.snd heq
  subst ds1
  refine ⟨hdigits,?_⟩

private theorem bind_success {α β : Type} (m : Result α) (k : α → Result β) (v : β)

  cases m with
  | ok x => exact ⟨x, rfl, h⟩
  | fail e => simp only [bind_tc_fail] at h; cases h
  | div => simp only [bind_tc_div] at h; cases h

private theorem pair_bind_success {α β γ : Type} (m : Result (α × β))
    (k : α → β → Result γ) (v : γ)
    (h : (do let (a,b) ← m; k a b) = ok v) :
    ∃ a b, m = ok (a,b) ∧ k a b = ok v := by
  cases m with
  | ok pair => cases pair with | mk a b => exact ⟨a,b,rfl,h⟩
  | fail e => simp only [bind_tc_fail] at h; cases h
  | div => simp only [bind_tc_div] at h; cases h

    caller-supplied operation; iterator semantics are the checked list model. -/

    (decodeBlock : Array Std.U8 32#usize → Result (Array Std.U32 8#usize))
    (s : QueryScan) (block : Array Std.U8 32#usize) :
    Result (Bool × QueryScan) := do
  let words ← decodeBlock block
  let (sf, pending) ← scanListLoop words.val s
  ok (optionStop pending, sf)

    (s sf : QueryScan) (block : Array Std.U8 32#usize) (stop : Bool)
    (hs : validState s)

    ∃ words : Array Std.U32 8#usize,
      decodeBlock block = .ok words ∧
      scan (q22StateOf s) (words.val.map (fun x => x.val)) =
        (q22StateOf sf, stop) ∧ validState sf := by
  unfold modelScanFn at hcall
  obtain ⟨words, hdecode, htail⟩ := bind_success (decodeBlock block) _ _ hcall
  obtain ⟨sf', pending, hloop, hpair⟩ := pair_bind_success
    (scanListLoop words.val s)
    (fun sf pending => .ok (optionStop pending, sf))
    (stop, sf) htail
  have hvals : optionStop pending = stop ∧ sf' = sf := by
    injection (Result.ok.inj hpair) with hstop hsf
    exact ⟨hstop, hsf⟩
  obtain ⟨sf0, pending0, hmodel, hscan, hvalid⟩ := scanListLoop_q22_valid words.val s hs
  have hsame : (sf0, pending0) = (sf', pending) :=
    Result.ok.inj (hmodel.symm.trans hloop)
  rcases hsame with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  have hpair' : (optionStop pending, sf') = (stop, sf) := Result.ok.inj hpair
  have hstop : optionStop pending = stop := congrArg Prod.fst hpair'
  have hsf : sf' = sf := congrArg Prod.snd hpair'
  refine ⟨words, hdecode, ?_, ?_⟩
  · cases hsf
    cases hstop
    exact hscan
  · cases hsf
    exact hvalid
