import Query31ExplicitScanConcreteSteps
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow Error
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Query31ExplicitListLoop
open Query31ExplicitScanBody Query31ExplicitScanConcreteSteps
open AspisV8R19.Q22WordScan

abbrev CurrentScan := Query31ExplicitScanBody.CurrentScan

def listNext : List Std.U32 → Result (Option Std.U32 × List Std.U32)
  | [] => .ok (none, [])
  | x :: xs => .ok (some x, xs)

def step (p : List Std.U32 × CurrentScan) :
    Result (ControlFlow (List Std.U32 × CurrentScan) (CurrentScan × Option Bool)) :=
  body (stdOps listNext) p.1 p.2

def scanListLoop (xs : List Std.U32) (s : CurrentScan) :
    Result (CurrentScan × Option Bool) := Aeneas.Std.loop step (xs, s)

private theorem take_set_succ {α : Type} (xs : List α) (i : Nat)
    (hi : i < xs.length) (x : α) :
    (xs.set i x).take (i + 1) = xs.take i ++ [x] := by
  induction i generalizing xs with
  | zero => cases xs with | nil => simp at hi | cons a tail => simp
  | succ i ih =>
      cases xs with
      | nil => simp at hi
      | cons a tail =>
          have hi' : i < tail.length := by simp at hi; omega
          simp [ih tail hi']

private theorem array_update_success_val {α : Type} {n : Usize}
    (v : Array α n) (i : Usize) (x : α) (hi : i.val < n.val) :
    ∃ a : Array α n, Array.update v i x = .ok a ∧
      a.val = v.val.set i.val x := by
  have hidx : i.val < v.val.length := by simpa [v.property] using hi
  let a : Array α n := ⟨v.val.set i.val x, by simp [List.length_set, v.property]⟩
  refine ⟨a, ?_, rfl⟩
  unfold Array.update
  change (match v.val[i.val]? with
    | none => Result.fail Error.arrayOutOfBounds
    | some _ => Result.ok a) = Result.ok a
  rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hidx]

theorem q22_state_fresh_update
    (s : CurrentScan) (candidate : Std.U32) (a : Array Std.U32 22#usize)
    (lenNext drawNext : Std.Usize)
    (hupdate : s.accepted.update s.accepted_len candidate = .ok a)
    (hbound : s.accepted_len.val < s.accepted.val.length)
    (hlenval : lenNext.val = s.accepted_len.val + 1)
    (hdrawval : drawNext.val = s.draws.val + 1) :
    q22StateOf { s with accepted := a, accepted_len := lenNext, draws := drawNext } =
      ⟨acceptedPrefix s ++ [candidate.val], s.draws.val + 1⟩ := by
  have hbound' : s.accepted_len.val < (22#usize).val := by
    simpa [s.accepted.property] using hbound
  obtain ⟨a0, hupdate0, hset⟩ := array_update_success_val s.accepted s.accepted_len candidate hbound'
  have haa : a0 = a := Result.ok.inj (hupdate0.symm.trans hupdate)
  have hseta : a.val = s.accepted.val.set s.accepted_len.val candidate := by
    simpa [haa] using hset
  change (⟨(a.val.take lenNext.val).map (fun x => x.val), drawNext.val⟩ : ScanState) =
    ⟨acceptedPrefix s ++ [candidate.val], s.draws.val + 1⟩
  simp only [ScanState.mk.injEq]
  constructor
  · rw [hseta, hlenval, take_set_succ _ _ hbound]
    simp [acceptedPrefix]
  · exact hdrawval

private theorem q22_state_duplicate_update (s : CurrentScan) (drawNext : Std.Usize)
    (hdrawval : drawNext.val = s.draws.val + 1) :
    q22StateOf { s with draws := drawNext } =
      ⟨acceptedPrefix s, s.draws.val + 1⟩ := by
  simp [q22StateOf, acceptedPrefix, hdrawval]

def validState (s : CurrentScan) : Prop :=
  s.accepted_len.val ≤ 22 ∧ s.draws.val ≤ 64 ∧
    (acceptedPrefix s).length = s.accepted_len.val

theorem validState_of_bounds (s : CurrentScan)
    (hlen : s.accepted_len.val ≤ 22) (hdraw : s.draws.val ≤ 64) : validState s := by
  refine ⟨hlen, hdraw, ?_⟩
  have harray : s.accepted.val.length = 22 := by
    simpa using s.accepted.property
  simp [acceptedPrefix, harray, Nat.min_eq_left hlen]

private theorem active_q22 (s : CurrentScan) (h : validState s)
    (hactive : s.accepted_len.val < 22 ∧ s.draws.val < 64) :
    (q22StateOf s).accepted.length ≠ 22 ∧ (q22StateOf s).draws ≠ 64 := by
  constructor
  · have hs : (q22StateOf s).accepted.length = s.accepted_len.val := by
      simpa [q22StateOf] using h.2.2
    omega
  · simp [q22StateOf]
    omega

private theorem add_one_small_local (a : Std.Usize) (ha : a.val < 64) :
    ∃ b : Std.Usize, (a + 1#usize : Result Std.Usize) = .ok b ∧
      b.val = a.val + 1 := by
  have hb : a.val + 1 ≤ Usize.max := by
    have hm := Usize.cMax_bound_concrete.1
    omega
  have hs : (a + 1#usize : Result Std.Usize) ⦃ b => b.val = a.val + 1 ⦄ := by
    apply UScalar.add_spec
    simpa only [UScalar.max_USize_eq] using
      (show a.val + (1#usize).val ≤ Usize.max by simpa using hb)
  obtain ⟨b, hab, hv⟩ := Aeneas.Std.WP.spec_imp_exists hs
  exact ⟨b, hab, hv⟩

private theorem slice_read_prefix_success (s : CurrentScan)
    (hlen : s.accepted_len.val < 22) :
    ∃ sl : Slice Std.U32,
      core.array.Array.index
        (core.ops.index.IndexSlice (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice Std.U32))
        s.accepted { «end» := s.accepted_len } = .ok sl ∧
      (↑sl : List Std.U32) = s.accepted.val.take s.accepted_len.val := by
  have h22 : (22#usize).val = 22 := rfl
  have hbound : s.accepted_len.val ≤ s.accepted.length := by
    simp only [Array.length, s.accepted.property, h22]
    omega
  have hs := core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice.index.step_spec
    ({ «end» := s.accepted_len } : core.ops.range.RangeTo Std.Usize)
    (Array.to_slice s.accepted) hbound
  obtain ⟨sl, hrun, hspec⟩ := Aeneas.Std.WP.spec_imp_exists hs
  refine ⟨sl, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice.index
      { «end» := s.accepted_len } (Array.to_slice s.accepted) = .ok sl
    exact hrun
  · rcases hspec with ⟨hv, _⟩
    simpa [Array.to_slice, List.slice] using hv

private theorem mem_map_val_iff (xs : List Std.U32) (candidate : Std.U32) :
    candidate.val ∈ xs.map (fun y => y.val) ↔ candidate ∈ xs := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    simp only [List.mem_map] at h
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hval⟩ := h
    have heq : candidate = y := by
      cases candidate with
      | mk cbv => cases y with
        | mk ybv =>
          simp only [Aeneas.Std.UScalar.mk.injEq]
          exact (BitVec.toNat_inj).mp hval.symm
    exact heq ▸ hy
  · intro h
    simp only [List.mem_map]
    exact ⟨candidate, h, rfl⟩

private theorem duplicate_from_bounds
    (iter iter1 : List Std.U32) (s : CurrentScan) (candidate : Std.U32)
    (hnext : listNext iter = .ok (some candidate, iter1))
    (hlen : s.accepted_len.val < 22) (hdraw : s.draws.val < 64)
    (hmember : candidate.val ∈ acceptedPrefix s) :
    ∃ drawNext,
      (s.draws + 1#usize : Result Std.Usize) = .ok drawNext ∧
      drawNext.val = s.draws.val + 1 ∧
      body (stdOps listNext) iter s =
        .ok (.cont (iter1, { s with draws := drawNext })) ∧
      q22StateOf { s with draws := drawNext } =
        ⟨acceptedPrefix s, s.draws.val + 1⟩ := by
  obtain ⟨drawNext, hdrawop, hdrawval⟩ := add_one_small_local s.draws hdraw
  obtain ⟨sl, hsl, hslval⟩ := slice_read_prefix_success s hlen
  have hmem : candidate ∈ (↑sl : List Std.U32) := by
    rw [hslval]
    have hp : candidate.val ∈
        (s.accepted.val.take s.accepted_len.val).map (fun x => x.val) := by
      simpa [acceptedPrefix] using hmember
    exact (mem_map_val_iff (s.accepted.val.take s.accepted_len.val) candidate).mp hp
  have hcontains : core.slice.Slice.contains core.cmp.PartialEqU32 sl candidate = .ok true := by
    rw [slice_contains_eq_mem]
    simp [hmem]
  have hnotfull : s.accepted_len ≠ 22#usize := by
    intro he
    have hv := congrArg UScalar.val he
    simp at hv
    omega
  have hnotcap : s.draws ≠ 64#usize := by
    intro he
    have hv := congrArg UScalar.val he
    simp at hv
    omega
  have hstep := duplicate_step (stdOps listNext) iter iter1 s candidate drawNext sl
    hnext hnotfull hnotcap hdrawop hsl hcontains
  have hstate := q22_state_duplicate_update s drawNext hdrawval
  exact ⟨drawNext, hdrawop, hdrawval, hstep, hstate⟩

private theorem q22_scan_continuation (s s' : ScanState) (x : Nat)
    (xs : List Nat)
    (hstop : ¬(s.accepted.length = 22 ∨ s.draws = 64))
    (hkeep : keep s.accepted x = s'.accepted)
    (hdraw : s.draws + 1 = s'.draws) :
    scan s (x :: xs) = scan s' xs := by
  simp [scan, hstop, hkeep, hdraw]

private theorem scanListLoop_empty (s : CurrentScan) :
    scanListLoop [] s = .ok (s, some false) := by
  unfold scanListLoop step
  rw [Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def]
  simp [body, stdOps, listNext]

private theorem scanListLoop_cons_cont
    (x : Std.U32) (xs : List Std.U32) (s s' : CurrentScan)
    (hbody : body (stdOps listNext) (x :: xs) s = .ok (.cont (xs, s'))) :
    scanListLoop (x :: xs) s = scanListLoop xs s' := by
  unfold scanListLoop step
  rw [Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def]
  simp only [hbody]

def optionStop : Option Bool → Bool
  | none => true
  | some b => b

/-- The list-backed iterator model for the actual source-shaped body refines
    Q22's scan recurrence. This keeps array `IntoIter` out of the trusted import
    closure; the generated body/source equivalence and the array-iterator
    boundary remain separate. -/
theorem scanListLoop_q22_valid : ∀ (xs : List Std.U32) (s : CurrentScan),
    validState s → ∃ sf pending,
      scanListLoop xs s = .ok (sf, pending) ∧
      scan (q22StateOf s) (xs.map (fun x => x.val)) =
        (q22StateOf sf, optionStop pending) ∧ validState sf := by
  intro xs
  induction xs with
  | nil =>
      intro s hs
      refine ⟨s, some false, scanListLoop_empty s, ?_, hs⟩
      simp [optionStop, scan]
  | cons x xs ih =>
      intro s hs
      by_cases hlen : s.accepted_len.val = 22
      · have hlenEq : s.accepted_len = 22#usize := by
          apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
          simpa using hlen
        have hnext : listNext (x :: xs) = .ok (some x, xs) := rfl
        have hbody : body (stdOps listNext) (x :: xs) s =
            .ok (.done (s, none)) := by
          simp [body, stdOps, hnext, hlenEq]
        have hloop : scanListLoop (x :: xs) s = .ok (s, none) := by
          unfold scanListLoop step
          rw [Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def]
          simp only [hbody]
        refine ⟨s, none, hloop, ?_, hs⟩
        have hq : (q22StateOf s).accepted.length = 22 := by
          change (acceptedPrefix s).length = 22
          have hp := hs.2.2
          omega
        simp [optionStop, scan, hq]
      · by_cases hdraw : s.draws.val = 64
        · have hdrawEq : s.draws = 64#usize := by
            apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
            simpa using hdraw
          have hnext : listNext (x :: xs) = .ok (some x, xs) := rfl
          have hbody : body (stdOps listNext) (x :: xs) s =
              .ok (.done (s, none)) := by
            simp [body, stdOps, hnext, hlen, hdrawEq]
          have hloop : scanListLoop (x :: xs) s = .ok (s, none) := by
            unfold scanListLoop step
            rw [Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def]
            simp only [hbody]
          refine ⟨s, none, hloop, ?_, hs⟩
          have hq : (q22StateOf s).draws = 64 := by
            simpa [q22StateOf] using hdraw
          simp [optionStop, scan, hq]
        · have hlenBound := hs.1
          have hlenLt : s.accepted_len.val < 22 := by omega
          have hdrawBound := hs.2.1
          have hdrawLt : s.draws.val < 64 := by omega
          have hnext : listNext (x :: xs) = .ok (some x, xs) := rfl
          by_cases hfresh : x.val ∉ acceptedPrefix s
          · obtain ⟨drawNext, lenNext, a, hdrawop, hdrawval, hlenop, hlenval,
              hupdate, hbody, hstate, hscan⟩ :=
              fresh_from_bounds listNext (x :: xs) xs s x hnext hlenLt hdrawLt hfresh
            let s' : CurrentScan := ⟨a, lenNext, drawNext⟩
            have hvalid' : validState s' := by
              refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
              · change lenNext.val ≤ 22
                omega
              · change drawNext.val ≤ 64
                omega
              · have hprefix := congrArg (fun q : ScanState => q.accepted.length) hstate
                change (acceptedPrefix s').length = lenNext.val
                calc
                  (acceptedPrefix s').length = (acceptedPrefix s).length + 1 := by
                    simpa [s', q22StateOf] using hprefix
                  _ = lenNext.val := by rw [hs.2.2, hlenval]
            obtain ⟨sf, pending, htail, hqtail, hvalidsf⟩ := ih s' hvalid'
            have hloop := scanListLoop_cons_cont x xs s s' (by simpa [s'] using hbody)
            have hqstep : scan (q22StateOf s) (x.val :: xs.map (fun y => y.val)) =
                scan (q22StateOf s') (xs.map (fun y => y.val)) := by
              have hstop : ¬((q22StateOf s).accepted.length = 22 ∨
                  (q22StateOf s).draws = 64) := by
                exact not_or.mpr (active_q22 s hs ⟨hlenLt, hdrawLt⟩)
              have hstate' : q22StateOf s' =
                  ⟨acceptedPrefix s ++ [x.val], s.draws.val + 1⟩ := by
                simpa [s'] using hstate
              have hkeep : keep (q22StateOf s).accepted x.val = (q22StateOf s').accepted := by
                have hacc := congrArg (fun t : ScanState => t.accepted) hstate'
                change keep (acceptedPrefix s) x.val = (q22StateOf s').accepted
                rw [hacc]
                simp [keep, hfresh]
              have hdraw' : (q22StateOf s).draws + 1 = (q22StateOf s').draws := by
                have hh := congrArg (fun t : ScanState => t.draws) hstate'
                simpa [q22StateOf] using hh.symm
              exact q22_scan_continuation (q22StateOf s) (q22StateOf s') x.val
                (xs.map fun y => y.val) hstop hkeep hdraw'
            refine ⟨sf, pending, ?_, ?_, hvalidsf⟩
            · rw [hloop, htail]
            · rw [List.map_cons, hqstep, hqtail]
          · have hmember : x.val ∈ acceptedPrefix s := by
              by_contra hn
              exact hfresh hn
            obtain ⟨drawNext, hdrawop, hdrawval, hbody, hstate⟩ :=
              duplicate_from_bounds (x :: xs) xs s x hnext hlenLt hdrawLt hmember
            let s' : CurrentScan := { s with draws := drawNext }
            have hvalid' : validState s' := by
              refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
              · change s.accepted_len.val ≤ 22
                exact hs.1
              · change drawNext.val ≤ 64
                omega
              · change (acceptedPrefix s).length = s.accepted_len.val
                exact hs.2.2
            obtain ⟨sf, pending, htail, hqtail, hvalidsf⟩ := ih s' hvalid'
            have hloop := scanListLoop_cons_cont x xs s s' (by simpa [s'] using hbody)
            have hqstep : scan (q22StateOf s) (x.val :: xs.map (fun y => y.val)) =
                scan (q22StateOf s') (xs.map (fun y => y.val)) := by
              have hstop : ¬((q22StateOf s).accepted.length = 22 ∨
                  (q22StateOf s).draws = 64) := by
                exact not_or.mpr (active_q22 s hs ⟨hlenLt, hdrawLt⟩)
              have hstate' : q22StateOf s' = ⟨acceptedPrefix s, s.draws.val + 1⟩ := by
                simpa [s'] using hstate
              have hkeep : keep (q22StateOf s).accepted x.val = (q22StateOf s').accepted := by
                have hacc := congrArg (fun t : ScanState => t.accepted) hstate'
                change keep (acceptedPrefix s) x.val = (q22StateOf s').accepted
                rw [hacc]
                simp [keep, hmember]
              have hdraw' : (q22StateOf s).draws + 1 = (q22StateOf s').draws := by
                have hh := congrArg (fun t : ScanState => t.draws) hstate'
                simpa [q22StateOf] using hh.symm
              exact q22_scan_continuation (q22StateOf s) (q22StateOf s') x.val
                (xs.map fun y => y.val) hstop hkeep hdraw'
            refine ⟨sf, pending, ?_, ?_, hvalidsf⟩
            · rw [hloop, htail]
            · rw [List.map_cons, hqstep, hqtail]

theorem scanListLoop_q22 : ∀ (xs : List Std.U32) (s : CurrentScan),
    validState s → ∃ sf pending,
      scanListLoop xs s = .ok (sf, pending) ∧
      scan (q22StateOf s) (xs.map (fun x => x.val)) =
        (q22StateOf sf, optionStop pending) := by
  intro xs s hs
  obtain ⟨sf, pending, hloop, hscan, _hvalid⟩ := scanListLoop_q22_valid xs s hs
  exact ⟨sf, pending, hloop, hscan⟩

#print axioms scanListLoop_q22_valid
#print axioms scanListLoop_q22
end Query31ExplicitListLoop

    simp only [List.mem_map] at h
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hval⟩ := h
    have heq : candidate = y := by
      cases candidate with
      | mk cbv => cases y with
        | mk ybv =>
          simp only [Aeneas.Std.UScalar.mk.injEq]
          exact (BitVec.toNat_inj).mp hval.symm
    exact heq ▸ hy
  · intro h
    simp only [List.mem_map]
    exact ⟨candidate, h, rfl⟩

private theorem array_update_success_val {α : Type} {n : Usize}
    (v : Array α n) (i : Usize) (x : α) (hi : i.val < n.val) :
    ∃ a : Array α n, Array.update v i x = .ok a ∧
      a.val = v.val.set i.val x := by
  have hidx : i.val < v.val.length := by simpa [v.property] using hi
  let a : Array α n := ⟨v.val.set i.val x, by simp [List.length_set, v.property]⟩
  refine ⟨a, ?_, rfl⟩
  unfold Array.update
  change (match v.val[i.val]? with
    | none => Result.fail Error.arrayOutOfBounds
    | some _ => Result.ok a) = Result.ok a
  rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hidx]

/-- The one-candidate fresh transition for the source-shaped body, with all
    five Std-operation slots instantiated by the actual Aeneas operations;
    only iterator advancement remains an explicit argument. -/
theorem fresh_from_bounds
    {Iter : Type} (next : Iter → Result (Option Std.U32 × Iter))
    (iter iter1 : Iter) (s : CurrentScan) (candidate : Std.U32)
    (hnext : next iter = .ok (some candidate, iter1))
    (hlen : s.accepted_len.val < 22) (hdraw : s.draws.val < 64)
    (hfresh : candidate.val ∉ acceptedPrefix s) :
    ∃ drawNext lenNext a,
      ((s.draws + 1#usize : Result Std.Usize) = .ok drawNext) ∧
      drawNext.val = s.draws.val + 1 ∧
      ((s.accepted_len + 1#usize : Result Std.Usize) = .ok lenNext) ∧
      lenNext.val = s.accepted_len.val + 1 ∧
      (s.accepted.update s.accepted_len candidate = .ok a) ∧
      body (stdOps next) iter s =
        .ok (.cont (iter1, { accepted := a, accepted_len := lenNext, draws := drawNext })) ∧
      q22StateOf { s with accepted := a, accepted_len := lenNext, draws := drawNext } =
        ⟨acceptedPrefix s ++ [candidate.val], s.draws.val + 1⟩ ∧
      scan (q22StateOf s) [candidate.val] =
        (q22StateOf { s with accepted := a, accepted_len := lenNext, draws := drawNext }, false) := by
  obtain ⟨drawNext, hdrawop, hdrawval⟩ := add_one_small s.draws hdraw
  obtain ⟨lenNext, hlenop, hlenval⟩ := add_one_small s.accepted_len (by omega)
  obtain ⟨sl, hsl, hslval⟩ := slice_read_prefix_success s hlen
  have hmem : candidate ∉ (↑sl : List Std.U32) := by
    rw [hslval]
    intro hm
    apply hfresh
    change candidate.val ∈ (s.accepted.val.take s.accepted_len.val).map (fun x => x.val)
    exact (mem_map_val_iff (s.accepted.val.take s.accepted_len.val) candidate).mpr hm
  have hcontains : core.slice.Slice.contains core.cmp.PartialEqU32 sl candidate = .ok false := by
    rw [slice_contains_eq_mem]
    simp [hmem]
  have hupdSpec := Array.update_spec s.accepted s.accepted_len candidate (by
    have h22 : (22#usize).val = 22 := rfl
    simp only [Array.length, s.accepted.property, h22]
    omega)
  obtain ⟨a, hupdate, _⟩ := Aeneas.Std.WP.spec_imp_exists hupdSpec
  have hnotfull : s.accepted_len ≠ 22#usize := by
    intro he
    have hv := congrArg UScalar.val he
    simp at hv
    omega
  have hnotcap : s.draws ≠ 64#usize := by
    intro he
    have hv := congrArg UScalar.val he
    simp at hv
    omega
  have hmodel := active_q22_of_bounded_source s hlen hdraw
  have hstep := fresh_step_q22 (stdOps next) iter iter1 s candidate drawNext lenNext sl a
    hnext hnotfull hnotcap hdrawop hsl hcontains hupdate hupdate hlenop
    hmodel.1 hmodel.2 hfresh (by
      have h22 : (22#usize).val = 22 := rfl
      simp only [s.accepted.property, h22]
      omega) hlenval hdrawval
  have hstate := q22_state_fresh_update s candidate a lenNext drawNext hupdate
    (by
      have h22 : (22#usize).val = 22 := rfl
      simp only [s.accepted.property, h22]
      omega) hlenval hdrawval
  exact ⟨drawNext, lenNext, a, hdrawop, hdrawval, hlenop, hlenval,
    hupdate, hstep.1, hstate, hstep.2⟩

#print axioms fresh_from_bounds
#print axioms slice_read_prefix_success
#print axioms slice_contains_eq_mem
end Query31ExplicitScanConcreteSteps

import Aeneas.Std
import Aeneas.Tactic.RustAttributes
import Aeneas.Data.Discriminant
import Query31ScanTypesOnly
import AspisV8R19.Q22WordScan
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow Error
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Query31ExplicitScanBody

abbrev CurrentScan := AspisR1Query31Transcript.aspis_core.r0_transcript.QueryScan

/-- The five Std boundaries used by the extracted scan-loop body.  They are
    parameters, not generated external axioms. -/
structure StdOps (Iter : Type) where
  iterNext : Iter → Result (Option Std.U32 × Iter)
  usizeAdd : Std.Usize → Std.Usize → Result Std.Usize
  readPrefix : Array Std.U32 22#usize → Std.Usize → Result (Slice Std.U32)
  contains : Slice Std.U32 → Std.U32 → Result Bool
  update : Array Std.U32 22#usize → Std.Usize → Std.U32 → Result (Array Std.U32 22#usize)


/-- The four pure/container boundaries use the actual typed Aeneas Std
    operations.  Iterator advancement remains explicit because the generated
    external iterator representation is intentionally abstract here. -/
def stdOps {Iter : Type} (next : Iter → Result (Option Std.U32 × Iter)) : StdOps Iter :=
  { iterNext := next
    usizeAdd := fun x y => x + y
    readPrefix := fun a n =>
      core.array.Array.index
        (core.ops.index.IndexSlice
          (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice Std.U32))
        a { «end» := n }
    contains := core.slice.Slice.contains core.cmp.PartialEqU32
    update := fun a i x => Array.update a i x }

/-- Source-shaped copy of QueryScan.scan_loop.body.  The declaration checker in
    this packet pins the current and prior generated source bodies to this
    operational sequence; each Std operation is supplied explicitly. -/
def body {Iter : Type} (ops : StdOps Iter) (iter : Iter) (s : CurrentScan) :
    Result (ControlFlow ((Iter × CurrentScan)) (CurrentScan × Option Bool)) := do
  let (o, iter1) ← ops.iterNext iter
  match o with
  | none => ok (ControlFlow.done (s, some false))
  | some candidate =>
    if s.accepted_len = 22#usize then
      ok (ControlFlow.done (s, none))
    else if s.draws = 64#usize then
      ok (ControlFlow.done (s, none))
    else
      let i ← ops.usizeAdd s.draws 1#usize
      let sl ← ops.readPrefix s.accepted s.accepted_len
      let b ← ops.contains sl candidate
      if b then
        ok (ControlFlow.cont (iter1, { s with draws := i }))
      else
        let a ← ops.update s.accepted s.accepted_len candidate
        let i1 ← ops.usizeAdd s.accepted_len 1#usize
        ok (ControlFlow.cont (iter1, { accepted := a, accepted_len := i1, draws := i }))



def acceptedPrefix (s : CurrentScan) : List Nat :=
  (s.accepted.val.take s.accepted_len.val).map (fun x => x.val)

def q22StateOf (s : CurrentScan) : AspisV8R19.Q22WordScan.ScanState :=
  ⟨acceptedPrefix s, s.draws.val⟩

private theorem take_set_succ {α : Type} (xs : List α) (i : Nat)
    (hi : i < xs.length) (x : α) :
    (xs.set i x).take (i + 1) = xs.take i ++ [x] := by
  induction i generalizing xs with
  | zero => cases xs with | nil => simp at hi | cons a tail => simp
  | succ i ih =>
      cases xs with
      | nil => simp at hi
      | cons a tail =>
          have hi' : i < tail.length := by simp at hi; omega
          simp [ih tail hi']

private theorem array_update_success_val {α : Type} {n : Usize}
    (v : Array α n) (i : Usize) (x : α) (hi : i.val < n.val) :
    ∃ a : Array α n, Array.update v i x = .ok a ∧
      a.val = v.val.set i.val x := by
  have hidx : i.val < v.val.length := by simpa [v.property] using hi
  let a : Array α n := ⟨v.val.set i.val x, by simp [List.length_set, v.property]⟩
  refine ⟨a, ?_, rfl⟩
  unfold Array.update
  change (match v.val[i.val]? with
    | none => Result.fail Error.arrayOutOfBounds
    | some _ => Result.ok a) = Result.ok a
  rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hidx]

theorem q22_state_fresh_update
    (s : CurrentScan) (candidate : Std.U32) (a : Array Std.U32 22#usize)
    (lenNext drawNext : Std.Usize)
    (hupdate : s.accepted.update s.accepted_len candidate = ok a)
    (hbound : s.accepted_len.val < s.accepted.val.length)
    (hlenval : lenNext.val = s.accepted_len.val + 1)
    (hdrawval : drawNext.val = s.draws.val + 1) :
    q22StateOf { s with accepted := a, accepted_len := lenNext, draws := drawNext } =
      ⟨acceptedPrefix s ++ [candidate.val], s.draws.val + 1⟩ := by
  have hbound' : s.accepted_len.val < (22#usize).val := by
    simpa [s.accepted.property] using hbound
  obtain ⟨a0, hupdate0, hset⟩ := array_update_success_val s.accepted s.accepted_len candidate hbound'
  have haa : a0 = a := Result.ok.inj (hupdate0.symm.trans hupdate)
  have hseta : a.val = s.accepted.val.set s.accepted_len.val candidate := by
    simpa [haa] using hset
  change (⟨(a.val.take lenNext.val).map (fun x => x.val), drawNext.val⟩ :
      AspisV8R19.Q22WordScan.ScanState) =
    ⟨acceptedPrefix s ++ [candidate.val], s.draws.val + 1⟩
  simp only [AspisV8R19.Q22WordScan.ScanState.mk.injEq]
  constructor
  · rw [hseta, hlenval, take_set_succ _ _ hbound]
    simp [acceptedPrefix]
  · exact hdrawval

/-- The prior Q22 list contract's exact one-word fresh transition. -/
theorem q22_fresh_transition (state : AspisV8R19.Q22WordScan.ScanState)
    (word : Nat) (hlen : state.accepted.length < 22)
    (hdraw : state.draws < 64) (hfresh : word ∉ state.accepted) :
    AspisV8R19.Q22WordScan.scan state [word] =
      ({ accepted := state.accepted ++ [word], draws := state.draws + 1 }, false) := by
  have hstop : ¬ (state.accepted.length = 22 ∨ state.draws = 64) := by omega
  simp [AspisV8R19.Q22WordScan.scan, hstop,
    AspisV8R19.Q22WordScan.keep, hfresh]

/-- The prior Q22 list contract's duplicate transition. -/
theorem q22_duplicate_transition (state : AspisV8R19.Q22WordScan.ScanState)
    (word : Nat) (hlen : state.accepted.length < 22)
    (hdraw : state.draws < 64) (hmember : word ∈ state.accepted) :
    AspisV8R19.Q22WordScan.scan state [word] =
      (state.accepted |> fun accepted =>
        ({ accepted, draws := state.draws + 1 } : AspisV8R19.Q22WordScan.ScanState), false) := by
  have hstop : ¬ (state.accepted.length = 22 ∨ state.draws = 64) := by omega
  simp [AspisV8R19.Q22WordScan.scan, hstop,
    AspisV8R19.Q22WordScan.keep, hmember]

/-- Fresh-candidate step law, with the exact source call results exposed. -/
theorem fresh_step
    {Iter : Type} (ops : StdOps Iter) (iter iter1 : Iter) (s : CurrentScan)
    (candidate : Std.U32) (drawNext lenNext : Std.Usize)
    (sl : Slice Std.U32) (a : Array Std.U32 22#usize)
    (hnext : ops.iterNext iter = .ok (some candidate, iter1))
    (hnotfull : s.accepted_len ≠ 22#usize)
    (hnotcap : s.draws ≠ 64#usize)
    (hdraw : ops.usizeAdd s.draws 1#usize = .ok drawNext)
    (hprefix : ops.readPrefix s.accepted s.accepted_len = .ok sl)
    (hcontains : ops.contains sl candidate = .ok false)
    (hupdate : ops.update s.accepted s.accepted_len candidate = .ok a)
    (hlen : ops.usizeAdd s.accepted_len 1#usize = .ok lenNext) :
    body ops iter s = .ok (.cont (iter1,
      { accepted := a, accepted_len := lenNext, draws := drawNext })) := by
  simp [body, hnext, hnotfull, hnotcap, hdraw, hprefix, hcontains, hupdate, hlen]

/-- Duplicate-candidate step law, with no update call. -/
theorem duplicate_step
    {Iter : Type} (ops : StdOps Iter) (iter iter1 : Iter) (s : CurrentScan)
    (candidate : Std.U32) (drawNext : Std.Usize) (sl : Slice Std.U32)
    (hnext : ops.iterNext iter = .ok (some candidate, iter1))
    (hnotfull : s.accepted_len ≠ 22#usize)
    (hnotcap : s.draws ≠ 64#usize)
    (hdraw : ops.usizeAdd s.draws 1#usize = .ok drawNext)
    (hprefix : ops.readPrefix s.accepted s.accepted_len = .ok sl)
    (hcontains : ops.contains sl candidate = .ok true) :
    body ops iter s = .ok (.cont (iter1, { s with draws := drawNext })) := by
  simp [body, hnext, hnotfull, hnotcap, hdraw, hprefix, hcontains]


/-- One-step source-body to Q22 recurrence bridge.  Every source operation is
    an explicit premise; `q22_state_fresh_update` connects the actual returned
    array/length/draw values to the recurrence state. -/
theorem fresh_step_q22
    {Iter : Type} (ops : StdOps Iter) (iter iter1 : Iter) (s : CurrentScan)
    (candidate : Std.U32) (drawNext lenNext : Std.Usize)
    (sl : Slice Std.U32) (a : Array Std.U32 22#usize)
    (hnext : ops.iterNext iter = .ok (some candidate, iter1))
    (hnotfull : s.accepted_len ≠ 22#usize)
    (hnotcap : s.draws ≠ 64#usize)
    (hdraw : ops.usizeAdd s.draws 1#usize = .ok drawNext)
    (hprefix : ops.readPrefix s.accepted s.accepted_len = .ok sl)
    (hcontains : ops.contains sl candidate = .ok false)
    (hupdate : ops.update s.accepted s.accepted_len candidate = .ok a)
    (hupdateStd : s.accepted.update s.accepted_len candidate = .ok a)
    (hlen : ops.usizeAdd s.accepted_len 1#usize = .ok lenNext)
    (hmodelLen : (q22StateOf s).accepted.length < 22)
    (hmodelDraw : (q22StateOf s).draws < 64)
    (hfresh : candidate.val ∉ acceptedPrefix s)
    (hbound : s.accepted_len.val < s.accepted.val.length)
    (hlenval : lenNext.val = s.accepted_len.val + 1)
    (hdrawval : drawNext.val = s.draws.val + 1) :
    body ops iter s = .ok (.cont (iter1,
      { accepted := a, accepted_len := lenNext, draws := drawNext })) ∧
    AspisV8R19.Q22WordScan.scan (q22StateOf s) [candidate.val] =
      (q22StateOf { accepted := a, accepted_len := lenNext, draws := drawNext }, false) := by
  have hbody := fresh_step ops iter iter1 s candidate drawNext lenNext sl a
    hnext hnotfull hnotcap hdraw hprefix hcontains hupdate hlen
  have hstate := q22_state_fresh_update s candidate a lenNext drawNext
    hupdateStd hbound hlenval hdrawval
  have hscan := q22_fresh_transition (q22StateOf s) candidate.val
    hmodelLen hmodelDraw hfresh
  refine ⟨hbody, ?_⟩
  rw [hscan]
  exact congrArg (fun q => (q, false)) hstate.symm

/-- Duplicate-step bridge to the Q22 recurrence.  The accepted prefix is
    unchanged and only the draw counter advances. -/
theorem duplicate_step_q22
    {Iter : Type} (ops : StdOps Iter) (iter iter1 : Iter) (s : CurrentScan)
    (candidate : Std.U32) (drawNext : Std.Usize) (sl : Slice Std.U32)
    (hnext : ops.iterNext iter = .ok (some candidate, iter1))
    (hnotfull : s.accepted_len ≠ 22#usize)
    (hnotcap : s.draws ≠ 64#usize)
    (hdraw : ops.usizeAdd s.draws 1#usize = .ok drawNext)
    (hprefix : ops.readPrefix s.accepted s.accepted_len = .ok sl)
    (hcontains : ops.contains sl candidate = .ok true)
    (hmodelLen : (q22StateOf s).accepted.length < 22)
    (hmodelDraw : (q22StateOf s).draws < 64)
    (hmember : candidate.val ∈ acceptedPrefix s)
    (hdrawval : drawNext.val = s.draws.val + 1) :
    body ops iter s = .ok (.cont (iter1, { s with draws := drawNext })) ∧
    AspisV8R19.Q22WordScan.scan (q22StateOf s) [candidate.val] =
      (q22StateOf { s with draws := drawNext }, false) := by
  have hbody := duplicate_step ops iter iter1 s candidate drawNext sl
    hnext hnotfull hnotcap hdraw hprefix hcontains
  have hscan := q22_duplicate_transition (q22StateOf s) candidate.val
    hmodelLen hmodelDraw hmember
  refine ⟨hbody, ?_⟩
  rw [hscan]
  simp [q22StateOf, acceptedPrefix, hdrawval]

#print axioms stdOps
#print axioms fresh_step_q22
#print axioms duplicate_step_q22
#print axioms q22_state_fresh_update
#print axioms q22_fresh_transition
#print axioms q22_duplicate_transition
#print axioms fresh_step
#print axioms duplicate_step
end Query31ExplicitScanBody

import Query31ScanTypesOnly
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow Error
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace AspisR1Query31Transcript

@[global_simps, irreducible]
def aspis_core.r0_transcript.QUERY_COUNT : Std.Usize := 22#usize

@[global_simps, irreducible]
def aspis_core.r0_transcript.QUERY_MAX_DRAWS : Std.Usize := 64#usize

def aspis_core.r0_transcript.QueryScan.finish
  (self : aspis_core.r0_transcript.QueryScan) :
  Result (core.result.Result (Array Std.U32 22#usize)
    aspis_core.transcript.QuerySampleError)
  := do
  if self.accepted_len = aspis_core.r0_transcript.QUERY_COUNT
  then ok (core.result.Result.Ok self.accepted)
  else
    ok (core.result.Result.Err
      (aspis_core.transcript.QuerySampleError.DrawLimitExhausted
      self.accepted_len aspis_core.r0_transcript.QUERY_MAX_DRAWS))

private theorem bind_success {α β : Type} (m : Result α) (k : α → Result β) (v : β)
    (h : (do let x ← m; k x) = ok v) : ∃ x, m = ok x ∧ k x = ok v := by
  cases m with
  | ok x => exact ⟨x, rfl, h⟩
  | fail e => simp only [bind_tc_fail] at h; cases h
  | div => simp only [bind_tc_div] at h; cases h

private theorem pair_bind_success {α β γ : Type} (m : Result (α × β))
    (k : α → β → Result γ) (v : γ)
    (h : (do let (a,b) ← m; k a b) = ok v) :
    ∃ a b, m = ok (a,b) ∧ k a b = ok v := by
  cases m with
  | ok pair => cases pair with | mk a b => exact ⟨a,b,rfl,h⟩
  | fail e => simp only [bind_tc_fail] at h; cases h
  | div => simp only [bind_tc_div] at h; cases h

def finishAdvance
    (advances : Array (Array Std.U8 32#usize) 8#usize)
    (index : Std.Usize) (s : aspis_core.r0_transcript.QueryScan) :
    Result (core.result.Result ((Array Std.U32 22#usize) × (Array Std.U8 32#usize))
      aspis_core.transcript.QuerySampleError) := do
  let r ← aspis_core.r0_transcript.QueryScan.finish s
  let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r
  match cf with
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
    let a ← Array.index_usize advances index
    ok (core.result.Result.Ok (val, a))
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
      ((Array Std.U32 22#usize) × (Array Std.U8 32#usize))
      (core.convert.FromSame aspis_core.transcript.QuerySampleError) residual

theorem finishAdvance_success
    (advances : Array (Array Std.U8 32#usize) 8#usize)
    (index : Std.Usize) (s : aspis_core.r0_transcript.QueryScan)
    (accepted : Array Std.U32 22#usize) (next : Array Std.U8 32#usize)
    (h : finishAdvance advances index s = ok (core.result.Result.Ok (accepted, next))) :
    aspis_core.r0_transcript.QueryScan.finish s =
        ok (core.result.Result.Ok accepted) ∧
      Array.index_usize advances index = ok next := by
  unfold finishAdvance at h
  obtain ⟨finished, hfinish, htail⟩ := bind_success
    (aspis_core.r0_transcript.QueryScan.finish s) _ _ h
  cases finished with
  | Ok value =>
    simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch, bind_tc_ok] at htail
    obtain ⟨a, hadvance, hpair⟩ := bind_success
      (Array.index_usize advances index) _ _ htail
    simp only [Result.ok.injEq, core.result.Result.Ok.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at hpair
    rcases hpair with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨hfinish, hadvance⟩
  | Err e =>
    simp [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual] at htail

theorem finish_success_iff
    (s : aspis_core.r0_transcript.QueryScan)
    (accepted : Array Std.U32 22#usize) :
    aspis_core.r0_transcript.QueryScan.finish s =
      ok (core.result.Result.Ok accepted) ↔
      s.accepted_len = aspis_core.r0_transcript.QUERY_COUNT ∧
        accepted = s.accepted := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_cases hc : s.accepted_len = aspis_core.r0_transcript.QUERY_COUNT
    · simp [aspis_core.r0_transcript.QueryScan.finish, hc,
        aspis_core.r0_transcript.QUERY_COUNT] at h
      exact ⟨hc, h.symm⟩

theorem arrayFromFnLoop_values_of_stable

    (callback : core.ops.function.FnMut F Usize T) (value : Nat → T)
    (fuel : Nat) (i : Usize) (f : F) (acc : List T)
    (out : List T) (fout : F)

    out = (List.range N.val).map value ∧ fout = f := by

  | zero =>

        intro hlt
        have hltv : i.val < N.val := by simpa only [UScalar.lt_equiv] using hlt
        omega
      simp only [arrayFromFnLoop, hnot] at hrun
      cases Result.ok.inj hrun
      have hiN : i.val = N.val := by omega
      constructor <;> (first | simpa [hiN] using hacc | rfl)
  | succ fuel ih =>
      by_cases hlt : i < N
      · have hltv : i.val < N.val := by simpa only [UScalar.lt_equiv] using hlt
        have hcall := hstable i hltv
        have hNbound : N.val ≤ Usize.max := by
          have hNsize : N.val < 2 ^ Usize.numBits := by
            simpa [Usize.numBits, UScalarTy.Usize_numBits_eq] using N.hBounds
          have hmax : Usize.max + 1 = 2 ^ Usize.numBits := by
            rw [Usize.numBits]
            exact Usize.max_succ_eq_pow
          omega
        have haddBound : i.val + 1 ≤ Usize.max := by omega
        have haddSpec : (i + 1#usize : Result Usize) ⦃z => z.val = i.val + 1⦄ := by
          apply UScalar.add_spec
          have hone : (1#usize).val = 1 := by scalar_tac
          simpa only [hone, UScalar.max_USize_eq] using haddBound
        obtain ⟨i', hadd, hi'⟩ := Aeneas.Std.WP.spec_imp_exists haddSpec
        simp only [arrayFromFnLoop, hlt] at hrun
        rw [hcall, bind_tc_ok] at hrun

        have hi'val : i'.val = i.val + 1 := hi'
        have hi'le : i'.val ≤ N.val := by rw [hi'val]; omega
        have hbudget' : N.val - i'.val ≤ fuel := by rw [hi'val]; omega
        have hacc' : (value i.val :: acc).reverse = (List.range i'.val).map value := by
          rw [List.reverse_cons, hacc, hi'val, List.range_succ]
          simp
        exact ih i' f (value i.val :: acc) out fout hi'le hbudget' hacc' hstable hrun
      · have hiN : i.val = N.val := by
          have hnotval : ¬ i.val < N.val := by
            intro h
            apply hlt
            simpa only [UScalar.lt_equiv] using h
          omega
        simp only [arrayFromFnLoop, hlt] at hrun
        cases Result.ok.inj hrun
        constructor <;> (first | simpa [hiN] using hacc | rfl)

            apply hlt
            simpa only [UScalar.lt_equiv] using h
          omega
        simp only [arrayFromFnLoop, hlt] at hrun
        cases Result.ok.inj hrun
        simp [hacc, hival]

import Aeneas.Std.Array.Array

/-! Minimal exact declaration slice from AspisV8R19.TraversalRuntime for
state-threaded array mapping. The definitions are retained verbatim; the
unrelated quartic-field import and traversal models are omitted. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisV8R19.TraversalRuntime
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

def mapState {T U F : Type} (call : F → T → Result (U × F)) :
    List T → F → Result (List U × F)
  | [], state => .ok ([],state)
  | x::xs, state => do
    let (y,state') ← call state x
    let (ys,state'') ← mapState call xs state'
    .ok (y::ys,state'')

theorem mapState_length {T U F : Type} (call : F → T → Result (U × F))
    (xs : List T) (state : F) (ys : List U) (last : F)
    (h : mapState call xs state = .ok (ys,last)) : ys.length = xs.length := by
  induction xs generalizing state ys last with
  | nil => simp [mapState] at h; rcases h with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩; rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    simp only [mapState] at h
    cases hc : call state x with
    | fail e => simp [hc] at h
    | div => simp [hc] at h
    | ok pair =>
      rcases pair with ⟨y,state'⟩
      cases hm : mapState call xs state' with
      | fail e => simp [hc,hm] at h
      | div => simp [hc,hm] at h
      | ok pair =>
        rcases pair with ⟨tail,state''⟩
        simp only [hc,hm,bind_tc_ok,Result.ok.injEq,Prod.mk.injEq] at h
        rcases h with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
        simp only [List.length_cons,ih _ _ _ hm]

end AspisV8R19.TraversalRuntime

namespace Aeneas.Std
open Result AspisV8R19.TraversalRuntime

def core.array.Array.map {T F U : Type} {N : Usize}
    (callback : core.ops.function.FnMut F T U) (self : Array T N) (f : F) :
    Result (Array U N) :=
  match h : mapState callback.call_mut self.val f with
  | .ok (ys,_last) => .ok ⟨ys,(mapState_length _ _ _ _ _ h).trans self.property⟩
  | .fail e => .fail e
  | .div => .div

end Aeneas.Std

import SelectorArrayMapRuntimeSlice

/-! Focused success rule for the dependent match in the extracted array map.
The successful discriminant is identified by Result injection before the
length-certificate proof is compared. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace Aeneas.Std
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisV8R19.TraversalRuntime

theorem core.array.Array.map_success
    {T U F : Type} {N : Usize}
    (callback : core.ops.function.FnMut F T U) (self : Array T N) (f : F)
    (ys : List U) (last : F)
    (hstate : mapState callback.call_mut self.val f = .ok (ys, last)) :
    core.array.Array.map callback self f =
      .ok ⟨ys, (mapState_length _ _ _ _ _ hstate).trans self.property⟩ := by
  unfold core.array.Array.map
  split
  · rename_i ys' last' heq
    have hpair : (ys', last') = (ys, last) := Result.ok.inj (heq.symm.trans hstate)
    cases hpair
    rfl
  · rename_i error heq
    have hbad : Result.fail error = Result.ok (ys, last) := heq.symm.trans hstate
    cases hbad
  · rename_i heq
    have hbad : Result.div = Result.ok (ys, last) := heq.symm.trans hstate
    cases hbad

#print axioms core.array.Array.map_success

    rw [AspisR1SimSemantic20.r1_wire.fields20.validate,AspisR1CircleCaller25.r1_wire.fields20.validate]

    by_cases short : alloc.vec.Vec.len payload < 32#usize

      have long : 32 ≤ payload.val.length := by change ¬payload.val.length<32 at short;omega
      have tailEq := ProverCommitFields20.drop_total payload long

      cases hp : alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice U8)
          payload {«end»:=32#usize} with

              AspisR1CircleCaller25.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.impl.c1,zero_test]

/-! Concrete circle policy and extracted caller success/state transport.
These nominal maps retain every machine coefficient; the generic policy is
instantiated with the existing unconditional sampler, including fallbacks. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitCircle25
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1CircleCaller25
abbrev Q := aspis_core.field.QM31
abbrev WQ := AspisR1CircleSampleWrapper.field.QM31
abbrev Bytes32 := Array U8 32#usize
abbrev State (H : Type) := r1_wire.SemanticTranscript H

def fromWrapper (q : WQ) : Q := ⟨⟨q.c0.a,q.c0.b⟩,⟨q.c1.a,q.c1.b⟩⟩
def toWrapper (q : Q) : WQ := ⟨⟨q.c0.a,q.c0.b⟩,⟨q.c1.a,q.c1.b⟩⟩

theorem wrapper_roundtrip (q : WQ) : toWrapper (fromWrapper q) = q := by cases q; rfl

def fromSemantic {H : Type} (s : ProverCommitSemantic20.State H) : State H :=
  ⟨s.state,s.hash,s.next_row⟩
def toSemantic {H : Type} (s : State H) : ProverCommitSemantic20.State H :=
  ⟨s.state,s.hash,s.next_row⟩

theorem semantic_roundtrip {H : Type} (s : ProverCommitSemantic20.State H) :
    toSemantic (fromSemantic s) = s := by cases s; rfl

def fromHash {H : Type} (hash : AspisR1SimSemantic20.aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H) :
    aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H := ⟨hash.coremarkerCopyInst,hash.digest⟩

def fromError : AspisR1SimSemantic20.r1_wire.Error → r1_wire.Error
  | .Allocation => .Allocation
  | .RowOrder expected actual => .RowOrder expected actual
  | .InvalidRow => .InvalidRow
  | .Tag row => .Tag row
  | .Length row => .Length row
  | .NonCanonical row index => .NonCanonical row index
  | .Boundary round => .Boundary round
  | .Terminal => .Terminal
  | .EqualCirclePoints => .EqualCirclePoints
  | .TrailingBytes => .TrailingBytes
  | .Public => .Public
  | .ActivePole => .ActivePole

def fromBlock {H : Type} (value : (core.result.Result Bytes32
    AspisR1SimSemantic20.r1_wire.Error) × ProverCommitSemantic20.State H) :
    (core.result.Result Bytes32 r1_wire.Error) × State H :=
  ((match value.1 with
    | core.result.Result.Ok block => core.result.Result.Ok block
    | core.result.Result.Err error => core.result.Result.Err (fromError error)),fromSemantic value.2)

/-- Universal nominal transport of the actual three-read block method,
including every hash failure/divergence and the row-order rejection state. -/
theorem block_transport {H : Type} (hash : AspisR1SimSemantic20.aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
    (state : ProverCommitSemantic20.State H) (row : U8) (record : Slice U8) :
    (do let value ← AspisR1SimSemantic20.r1_wire.SemanticTranscript.sample_block_validated
          hash state row record
        ok (fromBlock value)) =
      r1_wire.SemanticTranscript.sample_block_validated (fromHash hash)
        (fromSemantic state) row record := by
  simp only [AspisR1SimSemantic20.r1_wire.SemanticTranscript.sample_block_validated,
    r1_wire.SemanticTranscript.sample_block_validated,fromHash,fromSemantic,lift,bind_tc_ok]
  split
  · rfl
  · simp only [bind_assoc,bind_tc_ok]
    rfl

def row (second : Bool) : AspisR1CircleSampleWrapper.r0_transcript.CircleRow :=
  if second then .Second else .First

def points (p : AspisR1CircleSampleWrapper.circle.SecureCirclePoint) : Array Q 2#usize :=
  Array.make 2#usize [fromWrapper p.x,fromWrapper p.y]

def decodeQ (q : Q) : AspisWideTower.WideExact :=
  (ProverCommitCircleSampler22.coordinates ⟨toWrapper q,toWrapper q⟩).1

def decode (q : Array Q 2#usize) : List AspisWideTower.WideExact := q.val.map decodeQ

def sample (block : Bytes32) (second : Bool) : Result (Array Q 2#usize) := do
  let p ← AspisR1CircleSampleWrapper.sampler.circle_sample block (row second)
  ok (points p)

def policy : r1_wire.circle25.Policy Unit where point := sample

theorem points_decode (p : AspisR1CircleSampleWrapper.circle.SecureCirclePoint) :
    decode (points p) = [ (ProverCommitCircleSampler22.coordinates p).1,
      (ProverCommitCircleSampler22.coordinates p).2 ] := by
  simp only [decode,points,Array.make,List.map_cons,List.map_nil,decodeQ,wrapper_roundtrip]
  rfl

/-- Both circle rows are total with exact model coordinates on all blocks,
including singular/subfield fallbacks. No sampler-policy parameter remains. -/
theorem sample_total (block : Bytes32) (second : Bool) :
    ∃ value, policy.point block second = ok value ∧
      decode value = [ (ProverCommitCircleSampler22.model block (row second)).1.1,
        (ProverCommitCircleSampler22.model block (row second)).1.2 ] := by
  obtain ⟨p,h,meaning⟩ := ProverCommitCircleSampler22.circle_total_coordinates block (row second)
  refine ⟨points p,?_,?_⟩
  · simp only [policy,sample,h,bind_tc_ok]
  · rw [points_decode,meaning]

/-- The extracted first-circle caller consumes exactly the sampled block,
returns the installed point and retains the entire advanced state. -/
theorem first_caller {H : Type} (hash : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
    (state next : State H) (record : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (block : Bytes32)
    (order : state.next_row = 25#u8)
    (checked : r1_wire.semantic20.checked 25#u8 (alloc.vec.Vec.deref record) =
      ok (core.result.Result.Ok ()))
    (sampled : r1_wire.SemanticTranscript.sample_block_validated hash state 25#u8
      (alloc.vec.Vec.deref record) = ok (core.result.Result.Ok block,next)) :
    ∃ value, decode value = [ (ProverCommitCircleSampler22.model block .First).1.1,
        (ProverCommitCircleSampler22.model block .First).1.2 ] ∧
      r1_wire.circle25.point hash policy state 25#u8 record =
        ok (core.result.Result.Ok value,next) := by
  obtain ⟨value,h,meaning⟩ := sample_total block false
  refine ⟨value,meaning,?_⟩
  simp [r1_wire.circle25.point,order,checked,sampled,h]
  rfl

/-- The second row has its distinct fallback and retains its own advanced

def encode (x : QM31Exact) : field.QM31 := ⟨encodeCM x.re,encodeCM x.im⟩
def rawU (c d g h : Nat) := PartialProduct.foldOnce (c*g+P*P-d*h)
def rawV (c d g h : Nat) := PartialProduct.foldOnce (c*h+d*g)
def raw0 (a b c d e f g h : Nat) :=
  a*e+P*P-b*f+2*rawU c d g h+3*P-rawV c d g h
def raw1 (a b c d e f g h : Nat) :=
  a*f+b*e+rawU c d g h+2*rawV c d g h
def raw2 (a b c d e f g h : Nat) := a*g+c*e+2*(P*P)-b*h-d*f
def raw3 (a b c d e f g h : Nat) := a*h+b*g+c*f+d*e
def rawOutput (a b c d e f g h : Nat) : field.QM31 :=
  ⟨⟨encodeBase (raw0 a b c d e f g h : M31Exact),
     encodeBase (raw1 a b c d e f g h : M31Exact)⟩,
   ⟨encodeBase (raw2 a b c d e f g h : M31Exact),
     encodeBase (raw3 a b c d e f g h : M31Exact)⟩⟩

  rw [UScalar.le_equiv,encodeBase_val]
  have hp : field.P.val = P := by simp [field.P,P]

  exact Nat.not_le.mpr (ZMod.val_lt x)

      .ok (some (rawOutput x.re.re.val x.re.im.val x.im.re.val x.im.im.val

  have hc : c < PartialProduct.p := ZMod.val_lt x.im.re

  have he : e < PartialProduct.p := ZMod.val_lt y.re.re

  have hg : g < PartialProduct.p := ZMod.val_lt y.im.re
  let h := y.im.im.val
  have hh : h < PartialProduct.p := ZMod.val_lt y.im.im
  have hae := PartialProduct.product_bound a e ha he
  have haf := PartialProduct.product_bound a f ha hf
  have hag := PartialProduct.product_bound a g ha hg
  have hah := PartialProduct.product_bound a h ha hh
  have hbe := PartialProduct.product_bound b e hb he
  have hbf := PartialProduct.product_bound b f hb hf
  have hbg := PartialProduct.product_bound b g hb hg
  have hbh := PartialProduct.product_bound b h hb hh
  have hce := PartialProduct.product_bound c e hc he
  have hcf := PartialProduct.product_bound c f hc hf
  have hcg := PartialProduct.product_bound c g hc hg
  have hch := PartialProduct.product_bound c h hc hh
  have hde := PartialProduct.product_bound d e hd he
  have hdf := PartialProduct.product_bound d f hd hf
  have hdg := PartialProduct.product_bound d g hd hg
  have hdh := PartialProduct.product_bound d h hd hh

  have hu : rawU c d g h < 3*P := PartialProduct.partial_bound _ hi.2.2.1
  have hv : rawV c d g h < 3*P := PartialProduct.partial_bound _ hi.2.2.2
  have hfirst := PartialProduct.reconstruction_bounds (a*e) (b*f) (a*f) (b*e)

theorem word_add (a b : Nat) :

  change (⟨BitVec.ofNat 64 a + BitVec.ofNat 64 b⟩ : U64) = word (a+b)

  rfl

    core.num.U64.wrapping_sub (word a) (word b) = word (a-b) := by
  change (⟨BitVec.ofNat 64 a - BitVec.ofNat 64 b⟩ : U64) = word (a-b)

def finish32 (s : U32) : Result U32 := do
  if s >= field.P then
    let z ← s - field.P
    ok z
  else ok s

    ∃ z : U32, finish32 s = .ok z ∧ z.val = s.val%P ∧ z.val < P := by
  have hp : field.P.val = P := by simp [field.P, P]
  by_cases h : P ≤ s.val
  · obtain ⟨z, hz, hv⟩ := InverseRuntimeMul.sub_success s field.P (by simpa only [hp] using h)
    change (s - field.P : Result U32) = .ok z at hz
    have hc : z.val < P := by rw [hv,hp]; omega
    refine ⟨z, ?_, ?_, hc⟩
    · simp only [finish32, UScalar.le_equiv, hp, h, if_true, hz, bind_tc_ok]
    · rw [hv,hp,Nat.mod_eq_sub_mod h,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
  · refine ⟨s, ?_, ?_, by omega⟩
    · simp only [finish32, UScalar.le_equiv, hp, h, if_false]
    · rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]

theorem sub_encode (x y : M31Exact) :
    field.M31.sub (encodeBase x) (encodeBase y) = .ok (encodeBase (x-y)) := by
  have hx := ZMod.val_lt x
  have hy := ZMod.val_lt y
  have hp : field.P.val = P := by simp [field.P, P]
  have hb : (encodeBase x).val + field.P.val < 2^32 := by
    rw [encodeBase_val,hp]; unfold P at *; omega
  obtain ⟨a,ha,hav⟩ := InverseRuntimeMul.tryMk_success (ty := .U32) _ hb
  change (encodeBase x + field.P : Result U32) = .ok a at ha
  obtain ⟨s,hs,hsv⟩ := InverseRuntimeMul.sub_success a (encodeBase y) (by
    rw [hav,encodeBase_val,encodeBase_val,hp]; omega)
  change (a - encodeBase y : Result U32) = .ok s at hs
  have hsb : s.val < 2*P := by rw [hsv,hav,hp,encodeBase_val,encodeBase_val]; omega
  obtain ⟨z,hz,hzv,hzc⟩ := finish_success s hsb
  have he : z = encodeBase (x-y) := by
    apply eq_encodeBase z (x-y) hzc
    rw [hzv,ZMod.natCast_mod,hsv,hav,hp,encodeBase_val,encodeBase_val]
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega),Nat.cast_add,ZMod.natCast_zmod_val,ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]
    simp [P,M31Exact]
  simp only [field.M31.sub,ha,hs,bind_tc_ok]
  change finish32 s = .ok (encodeBase (x-y))
  rw [hz,he]

    field.M31.reduce_u64 x = .ok (encodeBase (x.val : M31Exact)) := by
  obtain ⟨z,hz,hv,hc⟩ := InverseRuntimeMul.generated_reducer_mod x
  have hr : field.reduce_u64 x = .ok z := by
    rw [reducer_eq,ComplexBaseExecution.reducer_eq,GuardedM31Execution.reducer_eq]
    exact hz
  simp only [field.M31.reduce_u64,hr,bind_tc_ok]
  congr 1
  apply eq_encodeBase z (x.val : M31Exact) hc
  rw [hv,ZMod.natCast_mod]

  core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from_val_eq x

theorem width_roundtrip (x : U64) (hx : x.val < 2^32) :
    core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from (UScalar.cast .U32 x) = x := by
  apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
  rw [from_value,InverseRuntimeMul.narrow_exact x hx]

theorem width_product (x y : U64) (hx : x.val < 2^32) (hy : y.val < 2^32) :
    ∃ z : U64, field.r23_product_u32_bounded x y = .ok z ∧ z.val = x.val*y.val := by

  have ha : x ≤ core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from core.num.U32.MAX := by

  have hb : y ≤ core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from core.num.U32.MAX := by
    rw [UScalar.le_equiv,hmax]; omega
  have hprod : x.val*y.val < 2^64 := by
    have h := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_lt hx hy
    exact h
  obtain ⟨z,hz,hv⟩ := InverseRuntimeMul.mul_success x y hprod
  change (x * y : Result U64) = .ok z at hz
  refine ⟨z, ?_, hv⟩
  simp only [field.r23_product_u32_bounded,lift,bind_tc_ok,ha,hb,if_true,
    width_roundtrip x hx,width_roundtrip y hy,hz]

    field.M31.is_zero (encodeBase x) = .ok (decide (x = 0)) := by
  have he : encodeBase x = 0#u32 ↔ x = 0 := by

    · intro h
      have v := encodeBase_cast x
      rw [h] at v
      exact v.symm
    · intro h; subst x; rfl
  simp only [field.M31.is_zero,he]

theorem product_lt (a b : Nat) (ha : a < P) (hb : b < P) : a*b < P*P :=

theorem fold_lt (n : Nat) (hn : n < P*P) : foldBits n < 2*P := by

  have hd : n / 2^31 < P := by

    omega

  omega

theorem one_fold_canonical (n : Nat) (hn : n < P*P) :
    condSubP (foldBits n) < P := by
  have h := fold_lt n hn
  unfold condSubP
  split <;> omega

theorem one_fold_mod (n : Nat) (hn : n < P*P) :
    condSubP (foldBits n) = n % P := by
  have hmod : condSubP (foldBits n) % P = n % P := by
    unfold condSubP
    split
    · rename_i h
      rw [← Nat.mod_eq_sub_mod h, foldBits_eq_fold31, fold31_mod]
    · rw [foldBits_eq_fold31, fold31_mod]
  rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (one_fold_canonical n hn)] at hmod
  exact hmod

theorem general_u62_negative :

def guardedMul (a b : Nat) : Nat :=

theorem guardedMul_eq_raw (a b : Nat) (ha : a < 2^32) (hb : b < 2^32) :
    guardedMul a b = rawM31Mul a b := by
  have hp : a*b < 2^64 := by
    have h := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_lt ha hb
    exact h
  unfold guardedMul
  split
  · rename_i hc
    rw [one_fold_mod (a*b) (product_lt a b hc.1 hc.2), rawM31Mul,
      rawReduceU64_eq_mod_nat (a*b) hp]
  · rfl

theorem guardedMul_mod (a b : Nat) (ha : a < 2^32) (hb : b < 2^32) :
    guardedMul a b = (a*b) % P := by
  rw [guardedMul_eq_raw a b ha hb, rawM31Mul]
  apply rawReduceU64_eq_mod_nat
  have h := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_lt ha hb
  exact h

def encode (x : Word) : aspis_core.field.M31 :=

  have hy : y.val < 2^32 := (encode y).hBounds

    core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next core.iter.range.StepUsize r =
    if h : r.start.val < r.end.val then
      .ok (some r.start, {start := (UScalar.ofNatCore (r.start.val+1)

  · have hb : r.start.val + 1 ≤ UScalar.max .Usize := by
      rw [UScalar.max]
      have := r.end.hBounds

    have hb' : r.start.val < UScalar.max .Usize := by omega
    simp [core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next, core.iter.range.StepUsize,
      core.iter.range.UScalarStep, core.cmp.PartialOrdUsize,
      core.cmp.impls.PartialOrdUsize.lt, core.clone.CloneUsize,
      liftFun2, liftFun1, h, core.iter.range.UScalarStep.forward_checked, hb']
  · simp [core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next, core.iter.range.StepUsize,

      core.cmp.impls.PartialOrdUsize.lt, liftFun2, h]

      have h : ¬ r.start.val < r.end.val := by omega
      have hb : aspis_core.field.square_n_loop.body r (encode x) = .ok (.done (encode x)) := by
        simp only [aspis_core.field.square_n_loop.body, range_next, dif_neg h, bind_tc_ok]
      rw [aspis_core.field.square_n_loop, loop.eq_def]
      simp only [hb, squares]
  | succ n ih =>
      have h : r.start.val < r.end.val := by omega
      let r' : core.ops.range.Range Usize :=
        {start := UScalar.ofNatCore (r.start.val+1)
          (by have := r.end.hBounds; omega), «end» := r.end}
      have hn' : r'.end.val-r'.start.val = n := by
        change r.end.val-(r.start.val+1) = n
        omega
      have hb : aspis_core.field.square_n_loop.body r (encode x) =
          .ok (.cont (r', encode (wordMul x x))) := by
        simp only [aspis_core.field.square_n_loop.body, range_next, dif_pos h,
          bind_tc_ok, mul_encode, r']
      rw [aspis_core.field.square_n_loop, loop.eq_def]
      simp only [hb]
      exact ih r' (wordMul x x) hn'

      .ok (encode (squares wordMul count.val x)) := by
  apply loop_exec
  simp

    aspis_core.field.M31.inv (encode x) = .fail .assertionFailure := by
  have he : encode x = 0#u32 := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq (by simpa using hx)

    aspis_core.field.M31.inv (encode x) = .ok (encode (wordChain x)) := by
  have he : encode x ≠ 0#u32 := UScalar.ne_of_val_ne (by simpa using hx)

  by_cases h : x.val = 0

theorem inv_correct (self : aspis_core.field.M31)
    (hc : self.val < AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.P) (hne : self.val ≠ 0) :
    ∃ out : aspis_core.field.M31,

/-! The literal M31 inverse addition chain, proved symbolically. Word
multiplication uses the retained raw reducer, not a fresh inversion oracle.
This does not assert extraction of the Rust range-loop or panic machinery. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisV8R19.InverseChain
open AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase

def squares {A : Type*} (mul : A → A → A) : Nat → A → A
  | 0, x => x
  | n+1, x => squares mul n (mul x x)

def chain {A : Type*} (mul : A → A → A) (x : A) : A :=
  let t2 := mul (mul x x) x
  let t4 := mul (squares mul 2 t2) t2
  let t8 := mul (squares mul 4 t4) t4
  let t16 := mul (squares mul 8 t8) t8
  let t24 := mul (squares mul 8 t16) t8
  let t28 := mul (squares mul 4 t24) t4
  let t29 := mul (mul t28 t28) x
  let t30 := mul t29 t29
  mul (mul t30 t30) x

theorem map_squares {A B : Type*} (f : A → B) (ma : A → A → A) (mb : B → B → B)
    (hm : ∀ a b, f (ma a b) = mb (f a) (f b)) (n : Nat) (x : A) :
    f (squares ma n x) = squares mb n (f x) := by
  induction n generalizing x with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp only [squares,ih,hm]

theorem map_chain {A B : Type*} (f : A → B) (ma : A → A → A) (mb : B → B → B)
    (hm : ∀ a b, f (ma a b) = mb (f a) (f b)) (x : A) :
    f (chain ma x) = chain mb (f x) := by
  simp only [chain,hm,map_squares f ma mb hm]

theorem squares_pow {A : Type*} [Monoid A] (n : Nat) (x : A) :
    squares (fun a b : A => a*b) n x = x^(2^n) := by
  induction n generalizing x with
  | zero => simp [squares]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [squares,ih,← pow_two,← pow_mul]
      congr 1
      simp [pow_succ,Nat.mul_comm]

theorem chain_pow {A : Type*} [Monoid A] (x : A) :
    chain (fun a b : A => a*b) x = x^2147483645 := by
  have h3 : x*x*x = x^3 := by simp [pow_succ]
  simp only [chain,h3,squares_pow,← pow_mul,← pow_add,← pow_succ]
  norm_num

abbrev Word := Fin P
def wordMul (a b : Word) : Word :=
  ⟨AspisV8R17.RawReducer.rawM31Mul a.val b.val,
    AspisV8R17.RawReducer.rawM31Mul_canonical a.isLt b.isLt⟩
def decode (a : Word) : M31Exact := a.val
def wordChain (a : Word) : Word := chain wordMul a

theorem decode_wordMul (a b : Word) : decode (wordMul a b) = decode a * decode b :=
  AspisV8R17.RawReducer.rawM31Mul_residue a.isLt b.isLt

theorem decode_wordChain (a : Word) : decode (wordChain a) = decode a ^ (P-2) := by
  unfold wordChain
  rw [map_chain decode wordMul (fun a b : M31Exact => a*b) decode_wordMul,chain_pow]
  rfl

theorem decode_zero (a : Word) : decode a = 0 ↔ a.val = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hv := congrArg ZMod.val h
    simpa [decode,ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt a.isLt] using hv
  · intro h; simp [decode,h]

theorem wordChain_inverse (a : Word) (ha : a.val ≠ 0) :
    decode (wordChain a) = (decode a)⁻¹ := by
  have hne : decode a ≠ 0 := fun h => ha ((decode_zero a).mp h)
  apply (mul_right_inj' hne).mp
  rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hne,decode_wordChain,mul_comm]
  have hp := ZMod.pow_card_sub_one_eq_one hne
  rw [show P-1 = (P-2)+1 by decide,pow_succ] at hp
  exact hp

def guarded (a : Word) : Except Unit Word :=
  if a.val = 0 then .error () else .ok (wordChain a)

theorem zero_rejected (a : Word) (ha : a.val = 0) : guarded a = .error () := by
  simp [guarded,ha]

theorem nonzero_success (a : Word) (ha : a.val ≠ 0) :
    guarded a = .ok (wordChain a) ∧ decode (wordChain a) = (decode a)⁻¹ :=
  ⟨by simp [guarded,ha],wordChain_inverse a ha⟩

/-! Narrow replay of retained raw reducer/addition proofs. Declaration bodies
from V5M31RawMulReduction lines 55–232 and QM31RustFormulaSeam lines 160–193
are retained; only imports, namespace and the minimal local aliases change.
This avoids loading the deployment/sampler aggregate for a local arithmetic
delta. It is not a new assertion of extracted Rust equality. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisV8R17.RawReducer
abbrev M31Exact := ZMod P

/-! ## Residue preservation (task item 4) -/

/-- `2^31` is `1` in the field, because `2^31 = P + 1`. -/
theorem cast_two_pow31 : ((2 ^ 31 : Nat) : M31Exact) = 1 := by
  rw [show (2 ^ 31 : Nat) = P + 1 from by norm_num [P], Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one,
    ZMod.natCast_self, zero_add]

/-- One fold preserves the residue class modulo `P`: writing
`n = 2^31 * (n / 2^31) + n % 2^31` and using `2^31 = 1` in the field collapses
the high part onto the low part. -/
theorem fold31_residue (n : Nat) : ((fold31 n : Nat) : M31Exact) = (n : M31Exact) := by
  have hsplit := Nat.div_add_mod n (2 ^ 31)
  unfold fold31
  rw [Nat.cast_add]
  conv_rhs => rw [← hsplit]
  rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_mul, cast_two_pow31]
  ring

/-- The whole reducer preserves the residue class: the `as u32` cast is exact,
each fold preserves residues, and subtracting `P` in the high branch is a
no-op modulo `P`. -/
theorem rawReduceU64_residue (x : Nat) (hx : x < 2 ^ 64) :
    ((rawReduceU64 x : Nat) : M31Exact) = (x : M31Exact) := by
  unfold rawReduceU64 condSubP
  rw [second_fold_cast_exact x hx, foldBits_eq_fold31, foldBits_eq_fold31]
  have hcond : ((if P ≤ fold31 (fold31 x) then fold31 (fold31 x) - P
      else fold31 (fold31 x) : Nat) : M31Exact) = ((fold31 (fold31 x) : Nat) : M31Exact) := by
    split
    · rename_i h; rw [Nat.cast_sub h, ZMod.natCast_self, sub_zero]
    · rfl
  rw [hcond, fold31_residue, fold31_residue]

/-- Consequently, on `u64` inputs the reducer is exactly the remainder modulo
`P`: canonical output plus preserved residue pins the value uniquely. -/
theorem rawReduceU64_eq_mod (z : Nat) (hz : z < 2 ^ 64) : rawReduceU64 z = z % P := by
  have hcanon : rawReduceU64 z < P := rawReduceU64_canonical z hz
  have hres := rawReduceU64_residue z hz
  rw [ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff] at hres
  have hmodeq : rawReduceU64 z % P = z % P := hres
  rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hcanon] at hmodeq
  exact hmodeq

/-! ## Multiplication seam (task items 5–8) -/

/-- Two canonical M31 factors multiply without overflowing `u64`
(`(P-1)^2 < 2^64`), which is exactly the precondition of the reducer above. -/
theorem canonicalMul_lt_two_pow64 {x y : Nat}
    (hx : CanonicalRawM31 x) (hy : CanonicalRawM31 y) : x * y < 2 ^ 64 := by
  unfold CanonicalRawM31 at hx hy
  have h : x * y ≤ (P - 1) * (P - 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (by omega)
  have h2 : (P - 1) * (P - 1) < 2 ^ 64 := by norm_num [P]
  omega

/-- The raw product reducer output is canonical for canonical inputs. -/
theorem rawM31Mul_canonical {x y : Nat}
    (hx : CanonicalRawM31 x) (hy : CanonicalRawM31 y) : CanonicalRawM31 (rawM31Mul x y) :=
  rawReduceU64_canonical _ (canonicalMul_lt_two_pow64 hx hy)

/-- The `ZMod P` image of the raw product equals the product of the input
residues. -/
theorem rawM31Mul_residue {x y : Nat}
    (hx : CanonicalRawM31 x) (hy : CanonicalRawM31 y) :
    ((rawM31Mul x y : Nat) : M31Exact) = (x : M31Exact) * (y : M31Exact) := by
  unfold rawM31Mul
  rw [rawReduceU64_residue _ (canonicalMul_lt_two_pow64 hx hy), Nat.cast_mul]


theorem rawM31Add_canonical
    {x y : Nat} (hx : CanonicalRawM31 x) (hy : CanonicalRawM31 y) :
    CanonicalRawM31 (rawM31Add x y) := by
  unfold CanonicalRawM31 at hx hy ⊢
  unfold rawM31Add
  by_cases hhigh : P ≤ x + y
  · simp [hhigh]
    omega
  · simp [hhigh]
    omega

/-- The one-subtraction graph is the ordinary remainder because the canonical
input bounds make the unreduced sum strictly smaller than `2*P`. -/
theorem rawM31Add_eq_mod
    {x y : Nat} (hx : CanonicalRawM31 x) (hy : CanonicalRawM31 y) :
    rawM31Add x y = (x + y) % P := by
  by_cases hhigh : P ≤ x + y
  · have hreduced : x + y - P < P := by
      unfold CanonicalRawM31 at hx hy
      omega
    rw [rawM31Add, if_pos hhigh, Nat.mod_eq_sub_mod hhigh,
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hreduced]
  · have hlow : x + y < P := Nat.lt_of_not_ge hhigh
    rw [rawM31Add, if_neg hhigh, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlow]

/-- The literal Rust addition graph commutes with reduction into the exact
`ZMod (2^31-1)` model.  Both comparison branches are covered explicitly. -/
theorem residue_rawM31Add
    {x y : Nat} (_hx : CanonicalRawM31 x) (_hy : CanonicalRawM31 y) :
    ((rawM31Add x y : Nat) : M31Exact) =
      (x : M31Exact) + (y : M31Exact) := by
  by_cases hhigh : P ≤ x + y
  · rw [rawM31Add, if_pos hhigh, Nat.cast_sub hhigh, Nat.cast_add,
      ZMod.natCast_self, sub_zero]
  · rw [rawM31Add, if_neg hhigh, Nat.cast_add]


#print axioms rawReduceU64_canonical
#print axioms rawReduceU64_residue
#print axioms rawM31Mul_residue
#print axioms residue_rawM31Add

namespace AspisV8R19.NormInverse
open AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase
noncomputable section

def baseInverse (x : M31Exact) : M31Exact :=
  InverseChain.decode (InverseChain.wordChain ⟨x.val,ZMod.val_lt x⟩)

theorem base_inverse_correct (x : M31Exact) (hx : x ≠ 0) : baseInverse x = x⁻¹ := by
  have hz : x.val ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have he : (x.val : M31Exact) = x := ZMod.natCast_zmod_val x
    rw [h,Nat.cast_zero] at he
    exact hx he.symm
  have h := InverseChain.wordChain_inverse ⟨x.val,ZMod.val_lt x⟩ hz
  simpa [baseInverse,InverseChain.decode] using h

def complexNorm (x : CM31Exact) : M31Exact := x.re*x.re+x.im*x.im
def complexInverse (x : CM31Exact) : CM31Exact :=
  let n := baseInverse (complexNorm x)
  ⟨x.re*n,(-x.im)*n⟩

theorem complex_norm_eq (x : CM31Exact) : complexNorm x = QuadraticAlgebra.norm x := by
  simp [complexNorm,QuadraticAlgebra.norm_def]

theorem complex_norm_nonzero (x : CM31Exact) (hx : x ≠ 0) : complexNorm x ≠ 0 := by
  rw [complex_norm_eq]
  exact fun h => hx (QuadraticAlgebra.norm_eq_zero_iff_eq_zero.mp h)

theorem complex_inverse_correct (x : CM31Exact) (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    complexInverse x = x⁻¹ := by
  unfold complexInverse
  rw [base_inverse_correct _ (complex_norm_nonzero x hx),complex_norm_eq]
  apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext <;> simp [QuadraticAlgebra.inv_def,mul_comm]

def quarticNorm (x : QM31Exact) : CM31Exact := x.re*x.re-qm31R*(x.im*x.im)
def quarticInverse (x : QM31Exact) : QM31Exact :=
  let n := complexInverse (quarticNorm x)
  ⟨x.re*n,(-x.im)*n⟩
def tryInverse (x : QM31Exact) : Option QM31Exact :=
  if x = 0 then none else some (quarticInverse x)

theorem quartic_norm_eq (x : QM31Exact) : quarticNorm x = QuadraticAlgebra.norm x := by
  simp [quarticNorm,QuadraticAlgebra.norm_def,mul_assoc]

theorem quartic_norm_nonzero (x : QM31Exact) (hx : x ≠ 0) : quarticNorm x ≠ 0 := by
  rw [quartic_norm_eq]
  exact fun h => hx (QuadraticAlgebra.norm_eq_zero_iff_eq_zero.mp h)

theorem quartic_inverse_correct (x : QM31Exact) (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    quarticInverse x = x⁻¹ := by
  unfold quarticInverse
  rw [complex_inverse_correct _ (quartic_norm_nonzero x hx),quartic_norm_eq]
  apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext <;> simp [QuadraticAlgebra.inv_def,mul_comm]

theorem try_inverse_none (x : QM31Exact) : tryInverse x = none ↔ x = 0 := by
  simp [tryInverse]

theorem try_inverse_some (x : QM31Exact) (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    tryInverse x = some x⁻¹ := by
  simp [tryInverse,hx,quartic_inverse_correct x hx]

def circleMap (t : QM31Exact) : Except SamplerCirclePolicy.MapError (QM31Exact × QM31Exact) :=
  match tryInverse (1+t*t) with
  | none => .error .singular
  | some n => if t.im = 0 then .error .subfield else .ok ((1-t*t)*n,(t+t)*n)

theorem circle_map_correct (t : QM31Exact) : circleMap t = SamplerCirclePolicy.pureMap t := by
  by_cases h : 1+t*t = 0
  · simp [circleMap,tryInverse,h,SamplerCirclePolicy.pureMap,pow_two]
  · rw [circleMap,try_inverse_some _ h]
    simp [SamplerCirclePolicy.pureMap,pow_two,h,SamplerCirclePolicy.point,
      AspisV8R15.CircleChord.px,AspisV8R15.CircleChord.py,div_eq_mul_inv,two_mul]

def chainAccept (xs : List Nat) : Option (QM31Exact × QM31Exact) :=
  (circleMap (SamplerFieldDecode.decode xs)).toOption

theorem chain_accept_eq : chainAccept = SamplerCirclePolicy.accept := by
  funext xs
  simp only [chainAccept,SamplerCirclePolicy.accept,circle_map_correct]

def chainCircleProgram (s : SourceDuplexStep.State) :=
  BoundedSamplerWrapper.program chainAccept SamplerWrapperPolicies.Error.challengeExhausted
    SamplerWrapperPolicies.Error.parameterExhausted 3 s

theorem chain_circle_program_eq (s : SourceDuplexStep.State) :
    chainCircleProgram s = SamplerCirclePolicy.circleProgram s := by
  unfold chainCircleProgram
  rw [chain_accept_eq]
  rfl

theorem chain_circle_law (s : SourceDuplexStep.State) :
    SamplerOracleLaws.CorrectLaw (chainCircleProgram s)
      (fun H => SamplerCirclePolicy.circleRun H s) := by
  rw [chain_circle_program_eq]
  exact SamplerCirclePolicy.circle_law s

#print axioms base_inverse_correct
#print axioms complex_norm_eq
#print axioms complex_norm_nonzero
#print axioms complex_inverse_correct
#print axioms quartic_norm_eq
#print axioms quartic_norm_nonzero
#print axioms quartic_inverse_correct
#print axioms try_inverse_none
#print axioms try_inverse_some
#print axioms circle_map_correct
#print axioms chain_accept_eq

end

/-! One Mersenne fold is a residue-preserving, bounded representative.
This justifies delaying canonicalization of the guarded product's two
intermediates; it is not a universal Rust or compiler refinement. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisV8R19.PartialProduct
def p : Nat := 2147483647
def foldOnce (x : Nat) : Nat := x % (p+1) + x / (p+1)

theorem partial_mod (x : Nat) : foldOnce x % p = x % p := by
  have h := congrArg (fun n : Nat => n % p) (Nat.mod_add_div x (p+1))
  simpa [foldOnce,Nat.add_mod,Nat.mul_mod,p] using h

theorem partial_bound (x : Nat) (hx : x < 2*p*p) : foldOnce x < 3*p := by
  have hm := Nat.mod_lt x (show 0 < p+1 by decide)
  have hd : x/(p+1) < 2*p := by
    apply (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul (show 0 < p+1 by decide)).mpr
    simp only [p] at *
    omega
  unfold foldOnce
  omega

theorem product_bound (a b : Nat) (ha : a < p) (hb : b < p) : a*b < p*p := by
  exact Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_lt ha hb

theorem intermediate_bounds (cg dh ch dg : Nat)
    (hcg : cg < p*p) (hdh : dh < p*p) (hch : ch < p*p) (hdg : dg < p*p) :
    dh ≤ cg+p*p ∧ cg+p*p < 2^64 ∧ cg+p*p-dh < 2*p*p ∧ ch+dg < 2*p*p := by
  simp only [p] at *
  omega

theorem reconstruction_bounds (ae bf af be u v : Nat)
    (hae : ae < p*p) (hbf : bf < p*p) (haf : af < p*p) (hbe : be < p*p)
    (hu : u < 3*p) (hv : v < 3*p) :
    bf ≤ ae+p*p ∧ ae+p*p < 2^64 ∧
    v ≤ ae+p*p-bf+2*u+3*p ∧ ae+p*p-bf+2*u+3*p < 2^64 ∧
    af+be+u+2*v < 2^64 := by
  simp only [p] at *
  omega

theorem offset_vanishes : (3*p)%p = 0 := by simp

theorem source_fold (x : Nat) : (x &&& p) + (x >>> 31) = foldOnce x := by
  have hp : p = 2^31-1 := rfl
  rw [hp,Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod,Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]
  rfl

theorem partial_cast (x : Nat) : (foldOnce x : ZMod p) = (x : ZMod p) := by
  have h := congrArg (fun n : Nat => (n : ZMod p)) (partial_mod x)
  simpa only [ZMod.natCast_mod] using h

theorem reconstruction_residues (a b c d u v : Nat) :
    ((a : ZMod p)-b+2*(foldOnce u : ZMod p)+3*(p : ZMod p)-(foldOnce v : ZMod p),
     (c : ZMod p)+d+(foldOnce u : ZMod p)+2*(foldOnce v : ZMod p)) =
    ((a : ZMod p)-b+2*(u%p : Nat)+(p : ZMod p)-(v%p : Nat),
     (c : ZMod p)+d+(u%p : Nat)+2*(v%p : Nat)) := by
  simp only [partial_cast,ZMod.natCast_mod,ZMod.natCast_self,mul_zero,add_zero]

              rw [← hp]

          | Second =>

              have hrun : sampler.circle_sample block .Second =
                  .ok RawCircleSampleActualFallbackCircleV2.fallbackPoint1 := by
                simpa only [RawCircleSampleActualFallbackCircleV2.fallbackPoint1] using hrun0
              have hp := Result.ok.inj (hrun.symm.trans hout)
              rw [← hp]

    subst p

    · rw [decode_point,hq]
    · change (decode (encode q.1))^2+(decode (encode q.2))^2=1
      rw [decode_encode,decode_encode,hq]
      exact SamplerCirclePolicy.point_on_circle _ hd

import AspisV8R19.LazyComplexExecution

/-! Total generated QM31 try-inverse execution on canonical word tuples.
The norm is proved nonzero from the existing exact tower, not assumed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisV8R19.QuarticInverseExecution
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR66Field
open AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase
open ComplexBaseExecution (encodeBase encodeBase_val encodeBase_cast eq_encodeBase)
open LazyComplexExecution (cm_sub cm_neg cm_mul cm_square cm_mul_r cm_inv cm_zero_test)
noncomputable section

def encode (x : QM31Exact) : field.QM31 :=
  ⟨LazyComplexExecution.encode x.re,LazyComplexExecution.encode x.im⟩

def decode (x : field.QM31) : QM31Exact :=
  ⟨⟨(x.c0.a.val : M31Exact),(x.c0.b.val : M31Exact)⟩,
   ⟨(x.c1.a.val : M31Exact),(x.c1.b.val : M31Exact)⟩⟩

def Canonical (x : field.QM31) : Prop :=
  x.c0.a.val < P ∧ x.c0.b.val < P ∧ x.c1.a.val < P ∧ x.c1.b.val < P

theorem encode_canonical (x : QM31Exact) : Canonical (encode x) :=
  ⟨ZMod.val_lt x.re.re,ZMod.val_lt x.re.im,ZMod.val_lt x.im.re,ZMod.val_lt x.im.im⟩

theorem decode_encode (x : QM31Exact) : decode (encode x) = x := by
  apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext <;> apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext <;>
    simp only [decode,encode,LazyComplexExecution.encode,encodeBase_cast]

theorem encode_decode (x : field.QM31) (hc : Canonical x) : encode (decode x) = x := by
  have ha := eq_encodeBase x.c0.a (x.c0.a.val : M31Exact) hc.1 rfl
  have hb := eq_encodeBase x.c0.b (x.c0.b.val : M31Exact) hc.2.1 rfl
  have hc' := eq_encodeBase x.c1.a (x.c1.a.val : M31Exact) hc.2.2.1 rfl
  have hd := eq_encodeBase x.c1.b (x.c1.b.val : M31Exact) hc.2.2.2 rfl
  rcases x with ⟨⟨a,b⟩,⟨c,d⟩⟩
  simp only [encode,decode,LazyComplexExecution.encode,← ha,← hb,← hc',← hd]

theorem zero_test (x : QM31Exact) :
    field.QM31.is_zero (encode x) = .ok (decide (x = 0)) := by
  have he : x = 0 ↔ x.re = 0 ∧ x.im = 0 := by
    rw [QuadraticAlgebra.ext_iff]; rfl
  simp only [field.QM31.is_zero,encode,cm_zero_test,bind_tc_ok,he]
  by_cases h : x.re = 0 <;> simp [h]

theorem try_inverse_nonzero (x : QM31Exact) (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    field.QM31.try_inv (encode x) = .ok (some (encode x⁻¹)) := by
  have hn := NormInverse.quartic_norm_nonzero x hx
  have hi := cm_inv (NormInverse.quarticNorm x) hn
  have he : (⟨x.re * (NormInverse.quarticNorm x)⁻¹,
      (-x.im) * (NormInverse.quarticNorm x)⁻¹⟩ : QM31Exact) = x⁻¹ := by
    rw [← NormInverse.quartic_inverse_correct x hx]
    simp only [NormInverse.quarticInverse,NormInverse.complex_inverse_correct _ hn]
  simp only [NormInverse.quarticNorm] at hi
  calc
    field.QM31.try_inv (encode x) = .ok (some (encode
        (⟨x.re * (NormInverse.quarticNorm x)⁻¹,
          (-x.im) * (NormInverse.quarticNorm x)⁻¹⟩ : QM31Exact))) := by
      simp only [field.QM31.try_inv,zero_test,hx,decide_false,bind_tc_ok,Bool.false_eq_true,if_false]
      simp only [encode,NormInverse.quarticNorm,cm_square,cm_mul_r,cm_sub,hi,cm_mul,cm_neg,bind_tc_ok]
    _ = .ok (some (encode x⁻¹)) := by rw [he]

theorem try_inverse_zero : field.QM31.try_inv (encode 0) = .ok none := by
  simp only [field.QM31.try_inv,zero_test,decide_true,bind_tc_ok,if_true]

theorem try_inverse_execution (x : field.QM31) (hc : Canonical x) :
    field.QM31.try_inv x = .ok
      (if decode x = 0 then none else some (encode (decode x)⁻¹)) := by
  have he := encode_decode x hc
  by_cases h : decode x = 0
  · rw [if_pos h,← he,h]
    exact try_inverse_zero
  · rw [if_neg h]
    conv_lhs => rw [← he]
    exact try_inverse_nonzero (decode x) h

theorem zero_iff_limbs (x : field.QM31) (hc : Canonical x) :
    decode x = 0 ↔ x.c0.a.val = 0 ∧ x.c0.b.val = 0 ∧ x.c1.a.val = 0 ∧ x.c1.b.val = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have he := encode_decode x hc
    rw [h] at he
    exact ⟨(congrArg (fun z : field.QM31 => z.c0.a.val) he).symm,
      (congrArg (fun z : field.QM31 => z.c0.b.val) he).symm,
      (congrArg (fun z : field.QM31 => z.c1.a.val) he).symm,
      (congrArg (fun z : field.QM31 => z.c1.b.val) he).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨ha,hb,hc',hd⟩
    apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext <;> apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext <;> simp [decode,ha,hb,hc',hd]

theorem none_iff_zero (x : field.QM31) (hc : Canonical x) :
    field.QM31.try_inv x = .ok none ↔
      x.c0.a.val = 0 ∧ x.c0.b.val = 0 ∧ x.c1.a.val = 0 ∧ x.c1.b.val = 0 := by
  rw [try_inverse_execution x hc,← zero_iff_limbs x hc]
  by_cases h : decode x = 0 <;> simp [h]

theorem some_inverse (x : field.QM31) (hc : Canonical x) (hx : decode x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ y, field.QM31.try_inv x = .ok (some y) ∧ Canonical y ∧ decode y = (decode x)⁻¹ := by
  refine ⟨encode (decode x)⁻¹,?_,encode_canonical _,decode_encode _⟩
  rw [try_inverse_execution x hc,if_neg hx]

theorem no_failure (x : field.QM31) (hc : Canonical x) (e : Error) :
    field.QM31.try_inv x ≠ .fail e := by
  rw [try_inverse_execution x hc]
  simp

theorem entry_execution (x : field.QM31) (hc : Canonical x) :
    quartic_inverse_probe x = .ok
      (if decode x = 0 then none else some (encode (decode x)⁻¹)) :=
  try_inverse_execution x hc

theorem retained_model_correspondence (x : field.QM31) (hc : Canonical x) :
    (do
      let out ← field.QM31.try_inv x
      ok (out.map decode)) = .ok (NormInverse.tryInverse (decode x)) := by
  rw [try_inverse_execution x hc]
  by_cases h : decode x = 0
  · simp [h,NormInverse.tryInverse]
  · simp [h,NormInverse.tryInverse,decode_encode,NormInverse.quartic_inverse_correct _ h]

#print axioms encode_canonical
#print axioms decode_encode
#print axioms encode_decode
#print axioms zero_test
#print axioms try_inverse_nonzero
#print axioms try_inverse_zero
#print axioms try_inverse_execution
#print axioms zero_iff_limbs
#print axioms none_iff_zero
#print axioms some_inverse
#print axioms no_failure
#print axioms entry_execution
#print axioms retained_model_correspondence
end
end AspisV8R19.QuarticInverseExecution
