import AspisV8R19.QuarticBaseExecution

/-! Word-level bounds and execution of the selected raw-representative CM31
multiplication/square, followed by exact tower algebra. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisV8R19.LazyComplexExecution
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR66Field
open AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase QuarticBaseExecution
open ComplexBaseExecution (encodeBase encodeBase_val encodeBase_cast)
noncomputable section

def encode (x : CM31Exact) : field.CM31 := ⟨encodeBase x.re,encodeBase x.im⟩

abbrev wide (x : M31Exact) : U64 := core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from (encodeBase x)

theorem wide_value (x : M31Exact) : (wide x).val = x.val := by
  rw [from_value,encodeBase_val]

theorem raw_sum (x y : M31Exact) :
    ∃ s : U64, (wide x + wide y : Result U64) = .ok s ∧
      s.val = x.val+y.val ∧ s.val < 2^32 := by
  have hx := ZMod.val_lt x
  have hy := ZMod.val_lt y
  have hb : (wide x).val+(wide y).val < 2^64 := by
    rw [wide_value,wide_value]; unfold P at *; omega
  obtain ⟨s,hs,hv⟩ := InverseRuntimeMul.add_success _ _ hb
  rw [wide_value,wide_value] at hv
  exact ⟨s,hs,hv,by rw [hv]; unfold P at *; omega⟩

theorem raw_difference (x y : M31Exact) :
    ∃ a s : U64,
      (wide x + core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from field.P : Result U64) = .ok a ∧
      (a - wide y : Result U64) = .ok s ∧
      s.val = x.val+P-y.val ∧ s.val < 2^32 := by
  have hx := ZMod.val_lt x
  have hy := ZMod.val_lt y
  have hp : (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from field.P).val = P := by
    rw [from_value]; simp [field.P,P]
  obtain ⟨a,ha,hav⟩ := InverseRuntimeMul.add_success (wide x)
    (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from field.P) (by rw [wide_value,hp]; unfold P at *; omega)
  rw [wide_value,hp] at hav
  obtain ⟨s,hs,hsv⟩ := InverseRuntimeMul.sub_success a (wide y) (by rw [hav,wide_value]; omega)
  rw [hav,wide_value] at hsv
  exact ⟨a,s,ha,hs,hsv,by rw [hsv]; unfold P at *; omega⟩

theorem raw_product (s t : U64) (hs : s.val < 2^32) (ht : t.val < 2^32) :
    ∃ p : U64, field.r23_product_u32_bounded s t = .ok p ∧
      field.M31.reduce_u64 p = .ok (encodeBase ((s.val : M31Exact)*(t.val : M31Exact))) := by
  obtain ⟨p,hp,hpv⟩ := width_product s t hs ht
  refine ⟨p,hp,?_⟩
  rw [reduce_encode,hpv,Nat.cast_mul]

theorem cm_sub (x y : CM31Exact) :
    field.CM31.sub (encode x) (encode y) = .ok (encode (x-y)) := by
  simp only [field.CM31.sub,encode,sub_encode,bind_tc_ok,
    QuadraticAlgebra.re_sub,QuadraticAlgebra.im_sub]

theorem cm_neg (x : CM31Exact) : field.CM31.neg (encode x) = .ok (encode (-x)) := by
  simp only [field.CM31.neg,encode,neg_encode,bind_tc_ok,
    QuadraticAlgebra.re_neg,QuadraticAlgebra.im_neg]

theorem cm_mul (x y : CM31Exact) :
    field.CM31.mul (encode x) (encode y) = .ok (encode (x*y)) := by
  obtain ⟨s,hs,hsv,hsb⟩ := raw_sum x.re x.im
  obtain ⟨t,ht,htv,htb⟩ := raw_sum y.re y.im
  obtain ⟨p,hp,hpr⟩ := raw_product s t hsb htb
  rw [hsv,htv,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_add,ZMod.natCast_zmod_val,
    ZMod.natCast_zmod_val,ZMod.natCast_zmod_val,ZMod.natCast_zmod_val] at hpr
  have he : (⟨x.re*y.re-x.im*y.im,
      (x.re+x.im)*(y.re+y.im)-x.re*y.re-x.im*y.im⟩ : CM31Exact) = x*y := by
    apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext <;> simp [QuadraticAlgebra.re_mul,QuadraticAlgebra.im_mul] <;> ring
  calc
    field.CM31.mul (encode x) (encode y) = .ok (encode
        (⟨x.re*y.re-x.im*y.im,
          (x.re+x.im)*(y.re+y.im)-x.re*y.re-x.im*y.im⟩ : CM31Exact)) := by
      simp only [field.CM31.mul,encode,mul_encode,lift,bind_tc_ok,hs,ht,hp,hpr,sub_encode]
    _ = .ok (encode (x*y)) := by rw [he]

theorem cm_square (x : CM31Exact) : field.CM31.square (encode x) = .ok (encode (x*x)) := by
  obtain ⟨s,hs,hsv,hsb⟩ := raw_sum x.re x.im
  obtain ⟨a,t,ha,ht,htv,htb⟩ := raw_difference x.re x.im
  obtain ⟨p,hp,hpr⟩ := raw_product s t hsb htb
  have hi := ZMod.val_lt x.im
  have hn : x.im.val ≤ x.re.val+P := by omega
  have hcast : (t.val : M31Exact) = x.re-x.im := by
    rw [htv,Nat.cast_sub hn,Nat.cast_add,ZMod.natCast_zmod_val,ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]
    simp [P,M31Exact]
  rw [hsv,Nat.cast_add,ZMod.natCast_zmod_val,ZMod.natCast_zmod_val,hcast] at hpr
  have he : (⟨(x.re+x.im)*(x.re-x.im),x.re*x.im+x.re*x.im⟩ : CM31Exact) = x*x := by
    apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext <;> simp [QuadraticAlgebra.re_mul,QuadraticAlgebra.im_mul] <;> ring
  calc
    field.CM31.square (encode x) = .ok (encode
        (⟨(x.re+x.im)*(x.re-x.im),x.re*x.im+x.re*x.im⟩ : CM31Exact)) := by
      simp only [field.CM31.square,encode,lift,bind_tc_ok,hs,ha,ht,hp,hpr,mul_encode,double_encode]
    _ = .ok (encode (x*x)) := by rw [he]

theorem cm_mul_r (x : CM31Exact) : field.mul_by_r (encode x) = .ok (encode (qm31R*x)) := by
  have he : (⟨x.re+x.re-x.im,x.re+(x.im+x.im)⟩ : CM31Exact) = qm31R*x := by
    apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext <;> simp [qm31R,QuadraticAlgebra.re_mul,QuadraticAlgebra.im_mul] <;> ring
  calc
    field.mul_by_r (encode x) = .ok (encode (⟨x.re+x.re-x.im,x.re+(x.im+x.im)⟩ : CM31Exact)) := by
      simp only [field.mul_by_r,encode,double_encode,sub_encode,add_encode,bind_tc_ok]
    _ = .ok (encode (qm31R*x)) := by rw [he]

theorem cm_inv (x : CM31Exact) (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    field.CM31.inv (encode x) = .ok (encode x⁻¹) := by
  have hn := NormInverse.complex_norm_nonzero x hx
  have hbase := inv_encode (NormInverse.complexNorm x) hn
  have he : (⟨x.re * (NormInverse.complexNorm x)⁻¹,
      (-x.im) * (NormInverse.complexNorm x)⁻¹⟩ : CM31Exact) = x⁻¹ := by
    rw [← NormInverse.complex_inverse_correct x hx]
    simp only [NormInverse.complexInverse,NormInverse.base_inverse_correct _ hn]
  simp only [NormInverse.complexNorm] at hbase
  calc
    field.CM31.inv (encode x) = .ok (encode
        (⟨x.re * (NormInverse.complexNorm x)⁻¹,
          (-x.im) * (NormInverse.complexNorm x)⁻¹⟩ : CM31Exact)) := by
      simp only [field.CM31.inv,field.CM31.inv_with,encode,
        NormInverse.complexNorm,mul_encode,add_encode,hbase,neg_encode,bind_tc_ok]
    _ = .ok (encode x⁻¹) := by rw [he]

theorem cm_zero_test (x : CM31Exact) :
    field.CM31.is_zero (encode x) = .ok (decide (x = 0)) := by
  have he : x = 0 ↔ x.re = 0 ∧ x.im = 0 := by
    rw [QuadraticAlgebra.ext_iff]; rfl
  simp only [field.CM31.is_zero,encode,base_zero_test,bind_tc_ok,he]
  by_cases h : x.re = 0 <;> simp [h]

#print axioms wide_value
#print axioms raw_sum

import AspisR1SimSemantic20.Funs
/-! The immutable byte operations reuse the parser cone's slice and clone
proofs (MultiproofConeSlices / MultiproofConeVecLaws), specialized to env J. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitFields20
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1SimSemantic20
abbrev Bytes := alloc.vec.Vec U8

theorem clone_bytes (s : Slice U8) :
    alloc.slice.Slice.to_vec core.clone.CloneU8 s = ok s := by
  obtain ⟨out,ho,hv⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (alloc.slice.Slice.to_vec_spec core.clone.CloneU8 s (by intros;rfl))
  exact ho.trans (congrArg (fun v : alloc.vec.Vec U8 => Result.ok v) hv.symm)

theorem drop_total (bytes : Bytes) (bound : 32≤bytes.val.length) :
    alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeFromUsizeSlice U8)
      bytes {start:=32#usize} = ok (Slice.drop bytes 32#usize) := by
  change core.slice.index.Slice.index _ bytes _ = _
  simp only [core.slice.index.Slice.index,
    core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeFromUsizeSlice.index,
    show (32#usize).val≤bytes.length from bound,if_true]

def finite (row : U8) (payload : Bytes) (value : Usize) : Nat →
    Result (core.result.Result Unit r1_wire.Error)
  | 0 => ok (core.result.Result.Ok ())
  | n+1 => do
    if alloc.vec.Vec.len payload < 32#usize then ok (core.result.Result.Ok ())
    else
      let bytes ← alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice U8)
        payload {«end»:=32#usize}
      let parsed ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_le_bytes bytes
      match parsed with
      | none => ok (core.result.Result.Err (r1_wire.Error.NonCanonical row value))
      | some x => do
        let q ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.impl.c1 x
        let bad ← core.cmp.PartialEq.ne.trait_default
          aspis_core.field.QM31.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqQM31 q aspis_core.field.QM31.ZERO
        if bad then ok (core.result.Result.Err (r1_wire.Error.NonCanonical row value))
        else do
          let suffix ← alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeFromUsizeSlice U8)
            payload {start:=32#usize}
          let tail ← alloc.slice.Slice.to_vec core.clone.CloneU8 suffix
          finite row tail (Usize.wrapping_add value 1#usize) n

/-- Complete validator recursion for every finite payload, with exact first
failing field index, ignored short suffix, and errors/divergence of callees. -/
theorem extracted_finite (remaining : Nat) (row : U8) (payload : Bytes) (value : Usize)
    (bound : payload.val.length<32*(remaining+1)) :
    r1_wire.fields20.validate row payload value = finite row payload value remaining := by
  induction remaining generalizing payload value with
  | zero =>
    have short : alloc.vec.Vec.len payload < 32#usize := by change payload.val.length<32;omega
    rw [r1_wire.fields20.validate]
    simp only [short,if_true,finite]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [r1_wire.fields20.validate]
    simp only [finite]
    by_cases short : alloc.vec.Vec.len payload < 32#usize
    · simp only [short,if_true]
    · simp only [short,if_false]
      have long : 32≤payload.val.length := by change ¬payload.val.length<32 at short;omega
      have tailEq := drop_total payload long
      have tailBound : (Slice.drop payload 32#usize).val.length<32*(n+1) := by
        simp only [Slice.getElem!_val_drop,List.length_drop]
        change payload.val.length-32<32*(n+1)
        omega
      have tailRec := ih (Slice.drop payload 32#usize) (Usize.wrapping_add value 1#usize) tailBound
      cases hp : alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice U8)
          payload {«end»:=32#usize} with
      | fail e => simp only [bind_tc_fail]
      | div => simp only [bind_tc_div]
      | ok bytes =>
        simp only [bind_tc_ok]
        cases hd : aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_le_bytes bytes with
        | fail e => simp only [bind_tc_fail]
        | div => simp only [bind_tc_div]
        | ok parsed =>
          simp only [bind_tc_ok]
          cases parsed with
          | none => rfl
          | some x =>
            simp only
            cases hc : aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.impl.c1 x with
            | fail e => simp only [bind_tc_fail]
            | div => simp only [bind_tc_div]
            | ok q =>
              simp only [bind_tc_ok]
              cases he : core.cmp.PartialEq.ne.trait_default
                aspis_core.field.QM31.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqQM31 q aspis_core.field.QM31.ZERO with
              | fail e => simp only [bind_tc_fail]
              | div => simp only [bind_tc_div]
              | ok bad =>
                simp only [bind_tc_ok]
                cases bad with
                | true => rfl
                | false =>
                  simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,if_false,tailEq,bind_tc_ok,clone_bytes,lift]
                  exact tailRec

#print axioms clone_bytes
#print axioms drop_total
#print axioms extracted_finite
end R1Z.ProverCommitFields20

import R1Z.ProverCommitStreamPack25
import R1Z.ProverCommitJointHistory19
/-! Real finite-ROM marginal for all rejection words on stream 3. The
coupling starts from model nonzero coins times independent fuel, packs their
actual consumed prefixes and replaces those coordinates of one common table.
Observer histories are protected by the existing seedGuess event. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitProductOracle25
open R0Z R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.LawTransport
open R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.CouplingR1PBin ProverCommitStreamPack25 ProverCommitProduct25
open ProverCommitJointHistory19 ProverCommitSeedEvent19
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
attribute [local irreducible] tripleEquiv raw swap
private def answerFinite : Fintype OracleAnswer := inferInstance
attribute [local instance] answerFinite
attribute [local irreducible] answerFinite
local instance zeroDecision : DecidablePred (fun a : OracleAnswer => a ≠ 0) :=
  fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _
abbrev LocalInput := Trio (NZ (0 : OracleAnswer)) × Trio (Fin 5 → OracleAnswer)
abbrev Input := Fin 8 → LocalInput
abbrev Coord := Fin 8 × Fin 15
local instance coordDecision : DecidableEq Coord := fun _ _ => Classical.propDecidable _

def flatten : (Fin 8 → Fin 15 → OracleAnswer) ≃ (Coord → OracleAnswer) where
  toFun t i := t i.1 i.2
  invFun t a i := t (a,i)
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

def words (p : Input) : Coord → OracleAnswer :=
  fun i => tripleEquiv (0 : OracleAnswer) 5 (raw (0 : OracleAnswer) 5 (p i.1)) i.2

theorem words_uniform : MP words := by
  have one : MP (fun p : LocalInput => tripleEquiv (0 : OracleAnswer) 5
      (raw (0 : OracleAnswer) 5 p)) := by
    intro test
    exact (QueryScanIdealHistory.mean_fintype_transport _ _ _).trans
      (source_stream_marginal (0 : OracleAnswer) 5 test)
  have h := mp_pi one 8
  intro test
  exact (QueryScanIdealHistory.mean_fintype_transport _ _ _).trans
    ((h (fun t => test (flatten t))).trans
      ((QueryScanIdealHistory.mean_fintype_transport _ _ _).trans (mp_equiv flatten test)))

def key (bound : Nat) (fits : 65 ≤ bound) (seed : OracleAnswer) (i : Coord) :
    RomFiniteBin.Address bound :=
  ProverCommitSimulatorOracle18.key (count := 15) bound fits seed (i.1,3,i.2)

theorem key_injective (bound : Nat) (fits : 65 ≤ bound) (seed : OracleAnswer) :
    Function.Injective (key bound fits seed) := by
  intro i j same
  have eq := ProverCommitSimulatorOracle18.key_injective (count := 15)
    (by norm_num) bound fits seed same
  apply Prod.ext
  · exact congrArg (fun z : ProverCommitSimulatorOracle18.Index 15 => z.1) eq
  · exact congrArg (fun z : ProverCommitSimulatorOracle18.Index 15 => z.2.2) eq

def table (bound : Nat) (fits : 65 ≤ bound) (seed : OracleAnswer)
    (p : Input × (RomFiniteBin.Address bound → OracleAnswer)) :
    RomFiniteBin.Address bound → OracleAnswer :=
  replaceTable (key bound fits seed) (key_injective bound fits seed) (words p.1) p.2

/-- The entire retained source oracle, not only the successful nonce, has
its exact uniform distribution. No source-law or coupling premise is supplied. -/
theorem source_oracle_uniform (bound : Nat) [Fintype (RomFiniteBin.Address bound)]
    (fits : 65 ≤ bound) (seed : OracleAnswer) : MP (table bound fits seed) := by
  have h := mp_prodMap words_uniform (show MP (id :
    (RomFiniteBin.Address bound → OracleAnswer) → _) from fun _ => rfl)
  intro test
  exact (h (fun p => test (replaceTable (key bound fits seed)
    (key_injective bound fits seed) p.1 p.2))).trans
      ((QueryScanIdealHistory.mean_fintype_transport _ _ _).trans
        (replacement_uniform (key bound fits seed) (key_injective bound fits seed) test))

/-- Each actual stream-3 source coordinate carries the packed raw word. -/
theorem source_at (bound : Nat) (fits : 65 ≤ bound) (seed : OracleAnswer)
    (p : Input × (RomFiniteBin.Address bound → OracleAnswer)) (i : Coord) :
    table bound fits seed p (key bound fits seed i) = words p.1 i := replace_at _ _ _ _ i

/-- Full ordered adaptive observer trace, including repeated queries and
termination, agrees outside the existing seed namespace event. -/
theorem observer_history (bound : Nat) (fits : 65 ≤ bound) (seed : OracleAnswer)
    (p : Input × (RomFiniteBin.Address bound → OracleAnswer)) (program : OProg) (fuel : Nat)
    (fresh : ¬ seedGuess (runLog program (RomFiniteBin.lookup bound p.2) fuel) seed) :
    runLog program (RomFiniteBin.lookup bound (table bound fits seed p)) fuel =
      runLog program (RomFiniteBin.lookup bound p.2) fuel := by
  apply runLog_agrees
  intro e member
  unfold RomFiniteBin.lookup
  split
  · next addr decoded =>
    apply replace_off
    rintro ⟨i,same⟩
    have hb := RomFiniteBin.encode_decode bound e.1 addr decoded
    have hkey := congrArg Subtype.val same
    apply fresh
    refine ⟨e,member,?_⟩
    rw [← hb,← hkey]
    exact source_point seed _ _ _
  · rfl

#print axioms words_uniform
#print axioms key_injective
#print axioms source_oracle_uniform

R1Z.ProverCommitStreamPack25:
import R1Z.ProverCommitPackWindows25
/-! Three search windows share one persistent source counter. Their consumed
prefixes are packed consecutively and their unused words remain in the
bijection as spare suffixes. This closes the fixed-window gap in the local
rejection marginal; it does not identify the full shipped caller. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitStreamPack25
open R0Z R0Z.FsAbort R1Z.CouplingR1PBin
open ProverCommitProduct25 ProverCommitPack25
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {A : Type} (zero : A)

abbrev Trio (T : Type) := T × (T × T)

def tripleEquiv (k : Nat) : Trio (Fin k → A) ≃ (Fin (k+(k+k)) → A) :=
  (Equiv.prodCongr (Equiv.refl (Fin k → A)) (ProverCommitPackWindows25.equiv zero k k)).trans
    (ProverCommitPackWindows25.equiv zero k (k+k))

theorem triple_uniform [Fintype A] (k : Nat) : MP (tripleEquiv zero k) :=
  mp_equiv (tripleEquiv zero k)

theorem pack_initial {n m : Nat} (a : Fin n → A) (b : Fin m → A)
    (i : Fin n) (before : i.val < used zero a) :
    ProverCommitPackWindows25.pack zero (a,b)
      ⟨i.val,by have h:=i.isLt;omega⟩ = a i := by
  simp only [ProverCommitPackWindows25.pack]
  rw [dif_pos before]

theorem pack_following {n m : Nat} (a : Fin n → A) (b : Fin m → A)
    (i : Fin m) :
    ProverCommitPackWindows25.pack zero (a,b)
      ⟨used zero a+i.val,by have hc:=used_le zero a;have hi:=i.isLt;omega⟩ = b i := by
  simp only [ProverCommitPackWindows25.pack]
  rw [dif_neg (by omega),dif_pos (by have hi:=i.isLt;omega)]
  apply congrArg b
  apply Fin.ext
  simp only [Fin.val_mk]
  omega

/-- The next search starts at the preceding search's actual consumed count.
Every word of the second window is retained at that position. -/
theorem second_window (k : Nat) (a b c : Fin k → A) (i : Fin k)
    (before : i.val < used zero b) :
    tripleEquiv zero k (a,b,c)
      ⟨used zero a+i.val,by have h:=used_le zero a;have hi:=i.isLt;omega⟩ = b i := by
  change ProverCommitPackWindows25.pack zero (a,ProverCommitPackWindows25.pack zero (b,c)) _ = _
  exact (pack_following zero a (ProverCommitPackWindows25.pack zero (b,c))
    (⟨i.val,by have hi:=i.isLt;omega⟩ : Fin (k+k))).trans
      (pack_initial zero b c i before)

theorem third_window (k : Nat) (a b c : Fin k → A) (i : Fin k) :
    tripleEquiv zero k (a,b,c)
      ⟨used zero a+(used zero b+i.val),by
        have h₁:=used_le zero a;have h₂:=used_le zero b;have hi:=i.isLt;omega⟩ = c i := by
  change ProverCommitPackWindows25.pack zero (a,ProverCommitPackWindows25.pack zero (b,c)) _ = _
  exact (pack_following zero a (ProverCommitPackWindows25.pack zero (b,c))
    (⟨used zero b+i.val,by have hc:=used_le zero b;have hi:=i.isLt;omega⟩ : Fin (k+k))).trans
      (pack_following zero b c i)

def separate (k : Nat) : (Trio (NZ zero) × Trio (Fin k → A)) ≃
    Trio (NZ zero × (Fin k → A)) where
  toFun p := ((p.1.1,p.2.1),(p.1.2.1,p.2.2.1),(p.1.2.2,p.2.2.2))
  invFun p := ((p.1.1,p.2.1.1,p.2.2.1),(p.1.2,p.2.1.2,p.2.2.2))
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

def raw (k : Nat) (p : Trio (NZ zero) × Trio (Fin k → A)) : Trio (Fin k → A) :=
  ((swap zero k (p.1.1,p.2.1)).2,
   (swap zero k (p.1.2.1,p.2.2.1)).2,
   (swap zero k (p.1.2.2,p.2.2.2)).2)

/-- Model nonzero coins times independent uniform fuel reconstruct a complete
uniform fifteen-word persistent source stream when k=5. -/
theorem source_stream_marginal [Fintype A] [Nonempty (NZ zero)] (k : Nat) :
    MP (fun p => tripleEquiv zero k (raw zero k p)) := by
  have h : MP (fun p : Trio (NZ zero × (Fin k → A)) =>
      ((swap zero k p.1).2,(swap zero k p.2.1).2,(swap zero k p.2.2).2)) :=
    mp_prodMap (raw_marginal zero k) (mp_prodMap (raw_marginal zero k) (raw_marginal zero k))
  intro test
  exact (mp_equiv (separate zero k)
    (fun p => test (tripleEquiv zero k
      ((swap zero k p.1).2,(swap zero k p.2.1).2,(swap zero k p.2.2).2)))).trans
    ((h (fun t => test (tripleEquiv zero k t))).trans (triple_uniform zero k test))

#print axioms triple_uniform
#print axioms pack_initial
#print axioms pack_following
#print axioms second_window
#print axioms third_window
#print axioms source_stream_marginal
end R1Z.ProverCommitStreamPack25
R1Z.ProverCommitPackWindows25:
import R1Z.ProverCommitPack25
/-! Unequal-length version: the following packed stream can contain several
searches, so three independent five-word windows fit one fifteen-word source
stream without gaps after early success. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitPackWindows25
open R0Z R0Z.FsAbort R1Z.CouplingR1PBin ProverCommitPack25
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {A : Type} (zero : A)
def pack {n m : Nat} (tapes : (Fin n → A) × (Fin m → A)) : Fin (n+m) → A :=
  let c := used zero tapes.1
  fun i => if h : i.val < c then tapes.1 ⟨i.val,by have hc:=used_le zero tapes.1;omega⟩
    else if h₂ : i.val < c+m then tapes.2 ⟨i.val-c,by omega⟩
    else tapes.1 ⟨i.val-m,by have hi:=i.isLt;omega⟩

def front {n m : Nat} (stream : Fin (n+m) → A) : Fin n → A :=
  fun i => stream ⟨i.val,by have hi:=i.isLt;omega⟩

def unpack {n m : Nat} (stream : Fin (n+m) → A) : (Fin n → A) × (Fin m → A) :=
  let c := used zero (front (n := n) (m := m) stream)
  ((fun i => if h : i.val < c then stream ⟨i.val,by have hi:=i.isLt;omega⟩
    else stream ⟨i.val+m,by have hi:=i.isLt;omega⟩),
   fun i => stream ⟨c+i.val,by have hc:=used_le zero (front (n := n) (m := m) stream);have hi:=i.isLt;omega⟩)

theorem used_pack {n m : Nat} (tapes : (Fin n → A) × (Fin m → A)) :
    used zero (front (n := n) (m := m) (pack zero tapes)) = used zero tapes.1 := by
  apply used_prefix
  intro i hi
  simp only [front,pack]
  rw [dif_pos hi]

theorem used_unpack {n m : Nat} (stream : Fin (n+m) → A) :
    used zero (unpack zero stream).1 = used zero (front (n := n) (m := m) stream) := by
  apply used_prefix
  intro i hi
  simp only [unpack]
  rw [dif_pos hi]
  rfl

theorem unpack_pack {n m : Nat} (tapes : (Fin n → A) × (Fin m → A)) :
    unpack zero (pack zero tapes) = tapes := by
  apply Prod.ext
  · funext i
    simp only [unpack,used_pack]
    by_cases hi : i.val < used zero tapes.1
    · rw [dif_pos hi]
      simp only [pack]
      rw [dif_pos hi]
    · rw [dif_neg hi]
      simp only [pack]
      rw [dif_neg (by omega),dif_neg (by omega)]
      apply congrArg tapes.1
      apply Fin.ext
      simp only [Fin.val_mk]
      omega
  · funext i
    simp only [unpack,used_pack]
    simp only [pack]
    have h₁ : ¬ used zero tapes.1 + i.val < used zero tapes.1 := by omega
    have h₂ : used zero tapes.1 + i.val < used zero tapes.1+m := by have h:=i.isLt;omega
    rw [dif_neg h₁,dif_pos h₂]
    apply congrArg tapes.2
    apply Fin.ext
    simp only [Fin.val_mk]
    omega

theorem pack_unpack {n m : Nat} (stream : Fin (n+m) → A) :
    pack zero (unpack zero stream) = stream := by
  funext i
  simp only [pack,used_unpack]
  by_cases h₁ : i.val < used zero (front (n := n) (m := m) stream)
  · rw [dif_pos h₁]
    simp only [unpack]
    rw [dif_pos h₁]
  · rw [dif_neg h₁]
    by_cases h₂ : i.val < used zero (front (n := n) (m := m) stream)+m
    · rw [dif_pos h₂]
      simp only [unpack]
      apply congrArg stream
      apply Fin.ext
      simp only [Fin.val_mk]
      omega
    · rw [dif_neg h₂]
      simp only [unpack]
      rw [dif_neg (by omega)]
      apply congrArg stream
      apply Fin.ext
      simp only [Fin.val_mk]
      have h:=i.isLt
      omega

def equiv (n m : Nat) : ((Fin n → A) × (Fin m → A)) ≃ (Fin (n+m) → A) where
  toFun := pack zero
  invFun := unpack zero
  left_inv := unpack_pack zero
  right_inv := pack_unpack zero

/-- The whole persistent stream is exactly uniform, even though its window
boundary is chosen by the preceding rejection answers. -/
theorem packed_uniform [Fintype A] (n m : Nat) : MP (pack zero (n := n) (m := m)) := mp_equiv (equiv zero n m)

#print axioms used_pack
#print axioms used_unpack
#print axioms unpack_pack
#print axioms pack_unpack
#print axioms packed_uniform
end R1Z.ProverCommitPackWindows25
R1Z.ProverCommitPack25:
import R1Z.ProverCommitProduct25
/-! Pack independent search windows into a persistent source stream. Keep
only the first search's consumed front before the next window, moving its
unused suffix behind that next window. The value-dependent packing is a
bijection, not an arbitrary value-dependent permutation. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitPack25
open R0Z R0Z.FsAbort R1Z.CouplingR1PBin
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {A : Type} (zero : A)

def used : {n : Nat} → (Fin n → A) → Nat
  | 0, _ => 0
  | _+1, tape => if tape 0 = zero then 1 + used (fun i => tape i.succ) else 1

theorem used_le {n : Nat} (tape : Fin n → A) : used zero tape ≤ n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact Nat.le_refl _
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [used]
    split
    · have h := ih (fun i => tape i.succ);omega
    · omega

/-- Later values cannot alter the number of words already consumed. -/
theorem used_prefix {n : Nat} (left right : Fin n → A)
    (front : ∀ i, i.val < used zero left → right i = left i) :
    used zero right = used zero left := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    have positive : 0 < used zero left := by simp only [used];split <;> omega
    have head := front 0 positive
    by_cases h : left 0 = zero
    · have hr : right 0 = zero := head.trans h
      simp only [used,h,hr,if_true]
      congr 1
      apply ih
      intro i hi
      apply front i.succ
      simp only [used,h,if_true]
      have hv : i.succ.val=i.val+1 := rfl
      omega
    · have hr : right 0 ≠ zero := fun e => h (head.symm.trans e)
      simp only [used,h,hr,if_false]

def pack {n : Nat} (tapes : (Fin n → A) × (Fin n → A)) : Fin (n+n) → A :=
  let c := used zero tapes.1
  fun i => if h : i.val < c then tapes.1 ⟨i.val,by have hc:=used_le zero tapes.1;omega⟩
    else if h₂ : i.val < c+n then tapes.2 ⟨i.val-c,by omega⟩
    else tapes.1 ⟨i.val-n,by have hi:=i.isLt;omega⟩

def front {n : Nat} (stream : Fin (n+n) → A) : Fin n → A :=
  fun i => stream ⟨i.val,by have hi:=i.isLt;omega⟩

def unpack {n : Nat} (stream : Fin (n+n) → A) : (Fin n → A) × (Fin n → A) :=
  let c := used zero (front stream)
  ((fun i => if h : i.val < c then stream ⟨i.val,by have hi:=i.isLt;omega⟩
    else stream ⟨i.val+n,by have hi:=i.isLt;omega⟩),
   fun i => stream ⟨c+i.val,by have hc:=used_le zero (front stream);have hi:=i.isLt;omega⟩)

theorem used_pack {n : Nat} (tapes : (Fin n → A) × (Fin n → A)) :
    used zero (front (pack zero tapes)) = used zero tapes.1 := by
  apply used_prefix
  intro i hi
  simp only [front,pack]
  rw [dif_pos hi]

theorem used_unpack {n : Nat} (stream : Fin (n+n) → A) :
    used zero (unpack zero stream).1 = used zero (front stream) := by
  apply used_prefix
  intro i hi
  simp only [unpack]
  rw [dif_pos hi]
  rfl

theorem unpack_pack {n : Nat} (tapes : (Fin n → A) × (Fin n → A)) :
    unpack zero (pack zero tapes) = tapes := by
  apply Prod.ext
  · funext i
    simp only [unpack,used_pack]
    by_cases hi : i.val < used zero tapes.1
    · rw [dif_pos hi]
      simp only [pack]
      rw [dif_pos hi]
    · rw [dif_neg hi]
      simp only [pack]
      rw [dif_neg (by omega),dif_neg (by omega)]
      apply congrArg tapes.1
      apply Fin.ext
      simp only [Fin.val_mk]
      omega
  · funext i
    simp only [unpack,used_pack]
    simp only [pack]
    have h₁ : ¬ used zero tapes.1 + i.val < used zero tapes.1 := by omega
    have h₂ : used zero tapes.1 + i.val < used zero tapes.1+n := by have h:=i.isLt;omega
    rw [dif_neg h₁,dif_pos h₂]
    apply congrArg tapes.2
    apply Fin.ext
    simp only [Fin.val_mk]
    omega

theorem pack_unpack {n : Nat} (stream : Fin (n+n) → A) :
    pack zero (unpack zero stream) = stream := by
  funext i
  simp only [pack,used_unpack]
  by_cases h₁ : i.val < used zero (front stream)
  · rw [dif_pos h₁]
    simp only [unpack]
    rw [dif_pos h₁]
  · rw [dif_neg h₁]
    by_cases h₂ : i.val < used zero (front stream)+n
    · rw [dif_pos h₂]
      simp only [unpack]
      apply congrArg stream
      apply Fin.ext
      simp only [Fin.val_mk]
      omega
    · rw [dif_neg h₂]
      simp only [unpack]
      rw [dif_neg (by omega)]
      apply congrArg stream
      apply Fin.ext
      simp only [Fin.val_mk]
      have h:=i.isLt
      omega

def equiv (n : Nat) : ((Fin n → A) × (Fin n → A)) ≃ (Fin (n+n) → A) where
  toFun := pack zero
  invFun := unpack zero
  left_inv := unpack_pack zero
  right_inv := pack_unpack zero

/-- The whole persistent stream is exactly uniform, even though its window
boundary is chosen by the preceding rejection answers. -/
theorem packed_uniform [Fintype A] (n : Nat) : MP (pack zero (n := n)) := mp_equiv (equiv zero n)

#print axioms used_le
#print axioms used_prefix
#print axioms used_pack
#print axioms used_unpack
#print axioms unpack_pack
#print axioms pack_unpack
#print axioms packed_uniform
end R1Z.ProverCommitPack25
R1Z.ProverCommitProduct25:
import R1Z.ProverCommitFuelJoin22
import R1Z.ProverCommitJointHistory19
/-! Product construction for rejection sampling. Swap a uniform nonzero model
coin with the first nonzero word of an independent raw tape. The swap is an
involution, so the entire reconstructed raw tape is exactly uniform, including
its rejected prefix and unused suffix. No shipped caller is postulated. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitProduct25
open R0Z R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.LawTransport
open R1Z.CouplingR1PBin
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {A : Type} (zero : A)
abbrev NZ := {a : A // a ≠ zero}

def swap : (n : Nat) → NZ zero × (Fin n → A) → NZ zero × (Fin n → A)
  | 0, p => p
  | n+1, (coin,tape) =>
    if h : tape 0 = zero then
      let q := swap n (coin,fun i => tape i.succ)
      (q.1,Fin.cons zero q.2)
    else (⟨tape 0,h⟩,Fin.cons coin.val (fun i => tape i.succ))

theorem swap_involution (n : Nat) (p : NZ zero × (Fin n → A)) :
    swap zero n (swap zero n p) = p := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rcases p with ⟨coin,tape⟩
    by_cases h : tape 0 = zero
    · simp only [swap,h,dite_true,dite_false,Fin.cons_zero,Fin.cons_succ]
      rw [ih]
      congr 1
      funext i
      exact Fin.cases h.symm (fun _ => rfl) i
    · simp only [swap,h,dite_true,dite_false,Fin.cons_zero,Fin.cons_succ,coin.property]
      congr 1
      funext i
      exact Fin.cases rfl (fun _ => rfl) i

def swapEquiv (n : Nat) : (NZ zero × (Fin n → A)) ≃ (NZ zero × (Fin n → A)) where
  toFun := swap zero n
  invFun := swap zero n
  left_inv := swap_involution zero n
  right_inv := swap_involution zero n

/-- A complete tape, not only its next accepted answer, has the exact raw
uniform law. The independent model coin remains in the original product. -/
theorem raw_marginal [Fintype A] [Nonempty (NZ zero)] (n : Nat) :
    MP (fun p : NZ zero × (Fin n → A) => (swap zero n p).2) :=
  mp_comp (mp_equiv (swapEquiv zero n)) mp_snd

/-- The model projection has its original uniform nonzero law and ignores
all independent fuel words. -/
theorem model_marginal [Fintype A] [Nonempty A] (n : Nat) :
    MP (Prod.fst : NZ zero × (Fin n → A) → NZ zero) := mp_fst

def first : {n : Nat} → (Fin n → A) → Option A
  | 0, _ => none
  | _+1, tape => if tape 0 = zero then first (fun i => tape i.succ) else some (tape 0)

def exhausted {n : Nat} (tape : Fin n → A) : Prop := ∀ i, tape i = zero

/-- The reconstructed search returns the model coin unless the retained
independent tape is all zero. No success hypothesis is required. -/
theorem first_swap (n : Nat) (coin : NZ zero) (tape : Fin n → A) :
    first zero (swap zero n (coin,tape)).2 =
      if exhausted zero tape then none else some coin.val := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [first,exhausted]
  | succ n ih =>
    by_cases h : tape 0 = zero
    · have ex : exhausted zero tape ↔ exhausted zero (fun i => tape i.succ) := by
        constructor
        · intro hall i; exact hall i.succ
        · intro hall i; exact Fin.cases h hall i
      simp only [swap,h,dite_true,dite_false,first,Fin.cons_zero,Fin.cons_succ,if_pos rfl]
      rw [ih]
      simp only [ex,if_true]
    · have ex : ¬ exhausted zero tape := fun hall => h (hall 0)
      simp only [swap,h,dite_true,dite_false,first,Fin.cons_zero,coin.property,if_false,ex]

/-- Explicit product coupling: reconstructed raw tape versus the original
model coin and independent fuel tape, with both exact marginals. -/
def coupling [Fintype A] [Nonempty (NZ zero)] (n : Nat) :
    Coupling (Fin n → A) (NZ zero × (Fin n → A)) where
  S := NZ zero × (Fin n → A)
  finS := inferInstance
  nonemptyS := by
    letI : Nonempty A := ⟨(Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty (NZ zero))).val⟩
    infer_instance
  toR := fun p => (swap zero n p).2
  toM := id
  meanR := raw_marginal zero n
  meanM := fun _ => rfl

/-- Twenty-four independent instances preserve the whole array of source
words, without enumerating the answer space or computing a recurrence. -/
theorem instances_marginal [Fintype A] [Nonempty A] [Nonempty (NZ zero)]
    (instances fuel : Nat) :
    MP (fun p : Fin instances → NZ zero × (Fin fuel → A) =>
      fun i => (swap zero fuel (p i)).2) := mp_pi (raw_marginal zero fuel) instances

#print axioms swap_involution
#print axioms raw_marginal
#print axioms model_marginal
#print axioms first_swap
#print axioms coupling
#print axioms instances_marginal
end R1Z.ProverCommitProduct25

import R1Z.ProverCommitFuelMass22
/-! Fixed fuel exceptions on retained uniform coin coordinates. This does
not assert that a concrete implementation has the required coupling. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitFuelJoin22
open R0Z R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsGood R0Z.HvzkV R0Z.LawTransport
open ProverCommitFuelMass22
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
abbrev Tape := Fin count → Fin k → OracleAnswer

def failure (i : Fin count) (t : Tape) : Prop := exhausted (fun _ => 0) (t i)

theorem failure_mass (i : Fin count) : eventMass (failure i) ≤ 1 / (p : ℚ)^k := by
  have hm := QueryScanSharedHistoryMass.eval_uniform (U := Fin k → OracleAnswer) i
    (fun draws => if exhausted (fun _ => 0) draws then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
  change eventMass (failure i) = eventMass (exhausted (fun _ => (0 : UInt8))) at hm
  rw [exhaustion_mass,QueryScanSharedHistoryMass.answer_cardinality,Nat.cast_pow,Nat.cast_ofNat] at hm
  rw [hm]
  have hp : (0 : ℚ) < (p : ℚ) := by norm_num [p]
  apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le (pow_pos hp _)
  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ hp.le (show (p : ℚ) ≤ (2 : ℚ)^256 by norm_num [p]) k

def bad {M : Type} (old : Fin 8 → M → Prop)
    (queries : M → List ProverCommitSeedEvent19.Entry)
    (i : Fin 8) (r : (M × OracleAnswer) × Tape) : Prop :=
  ProverCommitSeedEvent19.augmented old queries i r.1 ∨
    (i = 0 ∧ ∃ j, failure j r.2)

theorem old_contained {M : Type} (old : Fin 8 → M → Prop)
    (queries : M → List ProverCommitSeedEvent19.Entry) (i : Fin 8)
    (r : (M × OracleAnswer) × Tape)
    (h : ProverCommitSeedEvent19.augmented old queries i r.1) : bad old queries i r := Or.inl h

theorem mass {M : Type} [Fintype M] [Nonempty M]
    (old : Fin 8 → M → Prop) (queries : M → List ProverCommitSeedEvent19.Entry)
    (q : Nat) (bound : ∀ m, (queries m).length ≤ q) :
    eventMass (fun r => ∃ i, bad old queries i r) ≤
      eventMass (fun m => ∃ i, old i m) + ProverCommitSeedEvent19.budget q + charge := by
  have sub : ∀ r, (∃ i, bad old queries i r) →
      (∃ i, ProverCommitSeedEvent19.augmented old queries i r.1) ∨ ∃ j, failure j r.2 := by
    rintro r ⟨i,ho | ⟨_,hf⟩⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨i,ho⟩
    · exact Or.inr hf
  have h := ((eventMass_mono _ _ sub).trans (R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass_or_le _ _))
  have hleft : eventMass (fun r : (M × OracleAnswer) × Tape =>
      ∃ i, ProverCommitSeedEvent19.augmented old queries i r.1) =
      eventMass (fun r => ∃ i, ProverCommitSeedEvent19.augmented old queries i r) := by
    unfold eventMass
    convert R1Z.CouplingR1PBin.mp_fst (X := M × OracleAnswer) (Y := Tape)
      (fun r => if ∃ i, ProverCommitSeedEvent19.augmented old queries i r then (1 : ℚ) else 0) using 1 <;>
      congr 1 <;> funext r <;> split_ifs <;> rfl
  have hright : eventMass (fun r : (M × OracleAnswer) × Tape => ∃ j, failure j r.2) =
      eventMass (fun t => ∃ j, failure j t) := by
    unfold eventMass
    convert R1Z.CouplingR1PBin.mp_snd (X := M × OracleAnswer) (Y := Tape)
      (fun t => if ∃ j, failure j t then (1 : ℚ) else 0) using 1 <;>
      congr 1 <;> funext r <;> split_ifs <;> rfl
  have hc : eventMass (fun r => ∃ i, bad old queries i r) ≤
      eventMass (fun r : (M × OracleAnswer) × Tape =>
        ∃ i, ProverCommitSeedEvent19.augmented old queries i r.1) +
      eventMass (fun r : (M × OracleAnswer) × Tape => ∃ j, failure j r.2) := by
    simpa only [eventMass,R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass] using h
  rw [hleft,hright] at hc
  exact hc.trans (add_le_add (ProverCommitSeedEvent19.union_mass old queries q bound)
    (union_bound failure failure_mass))

structure RunJoin {R M V : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype M]
    (runtime : R → V) (model : M → V) (old : Fin 8 → M → Prop)
    (queries : M → List ProverCommitSeedEvent19.Entry) where
  cp : Coupling R ((M × OracleAnswer) × Tape)
  agreement : ∀ s, ¬ (∃ i, bad old queries i (cp.toM s)) →
    runtime (cp.toR s) = model (cp.toM s).1.1

theorem test_bound {R M V : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype M] [Nonempty M]
    {runtime : R → V} {model : M → V} {old : Fin 8 → M → Prop}
    {queries : M → List ProverCommitSeedEvent19.Entry}
    (join : RunJoin runtime model old queries) (test : V → ℚ)
    (bounded : ∀ v, 0 ≤ test v ∧ test v ≤ 1)
    (q : Nat) (bound : ∀ m, (queries m).length ≤ q) :
    |mean (fun r => test (runtime r)) - mean (fun m => test (model m))| ≤
      eventMass (fun m => ∃ i, old i m) + ProverCommitSeedEvent19.budget q + charge := by
  have ht := until_bad (fun s => test (runtime (join.cp.toR s)))
    (fun s => test (model (join.cp.toM s).1.1))
    (fun s => bounded _) (fun s => bounded _)
    (fun s => ∃ i, bad old queries i (join.cp.toM s))
    (fun s hn => congrArg test (join.agreement s hn))
  have hm := join.cp.meanM (fun m => if ∃ i, bad old queries i m then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
  have hmass : eventMass (fun s => ∃ i, bad old queries i (join.cp.toM s)) =
      eventMass (fun m => ∃ i, bad old queries i m) := by
    unfold eventMass
    convert hm using 1 <;> congr 1 <;> funext z <;> split_ifs <;> rfl
  have hr := join.cp.meanR (fun r => test (runtime r))
  have hi := join.cp.meanM (fun m => test (model m.1.1))
  rw [hr,hi] at ht
  have hp : mean (fun m : (M × OracleAnswer) × Tape => test (model m.1.1)) =
      mean (fun m => test (model m)) :=
    (R1Z.CouplingR1PBin.mp_fst (X := M × OracleAnswer) (Y := Tape)
      (fun m => test (model m.1))).trans
    (R1Z.CouplingR1PBin.mp_fst (X := M) (Y := OracleAnswer) (fun m => test (model m)))
  rw [hp,hmass] at ht
  exact ht.trans (mass old queries q bound)

/-- Every old seed-augmented run certificate remains sufficient. Both exact
marginals are retained; the extra tape does not alter the model output. -/
def of_seed {R M V : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype M]
    {runtime : R → V} {model : M → V} {old : Fin 8 → M → Prop}
    {queries : M → List ProverCommitSeedEvent19.Entry}
    (join : ProverCommitSeedJoin19.RunJoin runtime model old queries) :
    RunJoin runtime model old queries where
  cp := {
    S := join.cp.S × Tape
    finS := inferInstance
    nonemptyS := inferInstance
    toR := fun s => join.cp.toR s.1
    toM := fun s => (join.cp.toM s.1,s.2)
    meanR := fun f => (R1Z.CouplingR1PBin.mp_fst
      (X := join.cp.S) (Y := Tape) (fun s => f (join.cp.toR s))).trans (join.cp.meanR f)
    meanM := by
      intro f
      rw [mean_product,mean_product]
      exact join.cp.meanM (fun m => mean (fun t => f (m,t))) }
  agreement := by
    intro s hn
    exact join.agreement s.1 (fun ⟨i,hi⟩ => hn ⟨i,Or.inl hi⟩)

/-! Fixed five-draw exhaustion accounting. The probability theorem is for
uniform independent finite words. Connecting those words to the retained
shared source oracle is a separate execution obligation. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitFuelMass22
open R0Z R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsGood R0Z.HvzkV
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

def k : Nat := 5
def count : Nat := 24
def p : Nat := 2147483647

def exhausted {U : Type} (zero : U) (draws : Fin k → U) : Prop := ∀ i, draws i = zero

theorem exhaustion_mass {U : Type} [Fintype U] (zero : U) :
    eventMass (exhausted zero) = 1 / (Fintype.card U : ℚ)^k := by
  have he : exhausted zero = fun draws : Fin k → U => draws = fun _ => zero := by
    funext draws
    exact propext ⟨fun h => funext h, fun h i => congrFun h i⟩
  rw [he,QueryScanSharedHistoryMass.point_mass,Fintype.card_fun,Fintype.card_fin,Nat.cast_pow]

def charge : ℚ := (count : ℚ) / (p : ℚ)^k

theorem charge_le : charge ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ)^120 := by
  norm_num [charge,count,p,k]

/-- Per-side union charge; neither inter-instance independence nor an
exhaustive enumeration of field elements is required. -/
theorem union_bound {M : Type} [Fintype M] [Nonempty M]
    (failure : Fin count → M → Prop)
    (per_instance : ∀ i, eventMass (failure i) ≤ 1 / (p : ℚ)^k) :
    eventMass (fun m => ∃ i, failure i m) ≤ charge := by
  have h := R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass_exists_le_card failure (1 / (p : ℚ)^k)
    (fun i => by simpa only [R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass,eventMass] using per_instance i)
  simpa only [R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass,eventMass,Fintype.card_fin,charge,div_eq_mul_inv,one_mul] using h

/-- Enlarge the already seed-augmented fixed bad events once, on attempt 0. -/
def augmented {M : Type} (old : Fin 8 → M → Prop)
    (failure : Fin count → M → Prop) (i : Fin 8) (m : M) : Prop :=
  old i m ∨ (i = 0 ∧ ∃ j, failure j m)

theorem old_contained {M : Type} (old : Fin 8 → M → Prop)
    (failure : Fin count → M → Prop) (i : Fin 8) (m : M) (h : old i m) :
    augmented old failure i m := Or.inl h

theorem augmented_mass {M : Type} [Fintype M] [Nonempty M]
    (old : Fin 8 → M → Prop) (failure : Fin count → M → Prop)
    (per_instance : ∀ i, eventMass (failure i) ≤ 1 / (p : ℚ)^k) :
    eventMass (fun m => ∃ i, augmented old failure i m) ≤
      eventMass (fun m => ∃ i, old i m) + charge := by
  have sub : ∀ m, (∃ i, augmented old failure i m) →
      (∃ i, old i m) ∨ ∃ j, failure j m := by
    rintro m ⟨i, ho | ⟨_,hf⟩⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨i,ho⟩
    · exact Or.inr hf
  exact ((eventMass_mono _ _ sub).trans (R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass_or_le _ _)).trans
    (add_le_add (le_refl _) (union_bound failure per_instance))

theorem total_lt_target {q r : Nat} (hq : q ≤ 2^65) (hr : r ≤ 2^64) :
    1 / (2 : ℚ)^109 + 1 / (2 : ℚ)^137 + 1 / (2 : ℚ)^454 +
      QueryScanFreshUnion.freshBudget q + 2 * ProverCommitSeedEvent19.budget r +
      2 * charge < 1 / (2 : ℚ)^100 := by
  have h137 := QueryScanHistoryRealNumerics.dyadic_mono (by omega : 109 ≤ 137)
  have h454 := QueryScanHistoryRealNumerics.dyadic_mono (by omega : 109 ≤ 454)
  have hf := QueryScanFreshNumerics.fresh_budget_small hq
  have hs : ProverCommitSeedEvent19.budget r ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ)^109 :=
    (ProverCommitSeedEvent19.budget_mono hr).trans (by
      rw [ProverCommitSeedJoin19.budget_pow64]
      exact QueryScanHistoryRealNumerics.dyadic_mono (by omega : 109 ≤ 192))
  have hc := charge_le.trans (QueryScanHistoryRealNumerics.dyadic_mono (by omega : 109 ≤ 120))
  have hsum : 1 / (2 : ℚ)^109 + 1 / (2 : ℚ)^137 + 1 / (2 : ℚ)^454 +
      QueryScanFreshUnion.freshBudget q + 2 * ProverCommitSeedEvent19.budget r +
      2 * charge ≤ 10 / (2 : ℚ)^109 := by
    have hp : 0 ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ)^109 := by positivity
    linarith
  apply hsum.trans_lt
  norm_num

namespace R1Z.ProverCommitSeedJoin19
open R0Z R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsGood R0Z.HvzkV R0Z.LawTransport
open R1Z.ProverCommitSeedEvent19
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

structure RunJoin {R M V : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype M]
    (runtime : R → V) (model : M → V)
    (bad : Fin 8 → M → Prop) (queries : M → List Entry) where
  cp : Coupling R (M × OracleAnswer)
  agreement : ∀ s, ¬ (∃ i, augmented bad queries i (cp.toM s)) →
    runtime (cp.toR s) = model (cp.toM s).1

theorem test_bound {R M V : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype M] [Nonempty M]
    {runtime : R → V} {model : M → V} {bad : Fin 8 → M → Prop}
    {queries : M → List Entry} (join : RunJoin runtime model bad queries)
    (test : V → ℚ) (bounded : ∀ v, 0 ≤ test v ∧ test v ≤ 1)
    (q : Nat) (bound : ∀ m, (queries m).length ≤ q) :
    |mean (fun r => test (runtime r)) - mean (fun m => test (model m))| ≤
      eventMass (fun m => ∃ i, bad i m) + budget q := by
  have ht := until_bad
    (fun s => test (runtime (join.cp.toR s)))
    (fun s => test (model (join.cp.toM s).1))
    (fun s => bounded _) (fun s => bounded _)
    (fun s => ∃ i, augmented bad queries i (join.cp.toM s))
    (fun s hn => congrArg test (join.agreement s hn))
  have hr := join.cp.meanR (fun r => test (runtime r))
  have hi := join.cp.meanM (fun m => test (model m.1))
  have hp := R1Z.CouplingR1PBin.mp_fst (X := M) (Y := OracleAnswer)
    (fun m => test (model m))
  have hm := join.cp.meanM (fun m => if ∃ i, augmented bad queries i m then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
  have hmass : eventMass (fun s => ∃ i, augmented bad queries i (join.cp.toM s)) =
      eventMass (fun m => ∃ i, augmented bad queries i m) := by
    unfold eventMass
    convert hm using 1 <;> congr 1 <;> funext z <;> split_ifs <;> rfl
  rw [hr, hi, hp, hmass] at ht
  exact ht.trans (union_mass bad queries q bound)

/-- Product extension of an existing coupling retains both exact marginals. -/
def extend {R M : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype M] (cp : Coupling R M) :
    Coupling R (M × OracleAnswer) where
  S := cp.S × OracleAnswer
  finS := inferInstance
  nonemptyS := inferInstance
  toR := fun s => cp.toR s.1
  toM := fun s => (cp.toM s.1, s.2)
  meanR := fun f => (R1Z.CouplingR1PBin.mp_fst (X := cp.S) (Y := OracleAnswer)
    (fun s => f (cp.toR s))).trans (cp.meanR f)
  meanM := by
    intro f
    rw [mean_product, mean_product]
    exact cp.meanM (fun m => mean (fun seed => f (m,seed)))

/-- Containment preserves every old whole-run certificate, with the seed
retained independently. It proves implication, not proper logical inclusion. -/
def of_old {R M V : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype M]
    (runtime : R → V) (model : M → V) (old : Fin 8 → M → Prop)
    (queries : M → List Entry) (cp : Coupling R M)
    (agreement : ∀ s, ¬ (∃ i, old i (cp.toM s)) → runtime (cp.toR s) = model (cp.toM s)) :
    RunJoin runtime model old queries where
  cp := extend cp
  agreement := by
    intro s hn
    exact agreement s.1 (fun ⟨i, hi⟩ => hn ⟨i, Or.inl hi⟩)

theorem budget_pow64 : budget (2^64) = 1 / (2 : ℚ)^192 := by
  unfold budget
  rw [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat, show (256 : Nat) = 64+192 from rfl, pow_add]
  field_simp

theorem total_lt_target {q r : Nat} (hq : q ≤ 2^65) (hr : r ≤ 2^64) :
    1 / (2 : ℚ)^109 + 1 / (2 : ℚ)^137 + 1 / (2 : ℚ)^454 +
      QueryScanFreshUnion.freshBudget q + 2 * budget r < 1 / (2 : ℚ)^100 := by
  have h137 := QueryScanHistoryRealNumerics.dyadic_mono (by omega : 109 ≤ 137)
  have h454 := QueryScanHistoryRealNumerics.dyadic_mono (by omega : 109 ≤ 454)
  have hf := QueryScanFreshNumerics.fresh_budget_small hq
  have hs : budget r ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ)^109 :=
    (budget_mono hr).trans (by rw [budget_pow64]; exact
      QueryScanHistoryRealNumerics.dyadic_mono (by omega : 109 ≤ 192))
  have hsum : 1 / (2 : ℚ)^109 + 1 / (2 : ℚ)^137 + 1 / (2 : ℚ)^454 +
      QueryScanFreshUnion.freshBudget q + 2 * budget r ≤ 8 / (2 : ℚ)^109 := by
    have hp : 0 ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ)^109 := by positivity
    linarith
  apply hsum.trans_lt
  have he : 8 / (2 : ℚ)^109 = 1 / (2 : ℚ)^106 := by
    rw [show (109 : Nat) = 106+3 from rfl, pow_add, show (2 : ℚ)^3 = 8 by norm_num]
    field_simp
  rw [he]
  exact one_div_lt_one_div_of_lt (by positivity)
    (pow_lt_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega : 100 < 106))

#print axioms extend
#print axioms of_old

import R1Z.ProverCommitSimulatorSeedGuess18
import R1Z.QueryScanFreshNumerics
import R1Z.RomObserverBin
/-! A retained independent seed and a single, global seed-query event.
The event conservatively covers the entire simulator coin namespace: a query
with the exact domain and seed prefix is charged even if its suffix is malformed.
No independence of a source seed from its observed execution is assumed here. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitSeedEvent19
open R0Z R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsGood R0Z.HvzkV R0Z.LawTransport
open R1Z.ProverCommitSimulatorCoin18 R1Z.ProverCommitSimulatorOracle18
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

abbrev Entry := List UInt8 × OracleAnswer

def seedPoint (a : List UInt8) (seed : OracleAnswer) : Prop :=
  a.take ((domain.val.map ProverCommitSaltBytes.byte).length + 32) =
    domain.val.map ProverCommitSaltBytes.byte ++ List.ofFn seed

theorem seedPoint_unique (a : List UInt8) {s t : OracleAnswer}
    (hs : seedPoint a s) (ht : seedPoint a t) : s = t := by
  have he := List.append_cancel_left (hs.symm.trans ht)
  simpa only [List.ofFn_inj] using he

theorem source_point (s : OracleAnswer) (attempt : Nat) (stream : UInt8) (counter : Nat) :
    seedPoint (address (List.ofFn s) attempt stream counter) s := by
  have take_prefix (p t rest : List UInt8) (ht : t.length = 32) :
      (p ++ t ++ rest).take (p.length + 32) = p ++ t := by
    rw [← ht, ← List.length_append, List.take_append_of_le_length (Nat.le_refl _),
      List.take_length]
  unfold seedPoint address
  simpa only [List.append_assoc] using
    take_prefix (domain.val.map ProverCommitSaltBytes.byte) (List.ofFn s)
      (TranscriptR1.le32 attempt ++ [stream] ++ LayoutR1PBin.le64 counter)
      (by simp only [List.length_ofFn])

def seedGuess (queries : List Entry) (seed : OracleAnswer) : Prop :=
  ∃ entry ∈ queries, seedPoint entry.1 seed

def budget (q : Nat) : ℚ := (q : ℚ) / (2 : ℚ)^256

theorem point_mass_le (a : List UInt8) :
    eventMass (seedPoint a) ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ)^256 := by
  by_cases exists_seed : ∃ s, seedPoint a s
  · obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_seed
    have hm := eventMass_mono (seedPoint a) (fun t => t = s)
      (fun t ht => seedPoint_unique a ht hs)
    rw [QueryScanSharedHistoryMass.point_mass, QueryScanSharedHistoryMass.answer_cardinality,
      Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat] at hm
    exact hm
  · have empty : seedPoint a = fun _ => False := by
      funext s
      exact propext ⟨fun hs => exists_seed ⟨s, hs⟩, False.elim⟩
    rw [empty]
    simp only [eventMass, if_false, mean_const]
    positivity

theorem list_mass (queries : List Entry) :
    eventMass (seedGuess queries) ≤ budget queries.length := by
  induction queries with
  | nil => simp only [seedGuess, List.not_mem_nil, false_and, exists_false,
      eventMass, if_false, mean_const, budget, List.length_nil, Nat.cast_zero, zero_div, le_refl]
  | cons a tail ih =>
    have eqv : seedGuess (a::tail) = fun s => seedPoint a.1 s ∨ seedGuess tail s := by
      funext s
      simp only [seedGuess, List.mem_cons, exists_eq_or_imp]
    rw [eqv]
    have h := (R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass_or_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (point_mass_le a.1) ih)
    change eventMass (fun s => seedPoint a.1 s ∨ seedGuess tail s) ≤ _ at h
    apply h.trans
    simp only [budget, List.length_cons, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    exact le_of_eq (by ring)

theorem budget_mono {q r : Nat} (hq : q ≤ r) : budget q ≤ budget r := by
  unfold budget
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (Nat.cast_le.mpr hq) (by positivity)

/-- The list may depend on every model coin and every adaptive answer, but
not on this extra independent seed. Thus one charge covers all attempts. -/
theorem seed_mass {M : Type} [Fintype M] [Nonempty M]
    (queries : M → List Entry) (q : Nat) (bound : ∀ m, (queries m).length ≤ q) :
    eventMass (fun r : M × OracleAnswer => seedGuess (queries r.1) r.2) ≤ budget q := by
  unfold eventMass
  rw [mean_product]
  have h := R0Z.FsGood.mean_le_mean
    (fun m => eventMass (seedGuess (queries m))) (fun _ => budget q)
    (fun m => (list_mass (queries m)).trans (budget_mono (bound m)))
  rw [mean_const] at h
  exact h

/-- Only attempt zero carries the global event; it is not charged eight times. -/
def augmented {M : Type} (old : Fin 8 → M → Prop) (queries : M → List Entry)
    (i : Fin 8) (r : M × OracleAnswer) : Prop :=
  old i r.1 ∨ (i = 0 ∧ seedGuess (queries r.1) r.2)

theorem old_contained {M : Type} (old : Fin 8 → M → Prop) (queries : M → List Entry)
    (i : Fin 8) (r : M × OracleAnswer) (ho : old i r.1) : augmented old queries i r :=
  Or.inl ho

theorem union_mass {M : Type} [Fintype M] [Nonempty M]
    (old : Fin 8 → M → Prop) (queries : M → List Entry) (q : Nat)
    (bound : ∀ m, (queries m).length ≤ q) :
    eventMass (fun r => ∃ i, augmented old queries i r) ≤
      eventMass (fun m => ∃ i, old i m) + budget q := by
  have sub : ∀ r : M × OracleAnswer, (∃ i, augmented old queries i r) →
      (∃ i, old i r.1) ∨ seedGuess (queries r.1) r.2 := by
    rintro r ⟨i, ho | ⟨_, hs⟩⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨i, ho⟩
    · exact Or.inr hs
  have h := (eventMass_mono _ _ sub).trans (R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass_or_le _ _)
  have hm : eventMass (fun r : M × OracleAnswer => ∃ i, old i r.1) =
      eventMass (fun m => ∃ i, old i m) := by
    unfold eventMass
    rw [mean_product]
    congr 1
    funext m
    by_cases hm : ∃ i, old i m
    · simp only [if_pos hm, mean_const]
    · simp only [if_neg hm, mean_const]
  change eventMass (fun r => ∃ i, augmented old queries i r) ≤
    eventMass (fun r : M × OracleAnswer => ∃ i, old i r.1) +
      eventMass (fun r : M × OracleAnswer => seedGuess (queries r.1) r.2) at h
  rw [hm] at h
  exact h.trans (add_le_add (le_refl _) (seed_mass queries q bound))

#print axioms source_point
#print axioms point_mass_le
#print axioms list_mass
#print axioms budget_mono
#print axioms seed_mass
#print axioms old_contained
#print axioms union_mass

import R1Z.QueryScanSharedHistoryMass
import R1Z.ProverCommitSimulatorOracle18
/-! One simulator-coin/shared-oracle component, not a final-game attack.
Even a perfectly uniform table gives a seeded hash coin a joint correlation
with a query at a guessed seed. Independent coin marginals do not discharge
this history boundary. Retry/accepted-view projection is not proved here. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitSimulatorSeedGuess18
open R0Z R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsGood R0Z.LawTransport
open R1Z.QueryScanSharedHistoryMass
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {U : Type} [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]

/-- For fixed attempt/stream/counter, the source coin frames are also
injective in the seed. The shared-table seed-guess experiment below therefore
uses the same address relation, rather than a leaking invented experiment. -/
theorem seed_addresses_injective (attempt : Nat) (stream : UInt8) (counter : Nat) :
    Function.Injective (fun seed : R0Z.FsStatement.OracleAnswer =>
      ProverCommitSimulatorOracle18.address (List.ofFn seed) attempt stream counter) := by
  intro seed other same
  unfold ProverCommitSimulatorOracle18.address at same
  have h1 := List.append_cancel_right same
  have h2 := List.append_cancel_right h1
  have h3 := List.append_cancel_right h2
  have seeds := List.append_cancel_left h3
  simpa only [List.ofFn_inj] using seeds

/-- Two different entries of one uniform table coincide with mass 1/|U|. -/
theorem table_collision (a b : U) (different : a ≠ b) :
    eventMass (fun table : U → U => table a = table b) = 1 / (Fintype.card U : ℚ) := by
  unfold eventMass
  rw [R0Z.FsAbort.mean_equiv (R1Z.LazyTable.splitAt b)]
  have left (p : U × ({x : U // x ≠ b} → U)) :
      (R1Z.LazyTable.splitAt b).symm p a = p.2 ⟨a, different⟩ := by
    change (if h : a = b then p.1 else p.2 ⟨a, h⟩) = _
    rw [dif_neg different]
  have right (p : U × ({x : U // x ≠ b} → U)) :
      (R1Z.LazyTable.splitAt b).symm p b = p.1 := by
    change (if h : b = b then p.1 else p.2 ⟨b, h⟩) = _
    rw [dif_pos rfl]
  simp_rw [left, right]
  rw [mean_product]
  have inner (v : U) :
      mean (fun rest : {x : U // x ≠ b} → U =>
        if rest ⟨a, different⟩ = v then (1 : ℚ) else 0) = 1 / (Fintype.card U : ℚ) :=
    by simpa only [eventMass] using
      (eval_point_mass (A := {x : U // x ≠ b}) (U := U) ⟨a, different⟩ v)
  simp_rw [inner]
  exact mean_const _

/-- A source coin is H(seed), and one observer answer is H(guess).
Both use the same table, as HOST_HASH and programmed_hash's fallback do. -/
def observation (guess : U) (randomness : U × (U → U)) : U × U :=
  (randomness.2 randomness.1, randomness.2 guess)

def equalTest (pair : U × U) : ℚ := if pair.1 = pair.2 then 1 else 0

theorem independent_probability :
    mean (equalTest (U := U)) = 1 / (Fintype.card U : ℚ) := by
  unfold equalTest
  rw [mean_product]
  have inner (v : U) : mean (fun w : U => if v = w then (1 : ℚ) else 0) =
      1 / (Fintype.card U : ℚ) := by
    simpa only [eventMass, eq_comm (a := v)] using (point_mass v)
  simp_rw [inner]
  exact mean_const _

theorem seeded_probability (guess : U) :
    mean (fun r => equalTest (observation guess r)) =
      1 / (Fintype.card U : ℚ) +
        (1 - 1 / (Fintype.card U : ℚ)) / (Fintype.card U : ℚ) := by
  unfold observation equalTest
  rw [mean_product]
  let q : ℚ := 1 / (Fintype.card U : ℚ)
  have inner (seed : U) :
      mean (fun table : U → U => if table seed = table guess then (1 : ℚ) else 0) =
        if seed = guess then 1 else q := by
    by_cases same : seed = guess
    · subst seed
      simp only [if_pos rfl]
      exact mean_const 1
    · rw [if_neg same]
      simpa only [eventMass, q] using table_collision seed guess same
  simp_rw [inner]
  have decompose (seed : U) : (if seed = guess then (1 : ℚ) else q) =
      q + (if seed = guess then 1-q else 0) := by
    split <;> ring
  simp_rw [decompose]
  rw [mean_add', mean_const]
  congr 1
  simp only [mean, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  rfl

/-- For 256-bit seeds/answers the one-query correlation exceeds the entire
8 × 2^-486 query-scan allowance. This is a component loss, not a 100-bit
privacy break and not a statement about the accepted final proof view. -/
theorem numerical_gap :
    (8 : ℚ) / 2^486 < (1 - 1 / (2 : ℚ)^256) / (2 : ℚ)^256 := by
  have two_le : (2 : ℚ) ≤ 2^256 := by
    have h := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num : (1 : ℚ) ≤ 2) (by omega : 1 ≤ 256)
    simpa only [pow_one] using h
  have qhalf : (1 : ℚ) / 2^256 ≤ 1/2 :=
    one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num) two_le
  have lower : (1 : ℚ) / 2^257 ≤ (1 - 1 / (2 : ℚ)^256) / (2 : ℚ)^256 := by
    calc
      _ = (1/2 : ℚ) / (2 : ℚ)^256 := by
        rw [show 257 = 256+1 from rfl, pow_succ]
        ring
      _ ≤ _ := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (by positivity)
  have eight : (8 : ℚ) / 2^486 = 1 / (2 : ℚ)^483 := by
    rw [show 486 = 483+3 from rfl, pow_add, show (2 : ℚ)^3 = 8 by norm_num]
    ring
  rw [eight]
  apply lt_of_lt_of_le _ lower
  apply one_div_lt_one_div_of_lt (by positivity)
  exact pow_lt_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) (by omega : 257 < 483)

/-- No coupling of this precise coin/one-query component can give full
observation equality outside an event with only the query-scan budget. -/
theorem no_query_scan_only_join (size : Fintype.card U = 2^256) (guess : U) :
    ¬ ∃ (cp : Coupling (U × (U → U)) (U × U)) (bad : U × U → Prop),
      eventMass bad ≤ (8 : ℚ) / 2^486 ∧
      (∀ s, ¬ bad (cp.toM s) → observation guess (cp.toR s) = cp.toM s) := by
  rintro ⟨cp, bad, mass, agrees⟩
  have bounded (pair : U × U) : 0 ≤ equalTest pair ∧ equalTest pair ≤ 1 := by
    unfold equalTest
    split <;> norm_num
  have comparison := until_bad
    (fun s => equalTest (observation guess (cp.toR s)))
    (fun s => equalTest (cp.toM s))
    (fun s => bounded _) (fun s => bounded _)
    (fun s => bad (cp.toM s)) (fun s hn => congrArg equalTest (agrees s hn))
  have hm : eventMass (fun s => bad (cp.toM s)) = eventMass bad :=
    cp.meanM (fun m => if bad m then 1 else 0)
  have hr := cp.meanR (fun r => equalTest (observation guess r))
  have hi := cp.meanM (equalTest (U := U))
  rw [hr, hi, hm, seeded_probability, independent_probability] at comparison
  have gap : (8 : ℚ) / 2^486 <
      (1 - 1 / (Fintype.card U : ℚ)) / (Fintype.card U : ℚ) := by
    simpa only [size, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat] using numerical_gap
  have positive : 0 < (1 - 1 / (Fintype.card U : ℚ)) / (Fintype.card U : ℚ) :=
    lt_trans (by positivity) gap
  have cancel (a b : ℚ) : a+b-a = b := by ring
  rw [cancel, abs_of_pos positive] at comparison
  exact (not_le_of_gt gap) (comparison.trans mass)

#print axioms seed_addresses_injective
#print axioms table_collision
#print axioms independent_probability
#print axioms seeded_probability
#print axioms numerical_gap
#print axioms no_query_scan_only_join
end R1Z.ProverCommitSimulatorSeedGuess18

This does not substitute a deterministic HOST_HASH for a random oracle or
assert that the runtime programs the table according to this model. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitSimulatorOracle18
open R0Z R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.HvzkV R1Z.CouplingR1PBin
open R1Z.ProverCommitSimulatorCoin18
open R1Z.ProverCommitSaltBytes (byte)
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-- The five source slices are concatenated by HOST_HASH. Slice boundaries
are not part of the address, so injectivity below is on these actual bytes. -/
def address (seed : List UInt8) (attempt : Nat) (stream : UInt8) (counter : Nat) : List UInt8 :=
  domain.val.map byte ++ seed ++ R1Z.TranscriptR1.le32 attempt ++ [stream] ++
    R1Z.LayoutR1PBin.le64 counter

theorem source_frame (seed : Bytes32) (attempt : Aeneas.Std.U32)
    (stream : Aeneas.Std.U8) (counter : Aeneas.Std.U64) :
    ((frame seed attempt stream counter).val.flatMap (fun part => part.val.map byte)) =
      address (seed.val.map byte) attempt.val (byte stream) counter.val := by
  change domain.val.map byte ++ (seed.val.map byte ++
    ((Aeneas.Std.core.num.U32.to_le_bytes attempt).val.map byte ++
    ([byte stream] ++ ((Aeneas.Std.core.num.U64.to_le_bytes counter).val.map byte ++ [])))) = _
  rw [R1Z.ProverCommitSaltBytes.le32_source, R1Z.ProverCommitSaltBytes.le64_source]
  simp only [address, List.append_nil, List.append_assoc]

abbrev Index (count : Nat) := Fin 8 × Fin 4 × Fin count

def indexedAddress {count : Nat} (seed : OracleAnswer) (i : Index count) : List UInt8 :=
  address (List.ofFn seed) i.1.val (UInt8.ofNat i.2.1.val) i.2.2.val

theorem indexed_length {count : Nat} (seed : OracleAnswer) (i : Index count) :
    (indexedAddress seed i).length = 65 := by
  simp only [indexedAddress, address, List.length_append, List.length_map,
    List.length_ofFn, List.length_singleton]
  rfl

/-- Attempt, stream and counter remain distinct after byte concatenation,
provided the counter has not wrapped. No concrete address universe is read. -/
theorem indexed_injective {count : Nat} (room : count ≤ 2^64) (seed : OracleAnswer) :
    Function.Injective (indexedAddress (count := count) seed) := by
  intro i j same
  have body : R1Z.TranscriptR1.le32 i.1.val ++
      [UInt8.ofNat i.2.1.val] ++ R1Z.LayoutR1PBin.le64 i.2.2.val =
      R1Z.TranscriptR1.le32 j.1.val ++
      [UInt8.ofNat j.2.1.val] ++ R1Z.LayoutR1PBin.le64 j.2.2.val := by
    unfold indexedAddress address at same
    simpa only [List.append_assoc] using List.append_cancel_left
      (List.append_cancel_left (show domain.val.map byte ++
        (List.ofFn seed ++ (R1Z.TranscriptR1.le32 i.1.val ++
          ([UInt8.ofNat i.2.1.val] ++ R1Z.LayoutR1PBin.le64 i.2.2.val))) =
        domain.val.map byte ++
        (List.ofFn seed ++ (R1Z.TranscriptR1.le32 j.1.val ++
          ([UInt8.ofNat j.2.1.val] ++ R1Z.LayoutR1PBin.le64 j.2.2.val))) from by
        simpa only [List.append_assoc] using same))
  rw [List.append_assoc, List.append_assoc] at body
  obtain ⟨attempt, tail⟩ := List.append_inj body (by rfl)
  have ha : i.1 = j.1 := Fin.ext (R1Z.LayoutR1PBin.le32_inj _ _
    (lt_of_lt_of_le i.1.isLt (by norm_num))
    (lt_of_lt_of_le j.1.isLt (by norm_num)) attempt)
  have parts := List.cons.inj tail
  have stream := congrArg UInt8.toNat parts.1
  change i.2.1.val % 256 = j.2.1.val % 256 at stream
  have hi : i.2.1.val < 256 := lt_of_lt_of_le i.2.1.isLt (by norm_num)
  have hj : j.2.1.val < 256 := lt_of_lt_of_le j.2.1.isLt (by norm_num)
  rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hi, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hj] at stream
  have hs : i.2.1 = j.2.1 := Fin.ext stream
  have hc : i.2.2 = j.2.2 := Fin.ext (R1Z.LayoutR1PBin.le64_inj _ _
    (lt_of_lt_of_le i.2.2.isLt room) (lt_of_lt_of_le j.2.2.isLt room) parts.2)
  exact Prod.ext ha (Prod.ext hs hc)

def key {count : Nat} (bound : Nat) (fits : 65 ≤ bound) (seed : OracleAnswer)
    (i : Index count) : R1Z.RomFiniteBin.Address bound :=
  ⟨indexedAddress seed i, (R1Z.RomFiniteBin.mem_domain bound (indexedAddress seed i)).mpr
    (by simpa only [indexed_length] using fits)⟩

theorem key_injective {count : Nat} (room : count ≤ 2^64)
    (bound : Nat) (fits : 65 ≤ bound) (seed : OracleAnswer) :
    Function.Injective (key (count := count) bound fits seed) := by
  intro i j same
  exact indexed_injective room seed (congrArg Subtype.val same)

/-- Under the explicit uniform finite random-oracle table law, these source
coin requests have the independent coordinate law used by the model. The
seed is fixed, not a replacement for the table's randomness. -/
theorem coins_uniform {Answer : Type} [Fintype Answer] [Nonempty Answer]
    {count : Nat} (room : count ≤ 2^64)
    (bound : Nat) [finiteAddress : Fintype (R1Z.RomFiniteBin.Address bound)]
    (fits : 65 ≤ bound) (seed : OracleAnswer) :
    MP (fun table : R1Z.RomFiniteBin.Address bound → Answer =>
      fun i : Index count => table (key bound fits seed i)) := by
  intro f
  have he := R1Z.QueryScanIdealHistory.coordinates_uniform (U := Answer)
    (key bound fits seed) (key_injective room bound fits seed) f
  convert he using 1 <;> apply R1Z.QueryScanIdealHistory.mean_fintype_transport

#print axioms source_frame
#print axioms indexed_length
#print axioms indexed_injective
#print axioms key_injective
#print axioms coins_uniform
end R1Z.ProverCommitSimulatorOracle18

sim::simcoin18::coin_transition Kani receipt. This module does not identify

def domain : Slice U8 := Array.to_slice (Array.make 20#usize
  [85#u8, 78#u8, 80#u8, 82#u8, 79#u8, 86#u8, 69#u8, 68#u8, 58#u8, 82#u8,
   49#u8, 58#u8, 83#u8, 73#u8, 77#u8, 58#u8, 67#u8, 79#u8, 73#u8, 78#u8])

    Slice (Slice U8) :=
  Array.to_slice (Array.make 5#usize [domain, Array.to_slice seed,
    Array.to_slice (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes attempt),
    Array.to_slice (Array.make 1#usize [stream]),
    Array.to_slice (core.num.U64.to_le_bytes counter)])

/-- Exact extracted hash request and release-mode wrapping counter update.
There is exactly one callback, and no fresh coin is silently introduced. -/
theorem extracted_step (hash : Hash) (seed : Bytes32) (attempt : U32)
    (stream : U8) (counter : U64) :
    AspisR1SimulatorCoin18.sim.coin_owned18 hash seed attempt stream counter =
      (do let answer ← hash (frame seed attempt stream counter)
          ok (answer, U64.wrapping_add counter 1#u64)) := by
  rfl

/-- Failed/diverging callback evaluation remains failed/diverging. In the
successful case the only changed source field is the counter. -/
theorem successful_step (hash : Hash) (seed answer : Bytes32) (attempt : U32)
    (stream : U8) (counter : U64)
    (answered : hash (frame seed attempt stream counter) = ok answer) :
    AspisR1SimulatorCoin18.sim.coin_owned18 hash seed attempt stream counter =
      ok (answer, U64.wrapping_add counter 1#u64) := by
  rw [extracted_step, answered]
  rfl

#print axioms extracted_step
#print axioms successful_step
end R1Z.ProverCommitSimulatorCoin18

import R1Z.ProverCommitSeedJoin19
/-! Joint source-coin / adaptive history coupling. Replacing the finite set
of seed coin coordinates preserves the whole table law, and the entire
adaptive history is identical until a seed-namespace query. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitJointHistory19
open R0Z R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.LawTransport
open R1Z.GamesR1 R1Z.CouplingR1PBin R1Z.ProverCommitSeedEvent19
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {A I U : Type} [DecidableEq A]

def exchange (X Y : Type) : (X × (X × Y)) ≃ (X × (X × Y)) where
  toFun p := (p.2.1, p.1, p.2.2)
  invFun p := (p.2.1, p.1, p.2.2)
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

def swapCoordinates (key : I → A) (injective : Function.Injective key) :
    ((I → U) × (A → U)) ≃ ((I → U) × (A → U)) :=
  let split := QueryScanIdealHistory.splitCoordinates (U := U) key injective
  let reshape := Equiv.prodCongr (Equiv.refl (I → U)) split
  reshape.trans ((exchange (I → U) ({a : A // ¬ ∃ i, key i = a} → U)).trans reshape.symm)

def replaceTable (key : I → A) (injective : Function.Injective key)
    (coins : I → U) (table : A → U) : A → U :=
  (swapCoordinates key injective (coins, table)).2

theorem replace_at (key : I → A) (injective : Function.Injective key)
    (coins : I → U) (table : A → U) (i : I) :
    replaceTable key injective coins table (key i) = coins i := by
  change (if hx : ∃ j, key j = key i then coins (Classical.choose hx) else
    table (key i)) = coins i
  rw [dif_pos ⟨i,rfl⟩]
  exact congrArg coins (injective (Classical.choose_spec (show ∃ j, key j = key i from ⟨i,rfl⟩)))

theorem replace_off (key : I → A) (injective : Function.Injective key)
    (coins : I → U) (table : A → U) (a : A) (outside : ¬ ∃ i, key i = a) :
    replaceTable key injective coins table a = table a := by
  change (if hx : ∃ i, key i = a then coins (Classical.choose hx) else table a) = table a
  rw [dif_neg outside]

theorem replacement_uniform [Fintype A] [Fintype I] [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]
    (key : I → A) (injective : Function.Injective key) :
    MP (fun p : (I → U) × (A → U) => replaceTable key injective p.1 p.2) := by
  intro f
  exact (mp_equiv (swapCoordinates (U := U) key injective) (fun p => f p.2)).trans
    (mp_snd f)

/-- Exact adaptive trace transport, including repeats, addresses, order,
answers and early termination. The exception is tested on the model trace. -/
theorem runLog_agrees (program : OProg) (model source : List UInt8 → OracleAnswer)
    (fuel : Nat)
    (off : ∀ e ∈ runLog program model fuel, source e.1 = model e.1) :
    runLog program source fuel = runLog program model fuel := by
  induction fuel generalizing program with
  | zero => cases program <;> rfl
  | succ fuel ih =>
    cases program with
    | done => rfl
    | query a k =>
      have ha := off (a,model a) (by simp only [runLog, List.mem_cons, true_or])
      simp only [runLog, ha]
      congr 1
      exact ih (k (model a)) (fun e he => off e (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ he))

/-- Concrete byte-frame application: all simulator coin entries, for any
bounded finite coordinate schedule, are protected by the single seed event. -/
theorem byte_history_agrees {count : Nat} (room : count ≤ 2^64)
    (bound : Nat) [Fintype (RomFiniteBin.Address bound)] (fits : 65 ≤ bound)
    (seed : OracleAnswer) (coins : ProverCommitSimulatorOracle18.Index count → OracleAnswer)
    (table : RomFiniteBin.Address bound → OracleAnswer) (program : OProg) (fuel : Nat)
    (fresh : ¬ seedGuess (runLog program (RomFiniteBin.lookup bound table) fuel) seed) :
    let key := ProverCommitSimulatorOracle18.key (count := count) bound fits seed
    let hinj := ProverCommitSimulatorOracle18.key_injective room bound fits seed
    runLog program (RomFiniteBin.lookup bound (replaceTable key hinj coins table)) fuel =
      runLog program (RomFiniteBin.lookup bound table) fuel := by
  dsimp only
  apply runLog_agrees
  intro e he
  unfold RomFiniteBin.lookup
  split
  · next a decoded =>
    apply replace_off
    rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    have hb : a.val = e.1 := by
      have hd := RomFiniteBin.decode_encode bound a
      have hinj := RomFiniteBin.encode_decode bound e.1 a decoded
      exact hinj
    have keyeq := congrArg Subtype.val hi
    have point : seedPoint e.1 seed := by
      rw [← hb, ← keyeq]
      exact source_point seed _ _ _
    exact fresh ⟨e, he, point⟩
  · rfl

/-- Source has one table and a retained seed; the model has independent
coin coordinates, a table, and that same seed. These are exact uniform
marginals, rather than marginal coin uniformity alone. -/
def seededCoupling {S : Type} [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
    [Fintype A] [Fintype I] [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]
    (key : S → I → A) (injective : ∀ seed, Function.Injective (key seed)) :
    Coupling (S × (A → U)) (((I → U) × (A → U)) × S) where

  finS := inferInstance
  nonemptyS := inferInstance
  toR := fun p => (p.1, replaceTable (key p.1) (injective p.1) p.2.1 p.2.2)
  toM := fun p => (p.2, p.1)
  meanR := by
    intro f
    rw [mean_product, mean_product]
    congr 1
    funext seed
    exact replacement_uniform (key seed) (injective seed) (fun table => f (seed,table))
  meanM := fun f => mp_equiv (Equiv.prodComm S ((I → U) × (A → U))) f

/-- Joint observable equality for arbitrary post-coin views and adaptive

retry/abort projections of this bounded coin array. The remaining unbounded
source loops and source view correspondence are separate obligations. -/

    (bound : Nat) [Fintype (RomFiniteBin.Address bound)] (fits : 65 ≤ bound)
    {V : Type} (view : (ProverCommitSimulatorOracle18.Index count → OracleAnswer) → V)
    (program : V → OProg) (fuel : Nat)
    (seed : OracleAnswer) (coins : ProverCommitSimulatorOracle18.Index count → OracleAnswer)
    (table : RomFiniteBin.Address bound → OracleAnswer)
    (fresh : ¬ seedGuess (runLog (program (view coins)) (RomFiniteBin.lookup bound table) fuel) seed) :

    let hinj := ProverCommitSimulatorOracle18.key_injective room bound fits seed
    let sourceTable := replaceTable key hinj coins table
    let sourceCoins := fun i => sourceTable (key i)
    (view sourceCoins, runLog (program (view sourceCoins))
      (RomFiniteBin.lookup bound sourceTable) fuel) =
    (view coins, runLog (program (view coins)) (RomFiniteBin.lookup bound table) fuel) := by
  dsimp only
  have hc : (fun i => replaceTable
      (ProverCommitSimulatorOracle18.key (count := count) bound fits seed)
      (ProverCommitSimulatorOracle18.key_injective room bound fits seed) coins table
      (ProverCommitSimulatorOracle18.key bound fits seed i)) = coins := by
    funext i
    exact replace_at _ _ _ _ i
  rw [hc]
  exact congrArg (fun log => (view coins, log))
    (byte_history_agrees room bound fits seed coins table (program (view coins)) fuel fresh)

/-- Pointwise protection also transports the shipped simulator's programmed
lookup before its shared-oracle fallback. -/
theorem byte_oracle_agrees {count : Nat} (room : count ≤ 2^64)
    (bound : Nat) [Fintype (RomFiniteBin.Address bound)] (fits : 65 ≤ bound)
    (seed : OracleAnswer) (coins : ProverCommitSimulatorOracle18.Index count → OracleAnswer)
    (table : RomFiniteBin.Address bound → OracleAnswer) (a : List UInt8)
    (fresh : ¬ seedPoint a seed) :
    RomFiniteBin.lookup bound (replaceTable
      (ProverCommitSimulatorOracle18.key (count := count) bound fits seed)
      (ProverCommitSimulatorOracle18.key_injective room bound fits seed) coins table) a =
      RomFiniteBin.lookup bound table a := by
  unfold RomFiniteBin.lookup
  split
  · next addr decoded =>
    apply replace_off
    rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    have hb := RomFiniteBin.encode_decode bound a addr decoded
    have keyeq := congrArg Subtype.val hi
    apply fresh
    rw [← hb, ← keyeq]
    exact source_point seed _ _ _
  · rfl

def programmedOracle (entries : List Entry) (fallback : List UInt8 → OracleAnswer) :
    List UInt8 → OracleAnswer := fun a => (List.lookup a entries).getD (fallback a)

theorem programmed_history_agrees {count : Nat} (room : count ≤ 2^64)
    (bound : Nat) [Fintype (RomFiniteBin.Address bound)] (fits : 65 ≤ bound)
    (seed : OracleAnswer) (coins : ProverCommitSimulatorOracle18.Index count → OracleAnswer)
    (table : RomFiniteBin.Address bound → OracleAnswer) (entries : List Entry)
    (program : OProg) (fuel : Nat)
    (fresh : ¬ seedGuess (runLog program
      (programmedOracle entries (RomFiniteBin.lookup bound table)) fuel) seed) :
    runLog program (programmedOracle entries (RomFiniteBin.lookup bound (replaceTable
      (ProverCommitSimulatorOracle18.key (count := count) bound fits seed)
      (ProverCommitSimulatorOracle18.key_injective room bound fits seed) coins table))) fuel =
      runLog program (programmedOracle entries (RomFiniteBin.lookup bound table)) fuel := by
  apply runLog_agrees
  intro e he
  unfold programmedOracle
  rw [byte_oracle_agrees room bound fits seed coins table e.1
    (fun hp => fresh ⟨e,he,hp⟩)]

/-- Generic whole-component certificate with a pointwise table adapter.
For the source byte namespace, byte_oracle_agrees discharges the adapter. -/
def componentJoin [Fintype A] [Fintype I]
    (key : OracleAnswer → I → A) (injective : ∀ seed, Function.Injective (key seed))
    (lookup : (A → OracleAnswer) → List UInt8 → OracleAnswer)
    (off : ∀ seed coins table a, ¬ seedPoint a seed →
      lookup (replaceTable (key seed) (injective seed) coins table) a = lookup table a)
    {V : Type} (view : (I → OracleAnswer) → V)
    (entries : (I → OracleAnswer) → List Entry)
    (program : V → OProg) (fuel : Nat) :
    let runtime := fun r : OracleAnswer × (A → OracleAnswer) =>
      let c := fun i => r.2 (key r.1 i)
      (view c, runLog (program (view c)) (programmedOracle (entries c) (lookup r.2)) fuel)
    let model := fun m : (I → OracleAnswer) × (A → OracleAnswer) =>
      (view m.1, runLog (program (view m.1)) (programmedOracle (entries m.1) (lookup m.2)) fuel)
    ProverCommitSeedJoin19.RunJoin runtime model (fun _ _ => False)
      (fun m => runLog (program (view m.1)) (programmedOracle (entries m.1) (lookup m.2)) fuel) := by
  dsimp only
  refine ⟨seededCoupling key injective, ?_⟩
  intro p hn
  dsimp only [seededCoupling] at hn ⊢
  have hc : (fun i => replaceTable (key p.1) (injective p.1) p.2.1 p.2.2
      (key p.1 i)) = p.2.1 := by
    funext i
    exact replace_at _ _ _ _ i
  rw [hc]
  apply congrArg (fun log => (view p.2.1,log))
  apply runLog_agrees
  intro e he
  have fresh : ¬ seedPoint e.1 p.1 := by
    intro hp
    exact hn ⟨0,Or.inr ⟨rfl,⟨e,he,hp⟩⟩⟩
  unfold programmedOracle
  rw [off p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2 e.1 fresh]

#print axioms swapCoordinates

#print axioms replacement_uniform

#print axioms byte_history_agrees
#print axioms seededCoupling
#print axioms joint_observation

#print axioms programmed_history_agrees
