import R1Z.ProverCommitOwnedArrays
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitOwnedDecoder
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open R0Z.FsStatement
open R1Z.ProverCommitStreamSource (Bytes32 blockSlices)

/-- Symbolic byte-count induction, independent of the counter value. -/
theorem littleEndian_bits (w : Nat) (bits : BitVec w) :
    littleEndian (bits.toLEBytes.map (@UScalar.mk .U8)) = bits.toNat := by
  induction w using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h w ih =>
    by_cases zero : w = 0
    · subst w
      have bound := bits.isLt
      simp only [pow_zero] at bound
      simp [BitVec.toLEBytes, littleEndian]
      omega
    · rw [BitVec.toLEBytes.eq_1]
      simp only [if_pos (by omega : w > 0), List.map_cons, littleEndian]
      rw [ih (w-8) (by omega)]
      change (bits.setWidth 8).toNat + 256 * ((bits >>> 8).setWidth (w-8)).toNat = bits.toNat
      simp only [BitVec.toNat_setWidth, BitVec.toNat_ushiftRight, Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]
      change bits.toNat % 256 + 256 * ((bits.toNat / 256) % 2^(w-8)) = bits.toNat
      have bound := bits.isLt
      by_cases wide : 8 ≤ w
      · have power : 2^w = 256 * 2^(w-8) := by
          calc
            2^w = 2^((w-8)+8) := by congr 1; omega
            _ = _ := by rw [Nat.pow_add]; ring
        rw [power] at bound
        have divbound : bits.toNat / 256 < 2^(w-8) := by omega
        rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt divbound]
        omega
      · have powbound : 2^w ≤ 256 := by
          exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (by omega : w ≤ 8)
        have small : bits.toNat < 256 := by omega
        rw [Nat.div_eq_of_lt small, Nat.zero_mod, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt small]
        omega

theorem littleEndian_counter (counter : U64) :
    littleEndian (core.num.U64.to_le_bytes counter).val = counter.val := by
  exact littleEndian_bits 64 counter.bv

def answerBytes (answer : OracleAnswer) : Bytes32 :=
  Aeneas.Std.Array.make 32#usize
    (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin 32 => UScalar.mk (BitVec.ofNat 8 ((answer i).toNat))))

/-- The backend supplies exactly block counter.val, including the last block.
No large finite input carrier is reduced or enumerated. -/
theorem blockHash_at {n : Nat} (answers : Fin n → OracleAnswer)
    (domain : Slice U8) (seed : Bytes32) (counter : U64) (bound : counter.val < n) :
    blockHash answers (blockSlices domain seed counter) =
      ok (answerBytes (answers ⟨counter.val, bound⟩)) := by
  simp only [blockHash, blockSlices, Aeneas.Std.Array.to_slice, Aeneas.Std.Array.make]
  simp only [List.getElem?_cons_zero, List.getElem?_cons_succ, littleEndian_counter,
    dif_pos bound, answerBytes]
  rfl

theorem blockHash_end {n : Nat} (answers : Fin n → OracleAnswer)
    (domain : Slice U8) (seed : Bytes32) (counter : U64) (bound : n ≤ counter.val) :
    blockHash answers (blockSlices domain seed counter) = fail .panic := by
  simp only [blockHash, blockSlices, Aeneas.Std.Array.to_slice, Aeneas.Std.Array.make]
  simp only [List.getElem?_cons_zero, List.getElem?_cons_succ, littleEndian_counter,
    dif_neg (not_lt.mpr bound)]

#print axioms littleEndian_bits
#print axioms littleEndian_counter
#print axioms blockHash_at
#print axioms blockHash_end
end R1Z.ProverCommitOwnedDecoder

import R1Z.ProverCommitOwnedDecoder
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitOwnedDecoder
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open R1Z.ProverCommitFourSteps (collect)
open R1Z.ProverCommitStepLoop (State Hash Sample)

theorem collect_length {S : Type} (step : S → Result (Sample × S))
    (n : Nat) (s final : S) (values : List U32)
    (success : collect step n s = ok (.Ok values, final)) : values.length = n := by
  induction n generalizing s final values with
  | zero =>
    simp only [collect] at success
    cases success
    rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [collect] at success
    cases hs : step s with
    | fail e => simp only [hs, bind_tc_fail] at success; contradiction
    | div => simp only [hs, bind_tc_div] at success; contradiction
    | ok pair =>
      rcases pair with ⟨sample, after⟩
      simp only [hs, bind_tc_ok, Aeneas.Std.uncurry_apply_pair] at success
      cases sample with
      | Err e => cases success
      | Ok a =>
        cases ht : collect step n after with
        | fail e => simp only [ht, bind_tc_fail] at success; contradiction
        | div => simp only [ht, bind_tc_div] at success; contradiction
        | ok pair =>
          rcases pair with ⟨tail, last⟩
          simp only [ht, bind_tc_ok] at success
          cases tail with
          | Err e => cases success
          | Ok vs =>
            cases success
            exact congrArg Nat.succ (ih after _ vs ht)

theorem samples_length (hash : Hash) (domain : Slice U8) (n : Nat)
    (values : List U32) (success : samples hash domain n = some values) :
    values.length = n := by
  unfold samples at success
  cases h : collect (AspisR1ProverStep8.prover_commit_reference.limb_caller hash domain)
      n initial with
  | fail e => simp only [h, reduceCtorEq] at success
  | div => simp only [h, reduceCtorEq] at success
  | ok pair =>
    rcases pair with ⟨sample, final⟩
    cases sample with
    | Err e => simp only [h, reduceCtorEq] at success
    | Ok vs =>
      simp only [h, Option.some.injEq] at success
      subst values
      exact collect_length _ n initial final vs h

/-- No successful operational sample lookup uses the default zero. -/
theorem samples_index (hash : Hash) (domain : Slice U8) (n : Nat)
    (values : List U32) (success : samples hash domain n = some values) (i : Fin n) :
    values[i.val]?.getD 0#u32 = values[i.val]'(by rw [samples_length hash domain n values success]; exact i.isLt) := by
  rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by rw [samples_length hash domain n values success]; exact i.isLt)]
  rfl

#print axioms collect_length
#print axioms samples_length
#print axioms samples_index
end R1Z.ProverCommitOwnedDecoder

import R1Z.ProverCommitReferenceReads
import R1Z.ProverCommitSourceDecoder

/-! A fixed operational decoder from the extracted scalar caller. Unlike
representativeDecoder this executes the extracted next-word and sixteen-try
loop. The model builder balances the raw arrays after decoding. Identifying
this raw producer with the complete shipped producer is a separate obligation. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitOwnedDecoder
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.JointView
open R1Z.ProverCommitStepLoop (State Hash)
open R1Z.ProverCommitStreamSource (Bytes32 blockSlices)
open R1Z.ProverCommitSourceDecoder
open R1Z.ProverCommitWordCarrier (sourceBase)
open R1Z.ProverCommitTapeCompletion
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-- Decode the little-endian counter frame; no oracle or hash is evaluated. -/
def littleEndian : List U8 → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | b :: bs => b.val + 256 * littleEndian bs

/-- The finite oracle backend. Requests outside the allocated block stream
retain an operational failure instead of supplying fresh or padded words. -/
def blockHash {n : Nat} (answers : Fin n → OracleAnswer) : Hash := fun frame =>
  let counter := littleEndian (match frame.val[2]? with | none => [] | some bytes => bytes.val)
  if hi : counter < n then
    ok (Aeneas.Std.Array.make 32#usize
      (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin 32 => UScalar.mk (BitVec.ofNat 8 ((answers ⟨counter, hi⟩ i).toNat)))))
  else fail .panic

/-- Both shipped expanders begin with an empty cache and counter zero.
The seed value is immaterial to a backend indexed by its counter frame. -/
def initial : State :=
  ⟨Aeneas.Std.Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8, 0#u64,
    Aeneas.Std.Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8, 8#usize⟩

/-- Preserve the actual error path; only successful raw scalar arrays survive. -/
def samples (hash : Hash) (domain : Slice U8) (count : Nat) : Option (List U32) :=
  match R1Z.ProverCommitFourSteps.collect
    (AspisR1ProverStep8.prover_commit_reference.limb_caller hash domain) count initial with
  | .ok (.Ok values, _) => some values
  | _ => none

variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K]
local notation "F" => sourceBase (K := K)

/-- Total value conversion; the extracted sampler only returns canonical M31s. -/
def fieldValue (v : U32) : F :=
  R1Z.ProverCommitWordCarrier.baseEquiv
    ⟨v.val % AspisCircleGroupOrder.P, Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)⟩

def rawArrays (hash₁ hash₂ : Hash) : Option ((Fin L₁ → F) × (Fin L₂ → F)) := do
  let a ← samples hash₁ AspisR1ProverStreams.state_only_hiding.MASK_EXPAND_DOMAIN L₁
  let b ← samples hash₂ AspisR1ProverStreams.state_only_entropy.PROFILE21_SOURCE_EXPAND_DOMAIN L₂
  pure ((fun i => fieldValue (a[i.val]?.getD 0#u32)),
    (fun i => fieldValue (b[i.val]?.getD 0#u32)))

/-- Raw coordinates are retained for the protocol's existing balancing builder.
This is a concrete executable-reference composition, not an assumed equation
with quotientDecoder. -/
def decodeWith (hash₁ hash₂ : Hash) : Option (Tape K F) :=
  (rawArrays hash₁ hash₂).map (fun arrays =>
    R1Z.ProverCommitSourceCarrier.toTape
      (R1Z.ProverCommitSourceCarrier.fromQuotient (arrayCarrierEquiv arrays)))

def decoder (a : Fin E₁ → OracleAnswer) (b : Fin E₂ → OracleAnswer) :
    Option (Tape K F) := decodeWith (blockHash a) (blockHash b)

/-- Universal callback support of the composed reference, with no successful
execution assumption and with failure/divergence preserved by collect. -/
theorem samples_support (left right : Hash) (domain : Slice U8)
    (same : ∀ (seed : Bytes32) (counter : U64),
      left (blockSlices domain seed counter) = right (blockSlices domain seed counter))
    (count : Nat) : samples left domain count = samples right domain count := by
  unfold samples
  rw [R1Z.ProverCommitReferenceReads.all_calls_support left right domain same]

theorem decode_support (left₁ right₁ left₂ right₂ : Hash)
    (same₁ : ∀ (seed : Bytes32) (counter : U64),
      left₁ (blockSlices AspisR1ProverStreams.state_only_hiding.MASK_EXPAND_DOMAIN seed counter) =
      right₁ (blockSlices AspisR1ProverStreams.state_only_hiding.MASK_EXPAND_DOMAIN seed counter))
    (same₂ : ∀ (seed : Bytes32) (counter : U64),
      left₂ (blockSlices AspisR1ProverStreams.state_only_entropy.PROFILE21_SOURCE_EXPAND_DOMAIN seed counter) =
      right₂ (blockSlices AspisR1ProverStreams.state_only_entropy.PROFILE21_SOURCE_EXPAND_DOMAIN seed counter)) :
    decodeWith (K := K) left₁ left₂ = decodeWith right₁ right₂ := by
  simp only [decodeWith, rawArrays, samples_support left₁ right₁ _ same₁,
    samples_support left₂ right₂ _ same₂]

/-- Projection exposes the exact remaining scalar/cursor refinement goal. -/
theorem quotient_decodeWith (hash₁ hash₂ : Hash) :
    (decodeWith (K := K) hash₁ hash₂).map project =
      (rawArrays hash₁ hash₂).map arrayCarrierEquiv := by
  cases h : rawArrays (K := K) hash₁ hash₂ with
  | none => simp only [decodeWith, h, Option.map_none]
  | some arrays =>
    simp only [decodeWith, h, Option.map_some,
      R1Z.ProverCommitSourceCarrier.to_from]

#print axioms samples_support
#print axioms decode_support
#print axioms quotient_decodeWith
end R1Z.ProverCommitOwnedDecoder

/-! Universal oracle-support theorem for the extracted scalar/tower reference.
Only expander frames can affect its result. This does not identify the outer
material producer, its read order, or tree/binding/seed/salt coverage. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitReferenceReads
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProverStep8
open R1Z.ProverCommitStepLoop (State Hash transition)
open R1Z.ProverCommitStreamSource (blockSlices Bytes32)

theorem next_support (left right : Hash) (domain : Slice U8) (state : State)
    (same : left (blockSlices domain state.seed state.counter) =
      right (blockSlices domain state.seed state.counter)) :
    prover_commit_reference.next left domain state =
      prover_commit_reference.next right domain state := by
  unfold blockSlices at same
  simp only [prover_commit_reference.next, lift]
  by_cases h : state.word = 8#usize
  · simp only [h, if_true, bind_tc_ok, same]
  · simp only [h, if_false]

theorem transition_support (left right : Hash) (domain : Slice U8)
    (same : ∀ (seed : Bytes32) (counter : U64),
      left (blockSlices domain seed counter) = right (blockSlices domain seed counter))
    (s : R1Z.ProverCommitStepLoop.Sample × State) :
    transition left domain s = transition right domain s := by
  rcases s with ⟨sample, state⟩
  cases sample with
  | Ok value => rfl
  | Err error =>
    simp only [transition, prover_commit_reference.try_step,
      next_support left right domain state (same state.seed state.counter)]

theorem scalar_support (left right : Hash) (domain : Slice U8)
    (same : ∀ (seed : Bytes32) (counter : U64),
      left (blockSlices domain seed counter) = right (blockSlices domain seed counter))
    (state : State) :
    prover_commit_reference.limb_caller left domain state =
      prover_commit_reference.limb_caller right domain state := by
  rw [R1Z.ProverCommitStepLoop.caller_step_induction,
    R1Z.ProverCommitStepLoop.caller_step_induction]
  exact R1Z.ProverCommitExtractedStep.iterate_refines _ _
    (transition_support left right domain same) 16 _

theorem all_calls_support (left right : Hash) (domain : Slice U8)
    (same : ∀ (seed : Bytes32) (counter : U64),
      left (blockSlices domain seed counter) = right (blockSlices domain seed counter))
    (n : Nat) (state : State) :
    R1Z.ProverCommitFourSteps.collect (prover_commit_reference.limb_caller left domain) n state =
    R1Z.ProverCommitFourSteps.collect (prover_commit_reference.limb_caller right domain) n state := by
  exact R1Z.ProverCommitFourSteps.collect_congr _ _
    (scalar_support left right domain same) n state

theorem tower_support (left right : Hash) (domain : Slice U8)
    (same : ∀ (seed : Bytes32) (counter : U64),
      left (blockSlices domain seed counter) = right (blockSlices domain seed counter))
    (state : State) :
    prover_commit_reference.qm31_caller left domain state =
      prover_commit_reference.qm31_caller right domain state := by
  simp only [prover_commit_reference.qm31_caller,
    scalar_support left right domain same]

end R1Z.ProverCommitReferenceReads

import R1Z.ProverCommitStepLoop

/-! Symbolic sequential scalar calls, retaining each final failure state.
The extracted tower caller is exactly four calls in left-to-right order. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitFourSteps
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProverStep8
open R1Z.ProverCommitStepLoop (State Hash Sample transition)
abbrev Error := state_only_hiding.StateOnlyMaskBuildError

def collect {S : Type} (step : S → Result (Sample × S)) :
    Nat → S → Result (core.result.Result (List U32) Error × S)
  | 0, s => ok (.Ok [], s)
  | n+1, s => do
    let (sample, after) ← step s
    match sample with
    | .Err e => ok (.Err e, after)
    | .Ok a =>
      let (tail, final) ← collect step n after
      match tail with
      | .Err e => ok (.Err e, final)
      | .Ok values => ok (.Ok (a::values), final)

theorem collect_congr {S : Type} (left right : S → Result (Sample × S))
    (same : ∀ s, left s = right s) (n : Nat) (s : S) :
    collect left n s = collect right n s := by
  induction n generalizing s with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [collect, same]
    cases h : right s with
    | fail e => rfl
    | div => rfl
    | ok pair =>
      rcases pair with ⟨sample, after⟩
      cases sample with
      | Err e => rfl
      | Ok a => simp only [bind_tc_ok, ih]

theorem collect_extracted_steps (hash : Hash) (domain : Slice U8)
    (n : Nat) (state : State) :
    collect (prover_commit_reference.limb_caller hash domain) n state =
    collect (fun s => R1Z.ProverCommitExtractedStep.iterate
      (transition hash domain) 16 (.Err .MaskSampleExhausted, s)) n state := by
  apply collect_congr
  exact R1Z.ProverCommitStepLoop.caller_step_induction hash domain

def coordinates (q : aspis_core.field.QM31) : List U32 :=
  [q.c0.a, q.c0.b, q.c1.a, q.c1.b]

theorem qm31_collect (hash : Hash) (domain : Slice U8) (state : State) :
    (do
      let (sample, after) ← prover_commit_reference.qm31_caller hash domain state
      match sample with
      | .Err e => ok (.Err e, after)
      | .Ok q => ok (.Ok (coordinates q), after)) =
    collect (prover_commit_reference.limb_caller hash domain) 4 state := by
  simp only [prover_commit_reference.qm31_caller, collect, bind_assoc_eq]
  cases h1 : prover_commit_reference.limb_caller hash domain state with
  | fail e => rfl
  | div => rfl
  | ok pair =>
    rcases pair with ⟨sample, state1⟩
    simp only [bind_tc_ok, Aeneas.Std.uncurry_apply_pair]
    cases sample with
    | Err e => rfl
    | Ok a1 =>
      cases h2 : prover_commit_reference.limb_caller hash domain state1 with
      | fail e => rfl
      | div => rfl
      | ok pair =>
        rcases pair with ⟨sample, state2⟩
        simp only [bind_tc_ok, Aeneas.Std.uncurry_apply_pair]
        cases sample with
        | Err e => rfl
        | Ok a2 =>
          cases h3 : prover_commit_reference.limb_caller hash domain state2 with
          | fail e => rfl
          | div => rfl
          | ok pair =>
            rcases pair with ⟨sample, state3⟩
            simp only [bind_tc_ok, Aeneas.Std.uncurry_apply_pair]
            cases sample with
            | Err e => rfl
            | Ok a3 =>
              cases h4 : prover_commit_reference.limb_caller hash domain state3 with
              | fail e => rfl
              | div => rfl
              | ok pair =>
                rcases pair with ⟨sample, state4⟩
                simp only [bind_tc_ok, Aeneas.Std.uncurry_apply_pair]
                cases sample with
                | Err e => rfl
                | Ok a4 =>
                  rfl

/-- A stopped sampler carries its value and no longer consumes words. -/
def carry {S A : Type} (step : S → Option A × S) : Option A × S → Option A × S
  | (some a, s) => (some a, s)
  | (none, s) => step s

/-- Exactly n carried transitions, including absorbing successful states. -/
def run {S A : Type} (step : S → Option A × S) : Nat → Option A × S → Option A × S
  | 0, x => x
  | n+1, x => run step n (carry step x)

/-- The actual early-return loop shape, with n remaining tries. -/
def early {S A : Type} (step : S → Option A × S) : Nat → S → Option A × S
  | 0, s => (none, s)
  | n+1, s => match step s with
    | (some a, t) => (some a, t)
    | (none, t) => early step n t

theorem run_success {S A : Type} (step : S → Option A × S)
    (n : Nat) (a : A) (s : S) : run step n (some a, s) = (some a, s) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => exact ih

theorem early_eq_run {S A : Type} (step : S → Option A × S)
    (n : Nat) (s : S) : early step n s = run step n (none, s) := by
  induction n generalizing s with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [early, run, carry]
    cases h : step s with
    | mk value t =>
      cases value with
      | none => exact ih t
      | some a => exact (run_success step n a t).symm

/-- Invariant-restricted relational composition. Both transitions preserve the
valid-state invariant, so one local equality suffices for every loop length. -/
theorem run_refines {S A : Type} (left right : S → Option A × S)
    (valid : S → Prop)
    (same : ∀ s, valid s → left s = right s)
    (closed : ∀ s, valid s → valid (left s).2)
    (n : Nat) (x : Option A × S) (hx : valid x.2) :
    run left n x = run right n x := by
  induction n generalizing x with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rcases x with ⟨value, s⟩
    cases value with
    | some a => rw [run_success, run_success]
    | none =>
      simp only [run, carry]
      rw [← same s hx]
      exact ih (left s) (closed s hx)

theorem sixteen_tries {S A : Type} (left right : S → Option A × S)
    (valid : S → Prop)
    (same : ∀ s, valid s → left s = right s)
    (closed : ∀ s, valid s → valid (left s).2)
    (s : S) (hs : valid s) :
    early left 16 s = run right 16 (none, s) := by
  rw [early_eq_run]
  exact run_refines left right valid same closed 16 (none, s) hs

    Aeneas.Std.Array.index_usize block i = ok (byteAt block ⟨i.val, bound⟩) := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hval⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Aeneas.Std.Array.index_usize_spec block i (by have := block.property; change block.val.length = 32 at this; change i.val < block.val.length; omega))
  exact hx.trans (congrArg Result.ok hval)

theorem offset_value (word : Usize) (bound : word.val < 8) (amount : Usize)
    (small : amount.val ≤ 3) :
    (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul word 4#usize) amount).val =
      4*word.val+amount.val := by
  rw [Usize.wrapping_add_val_eq]
  have size := usize_size_lower
  have four : (4#usize).val = 4 := by scalar_tac
  have mul : (Usize.wrapping_mul word 4#usize).val = word.val*4 := by
    rw [Usize.wrapping_mul_val_eq, four, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
  rw [mul, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
  omega

theorem readBlock_byteWord (block : Bytes32) (word : Usize) (bound : word.val < 8) :
    readBlock block word = ok (byteWord block ⟨word.val, bound⟩) := by
  have size := usize_size_lower
  have off : (Usize.wrapping_mul word 4#usize).val = 4*word.val := by
    rw [Usize.wrapping_mul_val_eq]
    have four : (4#usize).val = 4 := by scalar_tac
    rw [four, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]; omega
  have one : (1#usize).val = 1 := by scalar_tac
  have two : (2#usize).val = 2 := by scalar_tac
  have three : (3#usize).val = 3 := by scalar_tac
  have o1 := offset_value word bound 1#usize (by decide)
  have o2 := offset_value word bound 2#usize (by decide)
  have o3 := offset_value word bound 3#usize (by decide)
  simp only [readBlock, index_byteAt _ _ (by omega : (Usize.wrapping_mul word 4#usize).val < 32),
    index_byteAt _ _ (by omega : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul word 4#usize) 1#usize).val < 32),
    index_byteAt _ _ (by omega : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul word 4#usize) 2#usize).val < 32),
    index_byteAt _ _ (by omega : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul word 4#usize) 3#usize).val < 32),
    bind_tc_ok, byteWord, off, o1, o2, o3, one, two, three]

#print axioms index_byteAt
#print axioms offset_value
#print axioms readBlock_byteWord
end R1Z.ProverCommitOwnedDecoder
R1Z.ProverCommitOwnedTotal:
import R1Z.ProverCommitOwnedReadBound
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitOwnedDecoder
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProverStep8
open R0Z.FsStatement
open R1Z.ProverCommitStepLoop (State)
open R1Z.ProverCommitStreamSource (Bytes32)

theorem usize_size_lower : 2^32 ≤ UScalar.size .Usize := by
  rw [UScalar.size_def]
  exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) System.Platform.le_numBits

theorem small_offset (word : Usize) (bound : word.val < 8) :
    (Usize.wrapping_mul word 4#usize).val ≤ 28 := by
  rw [Usize.wrapping_mul_val_eq]
  have four : (4#usize).val = 4 := by scalar_tac
  have size := usize_size_lower
  rw [four, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
  omega

theorem offset_add (offset : Usize) (bound : offset.val ≤ 28)
    (amount : Usize) (small : amount.val ≤ 3) :
    (Usize.wrapping_add offset amount).val < 32 := by
  rw [Usize.wrapping_add_val_eq]
  have size := usize_size_lower
  rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
  omega

theorem readBlock_total (block : Bytes32) (word : Usize) (bound : word.val < 8) :
    ∃ value, readBlock block word = ok value := by
  let offset := Usize.wrapping_mul word 4#usize
  have offsetbound : offset.val ≤ 28 := small_offset word bound
  have len : block.length = 32 := by exact block.property
  obtain ⟨b₀, h₀, _⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Aeneas.Std.Array.index_usize_spec block offset (by rw [len]; omega))
  obtain ⟨b₁, h₁, _⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Aeneas.Std.Array.index_usize_spec block (Usize.wrapping_add offset 1#usize)
      (by rw [len]; exact offset_add offset offsetbound 1#usize (by decide)))
  obtain ⟨b₂, h₂, _⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Aeneas.Std.Array.index_usize_spec block (Usize.wrapping_add offset 2#usize)
      (by rw [len]; exact offset_add offset offsetbound 2#usize (by decide)))
  obtain ⟨b₃, h₃, _⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Aeneas.Std.Array.index_usize_spec block (Usize.wrapping_add offset 3#usize)
      (by rw [len]; exact offset_add offset offsetbound 3#usize (by decide)))
  dsimp only [offset] at h₀ h₁ h₂ h₃
  simp only [readBlock, h₀, h₁, h₂, h₃, bind_tc_ok]
  exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

/-- If the finite stream has a word remaining, next-word cannot fail or diverge.
This includes the last cached word and the refill boundary. -/
theorem next_total {blocks : Nat} (answers : Fin blocks → OracleAnswer)
    (domain : Slice U8) (state : State) (before : valid blocks state)
    (room : position state < 8*blocks) :
    ∃ value after, prover_commit_reference.next (blockHash answers) domain state = ok (value, after) := by
  rw [next_factor]
  by_cases needed : state.word = 8#usize
  · have inbounds : state.counter.val < blocks := by
      have oldslot : state.word.val = 8 := by rw [needed]; scalar_tac
      unfold position at room
      rw [oldslot] at room
      omega
    obtain ⟨value, read⟩ := readBlock_total (answerBytes (answers ⟨state.counter.val, inbounds⟩))
      0#usize (by decide)
    simp only [refill, needed, if_true, blockHash_at answers domain state.seed state.counter inbounds,
      bind_tc_ok, Aeneas.Std.uncurry_apply_pair, read]
    exact ⟨_, _, rfl⟩
  · have bound : state.word.val < 8 := by
      rcases before with ⟨_, wordbound, _⟩
      scalar_tac
    obtain ⟨value, read⟩ := readBlock_total state.block state.word bound
    simp only [refill, needed, if_false, bind_tc_ok, Aeneas.Std.uncurry_apply_pair, read]
    exact ⟨_, _, rfl⟩

#print axioms usize_size_lower
#print axioms small_offset
#print axioms offset_add
#print axioms readBlock_total
#print axioms next_total
end R1Z.ProverCommitOwnedDecoder
R1Z.ProverCommitOwnedReadBound:
import R1Z.ProverCommitOwnedCursorProgress
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitOwnedDecoder
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProverStep8
open R0Z.FsStatement
open R1Z.ProverCommitStepLoop (State scalarFinite)
open R1Z.ProverCommitFourSteps (collect)

theorem scalarFinite_progress {blocks : Nat} (answers : Fin blocks → OracleAnswer)
    (domain : Slice U8) (capacity : blocks < 2^64) (n : Nat)
    (state after : State) (value : U32) (before : valid blocks state)
    (success : scalarFinite (blockHash answers) domain n state = ok (.Ok value, after)) :
    valid blocks after ∧ position state < position after := by
  induction n generalizing state after value with
  | zero => cases success
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [R1Z.ProverCommitStepLoop.scalarFinite_succ] at success
    obtain ⟨pair, next, rest⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ success
    rcases pair with ⟨word, current⟩
    simp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry_apply_pair] at rest
    have progress := next_progress answers domain state current word capacity before next
    split at rest
    · cases rest
      exact ⟨progress.1, by omega⟩
    · have later := ih current after value progress.1 rest
      exact ⟨later.1, by omega⟩

theorem scalar_progress {blocks : Nat} (answers : Fin blocks → OracleAnswer)
    (domain : Slice U8) (capacity : blocks < 2^64)
    (state after : State) (value : U32) (before : valid blocks state)
    (success : prover_commit_reference.limb_caller (blockHash answers) domain state = ok (.Ok value, after)) :
    valid blocks after ∧ position state < position after := by
  rw [R1Z.ProverCommitStepLoop.caller_sixteen] at success
  exact scalarFinite_progress answers domain capacity 16 state after value before success

theorem collect_progress {blocks : Nat} (answers : Fin blocks → OracleAnswer)
    (domain : Slice U8) (capacity : blocks < 2^64) (n : Nat)
    (state after : State) (values : List U32) (before : valid blocks state)
    (success : collect (prover_commit_reference.limb_caller (blockHash answers) domain)
      n state = ok (.Ok values, after)) :
    valid blocks after ∧ position state + n ≤ position after := by
  induction n generalizing state after values with
  | zero =>
    cases success
    exact ⟨before, by omega⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [collect] at success
    obtain ⟨pair, sampled, rest⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ success
    rcases pair with ⟨sample, current⟩
    simp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry_apply_pair] at rest
    cases sample with
    | Err e => cases rest
    | Ok value =>
      have first := scalar_progress answers domain capacity state current value before sampled
      obtain ⟨pair, collected, rest⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ rest
      rcases pair with ⟨tail, final⟩
      simp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry_apply_pair] at rest
      cases tail with
      | Err e => cases rest
      | Ok tail =>
        cases rest
        have later := ih current after tail first.1 collected
        exact ⟨later.1, by omega⟩

/-- A universal bound on successfully produced raw samples from a finite
backend. In particular the nine-block local Kani ROM is not a whole-array ROM. -/
theorem samples_bound {blocks : Nat} (answers : Fin blocks → OracleAnswer)
    (domain : Slice U8) (capacity : blocks < 2^64) (n : Nat)
    (values : List U32) (success : samples (blockHash answers) domain n = some values) :
    n ≤ 8*blocks := by
  unfold samples at success
  cases h : collect (prover_commit_reference.limb_caller (blockHash answers) domain) n initial with
  | fail e => simp only [h, reduceCtorEq] at success
  | div => simp only [h, reduceCtorEq] at success
  | ok pair =>
    rcases pair with ⟨sample, after⟩
    cases sample with
    | Err e => simp only [h, reduceCtorEq] at success
    | Ok vs =>
      have start : valid blocks initial := by simp [valid, initial]
      have progress := collect_progress answers domain capacity n initial after vs start h
      have bound := position_bound progress.1
      have zero : position initial = 0 := by rfl
      rw [zero] at progress
      omega

#print axioms scalarFinite_progress
#print axioms scalar_progress
#print axioms collect_progress
#print axioms samples_bound
end R1Z.ProverCommitOwnedDecoder
R1Z.ProverCommitOwnedCursorProgress:
import R1Z.ProverCommitOwnedProgress
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitOwnedDecoder
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProverStep8
open R0Z.FsStatement
open R1Z.ProverCommitStepLoop (State)
open R1Z.ProverCommitStreamSource (Bytes32 blockSlices)

/-- Every successful extracted next-word transition consumes exactly one word
inside the allocated finite stream. Counter wrapping is excluded by its bound. -/
theorem next_progress {blocks : Nat} (answers : Fin blocks → OracleAnswer)
    (domain : Slice U8) (state after : State) (value : U32)
    (capacity : blocks < 2^64) (before : valid blocks state)
    (success : prover_commit_reference.next (blockHash answers) domain state = ok (value, after)) :
    valid blocks after ∧ position after = position state + 1 := by
  rw [next_factor] at success
  obtain ⟨triple, filled, rest⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ success
  rcases triple with ⟨counter, block, slot⟩
  simp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry_apply_pair] at rest
  obtain ⟨loaded, read, result⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ rest
  have same : after = {state with counter := counter, block := block, word := Usize.wrapping_add slot 1#usize} :=
    ((Prod.mk.inj (Result.ok.inj result)).2).symm
  rw [same]
  rcases before with ⟨counterbound, wordbound, empty⟩
  by_cases refill_needed : state.word = 8#usize
  · simp only [refill, refill_needed, if_true] at filled
    obtain ⟨bytes, queried, result⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ filled
    have inbounds : state.counter.val < blocks := by
      by_contra outside
      rw [blockHash_end answers domain state.seed state.counter (by omega)] at queried
      cases queried
    have increment := R1Z.ProverCommitStreamBytes.counter_step state.counter (by omega)
    cases result
    have slotinc := small_increment 0#usize (by decide)
    have slotzero : (0#usize).val = 0 := by scalar_tac
    have oldslot : state.word.val = 8 := by rw [refill_needed]; scalar_tac
    simp only [valid, position, increment, slotinc, slotzero]
    omega
  · simp only [refill, refill_needed, if_false] at filled
    cases filled
    have less : state.word.val < 8 := by scalar_tac
    have inc := small_increment state.word wordbound
    have nonzero : state.counter.val ≠ 0 := by intro h; have := empty h; omega
    simp only [valid, position, inc]
    omega

#print axioms next_progress
end R1Z.ProverCommitOwnedDecoder

import R1Z.ProverCommitOwnedBackend
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitOwnedDecoder
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProverStep8
open R0Z.FsStatement
open R1Z.ProverCommitStepLoop (State Hash)
open R1Z.ProverCommitStreamSource (Bytes32 blockSlices)

theorem bind_success {A B : Type} (run : Result A) (f : A → Result B)
    (value : B) (success : (do let a ← run; f a) = ok value) :
    ∃ a, run = ok a ∧ f a = ok value := by
  cases run with
  | fail e => cases success
  | div => cases success
  | ok a => exact ⟨a, rfl, success⟩

def readBlock (block : Bytes32) (word : Usize) : Result U32 := do
  let offset := Usize.wrapping_mul word 4#usize
  let b₀ ← Aeneas.Std.Array.index_usize block offset
  let b₁ ← Aeneas.Std.Array.index_usize block (Usize.wrapping_add offset 1#usize)
  let b₂ ← Aeneas.Std.Array.index_usize block (Usize.wrapping_add offset 2#usize)
  let b₃ ← Aeneas.Std.Array.index_usize block (Usize.wrapping_add offset 3#usize)
  ok (core.num.U32.from_le_bytes (Aeneas.Std.Array.make 4#usize [b₀,b₁,b₂,b₃]))

def refill (hash : Hash) (domain : Slice U8) (state : State) :
    Result (U64 × Bytes32 × Usize) :=
  if state.word = 8#usize then do
    let block ← hash (blockSlices domain state.seed state.counter)
    ok (core.num.U64.wrapping_add state.counter 1#u64, block, 0#usize)
  else ok (state.counter, state.block, state.word)

theorem next_factor (hash : Hash) (domain : Slice U8) (state : State) :
    prover_commit_reference.next hash domain state = (do
      let (counter, block, word) ← refill hash domain state
      let value ← readBlock block word
      ok (value, {state with counter := counter, block := block, word := Usize.wrapping_add word 1#usize})) := by
  simp only [prover_commit_reference.next, refill, readBlock, blockSlices,
    lift, bind_assoc_eq, bind_tc_ok]

/-- A source cursor invariant, including the empty initial cache. -/
def valid (blocks : Nat) (state : State) : Prop :=
  state.counter.val ≤ blocks ∧ state.word.val ≤ 8 ∧
    (state.counter.val = 0 → state.word.val = 8)

def position (state : State) : Nat := 8*state.counter.val + state.word.val - 8

theorem position_bound {blocks : Nat} {state : State} (h : valid blocks state) :
    position state ≤ 8*blocks := by unfold valid position at *; omega

theorem small_increment (word : Usize) (bound : word.val ≤ 8) :
    (Usize.wrapping_add word 1#usize).val = word.val + 1 := by
  rw [Usize.wrapping_add_val_eq]
  have small : 2^32 ≤ UScalar.size .Usize := by
    rw [UScalar.size_def]
    exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) System.Platform.le_numBits
  have one : (1#usize).val = 1 := by scalar_tac
  rw [one, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]

#print axioms bind_success
#print axioms next_factor
#print axioms position_bound
#print axioms small_increment
end R1Z.ProverCommitOwnedDecoder
R1Z.ProverCommitOwnedWord:
import R1Z.ProverCommitOwnedDecoder
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitOwnedDecoder
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProverStep8
open R1Z.ProverCommitWordCarrier
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

def wordFin (word : U32) : R1Z.CommitReadsR1.Word :=
  ⟨word.val, by simpa only [UScalar.size_def, UScalarTy.U32_numBits_eq] using word.hSize⟩

theorem masked_val (word : U32) :
    (word &&& 2147483647#u32).val = word.val % 2^31 := by
  rw [UScalar.val_and]
  change word.val &&& (2^31-1) = word.val % 2^31
  exact Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod word.val 31

variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K]

/-- The extracted masking, comparison and field conversion implement exactly
the accepted-word predicate used by the fibre model, for every machine word. -/
theorem accepted_word (word : U32) :
    accepted (K := K) (wordFin word) =
      if word &&& 2147483647#u32 < aspis_core.field.P then
        some (fieldValue (word &&& 2147483647#u32)) else none := by
  have comparison : (word &&& 2147483647#u32 < aspis_core.field.P) ↔
      word.val % 2^31 < AspisCircleGroupOrder.P := by
    simp only [UScalar.lt_equiv, masked_val, aspis_core.field.P]
    rfl
  by_cases accepted : word.val % 2^31 < AspisCircleGroupOrder.P
  · rw [if_pos (comparison.mpr accepted)]
    simp only [R1Z.ProverCommitWordCarrier.accepted, wordFin, dif_pos accepted,
      fieldValue, masked_val, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt accepted]
  · rw [if_neg (fun h => accepted (comparison.mp h))]
    simp only [R1Z.ProverCommitWordCarrier.accepted, wordFin, dif_neg accepted]

#print axioms masked_val
#print axioms accepted_word
end R1Z.ProverCommitOwnedDecoder
R1Z.ProverCommitCircleProgram28:
import AspisR1CircleCaller25.Funs
import R1Z.ProverCommitStateLift28
/-! Generic monadic lift of the retained circle caller. Pure validation
and decoding use the original retained functions. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitCircleProgram28
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1CircleCaller25 ProverCommitStateLift28
variable {M : Type → Type} [Monad M] [MonadLiftT Result M]
def sample
  {H : Type} (effect : H → Parts → M Bytes32)
  (self : r1_wire.SemanticTranscript H) (row : Std.U8) (framed : Slice Std.U8)
  :
  M ((core.result.Result (Array Std.U8 32#usize) r1_wire.Error) ×
    (r1_wire.SemanticTranscript H))
  := do
  if row != self.next_row
  then
    pure (core.result.Result.Err (r1_wire.Error.RowOrder self.next_row row),
      self)
  else
    let s ← lift (Array.to_slice self.state)
    let i ← lift (Std.U8.wrapping_add 160#u8 row)
    let s1 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 2#usize [ 0#u8, i ]))
    let s2 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 3#usize [ s, s1, framed ]))
    let absorbed ← effect self.hash s2
    let s3 ← lift (Array.to_slice absorbed)
    let s4 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 1#usize [ 1#u8 ]))
    let s5 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 2#usize [ s3, s4 ]))
    let block ← effect self.hash s5
    let s6 ← lift (Array.to_slice absorbed)
    let s7 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 1#usize [ 2#u8 ]))
    let s8 ← lift (Array.to_slice (Array.make 2#usize [ s6, s7 ]))
    let a ← effect self.hash s8
    let i1 ← lift (Std.U8.wrapping_add self.next_row 1#u8)
    pure (core.result.Result.Ok block, { self with state := a, next_row := i1 })


def point
  {H : Type} {P : Type} (effect : H → Parts → M Bytes32) (PolicyInst : r1_wire.circle25.Policy P)
  (state : r1_wire.SemanticTranscript H) (row : Std.U8)
  (record1 : alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) :
  M ((core.result.Result (Array aspis_core.field.QM31 2#usize)
    r1_wire.Error) × (r1_wire.SemanticTranscript H))
  := do
  match row with
  | 25#uscalar =>
    if 25#u8 != state.next_row
    then
      pure (core.result.Result.Err (r1_wire.Error.RowOrder state.next_row 25#u8),
        state)
    else
      let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref record1
      let r ← r1_wire.semantic20.checked 25#u8 s
      match r with
      | core.result.Result.Ok _ =>
        let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref record1
        let (r1, state1) ←
          sample
            effect state 25#u8 s1
        match r1 with
        | core.result.Result.Ok b =>
          let a ← PolicyInst.point b false
          pure (core.result.Result.Ok a, state1)
        | core.result.Result.Err e => pure (core.result.Result.Err e, state1)
      | core.result.Result.Err e => pure (core.result.Result.Err e, state)
  | 26#uscalar =>
    if 26#u8 != state.next_row
    then
      pure (core.result.Result.Err (r1_wire.Error.RowOrder state.next_row 26#u8),
        state)
    else
      let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref record1
      let r ← r1_wire.semantic20.checked 26#u8 s
      match r with
      | core.result.Result.Ok _ =>
        let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref record1
        let (r1, state1) ←
          sample
            effect state 26#u8 s1
        match r1 with
        | core.result.Result.Ok b =>
          let a ← PolicyInst.point b true
          pure (core.result.Result.Ok a, state1)
        | core.result.Result.Err e => pure (core.result.Result.Err e, state1)
      | core.result.Result.Err e => pure (core.result.Result.Err e, state)
  | _ => pure (core.result.Result.Err r1_wire.Error.InvalidRow, state)

end R1Z.ProverCommitCircleProgram28

import R1Z.ProverCommitControlSource28
import R1Z.ProverCommitQuery26
/-! Concrete effect installation in the complete reconstructed suffix.
The token is Unit; all mutable oracle state is in the returned Machine. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitControl28
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1SimControl21
open ProverCommitStateLift28 ProverCommitCoinCall27
abbrev Bytes32 := ProverCommitCoinCall27.Bytes32
abbrev State := transcript.control21.Transcript Unit Unit
abbrev Values := Array aspis_core.field.QM31 25#usize
abbrev Points := Array (Array aspis_core.field.QM31 2#usize) 2#usize

def extracted : Effect Machine :=
  AspisR1CoinEffect27.CoinOracle.Insts.Effect27EffectDigest32CoinState.digest mapRecording

def reference : Effect Machine := fun s p => ok (expected s p)

def dictionary (effect : Effect Machine) : Unit → Parts → Port Machine Bytes32 :=
  fun _ parts => read effect parts

def queries (s : State) (row : U8) (payload : Slice U8) :=
  ProverCommitControlProgram28.queries (dictionary extracted) ProverCommitQuery26.policy s row payload

def tail (state : Bytes32) (sem : Values) (z : Points) (records : sim.Records)
    (variant : transport.Variant) :=
  ProverCommitControlProgram28.tail (dictionary extracted) ProverCommitQuery26.policy

      simp only [guessed,List.mem_cons,exists_eq_or_imp]
    rw [shape]
    exact ((R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass_or_le _ _).trans
      (add_le_add (point_mass a.1) ih)).trans (le_of_eq (by
        simp only [budget,List.length_cons,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one]; ring))

theorem budget_mono {q r a b : Nat} (hqr : q ≤ r) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    budget q a ≤ budget r b := by
  unfold budget
  gcongr

/-- A context may contain the adversary's nonce selection after its earlier
queries. It may not contain this fresh successful raw OS coordinate. This
is the E1 product calculation, not a whole adaptive-experiment join. -/
theorem context_mass {C : Type} [Fintype C] [Nonempty C]
    (prior : C → List Entry) (q : Nat) (bound : ∀ c, (prior c).length ≤ q) :
    eventMass (fun r : C × OracleAnswer => guessed (prior r.1) r.2) ≤ budget q 1 := by
  unfold eventMass
  rw [R0Z.LawTransport.mean_product]
  have h := R0Z.FsGood.mean_le_mean
    (fun c => eventMass (guessed (prior c))) (fun _ => budget q 1)
    (fun c => (list_mass (prior c)).trans (budget_mono (bound c) (le_refl _)))
  simpa only [eventMass,mean_const] using h

/-- Union bound requires no independence among attempts. The conditional
coordinate law must still be proved for each actual execution event. -/
theorem attempts_mass {M : Type} [Fintype M] [Nonempty M]
    (q attempts : Nat) (bad : Fin attempts → M → Prop)
    (per_attempt : ∀ i, eventMass (bad i) ≤ budget q 1) :
    eventMass (fun m => ∃ i, bad i m) ≤ budget q attempts := by
  have h := R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass_exists_le_card bad (budget q 1) per_attempt
  rw [Fintype.card_fin] at h
  simpa only [R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass,eventMass] using
    h.trans (le_of_eq (by unfold budget; ring))

/-- Two raw seeds, two worlds; 128 is 16 candidates times eight attempts.
This is a raw-draw envelope, not 128 successful source reservations. -/
theorem bounded_charge {q attempts : Nat} (hq : q ≤ 2^64) (ha : attempts ≤ 128) :

  (budget_mono hq ha).trans (by norm_num [budget])

theorem total_lt_target {scan q attempts : Nat}
    (hs : scan ≤ 2^65) (hq : q ≤ 2^64) (ha : attempts ≤ 128) :
    1 / (2 : ℚ)^109 + 1 / (2 : ℚ)^137 + 1 / (2 : ℚ)^454 +

      2 * ProverCommitFuelMass22.charge + 4 * budget q attempts <
        1 / (2 : ℚ)^100 := by
  have h137 := QueryScanHistoryRealNumerics.dyadic_mono (by omega : 109 ≤ 137)
  have h454 := QueryScanHistoryRealNumerics.dyadic_mono (by omega : 109 ≤ 454)
  have hf := QueryScanFreshNumerics.fresh_budget_small hs
  have hseed : ProverCommitSeedEvent19.budget q ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ)^109 :=
    (ProverCommitSeedEvent19.budget_mono hq).trans (by
      rw [ProverCommitSeedJoin19.budget_pow64]
      exact QueryScanHistoryRealNumerics.dyadic_mono (by omega : 109 ≤ 192))
  have hc := ProverCommitFuelMass22.charge_le.trans
    (QueryScanHistoryRealNumerics.dyadic_mono (by omega : 109 ≤ 120))
  have hr := (bounded_charge hq ha).trans
    (QueryScanHistoryRealNumerics.dyadic_mono (by omega : 109 ≤ 185))
  have upper : 1 / (2 : ℚ)^109 + 1 / (2 : ℚ)^137 + 1 / (2 : ℚ)^454 +
      QueryScanFreshUnion.freshBudget scan + 2 * ProverCommitSeedEvent19.budget q +
      2 * ProverCommitFuelMass22.charge + 4 * budget q attempts ≤

    have pos : 0 ≤ 1 / (2 : ℚ)^109 := by positivity
    linarith

def budget (q attempts : Nat) : ℚ :=

theorem prior_mass (prior : List Entry) :

theorem budget_mono {q r a b : Nat} (hqr : q ≤ r) (hab : a ≤ b) :

  unfold budget

/-- The prior context can contain arbitrary earlier oracle answers, ledger
entries and schedule history. Its query list cannot depend on this new nonce.
This is a conditional fresh-draw calculation, not an independent-seed
replacement for the source's actual nonce. -/
theorem context_mass {C : Type} [Fintype C] [Nonempty C]

  rw [Fintype.card_fin] at h

    h.trans (le_of_eq (by unfold budget; ring))

/-! Explicit D150 event on one fresh ROM coordinate, conditional on a fixed
byte-blind context. This is not a source selected-nonce or adaptive-history
refinement. In particular the ledger size is a visible parameter. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitReservationGuess38
open R0Z R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsGood R0Z.HvzkV
open GamesR1PBin ProverCommitReservationRom37
local instance (priority := 10000) allDecidable (p : Prop) : Decidable p :=
  Classical.propDecidable p
local instance (priority := 10000) allDecEq (U : Type) : DecidableEq U := Classical.decEq U

def budget (queries entries attempts : Nat) : ℚ :=
  ((queries : ℚ) + entries) * attempts / ((2 : ℚ)^256 - 1)

/-- The path argument is the digest naming the private reservation file.
Queries are the adversary's own input bytes; malformed inputs are allowed. -/
def reservationGuess (queries : List (List UInt8)) (entries : List OracleAnswer)
    (nonce : NZ) (path : OracleAnswer) : Prop :=
  reservationInput nonce.val ∈ queries ∨ path ∈ entries

theorem answer_card : Fintype.card OracleAnswer = 2^256 := by
  have all : ∀ j : Fintype OracleAnswer, @Fintype.card OracleAnswer j = 2^256 := fun j =>
    (congrArg (@Fintype.card OracleAnswer) (Subsingleton.elim j _)).trans
      QueryScanSharedHistoryMass.answer_cardinality
  exact all _

theorem nonzero_card : Fintype.card NZ = 2^256 - 1 := by
  change Fintype.card {x : OracleAnswer // ¬ x = 0} = _
  rw [Fintype.card_subtype_compl,answer_card]
  simp

theorem query_point (input : List UInt8) :
    eventMass (fun nonce : NZ => reservationInput nonce.val = input) ≤
      1 / ((2 : ℚ)^256 - 1) := by
  by_cases exists_nonce : ∃ nonce : NZ, reservationInput nonce.val = input
  · obtain ⟨nonce, hn⟩ := exists_nonce
    have h := eventMass_mono
      (fun n : NZ => reservationInput n.val = input) (fun n => n = nonce)
      (fun n hit => Subtype.ext
        (ProverCommitReservationFrames37.reservation_injective (hit.trans hn.symm)))
    rw [QueryScanSharedHistoryMass.point_mass, nonzero_card] at h
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by norm_num : 1 ≤ (2:Nat)^256),
      Nat.cast_pow,Nat.cast_ofNat,Nat.cast_one] at h
    exact h
  · have empty : (fun nonce : NZ => reservationInput nonce.val = input) =
        fun _ => False := by
      funext n
      exact propext ⟨fun hit => exists_nonce ⟨n,hit⟩,False.elim⟩
    rw [empty]
    simp only [eventMass,if_false,mean_const]
    norm_num

theorem query_list (queries : List (List UInt8)) :
    eventMass (fun nonce : NZ => reservationInput nonce.val ∈ queries) ≤
      queries.length / ((2 : ℚ)^256 - 1) := by
  induction queries with
  | nil => simp [eventMass,mean_const]
  | cons q qs ih =>
    have shape : (fun nonce : NZ => reservationInput nonce.val ∈ q::qs) =
        fun nonce => reservationInput nonce.val = q ∨ reservationInput nonce.val ∈ qs := by
      funext n
      simp only [List.mem_cons]
    rw [shape]
    exact ((R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass_or_le _ _).trans
      (add_le_add (query_point q) ih)).trans (le_of_eq (by
        simp only [List.length_cons,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one]; ring))

theorem path_list (entries : List OracleAnswer) :
    eventMass (fun path : OracleAnswer => path ∈ entries) ≤
      entries.length / ((2 : ℚ)^256 - 1) := by
  induction entries with
  | nil => simp [eventMass,mean_const]
  | cons path entries ih =>
    have shape : (fun p : OracleAnswer => p ∈ path::entries) =
        fun p => p = path ∨ p ∈ entries := by
      funext p
      simp only [List.mem_cons]
    have hp : eventMass (fun p : OracleAnswer => p = path) ≤
        1 / ((2 : ℚ)^256 - 1) := by
      rw [QueryScanSharedHistoryMass.point_mass,
        answer_card,Nat.cast_pow,Nat.cast_ofNat]
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by linarith)
    rw [shape]
    exact ((R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass_or_le _ _).trans
      (add_le_add hp ih)).trans (le_of_eq (by
        simp only [List.length_cons,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one]; ring))

/-- P1 supplies a fresh uniform digest when the input was not queried.
This product calculation also charges queried inputs, so the ignored digest
on a memo hit cannot silently be used as its real oracle answer. -/
theorem fresh_slice (queries : List (List UInt8)) (entries : List OracleAnswer) :
    eventMass (fun r : NZ × OracleAnswer => reservationGuess queries entries r.1 r.2) ≤
      budget queries.length entries.length 1 := by
  have hq : eventMass (fun r : NZ × OracleAnswer =>
      reservationInput r.1.val ∈ queries) =
      eventMass (fun nonce : NZ => reservationInput nonce.val ∈ queries) := by
    exact CouplingR1PBin.mp_fst (X := NZ) (Y := OracleAnswer)
      (fun nonce => if reservationInput nonce.val ∈ queries then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
  have he : eventMass (fun r : NZ × OracleAnswer => r.2 ∈ entries) =
      eventMass (fun path : OracleAnswer => path ∈ entries) := by
    exact CouplingR1PBin.mp_snd (X := NZ) (Y := OracleAnswer)
      (fun path => if path ∈ entries then (1 : ℚ) else 0)
  have h := R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass_or_le
    (fun r : NZ × OracleAnswer => reservationInput r.1.val ∈ queries)
    (fun r => r.2 ∈ entries)
  change eventMass (fun r : NZ × OracleAnswer => reservationGuess queries entries r.1 r.2) ≤
    eventMass (fun r : NZ × OracleAnswer => reservationInput r.1.val ∈ queries) +
    eventMass (fun r : NZ × OracleAnswer => r.2 ∈ entries) at h
  rw [hq,he] at h
  exact (h.trans (add_le_add (query_list queries) (path_list entries))).trans
    (le_of_eq (by unfold budget; ring))

/-- A union over actual attempted reservations needs no independence between
attempt events, but still needs their conditional/fresh-slice instantiation.
This deliberately does not assert that eight source retries already supply it. -/
theorem attempt_union {M : Type} [Fintype M] [Nonempty M]
    (attempts queries entries : Nat) (bad : Fin attempts → M → Prop)
    (per_attempt : ∀ i, eventMass (bad i) ≤ budget queries entries 1) :
    eventMass (fun m => ∃ i, bad i m) ≤ budget queries entries attempts := by
  have h := R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass_exists_le_card bad (budget queries entries 1)
    per_attempt
  rw [Fintype.card_fin] at h
  simpa only [R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass,eventMass] using
    h.trans (le_of_eq (by unfold budget; ring))

#print axioms attempt_union

namespace R1Z.ProverCommitReservationFrames37

theorem reservation_injective : Function.Injective reservationInput := by
  intro nonce other eq
  have suffix : List.ofFn nonce = List.ofFn other := List.append_cancel_left eq
  simpa only [List.ofFn_inj] using suffix

theorem reservation_control (nonce : OracleAnswer) :

theorem first_byte_separated (nonce : OracleAnswer) (tag : UInt8)
    (different : tag ≠ 97) (suffix : List UInt8) :
    reservationInput nonce ≠ tag::suffix := by
  intro eq
  have h := congrArg List.head? eq
  change some (97 : UInt8) = some tag at h

theorem state_control_separated (nonce : OracleAnswer) (state : List UInt8)
    (length : state.length = 32) (tag : UInt8) (different : tag ≠ 116)
    (suffix : List UInt8) :
    reservationInput nonce ≠ state ++ tag::suffix := by
  intro eq
  have empty : state.drop 32 = [] := by rw [← length,List.drop_length]
  have h := congrArg (fun xs : List UInt8 => (xs.drop 32).head?) eq
  rw [reservation_control] at h
  simp only [List.drop_append,empty,length,Nat.sub_self,List.drop_zero,
    List.nil_append,List.head?_cons] at h
  exact different (Option.some.inj h).symm

/-! Reservation ROM coordinates. The fresh-coordinate theorem is a P1 model
fact, not a source-to-ROM transport. The existing simulator seed event does
not contain reservation-input queries. No new cryptographic premise. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitReservationRom37
open R0Z R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsGood R0Z.HvzkV
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

def reservationDomain : List UInt8 := [97, 115, 112, 105, 115, 58, 115, 116, 97, 116, 101, 45, 111, 110, 108, 121, 58, 97, 116, 116, 101, 109, 112, 116, 45, 114, 101, 115, 101, 114, 118, 97, 116, 105, 111, 110, 58, 118, 49]
def reservationInput (nonce : OracleAnswer) : List UInt8 :=
  reservationDomain ++ List.ofFn nonce

theorem reservation_length (nonce : OracleAnswer) :
    (reservationInput nonce).length = 71 := by
  simp [reservationInput,reservationDomain]

/-- Unlike a global table marginal, this fixes *all* other ROM coordinates.
The entries can depend arbitrarily on that fixed context. -/
theorem entry_mass (entries : List OracleAnswer) :
    eventMass (fun answer : OracleAnswer => answer ∈ entries) ≤
      (entries.length : ℚ) / (2 : ℚ)^256 := by
  induction entries with
  | nil => simp [eventMass,mean_const]
  | cons entry entries ih =>
    have sub : (fun answer : OracleAnswer => answer ∈ entry::entries) =
        fun answer => answer = entry ∨ answer ∈ entries := by
      funext answer
      simp only [List.mem_cons]
    rw [sub]
    have h := (R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass_or_le _ _).trans (add_le_add
      (le_of_eq (QueryScanSharedHistoryMass.point_mass entry)) ih)
    rw [QueryScanSharedHistoryMass.answer_cardinality,Nat.cast_pow,Nat.cast_ofNat] at h
    exact h.trans (le_of_eq (by simp only [List.length_cons,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one]; ring))

theorem fresh_coordinate {A : Type} [DecidableEq A] (a : A)
    (rest : {j : A // j ≠ a} → OracleAnswer) (entries : List OracleAnswer) :
    eventMass (fun digest : OracleAnswer =>
      (LazyTable.splitAt a).symm (digest,rest) a ∈ entries) ≤
      (entries.length : ℚ) / (2 : ℚ)^256 := by
  simpa [LazyTable.splitAt] using entry_mass entries

theorem prior_preserved {A : Type} [DecidableEq A] (a : A)
    (rest : {j : A // j ≠ a} → OracleAnswer) (digest : OracleAnswer)
    (j : A) (fresh : j ≠ a) :
    (LazyTable.splitAt a).symm (digest,rest) j = rest ⟨j,fresh⟩ := by
  simp [LazyTable.splitAt,fresh]

/-- A concrete reservation frame starts with ASCII a (97), whereas the
existing private simulator coin prefix starts with ASCII U (85). -/
theorem not_simulator_seedPoint (nonce seed : OracleAnswer) :
    ¬ ProverCommitSeedEvent19.seedPoint (reservationInput nonce) seed := by
  intro h
  have heads := congrArg List.head? h
  change some (97 : UInt8) = some (85 : UInt8) at heads
  cases heads

def reservationQueried (queries : List ProverCommitSeedEvent19.Entry)
    (nonce : OracleAnswer) : Prop :=
  ∃ entry ∈ queries, entry.1 = reservationInput nonce

/-- An exact memo-hit is absent from the existing seed event, for every
simulator seed and nonce. This is a counterexample to event containment,
not a collision or privacy attack. It also holds for nonzero nonces. -/
theorem queried_not_seedGuess (nonce seed : OracleAnswer) :
    reservationQueried [(reservationInput nonce,0)] nonce ∧
      ¬ ProverCommitSeedEvent19.seedGuess [(reservationInput nonce,0)] seed := by
  constructor
  · exact ⟨(reservationInput nonce,0),by simp,rfl⟩
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨entry,member,point⟩ := h
    have eq : entry = (reservationInput nonce,0) := by simpa using member
    subst entry
    exact not_simulator_seedPoint nonce seed point

theorem no_existing_event_containment (nonce seed : OracleAnswer) :
    ¬ ∀ queries : List ProverCommitSeedEvent19.Entry,
      reservationQueried queries nonce → ProverCommitSeedEvent19.seedGuess queries seed := by
  intro h
  have counter := queried_not_seedGuess nonce seed
  exact counter.2 (h _ counter.1)

/-! Conditioning away zero nonces and following the actual rejection owner

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitReservationNonzero37
open R0Z R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsGood R0Z.HvzkV
open ProverCommitReservationRom37 ProverCommitEntropy18 GamesR1PBin
local instance (priority := 10000) allDecidable (p : Prop) : Decidable p :=
  Classical.propDecidable p
local instance (priority := 10000) allDecEq (U : Type) : DecidableEq U := Classical.decEq U

def mixedHit {A U : Type} (known : A) (entry : U)
    (r : A × ({j : A // j ≠ known} → U)) : Prop :=
  (LazyTable.splitAt known).symm (entry,r.2) r.1 = entry

theorem mixed_memo_mass {A U : Type} [Fintype A] [Nonempty A]
    [Fintype U] [Nonempty U] (known : A) (entry : U) :
    eventMass (mixedHit known entry) =
      1 / (Fintype.card U : ℚ) +
        (1 / (Fintype.card A : ℚ)) * (1 - 1 / (Fintype.card U : ℚ)) := by
  unfold eventMass mixedHit
  rw [R0Z.LawTransport.mean_product]
  have inner (nonce : A) :
      mean (fun rest : {j : A // j ≠ known} → U =>
        if (LazyTable.splitAt known).symm (entry,rest) nonce = entry then (1 : ℚ) else 0) =
      if nonce = known then 1 else 1 / (Fintype.card U : ℚ) := by
    by_cases hn : nonce = known
    · subst nonce
      simp [LazyTable.splitAt,mean_const]
    · have uniform := QueryScanSharedHistoryMass.eval_point_mass
        (U := U) (⟨nonce,hn⟩ : {j : A // j ≠ known}) entry
      simpa [eventMass,LazyTable.splitAt,hn] using uniform
  simp only [inner]
  have shape (nonce : A) :
      (if nonce = known then (1 : ℚ) else 1 / (Fintype.card U : ℚ)) =
      (if nonce = known then (1 : ℚ) else 0) * (1 - 1 / (Fintype.card U : ℚ)) +
        1 / (Fintype.card U : ℚ) := by
    have algebra (p : ℚ) (h : Prop) [Decidable h] :
        (if h then 1 else p) = (if h then 1 else 0) * (1-p) + p := by
      split_ifs <;> ring
    exact algebra _ _
  simp_rw [shape]
  rw [R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mean_add'',R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mean_mul_const,mean_const]
  have pointmean : mean (fun nonce : A => if nonce = known then (1 : ℚ) else 0) =
      1 / (Fintype.card A : ℚ) := QueryScanSharedHistoryMass.point_mass known
  rw [pointmean]
  ring

/-- This counterexample survives even an ideal exact-uniform nonzero nonce.
No conditioning loss or exhausted draw is asserted to have disappeared. -/
theorem nonzero_memo_exceeds (known : NZ) (entry : OracleAnswer) :
    1 / (2 : ℚ)^256 < eventMass (mixedHit known entry) := by
  have h := mixed_memo_mass known entry
  have card : Fintype.card OracleAnswer = 2^256 := by
    have all : ∀ j : Fintype OracleAnswer, @Fintype.card OracleAnswer j = 2^256 := fun j =>
      (congrArg (@Fintype.card OracleAnswer) (Subsingleton.elim j _)).trans
        QueryScanSharedHistoryMass.answer_cardinality
    exact all _
  rw [card,Nat.cast_pow,Nat.cast_ofNat] at h
  rw [h]
  have hp : 0 < 1 / (Fintype.card NZ : ℚ) := by
    apply one_div_pos.mpr
    exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have hd : 0 < 1 - 1 / (2 : ℚ)^256 := by norm_num
  exact lt_add_of_pos_right _ (mul_pos hp hd)

attribute [-instance] allDecidable allDecEq
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

def countdownNext (secret : SecP) (remaining : Nat) : Except Unit Candidate × Nat :=
  if remaining = 0 then (.ok (fun i => (secret i).val),0)
  else (.ok (fun _ => 0),remaining-1)

96-byte candidate; arbitrary remaining fuel is retained. -/
theorem rejected_prefix_success (secret : SecP) (rejects fuel : Nat) :
    run (countdownNext secret) (rejects+fuel+1) rejects = (.ok secret,0) := by
  induction rejects with
  | zero =>
    simpa only [Nat.zero_add] using
      success (countdownNext secret) 0 0 secret fuel (by simp [countdownNext])
  | succ rejects ih =>
    have step : countdownNext secret (rejects+1) = (.ok (fun _ => 0),rejects) := by
      simp [countdownNext]
    simp only [run,step,decode_zero]
    rw [show rejects+1+fuel = rejects+fuel+1 by omega]
    exact ih

/-- All legal rejected-prefix lengths 0..15 still exhibit the exact missing
query-event containment at the native generator's successful return. -/
theorem retry_query_not_covered (secret : SecP) (seed : OracleAnswer)
    (rejects : Nat) (bound : rejects < 16) :
    generate (countdownNext secret) rejects = (.ok secret,0) ∧
      (secret 0).val ≠ 0 ∧
      reservationQueried [(reservationInput (secret 0).val,0)] (secret 0).val ∧
      ¬ ProverCommitSeedEvent19.seedGuess [(reservationInput (secret 0).val,0)] seed := by
  refine ⟨?_,(secret 0).property,queried_not_seedGuess (secret 0).val seed⟩
  unfold generate
  have fuel : 16 = rejects+(15-rejects)+1 := by omega
  rw [fuel]
  exact rejected_prefix_success secret rejects (15-rejects)

#print axioms mixed_memo_mass
#print axioms nonzero_memo_exceeds
#print axioms rejected_prefix_success
#print axioms retry_query_not_covered
end R1Z.ProverCommitReservationNonzero37

/-! Exact conditional ROM counterexample to charging reservation memo hits
only to the existing simulator-domain seed event. One prior query, one
entry chosen as its answer; the nonce is still independent uniform. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitReservationMemo37
open R0Z R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsGood R0Z.HvzkV
open ProverCommitReservationRom37
local instance (priority := 10000) allDecidable (p : Prop) : Decidable p :=
  Classical.propDecidable p
local instance (priority := 10000) allDecEq (U : Type) : DecidableEq U := Classical.decEq U

/-- After a prior query at `known` has answer `entry`, the other coordinates
remain uniform. This is a conditional ROM slice, not a constant hash model.
The adversary inserts exactly the learned answer in its initial ledger. -/
def memoHit {U : Type} (known entry : U)
    (r : U × ({j : U // j ≠ known} → U)) : Prop :=
  (LazyTable.splitAt known).symm (entry,r.2) r.1 = entry

theorem generic_memo_mass {U : Type} [Fintype U] [Nonempty U]
    (known entry : U) :
    eventMass (memoHit known entry) =
      2 * (1 / (Fintype.card U : ℚ)) - (1 / (Fintype.card U : ℚ))^2 := by
  classical
  unfold eventMass memoHit
  rw [R0Z.LawTransport.mean_product]
  have inner (nonce : U) :
      mean (fun rest : {j : U // j ≠ known} → U =>
        if (LazyTable.splitAt known).symm (entry,rest) nonce = entry then (1 : ℚ) else 0) =
      if nonce = known then 1 else 1 / (Fintype.card U : ℚ) := by
    by_cases hn : nonce = known
    · subst nonce
      simp [LazyTable.splitAt,mean_const]
    · have uniform := QueryScanSharedHistoryMass.eval_point_mass
        (U := U) (⟨nonce,hn⟩ : {j : U // j ≠ known}) entry
      simpa [eventMass,LazyTable.splitAt,hn] using uniform
  simp only [inner]
  have shape (nonce : U) :
      (if nonce = known then (1 : ℚ) else 1 / (Fintype.card U : ℚ)) =
      (if nonce = known then (1 : ℚ) else 0) * (1 - 1 / (Fintype.card U : ℚ)) +
        1 / (Fintype.card U : ℚ) := by
    have algebra (p : ℚ) (h : Prop) [Decidable h] :
        (if h then 1 else p) = (if h then 1 else 0) * (1-p) + p := by
      split_ifs <;> ring
    exact algebra _ _
  simp_rw [shape]
  rw [R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mean_add'',R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mean_mul_const,mean_const]
  have pointmean : mean (fun nonce : U => if nonce = known then (1 : ℚ) else 0) =
      1 / (Fintype.card U : ℚ) := QueryScanSharedHistoryMass.point_mass known
  rw [pointmean]
  ring

theorem conditional_memo_mass (known entry : OracleAnswer) :
    eventMass (memoHit known entry) =
      2 / (2 : ℚ)^256 - (1 / (2 : ℚ)^256)^2 := by
  have h := generic_memo_mass known entry
  have card : Fintype.card OracleAnswer = 2^256 := by
    have all : ∀ j : Fintype OracleAnswer, @Fintype.card OracleAnswer j = 2^256 := fun j =>
      (congrArg (@Fintype.card OracleAnswer) (Subsingleton.elim j _)).trans
        QueryScanSharedHistoryMass.answer_cardinality
    exact all _
  rw [card,Nat.cast_pow,Nat.cast_ofNat] at h
  rw [mul_one_div] at h
  exact h

/-- The single-entry 2^-256 bound fails when the memo-hit event is omitted.
The failure occurs before any rejection conditioning. -/
theorem memo_exceeds_fresh_bound (known entry : OracleAnswer) :
    1 / (2 : ℚ)^256 < eventMass (memoHit known entry) := by
  rw [conditional_memo_mass]
  have hp : 0 < 1 / (2 : ℚ)^256 := by positivity
  have hlt : 1 / (2 : ℚ)^256 < 1 := by norm_num
  rw [show 2 / (2 : ℚ)^256 = 2 * (1 / (2 : ℚ)^256) from (mul_one_div _ _).symm]
  generalize (1 / (2 : ℚ)^256) = p at *
  nlinarith

/-- The exact prior-query list in this ROM slice never triggers the old
simulator event, for any independent simulator seed. Nonzero filtering of
the nonce does not change this pointwise event disjointness. -/
theorem old_event_absent (known entry seed : OracleAnswer) :
    ¬ ProverCommitSeedEvent19.seedGuess [(reservationInput known,entry)] seed := by
  rintro ⟨q,member,point⟩
  have eq : q = (reservationInput known,entry) := by simpa using member
  subst q
  exact not_simulator_seedPoint known seed point

#print axioms generic_memo_mass
#print axioms conditional_memo_mass
#print axioms memo_exceeds_fresh_bound
#print axioms old_event_absent
end R1Z.ProverCommitReservationMemo37

import Mathlib.Data.List.Basic
/-! Single-thread semantics of one live thread-local key. Thread creation,
key destruction and thread exit are outside this runtime contract. The
platform implementing these semantics is an explicit P6 boundary. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitTLS23
variable {Thread Value Output : Type} [DecidableEq Thread]

/-- An access executes its closure on the current value and stores the
closure's resulting value. Output includes errors if the caller chooses. -/
abbrev Access (Value Output : Type) := Value → Value × Output

def native (thread : Thread) (f : Access Value Output) (store : Thread → Value) :
    (Thread → Value) × Output :=
  let result := f (store thread)
  ((fun current => if current = thread then result.1 else store current), result.2)

theorem access_simulates (thread : Thread) (f : Access Value Output)
    (store : Thread → Value) :
    ((native thread f store).1 thread, (native thread f store).2) = f (store thread) := by
  simp only [native,ite_true]

theorem access_frame (thread other : Thread) (different : other ≠ thread)
    (f : Access Value Output) (store : Thread → Value) :
    (native thread f store).1 other = store other := by
  simp only [native,if_neg different]

def nativeRun (store : Thread → Value) :
    List (Thread × Access Value Output) → (Thread → Value) × List Output
  | [] => (store,[])
  | (thread,f)::tail =>
    let step := native thread f store
    let rest := nativeRun step.1 tail
    (rest.1,step.2::rest.2)

def singleRun (value : Value) : List (Access Value Output) → Value × List Output
  | [] => (value,[])
  | f::tail =>
    let step := f value
    let rest := singleRun step.1 tail
    (rest.1,step.2::rest.2)

def SingleThreaded (thread : Thread) (schedule : List (Thread × Access Value Output)) : Prop :=
  ∀ entry ∈ schedule, entry.1 = thread

/-- Exact state and all outputs for any finite schedule of access closures.
The single-thread premise is visible; no native TLS implementation equation
is silently added. -/
theorem schedule_simulates (thread : Thread) (schedule : List (Thread × Access Value Output))
    (oneThread : SingleThreaded thread schedule) (store : Thread → Value) :
    ((nativeRun store schedule).1 thread, (nativeRun store schedule).2) =
      singleRun (store thread) (schedule.map Prod.snd) := by
  induction schedule generalizing store with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons entry tail ih =>
    rcases entry with ⟨current,f⟩
    have same := oneThread (current,f) (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    change current = thread at same
    subst current
    have rest := ih (fun e he => oneThread e (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ he))
      (native thread f store).1
    simp only [nativeRun,singleRun,List.map_cons]
    rw [show (native thread f store).1 thread = (f (store thread)).1 by
      simp only [native,ite_true]] at rest
    exact congrArg (fun p : Value × List Output => (p.1,(f (store thread)).2::p.2)) rest

/-- Last stored value is what the next read returns, for the same live key. -/
theorem read_after_store (thread : Thread) (store : Thread → Value) (value : Value) :
    (native thread (fun v => (v,v))
      (native thread (fun _ => (value,())) store).1).2 = value := by
  simp only [native,ite_true]

#print axioms access_simulates
#print axioms access_frame
#print axioms schedule_simulates
#print axioms read_after_store
end R1Z.ProverCommitTLS23

import R1Z.SideChannelL1AttemptRecord
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L1_NativeProducer
open R1Z R1Z.SideChannelL1AttemptRecord
open ProverCommitRetry34 (Step)

/-- The native retry owner has two distinct Result boundaries. The callback
error escapes `?`; only an error from the prover enters the retry match.
Each leaf supplies its complete ordered prefix and updated state. -/
abbrev Callback (S Secret : Type) := Nat → S →
  (List Event × Except Error Secret) × S
abbrev Prover (S Secret Proof : Type) := Secret → S →
  (List Event × Except Error Proof) × S

def classifyResult {Proof : Type} : Except Error Proof → Step Proof
  | .ok p => .done p
  | .error .Rejected => .retry
  | .error e => .stop e

def producer {S Secret Proof : Type} (callback : Callback S Secret)
    (prover : Prover S Secret Proof) : Owner S Proof := fun index state =>
  let ((before,out),after) := callback index state
  match out with
  | .error e => (⟨before,.stop e⟩,after)
  | .ok secret =>
    let ((suffix,result),final) := prover secret after
    (⟨before ++ suffix,classifyResult result⟩,final)

/-- Control interpretation of native retry_attempt, with its distinct callback
and prover arms. This definition retains all prefixes even when a later call
fails. Native leaf-event association is a separate, open obligation. -/
def native {S Secret Proof : Type} (callback : Callback S Secret)
    (prover : Prover S Secret Proof) : Nat → Nat → S → Run Proof × S
  | 0, _, s => (⟨[],.stop .AttemptsExhausted⟩,s)
  | fuel+1, index, s =>
    let ((before,out),after) := callback index s
    match out with
    | .error e => (⟨[⟨before,.stop e⟩],.stop e⟩,after)
    | .ok secret =>
      let ((suffix,result),final) := prover secret after
      let record : Attempt Proof := ⟨before ++ suffix,classifyResult result⟩
      match result with
      | .ok proof => (⟨[record],.done ⟨proof,index+1⟩⟩,final)
      | .error .Rejected =>
        let (rest,finish) := native callback prover fuel (index+1) final
        (⟨record::rest.attempts,rest.result⟩,finish)
      | .error e => (⟨[record],.stop e⟩,final)

theorem native_eq_model {S Secret Proof : Type} (callback : Callback S Secret)
    (prover : Prover S Secret Proof) (fuel index : Nat) (state : S) :
    native callback prover fuel index state =
      run (producer callback prover) fuel index state := by
  induction fuel generalizing index state with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ fuel ih =>
    simp only [native,run,producer]
    cases h : callback index state with
    | mk pair after =>
      rcases pair with ⟨before,out⟩
      simp only [h]
      cases out with
      | error e => rfl
      | ok secret =>
        cases hp : prover secret after with
        | mk pair final =>
          rcases pair with ⟨suffix,result⟩
          simp only [hp]
          cases result with
          | ok proof => rfl
          | error e =>
            cases e <;> simp only [classifyResult]
            all_goals first | rfl | rw [ih]
#print axioms native_eq_model
end PV_L1_NativeProducer

def scan {A : Type} : Nat → List (Option A) → Nat × Option A

theorem cap_zero {A : Type} (xs : List (Option A)) : scan 0 xs = (0, none) := rfl

def kind {A B : Type} : Option A × Option B → Nat

 | (some _, none) => 1
 | (some _, some _) => 2
def checks (kind : Nat) : Nat := if kind=0 then 1 else 2
def branches {A B : Type} : Nat → List (Option A × Option B) → List Nat
 | 0, _ => []
 | _+1, [] => []

#print axioms second_zero

#print axioms accepted_pair

    kind (p.1.map f,p.2.map g)=kind p := by
  rcases p with ⟨a,b⟩; cases a <;> cases b <;> rfl
#print axioms kind_relabel
theorem branches_relabel {A B C D : Type} (f : A → C) (g : B → D)

  induction n generalizing xs with
  | zero => rfl

    cases xs with

#print axioms first_skips_second

#print axioms second_checks_both

#print axioms success_checks_both

#print axioms full_comparison_count_relabel

-- IID path weights, not an axiom identifying SHA outputs with IID words.
def geom (q : ℚ) (r : Nat) : ℚ := q^r * (1-q)
def success (q : ℚ) : Nat → ℚ
  | 0 => 0
  | n+1 => (1-q)+q*success q n
def valueMass (q u : ℚ) : Nat → ℚ
  | 0 => 0
  | n+1 => u+q*valueMass q u n
def prefixMass (q u : ℚ) (r : Nat) : ℚ := q^r*u
theorem geometric_zero (q : ℚ) : geom q 0 = 1-q := by simp [geom]
#print axioms geometric_zero
theorem geometric_step (q : ℚ) (r : Nat) : geom q (r+1) = q*geom q r := by simp [geom,pow_succ]; ring
#print axioms geometric_step
theorem success_zero (q : ℚ) : success q 0 = 0 := rfl
#print axioms success_zero
theorem success_closed (q : ℚ) (n : Nat) : success q n = 1-q^n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [success]
  | succ n ih => rw [success, ih, pow_succ]; ring
#print axioms success_closed
theorem total_capped (q : ℚ) (n : Nat) : success q n + q^n = 1 := by rw [success_closed]; ring
#print axioms total_capped
theorem value_factor (q u : ℚ) (n : Nat) (p : ℚ) (h : u*p=1-q) : valueMass q u n * p = success q n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [valueMass,success]
  | succ n ih => simp only [valueMass,success]; calc
      (u+q*valueMass q u n)*p = u*p+q*(valueMass q u n*p) := by ring
      _ = (1-q)+q*success q n := by rw [h,ih]
#print axioms value_factor
theorem uniform_on_success (q u p : ℚ) (n : Nat) (hp : p ≠ 0) (h : u*p=1-q) : valueMass q u n = success q n / p := by
  apply (eq_div_iff hp).2; exact value_factor q u n p h
#print axioms uniform_on_success
theorem prefix_independent (q u p : ℚ) (r : Nat) (h : u*p=1-q) : prefixMass q u r * p = geom q r := by
  unfold prefixMass geom; calc q^r*u*p = q^r*(u*p) := by ring
  _ = q^r*(1-q) := by rw [h]
#print axioms prefix_independent
theorem prefix_uniform (q u p : ℚ) (r : Nat) (hp : p ≠ 0) (h : u*p=1-q) : prefixMass q u r = geom q r / p := by
  apply (eq_div_iff hp).2; exact prefix_independent q u p r h
#print axioms prefix_uniform

#print axioms scalar_normalization

  prefix_independent _ _ _ _ (scalar_normalization p hp)
#print axioms scalar_trace_law

  rw [uniform_on_success _ _ _ _ hp (scalar_normalization p hp1), success_closed]
#print axioms scalar_uniform
theorem scalar_prefix_product (p : ℚ) (hp : p ≠ 0) (hp1 : p+1 ≠ 0) (r : Nat) : prefixMass (1/(p+1)) (1/(p+1)) r = geom (1/(p+1)) r * (1/p) := by
  rw [prefix_uniform _ _ _ _ hp (scalar_normalization p hp1)]; ring
#print axioms scalar_prefix_product

#print axioms entropy_reject_partition
theorem entropy_accept_partition (z : ℚ) : z+(1-z)*z+(1-z)^2=1 := by ring
#print axioms entropy_accept_partition
theorem entropy_pair_normalization (b : ℚ) (hb : b ≠ 0) : (1/b^2)*(b-1)^2 = 1-(1-(1-1/b)^2) := by field_simp; ring
#print axioms entropy_pair_normalization

  valueMass (1-(1-1/b)^2) (1/b^2) n = success (1-(1-1/b)^2) n / (b-1)^2 :=

  prefix_uniform _ _ _ _ hn (entropy_pair_normalization b hb)

/-! State-preserving adapters for the pinned borrow-back and env-J callback
representations. In particular the returned state is the result of applying
the borrow-back function, not the original callback environment. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.BuilderForestCallbackAdapter
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

def borrowToPair {S A : Type}
    (call : S → A → Result (S × (S → S))) (state : S) (arg : A) :
    Result (Unit × S) := do
  let (next, back) ← call state arg
  ok ((), back next)

def stateToPair {S A : Type} (call : S → A → Result S)
    (state : S) (arg : A) : Result (Unit × S) := do
  let next ← call state arg
  ok ((), next)

def pairToState {S A : Type} (call : S → A → Result (Unit × S))
    (state : S) (arg : A) : Result S := do
  let (_, next) ← call state arg
  ok next

theorem state_roundtrip {S A : Type} (call : S → A → Result S)
    (state : S) (arg : A) :
    pairToState (stateToPair call) state arg = call state arg := by
  cases h : call state arg <;> simp [pairToState, stateToPair, h]

theorem pair_roundtrip {S A : Type} (call : S → A → Result (Unit × S))
    (state : S) (arg : A) :
    stateToPair (pairToState call) state arg = call state arg := by
  cases h : call state arg with
  | ok p => rcases p with ⟨u, next⟩; cases u; simp [stateToPair, pairToState, h]
  | fail e => simp [stateToPair, pairToState, h]
  | div => simp [stateToPair, pairToState, h]

theorem borrow_success {S A : Type}
    (call : S → A → Result (S × (S → S))) (state next : S) (arg : A)
    (back : S → S) (h : call state arg = ok (next, back)) :
    borrowToPair call state arg = ok ((), back next) := by
  simp [borrowToPair, h]

while threading the updated callback, even if a returned environment carries
a different index. -/
theorem indexed_borrow {S I : Type} (next : S) (captured returned : I) :
    (fun c : S × I => (c.1, captured)) (next, returned) = (next, captured) := rfl

/-- Tuple adaptation changes only argument packaging, with no oracle call
duplication and no choice of a callback result. -/
theorem uncurry_call {A B C : Type} (call : A → B → Result C) (a : A) (b : B) :
    (fun p : A × B => call p.1 p.2) (a, b) = call a b := rfl
