/-! Executable std adapters for the forest extraction. Iterator operations
preserve error order and short-circuit state. These definitions replace std
externals only, not the three opaque Aspis declarations. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.BuilderForestStd
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
variable {T U E V C I A B : Type}

abbrev IntoIter (T : Type) (_n : Std.Usize) := List T
def intoIter {n : Std.Usize} (a : Array T n) : Result (IntoIter T n) := ok a.val
def arrayNext {n : Std.Usize} (it : IntoIter T n) : Result (Option T × IntoIter T n) :=
  match it with
  | [] => ok (none,[])
  | x::xs => ok (some x,xs)

structure Flatten (I A B U : Type) where
  outer : I
  inner : Option U

def flatten (it : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator I A)
    (conv : core.iter.traits.collect.IntoIterator A B U) (i : I) :
    Result (Flatten I A B U) := ok ⟨i,none⟩

def flattenNext (it : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator I A)
    (conv : core.iter.traits.collect.IntoIterator A B U)
    (innerIt : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator U B) (s : Flatten I A B U) :
    Result (Option B × Flatten I A B U) := do
  match s.inner with
  | some u =>
    let (x,u') ← innerIt.next u
    match x with
    | some b => ok (some b,⟨s.outer,some u'⟩)
    | none => flattenNext it conv innerIt ⟨s.outer,none⟩
  | none =>
    let (x,i') ← it.next s.outer
    match x with
    | none => ok (none,⟨i',none⟩)
    | some a =>
      let u ← conv.into_iter a
      flattenNext it conv innerIt ⟨i',some u⟩
partial_fixpoint

def iterAny (it : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator I A)
    (f : core.ops.function.FnMut C A Bool) (i : I) (c : C) : Result (Bool × I) := do
  let (x,i') ← it.next i
  match x with
  | none => ok (false,i')
  | some x =>
    let (b,c') ← f.call_mut c x
    if b then ok (true,i') else iterAny it f i' c'
partial_fixpoint

def sumDefault (it : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator I A)
    (sum : core.iter.traits.accum.Sum B A) (i : I) : Result B := sum.sum it i

def sumLoop (it : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator I Std.U64)
    (i : I) (acc : Std.U64) : Result Std.U64 := do
  let (x,i') ← it.next i
  match x with
  | none => ok acc
  | some x =>
    let acc' ← acc + x
    sumLoop it i' acc'
partial_fixpoint

def sum64 (it : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator I Std.U64) (i : I) := sumLoop it i 0#u64

def mapLoop (f : core.ops.function.FnMut C T U) : List T → C → Result (List U × C)
  | [], c => ok ([],c)
  | x::xs, c => do
    let (y,c') ← f.call_mut c x
    let (ys,c'') ← mapLoop f xs c'
    ok (y::ys,c'')

def arrayMap {n : Std.Usize} (f : core.ops.function.FnMut C T U)
    (a : Array T n) (c : C) : Result (Array U n) := do
  let (ys,_) ← mapLoop f a.val c
  if h : ys.length = n.val then ok ⟨ys,h⟩ else .fail .panic

def okOr (o : Option T) (e : E) : Result (core.result.Result T E) :=
  ok (match o with | none => .Err e | some x => .Ok x)
def branch (o : Option T) : Result (core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow
    (Option core.convert.Infallible) T) :=
  ok (match o with | none => .Break none | some x => .Continue x)
def residual (T : Type) (o : Option core.convert.Infallible) : Result (Option T) :=
  match o with | none => ok none | some i => nomatch i

def mapResult (f : core.ops.function.FnOnce C T U)
    (r : core.result.Result T E) (c : C) : Result (core.result.Result U E) :=
  match r with
  | .Err e => ok (.Err e)
  | .Ok x => do let y ← f.call_once c x; ok (.Ok y)

structure Chunks (T : Type) where
  remaining : Slice T
  size : Nat

def chunks (s : Slice T) (n : Std.Usize) : Result (Chunks T) :=
  if n.val = 0 then .fail .panic else ok ⟨s,n.val⟩

def chunksNext (s : Chunks T) : Result (Option (Slice T) × Chunks T) :=
  if s.remaining.val.isEmpty then ok (none,s)
  else
    let head : Slice T := ⟨s.remaining.val.take s.size,
      by have := s.remaining.property; simp only [List.length_take]; omega⟩
    let tail : Slice T := ⟨s.remaining.val.drop s.size,
      by have := s.remaining.property; simp only [List.length_drop]; omega⟩
    ok (some head,⟨tail,s.size⟩)

theorem intoIter_spec {n : Std.Usize} (a : Array T n) : intoIter a = ok a.val := rfl
theorem arrayNext_nil {n : Std.Usize} : arrayNext (n := n) ([] : List T) = ok (none,[]) := rfl
theorem arrayNext_cons {n : Std.Usize} (x : T) (xs : List T) :
    arrayNext (n := n) (x::xs) = ok (some x,xs) := rfl

theorem flatten_spec (it : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator I A)
    (conv : core.iter.traits.collect.IntoIterator A B U) (i : I) :
    flatten it conv i = ok ⟨i,none⟩ := rfl

theorem flattenNext_yield (it : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator I A)
    (conv : core.iter.traits.collect.IntoIterator A B U)
    (innerIt : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator U B) (i : I) (u u' : U) (b : B)
    (h : innerIt.next u = ok (some b,u')) :
    flattenNext it conv innerIt ⟨i,some u⟩ = ok (some b,⟨i,some u'⟩) := by
  rw [flattenNext]
  dsimp only [Flatten.inner, Flatten.outer]
  rw [h]; rfl

theorem flattenNext_skip (it : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator I A)
    (conv : core.iter.traits.collect.IntoIterator A B U)
    (innerIt : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator U B) (i : I) (u u' : U)
    (h : innerIt.next u = ok (none,u')) :
    flattenNext it conv innerIt ⟨i,some u⟩ = flattenNext it conv innerIt ⟨i,none⟩ := by
  rw [flattenNext]
  dsimp only [Flatten.inner, Flatten.outer]
  rw [h]; rfl

theorem flattenNext_done (it : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator I A)
    (conv : core.iter.traits.collect.IntoIterator A B U)
    (innerIt : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator U B) (i i' : I)
    (h : it.next i = ok (none,i')) :
    flattenNext it conv innerIt ⟨i,none⟩ = ok (none,⟨i',none⟩) := by
  rw [flattenNext]
  dsimp only [Flatten.inner, Flatten.outer]
  rw [h]; rfl

theorem flattenNext_open (it : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator I A)
    (conv : core.iter.traits.collect.IntoIterator A B U)
    (innerIt : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator U B) (i i' : I) (a : A) (u : U)
    (h : it.next i = ok (some a,i')) (hc : conv.into_iter a = ok u) :
    flattenNext it conv innerIt ⟨i,none⟩ = flattenNext it conv innerIt ⟨i',some u⟩ := by
  rw [flattenNext,h]; simp only [bind_tc_ok]; rw [hc]; rfl

theorem any_done (it : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator I A)
    (f : core.ops.function.FnMut C A Bool) (i i' : I) (c : C)
    (h : it.next i = ok (none,i')) : iterAny it f i c = ok (false,i') := by
  rw [iterAny,h]; rfl

theorem any_stop (it : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator I A)
    (f : core.ops.function.FnMut C A Bool) (i i' : I) (c c' : C) (a : A)
    (h : it.next i = ok (some a,i')) (hf : f.call_mut c a = ok (true,c')) :
    iterAny it f i c = ok (true,i') := by
  rw [iterAny,h]; simp only [bind_tc_ok]; rw [hf]; rfl

theorem any_continue (it : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator I A)
    (f : core.ops.function.FnMut C A Bool) (i i' : I) (c c' : C) (a : A)
    (h : it.next i = ok (some a,i')) (hf : f.call_mut c a = ok (false,c')) :
    iterAny it f i c = iterAny it f i' c' := by
  rw [iterAny,h]; simp only [bind_tc_ok]; rw [hf]; rfl

theorem sumDefault_spec (it : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator I A)
    (sum : core.iter.traits.accum.Sum B A) (i : I) : sumDefault it sum i = sum.sum it i := rfl

theorem sum_done (it : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator I Std.U64)
    (i i' : I) (acc : Std.U64) (h : it.next i = ok (none,i')) :
    sumLoop it i acc = ok acc := by rw [sumLoop,h]; rfl

theorem sum_step (it : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator I Std.U64)
    (i i' : I) (acc x acc' : Std.U64) (h : it.next i = ok (some x,i'))
    (ha : acc + x = ok acc') : sumLoop it i acc = sumLoop it i' acc' := by
  rw [sumLoop,h]; simp only [bind_tc_ok]; rw [ha]; rfl

theorem mapLoop_pure (f : core.ops.function.FnMut C T U) (g : T → U)
    (hf : ∀ c x, f.call_mut c x = ok (g x,c)) (xs : List T) (c : C) :
    mapLoop f xs c = ok (xs.map g,c) := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih => simp [mapLoop,hf,ih]

theorem arrayMap_pure {n : Std.Usize} (f : core.ops.function.FnMut C T U)
    (g : T → U) (hf : ∀ c x, f.call_mut c x = ok (g x,c)) (a : Array T n) (c : C) :
    arrayMap f a c = ok ⟨a.val.map g, by simp [a.property]⟩ := by
  simp [arrayMap,mapLoop_pure f g hf,a.property]

theorem okOr_none (e : E) : okOr (none : Option T) e = ok (.Err e) := rfl
theorem okOr_some (x : T) (e : E) : okOr (some x) e = ok (.Ok x) := rfl
theorem branch_none : branch (none : Option T) = ok (.Break none) := rfl
theorem branch_some (x : T) : branch (some x) = ok (.Continue x) := rfl
theorem residual_none : residual T none = ok none := rfl

theorem mapResult_err (f : core.ops.function.FnOnce C T U) (e : E) (c : C) :
    mapResult f (.Err e) c = ok (.Err e) := rfl
theorem mapResult_ok (f : core.ops.function.FnOnce C T U) (x : T) (c : C) :
    mapResult f (.Ok x : core.result.Result T E) c =
      (do let y ← f.call_once c x; ok (.Ok y)) := rfl

theorem chunks_zero (s : Slice T) : chunks s 0#usize = .fail .panic := by
  simp [chunks]
theorem chunks_positive (s : Slice T) (n : Std.Usize) (hn : n.val ≠ 0) :
    chunks s n = ok ⟨s,n.val⟩ := by simp [chunks,hn]
theorem chunksNext_empty (s : Chunks T) (h : s.remaining.val.isEmpty = true) :
    chunksNext s = ok (none,s) := by simp [chunksNext,h]

theorem chunksNext_content (s : Chunks T) (h : s.remaining.val.isEmpty = false) :
    ∃ head tail, chunksNext s = ok (some head,tail) ∧
      head.val = s.remaining.val.take s.size ∧
      tail.remaining.val = s.remaining.val.drop s.size ∧ tail.size = s.size := by
  simp only [chunksNext,h,Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte]
  exact ⟨_,_,rfl,rfl,rfl,rfl⟩

#print axioms intoIter_spec
#print axioms arrayNext_nil

#print axioms flattenNext_done

#print axioms sum_done

#print axioms mapLoop_pure
#print axioms arrayMap_pure
#print axioms okOr_none
#print axioms okOr_some
#print axioms branch_none
#print axioms branch_some
#print axioms residual_none
#print axioms mapResult_err

/- Namespace port of BuilderAuxContent: same symbolic proof, actual forest extraction. -/
import R1Z.PV_Src_Forest_DigestTotal
import R1Z.PV_Src_Forest_PartsContent

/-! Complete auxiliary Parts content, for both transfer and withdrawal.
The change digest and occupancy inverse are derived from actual callees. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_Src_Forest_AuxContent
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0Z.WriterRefine
open PV_Src_Forest_PrimitiveArguments PV_Src_Forest_DigestArguments BuilderRecordsFields
open BuilderForestAdmissionPort.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder

theorem note_digest (w : RW) (p : RP) (h : Usize) :
    note_digest_r w p h = noteDigestR (chunksOf (wordWitness w) (wordPublic p)) h.val := by
  simp only [note_digest_r,noteDigestR,pre_state,chunk,chunk_len w p,bind_tc_ok,sponge_digest]

theorem change_digest (w : RW) (p : RP) : change_dr w p = changeDR (wordWitness w) (wordPublic p) := by
  rw [change_dr,note_digest];rfl

theorem recipient_digest (w : RW) (p : RP) : recip_dr w p = recipDR (wordWitness w) (wordPublic p) := by
  rw [recip_dr,note_digest];rfl

theorem input_digest (w : RW) (p : RP) : input_leaf_r w p = inputLeafR (wordWitness w) (wordPublic p) := by
  rw [input_leaf_r,note_digest];rfl

theorem output_record (w : RW) (p : RP) :
    ∃ out, out_rec w p = ok out ∧
      PV_Src_Forest_PrimitiveWriters.occRecord out = outRec (wordWitness w) (wordPublic p) := by
  cases hp : p.transfer with
  | false =>
    refine ⟨⟨0#u32,0#u32,ZERO8,0#u32,false⟩,?_,?_⟩
    · rw [out_rec,hp];rfl
    · simp only [outRec,wordPublic,hp,Bool.false_eq_true,if_false,
        PV_Src_Forest_PrimitiveWriters.occRecord,zero_digest]
  | true =>
    obtain ⟨d,hd⟩ := PV_Src_Forest_DigestTotal.note_total (chunksOf (wordWitness w) (wordPublic p)) 32
    have hc : changeDR (wordWitness w) (wordPublic p) = ok d := hd
    refine ⟨⟨1#u32,invR d.val[7]!,d,0#u32,false⟩,?_,?_⟩
    · rw [out_rec,hp]
      simp only [if_true,change_digest,hc,bind_tc_ok]
      rw [index_ok d 7#usize (by decide)]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok,PV_Src_Forest_InverseResult.inverse,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
    · have hv : (wordPublic p).variant = .privateTransfer := by simp [wordPublic,hp]
      simp only [outRec,hv,hc,okOr_ok,PV_Src_Forest_PrimitiveWriters.occRecord]

theorem aux_callee (w : RW) (p : RP) :
    (do let i ← in_rec w
        let o ← out_rec w p
        BuilderForestAdmissionPort.aspis_r0_writer_copies.write_aux_block
          (Array.make 3#usize [w.input_value,w.output_value,w.change_value]) i o) =
      auxR (wordWitness w) (wordPublic p) := by
  obtain ⟨out,ho,hmodel⟩ := output_record w p
  rw [in_record,ho]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok,PV_Src_Forest_PrimitiveWriters.write_aux_block]
  rw [input_correspondence,hmodel]
  rfl

theorem parts_aux (w : RW) (p : RP) (pt : Parts) (h : parts w p = ok pt) :
    auxR (wordWitness w) (wordPublic p) = ok pt.aux := by
  unfold parts at h
  obtain ⟨m,_,h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  obtain ⟨blocks,_,h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  obtain ⟨⟨cur,l,r⟩,_,h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  obtain ⟨path,_,h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  rw [← aux_callee]
  obtain ⟨i,hi,h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  obtain ⟨o,ho,h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  obtain ⟨aux,ha,h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  have he := congrArg Parts.aux (Result.ok.inj h)
  rw [hi,ho]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [ha]
  exact congrArg Result.ok he

theorem parts_aux_content (w : RW) (p : RP) (pt : Parts) (h : parts w p = ok pt) :
    pt.aux = okOr (auxR (wordWitness w) (wordPublic p)) (Array.repeat 256#usize 0#u32) := by
  rw [parts_aux w p pt h,okOr_ok]

#print axioms note_digest
#print axioms change_digest
#print axioms recipient_digest
#print axioms input_digest
#print axioms output_record
#print axioms aux_callee
#print axioms parts_aux
#print axioms parts_aux_content
end R1Z.PV_Src_Forest_AuxContent
R1Z.PV_Src_Forest_DigestTotal:
/- Namespace port of BuilderDigestTotal: same symbolic proof, actual forest extraction. -/
import R1Z.PV_Src_Forest_DigestArguments

/-! Totality of canonical digest primitives for arbitrary raw words. This
uses symbolic finite-field refinement, not evaluation of a permutation. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PV_Src_Forest_DigestTotal
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0Z.WriterRefine

theorem bind_total {A B : Type} (x : Result A) (f : A → Result B)
    (hx : ∃ a, x = ok a) (hf : ∀ a, ∃ b, f a = ok b) :
    ∃ b, (do let a ← x; f a) = ok b := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := hf a
  exact ⟨b,by rw [ha];simpa only [bind_tc_ok] using hb⟩

theorem perm_total (pre ab : Array U32 16#usize) :
    ∃ rounds, R0PoseidonCopy.perm_rounds pre ab = ok rounds := by
  let B : R0Z.BuilderModel.BlockIn (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) :=
    ⟨fun i => liftU pre.val[i.val]!,fun i => liftU ab.val[i.val]!⟩
  obtain ⟨rounds,hr,_⟩ := R0Z.PoseidonRefine.perm_rounds_lift pre ab B
    (by constructor <;> intro i <;> rfl)
  exact ⟨rounds,hr⟩

theorem block_total (pre ab : Array U32 16#usize) : ∃ d, blockDigestR pre ab = ok d := by
  obtain ⟨rounds,hr⟩ := perm_total pre ab
  exact ⟨_,by rw [blockDigestR,hr];rfl⟩

theorem sponge_total (pre : Array U32 16#usize) (chunk : Array U32 8#usize) (len : Usize) :
    ∃ d, spongeDigestR pre chunk len = ok d := by
  unfold spongeDigestR
  apply bind_total
  · obtain ⟨ab,ha,_⟩ := sponge_absorb_spec chunk len;exact ⟨ab,ha⟩
  · intro ab;exact block_total pre ab

theorem step_total (pre : Array U32 16#usize) (chunk : Array U32 8#usize) (len : Usize) :
    ∃ s, spongeStep pre chunk len = ok s := by
  obtain ⟨ab,ha,_⟩ := sponge_absorb_spec chunk len
  obtain ⟨rounds,hr⟩ := perm_total pre ab
  exact ⟨_,by rw [spongeStep,ha];simp only [bind_tc_ok];rw [hr];rfl⟩

theorem init_total (tag len : U32) : ∃ s, R0BlockCopies.sponge_init tag len = ok s := by
  obtain ⟨s,hs,_⟩ := sponge_init_spec tag len
  exact ⟨s,hs⟩

theorem pre_total (R : RustChunks) (h : Nat) : ∃ s, spongePre R h = ok s := by
  unfold spongePre
  split <;>
    repeat first
      | exact init_total _ _
      | exact step_total _ _ _
      | apply bind_total
      | intro s
      | exact ⟨_,rfl⟩

theorem note_total (R : RustChunks) (h : Nat) : ∃ d, noteDigestR R h = ok d := by
  unfold noteDigestR
  apply bind_total _ _ (pre_total R h)
  intro s;exact sponge_total s _ _

#print axioms bind_total
#print axioms perm_total
#print axioms block_total
#print axioms sponge_total
#print axioms step_total
#print axioms init_total
#print axioms pre_total
#print axioms note_total
end R1Z.PV_Src_Forest_DigestTotal
R1Z.PV_Src_Forest_DigestArguments:
/- Namespace port of BuilderDigestArguments: same symbolic proof, actual forest extraction. -/
import R1Z.PV_Src_Forest_PrimitiveDigests
import R1Z.BuilderStdArray
import R1Z.BuilderRecordsArray

/-! Actual primitive digest and note-chunk arguments. These are complete
Result identities; no semantic admission or digest equality is assumed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_Src_Forest_DigestArguments
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0Z.WriterRefine PV_Src_Forest_PrimitiveArguments
open BuilderForestAdmissionPort.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder

 theorem from_fn_nat {C T : Type} (n : Usize)
    (f : core.ops.function.FnMut C Usize T) (c : C) (g : Nat → T)
    (hf : ∀ i, i.val < n.val → f.call_mut c i = ok (g i.val,c)) :
    BuilderForestStdPort.core.array.from_fn n f c =
      ok (BuilderRecordsArray.tabulate n g) := by
  rw [BuilderForestStdPort.core.array.from_fn,
    BuilderStdModels.fromFn_bounded n f (fun i => g i.val) c hf]
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [BuilderStdModels.indices,BuilderRecordsArray.tabulate,Array.make,List.map_ofFn]
  congr 1

theorem digest8_eq (s : Array U32 16#usize) :
    BuilderForestAdmissionPort.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.digest8 s = ok (R0Z.WriterRefine.digest8 s) := by
  unfold BuilderForestAdmissionPort.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.digest8
  have hf : ∀ i : Usize, i.val < 8 →
      digest8.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeU32.call_mut s i = ok (s.val[i.val]!,s) := by
    intro i hi
    rw [digest8.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeU32.call_mut,
      index_ok s i (by simp; omega)]
    rfl
  rw [from_fn_nat 8#usize digest8.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeU32 s (fun i => s.val[i]!) hf]
  rfl

theorem note_c3 (salt : Array U32 8#usize) : note_c3r salt = ok (noteC3R salt) := by
  unfold note_c3r
  let g : Nat → U32 := fun j => if j=0 then salt.val[6]! else if j=1 then salt.val[7]! else 0#u32
  have hf : ∀ i : Usize, i.val < 8 →
      note_c3r.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeU32.call_mut salt i = ok (g i.val,salt) := by
    intro i hi
    rw [note_c3r.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeU32.call_mut]
    by_cases h0 : i = 0#usize
    · rw [if_pos h0,index_ok salt 6#usize (by decide)]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok,g,h0,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq,if_true]
    · rw [if_neg h0]
      by_cases h1 : i = 1#usize
      · rw [if_pos h1,index_ok salt 7#usize (by decide)]
        simp [g,h1] <;> rfl
      · rw [if_neg h1]
        have h0' : i.val ≠ 0 := by intro h;apply h0;apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq;simpa using h
        have h1' : i.val ≠ 1 := by intro h;apply h1;apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq;simpa using h
        simp [g,h0',h1']
  rw [from_fn_nat 8#usize note_c3r.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeU32 salt g hf]
  rfl

theorem note_c2 (value asset : U32) (salt : Array U32 8#usize) :
    note_c2r value asset salt = ok (noteC2R value asset salt) := by
  unfold note_c2r
  let g : Nat → U32 := fun j => if j=0 then value else if j=1 then asset else salt.val[j-2]!
  have hf : ∀ i : Usize, i.val < 8 →
      note_c2r.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeU32.call_mut (value,asset,salt) i =
        ok (g i.val,(value,asset,salt)) := by
    intro i hi
    rw [note_c2r.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeU32.call_mut]
    by_cases h0 : i = 0#usize
    · rw [if_pos h0];simp [g,h0] <;> rfl
    · rw [if_neg h0]
      by_cases h1 : i = 1#usize
      · rw [if_pos h1];simp [g,h1] <;> rfl
      · rw [if_neg h1]
        have h0' : i.val ≠ 0 := by intro h;apply h0;apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq;simpa using h
        have h1' : i.val ≠ 1 := by intro h;apply h1;apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq;simpa using h
        have hv : (Usize.wrapping_sub i 2#usize).val = i.val-2 := by
          rw [R0Z.WriterRefine.usub _ _ (by simp; omega)] <;> rfl
        simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok]
        rw [index_ok salt _ (by rw [hv];simp;omega)]
        simp [g,h0',h1',hv] <;> rfl
  rw [from_fn_nat 8#usize note_c2r.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeU32 (value,asset,salt) g hf]
  rfl

theorem perm_eq (pre ab : Array U32 16#usize) :
    perm pre ab = R0PoseidonCopy.perm_rounds pre ab := by
  rw [perm,PV_Src_Forest_PrimitiveDigests.poseidon_perm_rounds]

theorem block_digest (pre ab : Array U32 16#usize) :
    block_digest_r pre ab = blockDigestR pre ab := by
  unfold block_digest_r blockDigestR
  rw [perm_eq]
  congr 1
  funext rounds
  rw [index_ok_gen rounds 10#usize (by decide)]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok,digest8_eq,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]

theorem sponge_digest (pre : Array U32 16#usize) (chunk : Array U32 8#usize) (len : Usize) :
    sponge_digest_r pre chunk len = spongeDigestR pre chunk len := by
  simp only [sponge_digest_r,spongeDigestR,PV_Src_Forest_PrimitiveDigests.block_sponge_absorb,block_digest]

theorem node_digest (left right : Array U32 8#usize) :
    node_digest_r left right = nodeDigestR left right := by
  simp only [node_digest_r,nodeDigestR,PV_Src_Forest_PrimitiveDigests.block_node_pre,
    PV_Src_Forest_PrimitiveDigests.block_node_absorb,block_digest]

theorem sponge_step_eq (pre : Array U32 16#usize) (chunk : Array U32 8#usize) (len : Usize) :
    sponge_step pre chunk len = spongeStep pre chunk len := by
  unfold sponge_step spongeStep
  rw [PV_Src_Forest_PrimitiveDigests.block_sponge_absorb]
  congr 1
  funext ab
  rw [perm_eq]
  congr 1
  funext rounds
  rw [index_ok_gen rounds 10#usize (by decide)]
  rfl

theorem owner (w : RW) : owner_d w = ownerD (wordWitness w) := by
  simp only [owner_d,ownerD,init_owner,initOwner,PV_Src_Forest_PrimitiveDigests.block_sponge_init,
    sponge_digest,wordWitness]

theorem scalar_eq (a b : Usize) : a = b ↔ a.val = b.val :=
  ⟨congrArg UScalar.val,UScalar.eq_of_val_eq⟩

theorem owner_success (w : RW) : ∃ d, ownerD (wordWitness w) = ok d := by
  obtain ⟨d,hd,_,_⟩ := owner_lift (K := ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) (wordWitness w)
  exact ⟨d,hd⟩

theorem ok_ite {T : Type} (condition : Prop) [Decidable condition] (a b : T) :
    (ok (if condition then a else b) : Result T) = if condition then ok a else ok b := by
  split_ifs <;> rfl

theorem chunk (w : RW) (p : RP) (h : Usize) :
    schunk w p h = ok ((chunksOf (wordWitness w) (wordPublic p)).schunk h.val) := by
  obtain ⟨d,hd⟩ := owner_success w
  rw [schunk]
  simp only [owner,hd,note_c2,note_c3,PV_Src_Forest_PrimitiveArguments.zero_digest]

/-! Apply the checked symbolic exponentiation invariant at the shipped
exponent. Large powers remain symbolic through the scalar word conversion. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_Src_Forest_InverseResult
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0Z.WriterRefine
open BuilderForestAdmissionPort.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder

theorem inverse (x : U32) : inv_r x = ok (invR x) := by
  have hc : (UScalar.cast .U64 x).val = x.val := by
    rw [UScalar.cast_val_eq]
    apply Nat.mod_eq_of_lt
    have hx : x.val < 2^32 := x.hBounds
    simp only [UScalarTy.numBits]
    omega
  obtain ⟨b,hb,hbv⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (UScalar.rem_spec (UScalar.cast .U64 x)
    (y := 2147483647#u64) (by decide))
  have hbv' : b.val = x.val % 2147483647 := by simpa only [hc,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] using hbv
  obtain ⟨out,hout,ho,hval⟩ := PV_Src_Forest_Inverse.loop
    b 2147483645#u64 1#u64 (by rw [hbv']; exact Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)) (by decide)
  have ho' : out.val < 2147483647 := ho
  have hfield : (out.val : ZMod 2147483647) = (b.val : ZMod 2147483647)^2147483645 := by
    have hv : (out.val : ZMod 2147483647) = (1 : ZMod 2147483647) * (b.val : ZMod 2147483647)^2147483645 := hval
    simpa only [one_mul] using hv
  have houtval := PV_Src_Forest_Inverse.field_power_value b out x.val 2147483645 hbv' ho' hfield
  have hword : UScalar.cast .U32 out = invR x := by
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact PV_Src_Forest_Inverse.cast_word_value out (x.val^2147483645) houtval
  unfold inv_r
  simp only [BuilderForestAdmissionPort.aspis_core.field.P,lift,bind_tc_ok]
  change (do let b ← (UScalar.cast .U64 x % 2147483647#u64 : Result U64)
             let out ← inv_r_loop b 2147483645#u64 1#u64
             ok (UScalar.cast .U32 out)) = _
  rw [hb]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [hout]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok,hword]

R1Z.PV_Src_Forest_Inverse:
/- Namespace port of BuilderInverse: same symbolic proof, actual forest extraction. -/
import R1Z.PV_Src_Forest_PrimitiveArguments

/-! Symbolic modular exponentiation for the actual extracted occupancy
inverse. No evaluation of the concrete exponent or digest is used. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_Src_Forest_Inverse
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open BuilderForestAdmissionPort.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder

theorem shift_one (e : U64) : (U64.wrapping_shr e 1#u32).val = e.val / 2 := by
  change (e.bv.ushiftRight _).toNat = _
  simp [BitVec.toNat_ushiftRight, Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]

theorem bit_one (e : U64) : (e &&& 1#u64).val = e.val % 2 := by
  simp only [UScalar.val_and,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq,Nat.and_one_is_mod]

theorem multiply_mod (m : U32) (hm : 1 < m.val) (a b : U64)
    (ha : a.val < m.val) (hb : b.val < m.val) :
    ∃ c, (U64.wrapping_mul a b % UScalar.cast .U64 m : Result U64) = ok c ∧
      c.val < m.val ∧ (c.val : ZMod m.val) = (a.val : ZMod m.val) * (b.val : ZMod m.val) := by
  have hm32 : m.val < 2^32 := m.hBounds
  have hab : a.val * b.val < 2^64 := by nlinarith
  have hmcast : (UScalar.cast .U64 m).val = m.val := by
    rw [UScalar.cast_val_eq]
    apply Nat.mod_eq_of_lt
    simpa using (show m.val < 2^64 by omega)
  obtain ⟨c,hc,hv⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (UScalar.rem_spec (U64.wrapping_mul a b)
    (y := UScalar.cast .U64 m) (by rw [hmcast]; omega))
  have hmul : (U64.wrapping_mul a b).val = a.val*b.val := by
    rw [U64.wrapping_mul_val_eq]
    apply Nat.mod_eq_of_lt
    simpa [UScalar.size_def] using hab
  rw [hmul,hmcast] at hv
  refine ⟨c,hc,?_,?_⟩
  · rw [hv]; exact Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  · rw [hv]
    simp only [ZMod.natCast_mod, Nat.cast_mul]

theorem multiply_prime (a b : U64)
    (ha : a.val < 2147483647) (hb : b.val < 2147483647) :
    ∃ c, (U64.wrapping_mul a b % UScalar.cast .U64 2147483647#u32 : Result U64) = ok c ∧
      c.val < 2147483647 ∧ (c.val : ZMod 2147483647) =
        (a.val : ZMod 2147483647) * (b.val : ZMod 2147483647) :=
  multiply_mod 2147483647#u32 (by decide) a b ha hb

theorem loop (b e acc : U64)
    (hb : b.val < 2147483647) (ha : acc.val < 2147483647) :
    ∃ out, inv_r_loop b e acc = ok out ∧ out.val < 2147483647 ∧
      (out.val : ZMod 2147483647) = (acc.val : ZMod 2147483647) * (b.val : ZMod 2147483647)^e.val := by
  generalize he : e.val = n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing b e acc with
  | h n ih =>
    rw [inv_r_loop]
    by_cases hz : e.val = 0
    · rw [if_neg (show ¬ e > 0#u64 by simpa [UScalar.lt_equiv] using hz)]
      exact ⟨acc,rfl,ha,by rw [← he,hz,pow_zero,mul_one]⟩
    · rw [if_pos (show e > 0#u64 by simpa [UScalar.lt_equiv] using (show 0 < e.val by omega))]
      try simp only [BuilderForestAdmissionPort.aspis_core.field.P,lift,bind_tc_ok]
      obtain ⟨b',hb',hb_bound,hb_val⟩ := multiply_prime b b hb hb
      have hn : (U64.wrapping_shr e 1#u32).val < n := by rw [shift_one]; omega
      have hdecomp : e.val = e.val%2 + 2*(e.val/2) := (Nat.mod_add_div e.val 2).symm
      by_cases hbit : e &&& 1#u64 = 1#u64
      · rw [if_pos hbit]
        obtain ⟨a',ha',ha_bound,ha_val⟩ := multiply_prime acc b ha hb
        rw [ha']
        try simp only [bind_tc_ok]
        rw [hb']
        try simp only [bind_tc_ok]
        obtain ⟨out,hout,hbound,hval⟩ := ih _ hn b' _ a' hb_bound ha_bound rfl
        refine ⟨out,hout,hbound,?_⟩
        rw [hval,ha_val,hb_val,shift_one]
        have hodd : e.val%2 = 1 := by
          have := congrArg UScalar.val hbit
          simpa only [bit_one,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] using this
        rw [← he]
        conv_rhs => rw [hdecomp,hodd,pow_add,pow_mul]
        simp only [pow_one,pow_two,mul_pow]
        ring
      · rw [if_neg hbit]
        try simp only [bind_tc_ok]
        rw [hb']
        try simp only [bind_tc_ok]
        obtain ⟨out,hout,hbound,hval⟩ := ih _ hn b' _ acc hb_bound ha rfl
        refine ⟨out,hout,hbound,?_⟩
        rw [hval,hb_val,shift_one]
        have heven : e.val%2 = 0 := by
          have hne : e.val%2 ≠ 1 := by
            intro h
            apply hbit
            apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
            simpa only [bit_one,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] using h
          have := Nat.mod_lt e.val (by decide : 0 < 2)
          omega
        rw [← he]
        conv_rhs => rw [hdecomp,heven,zero_add,pow_mul]
        simp only [pow_two,mul_pow]

theorem field_power_value (b out : U64) (x n : Nat)
    (hb : b.val = x % 2147483647) (ho : out.val < 2147483647)
    (hval : (out.val : ZMod 2147483647) = (b.val : ZMod 2147483647)^n) :
    out.val = x^n % 2147483647 := by
  rw [hb,ZMod.natCast_mod] at hval
  have hv := congrArg ZMod.val hval
  rw [← Nat.cast_pow,ZMod.val_natCast,ZMod.val_natCast,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt ho] at hv
  exact hv

theorem cast_word_value (out : U64) (n : Nat) (hn : out.val = n % 2147483647) :
    (UScalar.cast .U32 out).val = (BitVec.ofNat 32 (n % 2147483647)).toNat := by
  rw [UScalar.cast_val_eq,hn,BitVec.toNat_ofNat]
  rfl

  obtain ⟨o,ho,h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h

  rw [ha]

attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

structure Content (pt : Parts) (w : RustWitness) (p : RustPublic) : Prop where
  blocks : ∀ h, h < 57 → pt.blocks.val[h]! = blockR w p h
  path : pt.path = okOr (pathR w p) (Array.repeat 1536#usize 0#u32)
  aux : pt.aux = okOr (auxR w p) (Array.repeat 256#usize 0#u32)

theorem cell_eq (pt : Parts) (w : RustWitness) (p : RustPublic)
    (hc : Content pt w p) (c : Fin 29) (r : Fin 1024) :
    PV_Src_Forest_BankCells.cell pt c.val r.val = copyCell w p c r := by
  unfold PV_Src_Forest_BankCells.cell copyCell
  split
  · split
    · rw [hc.blocks (r.val/16) (by omega)]
    · split
      · rw [hc.path]
      · rw [hc.aux]
  · rfl

/-- Bank splitting and merging preserves every canonical raw cell for all
records, independently of semantic admission. -/
theorem canonical_merge_cell (w : RustWitness) (p : RustPublic)
    (c : Fin 29) (r : Fin 1024) :
    copyCellMerged w p c r = copyCell w p c r := by
  let M : Nat → U32 := fun k => if h : k < 16384 then cellT w p ⟨k,h⟩ else 0#u32
  have hs : ∀ k, k < 16384 → (stableBank w p).val[k]! = if LateRow k then 0#u32 else M k := by
    intro k hk
    rw [stableBank,arrT_get _ k hk]
    dsimp only [M]
    rw [dif_pos hk]
  have hl : ∀ k, k < 16384 → (lateBank w p).val[k]! = if LateRow k then M k else 0#u32 := by
    intro k hk
    rw [lateBank,arrT_get _ k hk]
    dsimp only [M]
    rw [dif_pos hk]
    by_cases hr : LateRow k
    · rw [if_pos hr,if_pos hr]
      unfold LateRow at hr
      unfold cellT copyCell
      dsimp only
      rw [if_pos (show k/1024 < 16 by omega),if_pos (show k%1024 < 912 by omega)]
    · rw [if_neg hr,if_neg hr]
  obtain ⟨_,out,hout,hcells⟩ := merge_model M (stableBank w p) (lateBank w p) hs hl
  by_cases hc : c.val < 16
  · have hk : c.val*1024+r.val < 16384 := by have := r.isLt; omega
    unfold copyCellMerged
    rw [if_pos hc,show mergedR w p = ok out from hout,okOr_ok,hcells _ hk]
    dsimp only [M]
    rw [dif_pos hk]
    unfold cellT
    have h1 : (⟨(c.val*1024+r.val)/1024,by omega⟩ : Fin 29) = c := by
      apply Fin.ext; dsimp; have := r.isLt; omega
    have h2 : (⟨(c.val*1024+r.val)%1024,Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)⟩ : Fin 1024) = r := by
      apply Fin.ext; dsimp; have := r.isLt; omega
    rw [h1,h2]
  · unfold copyCellMerged copyCell
    rw [if_neg hc,if_neg hc]

/-- Column-major readout with the thirteen padding columns made explicit. -/
def columnCell (flat : Array U32 16384#usize) (c : Fin 29) (r : Fin 1024) : U32 :=
  if c.val < 16 then flat.val[c.val*1024+r.val]! else 0#u32

theorem banks_columns (rw : RW) (rp : RP) (pt : Parts)
    (hp : parts rw rp = ok pt) (w : RustWitness) (p : RustPublic)
    (hc : Content pt w p) :
    ∃ merged, merged_banks rw rp = ok (true,PV_Src_Forest_BankMaterialization.stableModel pt,
      PV_Src_Forest_BankMaterialization.lateModel pt,merged) ∧
      ∀ c r, columnCell merged c r = copyCellMerged w p c r := by
  obtain ⟨merged,hm,hcells⟩ := PV_Src_Forest_BankMaterialization.banks_table rw rp pt hp
  refine ⟨merged,hm,fun c r => ?_⟩
  rw [canonical_merge_cell]
  unfold columnCell
  by_cases h : c.val < 16
  · rw [if_pos h,hcells _ (by have := r.isLt; omega)]
    have hd : (c.val*1024+r.val)/1024 = c.val := by have := r.isLt; omega
    have hr : (c.val*1024+r.val)%1024 = r.val := by have := r.isLt; omega
    rw [hd,hr]
    exact cell_eq pt w p hc c r
  · rw [if_neg h]
    unfold copyCell
    rw [if_neg h]

#print axioms cell_eq
#print axioms canonical_merge_cell
#print axioms banks_columns
end R1Z.PV_Src_Forest_PartsContent
R1Z.PV_Src_Forest_BankMaterialization:
/- Namespace port of BuilderBankMaterialization: same symbolic proof, actual forest extraction. -/
import R1Z.PV_Src_Forest_BankStep
import R1Z.PV_Src_Forest_BankMerge
import R1Z.PV_Src_Forest_BankCollect

/-! Full bank materialization from an arbitrary well-sized Parts record.
The 16,384 writes are proved by one symbolic prefix induction. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_Src_Forest_BankMaterialization
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0Z.WriterRefine
open BuilderForestAdmissionPort.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder
open PV_Src_Forest_BankStep BuilderRecordsArray
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

def stableModel (pt : Parts) : Bank := tabulate 16384#usize (stableValue pt)
def lateModel (pt : Parts) : Bank := tabulate 16384#usize (lateValue pt)

theorem loop (pt : Parts) (hblocks : pt.blocks.val.length = 57)
    (iter : core.ops.range.Range Usize) (stable late : Bank)
    (hend : iter.end = 16384#usize) (hstart : iter.start.val ≤ 16384)
    (hs : Prefix stable (stableModel pt) iter.start.val)
    (hl : Prefix late (lateModel pt) iter.start.val) :
    merged_banks_loop iter pt stable late = ok (stableModel pt,lateModel pt) := by
  generalize he : 16384-iter.start.val = remaining
  induction remaining using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing iter stable late with
  | h remaining ih =>
    by_cases hit : iter.start.val < 16384
    · obtain ⟨after,hnext,hval,hafterend⟩ := PV_Src_Forest_BankRange.next_some iter (by simpa [hend] using hit)
      rw [PV_Src_Forest_BankStep.step pt hblocks stable late iter after iter.start hit hnext]
      have hsval : stableValue pt iter.start.val = (stableModel pt).val[iter.start.val]! :=
        (tabulate_get _ _ _ (by simpa using hit)).symm
      have hlval : lateValue pt iter.start.val = (lateModel pt).val[iter.start.val]! :=
        (tabulate_get _ _ _ (by simpa using hit)).symm
      rw [hsval,hlval]
      apply ih (16384-after.start.val) (by omega) after _ _ (hafterend.trans hend) (by omega)
      · simpa only [hval] using prefix_step stable (stableModel pt) iter.start (by simpa using hit) hs
      · simpa only [hval] using prefix_step late (lateModel pt) iter.start (by simpa using hit) hl
      · rfl
    · rw [merged_banks_loop,PV_Src_Forest_BankRange.next_none iter (by simpa [hend] using (show 16384 ≤ iter.start.val by omega))]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      have hv : iter.start.val = (16384#usize : Usize).val := by simp; omega
      rw [prefix_done stable (stableModel pt) (by simpa only [hv] using hs),
        prefix_done late (lateModel pt) (by simpa only [hv] using hl)]

theorem from_zero (pt : Parts) (hblocks : pt.blocks.val.length = 57) (stable late : Bank) :
    merged_banks_loop ⟨0#usize,16384#usize⟩ pt stable late = ok (stableModel pt,lateModel pt) :=
  loop pt hblocks _ stable late rfl (by simp)
    (by intro j hj; simp at hj) (by intro j hj; simp at hj)

/-- This isolates precisely the remaining Parts computation. Once `parts`
returns a well-sized record, every stable/late/merged cell and merge flag is
identified with the existing checked writers; no array equality is assumed. -/
theorem banks_of_parts (w : RW) (p : RP) (pt : Parts)
    (hp : parts w p = ok pt) :
    merged_banks w p = (do
      let flag ← R0WriterCopies.merge_check (stableModel pt) (lateModel pt)
      let merged ← R0WriterCopies.merge_copy (stableModel pt) (lateModel pt)
      ok (flag,stableModel pt,lateModel pt,merged)) := by
  have hblocks := PV_Src_Forest_BankCollect.parts_blocks_length w p pt hp
  rw [merged_banks,hp]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [PV_Src_Forest_BankMerge.source_count]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [from_zero pt hblocks]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok,PV_Src_Forest_BankMerge.check,PV_Src_Forest_BankMerge.copy]

/-- Actual successful Parts computation gives the full-bank std table,
including a successful merge check. This needs no semantic admission premise. -/
theorem banks_table (w : RW) (p : RP) (pt : Parts) (hp : parts w p = ok pt) :
    ∃ merged, merged_banks w p = ok (true,stableModel pt,lateModel pt,merged) ∧
      ∀ k, k < 16384 → merged.val[k]! = PV_Src_Forest_BankCells.cell pt (k/1024) (k%1024) := by
  let M : Nat → U32 := fun k => PV_Src_Forest_BankCells.cell pt (k/1024) (k%1024)
  have hs : ∀ k, k < 16384 → (stableModel pt).val[k]! = if LateRow k then 0#u32 else M k := by
    intro k hk
    exact tabulate_get _ _ _ (by simpa using hk)
  have hl : ∀ k, k < 16384 → (lateModel pt).val[k]! = if LateRow k then M k else 0#u32 := by
    intro k hk
    exact tabulate_get _ _ _ (by simpa using hk)
  obtain ⟨hcheck,merged,hmerged,hcells⟩ := merge_model M (stableModel pt) (lateModel pt) hs hl
  refine ⟨merged,?_,?_⟩
  · rw [banks_of_parts w p pt hp,hcheck]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [hmerged]
    rfl
  · exact hcells

#print axioms loop
#print axioms from_zero
#print axioms banks_of_parts
#print axioms banks_table
end R1Z.PV_Src_Forest_BankMaterialization
R1Z.PV_Src_Forest_BankStep:
/- Namespace port of BuilderBankStep: same symbolic proof, actual forest extraction. -/
import R1Z.PV_Src_Forest_BankRange
import R1Z.BuilderRecordsArray

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_Src_Forest_BankStep
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0Z.WriterRefine
open BuilderForestAdmissionPort.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder
open PV_Src_Forest_BankCells
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
abbrev Bank := Array U32 16384#usize

def stableValue (pt : Parts) (k : Nat) : U32 :=
  if LateRow k then 0#u32 else cell pt (k/1024) (k%1024)
def lateValue (pt : Parts) (k : Nat) : U32 :=
  if LateRow k then cell pt (k/1024) (k%1024) else 0#u32

theorem late_cell (pt : Parts) (k : Nat) (hk : k < 16384) (h : LateRow k) :
    cell pt (k/1024) (k%1024) =
      (pt.blocks.val[k%1024/16]!).val[(k%1024%16)*16+k/1024]! := by
  unfold LateRow at h
  rw [cell, if_pos (by omega), if_pos (by omega)]

theorem step (pt : Parts) (hblocks : pt.blocks.val.length = 57) (stable late : Bank)
    (iter after : core.ops.range.Range Usize) (k : Usize) (hk : k.val < 16384)
    (next : core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next core.iter.range.StepUsize iter = ok (some k,after)) :
    merged_banks_loop iter pt stable late =
      merged_banks_loop after pt
        (stable.set k (stableValue pt k.val)) (late.set k (lateValue pt k.val)) := by
  rw [merged_banks_loop,next]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [PV_Src_Forest_BankShape.late_row]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  by_cases hlate : LateRow k.val
  · have hrows := hlate
    unfold LateRow at hrows
    simp only [hlate,decide_true,if_true,stableValue,lateValue]
    rw [update_ok stable k _ (by simpa using hk)]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    obtain ⟨r,hr,vr⟩ := rem1024 k
    rw [hr]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    obtain ⟨q,hq,vq⟩ := UScalar.div_spec r (y := 16#usize) (by simp)
    rw [hq]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    have vr' : r.val = k.val%1024 := by simpa using vr
    have vq' : q.val = k.val%1024/16 := by simpa [vr'] using vq
    rw [vec_index _ q (by rw [hblocks,vq']; omega)]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    obtain ⟨m,hm,vm⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (UScalar.rem_spec r (y := 16#usize) (by simp))
    rw [hm]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok,lift]
    obtain ⟨c,hc,vc⟩ := UScalar.div_spec k (y := 1024#usize) (by simp)
    rw [hc]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok,lift]
    have vm' : m.val = k.val%1024%16 := by simpa [vr'] using vm
    have vc' : c.val = k.val/1024 := by simpa using vc
    have vprod : (Usize.wrapping_mul m 16#usize).val = (k.val%1024%16)*16 := by
      rw [umul _ _ (by simp; omega)]; simp only [vm',UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
    have vsum : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul m 16#usize) c).val =
        (k.val%1024%16)*16+k.val/1024 := by
      rw [uadd _ _ (by rw [vprod,vc']; omega),vprod,vc']
    rw [index_ok _ _ (by rw [vsum]; simp; omega)]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [update_ok late k _ (by simpa using hk)]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok,vsum,vq']
    rw [late_cell pt k.val hk hlate]
  · simp only [hlate,decide_false,Bool.false_eq_true,if_false,stableValue,lateValue]
    obtain ⟨c,hc,vc⟩ := UScalar.div_spec k (y := 1024#usize) (by simp)
    rw [hc]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    obtain ⟨r,hr,vr⟩ := rem1024 k
    rw [hr]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [PV_Src_Forest_BankCells.copy_cell pt hblocks c r (by simpa [vr] using Nat.mod_lt k.val (by decide : 0 < 1024))]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [update_ok stable k _ (by simpa using hk)]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [update_ok late k _ (by simpa using hk)]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    have vc' : c.val = k.val/1024 := by simpa using vc
    simp only [vc',vr]

#print axioms late_cell
#print axioms step
end R1Z.PV_Src_Forest_BankStep

/- Namespace port of BuilderBankCells: same symbolic proof, actual forest extraction. -/
import R1Z.PV_Src_Forest_BankShape
import R1Z.BuilderRecordsPath

/-! The actual extracted bank dispatcher reads the Parts table cellwise.
No assumption about the origin or cryptographic meaning of Parts is made. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_Src_Forest_BankCells
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0Z.WriterRefine
open BuilderForestAdmissionPort.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder

def cell (pt : Parts) (c r : Nat) : U32 :=
  if c < 16 then
    if r < 912 then (pt.blocks.val[r/16]!).val[(r%16)*16+c]!
    else if r < 1008 then pt.path.val[(r-912)*16+c]!
    else pt.aux.val[(r-1008)*16+c]!
  else 0#u32

theorem vec_index {α : Type} [Inhabited α] (v : alloc.vec.Vec α) (i : Usize)
    (hi : i.val < v.val.length) :
    alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice α) v i = ok v.val[i.val]! := by
  rw [alloc.vec.Vec.index_slice_index]
  unfold alloc.vec.Vec.index_usize
  change (match v.val[i.val]? with | none => fail .arrayOutOfBounds | some x => ok x) = _
  rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi]
  simp only [getElem!_pos v.val i.val hi]

theorem copy_cell (pt : Parts) (hblocks : pt.blocks.val.length = 57)
    (c r : Usize) (hr : r.val < 1024) :
    BuilderForestAdmissionPort.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.copy_cell pt c r =
      ok (cell pt c.val r.val) := by
  rw [BuilderForestAdmissionPort.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.copy_cell]
  simp only [C1_COLS, PATH_ROW0, AUX_ROW0]
  unfold cell
  by_cases hc : c.val < 16
  · rw [if_pos (by simpa [UScalar.lt_equiv] using hc), if_pos hc]
    by_cases hpath : r.val < 912
    · rw [if_pos (by simpa [UScalar.lt_equiv] using hpath), if_pos hpath]
      obtain ⟨q,hq,vq⟩ := UScalar.div_spec r (y := 16#usize) (by simp)
      rw [hq]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      rw [vec_index _ q (by simp only [hblocks, vq]; simp; omega)]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      obtain ⟨rem,hrem,vrem⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (UScalar.rem_spec r (y := 16#usize) (by simp))
      rw [hrem]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
      have vq' : q.val = r.val/16 := by simpa using vq
      have vr : rem.val = r.val%16 := by simpa using vrem
      have vm : (Usize.wrapping_mul rem 16#usize).val = (r.val%16)*16 := by
        rw [umul _ _ (by simp; omega)]; simp only [vr, UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
      have va : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul rem 16#usize) c).val =
          (r.val%16)*16+c.val := by
        rw [uadd _ _ (by rw [vm]; omega), vm]
      rw [index_ok _ _ (by rw [va]; simp; omega)]
      simp only [vq',va]
    · rw [if_neg (by simpa [UScalar.lt_equiv] using hpath), if_neg hpath]
      by_cases haux : r.val < 1008
      · rw [if_pos (by simpa [UScalar.lt_equiv] using haux), if_pos haux]
        simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok]
        have vs : (Usize.wrapping_sub r 912#usize).val = r.val-912 := by
          simpa using BuilderRecordsPath.sub_val r 912#usize (by simp; omega)
        have vm : (Usize.wrapping_mul (Usize.wrapping_sub r 912#usize) 16#usize).val =
            (r.val-912)*16 := by
          rw [umul _ _ (by rw [vs]; simp; omega), vs]; rfl
        have va : (Usize.wrapping_add
            (Usize.wrapping_mul (Usize.wrapping_sub r 912#usize) 16#usize) c).val =
            (r.val-912)*16+c.val := by
          rw [uadd _ _ (by rw [vm]; omega),vm]
        rw [index_ok _ _ (by rw [va]; simp; omega)]
        simp only [va]
      · rw [if_neg (by simpa [UScalar.lt_equiv] using haux), if_neg haux]
        simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok]
        have vs : (Usize.wrapping_sub r 1008#usize).val = r.val-1008 := by
          simpa using BuilderRecordsPath.sub_val r 1008#usize (by simp; omega)
        have vm : (Usize.wrapping_mul (Usize.wrapping_sub r 1008#usize) 16#usize).val =
            (r.val-1008)*16 := by
          rw [umul _ _ (by rw [vs]; simp; omega),vs]; rfl
        have va : (Usize.wrapping_add
            (Usize.wrapping_mul (Usize.wrapping_sub r 1008#usize) 16#usize) c).val =
            (r.val-1008)*16+c.val := by
          rw [uadd _ _ (by rw [vm]; omega),vm]
        rw [index_ok _ _ (by rw [va]; simp; omega)]
        simp only [va]
  · rw [if_neg (by simpa [UScalar.lt_equiv] using hc), if_neg hc]

#print axioms vec_index
#print axioms copy_cell
end R1Z.PV_Src_Forest_BankCells
R1Z.PV_Src_Forest_BankShape:
/- Namespace port of BuilderBankShape: same symbolic proof, actual forest extraction. -/
import R1Z.BuilderForestAdmissionPort
import R0Z.WriterRefineMerge

/-! Symbolic refinement of the extracted row and block dispatch predicates.
No enumeration of concrete bank cells or Poseidon rounds. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_Src_Forest_BankShape
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

theorem range_usize (r : core.ops.range.Range Std.Usize) (x : Std.Usize) :
    BuilderStdModels.rangeContains core.cmp.PartialOrdUsize
      core.cmp.PartialOrdUsize core.cmp.PartialOrdUsize r x =
      ok (decide (r.start.val ≤ x.val ∧ x.val < r.end.val)) := by
  change (do
    let b ← ok (decide (r.start.val ≤ x.val))
    if b then ok (decide (x.val < r.end.val)) else ok false) = _
  by_cases h : r.start.val ≤ x.val <;> simp [h]

theorem inclusive_usize (r : core.ops.range.RangeInclusive Std.Usize)
    (x : Std.Usize) (he : r.exhausted = false) :
    BuilderStdModels.rangeInclusiveContains core.cmp.PartialOrdUsize
      core.cmp.PartialOrdUsize core.cmp.PartialOrdUsize r x =
      ok (decide (r.start.val ≤ x.val ∧ x.val ≤ r.end.val)) := by
  unfold BuilderStdModels.rangeInclusiveContains
  rw [he]
  change (do
    let b ← ok (decide (r.start.val ≤ x.val))
    if b then ok (decide (x.val ≤ r.end.val)) else ok false) = _
  by_cases h : r.start.val ≤ x.val <;> simp [h]

theorem late_row (k : Std.Usize) :
    BuilderForestAdmissionPort.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.late_row k = ok (decide (R0Z.WriterRefine.LateRow k.val)) := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hv⟩ := R0Z.WriterRefine.rem1024 k
  rw [BuilderForestAdmissionPort.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.late_row, hr]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  simp only [BuilderForestStdPort.core.ops.range.Range.contains]
  rw [range_usize]
  simp [hv, R0Z.WriterRefine.LateRow]

theorem node_kind (h : Std.Usize) :
    BuilderForestAdmissionPort.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.node_kind h = ok (decide ((4 ≤ h.val ∧ h.val ≤ 24) ∨
      (33 ≤ h.val ∧ h.val ≤ 56))) := by
  rw [BuilderForestAdmissionPort.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.node_kind]
  simp only [core.ops.range.RangeInclusive.new, bind_tc_ok]
  simp only [BuilderForestStdPort.core.ops.range.RangeInclusive.contains]
  rw [inclusive_usize _ _ rfl]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  split
  · rename_i ht
    simp_all

/-! A successful mapped range collection has the exact range length even
when the mapper is partial. No totality of the cryptographic callee is assumed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_Src_Forest_BankCollect
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result BuilderStdModels BuilderRecordsFields
variable {C T : Type}
abbrev Range := core.ops.range.Range Usize
abbrev MapRange (C : Type) := core.iter.adapters.map.Map Range C

def mapped (f : core.ops.function.FnMut C Usize T) :
    core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator (MapRange C) T :=
  mappedIterator (core.iter.traits.iterator.IteratorRange core.iter.range.StepUsize) f

theorem collect_length (f : core.ops.function.FnMut C Usize T)
    (r : Range) (c : C) (acc out : List T)
    (hbound : r.start.val ≤ r.end.val)
    (h : alloc.vec.FromIteratorVec.iterToList (mapped f) ⟨r,c⟩ acc = ok out) :
    out.length = acc.length + (r.end.val-r.start.val) := by
  generalize he : r.end.val-r.start.val = remaining
  induction remaining using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing r c acc out with
  | h remaining ih =>
    rw [alloc.vec.FromIteratorVec.iterToList] at h
    by_cases hlt : r.start.val < r.end.val
    · obtain ⟨after,hn,hs,he'⟩ := PV_Src_Forest_BankRange.next_some r hlt
      have hm : (mapped f).next ⟨r,c⟩ = (do
          let (v,c') ← f.call_mut c r.start
          ok (some v,⟨after,c'⟩)) := by
        change mapNext _ f ⟨r,c⟩ = _
        rw [mapNext]
        simp only [core.iter.traits.iterator.IteratorRange]
        rw [hn]; rfl
      rw [hm] at h
      obtain ⟨⟨v,c'⟩,_,h⟩ := bind_ok_inv (by simpa only [bind_assoc_eq,bind_tc_ok] using h)
      have ht := ih (after.end.val-after.start.val) (by rw [he']; omega)
        after c' (v::acc) out (by rw [he']; omega) h rfl
      simp only [List.length_cons] at ht
      rw [he'] at ht
      omega
    · have hn := PV_Src_Forest_BankRange.next_none r (by omega)
      have hm : (mapped f).next ⟨r,c⟩ = ok (none,⟨r,c⟩) := by
        change mapNext _ f ⟨r,c⟩ = _
        rw [mapNext]
        simp only [core.iter.traits.iterator.IteratorRange]
        rw [hn]; rfl
      rw [hm] at h
      simp only [bind_tc_ok] at h
      have hout : out = acc.reverse := (Result.ok.inj h).symm
      rw [hout,List.length_reverse]
      omega

    (r : Range) (c : C) (out : alloc.vec.Vec T) (hbound : r.start.val ≤ r.end.val)

      (core.iter.traits.collect.FromIteratorVec T) ⟨r,c⟩ = ok out) :

    core.iter.traits.collect.FromIteratorVec alloc.vec.FromIteratorVec.from_iter at h
  simp only [core.iter.traits.collect.IntoIterator.Blanket.into_iter,bind_tc_ok] at h
  obtain ⟨xs,hxs,h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  by_cases hb : xs.length ≤ Usize.max

    have ho := congrArg Subtype.val (Result.ok.inj h)

    BuilderForestAdmissionPort.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.parts.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeArrayU32256

  obtain ⟨path,_,h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  obtain ⟨inRec,_,h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h

import R1Z.PV_Src_ResultControl
import R1Z.BuilderRecordsFields

/-! Proof-local Result inversion. It checks the monadic head before applying
inversion, drops the old continuation by FVarId, and uses explicit fresh names.
This automation generates ordinary kernel-checked terms, not source axioms. -/
open Lean Meta Elab Tactic

namespace R1Z.PV_Src_CompilerTactic
private def bindHead (e : Expr) : Bool :=
  match e.getAppFn.constName? with
  | some n => n.toString.endsWith ".bind" || n.toString.endsWith ".bind_tc"
  | none => false

elab "pv_peel " h:ident " with " v:ident hv:ident : tactic => do
  let old ← withMainContext <| getFVarId h
  let lhs ← withMainContext do
    let ty ← instantiateMVars (← old.getType)
    unless ty.isAppOfArity ``Eq 3 do throwError "expected a Result equation"
    pure ty.getAppArgs[1]!
  unless bindHead lhs do
    let head ← withMainContext <| withTransparency .reducible <| whnf lhs
    unless bindHead head do
      throwError "not a monadic head: {head.getAppFn}"
  let vFresh ← mkFreshUserName `pv_value
  let eqFresh ← mkFreshUserName `pv_equation
  let nextFresh ← mkFreshUserName `pv_next
  let vs := mkIdent vFresh
  let es := mkIdent eqFresh
  let ns := mkIdent nextFresh
  let inv := mkIdent ``R1Z.BuilderRecordsFields.bind_ok_inv
  evalTactic (← `(tactic| obtain ⟨$vs,$es,$ns⟩ := $inv $h))
  let vi ← withMainContext <| getFVarId vs
  let ei ← withMainContext <| getFVarId es
  let ni ← withMainContext <| getFVarId ns
  let goal ← getMainGoal
  let goal ← goal.clear old
  let goal ← goal.rename vi v.getId
  let goal ← goal.rename ei hv.getId
  let goal ← goal.rename ni h.getId
  replaceMainGoal [goal]

end R1Z.PV_Src_CompilerTactic

/-! Small inversion at the exact Option -> Rust Result -> Try boundary.
No source callee is evaluated; the payload type remains arbitrary. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_Src_ResultControl
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

theorem option_continue {α ε : Type} {o : Option α} {e : ε}
    {r : core.result.Result α ε} {b : α}
    (ho : BuilderForestStd.okOr o e = ok r)
    (hb : core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r = ok (.Continue b)) :
    o = some b := by
  cases o with
  | none =>
    have he : r = .Err e := (Result.ok.inj ho).symm
    subst r
    simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok] at hb
    cases hb
  | some a =>
    have he : r = .Ok a := (Result.ok.inj ho).symm
    subst r
    have hab : a = b :=
      core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue.inj (Result.ok.inj hb)
    exact congrArg some hab

theorem error_ne_ok {α ε : Type} (e : ε) (a : α) :
    (ok (.Err e) : Result (core.result.Result α ε)) ≠ ok (.Ok a) := by
  intro h
  cases h

theorem same_residual_ne_ok {α ε : Type}
    (r : core.result.Result core.convert.Infallible ε) (a : α) :
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
      α (core.convert.FromSame ε) r ≠ ok (.Ok a) := by
  intro h
  cases r with
  | Ok bad => cases bad
  | Err e =>
    change (ok (.Err e) : Result (core.result.Result α ε)) = ok (.Ok a) at h
    cases h

import Aeneas

/-! Aeneas discriminant readers with enum-qualified instance names for import unions.
The pinned generator supplies both commands; only its anonymous instance name
is changed. Scalar types, explicit tags, generic binders and reader bodies are
preserved. This adapter must be rebuilt when the Aeneas generator is repinned. -/
open Lean Elab Term Meta
open Lean.Parser.Term Lean.Parser.Command

namespace ImportUnionNamedDiscriminant

syntax (name := namedDiscriminant) "import_union_discriminant" ident ("["num,*"]")? : attr

initialize namedDiscriminantAttribute : AttributeImpl ← do
  let attrImpl : AttributeImpl := {
    «name» := `namedDiscriminant,
    descr := "Emit the Aeneas reader with an enum-qualified instance name",
    add := fun declName stx _ => do
      let (ty, values) ← match stx with
        | `(attr| import_union_discriminant $ty) =>
          pure (← Aeneas.Discriminant.elabTypeToken ty, none)
        | `(attr| import_union_discriminant $ty [$xs,*]) =>
          pure (← Aeneas.Discriminant.elabTypeToken ty,
            some ((xs.getElems.toList.map Syntax.isNatLit?).map Option.get!))
        | _ => throwUnsupportedSyntax
      liftCommandElabM do
        let cmds ← Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM
          (Aeneas.Discriminant.generateReadDiscriminantCmds declName ty values)
        Lean.Elab.Command.elabCommand cmds[0]!
        let instName := mkIdent (declName ++ `instDiscriminant)
        let id ← `(Parser.Command.declId| $instName:ident)
        let inst := cmds[1]!.rewriteBottomUp fun node => Id.run do
          if node.isOfKind ``Lean.Parser.Command.instance then
            return node.setArg 3 (mkNullNode #[id.raw])
          return node
        if inst == cmds[1]! then
          throwError "Pinned Aeneas generator no longer emits an instance command"
        Lean.Elab.Command.elabCommand inst
  }
  registerBuiltinAttribute attrImpl
  pure attrImpl

end ImportUnionNamedDiscriminant

map. Nominal adaptation preserves every witness field; no record-callee
association or successful forest compilation is assumed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_Src_NativeDirections
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0Z.WriterRefine
open BuilderForestAdmissionPort.pool_v1
abbrev Input := pair_forest_trace.PoolV1PairForestInputNoteWitnessV1

def reference (i : Input) : BuilderRecordsPath.Input where
  pair := {
    nullifier_key := i.pair.nullifier_key
    salt := i.pair.salt
    value := i.pair.value
    pair_leaf := {
      first_commitment := i.pair.pair_leaf.first_commitment
      second_occupied := i.pair.pair_leaf.second_occupied
      second_commitment := i.pair.pair_leaf.second_commitment
      second_occupancy_inverse := i.pair.pair_leaf.second_occupancy_inverse }
    selected_second := i.pair.selected_second
    membership := {siblings := i.pair.membership.siblings,index := i.pair.membership.index} }
  super_root_siblings := i.super_root_siblings
  super_root_directions := i.super_root_directions

abbrev closure := pair_forest_trace.compile_forest_from_copies.closure_1.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeM31

theorem closure_result (input : Input) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < 24) :
    closure.call_mut (input.pair,input) i =
      ok ((BuilderRecordsPath.bits (reference input)).val[i.val]!, (input.pair,input)) := by
  rw [BuilderRecordsPath.bits_get _ i hi]
  dsimp only [closure, pair_forest_trace.compile_forest_from_copies.closure_1.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeM31]
  rw [pair_forest_trace.compile_forest_from_copies.closure_1.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeM31.call_mut]
  by_cases h0 : i = 0#usize
  · simp only [h0,if_true,lift,bind_tc_ok,reference]
    rfl
  · simp only [if_neg h0]
    by_cases h20 : i ≤ 20#usize
    · simp only [if_pos h20,lift,bind_tc_ok,reference]
      rfl
    · simp only [if_neg h20,lift,bind_tc_ok,reference]
      have h21 : 21 ≤ i.val := by
        have h := h20
        simp only [UScalar.le_equiv,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] at h
        omega
      have hv : (Usize.wrapping_sub i 21#usize).val = i.val-21 :=
        BuilderRecordsPath.sub_val i 21#usize (by simpa using h21)
      rw [index_ok_gen _ _ (by rw [hv]; simp; omega)]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok,lift,hv]
      rfl

def run (input : Input) : Result (Array U32 24#usize) :=
  BuilderForestStdPort.core.array.from_fn 24#usize closure (input.pair,input)

theorem run_eq (input : Input) : run input = ok (BuilderRecordsPath.bits (reference input)) := by
  unfold run
  rw [PV_Src_Forest_DigestArguments.from_fn_nat 24#usize closure (input.pair,input)
    (fun n => (BuilderRecordsPath.bits (reference input)).val[n]!)
    (fun i hi => closure_result input i (by simpa using hi))]
  congr 1

theorem booleans (input : Input) : ∃ out, run input = ok out ∧
    ∀ n, n < 24 → (out.val[n]!).val = 0 ∨ (out.val[n]!).val = 1 :=
  ⟨BuilderRecordsPath.bits (reference input),run_eq input,
    fun n hn => BuilderRecordsAdmission.bits_boolean (reference input) n hn⟩

#print axioms run_eq

import R1Z.BuilderForestAdmissionPort
import R1Z.PV_Src_Public

/-! Data at the actual extracted forest compiler/public-projection boundary.
The returned compilation is data; execution success is deliberately not part
of its definition or input carrier. Request variants fix the called output
value and optional recipient exactly as the two shipped entry wrappers do. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_Src_NativeInput
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open BuilderForestAdmissionPort.pool_v1

inductive Request where
  | transfer (publicInput : BuilderPublicProjection.Transfer)
      (recipient : payment_relation.PoolV1OutputNoteWitnessV1)
  | withdrawal (publicInput : BuilderPublicProjection.Withdrawal)

def forestPublic : Request → pair_forest_trace.ForestPublic
  | .transfer p _ => ⟨p.anchor_root,p.nullifier,some p.recipient_commitment,p.change_commitment,p.asset_id⟩
  | .withdrawal p => ⟨p.anchor_root,p.nullifier,none,p.change_commitment,p.asset_id⟩

def outputValue : Request → U32
  | .transfer _ r => r.value
  | .withdrawal p => p.amount

def recipient : Request → Option payment_relation.PoolV1OutputNoteWitnessV1
  | .transfer _ r => some r
  | .withdrawal _ => none

structure Input where
  request : Request
  witness : pair_forest_trace.PoolV1PairForestInputNoteWitnessV1
  change : payment_relation.PoolV1OutputNoteWitnessV1
  laneAnchor : Array U32 8#usize
  snapshot : pair_tree_profile.PoolV1PairLiveSnapshotV1
  compiled : pair_forest_trace.PoolV1PairForestMergedC1CompilationV1

/-- Actual extracted callee, including both native error layers. -/
def run [BuilderForestAdmissionPort.ExternalLinear] [BuilderForestAdmissionPort.Records]
    (i : Input) := pair_forest_trace.compile_forest_from_copies
  i.witness (outputValue i.request) (recipient i.request) i.change
  (forestPublic i.request) i.laneAnchor i.snapshot

/-- A field-preserving nominal adapter; there is no assumed transition or
public equality inside this definition. The transition comes from the actual
returned compiler payload, including both snapshot and afterstate. -/
def transition (t : pair_tree_profile.PoolV1PairLatePublicStatementV1) :
    BuilderPublicProjection.Transition where
  live_snapshot := {
    pool := t.live_snapshot.pool
    deployment_domain := t.live_snapshot.deployment_domain
    sequence := t.live_snapshot.sequence
    next_pair_index := t.live_snapshot.next_pair_index
    current_root := t.live_snapshot.current_root
    frontier := t.live_snapshot.frontier }
  candidate_afterstate := {
    next_pair_index := t.candidate_afterstate.next_pair_index
    next_root := t.candidate_afterstate.next_root
    next_frontier := t.candidate_afterstate.next_frontier }

def publicInput (i : Input) : PV_Src_Public.Input :=
  match i.request with
  | .transfer p _ => .transfer p (transition i.compiled.public_statement)
  | .withdrawal p => .withdrawal p (transition i.compiled.public_statement)

def newRecords [BuilderForestAdmissionPort.Records] (i : Input) :=
  pair_forest_copy_builder.CopyRecords.new i.witness (outputValue i.request)
    (recipient i.request) i.change i.snapshot (forestPublic i.request).asset

/-- Pure projection of the actual returned merged columns. -/
def columns {K : Type} [Field K]
    (read : Array (alloc.vec.Vec U32) 16#usize → Fin 29 → Fin 1024 → U32)
    (out : Array (alloc.vec.Vec U32) 16#usize) : R0P.Trace K :=
  fun c r => R0Z.WriterRefine.liftU (read out c r)

#print axioms run
#print axioms transition
#print axioms publicInput
#print axioms newRecords
#print axioms columns
end R1Z.PV_Src_NativeInput

/-! The actual extracted public calls for both shipped statement variants.
No native equality is used to define the canonical public projection. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PV_Src_Public
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result BuilderPublicProjection
open AspisBuilderPublicSource.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal

inductive Input where
  | transfer (p : Transfer) (t : Transition)
  | withdrawal (p : Withdrawal) (t : Transition)

def run : Input → Result SemanticPublic
  | .transfer p t => private_public p t
  | .withdrawal p t => withdrawal_public p t

def value : Input → SemanticPublic
  | .transfer p t => ⟨.PrivateTransfer,p.pool,p.deployment_domain,p.anchor_root,p.nullifier,
      p.asset_id,some p.recipient_commitment,p.change_commitment,none,t⟩
  | .withdrawal p t => ⟨.Withdrawal,p.pool,p.deployment_domain,p.anchor_root,p.nullifier,
      p.asset_id,none,p.change_commitment,some p.amount,t⟩

def canonicalPublic : Input → R0P.Public R1J.SpendWitnessMap.F
  | .transfer p t => transferPublic p t
  | .withdrawal p t => withdrawalPublic p t

theorem run_success (i : Input) : run i = ok (value i) := by cases i <;> rfl

/-- Execute the extracted public call. Totality, rather than an admission
premise, proves that the fallback is unreachable. -/
def output (i : Input) : SemanticPublic :=
  R0Z.WriterRefine.okOr (run i) (value i)

theorem output_eq (i : Input) : output i = value i := by
  rw [output,run_success,R0Z.WriterRefine.okOr_ok]

theorem public_eq (i : Input) : semanticPublic (output i) = canonicalPublic i := by
  rw [output_eq]
  cases i <;> rfl

theorem transfer_public_eq (p : Transfer) (t : Transition) (s : SemanticPublic)
    (h : private_public p t = ok s) :
    semanticPublic s = canonicalPublic (.transfer p t) :=
  transfer_success p t s h

theorem withdrawal_public_eq (p : Withdrawal) (t : Transition) (s : SemanticPublic)
    (h : withdrawal_public p t = ok s) :
    semanticPublic s = canonicalPublic (.withdrawal p t) :=
  withdrawal_success p t s h

#print axioms run_success
#print axioms output_eq
#print axioms public_eq
#print axioms transfer_public_eq

import R1Z.BuilderCanonical

/-! The two actual shipped public projection functions, extracted directly.
The projection retains both snapshot and afterstate; context byte fields stay
in the enclosing source record. Admission and output trace identity are not
inferred from the fact that this projection is total. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.BuilderPublicProjection
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisBuilderPublicSource
open pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal
open R0Z.WriterRefine R1J.SpendWitnessMap
abbrev Transfer := pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1PrivateTransferPublicV1
abbrev Withdrawal := pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1WithdrawalPublicV1
abbrev Transition := pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.PoolV1PairLatePublicStatementV1

def semanticPublic (p : SemanticPublic) : R0P.Public F where
  variant := match p.variant with
    | .PrivateTransfer => .privateTransfer
    | .Withdrawal => .withdrawal
  anchor := digK p.anchor
  nullifier := digK p.nullifier
  assetId := liftU p.asset_id
  recipient := p.recipient.map digK
  change := digK p.change
  withdrawalAmount := p.withdrawal_amount.map liftU
  nextPairIndex := p.transition.live_snapshot.next_pair_index.val
  snapshotFrontier := fun l => digK (p.transition.live_snapshot.frontier.val[l.val]!)
  nextRoot := digK p.transition.candidate_afterstate.next_root
  nextFrontier := fun l => digK (p.transition.candidate_afterstate.next_frontier.val[l.val]!)

def transferPublic (p : Transfer) (t : Transition) : R0P.Public F where
  variant := .privateTransfer
  anchor := digK p.anchor_root
  nullifier := digK p.nullifier
  assetId := liftU p.asset_id
  recipient := some (digK p.recipient_commitment)
  change := digK p.change_commitment
  withdrawalAmount := none
  nextPairIndex := t.live_snapshot.next_pair_index.val
  snapshotFrontier := fun l => digK (t.live_snapshot.frontier.val[l.val]!)
  nextRoot := digK t.candidate_afterstate.next_root
  nextFrontier := fun l => digK (t.candidate_afterstate.next_frontier.val[l.val]!)

def withdrawalPublic (p : Withdrawal) (t : Transition) : R0P.Public F where
  variant := .withdrawal
  anchor := digK p.anchor_root
  nullifier := digK p.nullifier
  assetId := liftU p.asset_id
  recipient := none
  change := digK p.change_commitment
  withdrawalAmount := some (liftU p.amount)
  nextPairIndex := t.live_snapshot.next_pair_index.val
  snapshotFrontier := fun l => digK (t.live_snapshot.frontier.val[l.val]!)
  nextRoot := digK t.candidate_afterstate.next_root
  nextFrontier := fun l => digK (t.candidate_afterstate.next_frontier.val[l.val]!)

theorem transfer_projection (p : Transfer) (t : Transition) :
    ∃ s, private_public p t = ok s ∧ semanticPublic s = transferPublic p t ∧
      s.pool = p.pool ∧ s.deployment_domain = p.deployment_domain ∧ s.transition = t :=
  ⟨_, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

theorem withdrawal_projection (p : Withdrawal) (t : Transition) :
    ∃ s, withdrawal_public p t = ok s ∧ semanticPublic s = withdrawalPublic p t ∧
      s.pool = p.pool ∧ s.deployment_domain = p.deployment_domain ∧ s.transition = t :=
  ⟨_, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

theorem transfer_success (p : Transfer) (t : Transition) (s : SemanticPublic)
    (h : private_public p t = ok s) : semanticPublic s = transferPublic p t := by
  cases Result.ok.inj h
  rfl

theorem withdrawal_success (p : Withdrawal) (t : Transition) (s : SemanticPublic)
    (h : withdrawal_public p t = ok s) : semanticPublic s = withdrawalPublic p t := by
  cases Result.ok.inj h
  rfl

theorem public_base {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] [CharP K 2147483647]
    (Fbase : Subfield K) (p : SemanticPublic) :
    R0P.PublicBase Fbase (mapPub (K := K) (semanticPublic p)) :=
  BuilderCanonical.publicBase_map Fbase _

#print axioms transfer_projection
#print axioms withdrawal_projection
#print axioms transfer_success
#print axioms withdrawal_success
#print axioms public_base
end R1Z.BuilderPublicProjection

import Lean.Elab.Tactic
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_RunJoin_BindControl16
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

theorem congr_bind {α β : Type} (m : Result α) (f g : α → Result β)
    (h : ∀ x, f x = g x) :
    (do let x ← m; f x) = (do let x ← m; g x) := by
  exact congrArg (fun k => m >>= k) (funext h)

#print axioms congr_bind

open Lean Meta Elab Tactic
private def bindHead (e : Expr) : Bool :=
  match e.getAppFn.constName? with
  | some n => n.toString.endsWith ".bind" || n.toString.endsWith ".bind_tc"
  | none => false

elab "pv_congr_bind16" : tactic => withMainContext do
  let target ← instantiateMVars (← getMainTarget)
  unless target.isAppOfArity ``Eq 3 do throwError "expected an equality"
  let lhs ← whnf target.getAppArgs[1]!
  let rhs ← whnf target.getAppArgs[2]!
  unless bindHead lhs && bindHead rhs do throwError "expected two explicit Result bind heads"
  evalTactic (← `(tactic| apply R1Z.PV_RunJoin_BindControl16.congr_bind))
  let (vi, next) ← (← getMainGoal).intro1P
  replaceMainGoal [next]
  let branches ← next.withContext do
    let ty ← whnf (← inferType (mkFVar vi))
    if ty.isAppOfArity ``Prod 2 then
      return (← next.cases vi).map (·.mvarId)
    else
      return #[next]
  replaceMainGoal branches.toList

namespace R1Z.PV_Src_CanonicalRoots
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0Z.WriterRefine R0Z.BuilderModel R1J.SpendWitnessMap

def word (l : Fin 21) (lane : Fin 8) : U32 :=
  UScalar.ofNatCore (R0P.emptyRootsNat l lane) (lt_u32 (emptyRoot_lt l lane))

def table : BuilderRecordsReference.Roots :=
  ⟨List.ofFn (fun l : Fin 21 => arr8 (word l)),by simp⟩

theorem at_level (l : Fin 21) : table.val[l.val]! = arr8 (word l) := by
  change (List.ofFn (fun l : Fin 21 => arr8 (word l)))[l.val]! = _
  rw [List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD,List.getElem?_ofFn,dif_pos l.isLt]
  rfl

theorem canonical (l : Fin 21) : Canon8 table.val[l.val]! := by
  intro lane hlane
  rw [at_level,arr8_get _ lane hlane]
  change (UScalar.ofNatCore (R0P.emptyRootsNat l ⟨lane,hlane⟩) _).val < 2147483647
  rw [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
  exact emptyRoot_lt _ _

    DigestLift table.val[l.val]! (emptyRootK (K := K) l) := by
  intro lane
  change liftU ((table.val[l.castSucc.val]!).val[lane.val]!) = _
  rw [at_level l.castSucc,arr8_get _ lane.val lane.isLt]
  simp only [liftU,word,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq,emptyRootK]

this file does not assume it as a global axiom or install a replacement. -/

      (∀ l : Fin 20, Canon8 roots.val[l.val]!) := by
  rw [h] at hr
  cases Result.ok.inj hr

theorem reference_parts (roots : BuilderRecordsReference.Roots) (i : Input)
    (snapshot : i.compiled.public_statement.live_snapshot = i.snapshot)
    (frontier : ∀ l : Fin 20, Canon8 i.snapshot.frontier.val[l.val]!)

  variant := PV_Src_PublicHeader.variant roots i
  asset := PV_Src_PublicHeader.asset roots i
  next := PV_Src_PublicHeader.next roots i snapshot
  frontier := PV_Src_PublicHeader.frontier roots i snapshot
  empty := by
    intro l
    change DigestLift ((BuilderRecordsPublic.empty20 roots).val[l.val]!) _
    rw [BuilderRecordsPublic.empty20,BuilderRecordsArray.tabulate_get _ _ _ (by simpa using l.isLt)]
    exact empty l
  frontierCanon := frontier
  emptyCanon := by
    intro l
    change Canon8 ((BuilderRecordsPublic.empty20 roots).val[l.val]!)
    rw [BuilderRecordsPublic.empty20,BuilderRecordsArray.tabulate_get _ _ _ (by simpa using l.isLt)]
    exact emptyCanon l

    (success : @run _ PV_Src_RecordDynamic.dictionary i = ok (.Ok i.compiled))
    (frontier : ∀ l : Fin 20, Canon8 i.snapshot.frontier.val[l.val]!)

    (emptyCanon : ∀ roots, pair_trace.pair_empty_roots = ok roots →
      ∀ l : Fin 20, Canon8 roots.val[l.val]!)

    PubCorr (PV_Src_Forest_PrimitiveArguments.wordPublic r.p)
      (mapPub (K := K) (PV_Src_Public.canonicalPublic (PV_Src_NativeInput.publicInput i))) := by

  subst r

    i.witness (outputValue i.request) (recipient i.request) i.change (forestPublic i.request)

/-! The compiler returns its supplied snapshot on every successful branch.
This discharges the apparent independent-snapshot issue at the successful
caller boundary; no hash or recurrence computation is evaluated. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_Src_ReturnedSnapshot
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open BuilderForestAdmissionPort BuilderForestAdmissionPort.pool_v1
open BuilderRecordsFields

theorem returned_snapshot [ExternalLinear] [Records]
    (input : pair_forest_trace.PoolV1PairForestInputNoteWitnessV1)
    (out : U32) (recipient : Option payment_relation.PoolV1OutputNoteWitnessV1)
    (change : payment_relation.PoolV1OutputNoteWitnessV1)
    (publicInput : pair_forest_trace.ForestPublic)
    (anchor : Array U32 8#usize)
    (snapshot : pair_tree_profile.PoolV1PairLiveSnapshotV1)
    (compiled : pair_forest_trace.PoolV1PairForestMergedC1CompilationV1)
    (h : pair_forest_trace.compile_forest_from_copies input out recipient change
      publicInput anchor snapshot = ok (.Ok compiled)) :
    compiled.public_statement.live_snapshot = snapshot := by
  rcases publicInput with ⟨pubAnchor,pubNullifier,pubRecipient,pubChange,pubAsset⟩
  cases pubRecipient <;> unfold pair_forest_trace.compile_forest_from_copies at h
  all_goals
    repeat' first
      | (pv_peel h with value hvalue)
      | exact False.elim (PV_Src_ResultControl.error_ne_ok _ _ h)
      | exact False.elim (PV_Src_ResultControl.same_residual_ne_ok _ _ h)
      | (have _test : Bool := value; cases value <;> simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at h)
      | (have _test : core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow _ _ := value; cases value)
      | (have _test : _ × _ := value; rcases value with ⟨value,rest⟩)
      | (cases h; rfl)

end R1Z.PV_Src_ReturnedSnapshot

/-! Successful forest compilation returns the very merged bank obtained from
its record object. Only the finite outer control flow is split: no hash,
recurrence cell, or validator computation is evaluated by this proof. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_Src_ForestCompilation
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open BuilderForestAdmissionPort BuilderRecordsFields
open BuilderForestAdmissionPort.pool_v1

/-- Every successful path shares the record object and returned bank. -/
theorem returned_bank [ExternalLinear] [Records]
    (input : pair_forest_trace.PoolV1PairForestInputNoteWitnessV1)
    (out : U32) (recipient : Option payment_relation.PoolV1OutputNoteWitnessV1)
    (change : payment_relation.PoolV1OutputNoteWitnessV1)
    (publicInput : pair_forest_trace.ForestPublic)
    (anchor : Array aspis_core.field.M31 8#usize)
    (snapshot : pair_tree_profile.PoolV1PairLiveSnapshotV1)
    (compiled : pair_forest_trace.PoolV1PairForestMergedC1CompilationV1)
    (h : pair_forest_trace.compile_forest_from_copies input out recipient change
      publicInput anchor snapshot = ok (.Ok compiled)) :
    ∃ records banks,
      pair_forest_copy_builder.CopyRecords.new input out recipient change snapshot
        publicInput.asset = ok records ∧
      pair_forest_copy_builder.CopyRecords.banks records = ok (some banks) ∧
      compiled.semantic_c1.c1 = banks.merged := by
  rcases publicInput with ⟨pubAnchor,pubNullifier,pubRecipient,pubChange,pubAsset⟩
  cases pubRecipient <;> unfold pair_forest_trace.compile_forest_from_copies at h
  all_goals
    pv_peel h with records hr
    refine ⟨records,?_⟩
    repeat' first
      | (pv_peel h with value hvalue; trace "bind")
      | exact False.elim (PV_Src_ResultControl.error_ne_ok _ _ h)
      | exact False.elim (PV_Src_ResultControl.same_residual_ne_ok _ _ h)
      | (have _test : Bool := value; cases value <;> simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at h; trace "bool")
      | (have _test : core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow _ _ := value; cases value; trace "flow")
      | (have _test : _ × _ := value; rcases value with ⟨value,rest⟩; trace "pair")
      | (cases h; trace "end")
    all_goals
      have ho := PV_Src_ResultControl.option_continue (by assumption) (by assumption)
      cases ho
      exact ⟨_, hr, by assumption, rfl⟩


#print axioms returned_bank
end R1Z.PV_Src_ForestCompilation

/-! Identify the merged column returned by the actual CopyRecords.banks
wrapper. This retains its success guard; Parts totality is proved separately.
No record mapper, forest-admission or semantic-validity fact is assumed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_Src_ForestBanks
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open BuilderForestAdmissionPort.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder
open BuilderRecordsFields

theorem merged_run (records : CopyRecords) (banks : CopyBanks)
    (h : CopyRecords.banks records = ok (some banks)) :
    PV_Src_ForestTrace.run records.w records.p = ok banks.merged := by
  unfold CopyRecords.banks at h
  obtain ⟨⟨good,stable,late,merged⟩,hm,h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
  cases good with
  | false => simp at h
  | true =>
    simp only [if_true] at h
    obtain ⟨cs,hs,h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
    obtain ⟨cl,hl,h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
    obtain ⟨cm,hc,h⟩ := bind_ok_inv h
    have he : cm = banks.merged := by
      have h' := Option.some.inj (Result.ok.inj h)
      exact congrArg CopyBanks.merged h'
    rw [PV_Src_ForestTrace.run,hm]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    exact hc.trans (congrArg Result.ok he)

theorem merged_trace {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] [CharP K 2147483647]
    (records : CopyRecords) (banks : CopyBanks)
    (h : CopyRecords.banks records = ok (some banks)) :
    (fun (c : Fin 29) (r : Fin 1024) => R0Z.WriterRefine.liftU (K := K)
      (PV_Src_Forest_Columns.read banks.merged c r)) =
      PV_Src_ForestTrace.trace records.w records.p := by
  funext c r
  change _ = R0Z.WriterRefine.liftU
    (PV_Src_Forest_Columns.read (R0Z.WriterRefine.okOr
      (PV_Src_ForestTrace.run records.w records.p) _) c r)
  rw [merged_run records banks h,R0Z.WriterRefine.okOr_ok]

#print axioms merged_run
#print axioms merged_trace
end R1Z.PV_Src_ForestBanks

def run (w : RW) (p : RP) : Result Columns := do

  BuilderForestAdmissionPort.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.columns merged

theorem run_exact (w : RW) (p : RP) :
    ∃ out, run w p = ok out ∧
      (∀ c, c < 16 → (out.val[c]!).val.length = 1024) ∧
      ∀ c r, PV_Src_Forest_Columns.read out c r = copyCellMerged (wordWitness w) (wordPublic p) c r := by

  rw [run,hb]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  exact hc

def trace {K : Type} [Field K] (w : RW) (p : RP) : R0P.Trace K :=
  fun c r => liftU (PV_Src_Forest_Columns.read
    (okOr (run w p) (Array.repeat 16#usize ⟨[],by simp⟩)) c r)

theorem trace_eq {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] [CharP K 2147483647]

      BuilderRefinement.mergedTrace (wordWitness w) (wordPublic p) := by
  obtain ⟨out,ho,_,hr⟩ := run_exact w p
  funext c r
  change liftU (PV_Src_Forest_Columns.read (okOr (run w p) _) c r) = _
  rw [ho,okOr_ok,hr]
  rfl
