    [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] [CharP K 2147483647]
    (w : RW) (p : RP) (pub : R0P.Public R1J.SpendWitnessMap.F)
    (words : WitnessOk (wordWitness w))

      (BuilderCanonical.rustWitness (BuilderRecordCanonical.witness (wordWitness w)))
      (BuilderCanonical.rustPublic pub) := by
  rw [trace_eq]
  exact BuilderFieldNormalization.trace_normalization _ _ _ words publicCorr

/-! Totality of the actual extracted Parts computation, for arbitrary raw
records. No spend, range, canonicality or callee-success premise is used. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_Src_ForestPartsTotal
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0Z.WriterRefine
open PV_Src_Forest_PrimitiveArguments BuilderStdModels
open BuilderForestAdmissionPort.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder

theorem path_total (bits : Array U32 24#usize)
    (cur l r : Array (Array U32 8#usize) 24#usize) :
    ∃ out, R0WriterCopies.write_path_block bits cur l r = ok out := by
  obtain ⟨out,ho,_⟩ := path_block_loop bits cur l r 24 0#usize
    (Array.repeat 1536#usize 0#u32) (by simp)
  exact ⟨out,ho⟩

theorem sub_total (a b : U32) : ∃ z, R0WriterCopies.m31_sub a b = ok z := by
  rw [R0WriterCopies.m31_sub]
  simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok]
  split <;> exact ⟨_,rfl⟩

theorem value_total (values : Array U32 3#usize) :
    ∃ out, R0WriterCopies.write_value_block values = ok out := by
  obtain ⟨v,hv,_⟩ := value_outer values 3 0#usize (Array.repeat 256#usize 0#u32) (by simp)
  obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := sub_total values.val[0]! values.val[1]!
  have e96 : (Usize.wrapping_mul 6#usize 16#usize).val = 96 := by rw [umul _ _ (by simp)]; simp
  have e97 : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 6#usize 16#usize) 1#usize).val = 97 := by
    rw [uadd _ _ (by rw [e96]; simp),e96]; simp
  have e98 : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 6#usize 16#usize) 2#usize).val = 98 := by
    rw [uadd _ _ (by rw [e96]; simp),e96]; simp
  have e112 : (Usize.wrapping_mul 7#usize 16#usize).val = 112 := by rw [umul _ _ (by simp)]; simp
  have e113 : (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 7#usize 16#usize) 1#usize).val = 113 := by
    rw [uadd _ _ (by rw [e112]; simp),e112]; simp
  rw [R0WriterCopies.write_value_block,hv]
  simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok]
  rw [index_ok values 0#usize (by decide),index_ok values 1#usize (by decide)]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  simp only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
  rw [hz]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [update_ok _ _ _ (by rw [e96]; simp)]
  simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok]
  rw [update_ok _ _ _ (by rw [e97]; simp)]
  simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok]
  rw [update_ok _ _ _ (by rw [e98]; simp)]
  simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok]
  rw [update_ok _ _ _ (by rw [e112]; simp)]
  simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok]
  rw [index_ok values 2#usize (by decide)]
  simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok]
  rw [update_ok _ _ _ (by rw [e113]; simp)]
  exact ⟨_,rfl⟩

theorem aux_total (values : Array U32 3#usize) (input output : R0WriterCopies.OccRecord) :
    ∃ out, R0WriterCopies.write_aux_block values input output = ok out := by
  obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := value_total values
  obtain ⟨i,hi,_⟩ := occ_row v 9#usize (by decide) input
  obtain ⟨o,ho,_⟩ := occ_row i 10#usize (by decide) output
  refine ⟨o,?_⟩
  rw [R0WriterCopies.write_aux_block,hv]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [hi]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  exact ho

theorem parts_total (w : RW) (p : RP) : ∃ pt, parts w p = ok pt := by
  let f := parts.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeArrayU32256
  let g := blockR (wordWitness w) (wordPublic p)
  have hf : ∀ i : Usize, i.val < 57 → f.call_mut (w,p) i = ok (g i.val,(w,p)) := by
    intro i hi
    change parts.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeArrayU32256.call_mut (w,p) i = _
    rw [parts.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeArrayU32256.call_mut,
      PV_Src_Forest_BlockResult.writer_ok w p i hi]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨blocks,hblocks,_⟩ := PV_Src_Forest_BlockCollect.vector_values f g (w,p) hf
  obtain ⟨path,hpath⟩ := path_total w.bits (curArr (wordWitness w) (wordPublic p))
    (leftArr (wordWitness w) (wordPublic p)) (rightArr (wordWitness w) (wordPublic p))
  obtain ⟨output,houtput,_⟩ := PV_Src_Forest_AuxContent.output_record w p
  obtain ⟨aux,haux⟩ := aux_total
    (Array.make 3#usize [w.input_value,w.output_value,w.change_value])
    (PV_Src_Forest_PrimitiveWriters.occRecord (inputRecord w)) (PV_Src_Forest_PrimitiveWriters.occRecord output)
  refine ⟨⟨blocks,path,aux⟩,?_⟩
  unfold parts
  simp only [BuilderForestStdPort.core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator.map.default,iterMap,bind_tc_ok]
  change (do let blocks ← core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator.collect.default (PV_Src_Forest_BankCollect.mapped f)
                (core.iter.traits.collect.FromIteratorVec (Array U32 256#usize)) ⟨⟨0#usize,57#usize⟩,(w,p)⟩
             _) = _
  rw [hblocks]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [PV_Src_Forest_PathContent.arrays]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok,PV_Src_Forest_PrimitiveWriters.write_path_block,hpath]
  rw [in_record,houtput]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok,PV_Src_Forest_PrimitiveWriters.write_aux_block,haux]

/- Namespace port of BuilderBlockCollect: same symbolic proof, actual forest extraction. -/
import R1Z.PV_Src_Forest_BlockResult

/-! Order-preserving collection of the actual 57 block calls. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_Src_Forest_BlockCollect
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0Z.WriterRefine BuilderStdModels BuilderRecordsFields
open BuilderForestAdmissionPort.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder
abbrev Range := core.ops.range.Range Usize

theorem mapped_trace_bounded {C T : Type} (f : core.ops.function.FnMut C Usize T)
    (g : Nat → T) (c : C) (r : Range) (hbound : r.start.val ≤ r.end.val)
    (hend : r.end.val ≤ 57)
    (hf : ∀ i, i.val < 57 → f.call_mut c i = ok (g i.val,c)) :
    FiniteTrace (PV_Src_Forest_BankCollect.mapped f) ⟨r,c⟩
      ((List.range' r.start.val (r.end.val-r.start.val)).map g) := by
  generalize he : r.end.val-r.start.val = remaining
  induction remaining using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing r with
  | h remaining ih =>
    by_cases hlt : r.start.val < r.end.val
    · obtain ⟨after,hn,hs,he'⟩ := PV_Src_Forest_BankRange.next_some r hlt
      have ht := ih (after.end.val-after.start.val) (by rw [he'];omega) after
        (by rw [he'];omega) (by rw [he'];exact hend) rfl
      have hm : (PV_Src_Forest_BankCollect.mapped f).next ⟨r,c⟩ = ok (some (g r.start.val),⟨after,c⟩) := by
        change mapNext _ f ⟨r,c⟩ = _
        rw [mapNext]
        simp only [core.iter.traits.iterator.IteratorRange]
        rw [hn]
        simp only [bind_tc_ok]
        rw [hf r.start (by omega)]
        rfl
      have hlen : remaining = (after.end.val-after.start.val)+1 := by rw [he'] at *;omega

/-! Membership digest arguments and totality. The induction variable is
symbolic; no concrete Merkle path is evaluated. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_Src_Forest_TreeArguments
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0Z.WriterRefine
open PV_Src_Forest_PrimitiveArguments PV_Src_Forest_DigestArguments PV_Src_Forest_AuxContent PV_Src_Forest_DigestTotal
open BuilderForestAdmissionPort.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder

theorem node_total (left right : Array U32 8#usize) : ∃ d, nodeDigestR left right = ok d := by
  obtain ⟨pre,hp,_⟩ := node_pre_loop_spec right 8 0#usize (Array.repeat 16#usize 0#u32) (by simp)
  have hp' : ∃ p, R0BlockCopies.node_pre right = ok p := by
    rw [R0BlockCopies.node_pre,hp]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [index_ok right 7#usize (by decide)]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok,R0BlockCopies.m31_add,lift]
    split <;> simp only [bind_tc_ok] <;> rw [update_ok pre 15#usize _ (by decide)] <;> exact ⟨_,rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨pre,hp⟩ := hp'
  obtain ⟨ab,ha,_⟩ := node_absorb_spec left
  obtain ⟨d,hd⟩ := block_total pre ab
  exact ⟨d,by rw [nodeDigestR,hp];simp only [bind_tc_ok];rw [ha];simp only [bind_tc_ok];exact hd⟩

theorem tree_total (W : RustWitness) (P : RustPublic) (n : Nat) :
    ∃ c, treeCurR W P n = ok c := by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact note_total (chunksOf W P) 3
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨c,hc⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨d,hd⟩ := node_total (orderedR c W.sibs.val[n]! (bitB W n)).1
      (orderedR c W.sibs.val[n]! (bitB W n)).2
    exact ⟨d,by rw [treeCurR,hc];simp only [bind_tc_ok];exact hd⟩

theorem bit (w : RW) (l : Usize) (hl : l.val < 24) :
    bit_b w l = ok (bitB (wordWitness w) l.val) := by
  rw [bit_b,index_ok w.bits l (by simpa using hl)]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok,bitB,wordWitness]
  let x := w.bits.val[l.val]!
  change ok (x != 0#u32) = ok (decide (x.val ≠ 0))
  by_cases hx : x = 0#u32
  · rw [hx];rfl
  · have hv : x.val ≠ 0 := by intro h;apply hx;apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq;simpa using h
    simp [hx,hv]

theorem ordered (cur sib : Array U32 8#usize) (b : Bool) :
    ordered_r cur sib b = ok (orderedR cur sib b) := by
  cases b <;> rfl

theorem tree (w : RW) (p : RP) (n : Usize) (hn : n.val ≤ 24) :
    tree_cur_r w p n = treeCurR (wordWitness w) (wordPublic p) n.val := by
  generalize he : n.val = k
  induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing n with
  | h k ih =>
    rw [tree_cur_r]
    by_cases hz : n.val = 0
    · have hn0 : n = 0#usize := by apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq;simpa using hz
      rw [if_pos hn0,← he,hz]
      exact input_digest w p
    · have hn0 : n ≠ 0#usize := by intro h;apply hz;simpa [h] using congrArg UScalar.val h
      rw [if_neg hn0]
      simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok]
      have hv : (Usize.wrapping_sub n 1#usize).val = n.val-1 :=
        R0Z.WriterRefine.usub _ _ (by simp;omega)
      have hk : (Usize.wrapping_sub n 1#usize).val < k := by omega
      rw [ih _ hk _ (by omega) rfl]
      rw [index_ok_gen w.sibs _ (by rw [hv];simp;omega)]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      rw [bit w _ (by rw [hv];omega)]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok,ordered,node_digest]
      rw [hv]
      conv_rhs => rw [← he,show n.val = (n.val-1)+1 by omega,treeCurR]
      rfl

theorem tree_ok (w : RW) (p : RP) (n : Usize) (hn : n.val ≤ 24) :
    tree_cur_r w p n = ok (okOr (treeCurR (wordWitness w) (wordPublic p) n.val) zero8) := by
  obtain ⟨c,hc⟩ := tree_total (wordWitness w) (wordPublic p) n.val
  rw [tree w p n hn,hc,okOr_ok]

#print axioms node_total
#print axioms tree_total
#print axioms bit
#print axioms ordered
#print axioms tree
#print axioms tree_ok
end R1Z.PV_Src_Forest_TreeArguments

namespace R1Z.PV_Src_Forest_Columns
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0Z.WriterRefine BuilderStdModels

def column (flat : Array U32 16384#usize) (c : Nat) : alloc.vec.Vec U32 :=
  ⟨flat.val.slice (c*1024) ((c+1)*1024),by
    apply (List.slice_length_le _ _ _).trans
    rw [flat.property]
    scalar_tac⟩

theorem column_step (flat : Array U32 16384#usize) (c : Usize) (hc : c.val < 16) :
    columns.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeVecM31.call_mut flat c =
      ok (column flat c.val,flat) := by
  let start := Usize.wrapping_mul c 1024#usize
  let finish := Usize.wrapping_mul (Usize.wrapping_add c 1#usize) 1024#usize
  have vs : start.val = c.val*1024 := by
    dsimp [start]
    rw [umul _ _ (by simp; omega)]
    rfl
  have va : (Usize.wrapping_add c 1#usize).val = c.val+1 := by
    rw [uadd _ _ (by simp; omega)]
    rfl
  have ve : finish.val = (c.val+1)*1024 := by
    dsimp [finish]
    rw [umul _ _ (by rw [va]; simp; omega),va]
    rfl
  have hb : start ≤ finish ∧ finish.val ≤ flat.to_slice.length := by
    change start.val ≤ finish.val ∧ finish.val ≤ flat.val.length
    rw [vs,ve,flat.property]
    simp only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
    omega
  have hs : core.array.Array.index
      (core.ops.index.IndexSlice (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice U32))
      flat ⟨start,finish⟩ = ok (column flat c.val) := by
    change core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice.index
      ⟨start,finish⟩ flat.to_slice = _
    rw [core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice.index]
    dsimp only
    rw [if_pos hb]
    congr 1
    apply Subtype.ext
    change flat.val.slice start.val finish.val = flat.val.slice (c.val*1024) ((c.val+1)*1024)
    rw [vs,ve]
  have ht := BuilderSliceCollect.collect_identity
    columns.closure.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleSharedU32M31
    (by intros; rfl) (column flat c.val) 0 ()
  have ht' : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator.collect.default
      (BuilderForestStdPort.core.iter.adapters.map.Map.Insts.CoreIterTraitsIteratorIterator
        (core.iter.traits.iterator.IteratorSliceIter U32)
        columns.closure.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleSharedU32M31)
      (core.iter.traits.collect.FromIteratorVec U32) ⟨⟨column flat c.val,0⟩,()⟩ =
      ok (column flat c.val) := by
    change core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator.collect.default
      (mappedIterator (core.iter.traits.iterator.IteratorSliceIter U32)
        columns.closure.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleSharedU32M31)
      (core.iter.traits.collect.FromIteratorVec U32) ⟨⟨column flat c.val,0⟩,()⟩ = _
    simpa [BuilderSliceCollect.suffix] using ht
  rw [columns.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeVecM31.call_mut]
  simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok]
  rw [hs]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok,core.slice.Slice.iter,
    BuilderForestStdPort.core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator.map.default,iterMap]
  change (do
    let v ← core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator.collect.default
      (BuilderForestStdPort.core.iter.adapters.map.Map.Insts.CoreIterTraitsIteratorIterator
        (core.iter.traits.iterator.IteratorSliceIter U32)
        columns.closure.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleSharedU32M31)
      (core.iter.traits.collect.FromIteratorVec U32) ⟨⟨column flat c.val,0⟩,()⟩
    ok (v,flat)) = _
  rw [ht']
  rfl

theorem columns_eq (flat : Array U32 16384#usize) :
    columns flat = ok (tabulate 16#usize (column flat)) := by
  rw [columns]
  change fromFn 16#usize columns.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeVecM31 flat = _
  have h := fromFn_bounded 16#usize
    columns.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeVecM31
    (fun c => column flat c.val) flat
    (fun c hc => column_step flat c (by simpa using hc))
  rw [h]
  congr 1

theorem column_length (flat : Array U32 16384#usize) (c : Nat) (hc : c < 16) :
    (column flat c).val.length = 1024 := by
  rw [column,List.slice_length,flat.property]
  simp only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
  omega

theorem column_at (flat : Array U32 16384#usize) (c r : Nat)
    (hc : c < 16) (hr : r < 1024) :
    (column flat c).val[r]! = flat.val[c*1024+r]! := by
  change (flat.val.slice (c*1024) ((c+1)*1024))[r]! = _
  apply List.getElem!_slice
  constructor
  · rw [flat.property]
    simp only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
    omega
  · omega

/-- Read a shipped Vec column, extending the sixteen columns by zero. -/
def read (out : Array (alloc.vec.Vec U32) 16#usize) (c : Fin 29) (r : Fin 1024) : U32 :=
  if c.val < 16 then (out.val[c.val]!).val[r.val]! else 0#u32

theorem read_table (flat : Array U32 16384#usize) (c : Fin 29) (r : Fin 1024) :
    read (tabulate 16#usize (column flat)) c r = PV_Src_Forest_PartsContent.columnCell flat c r := by
  unfold read PV_Src_Forest_PartsContent.columnCell
  by_cases h : c.val < 16
  · rw [if_pos h,if_pos h,tabulate_get _ _ _ (by simpa using h)]
    exact column_at flat c.val r.val h r.isLt
  · rw [if_neg h,if_neg h]

/-- Actual Parts-to-banks-to-Vec composition, conditional only on the
primitive canonical component correspondence that remains to be supplied. -/
theorem source_banks_columns
    (rw : BuilderForestAdmissionPort.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.RW)
    (rp : BuilderForestAdmissionPort.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.RP)
    (pt : BuilderForestAdmissionPort.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.Parts)
    (hp : BuilderForestAdmissionPort.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.parts rw rp = ok pt)
    (w : RustWitness) (p : RustPublic) (hc : PV_Src_Forest_PartsContent.Content pt w p) :
    ∃ merged out,
      BuilderForestAdmissionPort.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_builder.merged_banks rw rp =
        ok (true,PV_Src_Forest_BankMaterialization.stableModel pt,
          PV_Src_Forest_BankMaterialization.lateModel pt,merged) ∧
      columns merged = ok out ∧
      (∀ c, c < 16 → (out.val[c]!).val.length = 1024) ∧
      ∀ c r, read out c r = copyCellMerged w p c r := by
  obtain ⟨merged,hm,hcells⟩ := PV_Src_Forest_PartsContent.banks_columns rw rp pt hp w p hc
  refine ⟨merged,tabulate 16#usize (column merged),hm,columns_eq merged,?_,?_⟩
  · intro c h
    rw [tabulate_get _ _ _ (by simpa using h)]
    exact column_length merged c h
  · intro c r
    rw [read_table]
    exact hcells c r

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0P R0Z.ZkStatement R0Z.WriterRefine R1J.SpendWitnessMap

variable [ExternalLinear] [Records]

def prover {I : Type} (inputs : I → Input) (transport : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) : HonestProver K where
  Instance := I
  «public» := fun i => mapPub (BuilderPublicProjection.semanticPublic
    (PV_Src_Public.output (publicInput (inputs i))))
  build := fun i => columns PV_Src_Forest_Columns.read (inputs i).compiled.semantic_c1.c1
  transport := transport

/-- Exact remaining facts at the extracted compiler boundary. `compile_call`
retains both error layers; all other record predicates concern the same record
returned by the actual constructor. No output-trace correctness is assumed. -/
structure PV_Src_Premises {I : Type} (inputs : I → Input)
    (transport : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) : Prop where
  compile_call : ∀ i, run (inputs i) = ok (.Ok (inputs i).compiled)
  words : ∀ i records, newRecords (inputs i) = ok records →
    WitnessOk (wordWitness records.w)
  publicCorr : ∀ i records, newRecords (inputs i) = ok records →
    PubCorr (wordPublic records.p)

  admission : ∀ i records, newRecords (inputs i) = ok records →
    BuilderSpendRelation.RspendPlus
      (mapPub (K := K) (PV_Src_Public.canonicalPublic (publicInput (inputs i))))
      (BuilderCanonical.liftWitness (BuilderRecordCanonical.witness (wordWitness records.w)))
  row_call : ∀ j, transport j = PV_Src_Transport.row j

/-! The transport computed by the extracted arithmetic reference, with
success and bounds proved before constructing the finite equivalence.
The shipped bitwise callee association is deliberately not inferred here. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_Src_Transport
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0Z.WriterRefine

def index (j : Fin 1024) : Usize := UScalar.ofNatCore j.val (by scalar_tac)

theorem index_val (j : Fin 1024) : (index j).val = j.val :=
  UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq _

def rawRow (j : Fin 1024) : Usize := okOr (AspisBuilderReference.row_arithmetic (index j)) 0#usize

theorem rawRow_val (j : Fin 1024) : (rawRow j).val = AspisR1.rowNat j.val := by
  obtain ⟨out,ho,hv⟩ := BuilderTransport.reference_row (index j)
  rw [index_val] at hv
  rw [rawRow,ho,okOr_ok]
  exact hv

theorem row_success (j : Fin 1024) :
    AspisBuilderReference.row_arithmetic (index j) = ok (rawRow j) := by
  obtain ⟨out,ho,_⟩ := BuilderTransport.reference_row (index j)
  rw [rawRow,ho,okOr_ok]

def row (j : Fin 1024) : Fin 1024 :=
  ⟨(rawRow j).val,by rw [rawRow_val]; exact AspisR1.rowNat_lt _⟩

theorem row_eq (j : Fin 1024) : row j = AspisR1.row j := Fin.ext (rawRow_val j)

def transport : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024 where
  toFun := row
  invFun := row
  left_inv := by intro j; rw [row_eq,row_eq]; exact AspisR1.row_involutive j
  right_inv := by intro j; rw [row_eq,row_eq]; exact AspisR1.row_involutive j

theorem transport_eq : transport = BuilderSource.π := by
  apply Equiv.ext
  exact row_eq

/-- Reduce only the equation's head. Deep decoder continuations are shared
unchanged rather than traversed by a recursive simplifier. -/
elab "pv_head " h:ident : tactic => do
  let (old,ty) ← withMainContext do
    let old ← getFVarId h
    let ty ← instantiateMVars (← old.getType)
    unless ty.isAppOfArity ``Eq 3 do throwError "expected equation"
    let args := ty.getAppArgs
    let lhs ← withTransparency .reducible <| whnf args[1]!
    pure (old,← mkEq lhs args[2]!)
  let goal ← getMainGoal

variable {I A B U : Type}

def iterator (it : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator I A)
    (conv : core.iter.traits.collect.IntoIterator A B U)
    (inner : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator U B) :
    core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator (Flatten I A B U) B where

theorem same_next {S T : Type} (it : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator S T)
    (i j : S) (xs : List T) (hi : FiniteTrace it i xs) (hn : it.next j=it.next i) :
    FiniteTrace it j xs := by
  cases hi with
  | done i i' h => exact .done j i' (hn.trans h)
  | step i i' x xs h tail => exact .step j i' x xs (hn.trans h) tail

theorem inner_trace (it : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator I A)
    (conv : core.iter.traits.collect.IntoIterator A B U)
    (inner : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator U B)
    (i : I) (u : U) (xs ys : List B) (ht : FiniteTrace inner u xs)
    (tail : FiniteTrace (iterator it conv inner) ⟨i,none⟩ ys) :
    FiniteTrace (iterator it conv inner) ⟨i,some u⟩ (xs++ys) := by
  induction ht with
  | done u u' hn =>
    apply same_next _ _ _ _ tail
    exact flattenNext_skip it conv inner i u u' hn
  | step u u' x xs hn ht ih =>
    exact .step _ _ x _ (flattenNext_yield it conv inner i u u' x hn) ih
#print axioms inner_trace

theorem flatten_trace (it : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator I A)
    (conv : core.iter.traits.collect.IntoIterator A B U)
    (inner : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator U B) (contents : A → List B)
    (hc : ∀ a, ∃ u, conv.into_iter a=ok u ∧ FiniteTrace inner u (contents a))
    (i : I) (xs : List A) (ht : FiniteTrace it i xs) :
    FiniteTrace (iterator it conv inner) ⟨i,none⟩ (xs.flatMap contents) := by
  induction ht with
  | done i i' hn => exact .done _ _ (flattenNext_done it conv inner i i' hn)
  | step i i' a xs hn tail ih =>
    obtain ⟨u,hu,ht⟩ := hc a
    have hs := inner_trace it conv inner i' u (contents a) (xs.flatMap contents) ht ih
    apply same_next _ _ _ _ hs

theorem any_trace (it : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator I A)
    (f : core.ops.function.FnMut C A Bool) (g : A → Bool)
    (hf : ∀ c x, f.call_mut c x = ok (g x,c))
    (i : I) (xs : List A) (ht : FiniteTrace it i xs) (c : C) :
    ∃ b after, iterAny it f i c = ok (b,after) ∧

  induction ht generalizing c with

    exact ⟨false,i',any_done it f i i' c h,by simp⟩
  | step i i' x xs hn tail ih =>
    cases hg : g x with
    | true =>

      · simpa only [hg] using hf c x
      · simp only [Bool.true_eq_false,false_iff,List.forall_mem_cons]
        intro h
        have hx := h.1
        rw [hg] at hx
        cases hx
    | false =>
      obtain ⟨b,after,hr,hb⟩ := ih c
      refine ⟨b,after,?_,?_⟩
      · rw [any_continue it f i i' c c x hn (by simpa only [hg] using hf c x)]
        exact hr
      · simpa only [List.forall_mem_cons,hg,true_and] using hb

/-- Structural aggregation only: each of the 57 concrete block certificates

theorem loop (banks : pair_forest_copy_builder.CopyBanks)
    (blocks : ∀ block : Usize, block.val < 57 →
      pair_forest_trace.validate_forest_poseidon_block (columns banks block) block = ok (.Ok ()))

    pair_forest_trace.validate_forest_poseidon_rows_loop banks (.Ok ()) block = ok (.Ok ()) := by
  generalize hremaining : 57-block.val = remaining
  induction remaining using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing block with
  | h remaining ih =>
    rw [pair_forest_trace.validate_forest_poseidon_rows_loop]
    by_cases hlt : block.val < 57
    · rw [if_pos (by simpa [UScalar.lt_equiv] using hlt)]
      simp only [core.result.Result.is_ok,bind_tc_ok,if_true]
      simp only [BuilderForestStdPort.core.ops.range.Range.contains]
      rw [BuilderBankShape.range_usize]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
      by_cases hc : 34 ≤ block.val ∧ block.val < 54
      · simp [hc]
        have hp := blocks block hlt
        simp [columns,hc] at hp
        rw [hp]
        simp only [bind_tc_ok,lift]
        have hv : (Usize.wrapping_add block 1#usize).val = block.val+1 := by
          rw [uadd _ _ (by simp;omega)]
          rfl
        exact ih _ (by omega) _ (by omega) rfl
      · simp [hc]
        have hp := blocks block hlt
        simp [columns,hc] at hp
        rw [hp]
        simp only [bind_tc_ok,lift]
        have hv : (Usize.wrapping_add block 1#usize).val = block.val+1 := by

    (hend : iter.end.val=16) (hs : Canonical state) (hc : Canonical constants1) :
    ∃ out, poseidon2.permute_optimized_with_trace_loop0_loop0 iter state constants1 = ok out ∧
      Canonical out ∧ ∀ j : Fin 16,
        (iter.start.val ≤ j.val → liftU (K := K) out.val[j.val]! =
          R0P.poseidonPow5 (liftU state.val[j.val]! + liftU constants1.val[j.val]!)) ∧
        (j.val < iter.start.val → out.val[j.val]! = state.val[j.val]!) := by
  induction n generalizing iter state with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨state,?_,hs,?_⟩
    · rw [poseidon2.permute_optimized_with_trace_loop0_loop0,
        BuilderBankRange.next_none iter (by omega)]
      rfl
    · intro j
      exact ⟨fun h => False.elim (by have := j.isLt;omega),fun _ => rfl⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    have hi : iter.start.val < 16 := by omega
    obtain ⟨after,hn,ha,he⟩ := BuilderBankRange.next_some iter (by omega)
    obtain ⟨x,hstep,hx,hmodel⟩ := PV_Src_PortSboxStep.initial_step (K := K)
      iter after state constants1 iter.start hi hn hs hc
    obtain ⟨out,hout,hcan,hmeaning⟩ := ih after (state.set iter.start x)
      (by rw [ha];omega) (by rw [he];exact hend)
      (canonical_set state iter.start hi x hx hs)
    refine ⟨out,by rw [hstep,hout],hcan,?_⟩
    intro j
    constructor
    · intro hj
      by_cases same : j.val=iter.start.val
      · rw [(hmeaning j).2 (by rw [ha];omega),
          BuilderRecordsArray.set_get state iter.start x j.val (by simpa using hi),if_pos same]
        simpa only [same] using hmodel
      · rw [(hmeaning j).1 (by rw [ha];omega),
          BuilderRecordsArray.set_get state iter.start x j.val (by simpa using hi),if_neg same]
    · intro hj
      rw [(hmeaning j).2 (by rw [ha];omega),
        BuilderRecordsArray.set_get state iter.start x j.val (by simpa using hi),if_neg (by omega)]

theorem final_loop (n : Nat) (iter : core.ops.range.Range Usize)
    (state constants1 : State) (count : iter.start.val+n=16)
    (hend : iter.end.val=16) (hs : Canonical state) (hc : Canonical constants1) :
    ∃ out, poseidon2.permute_optimized_with_trace_loop2_loop0 iter state constants1 = ok out ∧
      Canonical out ∧ ∀ j : Fin 16,
        (iter.start.val ≤ j.val → liftU (K := K) out.val[j.val]! =
          R0P.poseidonPow5 (liftU state.val[j.val]! + liftU constants1.val[j.val]!)) ∧
        (j.val < iter.start.val → out.val[j.val]! = state.val[j.val]!) := by
  induction n generalizing iter state with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨state,?_,hs,?_⟩
    · rw [poseidon2.permute_optimized_with_trace_loop2_loop0,
        BuilderBankRange.next_none iter (by omega)]
      rfl
    · intro j
      exact ⟨fun h => False.elim (by have := j.isLt;omega),fun _ => rfl⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    have hi : iter.start.val < 16 := by omega
    obtain ⟨after,hn,ha,he⟩ := BuilderBankRange.next_some iter (by omega)
    obtain ⟨x,hstep,hx,hmodel⟩ := PV_Src_PortSboxStep.final_step (K := K)
      iter after state constants1 iter.start hi hn hs hc
    obtain ⟨out,hout,hcan,hmeaning⟩ := ih after (state.set iter.start x)
      (by rw [ha];omega) (by rw [he];exact hend)
      (canonical_set state iter.start hi x hx hs)
    refine ⟨out,by rw [hstep,hout],hcan,?_⟩
    intro j
    constructor
    · intro hj
      by_cases same : j.val=iter.start.val
      · rw [(hmeaning j).2 (by rw [ha];omega),
          BuilderRecordsArray.set_get state iter.start x j.val (by simpa using hi),if_pos same]
        simpa only [same] using hmodel
      · rw [(hmeaning j).1 (by rw [ha];omega),
          BuilderRecordsArray.set_get state iter.start x j.val (by simpa using hi),if_neg same]
    · intro hj
      rw [(hmeaning j).2 (by rw [ha];omega),
        BuilderRecordsArray.set_get state iter.start x j.val (by simpa using hi),if_neg (by omega)]

#print axioms initial_loop
#print axioms final_loop

/-! One symbolic nonlinear cell of each actual external-round loop. The
remaining loop Result is retained exactly; no permutation is evaluated. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_Src_PortSboxStep
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0Z.WriterRefine
open BuilderForestAdmissionPort
abbrev State := Array U32 16#usize

def Canonical (state : State) : Prop :=
  ∀ j : Fin 16, (state.val[j.val]!).val < 2147483647

theorem canonical_set (state : State) (index : Usize) (hi : index.val < 16)
    (x : U32) (hx : x.val < 2147483647) (hc : Canonical state) :
    Canonical (state.set index x) := by
  intro j
  rw [BuilderRecordsArray.set_get state index x j.val (by simpa using hi)]
  split
  · exact hx
  · exact hc j

variable {K : Type} [Field K] [CharP K 2147483647]

theorem initial_step (iter after : core.ops.range.Range Usize)
    (state constants1 : State) (index : Usize) (hi : index.val < 16)
    (next : core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next core.iter.range.StepUsize iter =
      ok (some index,after)) (hs : Canonical state) (hc : Canonical constants1) :
    ∃ x, poseidon2.permute_optimized_with_trace_loop0_loop0 iter state constants1 =
      poseidon2.permute_optimized_with_trace_loop0_loop0 after (state.set index x) constants1 ∧
      x.val < 2147483647 ∧ liftU (K := K) x =
        R0P.poseidonPow5 (liftU state.val[index.val]! + liftU constants1.val[index.val]!) := by
  obtain ⟨sum,hadd,_,haddv⟩ := PV_Src_PortField.addition (K := K)
    state.val[index.val]! constants1.val[index.val]! (hs ⟨index.val,hi⟩) (hc ⟨index.val,hi⟩)
  obtain ⟨x,hpow,hcan,hpowv⟩ := PV_Src_PortField.power (K := K) sum
  refine ⟨x,?_,hcan,by rw [hpowv,haddv]⟩
  rw [poseidon2.permute_optimized_with_trace_loop0_loop0,next]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [index_ok state index (by simpa using hi)]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [index_ok constants1 index (by simpa using hi)]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [hadd]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [hpow]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [BuilderRecordsArray.update_gen _ index _ (by simpa using hi)]
  rfl

theorem final_step (iter after : core.ops.range.Range Usize)
    (state constants1 : State) (index : Usize) (hi : index.val < 16)
    (next : core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next core.iter.range.StepUsize iter =
      ok (some index,after)) (hs : Canonical state) (hc : Canonical constants1) :
    ∃ x, poseidon2.permute_optimized_with_trace_loop2_loop0 iter state constants1 =
      poseidon2.permute_optimized_with_trace_loop2_loop0 after (state.set index x) constants1 ∧
      x.val < 2147483647 ∧ liftU (K := K) x =
        R0P.poseidonPow5 (liftU state.val[index.val]! + liftU constants1.val[index.val]!) := by
  obtain ⟨sum,hadd,_,haddv⟩ := PV_Src_PortField.addition (K := K)
    state.val[index.val]! constants1.val[index.val]! (hs ⟨index.val,hi⟩) (hc ⟨index.val,hi⟩)
  obtain ⟨x,hpow,hcan,hpowv⟩ := PV_Src_PortField.power (K := K) sum
  refine ⟨x,?_,hcan,by rw [hpowv,haddv]⟩
  rw [poseidon2.permute_optimized_with_trace_loop2_loop0,next]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [index_ok state index (by simpa using hi)]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [index_ok constants1 index (by simpa using hi)]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [hadd]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [hpow]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [BuilderRecordsArray.update_gen _ index _ (by simpa using hi)]

/-! Field meaning and canonical outputs of actual nonlinear scalar source.
This supports the root-helper hash correspondence without concrete reduction. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_Src_PortField
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0Z.WriterRefine
open BuilderForestAdmissionPort
variable {K : Type} [Field K] [CharP K 2147483647]

theorem multiply (a b : U32) :
    ∃ z, aspis_core.field.M31.mul a b = ok z ∧ z.val < 2147483647 ∧
      liftU (K := K) z = liftU a * liftU b := by
  let prod := U64.wrapping_mul (UScalar.cast .U64 a) (UScalar.cast .U64 b)
  let z := PV_Src_ScalarReduce.value prod
  have hz : aspis_core.field.M31.mul a b = ok z := by
    unfold aspis_core.field.M31.mul
    simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok]
    change aspis_core.field.M31.reduce_u62 prod = ok z
    rw [PV_Src_PortReduce.source,PV_Src_ScalarReduce.reference_eq]
  obtain ⟨v,hv,hmodel⟩ := R0Z.PoseidonRefine.mul_lift (K := K) a b
  have he : z = v := Result.ok.inj (hz.symm.trans ((PV_Src_PortMultiply.multiply a b).trans hv))
  refine ⟨z,hz,PV_Src_ScalarReduce.canonical prod,?_⟩
  rw [he]
  exact hmodel

theorem power (a : U32) :
    ∃ z, poseidon2.pow5 a = ok z ∧ z.val < 2147483647 ∧
      liftU (K := K) z = R0P.poseidonPow5 (liftU a) := by
  obtain ⟨s,hs,_,hsv⟩ := multiply (K := K) a a
  obtain ⟨t,ht,_,htv⟩ := multiply (K := K) s s
  obtain ⟨u,hu,huc,huv⟩ := multiply (K := K) t a
  refine ⟨u,?_,huc,?_⟩
  · rw [poseidon2.pow5,hs]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [ht]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    exact hu
  · rw [huv,htv,hsv]
    rfl

theorem addition (a b : U32) (ha : a.val < 2147483647) (hb : b.val < 2147483647) :
    ∃ z, aspis_core.field.M31.add a b = ok z ∧ z.val < 2147483647 ∧
      liftU (K := K) z = liftU a + liftU b := by
  obtain ⟨z,hz,hv,hc⟩ := PV_Src_PortAddition.canonical a b ha hb
  refine ⟨z,hz,hc,?_⟩
  unfold liftU
  rw [hv,R0Z.PoseidonRefine.cast_mod,Nat.cast_add]

#print axioms multiply
#print axioms power
#print axioms addition

def value (x : U64) : U32 :=

theorem value_raw (x : U64) : (value x).val = rawReduceU64 x.val := by

  unfold value condSubP

    rw [if_pos h,if_pos (by omega),u32_sub_small _ _ (by simpa using hb),hv]
    rfl
  · have hb : ¬2147483647 ≤ (UScalar.cast .U32 (fold (fold x))).val := by
      simpa only [UScalar.le_equiv,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] using h
    rw [if_neg h,if_neg (by omega),hv]

/-! The release reducer's folds remain in U64. Bounds are symbolic for all
raw U64 inputs; no concrete recurrence term is normalized. -/

namespace R1Z.PV_Src_ScalarFold
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0Z.WriterRefine R0Z.PoseidonRefine
open AspisV8R17.RawReducer

def mask : U64 := UScalar.cast .U64 (2147483647#u32 : U32)
def fold (x : U64) : U64 := U64.wrapping_add (x &&& mask) (U64.wrapping_shr x 31#u32)

theorem mask_value : mask.val = 2147483647 := by rw [mask,c64]; rfl

theorem shift_value (x : U64) : (U64.wrapping_shr x 31#u32).val = x.val >>> 31 := by
  change (U64.wrapping_shr x 31#u32).bv.toNat = _
  rw [U64.wrapping_shr_bv_eq]
  change (x.bv.ushiftRight 31).toNat = _
  exact BitVec.toNat_ushiftRight _ _

theorem fold_value (x : U64) : (fold x).val = foldBits x.val := by
  have hand : (x &&& mask).val = x.val &&& 2147483647 := by rw [UScalar.val_and,mask_value]
  have bound := first_fold_lt x.val x.bv.isLt
  unfold fold
  exact add64v _ _ _ _ hand (shift_value x) (by change foldBits x.val < 18446744073709551616; omega)

theorem narrow_value (x : U64) :
    (UScalar.cast .U32 (fold (fold x))).val = foldBits (foldBits x.val) := by
  have hv : (fold (fold x)).val = foldBits (foldBits x.val) := by rw [fold_value,fold_value]
  rw [c32 _ (by rw [hv]; exact second_fold_lt_two_pow32 x.val x.bv.isLt),hv]

/-! Symbolic recurrence for all fifteen source internal-linear writes.
Each step is named and scalar; this never unfolds a concrete hash recurrence. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_Src_PortInternalLoop
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0Z.WriterRefine
open BuilderForestAdmissionPort PV_Src_PortInternalStep

def steps (n : Nat) (index : Usize) (state : State) (full : U64) : State :=
  match n with
  | 0 => state
  | n+1 => steps n (Usize.wrapping_add index 1#usize)
      (state.set index (cell state full index)) full

theorem loop (n : Nat) (iter : core.ops.range.Range Usize) (state : State)
    (full : U64) (lo : 1 ≤ iter.start.val) (count : iter.start.val+n=16)
    (hend : iter.end.val=16) :
    poseidon2.internal_linear_lazy_loop iter state full =
      ok (steps n iter.start state full) := by
  induction n generalizing iter state with
  | zero =>
    rw [poseidon2.internal_linear_lazy_loop,BuilderBankRange.next_none iter (by omega)]
    rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨after,hn,ha,he⟩ := BuilderBankRange.next_some iter (by omega)
    rw [PV_Src_PortInternalStep.step iter after state full iter.start lo (by omega) hn]
    rw [ih after _ (by rw [ha];omega) (by rw [ha];omega) (by rw [he];exact hend)]
    simp only [steps]
    congr 2
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    rw [ha,BuilderRecordsArray.next_val iter.start (by omega)]

theorem full_loop (state : State) (full : U64) :
    poseidon2.internal_linear_lazy_loop {start := 1#usize, «end» := 16#usize}
      state full = ok (steps 15 1#usize state full) :=
  loop 15 _ state full (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)

/-! Exact one-cell equation for the actual internal linear loop. Arithmetic

namespace R1Z.PV_Src_PortInternalStep
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0Z.WriterRefine
open BuilderForestAdmissionPort
abbrev State := Array U32 16#usize

def cell (state : State) (full : U64) (index : Usize) : U32 :=
  PV_Src_ScalarReduce.value (U64.wrapping_add full
    (U64.wrapping_shl (UScalar.cast .U64 state.val[index.val]!)
      (UScalar.cast .U32 poseidon2.INTERNAL_SHIFTS.val[index.val-1]!)))

theorem canonical (state : State) (full : U64) (index : Usize) :
    (cell state full index).val < 2147483647 :=
  PV_Src_ScalarReduce.canonical _

theorem step (iter after : core.ops.range.Range Usize)
    (state : State) (full : U64) (index : Usize)
    (lo : 1 ≤ index.val) (hi : index.val < 16)
    (next : core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next core.iter.range.StepUsize iter =
      ok (some index,after)) :
    poseidon2.internal_linear_lazy_loop iter state full =
      poseidon2.internal_linear_lazy_loop after
        (state.set index (cell state full index)) full := by
  rw [poseidon2.internal_linear_lazy_loop,next]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [index_ok state index (by simpa using hi)]
  simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok]
  have sub : (Usize.wrapping_sub index 1#usize).val = index.val-1 :=
    BuilderRecordsPath.sub_val index 1#usize (by simpa using lo)
  rw [index_ok_gen poseidon2.INTERNAL_SHIFTS _ (by rw [sub];simp;omega)]
  simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok]
  rw [PV_Src_PortReduce.source,PV_Src_ScalarReduce.reference_eq]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [BuilderRecordsArray.update_gen _ index _ (by simpa using hi)]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok,cell,sub]

/-! The actual checked iterator sum equals a finite source-order fold.
The complete Result is retained, including checked-add failure. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_Src_PortSumTrace
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result BuilderStdModels
variable {I : Type}

def fold : List U64 → U64 → Result U64
  | [], acc => ok acc
  | x::xs, acc => do
    let next ← acc + x
    fold xs next

theorem trace (it : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator I U64)
    (i : I) (xs : List U64) (ht : FiniteTrace it i xs) (acc : U64) :
    BuilderForestStd.sumLoop it i acc = fold xs acc := by
  induction ht generalizing acc with
  | done i i' h =>
    rw [BuilderForestStd.sumLoop,h]
    rfl
  | step i i' x xs h tail ih =>
    rw [BuilderForestStd.sumLoop,h]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok,fold]
    simp only [ih]

      ⟨⟨s,i⟩,()⟩ ((s.val.drop i).map (UScalar.cast .U64)) :=
  mapped_trace _ _ _ (by intro c x; rfl) _ _ (BuilderSliceCollect.slice_trace s i) ()

theorem cast_sum (s : Slice U32) (i : Nat) (acc : U64) :
    BuilderForestStd.sumLoop
      (mappedIterator (core.iter.traits.iterator.IteratorSliceIter U32) castClosure)
      ⟨⟨s,i⟩,()⟩ acc = fold ((s.val.drop i).map (UScalar.cast .U64)) acc :=
  trace _ _ _ (cast_trace s i) acc

theorem steps_canonical (n : Nat) (index : Usize) (state : State) (full : U64)

    (first : state.val[0]!.val < 2147483647) :

/-! Checked source-order summation: the exact arithmetic bound prevents
overflow. No wrapping-add replacement or total-effect premise is used. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_Src_PortSumTotal
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open PV_Src_PortSumTrace

def natSum (xs : List U64) : Nat := (xs.map (fun x => x.val)).sum

theorem total (xs : List U64) (acc : U64)
    (bound : acc.val + natSum xs < 18446744073709551616) :
    ∃ out, fold xs acc = ok out ∧ out.val = acc.val + natSum xs := by
  induction xs generalizing acc with
  | nil => exact ⟨acc,rfl,by simp only [natSum,List.map_nil,List.sum_nil,Nat.add_zero]⟩
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have hb : acc.val + x.val < 18446744073709551616 := by
      simp only [natSum,List.map_cons,List.sum_cons] at bound
      omega
    have hs : (acc + x : Result U64) ⦃ z => z.val = acc.val + x.val ⦄ := by
      apply UScalar.add_spec
      scalar_tac
    obtain ⟨next,hn,hv⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hs
    obtain ⟨out,ho,hov⟩ := ih next (by
      rw [hv]
      simpa only [natSum,List.map_cons,List.sum_cons,Nat.add_assoc] using bound)
    refine ⟨out,?_,?_⟩
    · rw [fold,hn]
      exact ho
    · rw [hov,hv]
      simp only [natSum,List.map_cons,List.sum_cons,Nat.add_assoc]

theorem cast_bound (xs : List U32) :
    natSum (xs.map (UScalar.cast .U64)) ≤ xs.length * 4294967295 := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp only [natSum,List.map_nil,List.sum_nil,List.length_nil,Nat.zero_mul,Nat.le_refl]
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have hx : x.val ≤ 4294967295 := by scalar_tac
    have cast : (UScalar.cast .U64 x).val = x.val := by scalar_tac
    simp only [natSum,List.map_cons,List.sum_cons,List.length_cons] at *
    rw [cast]
    omega

theorem fifteen (xs : List U32) (length : xs.length ≤ 15) :
    ∃ out, fold (xs.map (UScalar.cast .U64)) 0#u64 = ok out ∧
      out.val = natSum (xs.map (UScalar.cast .U64)) := by
  have bound := cast_bound xs
  obtain ⟨out,ho,hv⟩ := total (xs.map (UScalar.cast .U64)) 0#u64 (by
    simp only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
    omega)
  exact ⟨out,ho,by simpa only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq,Nat.zero_add] using hv⟩

#print axioms total
#print axioms cast_bound
#print axioms fifteen
end R1Z.PV_Src_PortSumTotal

theorem shifts_bound (j : Fin 15) :
    (poseidon2.INTERNAL_SHIFTS.val[j.val]!).val ≤ 16 := by

    (hf : full.val < 68719476736) (hs : sh.val ≤ 16) :
    (U64.wrapping_add full (U64.wrapping_shl (UScalar.cast .U64 x) sh)).val =
      full.val + x.val * 2^sh.val := by
  have hsh := shl64 (UScalar.cast .U64 x) sh (by rw [c64];exact u32lt x) hs
  rw [c64] at hsh

    have h1 := Nat.mul_le_mul_left x.val (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide : 1 ≤ (2:Nat)) hs)
    have h2 := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (u32lt x) (by decide : 0 < (2:Nat)^16)
    norm_num only [Nat.reducePow,Nat.reduceMul] at h1 h2
    omega
  exact add64v _ _ _ _ rfl hsh (by omega)

    (lo : 1 ≤ index.val) (hi : index.val < 16) (hf : full.val < 68719476736) :

  have hs := shifts_bound ⟨index.val-1,by omega⟩
  have cast : (UScalar.cast .U32 poseidon2.INTERNAL_SHIFTS.val[index.val-1]!).val =

  unfold cell liftU
  rw [PV_Src_ScalarReduce.modulo,mixed_value full _ _ hf (by rw [cast];exact hs),cast]

not feed earlier lanes back into another cell; full_sum stays fixed. -/

namespace R1Z.PV_Src_PortInternalCells
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0Z.WriterRefine

theorem cell_set_other (state : State) (full : U64) (atIndex index : Usize)
    (value : U32) (ha : atIndex.val < 16) (hne : index.val ≠ atIndex.val) :
    cell (state.set atIndex value) full index = cell state full index := by
  unfold cell
  rw [BuilderRecordsArray.set_get state atIndex value index.val (by simpa using ha),if_neg hne]

    (count : index.val+n=16) (j : Fin 16) :

      if j.val < index.val then state.val[j.val]!
      else cell state full (Usize.ofNatCore j.val (by have := j.isLt;scalar_tac)) := by
  induction n generalizing index state with
  | zero =>
    rw [if_pos (by have := j.isLt;omega)]

    have hi : index.val < 16 := by omega
    have hn := BuilderRecordsArray.next_val index (by omega)

        BuilderRecordsArray.set_get state index _ j.val (by simpa using hi),if_neg (by omega)]

          (by simpa using hi),if_pos he]
        congr 1
        exact UScalar.eq_of_val_eq (by scalar_tac)
      · rw [if_neg (by rw [hn];omega)]

/-! Checked enumeration of a short finite iterator trace. The bound covers
all actual 4/14/4 round-constant groups without normalizing any hash term. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_Src_PortEnumerateTrace
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result BuilderStdModels
variable {I A : Type}

def pairs (xs : List A) (count : Usize) : List (Usize × A) :=
  match xs with
  | [] => []
  | x::tail => (count,x)::pairs tail (Usize.wrapping_add count 1#usize)

abbrev iterator (it : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator I A) :=
  core.iter.traits.iterator.IteratorEnumerate it

theorem trace (it : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator I A) (i : I)

    (bound : count.val+xs.length ≤ 24) :
    FiniteTrace (iterator it) ⟨i,count⟩ (pairs xs count) := by
  induction ht generalizing count with
  | done i i' hn =>
    apply FiniteTrace.done _ ⟨i',count⟩
    change core.iter.adapters.enumerate.IteratorEnumerate.next it ⟨i,count⟩ = _
    rw [core.iter.adapters.enumerate.IteratorEnumerate.next,hn]
    rfl
  | step i i' x xs hn tail ih =>
    have hc : count.val < 24 := by simp only [List.length_cons] at bound;omega
    have hs : (count+1#usize : Result Usize) ⦃ z => z.val=count.val+1 ⦄ := by
      apply UScalar.add_spec
      scalar_tac
    obtain ⟨next,hnext,hval⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hs
    have he : next=Usize.wrapping_add count 1#usize := by
      apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
      rw [hval,BuilderRecordsArray.next_val count hc]
    rw [he] at hnext
    apply FiniteTrace.step _ ⟨i',Usize.wrapping_add count 1#usize⟩ (count,x) (pairs xs _)
    · change core.iter.adapters.enumerate.IteratorEnumerate.next it ⟨i,count⟩ = _
      rw [core.iter.adapters.enumerate.IteratorEnumerate.next,hn]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok,hnext]
    · apply ih
      rw [BuilderRecordsArray.next_val count hc]
      simp only [List.length_cons] at bound
      omega

/-! Mathematical records with the literal public fixture witness constants
from r0_fixture.rs / v7_pair_forest_fixture.rs. The native record/byte mapping
is a separate obligation. Hashes stay symbolic throughout this module. -/

namespace R1Z.PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords
open R0P AspisR1 AspisR1.SpendRelation AspisPool.V7PairLeafOccupancy
abbrev M := R1J.SpendWitnessMap.F

def digest (seed : Nat) : R0P.Digest M := fun i => (seed + 17*i.val + 1 : Nat)

def path : Fin 24 → Bool × R0P.Digest M := fun i =>
  if i.val = 0 then (false,digest 900)
  else if i.val < 21 then
    (decide (((0x54321 : Nat) >>> (i.val-1)) &&& 1 = 1),digest (2000 + 20*(i.val-1)))
  else (decide (i.val ≠ 22),digest (3000 + 100*(i.val-21)))

def pair : PairLeaf M where
  firstCommitment := noteCommitment (ownerKey (digest 10)) 1000 77 (digest 100)
  secondOccupied := 1
  secondCommitment := digest 900
  secondOccupancyInverse := (digest 900 7)⁻¹

def witness (withdrawal : Bool) : Wspend where
  inputValue := ⟨1000,by decide⟩
  outputValue := if withdrawal then ⟨250,by decide⟩ else ⟨600,by decide⟩
  changeValue := if withdrawal then ⟨750,by decide⟩ else ⟨400,by decide⟩
  sk := digest 10
  salt := digest 100
  path := path
  pair := pair
  recipientOwner := digest 300
  recipientSalt := digest 400
  changeOwner := if withdrawal then digest 700 else digest 500
  changeSalt := if withdrawal then digest 800 else digest 600

def base (withdrawal : Bool) : Public M where
  variant := if withdrawal then .withdrawal else .privateTransfer
  anchor := merkleRoot (noteCommitment (ownerKey (digest 10)) 1000 77 (digest 100)) path
  nullifier := nullifierHash (digest 10) (digest 100)
  assetId := 77
  recipient := if withdrawal then none else some
    (noteCommitment (witness withdrawal).recipientOwner (witness withdrawal).outputValue.val
      77 (witness withdrawal).recipientSalt)
  change := noteCommitment (witness withdrawal).changeOwner (witness withdrawal).changeValue.val
    77 (witness withdrawal).changeSalt
  withdrawalAmount := if withdrawal then some 250 else none
  nextPairIndex := 0
  snapshotFrontier := fun i => AppendNode.frozenEmpty i.castSucc
  nextRoot := fun _ => 0
  nextFrontier := fun i => AppendNode.frozenEmpty i.castSucc

def outputPair (withdrawal : Bool) : R0P.Digest M :=
  if withdrawal then nodeCompress (base withdrawal).change (fun _ => 0)
  else nodeCompress (noteCommitment (witness withdrawal).recipientOwner
    (witness withdrawal).outputValue.val 77 (witness withdrawal).recipientSalt)
    (base withdrawal).change

def attachAppend {K : Type} [Field K] (pub : Public K) (pair : R0P.Digest K) : Public K :=
  { pub with
    nextRoot := AppendPath.pathPrefix pub pair 20
    nextFrontier := fun l => if l.val = digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex then
      AppendPath.pathPrefix pub pair l.val else pub.snapshotFrontier l }

theorem prefix_seal {K : Type} [Field K] (pub : Public K) (pair leaf : R0P.Digest K)
    (n : Nat) :
    AppendPath.pathPrefix (attachAppend pub pair) leaf n = AppendPath.pathPrefix pub leaf n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [AppendPath.pathPrefix]
    split
    · rw [ih]
      rfl
    · exact ih

theorem seal_append {K : Type} [Field K] [DecidableEq K]
    (pub : Public K) (pair : R0P.Digest K)
    (output : SpendRelation.outputPair pub = some pair) : AppendBinding (attachAppend pub pair) := by
  refine ⟨pair,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · exact output
  · exact (prefix_seal pub pair pair 20).symm
  · intro hc
    change (if digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex = digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex then
      AppendPath.pathPrefix pub pair (digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex) else _) = _
    rw [if_pos rfl,prefix_seal]
    rfl

def fixturePublic (withdrawal : Bool) : Public M := attachAppend (base withdrawal) (outputPair withdrawal)

theorem pair_valid : pair.Valid := by
  have sentinel : digest 900 7 ≠ 0 := by
    change (1020 : ZMod 2147483647) ≠ 0
    intro zero
    have values := congrArg (fun a : ZMod 2147483647 => a.val) zero
    change 1020 = 0 at values
    omega
  change 1*(1-1) = (0 : M) ∧ digest 900 7 * (digest 900 7)⁻¹ = 1 ∧
    (1-1)*(digest 900 7)⁻¹ = 0 ∧ ∀ lane, (1-1)*digest 900 lane = 0
  simp only [sub_self,mul_zero,zero_mul,mul_inv_cancel₀ sentinel,true_and,implies_true]

theorem input_relation (withdrawal : Bool) :
    InputWitnessCore.Relation (fixturePublic withdrawal) (witness withdrawal).inputValue.val
      (witness withdrawal).sk (witness withdrawal).salt
      (witness withdrawal).path (witness withdrawal).pair where
  valid := pair_valid
  spendable := rfl
  commitment := rfl
  sibling := rfl
  nullifier := rfl
  membership := rfl

theorem append (withdrawal : Bool) : AppendBinding (fixturePublic withdrawal) := by
  apply seal_append
  cases withdrawal <;> rfl

theorem spend (withdrawal : Bool) : Rspend (fixturePublic withdrawal) (witness withdrawal) := by
  refine ⟨?_,input_relation withdrawal,?_,rfl,?_,append withdrawal⟩
  · cases withdrawal
    · exact ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
    · refine ⟨rfl,rfl,?_⟩
      change (some (250 : M)) ≠ some 0
      simpa only [ne_eq,Option.some.injEq] using (show (250 : M) ≠ 0 by
        change (250 : ZMod 2147483647) ≠ 0
        intro zero
        have values := congrArg (fun a : ZMod 2147483647 => a.val) zero
        change 250 = 0 at values
        omega)
  · cases withdrawal <;> decide
  · cases withdrawal <;> rfl

theorem withdrawal_spendPlus : BuilderSpendRelation.RspendPlus (fixturePublic true) (witness true) := by
  refine ⟨spend true,?_⟩
  intro impossible
  cases impossible

/-- Transfer retains precisely the adopted D50 change-sentinel obligation;
no concrete Poseidon recurrence is unfolded to conceal that remaining check. -/
theorem transfer_spendPlus (sentinel : (fixturePublic false).change 7 ≠ 0) :
    BuilderSpendRelation.RspendPlus (fixturePublic false) (witness false) :=
  ⟨spend false,fun _ => sentinel⟩

R1Z.PV_Src_RootCertificate:
import R1Z.PV_Src_RootPrefix
import R1Z.PV_Src_RootSourceEquation

/-! Sound symbolic composition of the twenty-one exact parent hash cells.
The cells remain named hypotheses until independently proved. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_Src_RootCertificate
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open BuilderForestAdmissionPort BuilderForestAdmissionPort.pool_v1
open PV_Src_RootRecurrence PV_Src_RootPrefix

theorem steps_eq [ExternalLinear] (n : Nat) (level : Usize) (roots target : Roots)
    (count : level.val + n = 20)
    (hprefix : Prefix roots target (level.val+1))
    (parents : ∀ l : Fin 20,
      format.pool_v1_tree_parent target.val[l.val]! target.val[l.val]! =
        ok target.val[l.val+1]!) :
    PV_Src_RootRecurrence.steps level n roots = ok target := by
  induction n generalizing level roots with
  | zero =>
    have h : roots = target := BuilderRecordsArray.prefix_done roots target
      (by simpa [show level.val = 20 by omega] using hprefix)
    rw [PV_Src_RootRecurrence.steps,h]
  | succ n ih =>
    have bound : level.val < 20 := by omega
    rw [PV_Src_RootRecurrence.steps,PV_Src_RootPrefix.step target roots level bound hprefix
      (parents ⟨level.val,bound⟩)]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    apply ih
    · rw [BuilderRecordsArray.next_val level (by omega)];omega
    · have h := PV_Src_RootPrefix.extend target roots level bound hprefix
      simpa [BuilderRecordsArray.next_val level (by omega)] using h

theorem source_eq [ExternalLinear] (target : Roots)
    (initial_eq : format.pool_v1_tree_parent
      (Array.repeat 8#usize aspis_core.field.M31.ZERO)
      (Array.repeat 8#usize aspis_core.field.M31.ZERO) = ok target.val[0]!)
    (parents : ∀ l : Fin 20,
      format.pool_v1_tree_parent target.val[l.val]! target.val[l.val]! =
        ok target.val[l.val+1]!) :
    pair_trace.pair_empty_roots = ok target := by
  rw [PV_Src_RootSourceEquation.source,PV_Src_RootSourceEquation.run,initial_eq]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [BuilderRecordsArray.update_gen _ 0#usize _ (by decide)]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  apply steps_eq 20 0#usize _ target (by decide) _ parents
  exact BuilderRecordsArray.prefix_step _ target 0#usize (by decide) (by
    intro j hj; simp only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] at hj; omega)

#print axioms steps_eq
#print axioms source_eq
end R1Z.PV_Src_RootCertificate
R1Z.PV_Src_RootPrefix:
import R1Z.PV_Src_RootRecurrence

/-! Root-array hprefix invariant: only an already proved parent step can extend
it. The parent equality is explicit; it is not an assumed whole loop result. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_Src_RootPrefix
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0Z.WriterRefine
open BuilderForestAdmissionPort BuilderForestAdmissionPort.pool_v1
open PV_Src_RootRecurrence

abbrev Prefix (a target : Roots) (n : Nat) := BuilderRecordsArray.Prefix a target n

theorem step [ExternalLinear] (target roots : Roots) (level : Usize)
    (bound : level.val < 20) (hprefix : Prefix roots target (level.val+1))

import R1Z.BuilderRecordsArray

/-! Symbolic complete-Result recurrence for the actual extracted empty-root
loop. Parent hashes stay opaque; no generated hash cell is reduced. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_Src_RootRecurrence
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0Z.WriterRefine
open BuilderForestAdmissionPort BuilderForestAdmissionPort.pool_v1
abbrev Roots := BuilderRecordsReference.Roots

def step [ExternalLinear] (level : Usize) (roots : Roots) : Result Roots := do
  let a ← Array.index_usize roots level
  let parent ← format.pool_v1_tree_parent a a
  Array.update roots (Usize.wrapping_add level 1#usize) parent

def steps [ExternalLinear] (level : Usize) : Nat → Roots → Result Roots
  | 0, roots => ok roots
  | n+1, roots => do
      let after ← step level roots
      steps (Usize.wrapping_add level 1#usize) n after

theorem loop [ExternalLinear] (n : Nat) (iter : core.ops.range.Range Usize)
    (roots : Roots) (count : iter.start.val + n = iter.end.val)
    (bound : iter.end.val ≤ 20) :
    pair_trace.pair_empty_roots_loop iter roots = steps iter.start n roots := by
  induction n generalizing iter roots with
  | zero =>
    rw [pair_trace.pair_empty_roots_loop,BuilderBankRange.next_none iter (by omega)]
    rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨after,hn,hs,he⟩ := BuilderBankRange.next_some iter (by omega)
    have ha : after.start = Usize.wrapping_add iter.start 1#usize := by
      apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
      rw [BuilderRecordsArray.next_val iter.start (by omega),hs]
    have hi : ∀ r : Roots, pair_trace.pair_empty_roots_loop after r =
        steps (Usize.wrapping_add iter.start 1#usize) n r := by
      intro r
      rw [← ha]
      exact ih after r (by rw [hs,he];omega) (by rw [he];exact bound)
    rw [pair_trace.pair_empty_roots_loop,hn]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok,steps,step,bind_assoc_eq,hi,lift]

#print axioms loop
end R1Z.PV_Src_RootRecurrence

/-! The actual pure root helper is one initial parent hash followed by twenty
source recurrence steps. This source equation keeps every Result outcome.

set_option autoImplicit false

theorem path_total (w : RW) (p : RP) : ∃ b, pathR (wordWitness w) (wordPublic p) = ok b := by
  unfold pathR
  obtain ⟨b,hb,_⟩ := path_block_loop (wordWitness w).bits
    (curArr (wordWitness w) (wordPublic p)) (leftArr (wordWitness w) (wordPublic p))
    (rightArr (wordWitness w) (wordPublic p)) 24 0#usize (Array.repeat 1536#usize 0#u32) (by simp)
  exact ⟨b,by rw [R0WriterCopies.write_path_block];exact hb⟩
#print axioms path_total

theorem aux_total (w : RW) (p : RP) (hw : WitnessOk (wordWitness w)) :
    ∃ b, auxR (wordWitness w) (wordPublic p) = ok b := by
  have hv : ∀ i, i < 3 → ((valuesArr (wordWitness w)).val[i]!).val < 2^30 := by
    intro i hi
    interval_cases i
    · exact hw.values.1
    · exact hw.values.2.1
    · exact hw.values.2.2
  obtain ⟨a,ha,_⟩ := value_block (valuesArr (wordWitness w)) hv
  obtain ⟨b,hb,_⟩ := occ_row a 9#usize (by decide) (inRec (wordWitness w))
  obtain ⟨c,hc,_⟩ := occ_row b 10#usize (by decide) (outRec (wordWitness w) (wordPublic p))
  refine ⟨c,?_⟩
  rw [auxR,R0WriterCopies.write_aux_block,ha]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok,hb,hc]
#print axioms aux_total

theorem tree_loop (d : Array U32 8#usize) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val ≤ 8)
    (hd : Canon8 d) : pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.digest_is_canonical_loop d i = ok true := by
  generalize he : 8-i.val = remaining
  induction remaining using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing i with
  | h remaining ih =>
    rw [pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.digest_is_canonical_loop]
    simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok]
    have hlen : Slice.len (Array.to_slice d) = 8#usize := by
      apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq

    rw [hlen]
    by_cases hit : i.val < 8
    · rw [if_pos (by simpa [UScalar.lt_equiv] using hit),index_ok d i (by simpa using hit)]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      have hnot : ¬d.val[i.val]! ≥ aspis_core.field.P := by
        simp only [UScalar.le_equiv,aspis_core.field.P,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
        exact Nat.not_le.mpr (hd i.val hit)

      exact ih (8-(Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize).val) (by omega)
        (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize) (by omega) rfl
    · rw [if_neg (by simpa [UScalar.lt_equiv] using hit)]

import R1Z.BuilderSliceCollect

/-! Finite enumeration with a checked source counter. The bound20 covers the
actual4/14/4 round tables and rules out counter overflow; no permutation is
unfolded and the underlying Iterator.next trace remains explicit. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_RunJoin_EnumerateTrace
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result BuilderStdModels
variable {I A : Type}

def labels (count : Usize) : List A → List (Usize × A)
  | [] => []
  | x::xs => (count,x) :: labels (Usize.wrapping_add count 1#usize) xs

abbrev enumerated (it : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator I A) :=
  core.iter.traits.iterator.IteratorEnumerate it

theorem checked_next (count : Usize) (hc : count.val < 24) :
    (count + 1#usize : Result Usize) = ok (Usize.wrapping_add count 1#usize) := by
  have hv := BuilderRecordsArray.next_val count hc
  have bound : count.val + (1#usize : Usize).val ≤ Usize.max := by
    change count.val+1 ≤ Usize.max
    rw [← hv]
    scalar_tac
  obtain ⟨z,hz,hzv⟩ : ∃ z : Usize,
      (count+1#usize : Result Usize)=ok z ∧ z.val=count.val+1 := by
    apply WP.spec_imp_exists
    apply UScalar.add_spec
    simpa only [UScalar.max_USize_eq] using bound
  have he : z=Usize.wrapping_add count 1#usize :=
    UScalar.eq_of_val_eq (hzv.trans hv.symm)
  simpa only [he] using hz

theorem trace (it : core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator I A)
    (i : I) (xs : List A) (ht : FiniteTrace it i xs)
    (count : Usize) (bound : count.val+xs.length ≤ 20) :
    FiniteTrace (enumerated it) ⟨i,count⟩ (labels count xs) := by
  induction ht generalizing count with
  | done i i' hn =>
    apply FiniteTrace.done _ ⟨i',count⟩
    simp only [enumerated,core.iter.adapters.enumerate.IteratorEnumerate.next,hn,bind_tc_ok]
  | step i i' x xs hn tail ih =>
    have hc : count.val < 24 := by simp only [List.length_cons] at bound;omega
    have hv := BuilderRecordsArray.next_val count hc
    change FiniteTrace _ _ ((count,x)::labels (Usize.wrapping_add count 1#usize) xs)
    apply FiniteTrace.step _ ⟨i',Usize.wrapping_add count 1#usize⟩
    · simp only [enumerated,core.iter.adapters.enumerate.IteratorEnumerate.next,
        hn,bind_tc_ok,checked_next count hc]
    · apply ih
      rw [hv]
      simp only [List.length_cons] at bound
      omega

  ⟨(PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords.fixturePublic false,PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords.witness false),
    lift_spendPlus _ _ (PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords.transfer_spendPlus sentinel)⟩

theorem withdrawal_public :
    (BuilderSource.prover (K := K)).public withdrawal =
      mapPub (PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords.fixturePublic true) := rfl

theorem transfer_public (sentinel : (PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords.fixturePublic false).change 7 ≠ 0) :
    (BuilderSource.prover (K := K)).public (transfer sentinel) =
      mapPub (PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords.fixturePublic false) := rfl

/-- Explicit remaining fixture laws. These are not discharged by the
canonical constructors. The public equations refer to the actual chosen
statements; the transfer sentinel is the D50 mathematical guard. -/
structure FixturePremises {CommitHandle : Type}
    (transferX withdrawalX : R0Z.ZkStatement.Statement K CommitHandle) : Prop where
  transfer_public_V047 : transferX.1 = mapPub (PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords.fixturePublic false)
  withdrawal_public_V047 : withdrawalX.1 = mapPub (PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords.fixturePublic true)
  transfer_sentinel_V047 : (PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords.fixturePublic false).change 7 ≠ 0

theorem release_fibres {CommitHandle : Type}
    (transferX withdrawalX : R0Z.ZkStatement.Statement K CommitHandle)
    (premises : FixturePremises transferX withdrawalX) :
    ∃ wt ww : (BuilderSource.prover (K := K)).Instance,
      (BuilderSource.prover (K := K)).public wt = transferX.1 ∧
      (BuilderSource.prover (K := K)).public ww = withdrawalX.1 := by
  exact ⟨transfer premises.transfer_sentinel_V047,withdrawal,
    (transfer_public _).trans premises.transfer_public_V047.symm,
    withdrawal_public.trans premises.withdrawal_public_V047.symm⟩

R1Z.PV_RunJoin_SpendRelationMap:
import R1Z.PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap
import R1Z.PV_RunJoin_NoteHashMap
import R1Z.PV_RunJoin_AppendBindingMap

/-! Ring-hom transport for the complete spend relation. This is a coordinate
embedding equivalence for already mapped witnesses; it does not claim that
arbitrary projections preserve witness validity. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_RunJoin_SpendRelationMap
open AspisR1

open R0P AspisPool.V7PairLeafOccupancy SpendRelation

variable {K L : Type} [Field K] [Field L]

theorem map_eq_iff (f : K →+* L) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (x y : K) : f x = f y ↔ x = y := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact hf h
  · intro h
    exact congrArg f h

theorem map_zero_iff (f : K →+* L) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (x : K) : f x = 0 ↔ x = 0 := by
  rw [← map_zero f]
  exact map_eq_iff f hf x 0

theorem digest_injective (f : K →+* L) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    Function.Injective (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f : R0P.Digest K → R0P.Digest L) := by
  intro x y h
  funext i
  exact hf (congrFun h i)

theorem pair_valid_map_iff (f : K →+* L) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (p : PairLeaf K) : (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.pair f p).Valid ↔ p.Valid := by
  rcases p with ⟨firstCommitment, secondOccupied, secondCommitment,
    secondOccupancyInverse⟩
  change
    (f secondOccupied * (f secondOccupied - 1) = 0 ∧
      f (secondCommitment ⟨7, by decide⟩) * f secondOccupancyInverse =
        f secondOccupied ∧
      (1 - f secondOccupied) * f secondOccupancyInverse = 0 ∧
      ∀ lane, (1 - f secondOccupied) * f (secondCommitment lane) = 0) ↔
    (secondOccupied * (secondOccupied - 1) = 0 ∧
      secondCommitment ⟨7, by decide⟩ * secondOccupancyInverse = secondOccupied ∧
      (1 - secondOccupied) * secondOccupancyInverse = 0 ∧
      ∀ lane, (1 - secondOccupied) * secondCommitment lane = 0)
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
    have h1' : f (secondOccupied * (secondOccupied - 1)) = f 0 := by
      simpa [map_sub, map_mul] using h1
    have h2' : f (secondCommitment ⟨7, by decide⟩ * secondOccupancyInverse) =
        f secondOccupied := by simpa [map_mul] using h2
    have h3' : f ((1 - secondOccupied) * secondOccupancyInverse) = f 0 := by
      simpa [map_sub, map_mul] using h3
    refine ⟨(map_eq_iff f hf _ _).mp h1', (map_eq_iff f hf _ _).mp h2',
      (map_eq_iff f hf _ _).mp h3', ?_⟩
    intro lane
    have h4' : f ((1 - secondOccupied) * secondCommitment lane) = f 0 := by
      simpa [map_sub, map_mul] using h4 lane
    exact (map_eq_iff f hf _ _).mp h4'
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
    have h1' : f (secondOccupied * (secondOccupied - 1)) = f 0 := congrArg f h1
    have h2' : f (secondCommitment ⟨7, by decide⟩ * secondOccupancyInverse) =
        f secondOccupied := congrArg f h2
    have h3' : f ((1 - secondOccupied) * secondOccupancyInverse) = f 0 := congrArg f h3
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [map_sub, map_mul] using h1'
    · simpa [map_mul] using h2'
    · simpa [map_sub, map_mul] using h3'
    · intro lane
      have h4' : f ((1 - secondOccupied) * secondCommitment lane) = f 0 :=
        congrArg f (h4 lane)
      simpa [map_sub, map_mul] using h4'

theorem pair_spendable_map_iff (f : K →+* L) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (p : PairLeaf K) (b : Bool) :
    (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.pair f p).SelectedSlotIsSpendable b ↔
      p.SelectedSlotIsSpendable b := by
  cases b with
  | false => simp [PairLeaf.SelectedSlotIsSpendable, PairLeaf.selectedOccupied,
      PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.pair]
  | true =>
      change f p.secondOccupied = 1 ↔ p.secondOccupied = 1
      rw [← map_one f]
      exact map_eq_iff f hf _ _

theorem canonical_map_iff (f : K →+* L) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (pub : Public K) :
    PublicOptionShape.canonical (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) ↔
      PublicOptionShape.canonical pub := by
  cases hv : pub.variant with
  | privateTransfer =>
      cases hr : pub.recipient <;> cases ha : pub.withdrawalAmount <;>
        simp [PublicOptionShape.canonical, PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic, hv, hr, ha,
          map_zero_iff f hf]
  | withdrawal =>
      cases hr : pub.recipient <;> cases ha : pub.withdrawalAmount <;>
        simp [PublicOptionShape.canonical, PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic, hv, hr, ha,
          map_zero_iff f hf]

theorem map_digest_noteCommitment (f : K →+* L)
    (pk : R0P.Digest K) (value asset : K) (salt : R0P.Digest K) :
    PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f (noteCommitment pk value asset salt) =
      noteCommitment (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f pk) (f value)
        (f asset) (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f salt) := by
  change PV_RunJoin_PoseidonMap.mapDigest f (noteCommitment pk value asset salt) = _
  exact PV_RunJoin_NoteHashMap.map_noteCommitment f pk value asset salt

theorem map_digest_ownerKey (f : K →+* L) (sk : R0P.Digest K) :
    PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f (ownerKey sk) = ownerKey (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f sk) := by
  change PV_RunJoin_PoseidonMap.mapDigest f (ownerKey sk) = _
  exact PV_RunJoin_NoteHashMap.map_ownerKey f sk

theorem map_digest_nullifier (f : K →+* L)
    (sk salt : R0P.Digest K) :
    PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f (nullifierHash sk salt) =
      nullifierHash (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f sk) (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f salt) := by
  change PV_RunJoin_PoseidonMap.mapDigest f (nullifierHash sk salt) = _
  exact PV_RunJoin_NoteHashMap.map_nullifierHash f sk salt

theorem map_digest_merkleRoot (f : K →+* L) (leaf : R0P.Digest K)
    (path : Fin 24 → Bool × R0P.Digest K) :
    PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f (merkleRoot leaf path) =
      merkleRoot (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f leaf) (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.path f path) := by
  change PV_RunJoin_PoseidonMap.mapDigest f (merkleRoot leaf path) =
    merkleRoot (PV_RunJoin_PoseidonMap.mapDigest f leaf) (PV_RunJoin_NoteHashMap.mapPath f path)
  exact PV_RunJoin_NoteHashMap.map_merkleRoot f leaf path

theorem relation_map_iff (f : K →+* L) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (pub : Public K) (value : K) (sk salt : R0P.Digest K)
    (path : Fin 24 → Bool × R0P.Digest K) (pair : PairLeaf K) :
    InputWitnessCore.Relation (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) (f value)
      (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f sk) (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f salt)
      (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.path f path) (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.pair f pair) ↔
    InputWitnessCore.Relation pub value sk salt path pair := by
  let d := PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f
  have howner : d (ownerKey sk) = ownerKey (d sk) := by
    simpa [d] using map_digest_ownerKey f sk
  have hnote : d (noteCommitment (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt) =
      noteCommitment (d (ownerKey sk)) (f value) (f pub.assetId) (d salt) := by
    simpa [d] using map_digest_noteCommitment f (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt
  have hroot : ∀ leaf, d (merkleRoot leaf path) =
      merkleRoot (d leaf) (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.path f path) := by
    intro leaf
    simpa [d] using map_digest_merkleRoot f leaf path
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hcommitMap : d (pair.selectedCommitment (path 0).1) =
        d (noteCommitment (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt) := by
      calc
        d (pair.selectedCommitment (path 0).1) =
            (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.pair f pair).selectedCommitment (path 0).1 := by
              cases (path 0).1 <;> rfl
        _ = noteCommitment (ownerKey (d sk)) (f value) (f pub.assetId) (d salt) := h.commitment
        _ = d (noteCommitment (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt) := by
              rw [← howner]
              exact hnote.symm
    have hsiblingMap : d ((path 0).2) =
        d (if (path 0).1 then pair.firstCommitment else pair.secondCommitment) := by
      cases hb : (path 0).1 <;>
        simpa [d, PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.path, PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.pair, hb] using h.sibling
    have hnullifierMap : d pub.nullifier = d (nullifierHash sk salt) := by
      calc
        d pub.nullifier = (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub).nullifier := rfl
        _ = nullifierHash (d sk) (d salt) := h.nullifier
        _ = d (nullifierHash sk salt) := (map_digest_nullifier f sk salt).symm
    have hmembershipMap : d pub.anchor = d (merkleRoot
        (noteCommitment (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt) path) := by
      calc
        d pub.anchor = (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub).anchor := rfl
        _ = merkleRoot
              (noteCommitment (ownerKey (d sk)) (f value) (f pub.assetId) (d salt))
              (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.path f path) := h.membership
        _ = merkleRoot (d (noteCommitment (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt))
              (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.path f path) := by rw [← howner, hnote.symm]
        _ = d (merkleRoot (noteCommitment (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt) path) :=
              (hroot _).symm
    refine ⟨(pair_valid_map_iff f hf pair).mp h.valid,
      (pair_spendable_map_iff f hf pair (path 0).1).mp h.spendable,
      (digest_injective f hf hcommitMap), ?_,
      digest_injective f hf hnullifierMap,
      digest_injective f hf hmembershipMap⟩
    exact digest_injective f hf hsiblingMap
  · intro h
    have hcommitMap : d (pair.selectedCommitment (path 0).1) =
        d (noteCommitment (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt) := congrArg d h.commitment
    have hsiblingMap : d ((path 0).2) =
        d (if (path 0).1 then pair.firstCommitment else pair.secondCommitment) :=
      congrArg d h.sibling
    have hnullifierMap : d pub.nullifier = d (nullifierHash sk salt) :=
      congrArg d h.nullifier
    have hmembershipMap : d pub.anchor = d (merkleRoot
        (noteCommitment (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt) path) :=
      congrArg d h.membership
    have hmappedNote : noteCommitment (ownerKey (d sk)) (f value) (f pub.assetId) (d salt) =
        d (noteCommitment (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt) := by
      rw [← howner]
      exact hnote.symm
    refine ⟨(pair_valid_map_iff f hf pair).mpr h.valid,
      (pair_spendable_map_iff f hf pair (path 0).1).mpr h.spendable,
      ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · calc
          (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.pair f pair).selectedCommitment (path 0).1 =
              d (pair.selectedCommitment (path 0).1) := by cases (path 0).1 <;> rfl
          _ = d (noteCommitment (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt) := hcommitMap
          _ = noteCommitment (ownerKey (d sk)) (f value) (f pub.assetId) (d salt) :=
              hmappedNote.symm
    · calc
        (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.path f path 0).2 = d ((path 0).2) := rfl
        _ = d (if (path 0).1 then pair.firstCommitment else pair.secondCommitment) := hsiblingMap
        _ = if (path 0).1 then (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.pair f pair).firstCommitment
              else (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.pair f pair).secondCommitment := by cases (path 0).1 <;> rfl
    · calc
        (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub).nullifier = d pub.nullifier := rfl
        _ = d (nullifierHash sk salt) := hnullifierMap
        _ = nullifierHash (d sk) (d salt) := map_digest_nullifier f sk salt
    · calc
        (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub).anchor = d pub.anchor := rfl
        _ = d (merkleRoot (noteCommitment (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt) path) := hmembershipMap
        _ = merkleRoot (d (noteCommitment (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt))
              (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.path f path) := hroot _
        _ = merkleRoot (noteCommitment (ownerKey (d sk)) (f value) (f pub.assetId) (d salt))
              (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.path f path) := by rw [hmappedNote.symm]

theorem map_changeCommitment (f : K →+* L)
    (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) :
    PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f (changeCommitment pub w) =
      changeCommitment (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.witness f w) := by
  simpa [changeCommitment, PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic, PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.witness,
    PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest, map_digest_noteCommitment] using
    (map_digest_noteCommitment f w.changeOwner (w.changeValue.val : K)
      pub.assetId w.changeSalt)

theorem map_recipientCommitment (f : K →+* L)
    (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) :
    PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f (recipientCommitment pub w) =
      recipientCommitment (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.witness f w) := by
  simpa [recipientCommitment, PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic, PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.witness,
    PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest, map_digest_noteCommitment] using
    (map_digest_noteCommitment f w.recipientOwner (w.outputValue.val : K)
      pub.assetId w.recipientSalt)

theorem variantOutput_map_iff (f : K →+* L) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) :
    variantOutput (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.witness f w) ↔
      variantOutput pub w := by
  have hd : Function.Injective (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f : R0P.Digest K → R0P.Digest L) :=
    digest_injective f hf
  have hcast : f (w.outputValue.val : K) = (w.outputValue.val : L) := by simp
  cases hv : pub.variant with
  | privateTransfer =>
      cases hr : pub.recipient with
      | none => simp [variantOutput, PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic, hv, hr]
      | some r =>
          simp only [variantOutput, hv, hr, PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic, PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.witness,
            Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq]
          change PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f r =
              recipientCommitment (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.witness f w) ↔
            r = recipientCommitment pub w
          constructor
          · intro h
            apply hd
            calc
              PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f r =
                  recipientCommitment (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.witness f w) := h
              _ = PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f (recipientCommitment pub w) :=
                  (map_recipientCommitment f pub w).symm
          · intro h
            rw [h, map_recipientCommitment]
  | withdrawal =>
      cases ha : pub.withdrawalAmount with
      | none => simp [variantOutput, PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic, hv, ha]
      | some amount =>
          simp only [variantOutput, hv, ha, PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic, PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.witness,
            Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq]
          change f amount = (w.outputValue.val : L) ↔ amount = (w.outputValue.val : K)
          rw [← hcast]
          exact map_eq_iff f hf _ _

theorem rspend_map_iff (f : K →+* L) (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) :
    Rspend (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.witness f w) ↔ Rspend pub w := by
  have hf : Function.Injective f := f.injective
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨hcanonical, hrelation, hbalance, hchange, hvariant, happend⟩
    have hvalue : f (w.inputValue.val : K) = (w.inputValue.val : L) := by simp
    refine ⟨(canonical_map_iff f hf pub).mp hcanonical, ?_,
      ?_, ?_, (variantOutput_map_iff f hf pub w).mp hvariant,
      (PV_RunJoin_AppendBindingMap.appendBinding_map_iff f pub).mp happend⟩
    · have hm := (relation_map_iff f hf pub (w.inputValue.val : K) w.sk w.salt
        w.path w.pair).mp (by simpa [PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.witness, hvalue] using hrelation)
      simpa [PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.witness] using hm
    · simpa [PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.witness] using hbalance
    · apply digest_injective f hf
      calc
        PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f (pub.change) =
            changeCommitment (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.witness f w) := hchange
        _ = PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f (changeCommitment pub w) := (map_changeCommitment f pub w).symm
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨hcanonical, hrelation, hbalance, hchange, hvariant, happend⟩
    have hvalue : f (w.inputValue.val : K) = (w.inputValue.val : L) := by simp
    refine ⟨(canonical_map_iff f hf pub).mpr hcanonical, ?_,
      ?_, ?_, (variantOutput_map_iff f hf pub w).mpr hvariant,
      (PV_RunJoin_AppendBindingMap.appendBinding_map_iff f pub).mpr happend⟩
    · have hm := (relation_map_iff f hf pub (w.inputValue.val : K) w.sk w.salt
        w.path w.pair).mpr hrelation
      simpa [PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.witness, hvalue] using hm
    · simpa [PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.witness] using hbalance
    · calc
        (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub).change = PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f pub.change := rfl
        _ = PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f (changeCommitment pub w) := congrArg (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f) hchange
        _ = changeCommitment (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.witness f w) := map_changeCommitment f pub w
