R1Z.PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap:
import R1Z.PV_RunJoin_FixtureRecords

/-! Explicit coordinate maps for spend data. These definitions work for an
arbitrary scalar function, including the base-coordinate projection. They
do not assert preservation of the spend equations by an arbitrary function. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap
open AspisR1

open R0P AspisPool.V7PairLeafOccupancy SpendRelation
variable {K L M : Type}

def digest (f : K → L) (d : R0P.Digest K) : R0P.Digest L := fun i => f (d i)

def path (f : K → L) (p : Fin 24 → Bool × R0P.Digest K) :
    Fin 24 → Bool × R0P.Digest L := fun i => ((p i).1, digest f (p i).2)

def pair (f : K → L) (p : PairLeaf K) : PairLeaf L :=
  { firstCommitment := digest f p.firstCommitment
    secondOccupied := f p.secondOccupied
    secondCommitment := digest f p.secondCommitment
    secondOccupancyInverse := f p.secondOccupancyInverse }

def witness (f : K → L) (w : Witness K) : Witness L :=
  { inputValue := w.inputValue
    outputValue := w.outputValue
    changeValue := w.changeValue
    sk := digest f w.sk
    salt := digest f w.salt
    path := path f w.path
    pair := pair f w.pair
    recipientOwner := digest f w.recipientOwner
    recipientSalt := digest f w.recipientSalt
    changeOwner := digest f w.changeOwner
    changeSalt := digest f w.changeSalt }

def mapPublic (f : K → L) (p : Public K) : Public L :=
  { variant := p.variant
    anchor := digest f p.anchor
    nullifier := digest f p.nullifier
    assetId := f p.assetId
    recipient := p.recipient.map (digest f)
    change := digest f p.change
    withdrawalAmount := p.withdrawalAmount.map f
    nextPairIndex := p.nextPairIndex
    snapshotFrontier := fun i => digest f (p.snapshotFrontier i)
    nextRoot := digest f p.nextRoot
    nextFrontier := fun i => digest f (p.nextFrontier i) }

theorem witness_id (w : Witness K) : witness id w = w := by
  cases w
  rfl

theorem witness_comp (f : K → L) (g : L → M) (w : Witness K) :
    witness g (witness f w) = witness (g ∘ f) w := by
  rfl

theorem mapPublic_id (p : Public K) : mapPublic id p = p := by
  rcases p with ⟨v, a, n, asset, recipient, change, amount, index, frontier, root, next⟩
  cases recipient <;> cases amount <;> rfl

theorem mapPublic_comp (f : K → L) (g : L → M) (p : Public K) :
    mapPublic g (mapPublic f p) = mapPublic (g ∘ f) p := by
  rcases p with ⟨v, a, n, asset, recipient, change, amount, index, frontier, root, next⟩
  cases recipient <;> cases amount <;> rfl

/-! Ring-hom naturality for the R0 note-hash and 24-level Merkle functions.
These are algebraic transport lemmas only; they do not connect a runtime field
parser or a Rust trace to the generic semantic model. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_RunJoin_NoteHashMap

open R0P R1Z.PV_RunJoin_PoseidonMap

variable {K L : Type} [Field K] [Field L] (f : K →+* L)

theorem map_spongeInit (domain len : K) :
    mapState f (spongeInit domain len) =
      spongeInit (f domain) (f len) := by
  funext lane
  by_cases h8 : lane = 8
  · subst lane
    simp [mapState, spongeInit]
  · by_cases h9 : lane = 9
    · subst lane
      simp [mapState, spongeInit, h8]
    · simp [mapState, spongeInit, h8, h9]

theorem map_absorb (s : State K) (chunk : R0P.Digest K) :
    mapState f (absorb s chunk) =
      absorb (mapState f s) (mapDigest f chunk) := by
  funext lane
  by_cases h : lane.val < 8 <;>
    simp [mapState, mapDigest, absorb, h, map_add]

theorem map_spongeStep (s : State K) (chunk : R0P.Digest K) :
    mapState f (spongeStep s chunk) =
      spongeStep (mapState f s) (mapDigest f chunk) := by
  unfold spongeStep
  rw [map_poseidonPermutation, map_absorb]

theorem map_digestOf (s : State K) :
    mapDigest f (digestOf s) = digestOf (mapState f s) := by
  rfl

theorem map_ownerKey (sk : R0P.Digest K) :
    mapDigest f (ownerKey sk) = ownerKey (mapDigest f sk) := by
  unfold ownerKey
  rw [map_digestOf, map_spongeStep, map_spongeInit]
  simp only [map_ofNat]

theorem map_nullifierHash (sk salt : R0P.Digest K) :
    mapDigest f (nullifierHash sk salt) =
      nullifierHash (mapDigest f sk) (mapDigest f salt) := by
  unfold nullifierHash
  rw [map_digestOf, map_spongeStep, map_spongeStep, map_spongeInit]
  simp only [map_ofNat]

theorem map_noteCommitment (pk : R0P.Digest K) (value asset : K)
    (salt : R0P.Digest K) :
    mapDigest f (noteCommitment pk value asset salt) =
      noteCommitment (mapDigest f pk) (f value) (f asset) (mapDigest f salt) := by
  unfold noteCommitment
  let chunk2K : R0P.Digest K := fun i =>
    if i.val = 0 then value else if i.val = 1 then asset
      else salt ⟨i.val - 2, by omega⟩
  let chunk2L : R0P.Digest L := fun i =>
    if i.val = 0 then f value else if i.val = 1 then f asset
      else mapDigest f salt ⟨i.val - 2, by omega⟩
  let chunk3K : R0P.Digest K := fun i =>
    if h : i.val < 2 then salt ⟨i.val + 6, by omega⟩ else 0
  let chunk3L : R0P.Digest L := fun i =>
    if h : i.val < 2 then mapDigest f salt ⟨i.val + 6, by omega⟩ else 0
  have hchunk2 : mapDigest f chunk2K = chunk2L := by
    funext i
    change f (chunk2K i) = chunk2L i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [chunk2K, chunk2L, mapDigest]
  have hchunk3 : mapDigest f chunk3K = chunk3L := by
    funext i
    change f (chunk3K i) = chunk3L i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [chunk3K, chunk3L, mapDigest]
  change mapDigest f
      (digestOf (spongeStep (spongeStep (spongeStep
        (spongeInit (0x4153_0003 : K) 18) pk) chunk2K) chunk3K)) = _
  rw [map_digestOf, map_spongeStep, map_spongeStep, map_spongeStep,
    map_spongeInit, hchunk2, hchunk3]
  simp only [map_ofNat, chunk2L, chunk3L]

def mapPath (path : Fin 24 → Bool × R0P.Digest K) :
    Fin 24 → Bool × R0P.Digest L :=
  fun level => ((path level).1, mapDigest f (path level).2)

theorem map_merkleStep (cur : R0P.Digest K) (bit : Bool)
    (sibling : R0P.Digest K) :
    mapDigest f (merkleStep cur bit sibling) =
      merkleStep (mapDigest f cur) bit (mapDigest f sibling) := by
  cases bit <;> simp [merkleStep, map_nodeCompress]

theorem map_merkleRootAux (cur : R0P.Digest K)
    (path : Fin 24 → Bool × R0P.Digest K) :
    ∀ n, mapDigest f (merkleRootAux cur path n) =
      merkleRootAux (mapDigest f cur) (mapPath f path) n := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      unfold merkleRootAux
      by_cases h : n < 24
      · simp only [dif_pos h]
        rw [map_merkleStep, ih]
        simp [mapPath]
      · simp only [dif_neg h]
        exact ih

theorem map_merkleRoot (leaf : R0P.Digest K)
    (path : Fin 24 → Bool × R0P.Digest K) :
    mapDigest f (merkleRoot leaf path) =
      merkleRoot (mapDigest f leaf) (mapPath f path) := by
  unfold merkleRoot
  exact map_merkleRootAux f leaf path 24

import R0P.Semantics

/-! Field-homomorphism naturality for the scalar Poseidon model. These lemmas
are purely algebraic: no field characteristic, constant correspondence, or
finite-field computation is assumed. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace R1Z.PV_RunJoin_PoseidonMap

open R0P

variable {K L : Type} [Field K] [Field L] (f : K →+* L)

attribute [local irreducible] poseidonPermutation

abbrev State (K : Type) := Fin 16 → K
abbrev Digest (K : Type) := Fin 8 → K

def mapState (s : State K) : State L := fun i => f (s i)
def mapDigest (d : Digest K) : Digest L := fun i => f (d i)

theorem map_poseidonPow5 (x : K) :
    f (poseidonPow5 x) = poseidonPow5 (f x) := by
  simp [poseidonPow5]

theorem map_poseidonMat4 (s : Fin 4 → K) (i : Fin 4) :
    f (poseidonMat4 s i) = poseidonMat4 (fun i => f (s i)) i := by
  fin_cases i <;> simp [poseidonMat4, map_add]

theorem map_poseidonExternalLinear (s : State K) :
    mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (poseidonExternalLinear s) =
      poseidonExternalLinear (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s) := by
  funext i
  dsimp only [poseidonExternalLinear, mapState]
  simp_rw [map_add, map_zero, map_poseidonMat4]

theorem map_foldl_add (xs : List K) (init : K) :
    f (xs.foldl (· + ·) init) = (xs.map f).foldl (· + ·) (f init) := by
  induction xs generalizing init with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
      simp only [List.foldl_cons, List.map_cons]
      rw [ih, map_add]

theorem map_poseidonInternalLinear (s : State K) :
    mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (poseidonInternalLinear s) =
      poseidonInternalLinear (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s) := by
  funext i
  dsimp only [poseidonInternalLinear, mapState]
  have hxs : (List.ofFn (fun j : Fin 15 => s j.succ)).map f =
      List.ofFn (fun j : Fin 15 => f (s j.succ)) := by
    simp
  by_cases hi : i.val = 0
  · simp only [dif_pos hi, map_sub]
    rw [map_foldl_add, hxs, map_zero]
  · simp only [dif_neg hi, map_add, map_mul, map_natCast]
    rw [map_foldl_add, hxs, map_zero]

theorem map_poseidonFullRound (s c : State K) :
    mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (poseidonFullRound s c) =
      poseidonFullRound (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s)
        (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f c) := by
  unfold poseidonFullRound
  rw [map_poseidonExternalLinear]
  have hinput :
      mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (fun lane => poseidonPow5 (s lane + c lane)) =
        (fun lane => poseidonPow5
          (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s lane + mapState (K := K) (L := L) f c lane)) := by
    funext i
    simp [mapState, map_add, map_poseidonPow5]
  rw [hinput]

theorem map_poseidonInternalRound (s : State K) c :
    mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (poseidonInternalRound s c) =
      poseidonInternalRound (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s) (f c) := by
  unfold poseidonInternalRound
  rw [map_poseidonInternalLinear]
  have hinput :
      mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (fun i =>
        if i = 0 then poseidonPow5 (s 0 + c) else s i) =
      (fun i => if i = 0 then poseidonPow5
        (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s 0 + f c)
        else mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s i) := by
    funext i
    by_cases hi : i = 0
    · subst i
      simp [mapState, map_add, map_poseidonPow5]
    · simp [mapState, hi]
  rw [hinput]

theorem map_poseidonExternalInitial (r : Fin 4) (i : Fin 16) :
    f (poseidonExternalInitial (K := K) r i) =
      poseidonExternalInitial (K := L) r i := by
  fin_cases r <;> fin_cases i <;> exact map_natCast f _

theorem map_poseidonExternalFinal (r : Fin 4) (i : Fin 16) :
    f (poseidonExternalFinal (K := K) r i) =
      poseidonExternalFinal (K := L) r i := by
  fin_cases r <;> fin_cases i <;> exact map_natCast f _

theorem map_poseidonInternalConstants (r : Fin 14) :
    f (poseidonInternalConstants (K := K) r) =
      poseidonInternalConstants (K := L) r := by
  fin_cases r <;> exact map_natCast f _

theorem map_fullRoundFold (cs : List (State K)) (s : State K) :
    mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (cs.foldl poseidonFullRound s) =
      (cs.map (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f)).foldl poseidonFullRound
        (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s) := by
  induction cs generalizing s with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons c cs ih =>
      calc
        mapState (K := K) (L := L) f ((c :: cs).foldl poseidonFullRound s) =
            mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (cs.foldl poseidonFullRound
              (poseidonFullRound s c)) := rfl
        _ = (cs.map (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f)).foldl poseidonFullRound
              (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (poseidonFullRound s c)) := ih _
        _ = (cs.map (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f)).foldl poseidonFullRound
              (poseidonFullRound (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s)
                (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f c)) := by rw [map_poseidonFullRound]
        _ = ((c :: cs).map (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f)).foldl poseidonFullRound
              (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s) := rfl

theorem map_internalRoundFold (cs : List K) (s : State K) :
    mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (cs.foldl poseidonInternalRound s) =
      (cs.map f).foldl poseidonInternalRound (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s) := by
  induction cs generalizing s with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons c cs ih =>
      calc
        mapState (K := K) (L := L) f ((c :: cs).foldl poseidonInternalRound s) =
            mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (cs.foldl poseidonInternalRound
              (poseidonInternalRound s c)) := rfl
        _ = (cs.map f).foldl poseidonInternalRound
              (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (poseidonInternalRound s c)) := ih _
        _ = (cs.map f).foldl poseidonInternalRound
              (poseidonInternalRound (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s) (f c)) := by
                rw [map_poseidonInternalRound]
        _ = ((c :: cs).map f).foldl poseidonInternalRound
              (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s) := rfl

theorem map_poseidonPermutation (s : State K) :
    mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (poseidonPermutation s) =
      poseidonPermutation (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s) := by
  unfold poseidonPermutation
  change mapState (K := K) (L := L) f
      ((List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 4 => poseidonExternalFinal (K := K) r)).foldl
        poseidonFullRound
        ((List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 14 => poseidonInternalConstants (K := K) r)).foldl
          poseidonInternalRound
          ((List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 4 => poseidonExternalInitial (K := K) r)).foldl
            poseidonFullRound (poseidonExternalLinear s)))) =
    (List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 4 => poseidonExternalFinal (K := L) r)).foldl
      poseidonFullRound
      ((List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 14 => poseidonInternalConstants (K := L) r)).foldl
        poseidonInternalRound
        ((List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 4 => poseidonExternalInitial (K := L) r)).foldl
          poseidonFullRound (poseidonExternalLinear (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s))))
  have hi : (List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 4 => poseidonExternalInitial (K := K) r)).map
      (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f) =
      List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 4 => poseidonExternalInitial (K := L) r) := by
    rw [List.map_ofFn]
    exact congrArg List.ofFn (by
      funext r
      exact funext (map_poseidonExternalInitial f r))
  have hc : (List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 14 => poseidonInternalConstants (K := K) r)).map f =
      List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 14 => poseidonInternalConstants (K := L) r) := by
    rw [List.map_ofFn]
    exact congrArg List.ofFn (by
      funext r
      exact map_poseidonInternalConstants f r)
  have hf : (List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 4 => poseidonExternalFinal (K := K) r)).map
      (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f) =
      List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 4 => poseidonExternalFinal (K := L) r) := by
    rw [List.map_ofFn]
    exact congrArg List.ofFn (by
      funext r
      exact funext (map_poseidonExternalFinal f r))
  rw [map_fullRoundFold, hf]
  rw [map_internalRoundFold, hc]
  rw [map_fullRoundFold, hi]
  rw [map_poseidonExternalLinear]

theorem map_nodeCompress (a b : Digest K) :
    mapDigest (K := K) (L := L) f (nodeCompress a b) =
      nodeCompress (mapDigest (K := K) (L := L) f a)
        (mapDigest (K := K) (L := L) f b) := by
  change (fun i : Fin 8 => f (poseidonPermutation (fun l =>
      if h : l.val < 8 then a ⟨l.val, h⟩
      else if l.val = 15 then b 7 - (1051521018 : K)
      else b ⟨l.val - 8, by omega⟩) ⟨i.val, by omega⟩)) = _
  have hinput : mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (fun l =>
      if h : l.val < 8 then a ⟨l.val, h⟩
      else if l.val = 15 then b 7 - (1051521018 : K)
      else b ⟨l.val - 8, by omega⟩) =
    (fun l => if h : l.val < 8 then f (a ⟨l.val, h⟩)
      else if l.val = 15 then f (b 7) - (1051521018 : L)
      else f (b ⟨l.val - 8, by omega⟩)) := by
    funext l
    dsimp only [mapState]
    split_ifs with hlow hlast
    · rfl
    · rw [map_sub]
      exact congrArg (fun z : L => f (b 7) - z) (map_natCast f 1051521018)
    · rfl
  funext i
  let inK : State K := fun l =>
    if h : l.val < 8 then a ⟨l.val, h⟩
    else if l.val = 15 then b 7 - (1051521018 : K)
    else b ⟨l.val - 8, by omega⟩
  let inL : State L := fun l =>
    if h : l.val < 8 then f (a ⟨l.val, h⟩)
    else if l.val = 15 then f (b 7) - (1051521018 : L)
    else f (b ⟨l.val - 8, by omega⟩)
  change mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (poseidonPermutation inK)
      ⟨i.val, by omega⟩ = poseidonPermutation inL ⟨i.val, by omega⟩
  rw [congrFun (map_poseidonPermutation f inK) ⟨i.val, by omega⟩]
  rw [hinput]

/-! Ring-hom naturality for the public append binding. This transports the
public append equations through an injective field map; it adds no statement
about how the public values were produced. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_RunJoin_AppendBindingMap
open AspisR1

open R0P AspisPool.V7PairLeafOccupancy SpendRelation
open R1Z.PV_RunJoin_PoseidonMap

variable {K L : Type} [Field K] [Field L] (f : K →+* L)

theorem digest_injective (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    Function.Injective (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f : R0P.Digest K → R0P.Digest L) := by
  intro x y h
  funext i
  exact hf (congrFun h i)

theorem digest_nodeCompress (a b : R0P.Digest K) :
    PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f (nodeCompress a b) =
      nodeCompress (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f a) (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f b) := by
  change PV_RunJoin_PoseidonMap.mapDigest f (nodeCompress a b) =
    nodeCompress (PV_RunJoin_PoseidonMap.mapDigest f a) (PV_RunJoin_PoseidonMap.mapDigest f b)
  exact PV_RunJoin_PoseidonMap.map_nodeCompress f a b

theorem digest_zero :
    PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f (fun _ : Fin 8 => (0 : K)) =
      (fun _ : Fin 8 => (0 : L)) := by
  funext i
  exact map_zero f

theorem map_frozenEmpty (level : Fin 21) :
    PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f (AppendNode.frozenEmpty (K := K) level) =
      AppendNode.frozenEmpty (K := L) level := by
  funext i
  dsimp [PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest, AppendNode.frozenEmpty]
  exact map_natCast f _

theorem map_step (pub : Public K) (level : Fin 20) (cur : R0P.Digest K) :
    PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f (AppendPath.step pub level cur) =
      AppendPath.step (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) level
        (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f cur) := by
  unfold AppendPath.step
  change
    PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f
      (if digestBitZero pub level then
        nodeCompress cur (AppendNode.frozenEmpty level.castSucc)
       else
        nodeCompress (pub.snapshotFrontier level) cur) =
    (if digestBitZero pub level then
      nodeCompress (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f cur) (AppendNode.frozenEmpty level.castSucc)
     else
      nodeCompress (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f (pub.snapshotFrontier level))
        (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f cur))
  by_cases h : digestBitZero pub level
  · simp only [if_pos h]
    rw [digest_nodeCompress, map_frozenEmpty]
  · simp only [if_neg h]
    exact digest_nodeCompress f _ _

theorem map_pathPrefix (pub : Public K) (leaf : R0P.Digest K) (n : Nat) :
    PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f (AppendPath.pathPrefix pub leaf n) =
      AppendPath.pathPrefix (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub)
        (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f leaf) n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      unfold AppendPath.pathPrefix
      by_cases hn : n < 20
      · simp only [dif_pos hn]
        rw [map_step, ih]
      · simp only [dif_neg hn]
        exact ih

theorem map_outputPair (pub : Public K) :
    outputPair (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) =
      (outputPair pub).map (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f) := by
  cases hv : pub.variant with
  | privateTransfer =>
      cases hr : pub.recipient <;>
        simp [outputPair, PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic, hv, hr,
          digest_nodeCompress]
  | withdrawal =>
      simp [outputPair, PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic, hv,
        digest_nodeCompress, digest_zero]

theorem appendBinding_map_iff (pub : Public K) :
    AppendBinding (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) ↔ AppendBinding pub := by
  have hf : Function.Injective f := f.injective
  have hd : Function.Injective (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f : R0P.Digest K → R0P.Digest L) :=
    digest_injective f hf
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨pairL, hpairL, hrootL, hcarryL⟩
    cases hpair : outputPair pub with
    | none =>
        rw [map_outputPair f pub, hpair] at hpairL
        cases hpairL
    | some pairK =>
        have hpairMapped :
            outputPair (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) =
              some (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f pairK) := by
          rw [map_outputPair f pub, hpair]
          rfl
        have hpairValue : pairL = PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f pairK :=
          Option.some.inj (hpairL.symm.trans hpairMapped)
        refine ⟨pairK, hpair, ?_, ?_⟩
        · apply hd
          calc
            PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f pub.nextRoot =
                (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub).nextRoot := rfl
            _ = AppendPath.pathPrefix (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) pairL 20 := hrootL
            _ = AppendPath.pathPrefix (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub)
                  (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f pairK) 20 := by rw [hpairValue]
            _ = PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f (AppendPath.pathPrefix pub pairK 20) :=
                  (map_pathPrefix f pub pairK 20).symm
        · intro hc
          have hcMapped : digestCarry (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub).nextPairIndex < 20 := by
            simpa [PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic] using hc
          have hfrontier :

                (digestCarry (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub).nextPairIndex) := by
            simpa [PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic] using hcarryL hcMapped
          apply hd

            PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f

              AppendPath.pathPrefix (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub) pairL
                (digestCarry (PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pub).nextPairIndex) := hfrontier

                  (AppendPath.pathPrefix pub pairK (digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex)) :=

    refine ⟨PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.digest f pairK, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩

        simpa [PV_RunJoin_SpendDataMap.mapPublic] using hc

namespace R1Z.PV_RunJoin_PayloadAssociation22

local notation "E" => PV_RunJoin_ShippedExternal.E_shipped

/-- A carrier diagnostic only. This changes caller-supplied cached trace
metadata; it is not the result returned by the compiler on these arguments. -/
def flip : pair_trace.PoolV1PairTraceVariantV1 → pair_trace.PoolV1PairTraceVariantV1
  | .PrivateTransfer => .Withdrawal
  | .Withdrawal => .PrivateTransfer

def altered (i : Input) : Input :=
  {i with compiled := {i.compiled with trace := {i.compiled.trace with variant := flip i.compiled.trace.variant}}}

theorem run_preserved (i : Input) : @run E R (altered i) = @run E R i := rfl
#print axioms run_preserved

theorem public_preserved (i : Input) : publicInput (altered i) = publicInput i := rfl
#print axioms public_preserved

theorem records_preserved (i : Input) :
    PV_RunJoin_UniversalBuild22.records (altered i) = PV_RunJoin_UniversalBuild22.records i := rfl
#print axioms records_preserved

theorem payload_ne (i : Input) : (altered i).compiled ≠ i.compiled := by
  intro same
  have hv := congrArg (fun out : pair_forest_trace.PoolV1PairForestMergedC1CompilationV1 => out.trace.variant) same
  change flip i.compiled.trace.variant = i.compiled.trace.variant at hv
  cases h : i.compiled.trace.variant <;> simp [h,flip] at hv
#print axioms payload_ne

theorem no_return (i : Input) (success : @run E R i = ok (.Ok i.compiled)) :
    @run E R (altered i) ≠ ok (.Ok (altered i).compiled) := by
  intro returned
  rw [run_preserved,success] at returned
  exact payload_ne i (core.result.Result.Ok.inj (Result.ok.inj returned)).symm
#print axioms no_return

variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] [CharP K 2147483647]

theorem admission_preserved (i : Input) :
    PV_RunJoin_UniversalBuild22.Admission (K := K) (altered i) ↔
      PV_RunJoin_UniversalBuild22.Admission (K := K) i := by
  unfold PV_RunJoin_UniversalBuild22.Admission
  rw [public_preserved,records_preserved]
#print axioms admission_preserved

/-- Mathematical admission of raw data cannot by itself imply association of
an arbitrary caller-supplied cached payload with the actual returned result.
This refutes that candidate totality law conditional on any admitted successful
input. It is NOT a counterexample to V153 on actual returned compiler outputs. -/
theorem admission_does_not_fix_payload (i : Input)
    (admitted : PV_RunJoin_UniversalBuild22.Admission (K := K) i)
    (success : @run E R i = ok (.Ok i.compiled)) :
    ∃ j : Input, PV_RunJoin_UniversalBuild22.Admission (K := K) j ∧
      @run E R j ≠ ok (.Ok j.compiled) :=
  ⟨altered i,(admission_preserved i).mpr admitted,no_return i success⟩

import R1Z.PV_RunJoin_UniversalTransition22

namespace R1Z.PV_RunJoin_UniversalCompilerFrame22
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

/-- All successful compiler returns preserve the caller's directions and
value-bit computations, and select the public statement's variant. Neither
fixture output nor a concrete compiler execution is reduced here. -/
theorem payload [ExternalLinear] [Records]
    (input : pair_forest_trace.PoolV1PairForestInputNoteWitnessV1)
    (out : U32) (recipient : Option payment_relation.PoolV1OutputNoteWitnessV1)
    (change : payment_relation.PoolV1OutputNoteWitnessV1)
    (publicInput : pair_forest_trace.ForestPublic) (anchor : Array U32 8#usize)
    (snapshot : pair_tree_profile.PoolV1PairLiveSnapshotV1)
    (compiled : pair_forest_trace.PoolV1PairForestMergedC1CompilationV1)
    (h : pair_forest_trace.compile_forest_from_copies input out recipient change
      publicInput anchor snapshot = ok (.Ok compiled)) :
    compiled.trace.private_directions = BuilderRecordsPath.bits (PV_Src_NativeDirections.reference input) ∧
      compiled.trace.value_bits = Array.make 3#usize [PV_RunJoin_ValueBits20.bits input.pair.value,
        PV_RunJoin_ValueBits20.bits out,PV_RunJoin_ValueBits20.bits change.value] ∧
      compiled.trace.variant = (if publicInput.recipient_commitment.isSome then
        pair_trace.PoolV1PairTraceVariantV1.PrivateTransfer else .Withdrawal) := by
  rcases publicInput with ⟨pubAnchor,pubNullifier,pubRecipient,pubChange,pubAsset⟩
  cases pubRecipient <;> unfold pair_forest_trace.compile_forest_from_copies at h
  all_goals
    have hd := PV_Src_NativeDirections.run_eq input
    unfold PV_Src_NativeDirections.run at hd
    with_unfolding_all rw [hd] at h
    simp only [PV_RunJoin_ValueBits20.source,bind_tc_ok] at h
    repeat' first
      | (pv_peel h with value hvalue)
      | exact False.elim (PV_Src_ResultControl.error_ne_ok _ _ h)
      | exact False.elim (PV_Src_ResultControl.same_residual_ne_ok _ _ h)
      | (have _test : Bool := value; cases value <;> simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at h)
      | (have _test : core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow _ _ := value; cases value)
      | (have _test : _ × _ := value; rcases value with ⟨value,rest⟩)
      | (cases h; exact ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl⟩)
#print axioms payload

theorem native [ExternalLinear] [Records] (i : PV_Src_NativeInput.Input)
    (success : PV_Src_NativeInput.run i = ok (.Ok i.compiled)) :
    i.compiled.trace.private_directions = BuilderRecordsPath.bits (PV_Src_NativeDirections.reference i.witness) ∧
      i.compiled.trace.value_bits = Array.make 3#usize [PV_RunJoin_ValueBits20.bits i.witness.pair.value,
        PV_RunJoin_ValueBits20.bits (PV_Src_NativeInput.outputValue i.request),
        PV_RunJoin_ValueBits20.bits i.change.value] ∧
      i.compiled.trace.variant = (match i.request with
        | .transfer _ _ => pair_trace.PoolV1PairTraceVariantV1.PrivateTransfer
        | .withdrawal _ => .Withdrawal) := by
  have fields := payload i.witness (PV_Src_NativeInput.outputValue i.request)
    (PV_Src_NativeInput.recipient i.request) i.change
    (PV_Src_NativeInput.forestPublic i.request) i.laneAnchor i.snapshot i.compiled success
  refine ⟨fields.1,fields.2.1,?_⟩
  cases hr : i.request <;> simpa [PV_Src_NativeInput.forestPublic,hr] using fields.2.2
#print axioms native
end R1Z.PV_RunJoin_UniversalCompilerFrame22

    (input : pair_forest_trace.PoolV1PairForestInputNoteWitnessV1)
    (out : U32) (recipient : Option payment_relation.PoolV1OutputNoteWitnessV1)
    (change : payment_relation.PoolV1OutputNoteWitnessV1)
    (publicInput : pair_forest_trace.ForestPublic) (anchor : Array U32 8#usize)
    (snapshot : pair_tree_profile.PoolV1PairLiveSnapshotV1)

    (h : pair_forest_trace.compile_forest_from_copies input out recipient change
      publicInput anchor snapshot = ok (.Ok compiled)) :
    compiled.public_statement.candidate_afterstate = compiled.trace.afterstate := by
  rcases publicInput with ⟨pubAnchor,pubNullifier,pubRecipient,pubChange,pubAsset⟩
  cases pubRecipient <;> unfold pair_forest_trace.compile_forest_from_copies at h
  all_goals
    repeat' first
      | (pv_peel h with value hvalue)
      | exact False.elim (PV_Src_ResultControl.error_ne_ok _ _ h)
      | exact False.elim (PV_Src_ResultControl.same_residual_ne_ok _ _ h)
      | (have _test : Bool := value; cases value <;> simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at h)
      | (have _test : core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow _ _ := value; cases value)
      | (have _test : _ × _ := value; rcases value with ⟨value,rest⟩)
      | (cases h; rfl)

/-- Full source transition, including every snapshot and afterstate field,
for every successful native input. No fixtures or whole-run reduction. -/
theorem transition [ExternalLinear] [Records]
    (i : PV_Src_NativeInput.Input)
    (h : PV_Src_NativeInput.run i = ok (.Ok i.compiled)) :
    PV_Src_NativeInput.transition i.compiled.public_statement =
      { live_snapshot := {
          pool := i.snapshot.pool, deployment_domain := i.snapshot.deployment_domain,
          sequence := i.snapshot.sequence, next_pair_index := i.snapshot.next_pair_index,
          current_root := i.snapshot.current_root, frontier := i.snapshot.frontier },
        candidate_afterstate := {
          next_pair_index := i.compiled.trace.afterstate.next_pair_index,
          next_root := i.compiled.trace.afterstate.next_root,
          next_frontier := i.compiled.trace.afterstate.next_frontier } } := by
  have hs := PV_Src_ReturnedSnapshot.returned_snapshot i.witness
    (PV_Src_NativeInput.outputValue i.request) (PV_Src_NativeInput.recipient i.request)
    i.change (PV_Src_NativeInput.forestPublic i.request) i.laneAnchor i.snapshot i.compiled h
  have ha := afterstate i.witness (PV_Src_NativeInput.outputValue i.request)
    (PV_Src_NativeInput.recipient i.request) i.change
    (PV_Src_NativeInput.forestPublic i.request) i.laneAnchor i.snapshot i.compiled h
  unfold PV_Src_NativeInput.transition
  rw [hs,ha]

    simpa only [map_natCast] using Option.some.inj h

  rw [w32_val,v32_val]
  change (v.val : ZMod 2147483647).val = v.val
  rw [ZMod.val_natCast,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by have := v.isLt; omega)]

  | .withdrawal => .withdrawal (PV_Src_PublicRecords.withdrawal i.val.1 pool domain destination)

    simp only [request,hv,PV_Src_NativeInput.outputValue,PV_Src_PublicRecords.withdrawal]

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace R1Z.PV_Src_CheckedEncoding
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0Z.WriterRefine R1J.SpendWitnessMap
open BuilderForestAdmissionPort.pool_v1
abbrev W := AspisR1.SpendRelation.Wspend

def arr3 {α : Type} (f : Fin 3 → α) : Array α 3#usize := ⟨List.ofFn f,by simp⟩

theorem arr3_get {α : Type} [Inhabited α] (f : Fin 3 → α) (l : Nat) (hl : l < 3) :
    (arr3 f).val[l]! = f ⟨l,hl⟩ := by
  show (List.ofFn f)[l]! = _
  rw [List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD,List.getElem?_ofFn,dif_pos hl]
  rfl

def nativeWitness (w : W) (index : U32) : pair_forest_trace.PoolV1PairForestInputNoteWitnessV1 where
  pair := {
    nullifier_key := d32 w.sk
    salt := d32 w.salt
    value := v32 w.inputValue
    pair_leaf := {
      first_commitment := d32 w.pair.firstCommitment
      second_occupied := w32 w.pair.secondOccupied
      second_commitment := d32 w.pair.secondCommitment
      second_occupancy_inverse := w32 w.pair.secondOccupancyInverse }
    selected_second := (w.path 0).1
    membership := {
      siblings := arr20 (fun l => d32 (w.path ⟨l.val+1,by omega⟩).2)
      index := index } }
  super_root_siblings := arr3 (fun l => d32 (w.path ⟨l.val+21,by omega⟩).2)
  super_root_directions := arr3 (fun l => (w.path ⟨l.val+21,by omega⟩).1)

  ⟨d32 w.changeOwner,d32 w.changeSalt,v32 w.changeValue⟩

  ⟨d32 w.recipientOwner,d32 w.recipientSalt,v32 w.outputValue⟩

  .transfer p (recipient w)

  .withdrawal {p with amount := v32 w.outputValue}

def input (w : W) (request : PV_Src_NativeInput.Request) (index : U32)
    (snapshot : pair_tree_profile.PoolV1PairLiveSnapshotV1)
    (compiled : pair_forest_trace.PoolV1PairForestMergedC1CompilationV1)
    (laneAnchor : Array U32 8#usize) : PV_Src_NativeInput.Input :=
  ⟨request,nativeWitness w index,change w,laneAnchor,snapshot,compiled⟩

theorem checked (w : W) (request : PV_Src_NativeInput.Request) (index : U32)
    (snapshot : pair_tree_profile.PoolV1PairLiveSnapshotV1)
    (compiled : pair_forest_trace.PoolV1PairForestMergedC1CompilationV1)

    AspisR1.PublicOptionShape.canonical p := by
  cases hv : p.variant with

    obtain ⟨r,hr,ha⟩ := AspisR1.PublicOptionShape.private_transfer_shape

variable [LaneRoot] [R1Z.BuilderForestAdmissionPort.ExternalLinear] [R1Z.BuilderForestAdmissionPort.Records]

def Path
  (public1 : pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1PrivateTransferPublicV1)
  (witness :
  pool_v1.pair_forest_trace.PoolV1PairForestPrivateTransferWitnessV1)
  (context : pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1PaymentRelationContextV1)
  (snapshot : pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.PoolV1PairLiveSnapshotV1)  : Prop :=
  ∃ r, (
    pool_v1.pair_forest_trace.lane_root witness.input.pair
  ) = ok r ∧
  ∃ cf, (
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r
  ) = ok cf ∧
  match cf with
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
    ∃ r1, (
      pool_v1.payment_relation.validate_pool_v1_private_transfer_public_v1
      { public1 with anchor_root := val }
    ) = ok r1 ∧
    ∃ r2, (
      core.result.Result.map_err (BuiltinFnOnce
      pool_v1.payment_relation.PV30_PoolV1PaymentStatementFormatError
      pool_v1.pair_trace.PV30_PoolV1PairTraceErrorV1) r1
      (pool_v1.pair_trace.PV30_PoolV1PairTraceErrorV1.StatementCtor)
    ) = ok r2 ∧
    ∃ cf1, (
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r2
    ) = ok cf1 ∧
    match cf1 with
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue _ =>
      ∃ pvprcv, (
        pool_v1.pair_forest_trace.temporary_context context val
      ) = ok pvprcv ∧
      ∃ r3, (
        pool_v1.pair_trace.validate_common public1.pool
        public1.deployment_domain public1.anchor_sequence val
        public1.nullifier public1.asset_id witness.input.pair pvprcv
      ) = ok r3 ∧
      ∃ cf2, (
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r3
      ) = ok cf2 ∧
      match cf2 with
      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue _ =>
        ∃ b, (
          core.array.equality.PartialEqArray.ne core.cmp.PartialEqU8
          snapshot.pool public1.pool
        ) = ok b ∧
        if b
        then
          False
        else
          ∃ b1, (
            core.array.equality.PartialEqArray.ne core.cmp.PartialEqU8
            snapshot.deployment_domain public1.deployment_domain
          ) = ok b1 ∧
          if b1
          then
            False
          else
            if witness.recipient.value = 0#u32
            then
              False
            else
              if witness.change.value = 0#u32
              then
                False
              else
                ∃ i, (
                  spend.VALUE_LIMIT
                ) = ok i ∧
                if witness.recipient.value >= i
                then
                  False
                else
                  if witness.change.value >= i
                  then
                    False
                  else
                    ∃ o, (
                      lift (U32.checked_add witness.recipient.value
                      witness.change.value)
                    ) = ok o ∧
                    ∃ b2, (
                      core.option.Option.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqOption.ne
                      core.cmp.PartialEqU32 o (some witness.input.pair.value)
                    ) = ok b2 ∧
                    if b2
                    then
                      False
                    else
                      wp (
                      pool_v1.pair_forest_trace.compile_forest_from_copies
                        witness.input witness.recipient.value (some
                        witness.recipient) witness.change
                        {
                          anchor := public1.anchor_root,
                          nullifier := public1.nullifier,
                          recipient_commitment :=
                            (some public1.recipient_commitment),
                          change_commitment := public1.change_commitment,
                          asset := public1.asset_id
                        } val snapshot
                      ) isRustOk
      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
        False

  | h n ih =>
    rw [incremental_merkle.tree_reference.OwnedTree.append_one_loop,format.POOL_V1_TREE_DEPTH] at h
    by_cases active : level < 20#usize
    · rw [if_pos active] at h

theorem bit_value (index : U64) (level : Usize) (hl : level.val < 64) :
    (BuilderStdModels.shift64 index level &&& 1#u64).val =
      ((index.val >>> level.val) &&& 1) := by
  rw [UScalar.val_and,BuilderStdModels.shift64_spec]
  change ((index.bv.ushiftRight (level.val % 64)).toNat &&& 1) = _
  rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hl]
  rfl
#print axioms bit_value

theorem stop [ExternalLinear] (index : U64) (roots : Roots)
    (frontier final : Frontier) (carry result : Digest) (level finish : Usize)
    (bound : level.val ≤ 20)
    (h : incremental_merkle.tree_reference.OwnedTree.append_one_loop
      index roots frontier carry level = ok (final,result,finish)) :
    finish.val = level.val + R0P.digestTrailingOnes (20-level.val) (index.val >>> level.val) := by
  generalize hn : 20-level.val = n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing frontier carry level with
  | h n ih =>
    rw [incremental_merkle.tree_reference.OwnedTree.append_one_loop,format.POOL_V1_TREE_DEPTH] at h
    by_cases active : level < 20#usize
    · rw [if_pos active] at h
      simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok] at h
      have hl : level.val < 20 := active
      have hbval := bit_value index level (by omega)
      by_cases hb : BuilderStdModels.shift64 index level &&& 1#u64 = 1#u64
      · rw [if_pos hb] at h
        pv_peel h with sibling hs
        pv_peel h with parent hp
        rw [index_ok_gen roots level (by scalar_tac)] at h
        simp only [bind_tc_ok] at h
        rw [BuilderRecordsArray.update_gen frontier level _ (by simpa using hl)] at h
        simp only [bind_tc_ok] at h
        have hnext := BuilderRecordsArray.next_val level (by omega)
        have nextStop := ih (20-(Usize.wrapping_add level 1#usize).val) (by omega)
          _ parent _ (by omega) h rfl
        have hbit : ((index.val >>> level.val) &&& 1) ≠ 0 := by
          rw [hb] at hbval
          simp only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] at hbval
          omega
        rw [nextStop,hnext,← hn]
        rw [show 20-level.val = (20-(level.val+1))+1 by omega,
          R0P.digestTrailingOnes,if_neg hbit]
        rw [Nat.shiftRight_add]
        omega
      · rw [if_neg hb] at h
        have heq := congrArg (fun x : Frontier × Digest × Usize => x.2.2) (Result.ok.inj h)
        change level = finish at heq
        rw [← heq,← hn]
        have hbit : ((index.val >>> level.val) &&& 1) = 0 := by
          have hsmall : ((index.val >>> level.val) &&& 1) ≤ 1 := Nat.and_le_right
          have hne : ((index.val >>> level.val) &&& 1) ≠ 1 := by
            intro he
            apply hb
            apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
            simpa only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] using hbval.trans he
          omega
        rw [show 20-level.val = (20-(level.val+1))+1 by omega,
          R0P.digestTrailingOnes,if_pos hbit,Nat.add_zero]
    · rw [if_neg active] at h
      have heq := congrArg (fun x : Frontier × Digest × Usize => x.2.2) (Result.ok.inj h)
      change level = finish at heq
      rw [← heq,← hn]
      have he : level.val=20 := by change ¬level.val<20 at active; omega
      rw [he]
      rfl

Only cells strictly below the returned level can have been cleared. -/
theorem frame [ExternalLinear] (index : U64) (roots : Roots)
    (frontier final : Frontier) (carry result : Digest) (level stop : Usize)
    (bound : level.val ≤ 20)
    (h : incremental_merkle.tree_reference.OwnedTree.append_one_loop

      ∀ j : Fin 20, stop.val ≤ j.val → final.val[j.val]! = frontier.val[j.val]! := by
  generalize hn : 20-level.val = n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing frontier carry level with
  | h n ih =>
    rw [incremental_merkle.tree_reference.OwnedTree.append_one_loop,

    by_cases active : level < 20#usize
    · rw [if_pos active] at h

      split at h
      · pv_peel h with sibling hs
        pv_peel h with parent hp
        rw [index_ok_gen roots level (by scalar_tac)] at h
        simp only [bind_tc_ok] at h
        have hl : level.val < 20 := by simpa only [UScalar.lt_equiv,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] using active
        rw [BuilderRecordsArray.update_gen frontier level _ (by simpa using hl)] at h

        intro j hj
        rw [nextFrame.2.2 j hj,BuilderRecordsArray.set_get _ _ _ _ (by simpa using hl),if_neg (by omega)]
      · obtain ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl⟩ := Prod.mk.inj (Result.ok.inj h)

    · rw [if_neg active] at h

def fieldFold (sibling : Nat → R0P.Digest K) (reverse : Nat → Bool) :
    List Nat → R0P.Digest K → R0P.Digest K
  | [], current => current
  | level::levels, current =>
      fieldFold sibling reverse levels
        (if reverse level then R0P.nodeCompress (sibling level) current
         else R0P.nodeCompress current (sibling level))

theorem parent_source (left right : Digest) (hc : Canon8 right) :
    ∃ out, BuilderForestAdmissionPort.pool_v1.format.pool_v1_tree_parent left right = ok out ∧
      Canon8 out ∧ digK (K := K) out = R0P.nodeCompress (digK left) (digK right) := by
  obtain ⟨out,ho,hcanonical,hm⟩ := PV_Src_PortNodeResult.source (K := K) left right (hc 7 (by decide))
  exact ⟨out,ho,hcanonical,funext hm⟩
#print axioms parent_source

theorem step_source (current sibling : Digest) (reverse : Bool)
    (hc : Canon8 current) (hs : Canon8 sibling) :
    ∃ out, step BuilderForestAdmissionPort.pool_v1.format.pool_v1_tree_parent
        current sibling reverse = ok out ∧ Canon8 out ∧
      digK (K := K) out =
        (if reverse then R0P.nodeCompress (digK sibling) (digK current)
         else R0P.nodeCompress (digK current) (digK sibling)) := by
  cases reverse with
  | false => exact parent_source current sibling hs
  | true => exact parent_source sibling current hc
#print axioms step_source

theorem fold_source (sibling : Nat → Digest) (reverse : Nat → Bool)
    (levels : List Nat) (current : Digest) (hc : Canon8 current)
    (hs : ∀ level ∈ levels, Canon8 (sibling level)) :
    ∃ out, fold BuilderForestAdmissionPort.pool_v1.format.pool_v1_tree_parent
        sibling reverse levels current = ok out ∧ Canon8 out ∧
      digK (K := K) out = fieldFold (fun level => digK (sibling level)) reverse levels (digK current) := by
  induction levels generalizing current with
  | nil => exact ⟨current,rfl,hc,rfl⟩
  | cons level levels ih =>
    obtain ⟨next,hnext,hn,hm⟩ := step_source (K := K) current (sibling level) (reverse level) hc (hs level (by simp))
    obtain ⟨out,hout,ho,hl⟩ := ih next hn (fun l h => hs l (by simp only [List.mem_cons]; exact Or.inr h))
    refine ⟨out,?_,ho,?_⟩
    · rw [fold,hnext]
      exact hout
    · rw [fieldFold,← hm]
      exact hl
#print axioms fold_source

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
abbrev Digest := Array U32 8#usize

/-- Same two calls and operand order as the frozen lane-root branch. -/
def step (parent : Digest → Digest → Result Digest)
    (current sibling : Digest) (reverse : Bool) : Result Digest :=
  if reverse then parent sibling current else parent current sibling

theorem step_original (parent : Digest → Digest → Result Digest)
    (current sibling : Digest) (zero : Bool) :
    step parent current sibling (!zero) =
      (if zero then parent current sibling else parent sibling current) := by
  cases zero <;> rfl
#print axioms step_original

/-- Full Result recurrence. Neither errors nor failed prefixes are erased. -/
def fold (parent : Digest → Digest → Result Digest)
    (sibling : Nat → Digest) (reverse : Nat → Bool) : List Nat → Digest → Result Digest
  | [], current => ok current
  | level::levels, current => do
      let next ← step parent current (sibling level) (reverse level)
      fold parent sibling reverse levels next

theorem fold_append (parent : Digest → Digest → Result Digest)
    (sibling : Nat → Digest) (reverse : Nat → Bool)
    (xs ys : List Nat) (current : Digest) :
    fold parent sibling reverse (xs++ys) current =
      (do let mid ← fold parent sibling reverse xs current
          fold parent sibling reverse ys mid) := by
  induction xs generalizing current with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons level levels ih =>
    simp only [List.cons_append,fold]
    cases h : step parent current (sibling level) (reverse level) <;>
      simp only [bind_tc_ok,bind_tc_fail,bind_tc_div,ih]
#print axioms fold_append

theorem correct (d : Array U32 8#usize) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val ≤ 8) :
    pair_tree_profile.digest_is_canonical_loop d i = ok (decide (Tail d i.val)) := by
  generalize he : 8-i.val = remaining
  induction remaining using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing i with
  | h remaining ih =>
    rw [pair_tree_profile.digest_is_canonical_loop]
    simp only [Array.to_slice,Slice.len,lift,bind_tc_ok]
    by_cases hlt : i.val < 8
    · rw [if_pos (by simpa [UScalar.lt_equiv] using hlt),index_ok_gen d i (by simpa using hlt)]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      by_cases hc : d.val[i.val]!.val < 2147483647
      · have hn : ¬d.val[i.val]! ≥ aspis_core.field.P := by
          simpa only [UScalar.le_equiv,aspis_core.field.P,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq,not_le] using hc
        rw [if_neg hn]
        have hv := BuilderRecordsArray.next_val i (by omega)
        rw [ih (8-(Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize).val) (by omega)
          (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize) (by omega) rfl]
        have ht : Tail d (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize).val ↔ Tail d i.val := by
          constructor
          · intro h k hk hk8
            by_cases heq : k=i.val
            · simpa only [heq] using hc
            · exact h k (by omega) hk8
          · intro h k hk hk8
            exact h k (by omega) hk8
        rw [propext ht]
      · have hn : d.val[i.val]! ≥ aspis_core.field.P := by
          simpa only [UScalar.le_equiv,aspis_core.field.P,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq,not_lt] using hc
        rw [if_pos hn]
        have ht : ¬ Tail d i.val := fun h => hc (h i.val (by omega) hlt)
        simp only [decide_eq_false ht]
    · rw [if_neg (by simpa [UScalar.lt_equiv] using hlt)]
      have ht : Tail d i.val := by intro k hk hk8; omega
      simp only [decide_eq_true ht]

    pair_tree_profile.digest_is_canonical d = ok true ↔ Canon8 d := by

  simp only [Result.ok.injEq,decide_eq_true_eq,Tail,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
  exact ⟨fun h j hj => h j (Nat.zero_le j) hj,fun h j _ hj => h j hj⟩

deriving instance DecidableEq for r1_wire.Error

/-- Complete derived equality, including payloads on malformed-input errors.
Native comparison is checked separately by the cfg(kani) contract. -/
def equal (a b : r1_wire.Error) : Result Bool :=
  .ok (match a,b with
  | .Allocation,.Allocation => true
  | .RowOrder a b,.RowOrder c d => decide (a=c ∧ b=d)
  | .InvalidRow,.InvalidRow => true
  | .Tag a,.Tag b => decide (a=b)
  | .Length a,.Length b => decide (a=b)
  | .NonCanonical a b,.NonCanonical c d => decide (a=c ∧ b=d)
  | .Boundary a,.Boundary b => decide (a=b)
  | .Terminal,.Terminal => true
  | .EqualCirclePoints,.EqualCirclePoints => true
  | .TrailingBytes,.TrailingBytes => true
  | .Public,.Public => true
  | .ActivePole,.ActivePole => true
  | _,_ => false)

theorem exact (a b : r1_wire.Error) : equal a b = .ok (decide (a=b)) := by
  cases a <;> cases b <;> simp [equal]

  { ProverRwDictionaryDomain.selected ops with op256 := equal }

def toC (x : C) : NC := ⟨x.a,x.b⟩

def toQ (x : Q) : NQ := ⟨toC x.c0,toC x.c1⟩

def toW (x : W) : NW := ⟨toQ x.c0,toQ x.c1⟩

  | .fail e => .fail e
  | .div => .div

theorem mapResult_bind {A B : Type} (f : A → B) (r : Result A) :
    mapResult f r = (do let x ← r; .ok (f x)) := by cases r <;> rfl

      simp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry,map_bind,map_if,map_ok,lift,bind_tc_ok,outcome,core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch]

import R1Z.ProverRwFullFuns

/-! A concrete obstruction to an unrestricted fixed-tape interpretation of
getrandom.fill by the current pure external signature. This does not refute
privacy or an effectful / suitably proved observational refinement. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverRwEntropyObstruction
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ProverRwFull

def zeroInput : Slice U8 := Array.to_slice (Array.repeat 64#usize 0#u8)
def oneOutput : Slice U8 := Array.to_slice (Array.repeat 64#usize 1#u8)

theorem distinct : zeroInput ≠ oneOutput := by
  intro h
  have head := congrArg (fun s : Slice U8 => s.val.head?) h
  have bad : (0#u8) = (1#u8) := Option.some.inj head
  have value := congrArg (fun b : U8 => b.val) bad
  change 0 = 1 at value
  omega

/-- Every entropy retry starts with zeroInput again. A fixed pure dictionary
cannot return the first zero tape block and the second nonzero tape block at
that identical input. Such a two-draw tape is admitted by raw E1 sampling. -/
theorem no_two_draw_dictionary [ExternalTypes] (ops : ExternalFuns) :
    ¬ (@getrandom.fill _ ops zeroInput = ok (.Ok (),zeroInput) ∧
       @getrandom.fill _ ops zeroInput = ok (.Ok (),oneOutput)) := by
  rintro ⟨first,second⟩
  have returned := Result.ok.inj (first.symm.trans second)
  exact distinct (congrArg Prod.snd returned)

/-- A stateful two-block policy represents those same draws with no paradox:
the supplied cursor advances, even though the input buffer is identical. -/
def draw (cursor : Nat) (_ : Slice U8) : Slice U8 × Nat :=
  (if cursor=0 then zeroInput else oneOutput,cursor+1)

theorem effectful_two_draws :
    draw 0 zeroInput = (zeroInput,1) ∧ draw 1 zeroInput = (oneOutput,2) := by
  constructor <;> rfl

#print axioms distinct
#print axioms no_two_draw_dictionary
#print axioms effectful_two_draws
end R1Z.ProverRwEntropyObstruction

  | stop s _ => rfl
  | next s next final word words k _ _ _ model _ ih =>
    rw [List.map_cons,scan_cons_of_one _ _ _ _ model]

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ProverRwFull ProverRwQueryScan ProverRwQueryWord
open ProverRwQueryWordTotal ProverRwQueryTransition Query31ExplicitScanBody

inductive Chain (blocks : Blocks) : CurrentScan → List U32 → CurrentScan → Prop
  | stop (s : CurrentScan) : (s.accepted_len=22#usize ∨ s.draws=64#usize) → Chain blocks s [] s
  | next (s next final : CurrentScan) (word : U32) (words : List U32) (k : Usize) :
      (s.draws / 8#usize : Result Usize)=ok k →
      readWord blocks k s.draws=ok word →
      advance s word=ok next →
      AspisV8R19.Q22WordScan.scan (q22StateOf s) [word.val]=(q22StateOf next,false) →
      Chain blocks next words final → Chain blocks s (word::words) final

def finish (advances : Blocks) (s : CurrentScan) : Result Output := do
  if s.accepted_len=22#usize then
    if s.draws=64#usize then
      let a ← Array.index_usize advances 7#usize
      ok (.Ok (s.accepted,a))
    else
      let k ← s.draws / 8#usize
      let a ← Array.index_usize advances k
      ok (.Ok (s.accepted,a))
  else ok (.Err verifier.Error.Transcript)

theorem execute (blocks advances : Blocks) (fuel : Nat) (s : CurrentScan)
    (hlen : s.accepted_len.val≤22) (bound : s.draws.val+fuel=64) :
    ∃ words final output,
      host_transcript.scan_query_words blocks advances s.accepted s.accepted_len s.draws=ok output ∧
      Chain blocks s words final ∧ final.accepted_len.val≤22 ∧ final.draws.val≤64 ∧
      finish advances final=ok output := by
  induction fuel generalizing s with
  | zero =>
    have cap : s.draws=64#usize := by apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq; change s.draws.val=64; omega
    have src := source_factored blocks advances s.accepted s.accepted_len s.draws
    by_cases full : s.accepted_len=22#usize
    · have ha := ProverCommitArrayIndex25.array_index_usize_ok advances 7#usize (by decide)
      refine ⟨[],s,.Ok (s.accepted,advances.val[(7#usize).val]'(by simpa [advances.property] using (show (7#usize).val < (8#usize).val by decide))),?_,.stop s (Or.inr cap),hlen,by omega,?_⟩
      · rw [src]; simp only [factored,cap,full,if_true,ha,bind_tc_ok]
      · simp only [finish,cap,full,if_true,ha,bind_tc_ok]
    · refine ⟨[],s,.Err verifier.Error.Transcript,?_,.stop s (Or.inr cap),hlen,by omega,?_⟩
      · rw [src]; simp only [factored,cap,full,if_true,if_false]
      · simp only [finish,full,if_false]
  | succ fuel ih =>
    have hd : s.draws.val<64 := by omega
    have cap : s.draws≠64#usize := by intro he; have hv := congrArg UScalar.val he; change s.draws.val=64 at hv; omega
    obtain ⟨k,hk,hkv⟩ := division_total s.draws hd
    by_cases full : s.accepted_len=22#usize
    · have ha := ProverCommitArrayIndex25.array_index_usize_ok advances k (by exact hkv)
      refine ⟨[],s,.Ok (s.accepted,advances.val[k.val]'(by simpa [advances.property] using hkv)),?_,.stop s (Or.inl full),hlen,by omega,?_⟩
      · rw [source_factored]; simp only [factored,cap,full,if_false,if_true,hk,ha,bind_tc_ok]
      · simp only [finish,cap,full,if_false,if_true,hk,ha,bind_tc_ok]
    · have active : s.accepted_len.val<22 := by
        have ne : s.accepted_len.val≠22 := by intro he; apply full; apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq; exact he
        omega
      obtain ⟨word,hw⟩ := read_total blocks k s.draws hkv
      obtain ⟨next,hn,hnlen,hndraw,hmodel⟩ := advance_q22 s word active hd
      obtain ⟨words,final,output,hr,hchain,hfl,hfd,hfinish⟩ := ih next hnlen (by omega)
      refine ⟨word::words,final,output,?_,.next s next final word words k hk hw hn hmodel hchain,hfl,hfd,hfinish⟩
      rw [source_factored]
      simp only [factored,cap,full,if_false,hk,bind_tc_ok,hw,hn]
      exact hr

theorem queries_execute (blocks advances : Blocks) :
    ∃ words final output,
      host_transcript.queries_from_pairs blocks advances=ok output ∧
      Chain blocks ⟨Array.repeat 22#usize 0#u32,0#usize,0#usize⟩ words final ∧
      final.accepted_len.val≤22 ∧ final.draws.val≤64 ∧ finish advances final=ok output := by

/-! Bounded byte-read totality, proved symbolically over arbitrary blocks. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverRwQueryWordTotal
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ProverRwFull ProverRwQueryScan ProverRwQueryWord

theorem offset_mul (i : Usize) (bound : i.val<8) :
    (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize i).val=4*i.val := by
  rw [Usize.wrapping_mul_val_eq]
  have four : (4#usize).val=4 := rfl
  rw [four,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]
  have big := (32#usize).hSize
  change 32 < UScalar.size .Usize at big
  omega

theorem offset_add (i b : Usize) (bound : i.val<8) (hb : b.val≤3) :
    (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize i) b).val=4*i.val+b.val := by
  rw [Usize.wrapping_add_val_eq,offset_mul i bound,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]
  have big := (32#usize).hSize
  change 32 < UScalar.size .Usize at big
  omega

theorem division_total (draws : Usize) (bound : draws.val<64) :
    ∃ k, (draws / 8#usize : Result Usize)=ok k ∧ k.val<8 := by
  obtain ⟨k,hk,hv⟩ := UScalar.div_spec draws (y := 8#usize) (by decide)
  refine ⟨k,hk,?_⟩
  have eight : (8#usize).val=8 := rfl
  rw [eight] at hv
  omega

theorem read_total (blocks : Blocks) (k draws : Usize) (bound : k.val<8) :
    ∃ candidate, readWord blocks k draws=ok candidate := by
  obtain ⟨i,hi,hiv⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (UScalar.rem_spec draws (y := 8#usize) (by decide))
  have eight : (8#usize).val=8 := rfl
  rw [eight] at hiv
  have ib : i.val<8 := by omega
  have hk := ProverCommitArrayIndex25.array_index_usize_ok blocks k (by exact bound)
  let block := blocks.val[k.val]'(by simpa [blocks.property] using bound)
  have hm := offset_mul i ib
  have h1 := offset_add i 1#usize ib (by decide)
  have h2 := offset_add i 2#usize ib (by decide)
  have h3 := offset_add i 3#usize ib (by decide)
  have h0read := ProverCommitArrayIndex25.array_index_usize_ok block (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize i) (by change _<32; omega)
  have h1read := ProverCommitArrayIndex25.array_index_usize_ok block (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize i) 1#usize) (by change _<32; rw [h1]; change 4*i.val+1<32; omega)
  have h2read := ProverCommitArrayIndex25.array_index_usize_ok block (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize i) 2#usize) (by change _<32; rw [h2]; change 4*i.val+2<32; omega)
  have h3read := ProverCommitArrayIndex25.array_index_usize_ok block (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize i) 3#usize) (by change _<32; rw [h3]; change 4*i.val+3<32; omega)
  simp only [readWord,hi,bind_tc_ok,lift,hk]
  change ∃ candidate, (do
    let b0 ← Array.index_usize block (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize i)
    let b1 ← Array.index_usize block (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize i) 1#usize)
    let b2 ← Array.index_usize block (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize i) 2#usize)
    let b3 ← Array.index_usize block (Usize.wrapping_add (Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize i) 3#usize)
    ok (core.num.U32.from_le_bytes (Array.make 4#usize [b0,b1,b2,b3]) &&& 262143#u32)) = ok candidate
  rw [h0read,h1read,h2read,h3read]
  exact ⟨_,rfl⟩

#print axioms offset_mul
#print axioms offset_add
#print axioms division_total
#print axioms read_total
end R1Z.ProverRwQueryWordTotal

/-! Checked factoring of the actual source body: selected byte word then
one Q22 transition. No hash/materialization law is introduced. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverRwQueryWord
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ProverRwFull ProverRwQueryScan
open ProverRwQueryTransition Query31ExplicitScanBody

def readWord (blocks : Blocks) (k draws : Usize) : Result U32 := do
  let i ← draws % 8#usize
  let at1 ← Aeneas.Std.lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize i)
  let a ← Array.index_usize blocks k
  let i1 ← Array.index_usize a at1
  let i2 ← Aeneas.Std.lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add at1 1#usize)
  let i3 ← Array.index_usize a i2
  let i4 ← Aeneas.Std.lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add at1 2#usize)
  let i5 ← Array.index_usize a i4
  let i6 ← Aeneas.Std.lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add at1 3#usize)
  let i7 ← Array.index_usize a i6
  let i8 ←
    Aeneas.Std.lift (core.num.U32.from_le_bytes
      (Array.make 4#usize [ i1, i3, i5, i7 ]))
  let candidate ← Aeneas.Std.lift (i8 &&& 262143#u32)
  ok candidate

def factored (recur : Queries → Usize → Usize → Result Output)
    (blocks advances : Blocks) (accepted : Queries) (n draws : Usize) : Result Output := do
  if draws = 64#usize then
    if n = 22#usize then
      let a ← Array.index_usize advances 7#usize
      ok (.Ok (accepted,a))
    else ok (.Err verifier.Error.Transcript)
  else
    let k ← draws / 8#usize
    if n = 22#usize then
      let a ← Array.index_usize advances k
      ok (.Ok (accepted,a))
    else
      let candidate ← readWord blocks k draws
      let next ← advance ⟨accepted,n,draws⟩ candidate
      recur next.accepted next.accepted_len next.draws

theorem dispatch_factored (recur : Queries → Usize → Usize → Result Output)
    (blocks advances : Blocks) (accepted : Queries) (n draws : Usize) :
    dispatch recur blocks advances accepted n draws =
      factored recur blocks advances accepted n draws := by
  simp only [dispatch,factored,readWord,advance,bind_assoc_eq,lift,bind_tc_ok]
  split
  · rfl
  · apply (Aeneas.Std.bind_eq_iff _ _ _).mpr
    intro k hk
    split
    · rfl
    · repeat' first | apply (Aeneas.Std.bind_eq_iff _ _ _).mpr; intro _ _
      split <;> simp only [bind_assoc_eq,bind_tc_ok]

theorem source_factored (blocks advances : Blocks) (accepted : Queries) (n draws : Usize) :
    host_transcript.scan_query_words blocks advances accepted n draws =
      factored (host_transcript.scan_query_words blocks advances) blocks advances accepted n draws := by
  rw [source_unfold,dispatch_factored]

#print axioms dispatch_factored
#print axioms source_factored
end R1Z.ProverRwQueryWord

/-! Finite control refinement of the actual ordered 64-word query owner.
All byte reads, errors, duplicate handling, array updates and selected advance
states are retained; no dictionary contract or successful-read premise. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverRwQueryScan
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ProverRwFull
abbrev Queries := ProverRwQueryContains.Queries
abbrev Blocks := Array (Array U8 32#usize) 8#usize
abbrev Output := core.result.Result (Queries × Array U8 32#usize) verifier.Error

def dispatch
  (recur : Queries → Usize → Usize → Result Output)
  (blocks : Array (Array Std.U8 32#usize) 8#usize)
  (advances : Array (Array Std.U8 32#usize) 8#usize)
  (accepted : Array Std.U32 22#usize) (n : Std.Usize) (draws : Std.Usize) :
  Result (core.result.Result ((Array Std.U32 22#usize) × (Array Std.U8
    32#usize)) verifier.Error)
  := do
  if draws = 64#usize
  then
    if n = 22#usize
    then
      let a ← Array.index_usize advances 7#usize
      ok (core.result.Result.Ok (accepted, a))
    else ok (core.result.Result.Err verifier.Error.Transcript)
  else
    let k ← draws / 8#usize
    if n = 22#usize
    then
      let a ← Array.index_usize advances k
      ok (core.result.Result.Ok (accepted, a))
    else
      let i ← draws % 8#usize
      let at1 ← Aeneas.Std.lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_mul 4#usize i)
      let a ← Array.index_usize blocks k
      let i1 ← Array.index_usize a at1
      let i2 ← Aeneas.Std.lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add at1 1#usize)
      let i3 ← Array.index_usize a i2
      let i4 ← Aeneas.Std.lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add at1 2#usize)
      let i5 ← Array.index_usize a i4
      let i6 ← Aeneas.Std.lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add at1 3#usize)
      let i7 ← Array.index_usize a i6
      let i8 ←
        Aeneas.Std.lift (core.num.U32.from_le_bytes
          (Array.make 4#usize [ i1, i3, i5, i7 ]))
      let candidate ← Aeneas.Std.lift (i8 &&& 262143#u32)
      let b ← host_transcript.query_contains accepted n candidate
      if b
      then
        let i9 ← Aeneas.Std.lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add draws 1#usize)
        recur accepted n i9
      else
        let accepted1 ← Array.update accepted n candidate
        let i9 ← Aeneas.Std.lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add n 1#usize)
        let i10 ← Aeneas.Std.lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add draws 1#usize)
        recur accepted1 i9 i10

theorem source_unfold (blocks advances : Blocks) (accepted : Queries) (n draws : Usize) :
    host_transcript.scan_query_words blocks advances accepted n draws =
      dispatch (host_transcript.scan_query_words blocks advances) blocks advances accepted n draws := by
  rw [host_transcript.scan_query_words]
  rfl

theorem dispatch_congr (blocks advances : Blocks) (accepted : Queries) (n draws : Usize)
    (left right : Queries → Usize → Usize → Result Output)
    (same : ∀ a m, left a m (Usize.wrapping_add draws 1#usize) =
      right a m (Usize.wrapping_add draws 1#usize)) :
    dispatch left blocks advances accepted n draws =
      dispatch right blocks advances accepted n draws := by
  unfold dispatch
  split
  · rfl
  · apply (Aeneas.Std.bind_eq_iff _ _ _).mpr
    intro k hk
    split
    · rfl
    · repeat' first | apply (Aeneas.Std.bind_eq_iff _ _ _).mpr; intro _ _
      split
      · apply same
      · apply (Aeneas.Std.bind_eq_iff _ _ _).mpr
        intro updated hu
        simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok]
        apply same

def finite (blocks advances : Blocks) : Nat → Queries → Usize → Usize → Result Output
  | 0,accepted,n,draws => dispatch (fun _ _ _ => .div) blocks advances accepted n draws
  | fuel+1,accepted,n,draws => dispatch (finite blocks advances fuel) blocks advances accepted n draws

theorem scan_finite (blocks advances : Blocks) (fuel : Nat) (accepted : Queries)
    (n draws : Usize) (bound : draws.val+fuel=64) :
    host_transcript.scan_query_words blocks advances accepted n draws =
      finite blocks advances fuel accepted n draws := by
  induction fuel generalizing accepted n draws with
  | zero =>
    have cap : draws = 64#usize := by apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq; change draws.val=64; omega
    rw [source_unfold]
    simp only [finite,dispatch,cap,if_true]
  | succ fuel ih =>
    rw [source_unfold]
    change dispatch _ _ _ _ _ _ = dispatch _ _ _ _ _ _
    apply dispatch_congr
    intro a m
    apply ih
    have add : (Usize.wrapping_add draws 1#usize).val = draws.val+1 := by
      rw [Usize.wrapping_add_val_eq]
      have one : (1#usize).val = 1 := rfl
      rw [one,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]
      have big := (64#usize).hSize
      change 64 < UScalar.size .Usize at big
      omega
    omega

theorem queries_finite (blocks advances : Blocks) :
    host_transcript.queries_from_pairs blocks advances =
      finite blocks advances 64 (Array.repeat 22#usize 0#u32) 0#usize 0#usize := by
  exact scan_finite blocks advances 64 _ _ _ (by rfl)

#print axioms source_unfold
#print axioms dispatch_congr
#print axioms scan_finite
#print axioms queries_finite
end R1Z.ProverRwQueryScan

/-! Exact prefix membership for the emitted duplicate test, including totality. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverRwQueryMembership
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ProverRwFull ProverRwQueryContains

theorem search_success_iff (accepted : Queries) (candidate : U32)
    (fuel : Nat) (index : Usize) (size : index.val+fuel ≤ 22) :
    search accepted candidate fuel index = some true ↔
      ∃ j, index.val ≤ j ∧ j < index.val+fuel ∧ accepted.val[j]? = some candidate := by
  induction fuel generalizing index with
  | zero => simp only [search,reduceCtorEq]; constructor <;> intro h
            · contradiction
            · obtain ⟨j,lo,hi,_⟩ := h; omega
  | succ fuel ih =>
    have add : (Usize.wrapping_add index 1#usize).val = index.val+1 := by
      rw [Usize.wrapping_add_val_eq]
      have one : (1#usize).val = 1 := rfl
      rw [one,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]
      have big := (22#usize).hSize
      change 22 < UScalar.size .Usize at big
      omega
    by_cases hit : accepted.val[index.val]? = some candidate
    · simp only [search,hit,if_true,true_iff]
      exact ⟨index.val,by omega,by omega,hit⟩
    · simp only [search,hit,if_false]
      rw [ih _ (by omega)]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨j,lo,hi,hj⟩
        exact ⟨j,by omega,by omega,hj⟩
      · rintro ⟨j,lo,hi,hj⟩
        have ne : j ≠ index.val := by intro eq; subst j; exact hit hj
        exact ⟨j,by omega,by omega,hj⟩

theorem search_ne_false (accepted : Queries) (candidate : U32)
    (fuel : Nat) (index : Usize) :
    search accepted candidate fuel index ≠ some false := by
  induction fuel generalizing index with
  | zero => simp only [search,ne_eq,reduceCtorEq,not_false_eq_true]
  | succ fuel ih =>
    unfold search
    split
    · decide
    · exact ih _

theorem contains_prefix_iff (accepted : Queries) (n : Usize) (candidate : U32)
    (size : n.val ≤ 22) :
    host_transcript.query_contains accepted n candidate = ok true ↔
      ∃ j, j < n.val ∧ accepted.val[j]? = some candidate := by
  rw [contains_exact accepted n candidate size]
  have hs := search_success_iff accepted candidate n.val 0#usize (by simpa using size)
  have hn := search_ne_false accepted candidate n.val 0#usize
  have hz : (0#usize).val = 0 := rfl
  simp only [hz,Nat.zero_add,Nat.zero_le,true_and] at hs
  unfold contains
  cases h : search accepted candidate n.val 0#usize with
  | none => simp only [h,reduceCtorEq,false_iff] at hs; simpa only [h,Option.getD_none,Result.ok.injEq,Bool.false_eq_true,false_iff] using hs
  | some b =>
    cases b with
    | false => exact False.elim (hn h)
    | true => simpa only [h,Option.getD_some,Result.ok.injEq,true_iff] using hs

#print axioms search_success_iff
#print axioms search_ne_false
#print axioms contains_prefix_iff
end R1Z.ProverRwQueryMembership

import R1Z.ProverRwFullFuns

/-! The actual rewritten query membership loop is a bounded ordered scan.
No external operation, success premise or concrete 22-cell reduction is used. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverRwQueryContains
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow ProverRwFull
abbrev Queries := Array U32 22#usize

def search (accepted : Queries) (candidate : U32) : Nat → Usize → Option Bool
  | 0,_ => none
  | fuel+1,index =>
    if accepted.val[index.val]? = some candidate then some true
    else search accepted candidate fuel (Usize.wrapping_add index 1#usize)

theorem loop_search (accepted : Queries) (candidate : U32)
    (n index : Usize) (fuel : Nat) (bound : index.val+fuel=n.val)
    (size : n.val ≤ 22) :
    host_transcript.query_contains_loop accepted n candidate index =
      ok (search accepted candidate fuel index) := by
  unfold host_transcript.query_contains_loop
  induction fuel generalizing index with
  | zero =>
    have stop : ¬ index < n := by change ¬ index.val < n.val; omega
    rw [loop]
    simp only [host_transcript.query_contains_loop.body,stop,if_false,bind_tc_ok,search]
  | succ fuel ih =>
    have go : index < n := by change index.val < n.val; omega
    have hi : index.val < (22#usize).val := by change index.val < 22; omega
    have hidx := ProverCommitArrayIndex25.array_index_usize_ok accepted index hi
    have hlen : index.val < accepted.val.length := by simpa [accepted.property] using hi
    have add : (Usize.wrapping_add index 1#usize).val = index.val+1 := by
      rw [Usize.wrapping_add_val_eq]
      have one : (1#usize).val = 1 := rfl
      rw [one,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]
      have hn := n.hSize
      change n.val < UScalar.size .Usize at hn
      omega
    by_cases equal : accepted.val[index.val] = candidate
    · rw [loop]
      simp only [host_transcript.query_contains_loop.body,go,if_true,hidx,bind_tc_ok,
        search,List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlen,Option.some.injEq,equal,if_true]
    · rw [loop]
      simp only [host_transcript.query_contains_loop.body,go,if_true,hidx,bind_tc_ok,
        search,List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlen,Option.some.injEq,equal,if_false,lift]
      exact ih _ (by omega)

def contains (accepted : Queries) (n : Usize) (candidate : U32) : Bool :=
  (search accepted candidate n.val 0#usize).getD false

theorem contains_exact (accepted : Queries) (n : Usize) (candidate : U32)
    (size : n.val ≤ 22) :
    host_transcript.query_contains accepted n candidate = ok (contains accepted n candidate) := by
  unfold host_transcript.query_contains contains
  rw [loop_search accepted candidate n 0#usize n.val (by change 0+n.val=n.val; omega) size]
  cases search accepted candidate n.val 0#usize <;> rfl

#print axioms loop_search
#print axioms contains_exact
end R1Z.ProverRwQueryContains

import R1Z.ProverRwQueryMembership
import Query31ExplicitScanConcreteSteps

/-! Source duplicate/fresh updates transported to the retained Q22 state. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverRwQueryTransition
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ProverRwFull ProverRwQueryContains
open Query31ExplicitScanBody Query31ExplicitScanConcreteSteps

def advance (s : CurrentScan) (candidate : U32) : Result CurrentScan := do
  let seen ← host_transcript.query_contains s.accepted s.accepted_len candidate
  if seen then
    ok {s with draws := Usize.wrapping_add s.draws 1#usize}
  else
    let updated ← Array.update s.accepted s.accepted_len candidate
    ok ⟨updated,Usize.wrapping_add s.accepted_len 1#usize,Usize.wrapping_add s.draws 1#usize⟩

theorem mem_take_iff {α : Type} (xs : List α) (n : Nat) (x : α) :
    x ∈ xs.take n ↔ ∃ j, j<n ∧ xs[j]?=some x := by
  rw [List.mem_iff_getElem?]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨j,hj⟩
    obtain ⟨bound,_⟩ := List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.mp hj
    have lt : j<n := lt_of_lt_of_le bound (List.length_take_le _ _)
    exact ⟨j,lt,by rwa [List.getElem?_take_of_lt lt] at hj⟩
  · rintro ⟨j,lt,hj⟩
    exact ⟨j,by rwa [List.getElem?_take_of_lt lt]⟩

theorem mem_val_iff (xs : List U32) (candidate : U32) :
    candidate.val ∈ xs.map UScalar.val ↔ candidate ∈ xs := by
  rw [List.mem_map]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x,hx,he⟩
    have : x=candidate := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq he
    exact this ▸ hx
  · intro h; exact ⟨candidate,h,rfl⟩

theorem contains_model (s : CurrentScan) (candidate : U32) (bound : s.accepted_len.val ≤ 22) :
    host_transcript.query_contains s.accepted s.accepted_len candidate =
      ok (decide (candidate.val ∈ acceptedPrefix s)) := by
  have iff := ProverRwQueryMembership.contains_prefix_iff s.accepted s.accepted_len candidate bound
  have mem : candidate.val ∈ acceptedPrefix s ↔
      ∃ j, j<s.accepted_len.val ∧ s.accepted.val[j]?=some candidate := by
    exact (mem_val_iff _ candidate).trans (mem_take_iff _ _ _)
  rw [contains_exact _ _ _ bound] at iff ⊢
  by_cases yes : candidate.val ∈ acceptedPrefix s
  · have h := iff.mpr (mem.mp yes)
    simpa only [yes,decide_true] using h
  · have h : ProverRwQueryContains.contains s.accepted s.accepted_len candidate = false := by
      cases hb : ProverRwQueryContains.contains s.accepted s.accepted_len candidate
      · rfl
      · exact False.elim (yes (mem.mpr (iff.mp (by rw [hb]))))
    simp only [h,yes,decide_false]

theorem wrapping_succ (index : Usize) (bound : index.val<64) :
    (Usize.wrapping_add index 1#usize).val=index.val+1 := by
  rw [Usize.wrapping_add_val_eq]
  have one : (1#usize).val=1 := rfl
  rw [one,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]
  have big := (64#usize).hSize
  change 64 < UScalar.size .Usize at big
  omega

theorem advance_q22 (s : CurrentScan) (candidate : U32)
    (hlen : s.accepted_len.val<22) (hdraw : s.draws.val<64) :
    ∃ next, advance s candidate=ok next ∧
      next.accepted_len.val ≤ 22 ∧ next.draws.val=s.draws.val+1 ∧
      AspisV8R19.Q22WordScan.scan (q22StateOf s) [candidate.val] = (q22StateOf next,false) := by
  have active := active_q22_of_bounded_source s hlen hdraw
  have hd := wrapping_succ s.draws hdraw
  by_cases member : candidate.val ∈ acceptedPrefix s
  · refine ⟨{s with draws := Usize.wrapping_add s.draws 1#usize},?_,by simpa using (Nat.le_of_lt hlen),hd,?_⟩
    · simp only [advance,contains_model s candidate (by omega),member,decide_true,bind_tc_ok,if_true]
    · rw [q22_duplicate_transition _ _ active.1 active.2 member]
      simp only [q22StateOf,acceptedPrefix,hd]
  · have hi : s.accepted_len.val < s.accepted.length := by
      simpa only [Array.length,s.accepted.property,show (22#usize).val=22 from rfl] using hlen
    obtain ⟨updated,hu,_⟩ := Aeneas.Std.WP.spec_imp_exists (Array.update_spec s.accepted s.accepted_len candidate hi)
    have hn := wrapping_succ s.accepted_len (by omega)
    let next : CurrentScan := ⟨updated,Usize.wrapping_add s.accepted_len 1#usize,Usize.wrapping_add s.draws 1#usize⟩
    refine ⟨next,?_,by dsimp [next]; omega,hd,?_⟩
    · simp only [advance,contains_model s candidate (by omega),member,decide_false,bind_tc_ok,Bool.false_eq_true,if_false,hu]
      rfl
    · rw [q22_fresh_transition _ _ active.1 active.2 member]
      have shape := Query31ExplicitScanBody.q22_state_fresh_update s candidate updated
        (Usize.wrapping_add s.accepted_len 1#usize) (Usize.wrapping_add s.draws 1#usize) hu hi hn hd
      rw [shape]
      rfl

#print axioms mem_take_iff
#print axioms mem_val_iff
#print axioms contains_model
#print axioms wrapping_succ
#print axioms advance_q22
end R1Z.ProverRwQueryTransition

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
theorem model_window (blocks : Blocks) (k : Nat) (hk : k<8) (s : CurrentScan)
    (hlen : s.accepted_len.val≤22) (bound : s.draws.val+8≤64) :
    modelScanFn actualQueryWords s (blocks.val[k]'(by simpa [blocks.property] using hk)) =
      window (blockWord blocks k hk) 8 0 s := by
  obtain ⟨words,hw⟩ := ProverCommitQueryTotal26.words_total
    (blocks.val[k]'(by simpa [blocks.property] using hk))
  have hv := AspisR1QueryScanUnrolled.r0_transcript.query_words_success_byte_mask _ words hw
  simp only [modelScanFn,hw,bind_tc_ok,hv]
  have h := list_window (blockWord blocks k hk) 8 0 s hlen bound
  have hrange : List.range' 0 8=List.range 8 := by decide
  rw [←h]
  simp only [hrange]
  apply (Aeneas.Std.bind_eq_iff _ _ _).mpr
  intro p hp
  rcases p with ⟨sf,pending⟩
  rfl

theorem block_source (blocks advances : Blocks) (ki : Usize) (s : CurrentScan)
    (hk : ki.val<8) (hd : s.draws.val=8*ki.val) (hlen : s.accepted_len.val≤22) :
    ∃ stop sf,
      modelScanFn actualQueryWords s
        (blocks.val[ki.val]'(by simpa [blocks.property] using hk))=ok (stop,sf) ∧
      validState sf ∧
      run blocks advances s=(if stop then finishAt advances ki sf else run blocks advances sf) ∧
      (stop=false → sf.draws.val=8*(ki.val+1)) := by
  obtain ⟨stop,sf,hr,hvalid,ht,hf,hl,hu⟩ := window_total (blockWord blocks ki.val hk) 8 0 s hlen (by omega)
  have hm := model_window blocks ki.val hk s hlen (by omega)
  rw [hr] at hm
  have hs := window_source blocks advances ki.val 8 0 s hk (by omega) (by omega) hlen
  rw [hr,bind_tc_ok] at hs
  refine ⟨stop,sf,hm,hvalid,?_,by intro hh; have ht:=hf hh; omega⟩
  cases stop with
  | false => exact hs
  | true =>
    have strict := ProverRwQueryWindowStop.stop_lt (blockWord blocks ki.val hk) 8 0 s sf hlen (by omega) hr
    have index : min 7 (sf.draws.val/8)=ki.val := by omega
    exact hs.trans (run_at blocks advances ki sf (ht rfl) hvalid.2.1 hk index)

def finishAt (advances : Blocks) (k : Usize) (s : CurrentScan) : Result Output :=
  if s.accepted_len=22#usize then do
    let a ← Array.index_usize advances k
    ok (.Ok (s.accepted,a))
  else ok (.Err verifier.Error.Transcript)

theorem run_finish (blocks advances : Blocks) (s : CurrentScan)
    (terminal : s.accepted_len=22#usize ∨ s.draws=64#usize) :
    run blocks advances s=ProverRwQueryExecution.finish advances s := by

  rw [source_factored]
  by_cases full : s.accepted_len=22#usize
  · by_cases cap : s.draws=64#usize <;>
      simp only [factored,ProverRwQueryExecution.finish,full,cap,if_true,if_false]
  · have cap := terminal.resolve_left full
    simp only [factored,ProverRwQueryExecution.finish,full,cap,if_true,if_false]

theorem run_at (blocks advances : Blocks) (k : Usize) (s : CurrentScan)
    (terminal : s.accepted_len=22#usize ∨ s.draws=64#usize)
    (bound : s.draws.val≤64) (hk : k.val<8)
    (index : min 7 (s.draws.val/8)=k.val) :
    run blocks advances s=finishAt advances k s := by
  rw [run_finish blocks advances s terminal,ProverRwQueryResult.finish_exact advances s bound]
  have ha := ProverCommitArrayIndex25.array_index_usize_ok advances k hk
  simp only [finishAt,ha,bind_tc_ok,ProverRwQueryResult.selected,index]
