open Query31ExplicitScanBody
open AspisR1QueryScanUnrolled.r0_transcript

def run (blocks advances : Blocks) (s : CurrentScan) : Result Output :=
  host_transcript.scan_query_words blocks advances s.accepted s.accepted_len s.draws

def blockWord (blocks : Blocks) (k : Nat) (hk : k<8) (i : Nat) : U32 :=
  queryMaskWord (blockRankWord (blocks.val[k]'(by simpa [blocks.property] using hk)) i)

theorem window_source (blocks advances : Blocks) (k fuel i : Nat) (s : CurrentScan)
    (hk : k<8) (hpart : i+fuel=8) (hd : s.draws.val=8*k+i)
    (hlen : s.accepted_len.val≤22) :
    run blocks advances s = (do
      let p ← window (blockWord blocks k hk) fuel i s
      run blocks advances p.2) := by
  induction fuel generalizing i s with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ fuel ih =>
    by_cases full : s.accepted_len=22#usize
    · simp only [window,full,if_true,bind_tc_ok]
    · have id : i<8 := by omega
      have db : s.draws.val<64 := by omega
      have cap : s.draws≠64#usize := by intro he; have hv:=congrArg UScalar.val he; change s.draws.val=64 at hv; omega
      have active : s.accepted_len.val<22 := by
        have ne : s.accepted_len.val≠22 := by intro he; apply full; exact UScalar.eq_of_val_eq he
        omega
      obtain ⟨ki,hki,hkiv⟩ := UScalar.div_spec s.draws (y:=8#usize) (by decide)
      have kval : ki.val=k := by change ki.val=s.draws.val/8 at hkiv; omega
      have remval : s.draws.val%8=i := by omega
      have read := read_closed blocks ki s.draws (by omega)
      simp only [kval,remval] at read
      change readWord blocks ki s.draws=ok (blockWord blocks k hk i) at read
      obtain ⟨next,hn,hnlen,hndraw,_⟩ := advance_q22 s (blockWord blocks k hk i) active db
      have tail := ih (i+1) next (by omega) (by omega) hnlen
      change host_transcript.scan_query_words blocks advances s.accepted s.accepted_len s.draws = _
      rw [source_factored]
      simp only [factored,full,cap,if_false,hki,read,hn,bind_tc_ok,window,bind_assoc_eq]
      exact tail

R1Z.ProverRwQueryWindow:
import R1Z.ProverRwQueryListStep
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverRwQueryWindow
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ProverRwQueryTransition ProverRwQueryListStep
open Query31ExplicitScanBody
open Query31ExplicitListLoop (validState validState_of_bounds listNext scanListLoop optionStop step)

def window (word : Nat → U32) : Nat → Nat → CurrentScan → Result (Bool × CurrentScan)
  | 0,_,s => ok (false,s)
  | fuel+1,i,s =>
    if s.accepted_len=22#usize then ok (true,s)
    else if s.draws=64#usize then ok (true,s)
    else do let next ← advance s (word i); window word fuel (i+1) next

theorem list_window (word : Nat → U32) (fuel i : Nat) (s : CurrentScan)
    (hlen : s.accepted_len.val≤22) (bound : s.draws.val+fuel≤64) :
    (do let (sf,pending) ← scanListLoop ((List.range' i fuel).map word) s
        ok (optionStop pending,sf)) = window word fuel i s := by
  induction fuel generalizing i s with
  | zero =>
    unfold scanListLoop step
    rw [Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def]
    simp only [List.range'_zero,List.map_nil,body,stdOps,listNext,bind_tc_ok,window]
    rfl
  | succ fuel ih =>
    rw [List.range'_succ,List.map_cons]
    by_cases full : s.accepted_len=22#usize
    · unfold scanListLoop step
      rw [Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def]
      simp only [body,stdOps,listNext,bind_tc_ok,full,if_true,window]
      rfl
    · by_cases cap : s.draws=64#usize
      · unfold scanListLoop step
        rw [Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def]
        simp only [body,stdOps,listNext,bind_tc_ok,full,if_false,cap,if_true,window]
        rfl
      · have active : s.accepted_len.val<22 := by
          have ne : s.accepted_len.val≠22 := by intro he; apply full; exact UScalar.eq_of_val_eq he
          omega
        have hd : s.draws.val<64 := by omega
        obtain ⟨next,hn,hnlen,hndraw,_⟩ := advance_q22 s (word i) active hd
        have hb := body_advance s (word i) ((List.range' (i+1) fuel).map word) active hd
        rw [hn,bind_tc_ok] at hb
        have hloop : scanListLoop (word i :: (List.range' (i+1) fuel).map word) s =
            scanListLoop ((List.range' (i+1) fuel).map word) next := by
          unfold scanListLoop step
          rw [Aeneas.Std.loop.eq_def]
          simp only [hb]
        rw [hloop,ih (i+1) next hnlen (by omega)]
        simp only [window,full,cap,if_false,hn,bind_tc_ok]

theorem window_total (word : Nat → U32) (fuel i : Nat) (s : CurrentScan)
    (hlen : s.accepted_len.val≤22) (bound : s.draws.val+fuel≤64) :
    ∃ stop sf, window word fuel i s=ok (stop,sf) ∧ validState sf ∧
      (stop=true → sf.accepted_len=22#usize ∨ sf.draws=64#usize) ∧
      (stop=false → sf.draws.val=s.draws.val+fuel) ∧
      s.draws.val≤sf.draws.val ∧ sf.draws.val≤s.draws.val+fuel := by
  induction fuel generalizing i s with
  | zero => exact ⟨false,s,rfl,validState_of_bounds s hlen (by omega),by simp,by simp,by omega,by omega⟩
  | succ fuel ih =>
    by_cases full : s.accepted_len=22#usize
    · exact ⟨true,s,by simp only [window,full,if_true],validState_of_bounds s hlen (by omega),by intro _; exact Or.inl full,by simp,by omega,by omega⟩
    · by_cases cap : s.draws=64#usize
      · exact ⟨true,s,by simp only [window,full,if_false,cap,if_true],validState_of_bounds s hlen (by omega),by intro _; exact Or.inr cap,by simp,by omega,by omega⟩
      · have active : s.accepted_len.val<22 := by
          have ne : s.accepted_len.val≠22 := by intro he; apply full; exact UScalar.eq_of_val_eq he
          omega
        obtain ⟨next,hn,hnlen,hndraw,_⟩ := advance_q22 s (word i) active (by omega)

import R1Z.ProverRwFullFuns
import R1Z.ProverCommitRetrySource34
import R1Z.ProverCommitSemanticTransport26

/-! Retry control for the actual rewritten emission. The per-attempt body is
still the actual source function, with its explicit external dictionary;
no body/model or entropy-distribution equation is assumed here. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverRwRetryModel
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ProverRwFull
open ProverCommitSemanticTransport26
variable [ExternalTypes] [ExternalFuns]
abbrev Store := aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.DurableStateOnlyMaskNonceStore
abbrev Secret := aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.StateOnlyAttemptSecrets
abbrev Proof := alloc.vec.Vec U8 × prover.MaskedFixtureAudit
abbrev Pub := aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public
abbrev Compiled := aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_trace.PoolV1PairForestMergedC1CompilationV1
abbrev Hash := Slice (Slice U8) → Result (Array U8 32#usize)
abbrev Entropy (C : Type) := core.ops.function.FnMut C Usize (core.result.Result Secret verifier.Error)

def error : verifier.Error → ProverCommitRetry34.Error
  | .Parse => .Parse
  | .Semantic => .Semantic
  | .Transcript => .Transcript
  | .Relation => .Relation
  | .Merkle => .Merkle
  | .Query => .Query
  | .Checkpoint => .Checkpoint
  | .Allocation => .Allocation
  | .Rejected => .Rejected
  | .AttemptsExhausted => .AttemptsExhausted
  | .Entropy => .Entropy

def sourceOutput (v : core.result.Result prover.RetriedProof verifier.Error × Store) :
    ProverCommitRetry34.Step (ProverCommitRetry34.Published Proof) × Store :=
  (match v.1 with
    | .Ok p => .done ⟨(p.proof,p.audit),p.attempts.val⟩
    | .Err e => .stop (error e), v.2)

def drop {C : Type} (v : ProverCommitRetry34.Step (ProverCommitRetry34.Published Proof) × (C × Store)) :=
  (v.1,v.2.2)

def attempt {C : Type} (entropy : Entropy C) (pub : Pub) (compiled : Compiled)
    (variant : transport.Variant) (hash : Hash) : ProverCommitRetry34.Attempt (C × Store) Proof :=
  fun k s => do
    let (r,after) ← entropy.call_mut s.1 (ProverCommitRetrySource34.word k)
    match r with
    | .Err e => ok (.stop (error e),(after,s.2))
    | .Ok secret =>
      let (r1,store) ← prover.prove_masked_attempt pub compiled variant hash secret s.2
      match r1 with
      | .Ok p => ok (.done p,(after,store))
      | .Err .Rejected => ok (.retry,(after,store))
      | .Err e => ok (.stop (error e),(after,store))

theorem retry {C : Type} (entropy : Entropy C) (pub : Pub) (compiled : Compiled)
    (variant : transport.Variant) (hash : Hash) (store : Store) (callback : C)
    (k : Usize) (n : Nat) (bound : k.val+n=8) :
    mapR sourceOutput (prover.retry_attempt entropy pub compiled variant hash store callback k) =
      mapR drop (ProverCommitRetry34.run (attempt entropy pub compiled variant hash) n k.val (callback,store)) := by
  induction n generalizing store callback k with
  | zero =>
    have cap : k >= prover.ATTEMPT_CAP := by
      simp only [prover.ATTEMPT_CAP]
      change 8 ≤ k.val
      omega
    rw [prover.retry_attempt]
    simp only [cap,if_true,ProverCommitRetry34.run,map_ok,sourceOutput,error,drop]
  | succ n ih =>
    have below : ¬ k >= prover.ATTEMPT_CAP := by
      simp only [prover.ATTEMPT_CAP]
      change ¬ 8 ≤ k.val
      omega
    have add := ProverCommitRetrySource34.add_one k (by omega)
    have next : (Usize.wrapping_add k 1#usize).val+n=8 := by omega
    rw [prover.retry_attempt]
    simp only [below,if_false,ProverCommitRetry34.run,attempt,
      ProverCommitRetrySource34.word_val,map_bind]
    cases ent : entropy.call_mut callback k with
    | fail e => rfl
    | div => rfl
    | ok out =>
      rcases out with ⟨status,after⟩
      cases status with
      | Err e =>
        cases e <;> simp only [ent,bind_tc_ok,Aeneas.Std.uncurry,
          core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
          core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
          core.convert.FromSame.from,ProverCommitRetry34.run,map_ok,drop,sourceOutput,error]
      | Ok secret =>
        simp only [ent,bind_tc_ok,Aeneas.Std.uncurry,core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch]
        cases body : prover.prove_masked_attempt pub compiled variant hash secret store with
        | fail e => rfl
        | div => rfl
        | ok out =>
          rcases out with ⟨status,afterStore⟩
          cases status with
          | Ok p =>
            rcases p with ⟨proof,audit⟩
            simp only [body,bind_tc_ok,Aeneas.Std.uncurry,map_ok,sourceOutput,drop,add,lift,bind_tc_ok,map_ok]
          | Err e =>
            cases e <;> simp only [body,bind_tc_ok,Aeneas.Std.uncurry,map_ok,sourceOutput,drop,error,lift,bind_tc_ok]
            simpa only [add] using ih afterStore after (Usize.wrapping_add k 1#usize) next

#print axioms retry
end R1Z.ProverRwRetryModel

import AspisR1Retry34.Funs
import R1Z.ProverCommitRetry34
import R1Z.ProverCommitFields29
/-! Extracted structural retry owner, with an arbitrary effectful policy.
The eight-step bound proves all source arithmetic nonwrapping. The Kani
caller gate relates the verbatim native for-loop to this owned recursion;
source callee bodies are not assumed correct by the policy abstraction. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitRetrySource34
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1Retry34 ProverCommitRetry34

def word (n : Nat) : Usize := ⟨BitVec.ofNat _ n⟩

theorem word_val (n : Usize) : word n.val = n := by
  apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
  simp only [word,UScalar.val,BitVec.toNat_ofNat]
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by simpa only [UScalar.size_def,UScalar.val] using n.hSize)

def decodeStep {P S : Type} : owner.Step P S ProverCommitRetry34.Error → Step P × S
  | .Done p s => (.done p,s)
  | .Retry s => (.retry,s)
  | .Stop e s => (.stop e,s)

def decodeRun {P S : Type} : owner.Run P S ProverCommitRetry34.Error → Step (Published P) × S
  | .Published p count s => (.done ⟨p,count.val⟩,s)
  | .Stopped e s => (.stop e,s)
  | .Exhausted s => (.stop .AttemptsExhausted,s)

def policy {A S P : Type} (ops : owner.Attempt A S P ProverCommitRetry34.Error) : Attempt S P :=
  fun index state => do
    let step ← ops.attempt (word index) state
    ok (decodeStep step)

theorem add_one (index : Usize) (hi : index.val ≤ 8) :
    (Usize.wrapping_add index 1#usize).val = index.val+1 := by
  rw [Usize.wrapping_add_val_eq]
  have one : (1#usize).val=1 := by scalar_tac
  rw [one]
  apply Nat.mod_eq_of_lt
  have size : 9 < UScalar.size .Usize := by
    rw [UScalar.size_def,UScalarTy.Usize_numBits_eq]
    rcases System.Platform.numBits_eq with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num
  omega

/-- All callbacks, successes, early errors, failure/divergence and retained
states are preserved. The policy may retain an adaptive oracle transcript. -/
theorem source_model {A S P : Type} (ops : owner.Attempt A S P ProverCommitRetry34.Error)
    (n : Nat) (fuel index : Usize) (state : S)
    (hf : fuel.val=n) (bound : fuel.val+index.val ≤ 8) :
    (do let out ← owner.retry ops fuel index state; ok (decodeRun out)) =
      run (policy ops) n index.val state := by
  induction n generalizing fuel index state with
  | zero =>
    have zero : fuel=0#usize := by scalar_tac
    rw [owner.retry]
    simp only [zero,if_true,run,bind_tc_ok]
    rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    have nonzero : fuel≠0#usize := by scalar_tac
    have sub : (Usize.wrapping_sub fuel 1#usize).val=n := by
      rw [ProverCommitFields29.sub_one fuel (by omega)]

import R1Z.ProverCommitPublicNonce40
import R1Z.LayoutR1PBin

/-! A public binding is an existing memo coordinate, not a fresh private
coordinate. These counterexamples identify the exact old freshness interface
that cannot simply be specialised to D152. They do not refute privacy. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitPublicBinding40
open R0Z R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.FsAbort R0Z.FsGood R0Z.HvzkV
open GamesR1PBin LayoutR1PBin
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

abbrev Private := Fin 2 → NZ

def publicSec (nonce : NZ) (seeds : Private) : SecP := Fin.cases nonce seeds

def binding (pub : List UInt8) (tag : UInt8) (digest nonce : OracleAnswer) : List UInt8 :=
  dBind0 ++ pub ++ [tag] ++ ctxEnc digest nonce

def bindPos (e1 e2 : Nat) : CPos e1 e2 := .inr (.inr (.inl 0))

/-- This is the actual first binding branch of the frozen byte grammar.
Neither private OS seed occurs in it. -/
theorem grammar_binding {e1 e2 : Nat} (pub : List UInt8) (tag : UInt8)
    (lv : Fin 3 → Fib → List UInt8) (digest : OracleAnswer)
    (rest : RIdx → OracleAnswer) (nonce : NZ) (seeds : Private) :
    gram pub tag lv (publicSec nonce seeds) digest rest (bindPos e1 e2) =
      binding pub tag digest nonce.val := by
  simp [gram,publicSec,bindPos,binding]

/-- One adversary query can be this binding, with no knowledge of either seed.
The event is certain on the private-seed carrier, even for a fixed nonce. -/
theorem public_hit_mass (pub : List UInt8) (tag : UInt8)
    (digest : OracleAnswer) (nonce : NZ) :
    eventMass (fun _ : Private =>
      binding pub tag digest nonce.val = binding pub tag digest nonce.val) = 1 := by
  simp only [eventMass,if_true,mean_const]

/-- The old HitFresh interface requires at least 2^255 address-distinguishing
values. On the D152 private carrier this public address is constant. -/
theorem no_hidden_nonce_freshness (pub : List UInt8) (tag : UInt8)
    (digest : OracleAnswer) (nonce : NZ) :
    ¬ R0Z.FsAbortBounds.HitFresh (fun _ : Private => True)
      (fun _ => binding pub tag digest nonce.val)
      (fun _ => binding pub tag digest nonce.val) (2^255) := by
  intro fresh
  have h := R0Z.FsAbortBounds.hitFresh_mass (fun _ : Private => True)
    (fun _ => binding pub tag digest nonce.val)
    (fun _ => binding pub tag digest nonce.val) (2^255) (by positivity) fresh
  have certain : R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass (fun _ : Private =>
      True ∧ binding pub tag digest nonce.val = binding pub tag digest nonce.val) = 1 := by
    simp [R0Z.FsAbortBounds.mass,mean_const]
  rw [certain] at h
  norm_num at h

/-- No choice of a small seed-guess charge can repair this *public* hit. It
must instead be preserved by the public-prefix ROM coupling. -/
theorem public_hit_exceeds_private_charge (pub : List UInt8) (tag : UInt8)
    (digest : OracleAnswer) (nonce : NZ) :
    4 * ProverCommitPrivateMemo40.budget (2^64) 128 <
      eventMass (fun _ : Private =>
        binding pub tag digest nonce.val = binding pub tag digest nonce.val) := by
  rw [public_hit_mass]
  norm_num [ProverCommitPrivateMemo40.budget]

#print axioms no_hidden_nonce_freshness
#print axioms public_hit_exceeds_private_charge

theorem semantic_loop (rs : List Row) (out : Bytes) :

    induction rs with
    | nil => intro initial; cases initial <;> rfl
    | cons r rs ih =>
      intro initial
      cases initial with
      | error e => exact ih (.error e)
      | ok out => exact ih (row r out)
  exact aux rs (.ok out)

import R1Z.ProverCommitPublication33
import R1Z.ProverCommitMerge33
/-! Byte publication control. Codec and multiproof calls remain explicit
results, including errors; no success law for those callees is postulated.
This is a local caller theorem, not a complete source experiment. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitPublish43
abbrev Bytes := List UInt8
inductive Error where
  | semantic | parse | merkle | transcript
  deriving DecidableEq

structure QueryParts where
  c1 : Bytes
  c2 : Bytes
  salt1 : Bytes
  salt2 : Bytes
  folded : Bytes
  saltf : Bytes

def queryStep (out : Bytes) (p : QueryParts) : Bytes :=
  out ++ p.c1 ++ p.c2 ++ p.salt1 ++ p.salt2 ++ p.folded ++ p.saltf

def queryBytes (p : QueryParts) : Bytes :=
  p.c1 ++ p.c2 ++ p.salt1 ++ p.salt2 ++ p.folded ++ p.saltf

theorem query_step (out : Bytes) (p : QueryParts) :
    queryStep out p = out ++ queryBytes p := by
  simp only [queryStep,queryBytes,List.append_assoc]

def queries : List QueryParts → Bytes → Bytes
  | [],out => out
  | p::ps,out => queries ps (queryStep out p)

theorem query_loop (ps : List QueryParts) (out : Bytes) :
    ps.foldl queryStep out = queries ps out := by
  induction ps generalizing out with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons p ps ih => exact ih _

theorem query_exact (ps : List QueryParts) (out : Bytes) :
    queries ps out = out ++ (ps.map queryBytes).flatten := by
  induction ps generalizing out with
  | nil => simp only [queries,List.map_nil,List.flatten_nil,List.append_nil]
  | cons p ps ih =>
    rw [queries,ih,query_step]
    simp only [List.map_cons,List.flatten_cons,List.append_assoc]

structure Slot where
  nodes : Except Error Bytes
  cap : Nat

def appendSlot (out : Bytes) (slot : Slot) : Except Error Bytes := do
  let nodes ← slot.nodes
  if nodes.length > slot.cap then .error .parse
  else .ok (out ++ nodes ++ List.replicate (slot.cap-nodes.length) 0)

theorem slot_length (out : Bytes) (slot : Slot) (result : Bytes)
    (ok : appendSlot out slot = .ok result) : result.length=out.length+slot.cap := by
  unfold appendSlot at ok
  cases hn : slot.nodes with
  | error e => simp only [hn,bind,Except.bind] at ok; cases ok
  | ok nodes =>
    simp only [hn,bind,Except.bind] at ok
    split at ok
    · cases ok
    · cases ok
      simp only [List.length_append,List.length_replicate]
      omega

def slots : List Slot → Bytes → Except Error Bytes
  | [],out => .ok out
  | s::ss,out => (appendSlot out s).bind (slots ss)

def slotLoop (ss : List Slot) (out : Bytes) : Except Error Bytes :=
  ss.foldl (fun result slot => result.bind (fun bytes => appendSlot bytes slot)) (.ok out)

theorem slots_loop (ss : List Slot) (out : Bytes) : slotLoop ss out = slots ss out := by
  have aux : ∀ ss (initial : Except Error Bytes),
      ss.foldl (fun result slot => result.bind (fun bytes => appendSlot bytes slot)) initial =
        initial.bind (slots ss) := by
    intro ss
    induction ss with
    | nil => intro initial; cases initial <;> rfl
    | cons s ss ih =>
      intro initial
      cases initial with
      | error e => exact ih (.error e)
      | ok bytes => exact ih (appendSlot bytes s)
  exact aux ss (.ok out)

theorem slots_length (ss : List Slot) (out result : Bytes)
    (ok : slots ss out = .ok result) :
    result.length=out.length+(ss.map Slot.cap).sum := by
  induction ss generalizing out with
  | nil => cases ok; simp only [List.map_nil,List.sum_nil,Nat.add_zero]
  | cons s ss ih =>
    simp only [slots] at ok
    cases hs : appendSlot out s with
    | error e => simp only [hs,Except.bind] at ok; cases ok
    | ok next =>
      simp only [hs,Except.bind] at ok
      have hlen := slot_length out s next hs
      have htail := ih next ok
      simp only [List.map_cons,List.sum_cons]
      omega

/-- Both byte-length guards and every prior node error survive unchanged. -/
def assemble (front : Except Error Bytes) (ps : List QueryParts)
    (ss : List Slot) (offNodes proofBytes : Nat) : Except Error Bytes := do
  let front ← front
  let out := queries ps front
  if out.length ≠ offNodes then .error .parse else do
    let out ← slots ss out
    if out.length ≠ proofBytes then .error .parse else .ok out

def assembleLoop (front : Except Error Bytes) (ps : List QueryParts)
    (ss : List Slot) (offNodes proofBytes : Nat) : Except Error Bytes := do
  let front ← front
  let out := ps.foldl queryStep front
  if out.length ≠ offNodes then .error .parse else do
    let out ← slotLoop ss out
    if out.length ≠ proofBytes then .error .parse else .ok out

theorem assemble_loop (front : Except Error Bytes) (ps : List QueryParts)
    (ss : List Slot) (offNodes proofBytes : Nat) :
    assembleLoop front ps ss offNodes proofBytes = assemble front ps ss offNodes proofBytes := by
  simp only [assembleLoop,assemble,query_loop,slots_loop]

/-- Finalisation follows the native order: replay, transcript guard, Merkle
collision guard, then first-conflict ordered merge. Errors contain no proof. -/
def finish {Table : Type} (proof : Except Error Bytes) (replay : Except Error Bool)
    (collision : Bool) (merge : Except Error Table) : Except Error (Bytes × Table) := do
  let proof ← proof
  let agrees ← replay
  if !agrees then .error .transcript else
    if collision then .error .merkle else do
      let table ← merge
      .ok (proof,table)

theorem proof_error {Table : Type} (e : Error) (replay : Except Error Bool)
    (collision : Bool) (merge : Except Error Table) :
    finish (.error e) replay collision merge = .error e := rfl

theorem replay_error {Table : Type} (proof : Bytes) (e : Error)
    (collision : Bool) (merge : Except Error Table) :
    finish (.ok proof) (.error e) collision merge = .error e := rfl

theorem replay_disagreement {Table : Type} (proof : Bytes)
    (collision : Bool) (merge : Except Error Table) :
    finish (.ok proof) (.ok false) collision merge = .error .transcript := rfl

theorem merkle_collision {Table : Type} (proof : Bytes) (merge : Except Error Table) :
    finish (.ok proof) (.ok true) true merge = .error .merkle := rfl

theorem merge_error {Table : Type} (proof : Bytes) (e : Error) :
    finish (.ok proof) (.ok true) false (.error e : Except Error Table) = .error e := rfl

#print axioms query_step
#print axioms query_loop
#print axioms query_exact
#print axioms slot_length
#print axioms slots_loop
#print axioms slots_length
#print axioms assemble_loop
#print axioms proof_error
#print axioms replay_error
#print axioms replay_disagreement
#print axioms merkle_collision
#print axioms merge_error
end R1Z.ProverCommitPublish43

import R1Z.ProverCommitTrustedStd24
/-! Publication loop denotations over the D145 map interface. No Rust caller
law is added to TrustedStd. Callbacks below are pure and can encode arbitrary
opening computations; the loop theorem does not prove those computations. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitPublication33
open ProverCommitTrustedStd24
variable {Key Value State Thread Slot Output Query : Type}
variable {cmp : Key → Key → Ordering} [Std.TransCmp cmp] [Std.LawfulEqCmp cmp]

def folded (map : MapAPI Key Value State cmp) (key : Query → Key)
    (make : Key → Value) : List Query → State → State × List Bool
  | [], s => (s, [])
  | q::qs, s =>
    let step := map.entry_or_insert_with s (key q) (fun _ => make (key q))
    let rest := folded map key make qs step.1
    (rest.1, step.2.2 :: rest.2)

/-- The shipped for-loop's left fold records callback calls in query order.
The recursive owner is over the remaining owned query list. -/
def foldedLoop (map : MapAPI Key Value State cmp) (key : Query → Key)
    (make : Key → Value) (qs : List Query) (s : State) : State × List Bool :=
  qs.foldl (fun acc q =>
    let step := map.entry_or_insert_with acc.1 (key q) (fun _ => make (key q))
    (step.1, acc.2 ++ [step.2.2])) (s, [])

theorem folded_loop_rec (map : MapAPI Key Value State cmp) (key : Query → Key)
    (make : Key → Value) (qs : List Query) (s : State) :
    foldedLoop map key make qs s = folded map key make qs s := by
  have aux : ∀ qs s log,
      qs.foldl (fun (acc : State × List Bool) q =>
        let step := map.entry_or_insert_with acc.1 (key q) (fun _ => make (key q))
        (step.1, acc.2 ++ [step.2.2])) (s,log) =
      ((folded map key make qs s).1, log ++ (folded map key make qs s).2) := by
    intro qs
    induction qs with
    | nil => intros; simp only [List.foldl_nil,folded,List.append_nil]
    | cons q qs ih =>
      intro s log
      simp only [List.foldl_cons,ih,folded,List.append_assoc,List.singleton_append]
  exact aux qs s []

variable [DecidableEq Thread]
variable (map : MapAPI Key Value State cmp) (tls : TLSAPI Thread Slot Output)
  (thread : Thread) (schedule : List (Thread × ProverCommitTLS23.Access Slot Output))
  (trusted : TrustedStd map tls thread schedule)
include trusted

/-- Universal duplicate/laziness transport uses precisely D145's one std field.
No bound on query count, table size, keys or values. -/
theorem folded_decode (key : Query → Key) (make : Key → Value)
    (qs : List Query) (s : State) :
    (map.decode (folded map key make qs s).1, (folded map key make qs s).2) =
      folded modelMap key make qs (map.decode s) := by
  induction qs generalizing s with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons q qs ih =>
    have step := trusted.btree_entry_or_insert_with s (key q) (fun _ => make (key q))
    have rest := ih (map.entry_or_insert_with s (key q) (fun _ => make (key q))).1
    cases found : (map.decode s)[key q]? with
    | none =>
      simp only [found] at step
      have hs := congrArg Prod.fst step
      have hc := congrArg (fun p => p.2.2) step
      simp only [Prod.fst, Prod.snd] at hs hc
      rw [hs] at rest
      simp only [folded,modelMap,found]
      rw [hc]
      exact congrArg (fun p => (p.1,true::p.2)) rest
    | some v =>
      simp only [found] at step
      have hs := congrArg Prod.fst step
      have hc := congrArg (fun p => p.2.2) step
      simp only [Prod.fst, Prod.snd] at hs hc
      rw [hs] at rest
      simp only [folded,modelMap,found]
      rw [hc]
      exact congrArg (fun p => (p.1,false::p.2)) rest

/-- Native-loop denotation, recursive reference and invocation trace coincide
through the named standard-library boundary. -/
theorem folded_loop_decode (key : Query → Key) (make : Key → Value)
    (qs : List Query) (s : State) :
    (map.decode (foldedLoop map key make qs s).1, (foldedLoop map key make qs s).2) =
      folded modelMap key make qs (map.decode s) := by
  rw [folded_loop_rec]
  exact folded_decode map tls thread schedule trusted key make qs s

/-- Iteration consumers get the exact sorted sequence, including its order.
This covers the order in which leaf-pair salts are requested; the actual
coin stream remains a separate source boundary. -/
theorem ordered_consumer {Acc : Type} (step : Acc → Key × Value → Acc)
    (s : State) (initial : Acc) :
    (map.entries s).foldl step initial = (map.decode s).toList.foldl step initial := by
  rw [trusted.btree_iter_ordered]

/-- Query publication repeats the lookup for every query, retaining repeats.
The result is a list of optional values so misses are not silently excluded. -/
theorem query_answers (key : Query → Key) (qs : List Query) (s : State) :
    qs.map (fun q => map.get s (key q)) =
      qs.map (fun q => (map.decode s)[key q]?) := by
  exact List.map_congr_left (fun _ _ => trusted.btree_get _ _)

#print axioms folded_loop_rec
#print axioms folded_decode
#print axioms folded_loop_decode
#print axioms ordered_consumer
#print axioms query_answers
end R1Z.ProverCommitPublication33

import R1Z.ProverCommitTreeOps23
import R1Z.ProverCommitTLS23
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Sort
/-! D133 trusted standard-library boundary, alongside P6 (runtime) and P7
(compiler/artifact). These are named hypotheses, never Lean axioms. No field
mentions privacy, a prover experiment, a coupling, or a source caller law.
The model instance below witnesses consistency; it is not a Rust proof. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitTrustedStd24
variable {Key Value MapState Thread Slot Output : Type}
variable {cmp : Key → Key → Ordering} [Std.TransCmp cmp] [Std.LawfulEqCmp cmp]

/-- Ascending distinct natural keys: the used BTreeSet<usize> image. -/
def ascendingDistinct (input : List Nat) : List Nat := input.toFinset.sort (· ≤ ·)

/-- The used successful ordered-map API. Allocation failure remains in P6;
this API does not assert an allocator's totality or identify raw pointers. -/
structure MapAPI (Key Value MapState : Type) (cmp : Key → Key → Ordering) where
  decode : MapState → Std.TreeMap Key Value cmp
  empty : MapState
  insert : MapState → Key → Value → MapState × Option Value
  get : MapState → Key → Option Value
  entries : MapState → List (Key × Value)
  /-- Returned bool records callback invocation; hit does not evaluate it.
  The publication callee is pure field evaluation, with no mutable effects. -/
  entry_or_insert_with : MapState → Key → (Unit → Value) → MapState × Value × Bool
  /-- Native BTreeSet::from_iter followed by consuming ascending iteration.
  The natural carrier denotes source usize keys, not arbitrary field values. -/
  set_from_iter : List Nat → List Nat
  /-- Successful native observer, in the natural image of usize. -/
  len : MapState → Nat
  /-- slice::sort and Vec::dedup on the used natural image of u32 indices. -/
  slice_sort : List Nat → List Nat
  vec_dedup : List Nat → List Nat

/-- One live TLS key, with thread/key lifetime fixed for the invocation.
Different keys must be instantiated separately, without type-erased casts. -/
structure TLSAPI (Thread Slot Output : Type) where
  access : Thread → ProverCommitTLS23.Access Slot Output →
    (Thread → Slot) → (Thread → Slot) × Output

/-- Explicit named trust list: std BTreeMap insert/get/iter, BTreeSet collect/iter, and live-key
single-thread TLS. Only the designated schedule is assumed single-threaded;
map operation laws quantify over every map state and key, including repeats. -/
structure TrustedStd [DecidableEq Thread]
    (map : MapAPI Key Value MapState cmp) (tls : TLSAPI Thread Slot Output)
    (thread : Thread) (schedule : List (Thread × ProverCommitTLS23.Access Slot Output)) : Prop where
  btree_empty : map.decode map.empty = ∅
  btree_insert_state : ∀ s k v, map.decode (map.insert s k v).1 = (map.decode s).insert k v
  btree_insert_previous : ∀ s k v, (map.insert s k v).2 = (map.decode s)[k]?
  btree_get : ∀ s k, map.get s k = (map.decode s)[k]?
  btree_iter_ordered : ∀ s, map.entries s = (map.decode s).toList
  /-- D145's one added trusted std operation. Existing value is retained on a
  hit with no callback; a miss calls once, inserts and returns its result. -/
  btree_entry_or_insert_with : ∀ s k make,
    let result := map.entry_or_insert_with s k make
    (map.decode result.1, result.2) =
      match (map.decode s)[k]? with
      | some v => (map.decode s, v, false)
      | none => let v := make (); ((map.decode s).insert k v, v, true)
  /-- D156: exactly one additional library law. Collection and iteration
  have no user callbacks and consume no application coins. -/
  btree_set_from_iter_ordered : ∀ input, map.set_from_iter input = ascendingDistinct input
  /-- D157: cardinality, with no truncation in the usize image. -/
  btree_len : ∀ s, map.len s = (map.decode s).toList.length
  /-- D157: ascending stable sort for the used scalar keys. -/
  slice_sort_ascending : ∀ xs, map.slice_sort xs = xs.mergeSort (· ≤ ·)
  /-- D157: remove consecutive duplicates; callers sort first. -/
  vec_dedup_adjacent : ∀ xs, map.vec_dedup xs = xs.destutter (· ≠ ·)
  tls_live_key : ∀ t f store, tls.access t f store = ProverCommitTLS23.native t f store
  tls_single_thread : ProverCommitTLS23.SingleThreaded thread schedule

variable [DecidableEq Thread]
variable (map : MapAPI Key Value MapState cmp) (tls : TLSAPI Thread Slot Output)
  (thread : Thread) (schedule : List (Thread × ProverCommitTLS23.Access Slot Output))
  (trusted : TrustedStd map tls thread schedule)

include trusted

/-- Universal write induction now consumes exactly the named trusted list. -/
theorem writes (entries : List (Key × Value)) (state : MapState) :
    (map.decode (ProverCommitTreeOps23.runWrites map.insert state entries).1,
      (ProverCommitTreeOps23.runWrites map.insert state entries).2) =
    ProverCommitTreeOps23.runWrites ProverCommitTreeOps23.treeInsert (map.decode state) entries :=
  ProverCommitTreeOps23.writes_decode map.decode map.insert
    trusted.btree_insert_state trusted.btree_insert_previous entries state

theorem lookup [DecidableEq Key] [DecidableEq Value] (state : MapState) (key : Key) :
    map.get state key = ProverCommitTable20.lookup (map.decode state).toList key :=
  ProverCommitTreeOps23.get_decode map.decode map.get trusted.btree_get state key

/-- Exact iterator order and remaining suffix, including exhaustion. -/
theorem iteration (state : MapState) (n : Nat) :
    ProverCommitTreeOps23.iterSteps n (map.entries state) =
      ((map.decode state).toList.take n,(map.decode state).toList.drop n) := by
  rw [trusted.btree_iter_ordered,ProverCommitTreeOps23.iterSteps_spec]

omit trusted

def tlsRun (tls : TLSAPI Thread Slot Output) (store : Thread → Slot) :
    List (Thread × ProverCommitTLS23.Access Slot Output) → (Thread → Slot) × List Output
  | [] => (store,[])
  | (t,f)::tail =>
    let step := tls.access t f store
    let rest := tlsRun tls step.1 tail
    (rest.1,step.2::rest.2)

include trusted

theorem tls_run_native (store : Thread → Slot)
    (calls : List (Thread × ProverCommitTLS23.Access Slot Output)) :
    tlsRun tls store calls = ProverCommitTLS23.nativeRun store calls := by
  induction calls generalizing store with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons entry tail ih =>
    rcases entry with ⟨t,f⟩
    simp only [tlsRun,ProverCommitTLS23.nativeRun,trusted.tls_live_key,ih]

theorem tls_schedule (store : Thread → Slot) :
    ((tlsRun tls store schedule).1 thread,(tlsRun tls store schedule).2) =
      ProverCommitTLS23.singleRun (store thread) (schedule.map Prod.snd) := by
  rw [tls_run_native map tls thread schedule trusted]
  exact ProverCommitTLS23.schedule_simulates thread schedule trusted.tls_single_thread store

omit trusted

/-- Satisfiability witness in the mathematical std model, with a real empty
schedule. This does not manufacture evidence about the compiled Rust API. -/
def modelMap : MapAPI Key Value (Std.TreeMap Key Value cmp) cmp where
  decode := id
  empty := ∅
  insert := ProverCommitTreeOps23.treeInsert
  get := fun s k => s[k]?
  entries := Std.TreeMap.toList
  entry_or_insert_with := fun s k make =>
    match s[k]? with
    | some v => (s,v,false)
    | none => let v := make (); (s.insert k v,v,true)
  set_from_iter := ascendingDistinct
  len := fun s => s.toList.length
  slice_sort := fun xs => xs.mergeSort (· ≤ ·)
  vec_dedup := fun xs => xs.destutter (· ≠ ·)

def modelTLS : TLSAPI Thread Slot Output where
  access := ProverCommitTLS23.native

theorem model_consistent (t : Thread) :
    TrustedStd (modelMap (Key := Key) (Value := Value) (cmp := cmp))
      (modelTLS (Thread := Thread) (Slot := Slot) (Output := Output)) t [] := by
  refine ⟨rfl, fun _ _ _ => rfl, fun _ _ _ => rfl, fun _ _ => rfl,
    fun _ => rfl, fun _ _ _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl, fun _ _ _ => rfl, ?_⟩
  intro entry h
  exact False.elim (List.not_mem_nil h)

#print axioms writes
#print axioms lookup
#print axioms iteration
#print axioms tls_run_native
#print axioms tls_schedule
#print axioms model_consistent
end R1Z.ProverCommitTrustedStd24

import R1Z.ProverCommitTreeMap22
/-! Operation-level specification for source map gates. The induction below
is conditional on universal insert/get contracts; bounded Rust gates alone
do not supply those contracts for arbitrary tree height. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitTreeOps23
variable {Key Value State : Type} {cmp : Key → Key → Ordering}
  [Std.TransCmp cmp] [Std.LawfulEqCmp cmp]

def treeInsert (tree : Std.TreeMap Key Value cmp) (key : Key) (value : Value) :
    Std.TreeMap Key Value cmp × Option Value := (tree.insert key value,tree[key]?)

def runWrites (insert : State → Key → Value → State × Option Value)
    (state : State) : List (Key × Value) → State × List (Option Value)
  | [] => (state,[])
  | (key,value)::tail =>
    let step := insert state key value
    let rest := runWrites insert step.1 tail
    (rest.1,step.2::rest.2)

/-- Arbitrary write schedules, including repeats: the final map and the
entire sequence of previous answers follow from the two insert obligations.
These obligations are explicit named hypotheses, not a Rust source instance. -/
theorem writes_decode (decode : State → Std.TreeMap Key Value cmp)
    (insert : State → Key → Value → State × Option Value)
    (insert_state : ∀ s key value, decode (insert s key value).1 = (decode s).insert key value)
    (insert_previous : ∀ s key value, (insert s key value).2 = (decode s)[key]?)
    (schedule : List (Key × Value)) (state : State) :
    (decode (runWrites insert state schedule).1,(runWrites insert state schedule).2) =
      runWrites treeInsert (decode state) schedule := by
  induction schedule generalizing state with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons entry tail ih =>
    rcases entry with ⟨key,value⟩
    have rest := ih (insert state key value).1
    rw [insert_state] at rest
    simp only [runWrites,treeInsert]
    rw [insert_previous]
    exact congrArg (fun p => (p.1,(decode state)[key]?::p.2)) rest

/-- Exact get specification, composed with the existing universal list model. -/
theorem get_decode [DecidableEq Key] [DecidableEq Value]
    (decode : State → Std.TreeMap Key Value cmp) (get : State → Key → Option Value)
    (get_spec : ∀ s key, get s key = (decode s)[key]?) (state : State) (key : Key) :
    get state key = ProverCommitTable20.lookup (decode state).toList key := by
  rw [get_spec,ProverCommitTreeMap22.lookup_toList]

/-- Iterator specification preserves the unconsumed suffix, rather than only
membership of returned entries. The Rust cursor representation is separate. -/
def iterSteps {Entry : Type} : Nat → List Entry → List Entry × List Entry
  | 0, entries => ([],entries)
  | _+1, [] => ([],[])
  | n+1, entry::tail =>
    let rest := iterSteps n tail
    (entry::rest.1,rest.2)

theorem iterSteps_spec {Entry : Type} (n : Nat) (entries : List Entry) :
    iterSteps n entries = (entries.take n,entries.drop n) := by
  induction n generalizing entries with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    cases entries with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons entry tail => simp only [iterSteps,ih,List.take_succ_cons,List.drop_succ_cons]

theorem tree_iteration (tree : Std.TreeMap Key Value cmp) (n : Nat) :
    (iterSteps n tree.toList).1 ++ (iterSteps n tree.toList).2 = tree.toList := by
  rw [iterSteps_spec]
  exact List.take_append_drop n tree.toList

#print axioms writes_decode
#print axioms get_decode

This is a standard-library model theorem, not an identification of the
Rust allocator/tree implementation with Lean's tree representation. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitTreeMap22
open ProverCommitTable20
variable {Key Value : Type} [DecidableEq Key] [DecidableEq Value]

/-- Membership graph suffices even without an explicit uniqueness premise:
all duplicate keys, if present, necessarily carry the same value. -/
theorem lookup_of_graph (entries : List (Key × Value)) (key : Key) (value : Option Value)
    (graph : ∀ v, (key,v) ∈ entries ↔ value = some v) : lookup entries key = value := by
  induction entries with
  | nil =>
    cases value with
    | none => rfl
    | some v => exact False.elim (List.not_mem_nil ((graph v).mpr rfl))
  | cons entry tail ih =>
    rcases entry with ⟨a,b⟩
    by_cases same : a=key
    · subst a
      have hv := (graph b).mp (List.mem_cons_self ..)
      simp only [lookup,ite_true]
      exact hv.symm
    · simp only [lookup,if_neg same]
      apply ih
      intro v
      rw [← graph v]
      simp only [List.mem_cons,Prod.mk.injEq]
      constructor
      · exact Or.inr
      · rintro (⟨he,_⟩ | ht)
        · exact False.elim (same he.symm)
        · exact ht

variable {cmp : Key → Key → Ordering} [Std.TransCmp cmp] [Std.LawfulEqCmp cmp]

theorem lookup_toList (tree : Std.TreeMap Key Value cmp) (key : Key) :
    lookup tree.toList key = tree[key]? := by
  exact lookup_of_graph _ _ _ (fun v => Std.TreeMap.mem_toList_iff_getElem?_eq_some)

/-- Every finite tree size and every key; insert, overwrite and miss all
have the identical observable lookup law. -/
theorem insert_lookup (tree : Std.TreeMap Key Value cmp) (key query : Key) (answer : Value) :
    lookup (tree.insert key answer).toList query =
      lookup (ProverCommitTable20.insert tree.toList key answer false).1 query := by
  rw [lookup_toList,Std.TreeMap.getElem?_insert,ProverCommitTable20.insert_lookup,lookup_toList]
  simp only [Std.LawfulEqCmp.compare_eq_iff_eq]

def program (tree : Std.TreeMap Key Value cmp) (key : Key) (answer : Value) (collision : Bool) :
    Std.TreeMap Key Value cmp × Bool :=
  (tree.insert key answer, collision || conflict tree[key]? answer)

theorem program_collision (tree : Std.TreeMap Key Value cmp) (key : Key)
    (answer : Value) (collision : Bool) :
    (program tree key answer collision).2 =
      (ProverCommitTable20.insert tree.toList key answer collision).2 := by
  rw [ProverCommitTable20.insert_collision,lookup_toList]
  rfl

/-- Enumeration preserves exactly the published key/value graph. -/
theorem enumerated (tree : Std.TreeMap Key Value cmp) (key : Key) (value : Value) :
    (key,value) ∈ tree.toList ↔ lookup tree.toList key = some value := by
  rw [lookup_toList]
  exact Std.TreeMap.mem_toList_iff_getElem?_eq_some

def writes (tree : Std.TreeMap Key Value cmp) (collision : Bool) :
    List (Key × Value) → Std.TreeMap Key Value cmp × Bool
  | [] => (tree,collision)
  | (key,answer)::tail =>
      let next := program tree key answer collision
      writes next.1 next.2 tail

finite source write schedule, including repeated keys and arbitrary prefixes. -/

      (writes tree collision entries).1[query]?) ∧
    (ProverCommitTable20.writes table collision entries).2 =
      (writes tree collision entries).2 := by
  induction entries generalizing tree table collision with
  | nil => exact ⟨related,rfl⟩
  | cons entry tail ih =>
    rcases entry with ⟨key,answer⟩
    have rel : ∀ query, lookup (ProverCommitTable20.insert table key answer collision).1 query =

      intro query
      rw [ProverCommitTable20.insert_lookup,Std.TreeMap.getElem?_insert,related]
      simp only [Std.LawfulEqCmp.compare_eq_iff_eq]
    have flag : (ProverCommitTable20.insert table key answer collision).2 =
        (collision || conflict tree[key]? answer) := by
      rw [ProverCommitTable20.insert_collision,related]
    simpa only [writes,program,ProverCommitTable20.writes,flag] using
      ih (ProverCommitTable20.insert table key answer collision).1
        (tree.insert key answer) (collision || conflict tree[key]? answer) rel

    tree.toList.Pairwise (fun a b => cmp a.1 b.1 = .lt) :=
  Std.TreeMap.ordered_keys_toList

  induction pre with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons entry tail ih =>
    rcases entry with ⟨k,v⟩
    simp only [List.cons_append,lookup]
    by_cases h : k=key
    · simp only [h,if_true,Option.orElse_some]
    · simp only [h,if_false,ih]

update. This is the induction boundary consumed by a single ProverCommitTable20.insert step. -/
theorem insert_append_miss (pre suffix : Table Key Value) (key : Key) (answer : Value)
    (collision : Bool) (miss : lookup pre key=none) :
    ProverCommitTable20.insert (pre++suffix) key answer collision =
      let out := ProverCommitTable20.insert suffix key answer collision
      (pre++out.1,out.2) := by
  induction pre with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons entry tail ih =>
    rcases entry with ⟨k,v⟩
    by_cases h : k=key
    · simp only [lookup,h,if_true] at miss
      cases miss
    · simp only [lookup,h,if_false] at miss
      simp only [List.cons_append,ProverCommitTable20.insert,h,if_false,ih miss]

/-- Exact overwrite at one entry after any missed pre. The entire suffix
and the original key are retained, and the collision flag is sticky. -/
theorem overwrite_after_prefix (pre suffix : Table Key Value) (key : Key)
    (previous answer : Value) (collision : Bool) (miss : lookup pre key=none) :
    ProverCommitTable20.insert (pre++(key,previous)::suffix) key answer collision =
      (pre++(key,answer)::suffix,collision || decide (previous≠answer)) := by
  rw [insert_append_miss pre ((key,previous)::suffix) key answer collision miss]
  simp only [ProverCommitTable20.insert,if_true]

/-- The symbolic pre in the single-entry gate is exactly first-hit lookup;
its summary also accounts for hits before the selected entry. -/
theorem entry_collision (pre suffix : Table Key Value) (key address : Key)
    (previous answer : Value) (collision : Bool) :
    (ProverCommitTable20.insert (pre++(key,previous)::suffix) address answer collision).2 =
      (collision || conflict ((lookup pre address).orElse
        (fun _ => if key=address then some previous else lookup suffix address)) answer) := by
  rw [insert_collision,lookup_append]
  rfl

and owned Vec/List transport remain distinct from this finite induction. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitTable20
variable {Key Value : Type} [DecidableEq Key] [DecidableEq Value]
abbrev Table (Key Value : Type) := List (Key × Value)

def lookup (table : Table Key Value) (key : Key) : Option Value :=
  match table with
  | [] => none
  | (k,v)::tail => if k=key then some v else lookup tail key

def conflict (old : Option Value) (answer : Value) : Bool :=
  match old with
  | none => false
  | some previous => decide (previous≠answer)

def insert (table : Table Key Value) (key : Key) (answer : Value) (collision : Bool) :
    Table Key Value × Bool :=
  match table with
  | [] => ([(key,answer)],collision)
  | (k,v)::tail =>
    if k=key then ((k,answer)::tail,collision || decide (v≠answer))
    else let out := insert tail key answer collision
         ((k,v)::out.1,out.2)

/-- The collision branch is needed only for the first matching table entry.

theorem insert_collision (table : Table Key Value) (key : Key) (answer : Value)
    (collision : Bool) :
    (insert table key answer collision).2 = (collision || conflict (lookup table key) answer) := by
  induction table with
  | nil => simp only [insert,lookup,conflict,Bool.or_false]
  | cons entry tail ih =>
    rcases entry with ⟨k,v⟩
    by_cases same : k=key
    · simp only [insert,lookup,same,if_true,conflict]
    · simp only [insert,lookup,same,if_false,ih]

/-- Every individual address gets the overwritten answer or its prior lookup.

theorem insert_lookup (table : Table Key Value) (key query : Key) (answer : Value)
    (collision : Bool) :
    lookup (insert table key answer collision).1 query =
      if key=query then some answer else lookup table query := by
  induction table with
  | nil => simp only [insert,lookup]
  | cons entry tail ih =>
    rcases entry with ⟨k,v⟩
    by_cases same : k=key
    · subst k
      simp only [insert,if_true,lookup]
      split_ifs <;> rfl
    · simp only [insert,same,if_false,lookup,ih]
      by_cases hit : k=query
      · have miss : key≠query := by intro h;exact same (hit.trans h.symm)
        simp only [hit,if_true,miss,if_false]
      · simp only [hit,if_false]

def writes (table : Table Key Value) (collision : Bool) : List (Key × Value) →
    Table Key Value × Bool
  | [] => (table,collision)
  | (key,answer)::tail =>
    let next := insert table key answer collision
    writes next.1 next.2 tail

def oracleWrites (oracle : Key → Option Value) : List (Key × Value) → Key → Option Value
  | [] => oracle
  | (key,answer)::tail => oracleWrites (fun query => if key=query then some answer else oracle query) tail

/-- Complete finite write sequence: repeated addresses retain last-write
semantics. Applying any common fallback preserves every unprogrammed answer. -/
theorem writes_lookup (entries table : Table Key Value) (collision : Bool) (query : Key) :
    lookup (writes table collision entries).1 query = oracleWrites (lookup table) entries query := by
  induction entries generalizing table collision with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons entry tail ih =>
    rcases entry with ⟨key,answer⟩
    simp only [writes,oracleWrites]
    rw [ih]
    have lookupEq : lookup (insert table key answer collision).1 =
        (fun query => if key=query then some answer else lookup table query) := by
      funext q
      exact insert_lookup table key q answer collision
    rw [lookupEq]

theorem collision_sticky (table : Table Key Value) (entries : Table Key Value) :
    (writes table true entries).2=true := by
  induction entries generalizing table with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons entry tail ih =>
    rcases entry with ⟨key,answer⟩
    simp only [writes,insert_collision,Bool.true_or]
    exact ih _

R1Z.ProverCommitWrapping47:
import Aeneas
/-! Successful checked scalar operations equal their release wrapping forms.
These are kernel theorems about the backend operations, not a compiler law. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitWrapping47
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

def Refines {A B : Type} (f : A → B) (checked : Result A) (release : Result B) : Prop :=
  ∀ x, checked=ok x → release=ok (f x)

theorem bind {A B C D : Type} (f : A → B) (g : C → D)
    (c : Result A) (r : Result B) (k : A → Result C) (l : B → Result D)
    (first : Refines f c r) (next : ∀ a, Refines g (k a) (l (f a))) :
    Refines g (c >>= k) (r >>= l) := by
  intro x hx
  cases hc : c with
  | fail e => simp only [hc,bind_tc_fail] at hx; cases hx
  | div => simp only [hc,bind_tc_div] at hx; cases hx
  | ok a =>
    have hr := first a hc
    simp only [hc,bind_tc_ok] at hx
    rw [hr]
    exact next a x hx

theorem refl {A : Type} (r : Result A) : Refines id r r := by intro x h;exact h

theorem pure {A B : Type} (f : A → B) (x : A) : Refines f (ok x) (ok (f x)) := by
  intro y h
  cases h
  rfl

theorem wrap_add {ty : UScalarTy} (x y z : UScalar ty) (h : UScalar.add x y=ok z) :
    UScalar.wrapping_add x y=z := by
  have he := UScalar.add_equiv x y
  have hp : x + y = ok z := h
  rw [hp] at he
  change UScalar.mk (x.bv+y.bv)=z
  rw [← he.2.2]

theorem wrap_sub {ty : UScalarTy} (x y z : UScalar ty) (h : UScalar.sub x y=ok z) :
    UScalar.wrapping_sub x y=z := by
  have he := UScalar.sub_equiv x y
  have hp : x - y = ok z := h
  rw [hp] at he
  change UScalar.mk (x.bv-y.bv)=z
  rw [← he.2.2]

theorem wrap_mul {ty : UScalarTy} (x y z : UScalar ty) (h : UScalar.mul x y=ok z) :
    UScalar.wrapping_mul x y=z := by
  have he := UScalar.mul_equiv x y
  rw [h] at he
  change UScalar.mk (x.bv*y.bv)=z
  rw [← he.2.2]

theorem add {ty : UScalarTy} (x y : UScalar ty) :
    Refines id (UScalar.add x y) (ok (UScalar.wrapping_add x y)) := by
  intro z hz
  exact congrArg ok (wrap_add x y z hz)

theorem sub {ty : UScalarTy} (x y : UScalar ty) :
    Refines id (UScalar.sub x y) (ok (UScalar.wrapping_sub x y)) := by
  intro z hz
  exact congrArg ok (wrap_sub x y z hz)

theorem mul {ty : UScalarTy} (x y : UScalar ty) :
    Refines id (UScalar.mul x y) (ok (UScalar.wrapping_mul x y)) := by
  intro z hz
  exact congrArg ok (wrap_mul x y z hz)

#print axioms bind
#print axioms refl
#print axioms pure
#print axioms wrap_add
#print axioms wrap_sub
#print axioms wrap_mul
#print axioms add
#print axioms sub
#print axioms mul
end R1Z.ProverCommitWrapping47

import ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact
/-! Direct coordinate subtraction, independent of source-result transport. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitSubDecode47
open AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact

theorem limb_sub (a b : Nat) (hb : b<AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.P) :
    (((a+AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.P-b)%AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.P : Nat) :
      AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.M31Exact) =
        (a : AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.M31Exact)-(b : AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.M31Exact) := by
  have hle : b≤a+AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.P := by omega
  rw [ZMod.natCast_mod,Nat.cast_sub hle,Nat.cast_add,ZMod.natCast_self,add_zero]

theorem coordinates (x y z : CurrentQM) (hy : CurrentCanonicalQM y)
    (ha : z.c0.a.val=(x.c0.a.val+2147483647-y.c0.a.val)%2147483647)
    (hb : z.c0.b.val=(x.c0.b.val+2147483647-y.c0.b.val)%2147483647)
    (hc : z.c1.a.val=(x.c1.a.val+2147483647-y.c1.a.val)%2147483647)
    (hd : z.c1.b.val=(x.c1.b.val+2147483647-y.c1.b.val)%2147483647) :
    decode z=decode x-decode y := by
  apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext
  · apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext
    · change (z.c0.a.val : AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.M31Exact)=_
      rw [ha]
      exact limb_sub _ _ hy.1.1
    · change (z.c0.b.val : AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.M31Exact)=_
      rw [hb]
      exact limb_sub _ _ hy.1.2
  · apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext
    · change (z.c1.a.val : AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.M31Exact)=_
      rw [hc]
      exact limb_sub _ _ hy.2.1
    · change (z.c1.b.val : AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.M31Exact)=_
      rw [hd]
      exact limb_sub _ _ hy.2.2

#print axioms limb_sub
#print axioms coordinates
end R1Z.ProverCommitSubDecode47

      aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.StateOnlyAttemptSecrets verifier.Error))
    (pub : aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public)
    (compiled : aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_trace.PoolV1PairForestMergedC1CompilationV1)
    (v : transport.Variant)
    (hash : Slice (Slice U8) → Result (Array U8 32#usize))
    (store : aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.DurableStateOnlyMaskNonceStore)
    (callback : C) (k : Usize) (hk : 8 ≤ k.val) :
    prover.retry_attempt entropy pub compiled v hash store callback k =
      .ok (.Err verifier.Error.AttemptsExhausted,store) := by
  have guard : k >= prover.ATTEMPT_CAP := by
    simp only [prover.ATTEMPT_CAP]
    change 8 ≤ k.val
    exact hk
  rw [prover.retry_attempt]
  simp only [guard,if_true]

namespace R1Z.ProverRwRngTransportValidity
open Aeneas.Std

/-- Inclusive endpoints from rng-caller-aeneas-003's retained TPattern. -/
def Pattern (x : I32) : Prop :=
  (-2147483648 ≤ x.val ∧ x.val ≤ -1) ∨ (1 ≤ x.val ∧ x.val ≤ 2147483647)

abbrev PatternValue := { x : I32 // Pattern x }
abbrev ValidI32 := { x : I32 // x.val ≠ 0 }

/-- I32's own bounds supply the endpoints; only zero is excluded. -/
theorem pattern_iff_nonzero (x : I32) : Pattern x ↔ x.val ≠ 0 := by
  have bounds := x.hBounds
  change (-2147483648 ≤ x.val ∧ x.val < 2147483648) at bounds
  unfold Pattern
  omega

def toValid (x : PatternValue) : ValidI32 :=
  ⟨x.val, (pattern_iff_nonzero x.val).mp x.property⟩

def toPattern (x : ValidI32) : PatternValue :=
  ⟨x.val, (pattern_iff_nonzero x.val).mpr x.property⟩

theorem toValid_preserves_value (x : PatternValue) : (toValid x).val = x.val := rfl

theorem pattern_roundtrip (x : PatternValue) : toPattern (toValid x) = x := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rfl

theorem valid_roundtrip (x : ValidI32) : toValid (toPattern x) = x := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rfl

def eq
  (self : ProverRwFull.core.io.error.ErrorKind) (other : ProverRwFull.core.io.error.ErrorKind) :
  Result Bool
  := do
  let self1 := read_discriminant self
  let other1 := read_discriminant other
  ok (self1 = other1)

def decode (code : Isize) : Option ProverRwFull.core.io.error.ErrorKind :=
  match code.val with
  | 0 => some .NotFound
  | 1 => some .PermissionDenied
  | 2 => some .ConnectionRefused
  | 3 => some .ConnectionReset
  | 4 => some .HostUnreachable
  | 5 => some .NetworkUnreachable
  | 6 => some .ConnectionAborted
  | 7 => some .NotConnected
  | 8 => some .AddrInUse
  | 9 => some .AddrNotAvailable
  | 10 => some .NetworkDown
  | 11 => some .BrokenPipe
  | 12 => some .AlreadyExists
  | 13 => some .WouldBlock
  | 14 => some .NotADirectory
  | 15 => some .IsADirectory
  | 16 => some .DirectoryNotEmpty
  | 17 => some .ReadOnlyFilesystem
  | 18 => some .FilesystemLoop
  | 19 => some .StaleNetworkFileHandle
  | 20 => some .InvalidInput
  | 21 => some .InvalidData
  | 22 => some .TimedOut
  | 23 => some .WriteZero
  | 24 => some .StorageFull
  | 25 => some .NotSeekable
  | 26 => some .QuotaExceeded
  | 27 => some .FileTooLarge
  | 28 => some .ResourceBusy
  | 29 => some .ExecutableFileBusy
  | 30 => some .Deadlock
  | 31 => some .CrossesDevices
  | 32 => some .TooManyLinks
  | 33 => some .InvalidFilename
  | 34 => some .ArgumentListTooLong
  | 35 => some .Interrupted
  | 36 => some .Unsupported
  | 37 => some .UnexpectedEof
  | 38 => some .OutOfMemory
  | 39 => some .InProgress
  | 40 => some .Other
  | 41 => some .Uncategorized
  | _ => none

theorem decode_encode (x : ProverRwFull.core.io.error.ErrorKind) :
    decode (read_discriminant x) = some x := by
  cases x <;> simp [decode, read_discriminant, ProverRwFull.core.io.error.ErrorKind.read_discriminant]

theorem discriminant_injective : Function.Injective
    (fun x : ProverRwFull.core.io.error.ErrorKind => (read_discriminant x : Isize)) := by
  intro a b h
  have h' := congrArg decode h
  rw [decode_encode, decode_encode] at h'
  exact Option.some.inj h'

theorem eq_exact (a b : ProverRwFull.core.io.error.ErrorKind) :
    eq a b = .ok (decide (a = b)) := by
  simp only [eq, discriminant_injective.eq_iff]

/-- Finite native-error representation; value-level only, with its ABI/source

    (raw : RawReply E) :

import R1Z.ProverRwRngOwnerCertificate
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Pi

/-! A finite carrier for the D193 prototype, including error replies.
This is not a probability law for OS errors and not a deployed FS instance.
The single cursor is retained across calls; it is never reset per attempt. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PV_RunJoin_World
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow ProverRwRng
open ProverRwRngOwnerStep ProverRwRngOwnerEvents ProverRwRngOwnerInventory

abbrev Byte := Fin 256
abbrev RawReply := (Fin 64 → Byte) × Option Byte
abbrev RawTape := Fin 128 → RawReply

def byte (b : Byte) : U8 := UScalar.ofNatCore b.val b.isLt

def reply (r : RawReply) : ProverRwRngTape.Reply :=
  (⟨List.ofFn (fun i => byte (r.1 i)), by simp⟩,
    match r.2 with
    | none => .Ok ()
    | some error => .Err (byte error))

def replies (raw : RawTape) : List ProverRwRngTape.Reply :=
  List.ofFn (fun i => reply (raw i))

theorem replies_length (raw : RawTape) : (replies raw).length = 128 := by
  simp only [replies,List.length_ofFn]

def provider (raw : RawTape) (used : Usize) : Tape :=
  ProverRwRngTape.tape (replies raw)
    (by rw [replies_length]; scalar_tac) used

instance raw_finite : Fintype RawTape := inferInstance
instance raw_nonempty : Nonempty RawTape := inferInstance

theorem reply_at (raw : RawTape) (i : Fin 128) :
    (provider raw 0#usize).replies.val[i.val]? = some (reply (raw i)) := by
  simp only [provider,ProverRwRngTape.tape,replies,List.getElem?_ofFn,dif_pos i.isLt]

variable [ErasureFns]

/-- D193, specialized to the explicit finite carrier. All replies, including
errors and rejected zero blocks, retain their actual positions. The .ok guard
is extraction execution, not successful native entropy or proof generation. -/
theorem finite_owner (raw : RawTape) (used : Usize)
    (nonce : Array U8 32#usize) :
    ProverRwRng.old_owner nonce (provider raw used) =
      ProverRwRng.owner nonce (provider raw used) ∧
    ∀ after status,
      ProverRwRng.owner nonce (provider raw used) = .ok (after,status) →
      ∃ states,
        OwnerReplay (oldBody nonce) Prod.swap nonce (provider raw used) states (after,status) ∧
        OwnerReplay (newBody nonce) id nonce (provider raw used) states (after,status) ∧
        after.replies = (provider raw used).replies ∧
        after.used.val = used.val + drawCount states ∧
        drawCount states ≤ 16 ∧
        events states = (List.range' used.val (drawCount states)).map
          (fun index => (Array.repeat 64#usize 0#u8,index,(replies raw)[index]?)) ∧
        (∀ event ∈ events states, event.2.2.isSome = true) ∧
        after.replies.val.drop after.used.val =
          (replies raw).drop (used.val + drawCount states) := by
  exact ProverRwRngOwnerCertificate.universal_cap16 nonce (provider raw used)

/-- Sequential admitted owner executions share one provider. This relation
includes entropy error statuses; it assumes no equality of outputs or traces.
It does not install the native cap8 callback or choose its nonce policy. -/
inductive Owners : Tape → List (List State) → Tape → Prop
  | nil (p : Tape) : Owners p [] p
  | cons {p next final : Tape} {states : List State} {rest : List (List State)}
      (nonce : Array U8 32#usize) (status : ProverRwRngControl.Status)
      (run : ProverRwRng.owner nonce p = .ok (next,status))
      (trace : OwnerReplay (newBody nonce) id nonce p states (next,status))
      (tail : Owners next rest final) : Owners p (states :: rest) final

def count (calls : List (List State)) : Nat :=
  (calls.map drawCount).sum

def log (calls : List (List State)) : List Event := calls.flatMap events

theorem owner_inventory {nonce : Array U8 32#usize} {p next : Tape}
    {status : ProverRwRngControl.Status} {states : List State}
    (trace : OwnerReplay (newBody nonce) id nonce p states (next,status)) :
    next.replies = p.replies ∧ next.used.val = p.used.val + drawCount states ∧
      drawCount states ≤ 16 ∧
      events states = (List.range' p.used.val (drawCount states)).map
        (fun index => (Array.repeat 64#usize 0#u8,index,p.replies.val[index]?)) := by
  rcases trace with rejected | entered
  · rcases rejected with ⟨_,empty,final⟩
    cases final
    subst states
    exact ⟨rfl,rfl,by decide,rfl⟩
  · rcases entered with ⟨_,raw,replay,final⟩
    change raw = (next,status) at final
    subst raw
    obtain ⟨same,cursor,bound⟩ := replay_inventory nonce replay
    exact ⟨same,cursor,bound.trans (Nat.sub_le 16 _),replay_events nonce replay⟩

theorem owners_inventory {p final : Tape} {calls : List (List State)}
    (runs : Owners p calls final) :
    final.replies = p.replies ∧ final.used.val = p.used.val + count calls ∧
      count calls ≤ 16 * calls.length ∧
      log calls = (List.range' p.used.val (count calls)).map
        (fun index => (Array.repeat 64#usize 0#u8,index,p.replies.val[index]?)) := by
  induction runs with
  | nil p => exact ⟨rfl,rfl,by simp [count],rfl⟩
  | @cons p next final states rest nonce status run trace tail ih =>
    obtain ⟨same,cursor,bound,ordered⟩ := owner_inventory trace
    rcases ih with ⟨sameTail,cursorTail,boundTail,orderedTail⟩
    have counts : count (states :: rest) = drawCount states + count rest := by
      simp only [count,List.map_cons,List.sum_cons]
    refine ⟨sameTail.trans same,?_,?_,?_⟩
    · rw [counts,cursorTail,cursor,Nat.add_assoc]
    · rw [counts,List.length_cons]
      omega
    · change events states ++ log rest = _
      rw [ordered,orderedTail,same,cursor,counts,← List.map_append,← List.range'_append]
      simp only [Nat.one_mul]

/-- Eight source-owner calls cannot consume beyond the common 128-reply
budget from cursor zero. This is a capacity/ordered-event fact, not an entropy
uniformity or native callback theorem. -/
theorem cap8_inventory (raw : RawTape) {final : Tape} {calls : List (List State)}
    (runs : Owners (provider raw 0#usize) calls final) (cap : calls.length ≤ 8) :
    final.replies.val = replies raw ∧ final.used.val = count calls ∧
      count calls ≤ 128 ∧

        (fun index => (Array.repeat 64#usize 0#u8,index,(replies raw)[index]?)) ∧
      final.replies.val.drop final.used.val = (replies raw).drop (count calls) := by
  obtain ⟨same,cursor,bounded,ordered⟩ := owners_inventory runs
  change final.used.val = 0 + count calls at cursor
  have cursor' : final.used.val = count calls := by simpa only [Nat.zero_add] using cursor
  have same' : final.replies.val = replies raw := congrArg (fun v => v.val) same

variable [NativeTypes] [ErasureFns]

theorem callback_invocation {N : Type} (policy : Policy N) (p : Tape) (n : N)
    (k : Usize) (out : Tape × N × core.result.Result StateOnlyAttemptSecrets ProverRwRngCaller.Error)
    (hr : selected_callback policy p n k = .ok out) :
    ∃ nonce afterNonce afterTape nativeStatus,
      policy.call_mut n k = .ok (nonce,afterNonce) ∧
      StateOnlyAttemptSecrets.generate_with Tape.Insts.Prover_rw_rng_callerDraw64 nonce p =
        .ok (afterTape,nativeStatus) ∧
      out = (afterTape,afterNonce,mapped nativeStatus) := by
  cases hp : policy.call_mut n k with
  | fail e => simp only [selected_callback,hp,bind_tc_fail] at hr; cases hr
  | div => simp only [selected_callback,hp,bind_tc_div] at hr; cases hr
  | ok pair =>
    rcases pair with ⟨nonce,afterNonce⟩
    cases he : StateOnlyAttemptSecrets.generate_with Tape.Insts.Prover_rw_rng_callerDraw64 nonce p with
    | fail e =>
      simp only [selected_callback,hp,bind_tc_ok,Aeneas.Std.uncurry,he,bind_tc_fail] at hr
      cases hr
    | div =>
      simp only [selected_callback,hp,bind_tc_ok,Aeneas.Std.uncurry,he,bind_tc_div] at hr
      cases hr
    | ok result =>
      rcases result with ⟨afterTape,nativeStatus⟩
      have same := callback_step policy p afterTape n afterNonce k nonce nativeStatus hp he
      exact ⟨nonce,afterNonce,afterTape,nativeStatus,rfl,he,Result.ok.inj (hr.symm.trans same)⟩

theorem ordered_indices {N L B : Type} {policy : Policy N} {body : Body B L}
    {s : State N L B} {states out} (path : Replay policy body s states out) :
    states.map (fun t => t.2.2.2.2.val) = List.range' s.2.2.2.2.val states.length := by
  induction path with
  | done h => simp
  | @cont s next states out h path ih =>
    have prog := step_progress policy body s.1 s.2.1 s.2.2.1 s.2.2.2.1 s.2.2.2.2 next h
    simp only [List.map_cons,List.length_cons,List.range'_succ,ih,prog.2]

namespace R1Z.ProverRwRngCallerComposition
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow ProverRwRngCaller
open ProverRwRngCallerControl ProverRwRngCallerEntropy
variable [NativeTypes] [ErasureFns]

theorem one_owner (p p' : Tape) (nonce : Array U8 32#usize)
    (admitted : entropy_nonzero32 nonce = .ok true)
    (reply : Tape.Insts.Prover_rw_rng_callerDraw64.fill p (Array.repeat 64#usize 0#u8) =
      .ok ((p',.Ok ()),Array.repeat 64#usize 1#u8)) :
    StateOnlyAttemptSecrets.generate_with Tape.Insts.Prover_rw_rng_callerDraw64 nonce p =
      .ok (p',.Ok ⟨nonce,Array.repeat 32#usize 1#u8,Array.repeat 32#usize 1#u8⟩) := by
  have step := constant_step Tape.Insts.Prover_rw_rng_callerDraw64 p p' nonce
    0#usize 16#usize (by decide) 1#u8 (by rfl) (by rfl) reply
  simp only [show (1#u8 != 0#u8) = true from rfl,if_true] at step
  unfold StateOnlyAttemptSecrets.generate_with
  rw [admitted]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok,if_true,ENTROPY_RETRY_LIMIT]
  unfold StateOnlyAttemptSecrets.generate_with_loop
  rw [loop]
  simpa only [step,bind_tc_ok] using step

theorem zero_reject_fatal {N L B : Type} (policy : Policy N) (body : Body B L)
    (p0 p1 p2 p3 : Tape) (n0 n1 n2 : N) (l0 l1 l2 : L) (b0 b1 b2 : B)
    (nonce0 nonce1 : Array U8 32#usize)
    (policy0 : policy.call_mut n0 0#usize = .ok (nonce0,n1))
    (policy1 : policy.call_mut n1 1#usize = .ok (nonce1,n2))
    (admit0 : entropy_nonzero32 nonce0 = .ok true)
    (admit1 : entropy_nonzero32 nonce1 = .ok true)
    (draw0 : Tape.Insts.Prover_rw_rng_callerDraw64.fill p0 (Array.repeat 64#usize 0#u8) =
      .ok ((p1,.Ok ()),Array.repeat 64#usize 0#u8))
    (draw1 : Tape.Insts.Prover_rw_rng_callerDraw64.fill p1 (Array.repeat 64#usize 0#u8) =
      .ok ((p2,.Ok ()),Array.repeat 64#usize 1#u8))
    (draw2 : Tape.Insts.Prover_rw_rng_callerDraw64.fill p2 (Array.repeat 64#usize 0#u8) =
      .ok ((p3,.Ok ()),Array.repeat 64#usize 1#u8))
    (body0 : body.call_mut b0
      (⟨nonce0,Array.repeat 32#usize 1#u8,Array.repeat 32#usize 1#u8⟩,l0) =
        .ok ((l1,.Err .Rejected),b1))
    (body1 : body.call_mut b1
      (⟨nonce1,Array.repeat 32#usize 1#u8,Array.repeat 32#usize 1#u8⟩,l1) =
        .ok ((l2,.Err .Semantic),b2)) :
    prove_masked_retrying_with policy body true p0 n0 l0 b0 =
      .ok (p3,n2,l2,b2,.Err .Semantic) := by
  have entropy0 := zero_then_one_owner p0 p1 p2 nonce0 admit0 draw0 draw1
  have entropy1 := one_owner p2 p3 nonce1 admit1 draw2
  have callback0 := callback_step policy p0 p2 n0 n1 0#usize nonce0 _ policy0 entropy0
  have callback1 := callback_step policy p2 p3 n1 n2 1#usize nonce1 _ policy1 entropy1
  have increment : ((0#usize) + 1#usize : Result Usize) = .ok (1#usize) := by
    obtain ⟨next,h,hval⟩ := increment_safe 0#usize (by decide)
    have same : next = 1#usize := by apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq; exact hval
    simpa only [same] using h
  change retry_attempt policy body p0 n0 l0 b0 0#usize = _
  rw [body_rejected policy body p0 p2 n0 n1 l0 l1 b0 b1 0#usize 1#usize
    (by decide) _ callback0 body0 increment]
  exact body_fatal policy body p2 p3 n1 n2 l1 l2 b1 b2 1#usize
    (by decide) _ .Semantic (by intro h; cases h) callback1 body1

#print axioms zero_reject_fatal

import R1Z.ProverRwRngNonzero
import R1Z.ProverRwRngCallerControl

/-! Direct emitted-owner control under explicit primitive replies. No native
provider, OS law, whole-owner equivalence or drop contract is assumed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverRwRngCallerEntropy
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow ProverRwRngCaller
variable [NativeTypes] [ErasureFns]
abbrev Status := core.result.Result StateOnlyAttemptSecrets StateOnlyAttemptEntropyError
abbrev body {P : Type} := @StateOnlyAttemptSecrets.generate_with_loop.body _ _ P
abbrev ownerLoop {P : Type} := @StateOnlyAttemptSecrets.generate_with_loop _ _ P

theorem scan_same (nonce : Array U8 32#usize) :
    entropy_nonzero32 nonce = ProverRwRng.entropy_nonzero32 nonce := rfl

theorem constant_step {P : Type} (draw : Draw64 P) (p after : P)
    (nonce : Array U8 32#usize) (retry limit : Usize) (below : retry < limit)
    (byte : U8) (stable : byte ||| byte = byte) (initial : (0#u8) ||| byte = byte)
    (reply : draw.fill p (Array.repeat 64#usize 0#u8) =
      .ok ((after,.Ok ()),Array.repeat 64#usize byte)) :
    body draw nonce limit p retry =
      if byte != 0#u8 then
        .ok (.done (after,.Ok ⟨nonce,Array.repeat 32#usize byte,Array.repeat 32#usize byte⟩))
      else (do
        let nextRetry ← retry + 1#usize
        .ok (.cont (after,nextRetry))) := by
  unfold body StateOnlyAttemptSecrets.generate_with_loop.body
  simp only [below,if_true,zeroize.Zeroizing.new,
    zeroize.Zeroizing.Insts.CoreOpsDerefDerefMut.deref_mut,bind_tc_ok,Aeneas.Std.uncurry,reply,StateOnlyAttemptEntropyError.Insts.CoreConvertFromError.from]
  change (do
    let b ← entropy_nonzero32 (Array.repeat 32#usize byte)
    if b then do
      let b1 ← entropy_nonzero32 (Array.repeat 32#usize byte)
      if b1 then .ok (.done (after,.Ok ⟨nonce,Array.repeat 32#usize byte,Array.repeat 32#usize byte⟩))
      else (do
        let nextRetry ← retry + 1#usize
        .ok (.cont (after,nextRetry)))
    else (do
        let nextRetry ← retry + 1#usize
        .ok (.cont (after,nextRetry))) : Result (ControlFlow (P × Usize) (P × Status))) = _
  letI : ProverRwRng.ErasureFns :=
    { scalar := fun _ z => .ok z, array := fun _ z => .ok z }
  rw [scan_same, ProverRwRngNonzero.nonzero_repeat byte stable initial]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  split <;> simp_all only [bind_tc_ok,if_true,if_false]

theorem error_state {P : Type} (draw : Draw64 P) (p after : P)
    (nonce : Array U8 32#usize) (retry limit : Usize) (below : retry < limit)
    (written : Array U8 64#usize) (error : getrandom.error.Error)
    (reply : draw.fill p (Array.repeat 64#usize 0#u8) = .ok ((after,.Err error),written)) :
    body draw nonce limit p retry = .ok (.done (after,.Err (.Os error))) := by
  unfold body StateOnlyAttemptSecrets.generate_with_loop.body
  simp only [below,if_true,zeroize.Zeroizing.new,
    zeroize.Zeroizing.Insts.CoreOpsDerefDerefMut.deref_mut,bind_tc_ok,Aeneas.Std.uncurry,reply,StateOnlyAttemptEntropyError.Insts.CoreConvertFromError.from]

theorem cap_state {P : Type} (draw : Draw64 P) (p : P)
    (nonce : Array U8 32#usize) (retry limit : Usize) (stop : ¬ retry < limit) :
    body draw nonce limit p retry = .ok (.done (p,.Err .RepeatedZeroBlock)) := by
  simp only [body,StateOnlyAttemptSecrets.generate_with_loop.body,stop,if_false]

theorem zero_then_one_loop {P : Type} (draw : Draw64 P) (p0 p1 p2 : P)
    (nonce : Array U8 32#usize)
    (first : draw.fill p0 (Array.repeat 64#usize 0#u8) =
      .ok ((p1,.Ok ()),Array.repeat 64#usize 0#u8))
    (second : draw.fill p1 (Array.repeat 64#usize 0#u8) =
      .ok ((p2,.Ok ()),Array.repeat 64#usize 1#u8)) :
    StateOnlyAttemptSecrets.generate_with_loop draw nonce p0 16#usize 0#usize =
      .ok (p2,.Ok ⟨nonce,Array.repeat 32#usize 1#u8,Array.repeat 32#usize 1#u8⟩) := by
  have zero := constant_step draw p0 p1 nonce 0#usize 16#usize (by decide)
    0#u8 (by rfl) (by rfl) first
  have one := constant_step draw p1 p2 nonce 1#usize 16#usize (by decide)
    1#u8 (by rfl) (by rfl) second
  have add : ((0#usize) + 1#usize : Result Usize) = .ok (1#usize) := by
    rw [ProverRwSamplerArithmetic.add_exact 0#usize 1#usize (by scalar_tac)]
    apply congrArg Result.ok
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    rw [Usize.wrapping_add_val_eq]
    change 1 % UScalar.size .Usize = 1
    exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (1#usize).hSize
  simp only [show (0#u8 != 0#u8) = false from rfl,Bool.false_eq_true,if_false,add,bind_tc_ok] at zero
  simp only [show (1#u8 != 0#u8) = true from rfl,if_true] at one
  let step : P × Usize → Result (ControlFlow (P × Usize) (P × Status)) :=
    fun state => body draw nonce 16#usize state.1 state.2
  change loop step (p0,0#usize) = _
  rw [loop]
  simp only [step,zero,bind_tc_ok]
  rw [loop]
  simp only [step,one,bind_tc_ok]


theorem zero_then_one_owner (p0 p1 p2 : Tape) (nonce : Array U8 32#usize)
    (admitted : entropy_nonzero32 nonce = .ok true)
    (first : Tape.Insts.Prover_rw_rng_callerDraw64.fill p0 (Array.repeat 64#usize 0#u8) =
      .ok ((p1,.Ok ()),Array.repeat 64#usize 0#u8))
    (second : Tape.Insts.Prover_rw_rng_callerDraw64.fill p1 (Array.repeat 64#usize 0#u8) =
      .ok ((p2,.Ok ()),Array.repeat 64#usize 1#u8)) :
    StateOnlyAttemptSecrets.generate_with Tape.Insts.Prover_rw_rng_callerDraw64 nonce p0 =
      .ok (p2,.Ok ⟨nonce,Array.repeat 32#usize 1#u8,Array.repeat 32#usize 1#u8⟩) := by
  unfold StateOnlyAttemptSecrets.generate_with
  rw [admitted]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok,if_true,ENTROPY_RETRY_LIMIT]
  exact zero_then_one_loop _ _ _ _ _ first second

#print axioms scan_same
#print axioms constant_step
#print axioms error_state
#print axioms cap_state
#print axioms zero_then_one_loop
#print axioms zero_then_one_owner

def mapped (r : core.result.Result StateOnlyAttemptSecrets StateOnlyAttemptEntropyError) :
    core.result.Result StateOnlyAttemptSecrets ProverRwRngCaller.Error :=
  match r with | .Ok a => .Ok a | .Err _ => .Err .Entropy

theorem native_from (e : getrandom.error.Error) :
    StateOnlyAttemptEntropyError.Insts.CoreConvertFromError.from e =
      .ok (.Os e) := rfl

theorem callback_step {N : Type} (policy : Policy N) (p p' : Tape) (n n' : N)
    (k : Usize) (nonce : Array U8 32#usize)
    (r : core.result.Result StateOnlyAttemptSecrets StateOnlyAttemptEntropyError)
    (hpolicy : policy.call_mut n k = .ok (nonce,n'))
    (hentropy : StateOnlyAttemptSecrets.generate_with
      Tape.Insts.Prover_rw_rng_callerDraw64 nonce p = .ok (p',r)) :
    selected_callback policy p n k = .ok (p',n',mapped r) := by
  unfold selected_callback
  rw [hpolicy]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok,Aeneas.Std.uncurry]
  rw [hentropy]
  cases r <;> rfl

theorem variant_guard {N L B : Type} (policy : Policy N) (body : Body B L)
    (p : Tape) (n : N) (l : L) (b : B) :
    prove_masked_retrying_with policy body false p n l b =
      .ok (p,n,l,b,.Err .Semantic) := rfl

theorem cap_guard {N L B : Type} (policy : Policy N) (body : Body B L)
    (p : Tape) (n : N) (l : L) (b : B) (k : Usize) (cap : k ≥ 8#usize) :
    retry_attempt policy body p n l b k = .ok (p,n,l,b,.Err .AttemptsExhausted) := by
  rw [retry_attempt]
  simpa only [ATTEMPT_CAP,if_pos cap]

theorem callback_error {N L B : Type} (policy : Policy N) (body : Body B L)
    (p p' : Tape) (n n' : N) (l : L) (b : B) (k : Usize)
    (below : ¬ k ≥ 8#usize) (e : ProverRwRngCaller.Error)
    (callback : selected_callback policy p n k = .ok (p',n',.Err e)) :
    retry_attempt policy body p n l b k = .ok (p',n',l,b,.Err e) := by
  rw [retry_attempt]
  simp only [ATTEMPT_CAP,if_neg below,callback,bind_tc_ok,Aeneas.Std.uncurry]

theorem body_fatal {N L B : Type} (policy : Policy N) (body : Body B L)
    (p p' : Tape) (n n' : N) (l l' : L) (b b' : B) (k : Usize)
    (below : ¬ k ≥ 8#usize) (a : StateOnlyAttemptSecrets)
    (e : ProverRwRngCaller.Error) (fatal : e ≠ .Rejected)
    (callback : selected_callback policy p n k = .ok (p',n',.Ok a))
    (hbody : body.call_mut b (a,l) = .ok ((l',.Err e),b')) :
    retry_attempt policy body p n l b k = .ok (p',n',l',b',.Err e) := by
  rw [retry_attempt]
  simp only [ATTEMPT_CAP,if_neg below,callback,bind_tc_ok,Aeneas.Std.uncurry,hbody]
  cases e <;> first | rfl | exact False.elim (fatal rfl)

theorem body_rejected {N L B : Type} (policy : Policy N) (body : Body B L)
    (p p' : Tape) (n n' : N) (l l' : L) (b b' : B) (k next : Usize)
    (below : ¬ k ≥ 8#usize) (a : StateOnlyAttemptSecrets)
    (callback : selected_callback policy p n k = .ok (p',n',.Ok a))
    (hbody : body.call_mut b (a,l) = .ok ((l',.Err .Rejected),b'))
    (increment : (k + 1#usize : Result Usize) = .ok next) :
    retry_attempt policy body p n l b k = retry_attempt policy body p' n' l' b' next := by
  rw [retry_attempt]
  simp only [ATTEMPT_CAP,if_neg below,callback,bind_tc_ok,Aeneas.Std.uncurry,hbody,increment]

theorem body_success {N L B : Type} (policy : Policy N) (body : Body B L)
    (p p' : Tape) (n n' : N) (l l' : L) (b b' : B) (k next : Usize)
    (below : ¬ k ≥ 8#usize) (a : StateOnlyAttemptSecrets)
    (proof : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (audit : U64)
    (callback : selected_callback policy p n k = .ok (p',n',.Ok a))
    (hbody : body.call_mut b (a,l) = .ok ((l',.Ok (proof,audit)),b'))
    (increment : (k + 1#usize : Result Usize) = .ok next) :
    retry_attempt policy body p n l b k =
      .ok (p',n',l',b',.Ok {proof,audit,attempts := next}) := by
  rw [retry_attempt]
  simp only [ATTEMPT_CAP,if_neg below,callback,bind_tc_ok,Aeneas.Std.uncurry,hbody,increment]

theorem increment_safe (k : Usize) (below : k < 8#usize) :
    ∃ next : Usize, (k + 1#usize : Result Usize) = .ok next ∧ next.val = k.val + 1 := by
  have safe : k.val + (1#usize).val ≤ Usize.max := by scalar_tac
  obtain ⟨next,he,hv⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (Usize.add_spec (x := k) (y := 1#usize) safe)
  exact ⟨next,he,by simpa only [show (1#usize).val = 1 by scalar_tac] using hv⟩

#print axioms body_success
