  | [] => 0
  | s::ss => (if s.2.2.2.2.val < 8 then 1 else 0) + callbacks ss

theorem callback_bound {N L B : Type} {policy : Policy N} {body : Body B L}
    {s : State N L B} {states out} (path : Replay policy body s states out)
    (start : s.2.2.2.2.val ≤ 8) : callbacks states ≤ 8 - s.2.2.2.2.val := by
  induction path with
  | done h => simp only [callbacks]; split <;> omega
  | @cont s next states out h path ih =>
    have prog := step_progress policy body s.1 s.2.1 s.2.2.1 s.2.2.2.1 s.2.2.2.2 next h
    have nextBound : next.2.2.2.2.val ≤ 8 := by omega
    have bounded := ih nextBound
    simp only [callbacks,if_pos prog.1]
    omega

theorem cap8 {N L B : Type} (policy : Policy N) (body : Body B L)
    (p : Tape) (n : N) (l : L) (b : B) (out : Output N L B)
    (admitted : prove_masked_retrying_with policy body true p n l b = .ok out) :
    ∃ states, Replay policy body (p,n,l,b,0#usize) states out ∧ callbacks states ≤ 8 := by
  have hr : run policy body (p,n,l,b,0#usize) = .ok out := admitted
  obtain ⟨states,path⟩ := replay_complete policy body _ out hr
  exact ⟨states,path,callback_bound path (by change (0#usize).val ≤ 8; decide)⟩

  unfold retry_step
  split

theorem continues_bind {A B C : Type} (p : B → Prop) (x : Result A)

    Continues p (x >>= f) := by

  | div => intro next impossible; cases impossible

  split
  · intro next h; cases h
  · rename_i below
    unfold ATTEMPT_CAP at below
    have low : k < 8#usize := by scalar_tac
    obtain ⟨next,add,hval⟩ := increment_safe k low
    apply continues_bind
    rintro ⟨p',n',status⟩
    simp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry]
    cases status with

    | Ok a =>
      apply continues_bind

      cases r with
      | Ok pair =>

        simp only [add,bind_tc_ok]
        intro next h; cases h

noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PDict_ReachErase
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ProverRwFull
variable [ExternalTypes]
def publicationFrame (ops : ExternalFuns)
  (semantic : Slice U8 → alloc.vec.Vec U8 → Result ((core.result.Result Unit compact.CodecError) × alloc.vec.Vec U8))
  (query : alloc.vec.Vec U8 → host_commitment.Commitment → host_commitment.Commitment → Array U32 22#usize → Slice aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact → host_commitment.PrivateSalts → Result (alloc.vec.Vec U8))
  (nodes : alloc.vec.Vec U8 → host_commitment.Commitment → host_commitment.Commitment → host_tree.BinaryTree → Array U32 22#usize → Result (core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec U8) verifier.Error))
  (variant : transport.Variant) (p : prover.Publication) :
  Result (core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) verifier.Error)
  :=
  letI : ExternalFuns := ops
  do
  let i ← compact.PROOF_BYTES
  let out := alloc.vec.Vec.with_capacity Std.U8 i
  let a ← compact.MAGIC
  let s ← Aeneas.Std.lift (Array.to_slice a)
  let out1 ← alloc.vec.Vec.extend_from_slice core.clone.CloneU8 out s
  let i1 ← transport.Variant.tag variant
  let s1 ←
    Aeneas.Std.lift (Array.to_slice
      (Array.make 8#usize [ i1, 0#u8, 0#u8, 0#u8, 0#u8, 0#u8, 0#u8, 0#u8 ]))
  let out2 ← alloc.vec.Vec.extend_from_slice core.clone.CloneU8 out1 s1
  let s2 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref p.semantic_bytes
  let (r, out3) ← semantic s2 out2
  let r1 ←
    core.result.Result.map_err
      prover.publish_compact.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnOnceTupleCodecErrorError
      r ()
  let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r1
  match cf with
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue _ =>
    let s3 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref p.y1
    let (r2, out4) ← host_compact.compact_values s3 out3
    let r3 ←
      core.result.Result.map_err
        prover.publish_compact.closure_1.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnOnceTupleCodecErrorError
        r2 ()
    let cf1 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r3
    match cf1 with
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue _ =>
      let a1 ← aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.to_le_bytes p.inactive
      let s4 ← Aeneas.Std.lift (Array.to_slice a1)
      let out5 ← alloc.vec.Vec.extend_from_slice core.clone.CloneU8 out4 s4
      let s5 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref p.c0bytes
      let out6 ← alloc.vec.Vec.extend_from_slice core.clone.CloneU8 out5 s5
      let s6 ← Aeneas.Std.lift (Array.to_slice p.root)
      let out7 ← alloc.vec.Vec.extend_from_slice core.clone.CloneU8 out6 s6
      let s7 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref p.c1bytes
      let out8 ← alloc.vec.Vec.extend_from_slice core.clone.CloneU8 out7 s7
      let s8 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref p.fbytes
      let out9 ← alloc.vec.Vec.extend_from_slice core.clone.CloneU8 out8 s8
      let left_val := alloc.vec.Vec.len out9
      let right_val ← compact.OFF_OPENINGS
      massert (left_val = right_val)
      let (o, _) := core.option.Option.take p.backend.c1
      let cc1 ← core.option.Option.unwrap o
      let (o1, _) := core.option.Option.take p.backend.c2
      let cc2 ← core.option.Option.unwrap o1
      let s9 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref p.folded_word
      let out10 ←
        query out9 cc1 cc2 p.queries s9 p.folded_salts
      let left_val1 := alloc.vec.Vec.len out10
      let right_val1 ← compact.OFF_NODES
      massert (left_val1 = right_val1)
      let r4 ← nodes out10 cc1 cc2 p.tree p.queries
      let cf2 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r4
      match cf2 with
      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
        let left_val2 := alloc.vec.Vec.len val
        massert (left_val2 = i)
        ok (core.result.Result.Ok val)
      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
          (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error)
          residual
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
        (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error) residual
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
      (alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error) residual

    @prover.publish_compact _ ops = publicationFrame ops

    (identity : ∀ s, PV_RunJoin_MapErrInstalled.Identity (d.ops s)) :

      (body schedule unix address d) := by
  intro s secret
  change mapR (fun out : core.result.Result Proof verifier.Error × State N C => (out.1,out.2.ledger.header))
    (mapR (fun out : core.result.Result Proof verifier.Error × PV_RunJoin_LedgerWorld.World => (out.1,{s with ledger := out.2})) _) = _
  rw [PV_RunJoin_ResultTransport.map_comp]

    schedule unix address (d.pub s) (d.compiled s) .S2 (d.hash s) secret
    (PV_RunJoin_LedgerWorldInvariant.clear s.ledger)

/-- Source body changes only the ledger world; entropy and client cursors
retain their exact values, including returned errors. -/
theorem provider_frame (schedule : ProverCommitLedger36.Schedule) (unix : Bool)
    (address : PV_RunJoin_LedgerWorld.Address) (d : Inputs N C)
    (secret : Secret) (s next : State N C) (status : core.result.Result Proof verifier.Error)

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.PV_RunJoin_ResultPost
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

/-- Partial correctness retaining machine failure and divergence. -/
def Post {A : Type} (P : A → Prop) (m : Result A) : Prop :=
  ∀ a, m = .ok a → P a

theorem ok {A : Type} (P : A → Prop) (a : A) (holds : P a) : Post P (.ok a) := by
  intro out same
  cases same
  exact holds

theorem bind_right {A B : Type} (P : B → Prop) (m : Result A) (k : A → Result B)
    (continuation : ∀ a, Post P (k a)) : Post P (m >>= k) := by
  cases m with
  | fail e => intro out same; cases same
  | div => intro out same; cases same
  | ok a => exact continuation a

theorem bind_known {A B : Type} (P : B → Prop) (Q : A → Prop)
    (m : Result A) (k : A → Result B) (hprefix : Post Q m)
    (continuation : ∀ a, Q a → Post P (k a)) : Post P (m >>= k) := by
  cases computation : m with
  | fail e => intro out same; cases same
  | div => intro out same; cases same
  | ok a => exact continuation a (hprefix a computation)

theorem bind_eq_ok {A B : Type} {m : Result A} {k : A → Result B} {out : B}
    (run : (m >>= k) = .ok out) : ∃ a, m = .ok a ∧ k a = .ok out := by
  cases computation : m with
  | fail e => rw [computation] at run; cases run
  | div => rw [computation] at run; cases run
  | ok a => exact ⟨a,rfl,by simpa only [computation,bind_tc_ok] using run⟩

namespace R1Z.PV_RunJoin_LedgerBody
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ProverRwFull ProverRwRetryModel
open PV_RunJoin_ResultPost ProverCommitSemanticTransport26
variable [ExternalTypes]
variable [ProverRwRngCaller.NativeTypes] [ProverRwRngCaller.ErasureFns]
variable {N C : Type}
abbrev State (N C : Type) := PV_RunJoin_UnifiedRetry.State N PV_RunJoin_LedgerWorld.World C

structure Inputs (N C : Type) where
  ops : State N C → ExternalFuns
  pub : State N C → Pub
  compiled : State N C → Compiled
  hash : State N C → Hash

/-- Actual generic emitted caller with explicit source-header/ledger-world
writeback. Native association of the modeled effects is still unproved.
This data construction is not installed at the deployed endpoint. -/
def body (schedule : ProverCommitLedger36.Schedule) (unix : Bool)
    (address : PV_RunJoin_LedgerWorld.Address) (d : Inputs N C) :
    PV_RunJoin_UnifiedRetry.Body (State N C) := fun secret s =>
  letI : ExternalFuns := d.ops s
  mapR (fun out => (out.1,{s with ledger := out.2}))
    (PV_RunJoin_GenericSourceCaller.caller
      (PV_RunJoin_LedgerWorld.dictionary (d.ops s) schedule unix address)
      (d.pub s) (d.compiled s) .S2 (d.hash s) secret (PV_RunJoin_LedgerWorldInvariant.clear s.ledger))

def reservation (schedule : ProverCommitLedger36.Schedule) (unix : Bool)
    (address : PV_RunJoin_LedgerWorld.Address) (d : Inputs N C)
    (secret : Secret) (s : State N C) : Option ProverCommitLedger36.Path :=
  match body schedule unix address d secret s with
  | .ok (_,after) => after.ledger.entered
  | .fail _ | .div => none

/-- Exact V337-shaped ledger equation for this candidate effect interpreter.
It is a model/control theorem; native IO/E2 and full source/header projection
are required before using this ledger as a deployed filesystem decoder. -/
theorem native_ledger_shape (schedule : ProverCommitLedger36.Schedule) (unix : Bool)
    (address : PV_RunJoin_LedgerWorld.Address) (d : Inputs N C)
    (secret : Secret) (s next : State N C)
    (status : core.result.Result Proof verifier.Error)
    (run : body schedule unix address d secret s = .ok (status,next)) :
    next.ledger.model =
      match reservation schedule unix address d secret s with
      | none => s.ledger.model
      | some path => (ProverCommitLedger36.reserve schedule unix path s.ledger.model).2 := by
  have original := run
  unfold body mapR at run
  obtain ⟨raw,computation,run⟩ := bind_eq_ok run
  have invariant := PV_RunJoin_LedgerWorldInvariant.caller (d.ops s) schedule unix address s.ledger
    (d.pub s) (d.compiled s) .S2 (d.hash s) secret raw computation
  have same := congrArg (fun pair => pair.2.ledger) (Result.ok.inj run)
  dsimp only at same invariant
  rw [same] at invariant
  unfold reservation
  rw [original]
  cases entered : next.ledger.entered <;>
    simpa only [PV_RunJoin_LedgerWorldInvariant.Invariant,entered] using invariant

#print axioms native_ledger_shape
end R1Z.PV_RunJoin_LedgerBody

def Invariant (schedule : ProverCommitLedger36.Schedule) (unix : Bool)
    (initial : ProverCommitLedger36.State) (s : World) : Prop :=
  match s.entered with
  | none => s.model = initial
  | some path => s.model = (ProverCommitLedger36.reserve schedule unix path initial).2

def clear (s : World) : World := {s with entered := none}

theorem initial (schedule : ProverCommitLedger36.Schedule) (unix : Bool) (s : World) :
    Invariant schedule unix s.model (clear s) := rfl

theorem callback (ops : ExternalFuns) (schedule : ProverCommitLedger36.Schedule)
    (unix : Bool) (address : Address) (s after : World)
    (statement nonce : Array U8 32#usize) (accepted : Bool)
    (run : reserve ops schedule unix address (clear s) statement nonce = .ok (accepted,after)) :
    Invariant schedule unix s.model after := by
  have written := PV_RunJoin_LedgerWorldFields.writeback ops schedule unix address
    (clear s) after statement nonce accepted run
  unfold Invariant
  rw [written.2]
  exact written.1

theorem caller (ops : ExternalFuns) (schedule : ProverCommitLedger36.Schedule)
    (unix : Bool) (address : Address) (s : World)
    (pub : Pub) (compiled : Compiled) (variant : transport.Variant) (hash : Hash) (secret : Secret) :
    letI : ExternalFuns := ops
    Post (fun out => Invariant schedule unix s.model out.2)
      (PV_RunJoin_GenericSourceCaller.caller (dictionary ops schedule unix address)
        pub compiled variant hash secret (clear s)) := by
  letI : ExternalFuns := ops
  apply PV_RunJoin_BodyFootprint.caller _ _ pub compiled variant hash secret (clear s)
  · exact initial schedule unix s
  · intro statement nonce accepted after run
    exact callback ops schedule unix address s after statement nonce accepted run

theorem writeback (ops : ExternalFuns) (schedule : ProverCommitLedger36.Schedule)
    (unix : Bool) (address : Address) (s after : World)
    (statement nonce : Array U8 32#usize) (accepted : Bool)
    (run : reserve ops schedule unix address s statement nonce = .ok (accepted,after)) :
    after.model = (ProverCommitLedger36.reserve schedule unix (address nonce) s.model).2 ∧
      after.entered = some (address nonce) := by

  obtain ⟨⟨flag,header⟩,native_run,run⟩ := bind_eq_ok run
  have state := congrArg Prod.snd (Result.ok.inj run)
  exact ⟨congrArg (fun world => world.model) state.symm,
    congrArg (fun world => world.entered) state.symm⟩

/-- Every returned world retains the exact native source result projection.
No modeled fault outcome is substituted for the returned source boolean. -/
theorem native_return (ops : ExternalFuns) (schedule : ProverCommitLedger36.Schedule)
    (unix : Bool) (address : Address) (s after : World)
    (statement nonce : Array U8 32#usize) (accepted : Bool)

      _ ops s.header statement nonce = .ok (accepted,after.header) := by
  have projected := source_projection ops schedule unix address s statement nonce
  rw [run] at projected

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ProverRwFull ProverRwRetryModel

variable [ExternalTypes] [ExternalFuns]

theorem with_attempt {S : Type} (P : S → Prop)
    (store : aspis_prover.state_only_hiding.StateOnlyMaskNonceStore S)
    (pub : Pub) (compiled : Compiled) (variant : transport.Variant) (hash : Hash)
    (context : aspis_core.state_only_hiding.StateOnlyHidingContext)
    (binding : Array U8 32#usize) (secret : Secret) (s : S) (initial : P s)
    (callback : ∀ statement nonce accepted after,
      store.«reserve» s statement nonce = .ok (accepted,after) → P after) :
    Post (fun out => P out.2)
      (prover.prove_masked_with_attempt store pub compiled variant hash context binding secret s) := by
  rw [ProverRwBodyStore.factor]
  intro out run
  obtain ⟨⟨material,after⟩,reserved,run⟩ := bind_eq_ok run
  simp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry] at run
  have reserved_property := PV_RunJoin_ReservationFootprint.reserve_build P store secret hash binding context s
    initial (callback context.statement_digest context.mask_nonce)
  have property := reserved_property (material,after) reserved
  have kept := ProverRwBodyStore.continuation store pub compiled variant hash context binding secret material after
  rw [run] at kept
  change out.2 = after at kept
  rw [kept]
  exact property

/-- Source control for the full public-prefix -> actual emitted body path.
Every returned state is either the initial state or the one reservation's
writeback. Errors before reservation leave the state predicate unchanged. -/
theorem caller {S : Type} (P : S → Prop)
    (store : aspis_prover.state_only_hiding.StateOnlyMaskNonceStore S)
    (pub : Pub) (compiled : Compiled) (variant : transport.Variant) (hash : Hash)
    (secret : Secret) (s : S) (initial : P s)
    (callback : ∀ statement nonce accepted after,
      store.«reserve» s statement nonce = .ok (accepted,after) → P after) :
    Post (fun out => P out.2)
      (PV_RunJoin_GenericSourceCaller.caller store pub compiled variant hash secret s) := by
  unfold PV_RunJoin_GenericSourceCaller.caller
  apply bind_right
  intro raw
  apply bind_right
  intro mapped
  cases mapped with
  | Err error =>
    simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok]
    apply bind_right
    intro returned
    exact PV_RunJoin_ResultPost.ok _ _ initial
  | Ok bytes =>
    simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok]
    apply bind_right
    rintro ⟨context,binding⟩
    exact with_attempt P store pub compiled variant hash context binding secret s initial callback

#print axioms with_attempt
#print axioms caller
end R1Z.PV_RunJoin_BodyFootprint

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ProverRwFull ProverRwRetryModel

theorem after_checks {S : Type} (P : S → Prop)
    (store : aspis_prover.state_only_hiding.StateOnlyMaskNonceStore S)
    (secret : Secret) (hash : Hash) (binding : Array U8 32#usize)
    (context : aspis_core.state_only_hiding.StateOnlyHidingContext) (s : S)
    (callback : ∀ accepted after,
      store.«reserve» s context.statement_digest context.mask_nonce = .ok (accepted,after) → P after) :
    Post (fun out => P out.2) (ProverRwOuterAfterChecks.afterChecks store secret hash binding context s) := by
  intro out run
  cases reply : store.«reserve» s context.statement_digest context.mask_nonce with
  | fail e =>
    simp only [ProverRwOuterAfterChecks.afterChecks,reply,bind_tc_fail] at run
    cases run
  | div =>
    simp only [ProverRwOuterAfterChecks.afterChecks,reply,bind_tc_div] at run
    cases run
  | ok pair =>
    have kept := ProverRwBodyReservationTransport.callback_writeback store secret hash binding context
      s pair.2 pair.1 reply
    rw [run] at kept
    change out.2 = pair.2 at kept
    rw [kept]
    exact callback pair.1 pair.2 reply

/-- The exact emitted guard stage either retains the initial state or writes
back the one entered reservation callback. No native effect law is assumed
for proving this SOURCE control theorem. -/
theorem reserve_build {S : Type} (P : S → Prop)
    (store : aspis_prover.state_only_hiding.StateOnlyMaskNonceStore S)
    (secret : Secret) (hash : Hash) (binding : Array U8 32#usize)
    (context : aspis_core.state_only_hiding.StateOnlyHidingContext) (s : S)
    (initial : P s)
    (callback : ∀ accepted after,
      store.«reserve» s context.statement_digest context.mask_nonce = .ok (accepted,after) → P after) :
    Post (fun out => P out.2)
      (aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.StateOnlyAttemptSecrets.reserve_and_build_pool_v1_pair_forest_mask_material_v1
        store secret hash binding context s) := by
  rw [← PV_RunJoin_ReservationGuards.source_eq]
  exact PV_RunJoin_ReservationGuards.preserves P store secret hash binding context s initial
    (after_checks P store secret hash binding context s callback)

#print axioms after_checks
#print axioms reserve_build
end R1Z.PV_RunJoin_ReservationFootprint

import R1Z.ProverRwBodyStore

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverRwBodyReservationTransport
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ProverRwFull ProverRwBodyStore

theorem transfer {A B S : Type} (after : S) (r : Result (A × S))
    (f : A → S → Result (B × S)) (hr : Keeps after r)
    (hf : ∀ a s,Keeps s (f a s)) :
    Keeps after (r >>= fun (a,s) => f a s) := by
  cases r with
  | ok pair =>
    rcases pair with ⟨a,s⟩
    change s=after at hr
    subst s
    exact hf a after
  | fail e => trivial
  | div => trivial

variable [ExternalTypes]
section
variable [ExternalFuns]
theorem callback_writeback {S : Type}
    (store : aspis_prover.state_only_hiding.StateOnlyMaskNonceStore S)
    (attempt : aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.StateOnlyAttemptSecrets)
    (hash : Slice (Slice U8) → Result (Array U8 32#usize))
    (binding : Array U8 32#usize) (context : aspis_core.state_only_hiding.StateOnlyHidingContext)
    (s after : S) (accepted : Bool)
    (reservation : store.«reserve» s context.statement_digest context.mask_nonce=.ok (accepted,after)) :
    Keeps after (ProverRwOuterAfterChecks.afterChecks store attempt hash binding context s) := by
  unfold ProverRwOuterAfterChecks.afterChecks
  rw [reservation]
  cases accepted <;> simp only [bind_tc_ok,Bool.false_eq_true,if_false,if_true]
  all_goals
    repeat' first
      | exact ok_keeps _ _
      | apply bind_keeps; intro x
      | dsimp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry]
      | split
end

theorem body_writeback (ops : ExternalFuns) {S : Type}
    (store : aspis_prover.state_only_hiding.StateOnlyMaskNonceStore S)
    (pub : aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public)
    (compiled : aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_trace.PoolV1PairForestMergedC1CompilationV1)
    (v : transport.Variant) (hash : Slice (Slice U8) → Result (Array U8 32#usize))
    (binding digest : Array U8 32#usize)
    (attempt : aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.StateOnlyAttemptSecrets)
    (s after : S) (accepted : Bool)
    (reservation : store.«reserve» s digest attempt.mask_nonce=.ok (accepted,after)) :
    letI : ExternalFuns := ProverRwOuterGuardLeaves.selected ops
    Keeps after (prover.prove_masked_with_attempt store pub compiled v hash
      (ProverRwOuterContextModel.context digest attempt.mask_nonce) binding attempt s) := by
  letI : ExternalFuns := ProverRwOuterGuardLeaves.selected ops
  rw [ProverRwBodyStore.factor]
  refine transfer after _ (fun r state =>
    ProverRwBodyStoreSource.afterReserve store pub compiled v hash
      (ProverRwOuterContextModel.context digest attempt.mask_nonce) binding attempt r state) ?_ ?_
  · rw [ProverRwOuterGuardBridge.checked ops]
    exact callback_writeback store attempt hash binding _ s after accepted reservation
  · intro r state
    exact ProverRwBodyStore.continuation store pub compiled v hash _ binding attempt r state
#print axioms transfer
#print axioms callback_writeback
#print axioms body_writeback
end R1Z.ProverRwBodyReservationTransport
R1Z.PV_RunJoin_UnifiedRetry:
import R1Z.PV_RunJoin_SourceBinding
import R1Z.ProverRwEffectCallback
import R1Z.ProverCommitRetry34
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PV_RunJoin_UnifiedRetry
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open ProverRwRngCaller
open R1Z.ProverRwRetryModel (Proof Secret)
variable [ProverRwFull.ExternalTypes] [NativeTypes] [ErasureFns]

/-- ONE changing world: body effects can update the very public context read
by the next nonce policy. Separately threading an opaque store handle would
not establish this sharing with its backing filesystem or oracle context. -/
structure State (N L C : Type) where
  provider : Tape
  policy : N
  ledger : L
  client : C

abbrev Body (S : Type) := Secret → S → Result (core.result.Result Proof ProverRwFull.verifier.Error × S)

/-- The actual selected callback order, interpreted with explicit state. The
account closure receives the whole current world. The native owner retains
the provider on OS errors and on rejected draws. -/
def entropy {N L C : Type}
    (account : R1Z.ProverRwEffectCallback.Account (State N L C))
    (index : Nat) (s : State N L C) :
    Result (core.result.Result Secret ProverRwFull.verifier.Error × State N L C) := do
  let (nonce,next) ← account.call_mut s (ProverCommitRetrySource34.word index)
  let (provider,status) ← StateOnlyAttemptSecrets.generate_with
    Tape.Insts.Prover_rw_rng_callerDraw64 nonce next.provider
  let final := {next with provider := provider}
  match status with
  | .Err _ => .ok (.Err .Entropy,final)
  | .Ok secret => .ok (.Ok (PV_RunJoin_SourceBinding.secret secret),final)

def attempt {N L C : Type}
    (account : R1Z.ProverRwEffectCallback.Account (State N L C)) (body : Body (State N L C)) :
    ProverCommitRetry34.Attempt (State N L C) Proof := fun index s => do
  let (status,next) ← entropy account index s
  match status with
  | .Err e => .ok (.stop (ProverRwRetryModel.error e),next)
  | .Ok secret =>
    let (result,final) ← body secret next
    match result with
    | .Ok proof => .ok (.done proof,final)
    | .Err .Rejected => .ok (.retry,final)
    | .Err e => .ok (.stop (ProverRwRetryModel.error e),final)

def client {N L C : Type}
    (account : R1Z.ProverRwEffectCallback.Account (State N L C))
    (body : Body (State N L C)) (s : State N L C) :=
  ProverCommitRetry34.eight (attempt account body) s

/-- Full emitted source body boundary. Native ledger/oracle effects in the
returned world are separately associated; no pure entropy entry is installed. -/
structure SourceBody (S : Type) where
  ops : S → ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns
  pub : S → ProverRwRetryModel.Pub
  compiled : S → ProverRwRetryModel.Compiled
  hash : S → ProverRwRetryModel.Hash
  store : S → ProverRwRetryModel.Store

def BodySourceLaw {S : Type} (d : SourceBody S) (body : Body S) : Prop :=
  ∀ s secret,
    ProverCommitSemanticTransport26.mapR (fun out => (out.1,d.store out.2)) (body secret s) =
      letI : ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns := d.ops s
      ProverRwFull.prover.prove_masked_attempt (d.pub s) (d.compiled s) .S2 (d.hash s) secret (d.store s)

#print axioms entropy
#print axioms attempt
#print axioms client
#print axioms BodySourceLaw
end R1Z.PV_RunJoin_UnifiedRetry
R1Z.PV_RunJoin_SourceBinding:
import R1Z.PV_RunJoin_CallerWorld
import R1Z.ProverRwRetryModel
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PV_RunJoin_SourceBinding
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
variable [ProverRwFull.ExternalTypes]
variable [ProverRwRngCaller.NativeTypes] [ProverRwRngCaller.ErasureFns]

/-- The verifier error constructors are all retained, not collapsed into a
success flag. Native getrandom errors are mapped by the selected callback. -/
def error : ProverRwRngCaller.Error → ProverRwFull.verifier.Error
  | .Parse => .Parse
  | .Semantic => .Semantic
  | .Transcript => .Transcript
  | .Relation => .Relation
  | .Merkle => .Merkle
  | .Query => .Query
  | .Checkpoint => .Checkpoint
  | .Allocation => .Allocation
  | .Rejected => .Rejected
  | .AttemptsExhausted => .AttemptsExhausted
  | .Entropy => .Entropy

def secret (s : ProverRwRngCaller.StateOnlyAttemptSecrets) : ProverRwRetryModel.Secret :=
  ⟨s.mask_nonce,s.field_mask_entropy,s.leaf_salt_seed⟩

/-- Source representations and the remaining source leaves are DATA. The
pointwise body equation below is a separate Prop, not part of this definition.
The source dictionary is indexed by the current native body/ledger world;
entropy is handled by the stateful caller, never by this pure dictionary. -/
structure BodyData (L B : Type) where
  ops : B → L → ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns
  pub : B → ProverRwRetryModel.Pub
  compiled : B → ProverRwRetryModel.Compiled
  hash : B → ProverRwRetryModel.Hash
  store : L → ProverRwRetryModel.Store
  audit : B → U64 → ProverRwFull.prover.MaskedFixtureAudit

def status {L B : Type} (d : BodyData L B) (after : B) :
    core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × U64) ProverRwRngCaller.Error →
      core.result.Result ProverRwRetryModel.Proof ProverRwFull.verifier.Error
  | .Ok (proof,audit) => .Ok (proof,d.audit after audit)
  | .Err e => .Err (error e)

def output {L B : Type} (d : BodyData L B)
    (out : (L × core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec U8 × U64) ProverRwRngCaller.Error) × B) :=
  (status d out.2 out.1.2,d.store out.1.1)

/-- Exact residual successful/error BODY association at the source emission,
including the native MaskedFixtureAudit representation. This alone does not
associate changes to B with oracle events or L with the external filesystem. -/
def BodySourceLaw {L B : Type} (d : BodyData L B) (body : ProverRwRngCallerControl.Body B L) : Prop :=
  ∀ b l s,
    ProverCommitSemanticTransport26.mapR (output d) (body.call_mut b (s,l)) =
      letI : ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns := d.ops b l
      ProverRwFull.prover.prove_masked_attempt (d.pub b) (d.compiled b) .S2
        (d.hash b) (secret s) (d.store l)

theorem error_injective : Function.Injective error := by
  intro a b same
  cases a <;> cases b <;> cases same <;> rfl

theorem secret_nonce (s : ProverRwRngCaller.StateOnlyAttemptSecrets) :
    (secret s).mask_nonce = s.mask_nonce := rfl

#print axioms error
#print axioms secret
#print axioms status
#print axioms output
#print axioms BodySourceLaw
#print axioms error_injective
#print axioms secret_nonce
end R1Z.PV_RunJoin_SourceBinding
R1Z.ProverRwEffectCallback:
import R1Z.ProverRwEffectOwner
import R1Z.ProverRwRetryModel

/-! Checked factoring of the actual proof-account callback at its entropy-owner
call. The source account-key callback remains ordered before entropy. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverRwEffectCallback
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ProverRwFull
open ProverRwEffectSource ProverRwEffectOwner
variable [ExternalTypes] [ExternalFuns]
abbrev Account (C : Type) := core.ops.function.FnMut C Usize (Array U8 32#usize)
abbrev SourceCall {C : Type} := RealR1_client.prove_for_proof_accounts.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeResultStateOnlyAttemptSecretsError.call_mut (T0 := C)

def callback {C : Type} (account : Account C) (generate : Array U8 32#usize → Result Status)
    (state : RealR1_client.prove_for_proof_accounts.closure C) (k : Usize) := do
  let (nonce,afterAccount) ← account.call_mut state k
  let entropy ← generate nonce
  let mapped ← core.result.Result.map_err
    (RealR1_client.prove_for_proof_accounts.closure.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnOnceTupleStateOnlyAttemptEntropyErrorError account)
    entropy ()
  .ok (mapped,afterAccount,fun c : RealR1_client.prove_for_proof_accounts.closure C => c)

theorem callback_eq {C : Type} (account : Account C)
    (state : RealR1_client.prove_for_proof_accounts.closure C) (k : Usize) :
    callback account pureOwner state k = SourceCall account state k := by
  simp only [callback,SourceCall,
    RealR1_client.prove_for_proof_accounts.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeResultStateOnlyAttemptSecretsError.call_mut,
    pure_owner_eq]
  apply (Aeneas.Std.bind_eq_iff _ _ _).mpr

  rcases value with ⟨nonce,next⟩

specialization is an exact extraction theorem. The world interpretation is a
candidate awaiting effect adequacy, not a new extraction trust assumption. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverRwEffectOwner
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow ProverRwFull
open ProverRwEffectSource ProverRwEffectTape
variable [ExternalTypes] [ExternalFuns]

def pureOwner (nonce : Array U8 32#usize) : Result Status := do
  let b ← aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.entropy_nonzero32 nonce
  if b then
    loop (fun retry => pure (emit nonce aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.ENTROPY_RETRY_LIMIT retry)) 0#usize
  else .ok (.Err .RepeatedZeroBlock)

theorem pure_owner_eq (nonce : Array U8 32#usize) :
    pureOwner nonce =
      aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.StateOnlyAttemptSecrets.generate_for_mask_nonce nonce := by
  have steps : (fun retry => pure (emit nonce aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.ENTROPY_RETRY_LIMIT retry)) =
      (fun retry => aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.StateOnlyAttemptSecrets.generate_for_mask_nonce_loop.body
        nonce aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.ENTROPY_RETRY_LIMIT retry) := by
    funext retry
    exact pure_eq nonce _ retry
  unfold pureOwner aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.StateOnlyAttemptSecrets.generate_for_mask_nonce
    aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.StateOnlyAttemptSecrets.generate_for_mask_nonce_loop
  rw [steps]

/-- 16 entered draws plus the source's terminal cap test. A missing finite
reply remains a request boundary; it is never mapped to verifier.Error.Entropy. -/
def worldOwner (nonce : Array U8 32#usize) (world : World) : Execution :=
  match aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.entropy_nonzero32 nonce with
  | .fail e => ⟨.returned (.fail e),world⟩
  | .div => ⟨.returned .div,world⟩
  | .ok false => ⟨.returned (.ok (.Err .RepeatedZeroBlock)),world⟩
  | .ok true => run nonce aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.ENTROPY_RETRY_LIMIT 17 0#usize world

theorem rejected_nonce (nonce : Array U8 32#usize)
    (h : aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.entropy_nonzero32 nonce = .ok false) (world : World) :
    worldOwner nonce world = ⟨.returned (.ok (.Err .RepeatedZeroBlock)),world⟩ := by
  simp only [worldOwner,h]

theorem owner_tape (nonce : Array U8 32#usize) (world : World) :
    (worldOwner nonce world).world.reads.map Prod.snd ++ (worldOwner nonce world).world.tape =
      world.reads.map Prod.snd ++ world.tape := by
  unfold worldOwner
  cases aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.entropy_nonzero32 nonce with
  | fail e => rfl
  | div => rfl
  | ok b => cases b with
    | false => rfl
    | true => exact run_tape nonce _ _ _ world

/-- Full source-owner regression with an admitted nonzero public nonce. -/
theorem owner_zero_then_one (ops : ExternalFuns) (rest : List (Result Reply))
    (reads : List (Slice U8 × Result Reply)) :
    letI : ExternalFuns := ProverRwEffectPrefix.install ops
    let nonce := Array.repeat 32#usize 1#u8
    let zero := ProverRwEntropyObstruction.zeroInput
    let one := ProverRwEntropyObstruction.oneOutput
    let r0 : Result Reply := .ok (.Ok (),zero)
    let r1 : Result Reply := .ok (.Ok (),one)
    worldOwner nonce ⟨r0::r1::rest,reads⟩ =

        ⟨rest,reads ++ [(zero,r0),(zero,r1)]⟩⟩ := by
  letI : ExternalFuns := ProverRwEffectPrefix.install ops
  dsimp only
  unfold worldOwner
  rw [ProverRwEffectNonzero.nonzero_repeat 1#u8 (by rfl) (by rfl)]
  simp only [show (1#u8 != 0#u8) = true from by decide]
  simp only [aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.ENTROPY_RETRY_LIMIT]
  change run (Array.repeat 32#usize 1#u8) 16#usize 17 0#usize _ = _
  simp only [run,step,
    ProverRwEffectPrefix.request ops (Array.repeat 32#usize 1#u8) 16#usize 0#usize (by decide),resumeResult,
    bind_tc_ok,ProverRwEffectRegression.after_zero,finish,advance,
    ProverRwEffectRegression.add_zero_one,
    ProverRwEffectPrefix.request ops (Array.repeat 32#usize 1#u8) 16#usize 1#usize (by decide),
    ProverRwEffectRegression.after_one,List.append_assoc]
  rfl

#print axioms pure_owner_eq
#print axioms rejected_nonce
#print axioms owner_tape
#print axioms owner_zero_then_one

/-! Regression on the actual factored source continuation, with four explicit
transparent-wrapper entries installed. This is not native effect adequacy. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverRwEffectRegression
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow ProverRwFull
open ProverRwEffectSource ProverRwEffectTape ProverRwEffectPrefix
variable [ExternalTypes]

theorem constant_after (ops : ExternalFuns) (nonce : Array U8 32#usize) (retry : Usize)
    (byte : U8) (stable : byte ||| byte = byte) (initial : (0#u8) ||| byte = byte) :
    @after _ (install ops) nonce retry back
      (.Ok (),Array.to_slice (Array.repeat 64#usize byte)) =
      if byte != 0#u8 then .ok (.done (.Ok ⟨nonce,Array.repeat 32#usize byte,Array.repeat 32#usize byte⟩))
      else .ok (.cont (Usize.wrapping_add retry 1#usize)) := by
  letI : ExternalFuns := install ops
  change (do
    let b ← aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.entropy_nonzero32 (Array.repeat 32#usize byte)
    if b then do
      let b1 ← aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.entropy_nonzero32 (Array.repeat 32#usize byte)
      if b1 then .ok (.done (.Ok ⟨nonce,Array.repeat 32#usize byte,Array.repeat 32#usize byte⟩))
      else .ok (.cont (Usize.wrapping_add retry 1#usize))
    else .ok (.cont (Usize.wrapping_add retry 1#usize)) : Result Outcome) = _
  rw [ProverRwEffectNonzero.nonzero_repeat byte stable initial]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  split <;> simp_all only [bind_tc_ok,if_true,if_false]


theorem after_zero (ops : ExternalFuns) (nonce : Array U8 32#usize) (retry : Usize) :
    @after _ (install ops) nonce retry back (.Ok (),ProverRwEntropyObstruction.zeroInput) =
      .ok (.cont (Usize.wrapping_add retry 1#usize)) := by
  exact constant_after ops nonce retry 0#u8 (by rfl) (by rfl)

theorem after_one (ops : ExternalFuns) (nonce : Array U8 32#usize) (retry : Usize) :
    @after _ (install ops) nonce retry back (.Ok (),ProverRwEntropyObstruction.oneOutput) =
      .ok (.done (.Ok ⟨nonce,Array.repeat 32#usize 1#u8,Array.repeat 32#usize 1#u8⟩)) := by
  exact constant_after ops nonce retry 1#u8 (by rfl) (by rfl)

theorem add_zero_one : Usize.wrapping_add 0#usize 1#usize = 1#usize := by
  apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
  rw [Usize.wrapping_add_val_eq]
  change 1 % UScalar.size .Usize = 1
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (1#usize).hSize

/-- Two iterations of the factored actual source body. The result and both
ordered fill calls are explicit; no retry/success premise is assumed. -/
theorem zero_then_one (ops : ExternalFuns) (nonce : Array U8 32#usize)
    (rest : List (Result Reply)) (reads : List (Slice U8 × Result Reply)) :
    letI : ExternalFuns := install ops
    let zero := ProverRwEntropyObstruction.zeroInput
    let one := ProverRwEntropyObstruction.oneOutput
    let r0 : Result Reply := .ok (.Ok (),zero)
    let r1 : Result Reply := .ok (.Ok (),one)
    run nonce 16#usize 2 0#usize ⟨r0::r1::rest,reads⟩ =
      ⟨.returned (.ok (.Ok ⟨nonce,Array.repeat 32#usize 1#u8,Array.repeat 32#usize 1#u8⟩)),
        ⟨rest,reads ++ [(zero,r0),(zero,r1)]⟩⟩ := by
  letI : ExternalFuns := install ops
  dsimp only
  simp only [run,step,request ops nonce 16#usize 0#usize (by decide),resumeResult,
    bind_tc_ok,after_zero,finish,advance,add_zero_one,
    request ops nonce 16#usize 1#usize (by decide),after_one,List.append_assoc]
  rfl

#print axioms constant_after
#print axioms after_zero
#print axioms after_one
#print axioms add_zero_one
#print axioms zero_then_one
end R1Z.ProverRwEffectRegression

noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverRwEffectPrefix
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow ProverRwFull
open ProverRwEffectSource ProverRwEffectTape
variable [ExternalTypes]

@[reducible] def install (ops : ExternalFuns) : ExternalFuns :=
  { ops with
    op125 := fun inst _ value => inst.as_mut value
    op126 := fun _ value => .ok (value,id)
    op127 := fun _ value => .ok value
    op128 := fun _ value => .ok value }

def back (bytes : Slice U8) : Array U8 64#usize :=
  if h : bytes.length = 64#usize then ⟨bytes.val, by simpa only [Slice.length,Array.length] using h⟩
  else Array.repeat 64#usize 0#u8

theorem fresh_zero (ops : ExternalFuns) :
    @before _ (install ops) = .ok (ProverRwEntropyObstruction.zeroInput,back) := by
  rfl

theorem request (ops : ExternalFuns) (nonce : Array U8 32#usize) (limit retry : Usize)
    (below : retry < limit) :
    @emit _ (install ops) nonce limit retry =
      .read ProverRwEntropyObstruction.zeroInput (@after _ (install ops) nonce retry back) := by
  simp only [emit,below,if_true,fresh_zero]

import R1Z.ProverRwEffectSource

/-! A suspended call at the exact emitted fill boundary. Interpretation at a
fixed dictionary is checked; native/world association remains open. Tape
exhaustion suspends the request rather than inventing a native RNG error. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverRwEffectTape
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow ProverRwFull
open ProverRwEffectSource
variable [ExternalTypes] [ExternalFuns]

inductive Call where
  | stop : Result Outcome → Call
  | read : Slice U8 → (Reply → Result Outcome) → Call

def emit (nonce : Array U8 32#usize) (limit retry : Usize) : Call :=
  if retry < limit then
    match before with
    | .ok (input,back) => .read input (after nonce retry back)
    | .fail e => .stop (.fail e)
    | .div => .stop .div
  else .stop (.ok (.done (.Err .RepeatedZeroBlock)))

def pure (call : Call) : Result Outcome :=
  match call with
  | .stop out => out
  | .read input resume => do
    let reply ← getrandom.fill input
    resume reply

theorem pure_eq (nonce : Array U8 32#usize) (limit retry : Usize) :
    pure (emit nonce limit retry) =
      aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.StateOnlyAttemptSecrets.generate_for_mask_nonce_loop.body
        nonce limit retry := by
  rw [← staged_eq]
  unfold emit staged
  split
  · cases h : (before : Result (Slice U8 × Back)) with
    | fail e => simp [h, pure]
    | div => simp [h, pure]
    | ok pair => rcases pair with ⟨input,back⟩; simp [h, pure]
  · rfl

structure World where
  tape : List (Result Reply)
  reads : List (Slice U8 × Result Reply)

/-- A stopped source outcome, an unserved request, or a remaining retry.
The fuel boundary is a proof interpreter boundary, never a native error. -/
inductive Boundary where
  | returned : Result Status → Boundary
  | request : Slice U8 → (Reply → Result Outcome) → Boundary
  | retry : Usize → Boundary

structure Execution where
  boundary : Boundary
  world : World

def advance (input : Slice U8) (reply : Result Reply) (rest : List (Result Reply))
    (world : World) : World := ⟨rest,world.reads ++ [(input,reply)]⟩

def resumeResult (resume : Reply → Result Outcome) (reply : Result Reply) : Result Outcome := do
  let value ← reply
  resume value

def finish (out : Result Outcome) : Boundary :=
  match out with
  | .fail e => .returned (.fail e)
  | .div => .returned .div
  | .ok (.done status) => .returned (.ok status)
  | .ok (.cont next) => .retry next

def step (nonce : Array U8 32#usize) (limit retry : Usize) (world : World) : Execution :=
  match emit nonce limit retry with
  | .stop out => ⟨finish out,world⟩
  | .read input resume =>
    match world.tape with
    | [] => ⟨.request input resume,world⟩
    | reply :: rest => ⟨finish (resumeResult resume reply),advance input reply rest world⟩

def run (nonce : Array U8 32#usize) (limit : Usize) : Nat → Usize → World → Execution
  | 0, retry, world => ⟨.retry retry,world⟩
  | fuel+1, retry, world =>
    let out := step nonce limit retry world
    match out.boundary with
    | .retry next => run nonce limit fuel next out.world
    | _ => out

/-- All requested replies remain in their original order, including the reply
whose continuation fails/diverges or returns an entropy error. -/
theorem step_tape (nonce : Array U8 32#usize) (limit retry : Usize) (world : World) :
    (step nonce limit retry world).world.reads.map Prod.snd ++
        (step nonce limit retry world).world.tape = world.reads.map Prod.snd ++ world.tape := by
  unfold step
  cases emit nonce limit retry with
  | stop out => rfl
  | read input resume =>
    cases h : world.tape with
    | nil => simp [h]
    | cons reply rest => simp [advance, List.map_append, List.append_assoc, h]

theorem run_tape (nonce : Array U8 32#usize) (limit : Usize) (fuel : Nat)
    (retry : Usize) (world : World) :
    (run nonce limit fuel retry world).world.reads.map Prod.snd ++
      (run nonce limit fuel retry world).world.tape = world.reads.map Prod.snd ++ world.tape := by
  induction fuel generalizing retry world with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ fuel ih =>
    simp only [run]
    split
    · exact (ih _ _).trans (step_tape nonce limit retry world)
    · exact step_tape nonce limit retry world

/-- Generic finite-tape/source-control refinement: no callback-result or
output-equivalence premise. This uses the factored actual emitted continuation;
it does not identify the world interpreter with native source execution. -/
theorem step_served (nonce : Array U8 32#usize) (limit retry : Usize)
    (input : Slice U8) (resume : Reply → Result Outcome)
    (h : emit nonce limit retry = .read input resume)
    (reply : Result Reply) (rest : List (Result Reply)) (reads : List (Slice U8 × Result Reply)) :
    step nonce limit retry ⟨reply::rest,reads⟩ =
      ⟨finish (resumeResult resume reply),⟨rest,reads ++ [(input,reply)]⟩⟩ := by
  simp only [step,h,advance]

/-- Boundary regression only: both actual fill input buffers are fresh zeros;
the world records zero then nonzero without equating their responses. This
alone makes no assertion that the native owner succeeds. -/
theorem zero_then_nonzero_reads (rest : List (Result Reply)) :
    let zero := ProverRwEntropyObstruction.zeroInput
    let one := ProverRwEntropyObstruction.oneOutput
    let r0 : Result Reply := .ok (.Ok (),zero)
    let r1 : Result Reply := .ok (.Ok (),one)
    let w : World := ⟨r0::r1::rest,[]⟩
    let w1 := advance zero r0 (r1::rest) w
    let w2 := advance zero r1 rest w1
    w2.reads = [(zero,r0),(zero,r1)] ∧ w2.tape = rest := by
  exact ⟨rfl,rfl⟩

#print axioms pure_eq
#print axioms step_tape
#print axioms run_tape
#print axioms step_served
#print axioms zero_then_nonzero_reads
end R1Z.ProverRwEffectTape

/-! Exact call-site factoring of the retained emitted entropy body.
This proves a pure specialization equation, not a native effect transport. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverRwEffectSource
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow ProverRwFull
variable [ExternalTypes] [ExternalFuns]
abbrev Secret := aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.StateOnlyAttemptSecrets
abbrev Status := core.result.Result Secret aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.StateOnlyAttemptEntropyError
abbrev Reply := (core.result.Result Unit getrandom.error.Error) × Slice U8
abbrev Back := Slice U8 → zeroize.Zeroizing (Array U8 64#usize)
abbrev Outcome := ControlFlow Usize Status

def before : Result (Slice U8 × Back) := do
  let a := Array.repeat 64#usize 0#u8
  let bytes ←
    zeroize.Zeroizing.new (Array.Insts.ZeroizeZeroize 64#usize
      (zeroize.Zeroize.Blanket U8.Insts.ZeroizeDefaultIsZeroes)) a
  let (s, as_mut_back) ←
    zeroize.Zeroizing.Insts.CoreConvertAsMut.as_mut
      (Array.Insts.CoreConvertAsMutSlice Std.U8 64#usize)
      (Array.Insts.ZeroizeZeroize 64#usize (zeroize.Zeroize.Blanket
      U8.Insts.ZeroizeDefaultIsZeroes)) bytes
  ok (s, as_mut_back)

def after (mask_nonce : Array U8 32#usize) (retry : Usize)
    (as_mut_back : Back) (reply : Reply) : Result Outcome := do
  let (r,s1) := reply
  let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r
  match cf with
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue _ =>
    let bytes1 := as_mut_back s1
    let a1 := Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8
    let field_mask_entropy ←
      zeroize.Zeroizing.new (Array.Insts.ZeroizeZeroize 32#usize
        (zeroize.Zeroize.Blanket U8.Insts.ZeroizeDefaultIsZeroes)) a1
    let a2 := Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8
    let leaf_salt_seed ←
      zeroize.Zeroizing.new (Array.Insts.ZeroizeZeroize 32#usize
        (zeroize.Zeroize.Blanket U8.Insts.ZeroizeDefaultIsZeroes)) a2
    let (a3, deref_mut_back) ←
      zeroize.Zeroizing.Insts.CoreOpsDerefDerefMut.deref_mut
        (Array.Insts.ZeroizeZeroize 32#usize (zeroize.Zeroize.Blanket
        U8.Insts.ZeroizeDefaultIsZeroes)) field_mask_entropy
    let (s2, to_slice_mut_back) ← Aeneas.Std.lift (Array.to_slice_mut a3)
    let a4 ←
      zeroize.Zeroizing.Insts.CoreOpsDerefDeref.deref
        (Array.Insts.ZeroizeZeroize 64#usize (zeroize.Zeroize.Blanket
        U8.Insts.ZeroizeDefaultIsZeroes)) bytes1
    let s3 ←
      core.array.Array.index (core.ops.index.IndexSlice
        (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice Std.U8)) a4
        { «end» := 32#usize }
    let s4 ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s2 s3
    let a5 := to_slice_mut_back s4
    let field_mask_entropy1 := deref_mut_back a5
    let (a6, deref_mut_back1) ←
      zeroize.Zeroizing.Insts.CoreOpsDerefDerefMut.deref_mut
        (Array.Insts.ZeroizeZeroize 32#usize (zeroize.Zeroize.Blanket
        U8.Insts.ZeroizeDefaultIsZeroes)) leaf_salt_seed
    let (s5, to_slice_mut_back1) ← Aeneas.Std.lift (Array.to_slice_mut a6)
    let s6 ←
      core.array.Array.index (core.ops.index.IndexSlice
        (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeFromUsizeSlice Std.U8)) a4
        { start := 32#usize }
    let s7 ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s5 s6
    let a7 := to_slice_mut_back1 s7
    let leaf_salt_seed1 := deref_mut_back1 a7
    let a8 ←
      zeroize.Zeroizing.Insts.CoreOpsDerefDeref.deref
        (Array.Insts.ZeroizeZeroize 32#usize (zeroize.Zeroize.Blanket
        U8.Insts.ZeroizeDefaultIsZeroes)) field_mask_entropy1
    let b ← aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.entropy_nonzero32 a8
    if b
    then
      let a9 ←
        zeroize.Zeroizing.Insts.CoreOpsDerefDeref.deref
          (Array.Insts.ZeroizeZeroize 32#usize (zeroize.Zeroize.Blanket
          U8.Insts.ZeroizeDefaultIsZeroes)) leaf_salt_seed1
      let b1 ← aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.entropy_nonzero32 a9
      if b1
      then
        ok (done (core.result.Result.Ok
          {
            mask_nonce,
            field_mask_entropy := field_mask_entropy1,
            leaf_salt_seed := leaf_salt_seed1
          }))
      else
        let retry1 ← Aeneas.Std.lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add retry 1#usize)
        ok (cont retry1)
    else
      let retry1 ← Aeneas.Std.lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add retry 1#usize)
      ok (cont retry1)
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
    let r1 ←
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
        aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.StateOnlyAttemptSecrets
        aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.StateOnlyAttemptEntropyError.Insts.CoreConvertFromError
        residual
    ok (done r1)

def staged (nonce : Array U8 32#usize) (limit retry : Usize) : Result Outcome := do
  if retry < limit then
    let (input,back) ← before
    let reply ← getrandom.fill input
    after nonce retry back reply
  else ok (done (.Err .RepeatedZeroBlock))

theorem staged_eq (nonce : Array U8 32#usize) (limit retry : Usize) :
    staged nonce limit retry =
      aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.StateOnlyAttemptSecrets.generate_for_mask_nonce_loop.body
        nonce limit retry := by
  unfold staged before after
    aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.StateOnlyAttemptSecrets.generate_for_mask_nonce_loop.body
  split <;> simp only [bind_assoc, Aeneas.Std.uncurry, bind_tc_ok]
  repeat' first
    | apply (Aeneas.Std.bind_eq_iff _ _ _).mpr
      intro value called
      try (change (_ × _) at value; rcases value with ⟨value1,value2⟩)
      simp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry, bind_tc_ok]
    | rfl

#print axioms staged_eq
end R1Z.ProverRwEffectSource

import R1Z.ProverRwEffectSource

/-! Symbolic constant-buffer law for the actual emitted OR scan. No concrete
32-iteration kernel replay is used. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverRwEffectNonzero
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow ProverRwFull
variable [ExternalTypes] [ExternalFuns]
abbrev scan := aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.entropy_nonzero32_loop

theorem index_repeat (byte : U8) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < 32) :
    Array.index_usize (Array.repeat 32#usize byte) i = .ok byte := by
  have hb : i.val < (Array.repeat 32#usize byte).length := by
    simpa [Array.length,Array.repeat] using hi
  obtain ⟨x,hx,hv⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (Array.index_usize_spec (Array.repeat 32#usize byte) i hb)
  simpa only [Array.repeat_val,List.getElem_replicate] using hx.trans (congrArg Result.ok hv)

theorem scan_fixed (byte combined : U8) (stable : combined ||| byte = combined)
    (index : Usize) (fuel : Nat) (bound : index.val+fuel=32) :
    scan (Array.repeat 32#usize byte) combined index = .ok combined := by
  unfold scan aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.entropy_nonzero32_loop
  induction fuel generalizing index with
  | zero =>
    have stop : ¬ index < 32#usize := by change ¬ index.val < 32; omega
    rw [loop]
    simp only [aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.entropy_nonzero32_loop.body,stop,if_false,bind_tc_ok]
  | succ fuel ih =>
    have go : index < 32#usize := by change index.val < 32; omega
    have idx : index.val < 32 := by omega
    have add : (Usize.wrapping_add index 1#usize).val = index.val+1 := by
      rw [Usize.wrapping_add_val_eq]
      change (index.val+1) % UScalar.size .Usize = index.val+1
      rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]
      have hs : 32 < UScalar.size .Usize := (32#usize).hSize
      omega
    rw [loop]
    simp only [aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.entropy_nonzero32_loop.body,go,if_true,
      index_repeat byte index idx,bind_tc_ok,stable,lift,bind_tc_ok]
    exact ih (Usize.wrapping_add index 1#usize) (by omega)

theorem nonzero_repeat (byte : U8) (stable : byte ||| byte = byte)
    (initial : (0#u8) ||| byte = byte) :
    aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.entropy_nonzero32 (Array.repeat 32#usize byte) =
      .ok (byte != 0#u8) := by
  unfold aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.entropy_nonzero32
  unfold aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.entropy_nonzero32_loop
  rw [loop]
  have go : (0#usize) < 32#usize := by decide
  simp only [aspis_prover.state_only_entropy.entropy_nonzero32_loop.body,go,if_true,
    index_repeat byte 0#usize (by decide),bind_tc_ok,initial,lift,bind_tc_ok]
  have add0 : Usize.wrapping_add 0#usize 1#usize = 1#usize := by
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    rw [Usize.wrapping_add_val_eq]
    change 1 % UScalar.size .Usize = 1
    exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (1#usize).hSize
  rw [add0]
  have tail := scan_fixed byte byte stable 1#usize 31 (by rfl)
  change (do let combined ← scan (Array.repeat 32#usize byte) byte 1#usize
             ok (combined != 0#u8)) = _
  rw [tail]
  rfl

#print axioms index_repeat
#print axioms scan_fixed
#print axioms nonzero_repeat

namespace R1Z.ProverRwEffectControl

theorem after_os_error (nonce : Array U8 32#usize) (retry : Usize)
    (back : Back) (err : getrandom.error.Error) (bytes : Slice U8) :
    after nonce retry back (.Err err,bytes) = .ok (.done (.Err (.Os err))) := by
  rfl

theorem at_limit (nonce : Array U8 32#usize) (limit retry : Usize)
    (h : ¬ retry < limit) (world : World) :
    step nonce limit retry world =
      ⟨.returned (.ok (.Err .RepeatedZeroBlock)),world⟩ := by
  simp only [step,emit,h,if_false,finish]

/-- A served read is retained even when the external itself fails. -/
theorem failed_read (nonce : Array U8 32#usize) (limit retry : Usize)
    (input : Slice U8) (resume : Reply → Result Outcome)
    (h : emit nonce limit retry = .read input resume) (err : Aeneas.Std.Error)
    (rest : List (Result Reply)) (reads : List (Slice U8 × Result Reply)) :
    step nonce limit retry ⟨.fail err::rest,reads⟩ =
      ⟨.returned (.fail err),⟨rest,reads ++ [(input,.fail err)]⟩⟩ := by
  rw [step_served nonce limit retry input resume h]
  rfl

theorem diverged_read (nonce : Array U8 32#usize) (limit retry : Usize)
    (input : Slice U8) (resume : Reply → Result Outcome)
    (h : emit nonce limit retry = .read input resume)
    (rest : List (Result Reply)) (reads : List (Slice U8 × Result Reply)) :
    step nonce limit retry ⟨.div::rest,reads⟩ =
      ⟨.returned .div,⟨rest,reads ++ [(input,.div)]⟩⟩ := by
  rw [step_served nonce limit retry input resume h]
  rfl

/-- Under the exact prefix-call fact, an OS error stops the actual emitted
continuation and records the draw. No predicate about successful output is used. -/
theorem os_error_read (nonce : Array U8 32#usize) (limit retry : Usize)
    (below : retry < limit) (input : Slice U8) (back : Back)
    (hprefix : before = .ok (input,back)) (err : getrandom.error.Error)
    (bytes : Slice U8) (rest : List (Result Reply))
    (reads : List (Slice U8 × Result Reply)) :
    step nonce limit retry ⟨.ok (.Err err,bytes)::rest,reads⟩ =
      ⟨.returned (.ok (.Err (.Os err))),
        ⟨rest,reads ++ [(input,.ok (.Err err,bytes))]⟩⟩ := by
  have call : emit nonce limit retry = .read input (after nonce retry back) := by
    simp only [emit,below,if_true,hprefix]
  rw [step_served nonce limit retry input (after nonce retry back) call]
  simp only [resumeResult,bind_tc_ok,after_os_error,finish]

abbrev State (N C : Type) := PV_RunJoin_UnifiedRetry.State N Store C

/-- Pure extracted-body inputs. The external dictionary remains explicit;
this record is NOT a native dictionary or a filesystem/oracle effect handler. -/
structure Inputs (N C : Type) where
  ops : State N C → ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns
  pub : State N C → Pub
  compiled : State N C → Compiled
  hash : State N C → Hash

def sourceBody (d : Inputs N C) : PV_RunJoin_UnifiedRetry.SourceBody (State N C) :=
  ⟨d.ops,d.pub,d.compiled,d.hash,fun s => s.ledger⟩

def native (d : Inputs N C) (s : State N C) (secret : Secret) :=
  letI : ProverRwFull.ExternalFuns := d.ops s
  ProverRwFull.prover.prove_masked_attempt (d.pub s) (d.compiled s) .S2 (d.hash s) secret s.ledger

def body (d : Inputs N C) : PV_RunJoin_UnifiedRetry.Body (State N C) := fun secret s =>
  mapR (fun out => (out.1,{s with ledger := out.2})) (native d s secret)

/-- The body/source equation is discharged for the pure lift, at the actual
full emitted body. No native-world effect equality follows from this lift. -/
theorem source_law (d : Inputs N C) :
    PV_RunJoin_UnifiedRetry.BodySourceLaw (sourceBody d) (body d) := by
  intro s secret
  change mapR (fun out => (out.1,out.2.ledger))
    (mapR (fun out => (out.1,{s with ledger := out.2})) (native d s secret)) = native d s secret
  cases native d s secret with
  | fail e => rfl
  | div => rfl
  | ok out => cases out; rfl

    (status : core.result.Result Proof ProverRwFull.verifier.Error)
    (run : body d secret s = .ok (status,next)) : next.provider = s.provider := by
  unfold body at run
  cases computation : native d s secret with
  | fail e => simp only [computation,mapR,bind_tc_fail] at run; cases run
  | div => simp only [computation,mapR,bind_tc_div] at run; cases run
  | ok out =>
    simp only [computation,mapR,bind_tc_ok] at run
    have same := Result.ok.inj run
    exact congrArg (fun pair => pair.2.provider) same.symm

theorem client_frame (d : Inputs N C) (secret : Secret) (s next : State N C)
    (status : core.result.Result Proof ProverRwFull.verifier.Error)
    (run : body d secret s = .ok (status,next)) : next.client = s.client := by
  unfold body at run
  cases computation : native d s secret with
  | fail e => simp only [computation,mapR,bind_tc_fail] at run; cases run
  | div => simp only [computation,mapR,bind_tc_div] at run; cases run
  | ok out =>
    simp only [computation,mapR,bind_tc_ok] at run
    have same := Result.ok.inj run
    exact congrArg (fun pair => pair.2.client) same.symm

    ((field_index a sa).trans (hi.trans (field_index b sb).symm))
  have frontier : a.snapshot.frontier = b.snapshot.frontier := PV_RunJoin_CanonicalWordEq31.frontier (K := K)
    _ _ fa fb (fun j => (field_frontier a sa j).trans ((congrFun hf j).trans (field_frontier b sb j).symm))
  obtain ⟨ra,la,hra,hleafA,hA⟩ := PV_RunJoin_CompilerAppend31.afterstate a.witness
    (outputValue a.request) (recipient a.request) a.change (forestPublic a.request) a.laneAnchor a.snapshot a.compiled sa
  obtain ⟨rb,lb,hrb,hleafB,hB⟩ := PV_RunJoin_CompilerAppend31.afterstate b.witness
    (outputValue b.request) (recipient b.request) b.change (forestPublic b.request) b.laneAnchor b.snapshot b.compiled sb
  have roots := PV_RunJoin_SnapshotUnique31.root a.snapshot b.snapshot ra rb la lb _ _ hA hB index frontier
  have seqA := PV_RunJoin_SnapshotUnique31.sequence ra a.snapshot la _ hA
  have seqB := PV_RunJoin_SnapshotUnique31.sequence rb b.snapshot lb _ hB
  exact ⟨index,frontier,roots,seqA.trans (index.trans seqB.symm)⟩

theorem snapshot_ext (a b : pair_tree_profile.PoolV1PairLiveSnapshotV1)
    (hp : a.pool=b.pool) (hd : a.deployment_domain=b.deployment_domain)
    (hs : a.sequence=b.sequence) (hi : a.next_pair_index=b.next_pair_index)
    (hr : a.current_root=b.current_root) (hf : a.frontier=b.frontier) : a=b := by
  rcases a with ⟨pa,da,sa,ia,ra,fa⟩
  rcases b with ⟨pb,db,sb,ib,rb,fb⟩
  dsimp only at hp hd hs hi hr hf
  cases hp
  cases hd
  cases hs
  cases hi
  cases hr
  cases hf
  rfl
#print axioms snapshot_ext

/-- Context-byte agreement stays explicit P work; root/sequence are derived. -/
theorem whole (a b : Input) (sa : run a = ok (.Ok a.compiled)) (sb : run b = ok (.Ok b.compiled))
    (fa : ∀ j : Fin 20, Canon8 a.snapshot.frontier.val[j.val]!)
    (fb : ∀ j : Fin 20, Canon8 b.snapshot.frontier.val[j.val]!)
    (same : statement (K := K) a = statement (K := K) b)
    (pool : a.snapshot.pool=b.snapshot.pool)
    (domain : a.snapshot.deployment_domain=b.snapshot.deployment_domain) : a.snapshot=b.snapshot := by
  have fields := agree a b sa sb fa fb same
  exact snapshot_ext _ _ pool domain fields.2.2.2 fields.1 fields.2.2.1 fields.2.1
#print axioms whole

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std R0Z.WriterRefine R1J.SpendWitnessMap

theorem word (a b : U32) (ha : a.val < 2147483647) (hb : b.val < 2147483647)
    (h : liftU (K := K) a = liftU b) : a=b := by
  have hf : liftU (K := F) a = liftU b := by
    apply (ι : F →+* K).injective
    simpa only [liftU,map_natCast] using h
  have hn := congrArg (fun x : F => x.val) hf
  change (a.val : ZMod 2147483647).val = (b.val : ZMod 2147483647).val at hn
  rw [ZMod.val_natCast,ZMod.val_natCast,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt ha,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hb] at hn
  exact UScalar.eq_of_val_eq hn

theorem digest (a b : Array U32 8#usize) (ha : Canon8 a) (hb : Canon8 b)
    (h : digK (K := K) a = digK b) : a=b := by
  apply BuilderRecordCanonical.array_ext
  intro j hj
  have hj8 : j<8 := by simpa only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] using hj
  apply word (K := K) _ _ (ha j hj8) (hb j hj8)
  exact congrFun h ⟨j,hj8⟩

    (ha : ∀ j : Fin 20, Canon8 a.val[j.val]!)
    (hb : ∀ j : Fin 20, Canon8 b.val[j.val]!)
    (h : ∀ j : Fin 20, digK (K := K) a.val[j.val]! = digK b.val[j.val]!) : a=b := by
  apply BuilderRecordCanonical.array_ext
  intro j hj
  have hj20 : j<20 := by simpa only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] using hj
  exact digest (K := K) _ _ (ha ⟨j,hj20⟩) (hb ⟨j,hj20⟩) (h ⟨j,hj20⟩)

    (ha : pair_forest_trace.late_append left a leafA = ok (.Ok outA))

  obtain ⟨rootsB,heB,hrB⟩ := PV_RunJoin_LateSnapshot31.checked right b leafB outB hb

      PV_RunJoin_SnapshotRoot31.read ⟨b.next_pair_index,b.current_root,b.frontier⟩ rootsA := by
    rw [← index,← frontier]
    exact PV_RunJoin_SnapshotRoot31.frame _ _ _ _ _
  exact core.result.Result.Ok.inj (Result.ok.inj (hrA.symm.trans (frame.trans hrB)))

theorem calls [ExternalLinear] (records : pair_forest_copy_builder.CopyRecords)
    (snapshot : pair_tree_profile.PoolV1PairLiveSnapshotV1) (leaf : Digest)
    (afterstate : pair_terminal.PoolV1PairVerifiedAfterstateV1)
    (h : pair_forest_trace.late_append records snapshot leaf = ok (.Ok afterstate)) :
    ∃ (roots : Roots) (tree next : incremental_merkle.IncrementalMerkleTreeV1)
      (receipt : incremental_merkle.AppendOneV1),
      pair_trace.pair_empty_roots = ok roots ∧
      incremental_merkle.IncrementalMerkleTreeV1.from_parts_with_empty_roots
        snapshot.next_pair_index snapshot.current_root snapshot.frontier roots = ok (.Ok tree) ∧
      incremental_merkle.IncrementalMerkleTreeV1.append_one_with_empty_roots tree leaf roots = ok (.Ok (next,receipt)) := by
  unfold pair_forest_trace.late_append at h
  split at h
  · cases h
  · repeat' first
      | (have he := PV_RunJoin_DecoderReturn29.branch_continue _ _ hvalue; clear hvalue; cases he)
      | (have he := PV_RunJoin_ResultMap31.success _ _ _ _ hvalue; clear hvalue; cases he)
      | (have _result : core.result.Result _ _ := value; cases value <;> pv_head h)
      | (pv_peel h with value hvalue)
      | exact False.elim (PV_Src_ResultControl.error_ne_ok _ _ h)
      | exact False.elim (PV_Src_ResultControl.same_residual_ne_ok _ _ h)
      | (have _test : Bool := value; cases value <;> simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte] at h)
      | (have _test : core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow _ _ := value; cases value)
      | (cases h)
    all_goals exact ⟨_,_,_,_,by assumption,by assumption,by assumption⟩

    (snapshot : pair_tree_profile.PoolV1PairLiveSnapshotV1) (leaf : Digest)

        ⟨snapshot.next_pair_index,snapshot.current_root,snapshot.frontier⟩ roots = ok (.Ok snapshot.current_root) := by
  obtain ⟨roots,tree,next,receipt,he,hc,ha⟩ := calls records snapshot leaf afterstate h
  have frame := PV_RunJoin_LateAppendFrame31.construct _ _ _ _ tree hc

    (valid : incremental_merkle.tree_reference.validate_owned tree.inner tree.empty = ok (.Ok ()))

theorem nonfull [ExternalLinear] (tree next : incremental_merkle.IncrementalMerkleTreeV1)
    (leaf : Digest) (roots : Roots) (receipt : incremental_merkle.AppendOneV1)
    (h : incremental_merkle.IncrementalMerkleTreeV1.append_one_with_empty_roots tree leaf roots = ok (.Ok (next,receipt))) :
    ∃ capacity, incremental_merkle.POOL_V1_LEAF_CAPACITY = ok capacity ∧ tree.next_leaf_index < capacity := by
  unfold incremental_merkle.IncrementalMerkleTreeV1.append_one_with_empty_roots at h
  pv_peel h with made hmade
  cases made with
  | Err error =>
    change (ok (.Err error) : Result (core.result.Result _ _)) = ok (.Ok (next,receipt)) at h
    cases h
  | Ok constructed =>
    have frame := construct tree.next_leaf_index tree.root tree.frontier roots constructed hmade
    have validated := PV_RunJoin_RootConstructor31.owned _ _ _ _ constructed hmade
    have valid : incremental_merkle.tree_reference.validate_owned constructed.inner constructed.empty = ok (.Ok ()) := by
      rw [frame.1,frame.2]
      exact validated
    simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok] at h
    pv_peel h with appended happend
    cases appended with
    | Err error =>
      change (ok (.Err error) : Result (core.result.Result _ _)) = ok (.Ok (next,receipt)) at h
      cases h
    | Ok pair =>
      obtain ⟨capacity,hcapacity,small⟩ := owned constructed pair.1 leaf pair.2 valid happend
      exact ⟨capacity,hcapacity,by simpa only [frame.1] using small⟩

def read [ExternalLinear] (tree : incremental_merkle.IncrementalMerkleTreeV1) (roots : Roots) :
    Result (core.result.Result Digest incremental_merkle.PoolV1TreeError) :=
  if tree.next_leaf_index = 0#u64 then do
    let root ← Array.index_usize roots format.POOL_V1_TREE_DEPTH
    ok (.Ok root)
  else tree.reconstruct_nonfull_root roots

/-- Reconstruction reads index/frontier/empty roots; it does not read the
candidate root. This unfolds only the symbolic call spine, not a hash or loop. -/
theorem frame [ExternalLinear] (index : U64) (frontier : Frontier) (roots : Roots)
    (a b : Digest) : read ⟨index,a,frontier⟩ roots = read ⟨index,b,frontier⟩ roots := rfl

theorem checked [ExternalLinear] (tree : incremental_merkle.IncrementalMerkleTreeV1)
    (roots : Roots) (capacity : U64)
    (hcapacity : incremental_merkle.POOL_V1_LEAF_CAPACITY = ok capacity)
    (small : tree.next_leaf_index < capacity)
    (h : incremental_merkle.tree_reference.validate_owned tree roots = ok (.Ok ())) :
    read tree roots = ok (.Ok tree.root) := by
  rw [incremental_merkle.tree_reference.validate_owned,hcapacity] at h
  simp only [bind_tc_ok] at h
  rw [if_neg (by scalar_tac)] at h
  pv_peel h with scanned hscan
  pv_peel h with flow hflow
  cases flow with
  | Break residual => exact False.elim (PV_Src_ResultControl.same_residual_ne_ok _ _ h)
  | Continue value =>
    by_cases zero : tree.next_leaf_index = 0#u64
    · rw [if_pos zero] at h
      rw [read,if_pos zero]
      pv_peel h with root hr
      pv_peel h with equal he
      cases equal <;> simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte] at h

      rw [read,if_neg zero]
      pv_peel h with result hr
      pv_peel h with flow hflow

      | Break residual => exact False.elim (PV_Src_ResultControl.same_residual_ne_ok _ _ h)

        have returned := PV_RunJoin_DecoderReturn29.branch_continue result root hflow

        pv_peel h with different hd
        cases different <;> simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte] at h
        · have same := PV_RunJoin_ForestEquality30.equal root tree.root hd
          rw [same] at hr

        · cases h
